attractions.name: 南长街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: On the street, you can still see the preserved old threshold, the grooves of the old storefronts' door panels, and the creaking floor slabs when you walk up. However, these old-fashioned buildings are full of all kinds of fashionable creative elements. As the core part of Qingmingqiao Historical and Cultural Block in Wuxi, characteristic shops are gathered here, which is integrated with the old-fashioned buildings in Wuxi. It is quite flavorful. No matter whether you go there during the day or at night, you will have a different feeling.
attractions.shortFeatures: The charm of classical architecture still exists

attractions.name: 南禅寺
attractions.summary:
English:  
- Formerly known as "Liangxi Feng Da Sha," with a long history and many eminent monks. The current temple was rebuilt in the 1980s and 1990s.  
- During the Tian Sheng period of the Northern Song Dynasty, Emperor Renzong of Song named it "Fusheng Chan Yuan." Eight years later, Emperor Renzong also named the northern counterpart to the Southern Chan Temple, "Shousheng Chan Yuan."  
- The temple includes the Heavenly King Hall, Miaoguang Pagoda, Five Precepts Hall, and a Liberation Pond, all of which visitors can explore.  
- After visiting the temple to pay respects, you can stroll around the nearby streets and enjoy local delicacies. The night scenery here is also worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: A blessed place of worship with strong incense offerings.

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 无锡锡惠公园-寄畅园
attractions.summary: Jichang Garden is a classical garden located at the eastern foot of Huishan Mountain and within Xihui Park in Wuxi. Jichang Garden incorporates the water from Huishan Spring into its water scenery, cleverly utilizing the technique of borrowing scenery. Within the garden, one can see the reflection of the Dragon Light Tower on Xishan in the pond, which is quite unique in its arrangement. Jichang Garden was once a private garden for returning officials in the Ming Dynasty, and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Nanjing Zhan Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. The park is centered around a rockery pond, surrounded by buildings such as Yupan Pavilion Corridor, Zhiyu Barrier, Seven Star Bridge, Hanbi Pavilion, and Qingyu Corridor. It also introduces water from the "Erquan" (Huishan Spring) into the ravine, known as the "Bayin Stream" due to its murmuring sound. There are also buildings in the park, such as the "Bingtang Hall" within the park and the former study of the park owner, the "Hanzhen Study". Jichang Garden was deeply loved by the two emperors of the Qing Dynasty, Kangxi and Qianlong. They visited this garden several times during their southern tours, and now they can still see the imperial stone plaques of Kangxi's "Mountain Scenery and Stream Light" and Qianlong's "Jade and Golden Fir". Even the Xiqu Garden in Beijing's Summer Palace and the Grand Duke of Kuoran (destroyed in the war) in the Summer Palace were built in imitation of Jichang Garden. In addition, the towering trees in the park are also a great place to relax in summer, and in autumn, you can see colorful red maple and ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 天下第二泉
attractions.summary: The Second Spring in the World is located in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. A melodious music of "Two Springs Reflecting the Moon" will take you to the famous second spring in the world, make a cup of Two Springs tea, and drink it in your mouth. It is sweet and mellow. When you pour tea carefully, you can also find that the tea is several millimeters above the mouth of the cup without overflowing. This is because it contains a lot of minerals. Experts believe that the second spring water has the effect of relieving annoyance, quenching thirst and prolonging life. There are many clear springs in Huishan, and there is a saying of "Thirteen Springs of Nine Dragons" in history. Huishan Spring, located near Huishan Temple, was originally known as Yilan Spring. According to legend, it was excavated by Jingcheng, the magistrate of Wuxi County, in the wei year of Dali in the Tang Dynasty (AD 779). There are two pools in total, the upper pool is round, the water is clear and blue, and all drinks are drawn here; Lu Yu in the Tang Dynasty arranged 20 famous springs in his "Tea Classic", and Huishan Spring in Wuxi ranked second. Liu Bochu, another water critic, thought: "The spring water suitable for making tea has seven eyes, and Huishan Spring is the second." Since then, the name of "the second spring in the world" has been recognized by literati and celebrities in the past dynasties. Boil tea with two springs to entertain guests. Wang Ji, a famous painter, painted for a bamboo stove in the eighth year of Hongwugan (AD 1395), and wrote a poem: "I don't sleep at night in a cold fasting, and I sit by the fireside with tea; The fire simmers mountain chestnuts, knocks on ice to draw streams and springs, tiles turn white clouds, and bamboos emit green smoke; A sip of a phoenix gives birth to the armpit, and the Russian police bones are immortal! "It shows his falling feelings. The famous painter Wen Zhengming had a tea party with his friends in Huishan on February 19th, the 13th year of Zhengde in the Ming Dynasty (AD 1518). The party caused by the party to make a" Huishan Tea Party Picture ", which was colored on paper, reproducing the scene of poets and painters cooking tea in bamboo stoves and thinking in Maoting. This precious picture scroll is treasured in the Palace Museum. Pi Rixiu, a poet in the late Tang Dynasty, compared Li Deyu's addiction to drinking second spring water with Yang Guifei's love for lychees, and wrote a satirical poem: When the prime minister often thinks about cooking tea, it is only too late for the county marquis to urge him; Wu Guan went to the country for three thousand miles, and Mo Xiao Yang Fei loves lychees. In the later Song Dynasty, Hui Song Dynasty included the second spring water as a tribute, and it entered a hundred altars every month. Su Dongpo, a famous poet, sang the famous sentence "Take a small moon in the sky alone and try the second spring in the world". Both Kangxi and Qianlong went to Huishan to taste springs to inscribe chants. A Bing, a blind folk musician in modern times, once wandered around Huishan, and composed a song "Two Springs Reflect the Moon", which was widely circulated at home and abroad. For 3,000 years, the stone threshold has been trampled by water drawers for more than ten centimeters. The center is the spring pavilion, with the upper pool and the middle pool in the pavilion; Above the spring pavilion is the "Jinghui Hall": under the spring pavilion is the "Yilan Hall", and in front of the hall is the lower pool. The upper pool, middle pool and lower pool form a complete water system of "the second spring in the world". The three pools have different shapes, all built with exquisite bluestone railings. The middle pool is square, close to the upper pool, only three feet apart, and the stone bottom is "a trickle of running water. Clear and lovely, but the water quality is poor. " Above the upper pool and the lower pool, there is a "Two Springs Pavilion".
attractions.shortFeatures: The Origin of the Creation of Two Springs Reflecting the Moon

attractions.name: 惠山寺
attractions.summary: Huishan Temple was founded in the Southern and Northern Dynasties, and it has been more than 1,500 years ago. Huishan Temple has preserved precious cultural relics such as the stone bed of listening to pine in Tang Dynasty, the scriptures of Tang and Song Dynasties, the Xianghua Bridge, the Jinlian Bridge in Song Dynasty, the ancient ginkgo in Ming Dynasty, the imperial monument in Qing Dynasty, as well as the Daxiong Hall and Huishan Temple bell restored in recent years, which show the unique charm of Buddhist culture. Huishan Temple ranks first among the top ten jungles in Wuxi because of its long history and profound culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit historic sites, worship Buddha and pray for blessings

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 长春桥
attractions.summary: Changchun Bridge was built in 1936. It is located in a pool of Hanwanxuan and Jiangxuexuan. The front and rear lake embankments of the bridge are separated from Taihu Lake. The bridge is arched, like the Jade Belt Bridge in the Summer Palace, and the bridge opening reflects the sun into a muddy round shape. Japanese cherry blossoms have been introduced on the lake embankment for more than 60 years. Every April, flowers bloom like clouds, light red, pink and white. Under the shade of green mountains and green waters, they are particularly enchanting, and they are called "Changchun Cherry Blossom". In front of Changchun Bridge, there is an ancient building half exposed to the water, with the title "Jiangxuexuan", opposite Hanwanxuan. Next to Jiangxuexuan is Yundou Building, which was built by the owner in memory of the ancestor Yang Duwang, with Cai Yuanpei's inscription on it. Uphill, there is the Flower Temple, which was built in 1931. It offers the statue of "Flower Goddess Yi" in the middle, with a high bun and clouds, and a beautiful posture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built in 1936

attractions.name: 太湖佳绝处
attractions.name_en: Best Scenic Spot of Taihu Lake

attractions.name: 横云山庄
attractions.summary: Entering the gate tower of "the Taihu Lake Lake is a wonderful place" is Yuantouzhu Classical Garden Scenic Spot. Here, the frequency lake leans against the mountain, pavilions, corridors and pavilions, small bridges and flowing water, a style of classical gardens in the south of the Yangtze River, Changchun Bridge, Jiangxue Pavilion, memorial archway, Xu Xiake's bronze statue, Chanfen Hall, Pure perfume Pavilion and other scenic spots are distributed among them.

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-鼋渚春涛
attractions.name_en: Taihu Turtle Head Islet Scenic Area - Spring Waves of Turtle Islet
attractions.summary: Mountain pavilions are looming, and lakeside lighthouses are towering; Looking at the ups and downs of the island in the distance, I can hear the waves close to the shore. Many scenic spots are listed on the lakeshore, highlighting the accumulation of history everywhere. This is the essence scenic spot of Yuantouzhu. The main scenic spots are lighthouse, "Yuantouzhu" stone tablet, "Hengyun" cliff stone carvings, "Zhenze Shenyan" bronze statue, Chenglan Hall, Feiyun Pavilion, etc.

attractions.name: 太湖仙岛
attractions.summary:
It is a group of small islands in the lake in Yuantouzhu scenic spot, which is divided into scenic spots such as Dongtianfudi and Tiandu Xianfu, and has the reputation of "Three Mountains Yingbi". 
There are statues of Taoist fairy palace and grottoes of Taoism and Buddhism on the island. Among them, the 18-meter-high statue of the Jade Emperor in the Taoist temple is rare in China and very eye-catching. 
· There are Huaguo Mountain, Mountain Curtain Cave and Performing Arts Field for monkeys to inhabit and perform monkey art, reproducing the scenes in the famous classical novel The Journey to the West. 
Dajue Bay, Xianren Cave and other scenic spots gather the art of Chinese Buddhist and Taoist grottoes, and the scenic spots such as Tiantai, Yuelao Temple and Yuanyang Pavilion are also magnificent.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to enjoy the vast lake view

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 善卷洞
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- Shanjue Cave is located in the southwest of Yixing City. It is a famous limestone karst cave and one of the earliest caves in China to be opened for tourism.  
- It is the top of the "Three Wonders" of Yixing. The cave consists of four sections: Upper, Middle, Lower, and Rear, all of which are interconnected with unique formations. The most extraordinary are the Lower Cave and the Water Cave.  
- Here, you can see delicate and translucent stalactites, as well as magnificent natural boulders. In addition, an underground river flows through the cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat to explore the unique underground caves.

attractions.name: 宜兴竹海
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; treasure spot for kids.; Forests
attractions.summary:
- The Yixing Bamboo Sea Scenic Area is located in Hufu Town, Yixing, covering nearly 15,000 hectares of bamboo forest that rises and falls with the terrain. The bamboo sways with the mountains, resembling rolling waves that stretch endlessly.
- The scenic area is known for its clear mountains and waters, where the four seasons can be experienced in a single day, offering natural wonders and delights. Major attractions include "The First Source of Taihu Lake," "The First Peak of Southern Jiangsu," "Bamboo Brings Peace," and "The Mirror Lake Scenic View."
- This place is a natural oxygen bar and an excellent location for film and TV shooting. It has been used in the production of notable works such as *Romance of the Three Kingdoms*, *The Flying Hero White Dragon*, and *The Founding of the Song Dynasty*.
- Visitors can now take a cable car to the mountain top, where they can enjoy a panoramic aerial view of the bamboo sea. If the wind is strong, one can experience the magnificent and tumultuous waves of the bamboo forest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the Bamboo Sea and enjoy a cool summer.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:00-16:30(Admission ends at 16:00),Opens at Daylight saving time 08:00-17:00(Admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 西安世博园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; garden park; Gardens; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The venue of the World Horticultural Exposition is rich in green plant attractions, showcasing various plants and gardens designed by landscape masters from around the world.
- Major landmarks include the Chang'an Tower, Creative Pavilion, Nature Pavilion, and themed gardens (Chang'an Flower Valley, Colorful Zhongnan, Silk Road Flower Rain, Overseas Grand View, and Bashang Rainbow).
- The architecture here is innovative and unique, offering a chance to appreciate garden art from around the world, view rare plants and ecological landscapes from different regions of the Earth, and it is also a popular location for wedding photo shoots.
- The small train and electric vehicle pass through most of the classic landscapes of Xi'an Expo Park, with drivers and guides. Tickets can be purchased at four stations: Debao Gate, Bashang People's House, Guangyun Gate, and Chang'an Tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the garden art from around the world

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵文物陈列厅
attractions.name_en: Heritage Exhibition Hall of Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
attractions.summary: In the Museum of Terra Cotta Warriors, there is an exhibition hall for the relics of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor. Among a large number of unearthed cultural relics on display in the exhibition hall, the heavyweight national treasures should be two large painted bronze chariots and horses with lifelike shape and exquisite workmanship, known as the "crown of bronze" in the world.

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 九龙湖
attractions.summary: Jiulong Lake is located in the scenic spot of Huaqing Palace, which is a palace visited by feudal emperors in Tang Dynasty. Backed by the mountain and facing the Wei River, it is built against the peak of Lishan Mountain. It is large in scale and magnificent in architecture, with towers and halls all over Lishan Mountain.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after the nine dragons on the lake embankment

attractions.name: 《复活的军团》演出
attractions.summary: The Resurrected Legion is a live immersive multimedia war epic drama in China, directed by the Chinese director Mr. Jin Tiemu, and performed in Lintong, the hometown of the Terra Cotta Warriors. The drama consists of four acts and ten scenes. Through dramas such as court discussions, conscription, mobilization, family letters, siege, sacrifice, etc., incorporating family letters to pay off ten thousand gold, children traveling thousands of miles, mother's worries, newlywed farewell, and other emotions, visitors can be deeply moved by their patriotism. War can only end the war and open up the spirit of a strong country with iron blood and peace for all. Through figuring, resurrection, epilogue and other plays, guests from all directions who come to visit the Terra Cotta Warriors can clearly understand that the eight wonders of the world, the Terra Cotta Warriors, are the soul of the Qin Dynasty, the blood of the Qin Dynasty, the unity of the Qin Dynasty, and the Qin Dynasty. The Qin figurines standing in the Qin Mausoleum Museum today are monuments to countless unknown heroes. These ordinary Qin people created the unified Qin state, and our writing comes from the Qin people. Our territory is the continuation of the Qin Empire, and our unified Chinese nation began to form during the Qin Empire period. They are connected to our bloodline

attractions.name: 《长恨歌》演出
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
China's first large-scale live-action historical dance drama, with eleven scenes in four levels, such as "loving each other" and "being spoiled and charming". 
· A strong cast of 300 professional actors artistically reproduces this touching love story in the original place of the story. 
Since the official performance in 2007, more than 2,500 performances have been performed and 3.5 million audiences have been received, reaching the grand occasion of "one ticket is hard to find".
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei and Tang Minghuang's eternal love

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场音乐喷泉
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square Music Fountain
attractions.summary: The Music Fountain of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, also known as the Xi'an Music Fountain, is located on the central axis of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda. The Music Fountain Square consists of water feature fountains, cultural squares, garden landscapes, cultural corridors, and tourism and commercial facilities. It is an important Tang culture square in China. There are a large number of sculptures and statues on the square. While enjoying the music fountain, it is also a good choice to savor these sculptures carefully. The music fountain is divided into three areas: a hundred meter waterfall pool, an eight level waterfall pool, and a front-end music pool. The eight level variable frequency array in the eight level cascade pool is the largest array in the world, with 1024 nozzle points, which can transform into various water types such as mountains and seas, lotus flowers, vast clouds, seagulls spreading their wings, butterflies falling in love with flowers, water mist, etc., shining brightly and beautifully. In the large laser water curtain, which is 60 meters wide and over 20 meters high, four fountains spray out from the water, fully burning and exploding at a low temperature at a height of 6 meters, further enhancing the awe inspiring power of the entire fountain.

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 紫云楼
attractions.summary: Ziyun Tower is located in the center of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden, and is the main building of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. It is also a large-scale imitation of Tang royal architecture in China. The Ziyun Tower in history is said to have been built in the 14th year of the Kaiyuan reign of the Tang Dynasty. It is a jade tower with a golden hall and towering mountains. During the Qujiang Festival, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang would climb to this tower to enjoy singing and dancing, give banquets to officials, and appreciate the grand scene of people visiting Qujiang. The current Ziyun Tower was rebuilt based on historical records and is divided into a four story main building and a north-south square. The plaque north of Ziyun Tower was written by calligrapher Huang Miaozi. The main building is 39 meters high and adopts the architectural form of a double eaved pavilion roof. The eaves on each level are designed with pheasant tails and feature three layers of gold jewelry, making them even more magnificent. On the second and third floors, there are spacious flat seats, pavilions and arches, and pavilions with flying bridges, creating a magnificent atmosphere. The first floor of Ziyun Tower reflects the prosperity of the Zhenguan reign during the 23 year reign of Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin; The second floor is the prosperous Kaiyuan era of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji; The third floor is the performance area; The fourth floor is the treasure of the Tang Furong Garden - the Tang Museum. The third floor of Ziyun Tower regularly performs the world intangible cultural heritage - Dongcang Drum Music - every day. Dongchang drum music is an extension of the royal court music of the Sui and Tang dynasties, known as the "living fossil of music". The Tang Dynasty Museum on the fourth floor exhibits exquisite cultural relics from the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties unearthed in Shaanxi Province. Every night in front of Ziyun Tower, you can also enjoy the great Asian water screen movie - Qitian Dasheng. The performance combines music fountains, lasers, and flames, making it a "wedding of water and fire" that will create a brand new audio-visual experience for you. In addition, you can also enjoy lion dance performances in the south square of Ziyun Tower, laser performances, music fountains, and more in the north square.

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.

attractions.name: 永宁门
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Yongning Gate is the south gate of Xi'an City Wall. It was built in the early Sui Dynasty. At that time, it was the east of the three gates in the south of the imperial city. It was originally called Anmen Gate. It was reserved as the south gate when Han Jian shrank to build a new city in the late Tang Dynasty, and changed to Yongning Gate in the Ming Dynasty. Now Yongning Gate is round-the-island traffic, with South Gate Square outside the gate, South Street inside the gate and Nanguanzheng Street outside the gate.
attractions.shortFeatures: The main entrance of Xi'an City Wall

attractions.name: 安定门
attractions.summary: Anding Gate is the main west gate of Xi'an City Wall, commonly known as the West Gate. It was the middle gate in the west of Tang Imperial City, and it was preserved when Han Jian shrank and built a new city in the late Tang Dynasty. In the seventh to eleventh years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty (1374-1378), when the city wall was expanded, the location moved slightly southward and it was named Andingmen. "Stability" means Antai Kangding in the western frontier. Inside the city gate is West Street, and outside the gate is Xiguan Main Street. There are three gate towers in the west gate. The tower, arrow tower and gate tower are on the three walls from the inside to the outside. There are arched door openings downstairs. There is a square urn between the tower and the arrow tower, which is an entrance and exit passage in peacetime and an important defensive place in wartime. Its arrow tower is the most complete ancient castle in China so far. On the north side of the tower is an observation platform built by the Japanese emperor when he visited Xi'an.
attractions.shortFeatures: Zhengxi Gate of Xi'an Ancient City Wall

attractions.name: 长乐门
attractions.summary:
Changle Gate is the east gate of Xi'an City Wall, which was opened in the Ming Dynasty. There are six existing gate openings on the north and south sides of the city tower, the urn city and the north sides. 
Along the east side of Xi'an City Wall, Changle Gate is Zhongshan Gate in the north and southeast corner in the south. 
Before the Xi'an Incident, Zhang Xueliang set up a teaching team and a soldier team on the Changle Gate Tower, which has now been turned into a memorial site for the Xi'an Incident.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Main East Gate of Xi'an City Wall

attractions.name: 文昌门
attractions.summary: Wenchang Gate, located on the south side of Xi'an Forest of Steles Museum, is one of the newly opened city gates after the founding of New China. This section of the city wall has a Kuixing Building, which houses the statue of Kuixing. It is the only facility on the Xi'an city wall that has nothing to do with military defense. Kuixing is one of the twenty-eight constellations in ancient Chinese astronomy. Folk myths and legends dominate the rise and fall of the literary movement. In the minds of Confucian scholars, Kuixing has a supreme position. In the Ming and Qing Dynasties, Xi'an Fuxue and Confucius Temple were built next to the city wall, where the Forest of Steles Museum is now located, so Kuixing Tower was also built on the city wall. It was restored when the city gate was opened in 1986. Here, visitors can see Kuixing Zunrong holding a vermilion pen in his right hand, an ink fog in his left hand, and stepping on the head of a big fish at his feet. Outside Wenchang Gate, you can go west along Shuncheng Lane to Ji Bei Zhenbei Memorial Park, which was built in 1986 to commemorate the 1250th anniversary of Ji Bei Zhenbei's introduction of Tang culture into Japan. In the garden, a monument to Ji Bei Zhenbei was built on the site of the former Tang Guozijian with a piece of natural granite that has not been chiseled.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enshrined with the statue of Kuixing

Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场音乐喷泉
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square Music Fountain
attractions.summary: The Music Fountain of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, also known as the Xi'an Music Fountain, is located on the central axis of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda. The Music Fountain Square consists of water feature fountains, cultural squares, garden landscapes, cultural corridors, and tourism and commercial facilities. It is an important Tang culture square in China. There are a large number of sculptures and statues on the square. While enjoying the music fountain, it is also a good choice to savor these sculptures carefully. The music fountain is divided into three areas: a hundred meter waterfall pool, an eight level waterfall pool, and a front-end music pool. The eight level variable frequency array in the eight level cascade pool is the largest array in the world, with 1024 nozzle points, which can transform into various water types such as mountains and seas, lotus flowers, vast clouds, seagulls spreading their wings, butterflies falling in love with flowers, water mist, etc., shining brightly and beautifully. In the large laser water curtain, which is 60 meters wide and over 20 meters high, four fountains spray out from the water, fully burning and exploding at a low temperature at a height of 6 meters, further enhancing the awe inspiring power of the entire fountain.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《长恨歌》演出
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
China's first large-scale live-action historical dance drama, with eleven scenes in four levels, such as "loving each other" and "being spoiled and charming". 
· A strong cast of 300 professional actors artistically reproduces this touching love story in the original place of the story. 
Since the official performance in 2007, more than 2,500 performances have been performed and 3.5 million audiences have been received, reaching the grand occasion of "one ticket is hard to find".
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei and Tang Minghuang's eternal love

attractions.name: 西安世博园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; garden park; Gardens; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The venue of the World Horticultural Exposition is rich in green plant attractions, showcasing various plants and gardens designed by landscape masters from around the world.
- Major landmarks include the Chang'an Tower, Creative Pavilion, Nature Pavilion, and themed gardens (Chang'an Flower Valley, Colorful Zhongnan, Silk Road Flower Rain, Overseas Grand View, and Bashang Rainbow).
- The architecture here is innovative and unique, offering a chance to appreciate garden art from around the world, view rare plants and ecological landscapes from different regions of the Earth, and it is also a popular location for wedding photo shoots.
- The small train and electric vehicle pass through most of the classic landscapes of Xi'an Expo Park, with drivers and guides. Tickets can be purchased at four stations: Debao Gate, Bashang People's House, Guangyun Gate, and Chang'an Tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the garden art from around the world

attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 九龙湖
attractions.summary: Jiulong Lake is located in the scenic spot of Huaqing Palace, which is a palace visited by feudal emperors in Tang Dynasty. Backed by the mountain and facing the Wei River, it is built against the peak of Lishan Mountain. It is large in scale and magnificent in architecture, with towers and halls all over Lishan Mountain.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after the nine dragons on the lake embankment

attractions.name: 海棠汤
attractions.summary: Haitang Tang is Yang Guifei's special soup pool, which is named after a blooming begonia flower on the plane of the soup pool. The soup pool is wide from east to west and narrow from north to south. The top and bottom are divided into two floors, and 16 coupon stones form a blooming "begonia flower". Tangchi is about 5 meters long from east to west and 2.9 meters wide from north to south.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei's special soup pool

attractions.name: 西安事变旧址五间厅
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity
attractions.summary:
Wujianting is located in Huaqing Pool Scenic Area in Lintong, Xi'an, which is one of the famous sites of Xi'an Incident in history. 
Built in the late Qing Dynasty, it is a brick and wood hall. 
It is adjacent to Lishan Mountain in the south and Lotus Pond in the north. The courtyard is flat and the trees are lush. It is named Five Halls because it is connected by five single rooms.  
On the glass windows and walls of the five halls, there are still bullet marks from the fierce battle between soldiers and remonstrance. 
· Desks, chairs, beds, sofas, tea sets, stoves, carpets, telephones, etc. used in offices in each room are copied and placed as they were originally.
attractions.shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure hall
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:20; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 兵谏亭
attractions.summary:
Bingjian Pavilion is located next to the tabby stone in Xixiuling halfway up Lishan Mountain. Chiang Kai-shek's hiding place is famous for the "Xi'an Incident". 
· In order to commemorate the "Xi'an Incident", initiated by Hu Zongnan in 1946, all the non-commissioned officers of the Seventh Branch of Whampoa Military Academy raised money to build a stone pavilion, named "Zhengqi Pavilion". After the founding of New China, it was renamed "Chiang-shek Pavilion", and it was only changed to "Soldier Remonstrance Pavilion" in 1980s. 
The stone pavilion is 4 meters high and 2.5 meters wide. It seems inconspicuous, but it has a different meaning because it is closely related to major events in Chinese history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stone pavilion commemorating the revolution

- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.

Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.

attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
