attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 大鹏半岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Shenzhen Dapeng Peninsula National Geological Natural Park is located in the southeasternmost Dapeng Peninsula of Shenzhen. The geological heritage protection area covers an area of about 46.07 square kilometers. In 2005, it was rated as a national geological park. 
The types of geological relics in the park are mainly ancient volcanic relics formed by five volcanic eruptions about 146 million years ago and coastal landscapes formed in 20,000 to 10,000 years ago. The uncanny workmanship of nature has created the unique landscape here. 
The main peak of Qiniang Mountain formed by volcanic eruption is about 869.7 meters above sea level, making it the second highest peak in Shenzhen. The stretching coastline was rated as one of the "eight most beautiful coasts in China" by China National Geographic. 
The park is divided into four scenic spots: Qiongqiu Travel Scenic Spot, Haishi Wonder Scenic Spot, Luzui Tide Watching Scenic Spot and Buxi Yangmei Scenic Spot. Based on the needs of geological relics and natural environment protection, the areas officially open to the public in the park are "Qiongqiu Tour" and "Luzui Tide Watching", with museum scenic spots, main peak scientific research line and Luyan scientific research line.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shenzhen's "Gold Coast"

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

restaurants.name_en: Maoxinglong Time-honored Squab King Seafood Restaurant

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. Full text 

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 武汉天地
attractions.summary: Like Xintiandi in Shanghai, Wuhan Tiandi, which is close to Hankou River Beach, is a characteristic block transformed from old buildings. Strolling along the pedestrian walkway, the red brick small western-style buildings, antique wooden windows, antique blue bricks, and wooden or bamboo chairs placed outdoors all exude a strong nostalgic atmosphere. Many young people like to come here to take photos. Wuhan Tiandi gathers delicacies from all over the world. You can not only eat the New Element Restaurant opened by Li Na, a tennis elder sister, but also the South Restaurant of Shanghai Delicate Dim sum Restaurant, the Creative Sichuan Restaurant with pepper, and the Bali lobster and Yitang lobster that you must eat in summer in Jiangcheng. In addition to dining venues, a fashionable shopping center called Yifang Shopping Center has been built here, featuring over 300 global fashion brands and integrating international cuisine, IMAX theaters, LIFESTYLE bookstores, children's experiential play, and family consumption, conveying the spirit of fashion at the forefront.

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

attractions.summary: Here, you can learn about natural science in an all-round way through various modern equipment and rich display and interactive ways. For children, this must be a must-visit place for entertainment and education. The Science and Technology Museum is divided into three floors, with exhibition halls of the universe, life and water in the "natural plate";
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:00-16:30(Admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 归元禅寺
attractions.summary:
· One of the most important monasteries in Wuhan, together with Baotong Temple, Xilian Temple and Zhengjue Temple, is called the four jungles of Wuhan.  
It is the daily custom of many Wuhan citizens to come to Guiyuan Temple to pray for blessings. Every year on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, hundreds of thousands of pilgrims come here to grab the first incense. 
· Enter the Arhat Hall, start with any 　 Arhat, and count to your actual age in sequence. The identity, expression and movements of the counted Arhat indicate your fate.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the famous temple of the golden arhat

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 汉正街
attractions.summary:
Hanzheng Street is "the main street of ancient Hankou", the earliest central street in the history of Hankou, and a place where thousands of businessmen gather and commodities compete for flow. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is a commodity wholesale market with a wide range. It is mainly divided into different commodities. The prices of commodities here are still very cheap. However, when shopping here, on the one hand, you have to have a certain ability to identify commodities, because the authenticity and falsehood are uneven; On the other hand, you have to be able to counter-offer. Cheap is not that simple. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is being renovated and relocated, from Qiaokou District of Hankou to Hankou North. However, there are still many commercial ports at the original site, and it should take many years to completely relocate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hankou commercial district in history

attractions.name: 木兰草原
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Treasure spots for kids.
attractions.summary: Mulan Prairie - The only AAAA-level Mongolian-style scenic area in Central China, located in Niejiagang, Wangjiahe Town, Huangpi District, Wuhan, to the east of the famous Mulan Mountain and to the south of Mulan Lake, one of the top ten leisure resorts in Hubei. The scenic area is 36 kilometers from downtown Wuhan and 12 kilometers from the nearest highway exit, with very convenient transportation. The planned area of the scenic spot is 4,800 acres, divided into the Grassland Style Tourism Area and the Leisure Resort Area. It integrates grassland-style sightseeing, outdoor activities, water entertainment, business meetings, and leisure vacations. It is currently the only AAAA-level scenic area in Central China themed around grassland culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the prairie charm through horseback riding and archery.

attractions.name: 木兰山
attractions.tag: Climbing Heights and Mountains; Nature and Adventure
attractions.summary: The Mulan Mountain Scenic Area is located in the northern part of Huangpi District, Wuhan, just 50 kilometers from the city center. With an elevation of 582.1 meters, it is a national geological park, a provincial-level scenic area, and a provincial-level nature reserve. In November 2014, the Mulan Mountain Scenic Area was approved by the National Tourism Administration as a 5A-level tourist attraction, as the core scenic area of the Huangpi Mulan Cultural Ecological Tourism Zone. Mulan Mountain is known as the "back garden of Wuhan" and was praised by the Ming Dynasty poet Tu Da as "the most magnificent of Xiling, the ultimate view of the Three Chu regions."
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Hua Mulan's Hometown

attractions.name: 木兰天池
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
- Mulan Tianchi is a national forest park. The area is characterized by beautiful mountains and clear waters, and is an important part of the Mulan Cultural Ecotourism Area.
- The entire scenic area is divided into a sightseeing area and a leisure resort area. Due to the lower temperatures in summer compared to the city, it is ideal for a summer retreat.
- The area is crisscrossed with ravines and rich in forests, with flowing water throughout the year, presenting a wetland ecosystem where mountains and waters blend together.
- The main attractions in the area include waterfalls, stream pools, and strange rock formations. There is also a meadow with entertainment activities such as grass skiing and slideways.
- In early spring, Mulan Tianchi is a paradise for apricot blossoms, with thousands of acres of wild apricot flowers spread across the forest valleys, where the verdant hills and blooming apricot flowers create a picturesque scene.
attractions.shortFeatures: The lush mountains and clear waters are like a scene from a painting; a summer resort with beautiful mountains and clear waters.

attractions.name: 木兰云雾山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Mountains
attractions.summary: Yunwu Mountain, renowned for its titles of "Western Ling Scenic Area, Famous Region of Northern Chu, Boundary Defense of the West, and Ancestor Mountain of Han Land," is located in the Paotongdian area in the northwest of Huangpi District, Wuhan, about 65 kilometers from the city center and 29 kilometers from Huangpi District. It is a natural scenic area dominated by mountains, with the main peak at an elevation of about 709 meters, making it the highest peak in Wuhan. One of the Eight Scenic Views of Mulan, it is a national 5A-level scenic area. Mulan Yunwu Mountain features pleasant scenery, fresh air, and clear water. It is the grandest, most secluded, primitive, mysterious, and purest in the Mulan tourism circle, combining peaks, valleys, ravines, ponds, dams, waterfalls, springs, streams, flowers, grasses, stones, trees, temples, ancient villages, ancient architecture, and towering mountains, offering diverse and rich ecological landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Flower viewing and spring outing in the countryside park
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 香凝池
attractions.summary: In 1927, Feng Yuxiang visited Huaqing Pool and built a women's bathhouse called Xiangning Pool because he had observed Huaqing Pool multiple times during his stay in Shaanxi.

attractions.name: 《秦始皇和他的地下王国》电影
attractions.name_en: "Qin Shi Huang and His Underground Kingdom" Movie
attractions.summary: The 3D giant screen movie "Qin Shi Huang and His Underground Kingdom" is an 8K quality 3D film and television documentary filmed using SONY F65 digital cameras. As the "eighth wonder of the world", the Terra Cotta Warriors has attracted the attention of the whole world, while the unexplored the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has always been full of fog. "The First Emperor of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor and His Underground Kingdom" combines the new progress of the archaeology of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, approaches the Terra Cotta Warriors limitlessly, unveils the mystery of the Terra Cotta Warriors Mausoleum, and tells the secrets of the huge empire behind the Terracotta Warriors.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river.

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 静安寺
attractions.summary:
Jing'an Temple is a famous ancient temple in Shanghai. The architectural style of the temple is combined with Tibetan temples. The silver Buddha enshrined in the Daxiong Hall weighs 15 tons. 
The main buildings of the temple are Mountain Gate, Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, etc. Looking at the whole temple from a distance, a golden roof is particularly conspicuous. 
Jing'an Temple is full of incense. Every birthday and anniversary of Bodhisattva, the temple will hold a Dharma fair. Every year, on the eighth day of April in the lunar calendar, a three-day temple fair will be held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Rare Tibetan-style temples in the east

The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience.

attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing

attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.summary: The Ferris wheel is located 460 meters away from the Guangzhou Tower and is one of the popular tourist attractions in the tower. It cleverly utilizes the platform at the top of the tower and, unlike other Ferris wheels, runs on an inclined track. It is currently the tallest horizontal Ferris wheel in the world. The Ferris wheel is composed of 16 transparent crystal ball cabins that resemble sparkling pearls, slowly flowing around, and the beautiful scenery of Yangcheng unfolds before my eyes like a scroll. Sun, moon, and stars, accompanied by auspicious clouds, this place has become a romantic place for marriage proposals, allowing tourists to experience the romance at the top of the world. attractions.summary:

- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.

The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 
