attractions.name: 防洪纪念塔
attractions.summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

attractions.name: 松花江铁路桥
attractions.summary: The Songhua River Railway Bridge is located on the banks of the Songhua River. It is not only a well-known railway bridge over the Songhua River, but also the first cross river bridge in Harbin. Although the retired bridge no longer has the stunning scene of trains roaring, its figure still appears particularly charming, especially under the sunset. The Songhua River Railway Bridge, also known as the Songhua River Binzhou Railway Bridge, is a cross river bridge of the Middle East Railway that crosses the Eurasian continent over the Songhua River. The bridge was designed and supervised by Russian bridge experts. The Songhua River Railway Bridge was first built in May 1900 and put into use in October 1901. The bridge has 19 spans, is 7.2 meters wide, and has a total length of approximately 1015 meters. Due to the opening of the newly-built Songhua River Grand Bridge and the conventional speed line, the Songhua River Railway Bridge, which has accompanied Harbin for 113 years, was also decommissioned in 2014. People will no longer see trains passing over the bridge. Full text 

attractions.name: 松花江观光索道
attractions.summary: The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway starts from Tongjiang Square in the south and ends at Taiyang Island Scenic Area in the north, spanning across the Songhua River. It is a well-known tourist transportation vehicle. The total length of the cableway is 1156 meters, and the cableway bracket in the river is more than 70 meters away from the river surface. Riding in the car, you can overlook the panoramic view of both sides of the Songhua River, with infinite scenery. The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway is one of the key projects in Harbin City, which was built and constructed with huge investment in 1997. It introduced equipment from the world's senior cableway equipment company, Austria's Dopema Company, and ranks among the high-end international cableways today. The cableway is adjacent to Stalin Park, Flood Control Memorial Tower, and Central Street, like a jade belt tightly connecting the two banks of the Songhua River. The cableway is equipped with 19 fully automatic and fully enclosed high-end cabins for 8 people, 6 luxurious cabins, and built-in sofas, bars, and speakers, providing comfort, elegance, warmth, and romance. The cableway runs at a speed of 1-5 meters per second, with ease and speed. Walking leisurely in the courtyard, one can enjoy the scenery of northern China and the city, and the scenery wherever they go is infinite. So far, the cableway has been in operation for more than 20 years, with a safety factor of 100%. Full text 

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.summary: Despite its steep terrain, Laozhai Mountain still attracts many photography enthusiasts to climb up. Laozhai Mountain has an altitude of over 300 meters. Although it is not high, it has more than 1100 steps. After walking up the Round Arch Mountain Gate, you will encounter two iron ladders near the top. Following the iron ladders, you can reach the top of the mountain and overlook Xingping Ancient Town. Don't take the wrong path. Looking into the distance from the mountaintop, the Li River bends at the foot of the mountain, and boats shuttle by. The distant mountains are layered and particularly enchanting. attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.

· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday

- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.

Visitors can visit the Qingzhou Channel where a large cruise ship crosses the bridge, as well as beautiful attractions such as Lingding Island, the west artificial island of the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, and Shekou Homeport. Delivered for use in August 2020, the cruise ship integrates multiple functions, including a sightseeing area, exhibition area, atrium, technology store, multi-functional room, theater and other leisure and entertainment areas. The cruise ship is 72 meters long and 19 meters wide, with a maximum passenger capacity of 350 people. It has three spacious decks, with the top deck meeting the outdoor sightseeing needs of tourists. The upper deck has a sightseeing corridor for circumnavigation, the exhibition area has a cruise ship simulation driving teaching area, technology store and science classroom, restaurant and wine bar. The main deck has a theater for holding events, conferences, exhibitions, salons, etc. The main deck also has a luxurious private room that can accommodate 10-15 people for business banquets and small gatherings. attractions.name: 四方城
attractions.summary: Sifang City, located inside the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, also known as the "Shengong Shengde Stele Tower", was built in the 11th year of the Yongle reign of the Ming Dynasty (1413 AD). The building has a square floor plan and the roof has been destroyed, commonly known as Sifang City. Located on both sides of Lingyuan Road, opposite to Da Jinmen. The surrounding walls are shaped like barriers. There is a large stone beast in the city, with its head held high and tail trailing, as if it were alive. It carries the Great Ming Xiaoling Divine Merit and Virtue Stele on its back. The inscription on the stele is in regular script, with a length of 2746 words and a size as big as a fist. It records the merits of Ming Taizu throughout his life and was erected by his father Zhu Yuanzhang in the third year of Yongle reign of Ming Chengzu Zhu Di (1405 AD). The stele has a height of 8.84 meters, a height of 4.78 meters, a width of 2.24 meters, and a thickness of 0.83 meters. It is the largest existing stone stele on the ground in the Nanjing area.

attractions.name: 石象路
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Road trip; Roads/Highways
attractions.summary: Shixiang Road is an integral part of Xiaoling Mausoleum in Ming Dynasty. In the first half, there are 12 pairs of 6 kinds of stone beasts standing on both sides, in turn: lion, seed, camel, elephant, unicorn and horse, with 4 of each species, two standing and two lying. At the end of the stone beast, there is a pair of stone pillars, and after this, it turns north. There are eight stone Wengzhong bodies, four civil servants and military commanders each, and they are separated by the road. Xiaoling stone man and stone beast are all carved from a whole stone, which is tall, vivid and rough. They are classic works in the stone carvings of imperial tombs in Ming Dynasty.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 无梁殿
attractions.summary: The Wuliang Hall is the only remaining Ming Dynasty building in Linggu Temple, with a history of over 600 years. The temple was originally dedicated to the Infinite Life Buddha, hence it was once called the Infinite Hall. Due to the fact that the building is constructed with brick and stone arches, without the use of an inch of wood, it is commonly referred to as a beamless hall. It is precisely because of the Liangtai that it was able to survive in the war that it is one of the five existing Liangtai temples in China with a long history and a large scale. The Wuliang Hall is 50 meters long from east to west and 34 meters wide from north to south. The roof of the hall is double eaved with nine ridges, covered with gray black tube tiles. There are three Lama pagodas standing on the main ridge. Inside the hall is a brick built dome with five rooms and three entrances, each with one entrance. The three entrances on the sides are each a large vertical tube shaped dome, and the middle dome is large, with a width of 11.4 meters and a height of 14 meters. The front and rear coupons are relatively small, with a width of 4.88 meters and a height of 7 meters. The brick stacks on the upper end of the inner walls of the east and west mountains are stacked inward, protruding layer by layer, reaching up to 1 meter in length. They seem to fall without falling, which is truly remarkable. In 1933, the Nationalist government built a cemetery for fallen soldiers at the former site of Linggu Temple, and the Wuliang Hall was converted into a cemetery memorial hall. At present, the Wuliang Hall has been converted into a wax museum for celebrities of the Xinhai Revolution, exhibiting wax figures of dozens of celebrities before and after the Xinhai Revolution.

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 孙中山纪念馆
attractions.summary:
· Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, formerly known as the Tibetan Sutra Building, is located in the dense forest between Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum and Linggu Temple. It is a classical building imitating the Lama Temple in the Qing Dynasty. 
The main building is 20.8 meters high, covered with green glazed tiles on the top, yellow glazed tiles on the roof ridge, and a copper revolving canopy in the center of the main ridge, which is very beautiful. 
· The building introduces all kinds of deeds about Dr. Sun Yat-sen during his lifetime, and treasures precious historical materials such as Dr. Sun Yat-sen's classic works and photos. 
In the center of the front square, there is a bronze statue of Dr. Sun Yat-sen with a height of 2.6 meters in 　, and there is a 125-meter-long stele gallery behind the building, which is engraved with the full text of "Three People's Principles" written by Dr. Sun Yat-sen.

attractions.name: 中山书院
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Academy is an affiliated institution of the Memorial Hall, with a construction area of over 800 square meters. It faces north and south and is a two-story palace style building with double eaves and flying corners, red columns and green tiles, creating a magnificent atmosphere.

attractions.name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 鱼嘴湿地公园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Yuzui Wetland Park is located at the southern end of Hexi New City in Jianye District, Nanjing, at the confluence of the Yangtze River, Jiajiang River, and Qinhuai New River. The total area is 640000 square meters, with wetlands as the theme, cleverly integrating ecological water treatment systems, treehouses, wetland workstations and other facilities to create a wild urban ecological park.

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.

attractions.name: 佛顶宫
attractions.summary:
Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

attractions.name: 珠海长隆度假区
attractions.summary: Zhuhai Chimelong International Ocean Resort is located in Hengqin New District, Zhuhai. It includes numerous theme parks such as Chimelong Ocean Kingdom and Hengqin Island Theater, as well as luxury theme hotels such as Hengqin Bay Hotel, Penguin Hotel, and Circus Hotel. With complete supporting facilities, it is a great place to travel with friends and family on weekends. It is recommended that the entire resort be built in a one water ocean style, with a large area. If you want to visit the entire scenic area at once, staying for one day is definitely not enough. During the day, you can meet rare whale sharks, beluga whales, polar bears, and other adorable animals in the Ocean Kingdom, challenge the parrot roller coaster, and experience the excitement of rapidly descending from a height of 20 floors and the madness of 360 degree flipping. At night, there is a splendid fireworks display in Hengqin Sea, which starts around 8 pm, or you can go to the International Circus City to enjoy the circus performance. More than 150 circus performers spanning Europe, Asia, and Africa will offer you stunning performances and 360 degree panoramic multi perspective visual experiences, bringing you an international circus feast. If the accommodation and catering budget is sufficient, you can stay at the luxurious Hengqin Bay Hotel in the park. Parents with children can also choose the distinctive circus hotel and penguin hotel. Each hotel has a buffet restaurant with different styles, offering Chinese, Japanese, Western, and Asian cuisine to meet the needs of different groups of people. In addition to convenient food and accommodation, hotel guests can also take the priority channel to the scenic area without queuing, which is very worry free during holidays when there are many people. In addition, you can also choose to stay overnight at the Whale Shark Aquarium, set up a tent inside the Whale Shark Aquarium, and sleep with the cute whale sharks to experience a completely different fantasy journey from the daytime. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞船乐园
attractions.summary: Step into Chimelong Spaceship Park and embark on an exciting interstellar exploration journey. Here, every tourist has the opportunity to immerse themselves in a challenging and adventurous exploration mission through personalized character selection. Your every choice and interaction will bring point rewards, from riding exciting amusement equipment to interacting with theme characters, to participating in science popularization knowledge quizzes, every step is closely integrated with the park's dual themes of science and entertainment. The special mission of "Egg Boy Party" makes every step of the amusement a joy of discovery! In the dedicated check-in area of "Egg Party", you can share happy moments with the egg lovers and leave beautiful summer memories. Each check-in point not only has a unique theme setting, but also has the opportunity to win exquisite gifts and additional points. Capture the fun moments of this summer with family and friends, and make the joy of the 'Egg Party' the highlight of your journey. The officially opened Chimelong Spaceship Park has added 18 new sets of super fun equipment, ready to welcome the arrival of every explorer! The summer spaceship amusement park has 35 different types of amusement equipment. This summer, we will take you into a brand new world full of excitement and fun. In Chimelong Spaceship Park, animal displays, science classes, themed entertainment, new amusement facilities, and highly creative performances are integrated. Integrating multimedia technology with performances to achieve an educational and entertaining effect, allowing tourists to see knowledge while traveling, acquire knowledge while having fun, and fall in love with marine ecological conservation while watching performances and playing. The anticipated killer whale science popularization theater can accommodate nearly 5000 people at the same time. With the theme of killer whale conservation, combined with the flying of birds and the introduction and display of killer whale behavior, it showcases the vibrant marine ecology to people. Here, Chimelong has created a global large-scale indoor venue for killer whales and the first "killer whale breeding base" to create a living environment for animals in the wild. It has also created a world-class killer whale wave pool, where we can see natural behaviors such as splashing, jumping, and swimming, showcasing the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. In addition to the regular tour route, Chimelong Spaceship Park has also carefully designed a series of science popularization and learning activities such as "Exploration Home Tour" and "Little Conservator", aiming to enhance young people's understanding and awareness of marine ecosystems through an educational and entertaining environment. These courses not only cover a wide range of topics, but also delve into the mysteries of marine life. At Chimelong Spaceship Park, you will experience a variety of amusement facilities, from the exciting "Star River Storm" to the mysterious "Ancient Sea Fantasy Tour". The new "Egg Party" special mission combines innovative gamified point gameplay to embark on personalized interstellar exploration. This summer, bring your family and friends to Chimelong Spaceship Park to not only enjoy unparalleled entertainment experiences, but also gain a deeper understanding of the importance of marine ecological protection through educational entertainment. Looking forward to your arrival, creating unforgettable memories together and exploring, learning, and protecting our beautiful world. Welcome to Chimelong Spaceship Park for immersive space exploration, where you can explore the stars and sea, admire rare marine creatures, and experience the diversity and wonder of life. With 15 themed areas, 3 performance theaters, 17 amusement equipment, 13 science popularization classrooms, and 7 public classrooms, you can immerse yourself in this imaginative space. Let's embark on an interstellar adventure together! The first stop is the Space World: board the spaceship amusement park and enter the Black Hole Crossing Nebula. Tourists can instantly enter the fantasy space created by Chimelong for tourists in the "Space World". The giant simulated space dome takes you to board the spaceship amusement park and enter the Black Hole Crossing Nebula, allowing everyone to quickly enter the imagined themed world. The second stop is Asia Planet: Get to know the numerous magical creatures in river basins. Here, you can learn about freshwater ecosystems and showcase the world's freshwater seals - Baikal seals - with a variety of magical freshwater creatures that will surely broaden your horizons. Meanwhile, here you will also be amazed by the wisdom of how humans utilize freshwater. The third stop is Rainforest Planet: Explore the secrets of the rainforest together, watch the fun "Rainforest Theater" and "Rainforest Planet", immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the "Tree of Life" on the dome, and watch the "Dialogue with the Amazon" performance in the "Rainforest Theater". Rainforest Mysteries vividly tell interesting environmental stories. The fourth stop is Canyon Planet: Crossing the Canyon World, unveiling the mysterious veil of the large population of manatees. Canyon Planet is another world, surrounded by lakes and waterfalls, where you meet tiger fish living in these habitats and uncover the mysterious veil of the distant fairy tale mermaid pangolin. Station 5: Interstellar Platform: Encountering a gathering of interstellar guests who come and go to the "Interstellar Platform", meeting Mech King, Ape Star Man, and Weapon Master, the wonderful Black Light Show "Interstellar Theater" interprets the changes of water in different forms with fun and technology, combining education with entertainment, which is very interesting. The 6th stop is Coral Sanctuary: Over 100 different types and shapes of corals enter the parallel universe of the ocean and arrive at the "Coral Sanctuary", where they can dive into lush coral reefs without carrying breathing equipment. The stunning coral exhibition area, with a water volume of 3235m ³, is home to over 20000 living organisms and more than 100 different types and shapes of corals. Its magnificent appearance instantly evokes the mission of protecting the coral family and maintaining the ecological environment. The Coral Secret Realm has more interesting coral elders waiting for you, let the coral elders tell you the importance of coral reef protection for human survival. The 7th stop of Ocean Rhapsody: Join the Happy Ocean Party "Ocean Rhapsody" is a deep-sea party where you can sing and dance with cute ocean fish and enjoy happy time to the fullest. The 8th stop, Shocking Shark Black Hole: Encounter the shark family and learn about various "ocean hunters" who bring the joy of the ocean to the "Shocking Shark Black Hole". Hammerhead sharks will become your good friends. Tourists can not only enjoy multiple species of "ocean hunters", but also learn about the types, habits, characteristics, etc. of sharks through model fossils, intelligent interactive design, and other forms. They can rediscover sharks in different ways and perspectives, reduce their fear of sharks, and understand the importance of sharks. The 9th stop of Space Dragon Palace: Explore the wonders of creatures such as Dungeon, Dragonfish, and Emperor Crocodile through ancient and modern times. Travel through the famous marine predator planet to arrive at the "Space Dragon Palace". In this parallel universe, tourists travel through ancient and modern times as well as the future, and will encounter incredible ancient marine creatures such as Dungeon and ichthyosaurs. The 10th stop, Whale Strange Universe: Walking into the Deep Sea Dominator Evolution Corridor and Conservation Space+D12 "Whale Strange Universe" will lead tourists into the Deep Sea Dominator Evolution Corridor and Conservation Space. The 11th stop of the Coolby Tour: Science Popularization and Conservation Space. Through the "Coolby Tour", you can reach the "Interstellar Exhibition Hall", where multi-functional science popularization education interactive displays combine education with entertainment. The 12th stop is the Deep Sea Amusement Park: 16 amusement facilities, crossing storms and exploring the seabed. The "Deep Sea Amusement Park" is an underwater carnival with 16 amusement facilities, allowing you to realize your dream of going to the sea. Take the "Bermuda Adventure" to cross storms and the "Deep Sea Submarine" to explore the seabed. Bermuda Adventure is also an unmissable amusement project. On the high-tech ride on dynamic simulation device, it can accommodate up to 300 people to experience and play at the same time. When the lights go out and the dynamic simulation device is activated, tourists seem to be instantly transported into an ocean adventure. With the surging waves and raging storms, they feel as if they are at the center of the storm. This authentic feeling has given people a deeper understanding and reverence for the ocean. Deep sea submarine "is a real underwater submarine amusement facility in China. We specialize in real boats, real fish, and real diving, striving to provide tourists with an immersive experience. The entire theme project is divided into six areas: Coral Cave, Underwater Exploration, Adventure Base, Abyss Shuttle, Ocean Current Tour, and Magic Palace. It can accommodate 96 visitors at a time to participate. Tourists transformed into adventurers and boarded eight submarines resembling the "Striver" in appearance. Subsequently, the submarine slowly semi submerged into the water and advanced forward. Through the portholes on both sides, tourists could witness the beautiful scenery of the deep sea, watching dozens of unique marine fish such as sharks and stingrays swim through the window and play freely. As the submarine gradually advances, fantastical sights such as ancient shipwrecks, mysterious glowing treasure chests, lava "active volcanoes," and geothermal vents come into view. Countless fantasy landscapes with deep sea themes are elusive and ever-changing. The 13th stop is the Orca Science Popularization Theater: Watch the large population of killer whales and learn about whale and dolphin conservation knowledge. The "Orca Science Popularization Theater" is the finale project of the time travel journey, which can accommodate thousands of people for whale and dolphin science popularization courses, allowing tourists to enjoy the surprise of being close to the seabed, learn about marine life up close, and understand the importance of the ocean and conservation. The 14th stop, Future City: A variety of themed foods and products are available here for tourists to choose from, select souvenirs, and bring back memories of this extraordinary spaceship journey. The 15th stop is the Spaceship Food Square: a large family experience square that provides leisure and entertainment for guests. It has numerous non powered amusement facilities and connects to the Chimelong Spaceship Hotel and various restaurants in the hotel. Hotel guests can also quickly enter the theme park through this place. Full text 

attractions.name: 珠海横琴《长隆秀》
attractions.summary: The new grand circus program "Chimelong Show" in Zhuhai Hengqin was created by an international team and directed by a descendant of the Russian circus family. Based on the international scene, the program was enthusiastically performed by circus artists from 28 countries. The overall style integrates the diverse customs and contemporary fashion concepts of China, Russia, Argentina, the United States and other countries, covering acrobatics, dance, comic performance, magic, extreme sports and other art categories. It gathers the essence of art, from Venice chapter to African style, from Chinese traditional culture to Argentine inspired performance, from rock and roll Broadway to strolling in the space fantasy world, integrating the essence of ancient and modern cultures, so that the audience can enjoy the bizarre circus The world, feel the unique charm of circus. In terms of stage presentation, Zhuhai Hengqin Chimelong Theater integrates the concept of "water, land, and air" to create a multi-dimensional fantasy world, creating a more immersive, three-dimensional, and diverse audio-visual experience. A 270 ° panoramic circular stage and 3 large surrounding waterways, a 360 ° high-altitude suspended circular track over 250 meters, and a parade channel over 5 meters wide in the audience area. Various water, land, and air effects can be flexibly transformed according to different programs, bringing an immersive performance effect of "going from heaven to earth and underwater". The nearly 85 minute performance of "Chimelong Show" covers a wide range of skills such as acrobatics, dance, comedy, extreme sports, and special effects. There are also interactive parades on site, bringing a double shock of joy and excitement, making it easy for both children and adults to immerse themselves. Full text 
