attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· It is one of the largest ocean theme parks in the world, and it is also the world's first unique design that combines large-scale amusement facilities with precious animal exhibition areas. 
· It has Asia's first flying roller coaster with the longest track, Asia's first water roller coaster, the world's largest aquarium and acrylic glass, etc. 
The aquarium won five Guinness World Records at the same time, and there are as many as 15,000 exotic fish of different species in the aquarium.
attractions.shortFeatures: Asia's first water roller coaster

attractions.name: 鲸鲨馆
attractions.summary:
· Whale Shark Pavilion is a record-breaking marine fish exhibition hall with five Guinness World Records. It is the "largest marine fish exhibition hall in the world" and has the "largest acrylic glass". 
· Walk along the curved underwater promenade, thousands of rare fish swim by you, and the circular dome reveals the colorful underwater world. 
· If you want to experience the most magnificent view on the seabed, you have to come to the glass viewing screen with a height of 8.3 meters and a length of 39.6 meters. In addition to the largest fish-whale shark, there are also devil fish with a diameter of 4 meters. 
· You can also experience "overnight under the sea" here, "sleep" with eight whale sharks in the premier marine fish exhibition hall, and experience a peculiar journey completely different from daytime.
attractions.shortFeatures: 360-degree immersion experience the romantic underwater world

attractions.name: 【珠海】海洋保卫战
attractions.summary: The Ocean Defense Battle presents 150 unmanned aerial vehicle performances, large-scale fireworks displays, dazzling lasers and grand blasting scenes, fountain shows, high difficulty water flying man performances, stunt motorboats and "whale sharks" flying, creating a Hollywood live action blockbuster and a sensory enjoyment with strong audio-visual impact.

attractions.name: 海洋大街(长隆海洋王国内)
attractions.name_en: Ocean Street (in the Chimelong Ocean Kingdom)
attractions.summary: As soon as you enter Zhuhai Chimelong Ocean Kingdom, you will see Ocean Street. At the top of the street is a huge screen that plays promotional videos in a loop. On both sides of the street are some small shops with food and souvenir shops for you to choose from. You can also see the evening performance here, a wonderful place to take photos with fireworks, and the lighting is suitable

attractions.name: 珠海长隆海洋王国-海豚湾
attractions.name_en: Zhuhai Chimelong Ocean Kingdom - Dolphin Bay
attractions.summary: Dolphin Bay is located in Chimelong Ocean King, Fuxiang Bay, Hengqin New District, Xiangzhou District, Zhuhai City. In this dolphin base camp, there are bottle-nosed dolphins, spotted dolphins and other family members preparing for various activities, with performances and interactions, which are very interesting.

attractions.name: 珠海渔女
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Statues/Sculptures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The statue of Zhuhai Fisherman Girl stands on the banks of the beautiful Xianglu Bay in Zhuhai and is an iconic landscape of Zhuhai. 
Pan He, a famous Chinese sculptor, designed this stone sculpture according to the beautiful legend of fishermen in the South China Sea. Generally, tourists who come to Zhuhai will come here to take photos. 
· She wore pearls and fishing nets, and held high in her hands a round and huge pearl-like treasure, with a vivid look of love.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark seaside fisherman statue

attractions.name: 珠海大剧院
attractions.tag: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater
attractions.summary:
· A beautiful landscape on Lovers Road, it is the only opera house built on an island in China. 
The design scheme of Zhuhai Grand Theatre not only comes from the unique marine species "Sun Moon Shell", but also refines the image of "shell" and further expresses the significance of space with modern building materials and technologies. 
· The large shell "Ribei" is 90 meters high and can accommodate nearly 1,600 people, while the small shell "Yuebei" is a multi-function hall with a capacity of 500 people. When watching it during the day, it is clear and milky white; When the lights on the shells are on at night, it is a dazzling giant screen light dance show. 
· On the official website, you can check and book the performances of the Opera House, which is also a good pastime to visit Zhuhai.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Grand Theatre with a prominent marine style

attractions.name: 情侣路
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Lovers Road is the business card of Zhuhai, about 28 kilometers long. Popular attractions along the way include Jiuzhou Port, Seaside Swimming Pool, Zhuhai Fisherman Girl, Xianglu Bay, etc. 
· Walking on the road, you can look at the sea, blow the sea breeze, look at Macau on the other side, and enjoy a leisurely and pleasant time. 
If you are physically strong, you can ride the whole journey. Special bicycle rental services are provided near Gongbei or at the entrance of Mingting Park (Yeli Island).
attractions.shortFeatures: Strolling in the sea breeze and looking at Macau

attractions.name: 圆明新园
attractions.summary:
· The Yuanming New Garden is based on the architecture of the Old Summer Palace in Beijing before it was burned down, with 18 of the 40 famous views of Yuanmingyuan selected and built to a 1:1 scale. It is divided into three main scenic areas: the Royal Architecture Group, the Jiangnan Garden Architecture Group, and the Western Architecture Group, showcasing the prosperity of the Qing Dynasty.

· The central axis of the garden includes landmarks such as the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Nine Provinces' Clear and Tranquil Retreat, and the Pengdao Yao Tai, with more than ten Jiangnan garden-style buildings surrounding the lake. Additionally, performances like "Dreaming Back to the Old Summer Palace" are staged, combining elements like explosions and horse racing, making it worth a visit.

attractions.name: 香炉湾沙滩
attractions.summary: Xianglu Bay Beach is a crescent shaped bay beach named after fishermen who used to disembark here and pay their respects at Xianglu Cave in Shijingshan. Full text 

attractions.name: 汉阳造艺术区
attractions.summary:
· The abandoned industrial plant used was originally part of Hanyang Arsenal and 824 Factory during the Westernization Movement in China. 
· The park covers a small area, mostly composed of office buildings. Besides, graffiti, performance art and creative sculptures can be seen everywhere. 
· A model of old industrial transformation into commercial and artistic creation park, novel and innovative enough for artists to exert their unlimited creativity and imagination.

attractions.name: 琴台大剧院
attractions.summary: The theater is located on the bank of Yuehu Lake, on the bank of Han River, and Guqintai, which was built in Wanli period of Ming Dynasty across Hunan Lake. As the core component of Yuehu Culture and Art Theme Park, it will become the highest-grade cultural performance venue in Wuhan, and it is also the main meeting of the 8th China Art Festival in 2007. Changqintai Grand Theatre, which has a total construction area of 65,650 square meters. The Grand Theater adopts the traditional "Pin"-shaped stage, with a building entrance width of 18M, a height of 12M, a total depth of 50M and a width of 72M. It has a two-part orchestra pool with an area of 92m2, which can accommodate a band of 120 people. It has the full-habitat function of receiving large-scale musicals, operas, ballets, musicals, dramas, concerts and other artistic performances. The stage of the multi-function hall is 26M long, 16M wide and 11M high, and there are 14 lifting platforms in it. Through different combinations, different theater forms can be realized, namely, six forms: small drama conference hall, "convex" stage, "T" stage, center stage and flat hall. The equipment above and below the stage is linked, and the combination mode is ever-changing, creating a huge space for art, which can meet the requirements of various operas, musicals, dramas, operas and concerts at home and abroad. Construction of the Grand Theatre started in May 2004 and was completed in August 2007. The Wuhan Municipal Government invested 1.57 billion yuan, covering an area of 24,543 square meters, with a total construction area of 65,650 square meters, 4 floors underground, 6 floors above ground, and a building height of 40 meters. Among them, the Grand Theatre has 1,802 seats, which ranks among the super-large dramas in China. The architecture of the Grand Theatre involves more than 20 majors, and it is recognized as the most difficult in the field of architecture. Qintai Grand Theatre is the only large theatre in China originally designed by Chinese-Guangdong Pearl River Design Institute won the international bidding for the Grand Theatre scheme. It is a lifelong honor for an architect to be a big theater. Wuhan Real Estate Group, which has never been a theater, has overcome a large number of technical and construction difficulties, and set a number of domestic records in the Qintai Grand Theatre project, leading the country in construction quality, speed and cost control. With the flying keys of the appearance, the flying charm of the sleeves, the historical heaviness of the bronze curtain plate, and the red main tone of the Grand Theater, the Qintai Grand Theater makes people appreciate the rich Chu culture. At the beginning, some experts worried that using red for big color blocks would drive people crazy. Not long ago, the chief color consultant of the designer of the National Centre for the Performing Arts came to Han to recognize the color of the Grand Theatre, and some experts commented that it was stirring. Recently, many leaders, academicians and experts have inspected Qintai Grand Theatre, and they have a consensus: it is comparable to the National Grand Theatre, Shanghai Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Grand Theatre, and fills the gap of high-quality cultural facilities in the central region. The modern Grand Theatre is an essential infrastructure for an international city. This kind of theater should possess three characteristics: the internationality of theater function, the nationality of theater design, and the convenience of viewing performance orientation

attractions.name: 归元禅寺
attractions.summary:
· One of the most important monasteries in Wuhan, together with Baotong Temple, Xilian Temple and Zhengjue Temple, is called the four jungles of Wuhan.  
It is the daily custom of many Wuhan citizens to come to Guiyuan Temple to pray for blessings. Every year on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, hundreds of thousands of pilgrims come here to grab the first incense. 
· Enter the Arhat Hall, start with any 　 Arhat, and count to your actual age in sequence. The identity, expression and movements of the counted Arhat indicate your fate.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the famous temple of the golden arhat

attractions.name: 汉阳江滩
attractions.summary: Hanyang River Beach is located 50 meters east of Binjiang Avenue in Hanyang, Wuhan, starting from Qingchuan Pavilion and ending at Jiangang Shipyard, with a total length of 1,424 meters and an area of 90,000 square meters. Hanyang Jiangtan Swimming Pool is also the top swimming pool with the largest scale, the most advanced equipment and the richest amusement projects in Hanyang.

attractions.name: 鹦鹉洲长江大桥
attractions.summary: The Yingwuzhou Yangtze River Bridge is located upstream of the Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge, connecting the Meijiashan Interchange in Wuchang and the Ink Lake North Road in Hanyang. It is a major passage connecting the urban areas of Hanyang and Wuchang. The bridge body is orange red, like a giant dragon lying horizontally on the Yangtze River, which is quite spectacular. The Yingwu Zhou Yangtze River Bridge is the eighth Yangtze River bridge in Wuhan, and also a three tower four span suspension bridge. The main bridge is about 9.3 kilometers long, with a two-way eight lane bridge deck and a wide and flat surface. There are over one meter wide observation walkways on both sides of the bridge, allowing tourists to walk up close and enjoy the view of the bridge. On the railing of the bridge, there are exquisitely carved painting boards installed at regular intervals, featuring 15 different styles including Panlong Ancient Rhyme, Chu Phoenix Soaring, High Mountains and Flowing Water, White Clouds and Yellow Cranes, with a strong Chu charm. Full text 

attractions.name: 大禹神话园
attractions.summary: Dayu Myth Garden is a part of Hanyang River Beach in Wuhan. It is located on the Yangtze River Beach between Qingchuan Pavilion in Hanyang and Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge. It is a landscape garden with the theme of Dayu myth sculpture. The Dayu Myth Garden is about 400 meters long and 60 meters wide. It is divided into four parts: the upper, middle and lower areas and the Chinese Flood Culture Exhibition Hall: the upper area: from the north side of Hanyang Bridge Head of the Yangtze River Bridge to the south side of the Dayu Sacrificial Platform (now the box-type waterproof wall of the river embankment), it consists of jade-faced portraits, Shuanglong Gate, bronze sculptures of "Yinglong Painting the River and Sea" and Yu Fu Gun's flood control. Central District: Centered on the Dayu Sacrificial Platform and the connected circular Jiuding Square, it consists of "Cutting Yu Sheng", "Fighting Xiangliu", Yu Yue Jiuding bronze sculpture and round sculpture of "Can't enter the house three times", as well as a series of high reliefs of myths and legends of Dayu's water control in northern China. These sculptures can be called treasures, among which "Dayu's water control in the north" is the largest high relief in China at present. Lower District: From the Taipei side of Dayu's sacrifice to the river beach on the outer wall of Qingchuan Pavilion Scenic Area, it is composed of scattered chain stone carvings such as Dayu's southern water control myth, seal Lantian stone carvings, and 6-meter-high Zhenjiang pillar. China Flood Culture Exhibition Hall: about 80 meters long, facing Xima Long Street in Hanyang, with bluestone floor, with an exhibition hall of 800 square meters.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a Chinese flood culture exhibition hall

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖南路凌波门
attractions.name_en: Lingbo Gate, South East Lake Road
attractions.summary: The former Lingbomen Trestle Bridge is one of the favorite places for Wu Da students, and it also carries the cultural memory of Wu Da students. In 2012, the trestle was demolished due to potential safety hazards in wild swimming. After several twists and turns, Lingbo Gate was renovated again in May this year, and it became an East Lake scenic spot where surrounding students and foreign tourists rushed to set foot. On the shore of Lingbomen, East Lake, a stone tablet about 2 meters high was erected with the words "Lingbomen Swimming Pool" engraved on it. The back of the stone tablet details the "past lives" of Lingbo Gate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Not to miss East Lake attractions

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 楚天台
attractions.summary: Chutiantai is a landmark building in Moshan, which is comparable to the three famous buildings in the south of the Yangtze River. Chutiantai is built in the shape of antique Zhanghuatai, with a height of 35.26 meters. A copper phoenix with a height of 1.2 meters is placed on the roof. More than 600 pieces of natural marble are inlaid on the front wall to form the pattern of "Chutian Wonderland Danfeng Chaoyang", which is unique in Chutian. Chu Tiantai regularly performs chime music and dance every day, and displays a large number of imitations of cultural relics unearthed in Chu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built in the shape of antique Zhanghuatai

attractions.name: 武汉东湖海洋世界
attractions.summary: Wuhan Donghu Ocean World is located by the 5A level scenic spot of Donghu Lake. The building covers an area of 30000 square meters and showcases over a thousand species and more than ten thousand rare marine fish. The entire exhibition hall consists of the Tropical Rainforest Pavilion, Underwater Tunnel, Marine Biology Pavilion, Dreamy Jellyfish Pavilion, Ocean Theater, and more. We are currently upgrading and renovating the aquarium with the concept of understanding, understanding, loving, and protecting the ocean. We have introduced the Jiaolong IP and added themed venues such as the Shark Pavilion, Arctic Pavilion, Coral Pavilion, Specimen Pavilion, Science and Technology Pavilion, and Boutique Pavilion. Entering the East Lake Ocean World, you can have intimate conversations with thousands of marine creatures, enjoy the mystery and unfathomability of the Amazon rainforest, the profound and mysterious underwater landscape, the humor and wit of the sea beast theater, the thrilling dance of humans and sharks, and the graceful performance of mermaids. It is a large-scale dynamic marine science education base with ocean culture as its theme, integrating viewing, amusement, fun, and knowledge.

attractions.name: 落雁岛
attractions.summary: Luoyan Island is located next to Moshan Scenic Area in East Lake, Wuhan, across the lake from Chutiantai. Luoyan Island has beautiful scenery, fresh air and pleasant scenery. All buildings are made of wood, which is simple and natural, including Yinbo Building, Lovers Building, Flute Bridge and other scenic spots. There are some leisure and entertainment facilities such as fishing villages, water homes, farmhouses and resorts on the island.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the natural scenery of the original island

attractions.name: 知音号
attractions.summary: Zhiyin Hao is the world's first drifting theater created by Wuhan Culture and Tourism Group in collaboration with director Fan Yue, using a ship as a carrier. It features the multi-dimensional experiential play of the same name, "Zhiyin Hao". Unlike conventional plays, 'Zhiyin Hao' does not provide a complete main storyline, but rather creates a journey through time and space for you to travel. We will scatter every character you may encounter on your journey in the large ship, living as if they were real in various areas such as dance halls, bars, cabins, and decks on the Zhiyin ship. Between words, you can hear their stories, feel the various aspects of their lives, and have the opportunity to share your story with them. In the time of mutual exploration between you and them, meet, understand, and try to become each other's' kindred spirits'. Boarding the ship, you will embark on a real journey as a sailor on the Yangtze River with every character on the Zhiyin ship. Go aboard, actually you are also the one who brought the story onto the ship Full text 

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 蔡林记(胭脂路店)
attractions.summary: Cai Linji is a famous time-honored snack bar in Wuhan, famous for Hot dry noodles. Rouge Road Store is one of Cai Linji's branches. It provides authentic Wuhan snacks, such as Hot dry noodles, bean skins, soup bags, etc., and is a good place to experience Wuhan local cuisine.

Citic Architectural Design and Research Institute dining hall

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

restaurants.name_en: Qingang Seafood Plaza Hall 3 Seafood Restaurant

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: Mother River of Changsha

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 火宫殿牌楼
attractions.summary: The Fire Palace Archway is located at 127 Pozi Street, Changsha. The archway was originally the gatehouse of Qianyuan Palace. It was first built in the 12th year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty and was renovated in the 6th year of the Daoguang reign. The archway is made of bricks, and the roof is a "mountain" shaped pavilion tower building. The walls are decorated with dragons, phoenixes, and human reliefs. It is now a cultural relic protection unit in Changsha City.

attractions.name: 湖南博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the mystery exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- The largest comprehensive historical and art museum in Hunan Province, with a rich collection of cultural relics, particularly featuring the artifacts from the Mawangdui Han tomb, and bronzeware from the Shang and Zhou dynasties.
- The exhibits include gauzy, feather-light silk garments, perfectly preserved printed cotton robes, painted lacquerware, silk paintings, as well as various wooden figurines, musical instruments, weapons, and more.
- The exhibition includes a female corpse and her internal organs preserved in the basement, a restored giant coffin, and the remains of tomb pit No. 3 and mound No. 2 from the Mawangdui site.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the artifacts of the Mawangdui Han Tomb

attractions.name: 长沙市博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Changsha Museum is located in Changsha Riverside Cultural Park Scenic Area (Xinhe Delta), Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province. 
Changsha Museum is a national first-class museum and a comprehensive geographical museum, which integrates the functions of cultural relics collection, protection research, exhibition and publicity, and educational services. 
Changsha Museum was established in 1986, and the new museum opened on December 28th, 2015. The building is 5 floors high and has a building area of about 24,000 square meters. 
According to the official website of the Museum in March 2020, Changsha Museum has an exhibition area of about 9,000 square meters; There are more than 50,000 pieces (sets) of cultural relics in the collection, covering all kinds of objects that confirm the historical and cultural development of Changsha from Paleolithic Age to modern times, including Shang and Zhou bronzes, Chu and Han cultural relics, Changsha kiln porcelain of Tang Dynasty and modern cultural relics that can show the history of Changsha; Changsha Museum has two basic exhibitions: Changsha Ancient History and Culture Exhibition and Changsha Modern History and Culture Exhibition, and regularly updates special exhibitions and exchange exhibitions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Poetry Appreciation Gallery

attractions.name: 烈士公园
attractions.summary:
Martyrs Park is the largest park in Changsha, which is divided into three parts: memorial area, tourist area and entertainment area. The memorial area is centered on the Martyrs' Tower built in 1958 and surrounded by pine trees, making it majestic and majestic. 
The tourist area has an open terrain, with mountains and lakes, red flowers and green willows; There are amusement parks in the recreation district in the southeast, stocked with a variety of modern rides. There are also "Chaolou" and "Xianxian Pavilion" in the park for visitors to rest, and they sell Hunan-style snacks and various refreshments.

attractions.name: 湖南美术馆
attractions.summary: The Hunan Art Museum is located on the west bank of the Xiang River and at the foot of Yuelu Mountain, covering an area of over 50000 square meters and a building area of over 24700 square meters. The architectural spatial pattern is based on the basic image of "Three Xiangs and Four Waters". The main building adopts environmentally friendly and innovative customized ceramic panels in reddish brown and white colors, which are integrated with the surrounding environment. It is both thick, ancient and simple, showcasing the unique charm of Hunan's cultural heritage and red cultural genes. Full text 

attractions.name: 炭河古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Hi Play Park; Theme Parks; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
Tanhe Ancient City is a living ancient city of the Western Zhou Dynasty, located in Ningxiang City, Changsha, Hunan Province, the land of Siyang Fangzun. 
Dozens of high-tech experience projects in the scenic spot, such as da ji Ghost Haunted House, Prince Ghost Listening Room, Western Zhou Film Museum, da ji Charm, Jiang Taigong Calling the Wind and Rain Spell Hall, and Harem Experience Hall, are surprised again and again. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Charcoal River" is the soul of Ningxiang culture. It takes the splendid history and culture of the Western Zhou Dynasty as the background, and takes the legendary story of the country's heavy weapon "Four Sheep Fang Zun" as the main line. There are women's beauties, the lingering sorrow of life and death, the sorrow and anger of family enmity and country enmity, and the fierce ambition of Wu Wang's defeat of Zhou, which reproduces the love-hate relationship 3,000 years ago. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as Chime Music and Dance, Throwing Hydrangea in Colorful Building, Crossing Flash in the Western Zhou Dynasty, da ji's Charm, and Liu Hai's Chopping Wood. 
Charcoal River Ancient City, give me one day and return you a thousand years!

attractions.name: 炭河里国家考古遗址公园
attractions.summary: The Tanhe River Bronze Museum is located in Ningxiang City, which is known as the "hometown of peace". It officially opened on September 30, 2016 and is a bronze culture themed museum. The museum has a building area of 8662 square meters and a total of 5027 cultural relics, including 4 first-class cultural relics, 6 second-class cultural relics, 176 third class cultural relics, and 4841 general cultural relics. The museum displays bronze artifacts unearthed in Ningxiang as carriers and relies on the archaeological achievements of the Tanhe River site. Following the exhibition theme of "The Development History of Chinese Bronze Civilization - The Reproduction of the Tanhe River Country - Interpretation of Bronze Civilization", it reproduces the glorious history of the Tanhe River in Ningxiang during the Shang and Zhou dynasties.

attractions.name: 华谊兄弟(长沙)电影小镇
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Film and TV studio base; Film Studios; Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The town is located within the Changsha Xiangjiang New District Dawangshan Tourism Resort. The first phase of the project is the Italian town, which consists of Venice, the Water City, and Assisi, the Mountain City. It integrates scenes from Huayi Film and TV, blending the urban characteristics and architectural style of an Italian town. The buildings and roads in the area are mainly arranged in a linear layout, and the planning utilizes the existing natural terrain to reshape the mountainous geography of the site, thereby creating the classic appearance of an Italian town. The area also features Italian-style dining, handicrafts, tourist products, and traditional workshops, offering an interactive experience with a pure Italian style.
attractions.shortFeatures: Comprehensive cultural and tourism scenic area with a film theme

attractions.name: 天心阁
attractions.summary: Tianxin Pavilion is a city tower in the ancient city of Changsha, and the surrounding city walls are the only section of ancient city walls in Changsha. There is also a archway near Tianxin Pavilion called "Chonglie Gate", built in 1946 to commemorate the soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the three major battles in Changsha during the Anti Japanese War. Tianxin Pavilion is located within Tianxin Park and was first built in the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1746). The Tianxin Pavilion that tourists see today was rebuilt in 1983. The main building of Tianxin Pavilion is chargeable (including Tianxin Pavilion and the surrounding ancient city walls), while Tianxin Park is open for free. The overall architecture of Tianxin Pavilion is supported by 46 red painted columns, chestnut tiles and pink walls, and a solid gray white stone foundation. 62 stone lions are carved on the stone railings in front and behind the pavilion, and 32 wind horses and copper bells are hung on the pavilion, making a sound in the wind. There is a screening room next to the Tianxin Pavilion, which shows a film about the history of Tianxin Pavilion every hour, with a duration of about 7 minutes (equipment maintenance on Monday afternoon). The paid area also provides explanation services. Across from Tianxin Pavilion is the Bamboo Slips Museum, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 五一广场
attractions.summary: Wuyi Square is located in Furong District, Changsha City, with convenient transportation, numerous high-rise buildings and shops, integrating multiple functions such as tourism, vacation, leisure, and daily life.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 古石城
attractions.summary:
It is said that the ancestors of Ancient Stone City ran to the mountains to escape the war and gradually became a village. Therefore, the whole village was the descendant of one ancestor, and now there are hundreds of people. Houses are built with local materials, so almost all of them are stone houses, stone roads, stone wells and stone flat. Stone City has a long history, and its construction date is still a mystery. It is one of the best preserved ancient cities in Guangxi. 
Along the mountain road, you can enjoy the karst landform from a commanding position. You can find villagers' homes cooking farm dishes in Shitouzhai or Dayantou Village. After eating, continue to walk east, pass through Daping Village and Shuiyanmen Mountain to Xianggong Mountain, which is one of the best shooting spots of Lijiang River. There is a platform on the top of the mountain, which is a relatively easy mountain to climb. The best shooting time is 6:00, and it is a good place to watch the sunrise of the mountains of Lijiang River and the first bay of Lijiang River.

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 漓江四星游船
attractions.summary: The basic situation of the cruise ship is that the Li River cruise ship has been upgraded and upgraded. Taking into account the tourist experience and psychological expectations, strict regulations have been made for the per capita cabin area, passenger seat specifications, cabin dining table specifications, and per capita area of the walking deck of the upgraded cruise ship. In addition, fabric soft wrapped sofas are used, which greatly improve comfort and aesthetics compared to ordinary cruise ships. And high material standards are required for the decoration and renovation of the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. of the cruise ship, and clear regulations are made for the replacement period of curtains, tablecloths, and other decorations, creating a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. The sanitary facilities are fully equipped with advanced technology, and the humanized detail design is comprehensive. The four-star cruise ship has a double decker cabin layout and decoration, with the first floor being a business cabin (second-class), and the per capita area in the tourist cabin not less than 1.8 square meters; The second floor is a luxury business cabin (first-class cabin), with a per capita area of no less than 2.5 square meters in the tourist cabin; The ship is equipped with a double deck walking deck with a wide view and a per capita area of not less than 1.4 square meters. The deck is equipped with sunshades and resting tables and chairs; There are 1.2m high aluminum alloy safety guardrails around. The cabin floor is made of high wear-resistant wood flooring and high-end carpets, while the ceiling and wall panels are made of wood and honeycomb aluminum plate materials, with exquisite craftsmanship. The cabin decoration is beautiful and elegant, reflecting cultural connotations or ethnic characteristics, decorated with flowers and green plants. The cabin dining table is made of elm wood and water chestnut materials, with carved decorations. The tourist seats are designed with armrests, which are comfortable and stylish. The double decker cabin provides both Chinese and Western style buffet meals or customized special dining options for tourists. The tableware and tea utensils are made of high-quality ceramic materials and are equipped with matching tableware for both Chinese and Western cuisine. There are also mini bars to meet the entertainment needs of different tourists. Each row of seats or table is equipped with a tablet computer near the window sill, which can provide a series of intelligent services such as Guilin tourism information, entertainment, and ordering. It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades.

attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth".

attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 阳朔月亮山风景区
attractions.summary: Moon Mountain is a unique scenery within Yangshuo, located at the end of the Ten Mile Gallery landscape belt. Moon Mountain is an arched peak with a large hole running through it below the top, resembling a bright moon that blends seamlessly with nature. Looking at this Moon Mountain from different angles, the shape of this cave constantly changes, which is very interesting. Moon Mountain is about 380 meters high, and visitors can follow an 800 level hiking trail to reach the Moon Cave at the top of the mountain. The Moon Cave has a large area, with a height and width of 50 meters each, while the mountain walls are only a few meters thick. The top of the cave is covered with stalactites of various shapes, two of which resemble Wu Gang and Jade Rabbit in the Moon Palace. In fact, Moon Mountain can be admired from a distance. Across from the scenic area, there is a rest area with a gathering of restaurants, which is one of the locations where you can view Moon Mountain from afar. Due to its unique geological environment, Moon Mountain has also become a gathering place for rock climbing enthusiasts.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.

You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 朝天门广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the "Top Ten Cultural Symbols of Chongqing", it is located at the intersection of Jialing River and Yangtze River in Yuzhong Peninsula, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the hub of the two rivers and the largest waterway passenger terminal in Chongqing. 
· Chaotianmen was once one of the seventeen ancient city gates in Chongqing, where the Three Gorges cruise ships, sightseeing cruise ships and ferries to Foreigner Street all departed.  
The night view of Chaotianmen is also very beautiful. The lights are turned on at night, which is particularly beautiful. In front of you is the brightly lit pier, and there are flowery cruise ships shuttling around. 
· And this is also the "zero kilometer" point sign of Chongqing Highway, which will be located in Chaotianmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient Wharf in Chongqing

attractions.name: 重庆两江游
attractions.summary: Without admiring the night view, I haven't been to Chongqing. The Two Rivers Tour of Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous night view of Chongqing. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. The colorful lights reflect in the river, and the flowing lights are particularly tempting. The buildings of different heights along the river are arranged in a staggered manner under the illumination of the lights. And now there are also daytime boat trips available, where you can not only enjoy the night view of Chongqing, but also admire the unique landmarks of Chongqing during the day. Full text 

attractions.name: 重庆WFC会仙楼观景台
attractions.summary: The WFC Huixianlou Observation Deck is located on floors 73-75 of WFC and was officially unveiled on June 8, 2017, perfectly presenting the past and present of Huixianlou. In the early 1980s, the Huixianlou Observation Deck was the first high-altitude observation deck in Chongqing and was known as the "pinnacle of Chongqing". The WFC Huixianlou Observation Deck overlooks the core urban landscapes of Chongqing, including the confluence of two rivers, the Grand Theater, the night view of Nanbin Road, a tree viewing platform, two river cruise ships, and the three-dimensional night view of the mountain city. While enjoying a visual feast, one can also experience the unique geographical wonders of Chongqing, pursue the cultural symbols that belong to Chongqing, and bloom the charm of Chongqing. WFC Hui Xian Lou Observation Deck 73-74 floors offer a 360 degree modern and innovative viewing experience; The 75 story fully open-air design allows you to admire the dazzling starry sky and contemplate the vast universe. It can also be used as a filming location for wedding photos, commercial films, and movies; Fashion show venue; Cold buffet and cocktail parties can choose venues; A must visit place for travel. Has hosted five international and Chengdu Chongqing high-rise building competitions, the first cloud based collective wedding in Yuzhong District in 2023, and won awards such as the 2019 Cloud based Scenic Spot and the 2022 Landmark Attraction. The first height of WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck | Unparalleled View WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck, with an altitude of 590 meters, stands proudly on the Yuzhong Peninsula, bringing you an extraordinary visual feast at such a height. 360 ° panoramic view of the confluence of the two rivers and the seventeen bridges spanning the Yangtze River and Jialing River, allowing you to experience the unique urban panorama of the magical mountain city and the ever-changing urban changes of Chongqing. L Core Area | Location can not be copied WFC Huixianlou Sightseeing Platform, which is located in the core area of Yuzhong Peninsula, the mother city of Chongqing. It is the closest viewing platform to Monument to the people's Liberation, echoing the landmark landscapes such as Chongqing Grand Theater and Nanbin Road from afar. Whether tourists from all over the country or native citizens, it is easy to reach by light rail, public transport or other means of transportation. There are more than 800 parking spaces in the underground garage, which is convenient for self driving. L Past Life | History Can't Replace WFC Huixian Tower Sightseeing Platform is located on the 73-75 floors of Chongqing World Financial Center. WFC was the tallest Huixian Tower in Chongqing in the past, built in the 1980s, and the first high-rise in Chongqing higher than Monument to the people's Liberation. The location of Huixian Tower, formerly known as Huixian Bridge, was the birthplace of Chongqing's fashion industry in the 1920s. It once saw the emergence of high-end venues such as the Old Paris Barber Shop, Queen's Dance Hall, and Heart Caf é. On the 73rd floor of the WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck, a large number of old photos and maps of Chongqing are displayed. The mottled old time is condensed in each frame, showcasing the changes in Chongqing's history and the past and present of Huixian Tower from a temporal and spatial perspective, allowing the charm of Chongqing's city to be fully revealed. Although the graffiti is old, there are few people here and it is quiet, so you can take photos casually. 
Near Tuya Street is Sichuan Academy of Fine Arts. There are two places in the school that you can't miss, one is the art gallery and the other is the tank warehouse.

attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale graffiti art group

attractions.name: 山城步道
attractions.summary: The so-called trail refers to a city path that can only be walked on. Chongqing is a city built in the mountains, with many adjacent areas having a drop of several tens of meters, and transportation can only rely on urban trails that climb uphill and uphill. In the past, some famous trails were bustling, and many old ruins in Chongqing are located next to these trails. With the large-scale renovation of old cities and improvement of transportation conditions, these trails have gradually lost their function, and some have disappeared or become deserted. Some famous ruins in the surrounding area are slowly being forgotten by people and disappearing into the long river of history The repaired third trail is one of its representatives. This trail is located on the southern slope of the Yuzhong Peninsula, running from north to south, passing through Zhongshan Hospital, Kangjian Hall, Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, the former site of the French Renai Hall, and the suspended boardwalk. It is 1748 meters long and compactly connects a series of traditional neighborhoods and historical and cultural relics. The higher point of the trail is near the Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, and the lower point is at the entrance of Shancheng Lane, with a height difference of 79.5 meters. It is a mountain city trail with distinctive features of Chongqing city.

attractions.name: 重庆十八梯传统风貌区
attractions.summary: The land area of the Eighteen Stairs Traditional Style Area project is about 88 acres, with a construction area of about 170000 square meters and a total investment scale of over 2 billion yuan. According to the project positioning, it will rely on the cultural and tourism resources of Chongqing's "mother city", integrate and develop the modern cultural tourism industry, and build it into a characteristic cultural tourism demonstration zone, a cultural exhibition window for Chongqing facing the international community, and become an international cultural tourism destination. Integrating the four functions of commerce, scenery, tourism, and culture, presenting a panoramic view of Chongqing's 800 year history and cultural life in the region, and creating a strong experiential cultural and tourism commercial demonstration base. Chongqing Shibati Traditional Scenic Area, centering on "urban sightseeing", "intangible heritage inheritance" and "cultural creativity experience", and combining the industrial positioning of modern service industries such as "night economy", realizes the development of panoramic experience of "culture+tourism", "culture+commerce", "culture+creativity", and "culture+cross-border", and plans four characteristic areas of traditional cultural experience, China-Chic cultural and creative experience, international exchange center, and lifestyle center. Traditional Culture Experience (AB Zone) is based on the traditional folk culture, urban culture, and historical architectural culture of Bayu, creating an open cultural experience block that integrates cultural leisure, cultural sightseeing, and dining and accommodation, deeply attracting foreign tourists. Introduce Sichuan Chongqing hotpot, characteristic Jianghu cuisine, boutique Chongqing cuisine, specialty snacks, and other intangible cultural heritage displays to showcase the unique charm of "Chongqing flavor" and the Ba Yu culture. Use inherited and innovative handicraft products, refined and developed tourism products, and unique cultural IP derivatives to show China-Chic fashion culture and deeply attract literary and art customers. Introduce China-Chic brand, innovative retail, boutique accessories, craft gifts, theme coffee bars, and show the charm of China-Chic's cultural creativity with a variety of China-Chic brands. The D District International Exchange Center (open in 2022) integrates multiple functions such as international diversified culture, tourism service distribution, and city brand reception, creating an international exchange center that deeply attracts high-end consumers at home and abroad. The area plans to introduce cultural exhibitions, retail, catering and other formats, as well as cross-border flagship stores for brands, automotive concept experience stores, digital experience stores, fashion and cultural creativity, international trends, Michelin and Black Pearl foreign cuisine restaurants, and other brands showcasing distinctive culture, creating an international cultural exchange space. The Lifestyle Center (E Zone) (opened in 2022) integrates various functions such as nighttime economic demonstration gathering, personalized leisure consumption, and open youth socialization, showcasing exquisite lifestyles and deeply attracting young consumer groups. The area plans to introduce leisure and entertainment, retail, catering and other formats, with a focus on introducing cultural performances, specialty bars, themed pubs, international catering chains and other characteristic brands, creating a "late night canteen" that fits multiple taste experiences, and creating a leisure and entertainment street that integrates catering and trendy culture, activating the city's night economy. attractions.name: 南山一棵树观景台
attractions.summary: The Nanshan Tree Observation Deck is located on Nanshan Mountain in Nan'an District, Chongqing. It includes a tree observation pavilion and a wilderness leisure area, and can accommodate thousands of people at the same time. It is one of the places to enjoy the night view of the mountain city. Standing on the observation deck, looking from afar, the lights of thousands of households in Yuzhong District, Chongqing; Surrounded by two rivers, shining brightly; A long bridge spanning over, with a clear outline; The entire city, layered and arranged in a staggered and colorful manner, is magnificent and dazzling against the backdrop of the night sky.

- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.

attractions.summary: Happy Coast is a part of OCT, with water as its theme. Qushui Bay integrates restaurants, bars, traditional and modern buildings, making it a commercial area that combines shopping, dining, and entertainment. There are shopping centers, ocean dream halls, and joyful coastal water show theaters. Among them, the Ocean Dream Pavilion is currently the only oceanarium in the center of Shenzhen. The Water Show Theater will have a deep blue secret water show performance, and in the evening, there will be a music fountain, which is very exciting.

attractions.name: 东门老街
attractions.summary: Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
