attractions.name: 观澜海洋世界
attractions.summary: Guanlan Ocean World is a marine themed world that integrates science popularization, worship, interactive interpretation, and parent-child interactive experience of marine life. 10 major themes, 10000 super large venues, 1000 underwater creatures, and tens of thousands of fish gather together for a feast. The total construction area of the museum is about 10000 square meters, and the entire venue is divided into two floors. Level 1: Lost World, Walking into the Cabin, Underwater Tunnel, Mermaid Performance Theater, Jellyfish Maze, Sea Lion Performance Theater, Tropical Rainforest, Joker Performance Happy Theater, Outdoor Cute Pet Area, Maya Light. Second floor: Indoor Mengchong Amusement Park and Cai Yuzhilin Interactive Feeding Area. Recommended photo spots: On the first floor of the underwater tunnel, various fish that are usually hidden in the deep sea swim overhead, including the terrifying devil fish and piranhas from tropical rainforests - three must see theaters in the Amazon River in South America: Mermaid Theater, Sea Lion Performance Theater, and Joyful Theater. Two special areas: Maya Light and Jellyfish Maze. Two interactive areas: cute pet interaction and clown performance interaction.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.

attractions.summary: Gaozhuang Night Market in Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan Province is a charming and charming night market in Xishuangbanna. The colorful umbrellas in the Starlight Night Market are very distinctive, including the imported Thai Golden Pagoda, which is a very exquisite Buddhist pagoda and a major highlight. In addition, there are handicrafts from Southeast Asian countries, Dai pottery, specialty snacks, etc. in the Shuangjing area of Gaozhuang West, which can be purchased as souvenirs. Due to its unique climate, stalls can be set up all year round in Xishuangbanna. The Gaozhuang Night Market in Xishuangbanna is not only a gathering place for artistic youth, but also a good place for tourists to buy souvenirs.

attractions.name_en: The Great Pagoda Temple of Jinghong
attractions.summary: Jinghong Pagoda, also known as Myanmar Pagoda, is located next to the roundabout of Xuanwei Avenue in Jiangbei section of Cangjiang New District, Jinghong City. The Jinghong Golden Pagoda stands at 66.6 meters tall, symbolizing the connection of one river to six countries. The four small pagodas are solid pagodas, while the large pagoda serves as the Beiye Jing Museum. It has two levels of usable space and four entrances in the east, west, north, and south directions. Around the central tower pillar, there is a worship of Zhou Buddha for visitors to pray for blessings.

It is the only floating market with Southeast Asian customs in China. Visitors can also shuttle through the floating market by boat and experience the floating market by boating.

attractions.summary:
- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.summary: The Mekong Underwater World is a virtual panoramic immersive aquarium built around aquatic animals and tropical rainforests in the Mekong River. It is located in the Xishuangbanna Primitive Forest Park, a national 4A level tourist attraction, covering an area of over 5000 square meters. There is also a "Blueberry Six Cute Group" composed of star species of the Mekong River underwater world - Chinese sturgeon, jellyfish, otter, giant catfish, brown wrinkled tree frog, and Siamese giant carp, taking you into a primitive forest deep underwater world and experiencing a magical journey of the Mekong River Elf Dream Kingdom.

attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 西双版纳总佛寺
attractions.summary:
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple is the center for Buddhist believers in Xishuangbanna to worship Buddha, and it is also the highest-ranking Buddhist temple in Xishuangbanna. 
The general Buddhist temple is magnificent, with exquisite beams and columns carved, mainly including Weihan Hall, Buddhist College teaching building and other buildings. 
There is an altar in front of the north wall of today's courtyard building, where there are several Buddha statues, and the Buddha's Sutra is painted on the wall. 
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple and Manting Park are connected, and tourists usually enter the General Buddhist Temple from Manting Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beams and columns are beautifully carved, and the architecture is magnificent

attractions.name: 基诺山寨
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
Jinuo Shanzhai is a place where Jinuo people live in concentrated communities, and it is the only live performing arts experience place in China that shows Jinuo culture in the most comprehensive and concentrated way. 
The performances in the scenic spot are concentrated in the Sun Square in the center of the stockade. Young men and women dressed in Jinuo costumes are singing and dancing with props in hand, which is magnificent. 
You can eat the unique local barbecue, enjoy the performances with rich ethnic customs and experience the rich Jinuo folk customs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery and feel the Jinuo customs

attractions.name: 基诺山雨林徒步
attractions.summary: Entering the depths of Baopiao Village in the rain forest of Jinuo Mountain, one can see the phenomenon of huge tree roots, tall trees that cover the sky, traditional Chinese herbs in tropical rainforests, dripping leaf tips, flower growth in old trees, parasitic epiphytes and other wonders along the way. Along the 2-kilometer upstream challenge section, plant identification is carried out, water is taken from the rainforest, and several kilometers of mountain climbing sections are completed.

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 观前街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Located in the center of Suzhou ancient city, the area is prosperous in commerce, famous shops gather and numerous historic sites. There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering many Suzhou specialties

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 广东省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
The new museum was completed in 2010. It is the only provincial comprehensive museum in Guangdong Province, a patriotic education base and social practice base in Guangzhou. 
Guangdong's history, culture, art and nature are the three main exhibition directions, which are divided into four parts: history museum, nature museum, art museum and temporary exhibition hall. 
More precious exhibits include "baleen whale skeleton", "giant malachite" and "Xinyi jade" weighing more than five tons in natural specimens.
attractions.shortFeatures: Treasure Box Architecture with Rich Calligraphy and Painting in Lingnan

attractions.name: 广州塔460米摩天轮
attractions.summary: The Ferris wheel is located 460 meters away from the Guangzhou Tower and is one of the popular tourist attractions in the tower. It cleverly utilizes the platform at the top of the tower and, unlike other Ferris wheels, runs on an inclined track. It is currently the tallest horizontal Ferris wheel in the world. The Ferris wheel is composed of 16 transparent crystal ball cabins that resemble sparkling pearls, slowly flowing around, and the beautiful scenery of Yangcheng unfolds before my eyes like a scroll. Sun, moon, and stars, accompanied by auspicious clouds, this place has become a romantic place for marriage proposals, allowing tourists to experience the romance at the top of the world. Full text 

attractions.name: 珠江夜游大沙头码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Dashatou Pier
attractions.summary: Dashatou Wharf of the Pearl River Night Tour is one of the main wharfs of the Pearl River Night Tour. This is the former Guangzhou water transportation hub, where a fighter jet manufactured by the revolutionary military government successfully flew, so it is of great significance. Today, all kinds of cruise ships for the Pearl River night tour are also a scenic spot of Dashatou Wharf. It is also very pleasant to start from the memorial wharf here and see the beautiful night scenes of Guangzhou Tower, Haixinsha, the Pearl River New City and other places. Full text 

attractions.name: 白云山
attractions.tag: Climbing and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Baiyun Mountain is one of the famous mountains in southern Guangdong, known as the "First Beauty of Yangcheng" and "The First Mountain of Nanyue."

· It consists of more than 30 peaks. From the summit, visitors can overlook the entire city and get a distant view of the Pearl River, making it a popular destination for spring outings.

· After rain or during the late spring season, clouds swirl around the mountain, and the name "Baiyun Mountain" (White Cloud Mountain) is derived from this phenomenon.

· The scenic area is divided into seven tourist zones: Mingzhu Tower, Moxing Ridge, Mingchun Valley, Santai Ridge, Luhu Lake, Fei'e Ridge, and Heyi Ridge.

· Visitors can also enjoy recreational activities such as grass skiing, slideways, and small bungee jumping in the scenic area.

· Baiyun Mountain is dotted with stunning rhododendrons in red, pink, and white. From a distance, the mountains are adorned with a sea of blooming flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climbing high to enjoy the scenery and admire the moonlight.

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. The West Kowloon Christmas Market offers a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts. Surrounded by the charming Victoria Harbour scenery and lush green lawns of the West Kowloon Art Park, visitors can immerse themselves in the dazzling holiday lights and enjoy melodious live music and performances. Apart from the Christmas market, visitors should not miss the "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Parade" held by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) on the West Lawn at the seaside from November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025. The giant and dazzling Christmas tree standing over 20 meters tall in the enlarged version of Christmas Town will be transformed into a giant canvas this year, with projections of different winter festival scenes added to enhance the festive atmosphere. The Christmas town of over 10000 square feet will open on November 22, and the Hong Kong Tourism Board will also stage a total of four "Winter Victoria Harbour Water Fireworks" on the opening day and from December 24 to 26, shining brightly in Victoria Harbour. attractions.name: 香港科学馆
attractions.tag: Science and Technology Museum; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary:
· The Hong Kong Science Museum opened in 1992. It is located on Science Museum Road, Tsim Sha Tsui. It is a three-storey building with a sci-fi appearance. 
· Among them, 70% of the exhibits can be touched and operated by the audience, which is suitable for bringing children to play and experience the effects of science and technology on society. 
The most striking exhibit is the 22-meter-high energy shuttle, which is located in the center of the exhibition hall of the Science Museum and runs through the fourth floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the charm of science for yourself

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 凌霄阁
attractions.summary:
Lingxiao Pavilion is the terminal of the Peak Tram, and it is also a comprehensive tourist attraction integrating climbing, viewing, shopping, dining and entertainment. 
There are 6 floors in total. The 1st-3rd floors are mainly delicious food. There are 4 different fashionable restaurants in China, West and Japan, where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery while eating. 
· It also includes important attractions such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Peak Post Office, which are also a must-check-in place for tourists to visit Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: The skyscraper enjoys the beautiful view of Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安事变纪念馆
attractions.summary: Xi'an Incident Memorial Hall is a special memorial hall built on the basis of General Zhang Xueliang Mansion and General Yang Hucheng Zhiyuan Villa, the important former sites of Xi'an Incident, with a total area of 9,141 square meters. It was built and opened to the outside world on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the Xi'an Incident in December 1986. Over the past 20 years, the museum has received nearly 2 million visitors. It has been named as the first batch of 100 patriotism education demonstration bases in China, youth patriotism education bases in Shaanxi Province and Xi'an, national defense education bases, red scarf practice education bases and one of the 100 classic red tourism scenic spots in China.

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 陕西戏曲非遗博物馆
attractions.summary: "Visit the ancient capital for thousands of years, and enjoy the tune of the Great Qin Opera!" Shaanxi Shangyou Great Qin Opera strives to create a performance place where "Qin Opera can be seen all day long in Xi'an" for tourists all over the country to experience Shaanxi's profound history and culture. Shaanxi Shangyou Qin Opera Opera: Shaanxi local opera special show, intangible cultural heritage Qin Opera Opera, Mihu Opera (Meihu), Wanwanqiang Opera (Chinese Opera), Huayin Laoqiang Opera, etc. Shaanxi Shangyou Qin Opera Opera warmly welcomes tourists from all over the country to visit and guide!

attractions.name: 书院门步行街
attractions.summary:
Xi'an people usually refer to the Academy Gate, which refers to a pedestrian street from Forest of Steles to the entrance of Guanzhong Academy. 
There is a tall archway with ancient charm at the corner of the street, with three golden characters "Academy Gate" written on it. 
There are blue antique buildings on both sides of the street, the ground is paved with bluestone, and the end of the street is the Forest of Steles.  
During the day, it is a street of calligraphy and painting, with a strong literary flavor; It is a snack street in the evening, and Xi'an is rich in characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: A pedestrian street full of books

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《复活的军团》演出
attractions.summary: The Resurrected Legion is a live immersive multimedia war epic drama in China, directed by the Chinese director Mr. Jin Tiemu, and performed in Lintong, the hometown of the Terra Cotta Warriors. The drama consists of four acts and ten scenes. Through dramas such as court discussions, conscription, mobilization, family letters, siege, sacrifice, etc., incorporating family letters to pay off ten thousand gold, children traveling thousands of miles, mother's worries, newlywed farewell, and other emotions, visitors can be deeply moved by their patriotism. War can only end the war and open up the spirit of a strong country with iron blood and peace for all. Through figuring, resurrection, epilogue and other plays, guests from all directions who come to visit the Terra Cotta Warriors can clearly understand that the eight wonders of the world, the Terra Cotta Warriors, are the soul of the Qin Dynasty, the blood of the Qin Dynasty, the unity of the Qin Dynasty, and the Qin Dynasty. The Qin figurines standing in the Qin Mausoleum Museum today are monuments to countless unknown heroes. These ordinary Qin people created the unified Qin state, and our writing comes from the Qin people. Our territory is the continuation of the Qin Empire, and our unified Chinese nation began to form during the Qin Empire period. They are connected to our bloodline

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 小雁塔(荐福寺)
attractions.summary: The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located inside Jianfu Temple, named after its shape resembling the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and being smaller than it. Compared to the hustle and bustle of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the Small Wild Goose Pagoda is much quieter. Under the Small Wild Goose Pagoda, there are many exquisite stone sculptures from various dynasties, such as stone Buddhas, stone lions, stone horses, and horse tie stakes, placed outdoors. Tourists who enjoy folk cultural relics should not miss them. The Little Wild Goose Pagoda was built during the reign of Tang Jinglong (707 AD) to accommodate the "eminent monk Yijing" who came back from India to translate Buddhist scriptures. At the beginning of its construction, it had fifteen floors, but due to multiple earthquakes, it now has thirteen floors. There are wooden stairs inside the tower that spiral upwards to reach the top of the tower. Jianfu Temple was founded in the first year of Tang Ruizong's civilization (684 AD), originally located in Kaihua Fang, Chang'an City, Tang Dynasty. It was later destroyed and rebuilt at its current address. The temple preserves a large iron bell cast in 1192 AD (the third year of the Jin Mingchang era). In the Qing Dynasty, the bell would ring here every morning, which is the famous "Yanta Morning Bell". Nowadays, on New Year's Day every year, there is an event held here to ring bells and pray for blessings. In 2007, the Xi'an Museum was built inside the Jianfu Temple, adding a lake surface and new landscaping.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 德福巷
attractions.summary: Defu Lane is a famous bar street in Xi'an city. Defu Lane was originally an old residential area, which gradually became a leisure and cultural street in the 1990s. At the entrance of the alley stands a magnificent three door stone archway, with large blocks of bluestone paving the path on both sides, and antique buildings arranged in a staggered manner. On the streets less than 200 meters long, one after another, there are coffee shops, bars, and tea houses of all sizes, all named with a certain atmosphere. Nowadays, Defu Lane and the antique Shuyuanmen Ancient Culture Street complement each other from east to west, becoming a street with a very "foreign flavor" in the traditional cultural area.

attractions.name: 湘子庙
attractions.summary: The Xiangzi Temple near the south gate of Xi'an is said to be the former residence of Han Xiangzi, one of the Eight Immortals, and also the place where he became a monk. Therefore, throughout history, Xi'an Xiangzi Temple has been the birthplace of Xiangzi culture. Xiangzi Temple is still the existing Taoist ancestral temple in Xi'an city. Xiangzi Temple consists of a temple area, a south courtyard, and a north courtyard. It is said that this is the inner courtyard of the official residence of Han Yu, the uncle of Han Xiangzi. In order to practice and cultivate his nature, an underground secret room was once built here, also known as Xiangzi Cave, where he practiced and nurtured his nature. Decades ago, while digging an air raid shelter inside the Xiangzi Temple, a dark room was discovered, which is said to be the Xiangzi Cave from that time.
