attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿鸣谷
attractions.summary: Luming Valley is a narrow valley in the northeasternmost part of Nianhua Bay, a Zen town. It is the first petal of the "five petals" in the "Eight Views of Lotus". The trees here are towering, quiet and quiet, and it is a natural landscape with deep flowers and trees in Zen rooms. The name of Luming Valley is due to a thousand-year-old story. It is said that when the Tang monk came back from the Buddha's scriptures, he passed by here, and released two sacred deer brought back from the Luyeyuan of Buddha in Tianzhu Kingdom into the mountain forest. Up to now, there is a clear pool called "Lumian Pond" deep in the mountain bay. The Zen life here is therefore vividly called "Ming Sleeping Zen". There is Luming Tea House in Luming Valley, which is used to receive high-end tea parties or customized meditation activities of private and enterprises.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a retreat meditation temple

attractions.name: 梵天花海
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay "Brahma Flower Sea" is backed by mountains, and there is a clear river flowing in the sea of flowers. There is an elegant and vast sea of auspicious flowers here, which smudges Zen in time. Bright yellow sulfur chrysanthemum, pink zinnia, delicate drunken butterfly flower, one color flower, blindly Zen, interpret beauty and contain goodness. Flowers bloom all over the mountains, swaying gently, time is quiet and happiness is full.
attractions.shortFeatures: A sea of colorful flowers can be seen during flowering period

attractions.name: 拈花湾禅行表演
attractions.name_en: nian hua wan chan xing biao yan
attractions.summary: Zen walking performance is an important cultural activity in Nianhua Bay, aimed at providing tourists with a spiritual baptism through the influence of Zen culture. The performance lasts from 18:00 to 20:50 every day, providing visitors with an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of Zen culture and experience Zen life. In addition, Nianhua Bay also has other exciting night performances, such as "Nianhua Smile" night performance, "Water Curtain Dance", "Bright Tower Ceremony" and "Five Lakes Blooming Flowers" night performances, which are held at different locations and times, providing tourists with diverse cultural experiences. Nianhua Bay is not only a tourist attraction, but also a place that can purify and relax the soul. Through these cultural performances, tourists can deeply feel the charm and connotation of Zen culture.

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 九龙灌浴
attractions.summary:
Kowloon Bath, located in the square of Lingshan Giant Buddha, is the largest musical dynamic bronze sculpture group in China, telling the story of Sakyamuni's birth. 
· This is a major landscape of Lingshan Scenic Spot. With the accompaniment of music, the opening and closing of lotus flowers, and the Prince Buddha slowly rises from it, it rotates around in the water curtain formed by the water spray of Jiulong. 
· There are five performances a day. After the performances, the dragon mouth around the square will spray merit water, which visitors can take away; If you want to watch the bathing show in Kowloon, you can choose a location in advance.
attractions.shortFeatures: Giant bronze sculpture of lotus in bud

attractions.name: 灵山大佛
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue

attractions.name: 五印坛城
attractions.summary:
--Wuyin Mandala City stands in the rippling sea of perfume, complementing Lingshan Brahma Palace and Manfeilong Pagoda. It is a unique and authentic Tibetan cultural landscape. 
--What is displayed here is the Tibetan Buddhist culture. Although it is not as magnificent as the Brahma Palace, it is also extremely gorgeous. The mandala is dedicated to five Buddhas in five directions, and its appearance is solemn and brilliant. 
--Walking into the mandala, visitors can not only appreciate all kinds of Buddhist cultural and artistic treasures from all over Tibet, but also participate in interactive folk activities such as lighting butter lamps and pushing Mani sutra tubes.

attractions.name: 灵山梵宫
attractions.summary:
After visiting the main hall of the Brahma Palace, go directly to the second floor, and walk straight to the entrance of the Treasure Hall. 
The four beauties in ancient China, adult fish, falling geese, closed moon and ashamed flowers, were very exquisite. Their clothes were very realistic, and the shape of their cuffs was very thin. This kind of art was perfect. 
There are many works of Patriarch Bodhidharma. There is a large statue of Patriarch Bodhidharma erected in the center, with a red gourd on the back, a pool around it, and many works around it are exquisite treasures ~
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent Buddhist palace

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-鼋渚春涛
attractions.name_en: Taihu Turtle Head Islet Scenic Area - Spring Waves of Turtle Islet
attractions.summary: Mountain pavilions are looming, and lakeside lighthouses are towering; Looking at the ups and downs of the island in the distance, I can hear the waves close to the shore. Many scenic spots are listed on the lakeshore, highlighting the accumulation of history everywhere. This is the essence scenic spot of Yuantouzhu. The main scenic spots are lighthouse, "Yuantouzhu" stone tablet, "Hengyun" cliff stone carvings, "Zhenze Shenyan" bronze statue, Chenglan Hall, Feiyun Pavilion, etc.

attractions.name: 江南兰苑
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary: Jiangnan Orchid Garden is a special garden mainly cultivating and ornamental orchids. In 1989, it was listed as the research center of orchid germplasm resources protection in China by the Chinese Botanical Society. The garden has lush vegetation, scattered pavilions, quaint layout, orchid fragrance in all seasons, quiet and pleasant, which can be called a good place to enjoy orchids and taste tea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Special garden mainly cultivating ornamental orchids

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-樱花谷
attractions.name_en: Taihu Yuantouzhu Scenic Area - Cherry Blossom Valley
attractions.summary: Located at the northern foot of Luding Mountain in Yuantouzhu Scenic Area, it is adjacent to the Sino-Japanese Cherry Blossom Friendship Forest and integrated into one. It covers an area of 200,000 square meters and has more than 30,000 cherry blossoms of 68 varieties. It is the largest cherry blossom garden in China. Cherry Blossom Valley has buildings such as Cherry Blossom Viewing Building, Tianyun Pavilion, Fanyingxuan and Cuchun Bridge. It is a good place for people to enjoy cherry blossoms and carry out friendly exchange activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the cherry blossoms in the mountains from many angles in spring

attractions.name: 充山隐秀
attractions.summary: The mountain is hidden and beautiful, located at the southeast foothills of Luding Mountain, where the former Chen Family Garden was located. Chen Family Garden, also known as Ruopu, was built in 1928 by Chen Zhongyan, a national industrial and commercial businessman in Wuxi, and set up a nursery after the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is the main location of Taihu Ornamental Botanical Garden, which wins by trees and flowers, natural wild scenery, many ancient and famous trees, and birds and flowers everywhere.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are many ancient and famous trees

attractions.name: 藕花深处
attractions.summary:
The name of "Deep Lotus Flowers" comes from Li Qingzhao's poem "Return to the boat late after excitement, and stray into the deep lotus flowers", which is full of poetry. If there are no lotus roots to see, there are also cherry blossoms all over the embankment. 
A spoonful of rivers and lakes is thousands of miles away, and a piece of stone is Taihua Chihiro. Often, a poem, a tablet and a plaque are like the finishing touch. A little imagination will have the effect of four or two pounds. 
Deep in the north of the lotus root, there is a small memorial archway near the lake, with the forehead of "Hengyun Mountain Villa" hanging on the front and the forehead of "Scenic Spots in the District" hanging on the back. The word "District" is pronounced as "Europe", which has some origins. Jiu District is another name of Taihu Lake besides Zhenze, Lize and Wuhu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Numerous miles of contiguous aquatic plants

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 西园寺
attractions.tag: Garden garden; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples
attractions.summary: Xiyuan Jiezhuanglu Temple, referred to as Xiyuan Temple for short, is located outside Changmen in the west of Suzhou. It was founded from Yuan Dynasty to Yuan Dynasty and has a history of 700 years. The temple has deep ancient trees, heavy Brahma universe, green water, birds singing and flowers fragrant. Most of the existing temples were built in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and they are the largest temples in Suzhou. On the central axis, from south to north, there are three-room memorial archway, mountain gate, King Kong Hall, release pool, Daxiong Hall and Tibetan Sutra Building. There is Guanyin Hall on the east side of King Kong Hall and Arhat Hall on the west side. There are also Buddhist Chanting Hall, Fayun Hall, Guest Hall, Zhai Hall, warehouse and other buildings in the temple. There are four complete books of Dragon Tibet in the Tibetan Sutra Building, which were later given to Baolian Temple in Hong Kong, and more than 80,000 Buddhist scriptures such as Huayan Sutra written by Master Shan Ji in the Yuan Dynasty. Xiyuan Temple is a large temple with complete scale, magnificent temple, solemn Buddha statues and garden characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combining temples with gardens

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 观前街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Located in the center of Suzhou ancient city, the area is prosperous in commerce, famous shops gather and numerous historic sites. There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering many Suzhou specialties

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 五号院相声茶馆（古文化街通庆里店）
attractions.name_en: No. 5 Courtyard Xiangsheng Teahouse (Ancient Cultural Street Tongqingli Store)
attractions.summary: Experience the courtyard tea house, enjoy tea, taste fresh Tianjin style snacks, and listen to traditional cross-talk.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 平津战役纪念馆
attractions.summary:
The Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum is a special memorial dedicated to showcasing the great victory of the Pingjin Campaign, as decided by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. On August 23, 1994, the 67th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 14th Central Committee decided to build the Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum in Tianjin, with the Beijing Military Region taking the lead and working together with the municipal governments of Beijing and Tianjin to complete the construction. The foundation stone was laid on November 29, 1995, and the museum was completed and opened on July 23, 1997.

The main exhibition hall is a majestic three-story building, 22 meters high, with a simple and ancient style, featuring warm gray granite cladding. It combines traditional Chinese elements with modern aesthetic styles. On the large archway above the exhibition hall is a golden inscription of "Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum" in seven characters written by Marshal Nie Rongzhen, with his signature on the lower right. A 40-meter-wide granite staircase guides visitors into the exhibition hall. The total length of the exhibition line in the main hall is 740 meters, divided into six sections: Preliminaries, Campaign Decisions, Campaign Implementation, People's Support, Great Victory, and Heroes' Achievements. The exhibition displays over 400 historical photos, more than 2,000 cultural relics, as well as multimedia, electric sand tables, restored sites, landscapes, sculptures, and paintings as auxiliary exhibits.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place to learn about the history of the Pingjin Campaign

attractions.name: 南开大学(八里台校区)
attractions.summary: Nankai University is one of the famous higher education institutions in China, located in Tianjin, with the Balitai campus being one of its main campuses. The campus has a beautiful environment, unique architectural style, and a fusion of Chinese and Western architectural elements, making it an important cultural landmark in Tianjin.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 张学良故居
attractions.summary:
Zhang Xueliang's Former Residence Museum, also known as Shaoshual's Mansion, lived here in the 1920s and 1930s. This building is luxurious, beautiful and generous, mainly in western Baroque style. The rooms are elegantly decorated, and the stairs, floors, doors and windows are all made of Philippine wood. 
Zhang Xueliang's former residence, which has been renovated for more than two years, reappears today. The music, decoration, clothing, furniture and characters here reappear the original appearance of the Zhang family's life in the French Concession in Tianjin.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 天津博物馆
attractions.summary:
The predecessor of Tianjin Museum can be traced back to the Tianjin Museum established in 1918. Although it was newly built in recent years and has lost a lot of ancient flavor, it is still the main place to inherit the local history and culture of Tianjin. 
There are 4 floors in the museum. The first floor is "The Origin of Tianjin Humanities", the second floor is the exhibition of fine cultural relics, the third floor is "A Hundred Years of China Seeing Tianjin", and the fourth floor is the painting and calligraphy exhibition. Learn about the historical changes, local culture, etc. of the entire Tianjin here, and the treasures of the town hall such as Fan Kuan's "Snow Scene and Cold Forest Picture" axis in the Northern Song Dynasty, the enamel colored peony and young chicken pattern jade pot spring bottle in the Qing Qianlong Dynasty, the Taibao tripod in the Western Zhou Dynasty, and the topaz pig dragon will also make it worth your trip. Various themed exhibitions will be held from time to time.

attractions.name: 天津自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Science and Technology Museum; Museum; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary:
Tianjin Museum of Natural History has a wide area with three floors, including permanent exhibition area, temporary exhibition area, experience entertainment area and popular science education area. 
There are many exhibits in the museum. If you first enter the exhibition area, you can first see a long scroll of life evolution. A pair of "mother and son" giant Shandong dragon skeletons in the center of the hall will immediately bring you into the situation of natural legends. On the left side of the hall is the living butterfly garden in the first museum in China. You can not only watch the colorful living butterflies flying all over the sky, but also observe the transformation process from caterpillars to beautiful butterflies, and truly experience "emerging into butterflies". 
The most unmissable thing is the exhibition hall on the third floor, which displays about 300 precious specimens of world wildlife, such as precious Chinese animal specimens such as crested ibis, giant panda, golden monkey and takin, which are known as the "Four Treasures of Qinling Mountains".
attractions.shortFeatures: A long history and a rich collection

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 思南路
attractions.summary: Some people say that Sinan Road is the "harem" of Huaihai Road, hidden behind the bustling streets, like a solitary lotus in the world, quiet and peaceful, narrating the history of old Shanghai and the stories of the past at a slow pace. Sinan Road is named after the French composer Jules in the early 20th century Masnan is a famous French road, a clean and romantic one-way street, and two rows of French wutong trees covering the sky, connecting Huaihai Road and Xujiahui. The garden villas on both sides of the road have different styles, English, French, and Spanish, reflecting their pre liberation identity. It is said that there are more than twenty garden style western-style houses on Sinan Road, which gather almost all the residential styles of old Shanghai - it is a living book of urban history. Walking here, it feels like returning to that hurried and chaotic era that still remains prosperous. Nowadays, Sinan Road not only preserves various former residences, but also the Sinan Mansion, which has been transformed into a hotel. Along the street, there are also some specialty small shops. You can have a cup of coffee at a caf é or go to the "Aniang Noodle Shop" to enjoy a bowl of authentic yellow croaker Aniang noodles for 20 yuan, and then visit antique shops to savor the unique history and romance of Shanghai in nostalgia.

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.summary: The new grand circus program "Chimelong Show" in Zhuhai Hengqin was created by an international team and directed by a descendant of the Russian circus family. Based on the international scene, the program was enthusiastically performed by circus artists from 28 countries. The overall style integrates the diverse customs and contemporary fashion concepts of China, Russia, Argentina, the United States and other countries, covering acrobatics, dance, comic performance, magic, extreme sports and other art categories. It gathers the essence of art, from Venice chapter to African style, from Chinese traditional culture to Argentine inspired performance, from rock and roll Broadway to strolling in the space fantasy world, integrating the essence of ancient and modern cultures, so that the audience can enjoy the bizarre circus The world, feel the unique charm of circus. In terms of stage presentation, Zhuhai Hengqin Chimelong Theater integrates the concept of "water, land, and air" to create a multi-dimensional fantasy world, creating a more immersive, three-dimensional, and diverse audio-visual experience. A 270 ° panoramic circular stage and 3 large surrounding waterways, a 360 ° high-altitude suspended circular track over 250 meters, and a parade channel over 5 meters wide in the audience area. Various water, land, and air effects can be flexibly transformed according to different programs, bringing an immersive performance effect of "going from heaven to earth and underwater". The nearly 85 minute performance of "Chimelong Show" covers a wide range of skills such as acrobatics, dance, comedy, extreme sports, and special effects. There are also interactive parades on site, bringing a double shock of joy and excitement, making it easy for both children and adults to immerse themselves. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞船乐园
attractions.summary: Step into Chimelong Spaceship Park and embark on an exciting interstellar exploration journey. Here, every tourist has the opportunity to immerse themselves in a challenging and adventurous exploration mission through personalized character selection. Your every choice and interaction will bring point rewards, from riding exciting amusement equipment to interacting with theme characters, to participating in science popularization knowledge quizzes, every step is closely integrated with the park's dual themes of science and entertainment. The special mission of "Egg Boy Party" makes every step of the amusement a joy of discovery! In the dedicated check-in area of "Egg Party", you can share happy moments with the egg lovers and leave beautiful summer memories. Each check-in point not only has a unique theme setting, but also has the opportunity to win exquisite gifts and additional points. Capture the fun moments of this summer with family and friends, and make the joy of the 'Egg Party' the highlight of your journey. The officially opened Chimelong Spaceship Park has added 18 new sets of super fun equipment, ready to welcome the arrival of every explorer! The summer spaceship amusement park has 35 different types of amusement equipment. This summer, we will take you into a brand new world full of excitement and fun. In Chimelong Spaceship Park, animal displays, science classes, themed entertainment, new amusement facilities, and highly creative performances are integrated. Integrating multimedia technology with performances to achieve an educational and entertaining effect, allowing tourists to see knowledge while traveling, acquire knowledge while having fun, and fall in love with marine ecological conservation while watching performances and playing. The anticipated killer whale science popularization theater can accommodate nearly 5000 people at the same time. With the theme of killer whale conservation, combined with the flying of birds and the introduction and display of killer whale behavior, it showcases the vibrant marine ecology to people. Here, Chimelong has created a global large-scale indoor venue for killer whales and the first "killer whale breeding base" to create a living environment for animals in the wild. It has also created a world-class killer whale wave pool, where we can see natural behaviors such as splashing, jumping, and swimming, showcasing the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. In addition to the regular tour route, Chimelong Spaceship Park has also carefully designed a series of science popularization and learning activities such as "Exploration Home Tour" and "Little Conservator", aiming to enhance young people's understanding and awareness of marine ecosystems through an educational and entertaining environment. These courses not only cover a wide range of topics, but also delve into the mysteries of marine life. At Chimelong Spaceship Park, you will experience a variety of amusement facilities, from the exciting "Star River Storm" to the mysterious "Ancient Sea Fantasy Tour". The new "Egg Party" special mission combines innovative gamified point gameplay to embark on personalized interstellar exploration. This summer, bring your family and friends to Chimelong Spaceship Park to not only enjoy unparalleled entertainment experiences, but also gain a deeper understanding of the importance of marine ecological protection through educational entertainment. Looking forward to your arrival, creating unforgettable memories together and exploring, learning, and protecting our beautiful world. Welcome to Chimelong Spaceship Park for immersive space exploration, where you can explore the stars and sea, admire rare marine creatures, and experience the diversity and wonder of life. With 15 themed areas, 3 performance theaters, 17 amusement equipment, 13 science popularization classrooms, and 7 public classrooms, you can immerse yourself in this imaginative space. Let's embark on an interstellar adventure together! The first stop is the Space World: board the spaceship amusement park and enter the Black Hole Crossing Nebula. Tourists can instantly enter the fantasy space created by Chimelong for tourists in the "Space World". The giant simulated space dome takes you to board the spaceship amusement park and enter the Black Hole Crossing Nebula, allowing everyone to quickly enter the imagined themed world. The second stop is Asia Planet: Get to know the numerous magical creatures in river basins. Here, you can learn about freshwater ecosystems and showcase the world's freshwater seals - Baikal seals - with a variety of magical freshwater creatures that will surely broaden your horizons. Meanwhile, here you will also be amazed by the wisdom of how humans utilize freshwater. The third stop is Rainforest Planet: Explore the secrets of the rainforest together, watch the fun "Rainforest Theater" and "Rainforest Planet", immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the "Tree of Life" on the dome, and watch the "Dialogue with the Amazon" performance in the "Rainforest Theater". Rainforest Mysteries vividly tell interesting environmental stories. The fourth stop is Canyon Planet: Crossing the Canyon World, unveiling the mysterious veil of the large population of manatees. Canyon Planet is another world, surrounded by lakes and waterfalls, where you meet tiger fish living in these habitats and uncover the mysterious veil of the distant fairy tale mermaid pangolin. Station 5: Interstellar Platform: Encountering a gathering of interstellar guests who come and go to the "Interstellar Platform", meeting Mech King, Ape Star Man, and Weapon Master, the wonderful Black Light Show "Interstellar Theater" interprets the changes of water in different forms with fun and technology, combining education with entertainment, which is very interesting. The 6th stop is Coral Sanctuary: Over 100 different types and shapes of corals enter the parallel universe of the ocean and arrive at the "Coral Sanctuary", where they can dive into lush coral reefs without carrying breathing equipment. The stunning coral exhibition area, with a water volume of 3235m ³, is home to over 20000 living organisms and more than 100 different types and shapes of corals. Its magnificent appearance instantly evokes the mission of protecting the coral family and maintaining the ecological environment. The Coral Secret Realm has more interesting coral elders waiting for you, let the coral elders tell you the importance of coral reef protection for human survival. The 7th stop of Ocean Rhapsody: Join the Happy Ocean Party "Ocean Rhapsody" is a deep-sea party where you can sing and dance with cute ocean fish and enjoy happy time to the fullest. The 8th stop, Shocking Shark Black Hole: Encounter the shark family and learn about various "ocean hunters" who bring the joy of the ocean to the "Shocking Shark Black Hole". Hammerhead sharks will become your good friends. Tourists can not only enjoy multiple species of "ocean hunters", but also learn about the types, habits, characteristics, etc. of sharks through model fossils, intelligent interactive design, and other forms. They can rediscover sharks in different ways and perspectives, reduce their fear of sharks, and understand the importance of sharks. The 9th stop of Space Dragon Palace: Explore the wonders of creatures such as Dungeon, Dragonfish, and Emperor Crocodile through ancient and modern times. Travel through the famous marine predator planet to arrive at the "Space Dragon Palace". In this parallel universe, tourists travel through ancient and modern times as well as the future, and will encounter incredible ancient marine creatures such as Dungeon and ichthyosaurs. The 10th stop, Whale Strange Universe: Walking into the Deep Sea Dominator Evolution Corridor and Conservation Space+D12 "Whale Strange Universe" will lead tourists into the Deep Sea Dominator Evolution Corridor and Conservation Space. The 11th stop of the Coolby Tour: Science Popularization and Conservation Space. Through the "Coolby Tour", you can reach the "Interstellar Exhibition Hall", where multi-functional science popularization education interactive displays combine education with entertainment. The 12th stop is the Deep Sea Amusement Park: 16 amusement facilities, crossing storms and exploring the seabed. The "Deep Sea Amusement Park" is an underwater carnival with 16 amusement facilities, allowing you to realize your dream of going to the sea. Take the "Bermuda Adventure" to cross storms and the "Deep Sea Submarine" to explore the seabed. Bermuda Adventure is also an unmissable amusement project. On the high-tech ride on dynamic simulation device, it can accommodate up to 300 people to experience and play at the same time. When the lights go out and the dynamic simulation device is activated, tourists seem to be instantly transported into an ocean adventure. With the surging waves and raging storms, they feel as if they are at the center of the storm. This authentic feeling has given people a deeper understanding and reverence for the ocean. Deep sea submarine "is a real underwater submarine amusement facility in China. We specialize in real boats, real fish, and real diving, striving to provide tourists with an immersive experience. The entire theme project is divided into six areas: Coral Cave, Underwater Exploration, Adventure Base, Abyss Shuttle, Ocean Current Tour, and Magic Palace. It can accommodate 96 visitors at a time to participate. Tourists transformed into adventurers and boarded eight submarines resembling the "Striver" in appearance. Subsequently, the submarine slowly semi submerged into the water and advanced forward. attractions.name: 只有河南·戏剧幻城
attractions.summary: The highlight exhibition of the park is only Henan Drama Fantasy City, which is jointly created by Jianye Group and director Wang Chaoge. It is a drama fantasy city with 21 theaters and is currently one of the largest drama clusters in China. The scenic area uses immersive theatrical art as a technique and unique "phantom city" architecture as a carrier. By telling stories about "land, food, and inheritance", more people can experience the charm of theatrical culture. The recommended three main theaters in the park include three themed theaters, namely "Lijiacun Theater", "Fantasy City Theater", and "Railway Station Theater", as well as 18 small theaters scattered around. The Lijiacun Theater takes "land, food, and inheritance" as its main theme, telling the story of the bloodline inheritance and endless vitality in a village during the Great Famine in Henan in 1942. Outside this door, lies the painful years that the entire Henan province has experienced. This door may make you feel depressed and sad. Our purpose in opening this door is not to let you experience pain, but to hope that you cherish your blessings. The Phantom City Theater is a seated theater that can accommodate nearly 3000 people. It tells the story of a cultural epic spanning thousands of years on a site. The stage adopts modern techniques of sound, light, and electricity, combined with a mechanical stage that can be raised and lowered up to three floors, allowing the audience to cross time and space in the illusionary city and embark on a fantastic journey to the Xia, Shang, Zhou, and Song dynasties. The story of the Train Station Theater and the Lijiacun Theater is in line, telling the tale of a conflicted soldier who sacrifices himself to save others in a station during the Great Famine of 1942. The station theater also adopts an immersive viewing method, where actors immerse themselves in the audience and engage in dialogue, giving the audience the opportunity to become a part of the drama and experience a fully immersive viewing experience. The 328 meter long rammed earth wall of Civilization Light (Closing Garden Show) will transform into a 328 meter long "painting scroll" at night, and the moving "Along the River during Qingming Festival" and "Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains" will be projected onto the wall. In the 56 checkerboard layout of the small theater and situational drama space, you are a participant in the drama. Experience drama in a free way, and also move around in the time fragments of the situational drama space, multidimensional your perception. There is only one pit courtyard in the center of Henan province, which is the imprint of the land, the sculpture of loess, and the wisdom of the people. Tourists can enjoy traditional cuisine while also experiencing a unique folk culture banquet. Mailang Restaurant can accommodate 2500 people for dining at the same time. It is a modern and stylish comprehensive catering service center that integrates culture, design, and art. It is the exhibition area of Henan's 5,000-year history, and it is also the best window to understand Henan, with more than 140,000 cultural relics in the collection. 
The museum has eight exhibition halls in chronological order, among which the lotus crane square pot in the pre-Qin period is a national treasure that can't be missed.

attractions.name: 郑州黄河文化公园
attractions.name_en: The Yellow River Scenic Area of Zhengzhou
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Yellow River Culture Park is located on the banks of the Yellow River, 20 kilometers northwest of Zhengzhou, the capital city of Henan Province. It is bordered by majestic mountains to the south and the surging Yellow River to the north. The Yellow River Cultural Park has been built and opened to the public, including five major scenic spots: Wulong Peak, Yueshan Temple, Dayu Mountain, the statues of the two emperors Yan and Huang, and Xinghai Lake. It is home to more than 40 scenic spots such as the statues of the two emperors Yan and Huang, the statues of one hundred historical figures in China, nurturing statues, the statue of Dayu, the Yellow River Stele Forest, the first bridge over ten thousand miles of the Yellow River, the Floating Sky Pavilion, and the Jimu Pavilion. The park boasts magnificent river scenery and a long-standing Yellow River culture. It is located at the core of the birthplace of the Chinese nation, with rich historical relics and profound cultural heritage. The geographical features of the park are very unique, located at the boundary between the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River, the endpoint of the Loess Plateau, the starting point of the North China Plain, and also the starting point of the Yellow River becoming a "suspended river on the ground". Here, one can appreciate the unique features of the Yellow River, such as its suspended, dangerous, turbulent, wide, and turbid nature. The park integrates sightseeing tourism, leisure vacation, science popularization education, root seeking and ancestor worship, and the promotion of Chinese civilization. It is the leading scenic spot of the "soul of the Chinese nation" - the Yellow River tour.

attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
