attractions.summary: The Mochou Lake Scenic Area is located outside the Shuiximen in the west of Nanjing City. It is a classical garden in Jiangnan and a scenic spot of the Six Dynasties. There are many varieties of crabapples in the Mochou Lake scenic area, including the stick stem crabapple, papaya crabapple, Xifu crabapple, and drooping silk crabapple, which bloom from March to April every year; Every summer, tens of thousands of lotus flowers compete for beauty on the lake. The name originates from Mochou Lake, which was formerly known as Hengtang. Due to its proximity to Shitou City, it is also known as Shicheng Lake. According to legend, Mo Chou was a beautiful girl from Luoyang during the Southern Qi Dynasty. She was poor and sold herself to bury her father. She married far away to Jinling and was not allowed to marry her uncle or aunt. She committed suicide by throwing herself into the lake. Therefore, it is named Mochou Lake. The Shengqi Tower in Shengqi Tower Park was first built in the early years of the Ming Hongwu era and was renovated in the tenth year of the Qing Tongzhi era (1871). It is said that this is the place where Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang played chess with General Xu Da. Xu Da secretly placed a flag with the words "long live", but when he won the game, he only said that the game was a draw, which greatly impressed Zhu Yuanzhang. Therefore, he gave Mo Chou Lake to Xu Da, and this building was called the "Shengqi Building". To the west of the Shengqi Building in Yujintang is the former residence of Mo Chou, Yujintang. The three characters "Yujintang" were inscribed by Liu Haisu. In the center of the front hall hangs Chen Dayu's landscape painting of "Jinling's First Scenic Spot". In the middle of the back hall is the living room, with a statue of Mo Chou sitting at the round table embroidering flowers. On the left is her bedroom. The hall is adorned with antique style rosewood and mother of pearl furniture from the late Qing Dynasty. On May 5, 2012, Mo Chou's former residence was designated as a municipal level cultural relic protection unit. The west of Yujin Hall is the north and south halls. There are lotus appreciation pavilions surrounded by cloisters in the east and west. In the middle is the lotus pond. There is a White Marble statue of Mochou on the stone of the pond, which is more than 2 meters high. I saw her walking towards me with a mulberry basket in her hand and a long skirt dragging down the ground like a fairy of Lingbo. Her pair of resentful eyes seemed to be telling visitors from all directions about her misfortune.

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 哈尔滨热雪奇迹
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ice and Snow Park
attractions.summary:
Harbin Hot Snow Miracle (Sunac Snow World) has a constant temperature of about minus 5 degrees Celsius throughout the year, which can be comfortable and entertained in snow all seasons. It not only allows skiing enthusiasts to enjoy skiing in summer, but also allows beginners to feel the unique charm of ice and snow sports. It even prepares relaxed and safe children's snow trails for children, which is a good place for indoor skiing. 
Harbin Hot Snow Miracle (Sunac Snow World) has 8 snow trails and 2 cable cars. The drop of the snow field is about 80 meters and the highest altitude is about 120 meters. 
· Other entertainment projects in the ski resort: There are six snow trails with different slopes in the ski resort, with the highest vertical drop of 80 meters. The snow quality is very close to real snow, which not only allows ski enthusiasts to enjoy the enjoyment of the "Ice and Snow World", but also allows beginners to feel the unique charm of ice and snow sports. 
Snow entertainment equipment: snow slide, bumper ball, seesaw board, snow football 
Introduction to snow trails: There are eight snow trails in the snow resort: Big Bear Trail, Squirrel Trail is suitable for junior skiers, Little Bear Trail is suitable for entry skiers, Snow Rabbit Trail is suitable for intermediate skiers, Tiger Trail is suitable for advanced skiers, Black Dragon Trail, Park Trail is suitable for advanced skiers, and Elk Trail is suitable for intermediate and advanced skiers. The eight snow trails are divided into three types of snow trails.
attractions.shortFeatures: A skiing feast that never closes the board
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 11:00-21:00(Tickets available until 19:30; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 万达茂
attractions.summary: Wanda Mall is a large commercial complex in Harbin, integrating shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure. It has numerous international brand stores, gourmet restaurants, cinemas, and other entertainment facilities, making it a great place for citizens and tourists to relax and shop.

attractions.name: 名都滑雪场
attractions.summary: Harbin Mingdu Ski Resort is located at No.215 Haping Road, Power District, in the first nursery garden of Harbin. It is only fifteen minutes from the downtown area to the ski resort. The ski resort covers an area of 200,000 square meters and is a garden-style ski resort.
attractions.shortFeatures: Garden-style ski resort in urban areas

attractions.name: 哈尔滨万达广场
attractions.summary: Harbin Wanda Plaza is a large shopping and entertainment center in Harbin, integrating shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure, providing tourists and local residents with a comprehensive consumption experience.

attractions.name: 龙塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Long Tower, with a height of 336 meters, ranks second in the world and first in Asia among steel towers. It is a comprehensive multi-functional tower integrating broadcast and television transmission, tourism, dining and entertainment, advertising, environmental and meteorological monitoring, microwave communication, and wireless communication. It is an iconic landmark of Harbin, Northeast China. 

The total area of Long Tower is 16,600 square meters, with the base covering 13,000 square meters and the tower building covering 3,600 square meters. The tower base consists of one underground floor and four above-ground floors, forming a spherical crown shape. The tower body is an octagonal prism, with a parabolic shape and a cylindrical shaft in the center. The structure is surrounded by seven silver-white aluminum alloy panels and nine dark blue coated glass panels. The tower's lower and upper levels are located at 181 meters and 206 meters, respectively, consisting of a disc-shaped lower tower and a circular upper tower. The antennas are positioned between 220.5 meters and 336 meters. 

Long Tower has meticulously created an "honorable hospitality" service, adhering to aviation service standards and forming a team with international service capabilities. It has successfully hosted many central government leaders, including Li Changchun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and He Guoqiang, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, as well as foreign dignitaries such as Russian Deputy Prime Minister Sergey Khristenko and former South Korean Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung. Large-scale delegations from Hong Kong, Macau, and the business and professional sectors, as well as celebrities from the entertainment and business industries, often visit the tower. Visitors often praise the tower’s unique features, beautiful scenery, delicious food, and excellent service. Long Tower has become a must-visit tourist destination for both domestic and international travelers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The high-altitude rotating restaurant offers a view of the night scene; overlooking the panoramic view of Harbin from a height of 100 meters.

hotel.Hotel Name: Suzhou Ascott Vanke Mall Service Apartment

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 网师园
attractions.summary:
- Wangshi Garden is a representative example of a medium-sized classical Chinese garden, featuring traditional landscape and residential architecture. It was established during the Southern Song Dynasty.
- Initially named "Yuyin" (Fisherman's Retreat), it was renamed "Wangshi Garden" in 1765, reflecting the owner's intention to retreat into a life of seclusion.
- Despite the garden's many buildings, they are not crowded, and although the pond is less than one mu in size, it does not feel small. It can be considered a model of Chinese gardens where simplicity triumphs over complexity.
- From the main gate to the carriage hall, Wanjuantang, and Xiexiu Tower, the buildings unfold along the central axis. The main hall, Wanjuantang, is spacious with elegant decorations.
- In addition to understanding the layout's intricacies, another highlight of the garden is enjoying the traditional opera performances during the annual night garden events.
attractions.shortFeatures: The garden known for its delicate and intricate design.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区-虎丘塔
attractions.summary: Huqiu Pagoda is located on Huqiu Mountain in the northwest suburbs of Suzhou, 5 kilometers away from the city center. According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn Period, King Fuchai of Wu buried his father (Helu) here. Three days after the burial, a white tiger perched on it, hence the name Huqiu Mountain, abbreviated as Huqiu. Huqiu Pagoda is a famous ancient pagoda from the Song Dynasty, both domestically and internationally. Founded in the sixth year of Xiande in the Later Zhou Dynasty (959 AD) and completed in the second year of Jianlong in the Northern Song Dynasty (961 AD). The tower has seven levels and eight sides, with two layers of internal and external columns and half arches, brick body and wooden eaves. It is a representative work of brick towers in the Yangtze River Basin in the 10th century. Due to multiple fires from the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, the wooden eaves at the top were all damaged, and the current height of the tower is 47.5 meters. In 1956, a large number of cultural relics were discovered inside the tower, including rare art treasures such as Yue kiln and lotus stone turtle. The Tiger Hill Tower is a leaning tower.

attractions.name: 枫桥景区
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 观前街

There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering many Suzhou specialties

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 甪直古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Lùzhí Ancient Town has a history of over 2,500 years. The town is crisscrossed by waterways, with numerous bridges, and is known for its "Hall of Five Lakes" and "Confluence of Six Marshes."  
· There are 41 ancient bridges in the town, each with unique and elegant designs. Among them, five pairs of bridges connected at right angles stand out and are truly remarkable.  
· The most notable attractions include the Baosheng Temple from the Tang Dynasty, as well as the Shen Residence, Xiao Fangfang Performing Arts Center, Wang Tao Memorial Hall, and the famous Wansheng Rice Mill.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Wansheng Rice Shop in Ye Shengtao's Writings

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 《印象丽江》演出
attractions.tag: Featured performance; Mountain Climbing; Live Show
attractions.summary: Impression Lijiang "is one of the" Impression Series "directed by Zhang Yimou. The performance is set against the backdrop of snow capped mountains, with folk culture as the theme and local indigenous people as actors. On the open-air stage of the Ganhaizi Blue Moon Valley Theater in Yulong Snow Mountain at an altitude of 3100 meters, it truly showcases the indigenous people's emotions towards heaven, earth, people, and mountains. Impression of Lijiang "is divided into two parts:" Snow Mountain Chapter "and" Ancient City Chapter ", including six parts:" Ancient Road Horse Gang "," Duijiu Snow Mountain "," Heaven and Earth "," Jumping Song Group "," Encouragement and Sacrifice to Heaven ", and" Prayer Ceremony ". The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. The more than 500 actors participating in the performance are all from the surrounding rural areas, giving the audience a very authentic impression of Lijiang with their rough momentum, native posture, and simple singing.

attractions.name: 冰川公园
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountain Climbing; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
· Located on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north of Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, it is a typical representative of the modern glacier in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
· The park composed of stone caves and caves eroded by glaciers is a landform relic formed by Quaternary glaciers, and is known as the "Glass Palace of Lucerne".  
In autumn, winter and spring, the snow is vast here. In summer, you can see the glaciers formed more than 40,000 years ago, and you can feel the snow-capped mountains at close range. 
The white mountain at the top of the mountain is magnificent, spectacular, white and delicate, and there is also a marking stone tablet with an altitude of 4,680 meters, which is also a popular group photo place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience glaciers and snow-capped mountains up close

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山索道
attractions.summary: The Yulong Snow Mountain Cableway is one of the three cableways in the Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. Tourists can take the cableway directly from the cableway station located in Ganhaizi to the Glacier Park at an altitude of 4506 meters. After getting off the cableway and following the wooden boardwalk laid on the glacier, you can climb all the way to the highest point at an altitude of 4680 meters, experiencing the charm of the snow capped mountains and glaciers up close. Full text 

attractions.name: 白水河
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.
attractions.shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain

attractions.name: 甘海子
attractions.tag: Grassland wind collection; Climb a mountain; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
Ganhaizi is an open meadow at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain and a natural pasture. 
The terrain of the scenic spot is gentle and undulating, and there are low pine trees scattered on the vast meadow, covered by vegetation. From time to time, yaks pass by in front of us, which is a plateau pasture scenery. 
In Ganhaizi, you can see the thirteen peaks of Yulong Snow lined up in turn, which is the nearest and best place to look up at the whole picture of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
There is the only golf course with the longest fairway in the world, the highest altitude in Asia, and the only golf course at the foot of the snow-capped mountains. You can also play after the tour, which is very convenient.
attractions.shortFeatures: Meadow pasture at the foot of snow-capped mountains

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 九鼎龙潭
attractions.summary:
Jiuding Longtan, also known as Longquan, is located in the northwest corner of Shuhe Ancient Town. It is the water source of streams in the ancient town and a must-visit place in Shuhe. 
Longquan is a semicircular stone pool with two semi-circular stone pools. There is a pavilion between the two pools, which is the best place to watch the "Jiuding Longtan". 
The water in Longtan landscape is not deep, but it is not muddy in summer and shallow in winter. You can see the "Reflected Snow Mountain", "Broken Monument Knocking" and "Fish and Water Relatives" among the eight scenic spots of Shuhe River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Rippling clear water and quiet environment

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located northwest of Lijiang Old Town, it is quiet and ancient, with mountains and waters, more tranquil and primitive than Dayan Ancient Town.
- The mountains behind the ancient town are the foothills of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with lush and beautiful rolling peaks and dense forests.
- The Grand Stone Bridge and the Dajue Palace are well-preserved, with murals depicting figures from Buddhist teachings.
- It is an important part of the UNESCO World Heritage Lijiang Old Town and was selected as a "Charming Town of China" by CCTV in 2005.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tranquil and serene town of Chama Ancient Town.

attractions.summary: FREE SKY Cloud Sightseeing Floor is located on the 116th floor of Ping An Financial Center, the fourth tallest building in the world. It is proud of Shenzhen's new landmark at an altitude of about 547.6 meters, and has a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Shenzhen's different landscapes and urban features in all directions. The cloud sightseeing layer integrates sightseeing and entertainment, cultural creativity and popular science education, and is a new landmark of urban sightseeing with cultural connotation. At the same time, the sightseeing floor is connected with a huge transportation network and rich tourist lines, which will become an unmissable choice for many tourists to visit Shenzhen. The sightseeing floor covers a number of functional spaces, such as transparent viewing spots, interactive experience areas, characteristic exhibition areas, etc., and displays the young culture with rich Shenzhen characteristics with advanced intelligent multimedia facilities. This is an excellent place to taste the prosperity and natural reflection of Shenzhen. You can enjoy the unique experience of enjoying the city scenery at Dapeng Fuyun, and the 360-degree cloud overview is shocking.

attractions.name: 深圳改革开放展览馆
attractions.name_en: Shenzhen Reform and Opening-up Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary: The Shenzhen Reform and Opening up Exhibition Hall, located in Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, uses high-tech means such as photos, physical objects, videos, models, and interactive experience projects to comprehensively, vividly, and three dimensionally showcase the magnificent history and brilliant achievements of Guangdong's 40 years of opening up.

attractions.name: 南头古城
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
attractions.summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 金色海岸游艇
attractions.summary: The Shenzhen Golden Coast Yacht Pier is located on Seafood Street. Tourists can take a yacht to explore magnificent landscapes such as Seafood Street, Yantian Port, Dameisha Seaside Park, Xiaomeisha, Xiashawan Beach, Nanao Fishing Port, Chepingzhou Nature Reserve, Yazhou Island, Ji'ao Island, Shatoujiao, etc. from the sea, and enjoy multiple sea views.

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滩
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in Yantian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, surrounded by mountains on three sides and facing the sea on one side. The endless sea and soft sandy beaches have always made it popular, and visitors continue to flock to it. If you want to get rid of this crowded crowd, it's better to choose the way of taking a boat tour. On the vast sea, you can quietly enjoy the unbeatable beauty of Dameisha and laugh at the clouds rolling and relaxing in the sky.

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 甲秀楼
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jiaxiu Building is a landmark building in Guiyang. Anyone who goes to Guiyang will board it to observe the scenery. 
The existing building was rebuilt during the Xuantong period of Qing Dynasty. The three-story building stands on Aoji Stone, in front of which is the flowing Nanming River. 
Walking through the floating jade bridge connecting Jiaxiu Building, it is Cuiwei Garden, with pavilions and waterside pavilions in the garden, which is quite south of the Yangtze River. 
The night view of Jiaxiu Building is particularly beautiful. From a distance, it is brightly lit.
attractions.shortFeatures: A wooden attic built in the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 青云市集
attractions.summary: Qingyun Market is located in Nanming District, Yangshi City. Many people think of setting up a night market here, but after being packaged by the local management department, it has been upgraded to a traditional, retro, and industrial style internet famous market that integrates leisure, entertainment, and food. It is a place where young people gather and relax, with food, drink, drink, take photos, and neon lights flashing at night.

attractions.name: 黔灵山公园
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids' outings; City Parks
attractions.summary:
- Qianling Mountain Park is characterized by its famous mountains, beautiful waters, secluded forests, ancient temples, sacred springs, and spiritual monkeys, and is known as "The First Mountain of Southern Guizhou."
- The Hongfu Temple at the top of the mountain is the largest Buddhist monastery in Guizhou and is the province's most prominent temple. It was founded during the Qing Dynasty, and it is said that prayers here are very effective.
- There are many rhesus monkeys along the Hongfu Temple and the path down the mountain. Many visitors come to Qianling Mountain Park specifically to see these monkeys, which are free-roaming within the park.
- Halfway up the mountain, there is a zoo with a wide variety of animals. The Qilin Cave in the scenic area was the place where General Zhang Xueliang was once imprisoned.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the scenery of Guiyang City from the mountain

attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the Calcified Beach Waterfall and the Caves.

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 果戈里大街
attractions.summary:
· It has a history of more than 100 years, and there are many Russian-style buildings, including the famous Qiulin Food Company Building and St. Alexeyev Church. 
The prosperity and night scene are no less beautiful than Central Street, and it is also a "bar street" in Harbin. 
It is also a famous cultural street, with modern horseshoe stones on both sides of the road, and a piece engraved with Heilongjiang historical and cultural celebrities is inlaid every other section.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old Russian-style block

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 龙塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Long Tower, with a height of 336 meters, ranks second in the world and first in Asia among steel towers. It is a comprehensive multi-functional tower integrating broadcast and television transmission, tourism, dining and entertainment, advertising, environmental and meteorological monitoring, microwave communication, and wireless communication. It is an iconic landmark of Harbin, Northeast China. 

The total area of Long Tower is 16,600 square meters, with the base covering 13,000 square meters and the tower building covering 3,600 square meters. The tower base consists of one underground floor and four above-ground floors, forming a spherical crown shape. The tower body is an octagonal prism, with a parabolic shape and a cylindrical shaft in the center. The structure is surrounded by seven silver-white aluminum alloy panels and nine dark blue coated glass panels. The tower's lower and upper levels are located at 181 meters and 206 meters, respectively, consisting of a disc-shaped lower tower and a circular upper tower. The antennas are positioned between 220.5 meters and 336 meters. 

Long Tower has meticulously created an "honorable hospitality" service, adhering to aviation service standards and forming a team with international service capabilities. It has successfully hosted many central government leaders, including Li Changchun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and He Guoqiang, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, as well as foreign dignitaries such as Russian Deputy Prime Minister Sergey Khristenko and former South Korean Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung. Large-scale delegations from Hong Kong, Macau, and the business and professional sectors, as well as celebrities from the entertainment and business industries, often visit the tower. Visitors often praise the tower’s unique features, beautiful scenery, delicious food, and excellent service. Long Tower has become a must-visit tourist destination for both domestic and international travelers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The high-altitude rotating restaurant offers a view of the night scene; overlooking the panoramic view of Harbin from a height of 100 meters.

attractions.name: 防洪纪念塔
attractions.summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

attractions.name: 松花江观光索道
attractions.summary: The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway starts from Tongjiang Square in the south and ends at Taiyang Island Scenic Area in the north, spanning across the Songhua River. It is a well-known tourist transportation vehicle. The total length of the cableway is 1156 meters, and the cableway bracket in the river is more than 70 meters away from the river surface. Riding in the car, you can overlook the panoramic view of both sides of the Songhua River, with infinite scenery. The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway is one of the key projects in Harbin City, which was built and constructed with huge investment in 1997. It introduced equipment from the world's senior cableway equipment company, Austria's Dopema Company, and ranks among the high-end international cableways today. The cableway is adjacent to Stalin Park, Flood Control Memorial Tower, and Central Street, like a jade belt tightly connecting the two banks of the Songhua River. The cableway is equipped with 19 fully automatic and fully enclosed high-end cabins for 8 people, 6 luxurious cabins, and built-in sofas, bars, and speakers, providing comfort, elegance, warmth, and romance. The cableway runs at a speed of 1-5 meters per second, with ease and speed. Walking leisurely in the courtyard, one can enjoy the scenery of northern China and the city, and the scenery wherever they go is infinite. So far, the cableway has been in operation for more than 20 years, with a safety factor of 100%. Full text 
