- Sun Island Park is located on the northern bank of the Songhua River in Harbin, across from Stalin Park, and is known by visitors as a summer resort.
- The island features numerous European-style villas, which were once summer retreats for the Russians. These architectural structures are nestled amidst lush green trees.
- This is the largest winter theme park in China with a snow theme, and in winter, it becomes a world of snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Summer for escaping the heat, winter for enjoying snow sculptures.

attractions.name: 太阳岛冰雪艺术馆
attractions.name_en: Sun Island Ice and Snow Art Museum
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary:
The Ice and Snow Art Museum is currently the largest indoor ice and snow art venue in the world. 
The ice scene in the museum is made of natural ice and artificial snow of Songhua River, so that the ice and snow landscape that is only available in winter can be realized indoors in spring, summer and autumn. 
If you come here in summer and the temperature difference between indoor and outdoor is too big, you must rent cotton-padded clothes and trousers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate precious calligraphy and painting works

attractions.name: 亚布力森林温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
· Yabuli Forest Hot Spring is located in Yabuli Tourist Resort, Heilongjiang Province. The hot spring is divided into two areas: indoor pavilion and outdoor hot spring. 
The indoor pavilion takes tropical garden scenery as the theme of hot springs, and combines the abundant Chinese herbal medicine resources in local mountainous areas to create local characteristic medicinal hot springs. There are more than 20 kinds of characteristic hot springs such as ginseng spring, ganoderma lucidum spring, astragalus spring and schisandra spring. 
· Outdoor hot spring pools are distributed in the original birch forest and pine forest, and you can experience the hot spring experience of spring flowers, summer green, autumn yellow and winter snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical garden scenery indoor hot spring

attractions.name: 亚布力滑雪旅游度假区
attractions.summary: Yabuli Ski Resort is a famous ski resort in China, gathering multiple professional ski resorts and resort hotels. Here, you can experience the thrilling "snow diving" on professional ski slopes, and there are many professional coaches to help beginners quickly master basic skills, allowing you to fully enjoy the fun of skiing. Yabuli Ski Resort is located in the southern mountainous area of Yabuli Town. The snow quality here is excellent and the hardness is moderate. The snow accumulation period is 170 days, and the skiing period is nearly 150 days. From mid November to late March of the following year, it is a good time for skiing. In addition, there are also activities such as playing snow circles and snowmobiles. International events such as the Asian Winter Games are often held here. The resort consists of three peaks with an altitude of over 1000 meters (Daguokui, Erguokui, and Sanguokui), and is home to multiple ski resorts, such as the Xinhao Sunshine Ski Resort with better facilities and larger facilities in China, and the Xinti Commission Ski Resort with better facilities. Although skiing costs are slightly higher than ordinary ski resorts, they are worth experiencing. In addition, summer vacation areas are also suitable for leisure vacations. The forests here are dense and the scenery is beautiful. There are entertainment projects such as golf, boating, fishing, etc. in the vacation area, making it a good place to escape the heat and summer. Full text 

attractions.name: 亚布力世界第一滑道
attractions.name_en: Yabuli Sightseeing Cable Car and World's First Slide
attractions.summary:
· The world's first slide in Yabuli is located on Sanguokui Mountain at an altitude of 999.8 meters. It extends down the hillside, with a total length of 2,680 meters and a drop of 570 meters. It has 48 curves, which is the highest in the world. 
· You need to take the high-speed uphill cable car to the top of the mountain. During this period, you can overlook this beautiful forest and snowfield, pine trees, stone sea, hanging trees and other scenic spots. I was also lucky enough to see professional athletes speeding in the ski field. 
· The slide is divided into single-person vehicles and double-person vehicles. Each vehicle has a control handle. The slide will pass through two tunnels and 48 detours. The top speed can reach 80 kilometers per hour. Experience the thrill of speed and passion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Total length 2680 meters

restaurants.name_en: Yabuli Wanshun Farmhouse Roast Leg of Sheep

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 周庄沈厅
attractions.summary: The original name of Shen Hall was Jingye Hall, which was renamed Songmao Hall in the late Qing Dynasty. It was built by Shen Benren, a descendant of Shen Wansan, in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1742 AD). It is divided into seven entrances and five gates, and the architectural layout has the style of a wealthy family. Shen Hall is a must visit attraction in Zhouzhuang, and tourists come here mainly to explore the past of the wealthy Shen Wansan. Layout structure: The first entrance of the Shen Hall is the Water Wall Gate, which is equivalent to the private dock of the Shen family for docking their boats; The second entrance is the foyer; The third entrance is the tea pavilion, used to entertain guests with average status; The fourth entrance is the main hall, Songmao Hall, used to entertain distinguished guests; The fifth entrance is the lobby building where women reside; The sixth entrance is the small hall building; The seventh entrance is the restaurant, with a kitchen next to it. Highlights of Shen Hall: Brick carved gatehouse, main hall, treasure trove, and copper murals are several highlights of Shen Hall. The gatehouse between the third and fourth entrances is one of the five exquisite gatehouses in Shenting. There are beautiful brick carvings on the gatehouse, with the words "Accumulated Thick and Flowing Light" carved in the middle. The main hall, Songmao Hall, is spacious and grand, with old dark windows visible when looking up. In the sixth entrance of the small hall building, there is a statue of Shen Wansan, and in front of him is a glittering treasure trove, which is said to bring wealth to people. There are copper murals on both sides of the lane in Shen Hall, introducing the legendary life of Shen Wansan. Visiting the second floor of the Shen Hall's Ma Tower requires an additional fee. On the second floor, you can look at the various courtyards of the Shen Hall from a different angle, and also see the ladies' boudoirs. It is quite interesting to peek into the main hall's Song Mao Hall from the dark window.

attractions.name: 周庄张厅
attractions.summary:
Zhang Hall, formerly known as Yishun Hall, was built in the Ming Dynasty. In the early Qing Dynasty, Zhang's surname was transferred to Yuyan Hall, commonly known as Zhang Hall. 
After more than 500 years of vicissitudes, solid stone pillars and exquisite carvings, it is still not difficult to see the former elegant demeanor of Zhang Hall. 
The hall is spacious and bright, with a rare wooden drum pier under the court pillar, which is an obvious symbol of Ming Dynasty architecture. 
The backyard of Zhang Hall is a quiet and clean small garden, surrounded by dwellings with white walls and black tiles. 
Enter with the ticket of the day and listen to the story with the tour guide. Although things have changed, you can still feel the details of the life of large families.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sedan chair entered the boat in front of the door and passed through the house

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 东川红土地
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast of Kunming, the soil contains a lot of iron and aluminum, forming a dazzling color. 
· It is considered to be the most imposing red land in the world except Brazil. From a distance, it is colorful and a paradise for photographers. 
The scenic spots are scattered, forming three main viewing routes: northwest line, northeast line and south line. The most convenient way to play is to charter a car. 
The best time to visit the red land is when the wheat is ripe from April to May, when rape flowers grow vigorously from September to December, and when there is occasional residual snow in the fields from February to March.
attractions.shortFeatures: Paradise for photography enthusiasts

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 云南大学
attractions.summary: Yunnan University is located in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China and is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history. The campus is shaded by green trees and has a unique architectural style that combines elements of both Eastern and Western architecture. It is a famous cultural attraction in Kunming city.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 斗南花卉市场
attractions.summary: The Dounan Flower Market is located in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China. It is the largest fresh cut flower trading market in Asia and also the largest flower distribution center in China. There are a large number of flower trades here every day, with a wide variety and affordable prices, attracting numerous tourists and flower enthusiasts to visit and purchase.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

restaurants.name_en: Chongqing pig pen old Chongqing hot pot
Bridge fragrant Garden authentic bridge rice noodles

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 编钟演奏厅
attractions.summary: The Bell Chime Performance Hall of Hubei Provincial Museum performs wonderful bell chimes every day. The Zeng Houyi Bell Chime in the performance hall is one of the four treasures of Hubei Provincial Museum.

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 辛亥革命武昌起义纪念馆
attractions.summary: The predecessor of the Wuchang Uprising Memorial Hall was the Hubei Consultative Bureau in the late Qing Dynasty. In October 1911, the first shot of the Xinhai Revolution was fired in Wuchang. After the successful uprising, the revolutionary party established a military government here. The main body of the memorial hall is a small building with red walls and tiles, commonly known as the "Red Chamber" by locals. The memorial hall, founded in 1909, is a two-story brick and wood Western style building. There are currently two themed displays in the museum. One is the "Restoration Exhibition of the Former Site of the Governor General's Office of the Hubei Army", which reproduces the scene of the early establishment of the Governor's Office. From the display, we can learn about the organizational structure of the military government in its early days. There is also a flag on display, called the Eighteen Star Flag, which is the military flag of the Wuchang Uprising. The eighteen yellow stars represent the descendants of Yan and Huang from the eighteen provinces within Shanhaiguan. The other main exhibition is the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution", which showcases the historical scene of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution through cultural relics, pictures, and models. Here, you can also see portraits of figures related to the Wuchang Uprising. There is also a photo of a woman in the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution". The person in the photo is Zhang Zhujun, the president of the Shanghai Red Cross Society. During the Wuchang Uprising, she organized a civilian medical team and disguised revolutionary party member Huang Xing as a doctor of the Red Cross Society, taking her on a ship to Wuhan. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Westin R&F Hotel Zhiwei Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 佛顶宫
attractions.summary:
Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 六朝博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
It is the most comprehensive site museum in China to understand the "ancient capital of the Six Dynasties" at present, and it is also the most systematic thematic museum reflecting the culture of the Six Dynasties. 
· The core theme of the exhibition is to show the elegant demeanor of "Oriental Metropolis", with four exhibitions: Emperors of the Six Dynasties, Eternal Romance, Elegant Demeanor of the Six Dynasties and Outstanding People of the Six Dynasties. 
The museum site is a part of Jiankang City in the original Six Dynasties. It is precisely because of the excavation of this thousand-year-old site that today's Six Dynasties Museum exists.
attractions.shortFeatures: A special museum reflecting the culture of the Six Dynasties

attractions.name: 阅江楼
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Yuejiang Tower in Nanjing, along with the Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is collectively known as the Four Famous Towers of Jiangnan. It features a distinctive Ming Dynasty style and classical royal grandeur.
- The most unique feature of Yuejiang Tower is that the tower was built based on the "Yuejiang Lou Ji" (Record of Yuejiang Tower) by Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang of the Ming Dynasty.
- From the top of Yuejiang Tower, one can enjoy a panoramic view of the vast Yangtze River, the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, and the entire city of Jinling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the Ming Dynasty tower to admire the vast Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 国立美术馆旧址
attractions.name_en: Former Site of the National Art Museum
attractions.summary:
The former site of the National Fine Arts Exhibition Museum is located at No.266 Changjiang Road, Xuanwu District, Nanjing. It is a national key cultural relics protection unit and the predecessor of Jiangsu Art Museum today. It was built in 1936. As the first national art museum in China, it represents the official beginning of the career of China Art Museum. In 1960, it was renamed Jiangsu Art Museum and is still in use today. 
The National Fine Arts Exhibition Hall has held many influential exhibitions, including several national art exhibitions and various exhibitions of traditional Chinese paintings, oil paintings and prints. The "Second National Art Exhibition of the Ministry of Education" held in 1937, from the "Special Collection of the Second National Art Exhibition" preserved by Nanjing Library so far, shows that the artistic status of the preparatory committee members and examination committee of the exhibition is prominent, the works of the participating artists are heavy, and the scale of the exhibition is large. In the whole 20th century, no art exhibition can surpass it. 
On November 24th, 2018, the former site of the National Fine Arts Exhibition Museum was selected as the "Third Batch of Chinese 20th Century Architectural Heritage Projects". In October 2019, it was included in the list of the eighth batch of national key cultural relics protection units.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the representative works of new national form architecture

attractions.name: 德基广场
attractions.summary: Deji Square is located in Xuanwu District, Nanjing City. It is a large shopping center in the center of Nanjing city, integrating shopping, dining, and entertainment. It has numerous internationally renowned brands and high-end restaurants, and is a popular place for Nanjing citizens and tourists to relax and shop.

restaurants.name_en: Baijia Kitchen·Mong Kok Stew Private Cuisine

attractions.name: 天心阁
attractions.summary: Tianxin Pavilion is a city tower in the ancient city of Changsha, and the surrounding city walls are the only section of ancient city walls in Changsha. There is also a archway near Tianxin Pavilion called "Chonglie Gate", built in 1946 to commemorate the soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the three major battles in Changsha during the Anti Japanese War. Tianxin Pavilion is located within Tianxin Park and was first built in the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1746). The Tianxin Pavilion that tourists see today was rebuilt in 1983. The main building of Tianxin Pavilion is chargeable (including Tianxin Pavilion and the surrounding ancient city walls), while Tianxin Park is open for free. The overall architecture of Tianxin Pavilion is supported by 46 red painted columns, chestnut tiles and pink walls, and a solid gray white stone foundation. 62 stone lions are carved on the stone railings in front and behind the pavilion, and 32 wind horses and copper bells are hung on the pavilion, making a sound in the wind. There is a screening room next to the Tianxin Pavilion, which shows a film about the history of Tianxin Pavilion every hour, with a duration of about 7 minutes (equipment maintenance on Monday afternoon). The paid area also provides explanation services. Across from Tianxin Pavilion is the Bamboo Slips Museum, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 湘江风光带
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Xiangjiang River is the mother river of Changsha. It flows from south to north through Shaoshan Mountain and enters Changsha City, forming a beautiful scenic belt along the Yangtze River in Changsha. 
Xiangjiang Scenic Belt consists of more than ten leisure and fitness squares, green belts and historical and cultural landscapes, which have unique customs day and night. 
· It is also one of the best places to watch fireworks displays, so every weekend night, there is a lot of excitement along the river.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place for citizens to relax and entertain

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 湖南大学
attractions.summary: Hunan University is located in Changsha, Hunan Province, China. It is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history dating back to the founding of Yuelu Academy in 976 AD. Hunan University is renowned for its beautiful campus environment, rich cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Yuelu Academy and Aiwan Pavilion, which are important windows for understanding ancient Chinese education and culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

attractions.summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement

attractions.name: 栈桥
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; City coordinates; Bridges; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Qingdao's earliest military-specific artificial wharf is a landmark building and a famous scenic spot in Qingdao. 
The octagonal building inside the breakwater at the southern end is called "Huilan Pavilion". Standing here, you can enjoy the "Flying Pavilion Huilan", one of the ten scenic spots in Qingdao. 
The north coast is called "Zhanqiao Park", with lush flowers and plants, and stone chairs for tourists to rest and enjoy the scenery of the sea and sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old sea promenade

attractions.name: 圣弥厄尔教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in 1930, formerly known as "St. Miel Church", it is the largest Romanesque building in Qingdao and the only consecrated church in China. 
· Designed by German designer Biloha, according to Gothic and Romanesque architectural styles. It is a masonry twin tower building with four bells inside. 
· The church is spacious and bright. The hall is about 18 meters high. There are two confession booths on both sides of the corridors for priests to receive believers to confess and confess.  
• The church has a valuable organ imported from Germany, which is played only during Sunday Mass.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Western Architecture in Qingdao

attractions.name: 小鱼山公园
attractions.summary: Xiaoyushan Park is one of the best scenic spots in Qingdao, firstly because it is located in the city center and is a mountain close to the sea, with a geographical location; Secondly, due to its altitude of only 60 meters, climbing the mountain is not tiring. When you reach the top, you can see the representative scenery of Qingdao, which is "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky". At the top of Xiaoyushan Mountain, there is a three story octagonal pavilion called the Tide Viewing Pavilion, which is 18 meters high and covered with green glazed tiles. Climbing up the spiral staircase to enjoy the view, nearby are German style buildings with red tiles and yellow walls hidden among green trees. To the southeast, you can see the golden sand of the first beach connected to the blue sea. To the northeast, you can see the Qingdao TV Tower on Taiping Mountain. When the weather is good to the west, you can distinguish the small Qingdao and the wharf in the distance. To the north, you can take a panoramic view of Signal Mountain Park. The guesthouse on the mountainside of Signal Mountain and the three red topped mushroom buildings on the mountaintop are clearly visible. At night, you can take photos of the night view of Qingdao city on the mountain. To the west of the Lianchao Pavilion is the Hexagonal Pavilion with Bibo Pavilion, and to the east is the Four Corner Pavilion with Cuicui Pavilion. Both pavilions are covered with green glazed tiles, providing scenic views. The front of the curved corridor connecting the Lianchao Pavilion and Yongcui Pavilion features white reliefs, with modern characters "small" and "mountain" and ancient pictographic characters "fish" forming the mountain emblem of Xiaoyushan. You can take a photo with it, and there are also beautiful murals next to the emblem. In addition, on the southern slope of Xiaoyushan, there are miniature models that gather Qingdao architecture. If you are interested, you can also take a look. There are many scenic spots near Xiaoyushan Park, mostly along the coastline. To the west, you can follow the route of Zhanqiao - Navy Museum - Little Qingdao - Lu Xun Park - Xiaoyushan Park. To the east, you can see Kang Youwei's former residence, the first beach, Badaguan, and then go to Taipingjiao to see the sunset. Full text 

attractions.name: 鲁迅公园
attractions.summary:
Lu Xun Park is a free and open coastal park in Qingdao, with large reddish-brown reefs on the seaside. 
The park stretches from east to west along the long and narrow bedrock coast, adjacent to Qingdao Aquarium and First Bathing Beach in the east, with a total length of about 2 kilometers.  
The park has colorful red reefs, clear water, green pines, secluded paths, pavilions and pavilions, and charming scenery. It is a scenic spot with both garden beauty and natural beauty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Open Seaside Park with Beautiful Scenes

attractions.name: 海军博物馆
attractions.summary: The PLA Naval Museum is a military museum reflecting the development of the Chinese navy in China. It is the historical, spiritual and cultural highland of the People's Navy. The Navy Museum is located at No. 8 Laiyang Road, Shinan District, Qingdao, adjacent to Lu Xun Park to the east and Little Qingdao Park to the west, echoing the wharf from afar. The Naval Museum has a land area of approximately 141 acres and a sea area of approximately 214 acres. It was officially opened to the public in October 1989. In 2001, it was rated as a national defense education demonstration base by the Central Propaganda Department. In June 2021, at the important historical moment of celebrating the 100th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and achieving the goal of "the first 100 years", the Naval Museum completed its reconstruction and expansion, opened to the outside world with a new look, and presented the glorious history of the People's Navy for more than 70 years under the strong leadership of the CPC in a panoramic manner. On May 18, 2022, the Naval Museum's "Strong Towards the Sea - Basic Exhibition of the History of the People's Navy" was awarded the 19th (2021) "National Museum Top Ten Exhibition Excellence Award". The Naval Museum is divided into three exhibition areas: indoor, sea, and land. The indoor main exhibition hall is the basic display of the history of the People's Navy, with four exhibition halls covering an area of over 7000 square meters. It is divided into three parts: "Socialist Revolution and Construction Period", "New Era of Reform and Opening up and Socialist Modernization Construction", and "New Era of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics". There are over 18000 cultural relics in the collection, mainly displayed under the strong leadership of the Party, where the People's Navy was born, grew, and developed through artillery fire; Along the way, cutting through waves and traversing thousands of miles of maritime territory, galloping across the vast oceans, we are striding towards the goal of building a world-class navy. The exhibition area for naval vessels covers an area of over 40000 square meters, with 3 docks and 6 berths. It mainly showcases China's first destroyer Anshan (hull number 101), the first domestically produced destroyer Jinan (hull number 105), the first domestically produced air defense frigate Yingtan (hull number 531), the first nuclear submarine Long March 1 (hull number 401), the first experimental submarine Great Wall 200 (hull number 200) and other iconic vessels. The land equipment exhibition area covers an area of over 13000 square meters. The main exhibition showcases the small surface vessels, naval aviation equipment, marine equipment, and naval coastal defense equipment that have served in the People's Navy since its establishment. The main exhibits include: the Liberation class meritorious boats and gunboats that made great collective contributions in the Battle of Wanshan; The honor boat - No. 245 wooden shell torpedo boat showcased during the first naval parade of the People's Navy; The Il-14 aircraft, which once ensured the participation of Navy Commander Xiao Jingguang in various activities and carried out important tasks such as transporting rescue personnel, supplies, and international friends; Meritorious artillery that participated in the aid to Vietnam and anti US air defense operations; The T-34 tank, which has been widely equipped with the Marine Corps and island guarding forces such as the Xisha Islands; The YJ-62A shore to ship missile launcher, which is used to block ports and sea routes, and maneuver to strike large and medium-sized surface targets, is a significant naval weapon and equipment. These weapons and equipment have played a significant role in tasks such as liberating coastal islands, safeguarding maritime security, and protecting people's lives and property. The Naval Museum will focus on inheriting the red genes, keeping in mind the original mission, strengthening historical memory, and exerting educational functions, striving to build a leading domestic and world leading naval museum. Full text 

attractions.name: 琴屿路
attractions.summary: Qinyu Road, located between Luxun Park and Little Qingdao in Shinan District, Qingdao, is a very artistic path with distinctive Qingdao characteristics. You can come here to relax.

attractions.name: 小青岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a treasure spot for strolling with kids.; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiao Qingdao is named for its shape, which resembles an ancient zither, and is also known as "Qin Island." The white conical lighthouse standing at the highest point is the landmark building.  
· At night, the red light on the lighthouse and the lights on the pier float on the turquoise waves, creating the scene known as "Qin Island Floating Lights," which is regarded as one of Qingdao's top ten scenic spots and has become one of the city's symbols.  
· Now open to the public as a park, the island is mainly planted with black pines, along with seasonal flowering ornamental plants.  
· On the relatively flat southern part of the island, there is a small square, in the center of which stands a sculpture of a woman holding a zither, facing the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the landmark lighthouse on Qingdao Island.

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 青山渔村
attractions.summary: Qingshan Fishing Village is located in Laoshan Scenic Area, Laoshan District, Qingdao. Halfway up the mountainside of Laoshan Mountain, it still retains the original style of the fishing village. It has the reputation of Laoshan Fishing Village Folk Customs Museum
attractions.shortFeatures: Featuring fisherman culture

attractions.name: 崂山太清游览区
attractions.summary: The Taiqing Scenic Area is located at the southeast end of Laoshan Mountain, named after the Taoist temple Taiqing Palace. It is mainly divided into two tourist areas: the surrounding area of Taiqing Palace and along the Bashui River. The former is located by the sea, while the latter is a hiking route. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".

attractions.name: 黄岛金沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 
