Shangri-La Hotel Yuyue Mediterranean Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 天定山旅游度假小镇
attractions.summary: Tiandingshan Tourist Resort Town is a comprehensive parent-child entertainment square, including dozens of landscapes and amusement projects such as Cute Pet Paradise, Deer Garden, Ring Road Roaming, Extreme Adventure, Rainbow Slide, etc. Tiandingshan Tourist Resort Town is committed to creating a beautiful leisure and rural tourism destination for young people to get close to the natural environment, experience agricultural activities, enjoy organic ecological cuisine, and live a healthy life.

attractions.name: 净月潭
attractions.summary: Jingyue Lake is a reservoir in the southeast suburb of Changchun City. It is named for its shape like a crescent moon. Large areas of trees are planted around Jingyue Lake, making it a very large forest park in Changchun. It is known as the sisters lake of Taiwan's "Sun Moon Lake". Come to Jingyuetan Forest Park, you can stroll along the edge of the pond, enjoy the lake and mountain scenery by the reservoir dam, or stroll along the wooden boardwalk in the forest, breathe pure air, and enjoy forest bathing. In addition, there are attractions such as Jingyuetan Ski Resort and Beiputuo Temple in the park. The northwest end of Lake Jingyuetan Forest Park by bicycle is the main entrance, which can be reached by taking a light rail or bus from the city center. The park is very large, and there is a road around the lake. If you walk the whole way, it may take a whole day and it is very tiring. You can take a tour bus (electric scooter) along West Huantan Road at the main entrance square, and the final destination is the ski resort. You can get off halfway. However, what is more effortless and interesting is riding a bicycle. It takes nearly two hours to cycle around the lake, and bicycles can be rented at the main entrance. The forest bathing area, Jingyuetan Park, has lush trees and fresh air, making it perfect for enjoying forest bathing. On the south bank of Jingyue Lake, there is a forest bathhouse where you can stroll and relax in the dense forest, breathing in the pure air. To the west of Jingyue Lake, there is a small forest bathhouse where you can bring food, picnic cloth, or even a tent for camping. There is also Jilin Northeast Tiger Park in the park, but it is an independent attraction where you can see animals such as Northeast tigers, African lions, brown bears, and spotted deer. Rowing boats on Jingyue Lake is a pleasant thing, with boat docks located next to dams, ski resorts, and forest baths. In winter, you can come to Jingyuetan Ski Resort for skiing. There are beginner, intermediate, and advanced ski slopes as well as off-road ski slopes here. In summer, you can also experience the ski resort's cable ski slopes, which means taking the cable car up the mountain first, and then taking the 1.6-kilometer-long tube track slide down the mountain through layers of forest, which is quite exciting. Full text 

attractions.name: 长春博物馆
attractions.summary: Changchun Museum, which is a comprehensive museum that collects various types of collections such as Changchun's history, art, science, natural specimens, etc., collects, collects, displays and studies physical objects representing nature and Changchun's cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康大楼
attractions.summary: Wukang Building, located at the intersection of Huaihai Middle Road and Wukang Road, is flat in shape, like an iron, and looks like a French Renaissance style. Some celebrities in the cultural and entertainment circles have stayed here. The vicinity of Wukang Building is full of French style. Sitting at the open-air table of a roadside coffee shop, drinking a cup of coffee and basking in the sun, it seems like entering another time and space.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many famous people have stayed here

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

restaurants.name_en: No, I will just steam seafood dishes

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gulangyu Island is home to over a thousand buildings with a variety of styles, blending both Chinese and Western architecture. There are temples with traditional Chinese flying eaves and curved corners, Minnan-style courtyard houses, the Bagua Tower with a combination of Chinese and Western elements, small and delicate Japanese-style houses, 19th-century European consulates from Western countries, and the Shuzhuang Garden, which is considered a gem of Jiangnan classical gardens. It can be called an exposition of world architecture.

In recent years, several new buildings have been completed, including the former Gulangyu Park transformed into an Underwater World, the tall statue and relief of Zheng Chenggong in Haoyue Park, the marble statue of renowned Chinese gynecologist Lin Qiaozhi in Yuyuan, the subtropical plant introduction garden at Huijiao, with its shrubs, flowers, and fragrant palms, the Xiamen Museum displaying the city's thousand-year history and the development of its special economic zone, the Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall honoring the hero’s achievements, as well as Yanping Park, Gangzihou Swimming Pool, Zhongshan Library, People’s Stadium, and the Gulangyu villas with garden-style architecture, Guanhaiyuan Resort, Gulangyu Hotel, and more. With so many parks and buildings in just 1.78 square kilometers, the density of these structures is likely rare even in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: World Architecture Expo

Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 菽庄花园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
Shuzhuang Garden was built in 1913, named after the homophonic word "Shuzang" by Lin Erjia, a wealthy businessman in Taiwan Province. It is divided into two parts: Bushan Garden and Zanghai Garden. 
The main landscape of Bushan Garden is rockery, that is, twelve caves, with a total of 12 caves, inlaid with twelve zodiac signs at each cave entrance. 
The reason why Tibetan Sea Garden is called Tibetan Sea is that only when you turn out of the Moon Cave Gate will the sea appear in front of you, and the Forty-Fourth Bridge is the best point to view the sea. 
The Piano Museum in Tingtao Xuan in Shuzhuang Garden is a highlight. There will be special piano improvisation performances every half hour in the museum, which is worth listening to.
attractions.shortFeatures: Garden Landscape with Western Colors

attractions.name: 皓月园

Located in the east of Gulangyu Island, it was built to commemorate Zheng Chenggong's historical achievements in expelling Dutch barbarians and recovering Taiwan Province. 
The name of Haoyue Garden is taken from the word "Haoyue" in Zheng Chenggong's poem "I can't sleep when I miss you, but the bright moon is plain". 
The most eye-catching thing in the park is undoubtedly the statue of Zheng Chenggong, which is 10 times tall. 
Haoyue Garden is very close to Xiamen Island, and it is the best place to watch and shoot the Jinmao Twin Towers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Statue garden commemorating national heroes

Those interested in music can come and visit, otherwise they may find it boring. It is said to be the only organ museum in China and the largest in the world at present. The first floor of the venue displays many historical organs from around the world, most of which are produced in France and Spain. The treasure of the town hall here is the world's largest organ. The backyard of the museum houses some smuggled cultural relics seized from customs, all of which are stone carvings.

attractions.name: 国际刻字艺术馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary:
It is the only lettering art gallery in China. The museum officially opened on the morning of March 24, 2008. 
The newly opened Gulangyu International Lettering Art Museum is located in a small building with an area of more than 500 square meters opposite Shuzhuang Garden. The first floor is turned into an international exhibition hall, and the second floor is a China exhibition hall. At present, it is the only large-scale and high-grade international lettering art exhibition hall in the world. There are 407 works from China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and Malaysia in the museum. Most of these works were selected from the 5th National Lettering Art Exhibition and the 8th International Lettering Art Exhibition in 2004, representing the highest level of lettering art at home and abroad. The modern lettering art, which integrates calligraphy, engraving, painting, color, sculpture and decoration, has a distinctive flavor of the times and unique artistic charm, and is increasingly appreciated and favored by people.

attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.

The night view of Chaotianmen is also very beautiful. The lights are turned on at night, which is particularly beautiful. In front of you is the brightly lit pier, and there are flowery cruise ships shuttling around.

The Two Rivers Tour of Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous night view of Chongqing. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. attractions.name: 重庆WFC会仙楼观景台
attractions.summary: The WFC Huixianlou Observation Deck is located on floors 73-75 of WFC and was officially unveiled on June 8, 2017, perfectly presenting the past and present of Huixianlou. In the early 1980s, the Huixianlou Observation Deck was the first high-altitude observation deck in Chongqing and was known as the "pinnacle of Chongqing". The WFC Huixianlou Observation Deck overlooks the core urban landscapes of Chongqing, including the confluence of two rivers, the Grand Theater, the night view of Nanbin Road, a tree viewing platform, two river cruise ships, and the three-dimensional night view of the mountain city. While enjoying a visual feast, one can also experience the unique geographical wonders of Chongqing, pursue the cultural symbols that belong to Chongqing, and bloom the charm of Chongqing. WFC Hui Xian Lou Observation Deck 73-74 floors offer a 360 degree modern and innovative viewing experience; The 75 story fully open-air design allows you to admire the dazzling starry sky and contemplate the vast universe. It can also be used as a filming location for wedding photos, commercial films, and movies; Fashion show venue; Cold buffet and cocktail parties can choose venues; A must visit place for travel. Has hosted five international and Chengdu Chongqing high-rise building competitions, the first cloud based collective wedding in Yuzhong District in 2023, and won awards such as the 2019 Cloud based Scenic Spot and the 2022 Landmark Attraction. The first height of WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck | Unparalleled View WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck, with an altitude of 590 meters, stands proudly on the Yuzhong Peninsula, bringing you an extraordinary visual feast at such a height. 360 ° panoramic view of the confluence of the two rivers and the seventeen bridges spanning the Yangtze River and Jialing River, allowing you to experience the unique urban panorama of the magical mountain city and the ever-changing urban changes of Chongqing. L Core Area | Location can not be copied WFC Huixianlou Sightseeing Platform, which is located in the core area of Yuzhong Peninsula, the mother city of Chongqing. It is the closest viewing platform to Monument to the people's Liberation, echoing the landmark landscapes such as Chongqing Grand Theater and Nanbin Road from afar. Whether tourists from all over the country or native citizens, it is easy to reach by light rail, public transport or other means of transportation. There are more than 800 parking spaces in the underground garage, which is convenient for self driving. L Past Life | History Can't Replace WFC Huixian Tower Sightseeing Platform is located on the 73-75 floors of Chongqing World Financial Center. WFC was the tallest Huixian Tower in Chongqing in the past, built in the 1980s, and the first high-rise in Chongqing higher than Monument to the people's Liberation. The location of Huixian Tower, formerly known as Huixian Bridge, was the birthplace of Chongqing's fashion industry in the 1920s. It once saw the emergence of high-end venues such as the Old Paris Barber Shop, Queen's Dance Hall, and Heart Caf é. On the 73rd floor of the WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck, a large number of old photos and maps of Chongqing are displayed. The mottled old time is condensed in each frame, showcasing the changes in Chongqing's history and the past and present of Huixian Tower from a temporal and spatial perspective, allowing the charm of Chongqing's city to be fully revealed. This is the place where the story of Little Carrot Head took place. It once held the Communist Party, and it was also the place where many martyrs died. Its historical significance is much greater than that of scenic spots. 
Divided into two lanes, left and right, you need to climb the ladder, and visit Xiangshan Villa on the left side, which is actually the place where "political prisoners" are held; Climb the mountain on the right side to visit the place where Yang Hucheng died and the place where Little Carrot Head was killed.
