attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 苏州中心广场
attractions.summary: Suzhou Center is the core component of Suzhou Central Plaza, which is divided into two buildings. The northern district focuses on international fast fashion, family, and parent-child activities, while the southern district focuses on light luxury and dining. There are numerous brands gathered here, as well as an aerial ecological park, which forms a unified urban architectural image with the Oriental Gate and Jinji Lake.

attractions.name: 诚品书店(诚品生活苏州店)
attractions.summary: Eslite Bookstore is not so much a bookstore as a comprehensive building with bookstores as its main body. The entire building is built with a strong sense of design, and from the east gate, you can see the iconic 72 step staircase that is 18 meters high and 6 meters wide, which is very magnificent. The bookstore sells a large number of books and thoughtfully sets aside areas for customers to sit down and read. In addition, exquisite stationery stores, dessert shops, coffee shops, restaurants, and clothing stores are distributed on various floors, where literary and artistic youth can stroll around for a whole day. The rich collection of books includes 150000 varieties and 500000 volumes of Chinese and foreign books from 2000 publishing institutions around the world, covering five major book areas: Chinese and foreign literature, humanities and social sciences, art and design, lifestyle, and trend learning. You can see a large number of traditional Chinese books by Taiwanese writers, but the book prices are slightly higher. At the entrance of the book sales area is the "Eslite Selected Books" bookshelf, which lists Eslite's recommended books. It is said that the quality is good and worth a look. An interesting store located in B1 collects and sells small items and handicrafts, such as Suzhou embroidery, Suzhou fans, nuclear carving, woodcut New Year paintings, etc., all of which have local characteristics of Suzhou. The visual laboratory is located in the attic above the art book area, exhibiting art works and decorated in a small and fresh manner. The Eslite Children's Center on the second floor sells children's books and small toys, and customers with children can come here to take a stroll. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州湾王焰温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Suzhou Bay Wangyan Hot Spring is located in Taihu New Town, Wujiang District, Suzhou City. It is a hot spring-themed resort scenic spot integrating catering and accommodation, SPA health care, Chinese and western physiotherapy and outdoor leisure. No matter from the architectural style, aesthetic taste, experience projects, garden design, or style, Wang Yan Hot Spring is a unique and rare leading treasure. Wangyan Hot Spring takes the oriental aesthetic thought of "New Asia" as its source, the cultural heritage of "New Gusu" in the south of the Yangtze River as its foundation, and the natural realm of Taoism of "New Taihu Lake" as its soul. It connects the past and the present, integrates China and the West, and interprets the wonderful fusion of elegance and light luxury, and the mutual composition of classics and fashion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Characteristic hot springs in oriental garden style

attractions.name: 东钱湖
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· It is the largest freshwater lake in Zhejiang, composed of Guzi Lake, Mei Lake, and Outer Lake, and is four times the size of West Lake in Hangzhou.  
· The most popular attraction at Dongqian Lake is the long causeway near Xiaoputuo, which is highly recommended for a walk to enjoy the scenic beauty of Dongqian Lake.  
· Apart from visiting attractions, cycling around Dongqian Lake is arguably the most popular activity, allowing visitors to leisurely admire the lakeside landscapes, mountain views, and natural villages along the way.  
· The Plum Garden by Dongqian Lake is renowned as one of the most beautiful spots in Ningbo for appreciating plum blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cycling along the lake to see the Waterborne Guanyin

attractions.name: 宁波院士中心
attractions.summary: The Ningbo Academician Center was rebuilt from the old campus of Ningbo Normal University. The red brick facade and water ripple arch design exude a strong sense of age. The winding landscape corridor connects the research and development buildings and academic comprehensive buildings located at the east and west ends. Walking into the landscape corridor, you can see the lake and mountains in full view, becoming a popular spot for internet celebrities to check in.

attractions.name: 利民村
attractions.summary: Limin Village is located to the east and north of Taogong Mountain, to the west of Dongqian Lake Xiaoputuo Scenic Area, and is connected to Taogong Village. Without doorplate instructions, it is almost impossible to distinguish them. The residential houses in the village are distributed along the lake, facing the water on both sides, and there are several large trees by the lake. There is a long village road along the lake, and standing on the roadside, you can enjoy the scenery of the lake and mountains. Occasionally, speedboats or small boats gallop by on the lake, full of poetic and picturesque charm. If you go boating on the lake, the entire Limin Village will be reflected in the lake, like a mirage, becoming a beautiful landscape painting.

attractions.name: 东钱湖小普陀
attractions.summary:
Little Putuo in Ningbo, also known as Xiayu, is located in the center of Dongqian Lake. It is one of the main scenic spots in Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort and has a profound cultural heritage. 
The main landscapes of the scenic spot are: Butuo Cave Sky, Qiandi Smoke Wave, Taogong Diaoyi, Qingfeng Xianggui, Chenghu Lake Bright Moon, Xiayu Suolan, Mountain Monk Hubo, Erling Snapshot 
You can drink tea at the Moonwave Building in the square, or play live CS and barbecue at the paintball center 
Guanyin on the water is the landmark landscape of Xiaoputuo. There is a stone building "Western Ship" in the temple. It is very nice to board the boat and see the scenery of Dongqian Lake from a height. 
Every year in March and April, peach blossoms bloom in Taohuawu between Suolan Bridge and Guanyin on the Water, which is the best time to visit Xiaoputuo.
attractions.shortFeatures: Popular Guanyin Dojo around Ningbo

attractions.name: 东钱湖陶公岛景区
attractions.name_en: Dongqian Lake Taogong Island Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure
attractions.summary:
Taogong Island Scenic Spot is the seclusion place of Fan Li and Xi Shi, and Taogong Island is the most auspicious and romantic place in Ningbo.  
Taogong Island Scenic Spot integrates nostalgia, leisure and entertainment, among which the ancestral court of the God of Wealth is the only in the world, the dragon boat entertainment is the only in Ningbo, the picnic barbecue is the first in Ningbo, and the delicious taste of Taogong is the best in Ningbo. 
The main landscapes of Taogong Island Scenic Area are: Ruyi Gate, Caishen Ancestral Court, Wulu Caishen Temple, Jiutai Da Yuanbao, etc. It is the most popular place for tourism and leisure in Ningbo and Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combine nostalgia, leisure and entertainment

attractions.name: 韩岭美术馆
attractions.summary: Hanling Art Museum is located in Yinzhou District, Ningbo City. It is a garden themed art museum with a unique design and beautiful surroundings, suitable for taking photos and taking photos.

attractions.name: 韩岭老街
attractions.summary:
Hanling Old Street is known as "the first ancient street in eastern Zhejiang". Hanling Village has a long history. It is said that it was named after the Han surname lived here in its early years. 
There are two old streets in Hanling, namely the front street and the back street, which run through the whole village. Commerce and trade are concentrated in Qianjie, with a total length of more than 500 meters, which is divided into Xiajie, Middle Street and Shangjie. More than 30 shops in the village are mostly concentrated in the lower street, and there is a street stream flowing slowly in the middle of the lower street. The whole street used to be paved with blue-black cobblestones, but now it is a cement road. 
The old street still maintains the style of hundreds of years ago: there are all two-story buildings on both sides, gray tiles and white walls, and red paint facades, one room after another, stretching forward, using the place names left by the market of that year, such as bamboo shed roots, firewood fields, etc. There is also a small manhole in the village. The well water is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a hint of sweetness. Although there is tap water in the village, the villagers still like to eat the water from the small manhole.
attractions.shortFeatures: The old street maintains the style of hundreds of years ago

attractions.name: 天一阁博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; hidden gem for kids; Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the city of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, it is the oldest existing private library in China, as well as the oldest library in Asia and one of the world's earliest family libraries.
- Built in the mid-Ming Dynasty, it was overseen by Fan Qin, a retired Deputy Minister of the Ministry of War. Many exhibition halls display books collected by the Fan family from all corners of the world.
- The architecture combines various traditional folk crafts such as wood carving, brick carving, stone carving, gilding, and embossing, making it a masterpiece of Ningbo's residential architecture.
- Inside the Tianyi Pavilion, there is also an interesting Mahjong Museum, which has become a popular spot for many to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient private library.

attractions.name: 南塘老街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Ningbo Nantang Old Street, developed and constructed by Ningbo City Travel Investment Development Co., Ltd., is located outside the south gate of Ningbo Ancient City, Zhejiang Province. It used to be the "Three Cities at the South Gate" of the old Ningbo trade and culture gathering place, ranking one of the eight historical districts in Ningbo, and it is also the protected area of Ningbo's "Purple Line Planning". It runs north-south, bounded by Zuguanshan Road, and is divided into two streets: south and north streets. The block retains more than 300 meters of traditional streets and lanes, with one cultural protection unit and six cultural protection points. The descendants of Yuan Xie, a famous scholar in the Song Dynasty, have lived here for generations. The existing residential buildings of the Yuan family in the area are the largest, including residential courtyards, ancestral halls, schools, etc., and others include cultural protection buildings such as Yongshui Bridge, Yongshan Pavilion and Guansheng Temple. North Street takes traditional culture as its keynote, commerce as its content and urban tourism as its development direction. South Street focuses on the concept of "urban leisure", highlighting leisure life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reappear the century-old business life in Ningbo

attractions.name: 老外滩
attractions.tag: A hidden gem for strolling with kids; neighborhood walk.; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Ningbo Old Bund opened to the public in 1844 and is currently one of the few Bunds in China with a history of over a century. It serves as the gateway to the ancient city of Ningbo.  
- The Old Bund still preserves many European-style old buildings that have been converted into bars and restaurants. The Gothic-style Catholic Church in Jiangbei is one of the landmarks of Ningbo.  
- What makes the Old Bund unique is that it is not enclosed; citizens can experience their daily life at the Sanjiang Port of the Old Bund.  
- At the same time, the Old Bund is also a bar street, bustling with activity in the evening, and many foreigners enjoy relaxing and socializing here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoying drinks at a bar while admiring the beautiful European-style architecture.

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 迪士尼故事剧场
attractions.summary: This is a theater where people can follow Mickey's adventure journey, shuttle through 7 popular Disney classic stories, and meet a large group of Disney friends!

attractions.name: 赤柱广场-天幕广场
attractions.summary: It is a comprehensive commercial square that integrates shopping, dining, and leisure entertainment. You can find various fashionable clothing, accessories, cosmetics, and household items here. Whether you are a shopping enthusiast or a fashion follower, this place can meet your needs.

attractions.name: 美利楼
attractions.summary:
Walking along Stanley Waterfront at the southern end of Hong Kong Island, enjoying the sunshine, beach, breeze, and a beautiful Murray Building in front of you. It feels as freehand as you are on the beach in southern France. 
 
There are two exotic restaurants in Murray House, Spanish and German, where you can enjoy delicious food and wine with endless sea views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmarks in Stanley

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 凌霄阁
attractions.summary:
Lingxiao Pavilion is the terminal of the Peak Tram, and it is also a comprehensive tourist attraction integrating climbing, viewing, shopping, dining and entertainment. 
There are 6 floors in total. The 1st-3rd floors are mainly delicious food. There are 4 different fashionable restaurants in China, West and Japan, where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery while eating. 
· It also includes important attractions such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Peak Post Office, which are also a must-check-in place for tourists to visit Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: The skyscraper enjoys the beautiful view of Hong Kong

attractions.name: 中环至半山自动扶梯
attractions.summary: The Central to Mid Levels escalator connects the Central business district with the Mid Levels residential area. It was built by the British Hong Kong government in 1993 to improve traffic in Mid Levels. The escalator consists of 20 one-way escalators and 3 automatic pedestrian walkways, starting from the Central Market and ending at Conduit Road. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and there are multiple exits along the way, making it convenient for pedestrians to get on and off. The Mid Levels escalator crosses multiple major streets in Central, including Queen's Road Central, Hollywood Road, and other attractions along the way, such as the old Central Police Station, making it a great means of transportation for tourists. In addition, the escalator will also pass through the SOHO area, which is filled with restaurants and bars, European style small bars, specialty tea restaurants, and souvenir shops, where foodies can find satisfying cuisine.

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 香港会议展览中心
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary:
--The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, located at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, is one of the newest seaside buildings in Hong Kong. 
--It can be used for large-scale conferences and exhibitions, as well as two five-star hotels, office buildings and luxury apartments.  
--The venue of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony in 1997, where many awards ceremonies and music awards ceremonies are usually held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Place of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: Big Bus香港观光巴士游
attractions.summary: Kowloon Night Tour: Immerse yourself in the neon lights of Hong Kong after dark. The Kowloon night tour will pass through the bustling city center of Kowloon, visiting attractions such as Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, bustling Temple Street Night Market, Canton Road, Clock Tower, and Hong Kong Coliseum. The journey ends at the Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade, which is a great place to watch the exciting free performance "Symphony of Lights". The performance starts at 8:00 every night. Along the Hong Kong Island Red Line, you can explore different aspects of Hong Kong by open top buses, from the towering skyscrapers of Central, bustling shopping areas, leisurely SoHo district, colonial Hollywood Road, and antique Wenwu Temple. The convertible bus will pass through Repulse Bay, Deep Water Bay, Stanley, Aberdeen, and Victoria Harbour, allowing you to enjoy the magnificent scenery along the coastline while riding. When you arrive in Stanley, you can freely visit the characteristic attractions of Stanley such as Stanley Market, Murray Building, Pok Kong Pier, Chek Lap Kok Promenade and Stanley Main Beach, and take an open top bus back in 1 hour.

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园登山缆车
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Ocean Park cable car is a classic facility of the Ocean Park, taking visitors leisurely back and forth between the seaside amusement park at the foot of the mountain and the peak amusement park on the mountain. Passengers can slowly climb up the green hills in the sea breeze, fully enjoy the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, and have a panoramic view of various attractions in the Ocean Park, planning their next stop itinerary carefully.

attractions.name: 昂坪360
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Cable car ropeway; Cable Cars
attractions.summary:
· Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car is the longest outdoor double-cable cable car in Asia, and has won the reputation of Top Ten Surprise Cable Car Tours in the World, Top Ten Best Cable Car Experiences in the World and Top Ten Global Cable Car Tours. 
· A total length of 5.7 kilometers, built on a hill, connecting Tung Chung and Ngong Ping. Overlooking the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, surrounded by the South China Sea, it connects Tung Chung and Ngong Ping Market. 
· After getting off the bus, you will arrive at Ngong Ping Market, which is connected to Po Lin Temple and Tiantan Buddha. It is enjoyed by a vast natural environment and combines Chinese architecture with diversified shopping and dining experiences. 
· In addition to shopping and dining, Ngong Ping Market also provides entertainment programs including: 360VR Experience Hall, 360 Stage, 360 Dynamic Cinema and Walking with Buddha.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the magnificent scenery of mountains and seas; Crystal cabin bottom glass fully transparent

attractions.name: 大澳
attractions.summary:
· Tai O, located on an outlying island, is the earliest developed fishing village on the island. The tall shacks built on the water are the characteristic of Tai O. 
· Fishing villages are far away from the hustle and bustle of urban areas and less affected by urbanization, so they still retain the features of early Hong Kong fishing villages. 
· The vertical and horizontal waterways and water shacks constitute a unique feeling of water town and fishing village scenery, so it is known as the Venice of Hong Kong. 
· The traditional salted fish, shrimp paste and fish maw here are very famous. When you set foot in Tai O, you will feel the strong taste of the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: A tall hut built on the water

attractions.name: 黄大仙祠
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Wong Tai Sin Temple, formerly known as Sik Sik Yuen, is one of the most popular temples. 
· Wong Tai Sin, where the temple is enshrined, is said to be responsive to requests. There are other buildings rich in Chinese traditional colors in the temple, such as Sansheng Temple, Main Hall and Congxin Garden. 
There is a small park next to the shrine, which is well designed, exquisite and exquisite, and has a garden scenery. The Nine Dragon Wall on the side is modeled after the Forbidden City in Beijing.  
The most distinctive feature of Wong Tai Sin Temple is its "five-shaped" architectural layout. Feiluan Terrace, Sutra Hall, Yuye Pool, Yuxiang Pavilion and Zhaobi in the temple each represent the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire and earth.
attractions.shortFeatures: The temple of the three religions with exuberant incense

attractions.name: 前水警总部大楼及马厩
attractions.name_en: Former Water Police Headquarters Building and Stables
attractions.summary: The former Marine Police Headquarters building was built in 1884, including the main building, stables, and time tower; After restoration, it became the '1881 Heritage', which includes exhibitions related to this building.

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is a tributary of the lower reaches of the Yangtze River, mostly in Nanjing, and is regarded as the mother river of Nanjing 
Known as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai", it is one of the most prosperous places in Nanjing, and it is also a must-see place for many tourists to come to Nanjing. 
· You can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Qinhuai River by boat at night, and feel the local customs and customs of the river from different perspectives. 
There are festivals in all seasons, such as cultural temple fair in spring, Qinhuai summer in summer, Confucius Temple Food Festival in autumn, Jinling Lantern Festival in winter, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Listen to the music on both sides of the strait and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the Beautiful night view

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 佛顶宫
attractions.summary:
Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

attractions.name: 桃花溪
attractions.summary: In spring, the flower buds gradually bloom in Taohua Creek, creating a sea of enchanting flowers.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 扬帆夜市
attractions.summary: Yangfan Night Market is located in Furong District, Changsha City and was established in 2011. The night market is distributed in a cross shape, with a total length of about 1050 meters and more than 370 specialty small shops gathered, making it very lively.

attractions.name: 李自健美术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
attractions.shortFeatures: Artist's personal gallery

attractions.name: 谢子龙影像艺术馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Fine Art Galleries; Activities
attractions.shortFeatures: Collection of early historical images of China

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

- The exhibition includes a female corpse and her internal organs preserved in the basement, a restored giant coffin, and the remains of tomb pit No. 3 and mound No. 2 from the Mawangdui site.

attractions.summary:
- Located at the northern end of the city, it integrates mountains, sea, city, and port, making it a seaside mountain park with three sides facing the sea. It is also a landmark scenic spot in Yantai.

Moon Bay is a symbol of Yantai's urban charm, and it is also recognized as a romantic holy place for couples. 
Located on the coast of the Yellow Sea, Yantai Mountain on the left, East Fort on the right, close to Jiuzhang Cliff and backed by Daiwang Mountain. 
· Two headlands, one in the east and the other in the west, embrace a deep moon-shaped bay. The rocks, sea water, long embankments and harbors are integrated into one, which is spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Clear water and gentle sandy beach

attractions.name: 蓬莱阁
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Penglai Pavilion, along with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is known as one of China's Four Great Towers.  
· Known as the "Fairyland on Earth," the well-known myth of "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea" originates here.  
· Penglai Pavilion is located by the sea, often shrouded in mist, making it feel like being in a fairyland. On a good day, one can even witness a "mirage."  
· In addition to Penglai Pavilion, the scenic area also includes Tianheng Mountain, Dengzhou Museum, Ancient Ship Museum, and the dividing line between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.  
· From the mountain top, one can enjoy a distant view of the junction between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, where the boundary line between the yellow and blue waters is very distinct, and one can also see Changdao Island in the distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Legend of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea

attractions.name: 田横山公园
attractions.summary: Tianheng Mountain is located on the west side of Penglai Pavilion on Danya Mountain. There is a lighthouse built on the mountain. The line between Tianheng Mountain and Laotie Mountain lighthouse in Lushun is the boundary between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, so it has a unique geographical position of "one mountain divides two seas". In 202 BC, King Tian Heng of Qi committed suicide by cutting himself due to his unwillingness to serve his vassal Liu Bang. Upon hearing the news of Tian Heng's death, the five hundred strong men stationed on Tian Heng Mountain sang funeral songs, and after the songs ended, they committed suicide one after another. The indomitable spirit of Tian Heng and five hundred brave warriors deeply influenced future generations, hence the name Tian Heng Mountain. Tianheng Mountain has an altitude of only 72 meters, but the rocks are reddish brown. From a distance and up close, it has the characteristic of a "water blue mountain red" cliff scenery. The cliffs on the east, north, and west sides are steep, with strange rocks and scales. Standing on the railing, watching the sea and listening to the waves, thinking about the past and cherishing the present, has a unique charm. There are inscriptions on the tomb of Ji Tianheng, Qi Wang Ding, Xiaoyaolu, Bagua Pile, and Sun Tzu Han Bamboo Slips sculpture inside.

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing

- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.

Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".

attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.

attractions.name: 课植园
attractions.summary:
Kezhi Garden, which took 15 years to build, is the largest manor-style garden building in the town. It was once the private residence of Ma Wenqing, a local magnate. 
The name of the garden is "Class Planting", which means "don't forget to cultivate after reading in class". The class garden is a living and learning area, and the topiary is a recreational farming area, with a quiet environment and unique scenery. 
Wangyue Building and Bookstore are the most typical buildings combining Chinese and Western styles in the garden. The stele gallery in the garden is inlaid with handwritten stone carvings such as poems and letters of Tang, Zhu, Wen and Zhou, the four talented scholars of Ming Dynasty, which have high historical and cultural value. 
· It is a great place to take children to play here with rich tour content.
attractions.shortFeatures: A combination of Chinese and Western, originally owned by Jia Shang

attractions.name: 朱家角大清邮局
attractions.summary: The Zhujiajiao Great Qing Post Office was established in 1903 and is the former site of the Great Qing Post Office preserved in East China. It is also the earliest postal institution in the region. It is said that there were a total of thirteen postal stations in Shanghai at that time, and Zhujiajiao Post Office was one of them. After the Xinhai Revolution overthrew the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Post Office continued to operate as China Post. In 1953, it was relocated to the vicinity of Fangsheng Bridge on North Street, and in 2001, it was listed as a cultural relic protection unit in Qingpu District. The antique bronze cast dragon mailbox standing outside the old post office site is a unique business card of Zhu Jiajiao, showcasing the retro romance of "slow carriages and horses, long letters and letters". In 2022, the overall building of Zhujiajiao Daqing Post Office will undergo a comprehensive spatial upgrade, revitalizing through the renovation of the old style. While preserving the original Ming and Qing architectural styles and cultural heritage, it will integrate new Chinese aesthetics, combining cultural exchange, cultural and creative experiences, art exhibitions, study salons, boat tours, and other diverse cultural experiences. This will recreate the century old vicissitudes of the ancient town post office and showcase the long history of China Post. In addition to the historical attributes of ancient architectural sites, more cultural exchange spaces such as theme coffee, cultural exhibitions, characteristic cultural creation, creative workshops, art summer camps, etc. have also been opened up. In this building that has witnessed the time, we will continue to publicize the profound history and the vitality of modern China-Chic culture. Full text 

The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 独秀峰王城景区
attractions.name_en: Solitary Beauty Peak Prince City Scenic Area
attractions.summary: The Duxiu Peak Wangcheng Scenic Area can be traced back to over 600 years ago during the Hongwu period of the Ming Dynasty. It was once a fiefdom city built by Zhu Yuanzhang for his nephew Zhu Shouqian. Today, it is a national 5A level scenic spot in Guilin, and Duxiu Peak is its iconic attraction. The natural landscape and historical and cultural landscapes in the scenic area complement each other, making it a "city within a city's scenery" and a carrier of Guilin, a world-renowned historical and cultural city of mountains and waters. The famous saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world" originated from the stone wall of Duxiu Peak. It covers the three major historical and cultural systems of Guilin and is a typical representative of Guilin's history and culture. Walking into the scenic area is like entering the gate of Guilin's history and culture. Therefore, the famous saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world, and after reading all the royal cities, one knows Guilin" has been widely spread by the world. As early as the Southern and Northern Dynasties, the great literary scholar Yan Yanzhi began to write and recite poetry at the foot of Duxiu Peak, which opened up the literary style in the Lingnan region. During the Tang Dynasty, the first official university in Guangxi's history was established here. During the Song Dynasty, Wang Zhenggong engraved the timeless famous line "Guilin's landscape is the best in the world" on Duxiu Peak, which has become a representative advertising slogan for Guilin. During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang's military advisor Liu Bowen was interested in the wind and water treasure land of Duxiu Peak, and later built the Jingjiang Palace. In the Qing Dynasty, the Jingjiang Palace was converted into the Guangxi Gongyuan, becoming a large imperial examination center in the southwest region. A total of 585 successful candidates and 4 top scorers emerged, with one top scorer being the "Three Yuan Ji". During the Republic of China period, Sun Yat sen launched the Northern Expedition and established the Jingjiang Palace as the main base for the expedition. In 1954, Guangxi Normal University moved in. Duxiu Peak · Wangcheng is not only a place of outstanding people and land, but also the political, economic, and cultural center of Guangxi throughout history. Duxiu Peak is located in the center of Guilin city. It stands tall and rises from the ground, making it the top of all the mountains in Guilin and the king of all the mountains. Climbing to the summit, one can overlook the entire city of Guilin, with a majestic atmosphere of "overlooking all the mountains", and is known as the "pillar of the southern sky". As early as the Southern Dynasties period, the great literary scholar Yan Yanzhi wrote a poem titled "Not as outstanding as the Duxiu Peak, between the E and E towns" to describe the magnificent momentum of Duxiu Peak. Jingjiang Wangfu is a well preserved site of feudal lords in China and a core tourist attraction within the Duxiu Peak Wangcheng Scenic Area. The Jingjiang Wangfu Museum, also known as the "Carrier Hall," was the place where ancient princes handled government affairs. Nowadays, the museum displays the history of Jingjiang Wangfu and the entire Guilin. Visitors can gain a deeper understanding through high-tech full range projection and 3D projection, and also experience ancient printing techniques firsthand at the "Wangfu Tuofang". On the cliff of Duxiu Peak, there are about 200 cliff carvings, all of which have been preserved throughout the ages. The famous ancient saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world" comes from here. A large number of precious Buddha statues and Tai Sui stone carvings, as well as the Five Blessings series that was featured in the 2017 CCTV Spring Festival Gala, all come from the cliff carvings of Duxiu Peak and are now national key protected cultural relics. The Royal Palace Secret Topography has a history of over a hundred years and is a colorful wind water rubbing technique developed by the third generation Prince Jingjiang Zhu Zuojing. It has now been listed as an intangible cultural heritage. Tourists can experience ancient printing techniques here and learn how to make secret rubbings for the royal palace, which has important value for the inheritance and development of Chinese history, culture, and folk art. Full text 

attractions.name: 逍遥楼
attractions.summary: Between Jiefang Bridge and Fubo Mountain in the northern section of Binjiang Road in today's urban area. Founded in the Tang Dynasty, it is the Dongcheng Building of Guizhou City in the Tang Dynasty, with a stone tablet of "Xiaoyao Building" written by Yan Zhenqing. Yan Zhenqing (709-785), whose courtesy name is Qing Chen, was a native of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province today. He was a scholar in the Kaiyuan period of Tang Dynasty. He once worked as the censor in the palace, the prefect of Pingyuan (now Shandong Province), and then became the prince Taishi and the duke of Lu County. He was known as "Yan Lugong" in the world. His calligraphy is dignified, vigorous and powerful, and original, which is called "Yan Ti". Yan Zhenqing has never been to Guilin. According to legend, this tablet was re-engraved according to the hook copy of the tablet in Puzhou (now Yongji, Shanxi). Because it is located in Dongcheng Building, this building is called "Xiaoyao Building". The first year of Chongning in Song Dynasty (1102). Guangnan West Road was reassured by Cheng Jie to rebuild the building and renamed it "Xiangnan Building". The "Records of Xiangnan Building" on the stele yin of the existing "Xiaoyao Building" records the process of building repair and the reason for name change.
attractions.shortFeatures: Dongcheng Tower of Guizhou City in Tang Dynasty

The scenic area is located in the center of Taohuawan Scenic Area in Xiufeng District, Guilin City. It is a national 4A level tourist attraction, covering an area of more than 30 acres.
