attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院秦陵铜车马
attractions.name_en: Bronze Chariot and Horse of Qinling
attractions.summary: Copper chariots and horses were discovered 20 meters west of the imperial tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang. These are two large painted bronze chariots and horses, one in front and one behind, placed in a wooden coffin. Although it was crushed by soil when unearthed, there were no major changes in its original position, and the components of the chariot and horse were basically complete. This is a bronze chariot and horse that was discovered early, large in size, and well preserved in the history of archaeology in China. Archaeologists have restored it and it was exhibited to the public in 1983. Copper chariots and horses were one of the burial objects of Emperor Qin Shi Huang, symbolizing a part of his royal carriage. The copper chariot and horse are made by reducing the proportion of half of the real copper chariot and horse. The car cover and the interior and exterior of the carriage are painted with exquisite patterns, and the gold and silver decorations on top weigh up to 14 kilograms. The No.1 copper chariot is a standing chariot, also known as a tall chariot. The carriage is rectangular in shape with a single shaft and two wheels. The doors are located at the back of the carriage, and there is a circular copper umbrella on the carriage. Under the umbrella stands the imperial official, who controls the carriage with both hands and drives four horses in front. The carriage was equipped with weapons such as copper crossbows, copper shields, and copper arrowheads, which played a role in opening roads, guarding, and launching expeditions in the emperor's convoy. The second car is an Anche and also has a single shaft and two wheels. The total weight is 1241 kilograms, assembled from 3462 components of different sizes. The carriage consists of two compartments, one front and one rear, with windows between them. The door for boarding is located at the back and has an oval shaped hood. It is a precious bronze artifact unearthed in China, with complete equipment, high grade, and exquisite craftsmanship.

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. Full text 

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 小雁塔(荐福寺)
attractions.summary: The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located inside Jianfu Temple, named after its shape resembling the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and being smaller than it. Compared to the hustle and bustle of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the Small Wild Goose Pagoda is much quieter. Under the Small Wild Goose Pagoda, there are many exquisite stone sculptures from various dynasties, such as stone Buddhas, stone lions, stone horses, and horse tie stakes, placed outdoors. Tourists who enjoy folk cultural relics should not miss them. The Little Wild Goose Pagoda was built during the reign of Tang Jinglong (707 AD) to accommodate the "eminent monk Yijing" who came back from India to translate Buddhist scriptures. At the beginning of its construction, it had fifteen floors, but due to multiple earthquakes, it now has thirteen floors. There are wooden stairs inside the tower that spiral upwards to reach the top of the tower. Jianfu Temple was founded in the first year of Tang Ruizong's civilization (684 AD), originally located in Kaihua Fang, Chang'an City, Tang Dynasty. It was later destroyed and rebuilt at its current address. The temple preserves a large iron bell cast in 1192 AD (the third year of the Jin Mingchang era). In the Qing Dynasty, the bell would ring here every morning, which is the famous "Yanta Morning Bell". Nowadays, on New Year's Day every year, there is an event held here to ring bells and pray for blessings. In 2007, the Xi'an Museum was built inside the Jianfu Temple, adding a lake surface and new landscaping.

attractions.name: 大兴善寺
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Daxingshan Temple is located in Xingshan Temple West Street, Xiaozhai, about 2.5 kilometers south of Xi'an. 
· It was founded in the period from Sima Yantai to Taikang (AD 265-AD 289) of Emperor Wu of Jin Dynasty, more than 1600 years ago. It was first called Zunshan Temple. In the second year of Emperor Wendi Yang Jian of the Sui Dynasty (AD 582), Zunshan Temple was expanded on the basis of Zunshan Temple. Because the temple was located in Jingshan Square of Daxingcheng, the capital, it was renamed "Daxingshan Temple". 
During the Kaiyuan period of the Tang Dynasty, Indian monks were stationed in Xiben Temple successively, translating classics, setting up altars to pass on secrets, and then passing on and carrying forward them by one line and Huiguo, forming a profound treasure house of Buddhist culture-Tang Mi. Later, it was spread to Japan and South Korea through Konghai and Zuicheng, and then to Malaysia, Indonesia and other places, which spread widely and had a long influence.

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 黄河路
attractions.summary: Shanghai Huanghe Road is a place where food and culture blend together. In the heart of Shanghai, a bustling city, lies a street full of stories and flavors - Huanghe Road. Although its name reminds people of China's mother river, in fact, this street located in Huangpu District, adjacent to Nanjing West Road, is famous for its rich and diverse food culture, becoming a food paradise that diners eagerly explore. In addition to delicious food, the Yellow River Road also carries rich cultural connotations. This used to be a part of the bustling commercial district of Shanghai Beach, witnessing the changes and development of modern Shanghai history. The architectural styles along the street are diverse, including well preserved historical buildings and fashionable shops full of modern atmosphere, showcasing the unique charm of Shanghai as a city. While enjoying delicious food, tourists can also stroll around the streets and alleys, experiencing the perfect fusion of the city's historical heritage and modern atmosphere.

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 中国航海博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Military Sites; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Maritime Museum is the largest and highest-ranking comprehensive maritime museum in China. The museum focuses on "maritime" as its main theme and "museum" as its foundation. It is divided into six main exhibition halls: Maritime History, Ships, Maritime and Ports, Maritime Affairs and Maritime Safety, Seafarers, and Military Maritime. There are also two special exhibition areas: Fishing Vessels and Fishing, and Maritime Sports and Leisure. Additionally, the museum features a Planetarium, a 4D Cinema, and a Children's Activity Center, covering functions such as artifact collection, academic research, social education, and exhibitions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding China's Maritime History Simulation Model; The First Domestic Maritime-themed Museum

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience.

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 广州长隆度假区
attractions.summary: Guangzhou Chimelong Resort has multiple theme parks and high-end resort hotels, including Chimelong Wildlife World, Chimelong Happy World, Chimelong International Circus, Chimelong Water Park, Chimelong Flying Bird Park, Chimelong Hotel, Chimelong Panda Hotel, and more. Chimelong Wildlife World has giant panda triplets known as "cute, handsome, and cool", and has successfully bred 7 cubs and 10 cubs to date; It also has a koala population second only to Australia in size, as well as nearly 500 species and over 20000 rare animals worldwide, including white tigers, which account for more than half of the global population. Chimelong Happy World and Chimelong Water Park have been operating for over 10 years, and with the innovative equipment "Rock Wheel", Chimelong Water Park has won the TEA's "Outstanding Achievement Award". Chimelong Happy World and Chimelong Water Park have cultivated multiple well-known entertainment brands such as "Happy Halloween" and "Water Electric Syllable", becoming trendy landmarks for young people to play and relax. After 20 years of continuous innovation, Chimelong International Circus, together with Zhuhai Hengqin Chimelong International Circus, has welcomed nearly 500 circus artists from more than 20 countries to perform brilliantly in Guangzhou and Zhuhai, creating a "never-ending world circus stage". Chimelong Bird Park is a theme park that integrates bird watching, science education, and precious wetland plants - "a real place to watch birds fly", with hundreds and tens of thousands of rare birds and amphibians. Due to the large size of the scenic area, you can usually play in Happy World or Wildlife World for a whole day, while the circus starts at night. Therefore, if you want to play in more than one scenic area, it is recommended to stay at Chimelong Hotel, which provides free shuttle bus services for easy access. If you stay in the scenic area, the most cost-effective dining option at Chimelong Hotel is the Caidie Valley Food Gallery (only applicable to the entire scenic area), which is a bit like a "big foodie". It offers various types of cuisine, such as Cantonese cuisine, Sichuan cuisine, Brazilian barbecue, and hotpot. You can check online in advance for cash coupons for group purchases. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园

attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

· It has the world's largest forest live stage layout, and you can see live forests, streams, boats, etc., which is absolutely refreshing

attractions.shortFeatures: A gorgeous circus is staged on a super-large live stage

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 深圳市当代艺术与城市规划馆
attractions.name_en: Shenzhen Museum of Contemporary Art and Urban Planning
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary:
The whole building consists of Shenzhen Contemporary Art Museum and Urban Planning Exhibition Hall, which are independent and organically unified. The underground part of the two pavilions is in the form of reinforced concrete frame shear wall structure, which is divided into two structural systems above the ground-the skin steel structure system and the main structure system within the tower. Among them, the skin skeleton is composed of a large number of inclined, twisted and rotating curved steel members with complex shapes; The outer skin system is mainly composed of outer perforated stainless steel plate + inner glass curtain wall system, glass curtain wall system, slotted stone curtain wall system and main entrance frame curtain wall system. Its design concept is a crystal clear urban boulder with unique and aesthetic shape and rich internal display space. 
On the fifth floor, the two pavilions are connected with the cloud sculpture through an aerial bridge with a span of about 40 meters, forming a relatively independent and organically connected whole. As the functional sharing space of the two pavilions, Cloud Sculpture provides coffee shop, tea room service, etc. From the appearance, the cloud sculpture is a huge seamless mirror stainless steel whole. Through the unique surface and unique mirror treatment, the shapes and lights of the two pavilions are reflected to the audience at another angle. Cloud sculpture is not only a part of the architectural space of the two pavilions, but also a huge and shocking work of art.
attractions.shortFeatures: The building has a novel appearance and a futuristic feel

attractions.name: 盐田社區夜市文化街

Here, you can taste the taste of your hometown and enjoy the vitality of Shenzhen. Starting from here, let's explore Shenzhen's night economy together.

attractions.name: 东门老街
attractions.summary: Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 锦绣中华民俗村
attractions.summary: Jinxiu Zhonghua Folk Village consists of two parts: Jinxiu Zhonghua and Zhonghua Folk Village. The former has many miniature representations of well-known Chinese landscapes, allowing you to "explore China in one day". The latter has 24 village buildings where you can experience folk customs, and you can also watch folk performances of 56 ethnic groups. The two parks have been merged, just purchase one ticket. It is generally recommended to visit Jinxiu Zhonghua in the morning and Folk Village in the afternoon, as the large-scale performances in Folk Village are usually held in the afternoon. If you want to browse quickly for half a day, you can also consider combining walking with an electric scooter. The shuttle bus format is fixed, with the stop at the Confucian Temple in Jinxiu Zhonghua and the stop at Mosuo Village in Folk Village. It takes about 25 minutes to browse the entire scenic area. The docking time is 2 minutes. Splendid China mainly looks at miniature scenic spots and photographs. Nearly one hundred Chinese scenic spots are scaled down by 1:15, which can be called the collection of essence of China's natural scenery and human history. The mini version of the Great Wall, the Terra Cotta Warriors of the Qin Dynasty, the Mogao Grottoes of Dunhuang, Huangguoshu Waterfall and other places of interest can all be seen here, so it is said that "you can travel all over China in one day". The Chinese Folk Village offers a unique blend of 56 ethnic groups in China, where you can witness colorful ethnic costumes, the architectural styles of 24 villages, and various folk performances, making it a sight to behold. All 24 villages are built in a 1:1 ratio, giving people a sense of immersion. The architectural styles of ethnic minority villages are even more unique, such as the stone villages of the Buyi people, the wooden houses of the Mosuo people, the bamboo buildings of the Dai people, the Mongolian yurts, and the Tibetan monasteries. People take pictures of them from time to time. There are also many participating projects in the park that you can experience firsthand, such as the Wupeng boat, wooden boat, Dulong tribe zip line, horseback riding, archery, etc. You can check the official website link in advance for the performance schedule and introduction. Full text 

attractions.name: 何香凝美术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
attractions.summary:
It is the first national art museum named after an individual in China, and the second national modern museum after the National Art Museum of China. 
It is located in Shenzhen Overseas Chinese Town, the window city of China's reform and opening up, adjacent to Splendid China, Chinese Folk Culture Village and Window of the World, three famous cultural tourist attractions at home and abroad, and closely connected with the west gate entrance of the Folk Culture Village. 
He Xiangning Art Museum mainly collects, displays and studies He Xiangning's paintings and calligraphy works. It will also pay attention to relevant artists, sort out and preserve historical art materials, and organize high-grade art exhibitions and fine collections at home and abroad. Through academic research on modern art and the promotion of art education, it will carry forward Chinese cultural traditions and promote China's socialist spiritual civilization and cultural and artistic exchanges between China's art circles and overseas countries. On May 13, 1995, He Xiangning Art Museum was approved by the central government for construction; Construction started on March 1, 1996, was completed in April 1997, and officially opened on April 18. General Secretary Jiang Zemin personally inscribed the name of the museum. Provide all-round services for artists, art audiences, connoisseurs and collectors, and integrate with the first-class environment of OCT cultural tourism attractions. Encourage people to ask about art, discuss works, listen to lectures and participate in creation with a comfortable and elegant environment; Pay attention to artists' individual artistic expression, build a bridge between the art circles at home and abroad and the audience, integrate artists, works of art and art appreciators, and truly promote the great development and prosperity of Chinese art. The building area of the art museum is more than 5,000 square meters. Its architectural design strives to reflect Ms. He Xiangning's character and principles of solemnity, effectiveness and moderation throughout her life. The wide square, connected with the entrance of the west gate of the Chinese folk culture village, is a living space for people to communicate and activity, and has also become a prelude to the building. Through more than a dozen wide granite steps and a pedestrian bridge more than 20 meters long, visitors are introduced into the museum step by step. The whole building is gray and white, elegant and solemn; The recessed wall is in strong contrast with the protruding glass box. The long fox-shaped wall has a rectangular hole, and dozens of green bamboos are swaying in the wind behind the wall. Before entering the main exhibition hall, a quadrangle atrium was designed. The north-south central axis of the atrium coincided with the central axis of the pedestrian bridge and the main exhibition hall, making the courtyard an important excessive space. The three sides of the atrium adopt a large area of wooden windows and doors, abandoning the cumbersome decoration, and exuding a modern sense in a simple, simple and rich traditional cultural atmosphere. The interior design fully borrows the beautiful scenery of the external environment. When visitors enjoy the exhibits on the second floor, they climb the stairs to the third floor. Directly in front of the stairs, the transparent large glass borrows the stone forest of the folk village, just like a living landscape painting. The "patio" atrium is not only filled with the interest of the oriental courtyard, but also makes the indoor and outdoor echo each other, thus enriching the visual effect of visitors. Glass ceilings are used on the roofs of public halls and other places. Under the ceiling, visitors can see the blue sky and white clouds. Through the sunlight, the light and shadow produced by the building reflected on the ground and walls add to the interest of the indoor space.
attractions.shortFeatures: If you like literary style, you can come here to see the exhibition

attractions.name: 华·美术馆
attractions.summary: Hua · Art Museum is a design themed art museum that was officially established on September 1, 2008 in Shenzhen Overseas Chinese Town. It is adjacent to He Xiangning Art Museum and three major cultural tourism attractions, "Splendid China", "Chinese Folk Culture Village", and "Window of the World". Hua Art Museum focuses on and promotes design as its main development direction, including graphic design, spatial design, product design, clothing design, digital, imaging, animation and other design fields. At the same time, it will also pay attention to contemporary art and various diverse art activities, actively exploring and reflecting the relationship between design and contemporary art. Committed to introducing cutting-edge design concepts from both domestic and international sources, discovering and showcasing innovative design trends, discovering and cultivating art and design talents, providing the public with a rich and diverse window of design and artistic culture, and promoting the development of China's design field through planning and hosting special exhibitions, holding public lectures, organizing academic forums and domestic and international exchange and learning activities, and conducting design education. The main building of the Hua Art Museum was renovated from an old warehouse, and a hexagonal steel structure overlapped with a glass curtain wall to create an independent skin outside the old building, preserving the history and significance of the past architecture under the cutting-edge architectural appearance. The Hua Art Museum has a building area of over 3000 square meters, including a controllable temperature exhibition hall area of 2000 square meters, and also has a controllable temperature painting library, providing a professional environment and conditions for art display and collection.

attractions.name: 华侨城创意文化园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Art Districts
attractions.summary: Shenzhen OCT Cultural and Creative Park is a creative industry base integrating "creativity, design and art", the most distinctive creative cultural park in South China, and is committed to becoming a highland of Chinese creative design, culture and art with international influence. Turn the old factory building in OCT into a pioneer studio, dotted with bars, book bars, teahouses and other leisure and entertainment places. Various artistic activities and cultural salons will be held here from time to time. Every year, OCT Real Estate invests a large amount of money in academic research and daily operation for non-profit purposes to promote artistic development, and adheres to the principles of high starting point, high threshold and high grade, redefines and designs factory buildings that grow simultaneously with Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, integrates the diverse fields of "creativity, design and art", and builds creative industrial chains such as art, gallery, design, media, publishing, performing arts, entertainment, exhibition, photography, fashion, boutique, catering, bar and life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Avant-garde art space and creative market

attractions.name: 湾区之光摩天轮
attractions.summary: The "Light of the Bay Area" Ferris wheel is located at the eastern end of Shenzhen Happy Harbor. It was carefully crafted by OCT Group, in collaboration with the "London Eye" construction team, the European STARNETHENGINING team, and Juma Group, integrating advanced design and construction technologies from around the world. The Ferris wheel has a total height of 128 meters and 28 imported cabins, each with an area of approximately 16.8 square meters, capable of accommodating 25 people. Adopting a fish fin shaped irregular large stand with a design inspired by the ocean, not only does it offer a broad perspective, but it also represents a breakthrough in the artistic direction of the structure. The boarding and disembarking separation system, reasonable configuration of pedestrian flow lines, and ellipsoidal rotary spacecraft are the first of their kind in China. The all day panoramic rotating elevator car, with an ultra stable system, allows passengers to soar straight up like walking on flat ground. As the Ferris wheel slowly rotates, people can not only enjoy the charming scenery outside the elevator car, but also have more special "high-altitude experiences". The exclusive sedan designed for the experience, the wedding sedan born for romance, the gourmet sedan prepared for the journey of the tongue, the exclusive birthday party for children, and the customized afternoon tea for girlfriends bring a different high-altitude journey for tourists. As a towering Ferris wheel over Shenzhen and a domestically imported sedan style Ferris wheel with full day scenery, the "Bay Area Light" illuminates the city's night sky with the lights on, creating a romantic scene with the sea view and parks, becoming a dream landmark of the Guangdong Hong Kong Macao Greater Bay Area.

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 东涌沙滩
attractions.summary: The beach sand in Tung Chung is very fine, the coastline is short, and the seawater is very blue. The beach has a large area, and other parts of the beach are covered with rocks, making it a paradise for many hiking enthusiasts. The Dongxichong coastline is a "relatively beautiful and classic coastline hiking route" in Shenzhen, with a long coastline of Ping Shan and the sea, and mountains crisscrossing and stretching. It has a super beautiful sea view, allowing you to enjoy the blue sea and sky while hiking. If you walk from east to west, half of the mountain road and half of the coastline are fast, it will take more than 2 hours to complete, but the general travel time is within 5 hours.

attractions.name: 西涌沙滩
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; On foot; Hiking; Beaches; Seashores
attractions.summary:
At present, it is one of the eight most beautiful coastlines in China and the first choice beach for tourism in Shenzhen. 
· The 10-mile-long beach is as elegant and comfortable as satin, with beautiful scenery of mountains, seas, lakes and headlands. 
· The original ecological bathing beach at the southernmost tip of Dapeng Peninsula, with clear sea water, is suitable for swimming and leisure vacation in the sea. 
· It is divided into 4 parks, including group building, parent-child, couples, theme activities, sea projects, camping, stargazing, development, research, surfing base, bar, market and other entertainment projects.
attractions.shortFeatures: The original ecological bathing beach

attractions.summary:
· The main peak has a peak square of about 4,000 square meters, which is the tallest outdoor square in Shenzhen. 
· It's a good place to pay tribute to the great man's elegance, see the city's landscape and overlook Futian CBD. 
· One of the red tourist attractions in China, it is a good place for Shenzhen citizens to have daily leisure. 
There are rhododendrons in the garden, and a rhododendron flower show will be held.

attractions.name: 南头古城
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
attractions.summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 上海海洋水族馆
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; A Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
- The Ocean Aquarium has three floors. After entering the aquarium, take the elevator to the third floor, then visit from top to bottom.
- It includes exhibition areas such as the China Exhibition Area and the Americas Exhibition Area, with a wide variety of marine species in each zone.
- The entire exhibition hall uses themes, images, and various effects to showcase different types of marine life.
- The aquarium also features the world's only observation tunnel showcasing the Amazon rainforest. There is also a fast food restaurant on the first floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the underwater tunnel to observe marine life.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.summary: Anfu Road is associated with drama and is one of the representatives of Shanghai's literary and artistic style. Anfu Road, with art as its core, extends from the inside out, so there are also many coffee shops and wine cellars. On a weekend morning, a few pedestrians passed by sparsely on the road. At this moment, if you choose a coffee shop with fewer people and look out the window alone, you can experience the unique quietness of Shanghai. After the rain, the slightly damp sunlight shines through the glass. If you take a taxi to Anfu Road, the understanding driver will say, "Oh! Are you going to watch a play

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions
