attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园
attractions.summary: Haixinsha is located in the area of Bati, the Pearl River - Guangzhou Tower - Huacheng Square. It is an artificial island located on the the Pearl River. The night scene here is very beautiful. With the lights of Huacheng Square, you can see the colorful changes of Guangzhou Tower across the river, which reflect each other. Moreover, it is also a great destination for the exterior of Guangzhou Tower, where many photography enthusiasts take photos. The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Those who have watched the opening ceremony will surely remember this boat shaped sports arena vividly. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. The unique geographical location makes Haixinsha and its surrounding areas a must for exploring the international metropolis of Guangzhou, which is a new landmark of Guangzhou. The subway APM line connects these three areas to form a three-point line. Generally, APM can take you to Haixinsha Station, but if you want to have a better tour, it is recommended to get off at Dahua Theater Station. Because you can also visit the Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Library, which are new cultural landmarks in Guangzhou. Then take a slow walk to Liede Bridge and see Haixinsha and Guangzhou Tower from the other side.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 广州兰圃
attractions.summary: Lanpu and Yuexiu Park in Guangzhou are located in the city center, with convenient transportation and direct access by subway. Perhaps because across the road is Yuexiu Park, there are relatively few visitors to Lanpu, which makes the park very quiet. Lanpu is a great place to admire orchids. It is a specialized orchid park in the Lingnan region, cultivating over 200 varieties of orchids and nearly 10000 pots of orchids, including precious orchid species such as Dahuasu, Dafengwei Su, Dendrobium, and Xiandian Baimo. The orchid planting in Orchid Garden is divided into three grids. The first and third grids are mainly planted with orchids, which have light and fragrant flowers; The second grid is dominated by parasitic orchids, with bright flowers but little fragrance. Of course, for tourists, most of them don't care about the variety of orchids. Just take a look and take photos. The flowers are brightly colored and most of them are extremely photogenic. At its entrance, there are two couplets that read 'Fragrant in the Upper Country, Splendid in the South', and the horizontal sign reads' Orchid Garden ', which is very imposing. Strolling into the garden, one can see the elements of Jiangnan gardens everywhere, such as arches, stacked mountains, stone masonry, long corridors, and water pavilions. It suddenly feels like coming to a garden in Suzhou. The entire orchid garden is quiet and deep, with a very good environment, and the air is particularly elegant and high-quality due to the fragrance of orchids. Orchids are classified according to their flowering time, including spring orchids, summer orchids, autumn orchids, cold orchids, and New Year orchids. If you want to see magnolia, its flowering period is from February to March. If you want to see more orchids, spring would be more suitable. In addition to enjoying flowers, most people come here for tea and small Dim sum. Although Lanpu is small, it has many tea rooms with different tea resources and styles. The decoration of the tea rooms is mostly high-end, unique and elegant, very stylish. When the spring is warm and the flowers are blooming, sitting in the tea house with friends and enjoying a small drink, the feeling must be excellent.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Located 2km west of Canton Tower, North Gate Square of Sun Yat-sen University, at CUHK/memorial archway. 
The wharf is located in Guang Zhouta, Haizhu District, an important landscape area of the new central axis of the city. It is planned to open a number of water bus routes. The wharf is positioned as a midway terminal for citizens to visit Guang Zhouta, tour the Pearl River at night and travel. The departure route of Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf is-Ersha Island-Xinghai Concert Hall-North Gate of Zhongda University-Haiyin Bridge-Guangzhou Bridge-Haixinsha-Guang Zhouta-Liede Bridge-and returns to Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour around the bright night scene of Yangcheng

attractions.name: 广州市文化馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The new building of Guangzhou Cultural Center is designed with the theme of "Ten Miles of Red Clouds, One Bay of Water, Eight Bridges, Painting Boats, and Sixteen Pavilions". It cleverly combines traditional architecture and garden space to recreate the beautiful scenery of Lingnan water town gardens, including Hanmo Garden, Quyi Garden, Guangfu Garden, Guangxiu Garden and other theme garden buildings, as well as the large garden landscape formed by them together. It is a city living room rich in Lingnan ecological characteristics and cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 黄埔军校旧址纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Former Site of Huangpu Military Academy
attractions.summary:
- The Army Officer School, founded by Sun Yat-sen in 1924 during the first cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, is the cradle of Chinese military leaders.  
- The military school held seven sessions on Changzhou Island before relocating to Nanjing in 1930, and later moved to Chengdu and Taiwan. It was destroyed in 1938 by a Japanese bombing raid.  
- The entire old site features architectural styles from the Republic of China era, with key attractions including the school headquarters, Sun Yat-sen's former residence, the Eastern Expedition Martyrs' Cemetery, the Northern Expedition Monument, and the Dapo Di Artillery Battery.  
- The venue offers guided tours at 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00, and 15:00.
attractions.shortFeatures: The cradle of modern Chinese military leaders.

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 岭南印象园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gem for Kid-Friendly Activities; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.

attractions.name: 白云山
attractions.tag: Climbing and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Baiyun Mountain is one of the famous mountains in southern Guangdong, known as the "First Beauty of Yangcheng" and "The First Mountain of Nanyue."

· It consists of more than 30 peaks. From the summit, visitors can overlook the entire city and get a distant view of the Pearl River, making it a popular destination for spring outings.

· After rain or during the late spring season, clouds swirl around the mountain, and the name "Baiyun Mountain" (White Cloud Mountain) is derived from this phenomenon.

· The scenic area is divided into seven tourist zones: Mingzhu Tower, Moxing Ridge, Mingchun Valley, Santai Ridge, Luhu Lake, Fei'e Ridge, and Heyi Ridge.

· Visitors can also enjoy recreational activities such as grass skiing, slideways, and small bungee jumping in the scenic area.

· Baiyun Mountain is dotted with stunning rhododendrons in red, pink, and white. From a distance, the mountains are adorned with a sea of blooming flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climbing high to enjoy the scenery and admire the moonlight.

attractions.name: 云台花园
attractions.summary:
Yuntai Garden is named after Yuntai Ridge and the precious flowers at home and abroad in the garden. It is the largest western-style garden in China at present. 
The buildings in the garden combine eastern and western styles, and there are more than ten scenic spots such as Friendship Garden, Glass Greenhouse, Sun Square, Waterfall Liucai and Rose Garden. Among them, the Rose Garden is planted with hundreds of varieties of roses such as Black Rose, Double Happiness, Jejoy and Moroccan Princess. 
Every year, Yuntai Garden holds various large-scale theme flower shows, and a large-scale lantern festival will be held during the Mid-Autumn Festival, all of which are worth visiting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Large western garden

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 西安城市观光车
attractions.summary: The "Xi'an City Sightseeing Bus" takes the "Tang Culture" as its main axis and roughly runs through the Xi'an urban area in a north-south direction. Tourists can wait at the sightseeing station sign to get on the bus. During the operation, the "Sightseeing Bus" will stop at each sightseeing station for 5 to 10 minutes. Tourists can arrange to get on and off the bus according to their own itinerary for sightseeing experience, and can take the next "Xi'an City Sightseeing Bus" to continue to the later sightseeing stations for sightseeing. Starting station: Parking lot on the east side of Dayan Pagoda North Square (parking lot on the east side of Xi'an Citizen Tourist Service Center).

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场音乐喷泉
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square Music Fountain
attractions.summary: The Music Fountain of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, also known as the Xi'an Music Fountain, is located on the central axis of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda. The Music Fountain Square consists of water feature fountains, cultural squares, garden landscapes, cultural corridors, and tourism and commercial facilities. It is an important Tang culture square in China. There are a large number of sculptures and statues on the square. While enjoying the music fountain, it is also a good choice to savor these sculptures carefully. The music fountain is divided into three areas: a hundred meter waterfall pool, an eight level waterfall pool, and a front-end music pool. The eight level variable frequency array in the eight level cascade pool is the largest array in the world, with 1024 nozzle points, which can transform into various water types such as mountains and seas, lotus flowers, vast clouds, seagulls spreading their wings, butterflies falling in love with flowers, water mist, etc., shining brightly and beautifully. In the large laser water curtain, which is 60 meters wide and over 20 meters high, four fountains spray out from the water, fully burning and exploding at a low temperature at a height of 6 meters, further enhancing the awe inspiring power of the entire fountain.

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 兵马俑DIY手工制作体验基地（泥人坊）
attractions.name_en: Bingmayong Diy Shougong Zhizuo Tiyan Base (nirenfang)
attractions.summary: Terra Cotta Warriors DIY Handicraft Experience Base (Clay figurine workshop) is located 300 meters west from the main road in front of the ticket hall of the Terra Cotta Warriors (Qinling North Road) to the south. The front sign: Lintong District Clay figurine workshop handicraft exhibition hall; Convenient transportation, with a medium-sized parking lot in front of the door; The experience hall has a clean and elegant environment, with air conditioning inside, providing warmth in winter and coolness in summer; Provide free WF. We have a team engaged in receiving DIY handmade crafts, and have received countless individual guest groups such as parent-child tours and summer camps, with rich experience in reception; Having a master craftsman who has been engaged in the replication industry for 30 years, teaching hand in hand; We have a professional repair and firing team.

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Big pot big stove firewood fish village

attractions.name: 尖沙咀
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Tsim Sha Tsui is located at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, facing Victoria Harbour and across the sea from Central, Hong Kong Island. It is the "geographical center" of Hong Kong. 
There are many famous scenic spots in Hong Kong, such as Avenue of Stars, Victoria Harbour, Kowloon Park, etc., which are all must-check-in places for tourists to come to Hong Kong. It is also a good place to see the night view. Victoria Harbour and Avenue of Stars are good choices. 
· It is the most prosperous shopping paradise in Hong Kong, with various large shopping malls, duty-free shops, international brand stores, etc. to meet all the needs of one-stop shopping. 
· There are also cultural places such as the Hong Kong History Museum, the Hong Kong Science Museum and the Hong Kong Cultural Center, which are good choices for parent-child tours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping paradise on the shore of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 梅窝
attractions.summary: Mui Wo is located in the southeast of Lantau Island, Hong Kong, and the district is administratively an Islands District. Mui Wo, also known as Silver Mine Bay, is named after two silver mines in the former valley. Song Emperor Min and his attendants once took refuge here, and Mui Wo was stained with glory. Now, the old market is surrounded by new buildings. There are shops selling snacks near the ferry terminal. Across the river is the old market, which is also the hub of land and water transportation on Lantau Island. Outside the ferry terminal is the bus terminal, and there are shops, restaurants and markets nearby. Walking along the coast is where Silver Mine Bay Beach is located.
attractions.shortFeatures: Starting point of visiting Lantau Island

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 中环
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Central is the political and commercial center of Hong Kong. Many banks, multinational financial institutions and foreign consulates are located in Central. 
· All kinds of skyscrapers and shopping malls are all over Central, with gorgeous lights and neon lights. 
· Popular shopping malls such as Landmark Plaza, Jiaxuan Plaza, Prince Building, Alexander Building and International Financial Center Shopping Mall gather designer brands and international palace-level brand stores. 
· The landscape of Central is a mixture of colonial architecture and modern high-tech buildings. Hong Kong's iconic buildings such as Legislative Council Building, Bank of China Tower and IFC International Financial Center in Central are also located here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong Political and Business Centre

attractions.name: 中环至半山自动扶梯
attractions.summary: The Central to Mid Levels escalator connects the Central business district with the Mid Levels residential area. It was built by the British Hong Kong government in 1993 to improve traffic in Mid Levels. The escalator consists of 20 one-way escalators and 3 automatic pedestrian walkways, starting from the Central Market and ending at Conduit Road. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and there are multiple exits along the way, making it convenient for pedestrians to get on and off. The Mid Levels escalator crosses multiple major streets in Central, including Queen's Road Central, Hollywood Road, and other attractions along the way, such as the old Central Police Station, making it a great means of transportation for tourists. In addition, the escalator will also pass through the SOHO area, which is filled with restaurants and bars, European style small bars, specialty tea restaurants, and souvenir shops, where foodies can find satisfying cuisine.

attractions.name: 大馆(前中区警署建筑群)
attractions.tag: Theater; Art Museums; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary: The main building is located on Hollywood Road in Central, Hong Kong. The complex includes three historic sites: the former Central Police Station, the former Central Magistracy, and Victoria Prison. The Central Police Station was built in 1864 and was originally a three story classical style building. On December 20, 2005, the police held a farewell ceremony and officially handed over the Central Police Station. The original site is adjacent to the former Central Magistracy and Victoria Prison, which also have a long history, and is planned to be developed into a historical and cultural tourism area. In April 2011, the Hong Kong Jockey Club announced that it had completed archaeological surveys in the area and discovered some artifacts believed to be from the late Qing Dynasty to the early 20th century, including containers, pottery pipes, copper coins, fragments of porcelain bowls, suspected tunnel buildings, and foundation remains. Da Guan is now a historic site and art museum, dedicated to bringing rich and exciting historical relics and artistic experiences to Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 杜甫草堂
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; Former residences of celebrities.
attractions.summary: In the past, there was a small path in front of Du Fu's thatched cottage, lined with flowers and trees. He once wrote in his poem: "The flower path has never been swept for guests, the humble door is now opened for you." Today’s flower path is a red-walled alley connecting the Du Fu Thatched Cottage Memorial Hall and the original Caotang Temple. At the end of the flower path stands the "Caotang Screen Wall," where the characters "Caotang" were inlaid with blue-and-white porcelain shards by Zhou Shanpei, the Governor of Sichuan’s Quanye Dao during the late Qing Dynasty. These characters have been damaged and repaired several times. When Chairman Mao visited the cottage in 1958, he gazed at these two characters for a long time. As one of the symbols of the cottage, many visitors stop here to take photos as a memento.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit Du Fu's Former Residence and Experience the Cultural Sacred Site

attractions.name: 成都太古里
attractions.summary: Chengdu Taikoo Li is a large open style shopping center located in Jinjiang District, Chengdu. It combines modern commerce with traditional culture and is renowned for its unique architectural style and rich brand selection. This is not only a paradise for shopping, but also a great place to experience slow life in Chengdu.

attractions.name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
attractions.name_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
attractions.tag: Mengmeng Animals; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- The Giant Panda Breeding and Research Center fully simulates the natural habitat of the giant panda, featuring lakes, streams, bamboo forests, and lawns. It houses more than 100 giant pandas.

Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. Guilin Eternal Scenic Area is jointly created by Songcheng Performing Arts and Guilin Travel Stock, which reproduces Guilin's history, culture and ethnic customs, and is suitable for all ages to have fun with each other, rain or shine. 
The giant song fairy statue is magnificent and integrated with Guilin's landscape. It is the embodiment of the truth, goodness and beauty of Bagui land. Everything in the scenic spot is tourist-centered, with tens of thousands of square meters of No.3 secret tourism complex, wind and rain corridor and five-star standard toilet with all-indoor air conditioning. Haunted House, Qingming Riverside Film Museum, Wonderful Street and other high-tech and children's experience projects are full of fun. Yangshuo Ancient Village has created a unique farming and market life style. Lover's Harbor and No.4 Bay are good places for young people to relax. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Guilin" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Using advanced high-tech means such as sound, light and electricity and stage machinery, it sings the legend of truth, goodness and beauty in Bagui land through time and space in the three-dimensional space of water, land and air, bringing Bagui culture hidden under the 800-mile Lijiang River into everyone's field of vision, and reproduces a love affair in Guilin for three lives and three lifetimes. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as National Flash Show, Mo Tusi Recruiting Son-in-Law, Song Fairy Welcomes Guests, Guozhuang Carnival, etc. 
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!

attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
