· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 德基广场
attractions.summary: Deji Square is located in Xuanwu District, Nanjing City. It is a large shopping center in the center of Nanjing city, integrating shopping, dining, and entertainment. It has numerous internationally renowned brands and high-end restaurants, and is a popular place for Nanjing citizens and tourists to relax and shop.

attractions.name: 国立美术馆旧址
attractions.name_en: Former Site of the National Art Museum
attractions.summary:
The former site of the National Fine Arts Exhibition Museum is located at No.266 Changjiang Road, Xuanwu District, Nanjing. It is a national key cultural relics protection unit and the predecessor of Jiangsu Art Museum today. It was built in 1936. As the first national art museum in China, it represents the official beginning of the career of China Art Museum. In 1960, it was renamed Jiangsu Art Museum and is still in use today. 
The National Fine Arts Exhibition Hall has held many influential exhibitions, including several national art exhibitions and various exhibitions of traditional Chinese paintings, oil paintings and prints. The "Second National Art Exhibition of the Ministry of Education" held in 1937, from the "Special Collection of the Second National Art Exhibition" preserved by Nanjing Library so far, shows that the artistic status of the preparatory committee members and examination committee of the exhibition is prominent, the works of the participating artists are heavy, and the scale of the exhibition is large. In the whole 20th century, no art exhibition can surpass it. 
On November 24th, 2018, the former site of the National Fine Arts Exhibition Museum was selected as the "Third Batch of Chinese 20th Century Architectural Heritage Projects". In October 2019, it was included in the list of the eighth batch of national key cultural relics protection units.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the representative works of new national form architecture

attractions.name: 粤海关博物馆
attractions.summary: The Guangdong Customs Museum is located in Guangzhou, with a total of 4 floors facing north and south. There are thousands of collections in the museum, as well as a basic exhibition on "The Development History of Chinese Customs" and a special exhibition on "Guangdong Customs and the Maritime Silk Road".

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 太古仓
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built by British Swire Ocean Company between 1904 and 1908, it was used by Swire Steamship Company. It is a relatively complete storage terminal. 
It consists of 3 T-shaped trestle concrete wharves and 7 brick and wood structure warehouses, which is the historical epitome of Guangzhou Port's foreign trade. 
Guangzhou's "City Living Room", which integrates cultural creativity, exhibition and trade, sightseeing, leisure and entertainment and other functions. 
On the basis of retaining the original history, it will be transformed into a creative industrial park including bars, cinemas and yacht marinas.
attractions.shortFeatures: A creative park transformed into a dock warehouse

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 越秀公园-韩国庭院
attractions.summary: Yuexiu Park is the largest park in Guangzhou and one of the oldest parks in Guangzhou's history. The park is shaded by green trees and boasts picturesque lakes and mountains, making it a great destination for citizens to relax and entertain themselves. The Korean Garden is a distinctive attraction within Yuexiu Park, showcasing traditional Korean garden art and providing visitors with a window to learn about Korean culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 五羊石雕
attractions.summary: The Five Rams Stone Carving is located in Yuexiu Park and is a symbol of Guangzhou city, as well as the origin of the name "Yangcheng". The Five Rams Stone Carving originated from a beautiful legend. Legend has it that in the past, Guangzhou was very barren and people could not afford to eat or drink. Five immortals rode five sheep with ears of grain in their mouths and flew here, leaving the ears of grain to the people of Guangzhou. They wished for a bountiful harvest every year and then flew away with clouds, turning the sheep into stones. Guangzhou became a prosperous land from then on. The Five Rams Stone Carving was built in April 1960. The statue is 11 meters high and is carved from 130 pieces of granite. It is a commemoration of a beautiful legend. There is also a sculpture of the Five Immortals next to it, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Located 2km west of Canton Tower, North Gate Square of Sun Yat-sen University, at CUHK/memorial archway. 
The wharf is located in Guang Zhouta, Haizhu District, an important landscape area of the new central axis of the city. It is planned to open a number of water bus routes. The wharf is positioned as a midway terminal for citizens to visit Guang Zhouta, tour the Pearl River at night and travel. The departure route of Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf is-Ersha Island-Xinghai Concert Hall-North Gate of Zhongda University-Haiyin Bridge-Guangzhou Bridge-Haixinsha-Guang Zhouta-Liede Bridge-and returns to Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour around the bright night scene of Yangcheng

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 广东省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
The new museum was completed in 2010. It is the only provincial comprehensive museum in Guangdong Province, a patriotic education base and social practice base in Guangzhou. 
Guangdong's history, culture, art and nature are the three main exhibition directions, which are divided into four parts: history museum, nature museum, art museum and temporary exhibition hall. 
More precious exhibits include "baleen whale skeleton", "giant malachite" and "Xinyi jade" weighing more than five tons in natural specimens.
attractions.shortFeatures: Treasure Box Architecture with Rich Calligraphy and Painting in Lingnan

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海珠有轨电车1号线
attractions.summary: Guangzhou Haizhu Tram Line 1 has a total of 11 subway stations, including Wanshengwei, Pazhou Tower, Pazhou Bridge South, Exhibition East, Exhibition Central, Exhibition West, Nanfeng, Pati, Liede Bridge South, Guangzhou Tower East, and Guangzhou Tower.

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 黄埔军校旧址纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Former Site of Huangpu Military Academy
attractions.summary:
- The Army Officer School, founded by Sun Yat-sen in 1924 during the first cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, is the cradle of Chinese military leaders.  
- The military school held seven sessions on Changzhou Island before relocating to Nanjing in 1930, and later moved to Chengdu and Taiwan. It was destroyed in 1938 by a Japanese bombing raid.  
- The entire old site features architectural styles from the Republic of China era, with key attractions including the school headquarters, Sun Yat-sen's former residence, the Eastern Expedition Martyrs' Cemetery, the Northern Expedition Monument, and the Dapo Di Artillery Battery.  
- The venue offers guided tours at 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00, and 15:00.
attractions.shortFeatures: The cradle of modern Chinese military leaders.

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东牌坊
attractions.summary: The Old Gate East memorial archway is the main entrance of the Old Gate East Historic District, which is a landmark building here. A stone tablet below the memorial archway is engraved with the history of Nanjing City, which has a lot of historical and cultural details.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 冰川公园
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountain Climbing; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
· Located on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north of Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, it is a typical representative of the modern glacier in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
· The park composed of stone caves and caves eroded by glaciers is a landform relic formed by Quaternary glaciers, and is known as the "Glass Palace of Lucerne".  
In autumn, winter and spring, the snow is vast here. In summer, you can see the glaciers formed more than 40,000 years ago, and you can feel the snow-capped mountains at close range. 
The white mountain at the top of the mountain is magnificent, spectacular, white and delicate, and there is also a marking stone tablet with an altitude of 4,680 meters, which is also a popular group photo place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience glaciers and snow-capped mountains up close

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 拉市海
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary: Lashihai, located 10 kilometers west of Lijiang, is the largest plateau lake in Lijiang and the first nature reserve named after "wetland" in Yunnan Province. Every year, tens of thousands of waterfowl come here to spend the winter. Between December and February of the following year, it is the best time to watch birds in Lashihai. The lake is surrounded by Naxi villages, and every village near the lake has opened a horse farm. Lashihai has thus become an excellent place for horse riding, boating and bird watching in Lijiang. Tips: Every morning and evening hour is the best time for bird watching. The services of the surrounding racecourses are mixed, so pay attention to negotiating the price and service details in advance. When riding a horse, try not to put valuables in pockets and other places, which are easy to lose.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful grassland wetland

attractions.name: 拉市海茶马古道
attractions.summary: The Tea Horse Ancient Road refers to a folk international trade channel that exists in the southwestern region of China, with horse gangs as the main means of transportation. It is a corridor for economic and cultural exchanges among ethnic groups in southwestern China. The Tea Horse Ancient Road is a very special regional name, a world famous tourist route with spectacular natural scenery and mysterious culture, and it contains an endless cultural heritage. Full text 

attractions.name: 白沙古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
Baisha Ancient Town was once the political, economic and cultural center of Lijiang, and it was also the original settlement of Naxi people in Lijiang Dam, retaining the original Naxi culture. 
The ancient town retains its original appearance, has not been over-developed, is quieter than Dayan and Shuhe, and you can see Yulong Snow Mountain when you look up. 
Baisha Mural is the most famous scenic spot in the town. It lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, and it is a good place to learn about Dongba culture. 
You can sit and drink tea in the street shop, hang out slowly, and chat with the local old grandmother in a language that each other doesn't understand, which is relaxed and leisurely.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the quiet of the original ecological ancient town

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located northwest of Lijiang Old Town, it is quiet and ancient, with mountains and waters, more tranquil and primitive than Dayan Ancient Town.
- The mountains behind the ancient town are the foothills of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with lush and beautiful rolling peaks and dense forests.
- The Grand Stone Bridge and the Dajue Palace are well-preserved, with murals depicting figures from Buddhist teachings.
- It is an important part of the UNESCO World Heritage Lijiang Old Town and was selected as a "Charming Town of China" by CCTV in 2005.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tranquil and serene town of Chama Ancient Town.

restaurants.name_en: Red wine from southwest France. snack bar

attractions.name: 观澜湖火山温泉谷
attractions.name_en: Guanlan Lake Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
attractions.summary: Guanlan Lake Volcanic Hot Spring Valley is located in Haikou City and is a comprehensive tourist resort that integrates hot spring bathing, leisure and entertainment, and health preservation. There are various styles of hot spring pools here, including volcanic rock hot springs, herbal hot springs, floral hot springs, etc., which can meet the needs of different tourists. The hot spring valley has a beautiful environment with lush green trees, making it an excellent place to relax and enjoy nature.

attractions.name: 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社(百年记忆公社)
attractions.name_en: Mission Hills Huayi Brothers Feng Xiaogang Movie Town
attractions.summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 骑楼老街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street

attractions.name: 白沙门公园
attractions.summary:
Baishamen Park is located in the north of Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, bordering Qiongzhou Strait in the north. There are four tourism theme areas: Haikou Annual Ring, Happy Ocean, Xiban Coast and City Post Station, including Baishamen Children's Amusement Park, Pottery Sculpture Interpretation of Mazu Culture and Baishamen Park Tennis Court. 
The park also has a wetland scenic spot with pastoral ecological characteristics, which is the most distinctive place that distinguishes the park from other parks in Haikou. There is a complete water system, a small sandbar in the water, and a unique wooden bridge connecting the road section, which makes people experience the pastoral fun.
attractions.shortFeatures: A leisure park with both entertainment and viewing

attractions.name: 雷琼海口火山群世界地质公园
attractions.name_en: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
attractions.summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.
attractions.shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 海口钟楼
attractions.summary: The Haikou Bell Tower is an important landmark building in Haikou, with a history of nearly a hundred years. It was originally built to adapt to foreign trade. The building is five stories high and the walls are built with red bricks. The Haikou Bell Tower stands on Changdi Road, facing the estuary. The row of ancient buildings across from the Haikou Bell Tower is the famous Haikou Qilou Old Street. The current Haikou Bell Tower was renovated in 1987 with funding based on the original appearance of the old clock tower. Named 'New Sound of Ancient Bell'. The Bell Tower is a symbol of Haikou, witnessing the city's growth process. Full text 

attractions.name: 万绿园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Located in the reclamation area on the north side of Haikou, facing Qiongzhou Strait, it is the largest open tropical seaside ecological garden landscape garden in Haikou. 
· Many tropical ornamental plants are planted in Wanlv Garden, which integrates clear water and blue sky with high-rise buildings. 
The 16 scenic spots and many surrounding supporting facilities in the park are complete. It is a large park for Haikou citizens to exercise in the morning and take a walk in the evening.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical Ecological Garden for Citizens' Leisure

attractions.name: 西秀海滩公园
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Surf; Beaches; Surfing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Xixiu Beach, formerly known as Haikou Xiuying Beach, is about 6 kilometers away from the city center, with a coastline length of about 1,200 meters, which is close to Holiday Beach. Xixiu Beach was rated as one of the "Eight Scenic Spots in Haikou" by Haikou citizens in 1980s. In 1986, the State Sports Commission designated it as the only national sailing and windsurfing winter training base in China, and trained many Asian Games champions, world medalists and Atlanta Olympic champion Hong Kong athlete Li Lishan, such as Qi Guojian and Li Ke.
attractions.shortFeatures: A coastal tourist destination where sailing is popular

There is a complete water system, a small sandbar in the water, and a unique wooden bridge connecting the road section, which makes people experience the pastoral fun.
