attractions.name: 雷琼海口火山群世界地质公园
attractions.name_en: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
attractions.summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.
attractions.shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 东寨港红树林
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Nature Reserves; National Parks
attractions.summary: Dongzhaigang Mangrove Nature Reserve is about 30 kilometers away from the city center and 12 kilometers away from Haikou Meilan International Airport. It spans Yanfeng Town, Sanjiang Farm and Sanjiang Town in Meilan District, Haikou City, and borders Luodou Farm in Wenchang City, with a total coastline of 84 kilometers. It is the first mangrove nature reserve in China. Different from mangroves in other places, at high tide in Dongzhai Port, the dense mangroves will be flooded by the tide, exposing only the green canopy rippling with the waves, becoming a spectacular "sea forest". In addition, it is also a "bird paradise" and a "natural farm".
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat shuttle among half-flooded mangroves
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:30(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 18:00)

attractions.name: 保利国际温泉
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
- Covering an area of 150 acres, with a building area of nearly 15,000 square meters and an outdoor area of 23,000 square meters, the facility offers services including hot springs, dining, guest rooms, SPA, health care, and chess. The interior design is in Southeast Asian style, and it is built to international standards as a health, leisure, and resort destination.
- Featuring over 40 indoor and outdoor hot spring pools with various special therapeutic effects, the facility also includes a spa, children's water play pool, fish therapy, geothermal zone, dry/wet steam, and an outdoor heated swimming pool, among other amenities.
- The water temperature of the Poly International Hot Spring is 67°C. It is a calcium sulfate spring, rich in various trace elements beneficial to the human body. Due to its significant health and beauty effects, it is known as the "Health Soup."
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the unique hot spring pools and water park.

attractions.name: 淀山湖风景区
attractions.summary: The environment in Dianshan Lake Scenic Area is elegant, with misty trees along the coast and rich scenery of Jiangnan water towns. It connects the Taihu Lake Lake in the west and Huangpu River in the east. The Dianshan Lake Scenic Area crosses the Qingshang Highway in the middle, dividing the tourist area into two parts, east and west. The eastern half is a natural scenic spot, with a 100 meter long artificial embankment called "Liudi Chunxiao". The willows on the embankment are green and the flowers are red, and the water and sky are of the same color, offering a panoramic view of Dianshan Lake. The western half of the district is an antique street called "Shicheng Ancient Style", which provides living services for tourists. The surrounding area of Dianshan Lake Scenic Area also has rich historical and cultural landscapes, such as Songze Ancient Culture Site and Tangcun Ancient Culture Site. There are also rich ancient buildings, such as the Qinglong Temple in the Tang Dynasty. There is a "water sports field" near the lake, which is a venue for international rowing, rowing training, and competitions. On the east side of the lake, there are water sports fields, yacht clubs, golf courses, fishing clubs and other projects for tourists to experience. The scenic area is far away from the city center, with low traffic flow, suitable for families to take short self driving trips on weekends.

attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.

attractions.name: 课植园
attractions.summary:
Kezhi Garden, which took 15 years to build, is the largest manor-style garden building in the town. It was once the private residence of Ma Wenqing, a local magnate. 
The name of the garden is "Class Planting", which means "don't forget to cultivate after reading in class". The class garden is a living and learning area, and the topiary is a recreational farming area, with a quiet environment and unique scenery. 
Wangyue Building and Bookstore are the most typical buildings combining Chinese and Western styles in the garden. The stele gallery in the garden is inlaid with handwritten stone carvings such as poems and letters of Tang, Zhu, Wen and Zhou, the four talented scholars of Ming Dynasty, which have high historical and cultural value. 
· It is a great place to take children to play here with rich tour content.
attractions.shortFeatures: A combination of Chinese and Western, originally owned by Jia Shang

attractions.name: 和心园
attractions.summary: Hexin Garden was a private garden during the Qing Dynasty, with a serene environment and buildings that highlight the beauty of symmetry, showcasing the ingenuity of ancient architecture.

attractions.name: 放生桥
attractions.summary: Fangsheng Bridge is a landmark attraction of Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, spanning across the Caogang River and connecting the north and south parts of Zhujiajiao Scenic Area. Fangsheng Bridge is a five arch stone bridge in the Shanghai area that is long, large, and high. Standing at the top of the high bridge arch, one can admire the large white walled and black tiled houses, as well as the wooden boats passing under the bridge. The entire ancient town can be seen in full view, making it a place for filming. When the sun sets in the west, enjoying the sunset on the bridge or taking photos of the release bridge under the sunset by the river are both very artistic. The Release Bridge, as the name suggests, encourages people to do good deeds and accumulate virtue. This bridge was first built in the fifth year of the Longqing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1571). The stone arch bridge was donated by a monk named Xingchao from Cimen Temple with his savings from fifteen years of begging. Every lunar first and fifteenth day, monks and pilgrims would organize a "aquatic animal" release ceremony under the bridge. This custom has been passed down to this day. However, now there are often vendors selling small fish or turtles at the bridgehead for tourists to "experience" the release, which appears very commercialized. The Fangsheng Bridge that we see today was rebuilt in the 17th year of the Qing Dynasty's Jiaqing reign (1812). The entire stone bridge is majestic, with Longmen stone engraved with eight coiled dragons, creating a realistic image. There are four welcoming stone lions on the top of the bridge, looking up and opening their mouths, with a charming and silly appearance. There is a bamboo pillar in the middle, and a carved stone slab is embedded in the center of the bridge deck. There is a stele pavilion built on the east side of the bridge, where you can take a rest after wandering. There is a stone barge built by the water, which is used for boats to dock.

attractions.name: 北大街
attractions.summary: North Street, also known as the "First Street" and known as the "First Street of Ming and Qing Dynasties in Shanghai", has a history of more than 400 years and a total length of more than two miles. It starts from Fangsheng Bridge in the east and ends at Meizhou Lane in the west for more than 300 meters. It is the representative essence of Ming and Qing architecture. Here, old style residential houses are arranged in rows, with pink walls and grey tiles arranged in a staggered manner. The narrow streets lead to secluded paths, and the stone paths stretch endlessly. Old and famous shops stand on both sides, presenting a picturesque picture of the ancient charm of the Jiangnan water town. North Street is backed by the Caogang River and adjacent to the Fangsheng Bridge. As early as the early days of the ancient town's formation, it was convenient for both water and land transportation, and merchants gathered here, making it a hub for trade. Tea houses, taverns, north-south grocery stores, rice shops, and meat shops are all well-equipped, making it a thriving and ancient commercial center that has been thriving for over a century. It is often referred to as the "three mile long street with a thousand shops". Nowadays, there is still a century old shop called "Han Dalong Sauce Garden" preserved on the street, and the ancient style still exists; The century old hotel "Maosun Pavilion" has just opened; The ancient tea house of the ancient town, the crown of the Shanghai suburbs; Traditional handicraft workshops with a complete range of categories; Antiques, ceramics, flowers and birds, calligraphy and painting, local specialties, handicrafts, and specialty snack shops are all readily available. The streets are filled with store signs fluttering in the wind, with red lanterns hanging high, creating a prosperous scene. North Street is only three to four meters wide, with a narrow section of only two meters. On both sides, there are small brick and wood buildings, and the drip eaves are almost connected, forming a unique landscape of "One Line Street". On both sides of the residential buildings, there are flying eaves and upturned corners, the walls of Mashan, and the storefronts are decorated with grid style floor to ceiling long windows. The old-fashioned vermilion painted door panels exude a strong sense of antiquity and elegance. The "Yunqiao Fishing Music" antique architectural complex, one of the ten scenic spots in the original ancient town, has also sprung up at the entrance of North Street and Meizhou Lane, shining again. Suggested travel time: 1.5 hours

attractions.name: 泰安桥
attractions.summary: Tai'an Bridge is located in Shanghai, China and is a bridge with a long history. It is famous for its unique architectural style and rich historical background. It is not only a transportation hub, but also an important symbol of Shanghai's history and culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

attractions.name: 王昶纪念馆
attractions.summary: The Wang Chang Memorial Hall is located in Shanghai and was established to commemorate the famous scholar Wang Chang of the Qing Dynasty. The museum displays the life stories, academic achievements, and influence of Wang Chang on future generations, making it an important place to understand the academic culture of the Qing Dynasty.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 朱家角大清邮局
attractions.summary: The Zhujiajiao Great Qing Post Office was established in 1903 and is the former site of the Great Qing Post Office preserved in East China. It is also the earliest postal institution in the region. It is said that there were a total of thirteen postal stations in Shanghai at that time, and Zhujiajiao Post Office was one of them. After the Xinhai Revolution overthrew the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Post Office continued to operate as China Post. In 1953, it was relocated to the vicinity of Fangsheng Bridge on North Street, and in 2001, it was listed as a cultural relic protection unit in Qingpu District. The antique bronze cast dragon mailbox standing outside the old post office site is a unique business card of Zhu Jiajiao, showcasing the retro romance of "slow carriages and horses, long letters and letters". In 2022, the overall building of Zhujiajiao Daqing Post Office will undergo a comprehensive spatial upgrade, revitalizing through the renovation of the old style. While preserving the original Ming and Qing architectural styles and cultural heritage, it will integrate new Chinese aesthetics, combining cultural exchange, cultural and creative experiences, art exhibitions, study salons, boat tours, and other diverse cultural experiences. This will recreate the century old vicissitudes of the ancient town post office and showcase the long history of China Post. In addition to the historical attributes of ancient architectural sites, more cultural exchange spaces such as theme coffee, cultural exhibitions, characteristic cultural creation, creative workshops, art summer camps, etc. have also been opened up. In this building that has witnessed the time, we will continue to publicize the profound history and the vitality of modern China-Chic culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 圆津禅院
attractions.summary: Yuanjin Buddhist Temple is located in far western Shanghai’s Zhujiajiao Ancient Town. Dating to the Yuan Dynasty, the temple as first built around 1341. The hall contains many important cultural relics in addition to the well-known Qinghua Pavilion, located inside the temple grounds. The pavilion’s height makes it visible from many parts of Zhujiajiao, lending a sense of importance and focus. If you’re visiting Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, be sure not to miss visiting Yuanjin Buddhist Temple.

attractions.name: 报国寺
attractions.summary: The original site of Baoguo Temple, Guanwang Temple, is also a famous ancient temple by Dianshan Lake. It was built in the Ming Dynasty and rebuilt in the 13th year of the Chongzhen reign (1640). To this day, a stone tablet from the Chongzhen era is still preserved in the temple. Due to the worship of the famous Three Kingdoms general Guan Yu, it is named "Guan Wang Temple". Over a hundred years ago, the Guanwang Temple was bustling with incense and Buddhist activities were unprecedented. In the following years, there were several wars and most of the buildings were destroyed. By the late 1940s, only the East and West Halls remained. There are two stone tablets in the hall, a large copper bell with a golden Maitreya the size of a thumb on it. The golden Maitreya shimmers with golden light and is priceless. Later, it was stolen and the copper bell was destroyed in 1958. Since then, most of the Guanwang Temple has been damaged, and the incense offerings have gradually declined. However, people have not forgotten the grandeur of Guanwang Temple, and the ancient ginkgo tree behind the temple is a witness to history. In the early 1980s, Guanwang Temple underwent renovation and became increasingly popular. In 1989, Guanwang Temple was designated as the lower house of Shanghai Jade Buddha Temple and named Baoguo Temple. In 1991, a new Guanyin Hall was built, with two floors and a construction area of 950 square meters. The upper floor is a Jade Buddha Hall, and the lower floor houses a camphor wood Guanyin Buddha statue that is over one and two feet high. The current Baoguo Temple covers a total area of 38.5 acres, with a building area of over 5000 square meters. It has a magnificent atmosphere and is crowded with pilgrims, comparable to the ancient temples of Suzhou and Hangzhou.

attractions.name: 龙华寺
attractions.summary:
Most of the temples in Longhua Temple today belong to buildings dating from the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods of the Qing Dynasty, followed by Maitreya Hall, Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Three Sacred Hall, Abbot Room and Sutra Tower.
The Qinglong bronze bell cast during the Guangxu period, as the "Longhua Late Bell", was one of the "Eight Scenes in Shanghai" in the past. During the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, 718 letters of the Tripitaka, Fan Jin Chiba Baolian Piluzana Buddha and the royal gold seals were awarded as the "Three Treasures of Temple Protection" of Longhua Temple.
attractions.shortFeatures: An ancient temple with a long history and a large scale

attractions.name: 上海大观园
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Five-Star Park is a large theme park built based on the artistic concept of *Dream of the Red Chamber*, using traditional Chinese artistic techniques. The entire park is exquisitely designed, combining the grandeur of a royal garden with the graceful style of a Jiangnan garden. The interior furniture, furnishings, plaques, couplets, and even every plant and tree are arranged according to the characters' traits and storylines in *Dream of the Red Chamber*.

Around the Grand View Garden, there are also some scenic spots and entertainment activities for visitors to enjoy. Every spring and autumn, large performance events such as the Red Chamber Art Festival and Red Chamber Tourism Festival are held. It has won several prestigious awards, including the National Architecture Luban Award, Shanghai's Top 10 Buildings for the 40th Anniversary, Top 10 New Leisure Spots, Excellent Architecture of Shanghai for the 50th Anniversary of New China, Shanghai's Top 10 Tourism Gardens, one of Shanghai's Seven Civilized Parks, and honors such as Advanced Group of National Scenic Areas by the Ministry of Construction.

hotel.Hotel Name: Gu Dehui · Pu Shi Mei Su

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 丽江古城酒吧街
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the bustling and bustling of the ancient city of Lijiang

attractions.name: 大水车
attractions.summary:
· The landmark buildings and landmarks of the ancient city of Lijiang, tourists must go to the place to take photos. 
The oldest agricultural irrigation tool in China is a superb labor skill created by our ancestors and a precious historical and cultural heritage. 
In the past, there were waterwheels in ancient cities, represented by the big waterwheels in ancient cities, which are still used in some remote places today. 
The waterwheel in the ancient city of Lijiang is only used as a landmark building and ornamental function.
attractions.shortFeatures: Symbol of Old Town of Lijiang

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 拉市海茶马古道
attractions.summary: The Tea Horse Ancient Road refers to a folk international trade channel that exists in the southwestern region of China, with horse gangs as the main means of transportation. It is a corridor for economic and cultural exchanges among ethnic groups in southwestern China. The Tea Horse Ancient Road is a very special regional name, a world famous tourist route with spectacular natural scenery and mysterious culture, and it contains an endless cultural heritage. Full text 

attractions.name: 拉市海湿地.候鸟湾
attractions.name_en: Lashi Lake Wetland. Migratory Bird Bay
attractions.summary: The Migratory Bird Bay of Lashihai Wetland is located in Yulong Naxi Autonomous County, Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, China. It is a natural ecological reserve where tens of thousands of migratory birds such as egrets and herons come to settle and winter from November to February of the following year. This wetland park has great ecological significance and also provides abundant bird watching resources. The wetland's pristine environment and beautiful natural scenery have made it a popular destination for many photography and bird watching enthusiasts. Whether it's seasonal fruits, fresh lemonade, or afternoon sunshine partners, this is a great place for you to fully enjoy your leisure time.

attractions.name: 指云禅寺
attractions.summary: Zhiyun Temple is located in Lashi Township, Lijiang. It was first built during the Yongzheng period of the Qing Dynasty and was renovated during the Guangxu period. It is one of the five famous temples in Lijiang. The temple is very quiet and has a delicate appearance. There are two to three hundred year old trees such as mulberry trees, locust trees, ginkgo trees, cherry blossoms, etc. inside the temple, and the environment is very quiet and ancient. Zhiyun Temple has one large courtyard and five small courtyards. The courtyard is a two entry courtyard with a mountain gate, a Buddhist temple, a supporting hall, a monk's hall, a kitchen, a bathroom, etc. The Buddhist temple is rectangular in shape, with a triple eave pavilion style building and a square shaped diamond pointed pavilion in the center. It is clearly different from the tower style buildings in Tibetan areas, reflecting the characteristics of the fusion of Han, Tibetan, Bai, and Naxi architectural art. The ground floor is the Dharma Hall, and the upper two floors are the scripture storage buildings. Six towering 12 meter tall pillars stand tall among them, with twelve carved dragons and painted phoenixes at the southeast, northwest, and southeast corners, towering and magnificent, exuding an extraordinary aura.

attractions.name: 白沙古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
Baisha Ancient Town was once the political, economic and cultural center of Lijiang, and it was also the original settlement of Naxi people in Lijiang Dam, retaining the original Naxi culture. 
The ancient town retains its original appearance, has not been over-developed, is quieter than Dayan and Shuhe, and you can see Yulong Snow Mountain when you look up. 
Baisha Mural is the most famous scenic spot in the town. It lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, and it is a good place to learn about Dongba culture. 
You can sit and drink tea in the street shop, hang out slowly, and chat with the local old grandmother in a language that each other doesn't understand, which is relaxed and leisurely.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the quiet of the original ecological ancient town

attractions.name: 白沙壁画
attractions.summary: The famous "Lijiang Mural" is the product of the great opening of Naxi society in Ming Dynasty. Its painting lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty. The late Ming and early Qing Dynasties were the heyday of Lijiang murals, which has a history of 500 years. During these long years, Lijiang has experienced the rule of more than ten generations of chieftains and officials. Among the chieftains and officials, there are enlightened people and fatuous people; There are those who flourish and those who decline; There are believers in Buddhism, believers in Taoism and Lamaism. With the preference of the rulers, various religions in Lijiang often have an alternate development process one after another, and temples in Lijiang often rise and fall, which directly affects the rise and fall of murals. In 1962, the investigation report of Yunnan Cultural Relics Task Force wrote as follows: "Lijiang murals were distributed in Wande Palace in Yangxi, Conversion Hall in Dayan Town, Hantan Temple, Dajue Palace in Shuhe, Mu's former residence in Yajiao Village, Fuguo Temple in Zhishan, Baisha Liuli Hall, Dabaoji Palace, Dharma Protection Hall, Dading Pavilion and Xuesong Temple in Xuesong Village." At that time, there were more than ten existing murals in Lijiang. The existing 55 murals are distributed in four temples, such as Dabaoji Palace, Liuli Hall, Dading Pavilion and Dajue Palace in Shuhe, which are religious buildings around the ancient city. Among them, the murals located in Dabaoji Palace in Baisha Village, five kilometers north of Dayan Ancient City, were announced by the state as the fourth batch of national key cultural relics protection units in 1996.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exquisite ancient painting art

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 冰川公园大索道
attractions.summary: The cableway has a total length of 2980 meters, with an upper station elevation of 4506 meters and a lower station elevation of 3356 meters. The vertical height difference between the upper and lower stations is 1150 meters, making it one of the cableways built at high altitudes both domestically and internationally.

attractions.name: 《印象丽江》演出
attractions.tag: Featured performance; Mountain Climbing; Live Show
attractions.summary: Impression Lijiang "is one of the" Impression Series "directed by Zhang Yimou. The performance is set against the backdrop of snow capped mountains, with folk culture as the theme and local indigenous people as actors. On the open-air stage of the Ganhaizi Blue Moon Valley Theater in Yulong Snow Mountain at an altitude of 3100 meters, it truly showcases the indigenous people's emotions towards heaven, earth, people, and mountains. Impression of Lijiang "is divided into two parts:" Snow Mountain Chapter "and" Ancient City Chapter ", including six parts:" Ancient Road Horse Gang "," Duijiu Snow Mountain "," Heaven and Earth "," Jumping Song Group "," Encouragement and Sacrifice to Heaven ", and" Prayer Ceremony ". The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. The more than 500 actors participating in the performance are all from the surrounding rural areas, giving the audience a very authentic impression of Lijiang with their rough momentum, native posture, and simple singing.

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 白水河
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.
attractions.shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain

Guanfang Hotel Garden Villa Chinese and Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 中环
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Central is the political and commercial center of Hong Kong. Many banks, multinational financial institutions and foreign consulates are located in Central. 
· All kinds of skyscrapers and shopping malls are all over Central, with gorgeous lights and neon lights. 
· Popular shopping malls such as Landmark Plaza, Jiaxuan Plaza, Prince Building, Alexander Building and International Financial Center Shopping Mall gather designer brands and international palace-level brand stores. 
· The landscape of Central is a mixture of colonial architecture and modern high-tech buildings. Hong Kong's iconic buildings such as Legislative Council Building, Bank of China Tower and IFC International Financial Center in Central are also located here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong Political and Business Centre

attractions.name: 中环至半山自动扶梯
attractions.summary: The Central to Mid Levels escalator connects the Central business district with the Mid Levels residential area. It was built by the British Hong Kong government in 1993 to improve traffic in Mid Levels. The escalator consists of 20 one-way escalators and 3 automatic pedestrian walkways, starting from the Central Market and ending at Conduit Road. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and there are multiple exits along the way, making it convenient for pedestrians to get on and off. The Mid Levels escalator crosses multiple major streets in Central, including Queen's Road Central, Hollywood Road, and other attractions along the way, such as the old Central Police Station, making it a great means of transportation for tourists. In addition, the escalator will also pass through the SOHO area, which is filled with restaurants and bars, European style small bars, specialty tea restaurants, and souvenir shops, where foodies can find satisfying cuisine.

attractions.name: 大馆(前中区警署建筑群)
attractions.tag: Theater; Art Museums; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary: The main building is located on Hollywood Road in Central, Hong Kong. The complex includes three historic sites: the former Central Police Station, the former Central Magistracy, and Victoria Prison. The Central Police Station was built in 1864 and was originally a three story classical style building. On December 20, 2005, the police held a farewell ceremony and officially handed over the Central Police Station. The original site is adjacent to the former Central Magistracy and Victoria Prison, which also have a long history, and is planned to be developed into a historical and cultural tourism area. In April 2011, the Hong Kong Jockey Club announced that it had completed archaeological surveys in the area and discovered some artifacts believed to be from the late Qing Dynasty to the early 20th century, including containers, pottery pipes, copper coins, fragments of porcelain bowls, suspected tunnel buildings, and foundation remains. Da Guan is now a historic site and art museum, dedicated to bringing rich and exciting historical relics and artistic experiences to Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 索罟湾
attractions.summary: Sok Kwu Wan is a bay located on the east coast of Lamma Island, Hong Kong. Near Sok Kwu Wan Pier, besides the famous seafood restaurants in the area, there is also a 150-year-old Tin Hau Temple in Sok Kwu Wan. Sok Kwu Wan was named Picnic Bay by the British in the past, which means "Picnic Bay" in Chinese.
attractions.shortFeatures: Have a delicious seafood dinner

attractions.name: 洪圣爷湾泳滩
attractions.summary: Hung Shing Yeh Bay Beach is a famous beach on Lamma Island. The water here is clear and the sand is young. Many western tourists and island residents love to swim and sunbathe here. At dusk, when the setting sun sets on the sea, it is the most beautiful moment to look at the Lamma Island Power Plant on the other side.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many shores are suitable for fishing

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 国家自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· Located in the Tianqiao area on the central axis of the south city of the capital, it is backed by the World Cultural Heritage Temple of Heaven Park and faces the modern Tianqiao Theater. 
There are four basic exhibitions and a Dinosaur World Expo. The number of large-scale ancient mammal fossils in the exhibition museum ranks second in the world, and the ancient elephant fossils and dinosaur fossils of the Yellow River are famous at home and abroad. 
If you are bringing children, you must go to the "Discovery Corner" in the museum, so that you can give full play to your imagination.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the fossils of extinct animals and plants

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 大水车
attractions.summary:
· The landmark buildings and landmarks of the ancient city of Lijiang, tourists must go to the place to take photos. 
The oldest agricultural irrigation tool in China is a superb labor skill created by our ancestors and a precious historical and cultural heritage. 
In the past, there were waterwheels in ancient cities, represented by the big waterwheels in ancient cities, which are still used in some remote places today. 
The waterwheel in the ancient city of Lijiang is only used as a landmark building and ornamental function.
attractions.shortFeatures: Symbol of Old Town of Lijiang

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 印象西湖《最忆是杭州》演出
attractions.summary: Impression of West Lake "is one of the" Impression Series "created by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue. The theater is located between Yuehu Lake, Quyuan Fenghe, and Sudi in the northwest area of West Lake. Using the lake as a stage, the scene is rendered using high-tech sound and light technology, and the plot is performed by numerous actors to recreate the beautiful scenery and folk legends of Jiangnan. On a quiet night, on the charming Xizi Lake, the beautiful scenery of Jiangnan and timeless legends bloom in the night and memories.

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 三潭印月
attractions.tag: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Also known as Xiaoyingzhou, it is the largest island among the three islands in the West Lake and the only island that can be visited. It is known as the first scenic spot in the West Lake.
