The outline is like the word "Tian", the outer ring is Jiangnan garden, and the inside is divided into four small lakes by cross-shaped islands and bridges, which are full of poetry and painting. 
The whole island is densely covered with flowers and trees, mainly green willow, lotus, red maple and hibiscus, which is the representative work of water courtyard art in the south of the Yangtze River. 
The back of the RMB one-dollar banknote adopts the grand scene of three pools reflecting the moon, which shows that it plays an extremely important symbolic role in my country's scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landing on the island and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the West Lake from a new perspective

attractions.name: 花港观鱼
attractions.summary:
Huagang Fish Watching, located in the south of the West Lake, was once the private garden of officials in the Southern Song Dynasty. 
The whole park is divided into five scenic spots: Red Fish Pond, Peony Garden, Flower Harbor, Big Lawn and Dense Forest. 
· The most famous thing in the garden is the swarms of red carp in the red fish pond. There are always adults and children feeding the fish with feed and bread crumbs, which is a great pleasure. 
There are three main entrances to the park. The south gate is on Nanshan Road, the west gate is on Yanggong Causeway, and you can also walk north to Su Causeway.
attractions.shortFeatures: Buy feed to feed big, red carp

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 杭州长乔极地海洋公园
attractions.tag: "Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Playground"
attractions.summary:
· Hangzhou Polar Ocean Park is a large-scale polar ocean park that integrates polar animal exhibitions and polar landscape experiences.  
· The park features 19 major themed venues, 5 exciting performance theaters, and hundreds of polar animals, including whales, dolphins, fish, corals, and jellyfish.  
· The highlight not to be missed is the park's treasure—the pilot whale, the first whale species introduced to a marine park in China.  
· The most spectacular part of the ocean world is the animal performances, with the clever sea lion all-stars performing kung fu shows, including impressive tricks like the "Golden Rooster Stand" and "Upside-down Hook."
attractions.shortFeatures: Get close to and learn about adorable marine creatures.

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 北京大学-校史馆
attractions.summary: The History Museum of Peking University was founded during the centennial celebration of Peking University in May 1998 and completed in September 2001. The building is divided into three floors with a construction area of 3100 square meters. The first floor is the "Exhibition of Outstanding Figures at Peking University", showcasing the biographies and photos of 217 outstanding revolutionaries, thinkers, theorists, scientists, and educators in the history of Peking University. There is a gift department on the west side of the school history museum where you can purchase relevant reading materials and souvenirs.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

restaurants.name_en: Brother Wu's special roast whole lamb

attractions.name: 广州长隆度假区
attractions.summary: Guangzhou Chimelong Resort has multiple theme parks and high-end resort hotels, including Chimelong Wildlife World, Chimelong Happy World, Chimelong International Circus, Chimelong Water Park, Chimelong Flying Bird Park, Chimelong Hotel, Chimelong Panda Hotel, and more. Chimelong Wildlife World has giant panda triplets known as "cute, handsome, and cool", and has successfully bred 7 cubs and 10 cubs to date; It also has a koala population second only to Australia in size, as well as nearly 500 species and over 20000 rare animals worldwide, including white tigers, which account for more than half of the global population. Chimelong Happy World and Chimelong Water Park have been operating for over 10 years, and with the innovative equipment "Rock Wheel", Chimelong Water Park has won the TEA's "Outstanding Achievement Award". Chimelong Happy World and Chimelong Water Park have cultivated multiple well-known entertainment brands such as "Happy Halloween" and "Water Electric Syllable", becoming trendy landmarks for young people to play and relax. After 20 years of continuous innovation, Chimelong International Circus, together with Zhuhai Hengqin Chimelong International Circus, has welcomed nearly 500 circus artists from more than 20 countries to perform brilliantly in Guangzhou and Zhuhai, creating a "never-ending world circus stage". Chimelong Bird Park is a theme park that integrates bird watching, science education, and precious wetland plants - "a real place to watch birds fly", with hundreds and tens of thousands of rare birds and amphibians. Due to the large size of the scenic area, you can usually play in Happy World or Wildlife World for a whole day, while the circus starts at night. Therefore, if you want to play in more than one scenic area, it is recommended to stay at Chimelong Hotel, which provides free shuttle bus services for easy access. If you stay in the scenic area, the most cost-effective dining option at Chimelong Hotel is the Caidie Valley Food Gallery (only applicable to the entire scenic area), which is a bit like a "big foodie". It offers various types of cuisine, such as Cantonese cuisine, Sichuan cuisine, Brazilian barbecue, and hotpot. You can check online in advance for cash coupons for group purchases. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 广州长隆国际大马戏
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong International Circus has more than 300 circus elites from more than 20 countries, and more than 500 rare animals of more than 40 species performing on the same stage 
· It has the world's largest forest live stage layout, and you can see live forests, streams, boats, etc., which is absolutely refreshing 
· The performance is divided into several parts such as animal performance, float parade, acrobatics, etc. Cute and intelligent animals and awesome stage layout make it feel like being there 
· In addition, the theater strongly launched "Magic Legend II", which combines beauty, romance and fantasy to make the performance more legendary
attractions.shortFeatures: A gorgeous circus is staged on a super-large live stage

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 南宁博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Nanning Museum is a local comprehensive museum focusing on education, display, collection and research of Nanning's historical and cultural heritage. The architectural design of the museum is beautiful and has unique local characteristics. It looks like a bunch of light leaves, noble and gorgeous phoenix wings, the flying feather man on the bronze drum pattern, and the sailing fleet. The facade is decorated with modern materials such as hollow aluminum plates, and it is decorated with ethnic patterns such as Zhuang brocade. Modernity, regionality and nationality are unified, implying a modern Nanning with hard work, progress, tolerance and unity. In the hall, the art installation of the word "Yong" creatively designed by a famous designer is displayed, which not only embodies the original meaning of the word "Yong" surrounded by many waters, but also derives the cultural connotation of "harmony and harmony" from the holiday of "Yong" and "Yong", which is both artistic and functional, and is the first in domestic museums.
attractions.shortFeatures: A comprehensive museum for studying Nanning's history

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 东方明珠259米全透明悬空观光廊
attractions.summary: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower fully transparent sightseeing corridor is 259 meters high, 150 meters long and 2.1 meters wide. It is the only 360 degree fully transparent sightseeing corridor in the world. Standing on the fully transparent sightseeing corridor, enjoy the panoramic view of Shanghai in a unique way of "aerial stroll" and experience an unprecedented shock.

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 上海海昌海洋公园
attractions.summary: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park has been rated as a National 4A-level tourist attraction. The park is closely centered around marine culture and is divided into five major themed areas: Mermaid Bay, Polar Town, Ice and Snow Kingdom, Underwater Wonders, and Ocean Tribe. It features sixteen star performances, including "Killer Whale Science Show," "Dolphin Romance," "Sea Lion Fun Adventures," "Beluga Love," "Marine Animal Feeding Show," "Mermaid Fairy Tale," "Water Dance Between Fish," "Town Party," "Water Flying Man," "Chinese Style Grand Event," "Flying Fairy Little Dragon Girl," "Seven Cute Adventures," "Clown Meet and Greet," "Ocean Dream Parade," "Illusory Sea Realm," and "Ocean EDM Party." The park also has six animal exhibition halls: Antarctic Penguin Hall, Marine Mammal Exploration Hall, Iceberg Arctic Hall, Underwater World Hall, Volcano Shark Hall, and Coral Jellyfish Hall. It houses over 30,000 rare marine animals, including polar bears and emperor penguins. Additionally, there are six amusement facilities: Volcano Rafting, Dolphin Roller Coaster, Time and Space Cable Car, Deep Sea Adventure, Sky Theater, and Sensory 4D Cinema. The park is also complemented by the Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel, which features five marine-themed rooms, including penguin and mermaid-themed rooms, offering visitors a spectacular oceanic dream journey!
attractions.shortFeatures: See rare marine life and enjoy thrilling attractions.

attractions.name: 中国航海博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Military Sites; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Maritime Museum is the largest and highest-ranking comprehensive maritime museum in China. The museum focuses on "maritime" as its main theme and "museum" as its foundation. It is divided into six main exhibition halls: Maritime History, Ships, Maritime and Ports, Maritime Affairs and Maritime Safety, Seafarers, and Military Maritime. There are also two special exhibition areas: Fishing Vessels and Fishing, and Maritime Sports and Leisure. Additionally, the museum features a Planetarium, a 4D Cinema, and a Children's Activity Center, covering functions such as artifact collection, academic research, social education, and exhibitions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding China's Maritime History Simulation Model; The First Domestic Maritime-themed Museum

restaurants.name_en: Sunkimmi pure imported frozen yogurt from the United States
Crowne Plaza Dishui Lake All-Day Restaurant

attractions.name: 粤海关博物馆
attractions.summary: The Guangdong Customs Museum is located in Guangzhou, with a total of 4 floors facing north and south. There are thousands of collections in the museum, as well as a basic exhibition on "The Development History of Chinese Customs" and a special exhibition on "Guangdong Customs and the Maritime Silk Road".

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 太古仓
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built by British Swire Ocean Company between 1904 and 1908, it was used by Swire Steamship Company. It is a relatively complete storage terminal. 
It consists of 3 T-shaped trestle concrete wharves and 7 brick and wood structure warehouses, which is the historical epitome of Guangzhou Port's foreign trade. 
Guangzhou's "City Living Room", which integrates cultural creativity, exhibition and trade, sightseeing, leisure and entertainment and other functions. 
On the basis of retaining the original history, it will be transformed into a creative industrial park including bars, cinemas and yacht marinas.
attractions.shortFeatures: A creative park transformed into a dock warehouse

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 上下九步行街

attractions.summary:

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.

attractions.summary: Yuexiu Park is the largest park in Guangzhou and one of the oldest parks in Guangzhou's history. The park is shaded by green trees and boasts picturesque lakes and mountains, making it a great destination for citizens to relax and entertain themselves. The Korean Garden is a distinctive attraction within Yuexiu Park, showcasing traditional Korean garden art and providing visitors with a window to learn about Korean culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 五羊石雕
attractions.summary: The Five Rams Stone Carving is located in Yuexiu Park and is a symbol of Guangzhou city, as well as the origin of the name "Yangcheng". The Five Rams Stone Carving originated from a beautiful legend. Legend has it that in the past, Guangzhou was very barren and people could not afford to eat or drink. Five immortals rode five sheep with ears of grain in their mouths and flew here, leaving the ears of grain to the people of Guangzhou. They wished for a bountiful harvest every year and then flew away with clouds, turning the sheep into stones. Guangzhou became a prosperous land from then on. The Five Rams Stone Carving was built in April 1960. The statue is 11 meters high and is carved from 130 pieces of granite. It is a commemoration of a beautiful legend. There is also a sculpture of the Five Immortals next to it, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. - The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 上海博物馆(东馆)
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Museum has a collection of bronze artifacts from various eras since the Xia Dynasty, many of which are national treasures that have been passed down and recorded repeatedly, forming a complete system, complete variety, and many exquisite collections. The "Ancient Chinese Bronze Museum" in the East Pavilion is the sixth exhibition renovation in 50 years, presenting the audience with a relatively complete display of ancient Chinese bronze ware both domestically and internationally. At present, there are more than 500 selected exhibits on display, reflecting the development and evolution of ancient Chinese bronze ware from the late summer of the 18th century BC to the mid Qing Dynasty of the 19th century AD. The exhibition hall takes the development history of Chinese bronze craftsmanship as a clue and is divided into seven sections: the emergence period, the cultivation period, the peak period, the transformation period, the renewal period, the integration period, and the retro period. The exhibits fully demonstrate the characteristics of bronze craftsmanship in different periods and jointly showcase the brilliant brilliance of Chinese bronze art. There is also a section on bronze ware production technology, vividly showcasing how ancient laboring people used their astonishing intelligence and nimble hands to create the splendid and magnificent Chinese bronze culture. Compared with the People's Square building, the bronze exhibition hall in the East Hall has been adjusted and upgraded in terms of panel structure, panel content, unit descriptions, instrument descriptions, and exhibits. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 上海交通大学-校史博物馆(徐汇校区)
attractions.summary: The History Museum of Shanghai Jiao Tong University is located on the second and third floors of the old library, with a total exhibition area of approximately 600 square meters. The museum has three exhibition halls. The time span of the first exhibition hall ranges from the establishment of Nanyang Public School to the liberation of Shanghai, divided into three periods: the establishment of Nanyang Public School, the construction of a modern engineering university, and the integration of science, engineering, and management at Jiaotong University; The time span of the second exhibition hall is from the liberation of Shanghai to the present day. These two exhibition halls display nearly 700 precious cultural relics, documents, photographic materials, etc., reflecting the school's development process and fruitful achievements in academic research over the past century. The third exhibition hall is the performance exhibition of academicians from the "two academies" of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The photo data, literature and material objects of nearly 200 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the CAE Member who studied or taught at Jiaotong University were displayed. Their biographies and main achievements were introduced in order of their birth dates. The third exhibition room also has the "Professor Lin Tongyan Exhibition Room", which displays more than 300 photos, works, papers, and image materials of Mr. Lin Tongyan, a famous alumnus of Jiaotong University, internationally renowned structural engineer, educator, and Chinese American scholar.
