attractions.name: 甲秀楼
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jiaxiu Building is a landmark building in Guiyang. Anyone who goes to Guiyang will board it to observe the scenery. 
The existing building was rebuilt during the Xuantong period of Qing Dynasty. The three-story building stands on Aoji Stone, in front of which is the flowing Nanming River. 
Walking through the floating jade bridge connecting Jiaxiu Building, it is Cuiwei Garden, with pavilions and waterside pavilions in the garden, which is quite south of the Yangtze River. 
The night view of Jiaxiu Building is particularly beautiful. From a distance, it is brightly lit.
attractions.shortFeatures: A wooden attic built in the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 青云市集
attractions.summary: Qingyun Market is located in Nanming District, Yangshi City. Many people think of setting up a night market here, but after being packaged by the local management department, it has been upgraded to a traditional, retro, and industrial style internet famous market that integrates leisure, entertainment, and food. It is a place where young people gather and relax, with food, drink, drink, take photos, and neon lights flashing at night.

attractions.name: 黔灵山公园
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids' outings; City Parks
attractions.summary:
- Qianling Mountain Park is characterized by its famous mountains, beautiful waters, secluded forests, ancient temples, sacred springs, and spiritual monkeys, and is known as "The First Mountain of Southern Guizhou."
- The Hongfu Temple at the top of the mountain is the largest Buddhist monastery in Guizhou and is the province's most prominent temple. It was founded during the Qing Dynasty, and it is said that prayers here are very effective.
- There are many rhesus monkeys along the Hongfu Temple and the path down the mountain. Many visitors come to Qianling Mountain Park specifically to see these monkeys, which are free-roaming within the park.
- Halfway up the mountain, there is a zoo with a wide variety of animals. The Qilin Cave in the scenic area was the place where General Zhang Xueliang was once imprisoned.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the scenery of Guiyang City from the mountain

attractions.name: 青岩古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Ancient Towns; Military Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qingyan Ancient Town was established in the Ming Dynasty and has well-preserved a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing periods. It is known as one of the four major ancient towns in Guizhou, alongside Zhenyuan, Bian'an, and Longli.
- The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Missing Gun"

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 昆明老街
attractions.summary: Kunming Old Street is the most authentic old neighborhood in the center of Kunming. There are six streets and ten lanes in the block, and a large number of characteristic residential buildings and old businesses in the Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China are preserved, which has a unique historical charm. Ancient streets, buildings and gatehouses all have a sense of history and age. There are dozens of historical buildings and cultural buildings all over the blocks, which is the best place to feel the history and culture of Kunming.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat small pot rice noodles to shop for Yunnan antiques

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 海晏村
attractions.shortFeatures: A quiet village by Dianchi Lake

restaurants.name_en: Blue bird Spring food Western restaurant

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 老门东牌坊
attractions.summary: The Old Gate East memorial archway is the main entrance of the Old Gate East Historic District, which is a landmark building here. A stone tablet below the memorial archway is engraved with the history of Nanjing City, which has a lot of historical and cultural details.

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 紫金山天文台
attractions.summary: The Purple Mountain Observatory was built in 1934 and is located on the third peak of Purple Mountain in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. It is the site of the former site of the "National Purple Mountain Observatory" and is known as the cradle of modern astronomy in China. It is the main place for scientific research, observation, science popularization and other work in the history of Purple Mountain Observatory, and has left many important astronomical heritages. Some areas have been opened up as public science popularization service areas. This place records the history of the development of modern astronomy in China, inheriting the spirit of scientific exploration, and is also a famous scenic tourist destination in Nanjing. The Purple Mountain Observatory is a national science popularization education base, a national key cultural relic protection unit, and one of the first ten science and technology tourism bases in China. Entering the entrance of the scenic area and climbing up the stairs is the Meteorite Exhibition Hall, which has an exhibition area of about 200 square meters and displays more than 20 precious meteorites of various types. Tourists can have close contact with extraterrestrial visitors - meteorites, learn and understand meteorite knowledge. The former site of the observatory is the headquarters of the observatory, also known as the Great Observatory and the Great Equatorial Instrument Room. It is a combination of Chinese and Western architecture designed at the beginning of the construction of the observatory. The dome has distinctive Western characteristics. The gate is a memorial archway style, covered with glazed tiles. The central plaque has the word "observatory", which is based on the winter solstice on December 22, 1933. The 600mm reflecting Great Equatorial Instrument was placed, which was the largest telescope in the Far East at that time. Ancient Astronomical Instrument Exhibition Area Ancient Astronomical Instrument Exhibition Area is part of the essence of the Observatory. There is a celestial globe with a shape similar to a globe, also known as a celestial globe, embedded with stars. It was replicated by the Qing government in 1903; The armillary sphere and simple instrument, which have circular trajectories resembling the movements of several planets nested with each other, were both cast during the Ming Dynasty's Zhengtong period; There is a gnomon that uses the shadow of the sun to measure time; There is also the horizontal theodolite replicated by the Qing government in the early 20th century for measuring coordinates. The Meridian Room is the first building to be completed at the Purple Mountain Observatory, covered with square glass roofs and windows. It was built on the summer solstice of June 21, 1932, and the foundation stone was inscribed by Cai Yuanpei. The built-in meridian instrument is a celestial measurement instrument used to observe the moment when a star passes through its zenith. There are still some exhibits related to timekeeping displayed in the Meridian Room, such as copper pot droppers, scale droppers, modern navigation clocks, etc. The Ruins of Tianbao City Tianbao City was a fortress built by the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, and its former glory is no longer seen. There is a dome shaped observation room on the mountaintop. Climbing to the platform on the roof, you can overlook Nanjing City, and looking west is Xuanwu Lake; The perspective of the observatory is also very good, suitable for taking photos, and can capture a lot of observatory buildings. In addition, the scenic area also has graphic and textual exhibitions as well as special exhibitions. The graphic and textual exhibitions showcase the forefront and major achievements of scientific research at the Purple Mountain Observatory, as well as important history. They use astronomical photography images and physical objects and models to display basic knowledge of astronomy. The special exhibition is currently an original astronomical oil painting exhibition. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 南京明故宫遗址公园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 栖霞山名胜风景区-红叶谷
attractions.summary: Hongye Valley is located at the junction of the Imperial Garden and the southwest slope of Fengxiang Peak. Due to the lack of human intervention for many years and the erosion of mountains and rivers, the exposed rocks here showcase a landscape of cliff melting and strange rocks, while the rest are dense forests and wetlands. The unique climate environment makes the rocks here rugged, ancient maple trees stand tall, and ancient vines entangle. The construction of this scenic spot fully considers the harmonious combination of landforms, water bodies, plants, facilities, etc., pays attention to the restoration of the ecological functions of Qixia Mountain, continuously beautifies, optimizes, and colors the environment, and draws water to build ponds to improve the ecological environment of the area. Hongye Valley covers an area of about 50000 square meters, with beautiful natural scenery and unique rocks and red leaves. It is a new red leaf viewing area that integrates mountains, rocks, water, forests, and pavilions.

attractions.name: 栖霞山名胜风景区-明镜湖
attractions.summary: Mingjing Lake, located within Qixia Mountain, is naturally formed, with peach blossom streams and mid peak streams flowing down into the lake. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the lake area here was larger than it is now. Water lilies and lotus flowers were widely planted in the lake. At that time, willows and maple trees on the shore complemented each other, and it was often a place for literati to drink and write poetry. In 1751, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty came to Qixia Mountain on his first southern tour. When he saw the scenery of Mingjing Lake, he immediately wrote "Seven Wonders, Mingjing Lake" with his brush and ink; Rainbow is not sunshine, mirror is not copper. The bends of the creek and the bridge are intertwined. Xi Biming distinguishes between truth and falsehood, using his false illusions to cover up the vacuum. The stone Guanyin Bodhisattva, several meters high in the lake, smiles kindly at all beings in the world. A rainbow pavilion is built in the center of the lake, and a rainbow like curved bridge runs through it. The lake water is clear and transparent, just like a mirror; Ripples suddenly rise, and waves of light float. The red leaves around are reflected inside, beautiful beyond measure.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京明故宫遗址公园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 邕江夜游
attractions.summary: Yongjiang Night Tour is a new water tourism project in Nanning City, bringing a brand new water travel experience. Equipped with a 57 meter long and 17 meter wide barge, with three floors built on top. The first floor is the waiting hall, and the second and third floors are tourist leisure, entertainment, and dining areas; Two 120 passenger tourist boats, with an 80 seat hall on the first floor, 4 observation rooms on the second floor, and an observation deck on the third floor. The tourist boat has complete supporting facilities, comfortable and spacious, with a wide view. Tourists can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Yongjiang River and listen to the historical and cultural stories of Nanning in the gentle river breeze.

attractions.name: 花花大世界
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems: Nature and Adventure; Pick-Your-Own; Flower Fields
attractions.summary: The location is about 16 kilometers from the center of Nanning. On Coconut Grove Avenue, tall coconut trees line the street, creating a picturesque scene; the reflection of the sky and water at Tianfu Pond and the Wind and Rain Bridge is also beautiful. In addition to enjoying flowers at Huashan Square and Baojin Garden, visitors can feed the black bears, ostriches, sika deer, and goats, as well as pick fresh grapes, strawberries, melons, and other fruits and vegetables by hand.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire seasonal flowers and get close to animals.

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience.

Embark on the journey of "Soaring and Flying over the Horizon", feel the gentle breeze brushing your face, and fly over the treetops and rooftops. This is definitely a heart warming flying experience. On this magical journey around the world, fully appreciate the beautiful scenery along the way and enjoy the freedom and pleasure of soaring in the sky.

attractions.name: 胡迪牛仔嘉年华
attractions.summary: In the ranch set up by Andy with toys, visitors can join in a beaming dance party. Sheriff Woody had circled a herd of ponies, each pulling a pony carriage. When tourists get on the carriage, the ponies dance the square dance with cheerful music, and the carriage behind them swings happily with the horseshoe dance steps, which is endless.

attractions.name: 加勒比海盗——沉落宝藏之战
attractions.name_en: Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure
attractions.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean - The Battle of Fallen Treasures is a heavyweight project in Treasure Cove, telling the story of Captain Jack. Realistic renderings, combined with circular giant screens and cool 3D effects, make people feel as if they are immersed in the real scene of the battle of sunken treasures. In this facility, tourists will also turn into pirates and join Captain Jack's adventure team to explore the treasures hidden by David Jones in the deep sea. Throughout the process, tourists will board a small raft that can accommodate 30 people and cross the battle zone between two pirate fleets. Disney utilizes emerging technology to present the entire naval battle to visitors. Sail and embark on a fun filled sea journey, diving deep into the sea to search for the spoils of war that David Jones has buried beneath - along the way, you will also encounter pirates, mermaids, and even creepy sea monsters. Embark on a journey with the charming pirate, the cunning and charming Captain Jack, and set sail for Treasure Cove!

attractions.name: 晶彩奇航
attractions.summary:
With the help of music, lights and magical magic, Crystal Qihang will present classic Disney stories to tourists. Jingcai Qihang leads tourists across the water and visits the "dream world". Fountains and sculptures are lined by the water, celebrating classic fairy tales full of magic and fantasy such as Mulan, Beauty and the Beast, Fantasia, Magic, Aladdin and The Little Mermaid. 
Jingcai Qihang started at the dock of "Dream World". Winding along the way, passing by the spectacular sculpture garden, each sculpture perfectly conveys the essence of the story, which is full of fun, romantic and moving, positive and inspiring, and the music is beautiful. At the end of the journey, visitors will drive into the cave hidden under the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" and meet the magic crystal, which reflects bright light on the wall. This wonderful experience will surely inspire tourists' dreams and imaginations.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shocking audio-visual feast

attractions.name: 小飞侠天空奇遇
attractions.summary:
Visitors can take the "spaceship" of "Peter Pan Sky Adventure" overlooking London and fly to Neverland. 
Under the leadership of Peter Pan, tourists have to go through a series of adventures to fight Captain Hook and his pirate crew. 
The whole amusement project is full of dreamy and animated scenes, and it is a project that both adults and children can experience. 
The queuing time varies. It is recommended to plan the trip in advance to reduce the queuing time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Set sail and fly to Neverland

attractions.summary: the Bear and his friends are harmonious and friendly, and life is full of fun. The cute Winnie the Pooh is recognized as a good friend. Winnie the Pooh invites you to go to the 100-acre forest for a dream adventure. You will meet Eeyore, Valley Buddha, Mother Kangaroo, Piglet, Tigger and Adzuki Bean.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the 100-acre forest with 　 the Bear

attractions.name: 米奇童话专列
attractions.summary: The daytime theme parade-"Mickey Fairy Tale Train" will be full of fantasy, romance, music and laughter. Many Disney friends will come to you one by one. Mickey will drive the train on the locomotive, and the subsequent dream floats are all based on classic Disney movies, bringing you familiar Disney friends and intoxicating music. Walk through the theme park of Shanghai Disneyland. "Mickey's Fairy Tale Special Train" will drive through the longest cruise route in Disney parks around the world under the leadership of a magical locomotive. Amid the exciting music, "Mickey Fairy Tale Train" will bring wonders, surprises and laughter to tourists, creating an unforgettable and wonderful experience.
attractions.shortFeatures: Interact with characters from Disney movies

attractions.name: 奇梦之光幻影秀
attractions.name_en: Ignite the Dream - A Nighttime Spectacular of Magic and Light
attractions.summary: Mickey will show you the wonderful magic of dreams and the magical power of imagination. Follow him and have a swim! Witness the miracle at the center of Shanghai Disneyland! Mickey opens the door to a brand new adventure, presenting infinite and wonderful worlds one by one before your eyes. Through thrilling projection, laser, fountain, and various other visual effects techniques, Mickey will use his magic to turn the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" into a dreamlike new world, while illuminating the dreams in all of us.

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 中华艺术宫
attractions.summary:
It used to be the China National Pavilion of Shanghai World Expo, with a collection of more than 8,000 pieces, including a large number of paintings by famous painters such as Zhang Yuguang and Wu Guanzhong. 
The exhibition halls of the Art Palace are mainly located on the 0m floor, 5m floor, 33m floor, 41m floor and 49m floor. It is recommended to visit them from top to bottom. 
The most interesting thing is the treasure of the town hall-the multimedia version of Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival, which is located on the 49m floor, but you need to pay extra tickets to watch it. 
In addition, there are many exhibition halls for viewing, such as Shadow Art Exhibition, Modern Art Exhibition and Shanghai Artists Invitational Exhibition.
attractions.shortFeatures: Former China National Pavilion at Shanghai World Expo

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 迎泽公园
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yingze Park, with convenient transportation and wide vision, is the largest park in Taiyuan. 
There are flower exhibition hall, aquarium, calligraphy and painting exhibition hall, bonsai garden, peony, peony, rose and other specialized botanical gardens in the park, as well as tennis courts, miniature golf courses, amusement parks and other entertainment venues.  
This is a Jin Dynasty building, which moved here from other places, adding a quaint style to Yingze Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place for Taiyuan citizens to relax and entertain

attractions.name: 青龙古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
The whole building complex of Qinglong Town is like a soaring dragon. The curved road-shaped building complex in the south of the town is the dragon tail; The curved building in the west of the town is the right leg of the dragon that bends backward; The road leading to the collapsed cliff slope in the east of the town is the left leg of the dragon. Therefore, the road goes to the river, just like a dragon's claw just emerges from the water; Feng shui slope bow old road is the right front leg of the dragon; The curved ramp of the Dragon King Temple is the left front leg of the dragon, the lower street is the dragon's neck, and the grand cross is the dragon's claw; The slope is the dragon head, the five-mile long street is the dragon body, and the wells of two temples, such as the Shanghe Temple on the dragon head, are longan. A big river in the east of the town rolled from south to north. From a distance, Qinglong Town was like a dragon emerging from the water, soaring into the sky.  
There is an earth tower outside the town, which was originally a beacon tower for transmitting military information in the Spring and Autumn Period. From a distance, it looks like a giant pen. There are many shops on both sides of Qinglong Town, all of which are buildings of Ming and Qing Dynasties. Laoye Temple, Taishan Temple, Grandma Temple, River Temple, Wenchang Temple, Dragon King Temple, Dawang Temple, Chahuang Temple and other temples dominate the ancient town, and their temples are magnificent, either like eagles spreading their wings or like strange beasts, protecting the auspiciousness and peace of the ancient town.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are typical ancient buildings of Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 双塔寺
attractions.summary: The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

attractions.shortFeatures: A bustling commercial street with a long history in Taiyuan

attractions.name: 太原市食品街
attractions.summary: Taiyuan Food Street is located in Yingze District, Taiyuan City. Passing through the bustling commercial area of Gulou Street, you can see the ancient archway of Food Street and the spacious and tidy large parking lot of Gulou Street. The newly renovated food street, with its smooth marble pavement, features the five flavors of "sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, and salty" in ancient Chinese characters, indicating the uniqueness of this street. Standing at the south entrance of Food Street, looking north, there are two rows of two-story buildings modeled after the Ming and Qing dynasties, pavilions, memorial archway, cornices, and arch of wooden architecture. The traditional cultural symbols of Shanxi, such as painted buildings and red lanterns, are presented one by one in the block. Anti corrosion long flower pots, sculptures that reflect the characteristics of Shanxi noodles, and antique leisure chairs are neatly arranged on the road paved with bluestone strips. Taiyuan Food Street gathers numerous delicious foods, not only old shops such as Quanwazi snacks and Xueshan cold drinks, but also new ones such as Yantonglou, Jinyunlou, and Old Beijing braised and burned food are crowded with diners who come to try them out. A newly renovated food street is not just a symbol of cuisine, but also a cultural symbol. The "guards" dressed in the costumes of Song Dynasty warriors guard the street corner, adding a cultural atmosphere to the food street. In the center of the street, there are antique vending cars that not only complement the surrounding buildings, but also showcase the rich Jin merchant culture.

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 店头村
attractions.summary: Diantou Ancient Village is located in the branch of Lvliang Mountain, within the mouth of Fengyugou, with Mengshan Mountain to its back and Longshan Mountain to its south, stretching for 1km from east to west. Diantou Village is one of the eight villages in Fengyu. In history, it was a must pass place from Yangcheng in ancient Jin to Shaanxi Gansu Ningxia, and also an ancient military castle that was easy to defend but difficult to attack. There are currently over 360 relatively complete houses remaining. Diantou Ancient Village has a rich historical and cultural heritage, which is not only a corner of Jin culture, but also a carrier of ancient villages in Jin state. The team behind the movie 'Blood Drops' once filmed in the ancient village of Diantou.

attractions.name: 晋商博物院
attractions.summary: The Jin Shang Museum is a humanistic and historical museum established based on the former site of the Shanxi Governor's Office, a national key cultural relic protection unit. It integrates cultural relics, ancient architecture, garden landscapes, and exhibitions.

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 中国煤炭博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Coal Museum is the only professional museum in China dedicated to the coal industry and is a symbol of science and civilization. Due to its unique function and status, it has been awarded the title of "National First-Class Museum" by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Here, visitors can also view dozens of coal specimens, including long flame coal, poor coal, lignite, and gas coal. The museum's most distinctive feature is the "Coal Amusement Palace." The "Coal Amusement Palace" is a large-scale underground simulated mine, recreated using numerous real-life prototypes or 1:1 replicas. The visitor route spans several hundred meters and is said to be the largest in Asia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduced Underground Simulation Mine

attractions.name: 蒙山大佛
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Historical Ruins; Historical Sites; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
· The Mount Meng Giant Buddha, also known as the West Mountain Giant Buddha, was originally a cliff-side Buddha statue behind the Kaihua Temple on Mount Meng. It was destroyed during the late Yuan Dynasty.
· In 1980, the Mount Meng Giant Buddha was rediscovered. By the time of its discovery, the Buddha's head was missing, and the body was buried in soil and stone, severely weathered.
· The height from the bottom of the legs to the neck is about 30 meters, while the original height was approximately 46 meters. The current Buddha head was carved by later generations.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Thousand-Year-Old Buddha in the suburbs of Taiyuan.
