attractions.name: 木渎古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Mudu Ancient Town, known as the "First Town of Wu" in the Wu region, is famous for its small bridges, flowing water, and ancient trees, offering a unique charm among many other ancient towns.  
· The town is crisscrossed by waterways such as the Muguang River, and its stone embankments create an ancient waterway landscape. The old streets and narrow alleys are home to many traditional courtyards.  
· Inside the Hongyin Mountain Villa, there is a grand stage where Emperor Qianlong watched performances during his six visits to Jiangnan. The villa also displays twenty imperial edicts from the emperor.  
· The town is a food lover's paradise, with the recommended Shijia Restaurant serving its signature dish, Fish Lung Soup, made by simmering fish liver in chicken broth. The fish liver is tender, and the soup is extremely delicious.  
· Local crafts in Mudu include silk, double-sided embroidery, redwood carvings, Chengni inkstones, calligraphy and paintings, and stone carvings, all available for purchase as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to explore the classical gardens.

attractions.name: 盘门
attractions.tag: Historical sites; enjoy autumn leaves; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the only remaining ancient city gate relic in Suzhou and the only water-and-land dual-purpose city gate still in existence in China.
- Built in 514 BC, it was one of the eight city gates of Suzhou built by Wu Zixu, and the present Panmen was rebuilt during the Yuan Dynasty.
- The essence of the Panmen Scenic Area lies in the "Three Scenic Spots of Panmen": the ancient Panmen, Wumen Bridge, and Ruiguang Pagoda.
- To the west of Panmen is the Wuxiang Temple, dedicated to commemorating Wu Zixu, consisting of a hall, corridor pavilion, and garden. The eastern courtyard often hosts performances of Pingtan, a form of traditional storytelling and ballad singing.
attractions.shortFeatures: From a height, overlook the full view of the Water and Land Gate.

attractions.name: 夜游护城河
attractions.summary: Boarding a carved beams and painted rafters cruise ship and marching in the moat, a river of starlight rippled out, like a dream shattered. The Suzhou moat was excavated by Wu Zixu, a minister of the State of Wu during the Spring and Autumn Period, leaving behind rich historical and cultural relics on both sides of the ancient city moat. On one side, the fence of the city wall and plank road shines brightly under the landscape lights, resembling a palace in the sky at night. On the other side, there are ancient residential buildings with pink walls and black tiles in the old city area. Under the night sky, the smoke and willow painted bridges of the ancient city can still be faintly seen, and the ancient charm of the wind curtains and green curtains can be seen. Cruise boats are available all day long, but especially during night tours of the moat, the dazzling lights along the coast reflect on the rippling waves and swaying willow branches, complementing the architecture of the ancient city of Suzhou and blending seamlessly into it. It is intoxicating and allows one to fully appreciate the beauty and delicacy of the millennium old city of Suzhou.

attractions.name: 枫桥景区
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 西安事变旧址五间厅
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity
attractions.summary:
Wujianting is located in Huaqing Pool Scenic Area in Lintong, Xi'an, which is one of the famous sites of Xi'an Incident in history. 
Built in the late Qing Dynasty, it is a brick and wood hall. 
It is adjacent to Lishan Mountain in the south and Lotus Pond in the north. The courtyard is flat and the trees are lush. It is named Five Halls because it is connected by five single rooms.  
On the glass windows and walls of the five halls, there are still bullet marks from the fierce battle between soldiers and remonstrance. 
· Desks, chairs, beds, sofas, tea sets, stoves, carpets, telephones, etc. used in offices in each room are copied and placed as they were originally.
attractions.shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure hall
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:20; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 环园
attractions.summary: Huan Yuan was originally a post office of the Qing Dynasty. In 1936, Huan Yuan was converted into a temporary residence and a plan to suppress the Communist Party was deployed, which triggered the "Xi'an Incident".

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院秦陵铜车马
attractions.name_en: Bronze Chariot and Horse of Qinling
attractions.summary: Copper chariots and horses were discovered 20 meters west of the imperial tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang. These are two large painted bronze chariots and horses, one in front and one behind, placed in a wooden coffin. Although it was crushed by soil when unearthed, there were no major changes in its original position, and the components of the chariot and horse were basically complete. This is a bronze chariot and horse that was discovered early, large in size, and well preserved in the history of archaeology in China. Archaeologists have restored it and it was exhibited to the public in 1983. Copper chariots and horses were one of the burial objects of Emperor Qin Shi Huang, symbolizing a part of his royal carriage. The copper chariot and horse are made by reducing the proportion of half of the real copper chariot and horse. The car cover and the interior and exterior of the carriage are painted with exquisite patterns, and the gold and silver decorations on top weigh up to 14 kilograms. The No.1 copper chariot is a standing chariot, also known as a tall chariot. The carriage is rectangular in shape with a single shaft and two wheels. The doors are located at the back of the carriage, and there is a circular copper umbrella on the carriage. Under the umbrella stands the imperial official, who controls the carriage with both hands and drives four horses in front. The carriage was equipped with weapons such as copper crossbows, copper shields, and copper arrowheads, which played a role in opening roads, guarding, and launching expeditions in the emperor's convoy. The second car is an Anche and also has a single shaft and two wheels. The total weight is 1241 kilograms, assembled from 3462 components of different sizes. The carriage consists of two compartments, one front and one rear, with windows between them. The door for boarding is located at the back and has an oval shaped hood. It is a precious bronze artifact unearthed in China, with complete equipment, high grade, and exquisite craftsmanship.

attractions.name: 兵马俑DIY手工制作体验基地（泥人坊）
attractions.name_en: Bingmayong Diy Shougong Zhizuo Tiyan Base (nirenfang)
attractions.summary: Terra Cotta Warriors DIY Handicraft Experience Base (Clay figurine workshop) is located 300 meters west from the main road in front of the ticket hall of the Terra Cotta Warriors (Qinling North Road) to the south. The front sign: Lintong District Clay figurine workshop handicraft exhibition hall; Convenient transportation, with a medium-sized parking lot in front of the door; The experience hall has a clean and elegant environment, with air conditioning inside, providing warmth in winter and coolness in summer; Provide free WF. We have a team engaged in receiving DIY handmade crafts, and have received countless individual guest groups such as parent-child tours and summer camps, with rich experience in reception; Having a master craftsman who has been engaged in the replication industry for 30 years, teaching hand in hand; We have a professional repair and firing team.

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 骑行古城墙
attractions.summary: Riding a bicycle on the ancient city wall is a great way of sightseeing, and while cycling, you will have a feeling of time travel. At present, there are bicycle rental services available in the east, south, west, and north gates, and bicycles can be returned at any of the above gates after cycling. Full text 

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. Full text 

attractions.name: 京杭大运河杭州景区
attractions.summary: The Grand Canal (Hangzhou section) is the southernmost end of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal. Over thousands of years of history, it has integrated the unique products, cuisine, clothing, customs, and etiquette of various regions in northern and southern China, forming the canal cultural landscape represented by the "Ten Scenic Spots of the Canal". Caofang boats are the "tide" boats of the Hangzhou Grand Canal. Today's Caozao boats integrate historical ship elements of the canal with modern science and technology, and are an important carrier of modern canal tourism. Starting from Wulinmen Pier, taking Caofang boats all the way north can appreciate the unique scenery along the Grand Canal heritage line, such as Jiangqiao Muyu, Xiangji Fanyin, Fuyi Liuyu, Gongchen Yaoyue, and Qiaoxi Renjia. You can experience the slow life of Hangzhou by taking a boat ride. Canal water tourism represented by boats and boats, including canal tours, night tours, ancient town tours, and red transportation tours, is favored by citizens and tourists.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 岳王庙景区
attractions.summary: The Yuewang Temple is located at the northwest corner of West Lake, opposite Quyuan Fenghe, and is a place to commemorate the national hero Yue Fei. The tomb of Yue Fei and his son, as well as the kneeling statue of Qin Hui, who has been kneeling in front of the tomb for thousands of years, and four other treacherous officials, make people's hearts surge. In addition, the exhibition hall also displays historical materials about the life of General Yue Fei, which can reveal his life of being "loyal and devoted to the country". Entering the main entrance of the Yuewang Temple scenic area, there is a square courtyard, with the main building of the Yuewang Temple, the Martyrs' Shrine, directly in front of it. The main hall is dedicated to Yue Fei, and there is a plaque with the four characters "Heart Shines on the Heavenly Sun" hanging on the door, which is very solemn. Entering the main hall, one is greeted by a full body portrait of Yue Fei dressed in military attire, with his oath hanging high above his head, 'Return my country'. The murals on the walls around the main hall record the life of Yue Fei, among which the classic "Mother in law tattooed" is widely circulated. On both sides of the main hall, there are two generals of Yue Fei, Niu Gao and Zhang Xian, enshrined. After visiting the main hall, return to the courtyard, walk west through the stele corridor, cross the Jingzhong Bridge, and arrive at the tomb area. Here, one large and one small are the tombs of Yue Fei and his son Yue Yun. Facing the tomb of Yue is an archway, with a pair of iron statues of treacherous officials kneeling on either side of the door. They face the tomb of Yue Fei, kneeling to plead guilty to him. On the left are Qin Xian and his wife Wang. In the past, people came here not only to admire national heroes, but also to spit in front of these two kneeling statues. Nowadays, spitting is no longer allowed, and there are signs hanging on the wall next to it that read 'Civilized tourism, no spitting'. The entire Yuewang Temple is not large, but the ancient trees are towering. It is not far from the cemetery to return to the main entrance of the Yuewang Temple, and the entire tour time is about one hour. Full text 

attractions.name: 小河直街历史文化街区
attractions.name_en: Xiaohe Straight Street Historical and Cultural Block
attractions.summary:
· Xiaohezhijie Historic District is located at the intersection of Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, Xiaohe and Yuhangtang River. 
Original old houses, rarely renovated, still have many "old Hangzhou" living today, with a strong flavor of life. 
It is recommended to go to Fang Zengchang Sauce Garden, No.15 Xiaohezhi Street, and take a photo with the word "sauce". It is said that it used to be the largest pickle factory in Xiaohe area. 
There are many cafes, tea bars, mahjong shops and noodle shops along the way. Find a small tea shop opened by local residents, and visit the quaint courtyard along the way.

attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
Liangzhu National Heritage Park is located in Liangzhu and Pingyao towns in the northwest suburb of Hangzhou. It is the site of Liangzhu Cultural Center. 135 sites have been found, with a protection area of about 42 square kilometers. It is one of the most important large-scale archaeological sites in China and has outstanding significance in the development of oriental civilization. 
Heritage Park is different from ordinary parks. It is a comprehensive project to protect, utilize, develop and display cultural relics. The park takes Liangzhu Ancient City in Mojiao Mountain as the core, and includes cultural sites such as Fanshan Mountain, Huiguan Mountain, Tangshan Mountain and Yaoshan Mountain. Through the cross-section display and restoration display of the site site, a popular Liangzhu cultural cognitive system combining points, lines and surfaces is formed. According to the original intention of "Beautiful Island" in Liangzhu and the living area in Liangzhu culture period, it has the characteristics of hills, lonely hills, swamp plains with alternating rivers and lakes, and warm and humid subtropical climate. 
Liangzhu National Heritage Park will take the existing new Liangzhu Museum as the axis, and set up an "S"-shaped north-south green belt with a width of about 200 meters from east to west and a length of about 1,100 meters from north to south, as an important gateway and prelude to the heritage park. Visitors can visit Liangzhu Site through two different routes: water and land, or on foot or boating.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the precious cultural relics of Liangzhu period

You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

On the smoky gray wall, the white brick joints are outlined. Therefore, 1912 is definitely a place where photography enthusiasts in Nanjing often create and gather, and it is also an excellent place to take wedding photos.

There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

On the smoky gray wall, the white brick joints are outlined. Therefore, 1912 is definitely a place where photography enthusiasts in Nanjing often create and gather, and it is also an excellent place to take wedding photos.

attractions.tag: Adorable animals; a hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Zoos

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.

Named after the thatched roofs covering the village entrance and the wild charm during the Ming and Qing dynasties, this place is also the starting point of the famous "Shangxiang Ancient Road" and a necessary route for Hangzhou pilgrims to travel from the city to India to offer incense. Rural tourism and wetlands are the key words of Maojiabu. The century old Shangxiang Ancient Road connects West Lake with the villages in this area, making it an ideal destination for tourists to explore the ancient world. Maojiabu is divided into upper and lower parts, separated by Longjing Road in the middle. On the west side of Longjing Road is Shangmaojiabu, where there are more concentrated places for eating and drinking tea; The former residence of Du Jinsheng located in Xiamaojiabu is also worth a visit. The closer way to nature here is to watch birds on the waterfront. There are few tourists on the south bank of Maojiabu, and the reed marshes are dense. The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.

attractions.name: 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社(百年记忆公社)
attractions.name_en: Mission Hills Huayi Brothers Feng Xiaogang Movie Town
attractions.summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

You can also enjoy boating on the Li River and Taohua River, experiencing the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoying the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes allows you to enjoy the scenic views of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, Li River or Taohua River in the city. Visit the core scenic area of Guilin, experience the city's water system comparable to Venice's water city, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with eagles, Yao style, and naked eye 3D light and shadow show of the ancient city wall of Mulong Lake. Highlights and Features: Night tours of one river and four lakes are one of the classic products in our scenic area. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots and famous bridges and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also take a boat tour of the Li River or Taohua River to experience the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoy the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night Tour of Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Four Lakes can enjoy the splendid night scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with fish eagles. Highlights and Features: Night tour of Four Lakes is a premium route for night tours in our scenic area. You can take a boat tour of the core scenic area of Guilin and experience the water system around the city, which is comparable to the water city of Venice. Along the way, you can enjoy many famous scenic spots such as Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, and admire famous bridges and mountains; Watch the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the exquisite performance of half zither falling on the moon, and enjoy the dazzling and colorful scenery of Guilin at night. One day tour of one river and four lakes, boat tour of one river and four lakes, can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, and the inner section of the Lijiang River, and see the famous mountains with different shapes. Highlights and Features: Taking a boat tour around the core of Guilin city, you can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery up close. Along the way, many famous mountains such as Xiangbi Mountain, Fubo Mountain, Diecai Mountain, Qixing Mountain, Baoji Mountain, and Laoren Mountain will be presented in sequence; The various Chinese and foreign famous bridges, as well as the elegant and majestic pagodas and towers, adorn the ancient landscape city, allowing tourists to truly experience the unparalleled charm of Guilin's scenery. There has long been a saying in the local area that 'Yangshuo's scenery is as beautiful as Guilin, and Yangshuo's beauty lies in Xingping'. There are over 20 scenic spots here, including Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection, Monk and Nun Meeting, Chaoban Mountain, and a 20 yuan background picture. Throughout history, the beautiful mountains, rivers, and streams of Xingping have captivated countless ink artists. Along the Xingping Li River, you can also enjoy picturesque scenery such as Xingping Jiajing, Huangbu Reflection, Carp Jumping over Dragon Gate, Chaoban Mountain, Luosi Mountain, and Beautiful Women's Mirrors. Yangdi Xingping Lijiang Bamboo Raft Tour Yangdi section is a must visit project when visiting Yangshuo, Guilin. The beautiful Yangdi is an important part of Guilin tourism and Guilin scenery. The hundred mile Li River, with "one mountain, one water, and one poem title", is like a long scroll of colorful ink landscape with poetry and painting. The Yangdi Tourist Area is about 18 kilometers long and is the golden section of the Li River. Departing from Yangdi Pier on a bamboo raft, heading down the river, the scenery along the way is beautiful, including the picturesque Nine Horse Painting Mountain and the reflection of yellow cloth. This section of the river is winding and twisting, with clear waters lingering and numerous scenic spots. The peaks reflect the scenery, and the bamboo and wood are lush.

attractions.name_en: Solitary Beauty Peak Prince City Scenic Area
attractions.summary: The Duxiu Peak Wangcheng Scenic Area can be traced back to over 600 years ago during the Hongwu period of the Ming Dynasty. It was once a fiefdom city built by Zhu Yuanzhang for his nephew Zhu Shouqian. Today, it is a national 5A level scenic spot in Guilin, and Duxiu Peak is its iconic attraction. The natural landscape and historical and cultural landscapes in the scenic area complement each other, making it a "city within a city's scenery" and a carrier of Guilin, a world-renowned historical and cultural city of mountains and waters. The famous saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world" originated from the stone wall of Duxiu Peak. It covers the three major historical and cultural systems of Guilin and is a typical representative of Guilin's history and culture. Walking into the scenic area is like entering the gate of Guilin's history and culture. Therefore, the famous saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world, and after reading all the royal cities, one knows Guilin" has been widely spread by the world. As early as the Southern and Northern Dynasties, the great literary scholar Yan Yanzhi began to write and recite poetry at the foot of Duxiu Peak, which opened up the literary style in the Lingnan region. During the Tang Dynasty, the first official university in Guangxi's history was established here. During the Song Dynasty, Wang Zhenggong engraved the timeless famous line "Guilin's landscape is the best in the world" on Duxiu Peak, which has become a representative advertising slogan for Guilin. During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang's military advisor Liu Bowen was interested in the wind and water treasure land of Duxiu Peak, and later built the Jingjiang Palace. In the Qing Dynasty, the Jingjiang Palace was converted into the Guangxi Gongyuan, becoming a large imperial examination center in the southwest region. A total of 585 successful candidates and 4 top scorers emerged, with one top scorer being the "Three Yuan Ji". During the Republic of China period, Sun Yat sen launched the Northern Expedition and established the Jingjiang Palace as the main base for the expedition. In 1954, Guangxi Normal University moved in. Duxiu Peak · Wangcheng is not only a place of outstanding people and land, but also the political, economic, and cultural center of Guangxi throughout history. Duxiu Peak is located in the center of Guilin city. It stands tall and rises from the ground, making it the top of all the mountains in Guilin and the king of all the mountains. Climbing to the summit, one can overlook the entire city of Guilin, with a majestic atmosphere of "overlooking all the mountains", and is known as the "pillar of the southern sky". As early as the Southern Dynasties period, the great literary scholar Yan Yanzhi wrote a poem titled "Not as outstanding as the Duxiu Peak, between the E and E towns" to describe the magnificent momentum of Duxiu Peak. Jingjiang Wangfu is a well preserved site of feudal lords in China and a core tourist attraction within the Duxiu Peak Wangcheng Scenic Area. The Jingjiang Wangfu Museum, also known as the "Carrier Hall," was the place where ancient princes handled government affairs. Nowadays, the museum displays the history of Jingjiang Wangfu and the entire Guilin. Visitors can gain a deeper understanding through high-tech full range projection and 3D projection, and also experience ancient printing techniques firsthand at the "Wangfu Tuofang". On the cliff of Duxiu Peak, there are about 200 cliff carvings, all of which have been preserved throughout the ages. The famous ancient saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world" comes from here. A large number of precious Buddha statues and Tai Sui stone carvings, as well as the Five Blessings series that was featured in the 2017 CCTV Spring Festival Gala, all come from the cliff carvings of Duxiu Peak and are now national key protected cultural relics. The Royal Palace Secret Topography has a history of over a hundred years and is a colorful wind water rubbing technique developed by the third generation Prince Jingjiang Zhu Zuojing. It has now been listed as an intangible cultural heritage. Tourists can experience ancient printing techniques here and learn how to make secret rubbings for the royal palace, which has important value for the inheritance and development of Chinese history, culture, and folk art.
