attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州丝绸博物馆
attractions.summary: The theme of the silk museum building is "Silk Road". Suzhou is not only a city of gardens, but also a house of silk. Grasp the historic connection between the ancient Silk Road and the modern Silk City, and reflect the open consciousness of cultural exchanges between the East and the West. The overall color is mainly white, reflecting the true color of silk. The wall makes a natural twist at the population, symbolizing the softness and elegance of silk. A row of variant mulberry trees stands upright on the top of the wall, and the middle is circular and hollow, just like an ancient city wall on the Silk Road. The front of the wall is decorated with three white marble statues: mulberry-picking girl, alkane-yarn girl and silk-weaving girl. In the gate square, you can see an east-west passage symbolizing the "Silk Road", which intersects with the fully enclosed modern white wall running through the north and south of the main building.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a children's silk science museum

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 山塘昆曲馆
attractions.summary: Located on Shantang Street, the environment is quaint and the lighting treatment is good. During different bridge segments, projection screens are placed to explain some of the history of Kunqu Opera, giving people a dreamlike feeling, as if they were in a different world. The Shantang Kunqu Opera Hall performs classic Kunqu opera excerpts every day, sometimes interspersed with traditional and modern programs rich in Suzhou style such as Suzhou Pingtan, Guzheng performance, and comedy.

attractions.name: 华谊兄弟电影世界
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Film and TV base; Theme Parks; Film Studios
attractions.summary:
Huayi Brothers Film World is the first world-class film cultural experience project in China with the theme of self-sustaining film intellectual property rights. It is located in Yangcheng Lake Peninsula National Tourist Resort. The project covers an area of 460,000 square meters, with a total investment of 2 billion yuan. 
Huayi Brothers Movie World is based on seven classic Huayi Brothers movies, and has created five theme areas: Avenue of Stars District, If You Are the One District, Assembly District, Tongtian Empire District and Taiji District. In each area, you can watch movies, play movies and walk into movies: in the Avenue of Stars area with "the first movie children's professional experience hall in the whole park", you can Do not forget your initiative mind and realize your star dream; In the 50-meter-high bungee jumping event in If You Are the One area, you can jump and express your unswerving love; In the assembly area with "the world's first VR-Ride project", the iron-blooded military soul and the customs of the Republic of China will surely touch your heart; In Taiji District, the first movie-themed live show in China, "Weird Coffee Breaks through the Sky", restores the mobile prop "Troy" in the movie one to one, bringing you unprecedented audio-visual shock; In the "Swallow Building" in Tongtian Empire District, you can not only taste the tail-burning banquet in the prosperous times of the Tang Dynasty, but also see the beauty of the oiran.
attractions.shortFeatures: Immersive cinematic world

attractions.name: 重元寺
attractions.summary:
Chongyuan Temple was built in the second year of Tianjian (AD 503) during Liang Wudi's reign in the Southern and Northern Dynasties, only one year apart from Hanshan Temple built at the same time, and now it has a history of 1504 years. 
As a Buddhist place of Zen Buddhism, Chongyuan Temple in history is at its peak. The rebuilt Chongyuan Temple is located in the beautiful Yangcheng Lake Peninsula. Its bigger feature is the 33-meter-high Guanyin icon in the Guanyin Courtyard on the water, which is a landscape that reflects the unique features of the Lotus Buddha Country and Guanyin Dojo in Chongyuan Temple. 
The buildings of the temple include Mountain Gate, Bell and Drum Tower, Daxiong Hall, etc. With a building area of 2,100 square meters, Daxiong Hall is a larger single building among domestic temples. On Guanyin Island in front of the temple, there is a 33-meter-high main statue of Guanyin, which is currently the largest indoor statue in China. 
Yangcheng Lake overlooks Chongyuan Temple, the magnificent Daxiong Hall is magnificent, and the Guanyin Pavilion with cornices and corners is magnificent. In addition, the main building of the temple is advanced layer by layer, the Guanyin statue, the leather drum with copper cavity, the Guanyin wall on the island and the bronze bell, etc., which can be called a giant masterpiece in China, reproduce the elegance of Chongyuan Temple in those days.
attractions.shortFeatures: The huge statue of Guanyin is enshrined indoors

attractions.name: 葑门横街
attractions.summary: This street is the main street outside Fengmen Gate, with a Guoji Town style urban and rural trade center attached to Fengmen Gate. The majority of the buildings on the street still retain the style of the early Qing and late Ming dynasties' Zhenhe households.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 枫桥景区
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 斗南花卉市场
attractions.summary: The Dounan Flower Market is located in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China. It is the largest fresh cut flower trading market in Asia and also the largest flower distribution center in China. There are a large number of flower trades here every day, with a wide variety and affordable prices, attracting numerous tourists and flower enthusiasts to visit and purchase.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 大观公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for walking with kids; Lakes; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Daguan Park is located on the north side of Dianchi Lake. It is a beautiful park with lush greenery and elegant pavilions, featuring scenic areas like near Huapu and Daguan Tower, as well as Lou Wai Lou.  
· Built by the water, Daguan Park features a lakeside dam, lotus ponds, and exquisite pavilions and towers, all arranged with great elegance.  
· The Daguan Tower, built during the Kangxi period, offers views of the Western Hills and Dianchi Lake, and was once considered one of the top ten ancient towers in China.  
· During festivals, the park often holds garden parties and sometimes hosts traditional lantern festivals, attracting a steady stream of visitors and creating a lively atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: A beautiful park on the northern shore of Dianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 云南大学
attractions.summary: Yunnan University is located in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China and is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history. The campus is shaded by green trees and has a unique architectural style that combines elements of both Eastern and Western architecture. It is a famous cultural attraction in Kunming city.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

restaurants.name_en: Charcoal Shed Charcoal Fire Drying Pot
Grey Wolf roast leg of lamb
Cloud travel lake Chongqing old hot pot

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 春熙路
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jinhua Pavilion is located in the hinterland of Chunxi Road, a small street less than 50 meters long. It was newly built after the renovation of Chunxi Road in recent years, connecting Kejia Lane in Chunxi. Because of the architectural style of the Republic of China, this small street presents a different style, quiet and romantic in the downtown area, and then it has become an outdoor shooting place for many photographers, and even a location place for some photo studios to take photos. 
Chengdu Jinhua Pavilion was built in 1914, located between Zhengkejia Lane and Chunxi Road, but people are used to directly calling it Jinhua Pavilion on Chunxi Road, Chengdu. Sichuan has been a place with extremely developed sericulture since ancient times. Shu embroidery and Shu brocade are famous all over the world, and Chengdu is also known as Jinguan City. Jinhua Pavilion is named for it, which means "prosperity and brocade".
attractions.shortFeatures: Representative bustling commercial street in Chengdu

attractions.name: 金沙遗址博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploration Exhibition Hall; Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
- The Jinsha Site is a relic from the Shang and Zhou Dynasties, with the densest collection of ivory and the richest number of gold and jade artifacts from the same period in the world.
- The most famous item is the "Sun Bird" gold foil in the fourth exhibition hall, which has been designated as the symbol of Chinese cultural heritage and the main logo of Chengdu's city image.
- Here, visitors can pay to enjoy the 4D movie "Dream Back to Jinsha."
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the mysterious Sun God Bird.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 宽窄巷子
attractions.summary: Kuanzhai Alley is the only ancient street left over from the Qing Dynasty in Chengdu, consisting of three parallel old urban streets - Kuanzhai Alley, Kuanzhai Alley, and Jingzhai Alley, as well as a courtyard community between them. Come here, drink tea, eat hotpot, and experience the leisurely, slow, and new life of Chengdu. You can order a cup of Mengshan Huangya here and set up a dragon gate formation with the old man next to you; You can also call yourself 'Shu'er Lang' and enjoy the pleasure of digging your ears comfortably; You can also enjoy a wide variety of snacks at the snack stall. The Kuanzhai Alley under the night sky also has its own charm. Bars such as Dianzui, Baiye, and Huli are full of Chengdu's fashion sense, blooming its charm at night. Full text 

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞重逢1980街区
attractions.summary: Hongyadong Reunion 1980 Block is located on the fifth floor of Hongyadong, with the theme of "Old City · Story, Chongqing · Reunion". It revolves around the urban atmosphere and old alley scene culture of Chongqing, and authentically reproduces the various forms of the urban life in the 1980s and 1990s. The film level setting level allows people to "travel back to the 1980s and 1990s in one second" - retro scenes such as the No. 5 tram, Mountain City Wide Screen Cinema, Ba Ba Tea, Disco Square, etc. are reproduced, and there are also interactions with intangible cultural heritage craftsmen, vintage dance troupes, arcade games, internet celebrity performances, etc. The Mountain City Wide Screen Cinema in the neighborhood also features a holographic MR interactive music show called "Searching for Teresa Teng", which allows for naked eye 3D viewing of Teresa Teng "personally" singing classic songs.

attractions.name: 探索舱·云端乐园
attractions.summary: The Exploration Cabin Cloud Park is located on the side of the Jialing River in the Crystal Corridor, dedicated to creating an urban high-altitude amusement park. It includes a unique viewing experience: a sky view above 250 meters (an open-air fully transparent glass platform) with a 270 ° panoramic view, surrounded by clouds, mist, and green plants, overlooking the confluence of the two rivers and the mountain city landscape, and experiencing the magical 8D style of Chongqing. Thrilling high-altitude experience: The suspended walkway built on the back of the crystal corridor - Cloud Walk, walking on the first horizontal skyscraper in China, removing the obstruction of transparent glass, and intimately contacting the top of the city. It is not only a 360 ° panoramic visual feast, but also a game for brave people. High altitude river view swing: Cloud leap as an urban high-altitude river view swing, with double riding as the highlight of the experience, at the top of the city's clouds, feel the excitement of heartbeat. When soaring across the sky, you can also enjoy the scenery of the two rivers and four banks of the mountain city from afar, and join hands with your beloved Ta to create a romantic arc in the clouds. In the future, Discovery Cabin Cloud Park will continue to introduce comprehensive and innovative high-altitude play experience projects, creating a unique high-altitude amusement park in Southwest China, continuously leading diversified new tourism consumption trends, and further consolidating the project positioning as a cultural and tourism landmark in Southwest China.

attractions.name: 解放碑步行街
attractions.summary: Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street is a more prosperous business circle in Chongqing, where there are many department stores and hotels. It is a good place for shopping, eating and strolling. It is also a good place for visiting Chongqing beauties. The pedestrian street is located in Yuzhong District, centered on Monument to the people's Liberation, including Minquan Road, Zourong Road and Bayi Road. There are many food, shopping, and beauty shopping malls, as well as a variety of snacks and beautiful women, making it the "three highs" of a pedestrian street. You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. There are also scenic spots near the pedestrian street, such as Nengren Temple and Arhat Temple. Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street and its surrounding areas are also one of the main choices for tourists to stay in Chongqing. There are intercontinental hotels and economical hotels with high cost performance. Full text 

attractions.name: 梵高星空艺术馆
attractions.name_en: Van Gogh Starry Sky Art Museum
attractions.tag: Exploring exhibition halls; A treasure trove for strolling children; Performances and Exhibitions
attractions.summary: The Van Gogh Starry Sky Art Museum is an immersive experience museum with Van Gogh's art works as its theme. Through high-tech means, it presents Van Gogh's classic paintings in a new form to the audience, making visitors feel as if they are in Van Gogh's art world.
attractions.shortFeatures: Using technological means to showcase world-renowned paintings

attractions.name: 罗汉寺
attractions.summary:
Founded in the Northern Song Dynasty, it is named after 500 Luohan statues in the temple. It is said that Luohan Temple is very effective and its incense has always been very prosperous. 
When you enter the temple gate, you can see the ancient Buddha rock about 20 meters long. There are hundreds of Buddha statues carved in Moyan stone in Song Dynasty, with different shapes and vivid shapes. 
There is also a large wishing lamp at the back door. Even if you don't enter, you can stop and look at the exquisite woodcarving at the door. 
Since the filming of the movie Crazy Stone, it has become a must-see place for tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: Filming location of "Crazy Stone"

attractions.name: 重庆好吃街夜市
attractions.summary: Chongqing Delicious Street is a street of food culture. In Southwest Mandarin, the word "good" in "delicious" is pronounced as four sounds, meaning "greedy". "Delicious" means "greedy". Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 朝天门广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the "Top Ten Cultural Symbols of Chongqing", it is located at the intersection of Jialing River and Yangtze River in Yuzhong Peninsula, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the hub of the two rivers and the largest waterway passenger terminal in Chongqing. 
· Chaotianmen was once one of the seventeen ancient city gates in Chongqing, where the Three Gorges cruise ships, sightseeing cruise ships and ferries to Foreigner Street all departed.  
The night view of Chaotianmen is also very beautiful. The lights are turned on at night, which is particularly beautiful. In front of you is the brightly lit pier, and there are flowery cruise ships shuttling around. 
· And this is also the "zero kilometer" point sign of Chongqing Highway, which will be located in Chaotianmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient Wharf in Chongqing

attractions.name: 长江索道
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly hidden gems; cable car and gondola; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The second cable car across the Yangtze River in Chongqing, known as the "First Aerial Corridor of the Yangtze River" and the "Sky Bus of the Mountain City."
- The cabin is surrounded by transparent glass, offering a panoramic view of the natural scenery on both banks during the day, and a spectacular sight of dazzling lights at night.
- A filming location for several films and TV shows, including "Crazy Stone" and "A Bite of China."
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the beautiful cityscape of the mountain city across the Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 重庆两江游
attractions.summary: Without admiring the night view, I haven't been to Chongqing. The Two Rivers Tour of Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous night view of Chongqing. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. The colorful lights reflect in the river, and the flowing lights are particularly tempting. The buildings of different heights along the river are arranged in a staggered manner under the illumination of the lights. And now there are also daytime boat trips available, where you can not only enjoy the night view of Chongqing, but also admire the unique landmarks of Chongqing during the day. Full text 

attractions.name: 南山一棵树观景台
attractions.summary: The Nanshan Tree Observation Deck is located on Nanshan Mountain in Nan'an District, Chongqing. It includes a tree observation pavilion and a wilderness leisure area, and can accommodate thousands of people at the same time. It is one of the places to enjoy the night view of the mountain city. Standing on the observation deck, looking from afar, the lights of thousands of households in Yuzhong District, Chongqing; Surrounded by two rivers, shining brightly; A long bridge spanning over, with a clear outline; The entire city, layered and arranged in a staggered and colorful manner, is magnificent and dazzling against the backdrop of the night sky.

attractions.name: 磁器口古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town

attractions.name: 白公馆
attractions.summary:
· Bai Mansion, formerly known as Xiangshan Villa, was originally the villa of warlord Bai Ju, and later converted into a Kuomintang prison, a two-story building.  
This is the place where the story of Little Carrot Head took place. It once held the Communist Party, and it was also the place where many martyrs died. Its historical significance is much greater than that of scenic spots. 
Divided into two lanes, left and right, you need to climb the ladder, and visit Xiangshan Villa on the left side, which is actually the place where "political prisoners" are held; Climb the mountain on the right side to visit the place where Yang Hucheng died and the place where Little Carrot Head was killed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Prototype Place of the Novel Red Rock

attractions.name: 渣滓洞
attractions.summary:
· Originally a coal cave on the outskirts of Chongqing, a small coal mine opened in 1920, and later set up as a detention center by the Military Bureau of the National Government. 
Zhazidong is surrounded by mountains on three sides and ditches on one side. The terrain is hidden, and it specializes in detaining and persecuting revolutionaries. The more famous one is "Sister Jiang". 
Zhazi Cave was repaired and rebuilt on the original site, which truly reflected the scene at that time. The atmosphere was depressed, and the instruments of torture displayed were shocking.  
The whole scenic spot is not big, so you can visit the Tomb of the Martyrs and the White Mansion together. There are also special buses arranged in the scenic spot, which is very convenient.

attractions.name: 重庆融创海世界
attractions.summary: Chongqing Rongchuang Sea World is a comprehensive marine amusement park that integrates large-scale performances, amusement equipment, animal and fish displays, with a total construction area of 46000 square meters. Its indoor dolphin theater can accommodate 1500 tourists to watch performances at the same time. Two distinctive themed areas+fun research and popular science, taking you on a wonderful journey of ocean exploration. Multiple exciting performances, bringing you the chance to meet, stimulate, laugh, or heal in the ocean of cute pets. Rongchuang Sea World consists of two main theme areas: ocean circumnavigation and tropical rainforest. It extracts and blends elements of island scenery and rainforest flora and fauna, and presents them in exaggerated and unique shapes to create a strong and lively amusement atmosphere. Featuring multiple indoor amusement projects, large-scale animal performances, over 400 species of aquatic creatures, and hundreds of cute pet animal displays, the ocean circumnavigation area is designed to create a circular underwater sunken ship tunnel, allowing for close observation of playful beluga whales, intelligent dolphins, dreamy jellyfish groups, and a variety of colorful marine fish; Interactive with mermaids across the screen, as well as unique experiences such as diving and themed overnight stays, and exciting performances of marine animals. In addition, for research purposes, the Jellyfish Breeding Laboratory and Life Support Backyard area are also open for visitors to visit. Bring a wonderful and unforgettable underwater journey suitable for family outings. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 观音桥步行街
attractions.summary: Guanyinqiao Pedestrian Street is located in Jiangbei District, Chongqing and is one of the famous commercial districts in Chongqing. There are numerous department stores such as New World Department Store, New Century Department Store, and Da Rong City in the business district. Coming here, not only can you satisfy your shopping desires, but there are also many restaurants and shops for you to choose from. Nowadays, it is also one of the eight new landmarks in Chongqing and one of the ten famous commercial pedestrian streets in China.

restaurants.name_en: Fatty Bamboo House's first chicken offal Mao Xuewang

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.summary: The three star cruise ship on the Li River is comfortable, beautiful, hygienic, safe, energy-saving and environmentally friendly, making people feel comfortable and warm. Different boats have different styles, with soft sofas made of fabric or leather that are comfortable, soft, and elegant; Traditional hollowed out grid patterned Chinese rosewood, with an antique charm. Not only that, the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. are decorated with high standard materials, and the new arrangement of curtains and tablecloths creates a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. Full text 

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
