attractions.name: 老君山景区
attractions.summary: According to legend, Laojun Mountain Scenic Area is the place where the founder of Taoism, Li Er (Laozi), retired and practiced. During the Northern Wei Dynasty, a temple was built in the mountain to commemorate him, and later it was honored as a "famous mountain in the world". It has always been a place of strong incense. The trees in the mountains are lush, the scenery is picturesque, and mountain springs can be seen everywhere. In the golden autumn, this is the best choice for surrounding areas to enjoy the red leaves. After the rain, Laojun Mountain is surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland in the sky. The scenic area is vast, mainly divided into the central Laojun Mountain main scenic area, the Dream Chasing Valley scenic area in the west, and the Zhaigou scenic area in the east. Generally, tourists spend a day exploring the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, which is also a well-developed region of the entire scenic area. If you go to the mountaintop, there is still a chance to enjoy the beautiful sea of clouds, sunrise, and sunset. The main scenic area of Laojun Mountain includes major attractions such as Zhongtianmen, Jinding, Laojun Temple, Nantianmen, Yuhuangding, and Mazongling. Since its establishment in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Laojun Temple has been the center of worship for pilgrims from the Central Plains; The Taoist temple at the Jade Emperor's Peak enshrines the Jade Emperor, which is also a great place for mountain viewing; Jinding and Mazongling are great places to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds. Recommended itinerary: A one-day tour to explore the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain is the choice of most tourists. Roughly speaking, the route is as follows: Lingguan Hall - Laojun Statue at the foot of the mountain - Linqi Hall - Zhongtian Gate - Linyin Trail - Woyun Pine - Bodhisattva Hall - Laojun Temple, Jinding - Yuhuangding, and then return to the original route. Tourists can choose to visit Laojun Mountain on foot or by "walking+cableway" depending on their own situation. Between the Lingguan Hall at the foot of the mountain and the Zhongtian Gate on the mountainside, there is the Zhongling Cableway in the scenic area. Take the Zhongling Cableway and then walk from Zhongtianmen to the Jade Emperor Peak at the top of the mountain. The road from Zhongtianmen to the top is not very steep and usually takes about an hour to complete. If you have plenty of time, you can spend two days exploring Laojun Mountain. The approximate itinerary is as follows: D1： Visit the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain and stay overnight in the mountains. D2： From the top of Laojun Mountain, choose to descend from the Dream Chasing Valley in the west or the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, and reach the west and east gates of the scenic area respectively. In the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, accommodation is available near Zhongtianmen on the mountainside and Laojun Temple on the mountaintop. There are hotels near Zhongtianmen with good accommodation conditions, while the accommodation conditions around Laojun Temple are relatively poor. If you are planning to go to the mountaintop the next morning to watch the sunrise, then you can stay around the Laojun Temple. Compared to the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, the mountain roads in Chasing Dreams Valley are smoother, and tourists can choose one of them to descend according to their preferences. There are multiple places in the entire scenic area that can provide catering services for tourists, but some road signs in the scenic area are not yet very complete, so tourists need to pay more attention when playing. Full text 

attractions.name: 中天门广场
attractions.summary: The square is located in Luanchuan County, Luoyang City. At the entrance of the square, there is a mountain gate with the words "Jingshi" written on it. Surrounded by mountains and streams, the scenery is beautiful.

attractions.name: 十里画屏
attractions.summary: The Ten Mile Painted Screen is located within the Laojun Mountain Scenic Area in Luanchuan County, Luoyang City. Here, there are both the hardness of mountain peaks and the softness of clouds and mist, which are breathtaking and unforgettable. It is one of the famous landscapes of Laojun Mountain. The ten mile long cloud crossing plank road within Laojun Mountain is a picturesque scenery, hence it is called the Ten Mile Painted Screen. Looking around, the entire mountain is covered in green and red, magnificent and spectacular. Walking in the middle, step by step, the scenery is picturesque, making people mesmerized.

attractions.name: 金顶道观群
attractions.summary: The Jinding Taoist Temple is located in the Laojun Mountain Scenic Area of Luanchuan County, Luoyang City, at the top of towering peaks. Under the sunlight, the Taoist temple group reflects dazzling golden light, like a dream or a fairyland. The Jinding Taoist Temple complex includes two Jinding temples, one Jinding hall, as well as buildings such as the Daode Mansion and the Bell and Drum Towers. Among them, there is a cloud bridge connecting the larger Wumu Golden Hall and the majestic Daode Mansion, making it easy to visit.

attractions.name: 重渡沟风景区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Waterfalls; Forests; Rafting
attractions.summary:
- The title bestowed by Emperor Guangwu of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Liu Xiu, combined with mysterious historical legends and the three unique features of the scenic area, makes Chongdugou famous throughout China.
- It boasts layers upon layers of bamboo forests, with springs visible everywhere, flowing clear spring water that gathers into gentle rivers and waterfalls cascading down.
- Comprising multiple scenic spots, it is an ideal summer retreat, where visitors can enjoy beautiful views and experience local customs and traditions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Kilometer-long Bamboo Forest Corridor景观

attractions.name: 洛阳伏牛山滑雪场
attractions.name_en: Luoyang Funiushan Ski Resort Cool Season
attractions.summary: Luoyang Funiu Mountain Qingliangjie is an expansion park of Funiu Mountain Ski Resort. The vast expanse of alpine meadows, the clear and mirror like clusters of alpine lakes, the lush green peaks and ridges covered in pine trees, and the European style buildings adorned with vermilion and black tiles depict a Nordic style. There are many entertainment projects in the park, such as forest oxygen bar, cliff swing, jungle crossing, high-altitude zip line, Dutch windmill, bouncing clouds, colorful slides, parent-child amusement park, swing park, small train park, etc., which make people linger and forget to leave. Professional campsites such as tent campsites, target and slingshot shooting training camps, and expansion training camps provide visitors with numerous sports experiences; Funiu Mountain has a cool and pleasant climate, beautiful scenery, and enchanting scenery. It has become the preferred choice for holiday walks, camping, outdoor vacations, and sports and health preservation. The Qingliangjie Mountain Sports Competition Base in Funiu Mountain has utilized the unique sub plateau climate conditions at a golden altitude of 1500 meters to create facilities such as a dry snow summer training jumping platform group, a football training field, a large air film hall, a physical training hall, athlete apartments, and a dry snow service center. We mainly undertake competitive training projects such as football, basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, weightlifting, wrestling, athletics, fencing, skiing, etc., providing comprehensive and fully enclosed competitive training services for training teams. Several provincial skiing teams have trained here from 2021 to 2023 and have given high praise to the venue environment. From July to August this year, we hosted the youth men's and women's football competitions at the 14th Henan Provincial Games. The implementation of this project provides a demonstration effect for the integration of industry and education, truly achieving a high degree of integration between the tourism and vacation industry and the sports industry. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 白马寺
attractions.summary:
- The first temple built by the government after Buddhism was introduced to China, it is known as the "First Ancient Temple of China."
- The existing relics at the White Horse Temple date back to the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, and are all aligned along the north-south central axis.
- The Mahavira Hall is the main hall of the entire temple, with other major buildings including the Hall of Heavenly Kings, the Great Buddha Hall, and the Pilu Pavilion.
- The temple preserves a large number of rare Yuan dynasty sculptures, including statues of the Three Buddhas, the Two Heavenly Generals, and the Eighteen Arhats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Ancestral Grounds of Chinese Buddhism and the Tomb of Di Renjie

attractions.name: 白马寺国际佛殿苑
attractions.name_en: White Horse Temple International Buddha Hall Garden
attractions.summary: The Bai Ma Temple International Buddhist Hall Garden is located inside the Bai Ma Temple in Luoyang City. Walking into the garden, you will see a Buddhist hall full of exotic elements. This garden was built in the early 1990s and incorporates the architectural style of Thai temples, making it very exotic.

attractions.name: 狄仁杰墓
attractions.summary: Di Renjie's tomb is a round mound. There are two stone tablets in front of the tomb, and the larger stone is written with the words "There is Tang Zhongchen Diliang Cemetery", which was re-established in the 21st year of Wanli in Ming Dynasty (1593). The two monuments are arranged horizontally from east to west, about 5 meters apart; All of them are skillful and vigorous in the first carving skills of the coiled tablet of Six Kuilong; The class bucket fell down and buried deep in the soil. One to the east, one to the west.
attractions.shortFeatures: Di Gong's suspicious tomb next to White Horse Temple

attractions.name: 齐云塔
attractions.summary: Qiyun Pagoda was originally called Sakyamuni Stupa Pagoda, Jinfang Pagoda and White Horse Temple Pagoda. It was built in the Yongping period of the Eastern Han Dynasty and rebuilt in the Jin Dynasty. Qiyun Pagoda is the earliest existing ancient building in Luoyang, and it is also one of the few architectural remains of Jin Dynasty in the Central Plains. The shape of the tower has the characteristics of pavilion-style tower with dense eaves in Tang and Song Dynasties, and it adopts the method of imitation wood structure, which provides a rare physical example for studying the architectural characteristics of Jin Dynasty, especially the structural characteristics of brick towers in Jin Dynasty in Central Plains. From the shape and internal structure of the tower, the tower has high historical, scientific and artistic value. In 1961, the State Council announced Baima Temple and Qiyun Pagoda as national key cultural relics protection units.

attractions.name: 丽景门景区
attractions.tag: Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Without arriving at Lijingmen, one would be wasting their time in Luoyang City. Lijingmen was first built in the Sui Dynasty and is the western gate of the ancient city of Luoyang, known as the "first gate of the ancient capital". The current Lijingmen Scenic Area was rebuilt on the original site of the Luoyang Municipal Government, consisting of parts such as the City Gate Tower, Wengcheng, Arrow Tower, City Wall, Lijingqiao, and moat. It is also the location of Luoyang Old Street. Tourists can come here to climb up and enjoy the scenery, taste local snacks, and learn about the ancient Heluo culture. New Year Bell ringing Activity: Every year on the occasion of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Lijingmen City Tower holds the "Welcoming the New Year at midnight Bell" activity. Tourists can personally climb up to the city and ring the 108 bells symbolizing the prosperity, auspiciousness, peace, and happiness of the new year, echoing the sound of the Ma Temple bell from afar.

attractions.name: 洛阳博物馆
attractions.summary:
Luoyang Museum echoes the landmark buildings of the city such as the Pearl TV Tower of the Central Plains. The shape of the new museum is like a big tripod, which means "Dingding Luoyi". 
· The museum consists of a main building and an auxiliary building. The main building has two floors. The first floor is a general exhibition, and the second floor is a boutique exhibition of the museum. 
· There are more than 11,000 pieces of cultural relics on display in the new museum. Besides the local unearthed cultural relics, it also accepted a number of treasures allocated by the Palace Museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate Rare Treasures and Taste Luoyang Ancient Capital Culture

attractions.name: 良渚古城遗址公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
Liangzhu National Heritage Park is located in Liangzhu and Pingyao towns in the northwest suburb of Hangzhou. It is the site of Liangzhu Cultural Center. 135 sites have been found, with a protection area of about 42 square kilometers. It is one of the most important large-scale archaeological sites in China and has outstanding significance in the development of oriental civilization. 
Heritage Park is different from ordinary parks. It is a comprehensive project to protect, utilize, develop and display cultural relics. The park takes Liangzhu Ancient City in Mojiao Mountain as the core, and includes cultural sites such as Fanshan Mountain, Huiguan Mountain, Tangshan Mountain and Yaoshan Mountain. Through the cross-section display and restoration display of the site site, a popular Liangzhu cultural cognitive system combining points, lines and surfaces is formed. According to the original intention of "Beautiful Island" in Liangzhu and the living area in Liangzhu culture period, it has the characteristics of hills, lonely hills, swamp plains with alternating rivers and lakes, and warm and humid subtropical climate. 
Liangzhu National Heritage Park will take the existing new Liangzhu Museum as the axis, and set up an "S"-shaped north-south green belt with a width of about 200 meters from east to west and a length of about 1,100 meters from north to south, as an important gateway and prelude to the heritage park. Visitors can visit Liangzhu Site through two different routes: water and land, or on foot or boating.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the precious cultural relics of Liangzhu period

attractions.name: 良渚文化村
attractions.summary:
· This is an idyllic town owned by Vanke, featuring the "Garden City" brand. Although we can't afford a house, we can visit it. 
· Self-sufficient in everything in this village. There is Meilizhou Church, an all-wooden church designed by Japan's Tsujima Xiaosheng Architecture Office, and Liangzhu Museum, which tells the story of the rise of the dawn of Chinese civilization more than 5,000 years ago. There are also kindergartens, Fengqing Street and forest parks. 
· Yu Qiuyu commented on it, saying, "I have never seen a cultural site so beautiful, with such abundant water and plants, and such a matching pavilion. Generally, cultural sites always show us the reasons why people leave-because they are really unsuitable for life. It could be a sudden climate change, it could be war, causing a break in dwelling on cultural sites. But what I saw of Liangzhu was a place to perch. ”
attractions.shortFeatures: International cultural tourism village

attractions.name: 良渚博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids
attractions.summary:
The Liangzhu Museum is located in Liangzhu Town, Yuhang District. The Liangzhu site and surrounding areas have yielded a large number of exquisite jade artifacts dating back 4,000 to 5,000 years. At the museum, visitors can not only view these artifacts up close but also engage in various interactive experiences to learn about the past and present of the Liangzhu culture. It's also a great place to bring children for an educational and fun experience.

The museum's architecture is an artwork in itself, designed by British architect David Chipperfield. The building is inspired by the image of a "jade cone scattered on the ground" and represents contemporary architectural design. Inside the museum, there are three main exhibition halls: Seeking Truth, the Liangzhu Kingdom, and Liangzhu Civilization. These are interspersed with three open-air courtyards in a skylight style, decorated with representative elements of Liangzhu culture. Moving through this architectural space is truly an enjoyment in itself.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate exquisite jade artifacts and experience Liangzhu culture.

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 杭州植物园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn flowers; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
Hangzhou Botanical Garden, located in the northwest of the West Lake, has nine exhibition areas and four experimental areas, including economic plants, ornamental plants, trees and landscape gardens. 
The Botanical Garden has scenery to see in all seasons, and the most worth seeing is the plum exploration in Lingfeng. A large-scale flower show will be held here in early spring every year. 
More than 1,000 kinds of medicinal plants, including "Zhejiang Eight Flavors", are planted in Baicao Garden, which is highly popular in science. 
· The spring pool in Yuquan is full of fat herring and red and yellow carp, which is a good place to have a nap and wins the favor of children.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to go for an outing
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 07:00-17:30,Opens at Standard time 07:00-17:00

attractions.name: 小河直街历史文化街区
attractions.name_en: Xiaohe Straight Street Historical and Cultural Block
attractions.summary:
· Xiaohezhijie Historic District is located at the intersection of Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, Xiaohe and Yuhangtang River. 
Original old houses, rarely renovated, still have many "old Hangzhou" living today, with a strong flavor of life. 
It is recommended to go to Fang Zengchang Sauce Garden, No.15 Xiaohezhi Street, and take a photo with the word "sauce". It is said that it used to be the largest pickle factory in Xiaohe area. 
There are many cafes, tea bars, mahjong shops and noodle shops along the way. Find a small tea shop opened by local residents, and visit the quaint courtyard along the way.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historical relics such as workshops and shops are retained

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 花港观鱼
attractions.summary:
Huagang Fish Watching, located in the south of the West Lake, was once the private garden of officials in the Southern Song Dynasty. 
The whole park is divided into five scenic spots: Red Fish Pond, Peony Garden, Flower Harbor, Big Lawn and Dense Forest. 
· The most famous thing in the garden is the swarms of red carp in the red fish pond. There are always adults and children feeding the fish with feed and bread crumbs, which is a great pleasure. 
There are three main entrances to the park. The south gate is on Nanshan Road, the west gate is on Yanggong Causeway, and you can also walk north to Su Causeway.
attractions.shortFeatures: Buy feed to feed big, red carp

attractions.name: 曲院风荷
attractions.name_en: Quyuan Fenghe (Lotus in the Breeze at Crooked Courtyard)
attractions.summary:
One of the ten scenic spots of the West Lake, hundreds of varieties of lotus flowers are cultivated in Fenghe Park, where it is located, which is particularly attractive in summer. 
In the Southern Song Dynasty, there was a wine-making workshop here, which took streams to make koji wine. Whenever the wind blows in summer, the fragrance of wine and lotus is refreshing, so it is called "Quyuan Fenghe".  
· Lotus leaves and fields are enchanting, and small bridges of different shapes are erected on the water. People cross the bridges, like walking in the lotus flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lotus flowers are different red in summer

attractions.name: 断桥残雪
attractions.summary:
It is the meeting place of Xu Xian and White Lady in The Legend of the New White Lady, which adds a lot of romantic color to this long bridge. 
At the beginning of winter snow, the snow and ice on the sunny side of the bridge melt, but the shady side is still covered with residual snow. From a height, the bridge seems to be broken but not broken, forming the famous "broken bridge with residual snow". 
It can be used as the starting point for visiting the West Lake, from Baidi on the Broken Bridge to Gushan, and then visit various scenic spots around the West Lake in turn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Xu Xian and White Snake met on the broken bridge

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 飞来峰
attractions.summary: Feilai Peak, also known as Lingjiu Peak, is 168 meters high and composed of limestone. Due to long-term exposure to groundwater erosion, Feilai Peak has formed many fantastic and varied caves and ravines, including Qinglin Cave, Yuru Cave, Longhong Cave, etc. The old trees and vines on the mountain are intertwined and tangled; The rock bones are exposed, and the peaks and ridges are as sharp as cutting. The amazing thing about Feilai Peak is the relatively complete 345 Buddhist themed statues on the mountain, with diverse forms, rich themes, vivid carvings, and unique styles, making it an attractive and wonderful spectacle.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 07:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00),Opens at Daylight saving time 06:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30)

attractions.name: 杭州博物馆
attractions.summary: Hangzhou History Museum is a window for citizens and tourists to know the history of the city and feel the glory of Hangzhou. Walk into the Hangzhou History Museum, appreciate the historical and cultural heritage of Hangzhou, and feel the humanistic spirit of the new era with exquisite harmony and open atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Warring States Crystal Cup of National Treasure Cultural Relics in Collection

attractions.name: 龙井村
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Longjing Village is located in the southwest of West Lake Scenic Area, surrounded by mountains on all sides, showing a trend of high in the north and low in the south. It has nearly 800 mu of alpine tea gardens. 
The northwest peak, Lion Peak and Tianzhu Peak in the northwest of the village form a natural barrier to block the cold wind from the northwest. There is Jiuxi in the south, and the valley is deep and wide, which leads directly to Qiantang River. The southeast wind in spring and summer is easy to enter the valley. The geographical conditions of ventilation and ventilation provide unique advantages for the growth of Longjing tea. Longjing tea produced here ranks first among "lion, dragon, cloud and tiger". 
· According to legend, when Emperor Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River, he went to Hugong Temple at the foot of Shifeng Mountain in Longjing Village to taste West Lake Longjing tea. After drinking, he was full of praise, and named the eighteen tea trees in front of the temple "Imperial Tea". Longjing Village, the "first village in tea township", is famous for its abundance of top-class West Lake Longjing tea. 
It is bordered by Xizi Lake in the east, Wuyun Mountain in the west, Qiantang River in the south, and the north and south peaks inserted into the clouds in the north. It is surrounded by green mountains and clouds, just like an emerald gemstone inlaid on the shores of Xizi Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: "The First Village of Tea Township"

attractions.name: 杭州宋城
attractions.tag: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"

restaurants.name_en: Reflecting Jiangnan Guandu vegetarian Art Museum

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 人民英雄纪念碑
attractions.summary:
· The Monument to the People's Heroes is located in the center of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, the capital, and was built to commemorate the revolutionary martyrs in modern Chinese history.  
The whole Hero Monument is carved with more than 170 figures, which summarizes and vividly shows the great historical facts of the people's revolution in China in the past hundred years. 
On the front of the tablet, there are eight characters "People's Heroes Live Forever" inscribed by Chairman Mao himself, and on the back there is an inscription drafted by Chairman Mao and written by Premier Zhou Enlai. 
· This is the memory of the older generation and the study place of the younger generation. When you come to Tiananmen Square, you will definitely come here to commemorate it.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the symbol buildings of the motherland

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 奥林匹克公园
attractions.summary: The Olympic Park is located at the northern end of the Beijing Central Axis Extension Line. It embodies the three major concepts of "technology, green, and humanities", and is a new urban area that integrates multiple functions such as office, commercial, hotel, cultural, sports, conference, and residential.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 清华大学
attractions.summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 北京大学
attractions.summary: Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

restaurants.name_en: Badaling Great Wall Hotel Chinese Restaurant
Holiday Inn Beijing Sequoia Four Seasons Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 怪兽大厦
attractions.summary: The Monster Building in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong, also known as the Mega Building, is a "E" shaped building composed of five buildings: Fuk Cheong Building, Yee Cheong Building, Yee Fat Building, Hoi Shan Building, and Seaview Building.

attractions.name: 旺角
attractions.summary:
· One of the most popular areas in Hong Kong, where fashion, traditional culture, city style, snacks and delicious food are all gathered. 
There are many theme streets, such as Goldfish Street, Sneaker Street, Women's Street, Gun Street, Electric Street, etc. You can have fun until dawn in the early morning. 
· It is a shopping mecca in the hearts of young people, with cosmetics chain stores, electronic and digital stores and well-known upstairs bookstores; Garden Street and so on. 
· It is famous for its many snack bars, including Japanese baked wheat cakes, German sausages, desktop drinks, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Bustling shopping district with many characteristic blocks

attractions.name: 尖沙咀
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Tsim Sha Tsui is located at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, facing Victoria Harbour and across the sea from Central, Hong Kong Island. It is the "geographical center" of Hong Kong. 
There are many famous scenic spots in Hong Kong, such as Avenue of Stars, Victoria Harbour, Kowloon Park, etc., which are all must-check-in places for tourists to come to Hong Kong. It is also a good place to see the night view. Victoria Harbour and Avenue of Stars are good choices. 
· It is the most prosperous shopping paradise in Hong Kong, with various large shopping malls, duty-free shops, international brand stores, etc. to meet all the needs of one-stop shopping. 
· There are also cultural places such as the Hong Kong History Museum, the Hong Kong Science Museum and the Hong Kong Cultural Center, which are good choices for parent-child tours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping paradise on the shore of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 铜锣湾
attractions.summary:
Causeway Bay is a very prosperous place in Hong Kong, with a complete range of shops and department stores. It can be said that it is five steps to one shop and ten steps to one shop. In just 15 minutes, you can pass through more than ten shopping malls of different sizes. It is a good shopping place. 
· The choice here is also very diverse, from large department stores and boutique stores to stalls selling cheap goods. The prices of goods range from tens of Hong Kong dollars to tens of thousands of dollars. People are rich and frugal, enough to spend a whole day shopping. 
· If you like internationally renowned brands, you can visit Lee Garden Phase I/II, Hysan Place, Lee Stage and Fashion Walk; If you are looking for mid-to-high-end goods, you can go to Times Square, Sogo Department Store and wtc more World Trade Center; If you don't like large shopping malls and want to find young fashionable clothes, go to Kimberly Shopping Mall; The hot spot for sales of cheap clothes and groceries is naturally Jardine Square. 
When walking in Causeway Bay, be sure to take the ding-ding car once. The ding-ding car runs slowly, and you can hear the "thud-dang-dang" sound caused by the friction between the axle and the track when you pass by. Whenever you stop, you must first make a "ding-ding-ding" prompt sound.
attractions.shortFeatures: A commercial block integrating shopping, food and nightlife

attractions.name: 上环
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the feelings of old Hong Kong

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 香港电车叮叮车
attractions.summary: Dingding is an integral part of the bustling streets of Hong Kong, and it is also the only double decker tram in the world. The route of Dingding car is in the bustling commercial center of Hong Kong, passing through the western, upper, central, Wan Chai, Tai Koo, Shau Kei Wan and the Victoria Harbour coast. This ancient mode of transportation, which is only found on Hong Kong Island, is actually a type of tram. It is famous for the sound of "ding ding, ding ding" when the driver steps on the scooter while driving, so people call it Dingding car. The tram currently operates 6 partially overlapping routes connecting Kennedy Town to Shau Kei Wan, with an average tram arriving at the station every 1 minute and 30 seconds. The 6 main routes are as follows: 1. Shau Kei Wan to Sheung Wan Market (there are special trips between Shau Kei Wan and Kennedy Town during peak hours from Monday to Friday); 2. From Shau Kei Wan to Happy Valley; 3. North Point to Shek Tong Tsui; 4. Happy Valley to Kennedy Town; 5. Causeway Bay to Kennedy Town; 6. From Sheung Wan Market to Kennedy Town (only available during peak hours from Monday to Friday). Please refer to the official website for the detailed operation route diagram of Dingding car.

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 无锡古运河
attractions.summary: The Qingmingqiao Ancient Canal Scenic Area is located in the center of Wuxi city, with antique water town buildings and real old houses forming a block. There are attractions to visit, as well as bars and restaurants. The night view is more beautiful than the day view. The houses with pink walls and black tiles are lit up, and strings of red lanterns are reflected in the canal, attracting countless long guns and short cannons. Sitting on a cruise ship, from the Nanchan Temple Pier to the Kuatang Bridge, one can see fashionable antique style buildings in the Yangchun Lane commercial district. From the Tangqiao Bridge to the Qingming Bridge is the essence part, known as "Jiangnan Water Alley, the canal is out of print". Seeing the memorial archway of "Canal Ancient Town" on the right bank means entering the real historical block transformed from old houses. Along the way, many beautiful people and small terraces can be found near the water. After passing Dagong Bridge, there is the China Silk Industry Museum on the right bank, and after passing Qingming Bridge, there is the Wuxi Kiln Site Museum on the left bank. Then go ahead to the Narcissus Taoist Temple, and see the memorial archway of "Tang Tree Leaves Shadows", which means the end of the block. It is recommended to take a cruise to the foot of Shuixian Road Courtyard and then walk back to Nanchan Temple Pier. Along the way, you can visit attractions such as Shuixian Road Courtyard, Canal Culture and Art Museum, Kanggong Salvation Society, and China Silk Industry Museum. If interested, you can also turn to Yangchun Lane for a stroll. If you are tired, you can take an electric scooter between Kuatang Bridge and Qingming Bridge, with a fare of 5 yuan.

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 蠡园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; garden parks; Gardens
attractions.summary:
- Li Garden is a well-known park in Wuxi, famous for its water scenery and featuring the traditional Jiangnan garden style.
- According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn period, Fan Li and Xi Shi retreated to Taihu Lake, and many of the garden's buildings are themed around Fan Li and Xi Shi, with exquisite landscaping. In spring and summer, visitors can also come here to enjoy the flowers.
- The Li Garden scenic area includes attractions such as the Four Seasons Pavilion, Xi Shi Manor, Tao Zhu Mansion, Thousand-Step Long Corridor, and the Spring and Autumn Pavilion, all offering great visual appeal.
- To the east of Li Garden, there is a Ferris wheel at Li Lake Park. With Li Garden in the foreground and the Ferris wheel as the background, the photos taken here are very artistic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fang Li and Xi Shi Themed Water Garden

attractions.name: 灵山大佛
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 南禅寺
attractions.summary:
English:  
- Formerly known as "Liangxi Feng Da Sha," with a long history and many eminent monks. The current temple was rebuilt in the 1980s and 1990s.  
- During the Tian Sheng period of the Northern Song Dynasty, Emperor Renzong of Song named it "Fusheng Chan Yuan." Eight years later, Emperor Renzong also named the northern counterpart to the Southern Chan Temple, "Shousheng Chan Yuan."  
- The temple includes the Heavenly King Hall, Miaoguang Pagoda, Five Precepts Hall, and a Liberation Pond, all of which visitors can explore.  
- After visiting the temple to pay respects, you can stroll around the nearby streets and enjoy local delicacies. The night scenery here is also worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: A blessed place of worship with strong incense offerings.

attractions.name: 锡惠名胜区
