attractions.shortFeatures: Visit famous monuments such as Jichang Garden

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 太湖仙岛
attractions.summary:
It is a group of small islands in the lake in Yuantouzhu scenic spot, which is divided into scenic spots such as Dongtianfudi and Tiandu Xianfu, and has the reputation of "Three Mountains Yingbi". 
There are statues of Taoist fairy palace and grottoes of Taoism and Buddhism on the island. Among them, the 18-meter-high statue of the Jade Emperor in the Taoist temple is rare in China and very eye-catching. 
· There are Huaguo Mountain, Mountain Curtain Cave and Performing Arts Field for monkeys to inhabit and perform monkey art, reproducing the scenes in the famous classical novel The Journey to the West. 
Dajue Bay, Xianren Cave and other scenic spots gather the art of Chinese Buddhist and Taoist grottoes, and the scenic spots such as Tiantai, Yuelao Temple and Yuanyang Pavilion are also magnificent.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to enjoy the vast lake view

attractions.name: 三国城
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Film Studios
attractions.shortFeatures: Being in the scene of Romance of the Three Kingdoms

attractions.name: 王府井
attractions.summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing

attractions.name: 三里屯
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark of Beijing's fashionable life

attractions.name: 大栅栏
attractions.summary:
· Dashilan, pronounced "dàshílànr", is a famous commercial street outside Qianmen in Beijing. 
· Located in the center of old Beijing, it is an important part of the south central axis. It is located south of Tiananmen Square and west of Qianmen Street, with a total length of 275 meters from the east exit to the west exit. 
There are rows of shopping, dining, entertainment and other shops in the block, and all the time-honored brands are arranged among them, which is a must-choice place to experience Beijing culture. 
It was once the entertainment center of Beijing. Many famous theaters, teahouses, bookstores and the earliest cinemas in Beijing history have settled here. It is worth visiting.

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 人民大会堂
attractions.summary:
· Located on the west side of Tiananmen Square in the center of Beijing, it is an important part of Tiananmen Square. 
The Great Hall of the People faces east from west, 336 meters long from north to south, 206 meters wide from east to west, and 46.5 meters high. It covers an area of 150,000 square meters, which is larger than the total building area of the Forbidden City. 
It is an important place for the party, the state and various people's organizations to hold political activities, and it is also a place for Chinese state leaders and people to hold political, diplomatic and cultural activities. 
Usually, there will be some performances in the Great Hall of the People, such as concerts and some Peking Opera performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: The meeting place of the people's congress

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 大水法
attractions.summary:
· Dashuifa Site is a part of the Chinese and Western Building Scenic Spot in Yuanmingyuan, Beijing. 
The main scene of Xiyang Building Scenic Area is the artificial fountain, which is called "Water Law" at the time. It is characterized by a large number, great momentum and peculiar conception. 
· It mainly forms three large fountain groups: Harmony, Haiyantang and Dashuifa, which are quite interesting and are the essence of Chinese and Western cultures.

attractions.name: 北京大学
attractions.summary: Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 清华大学
attractions.summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 果戈里大街
attractions.summary:
· It has a history of more than 100 years, and there are many Russian-style buildings, including the famous Qiulin Food Company Building and St. Alexeyev Church. 
The prosperity and night scene are no less beautiful than Central Street, and it is also a "bar street" in Harbin. 
It is also a famous cultural street, with modern horseshoe stones on both sides of the road, and a piece engraved with Heilongjiang historical and cultural celebrities is inlaid every other section.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old Russian-style block

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 龙塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Long Tower, with a height of 336 meters, ranks second in the world and first in Asia among steel towers. It is a comprehensive multi-functional tower integrating broadcast and television transmission, tourism, dining and entertainment, advertising, environmental and meteorological monitoring, microwave communication, and wireless communication. It is an iconic landmark of Harbin, Northeast China. 

The total area of Long Tower is 16,600 square meters, with the base covering 13,000 square meters and the tower building covering 3,600 square meters. The tower base consists of one underground floor and four above-ground floors, forming a spherical crown shape. The tower body is an octagonal prism, with a parabolic shape and a cylindrical shaft in the center. The structure is surrounded by seven silver-white aluminum alloy panels and nine dark blue coated glass panels. The tower's lower and upper levels are located at 181 meters and 206 meters, respectively, consisting of a disc-shaped lower tower and a circular upper tower. The antennas are positioned between 220.5 meters and 336 meters. 

Long Tower has meticulously created an "honorable hospitality" service, adhering to aviation service standards and forming a team with international service capabilities. It has successfully hosted many central government leaders, including Li Changchun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and He Guoqiang, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, as well as foreign dignitaries such as Russian Deputy Prime Minister Sergey Khristenko and former South Korean Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung. Large-scale delegations from Hong Kong, Macau, and the business and professional sectors, as well as celebrities from the entertainment and business industries, often visit the tower. Visitors often praise the tower’s unique features, beautiful scenery, delicious food, and excellent service. Long Tower has become a must-visit tourist destination for both domestic and international travelers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The high-altitude rotating restaurant offers a view of the night scene; overlooking the panoramic view of Harbin from a height of 100 meters.

attractions.name: 防洪纪念塔
attractions.summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

attractions.name: 松花江观光索道
attractions.summary: The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway starts from Tongjiang Square in the south and ends at Taiyang Island Scenic Area in the north, spanning across the Songhua River. It is a well-known tourist transportation vehicle. The total length of the cableway is 1156 meters, and the cableway bracket in the river is more than 70 meters away from the river surface. Riding in the car, you can overlook the panoramic view of both sides of the Songhua River, with infinite scenery. The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway is one of the key projects in Harbin City, which was built and constructed with huge investment in 1997. It introduced equipment from the world's senior cableway equipment company, Austria's Dopema Company, and ranks among the high-end international cableways today. The cableway is adjacent to Stalin Park, Flood Control Memorial Tower, and Central Street, like a jade belt tightly connecting the two banks of the Songhua River. The cableway is equipped with 19 fully automatic and fully enclosed high-end cabins for 8 people, 6 luxurious cabins, and built-in sofas, bars, and speakers, providing comfort, elegance, warmth, and romance. The cableway runs at a speed of 1-5 meters per second, with ease and speed. Walking leisurely in the courtyard, one can enjoy the scenery of northern China and the city, and the scenery wherever they go is infinite. So far, the cableway has been in operation for more than 20 years, with a safety factor of 100%. Full text 

attractions.name: 太阳岛风景区
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids.; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- Sun Island Park is located on the northern bank of the Songhua River in Harbin, across from Stalin Park, and is known by visitors as a summer resort.
- The island features numerous European-style villas, which were once summer retreats for the Russians. These architectural structures are nestled amidst lush green trees.
- This is the largest winter theme park in China with a snow theme, and in winter, it becomes a world of snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Summer for escaping the heat, winter for enjoying snow sculptures.

attractions.name: 太阳岛冰雪艺术馆
attractions.name_en: Sun Island Ice and Snow Art Museum
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary:
The Ice and Snow Art Museum is currently the largest indoor ice and snow art venue in the world. 
The ice scene in the museum is made of natural ice and artificial snow of Songhua River, so that the ice and snow landscape that is only available in winter can be realized indoors in spring, summer and autumn. 
If you come here in summer and the temperature difference between indoor and outdoor is too big, you must rent cotton-padded clothes and trousers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate precious calligraphy and painting works

attractions.name: 亚布力森林温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
· Yabuli Forest Hot Spring is located in Yabuli Tourist Resort, Heilongjiang Province. The hot spring is divided into two areas: indoor pavilion and outdoor hot spring. 
The indoor pavilion takes tropical garden scenery as the theme of hot springs, and combines the abundant Chinese herbal medicine resources in local mountainous areas to create local characteristic medicinal hot springs. There are more than 20 kinds of characteristic hot springs such as ginseng spring, ganoderma lucidum spring, astragalus spring and schisandra spring. 
· Outdoor hot spring pools are distributed in the original birch forest and pine forest, and you can experience the hot spring experience of spring flowers, summer green, autumn yellow and winter snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical garden scenery indoor hot spring

attractions.name: 亚布力滑雪旅游度假区
attractions.summary: Yabuli Ski Resort is a famous ski resort in China, gathering multiple professional ski resorts and resort hotels. Here, you can experience the thrilling "snow diving" on professional ski slopes, and there are many professional coaches to help beginners quickly master basic skills, allowing you to fully enjoy the fun of skiing. Yabuli Ski Resort is located in the southern mountainous area of Yabuli Town. The snow quality here is excellent and the hardness is moderate. The snow accumulation period is 170 days, and the skiing period is nearly 150 days. From mid November to late March of the following year, it is a good time for skiing. In addition, there are also activities such as playing snow circles and snowmobiles. International events such as the Asian Winter Games are often held here. The resort consists of three peaks with an altitude of over 1000 meters (Daguokui, Erguokui, and Sanguokui), and is home to multiple ski resorts, such as the Xinhao Sunshine Ski Resort with better facilities and larger facilities in China, and the Xinti Commission Ski Resort with better facilities. Although skiing costs are slightly higher than ordinary ski resorts, they are worth experiencing. In addition, summer vacation areas are also suitable for leisure vacations. The forests here are dense and the scenery is beautiful. There are entertainment projects such as golf, boating, fishing, etc. in the vacation area, making it a good place to escape the heat and summer. Full text 

attractions.name: 亚布力世界第一滑道
attractions.name_en: Yabuli Sightseeing Cable Car and World's First Slide
attractions.summary:
· The world's first slide in Yabuli is located on Sanguokui Mountain at an altitude of 999.8 meters. It extends down the hillside, with a total length of 2,680 meters and a drop of 570 meters. It has 48 curves, which is the highest in the world. 
· You need to take the high-speed uphill cable car to the top of the mountain. During this period, you can overlook this beautiful forest and snowfield, pine trees, stone sea, hanging trees and other scenic spots. I was also lucky enough to see professional athletes speeding in the ski field. 
· The slide is divided into single-person vehicles and double-person vehicles. Each vehicle has a control handle. The slide will pass through two tunnels and 48 detours. The top speed can reach 80 kilometers per hour. Experience the thrill of speed and passion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Total length 2680 meters

attractions.name: 亚布力熊猫馆
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Yabuli Panda Pavilion is located in Yabuli Ski Resort, more than 200 kilometers away from Harbin. The whole Panda Pavilion covers an area of 2,700 square meters. According to the different indoor and outdoor venues of pandas, it is divided into inner venues and outer venues. The design inspiration of Panda Pavilion is the shape of fallen leaves. The scenic spots include Panda Pavilion, Beast Pavilion, Bear Pavilion, Primate Pavilion, Herbivore Pavilion, etc., which is unique, both a building and a scene. Moreover, more than 20 species of wild animals endemic to Northeast China, such as alpaca, sable, sika deer, brown bear and black bear, have been introduced to settle down here and live and multiply.

attractions.name: 亚布力虎峰岭风景区
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Military Sites
attractions.summary:
Hufengling, located in the easternmost part of Yabuli Forestry Bureau, covers a total area of about 11,964 hectares. No.8 and Hualingou outside Hufeng are the sources of Ant River. 
There is a famous Du Cao Cave on the ridge, which used to be a military place in War of Resistance against Japan and the War of Liberation. 
The "Lilac Peak" of Hufengling, located in the west of Hufengling, is 1,080 meters above sea level. It is an alpine wetland with unique scenery in four seasons.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the original mother forest

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 南屏步行街
attractions.summary: Nanping Street is an old block in the history of Kunming and also an ancient commercial street in the city. There are numerous restaurants, shops, supermarkets, and brand chain stores on the streets, offering a wide range of food, accommodation, travel, shopping, and entertainment options. It is one of the bustling streets in Kunming and also a popular spot for tourists to check in. At the entrance of Nanping Street, there is a large memorial archway, which is one of the landmark attractions here. Many tourists take photos here. There are also bronze statues on the street, with lifelike figures that can be photographed and recorded. Shopping, tasting delicious food, and savoring the charm of Kunming.

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 世界恐龙谷
attractions.summary: The World Dinosaur Valley is located in Lufeng, known as the birthplace of Chinese dinosaurs. It is a dinosaur cultural tourism theme park that integrates site protection, sightseeing and leisure, science popularization and scientific research. The park is divided into two major areas: the "Dinosaur Site Scientific Research Sightseeing Area" and the "Jurassic World Tourism Area". Here, you can see landscapes such as the One Generation Overlord (sculpture), Dragon Pillar Sky, Jurassic Trail, Jurassic Castle, etc. You can also play projects such as Fish Dragon Water Splashing, Wave Rolling, Dragon Roll Storm, Dinosaur Knights, etc. The World Dinosaur Valley immerses you in the world of dinosaurs, exploring and contemplating the mysteries of dinosaurs. Full text 

attractions.name: 世纪钟广场
attractions.summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark building in Tianjin next to the railway station

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 五号院相声茶馆（古文化街通庆里店）
attractions.name_en: No. 5 Courtyard Xiangsheng Teahouse (Ancient Cultural Street Tongqingli Store)
attractions.summary: Experience the courtyard tea house, enjoy tea, taste fresh Tianjin style snacks, and listen to traditional cross-talk.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 张学良故居
attractions.summary:
Zhang Xueliang's Former Residence Museum, also known as Shaoshual's Mansion, lived here in the 1920s and 1930s. This building is luxurious, beautiful and generous, mainly in western Baroque style. The rooms are elegantly decorated, and the stairs, floors, doors and windows are all made of Philippine wood. 
Zhang Xueliang's former residence, which has been renovated for more than two years, reappears today. The music, decoration, clothing, furniture and characters here reappear the original appearance of the Zhang family's life in the French Concession in Tianjin.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

restaurants.name_en: Shunhe Natural Fresh Food Food Cultural Center

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 东方明珠259米全透明悬空观光廊
attractions.summary: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower fully transparent sightseeing corridor is 259 meters high, 150 meters long and 2.1 meters wide. It is the only 360 degree fully transparent sightseeing corridor in the world. Standing on the fully transparent sightseeing corridor, enjoy the panoramic view of Shanghai in a unique way of "aerial stroll" and experience an unprecedented shock.

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 中华艺术宫
attractions.summary:
It used to be the China National Pavilion of Shanghai World Expo, with a collection of more than 8,000 pieces, including a large number of paintings by famous painters such as Zhang Yuguang and Wu Guanzhong. 
The exhibition halls of the Art Palace are mainly located on the 0m floor, 5m floor, 33m floor, 41m floor and 49m floor. It is recommended to visit them from top to bottom. 
The most interesting thing is the treasure of the town hall-the multimedia version of Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival, which is located on the 49m floor, but you need to pay extra tickets to watch it. 
In addition, there are many exhibition halls for viewing, such as Shadow Art Exhibition, Modern Art Exhibition and Shanghai Artists Invitational Exhibition.
attractions.shortFeatures: Former China National Pavilion at Shanghai World Expo

attractions.name: 上海千古情
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Eternal Scene Area is located in the World Expo Park on the banks of the Huangpu River, and is a completely new scenic area that subverts imagination. Wandering through the streets of time and space, the streets of eternal love, and the markets of heaven, it feels like a world apart. Magical Forest, Forest Ranch, Love Valley, Elf Valley, Children's Playground, and other scenic spots step by step. There are over ten theaters and performance venues, including the Eternal Love Theater, Performing Arts Theater, Forest Theater, Cliff Theater, Punk Square, Music Square, and Guozhuang Square. Large scale interactive experience projects such as "Battle of Shanghai", "Olivia", "Liaozhai Jinghun", horror research institute, fantasy space, virtual space, multimedia light and shadow show, etc., are thrilling and soul stirring! The scenic area is full of internet celebrity check-in points, and the experience of changing into thousands of outfits allows you to have a versatile life. There are big plays every day, trendy parties every week, and people of all ages can have fun, whether it's sunny or rainy. The large-scale song and dance performance 'Eternal Love in Shanghai' is a must see for a lifetime, based on the magnificent history of Shanghai and depicting the past and present of Shanghai. 3000 tons of Huangpu River water flow into the sea, with tens of thousands of stage machinery and equipment reaching the sky and earth, providing a visual feast and soul stirring experience! It's a heavyweight bomb of magic art!! Shanghai Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! More than two thousand years ago, Shanghai became the fiefdom of Huang Xie, one of the "Four Young Masters of the Warring States Period" and the Prince of Chunshen. He led the people to gradually develop this place from a fishing village in the East China Sea to a land of fish and rice in Jiangnan. In order to commemorate the immortal achievements of Lord Chunshen and the great wisdom of the Shanghai ancestors, later generations referred to Shanghai as "Shen" and the fishing tool bamboo fence "Hu". The first performance of 'Jiangnan in Shanghai' depicts the leisurely flow of the Pujiang River for thousands of years, nurturing the Jiangnan in poetry and painting. Jiangnan, you are a painting, misty with mist and rain, painted with ink and blue; Jiangnan, you are a song, with gentle words from Wu Nong, depicting the endless vicissitudes of life in the world. A ship, an umbrella, a relationship, this is the Jiangnan region of Shanghai. In the second episode of "Shanghai Beach", it is said that "the river and sea connect to Tianjin, and the city is in the southeast." In 1843, Shanghai officially opened up as a port to the outside world, and foreign firms flooded in one after another. From then on, the poetic and picturesque Jiangnan region of Shanghai became a bustling beach where Chinese and foreign cultures coexisted. The third episode of 'Modern Times' was held in Shanghai in the 1920s and 1930s, where Eastern and Western cultures intersected. Let's experience the modern era of the Ten Mile Market on the neon lit night in Shanghai. The fourth episode of 'The Age of Awakening': Shanghai is the starting point of the Chinese revolution. Young people full of revolutionary ideals, represented by Chen Yannian and Chen Qiaonian, have marched forward and dyed this land red with their youth and blood. Let's revisit those magnificent and tumultuous years. Full text 

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康路历史文化名街
attractions.name_en: Wukang Road Historic and Cultural Street
attractions.summary:
· "China's Famous Historical and Cultural Street" with 37 historical buildings is known as one of the most European-style neighborhoods in central Shanghai. 
It is also a veritable "celebrity road", where literary giants Ba Jin, Huang Xing and Soong Ching Ling once lived. 
In addition to the former residence of celebrities, a characteristic villa with a towering spire at No.99 is Zhengguanghe Old House, where the movie Lust, Caution was shot. 
Spanish, French Renaissance and other styles of buildings are very distinctive, and the ancient trees on both sides are lush, which is suitable for walking and taking photos.

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京夫子庙步行街
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Ancient Qinhuai Confucius Temple Pedestrian Street is located at No. 53 West Gongyuan Street, Confucius Temple, Nanjing, China. This street is a very lively commercial street in Nanjing, with visitors flocking to it every night. It sells various Nanjing specialty snacks and craft souvenirs. There is also a Confucius Temple on the street to commemorate Confucius.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.

Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World.

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world
