attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 中环
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Central is the political and commercial center of Hong Kong. Many banks, multinational financial institutions and foreign consulates are located in Central. 
· All kinds of skyscrapers and shopping malls are all over Central, with gorgeous lights and neon lights. 
· Popular shopping malls such as Landmark Plaza, Jiaxuan Plaza, Prince Building, Alexander Building and International Financial Center Shopping Mall gather designer brands and international palace-level brand stores. 
· The landscape of Central is a mixture of colonial architecture and modern high-tech buildings. Hong Kong's iconic buildings such as Legislative Council Building, Bank of China Tower and IFC International Financial Center in Central are also located here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong Political and Business Centre

attractions.name: 中环街市

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 东门老街
attractions.summary: Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

attractions.name: 深圳平安金融中心云际观光层
attractions.name_en: Ping An Finance Center Sky Observation Deck, Shenzhen

attractions.summary: FREE SKY Cloud Sightseeing Floor is located on the 116th floor of Ping An Financial Center, the fourth tallest building in the world. It is proud of Shenzhen's new landmark at an altitude of about 547.6 meters, and has a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Shenzhen's different landscapes and urban features in all directions. The cloud sightseeing layer integrates sightseeing and entertainment, cultural creativity and popular science education, and is a new landmark of urban sightseeing with cultural connotation. At the same time, the sightseeing floor is connected with a huge transportation network and rich tourist lines, which will become an unmissable choice for many tourists to visit Shenzhen. The sightseeing floor covers a number of functional spaces, such as transparent viewing spots, interactive experience areas, characteristic exhibition areas, etc., and displays the young culture with rich Shenzhen characteristics with advanced intelligent multimedia facilities. This is an excellent place to taste the prosperity and natural reflection of Shenzhen. You can enjoy the unique experience of enjoying the city scenery at Dapeng Fuyun, and the 360-degree cloud overview is shocking.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the suspended observation platform with a bird's-eye view of Shenzhen and Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳欢乐海岸
attractions.summary: Happy Coast is a part of OCT, with water as its theme. Qushui Bay integrates restaurants, bars, traditional and modern buildings, making it a commercial area that combines shopping, dining, and entertainment. There are shopping centers, ocean dream halls, and joyful coastal water show theaters. Among them, the Ocean Dream Pavilion is currently the only oceanarium in the center of Shenzhen. The Water Show Theater will have a deep blue secret water show performance, and in the evening, there will be a music fountain, which is very exciting.

restaurants.name_en: Foodie Legion Steam Seafood Music Restaurant

attractions.name: 阳澄湖
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Yangcheng Qingshuiwan Crab Village is endowed with its unique geographical location, beautiful environment, natural scenery, a hundred miles of water area, rippling blue waves, shallow water and hard bottom, lush aquatic plants, wide extension and suitable climate. It is the most ideal crystal palace for crabs to settle and grow. Therefore, the shape and meat quality of Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs are greatly different in the crab family.
attractions.shortFeatures: Taste the famous Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs

attractions.name: 莲花岛景区-游船离岛乘船处
attractions.name_en: Lotus Island Scenic Area - Boat Departure Point

attractions.name: 阳澄湖莲花岛
attractions.summary: Lianhua Island is located in the northeast of the ancient city of Suzhou, surrounded by water on three sides. It is named after its lotus like shape, which is embedded in the lake. The total area of the island is 3.2 square kilometers, with over 300 households living on the lake and making a living from crabs. The water here is vast and the water quality is particularly good. It is the birthplace of authentic Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs and is known as the "hometown of hairy crabs". The attractions on the island, such as Yiyuan Garden, Yaoshi Temple, Sanyuan Mansion, Xizui Wetland, Dadi Painting, Windmill Array, Cow Water Performance, and Water Treading, are both ornamental and experiential. With the rise of rural tourism, more and more tourists have come to visit, forming an industrial service chain integrating food, housing, tourism, entertainment and shopping. Lotus Island is developing into a resort for vacation and leisure. The Yiyuan Yiyuan Museum covers an area of over 5000 square meters and showcases the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake. It not only restores the original ecological lifestyle of Lianhua Island, but also uses artistic techniques to spread the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town. The entire building includes: the foyer, atrium, fishery hall, water town wedding hall, water town costume hall, historical and cultural hall, and folk customs hall. The waterwheel was an irrigation tool used in ancient times and was popular in most parts of China. When used, stepping on the crutch to rotate the large wheel axle drives the blade in the groove to scrape water upwards and pour it into the field. This type of water lifting facility has a long history because its shape resembles a dragon bone, also known as a "dragon bone water wheel". Fengqing Fishing Port Fengqing Fishing Port is home to the original residents of Lianhua Island who live by the water on both sides. The pink walls and black tiles are connected together, and there is a row of boats and boats in front of the houses, maintaining the original ecological style of the Jiangnan water town. There are aquatic products all year round, and in the golden autumn season, crabs are harvested with joy. Every household welcomes guests with a smiling face. The charming water alleys of Lianhua Island make tourists come and go frequently. Xizui Wetland Park covers an area of over 300 acres, with diverse vegetation types and a good ecological environment. Along the lakeside boardwalk, visitors can enjoy the lake scenery and lotus flowers. In the flower planting area, rapeseed flowers can be seen in spring and sunflowers can be seen in autumn, creating a beautiful scenery. Cattle fetching water used to be a common scene in agriculture in Jiangnan. In a pavilion that was over a person tall, an old cow with its eyes covered was placed by a large wooden plate, circling in circles. The rotation of the large wheel axle drove the blades in the trough to scrape the water upwards, and the river water was irrigated by the "bucket board" into the fields by the river. The former residence of Qian Qi in the San Yuan Mansion, where "San Yuan" refers to Lianzhong Huiyuan, Jieyuan, and Zhuangyuan. Only 15 people in Chinese history have received this honor. In October 2010, construction was carried out on Qian Qi's old house, which consists of three entrances in front and back, with a total area of 300 square meters. The first two entrances are Ming style buildings with an area of 160 square meters, while the last entrance is an early Qing Dynasty building with an area of 140 square meters. The Suzhou Yangcheng Lake Tourism Distribution Center is located in the middle of the "Beauty Leg" Peninsula in Yangcheng Lake Resort. It is a comprehensive service center that integrates tourism distribution, tourist services, cultural exhibitions, and product sales. It is also a transportation hub that combines road and water transportation, and is a benchmark for smart tourism distribution centers in China. It covers an area of 36.5 acres and has a building area of 6848 square meters. It consists of three main parts: an ecological parking lot, a distribution building, and a boat dock. Designed by the architectural master Kengo Kuma, the building resembles a layered structure of thatch, which is a concrete expression of the rural areas of Jiangnan; The massive triangular roof is like a mountain range connected along the lake, perfectly blending with nature. This is a new cultural landmark, as well as a brand new cultural window and innovation and entrepreneurship base by Yangcheng Lake. It has become a well-known check-in spot for internet celebrities. attractions.name: 忆园
attractions.summary: Yiyuan is a museum located at the northeast corner of Lianhua Island in Yangcheng Lake, Suzhou. It has carefully set up a fishery museum, a folk customs museum, a water town wedding museum, a Yangcheng clothing museum, a historical and cultural museum, etc. Through artistic techniques, it spreads the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town from point to surface, comprehensively showcasing the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake, and restoring the original ecological way of life of Lianhua Island.

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 周庄沈厅
attractions.summary: The original name of Shen Hall was Jingye Hall, which was renamed Songmao Hall in the late Qing Dynasty. It was built by Shen Benren, a descendant of Shen Wansan, in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1742 AD). It is divided into seven entrances and five gates, and the architectural layout has the style of a wealthy family. Shen Hall is a must visit attraction in Zhouzhuang, and tourists come here mainly to explore the past of the wealthy Shen Wansan. Layout structure: The first entrance of the Shen Hall is the Water Wall Gate, which is equivalent to the private dock of the Shen family for docking their boats; The second entrance is the foyer; The third entrance is the tea pavilion, used to entertain guests with average status; The fourth entrance is the main hall, Songmao Hall, used to entertain distinguished guests; The fifth entrance is the lobby building where women reside; The sixth entrance is the small hall building; The seventh entrance is the restaurant, with a kitchen next to it. Highlights of Shen Hall: Brick carved gatehouse, main hall, treasure trove, and copper murals are several highlights of Shen Hall. The gatehouse between the third and fourth entrances is one of the five exquisite gatehouses in Shenting. There are beautiful brick carvings on the gatehouse, with the words "Accumulated Thick and Flowing Light" carved in the middle. The main hall, Songmao Hall, is spacious and grand, with old dark windows visible when looking up. In the sixth entrance of the small hall building, there is a statue of Shen Wansan, and in front of him is a glittering treasure trove, which is said to bring wealth to people. There are copper murals on both sides of the lane in Shen Hall, introducing the legendary life of Shen Wansan. Visiting the second floor of the Shen Hall's Ma Tower requires an additional fee. On the second floor, you can look at the various courtyards of the Shen Hall from a different angle, and also see the ladies' boudoirs. It is quite interesting to peek into the main hall's Song Mao Hall from the dark window.

attractions.name: 周庄张厅
attractions.summary:
Zhang Hall, formerly known as Yishun Hall, was built in the Ming Dynasty. In the early Qing Dynasty, Zhang's surname was transferred to Yuyan Hall, commonly known as Zhang Hall. 
After more than 500 years of vicissitudes, solid stone pillars and exquisite carvings, it is still not difficult to see the former elegant demeanor of Zhang Hall. 
The hall is spacious and bright, with a rare wooden drum pier under the court pillar, which is an obvious symbol of Ming Dynasty architecture. 
The backyard of Zhang Hall is a quiet and clean small garden, surrounded by dwellings with white walls and black tiles. 
Enter with the ticket of the day and listen to the story with the tour guide. Although things have changed, you can still feel the details of the life of large families.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sedan chair entered the boat in front of the door and passed through the house

attractions.name: 双桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Shuangqiao is composed of Shide Bridge and Yongan Bridge. It was built in the Ming Dynasty. The two bridges are connected and look like ancient keys, also known as key bridges. 
The special significance here is that the reflection through the lake forms a standard circle with the bridge itself, which is very distinctive. 
Shuangqiao can best reflect the charm of the ancient town. Chen Yifei created an oil painting titled Memories of Hometown with Shuangqiao as the background. 
Although the commercial development is serious and there are many people here, the flowing water and ancient buildings in the south of the Yangtze River have been preserved.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful ancient bridge is a landmark of Zhouzhuang

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州园林博物馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Garden Museum was first located in the residential area of Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built and opened in the autumn of 1992. It is the first garden museum in China. The new museum of Suzhou Garden Museum is now located on the west side of the Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built in October 2005 and has a building area of 3,390 square meters. The Garden Art Hall also shows in detail the gardening techniques such as stacking mountains, water management, flowers and trees, and architecture. The whole new museum is divided into preface hall, garden history hall, garden art hall, garden culture hall and end hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Entering Suzhou Garden Culture

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 平江路闲雅苑昆曲评弹馆
attractions.name_en: Pingjiang Road Xianyayuan Kunqu and Pingtan Theater
attractions.summary: Suzhou Pingjiang Road Xianyayuan Kunqu Pingtan Museum is located in the core area of Pingjiang Road, presenting Kunqu and Pingtan art in the form of tea house singing. Elegant environment, garden style decoration, full of ancient style and charm. The actors in the museum are professional and perform classic songs such as' Slow Sound 'and' Night Mooring at Maple Bridge ', providing visitors with an immersive experience of Su style culture. The highlight lies in its unique performance form and strong cultural atmosphere, making it a great place to experience Suzhou's traditional culture.

attractions.name: 印象西湖《最忆是杭州》演出
attractions.summary: Impression of West Lake "is one of the" Impression Series "created by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue. The theater is located between Yuehu Lake, Quyuan Fenghe, and Sudi in the northwest area of West Lake. Using the lake as a stage, the scene is rendered using high-tech sound and light technology, and the plot is performed by numerous actors to recreate the beautiful scenery and folk legends of Jiangnan. On a quiet night, on the charming Xizi Lake, the beautiful scenery of Jiangnan and timeless legends bloom in the night and memories.

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 花港观鱼
attractions.summary:
Huagang Fish Watching, located in the south of the West Lake, was once the private garden of officials in the Southern Song Dynasty. 
The whole park is divided into five scenic spots: Red Fish Pond, Peony Garden, Flower Harbor, Big Lawn and Dense Forest. 
· The most famous thing in the garden is the swarms of red carp in the red fish pond. There are always adults and children feeding the fish with feed and bread crumbs, which is a great pleasure. 
There are three main entrances to the park. The south gate is on Nanshan Road, the west gate is on Yanggong Causeway, and you can also walk north to Su Causeway.
attractions.shortFeatures: Buy feed to feed big, red carp

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 余荫山房
attractions.summary: Yuyin Mountain Villa, also known as Yuyin Garden, is a private garden of Wu Bin, a scholar from the Qing Dynasty. It has a history of more than 130 years. The garden is renowned for its exquisite and intricate artistic features, with pavilions, halls, towers, bridges, corridors, and embankments all compactly arranged within a 300-step radius. The garden is rich in four major types of carvings—brick carvings, wood carvings, plaster carvings, and stone carvings—showing off the elegance and charm of the renowned garden. Ancient trees soar, and rare flowers dazzle, bringing vibrant life to the entire garden. The four major wonders of the garden, namely "Bamboo in the Side Wall," "Rainbow Bridge Reflecting the Moon," "Hidden Treasures in the Deep Willows," and "Double Greens Welcoming Spring," leave visitors in awe and make them reluctant to leave.
attractions.shortFeatures: Known for its compact and delicate layout.

attractions.name: 岭南印象园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gem for Kid-Friendly Activities; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 珠江夜游天字码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Tianzi Pier
attractions.summary: The Pearl River Night Tour is one of the eight scenic spots in Guangzhou, a window to display the splendid ancient civilization and modern development achievements of Guangzhou, and also a crystallization of Guangzhou tourism. The time-honored ferry dock in Guangzhou, the Tianzi Dock (built in the reign of Emperor Yongzheng in the Qing Dynasty), has a history of more than 270 years. It has become the main deck of the Pearl River night navigation, receiving foreign guests welcomed by the Party and leaders as well as the people's government of Guangdong Province and Guangzhou City. Full text 

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 宝墨园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; gardens and parks.; Gardens
attractions.summary:
· Bao Mo Garden is a distinctive Lingnan-style garden, built during the Jiaqing period of the Qing Dynasty to commemorate Bao Zheng.
· The main buildings and attractions in the garden include Zhiben Hall, Bao Mo Hall, Qingxin Pavilion, Yanglian Bridge, Zidong Boat, Longtu Pavilion, Qianxiang Corridor, and the Flavor Street.
· In front of the gate, there are two finely crafted folk brick carvings. The garden also features a large number of gray carvings, stone carvings, ceramic sculptures, and rosewood carvings, as well as traditional palace lanterns.
· Additionally, there are ancient pine trees over a thousand years old, Jiuli fragrant trees, two-faced trees, ginkgo trees, Yutang Spring, banyan trees, Crape Myrtle trees, and Lingnan-style bonsais.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lingnan Culture: Landscape and Garden; The Beauty of Lingnan Architecture

attractions.name: 沙湾古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient towns and villages; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
- With a history of over 800 years, it is well-preserved and a historic ancient town of Lingnan culture.
- Represented by Liugengtang, the ancient village layout of "stone steps and stone alleys" is well-preserved, retaining a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming, Qing, and Republic of China periods.
- Shawan Ancient Town has preserved a large number of artistic masterpieces, such as brick carvings, wood carvings, stone carvings, clay sculptures, and murals, and is known as the "Hometown of Folk Sculpture" in Guangdong Province.
- It also boasts intangible cultural heritage and traditional cultural activities, such as Lion Dance, Cantonese music, Shawan Floating Colors, brick carvings, as well as events like the Birthday of the North Emperor, Aoyu Dance, Dragon Boat Racing, and Orchid Cultivation.
attractions.shortFeatures: A robe of splendour travels through Shawan; Hometown of Chinese Folk Art; A famous historic and cultural town in China.

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 五四广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement

attractions.name: 栈桥
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; City coordinates; Bridges; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Qingdao's earliest military-specific artificial wharf is a landmark building and a famous scenic spot in Qingdao. 
The octagonal building inside the breakwater at the southern end is called "Huilan Pavilion". Standing here, you can enjoy the "Flying Pavilion Huilan", one of the ten scenic spots in Qingdao. 
The north coast is called "Zhanqiao Park", with lush flowers and plants, and stone chairs for tourists to rest and enjoy the scenery of the sea and sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old sea promenade

attractions.name: 圣弥厄尔教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in 1930, formerly known as "St. Miel Church", it is the largest Romanesque building in Qingdao and the only consecrated church in China. 
· Designed by German designer Biloha, according to Gothic and Romanesque architectural styles. It is a masonry twin tower building with four bells inside. 
· The church is spacious and bright. The hall is about 18 meters high. There are two confession booths on both sides of the corridors for priests to receive believers to confess and confess.  
• The church has a valuable organ imported from Germany, which is played only during Sunday Mass.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Western Architecture in Qingdao

attractions.name: 小鱼山公园
attractions.summary: Xiaoyushan Park is one of the best scenic spots in Qingdao, firstly because it is located in the city center and is a mountain close to the sea, with a geographical location; Secondly, due to its altitude of only 60 meters, climbing the mountain is not tiring. When you reach the top, you can see the representative scenery of Qingdao, which is "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky". At the top of Xiaoyushan Mountain, there is a three story octagonal pavilion called the Tide Viewing Pavilion, which is 18 meters high and covered with green glazed tiles. Climbing up the spiral staircase to enjoy the view, nearby are German style buildings with red tiles and yellow walls hidden among green trees. To the southeast, you can see the golden sand of the first beach connected to the blue sea. To the northeast, you can see the Qingdao TV Tower on Taiping Mountain. When the weather is good to the west, you can distinguish the small Qingdao and the wharf in the distance. To the north, you can take a panoramic view of Signal Mountain Park. The guesthouse on the mountainside of Signal Mountain and the three red topped mushroom buildings on the mountaintop are clearly visible. At night, you can take photos of the night view of Qingdao city on the mountain. To the west of the Lianchao Pavilion is the Hexagonal Pavilion with Bibo Pavilion, and to the east is the Four Corner Pavilion with Cuicui Pavilion. Both pavilions are covered with green glazed tiles, providing scenic views. The front of the curved corridor connecting the Lianchao Pavilion and Yongcui Pavilion features white reliefs, with modern characters "small" and "mountain" and ancient pictographic characters "fish" forming the mountain emblem of Xiaoyushan. You can take a photo with it, and there are also beautiful murals next to the emblem. In addition, on the southern slope of Xiaoyushan, there are miniature models that gather Qingdao architecture. If you are interested, you can also take a look. There are many scenic spots near Xiaoyushan Park, mostly along the coastline. To the west, you can follow the route of Zhanqiao - Navy Museum - Little Qingdao - Lu Xun Park - Xiaoyushan Park. To the east, you can see Kang Youwei's former residence, the first beach, Badaguan, and then go to Taipingjiao to see the sunset. Full text 

attractions.name: 鲁迅公园
attractions.summary:
Lu Xun Park is a free and open coastal park in Qingdao, with large reddish-brown reefs on the seaside. 
The park stretches from east to west along the long and narrow bedrock coast, adjacent to Qingdao Aquarium and First Bathing Beach in the east, with a total length of about 2 kilometers.  
The park has colorful red reefs, clear water, green pines, secluded paths, pavilions and pavilions, and charming scenery. It is a scenic spot with both garden beauty and natural beauty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Open Seaside Park with Beautiful Scenes

attractions.name: 海军博物馆
attractions.summary: The PLA Naval Museum is a military museum reflecting the development of the Chinese navy in China. It is the historical, spiritual and cultural highland of the People's Navy. The Navy Museum is located at No. 8 Laiyang Road, Shinan District, Qingdao, adjacent to Lu Xun Park to the east and Little Qingdao Park to the west, echoing the wharf from afar. The Naval Museum has a land area of approximately 141 acres and a sea area of approximately 214 acres. It was officially opened to the public in October 1989. In 2001, it was rated as a national defense education demonstration base by the Central Propaganda Department. In June 2021, at the important historical moment of celebrating the 100th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and achieving the goal of "the first 100 years", the Naval Museum completed its reconstruction and expansion, opened to the outside world with a new look, and presented the glorious history of the People's Navy for more than 70 years under the strong leadership of the CPC in a panoramic manner. On May 18, 2022, the Naval Museum's "Strong Towards the Sea - Basic Exhibition of the History of the People's Navy" was awarded the 19th (2021) "National Museum Top Ten Exhibition Excellence Award". The Naval Museum is divided into three exhibition areas: indoor, sea, and land. The indoor main exhibition hall is the basic display of the history of the People's Navy, with four exhibition halls covering an area of over 7000 square meters. It is divided into three parts: "Socialist Revolution and Construction Period", "New Era of Reform and Opening up and Socialist Modernization Construction", and "New Era of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics". There are over 18000 cultural relics in the collection, mainly displayed under the strong leadership of the Party, where the People's Navy was born, grew, and developed through artillery fire; Along the way, cutting through waves and traversing thousands of miles of maritime territory, galloping across the vast oceans, we are striding towards the goal of building a world-class navy. The exhibition area for naval vessels covers an area of over 40000 square meters, with 3 docks and 6 berths. It mainly showcases China's first destroyer Anshan (hull number 101), the first domestically produced destroyer Jinan (hull number 105), the first domestically produced air defense frigate Yingtan (hull number 531), the first nuclear submarine Long March 1 (hull number 401), the first experimental submarine Great Wall 200 (hull number 200) and other iconic vessels. The land equipment exhibition area covers an area of over 13000 square meters. The main exhibition showcases the small surface vessels, naval aviation equipment, marine equipment, and naval coastal defense equipment that have served in the People's Navy since its establishment. The main exhibits include: the Liberation class meritorious boats and gunboats that made great collective contributions in the Battle of Wanshan; The honor boat - No. 245 wooden shell torpedo boat showcased during the first naval parade of the People's Navy; The Il-14 aircraft, which once ensured the participation of Navy Commander Xiao Jingguang in various activities and carried out important tasks such as transporting rescue personnel, supplies, and international friends; Meritorious artillery that participated in the aid to Vietnam and anti US air defense operations; The T-34 tank, which has been widely equipped with the Marine Corps and island guarding forces such as the Xisha Islands; The YJ-62A shore to ship missile launcher, which is used to block ports and sea routes, and maneuver to strike large and medium-sized surface targets, is a significant naval weapon and equipment. These weapons and equipment have played a significant role in tasks such as liberating coastal islands, safeguarding maritime security, and protecting people's lives and property. The Naval Museum will focus on inheriting the red genes, keeping in mind the original mission, strengthening historical memory, and exerting educational functions, striving to build a leading domestic and world leading naval museum. attractions.summary: Qinyu Road, located between Luxun Park and Little Qingdao in Shinan District, Qingdao, is a very artistic path with distinctive Qingdao characteristics. You can come here to relax.

attractions.name: 小青岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a treasure spot for strolling with kids.; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiao Qingdao is named for its shape, which resembles an ancient zither, and is also known as "Qin Island." The white conical lighthouse standing at the highest point is the landmark building.  
· At night, the red light on the lighthouse and the lights on the pier float on the turquoise waves, creating the scene known as "Qin Island Floating Lights," which is regarded as one of Qingdao's top ten scenic spots and has become one of the city's symbols.  
· Now open to the public as a park, the island is mainly planted with black pines, along with seasonal flowering ornamental plants.  
· On the relatively flat southern part of the island, there is a small square, in the center of which stands a sculpture of a woman holding a zither, facing the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the landmark lighthouse on Qingdao Island.

attractions.name: 第二海水浴场
attractions.summary: If you go south along Ningwu Pass Road to explore Badaguan, you will come to the second beach next to Huashi Tower. The bathhouse and Badaguan complement each other, forming a typical beautiful landscape of "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky" in Qingdao. Therefore, couples often take wedding photos here, making it a popular location for outdoor filming. The beach of the second bath is slightly smaller than the first beach, but there are fewer tourists here and the environment is better. The beach shore here is made of reddish brown rocks, with cliffs as steep as knives, and black pine trees planted all over the shore, creating a pleasant environment. Even if you come here to take a stroll and bask in the sun, it is still quite comfortable. And the seawater in the second bath is relatively clean, with small waves and gentle slopes, making it a summer swimming destination. There are many pebbles on the western beach of the bathhouse, and visitors often come to pick them up. Due to the abundance of reefs in this area, it is suitable for picking up shells, and even living creatures such as hermit crabs and starfish can be seen. The sandy beach here is relatively fine, so it is suitable for walking barefoot here, and children can also play digging sand. There is also a stone embankment bridge that extends into the sea, where you can walk and feel closer to the ocean.

attractions.name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.
attractions.shortFeatures: Decoding the Production Process of Tsingtao Beer

attractions.name: 八大关
