attractions.summary:
Badaguan refers to eight roads named after the eight passes of the Great Wall (now it has been increased to ten). Because there are villas with architectural styles from more than 20 countries, such as Russia, Britain, France, Germany and Mai, it is known as the "World Architecture Expo". 
Huashi Building and Princess Building in Guannei are the most famous, with unique architectural styles and need to charge tickets. They are must-punch places here. 
In addition to viewing buildings, you can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of Badaguan in the four seasons. Shaoguan Road is full of peaches, which bloom in spring; Lagerstroemia indica is planted all over Zhengguan Road, which blooms in summer; Juyongguan Road is a five-angled maple, which is dyed with maple red in autumn frost; There are rows of cedar trees on both sides of Zijingguan Road, which are evergreen all year round.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn viewing resort with red leaves in autumn

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 青山渔村
attractions.summary: Qingshan Fishing Village is located in Laoshan Scenic Area, Laoshan District, Qingdao. Halfway up the mountainside of Laoshan Mountain, it still retains the original style of the fishing village. It has the reputation of Laoshan Fishing Village Folk Customs Museum
attractions.shortFeatures: Featuring fisherman culture

attractions.name: 崂山太清游览区
attractions.summary: The Taiqing Scenic Area is located at the southeast end of Laoshan Mountain, named after the Taoist temple Taiqing Palace. It is mainly divided into two tourist areas: the surrounding area of Taiqing Palace and along the Bashui River. The former is located by the sea, while the latter is a hiking route. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".

attractions.name: 黄岛金沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 

attractions.summary:
Luoyang Museum echoes the landmark buildings of the city such as the Pearl TV Tower of the Central Plains. The shape of the new museum is like a big tripod, which means "Dingding Luoyi". 
· The museum consists of a main building and an auxiliary building. The main building has two floors. The first floor is a general exhibition, and the second floor is a boutique exhibition of the museum. 
· There are more than 11,000 pieces of cultural relics on display in the new museum. Besides the local unearthed cultural relics, it also accepted a number of treasures allocated by the Palace Museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate Rare Treasures and Taste Luoyang Ancient Capital Culture

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城应天门遗址
attractions.name_en: The Ruins of Yingtian Gate, Sui-Tang Luoyang City
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Historical ruins
attractions.summary: Ying Tian Gate was the main southern gate of Ziwei City, originally constructed in the first year of the Sui Dynasty's Daye era (605 AD). It was initially named Ze Tian Gate, but in the first year of the Shenlong era (705 AD), it was renamed Ying Tian Gate to avoid using Empress Wu Zetian's name. Later, it became known as the Five Phoenix Tower and endured through the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song Dynasty. Ying Tian Gate was an important venue for the imperial court to hold major state ceremonies and diplomatic events. These included significant occasions such as the Yuan Zheng (New Year's Day), the Winter Solstice, ceremonial music performances, banquets, amnesties, and the transition to a new year. During such events, including tributes from foreign envoys and dignitaries, the emperor would ascend the gate to listen to state affairs. Historical ceremonies such as Emperor Gaozong's capture of the Baekje king, Empress Wu Zetian's ascension to the throne, and Emperor Xuanzong's reception of Japan's eighth envoy to Tang China were all held on the Ying Tian Gate tower. Its function was similar to that of the Meridian Gate in modern Beijing. Ying Tian Gate was a massive architectural complex shaped like a "concave" character, consisting of a main gate tower, parapet walls, east and west watchtowers, and connecting corridors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Sui and Tang ruins, savor the culture of the ancient capital.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 白马寺
attractions.summary:
- The first temple built by the government after Buddhism was introduced to China, it is known as the "First Ancient Temple of China."
- The existing relics at the White Horse Temple date back to the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, and are all aligned along the north-south central axis.
- The Mahavira Hall is the main hall of the entire temple, with other major buildings including the Hall of Heavenly Kings, the Great Buddha Hall, and the Pilu Pavilion.
- The temple preserves a large number of rare Yuan dynasty sculptures, including statues of the Three Buddhas, the Two Heavenly Generals, and the Eighteen Arhats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Ancestral Grounds of Chinese Buddhism and the Tomb of Di Renjie

attractions.name: 神州牡丹园
attractions.summary:
Shenzhou Peony Garden, opposite the White Horse Temple, has a strong cultural atmosphere. There are many Tang Dynasty-style buildings and large-scale cultural performances about peony themes. Peony Garden consists of Peony Cultural Zone, High-tech Four-Season Peony Exhibition Zone, Peony Leisure Zone, Peony Viewing Zone and Commercial Peony Comprehensive Zone. 
In the garden, there are rare peony stones naturally formed in the world for hundreds of millions of years, the peony king with a tree age of more than 300 years, the world's longest 100-meter national quintessence corridor-Tang Sancai peony mural and the world's largest white marble statue of Ouyang Xiu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architectural style of prosperous Tang

attractions.name: 王城公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
Founded in 1955, it is named after its construction on the site of Wangcheng in the Eastern Zhou Dynasty. It is the largest comprehensive park in Luoyang. 
The park consists of several parts, such as ancient cultural area, peony garden, animal museum, etc., which not only has profound traditional artistic conception, but also has rich modern flavor. 
During the annual Peony Festival, Wangcheng Park is the best place to enjoy flowers in the ancient city.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the peony fair and enjoy the national color flowers
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-19:00(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 18:00)

attractions.name: 洛邑古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Luoyi Ancient City Scenic Spot is located in the old city of Luoyang City, Henan Province, and is known as the "Central Plains Ferry". Taking Wenfeng Pagoda, Confucian Temple, Tuoling Palace, Siyanjinghao and other protected sites in the park as nodes, and Xintan and moat system as links, the overall goal is to organically combine classical and modern buildings, so that old buildings and new buildings are not separated, which not only reflects the traditional cultural heritage of Luoyi Ancient City but also does not lose the modern flavor. The park is scientifically divided into functional areas, and the elegant demeanor of the Millennium Ancient City is concentrated. In the park, functional areas such as catering, tourism, accommodation, business services, etc. are dotted among them. The whole park has a strong cultural atmosphere step by step. It develops and inherits the original cultural landscape and cultural atmosphere of Luoyi Ancient City, making it a highlight of cultural relics protection, revival and inheritance of Luoyang traditional culture in Luoyang Ancient City. Relying on profound cultural heritage, Luoyi Ancient City allows the world to see the beauty of Chinese culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Precipitated the ancient capital culture of thirteen dynasties

attractions.name: 老君山景区
attractions.summary: According to legend, Laojun Mountain Scenic Area is the place where the founder of Taoism, Li Er (Laozi), retired and practiced. During the Northern Wei Dynasty, a temple was built in the mountain to commemorate him, and later it was honored as a "famous mountain in the world". It has always been a place of strong incense. The trees in the mountains are lush, the scenery is picturesque, and mountain springs can be seen everywhere. In the golden autumn, this is the best choice for surrounding areas to enjoy the red leaves. After the rain, Laojun Mountain is surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland in the sky. The scenic area is vast, mainly divided into the central Laojun Mountain main scenic area, the Dream Chasing Valley scenic area in the west, and the Zhaigou scenic area in the east. Generally, tourists spend a day exploring the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, which is also a well-developed region of the entire scenic area. If you go to the mountaintop, there is still a chance to enjoy the beautiful sea of clouds, sunrise, and sunset. The main scenic area of Laojun Mountain includes major attractions such as Zhongtianmen, Jinding, Laojun Temple, Nantianmen, Yuhuangding, and Mazongling. Since its establishment in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Laojun Temple has been the center of worship for pilgrims from the Central Plains; The Taoist temple at the Jade Emperor's Peak enshrines the Jade Emperor, which is also a great place for mountain viewing; Jinding and Mazongling are great places to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds. Recommended itinerary: A one-day tour to explore the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain is the choice of most tourists. Roughly speaking, the route is as follows: Lingguan Hall - Laojun Statue at the foot of the mountain - Linqi Hall - Zhongtian Gate - Linyin Trail - Woyun Pine - Bodhisattva Hall - Laojun Temple, Jinding - Yuhuangding, and then return to the original route. Tourists can choose to visit Laojun Mountain on foot or by "walking+cableway" depending on their own situation. Between the Lingguan Hall at the foot of the mountain and the Zhongtian Gate on the mountainside, there is the Zhongling Cableway in the scenic area. Take the Zhongling Cableway and then walk from Zhongtianmen to the Jade Emperor Peak at the top of the mountain. The road from Zhongtianmen to the top is not very steep and usually takes about an hour to complete. If you have plenty of time, you can spend two days exploring Laojun Mountain. The approximate itinerary is as follows: D1： Visit the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain and stay overnight in the mountains. D2： From the top of Laojun Mountain, choose to descend from the Dream Chasing Valley in the west or the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, and reach the west and east gates of the scenic area respectively. In the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, accommodation is available near Zhongtianmen on the mountainside and Laojun Temple on the mountaintop. There are hotels near Zhongtianmen with good accommodation conditions, while the accommodation conditions around Laojun Temple are relatively poor. If you are planning to go to the mountaintop the next morning to watch the sunrise, then you can stay around the Laojun Temple. Compared to the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, the mountain roads in Chasing Dreams Valley are smoother, and tourists can choose one of them to descend according to their preferences. There are multiple places in the entire scenic area that can provide catering services for tourists, but some road signs in the scenic area are not yet very complete, so tourists need to pay more attention when playing. attractions.name: 龙门石窟
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Grottoes; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves in China, with a long history, the construction spanned multiple dynasties and lasted for over 500 years.
- Among the numerous caves carved during the Northern Wei period, the Ancient Yang Cave, the Central Cave of Binyang, the Lotus Cave, and the Cave Temple are the most representative.
- There are more than 97,000 Buddha statues in total, with the Western Mountain Caves being the most refined part, including the Luoshen Buddha statue and the "Twenty Images of Longmen."
- Among the key caves of the Tang Dynasty Longmen Grottoes, the grand and imposing group sculptures of the Great Luoshen Buddha are the most famous.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves of China

Located in the reclamation area on the north side of Haikou, facing Qiongzhou Strait, it is the largest open tropical seaside ecological garden landscape garden in Haikou. 
· Many tropical ornamental plants are planted in Wanlv Garden, which integrates clear water and blue sky with high-rise buildings. 
The 16 scenic spots and many surrounding supporting facilities in the park are complete. It is a large park for Haikou citizens to exercise in the morning and take a walk in the evening.

attractions.name: 西秀海滩公园
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Surf; Beaches; Surfing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Xixiu Beach, formerly known as Haikou Xiuying Beach, is about 6 kilometers away from the city center, with a coastline length of about 1,200 meters, which is close to Holiday Beach. Xixiu Beach was rated as one of the "Eight Scenic Spots in Haikou" by Haikou citizens in 1980s. In 1986, the State Sports Commission designated it as the only national sailing and windsurfing winter training base in China, and trained many Asian Games champions, world medalists and Atlanta Olympic champion Hong Kong athlete Li Lishan, such as Qi Guojian and Li Ke.
attractions.shortFeatures: A coastal tourist destination where sailing is popular

attractions.name: 观海台
attractions.summary: Guanhai Terrace is located in the west of Haikou City, between Xixiu Beach and Holiday Beach. Here, you can overlook the seascape of Qiongzhou Strait and have a panoramic view of Haikou Bay to the east. This place is rugged with rocks, and it is called "the sea is dry and the rocks are rotten". Because of its artistic conception, it has become the location of many wedding photography.
attractions.shortFeatures: Popular places for wedding shooting at the seaside

attractions.name: 骑楼老街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street

attractions.name: 琼台书院
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Historic buildings; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary: Qiongtai Academy is located on the campus of Qiongtai Teachers College, Zhongshan Road, Fucheng Town, Haikou City, about 4 kilometers away from the city center. It is a typical Lingnan architectural layout. The main building "Kuixing Building" is a brick and wood structure with green tiles and red corridors, which is well preserved. On the first floor, the plaque reads "Lecture Hall", and there is a couplet, "The trees are old and the flowers are tender, and the branches melt in spring". When you enter the door, there is another couplet, "Raise the righteousness of Gan Kun and cultivate the talents of the world". On the second floor, one side is the master's bedroom, the other side is the study room, and the middle is the master's living room. The whole building is carved with beams and painted buildings, and the front of the building is lined with trees. There are two statues of Zhang Yuesong, the teacher of the academy, and Xie Bao, the scholar.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where the story of Cantonese opera "Searching for the Academy" takes place

attractions.name: 五公祠
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
Wugong Temple Complex is located at No.169 Haifu Avenue, Haikou City, about 5 kilometers away from the city center. Near the downtown area, it is unique and quiet, and is known as "Qiongtai Scenic Spot", "Yinghai Humanities" and "Hainan's No.1 Scenic Spot". The building complex of Wugong Temple includes: the first floor of Hainan (also known as Wugong Temple), Xuepu Hall, Guanjia Hall, Xizhai (Wugong Jingshe), Dongzhai, Su Gong Temple, Liangfubo Temple, Dongzhuo Pavilion, Fusu Spring, Qiongyuan and the newly-built Wugong Temple Exhibition Hall. 
Wugong Temple is a cultural relic and historic site that displays ancient Chinese demotion culture, Hainan history and culture and ancient architectural art with Hainan characteristics. "Wugong Temple" is the general name of a group of ancient buildings, covering an area of about 100 mu together with gardens, wells and ponds. It was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, rebuilt in the 15th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1889), and then repaired many times, and it is still shining brightly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding the ancient culture of official demotion in ancient buildings

attractions.name: 海南省博物馆
attractions.summary:
Hainan Museum is located at 68 Guoxing Avenue, Haikou City, covering an area of over 60 mu, with a construction area of 44,500 square meters, an exhibition hall area of 12,000 square meters, and a storage area of 9,300 square meters. It is one of the major cultural construction projects of Hainan Province during the "12th Five-Year Plan" period and has been rated as one of the six most beautiful buildings in Hainan.

The preparation of Hainan Museum began in 1984. The first phase was completed and opened on November 15, 2008, and the second phase fully opened on May 18, 2017. It is a comprehensive museum in Hainan Province and a national first-class museum.

The exhibitions of Hainan Museum are systematically curated with the theme "Nanmeng Qidian" ("The Marvelous Land of the Southern Sea"). The exhibitions consist of three major permanent displays: "Voyage through the Southern Sea: Marine Civilization of the South China Sea," "Frontiers of a Unique Land: Hainan History," and "Between the Mortal and the Divine: Hainan Culture." Additionally, there are two special exhibitions: "The Queen of Wood: Hainan Huanghuali Wood" and "The King of Fragrance: Hainan Agarwood," as well as four intangible cultural heritage exhibitions: "Qiong Workshop: Hainan Traditional Handicrafts," "Qiong Delicacies Street: Hainan Culinary Culture," "Qiong Ethnic Village: Hainan Minority Intangible Cultural Heritage," and "Qiong Stage: Hainan Performing Arts." 

This comprehensive exhibition system vividly brings to life the marvelous Hainan scenery described in Ming Dynasty scholar Qiu Jun's essay *Ode to the Marvelous Land of the Southern Sea* for the public to appreciate.
attractions.shortFeatures: A comprehensive understanding of Hainan's history and culture

attractions.name: 海口云洞图书馆
attractions.summary: The Yundong Library is located adjacent to the sea, with a total area of over 700 square meters. The library has a wide variety of books, including a reading area, terrace, and coffee shop.

attractions.name: 鼓楼
attractions.summary:
One of the landmark buildings in Beijing, the ancient capital, is a group of ancient buildings located at the northern end of Beijing's north-south central axis, located at the northern end of Di'anmenwai Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing. 
The Bell and Drum Tower originated in the Han Dynasty. According to historical records, there was a morning drum and evening bell system in the Han Dynasty, in which "beating the drum at dawn to urge people to get up and ringing the bell at night to urge people to rest". The two floors are placed vertically in front and back, magnificent and majestic. 
As the time telling center of the capitals of Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Bell and Drum Tower has a very important position. The two buildings are placed vertically in front and back, which is magnificent and magnificent. 
In the establishment history of the city's bell and drum tower, Beijing's bell and drum tower is the largest in scale and the tallest in shape, and it is also an important building that witnessed the history of China in the past hundred years.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness China's century-old history and culture

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 王府井
attractions.summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing

attractions.name: 天安门城楼
attractions.summary:
· Tiananmen Gate Tower is located at the northern end of Tiananmen Square, on the central axis of Beijing. It is one of the most magnificent towers in ancient China and a place that every tourist who comes to Beijing must not miss. 
· On Tiananmen Square, you can see the standing Tiananmen Gate Tower from a distance. When you walk to the foot of the tower, the red tower seen countless times in textbooks and TV is close at hand. 
· The interior of the tower is antique. You can visit the living room of that year, as well as graphic and text exhibitions, and you can learn about the evolution of Tiananmen Square in various periods and the important activities held here. 
Many tourists imitate Chairman Mao's classic waving gesture at the founding ceremony and take photos here, which gives them a very wonderful sense of crossing and national pride. 
· It is also worth mentioning that the night view of the Tiananmen Gate Tower is also very beautiful. When the lanterns are first turned on, the landscape lights on the tower, which complement other buildings in Tiananmen Square, making it particularly magnificent.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Off season 08:30-15:30,Opens at Peak season 08:30-16:30

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 人民英雄纪念碑
attractions.summary:
· The Monument to the People's Heroes is located in the center of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, the capital, and was built to commemorate the revolutionary martyrs in modern Chinese history.  
The whole Hero Monument is carved with more than 170 figures, which summarizes and vividly shows the great historical facts of the people's revolution in China in the past hundred years. 
On the front of the tablet, there are eight characters "People's Heroes Live Forever" inscribed by Chairman Mao himself, and on the back there is an inscription drafted by Chairman Mao and written by Premier Zhou Enlai. 
· This is the memory of the older generation and the study place of the younger generation. When you come to Tiananmen Square, you will definitely come here to commemorate it.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the symbol buildings of the motherland

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 雍和宫
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast corner of the inner city of Dongcheng District, Beijing, that is, east of Yonghegong Street Road, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist temple in Beijing. 
In the thirty-second year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it became the residence of Yinzhen, the fourth son of the emperor. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Zhaotai Gate, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, Yonghe Gate, Lama Temple, Lecture Hall and Tantric Hall present the standard layout of "seven halls and blue blues" in Chinese Buddhist temples. 
· From the east-west memorial archway with cornices and arches to the antique east-west Shunshan Tower, there are more than a thousand halls in total, which are very luxurious and worth visiting
attractions.shortFeatures: Lived in two emperors Yongzheng and Qianlong

restaurants.name_en: Houhai Old Beijing Hutong Hot Pot

attractions.name: 天津博物馆
attractions.summary:
The predecessor of Tianjin Museum can be traced back to the Tianjin Museum established in 1918. Although it was newly built in recent years and has lost a lot of ancient flavor, it is still the main place to inherit the local history and culture of Tianjin. 
There are 4 floors in the museum. The first floor is "The Origin of Tianjin Humanities", the second floor is the exhibition of fine cultural relics, the third floor is "A Hundred Years of China Seeing Tianjin", and the fourth floor is the painting and calligraphy exhibition. Learn about the historical changes, local culture, etc. of the entire Tianjin here, and the treasures of the town hall such as Fan Kuan's "Snow Scene and Cold Forest Picture" axis in the Northern Song Dynasty, the enamel colored peony and young chicken pattern jade pot spring bottle in the Qing Qianlong Dynasty, the Taibao tripod in the Western Zhou Dynasty, and the topaz pig dragon will also make it worth your trip. Various themed exhibitions will be held from time to time.

attractions.name: 天津美术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary: Tianjin Art Museum is one of the most modern art exhibition halls in China. It is located at the intersection of Youyi Road and Pingjiang Road in Hexi District, Tianjin, at the core of the cultural square, with a total construction area of 28,000 square meters. It is built near the lake, with a simple and elegant appearance, full of modern flavor and perfect internal facilities.

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 庆王府
attractions.summary: The Prince Qing's Mansion is a historical building located in both Beijing and Tianjin. The Qingwang Mansion Boutique Cultural Hotel Area consists of an "Urban Cultural Heritage Club" and a "Villa style Historical and Cultural Theme Hotel", and is a comprehensive cultural tourism, business conference, and leisure vacation community. Qingwangfu Mansion is a villa style historical and cultural themed hotel in Tianjin. Its predecessor was the "Shanyili" English style alleyway residential complex built in 1937. It has 16 sets of townhouse style hotel suites and 17 sets of hotel style apartments. After two years of careful renovation, it fully preserves the architectural style of sloping red tiles and sulfur tank brick walls, as well as the dense and orderly block texture. Each villa room comes with its own courtyard, providing guests with a private and peaceful living experience away from the world. The main building of Qingwang Mansion features elegant and distinctive Chinese and Western style private rooms, offering a feast of Chinese, Western, and Asian cuisine. The atrium of the main building is a sky covered shared hall, where guests can relax and enjoy a cup of afternoon tea. Standing on the rooftop terrace of the third floor, you can have a bird's-eye view of the rows of modern Western style buildings on the Five Avenues, experiencing the tranquility and elegance that once belonged to the early 20th century. Experience the unique historical charm and cultural atmosphere of the Qingwang Mansion in Tianjin, and enjoy a special cocktail in the evening, allowing guests to enjoy a romantic and comfortable slow paced life after busy work. At the caf é located in the courtyard, you can enjoy a leisurely afternoon tea, coffee, pastries, and French light meals while admiring the beautiful scenery of the small bridge, flowing water, and lush greenery. The red bar and cigar shop specially set up in the annex have a leisurely feeling of being away from the hustle and bustle. Full text 

attractions.name: 新民园广场
attractions.summary: The newly built Tianjin Minyuan Square has a surface area of 22500 square meters and an underground area of 47500 square meters, continuing to retain the sports and fitness functions of the original Minyuan Sports Stadium. The square has added new functions such as tourism and leisure, cultural and museum exhibitions, and specialty catering, and has become the core scenic area and distribution center of the Five Avenues Cultural Tourism Zone together with the surrounding Qingwang Mansion, Xiannong Business and Tourism Area, and Minyuan Xili Cultural and Creative Block.

attractions.name: 西开教堂
attractions.summary: The Xikai Church is located at the southern end of the bustling Binjiang Road commercial street. It was founded in 1917 and is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Tianjin. The architectural style of the church is solemn and grand, and the sculptures inside the church are also complex and exquisite. In addition, Mass and Catholic holiday activities are open to the public, allowing participants to experience the strong religious atmosphere. The exterior of the church is made of red and yellow flower bricks, with three towers arranged in a cross shape and towering into the clouds covered with green copper sheets. After years of erosion, the mottled green shines with a sense of history under the sunshine, and each tower has a bronze cross on its top. Entering the church, the first thing that catches the eye is the main color scheme composed of lake blue, white, and light yellow, giving a fresh feeling. Various patterns are carved in just the right positions, and 14 columns are arranged from the doorway to the altar, exuding an extraordinary aura. There are exquisite copper statues of believers around the church, and oil paintings depicting the story of Jesus' suffering are hung on the walls. Inside the church, there are also colorful statues of the Virgin Mary, Jesus, angels, and others. In addition, the stained glass windows are also very charming. On one side of the church, you will find a small wooden room with a small cross on top, which is a "confession pavilion" used by priests to receive believers for confession and confession. The mass event of Xikai Church is open to the public, and non believers can also participate. However, during the mass time, visitors cannot wander around the church. They should sit quietly in the back row, not make loud noises or take photos, and feel the inner peace in the bustling city. In addition, there are also many Catholic holiday activities that are open to the public, just like Mass. The specific times for Mass and Catholic holiday events can be found on the official website. attractions.name: 滨江道商业街
attractions.summary: Binjiang Road Commercial Street is one of the bustling commercial streets in Tianjin. It starts from the seaside and extends southwest to Nanjing Road, with a total length of 2094 meters. This street not only has shops such as Quanye Chang, Zhongyuan Company, Daoxiangcun Food Store, Hengdeli Watch Store, Guangming Cinema, Dengyinglou Restaurant, but also newly built shopping malls (Binjiang Shopping Mall, Geely Building, International Shopping Mall, etc.) and shops. In April 1987, after the section from Shandong Road to Nanjing Road was converted into a small commodity market, individual stalls sprung up like mushrooms on the western section of Binjiang Road. Tourists flowed in all day long, and at night, colorful lights shone, becoming a new scenery of Jinmen Night Market.

attractions.name: 天津劝业场
attractions.summary: Quanye Chang was completed and opened in 1928. In 1931, the sixth and seventh floors were added as entertainment facilities such as theaters, making it a traditional shopping mall in Tianjin. Quanyechang was once a large shopping mall in Tianjin, as well as a large commercial and entertainment district, which is a symbol of Tianjin's commerce. It is now one of the three major retail department stores in Tianjin and one of the top ten shopping malls in the country. Quanye Market operates a variety of 30000 products, with channels covering the whole country, and is known for its complete range of small commodities. The Quanyechang was designed by architect Mu Le from the French firm Yonghe Engineering Company. The architectural form is a classical compromise style, and the old building has a magnificent and towering momentum, and has been listed as an excellent modern building by the country.

attractions.name: 津湾广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jinwan Square is located beside the Haihe River, opposite Tianjin Station across the Haihe River. It is one of the most prosperous areas in Tianjin. 
The biggest highlight is its cultural heritage. The diverse composition of Tianjin's modern architectural style highlights the characteristics of the times when Chinese and western cultures converge.  
In addition, it is also the best place to enjoy the day and night scenery of Haihe River. The tall buildings backed by it are a bustling modern city, which is gorgeous and charming when lit at night. 
The European buildings around the square and on both sides of the river also constitute the whole landscape, which is one of the iconic viewing spots in Tianjin.
attractions.shortFeatures: The bustling area of Tianjin with charming night scene

attractions.name: 解放桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jiefang Bridge is a hub bridge connecting Hebei, Hedong and Heping districts and communicating with tianjin railway station. 
· Originally known as "Wanguo Bridge", it was known as "a country within a country" because there was a concession of nine countries in Tianjin at that time. After the liberation of Tianjin, this bridge was renamed "Jiefang Bridge". 
· Jiefang Bridge will be opened during important festivals. When the bridge opens, luxury yachts will sail across the opened Jiefang Bridge, accompanied by the colorful Haihe River, which is intoxicating and the most beautiful time. 
If you are lucky, you may even meet the scene of taking wedding photos in the middle of Jiefang Bridge while stopping at the red light, which is novel and interesting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Tianjin

attractions.name: 世纪钟广场
attractions.summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark building in Tianjin next to the railway station

attractions.name: 国家海洋博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary: The main building of the National Museum of Marine Science and Technology has 3 floors, with some areas extending to 4 floors. The exhibition hall covers an area of approximately 23,000 square meters and is divided into six major exhibition zones, including: the Marine Nature Exhibition Zone, the Chinese Marine Civilization Exhibition Zone, the Marine Interactive Exhibition Zone, the Education and Public Outreach Center, the Marine Ecology Exhibition Zone, and the High-End Cooperation and Temporary Exhibition Zone. The museum also features public service facilities such as a museum shop, restaurant, café, and cinema. The National Museum of Marine Science and Technology will present Earth, the ocean, life, humans, and their interdependent and symbiotic systems, revealing the true meaning of harmony between humanity and the sea, guiding the public to better understand, love, and protect the ocean.

attractions.name: 泰达航母主题公园
attractions.tag: Parenting Treasure Spot; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
- A large military-themed park integrating eight major sections, including sightseeing, themed performances, and entertainment, based on the Soviet aircraft carrier "Kiev."
- The ship features dozens of attractions, such as the combat command center, intelligence room, aircraft carrier technology museum, history of naval ship development, sailor tilt room, and the Warrior's Corridor.
- Whether standing beside it or entering its interior, one can feel the overwhelming impact of the massive steel structure! It is perfect for military enthusiasts.
- The park also includes the World Aircraft Carrier Museum, weapon model exhibition, Expo Tianjin Pavilion, dock square, 4D cinema, and many other attractions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the aircraft carrier to watch the combat performance.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. attractions.summary:
· The barracks, built in 1925, have a wide playground and two tall three-story sloping-roofed buildings at right angles, with corridors more than ten feet wide in front of each floor. The building is magnificent and unique in style. It is well preserved so far, but it also reveals a magnificent and twisting. When tourists stop here, their feelings must be complicated. 
This ancient Romanesque building is located in a very inconspicuous alley. It is one of the largest buildings in the original concession. It is also the only preserved foreign barracks in the Nine-Kingdom Garrison Barracks in Tianjin, and the only completely preserved building of its kind in the country. 
It is said that when Pu Yi was in Tianjin, he visited the barracks to "inspect" and left a photo that can be seen in the exhibition room in Jingyuan.

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

Nowadays, "tasting the 'Three Wonders of Tianjin' and listening to teahouse cross-talk" has become a nationwide sensation. On stage, there was a piece of sobering wood, a folding fan, and a handkerchief. The actors were dressed in long robes and jackets, with their mouths flowing and their witty words echoing. Dozens or even hundreds of audience members were sipping tea and cracking melon seeds, laughing and applauding incessantly.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 重庆云端之眼观景台
attractions.summary: Standing higher, seeing more fully, the scenery varies by height, infinite scenery is in the sky. The "Top of Mountain City, Eye of Chongqing" Yangtze River Cableway High altitude Observation Deck is a gathering place for urban landscapes from the perspective of God. It is a popular photo spot in the Chongqing photography circle and has "Cloud Radio" and "Cloud Prayer" projects. From the indoor observation deck on the 67th floor and the apron observation deck on the 69th floor, you can enjoy a 360 ° panoramic view of Chongqing's forests and the scenery of the two rivers and four banks without any blind spots. During the day, looking up at the vast blue sky and bowing down to the continuous buildings; At night, the starry sky above and the lights of thousands of homes below provide visitors with a unique viewing experience of the Sky City "Skywalker".

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

The night view of the Two Rivers in Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous Chongqing night view. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. attractions.summary: Tengwang Pavilion, located by the city and facing the river, is known as the "first tower of the Xijiang River". For thousands of years, people have been intoxicated by the beautiful scenery of the Gan River, where "the sunset and solitary geese fly together, and the autumn water flows in the same color as the sky". In recent years, Nanchang City has built two cities in the north and south with the Gan River as the main axis. "One River, Two Banks" is not only a landmark landscape of modern Nanchang, but also an indispensable landscape element for visiting the Gan River. In order to further enhance the image of Nanchang as a historical and cultural city in China, meet the development needs of Nanchang as a tourist city, and facilitate the general public and domestic and foreign tourists to appreciate the charming scenery of Nanchang such as "famous city, famous river, famous building, famous scenery", greatly improve the quality of tourists' sightseeing, and enrich the content of tourists' sightseeing. The LED walls of 296 high-rise buildings along the Yangtze River form a giant screen, setting a Guinness record. Every night at 8:30, a spectacular light show is staged, taking you to experience the charm of Nanchang. Southeast Huaguang. attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 万寿宫历史文化街区
attractions.summary: The Wanshou Palace Historical and Cultural District showcases the architectural style and historical culture of the Jiangyou ethnic group. Here, tourists can stroll through retro style shops, taste snacks from the 1980s and 1990s, and reminisce about the past.

attractions.name: 绳金塔
attractions.tag: Monuments and ruins; historical buildings; Ancient Pagodas; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Shengjin Tower is located on the east side of Shengjin Tower Street in the Xihu District of Nanchang City, originally outside the ancient city’s Jinxiang Gate. It was first built during the Tang Dynasty, in the Tianyou period (904–907 AD). According to legend, before the tower was constructed, a monk named Weiyi dug the ground and found an iron box containing four golden ropes, three ancient swords (inscribed with the words "Drive Wind," "Pacify Fire," and "Subdue Dragon"), and a golden bottle filled with 300 relics, which is how the tower got its name.

· The Shengjin Tower is a typical brick-and-wood structure in Jiangnan, designed in a pagoda style. It stands approximately 50.86 meters tall and consists of seven levels and eight sides (with seven visible levels and eight hidden levels). The tower features red railings, blue tiles, black corners, clean walls, and a gourd-shaped copper roof with strong religious significance. It has graceful flying eaves, with copper bells hanging from them (recast using ancient bell-making techniques to create wind chimes, with seven layers producing seven different tones). The gourd-shaped copper roof shines brilliantly in gold, with the body of the tower adorned in red railings, blue tiles, and black corners, creating an elegant, simple, and timeless appearance. Each level of the tower has four real doorways and four false doorways, arranged in a staggered manner between levels, with each level’s doors differing in design. The Shengjin Tower is both ancient and beautiful, embodying the typical artistic style of Jiangnan architecture. Having been built during the Tang Dynasty over a thousand years ago, it serves as a carrier of historical information and a testament to the wisdom of generations of laboring people. Shengjin Tower is often referred to as "Water and Fire Harmonized, Overlooking Jiangcheng."
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient pagoda, originally built during the Tang Dynasty in the Tianyou era.

The world's largest clock will also be installed, with 60 space capsules representing a 60-minute time scale. The Ferris wheel will adopt dual power supply and dual power system to ensure the safety of tourists.
