attractions.name: 南昌海洋公园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Nanchang Ocean Park is a large-scale modern ocean park covering an area of 40 mu. The total length of the undersea tunnel of Nanchang Ocean Park is 74 meters, with more than 800 species of marine life and more than 10,000 tails. Nanchang Ocean Park is one of the largest marine aquariums in China and is known as Nanchang Ocean Zoo and Nanchang Aquarium. Ocean Park is a large-scale modern ocean park invested, designed and built by Hangzhou Underwater World Science Popularization Co., Ltd. The first phase of the marine aquarium has a total investment of 100 million yuan, covering an area of 40 mu, a building area of 12,000 square meters, a total water body of more than 5,000 tons, a total length of 74 meters of undersea tunnel, more than 800 species of marine life and more than 10,000 animals (tails). It is one of the largest marine aquariums in China. (1) The Freshwater Biological Museum of Ocean Park displays nearly a hundred kinds of tropical freshwater ornamental fish: ferocious silver pomfret, precious Chinese sturgeon, huge walrus... The mysterious Yama brings you infinite reverie from the forest scenery. (2) The lively and lovely seals and dolphin "actors" in the sea animal and dolphin performance theater perform spiritual programs such as header and skateboarding for you, which makes people laugh. (3) Hundreds of colorful and shaped coral reef fish in the Coral Reef Biological Museum, such as the overbearing cannonball fish, the lazy sucker fish, and the boxy papaya fish, swim in the flowery coral clusters. The unique charming scenery of the tropical coral sea makes people fascinated and linger. (4) Ocean Park Cross-Harbour Tunnel Pavilion is located in a dark underwater passage, and the super monster sharks and rays in the depths of the seabed near Bermuda are close at hand, which is thrilling. (5) The Ocean Theater of Nanchang Ocean Park performs large-scale performances such as human turtles, human sharks dancing together, and thousands of fish competing for food. (6) The Ocean Folk Museum of the park has participatory projects such as "Picking Shellfish on the Beach", "DIY Area for Weaving Fish Nets", "Multimedia Science Popularization Area" and "Fish Pond". (7) Park Ocean Restaurant provides all kinds of quick and delicious Chinese and western meals with children, which you will definitely like. (8) The souvenir mall is full of exquisite gifts with various ocean themes, which adds to the enrichment and joy of the journey. attractions.summary:
· Blurred Manor is a unique theme park in Hong Kong Disneyland, which opened on May 17th, 2013. The main amusement facility in the area is Blurred Mansion. 
· The story tells the story of a British explorer who is also an adventurer. Sir Henry, a member of the Explorers Institute, set up a mansion in the tropical rainforest and turned the basement into a museum for guests to visit. Different collections are displayed in the museum. 
· "Blurred Manor" is also known as one of the most complex amusement facilities in Disney history, and it is also the last project in the existing expansion plan of Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors will experience an audio-visual feast with sound, smell and somatosensory here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the blurred mansion

attractions.name: 明日世界
attractions.summary:
The new design and feeling of Tomorrowland in Hong Kong Disneyland are completely different from other theme parks. Walt Disney Fantasy Project has created the whole park into a galaxy space port dedicated to exploring the adventures and experiences of space odyssey. 
Every amusement facility, shop and restaurant are decorated with robots, spaceships and floating stars, and will become a part of the spaceport. 
· You can experience a time and space journey over Space Mountain, or you can take a flying saucer back and forth to space amusement facilities Space flying saucer.
attractions.shortFeatures: Star Wars Speed Shuttle is exciting and enjoyable

attractions.name: 反斗奇兵大本营
attractions.summary:
· This is the first theme park of "Anti-Fighting Base Camp" in Asia. 
Taking the movie "Raiders 3" as the backbone, all kinds of super-giant toys are placed in the area, and passengers are in it, such as becoming dwarfs. 
· There are three mobile games in the area: one is that guests take a bumpy ride on facilities like "dachshunds"; Another facility is a shuttle car, which picks up guests quickly back and forth along a U-shaped track with a height of tens of feet; Finally, there is a "skydiving" training tour, where guests can feel the speed of plunging down from a 25-meter platform according to their preferences.
attractions.shortFeatures: Skyward remote control car

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园登山缆车
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Ocean Park cable car is a classic facility of the Ocean Park, taking visitors leisurely back and forth between the seaside amusement park at the foot of the mountain and the peak amusement park on the mountain. Passengers can slowly climb up the green hills in the sea breeze, fully enjoy the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, and have a panoramic view of various attractions in the Ocean Park, planning their next stop itinerary carefully.

attractions.name: 摩天巨轮
attractions.summary: The Ferris wheel is located in the Ocean Park. Visitors can take the Ferris wheel to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Ocean Park and the vast ocean.

attractions.name: 长洲岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
· Cheung Chau Island is located between Lantau Island and Lamma Island. Cheung Chau is called Cheung Chau because of its long and narrow island shape, large at both ends and thin in the middle. 
· This is the most densely populated island in the outlying islands district. It is one of the few places in Hong Kong that maintains the characteristics of an old fishing port and lives leisurely. 
Hong Kong film and television dramas are often shot here, retaining the traditional style and having the charm of old villages. This is also the hometown of McDull.
attractions.shortFeatures: Play on the beach, watch the sunset and eat seafood food stalls

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

restaurants.name_en: Cheung Chau Island Pier Food Stall

attractions.name: 大湾区一号(港珠澳大桥航线)
attractions.summary: This is a brand new sea route to check-in on the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge. It departs from Shekou Port and takes 180 minutes to cross the bottom of the bridge twice. Visitors can visit the Qingzhou Channel where a large cruise ship crosses the bridge, as well as beautiful attractions such as Lingding Island, the west artificial island of the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, and Shekou Homeport. In the past, when visiting the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, we needed to take a boat to Zhuhai, which is now within reach and very convenient. The important facilities of the No.1 cruise ship in the Greater Bay Area, China's first comprehensive bay area cruise ship, and China's first oil electric hybrid, luxury catamaran passenger ship, have all achieved "Made in China" cruise ships using innovative IoT networking technology, with features such as low noise and zero emissions, energy conservation and environmental protection, and technological innovation. Delivered for use in August 2020, the cruise ship integrates multiple functions, including a sightseeing area, exhibition area, atrium, technology store, multi-functional room, theater and other leisure and entertainment areas. The cruise ship is 72 meters long and 19 meters wide, with a maximum passenger capacity of 350 people. It has three spacious decks, with the top deck meeting the outdoor sightseeing needs of tourists. The upper deck has a sightseeing corridor for circumnavigation, the exhibition area has a cruise ship simulation driving teaching area, technology store and science classroom, restaurant and wine bar. The main deck has a theater for holding events, conferences, exhibitions, salons, etc. The main deck also has a luxurious private room that can accommodate 10-15 people for business banquets and small gatherings. The main deck also has a large restaurant that can be used for various banquet activities. The bottom cabin of the ship is also... There is a buffet room available to meet the dining needs of 150 people simultaneously.

attractions.name: 伶仃洋
attractions.summary: Lingding Bay, also known as Lingding Bay and the Pearl River Estuary, is a trumpet shaped estuary with a wide water area.

attractions.name: 海上世界
attractions.tag: Amusement and entertainment; Night tour viewing; Recreation Centers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Sea World, known as "Minghua Wheel", is a maritime multi-functional entertainment center with 10,000-ton wheels as the main body. 
· Anchored at Liuwan on the coast of Shekou, Deng Xiaoping stayed here when he inspected Shekou, and wrote the inscription "Sea World" for the ship. 
There are also scenic spots such as Nuwa Binhai Park, 15-kilometer coastal promenade, Time Square, China Merchants History Museum, Tianhou Temple, Left Fort, Song Shaodi Mausoleum, and Lin Zexu Bronze Statue.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cruise Ship Transformed Food and Entertainment Center

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园-观桥公园
attractions.summary: Guanqiao Park is located in Nanshan District, Shenzhen, opposite the sports park of Shenzhen Bay Park across the bridge. The park is very large, with different themes and landscapes. It is a park composed of coastal green spaces and boardwalks.

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园-日出剧场
attractions.summary: Shenzhen Bay Park Area C - Sunrise Theater is located within Shenzhen Bay Park, facing east and with an open area, making it a great viewing spot for beautiful sunrises.

attractions.name: 深圳平安金融中心云际观光层
attractions.name_en: Ping An Finance Center Sky Observation Deck, Shenzhen
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Observation deck
attractions.summary: FREE SKY Cloud Sightseeing Floor is located on the 116th floor of Ping An Financial Center, the fourth tallest building in the world. It is proud of Shenzhen's new landmark at an altitude of about 547.6 meters, and has a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Shenzhen's different landscapes and urban features in all directions. The cloud sightseeing layer integrates sightseeing and entertainment, cultural creativity and popular science education, and is a new landmark of urban sightseeing with cultural connotation. At the same time, the sightseeing floor is connected with a huge transportation network and rich tourist lines, which will become an unmissable choice for many tourists to visit Shenzhen. The sightseeing floor covers a number of functional spaces, such as transparent viewing spots, interactive experience areas, characteristic exhibition areas, etc., and displays the young culture with rich Shenzhen characteristics with advanced intelligent multimedia facilities. This is an excellent place to taste the prosperity and natural reflection of Shenzhen. You can enjoy the unique experience of enjoying the city scenery at Dapeng Fuyun, and the 360-degree cloud overview is shocking.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the suspended observation platform with a bird's-eye view of Shenzhen and Hong Kong

attractions.name: 东部华侨城大侠谷
attractions.summary: Daxia Valley is a theme park located within the OCT scenic area in eastern Shenzhen, and is also one of its core tourist areas. Daxia Valley is a fusion of natural scenery and thrilling amusement projects, making it a choice for young people to gather and travel. It usually takes one day to visit the Great Xia Valley. It is recommended to take the jungle cable car to the Cloud Sea Highland after entering the scenic spot in the morning. This is the essence of the Great Xia Valley. The 110 meter high Natural Eye Observation Tower on the Cloud Sea Plateau and the "Peak of Extreme" all glass observation deck extending beyond the cliff offer panoramic views of the entire Eastern Overseas Chinese Town, making it the observation deck of the Great Hero Valley. After playing on the mountain, take the Cloud Sea Cableway down the mountain to the Ecological Canyon at noon or afternoon. This is a place where thrilling and exciting amusement projects are concentrated, including rapids, wooden roller coasters, 4000 miles from the center of the earth, deep-sea exploration, hurricane rescue, jungle shuttle, phantom whirlwind, children's amusement park, mountain and sea mysterious realm performances, etc. Among them, the most exciting ones are the wooden roller coasters and rapids. After playing exciting amusement projects, continue walking and you will come to Haifeide (a small town). Haifeide (a small town) is a characteristic block with the theme of world wine culture. The buildings in the town are full of exotic charm, and there are many copper sculptures related to wine on the street. Full text 

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路
attractions.summary: Lihuangpi Road and Huangpi Road are the same road. Lihuangpi Road, with a total length of 604 meters, was built in 1900 (the 26th year of Guangxu) and was built by Huangpi people, hence the name Huangpi Road. Later, it was assigned to the Russian Concession in Hankou, which was called Yima Road. Located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Because Li Yuanhong, the two presidents of the Republic of China, was a native of Huangpi, Wuhan, and was known as Li Huangpi, this road was renamed Li Huangpi Road in 1946. Lihuangpi Road is a famous "slow life" block in Wuhan, which is a continuation of Hankou's spirit and temperament.
attractions.shortFeatures: Literary and retro slow life block

attractions.name: 巴公房子
attractions.summary: Bagong House is located at No. 86 Poyang Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Around 1901, the Ba brothers bought a large piece of land in the Russian Concession in Hankou, covering the east-west direction from Liangyi Street (now Dongting Street) to Luojiabei Road (now Luojiashan Street), north-south direction from Lierbin Street (now Lanling Road) to today's Lihuangpi Road. A large isosceles triangle house was built in the triangle between Liangyi Street and Sanjiao Street (now Poyang Street) and Lihuangpi Road and Lanling Road. It was built in 1901 and completed in 1910. This is what people call Bagong House. The completed Bagong House became the landmark building of the Russian concession in this area.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian style apartment

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 江汉关大楼
attractions.summary: The former site of Jianghan Pass Building is located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. After entering the interior, people can visit indoors or enjoy pyrography in the exhibition area. After going upstairs, there is a semi outdoor area where they can take beautiful photos.

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 《云南映象》演出
attractions.summary: Yunnan Impression "is a new stage production that integrates tradition and modernity. It is directed by Chinese dance artist Yang Liping as the artistic director and chief director, and integrates and reconstructs the essence of original local songs and dances with classic ethnic dances, showcasing the rich ethnic customs of Yunnan. 70% of the actors in 'Yunnan Impressions' are ethnic minorities from various villages in Yunnan, and the costumes for the performances are restored to the life prototypes of folk costumes of various ethnic groups in Yunnan. These folk actors already have primitive dance genes flowing in their blood, and their songs and dances are full of the vibrant spirit of life, which professional actors do not possess.

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 昆明旅游索道
attractions.summary: The Kunming Tourist Cableway (formerly known as the Dianchi Xishan Cableway) uses the world's advanced cableway equipment produced in France and Italy, with half of its length spanning over the water surface of Dianchi Lake, making it a rare cableway that spans both water and mountains. Taking the cableway is one of the popular tourist attractions in Kunming. At No. 16 Hubin Road (near the Dragon King Temple), you can take the cableway and walk up like stepping into a wonderful viewing corridor, where you can enjoy the scenery of Dianchi Lake. Along the way, you can also capture a panoramic view of Dianchi Lake. Underneath the feet is Dianchi Lake, while looking up is the majestic Xishan Mountain. The cableway also allows tourists to conveniently visit Dianchi Lake and Xishan Scenic Area. Full text 

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 七彩云南欢乐世界
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The park has a total investment of 3 billion yuan, covering an area of more than 700 mu. It closely follows the three cultural contexts of ancient Yunnan culture, national culture and regional culture, and plans seven theme divisions in a unique and novel way: Yunnan Military Camp, Magic Yunnan Strange Land, Children's Dream World, Vientiane Tribe, Secret Land of the Wilderness, Frost Moon Cold Island and Four Seasons Flower Sea, and has built an entertainment center for children-FEC Paradise. 
There are 81 amusement projects in the park, including wide-wing roller coaster, blue fire roller coaster, twin-tower space shuttle and other super-large equipment. The park has achieved the perfect integration of characteristic culture and modern technology.
attractions.shortFeatures: Multi-themed entertainment center
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-20:00(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 轿子雪山
attractions.tag: Climbing to a high place and hiking in the mountains.; Snow Mountains
attractions.summary: Jiaozi Mountain is a national nature reserve, a national AAAA-level tourist attraction, the first tourism destination in China to receive ecological origin certification, and a national sports tourism boutique scenic area. It is also the lowest latitude, closest to the provincial capital, with a distinct vertical climate, rich biodiversity, and a highly representative high-altitude seasonal snow mountain in China. It is named after its highest peak, which resembles a sedan chair. Jiaozi Mountain is part of the Wumeng Mountain range, with the main peak at an elevation of about 4223 meters and a relative height difference of about 2623 meters. The scenic area features rugged and majestic peaks, waterfalls scattered throughout, clear and mysterious lakes, rare flowers and trees, and exotic animals and birds that occasionally appear. It has a unique vertical climate with cold, temperate, and tropical zones, creating the remarkable phenomenon of "one mountain divided into four seasons, with each season offering a distinct view." "Winter to see snow, spring to see ice, summer to admire flowers, and autumn to enjoy water" is a major feature of Jiaozi Mountain. Its wonders, including the peaks, waters, snow, rhododendrons, sea of clouds, sunrises, and Buddha light, are known as the "Seven Wonders of Jiaozi Mountain." The majestic and beautiful landscape blends together, making it an untouched land for seeking adventure and exploration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Spring admire azaleas, winter climb the icy mountain.

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南大学
attractions.summary: Yunnan University is located in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China and is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history. The campus is shaded by green trees and has a unique architectural style that combines elements of both Eastern and Western architecture. It is a famous cultural attraction in Kunming city.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 云南野生动物园
attractions.summary: Yunnan Wildlife Park Co., Ltd. is the only tourism attraction in Yunnan Province focused on the breeding, domestication, viewing, and exhibition of wild animals. It integrates sightseeing, science education, and ex situ conservation. Located 7 kilometers from downtown Kunming, it is situated within the Jindian National Forest Park, adjacent to Jindian Reservoir, and facing the Expo Garden across the water. Covering a total area of approximately 2,800 acres, the park highlights the theme of showcasing Yunnan's "Animal Kingdom." The park features lush greenery, beautiful scenery, and themed attractions such as the Rare Animal Area, African Herbivorous Animal Area, Giant Panda Pavilion, and Lion and Tiger Manor. It is home to over 200 species and more than 10,000 animals. Among them are national treasures such as the giant panda and golden snub-nosed monkey, as well as exotic species like giraffes, rhinos, orangutans, and emus. Most of these animals live in natural free-range conditions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up view of rare animals

attractions.name: 清明上河园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gem; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A large-scale Song Dynasty cultural theme park built based on the famous Song Dynasty painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*.
- The park closely replicates the scenes from *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*, consisting of eight functional zones and four cultural zones.
- The Southern Garden recreates the bustling streets of Northern Song Dynasty’s capital, Bianjing (today's Kaifeng), while the Northern Garden showcases the Song Dynasty's royal gardens and court entertainment, with palace architecture adorned in golden and brilliant colors.
- The staff inside the park wear Song Dynasty clothing, creating a time-travel experience. In addition, there are exciting scene performances and folk shows.
attractions.shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Scenery of Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden

attractions.name: 鼓楼夜市
attractions.summary: This is a paradise for foodies and a popular gathering place for snacks among Kaifeng residents on a daily basis. There are various types of snacks with different flavors, such as lamb kang bread with a crispy exterior and a fragrant interior, almond tea with a sweet and fragrant aroma, soup dumplings with rich juice, and even a barbecue to eat. It is a great place for three to five friends to enjoy delicious food, drink spicy food, and chat. Full text 

attractions.name: 开封古城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: The second largest ancient city wall building in China
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient city walls with architectural style of Yuan and Ming Dynasties
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-21:00(Tickets available until 20:30; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 中国翰园碑林
attractions.tag: Garden; Enjoy Autumn Flowers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The China Han Garden was established in 1985 by Li Gongtao with self-raised funds. It consists of two main scenic areas: the Stele Corridor and the Garden. The garden is fresh and elegant, with charming scenery, cascading waterfalls, fountains, and lakeside islands shining in harmony. The stele inscriptions mainly focus on calligraphy art, incorporating poetry, calligraphy, painting, and seal cutting. It is an artistic treasure trove that integrates stele engraving art and classical garden architecture. The stele corridors are divided into several sections based on their themes and subjects, including the Central Stele Corridor, Modern Stele Corridor, Song Dynasty Stele Corridor, Stele Corridor of Emperors and Famous Ministers of Various Dynasties, Painting Stele Corridor, Seal Engraving Stele Corridor, Hard Pen Calligraphy Stele Corridor, Stele Corridor of Minority Script Calligraphy, Middle-Aged Calligraphy Stele Corridor, and the International Friendship Stele Corridor.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are thousands of precious steles hidden.

attractions.name: 万岁山武侠城
attractions.summary: Wansui Mountain Wuxia City is located in the Wansui Mountain Tourist Area in the northwest of Kaifeng City. It is a large-scale tourist area built against the backdrop of Song Dynasty culture and martial arts culture. There are ancient and charming Song Dynasty garden streets and alleys built in the scenic area, with exciting martial arts and ancient costume performances all year round, as well as rich entertainment facilities. It is a good place for relaxation and entertainment in the surrounding areas of Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. When visiting Wansui Mountain Wuxia City, the first thing to experience is the beautiful scenery of the scenic area. The overall atmosphere of Wuxia City is shaped by the Song Dynasty, with many eye-catching landscapes such as Wansui Temple, which reproduces the glory of the thousand year old temple of the Song Dynasty, Dragon Altar, which embodies the spirit of Buddhism, Confucianism, and Taoism, the well preserved ruins of the ancient city walls of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and one of the large-scale artificial streams and waterfalls in China, the "Nine Dragon Waterfall". What's rare is that there are also very large forest green spaces in the scenic area, with a peaceful environment and flowers blooming in the appropriate season, which is very suitable for photography. Afterwards, tourists will notice the unique martial arts characteristics in the scenic area. There are 36 martial arts themed performances released here year-round (about 60 performances per day), including "Cross Slope", "Wu Song Drunken Beats Jiang Men Shen", "Wild Boar Forest" and several other exciting themed performances. Don't miss it here; Interactive performances such as "Wuxia Film and Television Experience Hall", "Wuzhuangyuan", and "Li Kui's Case" can also allow tourists to participate in Wuxia stories, which are full of fun. In the architectural design of the scenic area, there are also many elements of martial arts, such as the martial arts road with large weapons such as the "Heaven Reliant Sword" and "Overlord Sword", the "Swordsman Map" of the Song Dynasty Martial Arts Academy, the "Sword Altar" of the Cross Slope, the Juxian Village, and the martial arts venue, all of which are unique. In addition, during the Spring Festival every year, Wansui Mountain holds large-scale temple fairs with grand performances, rich specialty snacks, dazzling handicrafts, and unique entertainment activities, creating a lively atmosphere. It has become one of the popular temple fairs in the Central Plains region. Full text 

attractions.name: 开封包公祠
attractions.tag: Night Tour and Scenic View; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Bao Gong Temple is a restored and reconstructed site dedicated to commemorating Bao Zheng, a renowned ancient Chinese upright official and political reformer. It is located on the west shore of Bao Gong Lake in Kaifeng, Henan Province, and is one of the key attractions in the Central Plains tourist area developed by the National Tourism Administration.  

The temple consists of the main hall, second hall, east and west side halls, half-wall corridor, and a stele pavilion. Its style is ancient, solemn, and dignified. On the east side is the Lingshi Garden, which is composed of stone carvings and a waterside pavilion, elegant and distinctive. Inside the temple, there are exhibits such as a bronze statue of Bao Gong, a dragon, tiger, and dog bronze cleaver, wax figures of Bao Gong administering justice, the "Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele," historical novels about Bao Gong, Bao Gong’s career-declaration poems, the Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele, Bao Gong's family instructions, Bao Gong’s calligraphy, and an epitaph, among other historical artifacts.
attractions.shortFeatures: Song-style ancient architecture in memory of Bao Zheng.

attractions.name: 开封府
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Kaifeng Fu, also known as the Southern Yamen, was the administrative and judicial office for officials in the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, and was praised as the "first prefecture under heaven."
- Among the various government offices throughout history, it was the largest in scale, equivalent to the Beijing municipal government today.
- The architecture is grand and magnificent, complementing the waters of the Three Pools Lake, creating the scenic view of "Eastern Prefecture, Western Temple, Pavilion and Clear Water."
- In addition to a large collection of precious historical materials and exhibits, visitors can also enjoy performances such as the "Opening of the Yamen," "Judge Bao’s Rulings," and "Fire-Spitting Face-Changing."
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the ancient-style performance of Judge Bao solving cases.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Spring and summer 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Winter 07:00-18:30(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Autumn 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 龙亭景区
attractions.tag: Ancient ruins; Appreciate autumn flowers; City Parks; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the northern end of Zhongshan Road in Kaifeng, this ancient architectural complex is built according to the layout of the Qing Wanshou Palace.
- It was once the site of the Northern Song Dynasty imperial capital. From the stone railing, you can enjoy a view of the ancient city of Kaifeng, and inside the hall, you can view the displayed cultural relics.
- Known both domestically and internationally as a famous chrysanthemum viewing destination, it hosts an annual Chrysanthemum Festival in the golden autumn. During this time, the park is splendid, with thousands of chrysanthemum varieties competing in beauty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb to the Top and View the Scenery of Kaifeng Ancient City

attractions.name: 樊楼
attractions.summary: Fan Building, also known as Fan Building, located at the northern end of Songdu Royal Street, is a group of courtyard-style pavilions rebuilt in 1988, and it is also the largest entertainment center imitating Song Dynasty in Kaifeng at present. According to legend, Fanlou was once the most prosperous restaurant in Tokyo in the Northern Song Dynasty. Even the then emperor Song Huizong visited this building in person and left a much-told story about meeting Li Shishi. Fan Building consists of five buildings: east, west, south, north and middle, each building is three stories high. Among them, the west building is the main building of Fan Building, and it is also the largest one on the fifth floor. The throne of Emperor Huizong of Song Dynasty is located upstairs, and the furnishings are magnificent. There are Li Shishi's piano room and study on the middle and upper floors, which are elegantly and quietly arranged. Fan Building, located at the northern end of Royal Street in Songdu, is a group of courtyard-style pavilions rebuilt in 1988 according to historical records. According to legend, Fanlou was the first of the 72 restaurants in Tokyo in the Northern Song Dynasty. Song Huizong, the romantic emperor, and Li Shishi, a famous prostitute in Kyoto, often met here. The novel Water Margin also describes this building. Liu Zicui, a poet of the Song Dynasty, once left a story that "Liang Garden sings and dances are full of romantic songs, and fine wine is like a knife to solve sorrow. I recall the pleasure of Chengping, and the lights go to Fanlou in the late night." Hymn. Fan Lou consists of five buildings: east, west, south, north and middle. Grey tiles and blue bricks, carved beams and painted buildings, magnificent furnishings, simple and elegant.
attractions.shortFeatures: Courtyard-style imitation pavilion of Song Dynasty

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 枫桥景区
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 沧浪亭
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
It is the oldest garden in Suzhou and one of the four famous gardens in Suzhou. It was originally the pool pavilion of King Guangling of Wu Yue in the Five Dynasties. 
· Built by the water, the various window styles and bamboo in the garden are the biggest attractions. 
The biggest difference between the layout and other gardens in Suzhou lies in its transparency, and the rockery is integrated with the pool water outside the garden. 
The rockery in the garden is integrated with the pool water outside the garden, and the bamboo and wood are quiet, full of ancient meaning, natural harmony, which can be called clever conception.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classic gardens with rockery scenery
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 周庄张厅
attractions.summary:
Zhang Hall, formerly known as Yishun Hall, was built in the Ming Dynasty. In the early Qing Dynasty, Zhang's surname was transferred to Yuyan Hall, commonly known as Zhang Hall. 
After more than 500 years of vicissitudes, solid stone pillars and exquisite carvings, it is still not difficult to see the former elegant demeanor of Zhang Hall. 
The hall is spacious and bright, with a rare wooden drum pier under the court pillar, which is an obvious symbol of Ming Dynasty architecture. 
The backyard of Zhang Hall is a quiet and clean small garden, surrounded by dwellings with white walls and black tiles. 
Enter with the ticket of the day and listen to the story with the tour guide. Although things have changed, you can still feel the details of the life of large families.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sedan chair entered the boat in front of the door and passed through the house

attractions.name: 周庄沈厅
attractions.summary: The original name of Shen Hall was Jingye Hall, which was renamed Songmao Hall in the late Qing Dynasty. It was built by Shen Benren, a descendant of Shen Wansan, in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1742 AD). It is divided into seven entrances and five gates, and the architectural layout has the style of a wealthy family. Shen Hall is a must visit attraction in Zhouzhuang, and tourists come here mainly to explore the past of the wealthy Shen Wansan. Layout structure: The first entrance of the Shen Hall is the Water Wall Gate, which is equivalent to the private dock of the Shen family for docking their boats; The second entrance is the foyer; The third entrance is the tea pavilion, used to entertain guests with average status; The fourth entrance is the main hall, Songmao Hall, used to entertain distinguished guests; The fifth entrance is the lobby building where women reside; The sixth entrance is the small hall building; The seventh entrance is the restaurant, with a kitchen next to it. Highlights of Shen Hall: Brick carved gatehouse, main hall, treasure trove, and copper murals are several highlights of Shen Hall. The gatehouse between the third and fourth entrances is one of the five exquisite gatehouses in Shenting. There are beautiful brick carvings on the gatehouse, with the words "Accumulated Thick and Flowing Light" carved in the middle. The main hall, Songmao Hall, is spacious and grand, with old dark windows visible when looking up. In the sixth entrance of the small hall building, there is a statue of Shen Wansan, and in front of him is a glittering treasure trove, which is said to bring wealth to people. There are copper murals on both sides of the lane in Shen Hall, introducing the legendary life of Shen Wansan. Visiting the second floor of the Shen Hall's Ma Tower requires an additional fee. On the second floor, you can look at the various courtyards of the Shen Hall from a different angle, and also see the ladies' boudoirs. It is quite interesting to peek into the main hall's Song Mao Hall from the dark window.

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 南宋御街
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Neighborhood Walk; Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Royal Street in the Southern Song Dynasty is a main street paved in the capital of the Southern Song Dynasty. According to the records of Xianchun Lin'an Zhi and other documents, more than 10,000 stone slabs were used to lay the Imperial Street in the Southern Song Dynasty, but only fragrant cake bricks were found in previous archaeological excavations. Royal Street starts from the north gate and Ningmen of Huangcheng (now the intersection of Wansongling and Fenghuangshanjiao Road) in the south, passes through Chaotianmen (now Gulou), Zhongshan Middle Road, Zhongshan North Road, Guanqiao (now Guanqiao) to the intersection of Fengqi Road and Wulin Road, which is the central axis of Lin'an City in the Southern Song Dynasty, with a total length of about 4,185 meters. It is a special road for the emperor to worship his ancestors in the "Simencius" (Meng Chun, Meng Xia, Meng Qiu and Meng Dong) to Jingling Palace (now the west side of Wulin Road, where the statues of royal ancestors are enshrined).
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit local specialty shops in quaint commercial street

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 梅家坞村
attractions.summary: Meijiawu is located on both sides of Meiling Road in the western hinterland of West Lake Scenic Area, nearly 10 kilometers away from downtown Hangzhou, and is one of the main production areas of Longjing tea. Surrounded by green mountains, the village is full of lush tea trees, and the fragrance of tea leaves is refreshing. Taking a walk here and breathing in fresh air feels great. Nowadays, almost every villager in Meijiawu makes a living by growing and selling tea. Tea houses, tea societies, and many farmhouses can be seen everywhere in the village. Due to its proximity to the city center of Hangzhou, many tourists from the surrounding area invite three to five friends on weekends to drive here and enjoy authentic Longjing tea, local farm cuisine, and even play a few rounds of mahjong if interested, which is quite pleasant. If you come to Meijiawu during the tea picking season from March to April, you will see tea farmers busy in the fields. This is the season for picking and making new tea, and if you are interested, you can also experience the process of picking and making tea firsthand. If you come in April or May, you can enjoy the newly launched Longjing, especially before and after the Qingming Festival holiday, where many tourists from Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shanghai flock to it. Actually, avoiding the crowds during holidays and enjoying this tranquility is the wise choice. In addition to the excellent Longjing, Meijiawu also boasts cultural landmarks such as Ligeng Hall. Ligeng Hall is an ancient Ming and Qing dynasty mansion in the village. The three characters "Ligeng Hall" were inscribed by calligrapher Zhang Zhao, who wrote the book "Record of Yueyang Tower" inside Yueyang Tower. Today, it is also an antique tea house and restaurant.
