If you want to climb the mountain, you can also take the small path on the east side of the southern end of Meijiawu and go to the filming location of "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon" called "Yunqi Bamboo Trail" to enjoy the beautiful scenery of West Lake.

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 庙街
attractions.summary:
Temple Street, also known as Men's Street, is named after Tin Hau Temple in Yau Ma Tei. It is a popular location for Hong Kong movies. 
Although it is only a short street, it condenses the most authentic Hong Kong culture. 
· Temple Street is famous for its night market selling cheap goods, and is known as Hong Kong's civilian nightclub.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Hong Kong style street with strong market atmosphere

attractions.name: 旺角
attractions.summary:
· One of the most popular areas in Hong Kong, where fashion, traditional culture, city style, snacks and delicious food are all gathered. 
There are many theme streets, such as Goldfish Street, Sneaker Street, Women's Street, Gun Street, Electric Street, etc. You can have fun until dawn in the early morning. 
· It is a shopping mecca in the hearts of young people, with cosmetics chain stores, electronic and digital stores and well-known upstairs bookstores; Garden Street and so on. 
· It is famous for its many snack bars, including Japanese baked wheat cakes, German sausages, desktop drinks, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Bustling shopping district with many characteristic blocks

attractions.name: 西九文化区
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park presents a grand and diverse Christmas celebration in Hong Kong, creating a festive atmosphere together. Celebrate the holiday at the "West Kowloon Christmas Market" and choose global holiday cuisine and selected Christmas gifts with family, friends, and children. Appreciate the enlarged Christmas town and giant Christmas tree of the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Join the "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" global super inflatable bouncing party (November 22, 2024- Hong Kong). As winter approaches, the West Kowloon Cultural District (West Kowloon) invites the public to participate in the grand and diverse Christmas celebration event with family, friends, and children from November 22, 2024 (Friday) to January 5, 2025 (Sunday). Nine Colorful Christmas ". The West Kowloon Christmas Market will be unveiled on Friday, November 22, 2024. During the first three weekends (Friday to Sunday), six distinctive stalls will be opened on the lawn of the art park seaside first; Starting from December 12th (Friday), the market will expand to over 30 specialty stalls, located on the east lawn of the art park and the seaside platform opposite M+. The West Kowloon Christmas Market offers a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts. Surrounded by the charming Victoria Harbour scenery and lush green lawns of the West Kowloon Art Park, visitors can immerse themselves in the dazzling holiday lights and enjoy melodious live music and performances. Apart from the Christmas market, visitors should not miss the "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Parade" held by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) on the West Lawn at the seaside from November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025. The giant and dazzling Christmas tree standing over 20 meters tall in the enlarged version of Christmas Town will be transformed into a giant canvas this year, with projections of different winter festival scenes added to enhance the festive atmosphere. The Christmas town of over 10000 square feet will open on November 22, and the Hong Kong Tourism Board will also stage a total of four "Winter Victoria Harbour Water Fireworks" on the opening day and from December 24 to 26, shining brightly in Victoria Harbour. The global super inflatable bouncing party "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" will be held for the first time on December 21, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park lawn, bringing a new outdoor bouncing experience to children and kids. West Kowloon is the first stop of The Big Bounce World Tour in Asia, featuring four uniquely designed super giant inflatable amusement areas, including the "Global Super Inflatable Castle" and the Hong Kong's ultra long inflatable obstacle course. There are multiple exclusive events throughout the day, with parent-child events during the day and a night jumping party for people aged 16 and above at night. The party brings an exciting lineup of special guests and themes, inviting the public to celebrate the festival together with "day jumping and night jumping". Highlight 1 of the "Colorful Christmas in West Kowloon" event: West Kowloon Christmas Market: Visitors can purchase a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts at the featured stalls, bringing a happy holiday experience to families and young children. On designated days and times, there will be live music and performance times available: the first phase will take place from November 22nd to 24th, November 29th to December 1st, and December 6th to 8th (a total of 9 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The second phase will take place from December 12th to 23rd, 2024, and from 27th to 29th (a total of 15 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The actual opening hours will be announced again on December 24th to 26th, 2024 (a total of 3 days) from 14:00 to 23:00. Location: The first phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside Lawn. The second phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside East Lawn and M+opposite the Seaside Platform. The "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Tour" organized by the Hong Kong Tourism Board: Visitors can immerse themselves in the Greater Bay Area. Version of Christmas Town, On site, there is a winter scenery presented with colorful Christmas gifts and a giant Christmas tree. Time: November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025 Location: Art Park Seaside West Lawn 3, "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station": Both children and adults can participate in the global super large inflatable bouncing party, with bubble parties and DJ stationed on-site. During the day, it is a parent-child event, and in the evening, it is a night bouncing party for people aged 16 and above. There are special guests and themes available. Time: December 21, 2024 to January 5, 2025, 10:00-23:10 (divided into time slots) Location: Art Park Grand Lawn Cultural and Art Programs and Activities During the Christmas period, a series of art and cultural activities will be held at different locations in West Kowloon. Visitors can enjoy cultural and artistic activities while also enjoying a wonderful and unforgettable Christmas experience. Art enthusiasts can visit the two museums in West Kowloon for exhibitions. The "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Sino French Cultural Exchange in the 17th and 18th Centuries" exhibition at the Palace Museum in Hong Kong will be open to the public on December 18th, while visitors to M+can visit two special exhibitions, "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and "Guo Pei: Artistic Imagination in the Sky". Visitors can also watch weekend street performances planned by the West Kowloon Cultural Centre and other cultural events held in West Kowloon. The global touring exhibition "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition", organized by Visionairs Asia Hong Kong, will open on December 8, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park. The exhibition is presented in collaboration between digital heritage expert Histovery and the public restoration agency of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, with support from L'Oreal Group, and will be staged on the occasion of the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral. Through innovative technology, the exhibition allows visitors to experience the unique architectural treasure of Notre Dame Cathedral in high-definition historical landscapes. As Notre Dame Cathedral was engulfed in fire and reopened after five years of restoration, exploring this architectural treasure holds great historical and cultural significance. The 2024 Dahua Bank Ink Art Festival will be held from December 13th to 29th, 2024 at the Art Exhibition Pavilion and the High Lawn of the Art Park, presenting Hong Kong's premier ink art celebration to the audience. Sponsored by Dahua Bank (Hong Kong) and organized by Dahua Bank's "Art · Workshop", the Ink Art Festival will host a variety of exciting activities, including the 2024 Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award winning works exhibition, art workshops, ink themed forums, music performances, interactive installations, and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" Carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. The "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition" coincides with the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris this month, and visitors can visit the exhibition from Exhibition Art. Asia. Hong Kong (Visionairs) The Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition will be held from December 8, 2024 to March 7, 2025. Location: GF01-03 underground of the Art Park. Visitors can visit a series of exciting and rich activities, including the 2024 "Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award" exhibition and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. Location: Art Exhibition Pavilion and High Lawn of the Art Park. For more information about the activities, please refer to the organizers of the program or event. New concept stores and limited time "West Kowloon Consumption Rewards" have landed in the Art Park, providing visitors with more diverse dining options, including% Arabica's boutique coffee Honbo's signature burgers and hot dogs, Tiger Hall's delicious pearl milk tea, and local convenience store brand 852 Eight Five Two's light meals. Designated restaurants and retail stores in the West Kowloon Cultural District will also provide surprise shopping experiences during the Christmas period. On the same day, customers can redeem HKD 50 or HKD 100 cash vouchers by spending a specified amount through electronic payment (up to four different store receipts can be accumulated). For more details, please visit the website of the West Kowloon Cultural District. M+2024 Christmas Celebration Gift Series M+Store presents a series of festive gifts for museum visitors, allowing everyone to share joy with their loved ones. Selected items include exquisite Christmas gift baskets bringing high-quality food and exquisite M+products from the Hong Kong Grand Hyatt Hotel, as well as Christmas sock sets to add a festive atmosphere### Editor's note: The West Kowloon Cultural District is one of the largest cultural projects in the world, with the vision of creating a colorful new cultural zone for Hong Kong on a 40 hectare reclaimed land adjacent to Victoria Harbour. There are various theaters, performance spaces, and museums within the cultural zone that produce and host exhibitions, performance programs, and cultural and artistic activities; And it will provide 23 hectares of public space, including a two kilometer long seaside promenade. Full text 

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 天星小轮
attractions.summary: • Known as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, the Star Ferry has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. • It is not only an important part of the cross sea transportation system between Hong Kong and Kowloon, but also a must experience itinerary for visitors to Hong Kong. • The National Geographic Tourism Magazine once praised taking the Star Ferry to visit both sides of Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life". To this day, the Star Ferry still maintains its retro design, with wooden benches and iron fans in the cabin, giving it a strong Hong Kong vibe. At present, the Star Ferry has two ferry routes and stops at three piers, namely the Tsim Sha Tsui Central Link and the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line. Among them, the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line is more suitable for enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. Full text 

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 香港电车叮叮车
attractions.summary: Dingding is an integral part of the bustling streets of Hong Kong, and it is also the only double decker tram in the world. The route of Dingding car is in the bustling commercial center of Hong Kong, passing through the western, upper, central, Wan Chai, Tai Koo, Shau Kei Wan and the Victoria Harbour coast. This ancient mode of transportation, which is only found on Hong Kong Island, is actually a type of tram. It is famous for the sound of "ding ding, ding ding" when the driver steps on the scooter while driving, so people call it Dingding car. The tram currently operates 6 partially overlapping routes connecting Kennedy Town to Shau Kei Wan, with an average tram arriving at the station every 1 minute and 30 seconds. The 6 main routes are as follows: 1. Shau Kei Wan to Sheung Wan Market (there are special trips between Shau Kei Wan and Kennedy Town during peak hours from Monday to Friday); 2. From Shau Kei Wan to Happy Valley; 3. North Point to Shek Tong Tsui; 4. Happy Valley to Kennedy Town; 5. Causeway Bay to Kennedy Town; 6. From Sheung Wan Market to Kennedy Town (only available during peak hours from Monday to Friday). Please refer to the official website for the detailed operation route diagram of Dingding car.

attractions.name: 尖沙咀
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Tsim Sha Tsui is located at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, facing Victoria Harbour and across the sea from Central, Hong Kong Island. It is the "geographical center" of Hong Kong. 
There are many famous scenic spots in Hong Kong, such as Avenue of Stars, Victoria Harbour, Kowloon Park, etc., which are all must-check-in places for tourists to come to Hong Kong. It is also a good place to see the night view. Victoria Harbour and Avenue of Stars are good choices. 
· It is the most prosperous shopping paradise in Hong Kong, with various large shopping malls, duty-free shops, international brand stores, etc. to meet all the needs of one-stop shopping. 
· There are also cultural places such as the Hong Kong History Museum, the Hong Kong Science Museum and the Hong Kong Cultural Center, which are good choices for parent-child tours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping paradise on the shore of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 香港艺术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Museum of Art is located on the waterfront of Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, adjacent to the Space Museum. It is about ten times larger than the old museum. There are five floors in total. Each floor has two fixed exhibition areas, which are divided into Chinese cultural relics, Chinese paintings and calligraphy, Hong Kong contemporary art, historical paintings and Chinese paintings and calligraphy in virtual collections, etc., mainly ancient Chinese works of art, and there will be various mobile exhibitions that keep pace with the times from time to time. The equipment is advanced and perfect. There are six exhibition halls, lecture halls, outdoor plastic courtyards, art galleries and art exhibition services in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: A wide variety of ancient and modern collections

attractions.name: 中环街市
attractions.summary: The Central Market was completed in 1939 and is one of the few indoor markets in the area that was built before the war.

attractions.name: 西环钟声泳棚
attractions.summary: The Western Ring Swimming Pool was a place for citizens to swim in the 1960s and 1970s. It had a long wooden bridge, some bamboo sheds, and a rudimentary changing room, which could be said to be the public swimming pool of that time. Nowadays, there are very few people who come to swim at the Western Ring Swimming Pool. Most of them come to fish on weekdays, and the sunset here is beautiful. It not only attracts photography enthusiasts, but also many couples come to play and couples come to take wedding photos.

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 香港电车叮叮车
attractions.summary: Dingding is an integral part of the bustling streets of Hong Kong, and it is also the only double decker tram in the world. The route of Dingding car is in the bustling commercial center of Hong Kong, passing through the western, upper, central, Wan Chai, Tai Koo, Shau Kei Wan and the Victoria Harbour coast. This ancient mode of transportation, which is only found on Hong Kong Island, is actually a type of tram. It is famous for the sound of "ding ding, ding ding" when the driver steps on the scooter while driving, so people call it Dingding car. The tram currently operates 6 partially overlapping routes connecting Kennedy Town to Shau Kei Wan, with an average tram arriving at the station every 1 minute and 30 seconds. The 6 main routes are as follows: 1. Shau Kei Wan to Sheung Wan Market (there are special trips between Shau Kei Wan and Kennedy Town during peak hours from Monday to Friday); 2. From Shau Kei Wan to Happy Valley; 3. North Point to Shek Tong Tsui; 4. Happy Valley to Kennedy Town; 5. Causeway Bay to Kennedy Town; 6. From Sheung Wan Market to Kennedy Town (only available during peak hours from Monday to Friday). Please refer to the official website for the detailed operation route diagram of Dingding car.

attractions.name: 湾仔
attractions.summary: Wan Chai is a unique community where old and new coexist, blending the essence of old traditions with new developments. It is one of the regions with a long history and rich traditional cultural characteristics. Wan Chai has several well-known commercial buildings and skyscrapers, among which representative ones include Central Plaza and Times Square. Here, unique historical buildings, historic sites, and cultural relics are also preserved, such as the ancient post office in Wan Chai, the Hongsheng Ancient Temple that witnessed the development of the waterfront a century and a half ago, and the Beidi Temple that enshrines the bronze statue of Beidi.

attractions.name: 洪圣古庙
attractions.summary: Hongsheng Ancient Temple is a temple with a long history. This temple, built on giant rocks and nestled against the mountain, has only one hall with tiled roofs. It used to overlook the entire bay, but now it is surrounded by high-rise buildings, making it particularly prominent.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 江宁织造博物馆
attractions.summary:
Located in the Daxinggong area in the center of Nanjing today, Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty went to the south of the Yangtze River six times and lived in Jiangning Weaving House five times. 
Cao Xueqin was born in the government, and now it is a modern museum built on the former weaving site of Jiangning. The book powder of A Dream of Red Mansions must be punched in. 
There are Cao Xueqin's birthplace, Cao Xueqin's former residence exhibition hall and on-site weaving Nanjing Yunjin Museum, and the Dream of Red Mansions Literature Museum is also located in it. 
The museum collects ancient Chinese cultural relics such as dragon robes and cheongsam collected from overseas, among which the Tang Dynasty brocade is extremely precious.
attractions.shortFeatures: Explore Jiangnan Yunjin and appreciate precious cultural relics

attractions.name: 南京台城
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing City Wall Essence Section

attractions.name: 阅江楼
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Yuejiang Tower in Nanjing, along with the Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is collectively known as the Four Famous Towers of Jiangnan. It features a distinctive Ming Dynasty style and classical royal grandeur.
- The most unique feature of Yuejiang Tower is that the tower was built based on the "Yuejiang Lou Ji" (Record of Yuejiang Tower) by Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang of the Ming Dynasty.
- From the top of Yuejiang Tower, one can enjoy a panoramic view of the vast Yangtze River, the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, and the entire city of Jinling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the Ming Dynasty tower to admire the vast Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 青岩古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Ancient Towns; Military Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qingyan Ancient Town was established in the Ming Dynasty and has well-preserved a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing periods. It is known as one of the four major ancient towns in Guizhou, alongside Zhenyuan, Bian'an, and Longli.
- The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Missing Gun"

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 苏州古运河游船(新市桥码头)
attractions.summary: The Xinshiqiao Ancient Canal Tourist Terminal is currently one of the only two cruise ship terminals in Suzhou. There are exciting boat rides here, including storytelling and commentary.

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 阳澄湖莲花岛
attractions.summary: Lianhua Island is located in the northeast of the ancient city of Suzhou, surrounded by water on three sides. It is named after its lotus like shape, which is embedded in the lake. The total area of the island is 3.2 square kilometers, with over 300 households living on the lake and making a living from crabs. The water here is vast and the water quality is particularly good. It is the birthplace of authentic Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs and is known as the "hometown of hairy crabs". The attractions on the island, such as Yiyuan Garden, Yaoshi Temple, Sanyuan Mansion, Xizui Wetland, Dadi Painting, Windmill Array, Cow Water Performance, and Water Treading, are both ornamental and experiential. With the rise of rural tourism, more and more tourists have come to visit, forming an industrial service chain integrating food, housing, tourism, entertainment and shopping. Lotus Island is developing into a resort for vacation and leisure. The Yiyuan Yiyuan Museum covers an area of over 5000 square meters and showcases the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake. It not only restores the original ecological lifestyle of Lianhua Island, but also uses artistic techniques to spread the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town. The entire building includes: the foyer, atrium, fishery hall, water town wedding hall, water town costume hall, historical and cultural hall, and folk customs hall. The waterwheel was an irrigation tool used in ancient times and was popular in most parts of China. When used, stepping on the crutch to rotate the large wheel axle drives the blade in the groove to scrape water upwards and pour it into the field. This type of water lifting facility has a long history because its shape resembles a dragon bone, also known as a "dragon bone water wheel". Fengqing Fishing Port Fengqing Fishing Port is home to the original residents of Lianhua Island who live by the water on both sides. The pink walls and black tiles are connected together, and there is a row of boats and boats in front of the houses, maintaining the original ecological style of the Jiangnan water town. There are aquatic products all year round, and in the golden autumn season, crabs are harvested with joy. Every household welcomes guests with a smiling face. The charming water alleys of Lianhua Island make tourists come and go frequently. Xizui Wetland Park covers an area of over 300 acres, with diverse vegetation types and a good ecological environment. Along the lakeside boardwalk, visitors can enjoy the lake scenery and lotus flowers. In the flower planting area, rapeseed flowers can be seen in spring and sunflowers can be seen in autumn, creating a beautiful scenery. Cattle fetching water used to be a common scene in agriculture in Jiangnan. In a pavilion that was over a person tall, an old cow with its eyes covered was placed by a large wooden plate, circling in circles. The rotation of the large wheel axle drove the blades in the trough to scrape the water upwards, and the river water was irrigated by the "bucket board" into the fields by the river. The former residence of Qian Qi in the San Yuan Mansion, where "San Yuan" refers to Lianzhong Huiyuan, Jieyuan, and Zhuangyuan. Only 15 people in Chinese history have received this honor. In October 2010, construction was carried out on Qian Qi's old house, which consists of three entrances in front and back, with a total area of 300 square meters. The first two entrances are Ming style buildings with an area of 160 square meters, while the last entrance is an early Qing Dynasty building with an area of 140 square meters. The Suzhou Yangcheng Lake Tourism Distribution Center is located in the middle of the "Beauty Leg" Peninsula in Yangcheng Lake Resort. It is a comprehensive service center that integrates tourism distribution, tourist services, cultural exhibitions, and product sales. It is also a transportation hub that combines road and water transportation, and is a benchmark for smart tourism distribution centers in China. It covers an area of 36.5 acres and has a building area of 6848 square meters. It consists of three main parts: an ecological parking lot, a distribution building, and a boat dock. Designed by the architectural master Kengo Kuma, the building resembles a layered structure of thatch, which is a concrete expression of the rural areas of Jiangnan; The massive triangular roof is like a mountain range connected along the lake, perfectly blending with nature. This is a new cultural landmark, as well as a brand new cultural window and innovation and entrepreneurship base by Yangcheng Lake. It has become a well-known check-in spot for internet celebrities. attractions.name: 忆园
attractions.summary: Yiyuan is a museum located at the northeast corner of Lianhua Island in Yangcheng Lake, Suzhou. It has carefully set up a fishery museum, a folk customs museum, a water town wedding museum, a Yangcheng clothing museum, a historical and cultural museum, etc. Through artistic techniques, it spreads the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town from point to surface, comprehensively showcasing the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake, and restoring the original ecological way of life of Lianhua Island.
