attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 鼓楼
attractions.summary:
One of the landmark buildings in Beijing, the ancient capital, is a group of ancient buildings located at the northern end of Beijing's north-south central axis, located at the northern end of Di'anmenwai Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing. 
The Bell and Drum Tower originated in the Han Dynasty. According to historical records, there was a morning drum and evening bell system in the Han Dynasty, in which "beating the drum at dawn to urge people to get up and ringing the bell at night to urge people to rest". The two floors are placed vertically in front and back, magnificent and majestic. 
As the time telling center of the capitals of Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Bell and Drum Tower has a very important position. The two buildings are placed vertically in front and back, which is magnificent and magnificent. 
In the establishment history of the city's bell and drum tower, Beijing's bell and drum tower is the largest in scale and the tallest in shape, and it is also an important building that witnessed the history of China in the past hundred years.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness China's century-old history and culture

attractions.name: 王府井
attractions.summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 天安门城楼
attractions.summary:
· Tiananmen Gate Tower is located at the northern end of Tiananmen Square, on the central axis of Beijing. It is one of the most magnificent towers in ancient China and a place that every tourist who comes to Beijing must not miss. 
· On Tiananmen Square, you can see the standing Tiananmen Gate Tower from a distance. When you walk to the foot of the tower, the red tower seen countless times in textbooks and TV is close at hand. 
· The interior of the tower is antique. You can visit the living room of that year, as well as graphic and text exhibitions, and you can learn about the evolution of Tiananmen Square in various periods and the important activities held here. 
Many tourists imitate Chairman Mao's classic waving gesture at the founding ceremony and take photos here, which gives them a very wonderful sense of crossing and national pride. 
· It is also worth mentioning that the night view of the Tiananmen Gate Tower is also very beautiful. When the lanterns are first turned on, the landscape lights on the tower, which complement other buildings in Tiananmen Square, making it particularly magnificent.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Off season 08:30-15:30,Opens at Peak season 08:30-16:30

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 雍和宫
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast corner of the inner city of Dongcheng District, Beijing, that is, east of Yonghegong Street Road, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist temple in Beijing. 
In the thirty-second year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it became the residence of Yinzhen, the fourth son of the emperor. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Zhaotai Gate, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, Yonghe Gate, Lama Temple, Lecture Hall and Tantric Hall present the standard layout of "seven halls and blue blues" in Chinese Buddhist temples. 
· From the east-west memorial archway with cornices and arches to the antique east-west Shunshan Tower, there are more than a thousand halls in total, which are very luxurious and worth visiting
attractions.shortFeatures: Lived in two emperors Yongzheng and Qianlong

attractions.name: 国子监
attractions.summary:
Located in Guozijian Street, Andingmen, Beijing, adjacent to Confucius Temple and Lama Temple, it is the highest administrative institution of state management education in Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties in China and the highest institution of learning established by the state. 
Confucius Temple is a part of imperial academy, formerly known as imperial academy Confucius Temple or Capital Confucius Temple. It is the place where the emperor held the national ceremony of offering sacrifices to Confucius. It and imperial academy form the system of "left temple and right study". 
October-April is the best tourist season every year, with warm spring flowers and pleasant climate. You can also stroll around Huangchenggen Park and enjoy flowers and birds, which is very pleasant. 
Wisteria flower is one of the characteristics of the scenic spot, and many tourists come here every spring.
attractions.shortFeatures: State education departments in Ming and Qing Dynasties

restaurants.name_en: Old Beijing Yangxiezi Stick Bone Hall

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

Some celebrities in the cultural and entertainment circles have stayed here. The vicinity of Wukang Building is full of French style. Sitting at the open-air table of a roadside coffee shop, drinking a cup of coffee and basking in the sun, it seems like entering another time and space.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many famous people have stayed here

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world

attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.

attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.

The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.

- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.

attractions.name: 曲水园
attractions.summary: Located in the urban area of Qingpu, Qushui Garden is one of the five classical gardens in Shanghai (Yu Garden, Guyi Garden, Zuibai Pool, Qiuxia Garden, Qushui Garden). The Qushui Garden is small and beautiful, but it has rockeries, stone bridges, pavilions and ponds. The ancient trees in the park are dense, the flowers and plants are lush, and the mountain walls are covered with ivy. Strolling through the center of the park, one can often see elderly people singing and playing chess here; The eastern part of the garden is adjacent to the Huancheng River, where you can sit on the long corridor by the river and enjoy the riverside scenery, feeling infinitely comfortable. Qushui Garden was first built in the reign of Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty. It was adjacent to the Chenghuang Temple in Qingpu. At first, it was an affiliated garden of the Chenghuang Temple, but it was rebuilt on the original site due to repeated wars. Entering from the south gate on AD Road, to the left is the West Garden, which is mainly composed of buildings. The buildings here are magnificent, including the Deyue Pavilion, Youjue Hall, and Sunset Red Half Tower. Among them, the sunset red half building is built on a rockery made of the Taihu Lake Lake rocks, and the downstairs is a winding cave, which is very interesting. Zhongyuan is known for its mountains and waters, and is the central main part of Qushui Garden. There are attractions such as Lotus Pond, Ninghe Hall, and Flower God Hall here. Beside the Lotus Pond, there are pavilions and pavilions such as Xiaohao Liang, Yingxi Pavilion, and Jue Dui Feilai where you can enjoy the scenery of the pond. In summer, you can also admire the lotus flowers. There is a large rockery called "Xiao Feilai" in the north of the Lotus Pond. This is the center of the garden, and standing at the top of the mountain, the "Nine Peaks Viewing Pavilion" can overlook the surrounding landscape from a high altitude. Dongyuan is adjacent to the Huancheng River to the east, and its characteristic is full of wildness. Following the stone path filled with potted plants and accompanied by greenery, one can reach pavilions such as Tinglu Pavilion, Mudan Pavilion, Jiyun Pavilion, and Green Wave Corridor. The Green Wave Corridor is a long corridor built along the river, winding for more than 100 meters. Sitting here, listening to music and blowing the river breeze, is very comfortable. Standing on the other side of the river and looking towards the Green Wave Corridor, the river surface reflects green trees, blue sky, and a long corridor, which is also quite beautiful. The Shigu Wenwen Art Garden is located in the northwest of Qushui Garden and is a place where Shigu Wenwen and related calligraphy works are exhibited. Shigu script is one of the earliest surviving stone inscriptions in China, with characters carved on ten drum shaped granite blocks, each with a poem. There are ten stone drum imitations arranged in the flower garden of Shuyi Garden, and the bases are all attached with modern written poetry and prose for the convenience of tourists to read. If you are interested, you can go and take a look.

attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.

attractions.name: 朱家角大清邮局
attractions.summary: The Zhujiajiao Great Qing Post Office was established in 1903 and is the former site of the Great Qing Post Office preserved in East China. It is also the earliest postal institution in the region. It is said that there were a total of thirteen postal stations in Shanghai at that time, and Zhujiajiao Post Office was one of them. After the Xinhai Revolution overthrew the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Post Office continued to operate as China Post. In 1953, it was relocated to the vicinity of Fangsheng Bridge on North Street, and in 2001, it was listed as a cultural relic protection unit in Qingpu District. The antique bronze cast dragon mailbox standing outside the old post office site is a unique business card of Zhu Jiajiao, showcasing the retro romance of "slow carriages and horses, long letters and letters". In 2022, the overall building of Zhujiajiao Daqing Post Office will undergo a comprehensive spatial upgrade, revitalizing through the renovation of the old style. While preserving the original Ming and Qing architectural styles and cultural heritage, it will integrate new Chinese aesthetics, combining cultural exchange, cultural and creative experiences, art exhibitions, study salons, boat tours, and other diverse cultural experiences. This will recreate the century old vicissitudes of the ancient town post office and showcase the long history of China Post. In addition to the historical attributes of ancient architectural sites, more cultural exchange spaces such as theme coffee, cultural exhibitions, characteristic cultural creation, creative workshops, art summer camps, etc. have also been opened up. In this building that has witnessed the time, we will continue to publicize the profound history and the vitality of modern China-Chic culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 课植园
attractions.summary:
Kezhi Garden, which took 15 years to build, is the largest manor-style garden building in the town. It was once the private residence of Ma Wenqing, a local magnate. 
The name of the garden is "Class Planting", which means "don't forget to cultivate after reading in class". The class garden is a living and learning area, and the topiary is a recreational farming area, with a quiet environment and unique scenery. 
Wangyue Building and Bookstore are the most typical buildings combining Chinese and Western styles in the garden. The stele gallery in the garden is inlaid with handwritten stone carvings such as poems and letters of Tang, Zhu, Wen and Zhou, the four talented scholars of Ming Dynasty, which have high historical and cultural value. 
· It is a great place to take children to play here with rich tour content.
attractions.shortFeatures: A combination of Chinese and Western, originally owned by Jia Shang

attractions.name: 泰安桥
attractions.summary: Tai'an Bridge is located in Shanghai, China and is a bridge with a long history. It is famous for its unique architectural style and rich historical background. It is not only a transportation hub, but also an important symbol of Shanghai's history and culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

attractions.name: 和心园
attractions.summary: Hexin Garden was a private garden during the Qing Dynasty, with a serene environment and buildings that highlight the beauty of symmetry, showcasing the ingenuity of ancient architecture.

attractions.name: 上海蟠龙天地
attractions.summary: This scenic spot is located in Shanghai, which originated in the Sui Dynasty, was built in the Song Dynasty, and flourished in the Ming and Qing Dynasties. During the peak of Panlong, there were ten bridges called "Nine Dragons and One Phoenix". In the renovation of the ancient town, in addition to repairing the two ancient bridges of Xianghua Bridge and Fenglai Bridge, Panlong Tiandi also built eight new bridges based on the research of the ancient bridge form in Jiangnan, connecting the water market.

attractions.name: 丽景门景区
attractions.tag: Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Without arriving at Lijingmen, one would be wasting their time in Luoyang City. Lijingmen was first built in the Sui Dynasty and is the western gate of the ancient city of Luoyang, known as the "first gate of the ancient capital". The current Lijingmen Scenic Area was rebuilt on the original site of the Luoyang Municipal Government, consisting of parts such as the City Gate Tower, Wengcheng, Arrow Tower, City Wall, Lijingqiao, and moat. It is also the location of Luoyang Old Street. Tourists can come here to climb up and enjoy the scenery, taste local snacks, and learn about the ancient Heluo culture. New Year Bell ringing Activity: Every year on the occasion of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Lijingmen City Tower holds the "Welcoming the New Year at midnight Bell" activity. Tourists can personally climb up to the city and ring the 108 bells symbolizing the prosperity, auspiciousness, peace, and happiness of the new year, echoing the sound of the Ma Temple bell from afar.

attractions.name: 洛阳老街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The old street culture was formed in Jinzhongjing, and was built on the former site of Dongcheng, the eastern capital of Sui and Tang Dynasties. It has a history of more than 3,000 years. 
Luoyang Old Street preserves its original appearance, with crowds coming and going, hawkers shouting and shops on both sides, and it is full of the taste of the ancient capital. 
Here, you can experience the prosperous scene of old Luoyang now, and you can eat all kinds of local delicious foods in Luoyang, the most of which is Luoyang water banquet.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the original old street and taste snacks

attractions.name: 白马寺
attractions.summary:
- The first temple built by the government after Buddhism was introduced to China, it is known as the "First Ancient Temple of China."
- The existing relics at the White Horse Temple date back to the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, and are all aligned along the north-south central axis.
- The Mahavira Hall is the main hall of the entire temple, with other major buildings including the Hall of Heavenly Kings, the Great Buddha Hall, and the Pilu Pavilion.
- The temple preserves a large number of rare Yuan dynasty sculptures, including statues of the Three Buddhas, the Two Heavenly Generals, and the Eighteen Arhats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Ancestral Grounds of Chinese Buddhism and the Tomb of Di Renjie

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城国家遗址公园天堂明堂景区
attractions.summary: The Sui and Tang Luoyang City National Heritage Park was once the core area of the palace ruins of the Sui, Tang, Five Dynasties, and Song dynasties, among which the famous ones were the Mingtang and Tiantang during the reign of Empress Wu Zetian. Mingtang is located on the axis of Luoyang city during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It is the main hall of the palace city and an important place for Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu Zetian to unify the world and govern the country. The prototype of the Tianfu Tu in the 2013 film "Detective Dee: The Empire of Heaven" directed by Tsui Hark is here. Heaven is the place where Empress Wu Zetian worshipped Buddhism. The building has five floors on the exterior and nine floors on the interior, symbolizing the supreme status of the emperor as the ruler of China. Tourists can take the elevator directly to the ninth floor, overlooking the panoramic view of Luoyang, and the night view is not to be missed. There are also large and small Buddha statues and murals on other floors, which can reveal the profound Buddhist culture. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 神州牡丹园
attractions.summary:
Shenzhou Peony Garden, opposite the White Horse Temple, has a strong cultural atmosphere. There are many Tang Dynasty-style buildings and large-scale cultural performances about peony themes. Peony Garden consists of Peony Cultural Zone, High-tech Four-Season Peony Exhibition Zone, Peony Leisure Zone, Peony Viewing Zone and Commercial Peony Comprehensive Zone. 
In the garden, there are rare peony stones naturally formed in the world for hundreds of millions of years, the peony king with a tree age of more than 300 years, the world's longest 100-meter national quintessence corridor-Tang Sancai peony mural and the world's largest white marble statue of Ouyang Xiu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architectural style of prosperous Tang

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城应天门遗址
attractions.name_en: The Ruins of Yingtian Gate, Sui-Tang Luoyang City
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Historical ruins
attractions.summary: Ying Tian Gate was the main southern gate of Ziwei City, originally constructed in the first year of the Sui Dynasty's Daye era (605 AD). It was initially named Ze Tian Gate, but in the first year of the Shenlong era (705 AD), it was renamed Ying Tian Gate to avoid using Empress Wu Zetian's name. Later, it became known as the Five Phoenix Tower and endured through the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song Dynasty. Ying Tian Gate was an important venue for the imperial court to hold major state ceremonies and diplomatic events. These included significant occasions such as the Yuan Zheng (New Year's Day), the Winter Solstice, ceremonial music performances, banquets, amnesties, and the transition to a new year. During such events, including tributes from foreign envoys and dignitaries, the emperor would ascend the gate to listen to state affairs. Historical ceremonies such as Emperor Gaozong's capture of the Baekje king, Empress Wu Zetian's ascension to the throne, and Emperor Xuanzong's reception of Japan's eighth envoy to Tang China were all held on the Ying Tian Gate tower. Its function was similar to that of the Meridian Gate in modern Beijing. Ying Tian Gate was a massive architectural complex shaped like a "concave" character, consisting of a main gate tower, parapet walls, east and west watchtowers, and connecting corridors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Sui and Tang ruins, savor the culture of the ancient capital.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 洛阳博物馆
attractions.summary:
Luoyang Museum echoes the landmark buildings of the city such as the Pearl TV Tower of the Central Plains. The shape of the new museum is like a big tripod, which means "Dingding Luoyi". 
· The museum consists of a main building and an auxiliary building. The main building has two floors. The first floor is a general exhibition, and the second floor is a boutique exhibition of the museum. 
· There are more than 11,000 pieces of cultural relics on display in the new museum. Besides the local unearthed cultural relics, it also accepted a number of treasures allocated by the Palace Museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate Rare Treasures and Taste Luoyang Ancient Capital Culture

attractions.name: 洛邑古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Luoyi Ancient City Scenic Spot is located in the old city of Luoyang City, Henan Province, and is known as the "Central Plains Ferry". Taking Wenfeng Pagoda, Confucian Temple, Tuoling Palace, Siyanjinghao and other protected sites in the park as nodes, and Xintan and moat system as links, the overall goal is to organically combine classical and modern buildings, so that old buildings and new buildings are not separated, which not only reflects the traditional cultural heritage of Luoyi Ancient City but also does not lose the modern flavor. The park is scientifically divided into functional areas, and the elegant demeanor of the Millennium Ancient City is concentrated. In the park, functional areas such as catering, tourism, accommodation, business services, etc. are dotted among them. The whole park has a strong cultural atmosphere step by step. It develops and inherits the original cultural landscape and cultural atmosphere of Luoyi Ancient City, making it a highlight of cultural relics protection, revival and inheritance of Luoyang traditional culture in Luoyang Ancient City. Relying on profound cultural heritage, Luoyi Ancient City allows the world to see the beauty of Chinese culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Precipitated the ancient capital culture of thirteen dynasties

attractions.name: 龙门石窟
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Grottoes; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves in China, with a long history, the construction spanned multiple dynasties and lasted for over 500 years.
- Among the numerous caves carved during the Northern Wei period, the Ancient Yang Cave, the Central Cave of Binyang, the Lotus Cave, and the Cave Temple are the most representative.
- There are more than 97,000 Buddha statues in total, with the Western Mountain Caves being the most refined part, including the Luoshen Buddha statue and the "Twenty Images of Longmen."
- Among the key caves of the Tang Dynasty Longmen Grottoes, the grand and imposing group sculptures of the Great Luoshen Buddha are the most famous.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves of China
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城九洲池
attractions.summary: Today's Jiuzhouchi Site Park covers an area of 288 acres, including the Great Inner Dormitory area in the northwest of the palace city, a part of the Taoguang Garden in the north of the palace city, and the Jiuzhouchi Royal Garden in the north of the city west of the palace city. There are a total of 12 sites, which are protected and displayed through various scientific methods. We hope to use methods and forms such as displaying the original site of ancient ruins and simulating the ground to allow more people to understand the royal garden style during the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties. Jiuzhou Pool, as the imperial garden of Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang dynasties, was a real existence in history. According to the "Fangkao of the Two Capital Cities of Tang Dynasty", "Jiuzhou Pool has a curved pool with several islands in it, like Jiuzhou in the East China Sea. It covers an area of ten hectares, with a water depth of more than ten zhang, and is home to birds, fish, and flowers." In 1960, archaeologists discovered it while excavating Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The palace city area of Luoyang during the Sui and Tang dynasties was composed of a central core area and many surrounding small towns. Jiuzhou Pool is located in the northern part of Xige City on the west side of the Imperial Palace, accounting for about two fifths of Xige City. The scope of "ten hectares of residential land" recorded in the records is based on the Tang Dynasty's system of land cultivation. In the Tang Dynasty, one foot was about 29.5 centimeters and ten hectares were about 520000 square meters, which was larger than the entire western city. However, the actual archaeological measurement of the water area of Jiuzhou Lake is about 139250 square meters. Chinese classical garden art holds a pivotal position in traditional Chinese architecture. The forms of Chinese landscape gardens, represented by literati gardens and royal gardens, are aimed at pursuing the spiritual realm of nature, thus achieving the aesthetic pursuit of "although created by humans, as if opened by heaven", reflecting the cultural concept of "harmony between man and nature", which is completely consistent with the overall architectural concept of Luoyang City in the Sui and Tang dynasties. As a royal garden, Jiuzhou Pool not only embodies the combination of nature and culture, expressing the concept of harmonious unity between humans and nature, but also highlights the "ritual system" in traditional Chinese culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 汉口里
attractions.summary: The original historical and cultural street of the Republic of China-"Hankouli", based on the opening of Hankou for more than a hundred years, restores the representative buildings, culture and commercial forms of Hanzheng Street, Dajia Street, Changdi Street and Hualou Street in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and shows the old Hankou lifestyle.
attractions.shortFeatures: Showing the folk customs of Hankou in the late Qing Dynasty

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 湖北美术馆
attractions.summary: Hubei Museum of Art, formerly known as Hubei Provincial Art Museum, is located on the shore of Donghu Lake in Wuchang District, Wuhan City, opposite the Hubei Provincial Museum. The main building of the art museum has 4 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. There are ten exhibition halls in the museum, making it a holy land for art enthusiasts and cultural youth. The exhibitions in the museum are updated frequently. If you want to know the exhibition plan, there are previews on the official website. You can check them before going. In addition to the exhibition hall, the art museum also has modern collection art libraries, multifunctional academic lecture halls, VIP halls, artist studios, art training centers, movie theaters, Chinese and Western restaurants, cafes and other advanced supporting service facilities. After visiting the Hubei Provincial Museum, why not come here and have a look? If you're lucky, you can also see everyone's exhibition. Alternatively, you can sit in the coffee shop here and savor art and life.

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 武汉欢乐谷
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spots; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
- The first Happy Valley themed amusement park in Central China, a large cultural tourism destination that is complex, ecological, and innovative, offering a spectacular interpretation of diverse joy.  
- Composed of eight major themes: Dream Avenue, Cartoon Factory, Happy Time, Speed World, Fisherman's Island, Feather Paradise, Hurricane Bay, and Joyful River City.  
- Featuring more than 30 amusement rides, over 40 ecological and cultural landscapes, more than 10 cultural performance shows, and over 20 themed entertainment games.
attractions.shortFeatures: A popular amusement park with a wide variety of attractions.

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.

Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong.
