TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 香港大学美术博物馆
attractions.name_en: University Museum and Art Gallery, The University of Hong Kong
attractions.summary: The University of Hong Kong Art Museum is the oldest museum in Hong Kong. It was founded in 1953 and was first called the "Feng Pingshan Museum." The building it occupies originally belonged to the "Feng Pingshan Chinese Library" that was opened in 1932. Both are named after the donor of the building. By 1994, the museum was renamed the "Hong Kong University Art Museum". In 1996, a new wing was added to the museum, and the exhibition hall in Xuzhan Hall was completed and opened. In the past 60 years, the museum has collected many China art of historical value. They are mainly divided into three categories: bronzes, ceramics and paintings. They range from the Neolithic Age to the Qing Dynasty. They also include traditional Chinese and modern paintings from the Ming Dynasty to the 21st century.

attractions.name: 西环钟声泳棚
attractions.summary: The Western Ring Swimming Pool was a place for citizens to swim in the 1960s and 1970s. It had a long wooden bridge, some bamboo sheds, and a rudimentary changing room, which could be said to be the public swimming pool of that time. Nowadays, there are very few people who come to swim at the Western Ring Swimming Pool. Most of them come to fish on weekdays, and the sunset here is beautiful. It not only attracts photography enthusiasts, but also many couples come to play and couples come to take wedding photos.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.summary:
--The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, located at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, is one of the newest seaside buildings in Hong Kong. 
--It can be used for large-scale conferences and exhibitions, as well as two five-star hotels, office buildings and luxury apartments.  
--The venue of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony in 1997, where many awards ceremonies and music awards ceremonies are usually held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Place of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园登山缆车
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Ocean Park cable car is a classic facility of the Ocean Park, taking visitors leisurely back and forth between the seaside amusement park at the foot of the mountain and the peak amusement park on the mountain. Passengers can slowly climb up the green hills in the sea breeze, fully enjoy the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, and have a panoramic view of various attractions in the Ocean Park, planning their next stop itinerary carefully.

attractions.name: 昂坪360
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Cable car ropeway; Cable Cars
attractions.summary:
· Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car is the longest outdoor double-cable cable car in Asia, and has won the reputation of Top Ten Surprise Cable Car Tours in the World, Top Ten Best Cable Car Experiences in the World and Top Ten Global Cable Car Tours. 
· A total length of 5.7 kilometers, built on a hill, connecting Tung Chung and Ngong Ping. Overlooking the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, surrounded by the South China Sea, it connects Tung Chung and Ngong Ping Market. 
· After getting off the bus, you will arrive at Ngong Ping Market, which is connected to Po Lin Temple and Tiantan Buddha. It is enjoyed by a vast natural environment and combines Chinese architecture with diversified shopping and dining experiences. 
· In addition to shopping and dining, Ngong Ping Market also provides entertainment programs including: 360VR Experience Hall, 360 Stage, 360 Dynamic Cinema and Walking with Buddha.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the magnificent scenery of mountains and seas; Crystal cabin bottom glass fully transparent

attractions.name: 大澳
attractions.summary:
· Tai O, located on an outlying island, is the earliest developed fishing village on the island. The tall shacks built on the water are the characteristic of Tai O. 
· Fishing villages are far away from the hustle and bustle of urban areas and less affected by urbanization, so they still retain the features of early Hong Kong fishing villages. 
· The vertical and horizontal waterways and water shacks constitute a unique feeling of water town and fishing village scenery, so it is known as the Venice of Hong Kong. 
· The traditional salted fish, shrimp paste and fish maw here are very famous. When you set foot in Tai O, you will feel the strong taste of the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: A tall hut built on the water

restaurants.name_en: AOK Hong Kong style tea restaurant

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 南屏步行街
attractions.summary: Nanping Street is an old block in the history of Kunming and also an ancient commercial street in the city. There are numerous restaurants, shops, supermarkets, and brand chain stores on the streets, offering a wide range of food, accommodation, travel, shopping, and entertainment options. It is one of the bustling streets in Kunming and also a popular spot for tourists to check in. At the entrance of Nanping Street, there is a large memorial archway, which is one of the landmark attractions here. Many tourists take photos here. There are also bronze statues on the street, with lifelike figures that can be photographed and recorded. Shopping, tasting delicious food, and savoring the charm of Kunming.

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 金殿公园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for strolling with kids; Taoist Temples
attractions.summary: Jindian Park is named after the main hall, which is made of brass and shines brightly under the sunlight, casting a golden glow over the lush valley and the serene forest. It is also known as the Copper Roof Temple. The renowned Jindian is part of the Taoist Taihe Palace, originally built in the Ming Dynasty (1602), and is one of China's four major copper temples, with the best-preserved structure. In the 10th year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1671), the King of the Western Frontier, Wu Sangui, renovated it. With a long history, Jindian offers beautiful natural scenery, with paths winding through forests where towering trees create a canopy, occasionally interrupted by bird songs. The area is deeply infused with the essence of Taoist culture. In early spring, the hundred-acre camellia garden in the "Jindian Botanical Garden" blooms in full, filling the air with a sea of crimson, creating a breathtaking sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place for a refreshing stroll in a pleasant environment.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 广州塔460米摩天轮
attractions.summary: The Ferris wheel is located 460 meters away from the Guangzhou Tower and is one of the popular tourist attractions in the tower. It cleverly utilizes the platform at the top of the tower and, unlike other Ferris wheels, runs on an inclined track. It is currently the tallest horizontal Ferris wheel in the world. The Ferris wheel is composed of 16 transparent crystal ball cabins that resemble sparkling pearls, slowly flowing around, and the beautiful scenery of Yangcheng unfolds before my eyes like a scroll. Sun, moon, and stars, accompanied by auspicious clouds, this place has become a romantic place for marriage proposals, allowing tourists to experience the romance at the top of the world. Full text 

attractions.name: 海心桥
attractions.summary: To the north of the construction site of the the Pearl River Pedestrian Landscape Bridge is the island tip on the east side of Ersha Island, and to the south is the International Media Port. The width of the river is about 280 meters, with an upstream distance of about 500 meters from Guangzhou Bridge and a downstream distance of about 1.4 kilometers from Liede Bridge. The planned navigation net width at the bridge location is not less than 180 meters and the net height is 10 meters. The main bridge adopts a steel structure inclined arch bridge with a main span of 240 meters. The total length of the bridge deck on the east side is about 451 meters, and the total length of the main beam on the west side is about 296 meters. The pedestrian bridge has a total width of 20 meters in the middle span, with a width of 6 meters on the west side, 8 meters on the east side, and 6 meters on the middle staircase.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游广州塔·中大码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Canton Tower-Sun Yat-sen University Pier
attractions.summary: Guangzhou Tower · Zhongda Pier, close to Sun Yat sen University, is an important the Pearl River night cruise ship dock. The cruise ship starts from the Zhongda Pier via Ersha Island - Xinghai Concert Hall - Zhongda North Gate - Haiyin Bridge - Guangzhou Bridge - Haixinsha - Guangzhou Tower - Liede Bridge - and returns to Guangzhou Tower. Full text 

attractions.name: 南越王博物院(王墓展区)
attractions.name_en: The Nanyue King Museum of The Western Han Dynasty
attractions.summary: The Western Han Nanyue King Museum is located in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, and is the exhibition area for the royal tombs of the Nanyue King Museum (a research center for the history of Western Han Nanyue). In June 1983, the tomb of the King of Nanyue was excavated and unearthed. The museum was built based on the original site of the tomb, mainly displaying the original site of the King of Nanyue's tomb and its unearthed cultural relics. Compared to other museums, its highlight lies in the precious "Silk Thread Jade Robe". The Silk Thread Jade Robe of the King of Nanyue is one of the earliest and most complete sets of jade robes excavated in China, which is definitely worth a visit. Also, this museum was built on the site of the cemetery, so it contains the tomb of the King of Nanyue. To the east of the museum is a three story comprehensive exhibition building, and to the north is a two-story main exhibition building. The three buildings are connected as a whole by a surrounding corridor that connects them up and down. The museum has a total of 10 exhibition halls, with permanent exhibitions including cultural relics exhibitions and porcelain pillow exhibitions, as well as occasional temporary exhibitions. The cultural relics exhibition is the main body of the museum, mainly consisting of unearthed cultural relics from the tomb of King Zhao Xu of Nanyue, with over 10000 pieces of various burial objects unearthed from the tomb. The exhibition is divided into five units: Emperor Wen's Golden Seal, Treasures of the Main Chamber, Martyrdom in the Tomb, Treasures in the Imperial Treasury, and Bell and Ding Food. There are a large number of jade artifacts in the accompanying collection, such as the Qingyu Jiao Cup, eleven sets of jade accessories, and fifty-eight jade sword ornaments, all of which are significant discoveries in Han jade. The treasures among jade artifacts are undoubtedly the "Silk Thread Jade Robe", "Carrying Plate High Foot Cup", and "Dragon and Phoenix Pattern Heavy Ring Jade Pendant". The dragon and phoenix patterned heavy ring jade pendant is a decorative jade artifact unearthed from the right eye of the tomb owner. It is carved from blue and white jade and is divided into two rings: the inner ring is intricately carved with a swimming dragon, and the outer ring is intricately carved with a phoenix bird. Its design has been selected as the emblem of the Nanyue King Museum of the Western Han Dynasty. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 余荫山房
attractions.summary: Yuyin Mountain Villa, also known as Yuyin Garden, is a private garden of Wu Bin, a scholar from the Qing Dynasty. It has a history of more than 130 years. The garden is renowned for its exquisite and intricate artistic features, with pavilions, halls, towers, bridges, corridors, and embankments all compactly arranged within a 300-step radius. The garden is rich in four major types of carvings—brick carvings, wood carvings, plaster carvings, and stone carvings—showing off the elegance and charm of the renowned garden. Ancient trees soar, and rare flowers dazzle, bringing vibrant life to the entire garden. The four major wonders of the garden, namely "Bamboo in the Side Wall," "Rainbow Bridge Reflecting the Moon," "Hidden Treasures in the Deep Willows," and "Double Greens Welcoming Spring," leave visitors in awe and make them reluctant to leave.
attractions.shortFeatures: Known for its compact and delicate layout.

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west.

attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spots; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
- The first Happy Valley themed amusement park in Central China, a large cultural tourism destination that is complex, ecological, and innovative, offering a spectacular interpretation of diverse joy.  
- Composed of eight major themes: Dream Avenue, Cartoon Factory, Happy Time, Speed World, Fisherman's Island, Feather Paradise, Hurricane Bay, and Joyful River City.  
- Featuring more than 30 amusement rides, over 40 ecological and cultural landscapes, more than 10 cultural performance shows, and over 20 themed entertainment games.
attractions.shortFeatures: A popular amusement park with a wide variety of attractions.

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

attractions.summary: Combining ancient and modern commercial streets, the scenery is different during the day and night, so you can walk around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commercial street combining ancient and modern times

attractions.name: 解放阁
attractions.summary: Jiefang Pavilion is located at the southeast corner of the old city wall of Jinan, east of Heihu Spring, facing Heihu Spring across the moat. The pavilion is located at the breakthrough point of the siege of Jinan by the People's Liberation Army during the 1948 Battle of Jinan (specifically on September 24, 1948). When the old city wall was demolished due to urban construction, the people of Jinan specially built a magnificent Jiefang Pavilion on the old city site here to commemorate the liberation of Jinan. A 10 meter high stone platform was built in 1965, but construction was halted due to the Cultural Revolution. The pavilion was built on stage in 1985 and completed on September 24, 1986. Jiefang Pavilion is a provincial-level key cultural relic protection unit in Shandong Province and also one of the patriotic education bases in Jinan. Standing on the Jiefang Pavilion, people can pay their respects to the martyrs and heroes.

attractions.name: 黑虎泉
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Springs; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It contains a natural cave with massive stones lying within, resembling a fierce tiger hidden deep inside, and the sound of the spring is eerily similar to a tiger's roar, hence named Black Tiger Spring.
- Black Tiger Spring is majestic and powerful, with a flow rate second only to Baotu Spring, ranking second among all the springs in Jinan.
- Many locals come here to collect water, which is crystal clear. Bees might also want to try the spring water here.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Springs of Jinan.

attractions.name: 泉城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Quancheng is the alias of Jinan. The design of the whole square closely follows the theme of "Spring", and the shape of the word "Spring" in seal script is located in the center. 
There is a lotus statue in the middle of the lotus music fountain in the east of the square. The fountain will change different shapes, and each fountain lasts about 30 minutes. 
There is Ginza Shopping Plaza underground in Quancheng Plaza, and Furong Snack Street is not far away. It is a good choice to come here for leisure in the evening.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jinan city prominent sign

attractions.name: 千佛山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Treasure for Kids; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is known as one of the "Three Major Scenic Spots of Jinan" alongside Baotu Spring and Daming Lake. It is part of the Taishan mountain range, not very high, but with undulating peaks and lush forests.
- The Thousand Buddha Cave here houses nearly 30,000 Buddhist statues, with the largest reclining Buddha measuring 28 meters in length. The cave also features exquisite murals that showcase the profound cultural connotations of Buddhism.
- Visitors usually enter Qianfo Mountain through the North Gate and begin the climb. It generally takes less than an hour to reach the summit, where they can enjoy a panoramic view of downtown Jinan.
- A temple fair is held every year on the 3rd day of the 3rd lunar month and the 9th day of the 9th lunar month, lasting for a week, featuring performances such as gong and drum, martial arts, and Shandong kuaishu (a fast-paced storytelling art).
attractions.shortFeatures: The summit offers a panoramic view of downtown Jinan.

attractions.name: 泉城公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary: Quancheng Park, located in the middle of Jinan city, was built in September 1989 and opened to the public free of charge in September 1997. Formerly known as Jinan Botanical Garden, it was renamed Quancheng Park on September 22, 2006. The total area of the park is 46.7 hectares, with a green space rate of 81.7%. According to the groups with high ornamental value in the process of plant evolution, there are pine and cypress, peony, rose, bamboo, willow, chrysanthemum, clove and other gardens in this area. Through the classification of plants, people are shown with the peculiar tree posture, abundant flowers and fruits and colorful colors of various plants in different seasons. The ornamental greenhouse area is located in the western part of the garden, which is a large building complex composed of tropical, subtropical, sandy plant greenhouses and bonsai gardens. The introduction and domestication area is responsible for introducing foreign plants, saving and cultivating rare and endangered plants, and providing services for greening scientific research. There are also refreshment service department and photography department in the park, and large-scale flower exhibitions and bonsai root carving art exhibitions are organized to enrich the content of the masses' tour.
attractions.shortFeatures: A city park with a wide variety of plants

attractions.name: 老商埠夜市
attractions.summary: The Jinan Old Commercial Port Night Market mainly has a bar area, a coffee area, and a barbecue area, upgrading the century old style of the commercial port into a cultural IP, focusing on young customers, and holding the first Shitaiyan Retro Market, which integrates food, antiques, and cultural creativity.

attractions.name: 曲水亭街
attractions.summary:
Qushuiting Street is a famous old street with historical and cultural characteristics at home and abroad in Jinan, Quancheng. 
On one side is an old house with blue bricks and red tiles, and on the other side is a clear spring flowing calmly, where people facing the street wash rice and wash laundry, making the old street vibrant. 
At present, the spring city style of "every household springs water, every household hangs poplars" in Travels of Lao Can is still completely retained.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old street with historical and cultural characteristics in Jinan

attractions.name: 蓬莱阁
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Penglai Pavilion, along with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is known as one of China's Four Great Towers.  
· Known as the "Fairyland on Earth," the well-known myth of "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea" originates here.  
· Penglai Pavilion is located by the sea, often shrouded in mist, making it feel like being in a fairyland. On a good day, one can even witness a "mirage."  
· In addition to Penglai Pavilion, the scenic area also includes Tianheng Mountain, Dengzhou Museum, Ancient Ship Museum, and the dividing line between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.  
· From the mountain top, one can enjoy a distant view of the junction between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, where the boundary line between the yellow and blue waters is very distinct, and one can also see Changdao Island in the distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Legend of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea

attractions.name: 八仙过海景区
attractions.name_en: The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Seashores; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A national AAAA-level tourist attraction, the place where the Eight Immortals crossed the sea in Chinese mythology, with a shape resembling a treasure gourd lying across the sea.
- Composed of nearly 40 scenic spots, including the Eight Immortals Square, Eight Immortals Bridge, Wangying Tower, Eight Immortals Temple, Huixian Pavilion, and Baixian Terrace, among others.
- A maritime garden and pavilion themed around the Eight Immortals, with jade artifacts and stone carvings visible everywhere, making it a huge treasure trove.
- An ideal place for worshipping the immortals and sightseeing, hence Penglai enjoys the reputation of "a fairyland on earth and a leisure paradise."
attractions.shortFeatures: Revisiting ancient myths and legends

attractions.name: 文成城堡
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Castles
attractions.summary:
Wencheng Castle, located next to Yanpeng Tourist Avenue, was built by Mr. Li Wencheng, an overseas Chinese from Canada, and Penglai Wencheng Architectural Decoration Co., Ltd. with an investment of 600 million RMB. The castle is a skillful combination of European architectural elements, mainly in Baroque style, and the building materials mainly based on precious cave stones carry the essence of European architecture and decorative arts, embodying a unique aristocratic atmosphere. Surrounded by a moat, it is filled with seawater, which can raise sea cucumbers and abalones, and can also be used for people to play in the water and row boats, which is full of fun. Coupled with the design of concave front and convex back, the castle presents unique variability whether it is forward-looking or rear-looking, whether it is flat or three-dimensional. Although it is only 4 storeys high, its incomparable diversity of other buildings brings unlimited imagination. The shape is elegant and generous, the round roof points directly to the blue sky, the trapezoidal and tapered roofs on both sides are interspersed with each other, superimposed and staggered, and the fireplace chimney is dotted among them, which fully shows the unique romantic feelings and heroic spirit of European technology. 
In July, 17, Mahua FunAge's team traveled all over the country to find a venue to shoot the fourth comedy film "The Richest Man in Xihong City", and finally "stepped through the iron shoes and found nowhere, but it took no effort to get it". By chance, they met Wencheng Castle, which has great European classical architectural artistic characteristics, and finally were amazed by such a unique European-style castle group in China, taking it as the most ideal interior shooting location.
attractions.shortFeatures: The shooting location of "The Richest Man in Xihong City"

attractions.name: 欧乐堡梦幻世界
attractions.tag: The best places to take kids; playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary: Shandong Penglai OLE Dreamworld is located on the Golden Coast of Penglai, in close proximity to the national 5A scenic spots, the Baxian Crossing the Sea Scenic Area and the Sanxian Mountain Scenic Area. The park features classic European architectural styles, allowing visitors to experience foreign charm without leaving the country. It integrates the most advanced European and American technological elements, creating the most cutting-edge facilities, the most comprehensive attractions, and the highest technological content in any large amusement park in China, surpassing the limits of imagination.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the Exotic Theme Park

attractions.name: 蓬莱欧乐堡水上世界
attractions.summary: Penglai Oulebao Water World is equipped with six themed areas, multiple sets of large-scale water entertainment facilities, and more than 30 slides, integrating exotic charm to create a large-scale water amusement kingdom that combines excitement, adventure, parent-child, and fantasy. The main equipment includes: water roller coaster, high-speed halo, mysterious cave, parent-child water play area, joyful water area, dreamy vortex, magic loop, Green Lantern, flying carpet expert, spiral sprint, time travel, adventure drifting, hurricane bay, and unlimited check-in all day long. The "magic loop" that turns rivers and seas, allowing you to cheer freely in speed and passion; Experience the "dream vortex" of high-speed centrifugal rotation, an extraordinary and exciting journey that you can't stop loving; The 28 meter high "time and space shuttle" slide, which makes your heart beat faster, slides freely at a speed of 21 meters per second, allowing screams and splashes to accompany you and enjoy a wind like feeling; The "Hurricane Bay" with surging waves, the 10000 meter white sand wave making pool not only allows you to experience the surging waves, but also feel the warmth and romance of Ma Dai; A 550 meter long "adventure drift", traversing through the jungle and waterfalls, experiencing a thrilling and exciting wonderful journey; Parent child water play area and joyful water area, where both adults and children can freely play and enjoy the fun of water and water play in this lively world; More beautiful and romantic bubble shows bring you white romantic colors; DJ electronic music was full of excitement and turned the whole venue upside down; Splashing water battles allow you to unleash yourself and fully experience the joy of being wet. This is a summer paradise and a joyful ocean! Cool summer! Everything is in the water world of Orenburg! Full text 

attractions.name: 九丈崖
attractions.summary:
Because of sea erosion, the cliffs by the sea stand upright, and some places are greater than 90 degrees, which is unique in the domestic seaside landscape. 
The cliffs and reefs here are in various shapes. They are places for catching the sea and fishing, and they are also rare materials for artistic creation such as photography. 
A crown-shaped observation platform was also built on the cliff head of Jiuzhang Cliff. It's also a great place to watch the sunset and sunrise.
attractions.shortFeatures: Towering and steep seaside cliffs

attractions.name: 望夫礁景区
attractions.summary: Wangfu Reef Park is one of the tourist attractions on Long Island. The main attractions include the "Fu" character on the slope of Wangfu Reef, which is 21.9 meters high and 16.3 meters wide, as well as the Guanyin Pavilion, Olympic Monument, Geological Museum, etc. This large "Fu" character immediately highlights the atmosphere of the "source of Fu".

attractions.name: 月牙湾公园
attractions.summary: Crescent Bay, also known as Half Moon Bay, is located at the northern end of Beichangshan Island. Crescent Bay is a beach with mountains and water on its back. As the name suggests, its shape resembles a crescent moon in the night sky, embedded between green mountains and clear waters. However, what is particularly unique is the ball stones scattered on the beach, as white as jade, colorful and extremely beautiful. The main buildings in the park are a 20 meter high "Crescent Pavilion" that combines Chinese and Western styles, a "Guanlan Pavilion" standing on a cliff, and a long corridor about a kilometer long. In front of the long corridor, there is a 100 meter "stone carpet" decorated with stone balls, giving a feeling of "stepping on pearls" when walking on it. What is particularly charming is the ballstone of Crescent Bay, which can be said to be a world of glittering and precious ballstones. It is as white as jade and crystal clear as amber, and no matter where you pick it up, you will not be able to let go of a single one.

attractions.name: 仙境源
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Beaches
attractions.summary:
Wonderland Scenic Spot is located in Wanggou Village, on the east coast of Changdao County. It is famous for the unearthed human skull fossil and nearly 100 tombs dating back 2,500 years, and is known as the first village in northern China. It combines primitive natural scenery and beautiful myths and legends, showing the charming charm of natural landscape. The sea and sky in the scenic spot are vast, which makes people feel refreshed and linger. 
It is said that the source of fairyland used to be the place where the Eight Immortals lived, and the place where Qin Emperor and Hanwu sought immortals and medicine. Step into the source of fairyland, watch the sunrise of the Yellow Sea in the east, the majestic sunset of the Bohai Sea in the west, the Penglai Pavilion where the Eight Immortals gather in the south, and the Laotieshan Mountain in Liaodong Peninsula in the north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Natural scenery and myths and legends are integrated

attractions.name: 林海公园
attractions.summary:
Linhai Park is named after the vast sea and dense forest. Located at the southernmost tip of Long Island City, it is the freshest, most secluded and most mysterious place in the whole county. 
Linhai Park is a "concentrated fairyland and expanded bonsai", which is based on the mountain and the sea. It is famous for the intersection of the Yellow Sea and Bohai Sea, and it is also called "natural oxygen bar" because of its high content of negative oxygen ions. It is a rare health resort and eco-tourism area.
attractions.shortFeatures: Adjacent to the sea, the forest is vast

attractions.name: 万鸟岛
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Che Island, also known as Gaoshan Island, is located in the east of the middle of Long Island Islands. In the vast ocean, it is simply an insignificant grain of sand. However, the deep sea is attractive, and the island is small and interesting. There are tens of thousands of seagulls inhabiting the island, which is called "Ten Thousand Birds Island". 
The best time for birding is around May every year, when seagulls and various other birds hatch and brood. Watching seabirds is not only near this island, but also in several surrounding islands. The general sea tour route will also pass through several small islands, and some will leave some time for tourists to go to the island. Therefore, when taking part in the sea tour, don't forget to bring some hard bread to feed the seagulls.
attractions.shortFeatures: Seagull habitat and seabird breeding ground in northern China; Parent-child fun

attractions.name: 宝塔礁
attractions.summary: Baota Reef is named after its shape resembling a pagoda. The reef is about 21 meters high and has a diameter of about 5 meters. Its shape resembles a towering giant tower, and no matter from which angle you look, you will always appreciate different natural charm, which makes people admire the greatness of natural power. Baota Reef is composed of alternating layers of quartzite, with horizontal stone patterns dividing the tower into several straight layers. The vertical rock lines also divide each layer into multiple sections. Under this criss crossing, it seems that the tower is not a tight whole, but a loose building made up of stones of different sizes and shapes. Now a pristine navigation lighthouse has been built on the adjacent small island on the south side of the reef. The white tower on the island stands side by side with the pagoda in the sea, making it a beautiful scenery on the sea.

restaurants.name_en: Long Island Crescent Bay Fisherman's Inn Restaurant

attractions.name: 网师园
attractions.summary:
- Wangshi Garden is a representative example of a medium-sized classical Chinese garden, featuring traditional landscape and residential architecture. It was established during the Southern Song Dynasty.
- Initially named "Yuyin" (Fisherman's Retreat), it was renamed "Wangshi Garden" in 1765, reflecting the owner's intention to retreat into a life of seclusion.
- Despite the garden's many buildings, they are not crowded, and although the pond is less than one mu in size, it does not feel small. It can be considered a model of Chinese gardens where simplicity triumphs over complexity.
- From the main gate to the carriage hall, Wanjuantang, and Xiexiu Tower, the buildings unfold along the central axis. The main hall, Wanjuantang, is spacious with elegant decorations.
- In addition to understanding the layout's intricacies, another highlight of the garden is enjoying the traditional opera performances during the annual night garden events.
attractions.shortFeatures: The garden known for its delicate and intricate design.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
