- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 枫桥景区
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

attractions.name: 枫桥夜泊
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Night Mooring is famous for the Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Renhe. From Fengqiao Night Mooring, one can carefully enjoy the scenery of Hanshan Temple.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 木渎古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Mudu Ancient Town, known as the "First Town of Wu" in the Wu region, is famous for its small bridges, flowing water, and ancient trees, offering a unique charm among many other ancient towns.  
· The town is crisscrossed by waterways such as the Muguang River, and its stone embankments create an ancient waterway landscape. The old streets and narrow alleys are home to many traditional courtyards.  
· Inside the Hongyin Mountain Villa, there is a grand stage where Emperor Qianlong watched performances during his six visits to Jiangnan. The villa also displays twenty imperial edicts from the emperor.  
· The town is a food lover's paradise, with the recommended Shijia Restaurant serving its signature dish, Fish Lung Soup, made by simmering fish liver in chicken broth. The fish liver is tender, and the soup is extremely delicious.  
· Local crafts in Mudu include silk, double-sided embroidery, redwood carvings, Chengni inkstones, calligraphy and paintings, and stone carvings, all available for purchase as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to explore the classical gardens.

attractions.name: 沧浪亭
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
It is the oldest garden in Suzhou and one of the four famous gardens in Suzhou. It was originally the pool pavilion of King Guangling of Wu Yue in the Five Dynasties. 
· Built by the water, the various window styles and bamboo in the garden are the biggest attractions. 
The biggest difference between the layout and other gardens in Suzhou lies in its transparency, and the rockery is integrated with the pool water outside the garden. 
The rockery in the garden is integrated with the pool water outside the garden, and the bamboo and wood are quiet, full of ancient meaning, natural harmony, which can be called clever conception.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classic gardens with rockery scenery
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 可园
attractions.summary:
Suzhou Keyuan, also known as Near Mountain Forest and Paradise, is located in Sanyuanfang (No.708 Renmin Road) in the south of Suzhou, just one lane away from Canglang Pavilion. Keyuan is a classical garden building built in the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms. The garden gate faces south, facing Canglang Pavilion across the water.  
In 1963, it was listed as a cultural relics protection unit in Suzhou. The existing area of the garden is 5,000 square meters, with a pool in the middle, sparse buildings, curved corridors, bright water and woods, and clear courtyards. It has been repaired several times over the decades.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classical gardens with twists and turns in history
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 耦园
attractions.summary:
Coupling Garden, formerly known as Sheyuan, is located in Xiaoxinqiao Lane, Cangjie, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province. It was built by Lu Jin, the magistrate of Baoning during the Shunzhi period of Qing Dynasty. It takes the meaning of "the garden is involved in the day to become interesting" in Tao Yuanming's "Return to Lai Xi Ci". Huangshi Rockery is the characteristic of Coupling Garden. This garden is named Coupling Garden because there is a garden on the east and west sides of the house. The north-south revetment wharf is one of the characteristics of the coupling garden, which shows the characteristics of "people sleep on the river" in Gusu. 
Coupling Garden is a national key cultural relics protection unit and has been listed as a World Cultural Heritage by UNESCO.
attractions.shortFeatures: A poetic garden that symbolizes the natural birth of a couple
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

restaurants.name_en: Miss Niu Chaoshan Beef Hot Pot

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 千禧广场
attractions.shortFeatures: View the tallest building in the Central Plains

attractions.name: CBD广场
attractions.summary: Zhengdong New District CBD is an urban circular building complex that integrates various functions such as business, office, sightseeing, and leisure. Composed of two sets of high-rise buildings, the inner ring building is 80 meters high and the outer ring building is 120 meters high, with a comfortable and lively commercial pedestrian street between the two rings. As a new landmark of Zhengzhou, it is a place that you cannot miss when you come to Zhengzhou.

attractions.name: 如意湖景区
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy a large-scale water show

attractions.name: 郑州之林
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Forest is located in the western part of the CBD, with a total area of approximately 28.87 hectares. It is an important component of the Central Park of Zhengdong New District CBD and a large landscape green space in the CBD.

attractions.name: 河南省科技馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The new Henan Science and Technology Museum, located in Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou, covers an area of 130000 square meters and integrates exhibitions, cinemas, and academic exchanges. With an international perspective, Chinese temperament, and Henan characteristics, it aims to create an intelligent science popularization education base and become a new landmark in Zhengzhou.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30)

attractions.name: 中国绿化博览园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Autumn Foliage Viewing
attractions.summary:
Zhengzhou China Green Expo Park is located in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City. The park is divided into several functional areas, including the Maple Lake Area, Exhibition Garden Area, Green Lifestyle Experience Area, and Leisure and Entertainment Area. Many of these areas are centered around "Maple Lake," surrounded by ecological landscapes such as forests and wetlands. The park also offers facilities for visitors, including viewing platforms, an arts center, and a pier.

Zhengzhou Green Expo Park is a first-class, large-scale ecological theme park in China. It is an ecological and cultural garden that brings together various regional folk customs and historical cultural elements from across the country. It also serves as a base for showcasing the latest low-carbon, green technologies, and new species in ecological construction from both China and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the flowers and plants from all over the country.

attractions.name: 只有河南·戏剧幻城
attractions.summary: The highlight exhibition of the park is only Henan Drama Fantasy City, which is jointly created by Jianye Group and director Wang Chaoge. It is a drama fantasy city with 21 theaters and is currently one of the largest drama clusters in China. The scenic area uses immersive theatrical art as a technique and unique "phantom city" architecture as a carrier. By telling stories about "land, food, and inheritance", more people can experience the charm of theatrical culture. The recommended three main theaters in the park include three themed theaters, namely "Lijiacun Theater", "Fantasy City Theater", and "Railway Station Theater", as well as 18 small theaters scattered around. The Lijiacun Theater takes "land, food, and inheritance" as its main theme, telling the story of the bloodline inheritance and endless vitality in a village during the Great Famine in Henan in 1942. Outside this door, lies the painful years that the entire Henan province has experienced. This door may make you feel depressed and sad. Our purpose in opening this door is not to let you experience pain, but to hope that you cherish your blessings. The Phantom City Theater is a seated theater that can accommodate nearly 3000 people. It tells the story of a cultural epic spanning thousands of years on a site. The stage adopts modern techniques of sound, light, and electricity, combined with a mechanical stage that can be raised and lowered up to three floors, allowing the audience to cross time and space in the illusionary city and embark on a fantastic journey to the Xia, Shang, Zhou, and Song dynasties. The story of the Train Station Theater and the Lijiacun Theater is in line, telling the tale of a conflicted soldier who sacrifices himself to save others in a station during the Great Famine of 1942. The station theater also adopts an immersive viewing method, where actors immerse themselves in the audience and engage in dialogue, giving the audience the opportunity to become a part of the drama and experience a fully immersive viewing experience. The 328 meter long rammed earth wall of Civilization Light (Closing Garden Show) will transform into a 328 meter long "painting scroll" at night, and the moving "Along the River during Qingming Festival" and "Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains" will be projected onto the wall. In the 56 checkerboard layout of the small theater and situational drama space, you are a participant in the drama. Experience drama in a free way, and also move around in the time fragments of the situational drama space, multidimensional your perception. There is only one pit courtyard in the center of Henan province, which is the imprint of the land, the sculpture of loess, and the wisdom of the people. Dikengyuan not only gathers well-known traditional catering formats in Henan, but also has various rich formats such as several intangible cultural heritage themed pavilions and markets. Tourists can enjoy traditional cuisine while also experiencing a unique folk culture banquet. Mailang Restaurant can accommodate 2500 people for dining at the same time. It is a modern and stylish comprehensive catering service center that integrates culture, design, and art. It offers a variety of dining options including well-known Chinese and Western fast food, regional cuisine, desserts and drinks, and popular snacks for tourists to choose from. Full text 

attractions.name: 河南博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Henan Museum, founded in 1927, has rich collections and is one of the most worth visiting museums in China. 
It is the exhibition area of Henan's 5,000-year history, and it is also the best window to understand Henan, with more than 140,000 cultural relics in the collection. 
The museum has eight exhibition halls in chronological order, among which the lotus crane square pot in the pre-Qin period is a national treasure that can't be missed. 
Every Tuesday to Sunday, there will be Chinese ancient music performances in the museum. The performance times are 11:00 and 16:00 respectively, and each performance lasts about 20 minutes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enriching the collection and showing the long history of the Central Plains

attractions.name: 郑州市动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Zoo is located at No.103 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City. It was built in 1982 and opened in 1985. It covers an area of 430 mu and has jurisdiction over pet parks. After more than 30 years of construction and development, the number of animals on display in the park has grown from more than 20 species of 200 animals at first to more than 260 species of 3,300 animals today. It is a large-scale professional zoo in Henan Province and the executive director unit of China Zoo Association, shouldering the functions of wildlife ex situ conservation, animal breeding, popular science research and leisure and entertainment.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounter with rare animals
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Spring and summer 07:30-18:00,Opens at Autumn 07:30-18:00,Opens at Winter 07:30-17:30

restaurants.name_en: Sheraton Grand Hotel Caiyuexuan Sichuan and Cantonese Restaurant
Courtyard by Marriott Huiyi · Wan Yixuan
Wanda Mandarin Hotel Gourmet All Day Restaurant

attractions.name: 无锡热雪奇迹
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ice and Snow Park
attractions.summary:
· Wuxi Hot Snow Miracle is located in Sunac Cultural and Cultural Tourism City, Binhu District, Wuxi City. It is a ski resort in East China that integrates indoor skiing and snow entertainment, covering the entire population of Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai. It opened on June 29, 2019, with a construction area of approximately 17,500 square meters and a reception service area of approximately 7,500 square meters. 
· The constant temperature of the venue is about-6 ℃ throughout the year. It is suitable for all kinds of people to experience, practice and train. A snow recreation area and gentle slope covering an area of about 5,600 square meters are set up for young children. Children can also practice skiing and snow recreation activities. It is a good place for citizens and tourists to play in the snow in all seasons.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world of real ice and snow in Nordic style
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 10:00-21:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 18:00)

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 基诺山雨林徒步
attractions.summary: Entering the depths of Baopiao Village in the rain forest of Jinuo Mountain, one can see the phenomenon of huge tree roots, tall trees that cover the sky, traditional Chinese herbs in tropical rainforests, dripping leaf tips, flower growth in old trees, parasitic epiphytes and other wonders along the way. Along the 2-kilometer upstream challenge section, plant identification is carried out, water is taken from the rainforest, and several kilometers of mountain climbing sections are completed.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 西双版纳傣族园
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
- Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park is composed of five well-preserved Dai natural villages, namely Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga.
- Upon entering the park, the first thing you encounter is the Welcome Square, where you are greeted by warm-hearted Dai people performing welcome dances, singing blessings, and sprinkling water for good wishes.
- The park also houses the Manchunman Ancient Buddhist Temple, one of the oldest temples in Xishuangbanna, with a history of over 1,400 years. Every day, you can hear the sound of chanting inside the temple.
- The grandest festival for the Dai people in Xishuangbanna is the Water-Splashing Festival. At the Water-Splashing Square in the Dai Ethnic Park, you can experience the lively scenes of the festival every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Accept the warm welcome dance of the Dai people.

restaurants.name_en: Zhonghe Club · Restaurant Bar Pao Ding Fresh Cut Beef Shop

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 中国人民革命军事博物馆
attractions.name_en: Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution
attractions.tag: Venue exhibition hall; Military Sites; Museums
attractions.summary:
Founded in 1959, China's only large-scale comprehensive military history museum is one of the top ten buildings in the capital dedicated to the 10th anniversary of the National Day. 
The whole building is upright and magnificent, with 7 floors in the center, 4 floors on both sides, and a tall military emblem on the top floor. 
The exhibition is divided into the Agrarian Revolutionary War Hall, the War of Resistance against Japan Hall, the National Liberation War Hall, the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea Hall, the Ancient War Hall, etc.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 津湾广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jinwan Square is located beside the Haihe River, opposite Tianjin Station across the Haihe River. It is one of the most prosperous areas in Tianjin. 
The biggest highlight is its cultural heritage. The diverse composition of Tianjin's modern architectural style highlights the characteristics of the times when Chinese and western cultures converge.  
In addition, it is also the best place to enjoy the day and night scenery of Haihe River. The tall buildings backed by it are a bustling modern city, which is gorgeous and charming when lit at night. 
The European buildings around the square and on both sides of the river also constitute the whole landscape, which is one of the iconic viewing spots in Tianjin.
attractions.shortFeatures: The bustling area of Tianjin with charming night scene

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 静园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
Jingyuan, which combines Spanish and Japanese styles, is a typical representative of courtyard-style private mansion in Tianjin Concession period. 
It used to be the residence of Lu Zongyu, the minister of Beiyang government in Japan. Later, the last emperor Puyi lived here with Queen Wanrong and Shu Fei Wenxiu. 
· The noise of the city center is blocked out, only bursts of birdsong, which is very leisurely and suitable for tourists who like history and architecture to meditate and travel slowly. 
Reed flowers bloom in late autumn (October-December) every year, which is an excellent season to watch reed flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of the last emperor Puyi

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 盘山
attractions.summary: Panshan is located on the west side of Jixian County and is a famous mountain in the Beijing Tianjin area. There are many strange pine trees, rocks, and flowing water on the mountain, and with different heights, three layers of scenery appear in sequence, becoming the famous "Three Pans" scenery. Due to its beautiful scenery, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited Panshan 32 times and even exclaimed, "If I had known there were Panshan, why go down to Jiangnan. Although Panshan belongs to Tianjin city, it is actually closer to Beijing city center than to Tianjin city center. During holidays, tourists from the vicinity of Beijing and Tianjin rush to visit, and there are more people there. There are two cable cars in front of the mountain: the Jinsheng Cable Car (Shanmen Wansong Temple), which costs 60 yuan one-way and can reach halfway up the mountain; Yunsong Cableway (Wansong Temple Yunmao Temple), one-way 60 yuan, from halfway up the mountain to Yunmao Temple under the hanging moon peak, very close to the mountaintop. There is a mountain sightseeing bus and a hanging moon cableway in the back mountain, which are sold together for 100 yuan per trip. After taking the sightseeing bus and cableway in sequence, climb a short distance to reach the top of the mountain. The highest peak on the mountain is only 864.4 meters above sea level, but if you hike the entire distance, you will have to walk about 30 kilometers. Although the mountain is not high, you have to climb several hills, which is very tiring. A more reasonable arrangement is to take a sightseeing car and a hanging moon cableway from the back mountain directly to the top of the mountain, then walk down from the front mountain and walk along the front mountain from the hanging moon peak to the mountain gate, which is about 12 kilometers. Hanging Moon Peak: After climbing to the top of the mountain by sightseeing car and cable car, you can see the Pagoda of Dingguang Buddha Relic, which is a stone pagoda and a symbol of the mountain top. Start descending the mountain. If you have good physical strength, you can choose to climb the second highest peak of the mountain, Zilai Peak, at the fork in the road; If you want to save energy or time, just go all the way down the mountain. Top of the Mountain - Wansong Temple: After passing through the high temples such as Yunmao Temple, Nantian Gate, and Jiangjun Stone on Panshan Mountain, you can descend to the large temple Wansong Temple (formerly known as Li Jing'an, where the famous Tang Dynasty general Li Jing once lived). This is the road that the Yunsong Cableway passes through. If you hike, there are many dirt roads that are difficult to walk on and have few scenic spots. However, you can see the magnificent natural scenery, with rolling mountains, white clouds dotted in the blue sky, and the strange pine trees on the upper plate and the strange rocks in the middle plate all in one's sight. Wansong Temple Shanmen: This section is the route that the Jinsheng Cableway passes through. The road is relatively easy to walk, with a concentration of scenic spots and many cultural attractions. You can also see the scenery of Shuisheng in the lower part. Hiking down the mountain, one passes through the Tallinn, which is composed of 99 tombs and pagodas of eminent monks from various dynasties with different shapes; The place where Qianlong's substitute monk became a monk - Tiancheng Temple. To the east of the temple gate is the Woyun Tower, and at the foot of the mountain opposite the tower is the old site of a small stage. Qianlong once watched a play here. Further ahead, you can see Shuxia, one of the representative attractions of the Lower Water Festival. A waterfall like structure resembling strands of silk floats into the pool, bringing a refreshing feeling. Continuing on, I encountered a stone that looked like a gold ingot - Yuanbaoshi. It is said that touching it can bring wealth. When you see the stone with the words "entering victory" handwritten by Rong Lu, the Minister of War and Governor General of Zhili in the late Qing Dynasty, it indicates that the mountain gate is not far away. Every March and April, a temple fair is held in Panshan, where the scene of "Qianlong's Tour of Panshan" can be seen, recreating the grand scene of Qianlong's parade in the past. Full text 

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 西开教堂
attractions.summary: The Xikai Church is located at the southern end of the bustling Binjiang Road commercial street. It was founded in 1917 and is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Tianjin. The architectural style of the church is solemn and grand, and the sculptures inside the church are also complex and exquisite. In addition, Mass and Catholic holiday activities are open to the public, allowing participants to experience the strong religious atmosphere. The exterior of the church is made of red and yellow flower bricks, with three towers arranged in a cross shape and towering into the clouds covered with green copper sheets. After years of erosion, the mottled green shines with a sense of history under the sunshine, and each tower has a bronze cross on its top. Entering the church, the first thing that catches the eye is the main color scheme composed of lake blue, white, and light yellow, giving a fresh feeling. Various patterns are carved in just the right positions, and 14 columns are arranged from the doorway to the altar, exuding an extraordinary aura. There are exquisite copper statues of believers around the church, and oil paintings depicting the story of Jesus' suffering are hung on the walls. Inside the church, there are also colorful statues of the Virgin Mary, Jesus, angels, and others. In addition, the stained glass windows are also very charming. On one side of the church, you will find a small wooden room with a small cross on top, which is a "confession pavilion" used by priests to receive believers for confession and confession. The mass event of Xikai Church is open to the public, and non believers can also participate. However, during the mass time, visitors cannot wander around the church. They should sit quietly in the back row, not make loud noises or take photos, and feel the inner peace in the bustling city. In addition, there are also many Catholic holiday activities that are open to the public, just like Mass. The specific times for Mass and Catholic holiday events can be found on the official website. Full text 

attractions.name: 世纪钟广场
attractions.summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark building in Tianjin next to the railway station

attractions.name: 海河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It starts from Tianjin Jingang Bridge, ends at Dagukou and enters Bohai Bay, and runs through Tianjin city. It is the "mother river" of Tianjin. 
· There are Jingang Bridge, Lion Forest Bridge, Jintang Bridge, Bei'an Bridge, Jiefang Bridge and other bridges built on the Haihe River, which are very spectacular. 
There are all kinds of high-rise buildings and more than 20 historical and cultural buildings on both sides of the strait, which are worth visiting. There are also cruise docks in tianjin railway station, Ancient Culture Street and Great Beiyuan, where you can board the boat. 
Night is a good time to watch the Haihe River. The lights on both sides are on, and the scenery is very beautiful. I recommend Tianjin Eye, Jinta Jinmen and other places to take beautiful photos.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Haihe Holiday Hotel Venice Coffee Buffet Restaurant

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 粮道街
attractions.summary: Liangdao Street is located in Wuchang District, Wuhan City. It is a historic old street known for its rich historical culture and unique local cuisine. This was once the location of an ancient granary, hence its name. Nowadays, Liangdao Street not only retains the traditional architectural style, but also gathers numerous authentic Wuhan snacks, making it a great place for tourists to experience local culture and cuisine.
attractions.opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

attractions.name: 得胜桥
attractions.summary: Desheng Bridge is an old street in Wuchang District, Wuhan. The whole street is only 800 meters long and 6 meters wide. It starts from Zhongshan Road in the north and ends at the intersection of Zhonghua Road and Liangdao Street in the south. It is known as the street with the most Wuchang characteristics. This old street has a history of more than 600 years. Old houses with a history of hundreds of years can be seen everywhere, brick by brick, which is the epitome of the history of old Wuchang City.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient blocks with Wuchang characteristics

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路
attractions.summary: Lihuangpi Road and Huangpi Road are the same road. Lihuangpi Road, with a total length of 604 meters, was built in 1900 (the 26th year of Guangxu) and was built by Huangpi people, hence the name Huangpi Road. Later, it was assigned to the Russian Concession in Hankou, which was called Yima Road. Located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Because Li Yuanhong, the two presidents of the Republic of China, was a native of Huangpi, Wuhan, and was known as Li Huangpi, this road was renamed Li Huangpi Road in 1946. Lihuangpi Road is a famous "slow life" block in Wuhan, which is a continuation of Hankou's spirit and temperament.
attractions.shortFeatures: Literary and retro slow life block

attractions.name: 吉庆民俗街
attractions.summary: Premature Hubu Lane, late night Jiqing Street ". During the day, the area is sparsely populated, but as night falls, Jiqing Street is brightly lit and bustling with people. Simple stalls line up in a row, offering a wide variety of local delicacies. When enjoying the feast, you can also enjoy folk performances full of "Han flavor", which are extremely lively. Full text 

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖南路凌波门
attractions.name_en: Lingbo Gate, South East Lake Road
attractions.summary: The former Lingbomen Trestle Bridge is one of the favorite places for Wu Da students, and it also carries the cultural memory of Wu Da students. In 2012, the trestle was demolished due to potential safety hazards in wild swimming. After several twists and turns, Lingbo Gate was renovated again in May this year, and it became an East Lake scenic spot where surrounding students and foreign tourists rushed to set foot. On the shore of Lingbomen, East Lake, a stone tablet about 2 meters high was erected with the words "Lingbomen Swimming Pool" engraved on it. The back of the stone tablet details the "past lives" of Lingbo Gate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Not to miss East Lake attractions

attractions.name: 珞喻路光谷广场
attractions.summary: Guanggu Square is located in Wuhan. There is a "Star River" sculpture on the square, which is made of 7 steel dragon bones. The 7 dragon bones look like floating "ribbons" in the air. In addition, plants such as red maple, osmanthus, shrubs, and flowers are interspersed and planted on the square, which is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
