East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 东湖绿道
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; On foot; Hiking; Hiking/Biking
attractions.summary:
East Lake Greenway is located in East Lake Eco-tourism Scenic Area, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, with a total length of about 101.98 kilometers. It is the longest greenway around the lake in the core area of 5A-level cities in China. 
East Lake Greenway is divided into seven themed landscape roads: Tingtao Road, Huzhong Road, Baima Road, Country Road, Forest Road, Moshan Road and Hushan Road. It fully relies on eight natural features of East Lake Mountain, Forest, Ze, Garden, Island, Embankment, Field and Bay, and turns East Lake into an "ecological green heart" of the city where citizens are close to nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: Leisure trails connecting many scenic spots in East Lake

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 北京大学
attractions.summary: Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 北京欢乐谷
attractions.tag: Hi Fun Park; Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located on the East Fourth Ring Road in Beijing, it is one of the largest theme parks in Beijing combining sea, land, and air attractions.
- It features seven themed areas: Fjord Forest, Atlantis, Lost Maya, Aegean Harbor, Shangri-La, Dessert Kingdom, and Happy Time.
- It offers over 40 entertainment facilities, nearly 100 scenic spots, performances, and themed games, providing an exhilarating and exciting experience.
attractions.shortFeatures: Play a variety of exciting amusement rides.

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 解放桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jiefang Bridge is a hub bridge connecting Hebei, Hedong and Heping districts and communicating with tianjin railway station. 
· Originally known as "Wanguo Bridge", it was known as "a country within a country" because there was a concession of nine countries in Tianjin at that time. After the liberation of Tianjin, this bridge was renamed "Jiefang Bridge". 
· Jiefang Bridge will be opened during important festivals. When the bridge opens, luxury yachts will sail across the opened Jiefang Bridge, accompanied by the colorful Haihe River, which is intoxicating and the most beautiful time. 
If you are lucky, you may even meet the scene of taking wedding photos in the middle of Jiefang Bridge while stopping at the red light, which is novel and interesting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Tianjin

attractions.name: 世纪钟广场
attractions.summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark building in Tianjin next to the railway station

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 津门故里
attractions.summary: Located in Tianjin Ancient Culture Street, the memorial archway of the hometown of memorial archway is painted in the form of "smoke carving ink stone chasing jade". The words on the heart of the memorial archway are "the hometown of Tianjin" (facing south) and "sunny snow" (facing north). Jinmen "is another name for Tianjin," Hometown "means old place, and" Jinmen Hometown "is the old place of Tianjin Wei, which means the birthplace of Tianjin Wei. 'Qing' means good weather, while 'Xue' means' wash '; Qingxue "is the scenery just after snowfall, with a clear sky stretching thousands of miles and streets crowded with tourists. It metaphorically refers to a person's pure and innocent mood, as if washed away. Here, we offer incense to the Queen of Heaven and wish for a better future.

attractions.name: 宝和轩相声茶楼(古文化街店)
attractions.name_en: Baohexuan Crosstalk Teahouse (Ancient Culture Street Store)
attractions.summary: Baohe Xuan Tea House, opened in the eleventh year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1885), is the earliest miscellaneous garden in Jinmen (renamed "Quyi" at the first National Cultural and Art Congress in July 1949), and is also known as one of the "Four Great Pavilions". Founder Zhang Fuxing and Meng Guanghui wrote the plaque. After nearly a century of changes and the baptism of the times. In 2022, Baohe Xuan Tea House will appear in front of the world with a brand new appearance. Preserving the historical relics of the teahouse and presenting them in front of the audience in conjunction with the transition to the new era. Baohe Xuan Tea House gathers renowned cross-talk performers from three age groups: old, middle-aged, and young. The performers combine traditional culture with new era content to perform. Speaking, learning, teasing, singing, and performing all kinds of things in the world, laughing, cursing, and joking are just for the sake of everyone's laughter. Baohexuan Tea House is located in a cultural town 50 meters away from the theater building on Jinmen Ancient Culture Street across the Haihe River. Welcome everyone to Baohe Xuan Cross Talk Tea House to experience authentic Tianjin style cross talk! Full text 

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 西开教堂
attractions.summary: The Xikai Church is located at the southern end of the bustling Binjiang Road commercial street. It was founded in 1917 and is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Tianjin. The architectural style of the church is solemn and grand, and the sculptures inside the church are also complex and exquisite. In addition, Mass and Catholic holiday activities are open to the public, allowing participants to experience the strong religious atmosphere. The exterior of the church is made of red and yellow flower bricks, with three towers arranged in a cross shape and towering into the clouds covered with green copper sheets. After years of erosion, the mottled green shines with a sense of history under the sunshine, and each tower has a bronze cross on its top. Entering the church, the first thing that catches the eye is the main color scheme composed of lake blue, white, and light yellow, giving a fresh feeling. Various patterns are carved in just the right positions, and 14 columns are arranged from the doorway to the altar, exuding an extraordinary aura. There are exquisite copper statues of believers around the church, and oil paintings depicting the story of Jesus' suffering are hung on the walls. Inside the church, there are also colorful statues of the Virgin Mary, Jesus, angels, and others. In addition, the stained glass windows are also very charming. On one side of the church, you will find a small wooden room with a small cross on top, which is a "confession pavilion" used by priests to receive believers for confession and confession. The mass event of Xikai Church is open to the public, and non believers can also participate. However, during the mass time, visitors cannot wander around the church. They should sit quietly in the back row, not make loud noises or take photos, and feel the inner peace in the bustling city. In addition, there are also many Catholic holiday activities that are open to the public, just like Mass. The specific times for Mass and Catholic holiday events can be found on the official website. Full text 

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 新民园广场
attractions.summary: The newly built Tianjin Minyuan Square has a surface area of 22500 square meters and an underground area of 47500 square meters, continuing to retain the sports and fitness functions of the original Minyuan Sports Stadium. The square has added new functions such as tourism and leisure, cultural and museum exhibitions, and specialty catering, and has become the core scenic area and distribution center of the Five Avenues Cultural Tourism Zone together with the surrounding Qingwang Mansion, Xiannong Business and Tourism Area, and Minyuan Xili Cultural and Creative Block.

Pan Pacific Hotel Parsifijia Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 西禅古寺
attractions.summary: In the old days, there were Zen temples in the southeast, northwest, and northwest suburbs of Fuzhou. This temple was located at the foot of Yishan Mountain in the western suburbs of Fuzhou, so it was called Xichan Temple. In history, Xichan Temple has been destroyed several times, so although it is an ancient temple, most of the Xichan Temples you see now are newly built. Overall, the repairs are very good, and the main hall of the temple is very tall and magnificent. In the temple, there are the Shakya ManiHall, Dharma Hall, Sutra Pavilion, Jade Buddha Tower, Guanyin Pavilion, guest hall, Zen Hall, Abbot Room and other buildings. The most precious cultural relic is the Kangxi imperial calligraphy of the "Medicine Buddha Sutra" hidden in the Sutra Pavilion, but tourists cannot see it. The environment of Xichan Temple is beautiful and the greenery is well done, and there is also a famous feature - lychee trees. On the pillars of the ancient temple gate, there is a couplet engraved: "The four dynasties of the Li tree are passed down to the Song Dynasty, and the sound of the bell echoes through the ages." This is a couplet written by Zhou Lian in the Qing Dynasty. This not only indicates that there are many lychee trees in Xichan Temple, but also shows that Xichan Temple has existed since the Tang Dynasty. The lychee tree in the front courtyard of the Dharma Hall is an ancient tree that dates back to the Song Dynasty and is still blooming and bearing fruit today. Like other temples, Xichan Temple also has a release pool with a lot of fish and turtles inside. Children will be very happy to see it. In addition, overseas temples such as Shuanglin Temple in Singapore, Shuangqing Temple in Penang, Malaysia, and Nanputuo Temple in Vietnam are all under the jurisdiction of the Western Zen Lower House and are still managed by the monks of the Western Zen Temple. Therefore, this is a window for cultural exchange between Fuzhou and Southeast Asia. Every year, many foreign monks and believers visit and participate, making it a unique landscape of ancient temples. Overall, for a city like Fuzhou where almost every park is free, seeing paid temples is somewhat uncomfortable, and it feels like worshiping Buddha has a more secular flavor. If you have plenty of time and there are not many scenic spots in Fuzhou, and this is still considered a good attraction, then you can come. Full text 

attractions.name: 福州西湖公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
West Lake Park is located on Hubin Road in the northwest of the city. It has a history of more than 1,700 years and is the most complete classical garden in Fuzhou so far. 
In the third year of Jin Taikang, Yan Gao, the county governor, brought water from the northwest mountains here to irrigate farmland. Because it was located in the west of the city wall of Jin Dynasty, it was called the West Lake. 
There are three small islands in the West Lake-Kaihua Island, Xieping Island and Yaojiao Island. Fujian Provincial Museum and Food Exhibition Hall are also located in the West Lake Park.  
Every year during the Dragon Boat Festival, a dragon boat race will be held in the West Lake. At that time, the fierce and spectacular race scene will be launched between the vast water and sky, and the sound of gongs and drums will reach the sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fuzhou's old city park

attractions.name: 上下杭
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The blocks of Shanghang Road and Xiahang Road in Taijiang, Fuzhou, are also known as "Shuanghang". A traditional block with strong Chinese and Western architectural cultural characteristics in Fuzhou and typical Fujian merchants' cultural characteristics, including ten scenic spots in Nantai, three bridges and fishing fires.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traditional blocks with rich architectural culture

attractions.name: 闽江夜游
attractions.summary: The sages said: Good deeds are like water. The water of Minjiang River rises from the sky, and it is the mother river of Mindu. Minjiang River, which has won the first prize of Zhongzhao Lighting Award and the CCTV News Network for many times, is a pearl in the night scene of Chinese cities. Minjiang Night Tour departs from Taijiang Port on Jiangbin Road in Taijiang District, passing through Taijiang Jinwai Bund, Nanbei Jiangbin to Hongshan Bridge, and then turns back at Sanqiao before returning. If affected by tides, the route can be temporarily adjusted to return to Taijiang Port at Gushan Bridge. Minjiang Night Tour Route - Overview: Passed through attractions: Haixi 3D Light Show - Zhongzhou Island - Jiefang Bridge - Panchuanpu Catholic Church - Minjiang Bridge - Aofengzhou Bridge - Gushan Bridge "Minjiang Sightseeing Tour" Route - Overview: Passed through attractions: Panchuanpu Church, Taijiang Financial Street Wanda, Eastern Office Area, International Convention and Exhibition Center, etc. There are tour guides on board explaining the historical stories of various attractions. The "Minjiang Red Underground Route" - Overview: The "Minjiang Red Underground Route" was an important component of the Urban Work Department of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China during the Liberation War, and also served as a revolutionary communication network connecting northern Fujian, eastern Fujian, central Fujian, western Fujian, both sides of the Minjiang River, and the Fujian Zhejiang Jiangxi Border Region. You can watch the 1959 movie "Underground Route" on this route. Daily flight times: (1) Classic Minjiang Night Tour: Departure at 19:40. (2) Minjiang Night Tour High end new energy: departing at 19:00/20:15 (3) Minjiang Night Talk: departing at 21:20 daily (specific time subject to on-site inspection) Full text 

attractions.name: 乌山
attractions.summary: Wushan has been a popular tourist destination since the Tang Dynasty. In the "Record of Daoshan Pavilion" written by Zeng Gong, one of the "Eight Masters of Tang and Song Dynasties", Daoshan refers to Wushan. It is called Wushan, which is actually a public park. Here, trees provide shade, winding paths lead to secluded places, and there are many Teng plants. It is close to Sanfang Qixiang and is very suitable for taking a break after wandering around Sanfang Qixiang. If you are here specifically to see the Three Mountains and Two Towers, you can take a bus to Wushan Station and get off to directly see the Wushan Scenic Area. It only takes 20 minutes to walk from Wushan to Yushan, so you can play together. There is a tour guide map at the entrance of Wushan Scenic Area. Climbing can be done in the direction of the 81 step mountain climbing path, and there are signs along the way, which is not difficult to find. On the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Fuzhou city and Wuyi Square. Sitting in the long corridor of Wushan to cool off in summer is nothing more leisurely. Another must see attraction in Wushan is Wuta, which is one of the two towers of the "Three Mountains and Two Towers". It is located at the eastern foot of Wushan, opposite the White Pagoda in Yushan. The tower body is made of granite and has a slightly black appearance due to its age, echoing its name. Many people take photos here. Overall, it's good to leave such a secluded place in the city center, and it's great to go for a walk during leisure time. Full text 

attractions.name: 三坊七巷
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Celebrity Residences; Famous Residences; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It originated in the Jin Dynasty, flourished during the Tang and Five Dynasties, and reached its peak during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The layout of its alleys and lanes remains largely intact, making it a living fossil of the ancient Chinese li-bang system.
- Composed of three blocks, seven lanes, and a central street, it has long been known as the "Three Lanes and Seven Alleys."
- The area consists of narrow alleys, white-washed walls and tiled roofs, with an intricate network of lanes. The stone-paved roads are lined with stone archways at the entrances of each block and lane.
- Today, it is home to many time-honored food stalls and traditional crafts, making it a great place to visit, explore the birthplace of famous figures, and enjoy local specialties.
attractions.shortFeatures: Museum of Ming and Qing Architecture

attractions.name: 林则徐纪念馆
attractions.summary:
· Lin Zexu, the first person to open his eyes to the world in modern China. Lin Zexu Memorial Hall, located on Macao Road, was originally Lin Zexu's ancestral temple. 
· The whole museum is a classical garden building, which is now turned into Lin Zexu's life exhibition room. It is divided into parts such as Lin Zexu's life, Lin Zexu and the Opium War, Lin Zexu and disaster relief, water conservancy, the first person in the world, Lin Zexu's handwriting, etc., and introduces Lin Zexu's life of patriotism and concern for the people. 
There are three bluestone tablets inside, one is the imperial edict, the other is the imperial sacrifice, and the other is the imperial inscription, all of which were given by the emperor when Lin Zexu died, and were engraved when the temple was built.

attractions.name: 南后街
attractions.summary: Nanhou Street starts from Yangqiao intersection in the north and ends at Jipi Road to Macau Bridge in the south, with a total length of about 1,000 meters. It is named after it is located behind the South Street on the central axis of Fuzhou. Nanhou Street Memorial Arch is the central axis of "Three Lanes and Seven Alleys" in Fuzhou. There are seven lanes (Yangqiao Lane, Langguan Lane, Anmin Lane, Huangxiang, Taxiang, Gongxiang and Jipi Lane) on its east side and three lanes (Yijinfang, Wenrufang and Guanglufang) on its west side. It was the main commercial street from the rise of Fuzhou Three Lanes and Seven Alleys to the Republic of China, where merchants gathered on the road.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural street combining tradition with modernity

restaurants.name_en: Crowne Plaza Fuzhou Rongqiao. Caifeng Building

attractions.name: 厦门园林植物园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- Xiamen Botanical Garden, commonly known as "Wanshi Botanical Garden," is a meticulously designed botanical garden surrounding the Wanshi Rock Reservoir. The garden includes over 20 specialty gardens and planting areas, such as the Pine and Fir Garden, Rose Garden, Palm Garden, Large Cactus Garden, Hundred Flowers Hall, Orchid Garden, and more, cultivating over 6,000 species of tropical and subtropical plants.  
- The Rainforest World and Desert Plant Zone are particularly worth visiting. The misty atmosphere of the Rainforest World, along with the beautiful tropical rainforest scenery, makes it look like a fairyland.  
- The Instagram-worthy cactus in the Desert Plant Zone is a must-photograph spot. In addition to the plants, the garden also features landscapes such as stone carvings, lakes, lawns, and temples. From the highest point of the New Stele Forest, visitors can overlook half of Xiamen Island.
attractions.shortFeatures: The enchanting rainforest world

attractions.name: 南普陀寺
attractions.summary:
Nanputuo Temple is a key Buddhist temple in the Han nationality area. If you are going to pray, you might as well come here to worship. 
The most famous ones are the vegetarian food on the second floor of the vegetarian restaurant and the vegetarian cakes in the temple, with the plaque of the first vegetarian banquet in the world hanging on it, which is about 59 yuan per capita. 
Wulaoshan, the back mountain of Nanputuo Temple, is one of the eight scenic spots in Xiamen, and you can climb the mountain by the way. 
It only takes about 1 hour to walk from the temple to Wulaoshan, and you can also go to Xiamen Botanical Garden from this road. 
There are many inscriptions of celebrities around the temple. There is a huge stone carving of "Buddha" on the cliff behind the temple, and tourists often come to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Buddhist monasteries in the whole country

attractions.name: 顶澳仔猫街
attractions.summary:
Cat Street is near the West Village of Xiamen University. It is a 100-meter-long cat-themed street, very close to Xiamen University. 
The street is not wide, it is a big uphill road, and the decoration of cat elements can be seen everywhere, which is very suitable for taking photos. 
Most of them are cat-themed shops, which have all kinds of interesting cat-themed products. There is the only cat museum on both sides of the Taiwan Straits. 
There are more than a dozen cats of different breeds living here in the Cat Museum. Their lazy eyes and soft ears make people can't help but press the shutter button.  
The overall style of Cat Street is fresh and lively. It is recommended to wear clothes with bright colors and casual styles.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the fun cat museum

attractions.name: 曾厝垵
attractions.summary:
· Zeng Cuo An Village is known as "the most literary village in the country". It used to be a simple fishing village, but now it has become a hot cultural and creative village. 
Modern and quaint neighborhoods are integrated, and there are many unique small shops gathered on the street. You can eat, buy and shoot while shopping, which is enough for you to toss all day. Food is another label here besides literature and art. There are all kinds of snacks and dazzling fruits in five streets and eighteen lanes in Zeng Cuo An Village. 
It is also a gathering place for characteristic homestays, including traditional courtyards, baroque single-family villas, quaint and unique fishing villages, and lively and unique youth hostels. 
· Zeng Cuo An Village late at night belongs to folk songs and bars. Young people talk about their ideals in bars. Under the hoarse voice of folk songs, they drink with emotions and stories to recall the most unforgettable times.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xiamen cultural innovation landmark

attractions.name: 环岛路
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Hiking/Biking; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiamen Huandao Road is built along the coast. It is a section of coast from Xiamen University to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and is called the "Golden Coastline". 
· Also known as Five-Color Road: blue sea, golden beach, green grass, red runway and gray road. 
There are many scenic spots along the way, such as Hulishan Fort, Yefeng Village, International Convention and Exhibition Center, Wuyuan Bay, etc. 
On the side of Huandao Road facing the sea, there are sculptures of different styles such as "Wave of Gulangyu Island", "Meditation Song of the Sea" and "Choice", which are of great ornamental value. 
You can rent a bicycle to ride, which has a unique charm. It is the most beautiful section from Yefengzhai to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and it takes about 40 minutes to ride by bike.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy riding the coastline

attractions.name: 厦门海底世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
attractions.summary:
The venue looks like a blue crystal palace. It is the aquarium with the most complete varieties of fish on display in China, and is known as the Undersea Dragon Palace. 
There are five special exhibition areas in the exhibition hall: Penguin/Freshwater Fish Hall, Whale and Dolphin Herbarium, Aquarium, Undersea Tunnel and Marine Beast Performance Hall. 
It has the largest sperm whale skeleton in China at present, with a length of about 18.6 meters and a weight of about 48 tons. It is also one of the well-preserved large whale specimens in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: Complete sperm whale skeleton
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 港仔后海滨浴场
attractions.summary:
· Aberdeen Hou Beach is located in the west of Shuzhuang Garden, and the two are adjacent to each other. 
· Standing on the beach, with the Sunlight Rock on the back, you can see the highest bare rock. 
The bathing beach has soft sand, gentle slopes and flat waves, and low seawater flow rate. Coupled with the beautiful scenery of Gulangyu Island, it is very suitable for seaside leisure and swimming.
attractions.shortFeatures: Great view and beautiful scenery

attractions.name: 日光岩
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
attractions.summary:
· Sunlight Rock is the highest peak of Gulangyu Island and the iconic scenic spot of Gulangyu Island. 
Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 菽庄花园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
Shuzhuang Garden was built in 1913, named after the homophonic word "Shuzang" by Lin Erjia, a wealthy businessman in Taiwan Province. It is divided into two parts: Bushan Garden and Zanghai Garden. 
The main landscape of Bushan Garden is rockery, that is, twelve caves, with a total of 12 caves, inlaid with twelve zodiac signs at each cave entrance. 
The reason why Tibetan Sea Garden is called Tibetan Sea is that only when you turn out of the Moon Cave Gate will the sea appear in front of you, and the Forty-Fourth Bridge is the best point to view the sea. 
The Piano Museum in Tingtao Xuan in Shuzhuang Garden is a highlight. There will be special piano improvisation performances every half hour in the museum, which is worth listening to.
attractions.shortFeatures: Garden Landscape with Western Colors

attractions.name: 厦门海底世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
attractions.summary:
The venue looks like a blue crystal palace. It is the aquarium with the most complete varieties of fish on display in China, and is known as the Undersea Dragon Palace. 
There are five special exhibition areas in the exhibition hall: Penguin/Freshwater Fish Hall, Whale and Dolphin Herbarium, Aquarium, Undersea Tunnel and Marine Beast Performance Hall. 
It has the largest sperm whale skeleton in China at present, with a length of about 18.6 meters and a weight of about 48 tons. It is also one of the well-preserved large whale specimens in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: Complete sperm whale skeleton
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 古麓山寺
attractions.summary:
Gulushan Temple, also known as Huiguang Temple and Wanshou Temple, has a history of more than 1,700 years. It is the earliest relic of Buddhism entering Hunan and one of the early Buddhist temples in China. 
The environment of the temple is very quiet. There are two Podocarpus pines in front of the temple, which are relics of the Six Dynasties. There are precious Buddhist scriptures and ancient books in the temple. 
Today's ancient Lushan Temple is full of incense worshippers. The hall is hidden among layers of trees, with morning bells and evening drums, and bursts of Sanskrit sounds.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient and secluded temple deep in Yuelu Mountain

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 长沙生态动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; a treasure spot for walking kids.; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- Changsha Ecological Zoo is divided into 37 areas: walking enclosures, vehicle-accessible free-range areas, science education zones, ecological landscape zones, recreational areas, logistics service zones, animal enclosures, and training fields. It houses more than 300 species of animals, with a total of around 5,000 individuals.  
- Changsha Ecological Zoo is the only public and professional institution in Hunan Province approved by the State Forestry Administration and the Ministry of Agriculture, authorized to introduce and breed first- and second-class aquatic and terrestrial wild animals.  
- The vehicle-accessible area includes 11 zones: Bengal Tiger Zone, White Tiger Zone, African Lion Zone, Leopard Zone, Siberian Tiger Zone, Wolf Zone, Black Bear Zone, Brown Bear Zone, as well as Asian Herbivore Zone, African Herbivore Zone, etc. The walking area includes more than 30 specialized animal halls, including the Giant Panda Hall, Red Panda Hall, Crocodile Hall, Elephant Hall, Rhinoceros Hall, Reptile Hall, Tiger and Leopard Hall, Primate Hall, and more.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch rare wildlife

attractions.name: 湘江风光带
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Xiangjiang River is the mother river of Changsha. It flows from south to north through Shaoshan Mountain and enters Changsha City, forming a beautiful scenic belt along the Yangtze River in Changsha. 
Xiangjiang Scenic Belt consists of more than ten leisure and fitness squares, green belts and historical and cultural landscapes, which have unique customs day and night. 
· It is also one of the best places to watch fireworks displays, so every weekend night, there is a lot of excitement along the river.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place for citizens to relax and entertain

attractions.name: 杜甫江阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Du Fu Jiang Pavilion was built in memory of Du Fu, forming a context belt with Tianxin Pavilion, Daolin Second Temple in Yuelu Mountain and Yuelu Academy. 
There is a biography of a great poet inside. Whenever fireworks are set off on summer weekends, the number of visitors who come to watch will increase a lot. 
· Local landmark buildings, close to the Xiangjiang River, can climb high and overlook both sides of the Xiangjiang River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb high overlooking Xiangjiang River and enjoy the grand fireworks

attractions.name: 天心阁
attractions.summary: Tianxin Pavilion is a city tower in the ancient city of Changsha, and the surrounding city walls are the only section of ancient city walls in Changsha. There is also a archway near Tianxin Pavilion called "Chonglie Gate", built in 1946 to commemorate the soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the three major battles in Changsha during the Anti Japanese War. Tianxin Pavilion is located within Tianxin Park and was first built in the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1746). The Tianxin Pavilion that tourists see today was rebuilt in 1983. The main building of Tianxin Pavilion is chargeable (including Tianxin Pavilion and the surrounding ancient city walls), while Tianxin Park is open for free. The overall architecture of Tianxin Pavilion is supported by 46 red painted columns, chestnut tiles and pink walls, and a solid gray white stone foundation. 62 stone lions are carved on the stone railings in front and behind the pavilion, and 32 wind horses and copper bells are hung on the pavilion, making a sound in the wind. There is a screening room next to the Tianxin Pavilion, which shows a film about the history of Tianxin Pavilion every hour, with a duration of about 7 minutes (equipment maintenance on Monday afternoon). The paid area also provides explanation services. Across from Tianxin Pavilion is the Bamboo Slips Museum, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 五四广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement

attractions.name: 栈桥
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; City coordinates; Bridges; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Qingdao's earliest military-specific artificial wharf is a landmark building and a famous scenic spot in Qingdao. 
The octagonal building inside the breakwater at the southern end is called "Huilan Pavilion". Standing here, you can enjoy the "Flying Pavilion Huilan", one of the ten scenic spots in Qingdao. 
The north coast is called "Zhanqiao Park", with lush flowers and plants, and stone chairs for tourists to rest and enjoy the scenery of the sea and sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old sea promenade

attractions.name: 圣弥厄尔教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in 1930, formerly known as "St. Miel Church", it is the largest Romanesque building in Qingdao and the only consecrated church in China. 
· Designed by German designer Biloha, according to Gothic and Romanesque architectural styles. It is a masonry twin tower building with four bells inside. 
· The church is spacious and bright. The hall is about 18 meters high. There are two confession booths on both sides of the corridors for priests to receive believers to confess and confess.  
• The church has a valuable organ imported from Germany, which is played only during Sunday Mass.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Western Architecture in Qingdao

attractions.name: 小鱼山公园
attractions.summary: Xiaoyushan Park is one of the best scenic spots in Qingdao, firstly because it is located in the city center and is a mountain close to the sea, with a geographical location; Secondly, due to its altitude of only 60 meters, climbing the mountain is not tiring. When you reach the top, you can see the representative scenery of Qingdao, which is "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky". At the top of Xiaoyushan Mountain, there is a three story octagonal pavilion called the Tide Viewing Pavilion, which is 18 meters high and covered with green glazed tiles. Climbing up the spiral staircase to enjoy the view, nearby are German style buildings with red tiles and yellow walls hidden among green trees. To the southeast, you can see the golden sand of the first beach connected to the blue sea. To the northeast, you can see the Qingdao TV Tower on Taiping Mountain. When the weather is good to the west, you can distinguish the small Qingdao and the wharf in the distance. To the north, you can take a panoramic view of Signal Mountain Park. The guesthouse on the mountainside of Signal Mountain and the three red topped mushroom buildings on the mountaintop are clearly visible. At night, you can take photos of the night view of Qingdao city on the mountain. To the west of the Lianchao Pavilion is the Hexagonal Pavilion with Bibo Pavilion, and to the east is the Four Corner Pavilion with Cuicui Pavilion. Both pavilions are covered with green glazed tiles, providing scenic views. The front of the curved corridor connecting the Lianchao Pavilion and Yongcui Pavilion features white reliefs, with modern characters "small" and "mountain" and ancient pictographic characters "fish" forming the mountain emblem of Xiaoyushan. You can take a photo with it, and there are also beautiful murals next to the emblem. In addition, on the southern slope of Xiaoyushan, there are miniature models that gather Qingdao architecture. If you are interested, you can also take a look. There are many scenic spots near Xiaoyushan Park, mostly along the coastline. To the west, you can follow the route of Zhanqiao - Navy Museum - Little Qingdao - Lu Xun Park - Xiaoyushan Park. To the east, you can see Kang Youwei's former residence, the first beach, Badaguan, and then go to Taipingjiao to see the sunset. Full text 

attractions.name: 鲁迅公园
attractions.summary:
Lu Xun Park is a free and open coastal park in Qingdao, with large reddish-brown reefs on the seaside.

attractions.name: 海军博物馆
attractions.summary: The PLA Naval Museum is a military museum reflecting the development of the Chinese navy in China. It is the historical, spiritual and cultural highland of the People's Navy. The Navy Museum is located at No. 8 Laiyang Road, Shinan District, Qingdao, adjacent to Lu Xun Park to the east and Little Qingdao Park to the west, echoing the wharf from afar. The Naval Museum has a land area of approximately 141 acres and a sea area of approximately 214 acres. It was officially opened to the public in October 1989. In 2001, it was rated as a national defense education demonstration base by the Central Propaganda Department. In June 2021, at the important historical moment of celebrating the 100th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and achieving the goal of "the first 100 years", the Naval Museum completed its reconstruction and expansion, opened to the outside world with a new look, and presented the glorious history of the People's Navy for more than 70 years under the strong leadership of the CPC in a panoramic manner. On May 18, 2022, the Naval Museum's "Strong Towards the Sea - Basic Exhibition of the History of the People's Navy" was awarded the 19th (2021) "National Museum Top Ten Exhibition Excellence Award". The Naval Museum is divided into three exhibition areas: indoor, sea, and land. The indoor main exhibition hall is the basic display of the history of the People's Navy, with four exhibition halls covering an area of over 7000 square meters. It is divided into three parts: "Socialist Revolution and Construction Period", "New Era of Reform and Opening up and Socialist Modernization Construction", and "New Era of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics". There are over 18000 cultural relics in the collection, mainly displayed under the strong leadership of the Party, where the People's Navy was born, grew, and developed through artillery fire; Along the way, cutting through waves and traversing thousands of miles of maritime territory, galloping across the vast oceans, we are striding towards the goal of building a world-class navy. The exhibition area for naval vessels covers an area of over 40000 square meters, with 3 docks and 6 berths. It mainly showcases China's first destroyer Anshan (hull number 101), the first domestically produced destroyer Jinan (hull number 105), the first domestically produced air defense frigate Yingtan (hull number 531), the first nuclear submarine Long March 1 (hull number 401), the first experimental submarine Great Wall 200 (hull number 200) and other iconic vessels. The land equipment exhibition area covers an area of over 13000 square meters. The main exhibition showcases the small surface vessels, naval aviation equipment, marine equipment, and naval coastal defense equipment that have served in the People's Navy since its establishment. The main exhibits include: the Liberation class meritorious boats and gunboats that made great collective contributions in the Battle of Wanshan; The honor boat - No. 245 wooden shell torpedo boat showcased during the first naval parade of the People's Navy; The Il-14 aircraft, which once ensured the participation of Navy Commander Xiao Jingguang in various activities and carried out important tasks such as transporting rescue personnel, supplies, and international friends; Meritorious artillery that participated in the aid to Vietnam and anti US air defense operations; The T-34 tank, which has been widely equipped with the Marine Corps and island guarding forces such as the Xisha Islands; The YJ-62A shore to ship missile launcher, which is used to block ports and sea routes, and maneuver to strike large and medium-sized surface targets, is a significant naval weapon and equipment. These weapons and equipment have played a significant role in tasks such as liberating coastal islands, safeguarding maritime security, and protecting people's lives and property. The Naval Museum will focus on inheriting the red genes, keeping in mind the original mission, strengthening historical memory, and exerting educational functions, striving to build a leading domestic and world leading naval museum. attractions.name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 崂山太清游览区
attractions.summary: The Taiqing Scenic Area is located at the southeast end of Laoshan Mountain, named after the Taoist temple Taiqing Palace. It is mainly divided into two tourist areas: the surrounding area of Taiqing Palace and along the Bashui River. The former is located by the sea, while the latter is a hiking route. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".
