attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.

Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 重庆十八梯传统风貌区
attractions.summary: The land area of the Eighteen Stairs Traditional Style Area project is about 88 acres, with a construction area of about 170000 square meters and a total investment scale of over 2 billion yuan. According to the project positioning, it will rely on the cultural and tourism resources of Chongqing's "mother city", integrate and develop the modern cultural tourism industry, and build it into a characteristic cultural tourism demonstration zone, a cultural exhibition window for Chongqing facing the international community, and become an international cultural tourism destination. Integrating the four functions of commerce, scenery, tourism, and culture, presenting a panoramic view of Chongqing's 800 year history and cultural life in the region, and creating a strong experiential cultural and tourism commercial demonstration base. Chongqing Shibati Traditional Scenic Area, centering on "urban sightseeing", "intangible heritage inheritance" and "cultural creativity experience", and combining the industrial positioning of modern service industries such as "night economy", realizes the development of panoramic experience of "culture+tourism", "culture+commerce", "culture+creativity", and "culture+cross-border", and plans four characteristic areas of traditional cultural experience, China-Chic cultural and creative experience, international exchange center, and lifestyle center. Traditional Culture Experience (AB Zone) is based on the traditional folk culture, urban culture, and historical architectural culture of Bayu, creating an open cultural experience block that integrates cultural leisure, cultural sightseeing, and dining and accommodation, deeply attracting foreign tourists. Introduce Sichuan Chongqing hotpot, characteristic Jianghu cuisine, boutique Chongqing cuisine, specialty snacks, and other intangible cultural heritage displays to showcase the unique charm of "Chongqing flavor" and the Ba Yu culture. Use inherited and innovative handicraft products, refined and developed tourism products, and unique cultural IP derivatives to show China-Chic fashion culture and deeply attract literary and art customers. Introduce China-Chic brand, innovative retail, boutique accessories, craft gifts, theme coffee bars, and show the charm of China-Chic's cultural creativity with a variety of China-Chic brands. The D District International Exchange Center (open in 2022) integrates multiple functions such as international diversified culture, tourism service distribution, and city brand reception, creating an international exchange center that deeply attracts high-end consumers at home and abroad. The area plans to introduce cultural exhibitions, retail, catering and other formats, as well as cross-border flagship stores for brands, automotive concept experience stores, digital experience stores, fashion and cultural creativity, international trends, Michelin and Black Pearl foreign cuisine restaurants, and other brands showcasing distinctive culture, creating an international cultural exchange space. The Lifestyle Center (E Zone) (opened in 2022) integrates various functions such as nighttime economic demonstration gathering, personalized leisure consumption, and open youth socialization, showcasing exquisite lifestyles and deeply attracting young consumer groups. The area plans to introduce leisure and entertainment, retail, catering and other formats, with a focus on introducing cultural performances, specialty bars, themed pubs, international catering chains and other characteristic brands, creating a "late night canteen" that fits multiple taste experiences, and creating a leisure and entertainment street that integrates catering and trendy culture, activating the city's night economy. attractions.name: 山城步道
attractions.summary: The so-called trail refers to a city path that can only be walked on. Chongqing is a city built in the mountains, with many adjacent areas having a drop of several tens of meters, and transportation can only rely on urban trails that climb uphill and uphill. In the past, some famous trails were bustling, and many old ruins in Chongqing are located next to these trails. With the large-scale renovation of old cities and improvement of transportation conditions, these trails have gradually lost their function, and some have disappeared or become deserted. Some famous ruins in the surrounding area are slowly being forgotten by people and disappearing into the long river of history The repaired third trail is one of its representatives. This trail is located on the southern slope of the Yuzhong Peninsula, running from north to south, passing through Zhongshan Hospital, Kangjian Hall, Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, the former site of the French Renai Hall, and the suspended boardwalk. It is 1748 meters long and compactly connects a series of traditional neighborhoods and historical and cultural relics. The higher point of the trail is near the Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, and the lower point is at the entrance of Shancheng Lane, with a height difference of 79.5 meters. It is a mountain city trail with distinctive features of Chongqing city.

attractions.name: 人民大礼堂
attractions.name_en: The Great Hall of the People
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Chongqing People's Grand Hall is located on Renmin Road and was built in the 1950s. It is a replica of traditional ethnic architecture and one of Chongqing's most distinctive landmark buildings.
- The Grand Hall features architectural styles from the Ming and Qing dynasties, with a traditional symmetrical central axis, and its appearance is modeled after the Temple of Heaven's Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests in Beijing.
- It serves as the center for large gatherings and performances in Chongqing, hosting important events such as the city's Party Congress, People's Congress, Political Consultative Conference, and the unveiling of the municipality's administrative title, as well as international conferences.
- At night, the Grand Hall is beautifully illuminated, and many local women gather in the square in front of the hall to dance.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tiananmen Temple-style landmark of Chongqing

attractions.name: 鹅岭公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Eling Park is located on Changjiang 1st Road, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is named after its shape like the neck of a goose. 
The earliest private garden in Chongqing, the villa of Li Yaoting, a wealthy businessman, the first president of Chongqing Chamber of Commerce in the late Qing Dynasty. 
Looking at the Yangtze River in the south, Jialing River in the north, Yuzhong in the east and Futuguan in the west. 
· This is an excellent place overlooking the two rivers and night scenes of Chongqing, with the highest point at Kansheng Building.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb high to see the scenery of the two rivers and the night view is particularly beautiful

attractions.name: 二厂文创公园
attractions.name_en: Second Factory Cultural and Creative Park
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Art Districts; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as Chongqing No.2 Printing Factory, it can be said that it was once a color printing giant in southwest printing industry. 
The renovated old factory building retains the original style of the old single-family building and adds the artistic style of modern design; The combination of old and new is unique and charming. 
The movie "Passing Through Your World" was shot here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Location of "Passing Through Your World"

attractions.name: 李子坝轻轨站
attractions.summary: The local internet famous light rail station, where light rail trains pass through the walls of the building.

restaurants.name_en: Li Bolong, Ma Detiao, Mao Xuewang
Chen Lao Wu Lao hot pot

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. Full text 

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 东川红土地
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast of Kunming, the soil contains a lot of iron and aluminum, forming a dazzling color. 
· It is considered to be the most imposing red land in the world except Brazil. From a distance, it is colorful and a paradise for photographers. 
The scenic spots are scattered, forming three main viewing routes: northwest line, northeast line and south line. The most convenient way to play is to charter a car. 
The best time to visit the red land is when the wheat is ripe from April to May, when rape flowers grow vigorously from September to December, and when there is occasional residual snow in the fields from February to March.
attractions.shortFeatures: Paradise for photography enthusiasts

attractions.name: 落霞沟
attractions.summary:
· Luoxiagou, also known as Hentangdi, is a depression that suddenly sinks surrounded by Chongshan Mountains. It is said to be one of the most beautiful places in the red land 
The sun rises from the mountain to the east of Luoxiagou, and flashlight may appear on cloudy days. The light from 16:30 to 17:30 is the best, which is suitable for shooting sunrise and sunset.  
· In different seasons, Luoxia Valley will present different beautiful scenery, with red and green color blocks and lines, just like a fairyland on earth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Different seasons present different beauty

attractions.name: 乐谱凹
attractions.summary:
Music Score Ao is a village in Dongchuan, where the fields are ups and downs and strewn at random. 
· The concave color lines of the music score are beautiful, like a staff, which is suitable for partial light shooting. 
Nearly half of the concave field of vision of the music score is woods and villages. The light in the evening is better, and the sunset can be photographed.

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 尖沙咀中心
attractions.summary: Tsim Sha Tsui Centre is one of the participating buildings of Symphony of Lights. It is located at MTR Tsim Sha Tsui Station and East Tsim Sha Tsui Station, close to the Star Ferry Island Line Pier. With the launch of the landscaping project in Tsim Sha Tsui East, many shopping malls and hotels have been re-whitewashed to create a better environment. Since the whitewashing works of Tsim Sha Tsui Center and Empire Center in 2006, a number of sea-view ground floor shops have been converted into duplex shops, and a number of restaurants have been introduced, which have become a must-see food hotspot for tourists and gourmets.

attractions.name: 中环街市
attractions.summary: The Central Market was completed in 1939 and is one of the few indoor markets in the area that was built before the war.

attractions.name: 旺角西洋菜南街
attractions.summary: Sai Yeung Choi Street is a famous street in Kowloon, Hong Kong, located east of Nathan Road and Cheung Sha Wan Road, south to Dundas Street, and north to St. Francis' Church and Primary School in Shek Kip Mei. The location of this road was originally a field for growing watercress, so it was named 'watercress street'. Sai Yeung Choi Street is divided into two parts by the Mong Kok Police Station near Prince Edward Station. Xiyangcai Street is a popular place for mainland tourists to visit. Most of the shops on the street open from 10:00 and do not close until midnight at 24:00. It is the main electronic product sales location in Mong Kok, with well-known Broadway Electric Appliances, Fengze Electric Appliances, and even Gome having branches here. From televisions and speakers to computers and mobile phones, various electronic products are sold, making it a paradise for appliances. For friends who are not very familiar with electronic products, it is recommended to read and compare more, compare prices from three different sources, and remember to negotiate appropriately when purchasing. There are many cosmetics stores and bookstores along the street, and you can visit cosmetics supermarkets such as Sasa and Zhuoyue. Brand exclusive stores such as The Body Shop and DHC are much cheaper than buying directly in mainland China. Bookstores are mostly located on the second and third floors, making it a densely populated area for second floor bookstores in Hong Kong. Book lovers can come to these bookstores to search for old books, and there may be unexpected gains. There are also several fast fashion chain clothing stores on Xiyangcai Street, where you can buy various affordable and high-quality clothing. If you get tired of shopping, you can go buy a cow ball, fish egg, or a double skin milk from Yishun Milk Company. After charging, you can continue shopping. In addition, nearby Tongcai Street (Women's Street), Huayuan Street (Sneaker Street), and Goldfish Street are all good places for shopping. If you want to stay away from the bustling crowds, you can also take a stroll along the nearby Flower Market Road and immerse yourself in the pace of Hong Kong style daily life, which is another great experience. Full text 

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 蝴蝶园
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Butterfly Garden covers an area of 8 hectares. There are over 100 types of butterflies kept here, with the Brook King butterfly being the most abundant.

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 基诺山寨
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
Jinuo Shanzhai is a place where Jinuo people live in concentrated communities, and it is the only live performing arts experience place in China that shows Jinuo culture in the most comprehensive and concentrated way. 
The performances in the scenic spot are concentrated in the Sun Square in the center of the stockade. Young men and women dressed in Jinuo costumes are singing and dancing with props in hand, which is magnificent. 
You can eat the unique local barbecue, enjoy the performances with rich ethnic customs and experience the rich Jinuo folk customs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery and feel the Jinuo customs

attractions.name: 西双版纳勐泐文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 曼听御花园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 西双版纳总佛寺
attractions.summary:
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple is the center for Buddhist believers in Xishuangbanna to worship Buddha, and it is also the highest-ranking Buddhist temple in Xishuangbanna. 
The general Buddhist temple is magnificent, with exquisite beams and columns carved, mainly including Weihan Hall, Buddhist College teaching building and other buildings. 
There is an altar in front of the north wall of today's courtyard building, where there are several Buddha statues, and the Buddha's Sutra is painted on the wall. 
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple and Manting Park are connected, and tourists usually enter the General Buddhist Temple from Manting Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beams and columns are beautifully carved, and the architecture is magnificent

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 上海之巅观光厅
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Tower's Observation Deck at the Top of Shanghai is a functional experience area of the Shanghai Tower. From the 360-degree observation deck at the top, you can have a close-up view of the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and the World Financial Center below your feet, while enjoying a distant view of the Expo Park, City God Temple, the Shanghai Stadium, and Hongqiao Airport. The winding Suzhou Creek and Huangpu River merge into the Yangtze River and flow into the East China Sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ascend to the Top of the Sea and Enjoy the Panoramic City View.

attractions.name: 陆家嘴空中步行连廊
attractions.summary: The Pudong Lujiazui Sky Pedestrian Corridor is approximately 543 meters long, starting from the second floor of Guojin Center in the west, crossing Yincheng Middle Road, crossing Dongtai Road along the north side of Jinmao Tower to the east, following the Global Financial Center to reach the Lujiazui Ring Road, and connecting with the Lujiazui Circular Sky Corridor. From the corridor, one can overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Lujiazui Financial City. Citizens can take a leisurely stroll in the air through the aerial corridor, conveniently shuttling between various shopping malls and subway stations.

attractions.name: 浦东美术馆
attractions.tag: Special exhibition hall; night tour and sightseeing; Art Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Pudong Art Museum (MAP) is invested, constructed and operated by Lujiazui Group and designed by the famous French architect and Pritzker Prize winner Jean Nouvel. Construction started on September 26, 2017 and will be officially opened to the public in July 2021. Open. Pudong Art Museum is located in the core area of Xiaolujiazui Riverside. It is a modern building with 6 floors and 30 meters high. It extends westward to the bank of the Huangpu River and eastward to connect to the Oriental Pearl Tower via the Garden Square, forming a 30,000-square-meter art museum territory.
The main building of Pudong Art Museum covers an area of 13,000 square meters, with a total building space area of nearly 40,000 square meters. It has 13 exhibition halls and an exhibition area of more than 10,000 square meters. The facade and floor of the building are made of Shandong Baima granite, and the interior space and decoration are inspired by Malevich's classic geometric drawings.
As a state-owned public art museum, Pudong Art Museum is an important measure to build the "Shanghai Culture" brand. It shoulders the cultural mission and social responsibilities entrusted by the urban and municipal governments. It focuses on international art exhibitions and exchanges, takes into account domestic art exhibitions, and highlights the four major functions of exhibitions, aesthetic education, cultural creativity, and international exchanges. It is committed to becoming a new landmark of Shanghai's international cultural venues and an important platform for international cultural and artistic exchanges.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lujiazui Binjiang New Internet Celebrity Landmark

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 人民广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
People's Square is the largest public square in Shanghai. It was transformed from the "largest horse racing hall in the Far East" in the concession era, and it is also a landmark of Shanghai. 
People's Square in a broad sense is mainly composed of open squares, People's Park, Shanghai Grand Theatre, Shanghai Museum and other buildings. 
Hong Kong Famous Street, Di Mei Shopping Center and Old Shanghai 1930 Style Street are built underground in the square, showing the old appearance of Shanghai in 1930s. 
There is a fountain in the center of the square, which sprays water about every half hour at night. It is beautiful under various lights and is a good place to enjoy the cool air.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Landmark and Transportation Hub

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览（金陵东路码头）
attractions.name_en: The Huangpu River Cruise (Jinling East Road Pier)
attractions.summary: The express tour condenses the essence of both banks of the Pujiang River. The route is Jinling East Road Wharf - Shiliupu Old Wharf - Nanpu Bridge - Jiangnan Shipyard Site - Chinese Art Palace - Lupu Bridge - Bund World Architecture Expo Group - Jinling East Road Wharf. The entire tour lasts about 60 minutes.

attractions.name: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址
attractions.name_en: The site of the first CPC National Congress
attractions.summary: Shanghai is the birthplace of the CPC, the birthplace of its original aspiration, and the birthplace of its great founding spirit. The site of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China is the place where the CPC dreams to set sail and the spiritual home of CPC people. On July 23, 1921, the first National Congress of the CPC was held at No. 106 Wangzhi Road (now No. 76 Xingye Road) in Shanghai, announcing the official establishment of the CPC. In September 1952, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was restored, a memorial hall was established, and it was opened to the public. In March 1961, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was designated as a national key cultural relic protection unit. The Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China is directly under the Propaganda Department of the Shanghai Municipal Committee. On June 3, 2021, the brand new Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was officially completed. The upgraded Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China has formed the characteristic pattern of "one hall and three sites". With the newly completed exhibition hall as the main core, it manages the site of the first National Congress of the CPC, the former site of the dormitory of the first National Congress of the CPC (Bowen Women's School), and the former site of the CPC delegation office in Shanghai (Zhou Mansion) as three key cultural relics under national protection. It is a red hall that tells the story of the founding of the party, demonstrates the founding of the party, and interprets the great spirit of the founding of the party. There are over 128000 collections of various levels from the Opium War to the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The new basic display, The Great Beginning - The Exhibition of the Creation History of the CPC, tells the history of the founding of the Party in a panoramic way, leading the audience to deeply understand the rich connotation of the great spirit of party building.

attractions.name: 复兴公园
attractions.summary: Fuxing Park is one of the earliest parks established in Shanghai. More than 80 years ago, this was originally a fertile farmland inhabited by hardworking and poor farmers. Fuxing Park is a French style park with a regular garden layout and a natural style that gradually changes towards the southwest. In recent years, a large number of flowers and trees have been added, with a total of 140 species and over 10000 shrubs, including towering plane trees, as well as precious trees such as seven chestnut trees, oak trees, and maple trees. The Fuxing Park is also very lively at night. The French atmosphere matches the colorful night life. The sound of high-heeled shoes will suddenly come from a peaceful corner, or under the French wutong tree late at night, there are young people waiting for a taxi at the roadside. I always sleep very late here at night in Shanghai.

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 思南公馆
attractions.tag: Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
The name of Sinan Mansion comes from Sinan Road. Sinan Road dates back to the road name of the French Concession in Shanghai-Route Massenet, and the English name of Sinan Mansion Hotel comes from this. 
This area began to be developed in the 1920s as the core area of the French Concession at that time. This year, the first batch of garden houses rose along Lafide Road (now Fuxing Middle Road) south of French Park (now Fuxing Park). 
In the following ten years, garden houses in the area south of Lafeide Road, east of Mas South Road (now Sinan Road) and west of Luban Road (now Chongqing South Road) were built one after another, attracting a large number of military and political dignitaries, entrepreneurs, professionals and famous artists at that time to move in. Zhou Enlai, Liu Yazi, Mei Lanfang and other celebrities once lived here, making this area a residence and gathering place of the upper class at that time. 
Today, Sinan Mansion combines 49 renovated historic buildings and 9 new buildings into four complementary functional areas: hotel, commercial, residential and office. Sinan Mansion has become one of the preservation and protection projects of Shanghai's historical and cultural features and excellent historical buildings. It has 51 garden houses with a long history, and at the same time, it gathers various architectural styles such as independent garden houses, corridor buildings and garden lanes. It combines humanities, fashion and historical heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the patches of garden houses

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 静安寺
attractions.summary:
Jing'an Temple is a famous ancient temple in Shanghai. The architectural style of the temple is combined with Tibetan temples. The silver Buddha enshrined in the Daxiong Hall weighs 15 tons. 
The main buildings of the temple are Mountain Gate, Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, etc. Looking at the whole temple from a distance, a golden roof is particularly conspicuous. 
Jing'an Temple is full of incense. Every birthday and anniversary of Bodhisattva, the temple will hold a Dharma fair. Every year, on the eighth day of April in the lunar calendar, a three-day temple fair will be held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Rare Tibetan-style temples in the east

attractions.name: 静安雕塑公园
attractions.summary: Jing'an Sculpture Park is the only specialized sculpture park in the center of Shanghai, which serves as an urban public product with ecological, artistic, and cultural functions. Originally just a small green area, this place has now become a park. Although the space is not large and there are not many sculptures, the environment is pleasant, and the selected sculptures are often replaced. This is also a small place where nearby residents often come to exercise.

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 中国国家博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
With a total construction area of nearly 200,000 square meters and a collection of more than 1 million pieces, it is the largest museum in the world. 
The museum is divided into five floors and has 48 exhibition halls. It is one of the museums with the richest collection of Chinese cultural relics. 
The exhibition system consists of basic exhibition, special exhibition, international exchange exhibition and temporary exhibition, covering all stages from ancient times to the present. 
· There are a large number of visitors, so you can make an appointment online before going to save time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at Chinese Treasures through Millenniums

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest.
