It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

restaurants.name_en: Commune restaurant at the foot of the Great Wall
Grand Skylight Hotel Beijing Taiji Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩万国建筑博览群
attractions.summary: The Bund International Architecture Exhibition Group is located on the west bank of the Pujiang River, starting from Waibaidu Bridge in the north and ending at Jinling East Road in the south. With a length of about 1800 meters, 52 historical buildings with different styles and strong exotic colors are lined up in a row, becoming one of the major attractions of the Bund. You can glimpse the century old historical changes of Shanghai Bund from here. The Bund, since Shanghai was designated as a commercial port in the 1840s, has become the political, financial, commercial, and cultural center of foreign powers in Shanghai, where foreign banks, businesses, and associations gather. Strolling along the eastern coast of Zhongshan, you will see various historical buildings in different styles, such as the Customs Building, the South and North Towers of the Peace Hotel, the former HSBC Building, the Asia Building, the Waldorf Astoria Hotel, and the Beneficial Building. Combined with Gothic spires, Baroque columns, Spanish balconies, and ancient Greek domes, it is as if you have traveled to a foreign street in the last century. At night, the lights are bright and pleasing to the eye. Most of the buildings have now been converted into commercial office buildings such as the headquarters of China Pacific Insurance Company, the Consulate General of Thailand in Shanghai, the Shanghai headquarters of China Merchants Group, the headquarters of Pudong Development Bank, Shanghai Customs, the Shanghai Federation of Trade Unions, and the Shanghai Foreign Exchange Trading Center, which are not open to the public. Some buildings have also become consumer centers, such as the famous 18th Bund, which was the headquarters of Standard Chartered Bank in China. The first and second floors are the flagship stores of many international famous brands, such as Cartier, and upwards are the "18 Creative Center on the Bund", the Cantonese restaurant "Tanwailou", the Michelin 3-star three-star chefs restaurant, and the open-air river view bar, which are the must see places to enjoy the nightlife in Shanghai. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 上海四行仓库抗战纪念馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Sihang Warehouse Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall
attractions.summary: Sihang Warehouse was built in 1931. It is a six-story building with a reinforced concrete structure. It is named because it was a warehouse jointly funded and built by four banks in old Shanghai: Jincheng, Zhongnan, Daliu and Salt Industry. During the Battle of Songhu, 452 Kuomintang soldiers were stationed here heroically resisting the Japanese attack. The iron doors of the original four-line warehouse are preserved at the entrance of the Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall, which are stained with rust.
attractions.shortFeatures: Research and practical education base for primary and secondary school students

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 东方明珠259米全透明悬空观光廊
attractions.summary: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower fully transparent sightseeing corridor is 259 meters high, 150 meters long and 2.1 meters wide. It is the only 360 degree fully transparent sightseeing corridor in the world. Standing on the fully transparent sightseeing corridor, enjoy the panoramic view of Shanghai in a unique way of "aerial stroll" and experience an unprecedented shock.

attractions.name: 90米室外观光走廊
attractions.summary: The 90 meter outdoor sightseeing corridor is located on the high-rise of a famous building in Shanghai, providing a unique perspective that allows tourists to overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Shanghai city. This is an ideal place for photography enthusiasts and tourists seeking exciting experiences.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园-车入区
attractions.summary: The car entry area is a form of free range animal display, maintaining the exhibition mode of "people in 'cages', animals free", giving animals more freedom space. Experience groups of herbivorous animals such as zebras, antelopes, zebras, rhinoceroses, and others gathering together to leisurely forage in person; You can also experience the wild and majestic appearance of large beasts such as cheetahs, white tigers, African lions, bears, wolves, and other "tribes".

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 西园寺
attractions.tag: Garden garden; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples
attractions.summary: Xiyuan Jiezhuanglu Temple, referred to as Xiyuan Temple for short, is located outside Changmen in the west of Suzhou. It was founded from Yuan Dynasty to Yuan Dynasty and has a history of 700 years. The temple has deep ancient trees, heavy Brahma universe, green water, birds singing and flowers fragrant. Most of the existing temples were built in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and they are the largest temples in Suzhou. On the central axis, from south to north, there are three-room memorial archway, mountain gate, King Kong Hall, release pool, Daxiong Hall and Tibetan Sutra Building. There is Guanyin Hall on the east side of King Kong Hall and Arhat Hall on the west side. There are also Buddhist Chanting Hall, Fayun Hall, Guest Hall, Zhai Hall, warehouse and other buildings in the temple. There are four complete books of Dragon Tibet in the Tibetan Sutra Building, which were later given to Baolian Temple in Hong Kong, and more than 80,000 Buddhist scriptures such as Huayan Sutra written by Master Shan Ji in the Yuan Dynasty. Xiyuan Temple is a large temple with complete scale, magnificent temple, solemn Buddha statues and garden characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combining temples with gardens

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区-虎丘塔
attractions.summary: Huqiu Pagoda is located on Huqiu Mountain in the northwest suburbs of Suzhou, 5 kilometers away from the city center. According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn Period, King Fuchai of Wu buried his father (Helu) here. Three days after the burial, a white tiger perched on it, hence the name Huqiu Mountain, abbreviated as Huqiu. Huqiu Pagoda is a famous ancient pagoda from the Song Dynasty, both domestically and internationally. Founded in the sixth year of Xiande in the Later Zhou Dynasty (959 AD) and completed in the second year of Jianlong in the Northern Song Dynasty (961 AD). The tower has seven levels and eight sides, with two layers of internal and external columns and half arches, brick body and wooden eaves. It is a representative work of brick towers in the Yangtze River Basin in the 10th century. Due to multiple fires from the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, the wooden eaves at the top were all damaged, and the current height of the tower is 47.5 meters. In 1956, a large number of cultural relics were discovered inside the tower, including rare art treasures such as Yue kiln and lotus stone turtle. The Tiger Hill Tower is a leaning tower.

attractions.name: 观前街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Located in the center of Suzhou ancient city, the area is prosperous in commerce, famous shops gather and numerous historic sites. There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering many Suzhou specialties

attractions.name: 苏州中心广场
attractions.summary: Suzhou Center is the core component of Suzhou Central Plaza, which is divided into two buildings. The northern district focuses on international fast fashion, family, and parent-child activities, while the southern district focuses on light luxury and dining. There are numerous brands gathered here, as well as an aerial ecological park, which forms a unified urban architectural image with the Oriental Gate and Jinji Lake.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 静山夕阳观景处
attractions.name_en: jing shan xi yang guan jing chu
attractions.summary: Jingshan Sunset View is located in Suzhou, where people can enjoy the beautiful scenery of sunrise and sunset as well as the beautiful the Taihu Lake Lake.

attractions.name: 东村古村
attractions.summary: The East Village is located in the north of Xishan Island, Suzhou, with Qingshan Mountain to the south and the Taihu Lake Lake to the north, facing Hengshan, Yinshan and Shaoshan Islands. Dongcun was established in the late Qin and early Han dynasties. It was named after Dongyuan Gong, one of the Four Heroes of Shangshan, who once lived here in seclusion. In ancient times, it was called Dongyuan Village, abbreviated as Dongcun. Existing ancient residences: Fangzhu Hall, Shensi Hall, Ruimu Hall, Renyu Hall, Yansheng Hall, Xuepu Hall, Liugeng Hall, Shaoyi Hall, Xiaoyou Hall, Rende Hall, Dunhe Hall, Cuixiu Hall, Langrun Hall, Jingxiu Hall, etc. There are also historical sites such as Qixian Lane Gate, Yong'an Bridge, and Dongyuan Temple. Jingxiu Hall - The Golden House of Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty, where delicate treasures were hidden. Due to economic and transportation constraints, the preservation of the ancient village style in Dongcun is better than other areas in Xishan. Most of the roads in the village are still in their original stone and blue brick appearance, and the ancient houses on both sides are mostly from the Qianlong and Jiaqing periods of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 林屋洞
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Linwudong is named after the cave is as flat as a house, and the stones standing in the cave are like a forest. It ranks ninth among the top ten caves in Taoism, and is called the ninth cave in the world. It is also known as "the secluded and empty sky of the left god". Taoist cultural relics such as golden dragons, jade slips and idols of the Tang Dynasty have been unearthed in Linwudong. Thousands of ancient poems praised: "A mountain flies in Taihu Lake, and thousands of beauties are hidden deep in the forest house cave".  
There are holes in the cave, which are connected, secluded and deep, curved and folded. There are stone scenes such as stone room, dragon bed, silver room, stone bell, stone drum, golden court, jade pillar, Baizhi, Jinsha, dragon basin, geofanmen, stone swallow, hidden spring, milk spring, etc., among which it is unpredictable and confusing. 
 
There are many talented people in the history of Taoist culture, and they often live far away from the world and buried hills. Located on the south side of Linwu Cave, also known as Wujie Jingshe, it is the seclusion place of Wujie lay people in Song Dynasty. He was the magistrate of Pingjiang (now Suzhou) less than two months before he was dismissed from office, so he built a garden to live in seclusion, claiming to be his residence "Daoyin Garden". His "The Record of Daoyin Garden" is engraved at the entrance of the forest house cave. 
 
The best time to travel here is in early spring, which is a wonderful place to enjoy plum blossoms. As soon as you enter Xishan Island, along the lakeside hills, plum blossoms are blooming all over the mountains and plains, and they are snow-white. People enter the forest, like entering the ocean of flowers. "There are flowers and branches everywhere in the mountains, and I don't know how far and near it is." It is warm in winter and cool in summer, and Linwudong has a constant temperature and wonderful scenery, so it was praised as a fairyland on earth by the ancients. 
 
 
Roaming route: Rain Cave-Gefan Cave-Tianhou Bie Palace-Bing Cave-Dragon Cave-Yanggu Cave 
 
[food] 
 
The "Three Treasures of Taihu Lake" (whitebait, white shrimp and plum ectenes) abundant here can be tasted according to your preference, and it is enough to accompany two or three farm dishes.
attractions.shortFeatures: It's fun to drill the maze composed of Taihu stones

attractions.name: 西山雕花楼
attractions.summary: The Xishan Carved Flower Mansion is a historical building complex from the Ming and Qing dynasties, covering an area of over 6,000 square meters. It was completed over four reigns of the Qing Dynasty. The entire mansion consists of interconnected buildings: multiple floors, multiple rooms, and all rooms are connected to each other, forming a grand and magnificent structure. It is considered the first ancient famous residence in the Jiangnan region. The mansion contains over 3,000 pieces of brick and wood carvings from the Qing Dynasty, each unique. The carvings, characterized by their diversity, intricacy, craftsmanship, and ingenuity, feature patterns of landscapes, flowers and birds, feathers, and antiques, reflecting daily life and showcasing the classic craftsmanship of the Xiangshan guild from the Ming and Qing dynasties in Jiangnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the exquisite carvings with a royal grandeur.

restaurants.name_en: Wu Ling Lu Seafood BBQ Restaurant

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园
attractions.summary: Haixinsha is located in the area of Bati, the Pearl River - Guangzhou Tower - Huacheng Square. It is an artificial island located on the the Pearl River. The night scene here is very beautiful. With the lights of Huacheng Square, you can see the colorful changes of Guangzhou Tower across the river, which reflect each other. Moreover, it is also a great destination for the exterior of Guangzhou Tower, where many photography enthusiasts take photos. The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Those who have watched the opening ceremony will surely remember this boat shaped sports arena vividly. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. The unique geographical location makes Haixinsha and its surrounding areas a must for exploring the international metropolis of Guangzhou, which is a new landmark of Guangzhou. The subway APM line connects these three areas to form a three-point line. Generally, APM can take you to Haixinsha Station, but if you want to have a better tour, it is recommended to get off at Dahua Theater Station. Because you can also visit the Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Library, which are new cultural landmarks in Guangzhou. Then take a slow walk to Liede Bridge and see Haixinsha and Guangzhou Tower from the other side.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 广州兰圃
attractions.summary: Lanpu and Yuexiu Park in Guangzhou are located in the city center, with convenient transportation and direct access by subway. Perhaps because across the road is Yuexiu Park, there are relatively few visitors to Lanpu, which makes the park very quiet. Lanpu is a great place to admire orchids. It is a specialized orchid park in the Lingnan region, cultivating over 200 varieties of orchids and nearly 10000 pots of orchids, including precious orchid species such as Dahuasu, Dafengwei Su, Dendrobium, and Xiandian Baimo. The orchid planting in Orchid Garden is divided into three grids. The first and third grids are mainly planted with orchids, which have light and fragrant flowers; The second grid is dominated by parasitic orchids, with bright flowers but little fragrance. Of course, for tourists, most of them don't care about the variety of orchids. Just take a look and take photos. The flowers are brightly colored and most of them are extremely photogenic. At its entrance, there are two couplets that read 'Fragrant in the Upper Country, Splendid in the South', and the horizontal sign reads' Orchid Garden ', which is very imposing. Strolling into the garden, one can see the elements of Jiangnan gardens everywhere, such as arches, stacked mountains, stone masonry, long corridors, and water pavilions. It suddenly feels like coming to a garden in Suzhou. The entire orchid garden is quiet and deep, with a very good environment, and the air is particularly elegant and high-quality due to the fragrance of orchids. Orchids are classified according to their flowering time, including spring orchids, summer orchids, autumn orchids, cold orchids, and New Year orchids. If you want to see magnolia, its flowering period is from February to March. If you want to see more orchids, spring would be more suitable. In addition to enjoying flowers, most people come here for tea and small Dim sum. Although Lanpu is small, it has many tea rooms with different tea resources and styles. The decoration of the tea rooms is mostly high-end, unique and elegant, very stylish. When the spring is warm and the flowers are blooming, sitting in the tea house with friends and enjoying a small drink, the feeling must be excellent.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Located 2km west of Canton Tower, North Gate Square of Sun Yat-sen University, at CUHK/memorial archway. 
The wharf is located in Guang Zhouta, Haizhu District, an important landscape area of the new central axis of the city. It is planned to open a number of water bus routes. The wharf is positioned as a midway terminal for citizens to visit Guang Zhouta, tour the Pearl River at night and travel. The departure route of Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf is-Ersha Island-Xinghai Concert Hall-North Gate of Zhongda University-Haiyin Bridge-Guangzhou Bridge-Haixinsha-Guang Zhouta-Liede Bridge-and returns to Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour around the bright night scene of Yangcheng

attractions.name: 广州市文化馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The new building of Guangzhou Cultural Center is designed with the theme of "Ten Miles of Red Clouds, One Bay of Water, Eight Bridges, Painting Boats, and Sixteen Pavilions". It cleverly combines traditional architecture and garden space to recreate the beautiful scenery of Lingnan water town gardens, including Hanmo Garden, Quyi Garden, Guangfu Garden, Guangxiu Garden and other theme garden buildings, as well as the large garden landscape formed by them together. It is a city living room rich in Lingnan ecological characteristics and cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 黄埔军校旧址纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Former Site of Huangpu Military Academy
attractions.summary:
- The Army Officer School, founded by Sun Yat-sen in 1924 during the first cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, is the cradle of Chinese military leaders.  
- The military school held seven sessions on Changzhou Island before relocating to Nanjing in 1930, and later moved to Chengdu and Taiwan. It was destroyed in 1938 by a Japanese bombing raid.  
- The entire old site features architectural styles from the Republic of China era, with key attractions including the school headquarters, Sun Yat-sen's former residence, the Eastern Expedition Martyrs' Cemetery, the Northern Expedition Monument, and the Dapo Di Artillery Battery.  
- The venue offers guided tours at 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00, and 15:00.
attractions.shortFeatures: The cradle of modern Chinese military leaders.

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 岭南印象园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gem for Kid-Friendly Activities; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 空中缆车
attractions.summary: Entering from the north gate, you can directly take the cable car from Swan Lake Station to Panda Park Station (near the south gate), pass through Panda Park Koala Pavilion to Africa Grassland Station, then take the small train ride to the amusement area and return to Swan Lake Station.

attractions.name: 猛兽地带-非洲狮
attractions.summary: Walking into the African corridor, the incoming heat wave brings the scorching sun, which in Greek means' scorching sun 'in Africa. The African Corridor is adjacent to the tropical rainforest area, sweeping away the humidity of the rainforest. The first thing tourists see is the home of a very familiar animal - the mongoose brother. There are three families with a total of 30 mongoose brothers living here. These diligent and elf like small animals are known as coal digging machines among animals, and can repair a tunnel for escaping in one night. The neighbors of the small tailed mongoose's house have a Japanese hippopotamus from the primitive forests of West Africa, which is the smallest hippopotamus in the world. The unique glass pavilion allows visitors to enjoy the rarely seen lower body of the hippopotamus and see them swimming in the pool with short hands and feet. In contrast, the animals in the herbivorous animal corridor are much more elegant, quietly grazing, but being overshadowed by the colorful macaws and hornbills nearby. Watching African animals and learning about African culture cannot do without the dance of African indigenous people. At the Africa Square, there are daily indigenous dance performances, taking tourists into the African world.

attractions.name: 澳洲森林
attractions.summary: In the eucalyptus forest full of Australian atmosphere, you can see rare monotremes up close - the cute red kangaroo; There is also the second largest bird on Earth - the emu, which looks like an ostrich. Don't confuse them; Don't miss out on the elegant black swan.

attractions.name: 非洲森林
attractions.summary: The "African Forest" exhibition area covers an area of over 30000 square meters, and the overall design highly restores the landscape of African forests. More than 30 black and white colobus monkeys and intelligent chimpanzees have settled down in African forests and interacted with everyone up close! In addition, there are various small animals crossing through the forests of Africa, such as the active black and white lemurs and the elf white cheeked gibbons appearing beside you. There are also authentic drum performances by Kenyan indigenous people on site, allowing tourists to fully experience the rich African culture.

attractions.name: 丛林发现
attractions.summary: Jungle Discovery is an interactive experience area within Chimelong Wildlife World in Guangzhou, where visitors can observe and learn about the living habits of various wild animals up close, and experience the fun of interacting with them.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 雨林仙踪
attractions.summary: The interactive three-dimensional ecological rainforest exhibition area "Rainforest Fairy" covers an area exceeding the projects "Jurassic Forest" and "Golden Snake Secret Realm" in the same region. It innovatively integrates international advanced exhibition concepts and fully follows the concept of natural layering in the natural rainforest ecosystem to observe animals, opening an unprecedented and unimaginable exploration door for you. At the "Rainforest Wizard of Oz", tourists can delve into the giant ant nests of giant anteaters and observe their magical process of feeding with their tongues; Traverse the magical glass passage and catch a glimpse of mini plush monkeys playing overhead! Don't worry about missing out on the graceful and graceful climbing posture of the orangutans living in the treetops. The unique aerial wooden boardwalk allows you to fully enjoy their wonderful artistic gymnastics performances! In addition, there are dozens of "rainforest residents" such as gibbons, gibbons, flying hornbills, honeysuckers, and big billed birds that come into close contact with you.

attractions.name: 长颈鹿广场
attractions.shortFeatures: Star animals that must be photographed and punched in

attractions.name: 考拉广场
attractions.summary: Koala Square is located within the Chimelong Tourist Resort in Guangzhou. These national treasures from Australia are blooming and scattering in the Chimelong Wildlife Park. Not only are there twins "Huanhuan" and "Lele", but also the koala family with "six generations living together".

attractions.name: 熊猫乐园
attractions.summary: In 'Panda Village', there are the only triplets of panda cubs in the world who are cute, handsome, and cool. Mengmeng is a gentle and lovely older sister, while Shuai and Kuku are handsome and charming younger brothers. At Panda Park, you can watch panda cubs eat fragrant bamboo up close and take away furry panda dolls.

attractions.name: 青龙山
attractions.summary: In the brand new Jurassic Forest covering hundreds of thousands of square meters, robots from the future take you through time and space tunnels, and the Jurassic scenery is presented realistically. The world's most real and largest dinosaurs are around you, making you feel like you are in prehistoric times. Experience the resurrection of dinosaurs in an unprecedented way and embark on exciting jungle adventures.

attractions.name: 金蛇秘境
attractions.summary: The "Golden Snake Secret Realm" created with huge investment in the Year of the Snake is the largest ecological themed snake park, showcasing over 20 species and more than 300 rare snakes, including the world's largest golden python. Hundreds of thousands of square meters of pristine forest secrets, unique dome shaped snake watching methods, and innovative multimedia viewing experiences bring visitors a brand new world of snakes, discovering the friendly, beautiful, and auspicious side of snakes and providing unprecedented snake watching experiences.

attractions.name: 考拉园
attractions.summary: Going to Koala Park can fulfill your desire to carefully observe the adorable koalas. Here, there are not only twins "Huanhuan" and "Lele", but also a four generation koala family living together. Koalas are very drowsy during the day, except for eating eucalyptus leaves, they just sleep. If you encounter a koala with its eyes open and not sleeping, it's lucky.

attractions.name: 亚洲象园
attractions.summary: The Asian Elephant Park is located in Guangzhou and is a park dedicated to showcasing and protecting Asian elephants. Tourists can observe these large animals up close, understand their living habits and conservation status. There are also educational exhibitions within the park aimed at raising public awareness of Asian elephants and their habitat conservation.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 白云山
attractions.tag: Climbing and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Baiyun Mountain is one of the famous mountains in southern Guangdong, known as the "First Beauty of Yangcheng" and "The First Mountain of Nanyue."

· It consists of more than 30 peaks. From the summit, visitors can overlook the entire city and get a distant view of the Pearl River, making it a popular destination for spring outings.

· After rain or during the late spring season, clouds swirl around the mountain, and the name "Baiyun Mountain" (White Cloud Mountain) is derived from this phenomenon.

· The scenic area is divided into seven tourist zones: Mingzhu Tower, Moxing Ridge, Mingchun Valley, Santai Ridge, Luhu Lake, Fei'e Ridge, and Heyi Ridge.

· Visitors can also enjoy recreational activities such as grass skiing, slideways, and small bungee jumping in the scenic area.

· Baiyun Mountain is dotted with stunning rhododendrons in red, pink, and white. From a distance, the mountains are adorned with a sea of blooming flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climbing high to enjoy the scenery and admire the moonlight.

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 榕杉湖景区
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: Rongshan Lake Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin City. It is a Lianxin Lake connected by water bodies. It is bounded by Yangqiao, with Shanhu Lake in the east and Ronghu Lake in the west. It is named after the banyan trees and fir trees growing on the shore of the lake. During the Tang and Song Dynasties, the artificially excavated moat in the south of the city was called Nanyang River. It was called Jianhu Lake in Yuan Dynasty, and the city was expanded in Ming Dynasty to become Inner Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after banyan tree and fir tree

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

attractions.name: 东西巷
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: East and West Lane, close to Jingjiang Palace, is a comprehensive commercial block integrating tourism, folk customs, culture, shopping, catering, leisure and entertainment. East-West Lane is the only historical street left over from the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Guilin, with a pleasant spatial scale. It is a scenic spot of Guilin's ancient historical features, including Zhengyang Street East Lane, Jiangnan Lane, Lanjing Lane and other traditional streets and lanes in Guilin.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the rare historic districts of the city

attractions.name: 逍遥楼
attractions.summary: Between Jiefang Bridge and Fubo Mountain in the northern section of Binjiang Road in today's urban area. Founded in the Tang Dynasty, it is the Dongcheng Building of Guizhou City in the Tang Dynasty, with a stone tablet of "Xiaoyao Building" written by Yan Zhenqing. Yan Zhenqing (709-785), whose courtesy name is Qing Chen, was a native of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province today. He was a scholar in the Kaiyuan period of Tang Dynasty. He once worked as the censor in the palace, the prefect of Pingyuan (now Shandong Province), and then became the prince Taishi and the duke of Lu County. He was known as "Yan Lugong" in the world. His calligraphy is dignified, vigorous and powerful, and original, which is called "Yan Ti". Yan Zhenqing has never been to Guilin. According to legend, this tablet was re-engraved according to the hook copy of the tablet in Puzhou (now Yongji, Shanxi). Because it is located in Dongcheng Building, this building is called "Xiaoyao Building". The first year of Chongning in Song Dynasty (1102). Guangnan West Road was reassured by Cheng Jie to rebuild the building and renamed it "Xiangnan Building". The "Records of Xiangnan Building" on the stele yin of the existing "Xiaoyao Building" records the process of building repair and the reason for name change.
attractions.shortFeatures: Dongcheng Tower of Guizhou City in Tang Dynasty

attractions.name: 漓江四星游船
attractions.summary: The basic situation of the cruise ship is that the Li River cruise ship has been upgraded and upgraded. Taking into account the tourist experience and psychological expectations, strict regulations have been made for the per capita cabin area, passenger seat specifications, cabin dining table specifications, and per capita area of the walking deck of the upgraded cruise ship. In addition, fabric soft wrapped sofas are used, which greatly improve comfort and aesthetics compared to ordinary cruise ships. And high material standards are required for the decoration and renovation of the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. of the cruise ship, and clear regulations are made for the replacement period of curtains, tablecloths, and other decorations, creating a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. The sanitary facilities are fully equipped with advanced technology, and the humanized detail design is comprehensive. The four-star cruise ship has a double decker cabin layout and decoration, with the first floor being a business cabin (second-class), and the per capita area in the tourist cabin not less than 1.8 square meters; The second floor is a luxury business cabin (first-class cabin), with a per capita area of no less than 2.5 square meters in the tourist cabin; The ship is equipped with a double deck walking deck with a wide view and a per capita area of not less than 1.4 square meters. The deck is equipped with sunshades and resting tables and chairs; There are 1.2m high aluminum alloy safety guardrails around. The cabin floor is made of high wear-resistant wood flooring and high-end carpets, while the ceiling and wall panels are made of wood and honeycomb aluminum plate materials, with exquisite craftsmanship. The cabin decoration is beautiful and elegant, reflecting cultural connotations or ethnic characteristics, decorated with flowers and green plants. The cabin dining table is made of elm wood and water chestnut materials, with carved decorations. The tourist seats are designed with armrests, which are comfortable and stylish. The double decker cabin provides both Chinese and Western style buffet meals or customized special dining options for tourists. The tableware and tea utensils are made of high-quality ceramic materials and are equipped with matching tableware for both Chinese and Western cuisine. There are also mini bars to meet the entertainment needs of different tourists. Each row of seats or table is equipped with a tablet computer near the window sill, which can provide a series of intelligent services such as Guilin tourism information, entertainment, and ordering. attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
