attractions.name: 桂林千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area is jointly created by Songcheng Performing Arts and Guilin Travel Stock, which reproduces Guilin's history, culture and ethnic customs, and is suitable for all ages to have fun with each other, rain or shine. 
The giant song fairy statue is magnificent and integrated with Guilin's landscape. It is the embodiment of the truth, goodness and beauty of Bagui land. Everything in the scenic spot is tourist-centered, with tens of thousands of square meters of No.3 secret tourism complex, wind and rain corridor and five-star standard toilet with all-indoor air conditioning. Haunted House, Qingming Riverside Film Museum, Wonderful Street and other high-tech and children's experience projects are full of fun. Yangshuo Ancient Village has created a unique farming and market life style. Handicraft workshops such as grandfather's wine jar, grandma's cakes and father's toys in Shijing Street and Fengqing Street keep homesickness and look for the memories of parents. Lover's Harbor and No.4 Bay are good places for young people to relax. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Guilin" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Using advanced high-tech means such as sound, light and electricity and stage machinery, it sings the legend of truth, goodness and beauty in Bagui land through time and space in the three-dimensional space of water, land and air, bringing Bagui culture hidden under the 800-mile Lijiang River into everyone's field of vision, and reproduces a love affair in Guilin for three lives and three lifetimes. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as National Flash Show, Mo Tusi Recruiting Son-in-Law, Song Fairy Welcomes Guests, Guozhuang Carnival, etc. 
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduction of Guilin ethnic customs

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 十里画廊

attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 太和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Supreme Harmony, commonly known as the Jinluan Hall, is the highest existing palace in China and is known as the first of the "Three Great Halls of the East". 
The interior decoration of the hall is very luxurious, with gold bricks paving the floor, and a throne with golden lacquer cloud dragon patterns, inlaid with thousands of golden dragon patterns, which is exquisite and unusually. 
There are also sundials, bronze turtles, bronze cranes, etc. in front of the temple, and a stone faucet for drainage is installed. During the rainy season, it can present the spectacle of thousands of dragons spitting water. 
At the same time, it is also the center of gravity of the Forbidden City, where it is used to hold various grand ceremonies, such as the emperor's accession to the throne, the emperor's wedding, and the establishment of the queen.
attractions.shortFeatures: The "Golden Temple" in the Forbidden City

attractions.name: 保和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Preservation of Harmony was built in 1420, behind the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and it is one of the three halls outside the Forbidden City. 
The floor in the hall is paved with gold bricks, and there is a carved gold lacquer throne from north to south. The inner and outer eaves are painted with golden dragons and seals, and the ceiling is a front dragon with powder and gold, which is luxurious and rich when matched with the decoration and furnishings that emphasize Dan red. 
The temple had different uses in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Before the ceremony of the Ming Dynasty, the emperor often changed clothes here. In the Qing Dynasty, every New Year's Eve and the 15th day of the first month, the emperor's family banquet and palace examination were held in Baohe Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Roof covered with yellow glazed tiles

attractions.name: 慈宁宫
attractions.summary: The Cining Palace is the essence of ancient Chinese palace architecture. Founded in the 15th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty, the Cining Palace was the residence of the previous imperial concubines.

attractions.name: 御花园
attractions.summary:
Located at the northern end of the central axis of the Forbidden City, it covers an area of more than 12,000 square meters. It was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty and named "Palace Houyuan". It was renamed "Imperial Garden" in the Yongzheng Dynasty of the Qing Dynasty. 
The buildings in the park adopt the symmetrical layout of the central axis, and the buildings are mostly leaning against walls. Only a few beautifully shaped pavilions stand in the park, and the space is wide. 
Cypress and locust trees are planted in the garden, with potted plants and bronze statues to add vitality, forming an evergreen scenery all year round, highlighting the Han culture of harmony between man and nature. 
In early spring, the apricot trees next to Chengrui Pavilion in the Royal Garden gradually enter the full bloom period.
attractions.shortFeatures: According to legend, the place where the emperor climbed to enjoy the moon

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 北海公园
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Enjoying Autumn Leaves
attractions.summary:
·Beihai Park is located in the center of Beijing and is the oldest existing classical royal garden in China, with the most complete preservation and the deepest cultural heritage.  
·The park is centered around Beihai Lake and is divided into four main areas: the "North Shore Scenic Area," "East Shore Scenic Area," "Qiong Island Scenic Area," and "Tuan City Scenic Area."  
·The vast water area is rare in Beijing, and the best time for boating and sightseeing in the park is in the evening, when one can admire imperial architecture and sit by the lake, chatting with elderly locals about the royal history of the capital.  
·On the east shore, there are several courtyard-style gardens such as Hao Pu Jian, Hua Fang Zhai, and Can Tan, which are hidden among the ancient pines and cypress trees. These gardens not only have a natural charm but also exude the elegance of a private garden in southern China.  
·On the north shore, from east to west, there are Jingxin Zhai, Western Heaven, Chengguan Hall, the Nine-Dragon Wall, Chanfu Temple, and the World of Bliss. The Five-Dragon Pavilion is dotted along the lake, blending seamlessly with the natural landscape, creating a scene that seems entirely natural, like a masterpiece of landscape painting.  
·Beihai Park is home to one of the Eight Scenic Spots of Yanjing, "Qiong Island Spring Shade," which will reach its best viewing period in April. The blooming flowers, beautiful rocks, and captivating scenery make it a particularly enchanting sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Royal Garden of Bai Ta Lake, intertwined with water.

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

restaurants.name_en: Kitchen No. 319. Old Beijing Hotpot Restaurant

attractions.name: 盛鑫源洗浴
attractions.summary: Harbin Shengxinyuan Bathhouse has large bathing areas for men and women, rest halls, bone-loosening rooms, jade steaming, gemstone experience areas, yurts, billiards, video games, table tennis, chess and card rooms, children's playgrounds, Dining and other comprehensive facilities. It also has business suites, standard rooms, etc., where you can experience leisure and health, feel the courtesy, and the waiting pavilion of Shengxinyuan Bathhouse.

attractions.name: 松花江观光索道
attractions.summary: The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway starts from Tongjiang Square in the south and ends at Taiyang Island Scenic Area in the north, spanning across the Songhua River. It is a well-known tourist transportation vehicle. The total length of the cableway is 1156 meters, and the cableway bracket in the river is more than 70 meters away from the river surface. Riding in the car, you can overlook the panoramic view of both sides of the Songhua River, with infinite scenery. The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway is one of the key projects in Harbin City, which was built and constructed with huge investment in 1997. It introduced equipment from the world's senior cableway equipment company, Austria's Dopema Company, and ranks among the high-end international cableways today. The cableway is adjacent to Stalin Park, Flood Control Memorial Tower, and Central Street, like a jade belt tightly connecting the two banks of the Songhua River. The cableway is equipped with 19 fully automatic and fully enclosed high-end cabins for 8 people, 6 luxurious cabins, and built-in sofas, bars, and speakers, providing comfort, elegance, warmth, and romance. The cableway runs at a speed of 1-5 meters per second, with ease and speed. Walking leisurely in the courtyard, one can enjoy the scenery of northern China and the city, and the scenery wherever they go is infinite. So far, the cableway has been in operation for more than 20 years, with a safety factor of 100%. Full text 

attractions.name: 太阳岛风景区
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids.; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- Sun Island Park is located on the northern bank of the Songhua River in Harbin, across from Stalin Park, and is known by visitors as a summer resort.
- The island features numerous European-style villas, which were once summer retreats for the Russians. These architectural structures are nestled amidst lush green trees.
- This is the largest winter theme park in China with a snow theme, and in winter, it becomes a world of snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Summer for escaping the heat, winter for enjoying snow sculptures.

attractions.name: 伏尔加庄园
attractions.summary:
The Volga Manor is located on the banks of the Ashi River in the suburban area of Harbin, covering an area of over 600,000 square meters. It is a national AAAA-level cultural tourism attraction, a base for China-Russia cultural exchange, a creative base for the Russian Artists Association, and an international exchange center of Moscow University. The manor advocates the business philosophy of "cultural depth for long-term success, and taste for true value." The reconstructed St. Nicholas Church and the riverside restaurant carry the memories of the old Harbin residents; the Petrov Art Palace and the Pushkin Exhibition Hall provide platforms for cultural and artistic exchange. It is a cultural destination for tourists, a vacation manor.

The manor can accommodate approximately 1,000 people for dining and 800 people for accommodation, offering high-quality services for tourism, leisure vacations, exhibitions, business meetings, study tours, weddings, outdoor sports, and other activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian Style Manor

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 果戈里大街
attractions.summary:
· It has a history of more than 100 years, and there are many Russian-style buildings, including the famous Qiulin Food Company Building and St. Alexeyev Church. 
The prosperity and night scene are no less beautiful than Central Street, and it is also a "bar street" in Harbin. 
It is also a famous cultural street, with modern horseshoe stones on both sides of the road, and a piece engraved with Heilongjiang historical and cultural celebrities is inlaid every other section.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old Russian-style block

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 东北虎林园
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
attractions.summary:
The Northeast Tiger Park is located on the north bank of the Songhua River, covering an area of approximately 1.2 million square meters, and is only separated by a small body of water from the famous summer resort, Sun Island Scenic Area. The Tiger Park occupies 360,000 square meters and is currently the world's largest wild natural park for Northeast Tigers. It was established to save and protect the endangered Northeast Tiger species.

The park currently has 10 sightseeing areas: the Wild Training Area, Adult Tiger Area, Young Tiger Area, Tiger King Area, Breeding Tiger Area, Breeding Male Tiger Area, Lion and Tiger Area, African Lion Area, Walking Area, and Tiger Viewing Platform. Visitors can see over 100 purebred Northeast Tigers, 8 white tigers, 1 snow tiger, 2 white lions, 2 liger hybrids, 3 black jaguars, and 20 African lions. Except for the Walking Area and Tiger Viewing Platform, the other areas require visitors to travel in vehicles to search for the tigers and appreciate their majesty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up Observation of Amur Tiger's Habitat

attractions.name: 哈尔滨大剧院
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary: Harbin Grand Theatre is a newly completed theater in Harbin, and it will soon become the best place for concerts, stage plays, dramas and other performances in Harbin. This Harbin Grand Theatre, which is inspired by the ice and snow landscape of Northern China, is also a rookie in Harbin architecture. The undulating architectural lines are rich in natural rhythm, like continuous snow-capped mountains. Even if you don't watch the show, this unique architectural beauty is worth visiting.
attractions.shortFeatures: New landmark of online celebrity, night scene space feeling; A landmark building like flowing clouds

attractions.name: 侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆
attractions.summary: The Criminal Evidence Site of Unit 731, located in the southern suburbs of Harbin, displays a large amount of evidence of Japanese aggressors conducting experiments on living people. Various experimental equipment, character scenes, sculptures, pictures, and testimony materials, as well as sites such as microbiology laboratories, frostbite laboratories, and crematoriums, are all iron evidence like mountains. Unit 731 was founded in 1933 and has been conducting human experiments on captured Chinese soldiers and a large number of innocent Chinese civilians for more than 20 years, including frostbite experiments, dissection of living people, gas experiments, microbiological experiments, pressure experiments, and so on.. And now there are still many radioactive devices buried on the land of the three northeastern provinces of China. The site exhibition hall is divided into an indoor exhibition hall and an outdoor site. The indoor exhibition hall is the headquarters building of the 731 Army. On the walls on both sides of the central corridor of the building, there are nearly 3000 names of people who were victims of microbial experiments and microbial warfare. These names are well documented, including Chinese, Soviet, Mongolian and Korean. Among them, 1467 people were brutally killed by being transported through this corridor to the "special prison" through the "special transfer" method, and the remaining more than 1000 people were mostly victims of the Southern Microbial War. On the eve of Japan's surrender in 1945, when the 731 troops were defeated and fled, they did not forget to continue to maim the Chinese people. They released mice infected with pestis bacteria, which led to the pestis in the cottage area in 1946, and a large number of local residents died of this disaster. In order to cover up the crimes of Unit 731, most of the buildings here were destroyed during their escape, forming the current pattern of the ruins. Unit 731 is the largest microbial warfare unit in the history of world wars, and it is known as one of the world's two great killing dens, along with Auschwitz concentration camp, for annihilating humanity. What is displayed here is not only the heinous crimes of the Japanese aggressors, but also a warning to the Chinese not to forget the national humiliation. Full text 
