attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 断桥残雪
attractions.summary:
It is the meeting place of Xu Xian and White Lady in The Legend of the New White Lady, which adds a lot of romantic color to this long bridge. 
At the beginning of winter snow, the snow and ice on the sunny side of the bridge melt, but the shady side is still covered with residual snow. From a height, the bridge seems to be broken but not broken, forming the famous "broken bridge with residual snow". 
It can be used as the starting point for visiting the West Lake, from Baidi on the Broken Bridge to Gushan, and then visit various scenic spots around the West Lake in turn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Xu Xian and White Snake met on the broken bridge

attractions.name: 曲院风荷
attractions.name_en: Quyuan Fenghe (Lotus in the Breeze at Crooked Courtyard)
attractions.summary:
One of the ten scenic spots of the West Lake, hundreds of varieties of lotus flowers are cultivated in Fenghe Park, where it is located, which is particularly attractive in summer. 
In the Southern Song Dynasty, there was a wine-making workshop here, which took streams to make koji wine. Whenever the wind blows in summer, the fragrance of wine and lotus is refreshing, so it is called "Quyuan Fenghe".  
· Lotus leaves and fields are enchanting, and small bridges of different shapes are erected on the water. People cross the bridges, like walking in the lotus flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lotus flowers are different red in summer

attractions.name: 杭州西湖观荷区
attractions.summary: The West Lake Lotus Viewing Area in Hangzhou is a famous scenic spot within the West Lake Scenic Area, known for its summer blooming lotus flowers. This is one of the best places to admire lotus flowers, where tourists can enjoy various varieties of lotus flowers and experience the natural beauty and peaceful atmosphere of West Lake.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 乌龟潭
attractions.summary:
Come out from the side of Yanggong Embankment and go north. After crossing Jingxing Bridge, you can see the lake area connected to the West Lake on the west side, which is Wugui Pond. It is named after a hill in the pool that looks like a turtle from a high place (such as Santai Pavilion). The scenery here is beautiful and quiet, with open water surface, natural revetment, surrounding natural mountains immersed in water, and a wide variety of aquatic wet plants, woody flowering plants and berry plants in the middle and middle layers, forming a rich landscape level. Small islands stand in the water and are connected with the waterfront by garden bridges and pavilion bridges. No matter how crowded Su Causeway and Bai Causeway are, it is still quiet here, with few tourists. 
Guitan is one of the places with the longest cherry blossoms in Hangzhou. Everyone's favorite "Three Heroes of Late Cherry Blossoms" will be the finale of the whole cherry blossom season in Hangzhou.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display the historical, natural and ecological landscape of West Lake

attractions.name: 城市阳台
attractions.summary: Hangzhou City Balcony is located in the core area of Qianjiang New Town. There are three city balconies, one main and two auxiliary balconies. Each balcony is an open and vibrant modern city park, which integrates various functions such as leisure, tide watching, recreation and relaxation. The main balcony is located on the central axis of the core area, with the Qiantang River embankment as the bottom line and tens of meters away from the river surface. It is about 322 meters long. Most of it is overhead on the river surface, and the farthest point protrudes from the river embankment for about 80 meters. The whole balcony is divided into upper and lower floors, and the building area of the first floor alone is 24,000 square meters.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the night view and watch the light show. Excellent observation platform

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 龙门古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for stroller walks; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary: Longmen Ancient Town is a national 4A-level tourist attraction, located on the beautiful southern bank of the Fuchun River. The town boasts a picturesque environment. Over 90% of the residents have the surname Sun, making it the largest settlement of descendants of Sun Quan, the Emperor of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period. The town has a rich historical and cultural heritage, retaining a strong clan atmosphere and unique local customs. The ancient town's layout is complex, with a defensive, fan-shaped network of streets and alleys as its framework. The clan halls and courtyards are connected, and the alleys interlink, creating a maze-like traditional residential settlement. It is the most complete and rare example of ancient Ming and Qing architectural clusters in the rural countryside of southern Jiangnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie *Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains*

attractions.name: 小河直街历史文化街区
attractions.name_en: Xiaohe Straight Street Historical and Cultural Block
attractions.summary:
· Xiaohezhijie Historic District is located at the intersection of Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, Xiaohe and Yuhangtang River. 
Original old houses, rarely renovated, still have many "old Hangzhou" living today, with a strong flavor of life. 
It is recommended to go to Fang Zengchang Sauce Garden, No.15 Xiaohezhi Street, and take a photo with the word "sauce". It is said that it used to be the largest pickle factory in Xiaohe area. 
There are many cafes, tea bars, mahjong shops and noodle shops along the way. Find a small tea shop opened by local residents, and visit the quaint courtyard along the way.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historical relics such as workshops and shops are retained

attractions.name: 九溪十八涧
attractions.summary: Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams are located in the mountains west of West Lake, winding seven kilometers from Longjing into Qiantang River. The scenery of Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams is natural, with little craftsmanship. Every tourist who has visited here likes the peaceful and pleasant scenery.

attractions.name: 龙井村
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Longjing Village is located in the southwest of West Lake Scenic Area, surrounded by mountains on all sides, showing a trend of high in the north and low in the south. It has nearly 800 mu of alpine tea gardens. 
The northwest peak, Lion Peak and Tianzhu Peak in the northwest of the village form a natural barrier to block the cold wind from the northwest. There is Jiuxi in the south, and the valley is deep and wide, which leads directly to Qiantang River. The southeast wind in spring and summer is easy to enter the valley. The geographical conditions of ventilation and ventilation provide unique advantages for the growth of Longjing tea. Longjing tea produced here ranks first among "lion, dragon, cloud and tiger". 
· According to legend, when Emperor Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River, he went to Hugong Temple at the foot of Shifeng Mountain in Longjing Village to taste West Lake Longjing tea. After drinking, he was full of praise, and named the eighteen tea trees in front of the temple "Imperial Tea". Longjing Village, the "first village in tea township", is famous for its abundance of top-class West Lake Longjing tea. 
It is bordered by Xizi Lake in the east, Wuyun Mountain in the west, Qiantang River in the south, and the north and south peaks inserted into the clouds in the north. It is surrounded by green mountains and clouds, just like an emerald gemstone inlaid on the shores of Xizi Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: "The First Village of Tea Township"

attractions.name: 龙井茶田
attractions.summary: Located at the western foothills of Wengjia Mountain, west of West Lake. Longjing was originally named Longhong, and during the Jin Dynasty, Ge Hong practiced alchemy here. Longjing is a circular spring pool that never dries up in severe drought. Ancient people believed that this spring was connected to the sea and contained dragons, hence the name Longjing. About 500 meters away from Longjing, there is Longjing Temple in Luohuiwu, commonly known as Old Longjing. It was founded in the Later Han Dynasty of the Five Dynasties and was originally named Baoguo Kanjingyuan. During the Northern Song Dynasty, it was renamed Shoushengyuan. During the Southern Song Dynasty, it was renamed Guangfuyuan and Yan'en Yanqing Temple. In the third year of the Ming Dynasty's Zhengtong reign (1438), it was relocated to Jingpan, and now the temple has been abandoned and is secluded as a tea room. The water of Longjing Spring is composed of two parts: groundwater and surface water. The proportion of groundwater is relatively high, so groundwater is below and surface water is above. If a rod is used to stir the spring water in the well, the spring water below will flip to the surface. Forming a circle of dividing water lines, when the underground spring water sinks again, the dividing water lines gradually shrink until they disappear, which is very interesting.

attractions.name: 满觉陇
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn flowers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Juelong, also known as Manlong and Manjialong, is located in the south of the West Lake in Hangzhou, a valley at the southern foot of the southern peak. In the fourth year of Tianfu in the later Jin Dynasty (AD 939), Yuanxing Courtyard was built, and in the second year of Zhiping in the Northern Song Dynasty (AD 1065), it was changed to Manjue Courtyard. Manjue means "perfect consciousness", and the place was named after the temple. 
Juelong is famous for its sweet-scented osmanthus. Every autumn, sweet-scented osmanthus blooms, the fragrance fills the empty mountains, and falls like rain, so it has the reputation of "Manlong Guiyu". In 1985, "Manlong Guiyu" was rated as one of the ten scenic spots of the New West Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Longguiyu, you can have a panoramic view of the tea garden scenery

attractions.name: 漓江风景名胜区
attractions.summary: There is an article in primary school Chinese textbooks that says' Guilin's scenery is the best in the world ', which refers to visiting the Li River. The mountains on both sides of the Lijiang River are tall and straight, with thousands of shapes. They are the essence of Guilin scenery. The Li River, a hundred mile gallery ", each scenery is a typical Chinese ink painting. The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. The main ways to visit the Li River in general include taking boats, bamboo rafts, and hiking, including three-star and four-star boat tours, bamboo raft tours, and large boat tours in Xingping Fishing Village.

attractions.name: 漓江四星游船
attractions.summary: The basic situation of the cruise ship is that the Li River cruise ship has been upgraded and upgraded. Taking into account the tourist experience and psychological expectations, strict regulations have been made for the per capita cabin area, passenger seat specifications, cabin dining table specifications, and per capita area of the walking deck of the upgraded cruise ship. In addition, fabric soft wrapped sofas are used, which greatly improve comfort and aesthetics compared to ordinary cruise ships. And high material standards are required for the decoration and renovation of the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. of the cruise ship, and clear regulations are made for the replacement period of curtains, tablecloths, and other decorations, creating a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. The sanitary facilities are fully equipped with advanced technology, and the humanized detail design is comprehensive. The four-star cruise ship has a double decker cabin layout and decoration, with the first floor being a business cabin (second-class), and the per capita area in the tourist cabin not less than 1.8 square meters; The second floor is a luxury business cabin (first-class cabin), with a per capita area of no less than 2.5 square meters in the tourist cabin; The ship is equipped with a double deck walking deck with a wide view and a per capita area of not less than 1.4 square meters. The deck is equipped with sunshades and resting tables and chairs; There are 1.2m high aluminum alloy safety guardrails around. The cabin floor is made of high wear-resistant wood flooring and high-end carpets, while the ceiling and wall panels are made of wood and honeycomb aluminum plate materials, with exquisite craftsmanship. The cabin decoration is beautiful and elegant, reflecting cultural connotations or ethnic characteristics, decorated with flowers and green plants. The cabin dining table is made of elm wood and water chestnut materials, with carved decorations. The tourist seats are designed with armrests, which are comfortable and stylish. The double decker cabin provides both Chinese and Western style buffet meals or customized special dining options for tourists. The tableware and tea utensils are made of high-quality ceramic materials and are equipped with matching tableware for both Chinese and Western cuisine. There are also mini bars to meet the entertainment needs of different tourists. Each row of seats or table is equipped with a tablet computer near the window sill, which can provide a series of intelligent services such as Guilin tourism information, entertainment, and ordering. Full text 

attractions.name: 九马画山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 黄布倒影
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
attractions.shortFeatures: Background map of 20 yuan RMB

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 阳朔月亮山风景区
attractions.summary: Moon Mountain is a unique scenery within Yangshuo, located at the end of the Ten Mile Gallery landscape belt. Moon Mountain is an arched peak with a large hole running through it below the top, resembling a bright moon that blends seamlessly with nature. Looking at this Moon Mountain from different angles, the shape of this cave constantly changes, which is very interesting. Moon Mountain is about 380 meters high, and visitors can follow an 800 level hiking trail to reach the Moon Cave at the top of the mountain. The Moon Cave has a large area, with a height and width of 50 meters each, while the mountain walls are only a few meters thick. The top of the cave is covered with stalactites of various shapes, two of which resemble Wu Gang and Jade Rabbit in the Moon Palace. In fact, Moon Mountain can be admired from a distance. Across from the scenic area, there is a rest area with a gathering of restaurants, which is one of the locations where you can view Moon Mountain from afar. Due to its unique geological environment, Moon Mountain has also become a gathering place for rock climbing enthusiasts.

attractions.name: 大榕树
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Ancient Trees
attractions.summary:
It is famous for a thousand-year-old banyan tree that grows here. It looks like a giant umbrella from a distance and is an important part of Lijiang Scenic Area. 
· The big banyan tree is about 17 meters high and dated back about 1,500 years. It is intertwined and forms a forest alone, like a huge mushroom cloud rising from the ground. 
What made her famous was that Sister Liu threw a love hydrangea at Brother A Niu under the tree, where the movie Sister Liu was shot. 
· The Jinbao River flows slowly in front of the ancient banyan tree, and the river is intercepted by the dam. When the tide is high, the water rolls on the dam surface, and when the tide is low, you can run up and play in the water.
attractions.shortFeatures: Location of the movie "Sister Liu"

attractions.name: 天籁·蝴蝶泉
attractions.summary: Tianlai Butterfly Spring is a scenic spot located along the Ten Mile Gallery, only three or four kilometers away from Yangshuo County and Moon Mountain. It is also a popular destination for many tourist groups. The interesting part of the scenic area is the song and dance performances of the Miao and Dong ethnic groups, and there is also a small-scale cave that can be visited. A huge butterfly sculpture can be seen on the stone wall from a distance outside the entrance of the scenic area, which is also the symbol of the scenic area. There is a small karst cave in the scenic area, where there is a stalactite that looks like a butterfly and has spring water flowing out, hence it is called Butterfly Spring. However, here you can't see large groups of wild butterflies dancing gracefully. Instead, you can see a butterfly exhibition. The photos taken from the Ten Mile Gallery observation deck have a great perspective, and the suspension bridge and slide in the mountains are popular among children. Visiting caves and climbing mountains doesn't take too long, and after descending the mountain, you can directly go to watch performances. Compared to natural landscapes, the ethnic song and dance performances here are more exciting, with displays of Zhunzhai flowers, golden flowers, and hall masters, which can give people a strong sense of ethnic customs. After the performance, you can also go take photos with the actors, but there will be a certain fee for taking photos. There is an area at the foot of the scenic area that sells ethnic souvenirs. If you are interested, you can also purchase some to give back to your friends and family.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 太平天国历史博物馆(瞻园)
attractions.name_en: The Historical Museum of The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
attractions.tag: Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Zhanyuan, also known as the Great Ming Palace or the First Garden of Jinling, was first built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty. It was originally the palace of Xu Da, a founding hero of the Ming Dynasty. It is a long-standing garden in Nanjing and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Wuxi Jichang Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. Historical background: Zhanyuan has a history of over 600 years. The layout of the whole garden is elegant and exquisite, including ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Taihu Lake Lake stones of the Northern Song Dynasty, quiet buildings, pavilions, rockeries, etc. During Emperor Qianlong's southern tour, he visited here twice and borrowed the imperial name of the garden from Ouyang Xiu's poem "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky". He personally inscribed the plaque "Viewing the Garden". During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, it was still the residence of the Eastern King Yang Xiuqing and the Young Western King Xiao Youhe. Dongzhan Garden is divided into two parts, east and west. The main gate (south gate) is located in the east half, with a large plaque hanging on the gate reading "Jinling First Garden". In the center of the entrance is a half body bronze statue of Hong Xiuquan. The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom History Museum is the main visiting point of Dongzhan Garden, displaying cultural relics such as the Jade Seal of the Heavenly Father, the Golden Crown of the Loyal King, the Great Flag, the Sword, and the Stone Trough. Xizhan Garden can be reached through Shuiyuan, which is a typical Jiangnan garden. The ancient buildings in the park include the Viewing Pavilion, Flower Basket Hall, Zhishuang Pavilion, Yingcui Pavilion, and winding corridors. These buildings and corridors divide the Xizhan Garden into five small courtyards and a main garden, with rockeries being the main scenery and backbone of the entire garden. There are rockeries in the south, north, and west, each exquisitely crafted. The central part of the main garden is Jingmiao Hall, surrounded by water on three sides and by land on one side. The "Tiger" stone tablet on the right wall at the entrance of the Guanyu Pavilion is said to have been bestowed upon the tiger general Xu Da by Zhu Yuanzhang. It stands upright like a tiger, howling loudly in the sky. Upon closer examination, one can discern the four characters "the richest in the world", making it the "number one tiger in the world". The copper pavilion and the other miracle in the the Taihu Lake Shizhan Garden, the copper pavilion (namely the fan pavilion), are the world's earlier heating equipment (equivalent to air conditioning buildings). In addition, there are also two the Taihu Lake Lake stones in the garden. The Immortal Peak is in the garden behind the south gate, and it stands in a beautiful place; Leaning against the cloud peak in the southeast corner of the flower basket hall, amidst the osmanthus bushes, it stands out with a sudden and graceful charm. Full text 

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 明城墙公园
attractions.summary: The Ming City Wall Park covers a wide area, with lush trees and a beautiful environment. The Ming City Wall in the park is quite famous, with a total length of more than 20 kilometers. It was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty and has a long history.

attractions.name: 中山码头
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Port is located on the south bank of the Yangtze River in Nanjing, also known as Xiaguan Port. Before the opening of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge in the past, people used to take ferries across the river through Zhongshan Pier, with Pukou Railway Station (Nanjing North Station) on the opposite bank. Transportation at the pier was extremely busy. Until the opening of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge and the closure of Pukou Railway Station, only some locals still take ferries at Zhongshan Pier. However, due to the strong Republican style of Zhongshan Pier and Pukou Railway Station, it has attracted many literary and artistic youth and photography enthusiasts to come here for photos and nostalgia. Its tourism significance is gradually outweighing its transportation role. The "Ningpu Line" ferry still operates from Zhongshan Port to Pukou Port today. From 5:00 to 23:00, the ferry departs every 20 minutes, with a 15 minute one-way fare of 2 yuan. Pukou Port is adjacent to Pukou Railway Station. Take a ferry and take a look at the old railway station. Here, you can embark on a nostalgic journey of the Republic of China.

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 宜兴窑湖小镇
attractions.summary: Yaohu Town is located in Yixing, Jiangsu, which was formerly known as Yangxian. When the great literary figure Su Dongpo visited Yixing, he found spiritual resonance and a spiritual home in the mountains and waters of Yangxian, and left behind the excellent poem "Yangxian Tie", expressing his desire to buy farmland and retire in Yangxian from the beginning, saying "I will grow old in Yangxian, only for the good of the mountains and rivers. Yaohu Town is based on local cultural elements such as mountains, water, pottery, bamboo, and tea. It is a diversified town that integrates ecological nature and traditional culture. Its uniqueness lies in creating an immersive all encompassing scene that combines activities and performances, shaping a unique experience that combines intangible cultural heritage handicrafts with Zen lifestyle aesthetics. In addition, Yaohu Town is also a vacation tourism destination that combines themed vacations with exhibition activities. Its rich tourism formats and differentiated products provide tourists with high-quality, pure ecological, full-time, and diverse experiences and services. Here, tourists can personally experience the poetic life of the beauty of nature, culture, and life.

attractions.name: 宜兴竹海
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; treasure spot for kids.; Forests
attractions.summary:
- The Yixing Bamboo Sea Scenic Area is located in Hufu Town, Yixing, covering nearly 15,000 hectares of bamboo forest that rises and falls with the terrain. The bamboo sways with the mountains, resembling rolling waves that stretch endlessly.
- The scenic area is known for its clear mountains and waters, where the four seasons can be experienced in a single day, offering natural wonders and delights. Major attractions include "The First Source of Taihu Lake," "The First Peak of Southern Jiangsu," "Bamboo Brings Peace," and "The Mirror Lake Scenic View."
- This place is a natural oxygen bar and an excellent location for film and TV shooting. It has been used in the production of notable works such as *Romance of the Three Kingdoms*, *The Flying Hero White Dragon*, and *The Founding of the Song Dynasty*.
- Visitors can now take a cable car to the mountain top, where they can enjoy a panoramic aerial view of the bamboo sea. If the wind is strong, one can experience the magnificent and tumultuous waves of the bamboo forest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the Bamboo Sea and enjoy a cool summer.

attractions.name: 陶祖圣境
attractions.tag: Get closer to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Geological Sites; Caves
attractions.summary:
The Tao Zu Sheng Jing is located in Jintang Mountain in the city of Yixing. It was expanded from the original Muli Cave and is adjacent to famous scenic areas such as the Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Xishi Cave, and Panshan Temple.  
The three main attractions within the scenic area are the stalactites of Muli Cave, the bamboo forests covering the mountains, and the pottery-making at Fan Li's pottery workshop. In addition, there are cultural sites related to the love story between Fan Li and Xishi.  
To enter the scenic area, visitors need to travel by waterway. The entire area is not large, and the tour takes about two hours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the Stalactites in Various Shapes

attractions.name: 蜀山古南街
attractions.summary: Shushan Ancient South Street is located in Dingshu Town, Yixing City, with the Lihe River to the south and Shushan Mountain to the north. The street is thousands of kilometers long and only three to four meters wide. The buildings on the street are all two-story brick and wood structures. The natural balance of the street scenery continues day after day, telling the story of the old street being as wet as a gentle rain in the south of the Yangtze River. A vegetable picking woman sitting against the door, an old man playing chess shirtless with a hand cranked fan, a strong man holding a purple clay pot, a small dog wagging its tail and walking on the street corner, a mahjong player playing in the dim light; These scenes create a typical ancient street in Jiangnan during the Ming and Qing dynasties, flowing with the poetic charm of Taodu along the Li River that runs through the ancient town of Taodu. As one of the first batch of ancient architectural protection units in Jiangsu Province and a cultural relic protection unit in Yixing City, Shushan Old Street Hutong is said to have been a bustling "purple clay street" in the past. More than half of the residents here are engaged in the production and operation of purple clay. They use their own houses, with the back house serving as a production workshop and the front house facing the street displaying goods and setting up shops for operation. There are over thirty purple clay pottery shops in the entire old street, indicating the prosperity of the purple clay industry at that time. In addition to pottery shops, the old street also has tea houses, cloth shops, hardware stores, and small department stores, all centered around the family. They live a peaceful and self-sufficient life without discrimination between the elderly and the young. The Li River next to the old street is filled with wooden boats of all sizes, including fishermen, rural farmers transporting vegetables, and more importantly, ceramic product transport ships. Through this river, ceramics from the south street are transported to all directions.

attractions.name: 中国宜兴陶瓷博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary: The Yixing Ceramic Museum is the earliest established professional ceramic museum in China, founded by the first director, Shi Shunhua, and has a history of nearly fifty years. The museum complex is built on the mountainside, with magnificent architecture, integrating exhibitions, research, displays, tourism, shopping, and academic exchanges in ceramics. It houses treasures from various periods, including works by famous Yixing clay artists and an exhibition of the "Five Golden Flowers," both of which are highly recommended. The museum's admission fee is 20 yuan, and the best part is that parking nearby is free of charge.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate various precious ceramic products.

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 乌衣巷
attractions.summary:
Wuyi Lane is located in the south of Confucius Temple. During the Three Kingdoms, it was the location of Wu Guomao's army barracks guarding Stone City. 
· At that time, all the sergeants were wearing black uniforms, so the alley name was "Wuyi". 
Scholars and tourists are constantly visiting, and it has become a resort to pay tribute to the famous appearances of the Eastern Jin Dynasty and express their nostalgia for the past. 
At present, it is a narrow street, and the paved houses on both sides are folk handicraft shops.
attractions.shortFeatures: A famous lane where talented people come forth in large numbers and literati praise

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.
