It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

restaurants.name_en: The emperor is big when eating

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 无锡古运河
attractions.summary: The Qingmingqiao Ancient Canal Scenic Area is located in the center of Wuxi city, with antique water town buildings and real old houses forming a block. There are attractions to visit, as well as bars and restaurants. The night view is more beautiful than the day view. The houses with pink walls and black tiles are lit up, and strings of red lanterns are reflected in the canal, attracting countless long guns and short cannons. Sitting on a cruise ship, from the Nanchan Temple Pier to the Kuatang Bridge, one can see fashionable antique style buildings in the Yangchun Lane commercial district. From the Tangqiao Bridge to the Qingming Bridge is the essence part, known as "Jiangnan Water Alley, the canal is out of print". Seeing the memorial archway of "Canal Ancient Town" on the right bank means entering the real historical block transformed from old houses. Along the way, many beautiful people and small terraces can be found near the water. After passing Dagong Bridge, there is the China Silk Industry Museum on the right bank, and after passing Qingming Bridge, there is the Wuxi Kiln Site Museum on the left bank. Then go ahead to the Narcissus Taoist Temple, and see the memorial archway of "Tang Tree Leaves Shadows", which means the end of the block. It is recommended to take a cruise to the foot of Shuixian Road Courtyard and then walk back to Nanchan Temple Pier. Along the way, you can visit attractions such as Shuixian Road Courtyard, Canal Culture and Art Museum, Kanggong Salvation Society, and China Silk Industry Museum. If interested, you can also turn to Yangchun Lane for a stroll. If you are tired, you can take an electric scooter between Kuatang Bridge and Qingming Bridge, with a fare of 5 yuan.

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 灵山大佛
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue

attractions.name: 九龙灌浴
attractions.summary:
Kowloon Bath, located in the square of Lingshan Giant Buddha, is the largest musical dynamic bronze sculpture group in China, telling the story of Sakyamuni's birth. 
· This is a major landscape of Lingshan Scenic Spot. With the accompaniment of music, the opening and closing of lotus flowers, and the Prince Buddha slowly rises from it, it rotates around in the water curtain formed by the water spray of Jiulong. 
· There are five performances a day. After the performances, the dragon mouth around the square will spray merit water, which visitors can take away; If you want to watch the bathing show in Kowloon, you can choose a location in advance.
attractions.shortFeatures: Giant bronze sculpture of lotus in bud

attractions.name: 灵山梵宫
attractions.summary:
After visiting the main hall of the Brahma Palace, go directly to the second floor, and walk straight to the entrance of the Treasure Hall. 
The four beauties in ancient China, adult fish, falling geese, closed moon and ashamed flowers, were very exquisite. Their clothes were very realistic, and the shape of their cuffs was very thin. This kind of art was perfect. 
There are many works of Patriarch Bodhidharma. There is a large statue of Patriarch Bodhidharma erected in the center, with a red gourd on the back, a pool around it, and many works around it are exquisite treasures ~
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent Buddhist palace

attractions.name: 五印坛城
attractions.summary:
--Wuyin Mandala City stands in the rippling sea of perfume, complementing Lingshan Brahma Palace and Manfeilong Pagoda. It is a unique and authentic Tibetan cultural landscape. 
--What is displayed here is the Tibetan Buddhist culture. Although it is not as magnificent as the Brahma Palace, it is also extremely gorgeous. The mandala is dedicated to five Buddhas in five directions, and its appearance is solemn and brilliant. 
--Walking into the mandala, visitors can not only appreciate all kinds of Buddhist cultural and artistic treasures from all over Tibet, but also participate in interactive folk activities such as lighting butter lamps and pushing Mani sutra tubes.

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 香月花街
attractions.summary: Xiangyuehua Street is the Zen theme street of Nianhuawan. It is the core area of leisure and holiday life in Nianhuawan, and it is also the most humanistic block at present. The architecture here is dominated by Tang style and Song rhyme, which is simple and elegant. There are also a dazzling array of cultural and creative product shops and special experience workshops, as well as shops with various themed restaurants, creative food and local snacks, and Zen-themed inns with different styles and themes. Here, you can find the most comfortable and pleasant Zen life experience to meet your needs of physical and mental vacation relaxation.
attractions.shortFeatures: The architecture is mainly Tang style and Song rhyme

attractions.name: 梵天花海
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay "Brahma Flower Sea" is backed by mountains, and there is a clear river flowing in the sea of flowers. There is an elegant and vast sea of auspicious flowers here, which smudges Zen in time. Bright yellow sulfur chrysanthemum, pink zinnia, delicate drunken butterfly flower, one color flower, blindly Zen, interpret beauty and contain goodness. Flowers bloom all over the mountains, swaying gently, time is quiet and happiness is full.
attractions.shortFeatures: A sea of colorful flowers can be seen during flowering period

attractions.name: 鹿鸣谷
attractions.summary: Luming Valley is a narrow valley in the northeasternmost part of Nianhua Bay, a Zen town. It is the first petal of the "five petals" in the "Eight Views of Lotus". The trees here are towering, quiet and quiet, and it is a natural landscape with deep flowers and trees in Zen rooms. The name of Luming Valley is due to a thousand-year-old story. It is said that when the Tang monk came back from the Buddha's scriptures, he passed by here, and released two sacred deer brought back from the Luyeyuan of Buddha in Tianzhu Kingdom into the mountain forest. Up to now, there is a clear pool called "Lumian Pond" deep in the mountain bay. The Zen life here is therefore vividly called "Ming Sleeping Zen". There is Luming Tea House in Luming Valley, which is used to receive high-end tea parties or customized meditation activities of private and enterprises.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a retreat meditation temple

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 南头古城
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
attractions.summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 东涌沙滩
attractions.summary: The beach sand in Tung Chung is very fine, the coastline is short, and the seawater is very blue. The beach has a large area, and other parts of the beach are covered with rocks, making it a paradise for many hiking enthusiasts. The Dongxichong coastline is a "relatively beautiful and classic coastline hiking route" in Shenzhen, with a long coastline of Ping Shan and the sea, and mountains crisscrossing and stretching. It has a super beautiful sea view, allowing you to enjoy the blue sea and sky while hiking. If you walk from east to west, half of the mountain road and half of the coastline are fast, it will take more than 2 hours to complete, but the general travel time is within 5 hours.

attractions.name: 海河游船
attractions.summary: Haihe Sightseeing Boat gathers the essence of Tianjin tourism. Along the way, you can not only feel the changes of Tianjin era, but also appreciate the modern buildings of modern cities. A Haihe River has summarized the history of Tianjin. As the saying goes, only with the Haihe River can there be the history and prosperity of Tianjin, and the prosperity of Haihe River leads to the prosperity of Tianjin. In the Haihe River sightseeing cruise route, what attracts people's attention are the distinctive bridges, which are the pride of Tianjin's urban style. The Yongle Bridge, which integrates with the huge Ferris wheel "Tianjin Eye", the Jiefang Bridge, one of Tianjin's iconic buildings, and the Lion Grove, which has a variety of stone lions. While getting close to these bridges by boat, taking the Haihe River cruise can also enjoy the "Nine Bridges and Thirteen Scenic Spots" along the Haihe River, such as the Dabeiyuan commercial area, the historic Tianjin Station, and the Italian style street that combines Chinese and Western styles.

attractions.name: 杨柳青古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
This famous historical town in northern China has a thousand-year-old cultural heritage. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, Yangliuqing was the distribution center of folk art in northern China, which gave birth to wonderful folk art works such as Yangliuqing New Year pictures, the first of the four woodcut New Year pictures in China, Yangliuqing kites and paper-cutting, which are well-known in Tianjin and Beijing. Ancient Painting Society is also the only folk art exhibition hall of New Year pictures in Yangliuqing, where visitors can appreciate the evolution of Yangliuqing New Year pictures, the treasures of Yangliuqing New Year pictures in past dynasties and experience the whole production process of traditional New Year pictures. 
The old theater, memorial archway and Wenchang Pavilion in the town, which are called the three treasures of Yangliuqing. Now only Wenchang Pavilion still exists; In addition, there are Puliang Pagoda, Baoen Temple and Baitan Temple sites in Qing Dynasty. There are also nearby scenic spots such as Shijia Courtyard, one of the "Eight Great Masters" in Tianjin, Tianjin Tropical Plant Sightseeing Park, a national 4A-level scenic spot, and the exhibition hall of the former site of Tianjin Front Command of Pingjin Campaign, a national scenic spot. 
After visiting Yangliuqing Town, you must try the siomai in Majiaguan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical towns in northern China

attractions.name: 杨柳青如意大街
attractions.summary: This is a bustling street filled with various small shops and stalls. There are many lanterns during festivals, which are suitable for taking children to explore. There are also many jewelry, gourds, ornaments, walnuts, handicrafts, etc. here. There is also a cultural center and the Shijia Courtyard nearby.

attractions.name: 杨柳青民俗文化馆
attractions.summary: The Tianjin Yangliuqing Folk Culture Museum showcases the historical and cultural characteristics of Yangliuqing Ancient Town, inheriting the essence of traditional Chinese culture. The exhibition of Yangliuqing Folk Culture Museum takes the perspective of canal culture as the entry point, with Yangliuqing woodblock New Year paintings as the main line. The unique canal culture and rushing camp culture of Yangliuqing are interwoven, reflecting the folk history and culture accumulated in the ancient town for thousands of years. The exhibition hall utilizes a large number of old objects, photos, paintings and other physical objects from folk production and life, providing viewers with visual and spiritual cultural enjoyment, fully showcasing the prosperity of traditional Chinese folk culture represented by New Year's painting culture, courtyard culture, canal culture, folk culture, etc.

attractions.name: 石家大院
attractions.summary: The Shijia Courtyard is located in the center of Yangliuqing Town, a millennium old ancient town. It was originally the residence of Shi Yuanshi, one of the Eight Great Masters of Jinmen in the late Qing Dynasty. The house was named "Zunmei Hall" and is commonly known as the "Shijia Courtyard" by the public. The Shijia Mansion was first built in the early years of the Guangxu reign (1875). It is a large Qing Dynasty residential building with a history of over 140 years, covering an area of 7500 square meters and a building area of 3552 square meters. The entire building complex consists of 18 courtyards, with a typical four in one layout, courtyards within courtyards, clear axis lines, and grand and imposing style. Its brick, wood, and stone carvings are exquisitely lifelike and symbolize good luck, while the theater in the courtyard is a well preserved and large-scale enclosed residential theater in China. The Shijia Mansion was once known as the "First Residence in North China" and the "First Residence in Tianjin".

attractions.name: 石家大院-花厅
attractions.summary: The Shijia Courtyard is located in Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and is a well preserved group of Qing Dynasty residential buildings. The Flower Hall is a part of the Shijia Grand Courtyard, renowned for its exquisite wood, brick, and stone carving art, showcasing the unique charm of Qing Dynasty architecture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 大沽口炮台遗址
attractions.tag: Historical site; Military Sites; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
In modern Chinese history, the Dagu Fort has become an important maritime defense barrier in China, often referred to as "Humen in the South, Dagu in the North."  
In the Boxer Protocol signed in 1901, the Qing government was forced to demolish the Dagu Fort. The two well-preserved sites are the "Wei" character South Fort and the "Hai" character Old Fort.  
It is now rated as one of the "Ten Scenic Spots of Tianjin" and designated as a patriotic education base in Tianjin.  
Adjacent to the Dagu Mouth are the Haimen Bridge and Dagu Lighthouse. During the day, visitors can explore the fort ruins and take speedboats out to sea; at night, they can enjoy the sight of the countless colorful lights on the bridge.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Old Fort at the Mouth of the Haihe River

attractions.name: 大沽口炮台遗址纪念碑
小站练兵园
attractions.summary: In the late Qing Dynasty, the new policy was reformed and the new army was trained. The Tianjin Small Station Training Park was the location of the "new army" military academy in history. Yuan Shikai once supervised the training of the "New Army" here. After the Sino Japanese War, the small station training park built a city wall, a military academy, a barracks, Yuan Shikai's Xingyuan and the New Army's training supervision office, as well as a small station training history museum, a military museum, a cinema, and a shopping street. In addition, there are supporting facilities such as a tourist service center and a tourist rest area, making it a story themed historical and cultural tourism area that combines education, leisure, shopping, and conference functions. The exhibition hall displays various cold and hot weapons, military clothing, and military supplies. The exhibits include ancient Chinese cold weapons, modern hot weapons, military clothing and supplies from different periods, and tens of thousands of precious photos, which have become prominent features of the exhibition hall of Tianjin Xiaozhan Military Training Park.

attractions.name: 天津小站练兵历史人物馆
attractions.summary: The Tianjin Xiaozhan Military Training Historical Figures Museum has exhibition halls and screening halls, where people can learn about the background and history of Xiaozhan's military training.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 静园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
Jingyuan, which combines Spanish and Japanese styles, is a typical representative of courtyard-style private mansion in Tianjin Concession period. 
It used to be the residence of Lu Zongyu, the minister of Beiyang government in Japan. Later, the last emperor Puyi lived here with Queen Wanrong and Shu Fei Wenxiu. 
· The noise of the city center is blocked out, only bursts of birdsong, which is very leisurely and suitable for tourists who like history and architecture to meditate and travel slowly. 
Reed flowers bloom in late autumn (October-December) every year, which is an excellent season to watch reed flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of the last emperor Puyi

restaurants.name_en: Haihe Holiday Hotel Haihe Xuan Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 如意峰索道景区
attractions.summary: 1、 Basic information: Yangshuo Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area is a high-altitude tourism and leisure project jointly invested and built by Shaanxi Junjing Cableway Investment and Construction Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shaanxi Tourism Group, and Guilin Ruisheng Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The total investment of the project is 260 million yuan. The scenic area is located in Meng Village, Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, adjacent to National Highway 321, 5km away from the Gaotian entrance and exit of Baomao (Guiwu) Expressway, and about 5km away from core scenic areas such as Yulong River, Moon Mountain, Shili Gallery in Yangshuo and Yinziyan Scenic Area in Lipu. 2、 Project Construction The project will build Yangshuo Mountain Top Natural Park, which is composed of the natural karst natural landscape "three peaks and two valleys" (Yuanbao Peak, Ruyi Peak, Xianglian Peak, Caixi Valley, Baihua Valley), cableway, Ruyi Cloud Top Viewing Platform, Ruyi Cable Bridge, Walk in the Forest, glass walkway Road, Digital Experience Hall and other creative landscapes. Tourists can overlook the unique karst peak forest landscape in Yangshuo from a high altitude in all directions, walk through the forest, watch the landscape of Guilin, and experience the fun of walking in the forest! The Ruyi Peak Cableway has a total length of 2012 meters. The lower station of the cableway is located in Xingtianle International Tourism Resort, and the upper station leads directly to Yuanbao Peak. The vertical height difference is 242 meters, and the one-way capacity can reach 2000 people/hour, with a speed of 0.5-6 meters/second (adjustable). The cableway has introduced equipment from POMA company in France, which is a single line cyclic unhooking gripper 8-person hanging box cableway. The overall operation and safety system adopts advanced passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 3、 Since its opening on January 6, 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area has been operating in good condition. During the operation period, the goal of zero occurrence of safety production responsibility accidents was achieved, with no major tourist complaints or incidents of malfunctioning parking, and no occurrence of fire and other personal injury safety accidents. In November 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the honor of "Top Ten Scenic Spots of Guilin City" by the Guilin Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism. On December 24, 2021, it was rated as a "Contract abiding and Creditworthy" public enterprise in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region for the year 2020 by the Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. On December 28, 2021, Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the certificates of "Safety Production Standardization Enterprise" and "Service Quality 5S Enterprise" by the China Cableway Association. In 2022, it was awarded as one of the "Top Ten Internet Famous Scenic Spots in Guilin" and "Top Ten Astronomy and Climate Landscape Check ins in Guangxi", and was selected as one of the "World Karst Science Entrance Examination Route". 4、 Sightseeing route Take the cableway up the mountain -- View Yuanbao Peak -- Experience Ruyi Cable Bridge -- View Yangshuo from Ruyi Cloud Summit -- Walk through the forest and view the peak forest landscape -- Experience the glass walkway -- Visit the "Singing in Guilin" experience hall -- Return to the mountain 1. The horizontal distance of Ruyi Peak cableway is 2012 meters, the height difference is 241 meters, and the one-way traffic volume is 2000 people/hour. The cableway system equipment is designed and manufactured by POMA company in France. The overall operation and safety system adopts good passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 2. The Ruyi Suoqiao Bridge is 142.4 meters long, 2 meters wide, and 58 meters away from the valley floor. Standing among them, one can see the Yangshuo Peak Forest in full view, and the slight swaying in the air provides a thrilling and wonderful experience. 3. Ruyi Cloud Peak is named after its ridge resembling the traditional auspicious object of the Chinese nation, Ruyi. Ruyi Cloud Peak is a 360 ° viewing platform from the highest point of Ruyi Peak, a sacred place for people to pray and fulfill their wishes, and also a viewing spot for the Linqi Mountain in the distance. 4. The forest walking path winds through the peaks and valleys, with a total length of 246 meters and a center height of 32.5 meters. It is composed of a grid structure embedded with tempered glass and steel grilles. From a distance, it looks like a graceful "rainbow" in the peaks and forests, and also like an aerial ribbon left at the top of the jungle. Walking through it, you can fully enjoy the beauty of the peak forest and feel the joy of crossing the native jungle from the sky. 5. Glass walkway glass walkway is built along the cliff wall, 138 meters long and 1.8 meters wide. Walking on it is thrilling and extremely challenging. Looking into the distance, the peaks and forests are lush, the smoke from cooking is lingering, and the countryside is picturesque. 6. The Singing Tour Guilin Experience Hall is located at the upper station of the Ruyi Peak Cableway. It is an immersive digital experience space that uses digital technology and environmental art to showcase spatial creativity and intelligent interactive experiences. It integrates karst style and ethnic cultural creativity, making visitors feel as if they are walking in the dynamic painting of Guilin's mountains and waters, creating a wonderful feeling of "people swimming in the painting".

attractions.name: 桂林千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area is jointly created by Songcheng Performing Arts and Guilin Travel Stock, which reproduces Guilin's history, culture and ethnic customs, and is suitable for all ages to have fun with each other, rain or shine. 
The giant song fairy statue is magnificent and integrated with Guilin's landscape. It is the embodiment of the truth, goodness and beauty of Bagui land. Everything in the scenic spot is tourist-centered, with tens of thousands of square meters of No.3 secret tourism complex, wind and rain corridor and five-star standard toilet with all-indoor air conditioning. Haunted House, Qingming Riverside Film Museum, Wonderful Street and other high-tech and children's experience projects are full of fun. Yangshuo Ancient Village has created a unique farming and market life style. Handicraft workshops such as grandfather's wine jar, grandma's cakes and father's toys in Shijing Street and Fengqing Street keep homesickness and look for the memories of parents. Lover's Harbor and No.4 Bay are good places for young people to relax. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Guilin" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Using advanced high-tech means such as sound, light and electricity and stage machinery, it sings the legend of truth, goodness and beauty in Bagui land through time and space in the three-dimensional space of water, land and air, bringing Bagui culture hidden under the 800-mile Lijiang River into everyone's field of vision, and reproduces a love affair in Guilin for three lives and three lifetimes. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as National Flash Show, Mo Tusi Recruiting Son-in-Law, Song Fairy Welcomes Guests, Guozhuang Carnival, etc. 
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduction of Guilin ethnic customs

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 漓江风景名胜区
attractions.summary: There is an article in primary school Chinese textbooks that says' Guilin's scenery is the best in the world ', which refers to visiting the Li River. The mountains on both sides of the Lijiang River are tall and straight, with thousands of shapes. They are the essence of Guilin scenery. The Li River, a hundred mile gallery ", each scenery is a typical Chinese ink painting. The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. The main ways to visit the Li River in general include taking boats, bamboo rafts, and hiking, including three-star and four-star boat tours, bamboo raft tours, and large boat tours in Xingping Fishing Village.

attractions.name: 漓江竹筏游
attractions.name_en: Bamboo Rafting on the Li River in Xingping
attractions.summary: Xingping Jiuma Painting Mountain Lijiang River Bamboo Raft Youxingping Section is located in Yangshuo, which has always been considered as the essence of Guilin landscape. There has long been a saying in the local area that 'Yangshuo's scenery is as beautiful as Guilin, and Yangshuo's beauty lies in Xingping'. There are over 20 scenic spots here, including Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection, Monk and Nun Meeting, Chaoban Mountain, and a 20 yuan background picture. Throughout history, the beautiful mountains, rivers, and streams of Xingping have captivated countless ink artists. Along the Xingping Li River, you can also enjoy picturesque scenery such as Xingping Jiajing, Huangbu Reflection, Carp Jumping over Dragon Gate, Chaoban Mountain, Luosi Mountain, and Beautiful Women's Mirrors. Yangdi Xingping Lijiang Bamboo Raft Tour Yangdi section is a must visit project when visiting Yangshuo, Guilin. The beautiful Yangdi is an important part of Guilin tourism and Guilin scenery. The hundred mile Li River, with "one mountain, one water, and one poem title", is like a long scroll of colorful ink landscape with poetry and painting. The Yangdi Tourist Area is about 18 kilometers long and is the golden section of the Li River. Departing from Yangdi Pier on a bamboo raft, heading down the river, the scenery along the way is beautiful, including the picturesque Nine Horse Painting Mountain and the reflection of yellow cloth. This section of the river is winding and twisting, with clear waters lingering and numerous scenic spots. The peaks reflect the scenery, and the bamboo and wood are lush.

attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.

attractions.summary:
· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 
