attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 虎跑公园
attractions.summary: Hupao Park is located in the southwestern mountainous area of West Lake, and is home to the famous "third spring in the world" - Hupao Dream Spring. Hupao Spring Water is known for its sweet and mellow taste, and drinking it regularly has certain health benefits. Therefore, it is often seen that locals carry buckets to fetch water here, and using Hupao Spring Water to brew Longjing tea is a famous "perfect match". The area around Hupao Spring was originally known as Hupao Temple. It was named after a Tang Dynasty monk named Xingkong who dreamed of a tiger digging the ground and digging up spring water here. This is also the place where the legendary monk Jigong passed away. You can see attractions such as Jigong Hall and Jigong Pagoda Courtyard, where Jigong's bones are hidden. Modern art master Li Shutong (Master Hongyi) also became a monk here, and now there is a Li Shutong Memorial Hall, displaying over a hundred physical exhibits of Li Shutong's life. The environment of Hupao Park is quiet. Along the mountain, there are many landscapes, such as bower, spring pool and arhat hall. At the spring viewing place, you can see the statue of tiger digging spring. The park is lush with branches and leaves, and it is also a great place to cool off in summer. Resting in the tea house here, sipping Longjing tea soaked in Tiger Run Spring, is incredibly relaxing.

attractions.name: 城隍阁景区
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Pavilion (Hangzhou New West Lake Ten Scenic Spots Wu Shantian Scenic Area) is located at the top of Wu Shan, which is the general name of several hills such as Qibao Mountain, Ziyang Mountain and Yunju Mountain. Chenghuang Pavilion, an antique pavilion-style building with seven floors underground, is 41.6 meters high, dazzling and rich. It integrates the architectural styles of Yuan and Ming temples, focuses on the big picture and outlines the details, and wins the rivers, mountains, lakes and cities of Hangzhou.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb Mount Wu and look up at the bright moon

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 杭州植物园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn flowers; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
Hangzhou Botanical Garden, located in the northwest of the West Lake, has nine exhibition areas and four experimental areas, including economic plants, ornamental plants, trees and landscape gardens. 
The Botanical Garden has scenery to see in all seasons, and the most worth seeing is the plum exploration in Lingfeng. A large-scale flower show will be held here in early spring every year. 
More than 1,000 kinds of medicinal plants, including "Zhejiang Eight Flavors", are planted in Baicao Garden, which is highly popular in science. 
· The spring pool in Yuquan is full of fat herring and red and yellow carp, which is a good place to have a nap and wins the favor of children.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to go for an outing
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 07:00-17:30,Opens at Standard time 07:00-17:00

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 广西药用植物园
attractions.summary: The Guangxi Medicinal Plant Garden is affiliated with the Health Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. It is located in the eastern suburbs of Nanning, 8 kilometers from the city center. The coordinates are 108°19′E, 22°51′N. The altitude ranges from 72 to 113 meters. The area has a subtropical climate, characterized by abundant heat, ample rainfall, and distinct dry and wet seasons. The average annual temperature is 21.6°C, with a maximum extreme temperature of 40.4°C and a minimum extreme temperature of -2.1°C. The average monthly temperature exceeds 20°C for seven months, with an average temperature of 12.8°C in January and an average maximum temperature of 28.3°C in July. The annual sunshine duration is 1,827 hours, and the annual precipitation is 1,200-1,500 millimeters, mostly concentrated from May to September. The annual average relative humidity is 79%.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display herbs and plants such as Two-leaf Pin.

attractions.name: 雨花台
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Zhonghua Gate in Nanjing, it consists of three beautiful hills surrounded by pine and cypress trees, and is a red tourism site in Nanjing.
- The entire scenic area is divided into six main zones: the Martyrs’ Cemetery Area, the Historical Sites Area, the Yuhuashi Stone Cultural Area, the Yuhuacha Tea Culture Area, the Amusement Activity Area, and the Ecological Forest Area.
- The Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial Hall and the Martyrs’ Achievements Exhibition Hall display many books, manuscripts, clothing, and writing tools used by the soldiers of that time.
- The park is lush and green, making it not only a popular tourist destination but also a place for leisure and recreation for Nanjing residents.
- An annual Yuhuashi Art Festival is held every September, and a large Rhododendron Exhibition takes place from March to June. It is also a great spot for plum and magnolia flower viewing.

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 春熙路
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jinhua Pavilion is located in the hinterland of Chunxi Road, a small street less than 50 meters long. It was newly built after the renovation of Chunxi Road in recent years, connecting Kejia Lane in Chunxi. Because of the architectural style of the Republic of China, this small street presents a different style, quiet and romantic in the downtown area, and then it has become an outdoor shooting place for many photographers, and even a location place for some photo studios to take photos. 
Chengdu Jinhua Pavilion was built in 1914, located between Zhengkejia Lane and Chunxi Road, but people are used to directly calling it Jinhua Pavilion on Chunxi Road, Chengdu. Sichuan has been a place with extremely developed sericulture since ancient times. Shu embroidery and Shu brocade are famous all over the world, and Chengdu is also known as Jinguan City. Jinhua Pavilion is named for it, which means "prosperity and brocade".
attractions.shortFeatures: Representative bustling commercial street in Chengdu

attractions.name: 成都太古里
attractions.summary: Chengdu Taikoo Li is a large open style shopping center located in Jinjiang District, Chengdu. It combines modern commerce with traditional culture and is renowned for its unique architectural style and rich brand selection. This is not only a paradise for shopping, but also a great place to experience slow life in Chengdu.

attractions.name: 成都IFS国际金融中心
attractions.summary: The Chengdu IFS International Financial Center is a landmark building in Chengdu, integrating shopping, dining, entertainment, and office functions. It boasts numerous internationally renowned brands and high-end dining options, making it a popular destination for leisure and shopping among Chengdu residents and tourists.

attractions.name: 九眼桥
attractions.summary:
Jiuyan Bridge, also known as Zhenjiang Bridge, was built in 1593. The bridge deck is paved with bluestone blocks, retaining the image of a nine-hole stone arch bridge with Ming Dynasty architectural style.  
It is now one of the gathering places of bars in Chengdu, and it is also a symbol of Chengdu's night culture. There are hundreds of bars on the street, most of which have open-air seats. 
It's very lively at night. You can choose a small shop you like and the price of drinks is appropriate, and enjoy the scenery by the river while drinking fine wine.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to enjoy Chengdu's nightlife

attractions.name: 安顺廊桥
attractions.summary: Located next to the Hejiang Pavilion at the confluence of Fuhe and Nanhe in Chengdu, Anshun Covered Bridge spans the Nanhe River, Anshun Bridge has a long history, and the original architectural traces can be traced back to the Yuan Dynasty. In Kyle Polo's travel notes, Anshun Covered Bridge is one of the four bridges that impressed him deeply. At the beginning of the 21st century, Anshun Bridge was built several times before it was restored to its original appearance. Until 2000, Chengdu Funan River Engineering Headquarters was redesigned and built. After three years of careful carving, the brand-new Anshun Covered Bridge was unveiled on August 3, 2003. You can take photography.
attractions.shortFeatures: Founded in the Yuan Dynasty

attractions.name: 兰桂坊
attractions.summary: Even if you don't go to Hong Kong, you can feel the feast of "Landmark Bar" in Chengdu. Lan Kwai Fong, which combines eating, drinking and having fun, has stylish decoration, petty bourgeoisie atmosphere and elegant environment, which is different from the quiet during the day. After nightfall, Lan Kwai Fong is full of dim lights.
attractions.shortFeatures: An international city landmark

attractions.name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
attractions.name_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
attractions.tag: Mengmeng Animals; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- The Giant Panda Breeding and Research Center fully simulates the natural habitat of the giant panda, featuring lakes, streams, bamboo forests, and lawns. It houses more than 100 giant pandas.
- Near the main entrance, there is a Giant Panda Museum, where you can send postcards stamped with panda-themed postmarks from the Panda Country Post Office, and watch documentaries about giant pandas at the cinema.
- In addition to giant pandas, you can also see other animals like the black-necked crane, peacock, and heron. The Sun and Moon Nurseries house the cutest, newly born and a few months old panda cubs, which are extremely adorable. Highly recommended!
attractions.shortFeatures: The adorable national treasure is waiting for you.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 宽窄巷子
attractions.summary: Kuanzhai Alley is the only ancient street left over from the Qing Dynasty in Chengdu, consisting of three parallel old urban streets - Kuanzhai Alley, Kuanzhai Alley, and Jingzhai Alley, as well as a courtyard community between them. Come here, drink tea, eat hotpot, and experience the leisurely, slow, and new life of Chengdu. You can order a cup of Mengshan Huangya here and set up a dragon gate formation with the old man next to you; You can also call yourself 'Shu'er Lang' and enjoy the pleasure of digging your ears comfortably; You can also enjoy a wide variety of snacks at the snack stall. The Kuanzhai Alley under the night sky also has its own charm. Bars such as Dianzui, Baiye, and Huli are full of Chengdu's fashion sense, blooming its charm at night. Full text 

attractions.name: 成都市人民公园
attractions.summary: The park was founded in 1911 and is now a leisure destination for locals to drink tea, chat, and play cards. You can experience the happy "slow life" of Chengdu people here. You can order a cup of tea, read a book, bask in the sun and daydream in the tea house in the park. The original name of the park was Shaocheng Park, which was originally the "Eight Banners and Full City" of the Qing Dynasty, used for the residence of Manchus and Mongolians. In the third year of the Xuantong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1911), General Yukun stationed in Chengdu abolished the system of supplying banner residents and built a park. Nowadays, there are attractions such as Plum Garden, Haitang Garden, and large rockeries in the park, making it a place for locals to relax and have fun. Come here to drink tea, play cards, set up a dragon gate formation, chat, and enjoy the leisurely slow life of the leisure capital. Full text 

attractions.name: 蜀风雅韵川剧院
attractions.summary: The Sichuan opera performance with the "Shu style and elegant charm" in Chengdu is a shining pearl in the treasure trove of Chinese opera. It is a popular folk art among the people of southwestern provinces such as Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou. In terms of the vocal style of traditional Chinese opera, Sichuan opera is composed of four major vocal styles: Gaoqiang, Kunqiang, Huqin, and Qianqiang, as well as a local folk lantern opera. These five types, except for lantern opera, were introduced to Sichuan by opera troupes from other provinces from the late Ming Dynasty to the mid Qing Dynasty. Sichuan Opera is a shining pearl in the treasure trove of Chinese opera. The Sichuan style and elegant charm have once gathered many famous Sichuan Opera performers. In recent years, they have reunited with famous Sichuan Opera performers to jointly launch a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Shufeng Yayun was founded in 1998, based in the Land of Abundance and facing both domestic and international markets, showcasing authentic Western Sichuan folk arts and classic operas in all aspects. It is a large-scale multi-functional pear garden destination that integrates traditional Chinese art performances, folk characteristic skill performances, and opera and drama supplies. "Sichuan Style and Elegant Charm", a Sichuan featured performance, integrates the essence of Bashu Quyi, covering the culture of the Three Kingdoms and Bashu folk stunts: Sichuan Opera, face changing, spitting fire, puppet, tea art, rolling lights, etc., which are unique in Sichuan culture. The charm of Shu has been passed down through the ages, and the elegance has been passed down for a hundred years. Shu style and elegant charm, located in the ancient architectural complex of Qingyang Palace on the ancient path of Qintai in Chengdu, Sichuan, China, adjacent to the ancient famous Qingyang Palace partition wall, with Du Fu Thatched Cottage and Wuhou Temple complementing each other from afar. The architecture of Shu style and elegant charm is ancient and rustic, with the generous and leisurely spirit of ancient Western Shu. It was once a century old pear garden with ups and downs. The Sichuan Opera Actors Guild Hall, which has been a gathering place for famous actors for a long time, is currently a folk pear orchard with deep roots in Sichuan. The elegant Sichuan style gongs, drums, zithers, and flutes show their elegance without a word. Playing, playing, and singing, the essence of Qupai comes at once. Life, dan, jing, mo, and ugliness all come on the stage. Kun, gao, hu, tan, and opera come one after another. Here, there are authentic Sichuan opera skills such as face changing, spitting fire, and dressing up, as well as famous lantern rolling and hand shadow plays in the prosperous era of China. There are also staff headed puppets that are exquisitely crafted, with drums and music playing together to create a soul stirring sound, and traditional melodies lingering in the background. One night, a thousand year experience of Western Shu culture - Shu style and elegance welcome you. Shufeng Yayun used to be a gathering place for famous Sichuan opera actors. In recent years, it has reunited with famous actors in Sichuan and launched a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Not only did it gain fame, but it was also widely reported by media both domestically and internationally. In the blink of an eye, it brings back the charm of the pear orchard from the past, and the traditional sound lingers around. The Western Shu civilization has been passed down from generation to generation, with unique advantages. Face changing, spitting fire, and rolling lanterns are well-known in China, and the puppet with a staff head is exquisitely crafted with exquisite skills; My daughter's clear voice is indescribable. Listening to the guqin playing, I couldn't help but dream back to the Three Kingdoms. Upon hearing the sound of the erhu, it changed to the floating clouds and the wild dogs. The hand shadow play, which has been extinct for many years, returns to the folk; The sound of drums and music resonates with the soul, bringing infinite joy. The Shu style and elegant charm have lofty aspirations, intending to revive the folk art of Ba Shu and bring back the floating culture of folk art in tea houses, and bring back famous actors and masters with unique skills to the people. Today, Shufeng Yayun has become a gathering place for famous figures and masters in folk culture, and a hub for ticket enthusiasts to visit Chengdu. Full text 

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 杜甫草堂
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; Former residences of celebrities.
attractions.summary: In the past, there was a small path in front of Du Fu's thatched cottage, lined with flowers and trees. He once wrote in his poem: "The flower path has never been swept for guests, the humble door is now opened for you." Today’s flower path is a red-walled alley connecting the Du Fu Thatched Cottage Memorial Hall and the original Caotang Temple. At the end of the flower path stands the "Caotang Screen Wall," where the characters "Caotang" were inlaid with blue-and-white porcelain shards by Zhou Shanpei, the Governor of Sichuan’s Quanye Dao during the late Qing Dynasty. These characters have been damaged and repaired several times. When Chairman Mao visited the cottage in 1958, he gazed at these two characters for a long time. As one of the symbols of the cottage, many visitors stop here to take photos as a memento.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit Du Fu's Former Residence and Experience the Cultural Sacred Site

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is a tributary of the lower reaches of the Yangtze River, mostly in Nanjing, and is regarded as the mother river of Nanjing 
Known as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai", it is one of the most prosperous places in Nanjing, and it is also a must-see place for many tourists to come to Nanjing. 
· You can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Qinhuai River by boat at night, and feel the local customs and customs of the river from different perspectives. 
There are festivals in all seasons, such as cultural temple fair in spring, Qinhuai summer in summer, Confucius Temple Food Festival in autumn, Jinling Lantern Festival in winter, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Listen to the music on both sides of the strait and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the Beautiful night view

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 栖霞寺
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
Sheshan Qixia Temple is located on Qixia Mountain in the northeast of Nanjing. It is one of the four famous temples in China and the birthplace of the "Three Theories" of Jiangnan Buddhism. Qixia Temple is not only large in scale and magnificent in style, but also the best scenery in Nanjing. It is also famous for its important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Qixia Temple Feng covers an area of more than 40 mu, and there are three courtyards of Pilu Temple Tibetan Sutra Building, which rise layer by layer according to the mountain, and the pattern is neat and beautiful. Main attractions: Stupa The Qixia Temple Stupa is a relic of the Southern Tang Dynasty. It is one of the oldest stone pagodas south of the Yangtze River and the largest stupa in my country. The stone pagoda is eight-angled and five-level, about fifteen meters high. The base is surrounded by a stone railing with a hook line, which is restored for the original objects of the Five Dynasties excavated in modern times. The floor of the base is carved with seawater, dragon, phoenix, fish, shrimp and other figures, and only a part of it remains. The eight phases of Sakyamuni are embossed on all sides of the Sumeru seat under the pagoda. After thousands of years of wind and rain, although some stone eaves have been destroyed, they still stand tall, becoming a witness to the prosperity of Buddha spirit in Jinling. The Great Buddha Pavilion, also known as the Three Holy Temples, is dedicated to the Buddha of Infinite Life and was excavated for Shiyi in the Southern Qi Dynasty. The Buddha statue is 10.8 meters high, and its seat is 13.3 meters high. Guanyin is 11 meters high to stand on the left and right side of the Bodhisattva. The pleated style of the Buddha statue is quite similar to the stone Buddha in Yungang, Datong. The original two Buddhas next to the stupa are more than three meters high, beautiful and elegant, similar to the Longmen Stone Buddha in Luoyang, and are also peerless treasures in the golden age of Chinese Buddhist art. Qianfoyan, known as "Yungang in the south of the Yangtze River", is the only Southern Dynasty grottoes in China. Wuliang Hall Wuliang Hall is the earliest and largest Buddhist shrine in Qianfo Rock. The Buddha of Infinite Life is in the middle, and Guanyin is on both sides. The statue is well-proportioned and the lines are smooth. The fold style of the three Buddhas' clothes is similar to that of Yungang Grottoes, and the excavation date is seventeen years earlier than that of Yungang Grottoes. The statue is exquisite and simple, which can be compared with Datong Longmen. Its value lies in preserving the original rhyme of Buddha statues in the Southern Dynasties, which is especially rare in the south of the Yangtze River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire exquisite stupas and Buddha statues in grottoes

attractions.name: 颐尚温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Located in Tangshan Town, Nanjing, which is famous for its hot springs, it is one of the most famous hot springs in this area. The clear water in front of the door is a mirror and the green hills behind it are a screen. 
Yishang Hot Spring has two spring resources, and the water is pure natural and does not need to be heated. There are not only Chinese hot springs, but also hot springs arranged in Roman and Turkish western styles. While soaking in hot springs, you can enjoy the stars in the sky. It is also a great enjoyment to encounter snow in winter, and snowflakes fall on the tip of your nose.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous popular hot spring in Tangshan

attractions.name: 东部华侨城大侠谷
attractions.summary: Daxia Valley is a theme park located within the OCT scenic area in eastern Shenzhen, and is also one of its core tourist areas. Daxia Valley is a fusion of natural scenery and thrilling amusement projects, making it a choice for young people to gather and travel. It usually takes one day to visit the Great Xia Valley. It is recommended to take the jungle cable car to the Cloud Sea Highland after entering the scenic spot in the morning. This is the essence of the Great Xia Valley. The 110 meter high Natural Eye Observation Tower on the Cloud Sea Plateau and the "Peak of Extreme" all glass observation deck extending beyond the cliff offer panoramic views of the entire Eastern Overseas Chinese Town, making it the observation deck of the Great Hero Valley. After playing on the mountain, take the Cloud Sea Cableway down the mountain to the Ecological Canyon at noon or afternoon. This is a place where thrilling and exciting amusement projects are concentrated, including rapids, wooden roller coasters, 4000 miles from the center of the earth, deep-sea exploration, hurricane rescue, jungle shuttle, phantom whirlwind, children's amusement park, mountain and sea mysterious realm performances, etc. Among them, the most exciting ones are the wooden roller coasters and rapids. After playing exciting amusement projects, continue walking and you will come to Haifeide (a small town). Haifeide (a small town) is a characteristic block with the theme of world wine culture. The buildings in the town are full of exotic charm, and there are many copper sculptures related to wine on the street. Full text 

attractions.name: 甘坑古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Villages; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gankeng Village was originally an ancient village with a long history. Together with Guanlan Printmaking Village, Hehu New Residence, Makan Ancient Village and Dawanshiju, it is known as one of the top ten Hakka ancient villages in Shenzhen. The protection and development direction of Gankeng is to rebuild the central OCT of Shenzhen and give Shenzhen people a slow time. 
More than 350 years ago, Xie Wenming and Zhuo Meifa, the ancestors of Gankeng Village, Hakkas from Meizhou, took a fancy to the natural environment here and settled here and thrived. Nowadays, the Hakka people open their sincere arms and invite tourists from all over the country to Gankeng to experience and explore Shenzhen Hakka culture with an inclusive mind. 
In Gankeng Village, there are Hakka dwellings and many ancient buildings, surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the houses are connected with alleys, which are strewn at random, just like a picture scroll. More amorous style buildings such as gun towers, watchtowers, arcades and diaojiao buildings are blended into the mountains and rivers, forming a unique carrier of Hakka culture with hundreds of years old Hakka houses.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hakka Water Town Customs and Farming Experience

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 翱翔•飞越地平线
attractions.summary: Come on an exciting flight and witness this magical world in an unprecedented way! Embark on the journey of "Soaring and Flying over the Horizon", feel the gentle breeze brushing your face, and fly over the treetops and rooftops. This is definitely a heart warming flying experience. On this magical journey around the world, fully appreciate the beautiful scenery along the way and enjoy the freedom and pleasure of soaring in the sky.

attractions.name: 创极速光轮
attractions.summary:
The world premiere, Tomorrowland Park shows the future world depicted in the Disney movie Chuang: War Chronicle. 
· Riding a two-wheeled speed light wheel motorcycle, tourists fly past the track under the magnificent dome, and enter the fantasy space where reality and reality can't be distinguished at high speed. 
Visitors in the waiting area can imagine the future world under the color-changing dome, and watch the speedy light wheel fly by to the infectious music. 
The giant dome is undulating, and it will be shocking even when viewed from a distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: A thrilling speed

attractions.name: 雷鸣山漂流
attractions.summary: Embark on an exciting raft journey, delve into the dark abyss, race against fierce beasts, and toss and roll in the rapids. Join the Explorer Alliance and head to the peak of the exploration island - the "Thunder Mountain" that emits a terrifying roar.

attractions.name: 爱丽丝梦游仙境迷宫
attractions.summary: Specially designed for Shanghai Disneyland, "Alice in Wonderland Labyrinth" is the first attraction in Disneyland worldwide to feature the theme of Tim Burton's live-action movie Alice in Wonderland. Visitors are free to choose the route to the whimsical world of the labyrinth when heading to the "Crazy Hat Tea Party". In a maze composed of hedges, stone walls, giant flowers and fantastic sculptures, a family adventure will bring endless fun to visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Across the labyrinth for a tea party

attractions.name: 奇梦之光幻影秀
attractions.name_en: Ignite the Dream - A Nighttime Spectacular of Magic and Light
attractions.summary: Mickey will show you the wonderful magic of dreams and the magical power of imagination. Follow him and have a swim! Witness the miracle at the center of Shanghai Disneyland! Mickey opens the door to a brand new adventure, presenting infinite and wonderful worlds one by one before your eyes. Through thrilling projection, laser, fountain, and various other visual effects techniques, Mickey will use his magic to turn the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" into a dreamlike new world, while illuminating the dreams in all of us.

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京市民俗博物馆
attractions.summary: The former residence of Gan Xi, also known as Gan Family Courtyard or Gan Xi Mansion, was built by Gan Fu in Jiangning during the early years of the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang reign. Gan Xi was the second son of Gan Fu and a famous literati of the late Qing Dynasty. He had passed the imperial examination and had a wealth of works throughout his life. It was discovered in the cultural relics census conducted by the cultural relics department of Nanjing in 1982. In order to effectively utilize and reproduce the style of Jiangnan residential buildings during the Ming and Qing dynasties, the cultural relics department repaired some buildings and built the Nanjing Folk Customs Museum. The museum was opened to the public in November 1992, designated as a cultural protection unit in Jiangsu Province in 1995, and listed as a patriotic education base under the jurisdiction of the government in 2001. The outer side now forms a distinctive folk culture old street with the historical old street of Xinanli.

attractions.name: 太平天国历史博物馆(瞻园)
attractions.name_en: The Historical Museum of The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
attractions.tag: Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Zhanyuan, also known as the Great Ming Palace or the First Garden of Jinling, was first built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty. It was originally the palace of Xu Da, a founding hero of the Ming Dynasty. It is a long-standing garden in Nanjing and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Wuxi Jichang Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. Historical background: Zhanyuan has a history of over 600 years. The layout of the whole garden is elegant and exquisite, including ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Taihu Lake Lake stones of the Northern Song Dynasty, quiet buildings, pavilions, rockeries, etc. During Emperor Qianlong's southern tour, he visited here twice and borrowed the imperial name of the garden from Ouyang Xiu's poem "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky". He personally inscribed the plaque "Viewing the Garden". During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, it was still the residence of the Eastern King Yang Xiuqing and the Young Western King Xiao Youhe. Dongzhan Garden is divided into two parts, east and west. The main gate (south gate) is located in the east half, with a large plaque hanging on the gate reading "Jinling First Garden". In the center of the entrance is a half body bronze statue of Hong Xiuquan. The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom History Museum is the main visiting point of Dongzhan Garden, displaying cultural relics such as the Jade Seal of the Heavenly Father, the Golden Crown of the Loyal King, the Great Flag, the Sword, and the Stone Trough. Xizhan Garden can be reached through Shuiyuan, which is a typical Jiangnan garden. The ancient buildings in the park include the Viewing Pavilion, Flower Basket Hall, Zhishuang Pavilion, Yingcui Pavilion, and winding corridors. These buildings and corridors divide the Xizhan Garden into five small courtyards and a main garden, with rockeries being the main scenery and backbone of the entire garden. There are rockeries in the south, north, and west, each exquisitely crafted. The central part of the main garden is Jingmiao Hall, surrounded by water on three sides and by land on one side. The "Tiger" stone tablet on the right wall at the entrance of the Guanyu Pavilion is said to have been bestowed upon the tiger general Xu Da by Zhu Yuanzhang. It stands upright like a tiger, howling loudly in the sky. Upon closer examination, one can discern the four characters "the richest in the world", making it the "number one tiger in the world". The copper pavilion and the other miracle in the the Taihu Lake Shizhan Garden, the copper pavilion (namely the fan pavilion), are the world's earlier heating equipment (equivalent to air conditioning buildings). In addition, there are also two the Taihu Lake Lake stones in the garden. The Immortal Peak is in the garden behind the south gate, and it stands in a beautiful place; Leaning against the cloud peak in the southeast corner of the flower basket hall, amidst the osmanthus bushes, it stands out with a sudden and graceful charm. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
