attractions.name: 小西湖景区
attractions.summary: The Xiaoxihu Scenic Area is located between the Confucius Temple and the Laomen East Scenic Area. This place preserves a relatively primitive appearance, mainly consisting of low rise residential buildings, several of which have been transformed into hotels, restaurants, and cafes. The overlapping years make it very suitable for photography.

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 中国科举博物馆(江南贡院)
attractions.summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

attractions.name: 秦淮河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is a tributary of the lower reaches of the Yangtze River, mostly in Nanjing, and is regarded as the mother river of Nanjing 
Known as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai", it is one of the most prosperous places in Nanjing, and it is also a must-see place for many tourists to come to Nanjing. 
· You can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Qinhuai River by boat at night, and feel the local customs and customs of the river from different perspectives. 
There are festivals in all seasons, such as cultural temple fair in spring, Qinhuai summer in summer, Confucius Temple Food Festival in autumn, Jinling Lantern Festival in winter, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Listen to the music on both sides of the strait and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the Beautiful night view

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 南京长江传奇系列游轮
attractions.summary: The "Yangtze River Love" cruise ship is currently a twin body riverside passenger ship on the Yangtze River in China. It is also a large luxury cruise ship independently designed and built in Jiangsu Province, with a length of 95.7 meters, a width of 19.6 meters, a height of 21.8 meters, and a total tonnage of 5796. The "Love of the Yangtze River" is designed with 5 floors and a total operating area of over 5000 square meters. The first floor multifunctional hall can accommodate 190 people, equipped with ultra wide LED screens, sound system, and lighting; The second floor of the ship features a large outdoor deck and an immersive column free themed hall that can accommodate 26 tables for banquets and dining. The accompanying digital interactive concierge corridor and 270 degree holographic projection are the preferred options for cruise ship banquets; Ship's third floor private room, leisure booth area, simulated cockpit, VIP observation area in the front cabin; Fourth floor tea art private room, outdoor leisure booth area, VIP observation area in the front cabin; The top-level creative lawn deck aims to provide tourists with a higher quality and more personalized riverside travel experience. A unique venue is the perfect choice for various events such as weddings, birthdays, brand launches, and team building. The "Yangtze River Legend" cruise ship is a luxury cruise ship designed against the backdrop of Nanjing's local culture. The captain is 69.80 meters long, the width is 11.20 meters, the height is 19 meters, the total tonnage is 1818, the rated passenger capacity is 399 people, and it has fully transparent floor to ceiling glass and brand new central air conditioning. The multifunctional hall on the first floor has a french window, which can accommodate 160 people and is equipped with large LED screen, sound and light; The second floor leisure booth area and private rooms have a comfortable environment and a 300 degree panoramic view; Three levels of sun deck, wide view, spacious and clean. Featuring elements of cultural history, dining, entertainment, etc., it provides a comprehensive immersive experience of riverside tourism that includes immersion, sound, sight, and sensation. The Yangtze River Love Cruise sightseeing area is divided into four floors: the first floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a reception hall, a multifunctional hall, and a main service desk. The second floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a sightseeing deck, dining rooms, and a themed banquet hall. The third floor of the cruise ship is equipped with private rooms, a leisure booth area, and a VIP observation area in the front cabin. The fourth floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a tea room, a leisure booth area, and a VIP observation area in the front cabin. Creative lawn deck on the top floor of the cruise ship. The Yangtze River Legend Cruise sightseeing area is divided into four floors: the first floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a reception hall, a multifunctional hall, and a main service desk; The second floor of the cruise ship is equipped with leisure booths, a central water bar, a snack bar, and VIP private rooms; The third floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a sunny water bar, a sunny deck, and outdoor booths.

attractions.name: 六朝博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
It is the most comprehensive site museum in China to understand the "ancient capital of the Six Dynasties" at present, and it is also the most systematic thematic museum reflecting the culture of the Six Dynasties. 
· The core theme of the exhibition is to show the elegant demeanor of "Oriental Metropolis", with four exhibitions: Emperors of the Six Dynasties, Eternal Romance, Elegant Demeanor of the Six Dynasties and Outstanding People of the Six Dynasties. 
The museum site is a part of Jiankang City in the original Six Dynasties. It is precisely because of the excavation of this thousand-year-old site that today's Six Dynasties Museum exists.
attractions.shortFeatures: A special museum reflecting the culture of the Six Dynasties

restaurants.name_en: Flowers bloom like clouds, lava stone fish

attractions.name: 基诺山雨林徒步
attractions.summary: Entering the depths of Baopiao Village in the rain forest of Jinuo Mountain, one can see the phenomenon of huge tree roots, tall trees that cover the sky, traditional Chinese herbs in tropical rainforests, dripping leaf tips, flower growth in old trees, parasitic epiphytes and other wonders along the way. Along the 2-kilometer upstream challenge section, plant identification is carried out, water is taken from the rainforest, and several kilometers of mountain climbing sections are completed.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 

- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.

- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 宁海森林温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; a hidden gem for kids.
attractions.summary:
The commonly known "Tianming Mountain Nanxi Hot Spring" is a natural "Oxygen Valley" in Ningbo, and one of China's three major famous hot springs.  
With a water temperature of around 49.5°C, it is rich in various beneficial minerals and trace elements, making it a rare mid-temperature hot spring with a sodium bicarbonate water quality in China, regarded as a "unique gem in the Yangtze River Delta."  
Surrounded by peaks, the scenic area boasts a beautiful natural environment and is a comprehensive resort that integrates natural attractions, hot spring spas, outdoor activities, and gourmet food.  
The average temperature in summer is 3-5°C lower than in the city, making it an ideal place for leisure, cooling off, and escaping the heat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Forest Hot Springs in East China

attractions.name: 前童古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qiantong Ancient Town is known as the "First Confucian Town in Jiangnan," "Little Lijiang of Jiangnan," and "Living Folk Museum."
- It is the largest settlement of the Tong family in Jiangnan. The town preserves a complete set of Ming and Qing Dynasty architecture, with white walls and black tiles, exuding grandeur.
- The entire town resembles a countryside painting rich in ancient charm, with every household featuring carved beams, every home having flowing water, and an octagonal water system running throughout the village.
- The village follows a "return" style layout with a nine-square, eight-trigram arrangement. The streets and alleys are narrow, and the buildings are densely packed, making it feel like walking through a maze.

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 古麓山寺
attractions.summary:
Gulushan Temple, also known as Huiguang Temple and Wanshou Temple, has a history of more than 1,700 years. It is the earliest relic of Buddhism entering Hunan and one of the early Buddhist temples in China. 
The environment of the temple is very quiet. There are two Podocarpus pines in front of the temple, which are relics of the Six Dynasties. There are precious Buddhist scriptures and ancient books in the temple. 
Today's ancient Lushan Temple is full of incense worshippers. The hall is hidden among layers of trees, with morning bells and evening drums, and bursts of Sanskrit sounds.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient and secluded temple deep in Yuelu Mountain

attractions.name: 潮宗街
attractions.summary: Chaozong Street is named after Chaozongmen, the city gate, also known as Caochangmen Main Street. It starts from Xiangjiang Road in the east and ends at Huangxing North Road (formerly Beizheng Street) in the west. It is one of the only four remaining ancient granite streets in Changsha City. It was originally 511 meters long, but today it is about 400 meters wide and 9 meters wide. It was the widest street in the past. Chaozong Street has historical and cultural monuments such as the former site of Jinjiu activities, the True Jesus Church Hall, the hotel and stage of the Republic of China in Ziyuan, the remains of War of Resistance against Japan's air defense facilities, the former site of Cultural Bookstore and the former residence of Qu Hongyu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Blocks witness the historical changes of Changsha

attractions.name: 杜甫江阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Du Fu Jiang Pavilion was built in memory of Du Fu, forming a context belt with Tianxin Pavilion, Daolin Second Temple in Yuelu Mountain and Yuelu Academy. 
There is a biography of a great poet inside. Whenever fireworks are set off on summer weekends, the number of visitors who come to watch will increase a lot. 
· Local landmark buildings, close to the Xiangjiang River, can climb high and overlook both sides of the Xiangjiang River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb high overlooking Xiangjiang River and enjoy the grand fireworks

attractions.name: 黄兴路步行街
attractions.summary: Huangxing Road Pedestrian Street is one of the bustling areas in Changsha City. It is a pedestrian commercial street that was renovated and completed in 2002. Starting from Simenkou in Furong District in the north and ending at Nanmenkou in the south, the total length is 838 meters and the street width is 23-26 meters. It includes Huangxing Square, which covers nearly 10000 square meters, with a total commercial area of 250000 square meters, including a newly built area of 150000 square meters. It is a comprehensive venue that integrates shopping, leisure, entertainment, catering, culture, and tourism functions. The pedestrian street is divided into an inner street and an outer street, with the inner street having three levels. There are numerous shops and a complete range of brands. In addition to various regular clothing and jewelry stores, this place also gathers snacks and delicacies from all over the country. The nearby Pozi Street is also a gathering place for Changsha's specialty snacks, such as the Fire Palace, Shuangyan Tower, and Red Plum Cold Drinks, which are well-known to Changsha people. There are countless of them.

attractions.name: 黑麋峰国家森林公园
attractions.summary: The Heimufeng National Forest Park is located in the northeast corner of Wangcheng County, Changsha City, Hunan Province, only 19 kilometers away from Changsha. It has beautiful scenery and pleasant climate, and has been known as the "heavenly paradise" since ancient times. Heimufeng National Forest Park is a relatively large forest park in the suburbs of Changsha, with an area of 4079 hectares and a main peak elevation of 590.5 meters. Climbing to the summit, surrounded by vast mountains, rushing towards the horizon, admiring the sunrise in the morning and the sunset in the evening, it is refreshing and delightful. The air here is fresh, the water quality is excellent, the mountains are high and the forests are dense, there is no scorching heat in summer, and no severe cold in winter. It is known as the big "oxygen bar" for urbanites. Heimu Peak has a flourishing cultural heritage. The ink still lingers to this day. The great Tang poet went up the mountain to seek beauty, so the Taoist called this mountain "Dongyang Mountain" and listed it as one of the twenty-four "Thirty six Dongtian" in the country. The "Black Deer Ancient Temple" on the mountaintop has a history of more than 1200 years, with an endless fragrance and renowned reputation.

restaurants.name_en: Iwaki restaurant, barbecue, earthen pot skewers
Fragrant him and her cooking rice

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 鲁迅广场
attractions.summary: Lu Xun Square is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, on the left side of Changtian Tower. There is a half body statue of Lu Xun built on the square, surrounded by lush pine and cypress trees, colorful flowers, green trees, and solemn and dignified surroundings. The square echoes the Xingyin Pavilion to the south, with one side commemorating the great patriotic poet Qu Yuan of ancient times and the other side commemorating the leader of the modern New Culture Movement, Lu Xun.

attractions.name: 行吟阁
attractions.summary: Xingyin Pavilion is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a landmark building of the entire Donghu Lake. The Xingyin Pavilion is surrounded by water on all sides, and can be reached by the Tingtao Pavilion via the Lotus Wind Bridge. The other side is connected to the land by the Falling Feather Bridge. Xingyin Pavilion was built in 1955, named after the phrase "Qu Yuan was released and swam by the river and pool, singing along the banks of the river" in the poem "Fisherman's Father" in Chu Ci. This pavilion is an antique brick and wood building, actually constructed with reinforced concrete. The pavilion is 22.5 meters high, square in plan, with four corners and a spire, three stories of cornices, covered with green tiles, antique. A statue of Qu Yuan stands in front of the pavilion, with a height of 3.6 meters, a pedestal height of 3.2 meters, and a total height of 6.8 meters. He looked up at the sky with his head held high, taking a step to walk as if he were reciting the "Tianwen" by the edge of the river. On all sides of the platform, there are beautiful trees and flowers scattered, and the island is surrounded by weeping willows and palm trees, embellished with elegance and a broad artistic conception. Inside the Xingyin Pavilion, there are columns and spiral staircases that allow visitors to climb up layer by layer. There are windows on the second and third floors for visitors to admire. Climbing up to the Xingyin Pavilion and looking around, there is even a magnificent scene.

attractions.name: 长天楼
attractions.summary: Changtian Tower is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, with the left side leading to Bitan for fish watching and the right side being Lu Xun Square. Changtian Tower was built in 1956 with a total area of 1775 square meters. It is a palace style building with a brick, wood, and cement structure. The small building has two floors, with a width of 7 rooms and a depth of 2 rooms. The building is open and clean, with interesting railings and straight colonnades at both ends, leading to the left and right pavilions. The front of the building is spacious, and behind it is a small courtyard with flower walls and moon doors that lead to the back mountain. Tourists can gaze out of the window and see the vast expanse of blue waves, wanting to catch up with the blue sky, feeling the emotion of 'autumn water grows together and the sky becomes one color'.

attractions.name: 九女墩
attractions.summary: Jiunvdun is located on the northwest bank of Wuhan East Lake in Tingtao Scenic Area. According to legend, nine women who participated in the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom rebel army died bravely here, and their remains were buried here by the villagers. At that time, in order to avoid persecution by the Qing government, it was called a pier instead of a grave. There is a 70-square-meter platform in front of the tomb of Jiunvdun, surrounded by guardrails, and a magnificent monument in the middle. The monument was built in 1952, made of granite, and is more than 8 meters high. It is engraved with inscriptions and inscriptions written by Dong Biwu, Soong Ching Ling, Guo Moruo, He Xiangning, Zhang Nanxian and others. There are six copper bells hanging at the top, and the wind blows the bells, just like the fierce battle of martyrs and heroes running on the battlefield.
attractions.shortFeatures: In memory of the nine women of the rebels

attractions.name: 可竹轩
attractions.summary: Kezhuxuan is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan. It was founded in 1958, taking inspiration from Su Shi's saying "I would rather eat meat than live without bamboo". This is an ancient architectural corridor imitating bamboo art, with single-layer eaves, blue tiled walls, colorful eaves, staggered pavilions, and winding corridors, exuding an antique charm. It stands quietly in the Cangbai Park, deep in the green shade, surrounded by emerald bamboo, elegant and unique, appearing quaint and elegant. The emerald bamboo and camphor trees exude a scholarly atmosphere everywhere. Around the Kezhu Pavilion, there are old camphor trees that have been planted for a hundred years. Behind the pavilion, there are hundreds of bamboo poles, swaying in the wind with an audible sound. There is a Zhou Cangbai Memorial Room inside the building, which displays images, texts, and physical materials related to Zhou Cangbai, including the piano used by Mr. Zhou before his death.

attractions.name: 湖光阁
attractions.summary: Huguang Pavilion is located on a small island in the center of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, north of Moshan Scenic Area and south of Tingtao Scenic Area. It is the main garden building of the central island of the lake. Huguang Pavilion was built in 1931, originally named "Zhongzheng Pavilion", and renamed "Huguang Pavilion" after liberation. The Huguang Pavilion is a typical tower style building connected to the land by a ten mile long embankment. The attic has three floors, with green eaves and antique style tiles. Ascending to the attic, one can take in a panoramic view of the surrounding lakes and mountains. The Huguang Pavilion is connected to the Xuhai Beach Bathing Beach, where visitors can climb up to enjoy the scenery and play in the sand and water below, creating endless fun.

attractions.name: 寓言雕塑园
attractions.summary: The Fable Garden is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a fable sculpture garden based on ancient Chinese fables. More than 20 ancient allegorical story sculptures with profound meanings have been built, including Yu Gong moving mountains, covering his ears and stealing bells, fox pretending to be a tiger's power, Mr. Dongguo, playing the flute for numbers, self contradiction, blind people touching elephants, playing the qin for cows, waiting for rabbits by the trees, praying with his arm as a carriage, and oil sellers. They are vivid and lifelike. Fable sculptures are mainly composed of large blocks, with various variations of characters depicted using vertical and parallel lines to depict detailed patterns. The relief group named "Yu Gong Moves the Mountain" is 40 meters long and 6 meters wide, with a magnificent momentum. These sculptures, with their antique, vivid, and simple shapes, not only bring joy to tourists, but also have a great educational significance.

attractions.name: 碧潭观鱼
attractions.summary: The pavilions and pavilions with the layout of fish watching in Bitan are ingenious, which not only reflects the architectural features of Chu's preference to build pavilions near the water, but also has a kind feeling of holding water with your hands. The winding Jiuqu Bridge is connected with the green tile pavilion, forming the most beautiful place in East Lake. East Lake has been raising goldfish since 1951, and now it has bred more than 80 varieties of goldfish, including a "red high head" with a big red hydrangea on its head; A "lion's head" with wings and a wide and raised head; "Goose Top Red" wearing silver armor and a little red tassel; The "Mo Long" covered in pure ink paint, light, brave and enchanting; Short tail, round body, colorful "five-flower egg ball" and so on. Visitors can watch fish or fish here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pavilions and pavilions with character layout

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 东湖绿道
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; On foot; Hiking; Hiking/Biking
attractions.summary:
East Lake Greenway is located in East Lake Eco-tourism Scenic Area, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, with a total length of about 101.98 kilometers. It is the longest greenway around the lake in the core area of 5A-level cities in China. 
East Lake Greenway is divided into seven themed landscape roads: Tingtao Road, Huzhong Road, Baima Road, Country Road, Forest Road, Moshan Road and Hushan Road. It fully relies on eight natural features of East Lake Mountain, Forest, Ze, Garden, Island, Embankment, Field and Bay, and turns East Lake into an "ecological green heart" of the city where citizens are close to nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: Leisure trails connecting many scenic spots in East Lake

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 东湖游船
attractions.summary: The Great Beauty East Lake Cruise, located in the green heart of East Lake, is a large-scale inland lake cruise operation platform in Central China. With ten themed docks and carefully arranged characteristic sightseeing routes, the East Lake Cruise has woven the water tourism transportation of East Lake into a network, creating a new hotspot for tourism and leisure in Wuhan, represented by "taking a cruise, enjoying East Lake, strolling through lanterns, exploring plum blossoms and cherry blossoms, and playing on greenways". Take a boat tour of Donghu Lake and enjoy a slow life. You can enjoy the scenery on the boat, and the people watching you on the boat. During the day, take a boat to the deepest part of Donghu Green Heart to get oxygen. Explore the "Green Treasure House" Moshan Scenic Area, the "Human Wonderland" Luoyan Scenic Area, the "World's Three Great Cherry Gardens" Moshan Cherry Garden, the "Science Popularization Education Base" Donghu Ocean Park, the "Romantic Date Destination" Donghu Eye... You can also go to the "Asian Big City Lake" Donghu to see the sea, go for a walk on the Donghu Greenway, and gaze at the skyline. At night, take a boat ride and immerse yourself in the dreamy night of Donghu Lake. The 14.5-kilometer "Listening to the Waves Painting Scroll" slowly unfolds along the boat's route, allowing you to admire the dazzling lights and stars deep in Donghu Lake, and appreciate the enchanting scenery of "Chu charm of mountains and waters, painting the golden Donghu Lake" and "heart moves with the boat, light moves with the water". Transportation strategy: Public transportation Chufengyuan - Moshan Guanguang recommended boarding dock - Chufengyuan Pier A. Xingyin Pavilion - Meiyuan Guanguang Water Pavilion - Meiyuan Guanguang Recommended Boarding Pier - Xingyin Pavilion Pier A Bus: You can take Bus 701 to the East Lake Bus Station on Huanhu Road, and walk for 10 minutes to get there. B Subway: You can take Metro Line 8 to Liyuan Station and get off at Exit C. Walk into Liyuan Square for 20 minutes to reach the destination. Recommended Boarding Terminal - Luoxia Shuixie Pier A Bus: You can take bus 712 or 605 to Xudong Street Subway Liyuan Station and walk for 15 minutes to get there. B Subway: You can take Metro Line 8 to Liyuan Station and get off at Exit C, then walk for 15 minutes to get there. Recommended boarding dock - Meiyuan Pier A bus: You can take bus 413, 401, 402 to Lumo Road Moshan bus stop and walk for 10 minutes to arrive. B Subway: You can take Line 2 Baotongsi Subway Station and get off at Exit B. Then take bus 413 or 401 to Lumo Road Moshan Bus Station, and walk for 10 minutes to arrive. B Subway: You can take Metro Line 2 to Guanggu Avenue Subway Station and get off at Exit B. Then take Bus 513 to Qingwang Road Luoyan Scenic Area Bus Station, and walk for 10 minutes to get there. Self driving route: Chufengyuan - Moshan Guanguang Recommended boarding dock - Chufengyuan Pier Self driving: Enter the parking lot through the north-south passage of Liyuan Square and Yuguang Road, and walk for about 5 minutes to the entrance of Huguang Overture. (Surrounding parking lots: Chufengyuan Parking Lot, Liyuan Square Parking Lot) Xingyinge Meiyuan Guanguang Shuixie Meiyuan Guanguang Recommended Boarding Pier - Xingyinge Pier Self driving: Enter the parking lot of Donghu Ecotourism Scenic Area through the Liyuan Square passage, park in Tingtao Scenic Area, and walk for 15 minutes along the signboard to arrive (Surrounding parking lot: Donghu Ecotourism Scenic Area Parking Lot) Recommended Boarding Pier - Luoxia Shuixie Pier Self driving: Enter the parking lot through the north-south passage of Liyuan Square and Yuguang Road, enter Tingtao Scenic Area, and walk for about 15 minutes along the signboard to arrive (Surrounding parking lots: Chufengyuan Parking Lot, Liyuan Square Parking Lot) Recommended Boarding Pier - Meiyuan Pier Self driving: After passing through the Donghu Tunnel, drive from the direction of Lumo Road to the south gate of Moshan, and walk for about 5 minutes to arrive.
