attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉植物园
attractions.tag: Treasure spot for walking kids; Enjoy autumn flowers; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- The Wuhan Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was established in 1956. It is one of the three core national botanical gardens, integrating scientific research, species conservation, science popularization, and leisure tourism. It has collected and cultivated more than 10,293 plant species, primarily focusing on plant resources from the Central China region and inland aquatic plants of China. It serves as the most important base for plant species diversity and genetic resource preservation in Central China, with the largest aquatic plant resource garden and kiwi germplasm resource garden in the world.
- The Wuhan Botanical Garden is a national AAAA-level scenic area and has been recognized as a National Science Popularization Education Base, National Youth Science and Technology Education Base, and a base for science popularization, environmental education, and patriotism education in Hubei Province and Wuhan City.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciating Seasonal Flowers in Gardens Around the World

attractions.name: 东湖落雁景区
attractions.summary: The Luoyan Scenic Area is located on the east bank of Donghu Lake in Wuhan and is an important part of the Donghu Scenic Area. The scenic area has undulating hills, vast water bodies, numerous peninsulas, and intersecting harbors, creating a very beautiful natural environment. Every year, the scenic area attracts a large number of migratory birds to winter, and a large number of cormorants inhabit the pond cypress on the island, which is very spectacular and can be called the "bird hunting land" of Wuhan. The scenic area includes eight major landscapes, including Qinghe Ancient Bridge, Magpie Bridge Meeting, Yanzhou Suoqiao, Luzhou Ancient Ferry, Zhao's Garden, Ancient Tree Wonders, Yanqiping Sand, and Luzhou Falling Geese, full of romantic feelings.

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. Full text 

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 武汉天地
attractions.summary: Like Xintiandi in Shanghai, Wuhan Tiandi, which is close to Hankou River Beach, is a characteristic block transformed from old buildings. Strolling along the pedestrian walkway, the red brick small western-style buildings, antique wooden windows, antique blue bricks, and wooden or bamboo chairs placed outdoors all exude a strong nostalgic atmosphere. Many young people like to come here to take photos. Wuhan Tiandi gathers delicacies from all over the world. You can not only eat the New Element Restaurant opened by Li Na, a tennis elder sister, but also the South Restaurant of Shanghai Delicate Dim sum Restaurant, the Creative Sichuan Restaurant with pepper, and the Bali lobster and Yitang lobster that you must eat in summer in Jiangcheng. In addition to dining venues, a fashionable shopping center called Yifang Shopping Center has been built here, featuring over 300 global fashion brands and integrating international cuisine, IMAX theaters, LIFESTYLE bookstores, children's experiential play, and family consumption, conveying the spirit of fashion at the forefront.

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉科技馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary: Here, you can learn about natural science in an all-round way through various modern equipment and rich display and interactive ways. For children, this must be a must-visit place for entertainment and education. The Science and Technology Museum is divided into three floors, with exhibition halls of the universe, life and water in the "natural plate";
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:00-16:30(Admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 归元禅寺
attractions.summary:
· One of the most important monasteries in Wuhan, together with Baotong Temple, Xilian Temple and Zhengjue Temple, is called the four jungles of Wuhan.  
It is the daily custom of many Wuhan citizens to come to Guiyuan Temple to pray for blessings. Every year on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, hundreds of thousands of pilgrims come here to grab the first incense. 
· Enter the Arhat Hall, start with any 　 Arhat, and count to your actual age in sequence. The identity, expression and movements of the counted Arhat indicate your fate.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the famous temple of the golden arhat

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 汉正街
attractions.summary:
Hanzheng Street is "the main street of ancient Hankou", the earliest central street in the history of Hankou, and a place where thousands of businessmen gather and commodities compete for flow. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is a commodity wholesale market with a wide range. It is mainly divided into different commodities. The prices of commodities here are still very cheap. However, when shopping here, on the one hand, you have to have a certain ability to identify commodities, because the authenticity and falsehood are uneven; On the other hand, you have to be able to counter-offer. Cheap is not that simple. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is being renovated and relocated, from Qiaokou District of Hankou to Hankou North. However, there are still many commercial ports at the original site, and it should take many years to completely relocate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hankou commercial district in history

attractions.name: 木兰天池
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
- Mulan Tianchi is a national forest park. The area is characterized by beautiful mountains and clear waters, and is an important part of the Mulan Cultural Ecotourism Area.
- The entire scenic area is divided into a sightseeing area and a leisure resort area. Due to the lower temperatures in summer compared to the city, it is ideal for a summer retreat.
- The area is crisscrossed with ravines and rich in forests, with flowing water throughout the year, presenting a wetland ecosystem where mountains and waters blend together.
- The main attractions in the area include waterfalls, stream pools, and strange rock formations. There is also a meadow with entertainment activities such as grass skiing and slideways.
- In early spring, Mulan Tianchi is a paradise for apricot blossoms, with thousands of acres of wild apricot flowers spread across the forest valleys, where the verdant hills and blooming apricot flowers create a picturesque scene.
attractions.shortFeatures: The lush mountains and clear waters are like a scene from a painting; a summer resort with beautiful mountains and clear waters.

attractions.name: 木兰云雾山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Mountains
attractions.summary: Yunwu Mountain, renowned for its titles of "Western Ling Scenic Area, Famous Region of Northern Chu, Boundary Defense of the West, and Ancestor Mountain of Han Land," is located in the Paotongdian area in the northwest of Huangpi District, Wuhan, about 65 kilometers from the city center and 29 kilometers from Huangpi District. It is a natural scenic area dominated by mountains, with the main peak at an elevation of about 709 meters, making it the highest peak in Wuhan. One of the Eight Scenic Views of Mulan, it is a national 5A-level scenic area. Mulan Yunwu Mountain features pleasant scenery, fresh air, and clear water. It is the grandest, most secluded, primitive, mysterious, and purest in the Mulan tourism circle, combining peaks, valleys, ravines, ponds, dams, waterfalls, springs, streams, flowers, grasses, stones, trees, temples, ancient villages, ancient architecture, and towering mountains, offering diverse and rich ecological landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Flower viewing and spring outing in the countryside park
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 白城沙滩
attractions.summary:
Located at the foot of Baicheng in the south of Xiamen University, it is a beautiful beach between Yanwu Bridge and Hulishan Fort.  
· There are many interesting scenes. The beach is dotted with huge mouse sculptures, and the semi-ring flyover is like a huge clock. 
There are ruins of Zheng Chenggong's era distributed on the beach, which combines beautiful scenery with profound cultural and historical heritage. 
· This is a natural leisure park for Xiamen University students, Xiamen citizens and tourists to stroll, play games, swim and watch the sunset.
attractions.shortFeatures: Seaside beach adjacent to Xiamen University

attractions.name: 南普陀寺
attractions.summary:
Nanputuo Temple is a key Buddhist temple in the Han nationality area. If you are going to pray, you might as well come here to worship. 
The most famous ones are the vegetarian food on the second floor of the vegetarian restaurant and the vegetarian cakes in the temple, with the plaque of the first vegetarian banquet in the world hanging on it, which is about 59 yuan per capita. 
Wulaoshan, the back mountain of Nanputuo Temple, is one of the eight scenic spots in Xiamen, and you can climb the mountain by the way. 
It only takes about 1 hour to walk from the temple to Wulaoshan, and you can also go to Xiamen Botanical Garden from this road. 
There are many inscriptions of celebrities around the temple. There is a huge stone carving of "Buddha" on the cliff behind the temple, and tourists often come to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Buddhist monasteries in the whole country

attractions.name: 云上厦门观光厅
attractions.tag: Observation deck; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shimao Yunshang Xiamen Sightseeing Hall stands on the 55F of Tower B, Shimao Strait Building, Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, and has the highest altitude view in Xiamen. The sightseeing hall of about 1,300 square meters integrates high-altitude vision, multimedia interaction, leisure and entertainment. At an altitude of about 300 meters, you can overlook Gulangyu Island, the sea garden, and Xiamen-Hong Kong area, which is "the richest Xiamen flavor". Wanshishan, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Huandao Road and other "Old Xiamen" business cards can be seen at a glance. Kinmen Island and Taiwan Province Strait, which are separated only by a strip of water, have a panoramic view. Shimao Yunshang Xiamen Sightseeing Hall looks at the mountains, the sea, the garden and the waves from a unique perspective, where you can enjoy the pure "private house" sea and sky scenery. 
B1F Ticket Hall-Multimedia Interaction 
There is a wonderful Preshow and cool multimedia interaction on the way to buy tickets. The ultra-high-speed elevator can reach the 55F sightseeing hall in only 45 seconds, opening the long-awaited high-altitude sightseeing experience at speed. 
55F Sightseeing Hall-360 ° transparent viewing platform 
Rotate Xiamen's charming customs 360 degrees, overlooking the graceful city through floor-to-ceiling windows. Famous scenic spots in Xiamen, such as Gulangyu Island, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Shapowei, Yanwu Bridge, Baicheng Beach and Hulishan Fort, can be seen at a glance, and enjoy the shock of 300 meters at an altitude. 
View Restaurant-Exclusive starry cuisine 
While enjoying delicious food at leisure, you can see the vigorous waves of the vast sea at a glance, which is pleasing to the eye, and you can enjoy different delicious food and quiet time. 
VR interactive experience-fantasy is just around the corner 
Immersive swimming explores in the clouds, swimming in the ocean world like a dream, and feeling the high-altitude tour around the Twin Towers. High-tech VR interaction brings you a brand-new immersive and wonderful experience. 
High-altitude glass box-a challenge for the brave 
A new perspective for the brave! Step on the high-altitude glass box and feel the trembling 300 meters under your feet, which stimulates your eyeballs and challenges your heartbeat. 
Air Shop-Bringing Xiamen on the Cloud Home 
Postcards, commemorative shirts, Taiwan Province accompanying gifts, Xiamen souvenirs, and cute themed cute things bring home the beautiful memories of Xiamen on the clouds.  
High-altitude telescope-start mysterious exploration 
Explore the beautiful scenery of Xiamen through a telescope. When the weather is fine, you can also overlook Kinmen. Wandering at the low place VS overlooking at the high altitude will tell you a complete story of Xiamen and take you to enjoy the charming scenery of Xiamen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the shocking scenery at an altitude of 100 meters

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gulangyu Island is home to over a thousand buildings with a variety of styles, blending both Chinese and Western architecture. There are temples with traditional Chinese flying eaves and curved corners, Minnan-style courtyard houses, the Bagua Tower with a combination of Chinese and Western elements, small and delicate Japanese-style houses, 19th-century European consulates from Western countries, and the Shuzhuang Garden, which is considered a gem of Jiangnan classical gardens. It can be called an exposition of world architecture.

In recent years, several new buildings have been completed, including the former Gulangyu Park transformed into an Underwater World, the tall statue and relief of Zheng Chenggong in Haoyue Park, the marble statue of renowned Chinese gynecologist Lin Qiaozhi in Yuyuan, the subtropical plant introduction garden at Huijiao, with its shrubs, flowers, and fragrant palms, the Xiamen Museum displaying the city's thousand-year history and the development of its special economic zone, the Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall honoring the hero’s achievements, as well as Yanping Park, Gangzihou Swimming Pool, Zhongshan Library, People’s Stadium, and the Gulangyu villas with garden-style architecture, Guanhaiyuan Resort, Gulangyu Hotel, and more. With so many parks and buildings in just 1.78 square kilometers, the density of these structures is likely rare even in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: World Architecture Expo

attractions.name: 日光岩
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
attractions.summary:
· Sunlight Rock is the highest peak of Gulangyu Island and the iconic scenic spot of Gulangyu Island. 
Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 菽庄花园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
Shuzhuang Garden was built in 1913, named after the homophonic word "Shuzang" by Lin Erjia, a wealthy businessman in Taiwan Province. It is divided into two parts: Bushan Garden and Zanghai Garden. 
The main landscape of Bushan Garden is rockery, that is, twelve caves, with a total of 12 caves, inlaid with twelve zodiac signs at each cave entrance. 
The reason why Tibetan Sea Garden is called Tibetan Sea is that only when you turn out of the Moon Cave Gate will the sea appear in front of you, and the Forty-Fourth Bridge is the best point to view the sea. 
The Piano Museum in Tingtao Xuan in Shuzhuang Garden is a highlight. There will be special piano improvisation performances every half hour in the museum, which is worth listening to.
attractions.shortFeatures: Garden Landscape with Western Colors

attractions.name: 皓月园
attractions.summary:
Located in the east of Gulangyu Island, it was built to commemorate Zheng Chenggong's historical achievements in expelling Dutch barbarians and recovering Taiwan Province. 
The name of Haoyue Garden is taken from the word "Haoyue" in Zheng Chenggong's poem "I can't sleep when I miss you, but the bright moon is plain". 
The most eye-catching thing in the park is undoubtedly the statue of Zheng Chenggong, which is 10 times tall. 
Haoyue Garden is very close to Xiamen Island, and it is the best place to watch and shoot the Jinmao Twin Towers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Statue garden commemorating national heroes
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:00-17:30,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:00-18:00

attractions.name: 八卦楼
attractions.summary: The Organ Museum is located at 43 Guxin Road, Gulangyu Island. The venue is not very large and displays more than 5000 organs of various ages and styles. Those interested in music can come and visit, otherwise they may find it boring. It is said to be the only organ museum in China and the largest in the world at present. The first floor of the venue displays many historical organs from around the world, most of which are produced in France and Spain. The treasure of the town hall here is the world's largest organ. The backyard of the museum houses some smuggled cultural relics seized from customs, all of which are stone carvings.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 国际刻字艺术馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary:
It is the only lettering art gallery in China. The museum officially opened on the morning of March 24, 2008. 
The newly opened Gulangyu International Lettering Art Museum is located in a small building with an area of more than 500 square meters opposite Shuzhuang Garden. The first floor is turned into an international exhibition hall, and the second floor is a China exhibition hall. At present, it is the only large-scale and high-grade international lettering art exhibition hall in the world. There are 407 works from China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and Malaysia in the museum. Most of these works were selected from the 5th National Lettering Art Exhibition and the 8th International Lettering Art Exhibition in 2004, representing the highest level of lettering art at home and abroad. The modern lettering art, which integrates calligraphy, engraving, painting, color, sculpture and decoration, has a distinctive flavor of the times and unique artistic charm, and is increasingly appreciated and favored by people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display many high-level lettering works
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 颠倒博物馆
attractions.tag: A treasure trove for strolling children; Featured exhibition hall; Experiences
attractions.summary: The Inverted Museum is a unique interactive experience hall in Xiamen, known for its unconventional interior design and layout. Tourists can experience various upside down scenes here, such as upside down living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, etc., which are perfect for taking photos and checking in, enjoying a wonderful visual and spatial experience.
attractions.shortFeatures: A photography paradise with inverted decoration style

restaurants.name_en: Deep Sea Fish Hong Kong Seafood Restaurant

attractions.name: 解放碑步行街
attractions.summary: Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street is a more prosperous business circle in Chongqing, where there are many department stores and hotels. It is a good place for shopping, eating and strolling. It is also a good place for visiting Chongqing beauties. The pedestrian street is located in Yuzhong District, centered on Monument to the people's Liberation, including Minquan Road, Zourong Road and Bayi Road. There are many food, shopping, and beauty shopping malls, as well as a variety of snacks and beautiful women, making it the "three highs" of a pedestrian street. You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. There are also scenic spots near the pedestrian street, such as Nengren Temple and Arhat Temple. Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street and its surrounding areas are also one of the main choices for tourists to stay in Chongqing. There are intercontinental hotels and economical hotels with high cost performance. Full text 

- The second cable car across the Yangtze River in Chongqing, known as the "First Aerial Corridor of the Yangtze River" and the "Sky Bus of the Mountain City."

attractions.name: 十八梯
attractions.summary: Eighteen Stairs, once a street on the Yuzhong Peninsula in Chongqing, symbolizes the true mountain city of old Chongqing. In 2015, the Eighteen Stairs area began to be demolished, and today's Eighteen Stairs are littered with ruins and walls. There are two pedestrian streets in Yuzhong Peninsula, Chongqing. One is the first street in the west of China known as "Monument to the people's Liberation", and the other is not far from Monument to the people's Liberation, called "Eighteen Ladders". Enjoy the prosperity of modern cities at Monument to the people's Liberation; At the Eighteen Stairs, one can experience the true mountain city and old Chongqing. The old Chongqing city is divided into the upper half and the lower half. The Eighteen Ladders are located at Jiaochangkou in Yuzhong District and are an old street that runs from the upper half (mountain top) to the lower half (mountain foot). This old street is entirely paved with stone steps, steep and winding, connecting the bustling commercial district on the mountaintop with the old city area by the river below. There are a large number of ordinary people living around the old street, and the street emits a strong urban atmosphere. Ear pluckers, foot trimmers, carpenters, tailors, Shaobing (Baked cake in griddle) sellers, needle and thread sellers, mahjong players, as well as the indispensable Bangbang Army in the mountain city, are scattered everywhere, with dogs and cats lying on the ground casually dozing. The Eighteen Stairs is a true portrayal of the life of old Chongqing citizens. The origin of the Eighteen Stairs can be traced back to the Ming Dynasty. There was originally a well here, and nearby residents ate water from it. The well was located exactly eighteen stone steps away from the residents' homes, so people called it the "Eighteen Stairs".

attractions.name: 山城巷传统风貌区
attractions.summary:
Shancheng Lane starts from Nanjimen and ends at Consul Lane, connecting the upper and lower halves of Yuzhong District. The whole Shancheng Lane covers an area of about 2.4 hectares, with a house area of about 20,000 square meters. Here, you can not only see the geographical characteristics of Chongqing's climbing hills, but also appreciate the original local customs and architectural art of old Chongqing. Therefore, Shancheng Lane is not only a small architectural history museum, but also a natural exhibition area of people's living culture in Chongqing Shancheng. 
The historical evolution of Shancheng Lane can be traced back to the Ming and Qing Dynasties. At that time, it was mostly the house of military generals, and it was one of the high-grade residential areas in the ancient city of Chongqing. In the Qing Dynasty, there was a "Sky Lantern Pole" here, and every festival, the "Sky Lantern" was lit to pray for peace, hence the name "Sky Lantern Lane" and "Sky Lantern Street". In 1900, French missionaries came to this lane and built Renai Hall, Renai Hospital and School. Looking at Shancheng Lane in the distance, the lights winding up the stone ladder, flashing like the stars in the sky. In 1972, Sky Lantern Lane was renamed Shancheng Lane. As the only street named after "Mountain City" in Chongqing, Shancheng Lane is one of the 32 key landscape areas in the city and one of the 12 key landscape areas in Yuzhong District.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 四川美术学院美术馆
attractions.summary: The Luo Zhongli Art Museum is located within the campus of Sichuan Academy of Fine Arts University City. It was designed and built by renowned artists such as Luo Zhongli and Hao Dapeng. The exterior walls are adorned with colorful patterns made of broken porcelain pieces, which are both dazzling and avant-garde, making them very eye-catching. The art museum displays works by Luo Zhongli from various periods, as well as some works by art students. If you love art, don't miss it.

Come to Friendship Pier and take a boat out to sea. From the sea, you can overlook coastal attractions such as the wharf, Little Qingdao, and the Navy Museum. You can also enjoy the city scenery of green trees and red tiles in Qingdao. The entire sea sightseeing takes about 20 minutes.

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 黄岛金沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 

attractions.summary: Qingdao Polar Ocean Park is a national AAAA level scenic spot located at No. 60 Donghai East Road, Laoshan District, Qingdao City. It is situated in the core coastal tourism belt of Laoshan, facing the Yellow Sea, backed by Fushan Mountain, adjacent to Sculpture Garden, Shilaoren Beach, and Wheat Island Park, facing the sea on three sides. With beautiful scenery and convenient transportation, it is a polar ocean themed park that integrates ocean display, cultural tourism experience, science education, and animal conservation. The Qingdao Polar Ocean Park consists of five major venues: the Polar Ocean Pavilion, the Horizon Theater, the Deep Sea Fantasy Jellyfish Secret Realm, the Polar Legend Ice and Snow Experience Pavilion, and the 360 ° Ball Screen Cinema. Combined with the Whale Joy Square in the center of the park, it creates a unique and joyful ocean cube in Shandong Province. Immersed in it, you can observe polar animals such as beluga whales, dolphins, walruses, polar bears up close, as well as over 50000 marine creatures such as hawksbill turtles, sand tiger sharks, golden scads, swallow rays, jellyfish, and seahorses. attractions.name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
