attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京市博物馆(朝天宫)
attractions.summary: Chaotian Palace was a Confucian temple in the Qing Dynasty. The entire architectural complex includes Jiangning Prefectural School, Chaotian Palace, and the Nanjing Museum, which was converted from several main halls of Chaotian Palace. Currently, Jiangning Prefectural School is the Jiangsu Kunqu Opera House, which can only be viewed from the outside. The only places that tourists can visit inside are Chaotian Palace and Nanjing Museum. The history of Chaotian Palace can be traced back to the Spring and Autumn Period. Wu King Fuchai melted iron and forged swords here, and the history of building a Confucian temple can be traced back to the Northern Song Dynasty. In the Ming Dynasty, it was named Chaotian Palace and was a place for the royal family to worship Taoist gods and learn the etiquette of meeting the emperor. Later, it was destroyed in war. In the fifth to ninth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1866-1870 AD), it was rebuilt on the original basis and became a Confucian temple. Jiangning Prefectural School also moved from Jiming Mountain here. The Chaotian Palace is adjacent to the artificial canal "Yundu" in the south, surrounded by "Wanren Palace Wall", with a pan pool in the wall, and on the east and west sides are the memorial archway of "Depai Tiandi" and "Daoguan Ancient and Modern" respectively. The main buildings, from southeast to northwest, are Lingxing Gate, Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, and Chongsheng Hall. The roof is covered with yellow glazed tiles, and the four pairs of dragon statues under Lingxing Gate are lifelike. In front of Dacheng Gate stands a statue of Confucius. Behind the Chongsheng Hall is the back garden, near the Feiyun Pavilion on the east is the Qianlong Imperial Stele Pavilion, and the Jingyi Pavilion on the west is the highest point of Yeshan. On one side of the Chongsheng Hall of Nanjing Museum is the main exhibition hall of Nanjing Museum, which mainly displays the basic exhibition "Dragon and Tiger Dwelling - Nanjing Urban History Exhibition". The exhibits are arranged in chronological order, with the first layer featuring exhibits from ancient times to the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the second layer featuring exhibits from the Republican era. On the third floor is the "Yutang Exquisite Artifacts - Exhibition of Fine Treasures in the Collection". The "Treasure of the Town Hall" blue and white plum vase from the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties is located here, with the exquisite painting "Xiao He Chases Han Xin under the Moon" on the vase. The Nanjing Museum has designated the Dacheng Hall and Chongsheng Hall as special and temporary exhibition halls, and any exhibitions currently being held at the Chaotian Palace will be displayed on signs at the entrance. The venues for special and temporary exhibitions may change from time to time. For specific locations, please call the scenic area management department at 025-84200177.

attractions.name: 江宁织造博物馆
attractions.summary:
Located in the Daxinggong area in the center of Nanjing today, Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty went to the south of the Yangtze River six times and lived in Jiangning Weaving House five times. 
Cao Xueqin was born in the government, and now it is a modern museum built on the former weaving site of Jiangning. The book powder of A Dream of Red Mansions must be punched in. 
There are Cao Xueqin's birthplace, Cao Xueqin's former residence exhibition hall and on-site weaving Nanjing Yunjin Museum, and the Dream of Red Mansions Literature Museum is also located in it. 
The museum collects ancient Chinese cultural relics such as dragon robes and cheongsam collected from overseas, among which the Tang Dynasty brocade is extremely precious.
attractions.shortFeatures: Explore Jiangnan Yunjin and appreciate precious cultural relics

attractions.name: 南京台城
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing City Wall Essence Section

attractions.name: 阅江楼
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Yuejiang Tower in Nanjing, along with the Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is collectively known as the Four Famous Towers of Jiangnan. It features a distinctive Ming Dynasty style and classical royal grandeur.
- The most unique feature of Yuejiang Tower is that the tower was built based on the "Yuejiang Lou Ji" (Record of Yuejiang Tower) by Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang of the Ming Dynasty.
- From the top of Yuejiang Tower, one can enjoy a panoramic view of the vast Yangtze River, the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, and the entire city of Jinling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the Ming Dynasty tower to admire the vast Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 桂林两江四湖景区
attractions.summary: Night Tour of Two Rivers and Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Two Rivers and Four Lakes: You can enjoy the landscape scenery of Shanhu Lake, Ronghu Lake, Guihu Lake, Mulong Lake, Lijiang River, and Taohua River in the city, visit the core scenic belt of Guilin, and experience the water system around the city that is comparable to the water city of Venice. Highlights and Features: Night tours of the Two Rivers and Four Lakes are one of the classic products in our scenic area. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots, famous bridges, and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with fish eagles, the Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also enjoy boating on the Li River and Taohua River, experiencing the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoying the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes by boat. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes allows you to enjoy the scenic views of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, Li River or Taohua River in the city. Visit the core scenic area of Guilin, experience the city's water system comparable to Venice's water city, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with eagles, Yao style, and naked eye 3D light and shadow show of the ancient city wall of Mulong Lake. Highlights and Features: Night tours of one river and four lakes are one of the classic products in our scenic area. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots and famous bridges and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also take a boat tour of the Li River or Taohua River to experience the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoy the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night Tour of Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Four Lakes can enjoy the splendid night scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with fish eagles. Highlights and Features: Night tour of Four Lakes is a premium route for night tours in our scenic area. You can take a boat tour of the core scenic area of Guilin and experience the water system around the city, which is comparable to the water city of Venice. Along the way, you can enjoy many famous scenic spots such as Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, and admire famous bridges and mountains; Watch the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the exquisite performance of half zither falling on the moon, and enjoy the dazzling and colorful scenery of Guilin at night. One day tour of one river and four lakes, boat tour of one river and four lakes, can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, and the inner section of the Lijiang River, and see the famous mountains with different shapes. Highlights and Features: Taking a boat tour around the core of Guilin city, you can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery up close. Along the way, many famous mountains such as Xiangbi Mountain, Fubo Mountain, Diecai Mountain, Qixing Mountain, Baoji Mountain, and Laoren Mountain will be presented in sequence; The various Chinese and foreign famous bridges, as well as the elegant and majestic pagodas and towers, adorn the ancient landscape city, allowing tourists to truly experience the unparalleled charm of Guilin's scenery. Full text 

attractions.name: 象鼻山
attractions.summary: At the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River in Guilin, the mountains resemble elephants drinking by the river with their long trunks stretched out. There is a Water Moon Cave under the elephant trunk, and a newly built Puxian Pagoda from the Ming Dynasty on the mountain.

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

attractions.name: 逍遥楼
attractions.summary: Between Jiefang Bridge and Fubo Mountain in the northern section of Binjiang Road in today's urban area. Founded in the Tang Dynasty, it is the Dongcheng Building of Guizhou City in the Tang Dynasty, with a stone tablet of "Xiaoyao Building" written by Yan Zhenqing. Yan Zhenqing (709-785), whose courtesy name is Qing Chen, was a native of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province today. He was a scholar in the Kaiyuan period of Tang Dynasty. He once worked as the censor in the palace, the prefect of Pingyuan (now Shandong Province), and then became the prince Taishi and the duke of Lu County. He was known as "Yan Lugong" in the world. His calligraphy is dignified, vigorous and powerful, and original, which is called "Yan Ti". Yan Zhenqing has never been to Guilin. According to legend, this tablet was re-engraved according to the hook copy of the tablet in Puzhou (now Yongji, Shanxi). Because it is located in Dongcheng Building, this building is called "Xiaoyao Building". The first year of Chongning in Song Dynasty (1102). Guangnan West Road was reassured by Cheng Jie to rebuild the building and renamed it "Xiangnan Building". The "Records of Xiangnan Building" on the stele yin of the existing "Xiaoyao Building" records the process of building repair and the reason for name change.
attractions.shortFeatures: Dongcheng Tower of Guizhou City in Tang Dynasty

attractions.name: 东西巷
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: East and West Lane, close to Jingjiang Palace, is a comprehensive commercial block integrating tourism, folk customs, culture, shopping, catering, leisure and entertainment. East-West Lane is the only historical street left over from the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Guilin, with a pleasant spatial scale. It is a scenic spot of Guilin's ancient historical features, including Zhengyang Street East Lane, Jiangnan Lane, Lanjing Lane and other traditional streets and lanes in Guilin.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the rare historic districts of the city

attractions.name: 漓江三星游船
attractions.summary: The three star cruise ship on the Li River is comfortable, beautiful, hygienic, safe, energy-saving and environmentally friendly, making people feel comfortable and warm. Different boats have different styles, with soft sofas made of fabric or leather that are comfortable, soft, and elegant; Traditional hollowed out grid patterned Chinese rosewood, with an antique charm. Not only that, the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. are decorated with high standard materials, and the new arrangement of curtains and tablecloths creates a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. Full text 

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 桂林千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area is jointly created by Songcheng Performing Arts and Guilin Travel Stock, which reproduces Guilin's history, culture and ethnic customs, and is suitable for all ages to have fun with each other, rain or shine. 
The giant song fairy statue is magnificent and integrated with Guilin's landscape. It is the embodiment of the truth, goodness and beauty of Bagui land. Everything in the scenic spot is tourist-centered, with tens of thousands of square meters of No.3 secret tourism complex, wind and rain corridor and five-star standard toilet with all-indoor air conditioning. Haunted House, Qingming Riverside Film Museum, Wonderful Street and other high-tech and children's experience projects are full of fun. Yangshuo Ancient Village has created a unique farming and market life style. Handicraft workshops such as grandfather's wine jar, grandma's cakes and father's toys in Shijing Street and Fengqing Street keep homesickness and look for the memories of parents. Lover's Harbor and No.4 Bay are good places for young people to relax. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Guilin" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Using advanced high-tech means such as sound, light and electricity and stage machinery, it sings the legend of truth, goodness and beauty in Bagui land through time and space in the three-dimensional space of water, land and air, bringing Bagui culture hidden under the 800-mile Lijiang River into everyone's field of vision, and reproduces a love affair in Guilin for three lives and three lifetimes. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as National Flash Show, Mo Tusi Recruiting Son-in-Law, Song Fairy Welcomes Guests, Guozhuang Carnival, etc. 
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduction of Guilin ethnic customs

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 杭州西湖风景名胜区-赵公堤
attractions.summary: Zhao Gong Causeway is one of the three embankments of West Lake, also known as Xiaoxin Causeway. Built by the Zhao surname Lin'an Prefect in the second year of Chunyou in the Southern Song Dynasty (1242), from Su Causeway to Quyuan, the embankment is 250 zhang long and is known as the "Su Causeway with flowers and willows on the banks". Later, the embankment was abandoned and the Jinsha Causeway was built in the Qing Dynasty, later changed to a road. The current Zhao Gong Causeway was built in 2003.

attractions.name: 断桥残雪
attractions.summary:
It is the meeting place of Xu Xian and White Lady in The Legend of the New White Lady, which adds a lot of romantic color to this long bridge. 
At the beginning of winter snow, the snow and ice on the sunny side of the bridge melt, but the shady side is still covered with residual snow. From a height, the bridge seems to be broken but not broken, forming the famous "broken bridge with residual snow". 
It can be used as the starting point for visiting the West Lake, from Baidi on the Broken Bridge to Gushan, and then visit various scenic spots around the West Lake in turn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Xu Xian and White Snake met on the broken bridge

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 北高峰
attractions.summary: The North Peak is located behind Lingyin Temple in Hangzhou and is a famous mountain range around West Lake in Hangzhou. Although the altitude of Beigao Peak is only over 300 meters, it was mistakenly identified as the peak of Hangzhou for a long time because it is considered a relatively high mountain range around West Lake. There are hiking trails and cable cars in the mountains of Beigao Peak, and many locals and hiking enthusiasts come to climb and stroll along the way, surrounded by lush trees. Looking around from the mountaintop, West Lake and mountains all come into view, making people feel relaxed and happy.

attractions.name: 龙门古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for stroller walks; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary: Longmen Ancient Town is a national 4A-level tourist attraction, located on the beautiful southern bank of the Fuchun River. The town boasts a picturesque environment. Over 90% of the residents have the surname Sun, making it the largest settlement of descendants of Sun Quan, the Emperor of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period. The town has a rich historical and cultural heritage, retaining a strong clan atmosphere and unique local customs. The ancient town's layout is complex, with a defensive, fan-shaped network of streets and alleys as its framework. The clan halls and courtyards are connected, and the alleys interlink, creating a maze-like traditional residential settlement. It is the most complete and rare example of ancient Ming and Qing architectural clusters in the rural countryside of southern Jiangnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie *Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains*

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 西溪梅墅
attractions.summary: Xixi Plum Villa is located in the southeast of Xixi Wetland Park, adjacent to the Hezhu essence "Autumn Snow Nunnery" scenic spot, and together with the nearby Plum Bamboo Villa, Xixi Thatched Cottage, Xixi Water Pavilion, etc., it forms the Xixi Plum Bamboo Leisure Area. Surrounded by plum blossoms in the forest, it is one of the main plum viewing areas in Xixi, recreating the artistic conception of "travelers exploring the secluded and asking questions, deep in the snow fragrance is Xixi". The current Xixi Meishu is a group of rural farmhouse style buildings, mainly including Xixi Meishu, Xiangxue House, Tanchun Pavilion, Gongshan Xiaozhu, etc. The main building has a wooden surface and adobe walls, simple and natural, full of rural atmosphere; The roof is designed as a suspended mountain top, with staggered heights and varying shapes, complementing nature. Xixi Meishu is gradually becoming a plum blossom viewing destination that integrates sightseeing, science education, and leisure life, and is one of the highlights of Xixi's characteristic leisure.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 西溪天堂
attractions.summary: Xixi Paradise is a tourist complex located in the southeast corner of Xixi Wetland Park. Here, there is a stunning view of snow covered reeds, Huizhou style residential buildings with pink walls and black tiles, and bustling markets and homes filled with fireworks. Visitors can pick, take boats, and watch performances. Once you visit here, you can understand the true meaning of "Heaven above, Suzhou and Hangzhou below".

attractions.name: 九溪十八涧
attractions.summary: Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams are located in the mountains west of West Lake, winding seven kilometers from Longjing into Qiantang River. The scenery of Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams is natural, with little craftsmanship. Every tourist who has visited here likes the peaceful and pleasant scenery.

attractions.name: 满觉陇
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn flowers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Juelong, also known as Manlong and Manjialong, is located in the south of the West Lake in Hangzhou, a valley at the southern foot of the southern peak. In the fourth year of Tianfu in the later Jin Dynasty (AD 939), Yuanxing Courtyard was built, and in the second year of Zhiping in the Northern Song Dynasty (AD 1065), it was changed to Manjue Courtyard. Manjue means "perfect consciousness", and the place was named after the temple. 
Juelong is famous for its sweet-scented osmanthus. Every autumn, sweet-scented osmanthus blooms, the fragrance fills the empty mountains, and falls like rain, so it has the reputation of "Manlong Guiyu". In 1985, "Manlong Guiyu" was rated as one of the ten scenic spots of the New West Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Longguiyu, you can have a panoramic view of the tea garden scenery

attractions.name: 小河直街历史文化街区
attractions.name_en: Xiaohe Straight Street Historical and Cultural Block
attractions.summary:
· Xiaohezhijie Historic District is located at the intersection of Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, Xiaohe and Yuhangtang River. 
Original old houses, rarely renovated, still have many "old Hangzhou" living today, with a strong flavor of life. 
It is recommended to go to Fang Zengchang Sauce Garden, No.15 Xiaohezhi Street, and take a photo with the word "sauce". It is said that it used to be the largest pickle factory in Xiaohe area. 
There are many cafes, tea bars, mahjong shops and noodle shops along the way. Find a small tea shop opened by local residents, and visit the quaint courtyard along the way.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historical relics such as workshops and shops are retained

restaurants.name_en: Youth filled with seafood buffet hot pot barbecue

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 万达广场(二七店)
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Wanda Plaza (Erqi Store) is a large shopping center in Zhengzhou city, integrating shopping, dining, and entertainment, providing a great place for citizens and tourists to relax and enjoy themselves.

attractions.name: 郑州大剧院
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Grand Theatre, located at the intersection of Xuesong South Road and Danshui Avenue in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, is an important part of Zhengzhou's four centers (Olympic Sports Center, Cultural and Art Center, Citizen Activity Center, and Modern Media Center) and a hall of performing arts in the Central Plains region. The total investment of Zhengzhou Grand Theater is five floors above ground and two floors underground. The total area of this project is about 50000 square meters, and the total construction area is about 127000 square meters. The theater includes a 1686 seat song and dance theater (Zone A), a 454 seat opera theater (Zone B), an 878 seat music hall, and a 431 seat multifunctional hall (Zone C), as well as underground commercial and parking lots, supporting ancillary buildings. It is the only efficient, professional, and practical first-class theater in Henan Province and even in the country.

attractions.name: 郑州博物馆(文翰街馆)
attractions.summary: The museum consists of a hall, temporary exhibition halls, intangible cultural heritage display areas, academic lecture halls, public service spaces, and audience service rooms.

attractions.name: 郑州美术馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The new building of Zhengzhou Art Museum is located in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City. The architectural design combines elements of grottoes and is uniquely constructed. The art museum is divided into seven exhibition halls, with rich exhibits and complete supporting facilities.

attractions.name: 郑州奥林匹克体育中心
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Olympic Sports Center, abbreviated as "Zhengzhou Olympic Sports Center", is located in Changxihu New District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China. Construction of the Zhengzhou Olympic Sports Center began on November 1, 2016. The total construction area of Zhengzhou Olympic Sports Center is 584000 square meters, with 11 floors above ground, including 1 sports stadium, 1 Grade A gymnasium, and 1 Grade A swimming pool.

attractions.name: 郑州银基冰雪世界
attractions.summary: Yinji Ice and Snow World is located within Yinji International Tourism Resort in Xinmi City. It is a year-round temperature controlled indoor ice and snow themed family park that integrates ice rinks, snow entertainment, and amusement projects. The park is mainly divided into four themed areas: Christmas World, White Castle, Emerald Valley, and Snow Cat Town, each built based on the story background. Snow Cat Town: This is the hometown of the mysterious snow cat Turger. On the annual exclusive festival of snow cats, under the brilliant neon lights, all the cats gather on the square to showcase their beautiful postures. Christmas World: Due to the magic of the White Queen, the entire world has turned into ice, and Santa Claus delivers gifts to make everyone happy. They avoided the surveillance of the White Queen and built a secret gift making factory, busy making gifts every day. White Castle: It is built from sparkling snowflake stones, with beautiful crystal chandeliers shining brightly, and the figure of the White Queen appearing between the snow-white stained glass windows. Jade Valley: This is the Jade Valley Snow Recreation Area, which has been enchanted by the White Queen. It has become a white world that is frozen and snowy all year round, cold but filled with a romantic and beautiful atmosphere. There are two snow slides and seven ice slides here, as well as various special ice sculpture exhibitions. Tourists can play and frolic in the snow all year round here. Full text 

attractions.name: 黄帝故里
attractions.summary:
The Hometown of the Yellow Emperor was established during the Han and Wei dynasties and is a sacred place for descendants of Yan and Huang both in China and abroad to trace their roots and pay respects to their ancestors. The scenic area of the Hometown of the Yellow Emperor consists of five parts: the Square Area, the Ancestral Hall Area, the Ding Altar Area, the Art Garden Area, and the Xuanyuan Hill Area. The area is rich in cultural heritage, and the grand ceremony held annually for ancestor worship is a magnificent event worth visiting.

The Hometown of the Yellow Emperor is very close to the Xinzheng Museum. After visiting the Hometown, you can conveniently go to the museum, which has many ancient artifacts worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Sacrifice to the Chinese ancestor, the Yellow Emperor

attractions.name: 郑州园博园
attractions.summary:
· Zhengzhou Garden Expo Park is located in the southern part of the Zhengzhou Aviation Port Economic Comprehensive Experimental Zone.  
· The park will feature 94 outdoor exhibition gardens, including 18 domestic gardens, 18 international gardens, 2 master gardens, 3 gardens from Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, and 53 gardens from cities outside the province. The participating cities include municipalities directly under the central government, provincial capitals, prefecture-level cities, and county-level cities. The exhibition gardens will feature styles such as royal gardens, Jiangnan gardens, Lingnan gardens, and more.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate classical or modern garden landscaping.

Drunk Fisherman Secret Grilled Whole Fish
Jinsha Lake Golf Club and Catering Department

attractions.name: 汾河公园
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for taking kids out.; City Parks
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the sunset beauty of the Fen River.

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 中国煤炭博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Coal Museum is the only professional museum in China dedicated to the coal industry and is a symbol of science and civilization. Due to its unique function and status, it has been awarded the title of "National First-Class Museum" by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Here, visitors can also view dozens of coal specimens, including long flame coal, poor coal, lignite, and gas coal. The museum's most distinctive feature is the "Coal Amusement Palace." The "Coal Amusement Palace" is a large-scale underground simulated mine, recreated using numerous real-life prototypes or 1:1 replicas. The visitor route spans several hundred meters and is said to be the largest in Asia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduced Underground Simulation Mine

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

hotel.Hotel Name: Guilin Convention and Exhibition International Hotel

attractions.name: 芦笛岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Caves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a scenic area mainly focused on touring caves, with supplementary attractions of mountain and countryside landscapes, and is a brilliant pearl of the Guilin landscape.
- Inside the cave, the stalactites are stunning and varied, magnificent and grand, known for their delicate, gorgeous, and surreal characteristics.
- The widest and most beautiful part of the Reed Flute Cave is the Crystal Palace, located at the deepest part of the ancient underground lake. The stalactites hang like palace lamps, shining brilliantly and nobly.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the 1987 version of *Journey to the West*

attractions.name: 象鼻山
attractions.summary: At the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River in Guilin, the mountains resemble elephants drinking by the river with their long trunks stretched out. There is a Water Moon Cave under the elephant trunk, and a newly built Puxian Pagoda from the Ming Dynasty on the mountain.

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

attractions.name: 东西巷
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: East and West Lane, close to Jingjiang Palace, is a comprehensive commercial block integrating tourism, folk customs, culture, shopping, catering, leisure and entertainment. East-West Lane is the only historical street left over from the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Guilin, with a pleasant spatial scale. It is a scenic spot of Guilin's ancient historical features, including Zhengyang Street East Lane, Jiangnan Lane, Lanjing Lane and other traditional streets and lanes in Guilin.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the rare historic districts of the city

attractions.name: 桂林两江四湖景区
attractions.summary: Night Tour of Two Rivers and Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Two Rivers and Four Lakes: You can enjoy the landscape scenery of Shanhu Lake, Ronghu Lake, Guihu Lake, Mulong Lake, Lijiang River, and Taohua River in the city, visit the core scenic belt of Guilin, and experience the water system around the city that is comparable to the water city of Venice. Highlights and Features: Night tours of the Two Rivers and Four Lakes are one of the classic products in our scenic area. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots, famous bridges, and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with fish eagles, the Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also enjoy boating on the Li River and Taohua River, experiencing the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoying the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes by boat. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes allows you to enjoy the scenic views of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, Li River or Taohua River in the city. Visit the core scenic area of Guilin, experience the city's water system comparable to Venice's water city, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with eagles, Yao style, and naked eye 3D light and shadow show of the ancient city wall of Mulong Lake. Highlights and Features: Night tours of one river and four lakes are one of the classic products in our scenic area. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots and famous bridges and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also take a boat tour of the Li River or Taohua River to experience the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoy the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night Tour of Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Four Lakes can enjoy the splendid night scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with fish eagles. Highlights and Features: Night tour of Four Lakes is a premium route for night tours in our scenic area. You can take a boat tour of the core scenic area of Guilin and experience the water system around the city, which is comparable to the water city of Venice. Along the way, you can enjoy many famous scenic spots such as Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, and admire famous bridges and mountains; Watch the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the exquisite performance of half zither falling on the moon, and enjoy the dazzling and colorful scenery of Guilin at night. One day tour of one river and four lakes, boat tour of one river and four lakes, can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, and the inner section of the Lijiang River, and see the famous mountains with different shapes. Highlights and Features: Taking a boat tour around the core of Guilin city, you can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery up close. Along the way, many famous mountains such as Xiangbi Mountain, Fubo Mountain, Diecai Mountain, Qixing Mountain, Baoji Mountain, and Laoren Mountain will be presented in sequence; The various Chinese and foreign famous bridges, as well as the elegant and majestic pagodas and towers, adorn the ancient landscape city, allowing tourists to truly experience the unparalleled charm of Guilin's scenery. Full text 

attractions.name: 漓江古东景区-古东瀑布景区
attractions.name_en: Lijiang Gudong Scenic Area - Gudong Waterfall Scenic Area
attractions.summary: The Gudong Waterfall Scenic Area attracts tourists' attention with its unique natural scenery. The waterfall presents a dual charm of strip-shaped and blocky forms. The strip-shaped waterfall dances lightly in the wind, with soft and graceful lines. In places with large drops, it is like a silver spear breaking through the air, showing the interweaving of strength and softness. The color hierarchy of the waterfall is distinct, with alternating shades of blue, white, and brown. The block shaped waterfall is smooth as new, with a blend of blue and white, making people feel as if they can see the fusion of water and stone, creating a leisurely atmosphere. Standing in the forest area, towering ancient trees and red maple trees stand out among the lush greenery, as if they are the color palette of nature. The ancient vines entwine the ancient trees, and the stream flows gently, adding endless wildness. The air here is fresh, filled with fragrant flowers and bird songs, like a natural oxygen bar, making people feel relaxed and happy. As a natural park near Guilin city, the Gudong Waterfall Scenic Area has vast land and unique waterfall landscapes. The blending of mountains and waters here, with ancient towns, countryside, and forests intertwined, provides tourists with a perfect destination that combines exploration, sightseeing, and leisure. Whether it's climbing high and looking into the distance, or exploring the depths, this is the perfect choice, making people linger and forget to leave.
