attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 苏州中心广场
attractions.summary: Suzhou Center is the core component of Suzhou Central Plaza, which is divided into two buildings. The northern district focuses on international fast fashion, family, and parent-child activities, while the southern district focuses on light luxury and dining. There are numerous brands gathered here, as well as an aerial ecological park, which forms a unified urban architectural image with the Oriental Gate and Jinji Lake.

attractions.name: 诚品书店(诚品生活苏州店)
attractions.summary: Eslite Bookstore is not so much a bookstore as a comprehensive building with bookstores as its main body. The entire building is built with a strong sense of design, and from the east gate, you can see the iconic 72 step staircase that is 18 meters high and 6 meters wide, which is very magnificent. The bookstore sells a large number of books and thoughtfully sets aside areas for customers to sit down and read. In addition, exquisite stationery stores, dessert shops, coffee shops, restaurants, and clothing stores are distributed on various floors, where literary and artistic youth can stroll around for a whole day. The rich collection of books includes 150000 varieties and 500000 volumes of Chinese and foreign books from 2000 publishing institutions around the world, covering five major book areas: Chinese and foreign literature, humanities and social sciences, art and design, lifestyle, and trend learning. You can see a large number of traditional Chinese books by Taiwanese writers, but the book prices are slightly higher. At the entrance of the book sales area is the "Eslite Selected Books" bookshelf, which lists Eslite's recommended books. It is said that the quality is good and worth a look. An interesting store located in B1 collects and sells small items and handicrafts, such as Suzhou embroidery, Suzhou fans, nuclear carving, woodcut New Year paintings, etc., all of which have local characteristics of Suzhou. The visual laboratory is located in the attic above the art book area, exhibiting art works and decorated in a small and fresh manner. The Eslite Children's Center on the second floor sells children's books and small toys, and customers with children can come here to take a stroll. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州湾王焰温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Suzhou Bay Wangyan Hot Spring is located in Taihu New Town, Wujiang District, Suzhou City. It is a hot spring-themed resort scenic spot integrating catering and accommodation, SPA health care, Chinese and western physiotherapy and outdoor leisure. No matter from the architectural style, aesthetic taste, experience projects, garden design, or style, Wang Yan Hot Spring is a unique and rare leading treasure. Wangyan Hot Spring takes the oriental aesthetic thought of "New Asia" as its source, the cultural heritage of "New Gusu" in the south of the Yangtze River as its foundation, and the natural realm of Taoism of "New Taihu Lake" as its soul. It connects the past and the present, integrates China and the West, and interprets the wonderful fusion of elegance and light luxury, and the mutual composition of classics and fashion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Characteristic hot springs in oriental garden style

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 武侯祠横街
attractions.tag: Strolling through the neighborhood; Traditional/Cultural Experiences
attractions.summary: Wuhou Temple Horizontal Street is located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, and is a street full of historical and cultural atmosphere. This is adjacent to the famous Wuhou Temple and is a great place for tourists to learn about the culture of the Three Kingdoms and the history of Chengdu. The streets are lined with various specialty snack shops and handicraft shops, making it a great place to experience local life and culture in Chengdu.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name_en: Chengdu Wuhou Shrine Museum - Cultural Relics Area

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 成都武侯祠戏台
attractions.summary: The Chengdu Wuhou Temple Stage is located within the Wuhou Temple in Chengdu and is an important cultural site commemorating Zhuge Liang, the Prime Minister of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. As a part of the Wuhou Temple, the stage often performs opera performances related to the Three Kingdoms culture, making it a great place to learn about the Three Kingdoms culture and experience traditional opera art.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 成都欢乐谷
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at No. 16 Xihua Avenue, Jinniu District, Chengdu, next to the Sanshan Road-Jiaotong Interchange, covering an area of approximately 510,000 square meters, about 6.6 kilometers from Tianfu Square, and just 10-20 minutes away from major commercial and entertainment areas in Chengdu.
- Chengdu Happy Valley is the best theme park in the western region, consisting of nine themed areas: Sunshine Harbor, Happy Time, Flying Island, Magic Castle, Silk Road Legend, Happy Lightyear, Bashu Mystique, Mediterranean Adventure, and Caribbean Storm.
- The Magic Castle and Happy Lightyear areas offer family-friendly attractions such as "Crazy Bus," "Bubble Battle," and "Happy Planet," which are highly entertaining for children.
- The park also regularly hosts various events such as the National Style Trendy Play Festival, Music Festivals, Street Art Festivals, Halloween celebrations, and large performances like the Happy Parade, making it a great place for leisure and entertainment.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience thrilling and exciting game attractions.

attractions.name: 成都欢乐谷奥特曼主题馆
attractions.name_en: Chengdu Happy Valley Ultraman Theme Pavilion
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue and exhibition hall; Popular Spots
attractions.summary: The Chengdu Happy Valley Ultraman Theme Hall is the first indoor entertainment venue in southwestern China with Ultraman as its theme, located within the Chengdu Happy Valley. Not only is there a rich collection of Ultraman exhibitions here, but there is also an interactive experience area that allows visitors, especially children, to get up close and understand the world of Ultraman.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 19:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
attractions.name_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
attractions.tag: Mengmeng Animals; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- The Giant Panda Breeding and Research Center fully simulates the natural habitat of the giant panda, featuring lakes, streams, bamboo forests, and lawns. It houses more than 100 giant pandas.
- Near the main entrance, there is a Giant Panda Museum, where you can send postcards stamped with panda-themed postmarks from the Panda Country Post Office, and watch documentaries about giant pandas at the cinema.
- In addition to giant pandas, you can also see other animals like the black-necked crane, peacock, and heron. The Sun and Moon Nurseries house the cutest, newly born and a few months old panda cubs, which are extremely adorable. Highly recommended!
attractions.shortFeatures: The adorable national treasure is waiting for you.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 熊猫时空馆
attractions.summary: The Panda Space Time Hall project is a panda themed high-tech experience hall jointly built by Sichuan Publishing Group and its subsidiary, Shenzhen Pulefang Culture Technology Co., Ltd., on the premise of the new version of the slogan of Sichuan culture and tourism, "The Three Ninth Tianfu National Congress, and Walk in Sichuan at ease" ("Three Ninth National Congress" - Sanxingdui, Jiuzhaigou Valley Scenic and Historic Interest Area, and Giant Panda Cat). The project is located at No. 1688 Panda Avenue, Chenghua District, Chengdu (directly opposite the gate of Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding), close to the Chengdu Mianyang and Chengdu Nanchong expressways, with convenient transportation. The main building area of the project is 8820 square meters, with a total of 14000 square meters of internal and external plazas. The overall structure of the building is U-shaped, with a panda face shaped facade and two above ground floors plus a three story rooftop. It is an experiential service base that combines culture, technology, and tourism to meet the needs of tourists at the Chengdu Giant Panda Breeding Research Base. The project has obvious geographical advantages, including geographic space, industrial policies, and national treasure resources. The city has opened tourist buses for direct access, and it is very convenient to drive, take buses, subways, and taxis. The location is superior and the transportation is convenient. As the main urban area of Chengdu and a well-known old industrial base in Sichuan Province (with 14 industrial relics, accounting for half of Chengdu), Chenghua District has more than 30 square kilometers of usable land space and a five city ecological zone. At the same time, it has the characteristics and development center of Chengdu's tourism industry. It is not only a must visit attraction for traveling to Chengdu, but also a cultural tourism business card of Chengdu. It is also a world giant panda relocation protection, scientific research and breeding, public education, and cultural tourism base. The Panda Space Museum is presented in the form of a commercial complex and cultural output, with high standards and high-quality construction of cultural tourism services and basic supporting facilities within the project area. It has become an important incubation "battlefield" for panda IP, and will become a panda IP incubator, panda science and education research institute, panda base expansion city, and international window exhibition area, creating a fantasy world of "Panda Planet" and a fun amusement park of "Panda Capital". (2) The exhibition hall is themed on "The Power of National Treasures", and the storyline is based on "Wild Pandas" as the creative origin. With an international perspective and the name of "Panda Ambassador", it tells the story of the situation encountered in the process of panda wild release and population self maintenance, as well as the determination to bravely face difficulties, demonstrating the power of "national treasures" and taking on the responsibility of "national treasures". The responsibility of being a "guardian" is to showcase China's unique panda culture with universal values, Transmitting the powerful positive energy of friendship, environmental protection, and cherishing nature and wildlife, and leveraging the "panda culture" to showcase China's positive actions in environmental protection and wildlife conservation to the world, conveying the "Chinese solution", elevating the appearance of panda diplomacy spiritually, demonstrating the great power style and attitude with pandas as carriers, strengthening cultural confidence, and promoting the "going global" of Chinese culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.name: 小雁塔(荐福寺)
attractions.summary: The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located inside Jianfu Temple, named after its shape resembling the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and being smaller than it. Compared to the hustle and bustle of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the Small Wild Goose Pagoda is much quieter. Under the Small Wild Goose Pagoda, there are many exquisite stone sculptures from various dynasties, such as stone Buddhas, stone lions, stone horses, and horse tie stakes, placed outdoors. Tourists who enjoy folk cultural relics should not miss them. The Little Wild Goose Pagoda was built during the reign of Tang Jinglong (707 AD) to accommodate the "eminent monk Yijing" who came back from India to translate Buddhist scriptures. At the beginning of its construction, it had fifteen floors, but due to multiple earthquakes, it now has thirteen floors. There are wooden stairs inside the tower that spiral upwards to reach the top of the tower. Jianfu Temple was founded in the first year of Tang Ruizong's civilization (684 AD), originally located in Kaihua Fang, Chang'an City, Tang Dynasty. It was later destroyed and rebuilt at its current address. The temple preserves a large iron bell cast in 1192 AD (the third year of the Jin Mingchang era). In the Qing Dynasty, the bell would ring here every morning, which is the famous "Yanta Morning Bell". Nowadays, on New Year's Day every year, there is an event held here to ring bells and pray for blessings. In 2007, the Xi'an Museum was built inside the Jianfu Temple, adding a lake surface and new landscaping.

attractions.name: 刘公岛景区
attractions.summary: Liugong Island, located at the mouth of Weihai Bay, faces the Yellow Sea and is backed by Weihai Bay. It is known as the "Peach Blossom Spring on the Sea". The main attractions on the island include Liugong Island National Forest Park, Liugong Island Expo Park, Liugong Island Whale Museum, Qidingshan Battery, and more. There is also a Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895 Museum, making it a memorial site for the war and a patriotic education base. To visit Liugong Island, you need to take a passenger ship from Weihai, which takes about 20 minutes. It is recommended to head west to the nearby Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895 Museum after landing on the island. This is a museum of archaeological sites, mainly featuring Qing Dynasty buildings such as the Beiyang Navy Admiral's Office and the Naval Academy, which truly reproduces the historical appearance of the Beiyang Navy and the War of 1894-1895. After visiting, head north through the exit and enter Liugong Island National Forest Park, which is also one of the few marine parks in China. The park is covered with green pine and cypress trees, with blooming mountain flowers and a very high plant coverage. There is a small zoo in the park, and visitors can see many sika deer in the sika deer house. Afterwards, you can go to the mountain to see the Qidingshan Battery. After visiting, you can take the cable car here and enjoy the Liugong Island Expo Park. From the cable car, you can also overlook the entire Expo Park. In the Expo Park, you can truly understand the history of Liugong Island, and it takes about 2 hours to play the entire park. The "Liu Gong Virtue" area mainly uses huge wall carvings and wood carvings to tell the culture of Liu Gong Island. In the Memorial Hall of the Battle of Jiawu, one can also see the process of the Beiyang Fleet from its formation to its downfall, vividly reproducing the heroic scenes of the war. Outside the memorial hall is the Deng Shichang stone carving that came into view when landing on the island. The buildings outside the exhibition hall are mostly characterized by sloping roofs and a square chimney, which is very distinctive. In addition, tourists can also choose to take a sightseeing bus through the forest and pine forests, and the 20 minute journey can take in a panoramic view of all major attractions. Alternatively, you can choose to take a cruise around the island to experience the full view of Liugong Island. Among them, Courtyard 4 and Courtyard 5 have more than 60 island folk countryside houses, peaceful courtyards, fresh air, counting stars and listening to frogs here, as if returning to childhood. The rich historical and cultural atmosphere, tranquil island nights, bathing in the sea breeze, enjoying the sea view, have a unique flavor in your heart. Liugong Island attracts tourists from home and abroad with its unique natural scenery and rich historical and cultural atmosphere. On the rest island, staying at Liu Gong Island Hotel, you can fully appreciate the beauty of nature, watch the waves bloom, listen to the sound of the waves, bask in the gentle sea breeze, enjoy the tranquility and comfort of a paradise, and experience the peaceful night on the island. It will definitely make your journey unique and exciting. Full text 

attractions.name: 《神游传奇》秀
attractions.summary: A live performance that can run! An immersive stage with real mountains and real waters! 360 degree rotating mobile stand! A comprehensive performance around water, land, and air! Breaking free from the constraints of a single stage performance mode, the stage is placed between natural mountains, waters, and the world. The theater is centered around the audience, with the giant wheel audience seats running back and forth, rotating 360 degrees, surrounded by large stages of different mountain and water forms. The mountains and waters are connected, and people and nature are integrated, allowing the mobile stands that can run to lead the audience to experience the exciting performance of water, land, and air across time and space. Pioneering the combination of natural and cultural landscapes in live performances. The Legend of Journey to the West vividly showcases the essence of China's 5000 year civilization. The story is divided into a prologue and six main chapters, telling various bizarre stories and legends about the land of China since Pangu opened the heavens and the earth. They include the Tianci Huaxia, Ancestral Tribe, Phoenix Nirvana, Eight Immortals Congratulations, Journey to the East to Seek Immortals, Dragon Soaring, and God Bless Huaxia. The perseverance of Hou Yi shooting the sun, the magnificent beauty of Chang'e flying to the moon, the grandeur of flash floods and volcanic eruptions during Yu the Great's flood control, the rippling blue waves, small bridges and flowing water of a paradise, the majestic momentum of dragons and tigers leaping, the prosperity of the Taiping Temple, and the vast opening of real-life dramas. The audience can enjoy the wonderful performance that spans time and space in all directions, including water, land, and air, without leaving their seats. Full text 

Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 创极速光轮
attractions.summary:
The world premiere, Tomorrowland Park shows the future world depicted in the Disney movie Chuang: War Chronicle. 
· Riding a two-wheeled speed light wheel motorcycle, tourists fly past the track under the magnificent dome, and enter the fantasy space where reality and reality can't be distinguished at high speed. 
Visitors in the waiting area can imagine the future world under the color-changing dome, and watch the speedy light wheel fly by to the infectious music. 
The giant dome is undulating, and it will be shocking even when viewed from a distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: A thrilling speed

attractions.name: 七个小矮人矿山车
attractions.summary:
· The Seven Dwarfs mine car is suitable for the whole family to ride together. It is based on the classic Disney animated film Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs. 
Drive tourists into a beautiful mine shining with gemstones, and meet seven dwarfs singing while working. 
Visitors can enjoy the music and animated characters of Disney classic films, and meet helpful forest animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: A roller coaster for the whole family

attractions.name: 探险岛
attractions.summary: Shanghai Disneyland's "Adventure Island" will lead visitors into newly discovered ancient tribes-there are mysterious colors everywhere and hidden treasures. Visitors at the foot of Leiming Mountain can go to the "Monument Exploration Camp" to get out of their own exploration path and prove themselves to be real adventurers; Or travel through time and space in "soaring and flying over the horizon"; You can also board the thrilling raft adventure "Thunder Mountain Rafting" and go deep into the hinterland of "Adventure Island".
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring Ancient Tribes

attractions.name: 爱丽丝梦游仙境迷宫
attractions.summary: Specially designed for Shanghai Disneyland, "Alice in Wonderland Labyrinth" is the first attraction in Disneyland worldwide to feature the theme of Tim Burton's live-action movie Alice in Wonderland. Visitors are free to choose the route to the whimsical world of the labyrinth when heading to the "Crazy Hat Tea Party". In a maze composed of hedges, stone walls, giant flowers and fantastic sculptures, a family adventure will bring endless fun to visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Across the labyrinth for a tea party

attractions.name: 奇想花园
attractions.summary: "Fantasy Garden" is the first theme park with garden design in Disneyland around the world, covering popular attractions such as "Fantasy Carousel" and "Dumbo". Visitors walking through the garden will meet Mickey and his companions, and can go to the viewing ladder to enjoy the stage performance of "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" and "Luminous Phantom Show". Under the starry night sky, the "Fantasy Garden" accompanied by beautiful melody is like a dream, as if a wonderful fairy and her friends were scattering magical magic gold powder in the garden.
attractions.shortFeatures: Includes seven gardens with different styles

attractions.name: 明日世界
attractions.summary: Tomorrow's world is full of endless possibilities and presents a bright vision for the future. Disney uses various innovative technologies to bring a new look to this park: the new interstellar exploration project "Buzz Lightyear Interstellar Rescue" leads visitors to move forward bravely and surpass infinity; The "jetpack aircraft" allows people to break free from the constraints of gravity; The "Chuangsu Speed Light Wheel" is wrapped under a huge semi transparent dome building, transforming into different colors, attracting tourists to step onto the two wheeled light wheel motorcycle queue and challenge one of the thrilling roller coaster projects in Disney parks around the world. Tourists can also experience two interactive experiences specially designed for Shanghai Disneyland next to "Tomorrow's World" - "Star Wars Expedition Base" and "Marvel Heroes Headquarters".

attractions.name: 加勒比海盗——沉落宝藏之战
attractions.name_en: Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure
attractions.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean - The Battle of Fallen Treasures is a heavyweight project in Treasure Cove, telling the story of Captain Jack. Realistic renderings, combined with circular giant screens and cool 3D effects, make people feel as if they are immersed in the real scene of the battle of sunken treasures. In this facility, tourists will also turn into pirates and join Captain Jack's adventure team to explore the treasures hidden by David Jones in the deep sea. Throughout the process, tourists will board a small raft that can accommodate 30 people and cross the battle zone between two pirate fleets. Disney utilizes emerging technology to present the entire naval battle to visitors. Sail and embark on a fun filled sea journey, diving deep into the sea to search for the spoils of war that David Jones has buried beneath - along the way, you will also encounter pirates, mermaids, and even creepy sea monsters. Embark on a journey with the charming pirate, the cunning and charming Captain Jack, and set sail for Treasure Cove!

attractions.name: 奇梦之光幻影秀
attractions.name_en: Ignite the Dream - A Nighttime Spectacular of Magic and Light
attractions.summary: Mickey will show you the wonderful magic of dreams and the magical power of imagination. Follow him and have a swim! Witness the miracle at the center of Shanghai Disneyland! Mickey opens the door to a brand new adventure, presenting infinite and wonderful worlds one by one before your eyes. Through thrilling projection, laser, fountain, and various other visual effects techniques, Mickey will use his magic to turn the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" into a dreamlike new world, while illuminating the dreams in all of us.
