attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 永宁门
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Yongning Gate is the south gate of Xi'an City Wall. It was built in the early Sui Dynasty. At that time, it was the east of the three gates in the south of the imperial city. It was originally called Anmen Gate. It was reserved as the south gate when Han Jian shrank to build a new city in the late Tang Dynasty, and changed to Yongning Gate in the Ming Dynasty. Now Yongning Gate is round-the-island traffic, with South Gate Square outside the gate, South Street inside the gate and Nanguanzheng Street outside the gate.
attractions.shortFeatures: The main entrance of Xi'an City Wall

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《秦始皇和他的地下王国》电影
attractions.name_en: "Qin Shi Huang and His Underground Kingdom" Movie
attractions.summary: The 3D giant screen movie "Qin Shi Huang and His Underground Kingdom" is an 8K quality 3D film and television documentary filmed using SONY F65 digital cameras. As the "eighth wonder of the world", the Terra Cotta Warriors has attracted the attention of the whole world, while the unexplored the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has always been full of fog. "The First Emperor of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor and His Underground Kingdom" combines the new progress of the archaeology of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, approaches the Terra Cotta Warriors limitlessly, unveils the mystery of the Terra Cotta Warriors Mausoleum, and tells the secrets of the huge empire behind the Terracotta Warriors.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

restaurants.name_en: New Recipe Full-day Restaurant Buffet Dinner

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 人民大会堂
attractions.summary:
· Located on the west side of Tiananmen Square in the center of Beijing, it is an important part of Tiananmen Square. 
The Great Hall of the People faces east from west, 336 meters long from north to south, 206 meters wide from east to west, and 46.5 meters high. It covers an area of 150,000 square meters, which is larger than the total building area of the Forbidden City. 
It is an important place for the party, the state and various people's organizations to hold political activities, and it is also a place for Chinese state leaders and people to hold political, diplomatic and cultural activities. 
Usually, there will be some performances in the Great Hall of the People, such as concerts and some Peking Opera performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: The meeting place of the people's congress

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 午门
attractions.summary:
The main entrance of the Forbidden City, the largest of the four gates, has a history of nearly 600 years and is now an important exhibition hall of the Palace Museum. 
There are three doors in the middle of the tower, and a tuck door on each side. The middle door can only be walked once when the emperor, the queen enters the palace on the wedding day, and when the top scholar, the second place and the flowers leave the palace in the final imperial examination. 
This is also the place where the emperor holds important ceremonies. In case of a large-scale triumphant prisoner sacrifice ceremony, the emperor will climb to the Meridian Gate Tower to accept worship.
attractions.shortFeatures: The main entrance of the Forbidden City
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:40)

attractions.name: 太和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Supreme Harmony, commonly known as the Jinluan Hall, is the highest existing palace in China and is known as the first of the "Three Great Halls of the East". 
The interior decoration of the hall is very luxurious, with gold bricks paving the floor, and a throne with golden lacquer cloud dragon patterns, inlaid with thousands of golden dragon patterns, which is exquisite and unusually. 
There are also sundials, bronze turtles, bronze cranes, etc. in front of the temple, and a stone faucet for drainage is installed. During the rainy season, it can present the spectacle of thousands of dragons spitting water. 
At the same time, it is also the center of gravity of the Forbidden City, where it is used to hold various grand ceremonies, such as the emperor's accession to the throne, the emperor's wedding, and the establishment of the queen.
attractions.shortFeatures: The "Golden Temple" in the Forbidden City

attractions.name: 保和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Preservation of Harmony was built in 1420, behind the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and it is one of the three halls outside the Forbidden City. 
The floor in the hall is paved with gold bricks, and there is a carved gold lacquer throne from north to south. The inner and outer eaves are painted with golden dragons and seals, and the ceiling is a front dragon with powder and gold, which is luxurious and rich when matched with the decoration and furnishings that emphasize Dan red. 
The temple had different uses in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Before the ceremony of the Ming Dynasty, the emperor often changed clothes here. In the Qing Dynasty, every New Year's Eve and the 15th day of the first month, the emperor's family banquet and palace examination were held in Baohe Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Roof covered with yellow glazed tiles

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 御花园
attractions.summary:
Located at the northern end of the central axis of the Forbidden City, it covers an area of more than 12,000 square meters. It was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty and named "Palace Houyuan". It was renamed "Imperial Garden" in the Yongzheng Dynasty of the Qing Dynasty. 
The buildings in the park adopt the symmetrical layout of the central axis, and the buildings are mostly leaning against walls. Only a few beautifully shaped pavilions stand in the park, and the space is wide. 
Cypress and locust trees are planted in the garden, with potted plants and bronze statues to add vitality, forming an evergreen scenery all year round, highlighting the Han culture of harmony between man and nature. 
In early spring, the apricot trees next to Chengrui Pavilion in the Royal Garden gradually enter the full bloom period.
attractions.shortFeatures: According to legend, the place where the emperor climbed to enjoy the moon

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 定陵
attractions.summary: The world-famous Ming Thirteen Tombs are located at the southern foot of Tianshou Mountain in Changping District, Beijing. They were first built as long tombs in May of the seventh year of the Yongle reign (1409 AD), and lasted for more than 230 years until the last emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Chongzhen, entered the Siling Mausoleum. During this period, 13 magnificent imperial tombs with golden walls, 7 imperial consort tombs, and 1 eunuch tomb were built here. A total of 13 emperors, 23 empresses, 2 crown princes, over 30 concubines, and 2 eunuchs were buried, making it the most well preserved and buried imperial tomb complex in the world today. The Ming Thirteen Tombs have magnificent architecture, complete system, long history, and high historical and cultural value. The Ming Dingling Mausoleum is the tomb of Emperor Wanli, and the overall layout of the ground buildings is in a front to back circular shape, symbolizing the ancient Chinese philosophical concept of "the sky is round and the earth is round". The construction of Dingling began as early as the lifetime of Emperor Wanli. It started in the twelfth year of Wanli (1584 AD) and took six years to complete, consuming eight million taels of silver. The emperor was only 28 years old when the tomb was built, and it was not officially put into use until 1620. The tomb remained unused for 30 years. Dingling has become one of the three cemeteries among the Thirteen Tombs.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 中国人民革命军事博物馆
attractions.name_en: Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution
attractions.tag: Venue exhibition hall; Military Sites; Museums
attractions.summary:
Founded in 1959, China's only large-scale comprehensive military history museum is one of the top ten buildings in the capital dedicated to the 10th anniversary of the National Day. 
The whole building is upright and magnificent, with 7 floors in the center, 4 floors on both sides, and a tall military emblem on the top floor. 
The exhibition is divided into the Agrarian Revolutionary War Hall, the War of Resistance against Japan Hall, the National Liberation War Hall, the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea Hall, the Ancient War Hall, etc.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 颐和园-长廊
attractions.summary: The Summer Palace Corridor is located on the north bank of Kunming Lake, south of Wanshou Mountain, and was built during the Qianlong period. The long corridor was damaged during the invasion of Beijing by the British and French armies, and was rebuilt in 1888. Currently, it is one of the scenic spots worth visiting in the Summer Palace. There are a large number of murals painted on both sides of the corridor, and the richness of the paintings has once been recorded in the Guinness World Records.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 首钢工业遗址公园
attractions.summary: The Shougang Industrial Site Park is located in Lianshi Lake, the largest lake of Yongding River in Shijingshan. Shijingshan District is divided into three sections from north to south according to the natural flow of Yongding River, and three theme parks are built. The middle section is the Shougang area, and a total area of 70 hectares of Shougang Waterfront Park - Shougang Industrial Site Park is constructed. In January 2018, it was selected for the first batch of China's industrial heritage protection list.

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 北海公园
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Enjoying Autumn Leaves
attractions.summary:
·Beihai Park is located in the center of Beijing and is the oldest existing classical royal garden in China, with the most complete preservation and the deepest cultural heritage.  
·The park is centered around Beihai Lake and is divided into four main areas: the "North Shore Scenic Area," "East Shore Scenic Area," "Qiong Island Scenic Area," and "Tuan City Scenic Area."  
·The vast water area is rare in Beijing, and the best time for boating and sightseeing in the park is in the evening, when one can admire imperial architecture and sit by the lake, chatting with elderly locals about the royal history of the capital.  
·On the east shore, there are several courtyard-style gardens such as Hao Pu Jian, Hua Fang Zhai, and Can Tan, which are hidden among the ancient pines and cypress trees. These gardens not only have a natural charm but also exude the elegance of a private garden in southern China.  
·On the north shore, from east to west, there are Jingxin Zhai, Western Heaven, Chengguan Hall, the Nine-Dragon Wall, Chanfu Temple, and the World of Bliss. The Five-Dragon Pavilion is dotted along the lake, blending seamlessly with the natural landscape, creating a scene that seems entirely natural, like a masterpiece of landscape painting.  
·Beihai Park is home to one of the Eight Scenic Spots of Yanjing, "Qiong Island Spring Shade," which will reach its best viewing period in April. The blooming flowers, beautiful rocks, and captivating scenery make it a particularly enchanting sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Royal Garden of Bai Ta Lake, intertwined with water.

attractions.name: 中国国家博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
With a total construction area of nearly 200,000 square meters and a collection of more than 1 million pieces, it is the largest museum in the world. 
The museum is divided into five floors and has 48 exhibition halls. It is one of the museums with the richest collection of Chinese cultural relics. 
The exhibition system consists of basic exhibition, special exhibition, international exchange exhibition and temporary exhibition, covering all stages from ancient times to the present. 
· There are a large number of visitors, so you can make an appointment online before going to save time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at Chinese Treasures through Millenniums

attractions.name: 雍和宫
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast corner of the inner city of Dongcheng District, Beijing, that is, east of Yonghegong Street Road, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist temple in Beijing. 
In the thirty-second year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it became the residence of Yinzhen, the fourth son of the emperor. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Zhaotai Gate, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, Yonghe Gate, Lama Temple, Lecture Hall and Tantric Hall present the standard layout of "seven halls and blue blues" in Chinese Buddhist temples. 
· From the east-west memorial archway with cornices and arches to the antique east-west Shunshan Tower, there are more than a thousand halls in total, which are very luxurious and worth visiting
attractions.shortFeatures: Lived in two emperors Yongzheng and Qianlong

attractions.name: 北京孔庙
attractions.summary: The Beijing Confucian Temple is located on Guozijian Street, adjacent to Guozijian. It was first built in the Yuan Dynasty and was a place for worshipping Confucius during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. The Beijing Confucian Temple, revered by royal emperors throughout history, holds a high status and has undergone multiple renovations. In terms of specifications and status, it is the second largest Confucian temple in the country, second only to the Qufu Confucian Temple. At present, the Confucius Temple and the nearby Guozijian are open for visitors as the Confucius Temple and Guozijian Museum, with unified ticket sales. The ticket office is located next to the gate of the Confucius Temple. After purchasing tickets, you can first enter the Confucius Temple for sightseeing. After sightseeing, you can enter the Guozijian for sightseeing at the "Chijing Gate" next to the Confucius Temple Stele Pavilion. The total travel time for the two places is about 3-4 hours, with the Confucian Temple section taking about 2 hours. When visiting numerous Yuan Dynasty buildings and visiting Confucian temples, the first thing to pay attention to is the architecture inside the courtyard. Some of the buildings inside the Confucian Temple have undergone generations of repairs, but still maintain the style of the Yuan Dynasty. For example, the first master's gate at the gate is the Xieshan roof of the Dadu Arch. This kind of building is rare in Beijing, and you can have a good visit. The entire courtyard is antique and has many famous ancient trees. The environment is quaint and elegant, and you can take photos here. The numerous stone tablets and pavilions that can be seen everywhere are another highlight of the Confucius Temple. There are numerous stone tablets and pavilions in various courtyards of the Confucius Temple. There are inscriptions on famous scholars such as Yuan Chonghuan, Lin Zexu, and Li Hongzhang, as well as a register of over 50000 scholars from the Yuan Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty. There is also a forest of steles engraved with all thirteen Confucian classics. These numerous ancient steles are very precious, and their contents are also worth visiting. Another well-known activity of watching traditional ritual and music performances and visiting Confucian temples is watching traditional ritual and music performances. In the Chongsheng Temple located deep inside the Confucian Temple, there are several performances of the traditional ritual and music dance "Dacheng Ritual and Music" every day. The performances are held at 10:00, 11:00, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00 (the number of performances may sometimes decrease depending on the season and the number of tourists), with each performance lasting half an hour. There are chapters such as "Xue Er", "Fu Xi", "Guan Ju", "Da Tong", etc. The atmosphere of traditional Chinese culture is strong and very exciting. You can pay attention to the time to visit. In addition, there are also the Dacheng Hall, a temple dedicated to Confucius, the Chongsheng Temple, an exhibition hall showcasing the historical evolution of the Confucius Temple, and the National Studies Museum, among others, all located within the temple. Here, you can see the ritual vessels, tablets, and historical evolution of Confucian temples dedicated to Confucius, and learn about and visit them one by one. Full text 

attractions.name: 国子监
attractions.summary:
Located in Guozijian Street, Andingmen, Beijing, adjacent to Confucius Temple and Lama Temple, it is the highest administrative institution of state management education in Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties in China and the highest institution of learning established by the state. 
Confucius Temple is a part of imperial academy, formerly known as imperial academy Confucius Temple or Capital Confucius Temple. It is the place where the emperor held the national ceremony of offering sacrifices to Confucius. It and imperial academy form the system of "left temple and right study". 
October-April is the best tourist season every year, with warm spring flowers and pleasant climate. You can also stroll around Huangchenggen Park and enjoy flowers and birds, which is very pleasant. 
Wisteria flower is one of the characteristics of the scenic spot, and many tourists come here every spring.
attractions.shortFeatures: State education departments in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 前门大街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Beijing's famous commercial street, located on the central axis of Beijing, starts from Moon Bay and ends at Tianqiao intersection, connecting with Tianqiao South Street. 
The street is about 845 meters long. It was called Zhengyangmen Street from the Ming Dynasty, Qing Dynasty to the Republic of China, and it was commonly known as Qianmen Street by the people. In 1965, it was officially named Qianmen Street. 
There are many famous time-honored shops, such as Quanjude and Donglaishun, including Dashilan and Xianyukou Hutong. 
While the original time-honored stores and traditional business characteristics have basically been preserved, new stores such as clothing department stores, food, clocks and clocks have been opened one after another.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beijing-style old commercial street

attractions.name: 大栅栏
attractions.summary:
· Dashilan, pronounced "dàshílànr", is a famous commercial street outside Qianmen in Beijing. 
· Located in the center of old Beijing, it is an important part of the south central axis. It is located south of Tiananmen Square and west of Qianmen Street, with a total length of 275 meters from the east exit to the west exit. 
There are rows of shopping, dining, entertainment and other shops in the block, and all the time-honored brands are arranged among them, which is a must-choice place to experience Beijing culture. 
It was once the entertainment center of Beijing. Many famous theaters, teahouses, bookstores and the earliest cinemas in Beijing history have settled here. It is worth visiting.

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 南岸嘴
attractions.summary: A green dragon and a yellow dragon meet here-Nan'anzui is an extraordinary place in China's geography and is known as "the first corner of China". Because it is the impact zone formed by the confluence of the Yangtze River, the largest river in China, and the Han River, the largest tributary of the Yangtze River. Some people say that Nan'anzui is where China's Dantian is located, which means that it is the place where China's essence is most concentrated.

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 龟山公园-铁门关
attractions.tag: Historic site; Military Sites; Historical Sites
attractions.summary: For hundreds of years from the Three Kingdoms period to the early Tang Dynasty, Tiemenguan has been an important military fortress in Wuhan, and has experienced many fierce offensive and defensive battles. In the fourth year of Tang Wude (AD 621), with the construction of Hanyang City, the military role of Tiemenguan was gradually weakened, and it became an important channel for cultural, economic and trade exchanges, and at the same time became a tourist attraction. At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Tiemenguan was destroyed, leaving only the earth foundation wall base. At the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, Guandi Temple was built on the remaining earth foundation. In the early years of the Republic of China, due to war, the ruins of Tiemenguan together with the temple became ruins. In December 1990, Tiemenguan was rebuilt.
attractions.shortFeatures: Strong ethnic architectural style

attractions.name: 汉阳造艺术区
attractions.summary:

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.

Simple stalls line up in a row, offering a wide variety of local delicacies. When enjoying the feast, you can also enjoy folk performances full of "Han flavor", which are extremely lively. attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement

attractions.name: 第二海水浴场
attractions.summary: If you go south along Ningwu Pass Road to explore Badaguan, you will come to the second beach next to Huashi Tower. The bathhouse and Badaguan complement each other, forming a typical beautiful landscape of "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky" in Qingdao. Therefore, couples often take wedding photos here, making it a popular location for outdoor filming. The beach of the second bath is slightly smaller than the first beach, but there are fewer tourists here and the environment is better. The beach shore here is made of reddish brown rocks, with cliffs as steep as knives, and black pine trees planted all over the shore, creating a pleasant environment. Even if you come here to take a stroll and bask in the sun, it is still quite comfortable. And the seawater in the second bath is relatively clean, with small waves and gentle slopes, making it a summer swimming destination. There are many pebbles on the western beach of the bathhouse, and visitors often come to pick them up. Due to the abundance of reefs in this area, it is suitable for picking up shells, and even living creatures such as hermit crabs and starfish can be seen. The sandy beach here is relatively fine, so it is suitable for walking barefoot here, and children can also play digging sand. There is also a stone embankment bridge that extends into the sea, where you can walk and feel closer to the ocean.

attractions.name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.
attractions.shortFeatures: Decoding the Production Process of Tsingtao Beer

attractions.name: 八大关

attractions.summary:
Badaguan refers to eight roads named after the eight passes of the Great Wall (now it has been increased to ten). Because there are villas with architectural styles from more than 20 countries, such as Russia, Britain, France, Germany and Mai, it is known as the "World Architecture Expo". 
Huashi Building and Princess Building in Guannei are the most famous, with unique architectural styles and need to charge tickets. They are must-punch places here. 
In addition to viewing buildings, you can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of Badaguan in the four seasons. Shaoguan Road is full of peaches, which bloom in spring; Lagerstroemia indica is planted all over Zhengguan Road, which blooms in summer; Juyongguan Road is a five-angled maple, which is dyed with maple red in autumn frost; There are rows of cedar trees on both sides of Zijingguan Road, which are evergreen all year round.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn viewing resort with red leaves in autumn

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 青山渔村
attractions.summary: Qingshan Fishing Village is located in Laoshan Scenic Area, Laoshan District, Qingdao. Halfway up the mountainside of Laoshan Mountain, it still retains the original style of the fishing village. It has the reputation of Laoshan Fishing Village Folk Customs Museum
attractions.shortFeatures: Featuring fisherman culture

attractions.name: 崂山太清游览区
attractions.summary: The Taiqing Scenic Area is located at the southeast end of Laoshan Mountain, named after the Taoist temple Taiqing Palace. It is mainly divided into two tourist areas: the surrounding area of Taiqing Palace and along the Bashui River. The former is located by the sea, while the latter is a hiking route. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".

attractions.name: 黄岛金沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 

attractions.name: 西双版纳傣族园
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
- Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park is composed of five well-preserved Dai natural villages, namely Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga.
- Upon entering the park, the first thing you encounter is the Welcome Square, where you are greeted by warm-hearted Dai people performing welcome dances, singing blessings, and sprinkling water for good wishes.
- The park also houses the Manchunman Ancient Buddhist Temple, one of the oldest temples in Xishuangbanna, with a history of over 1,400 years. Every day, you can hear the sound of chanting inside the temple.
- The grandest festival for the Dai people in Xishuangbanna is the Water-Splashing Festival. At the Water-Splashing Square in the Dai Ethnic Park, you can experience the lively scenes of the festival every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Accept the warm welcome dance of the Dai people.

attractions.name: 江边夜市
attractions.summary: Jinghong has several night markets, among which the riverside night market is one of the hottest and most visited by tourists. This is also one of the night markets that locals like to go to, and it is extremely popular. Every night is a crowded rhythm, and the night market mainly focuses on delicious food and handicrafts. There are Dai style barbecue snacks, freshly squeezed fruit juice, banana balada and other specialty snacks that can be eaten from the street to the end without getting bored.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 曼听公园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
