attractions.name: 夜上黄鹤楼
attractions.name_en: Night Tour Of Yellow Crane Tower
attractions.summary: Night at the Yellow Crane Tower "was jointly created by the Wuhan Garden Bureau, Wuhan Tourism and Sports Group, and the Yellow Crane Tower Park. It is a cultural tourism performance that integrates real-life, immersive, and experiential elements, and has been open for night tours since the reconstruction and completion of the Yellow Crane Tower in 1985. The project is based on the Yellow Crane Tower Park and revolves around its unique historical and cultural heritage. It adopts a combination of sound, light, and electricity techniques, incorporating artistic performances and park tour modes. Through high-tech light and shadow technology, it creates a new experience of urban landmark night tours. Both the west and south gates of the Yellow Crane Tower Park allow visitors to enter the park, and both tour routes allow for free observation of performances. Tourists can choose according to their preferences and experience the excitement of night tours during peak hours. South Gate - Goose Pool - Poetry Stele Gallery - Cui Hao Poetry Wall and Pen Stop Pavilion - Ascending the Yellow Crane Tower - Main Building Show West Gate - Main Building Show - Ascending the Yellow Crane Tower - Cui Hao Poetry Wall and Pen Stop Pavilion - Poetry Stele Gallery - Goose Pool TIPS: Tourists can also quickly travel from the Yellow Crane Tower Square to Goose Pool through Zizhu Garden, and the exciting content will not be missed again. Enter the park from the South Gate, which is the Goose Pool at the Yellow Crane Tower at night. The lights reflect the emerald green lotus leaves and micro powdered lotus flowers, creating a summer atmosphere. As the story of "The Origin of the Crane" unfolds, the Yellow Crane Fairy dances on the water, the fountain in the pool blooms like a flower, and the water curtain and clothes are illuminated with dreamy colors by the lights. The elegant landscape scenery on the Poetry Stele Gallery lights up endlessly in a cycle. It is worth mentioning that recently, there has been an additional QR code at both ends of the long corridor. Tourists can scan the code and send real-time bullet comments on the scroll. Come and experience it now! There is a scenery in front of me that cannot be understood. Cui Hao wrote a poem on top of it. "Cui Hao wrote a poem and Li Bai stopped writing. In order to commemorate this interesting story between poets, the Cui Hao Poetry Wall was built opposite the Li Bai Stop Writing Pavilion. Dance performances are held three times a night, with actresses dressed in ancient costumes dancing in the Songbi Pavilion, their graceful movements reminiscent of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. After watching the dance at the Jiebi Pavilion, turning around, Cui Hao wrote a poem on the wall. I don't know if Li Bai came up with even more brilliant poems when facing Cui Hao's "Yellow Crane Tower" every day. Turtle and Snake Lock the Great River, Yellow Crane Tower is located at the top of Snake Mountain. Climbing up to the main building, you can overlook the magnificent Yangtze River that flows through the city for thousands of miles. The majestic river and the dazzling night view of the city are all within reach. The Yellow Crane Tower Light and Shadow Show showcases the rich history with dynamic lighting. Through the combination of architectural design with animated light and shadow, as well as the rendering of lighting design, the classic story of the Yellow Crane Tower, which is widely known, is reinterpreted on the building, with magnificent visuals and dazzling light and shadow. Tourists stop in front of the building to watch the movie, and the vicissitudes of history come to life, bringing the stories of the past to life before their eyes. The Yellow Crane Tower at night narrates the wonderful story of the other side of Jiangcheng from a unique perspective. A small fan brings a slight coolness, and the long summer days linger. This summer, welcome to unlock new gameplay on the Yellow Crane Tower at night! Full text 

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 鲁迅广场
attractions.summary: Lu Xun Square is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, on the left side of Changtian Tower. There is a half body statue of Lu Xun built on the square, surrounded by lush pine and cypress trees, colorful flowers, green trees, and solemn and dignified surroundings. The square echoes the Xingyin Pavilion to the south, with one side commemorating the great patriotic poet Qu Yuan of ancient times and the other side commemorating the leader of the modern New Culture Movement, Lu Xun.

attractions.name: 行吟阁
attractions.summary: Xingyin Pavilion is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a landmark building of the entire Donghu Lake. The Xingyin Pavilion is surrounded by water on all sides, and can be reached by the Tingtao Pavilion via the Lotus Wind Bridge. The other side is connected to the land by the Falling Feather Bridge. Xingyin Pavilion was built in 1955, named after the phrase "Qu Yuan was released and swam by the river and pool, singing along the banks of the river" in the poem "Fisherman's Father" in Chu Ci. This pavilion is an antique brick and wood building, actually constructed with reinforced concrete. The pavilion is 22.5 meters high, square in plan, with four corners and a spire, three stories of cornices, covered with green tiles, antique. A statue of Qu Yuan stands in front of the pavilion, with a height of 3.6 meters, a pedestal height of 3.2 meters, and a total height of 6.8 meters. He looked up at the sky with his head held high, taking a step to walk as if he were reciting the "Tianwen" by the edge of the river. On all sides of the platform, there are beautiful trees and flowers scattered, and the island is surrounded by weeping willows and palm trees, embellished with elegance and a broad artistic conception. Inside the Xingyin Pavilion, there are columns and spiral staircases that allow visitors to climb up layer by layer. There are windows on the second and third floors for visitors to admire. Climbing up to the Xingyin Pavilion and looking around, there is even a magnificent scene.

attractions.name: 长天楼
attractions.summary: Changtian Tower is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, with the left side leading to Bitan for fish watching and the right side being Lu Xun Square. Changtian Tower was built in 1956 with a total area of 1775 square meters. It is a palace style building with a brick, wood, and cement structure. The small building has two floors, with a width of 7 rooms and a depth of 2 rooms. The building is open and clean, with interesting railings and straight colonnades at both ends, leading to the left and right pavilions. The front of the building is spacious, and behind it is a small courtyard with flower walls and moon doors that lead to the back mountain. Tourists can gaze out of the window and see the vast expanse of blue waves, wanting to catch up with the blue sky, feeling the emotion of 'autumn water grows together and the sky becomes one color'.

attractions.name: 九女墩
attractions.summary: Jiunvdun is located on the northwest bank of Wuhan East Lake in Tingtao Scenic Area. According to legend, nine women who participated in the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom rebel army died bravely here, and their remains were buried here by the villagers. At that time, in order to avoid persecution by the Qing government, it was called a pier instead of a grave. There is a 70-square-meter platform in front of the tomb of Jiunvdun, surrounded by guardrails, and a magnificent monument in the middle. The monument was built in 1952, made of granite, and is more than 8 meters high. It is engraved with inscriptions and inscriptions written by Dong Biwu, Soong Ching Ling, Guo Moruo, He Xiangning, Zhang Nanxian and others. There are six copper bells hanging at the top, and the wind blows the bells, just like the fierce battle of martyrs and heroes running on the battlefield.
attractions.shortFeatures: In memory of the nine women of the rebels

attractions.name: 可竹轩
attractions.summary: Kezhuxuan is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan. It was founded in 1958, taking inspiration from Su Shi's saying "I would rather eat meat than live without bamboo". This is an ancient architectural corridor imitating bamboo art, with single-layer eaves, blue tiled walls, colorful eaves, staggered pavilions, and winding corridors, exuding an antique charm. It stands quietly in the Cangbai Park, deep in the green shade, surrounded by emerald bamboo, elegant and unique, appearing quaint and elegant. The emerald bamboo and camphor trees exude a scholarly atmosphere everywhere. Around the Kezhu Pavilion, there are old camphor trees that have been planted for a hundred years. Behind the pavilion, there are hundreds of bamboo poles, swaying in the wind with an audible sound. There is a Zhou Cangbai Memorial Room inside the building, which displays images, texts, and physical materials related to Zhou Cangbai, including the piano used by Mr. Zhou before his death.

attractions.name: 湖光阁
attractions.summary: Huguang Pavilion is located on a small island in the center of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, north of Moshan Scenic Area and south of Tingtao Scenic Area. It is the main garden building of the central island of the lake. Huguang Pavilion was built in 1931, originally named "Zhongzheng Pavilion", and renamed "Huguang Pavilion" after liberation. The Huguang Pavilion is a typical tower style building connected to the land by a ten mile long embankment. The attic has three floors, with green eaves and antique style tiles. Ascending to the attic, one can take in a panoramic view of the surrounding lakes and mountains. The Huguang Pavilion is connected to the Xuhai Beach Bathing Beach, where visitors can climb up to enjoy the scenery and play in the sand and water below, creating endless fun.

attractions.name: 寓言雕塑园
attractions.summary: The Fable Garden is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a fable sculpture garden based on ancient Chinese fables. More than 20 ancient allegorical story sculptures with profound meanings have been built, including Yu Gong moving mountains, covering his ears and stealing bells, fox pretending to be a tiger's power, Mr. Dongguo, playing the flute for numbers, self contradiction, blind people touching elephants, playing the qin for cows, waiting for rabbits by the trees, praying with his arm as a carriage, and oil sellers. They are vivid and lifelike. Fable sculptures are mainly composed of large blocks, with various variations of characters depicted using vertical and parallel lines to depict detailed patterns. The relief group named "Yu Gong Moves the Mountain" is 40 meters long and 6 meters wide, with a magnificent momentum. These sculptures, with their antique, vivid, and simple shapes, not only bring joy to tourists, but also have a great educational significance.

attractions.name: 碧潭观鱼
attractions.summary: The pavilions and pavilions with the layout of fish watching in Bitan are ingenious, which not only reflects the architectural features of Chu's preference to build pavilions near the water, but also has a kind feeling of holding water with your hands. The winding Jiuqu Bridge is connected with the green tile pavilion, forming the most beautiful place in East Lake. East Lake has been raising goldfish since 1951, and now it has bred more than 80 varieties of goldfish, including a "red high head" with a big red hydrangea on its head; A "lion's head" with wings and a wide and raised head; "Goose Top Red" wearing silver armor and a little red tassel; The "Mo Long" covered in pure ink paint, light, brave and enchanting; Short tail, round body, colorful "five-flower egg ball" and so on. Visitors can watch fish or fish here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pavilions and pavilions with character layout

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 东湖绿道
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; On foot; Hiking; Hiking/Biking
attractions.summary:
East Lake Greenway is located in East Lake Eco-tourism Scenic Area, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, with a total length of about 101.98 kilometers. It is the longest greenway around the lake in the core area of 5A-level cities in China. 
East Lake Greenway is divided into seven themed landscape roads: Tingtao Road, Huzhong Road, Baima Road, Country Road, Forest Road, Moshan Road and Hushan Road. It fully relies on eight natural features of East Lake Mountain, Forest, Ze, Garden, Island, Embankment, Field and Bay, and turns East Lake into an "ecological green heart" of the city where citizens are close to nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: Leisure trails connecting many scenic spots in East Lake

attractions.name: 武汉植物园
attractions.tag: Treasure spot for walking kids; Enjoy autumn flowers; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- The Wuhan Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was established in 1956. It is one of the three core national botanical gardens, integrating scientific research, species conservation, science popularization, and leisure tourism. It has collected and cultivated more than 10,293 plant species, primarily focusing on plant resources from the Central China region and inland aquatic plants of China. It serves as the most important base for plant species diversity and genetic resource preservation in Central China, with the largest aquatic plant resource garden and kiwi germplasm resource garden in the world.
- The Wuhan Botanical Garden is a national AAAA-level scenic area and has been recognized as a National Science Popularization Education Base, National Youth Science and Technology Education Base, and a base for science popularization, environmental education, and patriotism education in Hubei Province and Wuhan City.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciating Seasonal Flowers in Gardens Around the World

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 辛亥革命武昌起义纪念馆
attractions.summary: The predecessor of the Wuchang Uprising Memorial Hall was the Hubei Consultative Bureau in the late Qing Dynasty. In October 1911, the first shot of the Xinhai Revolution was fired in Wuchang. After the successful uprising, the revolutionary party established a military government here. The main body of the memorial hall is a small building with red walls and tiles, commonly known as the "Red Chamber" by locals. The memorial hall, founded in 1909, is a two-story brick and wood Western style building. There are currently two themed displays in the museum. One is the "Restoration Exhibition of the Former Site of the Governor General's Office of the Hubei Army", which reproduces the scene of the early establishment of the Governor's Office. From the display, we can learn about the organizational structure of the military government in its early days. There is also a flag on display, called the Eighteen Star Flag, which is the military flag of the Wuchang Uprising. The eighteen yellow stars represent the descendants of Yan and Huang from the eighteen provinces within Shanhaiguan. The other main exhibition is the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution", which showcases the historical scene of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution through cultural relics, pictures, and models. Here, you can also see portraits of figures related to the Wuchang Uprising. There is also a photo of a woman in the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution". The person in the photo is Zhang Zhujun, the president of the Shanghai Red Cross Society. During the Wuchang Uprising, she organized a civilian medical team and disguised revolutionary party member Huang Xing as a doctor of the Red Cross Society, taking her on a ship to Wuhan. Full text 

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 太原古县城景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Taiyuan Ancient County City is located in Jinyuan District, covering an area of approximately 0.8 square kilometers. There are numerous historical architectural remains in the city, with a clear cross street layout and a well-developed street and alley texture. It follows the ancient architectural pattern of the "Phoenix Soaring in the City" of Jinyang Ancient City, resembling a phoenix with a head to the north and a tail to the south. It has been known as the "Phoenix City" since ancient times and is an extension of the 2500 year cultural heritage of Jinyang Ancient City. There are 79 existing cultural relics buildings in the city, and 49 historical buildings listed for protection by the Taiyuan Municipal Government. Among them, the Confucian Temple has been listed as a national key cultural relic protection unit.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-21:00(Tickets available until 20:00; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 柳巷
attractions.shortFeatures: A bustling commercial street with a long history in Taiyuan

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 双塔寺
attractions.summary: The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

attractions.shortFeatures: One of Manjushri's ashrams

attractions.name: 天龙山石窟
attractions.summary: The Tianlong Mountain Grottoes are located on the mountainside of Tianlong Mountain, 40 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City. Tianlong Mountain was originally named Fangshan. In the Northern Qi Dynasty, after the construction of Tianlong Temple at the foot of the mountain, this mountain was called Tianlong Mountain. This was once the summer palace of Gao Huan, the father of the Northern Qi Emperor Gao Yang. Tianlong Mountain has beautiful scenery, surrounded by undulating mountains and lush pine and cypress forests. The Dragon King Stone Cave on the top of the mountain has rippling springs, and the streams in front of the mountain are clear and gurgling. The Tianlongshan Grottoes are located at the waist of the cliffs on the east and west peaks of Tianlongshan Mountain. There are 24 caves excavated by the Eastern Wei, Northern Qi, Sui, and Tang dynasties, including eight caves on the east peak, thirteen caves on the west peak, and three caves on the north side of the mountain. There are over 1500 statues and 1144 reliefs, cofferdams, and portraits in the Coexistence Grottoes. The Tianlongshan Grottoes are known for their mature, full, refined techniques, and meticulous expression of emotions, which are close to the life atmosphere of laborers. They are characterized by strong ethnic and local characteristics, and are known for their "small but refined" nature.

attractions.name: 太山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Located in the north of Fengyugou, 23 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City. Surrounded by jungles, ancient cypresses, and temples hidden in the middle, it is not easy to see unless you climb. The name of Taishan first appeared in Song Shu written by Shen Yue. It is said that in the Northern Han Dynasty, there was a mountain man Shi Gandang, who was famous for his bravery, and the mountain where he lived was also famous all over the world. 
It is particularly worth mentioning that on May 8th, 2008, a hexagonal underground palace was discovered in Longquan Temple in Taishan, which amazed the archaeological community. There were five relics buried in the underground palace. Taiyuan TV broadcast live the whole process of archaeologists opening the stone letter and golden coffin. In the amazed eyes of the audience, five coffins were opened heavily... silver coffins and golden coffins were dazzling and ingenious, and the answer was finally kept in the golden coffins. Experts said that for fear that the technical means are imperfect and the precious cultural relics in the golden coffin cannot be properly protected, the last layer of the coffin will be opened at another time. Even so, Shanxi people still feel the mystery of archaeological excavation of cultural relics in a brand-new way. Even the soft ribbon on the silver coffin has inspired many people's associations. More than 1300 years later, you can still see the true appearance of Tang Dynasty silk, and the audience is excited. The underground palace of Longquan Temple is the only underground palace where relics of the Tang Dynasty have been buried so far in Shanxi. 
Internal attractions: Daxiong Hall, Longquan Temple, Li Cunxiao Tomb and so on
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous for its red leaves in late autumn

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 佛顶宫
attractions.summary:
Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 夫子庙大成殿
attractions.summary:
Dacheng Hall of Confucius Temple is the main hall of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. The largest portrait of Confucius in China hangs in the center of the hall. 
The furnishings in the hall imitate fifteen kinds of ancient musical instruments such as chimes and chimes 2,500 years ago, and regularly perform ancient songs and elegant music. 
The main hall is surrounded by murals of Confucius' achievements, with both form and spirit. The temple is surrounded by two stele galleries, and there are thirty original inscriptions of Mo Bao written by famous calligraphers such as Zhao Puchu, Lin Sanzhi, Shen Peng and Wu Zhongqi on the wall. 
The stele gallery displays the Yuhua Stone exhibition, which is known as "the unique thing in China". Exhibitions of other historical relics and works of art are often organized in Dacheng Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Offering Sacrifices and Understanding Confucius' Hall

attractions.name: 中国科举博物馆(江南贡院)
attractions.summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

attractions.name: 王导谢安纪念馆
attractions.summary: The Wang Dao Xie An Memorial Hall is located in Wuyi Lane on the south bank of the Qinhuai River at the Confucius Temple in Nanjing. It is a thematic exhibition hall that showcases the culture and art of the Six Dynasties and the family backgrounds of Wang and Xie. There are buildings such as Laiyan Hall and Jianjin Tower in the museum, displaying precious cultural relics from the Six Dynasties period. This was once the barracks of the Jianye Forbidden Army, the capital of Eastern Wu. Because soldiers were dressed in black at that time, the alley was named "Wuyi", and to this day, there is still a glimpse of the "Wuyi Well" in the alley. During the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Wuyi Lane was a residential area for high-ranking officials and nobles in the imperial court. The houses in the alley are towering and arranged in rows. During the Six Dynasties period, representative figures of the Wang Xie family, including Wang Dao and Xie An, lived here. During the Tang Dynasty, Liu Yuxi visited this place and wrote the timeless masterpiece "Wild grass and flowers by Zhuque Bridge, sunset slanting at the entrance of Wuyi Lane. In the past, swallows flew into ordinary people's homes in front of Wang Xietang".
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-22:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 李香君故居
attractions.summary: The story of Li Xiangjun and the talented scholar Hou Fangyu is well-known in the ancient capital of the Six Dynasties. Naturally, when you come to this land of golden powder in the Six Dynasties, how can you not read the legend of the Eight Beauties of Qinhuai? The former residence of Li Xiangjun, also known as the "Meixiang Tower", is a typical Qing Dynasty river hall and river house building with three entrances and two courtyards. The style is exquisite and elegant, displaying some ancient calligraphy, painting, seal carving, and also restoring Li Xiangjun's living conditions at that time. Let's unfold 'Peach Blossom Fan' and reminisce about the entanglement of a chaotic era. The Li Xiangjun Former Residence Exhibition Hall is located at the southern end of Laiyan Bridge in Confucius Temple, at No. 38 Chaoku Street. The hall faces south and north, with three entrances and two courtyards, facing the food street, backed by the Qinhuai River, with blue bricks and small tiles, horsehead walls, hanging corridors, and lattice windows. It is a typical Jiangnan residential style. There are sedan halls, information halls, Meixianglou former residence exhibitions, tea culture, fan culture exhibition halls, calligraphy and painting exhibition rooms, river halls, ancient water gates, etc. in the museum. The Meixiang Tower in the museum is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit with a history of more than 300 years. It is the former residence of the famous Li Xiangjun in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. Li Xiangjun, who rebelled against the Qing and restored the Ming dynasty, spared no effort to maintain national integrity by touching the pillar with his head and performing a tragic drama with a blood splatter fan, which is admired by future generations. The former residence currently has a boudoir, study, living room, and piano room. The river hall of Meixiang Building is also a representative building. The carved beams and painted rafters in the hall are exquisite and vivid. Each work has auspicious meanings, has a strong atmosphere of Ming and folk culture, and is well preserved.

attractions.name: 秦大士故居
attractions.summary: The former residence of Qin Dashi is a well preserved former residence of the top scholar in Nanjing. It was originally a mansion bestowed by Emperor Chongzhen of the late Ming Dynasty to Grand Secretary He Ruchong. Qin Dashi originally lived in Qin Zhuangyuan Lane. After retiring in the 28th year of the Qianlong reign, he still lived in his original residence. Seven years later, he bought this mansion and the old residence in Qin Zhuangyuan Lane was converted into the Qin Family Ancestral Hall. The entire building of Qin Zhuangyuan Mansion originally had five roads and nine entrances, stretching south to Changle Road, north to Chaoku Street, east to Pipa Lane, west to Wuding Bridge, and a garden behind it. It was named "Zhan Garden" after Ouyang Xiu of the Song Dynasty, who said, "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky. The park is lush with trees, with towering rockeries. There was originally a "Hundred Sons Living Together Hall" in the mansion, surrounded by four types of trees: cypress, catalpa, paulownia, and reed. This is a representative building of the Nanjing Prefecture during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Qin Dashi was the top scholar during the Qianlong period (1714-1777), with the courtesy names Luyi, Jianquan, Jianquan, and Qiutian Laoren. He once served as a trial lecturer to teach the prince how to read. He was proficient in seal script, clerical script, cursive script, regular script, and calligraphy, and his works of poetry and painting were considered excellent. He was commissioned by Emperor Qianlong to write the "Selected Works of the Ming Dynasty". The calligraphy art of the Qing Dynasty saw great development. Many calligraphers have emerged, and the stars are brilliant. The famous calligraphy critic of the Qing Dynasty, Bao Shidou, selected 91 calligraphers from the Qing Dynasty in his book "Yizhou Shuangji", among whom was Qin Dashi. It can be seen that the calligraphy of Qin Dashi was highly regarded during the Qing Dynasty. The current collection includes twelve calligraphy stone tablets by Qin Dashi, which were written by him after his retirement from office and were approximately between the 34th and 41st years of the Qianlong reign. The font size is uniform, the layout is neat, yet each has its own form and spirit, and all styles are well prepared, pleasing to the eye.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山索道
attractions.summary: The Yulong Snow Mountain Cableway is one of the three cableways in the Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. Tourists can take the cableway directly from the cableway station located in Ganhaizi to the Glacier Park at an altitude of 4506 meters. After getting off the cableway and following the wooden boardwalk laid on the glacier, you can climb all the way to the highest point at an altitude of 4680 meters, experiencing the charm of the snow capped mountains and glaciers up close. Full text 

attractions.name: 冰川公园
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountain Climbing; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
· Located on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north of Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, it is a typical representative of the modern glacier in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
· The park composed of stone caves and caves eroded by glaciers is a landform relic formed by Quaternary glaciers, and is known as the "Glass Palace of Lucerne".  
In autumn, winter and spring, the snow is vast here. In summer, you can see the glaciers formed more than 40,000 years ago, and you can feel the snow-capped mountains at close range. 
The white mountain at the top of the mountain is magnificent, spectacular, white and delicate, and there is also a marking stone tablet with an altitude of 4,680 meters, which is also a popular group photo place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience glaciers and snow-capped mountains up close

attractions.name: 白水河
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.
attractions.shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 《印象丽江》演出
attractions.tag: Featured performance; Mountain Climbing; Live Show
attractions.summary: Impression Lijiang "is one of the" Impression Series "directed by Zhang Yimou. The performance is set against the backdrop of snow capped mountains, with folk culture as the theme and local indigenous people as actors. On the open-air stage of the Ganhaizi Blue Moon Valley Theater in Yulong Snow Mountain at an altitude of 3100 meters, it truly showcases the indigenous people's emotions towards heaven, earth, people, and mountains. Impression of Lijiang "is divided into two parts:" Snow Mountain Chapter "and" Ancient City Chapter ", including six parts:" Ancient Road Horse Gang "," Duijiu Snow Mountain "," Heaven and Earth "," Jumping Song Group "," Encouragement and Sacrifice to Heaven ", and" Prayer Ceremony ". The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. The more than 500 actors participating in the performance are all from the surrounding rural areas, giving the audience a very authentic impression of Lijiang with their rough momentum, native posture, and simple singing.

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located northwest of Lijiang Old Town, it is quiet and ancient, with mountains and waters, more tranquil and primitive than Dayan Ancient Town.
- The mountains behind the ancient town are the foothills of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with lush and beautiful rolling peaks and dense forests.
- The Grand Stone Bridge and the Dajue Palace are well-preserved, with murals depicting figures from Buddhist teachings.
- It is an important part of the UNESCO World Heritage Lijiang Old Town and was selected as a "Charming Town of China" by CCTV in 2005.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tranquil and serene town of Chama Ancient Town.

attractions.name: 四方街篝火晚会
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the ancient city of the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, food streets and bar streets nearby. It is a bustling place in the ancient city, full of tourists. As long as it's a non rainy night, Sifang Street will hold a bonfire party. Summon up the courage to join the crowd, hold hands around the bonfire, and dance a Naxi exclusive square dance, which will be an unforgettable experience.

attractions.name: 拉市海湿地公园
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
Located about 10 kilometers west of Lijiang City, it is the largest plateau lake in Lijiang and the first nature reserve named after "wetland" in Yunnan Province. 
Every year, tens of thousands of waterfowl come here to spend the winter. Between December and February of the following year, it is the best time to watch birds in Lashihai. 
The lake is surrounded by Naxi villages, and every village near the lake has opened a horse farm, which has become an excellent place for horse riding, boating and bird watching in Lijiang.

restaurants.name_en: Red wine from southwest France. snack bar

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 绳金塔
attractions.tag: Monuments and ruins; historical buildings; Ancient Pagodas; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Shengjin Tower is located on the east side of Shengjin Tower Street in the Xihu District of Nanchang City, originally outside the ancient city’s Jinxiang Gate. It was first built during the Tang Dynasty, in the Tianyou period (904–907 AD). According to legend, before the tower was constructed, a monk named Weiyi dug the ground and found an iron box containing four golden ropes, three ancient swords (inscribed with the words "Drive Wind," "Pacify Fire," and "Subdue Dragon"), and a golden bottle filled with 300 relics, which is how the tower got its name.

· The Shengjin Tower is a typical brick-and-wood structure in Jiangnan, designed in a pagoda style. It stands approximately 50.86 meters tall and consists of seven levels and eight sides (with seven visible levels and eight hidden levels). The tower features red railings, blue tiles, black corners, clean walls, and a gourd-shaped copper roof with strong religious significance. It has graceful flying eaves, with copper bells hanging from them (recast using ancient bell-making techniques to create wind chimes, with seven layers producing seven different tones). The gourd-shaped copper roof shines brilliantly in gold, with the body of the tower adorned in red railings, blue tiles, and black corners, creating an elegant, simple, and timeless appearance. Each level of the tower has four real doorways and four false doorways, arranged in a staggered manner between levels, with each level’s doors differing in design. The Shengjin Tower is both ancient and beautiful, embodying the typical artistic style of Jiangnan architecture. Having been built during the Tang Dynasty over a thousand years ago, it serves as a carrier of historical information and a testament to the wisdom of generations of laboring people. Shengjin Tower is often referred to as "Water and Fire Harmonized, Overlooking Jiangcheng."

attractions.name: 南昌汉代海昏侯国遗址公园
attractions.name_en: The National Archaeological Site Park of Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis
attractions.summary: The Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site in Nanchang consists of the capital city of Haihun Marquis State, Zijin City, the first generation Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery, and the western and southern tomb groups of the city site. It is a typical Han Dynasty capital settlement site discovered in China. Since the archaeological excavation of Liuhe Cemetery began in 2011, more than 10000 precious cultural relics such as gold, bronze, iron, jade, lacquered wood, ceramics, bamboo weaving, grass weaving, textiles, bamboo slips, and wooden slips have been unearthed, which is rare in recent archaeological work in China. Among them, as many as 480 gold artifacts were excavated and unearthed. At the same time, the discovery of precious cultural relics such as Confucius' clothing mirror, gilded patterned bells, chimes, jade seals, etc., has great value. The Haihun Hou State Archaeological Site Park is divided into six functional areas: the Site Museum Area, the Tomb Exhibition Area, the Zijin City Exhibition Area, the Archaeological Reserve Area, the Entrance Functional Area, and the Historical Experience Ecological Leisure Area. Highlight 1: The design of the Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Tourist Center in Nanchang incorporates elements from the jade bi unearthed from Liu He's tomb. From a high altitude, it looks like a self forming circular "Congbi Litian" jade clasp. The building area is 8500 square meters. The tourist center comprehensively accommodates tourist reception services, cultural leisure display, cultural experience, entertainment shopping and other functions. Highlight 2: The architectural form of the Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Guo Site Museum has extracted the dragon shaped patterns that have appeared multiple times in the cultural relics unearthed from Liu He's tomb, symbolizing the hidden dragon in the mountains and fields. The building area is 39296 square meters. Our positioning for it is cultural display, cultural experience, etc. The archaeological museum has exhibitions and displays of unearthed cultural relics, as well as projects such as 4D cinemas and VR experiences. Highlight 3: Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery Liu He Cemetery has a trapezoidal plan, with a width of 141-186 meters from north to south and a length of 233-248 meters from east to west. The perimeter of the walls is 868 meters and the width is about 2 meters, covering a total area of about 46000 square meters. The cemetery consists of two main tombs, seven burial tombs, an outer pit and garden wall, north and east gates and their gates, sleeping quarters, ancestral halls, and temple officials' quarters. There is a complete road system and drainage facilities in the park. Some tombs have ancestral halls built in front of them. The two main tombs, Hou Tomb and Hou Madam Tomb, are located in the same tomb but different caves, occupying a higher and central position in the cemetery. The two tombs share a high platform with an area of about 4000 square meters. Its ceremonial architecture consists of east and west wing rooms, sleeping halls, and ancestral halls. Full text 

"Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

attractions.summary: The so-called trail refers to a city path that can only be walked on. Chongqing is a city built in the mountains, with many adjacent areas having a drop of several tens of meters, and transportation can only rely on urban trails that climb uphill and uphill. In the past, some famous trails were bustling, and many old ruins in Chongqing are located next to these trails. With the large-scale renovation of old cities and improvement of transportation conditions, these trails have gradually lost their function, and some have disappeared or become deserted. Some famous ruins in the surrounding area are slowly being forgotten by people and disappearing into the long river of history The repaired third trail is one of its representatives. This trail is located on the southern slope of the Yuzhong Peninsula, running from north to south, passing through Zhongshan Hospital, Kangjian Hall, Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, the former site of the French Renai Hall, and the suspended boardwalk. It is 1748 meters long and compactly connects a series of traditional neighborhoods and historical and cultural relics. The old street stretches one kilometer from end to end, with an elevation difference of about 80 meters across nine levels of slopes. This is the only place in Chongqing where visitors can simultaneously "view two rivers," "see three bridges," and "admire three landmarks." At night, the 270-degree panoramic view from the "Two Rivers Viewing Platform" offers a sweeping view of the Yuzhong Peninsula and Jiangbei District, presenting the essence of Chongqing’s nightscape. It truly offers "a complete view of Chongqing at a glance." In addition to its unique landscape features, the area is also a food haven. Along the one-kilometer old street, every few steps you’ll find "Chongqing famous snacks" and "China’s renowned shops," as well as restaurants and bars with prime riverfront views. Today, Danzishi Old Street has become the first choice for locals to relax and entertain, as well as the must-visit destination for showing out-of-town guests the charm of Chongqing.
