The 20 major creative events throughout the year include the Chinese Carnival, International Street Art Festival, Halloween, Christmas and New Year season, and more, aiming to bring fresh experiences and endless joy to visitors!

Among the miniature architectural wonders scattered throughout the park, the most popular iconic structures are the New Swan Castle, the Louvre Glass Pyramid from France, and the Lighthouse of Alexandria. As the leader of theme parks in Central and Southern China, Changsha Window of the World continuously upgrades its hardware and software to provide better services and even more fantastic experiences for visitors!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch iconic landmarks around the world.

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 《云南映象》演出
attractions.summary: Yunnan Impression "is a new stage production that integrates tradition and modernity. It is directed by Chinese dance artist Yang Liping as the artistic director and chief director, and integrates and reconstructs the essence of original local songs and dances with classic ethnic dances, showcasing the rich ethnic customs of Yunnan. 70% of the actors in 'Yunnan Impressions' are ethnic minorities from various villages in Yunnan, and the costumes for the performances are restored to the life prototypes of folk costumes of various ethnic groups in Yunnan. These folk actors already have primitive dance genes flowing in their blood, and their songs and dances are full of the vibrant spirit of life, which professional actors do not possess.

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 昆明旅游索道
attractions.summary: The Kunming Tourist Cableway (formerly known as the Dianchi Xishan Cableway) uses the world's advanced cableway equipment produced in France and Italy, with half of its length spanning over the water surface of Dianchi Lake, making it a rare cableway that spans both water and mountains. Taking the cableway is one of the popular tourist attractions in Kunming. At No. 16 Hubin Road (near the Dragon King Temple), you can take the cableway and walk up like stepping into a wonderful viewing corridor, where you can enjoy the scenery of Dianchi Lake. Along the way, you can also capture a panoramic view of Dianchi Lake. Underneath the feet is Dianchi Lake, while looking up is the majestic Xishan Mountain. The cableway also allows tourists to conveniently visit Dianchi Lake and Xishan Scenic Area. Full text 

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 七彩云南欢乐世界
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The park has a total investment of 3 billion yuan, covering an area of more than 700 mu. It closely follows the three cultural contexts of ancient Yunnan culture, national culture and regional culture, and plans seven theme divisions in a unique and novel way: Yunnan Military Camp, Magic Yunnan Strange Land, Children's Dream World, Vientiane Tribe, Secret Land of the Wilderness, Frost Moon Cold Island and Four Seasons Flower Sea, and has built an entertainment center for children-FEC Paradise. 
There are 81 amusement projects in the park, including wide-wing roller coaster, blue fire roller coaster, twin-tower space shuttle and other super-large equipment. The park has achieved the perfect integration of characteristic culture and modern technology.
attractions.shortFeatures: Multi-themed entertainment center
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-20:00(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 轿子雪山
attractions.tag: Climbing to a high place and hiking in the mountains.; Snow Mountains
attractions.summary: Jiaozi Mountain is a national nature reserve, a national AAAA-level tourist attraction, the first tourism destination in China to receive ecological origin certification, and a national sports tourism boutique scenic area. It is also the lowest latitude, closest to the provincial capital, with a distinct vertical climate, rich biodiversity, and a highly representative high-altitude seasonal snow mountain in China. It is named after its highest peak, which resembles a sedan chair. Jiaozi Mountain is part of the Wumeng Mountain range, with the main peak at an elevation of about 4223 meters and a relative height difference of about 2623 meters. The scenic area features rugged and majestic peaks, waterfalls scattered throughout, clear and mysterious lakes, rare flowers and trees, and exotic animals and birds that occasionally appear. It has a unique vertical climate with cold, temperate, and tropical zones, creating the remarkable phenomenon of "one mountain divided into four seasons, with each season offering a distinct view." "Winter to see snow, spring to see ice, summer to admire flowers, and autumn to enjoy water" is a major feature of Jiaozi Mountain. Its wonders, including the peaks, waters, snow, rhododendrons, sea of clouds, sunrises, and Buddha light, are known as the "Seven Wonders of Jiaozi Mountain." The majestic and beautiful landscape blends together, making it an untouched land for seeking adventure and exploration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Spring admire azaleas, winter climb the icy mountain.

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南大学
attractions.summary: Yunnan University is located in Kunming, Yunnan Province, China and is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history. The campus is shaded by green trees and has a unique architectural style that combines elements of both Eastern and Western architecture. It is a famous cultural attraction in Kunming city.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 云南野生动物园
attractions.summary: Yunnan Wildlife Park Co., Ltd. is the only tourism attraction in Yunnan Province focused on the breeding, domestication, viewing, and exhibition of wild animals. It integrates sightseeing, science education, and ex situ conservation. Located 7 kilometers from downtown Kunming, it is situated within the Jindian National Forest Park, adjacent to Jindian Reservoir, and facing the Expo Garden across the water. Covering a total area of approximately 2,800 acres, the park highlights the theme of showcasing Yunnan's "Animal Kingdom." The park features lush greenery, beautiful scenery, and themed attractions such as the Rare Animal Area, African Herbivorous Animal Area, Giant Panda Pavilion, and Lion and Tiger Manor. It is home to over 200 species and more than 10,000 animals. Among them are national treasures such as the giant panda and golden snub-nosed monkey, as well as exotic species like giraffes, rhinos, orangutans, and emus. Most of these animals live in natural free-range conditions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up view of rare animals

restaurants.name_en: Chao Ting Xuan (French teppanyaki, Teochew cuisine)

attractions.name: 中国科学技术馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary:
· Located next to Beijing Olympic Forest Park, it is the only national comprehensive science and technology museum in China. 
· The museum is divided into five floors, including one underground floor and four above ground floors. The main open venues include the main exhibition hall of Hall A, the ball screen cinema of Hall B, the children's science park of Hall C, the temporary exhibition hall and the special effects cinema. 
· In addition to science and technology exhibitions, there is also a science park suitable for children in the museum, where they can learn scientific knowledge through interactive games. 
In addition, the underground floor is Cosmic Theater, Dynamic Theater and 4D Theater, where you can watch three-dimensional giant screen movies and feel the magical effects of high technology.
attractions.shortFeatures: Science Paradise for Children

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 北京天文馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Planetariums
attractions.summary:
- China's first planetarium, where visitors can watch fascinating high-tech films and learn various astronomical knowledge.
- It is divided into two sections: Hall A and Hall B. Hall A includes exhibition halls, a public observatory, and other displays such as the origin of the universe and the history of the invention of the compass. It also offers observational functions, allowing visitors to view the beauty of space through telescopes.
- The Planetarium Hall is the most important area in Hall A, featuring a 23.5-meter diameter dome. Advanced instruments are used to realistically reproduce around 9,000 stars visible to the naked eye from Earth, allowing visitors to observe the changes in the starry sky and experience its beauty.
- Hall B mainly features spectacular theatrical displays. Using dome and multidimensional technology, it presents stunning astronomical films. The 3D theater is located on the B1 floor, providing a thrilling, immersive experience as if one were truly there.

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 国家自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· Located in the Tianqiao area on the central axis of the south city of the capital, it is backed by the World Cultural Heritage Temple of Heaven Park and faces the modern Tianqiao Theater. 
There are four basic exhibitions and a Dinosaur World Expo. The number of large-scale ancient mammal fossils in the exhibition museum ranks second in the world, and the ancient elephant fossils and dinosaur fossils of the Yellow River are famous at home and abroad. 
If you are bringing children, you must go to the "Discovery Corner" in the museum, so that you can give full play to your imagination.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the fossils of extinct animals and plants

restaurants.name_en: Xinjiang Building Khan Tenggeli VIP Hall

hotel.Hotel Name: Shenzhen Luwan International Mansion Resort Hotel

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 大鹏半岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Shenzhen Dapeng Peninsula National Geological Natural Park is located in the southeasternmost Dapeng Peninsula of Shenzhen. The geological heritage protection area covers an area of about 46.07 square kilometers. In 2005, it was rated as a national geological park. 
The types of geological relics in the park are mainly ancient volcanic relics formed by five volcanic eruptions about 146 million years ago and coastal landscapes formed in 20,000 to 10,000 years ago. The uncanny workmanship of nature has created the unique landscape here. 
The main peak of Qiniang Mountain formed by volcanic eruption is about 869.7 meters above sea level, making it the second highest peak in Shenzhen. The stretching coastline was rated as one of the "eight most beautiful coasts in China" by China National Geographic. 
The park is divided into four scenic spots: Qiongqiu Travel Scenic Spot, Haishi Wonder Scenic Spot, Luzui Tide Watching Scenic Spot and Buxi Yangmei Scenic Spot. Based on the needs of geological relics and natural environment protection, the areas officially open to the public in the park are "Qiongqiu Tour" and "Luzui Tide Watching", with museum scenic spots, main peak scientific research line and Luyan scientific research line.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shenzhen's "Gold Coast"

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

restaurants.name_en: Wai Wa Shuo De Restaurant Brewery
Long Kee Fishing Raft Marine Restaurant

attractions.name: 情侣路
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Lovers Road is the business card of Zhuhai, about 28 kilometers long. Popular attractions along the way include Jiuzhou Port, Seaside Swimming Pool, Zhuhai Fisherman Girl, Xianglu Bay, etc. 
· Walking on the road, you can look at the sea, blow the sea breeze, look at Macau on the other side, and enjoy a leisurely and pleasant time. 
If you are physically strong, you can ride the whole journey. Special bicycle rental services are provided near Gongbei or at the entrance of Mingting Park (Yeli Island).
attractions.shortFeatures: Strolling in the sea breeze and looking at Macau

attractions.name: 珠海爱情邮局
attractions.summary: The Zhuhai Love Post Office was completed in December 2016. Taking advantage of the unique hardware advantages of the couple's road, the Love Post Office serves as the core area, supporting the existing love themed facilities in the city living room (such as lighthouses, love gardens, wedding boardwalks, etc.), radiating the greenway stations along the couple's road, and creating a romantic coastline. Love Post Office aims to create a love culture business card for the South China Sea through the integration of love themed culture, creative interactive experiences, sales of themed derivatives, series of themed activities, and personalized wedding services, among other means of public participation.

attractions.name: 香炉湾城市阳台
attractions.summary: The Xianglu Bay Urban Balcony Project is located by Xianglu Bay on Lover's Middle Road, with a total planned land area of approximately 353400 square meters. It aims to create a public service center node that integrates coastal leisure, tourism, cultural experience, and waterfront entertainment. To the southwest are Jingshan Park and Seaside Park, facing the sea, surrounded by mountains and water, with beautiful natural landscapes and ecological environment.

attractions.name: 香炉湾沙滩
attractions.summary: Xianglu Bay Beach is a crescent shaped bay beach named after fishermen who used to disembark here and pay their respects at Xianglu Cave in Shijingshan. Full text 

attractions.name: 野狸岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
· Connected with the downtown area by Haiyan Bridge, it is the nearest island to Zhuhai. The island is not large, and it only takes about forty minutes to walk around the island. 
The geographical location of Yeli Island is very convenient, and many tourists will stop by when walking along Lovers Road. 
There are four small peaks on the island. Yeli Mountain is the highest mountain on the island, with pleasant scenery. It is suitable for bathing in the sea breeze and enjoying the sunrise and sunset here. 
· Zhuhai Opera House, located on the waterfront of Yeli Island, is the only opera house built on an island in China. Its shell-like design is full of artistic sense.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk and ride around the island to watch the sunrise and sunset

attractions.name: 珠海渔女
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Statues/Sculptures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The statue of Zhuhai Fisherman Girl stands on the banks of the beautiful Xianglu Bay in Zhuhai and is an iconic landscape of Zhuhai. 
Pan He, a famous Chinese sculptor, designed this stone sculpture according to the beautiful legend of fishermen in the South China Sea. Generally, tourists who come to Zhuhai will come here to take photos. 
· She wore pearls and fishing nets, and held high in her hands a round and huge pearl-like treasure, with a vivid look of love.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark seaside fisherman statue

attractions.name: 珠海大剧院
attractions.tag: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater
attractions.summary:
· A beautiful landscape on Lovers Road, it is the only opera house built on an island in China. 
The design scheme of Zhuhai Grand Theatre not only comes from the unique marine species "Sun Moon Shell", but also refines the image of "shell" and further expresses the significance of space with modern building materials and technologies. 
· The large shell "Ribei" is 90 meters high and can accommodate nearly 1,600 people, while the small shell "Yuebei" is a multi-function hall with a capacity of 500 people. When watching it during the day, it is clear and milky white; When the lights on the shells are on at night, it is a dazzling giant screen light dance show. 
· On the official website, you can check and book the performances of the Opera House, which is also a good pastime to visit Zhuhai.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Grand Theatre with a prominent marine style

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shijingshan Park is surrounded by mountains and rivers, integrating viewing stone scenery, climbing high and looking into the distance, children's play and extreme sports. 
At present, there are five areas in the park: mountain top scenic spot, mountainside stone scenic spot, lakeside recreation area, cableway slide area and large amusement park area. 
· Take the Shijingshan cableway to the top of the mountain, overlooking Xianglu Bay, Macau and Zhuhai, and it is the best sightseeing spot in Zhuhai. 
There is also a 630-meter-long pipe-rail slide from the top of the mountain to the bottom of the mountain, which can experience the fresh excitement of crossing the jungle, but both the cableway and slide need to be paid extra.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take the ropeway to the summit and overlook the mountains and seas

attractions.name: 珠海景山观光索道
attractions.summary: The Zhuhai Jingshan Cableway and Slide Project is located at the eastern foot of Shijingshan in the center of Zhuhai city, adjacent to Xianglu Bay and Lover's Road seaside, and is one of the main attractions for enjoying Zhuhai. The Jingshan Cableway descends to the "City Balcony" and connects to the Zhuhai Skywalk "Zhuhai Jingshan Road". The 360 degree viewing platform offers a distant view of landmark landscapes in Zhuhai, including Hong Kong, Macau, Zhuhai Fisherman's Girls, Zhuhai Grand Theatre, and the "Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge". From a perspective above the city center, visitors can experience a different kind of Zhuhai! The Jingshan slide adopts new generation products imported from Germany, with the addition of a 720 degree double-layer spiral track. The curved design and eddy current deceleration system are both stimulating and safe. Riding a slide from the mountaintop to the foot of the mountain, there is a romantic feeling of chasing the sunset at dusk, which is a popular "sunset car" among netizens.

attractions.name: 九洲船说·相约大海
attractions.name_en: jiu zhou chuan shuo · xiang yue da hai
attractions.summary: The Nine Continents Ship Talk: Meeting in the Sea "is the world's first live action light and shadow play set against the backdrop of the blue sea. It integrates" going out to sea, watching bridges, and appreciating dramas ", integrating ship, multimedia, stage technology, visual lighting effects, and contemporary art such as drama, film, and dance, providing visitors with an unprecedented sea viewing experience and creating a new landmark for Zhuhai's cultural and tourism industry. Embark on a mini cruise ship near the coast to enjoy the magnificent scenery of the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, one of the "Seven Wonders of the New World" up close, and immerse yourself in a sea masterpiece - follow the plot of "A Promise of Gold" to travel through the past and present, experience the integrity legend of the Bay Area, and appreciate the maritime commerce and trade trends. At first glance, immerse yourself in the drama and be fascinated! There are also many eye-catching highlights: the borderless theater on the sea, the nearly thousand square sea giant ice screen, the sea fountain, the fusion of water and fire, and other stunning lighting effects

attractions.name: 澳门环岛游
attractions.summary: The Macau Island Tour can be regarded as a classic tourism project with distinctive features in Zhuhai City, which has always been popular among tourists. This route is set off by sightseeing boats from Wan Chai Tourist Pier and takes 60-90 minutes to sail. Along the way, in addition to enjoying the beautiful scenery of the "romantic city" Zhuhai, you can also get up close to Macau's characteristic attractions such as Fisherman's Wharf, Nanhai Guanyin Statue, Lisboa Entertainment Center, Bank of China Tower, Tourism Tower, Macau Governor's Office, and A-Ma Temple, and witness the charming charm of "Oriental Monte Carlo". If choosing a night boat tour, visitors can also appreciate the colorful charm of Macau, a city that never sleeps, emanating from the sea breeze. Full text 

attractions.name: 花海长廊
attractions.summary: The Hengqin Flower Sea Corridor is about 14 kilometers long and has a beautiful flower sea landscape. According to different flowering periods, it is planted with cherry kapok, phoenix wood, and kapok. The Flower Sea Corridor spans three cross sea bridges and Mangzhou Wetland Park. In addition to admiring the charming flower sea, tourists can also camp and have picnics here.

attractions.name: 花海长廊2号驿站
attractions.summary: Huahai Corridor No.2 Station is located in Zhuhai and is a tourist attraction that integrates leisure, sightseeing, and entertainment. This place attracts numerous tourists with its unique flower sea landscape and rich entertainment facilities. Tourists can enjoy the beauty of nature here while experiencing various outdoor activities.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 花海长廊三号驿站
attractions.summary: The Flower Sea Corridor No. 3 Station is located in Zhuhai City and is a comprehensive tourist attraction that integrates leisure, sightseeing, and entertainment. This place attracts a large number of tourists with its unique flower sea landscape and rich entertainment facilities. Tourists can enjoy natural beauty, participate in various outdoor activities, and experience different travel pleasures here.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 19:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 二井湾湿地公园
attractions.summary: Erjingwan Wetland Park is a large natural ecological wetland, planted with true and semi red mangrove plants such as paulownia trees, okra, poplar, magnolia, hibiscus, silver leaf trees, and water yellow bark. Different types of birds and wild animals can also be seen here. The roads in the park are crisscrossed, and water birds fly in the reed beds, which is very healing.

attractions.name: 励骏庞都广场
attractions.summary: Lijun Pangdu Square is located across from Hengqin Port in Zhuhai, surrounded by modern office buildings and high-rise residential buildings. The square was designed by architect Mr. Ma Ruolong, adopting the Portuguese Manuel architectural style and adding Chinese cultural elements. It has become a new popular check-in spot for internet celebrities in Zhuhai and a place for many young couples to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 珠海长隆海洋王国
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· It is one of the largest ocean theme parks in the world, and it is also the world's first unique design that combines large-scale amusement facilities with precious animal exhibition areas. 
· It has Asia's first flying roller coaster with the longest track, Asia's first water roller coaster, the world's largest aquarium and acrylic glass, etc. 
The aquarium won five Guinness World Records at the same time, and there are as many as 15,000 exotic fish of different species in the aquarium.
attractions.shortFeatures: Asia's first water roller coaster

restaurants.name_en: Wah Kee Taste Source Tea Restaurant

attractions.name: 上海乐高探索中心
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Children's playground
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Lego Discovery Center is a super indoor amusement park made of thousands of Lego bricks. It is operated by Merlin Entertainment Group, a global family entertainment giant. It is the first Lego Discovery Center in China and the 17th Lego Discovery Center in the world. 
There are 11 theme areas, including: Lego Factory Tour, Castle Adventure, Mini World, Lego Creative Studio, Lego Friends, Depot Farm, Wonderful Undersea Tour, Magic Turntable, Lego Naughty Castle, Lego Racing Circuit and Lego 4D Experience, which provides parent-child families with an average of about 2-3 hours of rich and inspiring Lego-themed play experience. The unique concept of entertaining and entertaining allows children and parents to stimulate unlimited imagination and creativity while having fun.
attractions.shortFeatures: Children build fun building blocks with their own hands
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-18:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:45)

attractions.name: 上海海洋水族馆
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; A Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
- The Ocean Aquarium has three floors. After entering the aquarium, take the elevator to the third floor, then visit from top to bottom.
- It includes exhibition areas such as the China Exhibition Area and the Americas Exhibition Area, with a wide variety of marine species in each zone.
- The entire exhibition hall uses themes, images, and various effects to showcase different types of marine life.
- The aquarium also features the world's only observation tunnel showcasing the Amazon rainforest. There is also a fast food restaurant on the first floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the underwater tunnel to observe marine life.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 上海动物园
attractions.tag: Adorable animals; a hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- Shanghai Zoo, located near Hongqiao Airport, was originally named Xijiao Park. It is a place full of memories for many old Shanghai residents and is the second largest zoo in China.
- The entire park is lush with flowers and greenery, offering a tranquil environment. A small river runs through the area, and walking within the park, one can experience the rare natural ecological atmosphere in the midst of a bustling metropolis.
- The zoo is home to over 620 species of animals, with exhibition areas for amphibians, reptiles, herbivores, carnivores, and birds, as well as educational and butterfly pavilions.
- Children can feed the small animals, or enjoy playing on the large lawn, sunbathing, boating, or riding the Ferris wheel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Observe Rare Animals and Spend Quality Time with Family

attractions.name: 人民广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
People's Square is the largest public square in Shanghai. It was transformed from the "largest horse racing hall in the Far East" in the concession era, and it is also a landmark of Shanghai. 
People's Square in a broad sense is mainly composed of open squares, People's Park, Shanghai Grand Theatre, Shanghai Museum and other buildings. 
Hong Kong Famous Street, Di Mei Shopping Center and Old Shanghai 1930 Style Street are built underground in the square, showing the old appearance of Shanghai in 1930s. 
There is a fountain in the center of the square, which sprays water about every half hour at night. It is beautiful under various lights and is a good place to enjoy the cool air.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Landmark and Transportation Hub

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 南昌融创乐园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Nanchang Sunac Cultural Tourism City is located in the Honggutan Jiulong Lake New District of Nanchang, integrating traditional Ganjia culture with world-class theme park elements.  
- Whether you are an adventurous young trendsetter, a romantic couple in search of sweet moments, or a parent wanting to give your children a magical childhood, Nanchang Sunac Park has something for everyone. The park’s large-scale attractions, including the longest wooden roller coaster in China, "Bamboo Forest Green Python," the highest and fastest roller coaster, "Flying Roller Coaster," and the nearly 40-meter-high flying chairs "Phoenix Dance in the Sky," are a paradise for amusement park enthusiasts; international-level stage shows such as the water and light performance "Bridge of Light" are also eye-catching.  
- Not only is Sunac Park worth a visit, but Sunac Mall is also a place where you can spend an entire day. In Nanchang Sunac Sea World, you can watch various marine fish swim past you, and in Movie Park, you can travel through history to experience Jiangxi's culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Thrilling Experience of the Three Major Roller Coasters

attractions.name: 九龙湖公园
attractions.summary: The facilities in Jiulong Lake Wetland Park are well-equipped, with a fountain for citizens to enjoy and a green island around the lake for citizens to exercise. Providing a rich and shared resting space for citizens and other living beings.

attractions.name: 南昌之星摩天轮
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ferris wheel; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The landmark of Nanchang, 160 meters high, is 25 meters higher than the previous world record holder "Eye of London". 
· The diameter of the turntable is 153 meters, with 60 space capsules. A ferris wheel can seat six people and can accommodate nearly a thousand people per hour. It takes half an hour to sit in a circle. 
· Overlooking the whole city of Nanchang, the cabin is equipped with LCD TV and Mitsubishi heating and cooling air conditioning. 
The world's largest clock will also be installed, with 60 space capsules representing a 60-minute time scale. The Ferris wheel will adopt dual power supply and dual power system to ensure the safety of tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the romantic landmarks

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 红谷滩金街(南昌红谷滩店)
attractions.summary: Honggutan Jinjie is a characteristic commercial block in Jiangxi Province, which is a modern block that is young, fashionable, healthy, and vibrant.

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

restaurants.name_en: BN House Park Ning Western Food

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 普陀寺
attractions.summary: Putuo Temple is one of the four scenic spots in Foshan, which covers an area of more than 400,000 square meters. The ancient architectural art in the scenic spot is exquisite, with yellow walls and tiles in the palace, cornices and cornices, and a "Dalu Bronze Bell" weighing 7,000 kg hanging in the bell tower. The Buddha statue is exquisite in shape and magnificent in posture. There are many long-lived turtles in the pond of the temple, which has become one of the highlights of Putuo Temple.
attractions.shortFeatures: The temple architecture is magnificent
