attractions.name: 五缘湾湿地公园
attractions.summary: Wuyuan Bay Wetland Park covers an area of 85 hectares, equivalent to half of Gulangyu Island. It is a large park and wetland ecological park in Xiamen, known as the city's green lung. Every March, a large number of egrets build nests and breed here, and it is also an important stop for migratory birds to migrate north and south. On the current plot of the park, there are aquatic and wetland plant zones, aquatic plant communities, reed and wetland plant communities. Currently, 25 species of wetland waterbirds from 9 families and 29 species of forest and farmland birds from 17 families that inhabit wetlands will continue to live and sing here. Tourists can sit on the observation balcony of the Water Pavilion and watch the five bridges complement each other from afar. They can stroll on the wooden boardwalk to see the reeds swaying and water lilies blooming on the lake. On the bird island in the center of the lake, they can watch water birds rise and fall in the misty air, or enjoy the fun of fishing on the wooden platform. Across from the thousand foot wooden boardwalk is a gathering place for yachts, where sailboats or sea swimming training can be seen from time to time. Because Wuyuan Bay is the main venue for many international sailing competitions and the starting point for many sailboats going out to sea, if you have enough time, you can also schedule a sailing activity to experience the excitement of sea breeze and seawater rushing towards you.

attractions.name: 中山路步行街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street is the oldest commercial street in Xiamen. People often buy souvenir gifts here, and there must be exhibitions and sales activities on holidays. 
The buildings here are all arcades, with 　 and milky white as the main colors, with a strong Nanyang style. The colorful night scene and the dazzling array of snacks from Fujian and Taiwan are also a major feature of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. 
Famous snack bars include eight mothers-in-law burning fairy grass and Huang Zehe peanut soup, etc., which are worth trying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xiamen Landmark Commercial Street

attractions.name: 五缘湾游海帆船出海
attractions.summary: Sailing boats in Wuyuan Bay can enjoy the sea view along the way. The sailboats dock at Wuyuan Bay Yacht Port in Huli District, Xiamen City. The sailboats rely on natural wind to act on the sails, making it a fashionable and environmentally friendly sport without noise or gasoline pollution. There is no stimulation from speedboats or leisure from cruise ships, neither fast nor slow, just right. Sitting on a sailboat, feeling the sea breeze blowing, full of comfort.

attractions.name: 鹭江夜游
attractions.summary: As a must check in night tour project in Xiamen. Strolling through Xiamen during the day and admiring the Lujiang River at night. This is a route that offers a panoramic view of the night scenery of Xiamen and Gulangyu, including Gulangyu Island, Twin Towers, International Cruise Home Port, Tide Eye, and Haicang Bridge The city is on the sea, still in the city ", experiencing a visual collision between a quaint world heritage island and a modern metropolis. How can you miss such a" unique romance "! Full text 

attractions.name: 厦门海上游
attractions.summary: Xiamen's five major products for sea tourism operations: Jinxia Ring Drum Tour, Sea Tour Jinxia, Ring Drum Night Tour, Lujiang Night Tour, and Ludao Serenade. It has 25 cruise ships that are navigable in the Lujiang and Jinxia waters, with diverse models and complete functions. Among them, there are distinctive vessels such as the ancient and successful series of cruise ships, the Republic of China style Lujiang Star, the Minnan style Taikoo 3, and the European classical Poseidon 6 themed cruise ship. Cruise ships have a unique style, with rich and colorful performances on board, bringing tourists a brand new sea leisure experience. The upstream of Xiamen embodies the culture and characteristics of Xiamen, and links the routes of essence of Xiamen's urban landscape, so that tourists can understand the past life of Xiamen and appreciate the spirit of Xiamen. Sitting on a cruise ship upstream of Xiamen, the frozen beauty of the architecture blends harmoniously with the flowing sound of the Lujiang River. The boat activity that embraces all rivers represents the image and cultural connotation of the city, allowing tourists to experience the beauty of the water world and gain novel experiences. Starting from the Century Peace Pier, along the way, the Gulangyu architectural complex, the Shimao Twin Towers skyline, the Lujiang Road, the Yanwu Bridge, and the Kinmen Islands across the sea from Xiamen, pass by and breathe with this city. At night, the magnificent light and shadow shows on both sides of the Lujiang River showcase the warmth and charm of Xiamen's city.

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gulangyu Island is home to over a thousand buildings with a variety of styles, blending both Chinese and Western architecture. There are temples with traditional Chinese flying eaves and curved corners, Minnan-style courtyard houses, the Bagua Tower with a combination of Chinese and Western elements, small and delicate Japanese-style houses, 19th-century European consulates from Western countries, and the Shuzhuang Garden, which is considered a gem of Jiangnan classical gardens. It can be called an exposition of world architecture.

In recent years, several new buildings have been completed, including the former Gulangyu Park transformed into an Underwater World, the tall statue and relief of Zheng Chenggong in Haoyue Park, the marble statue of renowned Chinese gynecologist Lin Qiaozhi in Yuyuan, the subtropical plant introduction garden at Huijiao, with its shrubs, flowers, and fragrant palms, the Xiamen Museum displaying the city's thousand-year history and the development of its special economic zone, the Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall honoring the hero’s achievements, as well as Yanping Park, Gangzihou Swimming Pool, Zhongshan Library, People’s Stadium, and the Gulangyu villas with garden-style architecture, Guanhaiyuan Resort, Gulangyu Hotel, and more. With so many parks and buildings in just 1.78 square kilometers, the density of these structures is likely rare even in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: World Architecture Expo

attractions.name: 港仔后海滨浴场
attractions.summary:
· Aberdeen Hou Beach is located in the west of Shuzhuang Garden, and the two are adjacent to each other. 
· Standing on the beach, with the Sunlight Rock on the back, you can see the highest bare rock. 
The bathing beach has soft sand, gentle slopes and flat waves, and low seawater flow rate. Coupled with the beautiful scenery of Gulangyu Island, it is very suitable for seaside leisure and swimming.
attractions.shortFeatures: Great view and beautiful scenery

attractions.name: 菽庄花园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
Shuzhuang Garden was built in 1913, named after the homophonic word "Shuzang" by Lin Erjia, a wealthy businessman in Taiwan Province. It is divided into two parts: Bushan Garden and Zanghai Garden. 
The main landscape of Bushan Garden is rockery, that is, twelve caves, with a total of 12 caves, inlaid with twelve zodiac signs at each cave entrance. 
The reason why Tibetan Sea Garden is called Tibetan Sea is that only when you turn out of the Moon Cave Gate will the sea appear in front of you, and the Forty-Fourth Bridge is the best point to view the sea. 
The Piano Museum in Tingtao Xuan in Shuzhuang Garden is a highlight. There will be special piano improvisation performances every half hour in the museum, which is worth listening to.
attractions.shortFeatures: Garden Landscape with Western Colors

attractions.name: 钢琴博物馆
attractions.summary:
· Tingtaoxuan, located in Shuzhuang Garden, Gulangyu Scenic Spot, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, houses many pianos with a long history. 
It is divided into the first hall and the second hall. There will be regular piano explanations in the hall, and there will be piano performances from time to time in the hall. 
As a decoration, candlestick lamps have a history of more than one hundred years. Visiting the Piano Museum is equivalent to browsing the history of piano development in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the strangely shaped clavichord
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 日光岩
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
attractions.summary:
· Sunlight Rock is the highest peak of Gulangyu Island and the iconic scenic spot of Gulangyu Island. 
Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 万国建筑博览
attractions.summary: The International Architecture Exhibition is not just the name of a building, but a combination of various Chinese and Western architecture on Gulangyu Island. These architectural complexes are collectively referred to as the International Architecture Exhibition, which is the essence of the cultural exchange between China and the West on Gulangyu Island. These buildings include traditional Chinese temples with upturned eaves and corners, Minnan style courtyard bungalows, Bagua buildings with a combination of Chinese and Western walls, small and exquisite Japanese houses, former national consulates in 19th century European style, and Shuzhuang Garden, which can be regarded as a masterpiece of classical gardens in Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 原英国领事馆
attractions.summary: The former British Consulate General's residence in Xiamen, located at No. 5 Zhangzhou Road, Gulangyu Island, is a beautiful mansion nestled among green trees. Today, it has become an exhibition hall of the Xiamen Jinquan Coin Museum. The original British Consulate building on Gulangyu Island was a three story red brick building with bricks and stones at the four corners. The structure was square and rigorous, with floor to ceiling doors and windows, all equipped with louvers to adjust sunlight and block wind and sand, and also decorated with fireplaces. According to research, this mansion represents the early colonial architectural style of Gulangyu Island.

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿龙头路
attractions.summary: Longtou Road is located on Gulangyu Island, not far from the pier, and it is also a necessary route to reach the pier. This road is a bustling commercial street on Gulangyu Island. The not wide streets are lined with various cultural shops, delicious snacks, and more. Each shop has its own style and characteristics in terms of window display and decoration. Even if you don't go into the shop, it's still great to just stroll outside and take a look.

attractions.name: 八卦楼
attractions.summary: The Organ Museum is located at 43 Guxin Road, Gulangyu Island. The venue is not very large and displays more than 5000 organs of various ages and styles. Those interested in music can come and visit, otherwise they may find it boring. It is said to be the only organ museum in China and the largest in the world at present. The first floor of the venue displays many historical organs from around the world, most of which are produced in France and Spain. The treasure of the town hall here is the world's largest organ. The backyard of the museum houses some smuggled cultural relics seized from customs, all of which are stone carvings.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 厦门园林植物园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- Xiamen Botanical Garden, commonly known as "Wanshi Botanical Garden," is a meticulously designed botanical garden surrounding the Wanshi Rock Reservoir. The garden includes over 20 specialty gardens and planting areas, such as the Pine and Fir Garden, Rose Garden, Palm Garden, Large Cactus Garden, Hundred Flowers Hall, Orchid Garden, and more, cultivating over 6,000 species of tropical and subtropical plants.  
- The Rainforest World and Desert Plant Zone are particularly worth visiting. The misty atmosphere of the Rainforest World, along with the beautiful tropical rainforest scenery, makes it look like a fairyland.  
- The Instagram-worthy cactus in the Desert Plant Zone is a must-photograph spot. In addition to the plants, the garden also features landscapes such as stone carvings, lakes, lawns, and temples. From the highest point of the New Stele Forest, visitors can overlook half of Xiamen Island.
attractions.shortFeatures: The enchanting rainforest world

attractions.name: 南普陀寺
attractions.summary:
Nanputuo Temple is a key Buddhist temple in the Han nationality area. If you are going to pray, you might as well come here to worship. 
The most famous ones are the vegetarian food on the second floor of the vegetarian restaurant and the vegetarian cakes in the temple, with the plaque of the first vegetarian banquet in the world hanging on it, which is about 59 yuan per capita. 
Wulaoshan, the back mountain of Nanputuo Temple, is one of the eight scenic spots in Xiamen, and you can climb the mountain by the way. 
It only takes about 1 hour to walk from the temple to Wulaoshan, and you can also go to Xiamen Botanical Garden from this road. 
There are many inscriptions of celebrities around the temple. There is a huge stone carving of "Buddha" on the cliff behind the temple, and tourists often come to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Buddhist monasteries in the whole country

attractions.name: 钟楼
attractions.summary: The Bell Tower of Nanputuo Temple is located inside Nanputuo Temple in Xiamen, Fujian Province. It is a double story building with double eaves and a gable roof. The first floor of the clock tower is the Ksitigarbha Hall, while the morning bell and evening drum are used for telling the time in the morning and evening.

attractions.name: 厦门大学
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Schools
attractions.summary:
Founded in 1921 by Mr. Chen Jiageng, a patriotic overseas Chinese leader, it is one of the most beautiful campuses in China. 
The quaint architecture of overseas Chinese hometown in southern Fujian, lush southern plants and youthful Nanqiang students all retain their original appearance. 
The humanistic charm of Jiannan Auditorium and Songen Building, and the beautiful scenery of Furong Lake and Lover Valley are the campus corners that can best reflect the beauty of Xiamen University.
attractions.shortFeatures: A famous university surrounded by mountains and seas

attractions.name: 五老峰
attractions.summary:
Wulaofeng is located on the five hills behind Nanputuo Temple, also known as the back mountain of Nanputuo Temple. 
There are white clouds on the top of the five hills, and the jungle under the clouds is lush, faintly like a long beard. From a distance, it seems like five old people with white hair and beard who have experienced all the vicissitudes of the world, looking eagerly at the vast sea. This is one of the eight scenic spots in Xiamen "Five Old Lingxiao" scenic spot. 
It takes about half an hour to one hour to walk from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain. There are many viewing platforms along the road, where you can see the panoramic view of Xiamen and take photos. At the highest point, you can see all the buildings of Xiamen University and Gulangyu Island. 
· If Bee Bee goes to Wulaofeng from Xiamen Botanical Garden, it has to pay the admission fee of the Botanical Garden; But if you go from Nanputuo Temple, it is free.
attractions.shortFeatures: Standing on the mountain top, you can have a bird's-eye view of Xiamen University

attractions.name: 白城沙滩
attractions.summary:
Located at the foot of Baicheng in the south of Xiamen University, it is a beautiful beach between Yanwu Bridge and Hulishan Fort.  
· There are many interesting scenes. The beach is dotted with huge mouse sculptures, and the semi-ring flyover is like a huge clock. 
There are ruins of Zheng Chenggong's era distributed on the beach, which combines beautiful scenery with profound cultural and historical heritage. 
· This is a natural leisure park for Xiamen University students, Xiamen citizens and tourists to stroll, play games, swim and watch the sunset.
attractions.shortFeatures: Seaside beach adjacent to Xiamen University

attractions.name: 厦门双子塔
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Xiamen Twin Towers is a new landmark in Xiamen. Two independent towers are connected by podiums, which look like sails and incorporate the visual elements of Xiamen's flower "bougainvillea". 
One of them is a five-star hotel and a top office building, the other is a SOHO office building, and the podium building is built into a comprehensive commercial building integrating shopping, leisure, entertainment and catering. 
Be sure to board the Xiamen Viewing Hall on the Yunshang on the 55th floor to experience the invincible 360 view. Overlooking Gulangyu Island and overlooking the whole Ludao customs, it is beautiful. 
The sightseeing hall also has a coffee room, selling all kinds of special souvenirs, handicrafts, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: The 55th floor sightseeing hall overlooks Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 环岛路
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Hiking/Biking; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiamen Huandao Road is built along the coast. It is a section of coast from Xiamen University to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and is called the "Golden Coastline". 
· Also known as Five-Color Road: blue sea, golden beach, green grass, red runway and gray road. 
There are many scenic spots along the way, such as Hulishan Fort, Yefeng Village, International Convention and Exhibition Center, Wuyuan Bay, etc. 
On the side of Huandao Road facing the sea, there are sculptures of different styles such as "Wave of Gulangyu Island", "Meditation Song of the Sea" and "Choice", which are of great ornamental value. 
You can rent a bicycle to ride, which has a unique charm. It is the most beautiful section from Yefengzhai to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and it takes about 40 minutes to ride by bike.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy riding the coastline

attractions.name: 环岛路海滩
attractions.summary: Xiamen Huandao Road is one of the scenic tourist roads around the sea in Xiamen. The construction of Huandao Road has always pursued the tenet of "seeing the sea by the sea and leaving the most beautiful beaches to the people". Some are close to the mountains and the sea, some bridge the sea, and some drill holes through stones. The construction starting point is high and the standards are strict, which fully reflects the characteristics of subtropical scenery.
attractions.shortFeatures: Sightseeing scenic belt

attractions.name: 环岛路观光大道
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots here, including temples, ancient trees, strange stones, sculptures, and three seaside squares.

attractions.name: 曾厝垵
attractions.summary:
· Zeng Cuo An Village is known as "the most literary village in the country". It used to be a simple fishing village, but now it has become a hot cultural and creative village. 
Modern and quaint neighborhoods are integrated, and there are many unique small shops gathered on the street. You can eat, buy and shoot while shopping, which is enough for you to toss all day. Food is another label here besides literature and art. There are all kinds of snacks and dazzling fruits in five streets and eighteen lanes in Zeng Cuo An Village. 
It is also a gathering place for characteristic homestays, including traditional courtyards, baroque single-family villas, quaint and unique fishing villages, and lively and unique youth hostels. 
· Zeng Cuo An Village late at night belongs to folk songs and bars. Young people talk about their ideals in bars. Under the hoarse voice of folk songs, they drink with emotions and stories to recall the most unforgettable times.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xiamen cultural innovation landmark

attractions.name: 黄厝海滩
attractions.summary:
· Huangcuo Beach is the most natural and cleanest beach on the whole roundabout road, and it is a good place to get close contact with the sea in Xiamen. 
There are many surrounding scenic spots, including International Convention and Exhibition Center, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Hulishan Fort, etc., with superior geographical location. 
For those who like quietness, this is a good place to watch the sea quietly. It is also a good choice to ride a bike by the seaside and blow the sea breeze.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the International Marathon

attractions.name: 椰风寨
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· Located on the seaside of Huandao Road, Xiamen City, covering an area of nearly 10,000 square meters, it is a beach resort full of coconut trees. 
It is the first comprehensive leisure tourism center in Xiamen that integrates outdoor amusement, catering and leisure, water sports and beach expansion.  
The whole park is divided into six functional areas: seaside amusement park, Xindi Paradise, 4D dynamic cinema, seaside bathing, water sports area and food court. 
Across the sea, you can overlook Kinmen Island and the big brand of "One Country, Two Systems", and you can also enjoy the beautiful sunrise here. It is a good place for few people to relax.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coconut tree-lined beaches

attractions.name: 集美学村
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Schools; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jimei Village, founded by Chen Jiageng, a famous patriotic overseas Chinese leader, is the general name of all kinds of schools and cultural institutions in Jimei District. 
The architecture integrates Chinese and western styles, the most beautiful of which is Jimei Middle School, its Daonan Building and Nanxun Building of Jimei Overseas Chinese School, etc., which are unique in style and highly ornamental. 
Popular scenic spots in the school village include Aoyuan, Dragon Boat Pond, Chen Jiageng's former residence, Jiageng Park, etc., which can be visited on foot.
attractions.shortFeatures: A university town with combination of Chinese and Western styles

attractions.name: 龙舟池
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary:
· Dragon Boat Pond, located in Jimei Village, was reclaimed by Mr. Tan Kah Kee in 1950 by building a dike on the beach. 
· There are seven pavilions with different styles: Qiming, Nanhui, Chang Gung, Zuo, Right, Feng and Yuan. 
Every year, there is a grand dragon boat race during the Dragon Boat Festival, with drums and music singing in unison, melodious southern sound and buzzing people. The quiet campus on weekdays becomes a sea of joy.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pavilions with southern Fujian characteristics are built by the pool

attractions.name: 同安影视城
attractions.summary: Tong'an Film and Television City (formerly Yuanhua Film and Television City) is adjacent to the famous Degu Temple Brahma Temple, with a total area of 1,000 mu. It is an antique man-made landscape entertainment city invested and built by Yuanhua Group. Yuanhua Film and Television City is a large-scale comprehensive theme park that combines nature with antique man-made landscape, and integrates the essence of ancient Chinese architecture, folk customs, modern high-tech entertainment and film and television production. She conforms to the world upsurge of advocating "returning to nature and overseas Chinese seeking their roots and visiting their ancestors", and timely shows a new world of tourism and entertainment of Han culture and garden art for tourists at home and abroad and urban and rural residents. The film and television city integrates entertainment, knowledge, artistry and participation, making it a high-quality amusement park with the flavor of the times.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the ancient city in person, all kinds of antique buildings; Crossing to the old city of Beijing

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 五号院相声茶馆（古文化街通庆里店）
attractions.name_en: No. 5 Courtyard Xiangsheng Teahouse (Ancient Cultural Street Tongqingli Store)
attractions.summary: Experience the courtyard tea house, enjoy tea, taste fresh Tianjin style snacks, and listen to traditional cross-talk.

attractions.name: 海河游船
attractions.summary: Haihe Sightseeing Boat gathers the essence of Tianjin tourism. Along the way, you can not only feel the changes of Tianjin era, but also appreciate the modern buildings of modern cities. A Haihe River has summarized the history of Tianjin. As the saying goes, only with the Haihe River can there be the history and prosperity of Tianjin, and the prosperity of Haihe River leads to the prosperity of Tianjin. In the Haihe River sightseeing cruise route, what attracts people's attention are the distinctive bridges, which are the pride of Tianjin's urban style. The Yongle Bridge, which integrates with the huge Ferris wheel "Tianjin Eye", the Jiefang Bridge, one of Tianjin's iconic buildings, and the Lion Grove, which has a variety of stone lions. While getting close to these bridges by boat, taking the Haihe River cruise can also enjoy the "Nine Bridges and Thirteen Scenic Spots" along the Haihe River, such as the Dabeiyuan commercial area, the historic Tianjin Station, and the Italian style street that combines Chinese and Western styles.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 张学良故居
attractions.summary:
Zhang Xueliang's Former Residence Museum, also known as Shaoshual's Mansion, lived here in the 1920s and 1930s. This building is luxurious, beautiful and generous, mainly in western Baroque style. The rooms are elegantly decorated, and the stairs, floors, doors and windows are all made of Philippine wood. 
Zhang Xueliang's former residence, which has been renovated for more than two years, reappears today. The music, decoration, clothing, furniture and characters here reappear the original appearance of the Zhang family's life in the French Concession in Tianjin.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Tang La Yaxiu Tang Garden. Health Royal Banquet

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 得胜桥
attractions.summary: Desheng Bridge is an old street in Wuchang District, Wuhan. The whole street is only 800 meters long and 6 meters wide. It starts from Zhongshan Road in the north and ends at the intersection of Zhonghua Road and Liangdao Street in the south. It is known as the street with the most Wuchang characteristics. This old street has a history of more than 600 years. Old houses with a history of hundreds of years can be seen everywhere, brick by brick, which is the epitome of the history of old Wuchang City.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient blocks with Wuchang characteristics

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路
attractions.summary: Lihuangpi Road and Huangpi Road are the same road. Lihuangpi Road, with a total length of 604 meters, was built in 1900 (the 26th year of Guangxu) and was built by Huangpi people, hence the name Huangpi Road. Later, it was assigned to the Russian Concession in Hankou, which was called Yima Road. Located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Because Li Yuanhong, the two presidents of the Republic of China, was a native of Huangpi, Wuhan, and was known as Li Huangpi, this road was renamed Li Huangpi Road in 1946. Lihuangpi Road is a famous "slow life" block in Wuhan, which is a continuation of Hankou's spirit and temperament.
attractions.shortFeatures: Literary and retro slow life block

attractions.name: 吉庆民俗街
attractions.summary: Premature Hubu Lane, late night Jiqing Street ". During the day, the area is sparsely populated, but as night falls, Jiqing Street is brightly lit and bustling with people. Simple stalls line up in a row, offering a wide variety of local delicacies. When enjoying the feast, you can also enjoy folk performances full of "Han flavor", which are extremely lively. Full text 

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖南路凌波门
attractions.name_en: Lingbo Gate, South East Lake Road
attractions.summary: The former Lingbomen Trestle Bridge is one of the favorite places for Wu Da students, and it also carries the cultural memory of Wu Da students. In 2012, the trestle was demolished due to potential safety hazards in wild swimming. After several twists and turns, Lingbo Gate was renovated again in May this year, and it became an East Lake scenic spot where surrounding students and foreign tourists rushed to set foot. On the shore of Lingbomen, East Lake, a stone tablet about 2 meters high was erected with the words "Lingbomen Swimming Pool" engraved on it. The back of the stone tablet details the "past lives" of Lingbo Gate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Not to miss East Lake attractions

attractions.name: 珞喻路光谷广场
attractions.summary: Guanggu Square is located in Wuhan. There is a "Star River" sculpture on the square, which is made of 7 steel dragon bones. The 7 dragon bones look like floating "ribbons" in the air. In addition, plants such as red maple, osmanthus, shrubs, and flowers are interspersed and planted on the square, which is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 东湖绿道
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; On foot; Hiking; Hiking/Biking
attractions.summary:
East Lake Greenway is located in East Lake Eco-tourism Scenic Area, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, with a total length of about 101.98 kilometers. It is the longest greenway around the lake in the core area of 5A-level cities in China. 
East Lake Greenway is divided into seven themed landscape roads: Tingtao Road, Huzhong Road, Baima Road, Country Road, Forest Road, Moshan Road and Hushan Road. It fully relies on eight natural features of East Lake Mountain, Forest, Ze, Garden, Island, Embankment, Field and Bay, and turns East Lake into an "ecological green heart" of the city where citizens are close to nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: Leisure trails connecting many scenic spots in East Lake

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 西九文化区
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park presents a grand and diverse Christmas celebration in Hong Kong, creating a festive atmosphere together. Celebrate the holiday at the "West Kowloon Christmas Market" and choose global holiday cuisine and selected Christmas gifts with family, friends, and children. Appreciate the enlarged Christmas town and giant Christmas tree of the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Join the "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" global super inflatable bouncing party (November 22, 2024- Hong Kong). As winter approaches, the West Kowloon Cultural District (West Kowloon) invites the public to participate in the grand and diverse Christmas celebration event with family, friends, and children from November 22, 2024 (Friday) to January 5, 2025 (Sunday). Nine Colorful Christmas ". The West Kowloon Christmas Market will be unveiled on Friday, November 22, 2024. During the first three weekends (Friday to Sunday), six distinctive stalls will be opened on the lawn of the art park seaside first; Starting from December 12th (Friday), the market will expand to over 30 specialty stalls, located on the east lawn of the art park and the seaside platform opposite M+. The West Kowloon Christmas Market offers a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts. Surrounded by the charming Victoria Harbour scenery and lush green lawns of the West Kowloon Art Park, visitors can immerse themselves in the dazzling holiday lights and enjoy melodious live music and performances. Apart from the Christmas market, visitors should not miss the "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Parade" held by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) on the West Lawn at the seaside from November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025. The giant and dazzling Christmas tree standing over 20 meters tall in the enlarged version of Christmas Town will be transformed into a giant canvas this year, with projections of different winter festival scenes added to enhance the festive atmosphere. The Christmas town of over 10000 square feet will open on November 22, and the Hong Kong Tourism Board will also stage a total of four "Winter Victoria Harbour Water Fireworks" on the opening day and from December 24 to 26, shining brightly in Victoria Harbour. The global super inflatable bouncing party "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" will be held for the first time on December 21, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park lawn, bringing a new outdoor bouncing experience to children and kids. West Kowloon is the first stop of The Big Bounce World Tour in Asia, featuring four uniquely designed super giant inflatable amusement areas, including the "Global Super Inflatable Castle" and the Hong Kong's ultra long inflatable obstacle course. There are multiple exclusive events throughout the day, with parent-child events during the day and a night jumping party for people aged 16 and above at night. The party brings an exciting lineup of special guests and themes, inviting the public to celebrate the festival together with "day jumping and night jumping". Highlight 1 of the "Colorful Christmas in West Kowloon" event: West Kowloon Christmas Market: Visitors can purchase a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts at the featured stalls, bringing a happy holiday experience to families and young children. On designated days and times, there will be live music and performance times available: the first phase will take place from November 22nd to 24th, November 29th to December 1st, and December 6th to 8th (a total of 9 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The second phase will take place from December 12th to 23rd, 2024, and from 27th to 29th (a total of 15 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The actual opening hours will be announced again on December 24th to 26th, 2024 (a total of 3 days) from 14:00 to 23:00. Location: The first phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside Lawn. The second phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside East Lawn and M+opposite the Seaside Platform. The "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Tour" organized by the Hong Kong Tourism Board: Visitors can immerse themselves in the Greater Bay Area. Version of Christmas Town, On site, there is a winter scenery presented with colorful Christmas gifts and a giant Christmas tree. Time: November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025 Location: Art Park Seaside West Lawn 3, "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station": Both children and adults can participate in the global super large inflatable bouncing party, with bubble parties and DJ stationed on-site. During the day, it is a parent-child event, and in the evening, it is a night bouncing party for people aged 16 and above. There are special guests and themes available. Time: December 21, 2024 to January 5, 2025, 10:00-23:10 (divided into time slots) Location: Art Park Grand Lawn Cultural and Art Programs and Activities During the Christmas period, a series of art and cultural activities will be held at different locations in West Kowloon. Visitors can enjoy cultural and artistic activities while also enjoying a wonderful and unforgettable Christmas experience. Art enthusiasts can visit the two museums in West Kowloon for exhibitions. The "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Sino French Cultural Exchange in the 17th and 18th Centuries" exhibition at the Palace Museum in Hong Kong will be open to the public on December 18th, while visitors to M+can visit two special exhibitions, "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and "Guo Pei: Artistic Imagination in the Sky". Visitors can also watch weekend street performances planned by the West Kowloon Cultural Centre and other cultural events held in West Kowloon. The global touring exhibition "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition", organized by Visionairs Asia Hong Kong, will open on December 8, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park. The exhibition is presented in collaboration between digital heritage expert Histovery and the public restoration agency of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, with support from L'Oreal Group, and will be staged on the occasion of the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral. Through innovative technology, the exhibition allows visitors to experience the unique architectural treasure of Notre Dame Cathedral in high-definition historical landscapes. As Notre Dame Cathedral was engulfed in fire and reopened after five years of restoration, exploring this architectural treasure holds great historical and cultural significance. The 2024 Dahua Bank Ink Art Festival will be held from December 13th to 29th, 2024 at the Art Exhibition Pavilion and the High Lawn of the Art Park, presenting Hong Kong's premier ink art celebration to the audience. Sponsored by Dahua Bank (Hong Kong) and organized by Dahua Bank's "Art · Workshop", the Ink Art Festival will host a variety of exciting activities, including the 2024 Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award winning works exhibition, art workshops, ink themed forums, music performances, interactive installations, and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" Carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. The "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition" coincides with the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris this month, and visitors can visit the exhibition from Exhibition Art. Asia. Hong Kong (Visionairs) The Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition will be held from December 8, 2024 to March 7, 2025. Location: GF01-03 underground of the Art Park. Visitors can visit a series of exciting and rich activities, including the 2024 "Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award" exhibition and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. Location: Art Exhibition Pavilion and High Lawn of the Art Park. For more information about the activities, please refer to the organizers of the program or event. New concept stores and limited time "West Kowloon Consumption Rewards" have landed in the Art Park, providing visitors with more diverse dining options, including% Arabica's boutique coffee Honbo's signature burgers and hot dogs, Tiger Hall's delicious pearl milk tea, and local convenience store brand 852 Eight Five Two's light meals. Designated restaurants and retail stores in the West Kowloon Cultural District will also provide surprise shopping experiences during the Christmas period. On the same day, customers can redeem HKD 50 or HKD 100 cash vouchers by spending a specified amount through electronic payment (up to four different store receipts can be accumulated). For more details, please visit the website of the West Kowloon Cultural District. M+2024 Christmas Celebration Gift Series M+Store presents a series of festive gifts for museum visitors, allowing everyone to share joy with their loved ones. Selected items include exquisite Christmas gift baskets bringing high-quality food and exquisite M+products from the Hong Kong Grand Hyatt Hotel, as well as Christmas sock sets to add a festive atmosphere### Editor's note: The West Kowloon Cultural District is one of the largest cultural projects in the world, with the vision of creating a colorful new cultural zone for Hong Kong on a 40 hectare reclaimed land adjacent to Victoria Harbour. There are various theaters, performance spaces, and museums within the cultural zone that produce and host exhibitions, performance programs, and cultural and artistic activities; And it will provide 23 hectares of public space, including a two kilometer long seaside promenade.
