attractions.name: 浅水湾
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 天星小轮
attractions.summary: • Known as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, the Star Ferry has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. • It is not only an important part of the cross sea transportation system between Hong Kong and Kowloon, but also a must experience itinerary for visitors to Hong Kong. • The National Geographic Tourism Magazine once praised taking the Star Ferry to visit both sides of Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life". To this day, the Star Ferry still maintains its retro design, with wooden benches and iron fans in the cabin, giving it a strong Hong Kong vibe. At present, the Star Ferry has two ferry routes and stops at three piers, namely the Tsim Sha Tsui Central Link and the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line. Among them, the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line is more suitable for enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. Full text 

attractions.name: 梅窝
attractions.summary: Mui Wo is located in the southeast of Lantau Island, Hong Kong, and the district is administratively an Islands District. Mui Wo, also known as Silver Mine Bay, is named after two silver mines in the former valley. Song Emperor Min and his attendants once took refuge here, and Mui Wo was stained with glory. Now, the old market is surrounded by new buildings. There are shops selling snacks near the ferry terminal. Across the river is the old market, which is also the hub of land and water transportation on Lantau Island. Outside the ferry terminal is the bus terminal, and there are shops, restaurants and markets nearby. Walking along the coast is where Silver Mine Bay Beach is located.
attractions.shortFeatures: Starting point of visiting Lantau Island

attractions.name: 海滨长廊
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Waterfront Promenade is a southern waterfront area located in the West Kowloon New Reclamation Area in Hong Kong. The West Kowloon Waterfront Promenade can see the sea view of the west of Hong Kong Island and Victoria Harbour. It is one of the places to watch the fireworks in Victoria Harbour. Since the West Kowloon Waterfront Promenade is not as close to the bustling urban area as Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront Park, there are not many people and the environment is relatively quiet. However, some cyclists, drivers, photographers and anglers also come here every day.

attractions.name: 银矿湾泳滩
attractions.summary:
Silver Mine Bay (also written as Silver Mine Bay) is a bay in Hong Kong located in the Mui Wo area in southeastern Lantau, New Territories. Silver Mine Bay Beach here is wide and shallow, making it one of Hong Kong's famous beaches.
Silver Mine Bay is named after the Silver Mine Cave located on the nearby mountain. The cave once produced silver and was mined around the late 19th century. Due to the low silver content of the ore, production stopped, leaving only the cave remains for tourists to cherish.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after the nearby silver mine cave

attractions.name: 文武庙
attractions.summary:
Built in 1847, Man Mo Temple is located on Hollywood Road. It is one of the most historic temples in Hong Kong and the center of religious beliefs on Hong Kong Island. 
The so-called Wenwu Temple, "Wen" refers to Emperor Wenchang and "Wu" refers to Emperor Guan Shengdi. Opposite the temple, there is a street park. The park is small, quiet and comfortable, and there is a remote children's playground. It makes people feel that although the streets here are crowded, people's hearts are quiet and relaxed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong's famous Chinese temple

attractions.name: 银矿洞
attractions.summary: The Silver Mine Cave is located on Lantau Island in the New Territories of Hong Kong and is a historic mining site. This used to be an important silver mining site in Hong Kong, but now it has become a popular tourist attraction, attracting many adventure enthusiasts and history enthusiasts to visit.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 东川红土地
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast of Kunming, the soil contains a lot of iron and aluminum, forming a dazzling color. 
· It is considered to be the most imposing red land in the world except Brazil. From a distance, it is colorful and a paradise for photographers. 
The scenic spots are scattered, forming three main viewing routes: northwest line, northeast line and south line. The most convenient way to play is to charter a car. 
The best time to visit the red land is when the wheat is ripe from April to May, when rape flowers grow vigorously from September to December, and when there is occasional residual snow in the fields from February to March.
attractions.shortFeatures: Paradise for photography enthusiasts

restaurants.name_en: Bridge fragrant Garden authentic bridge rice noodles
Chongqing pig pen old Chongqing hot pot

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 东方之门
attractions.name_en: Gate to the East Exhibition Center
attractions.summary:
Oriental Gate is regarded as a skyscraper on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou, with a total height of about 301.8 meters. The Oriental Gate is divided into two parts: the South Building and the North Building. Its external shape is a door, and it is known as "the first door in the world". This landmark building is adjacent to Jinji Lake in the east and International Building and Century Financial Building in the west. It is not only a new gate for Suzhou, but also a new gate for the world to look at China. 
This 88-story building was completed in 2013, surpassing Suzhou Xindi Center to become the tallest building in Suzhou. Oriental Gate includes commercial, hotel, office buildings and other services, creating a new urban hotspot for Suzhou with commercial prosperity and driving the prosperity of CDB area. 
Jinji Lake at night is very vibrant. Moonlight Pier, Water Curtain Movie, Ligongdi and Suzhou Paradise light up the shores of Jinji Lake, and the majestic and elegant Oriental Gate is also one of the major landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Suzhou Internet celebrity punch-in new landmark

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社(百年记忆公社)
attractions.name_en: Mission Hills Huayi Brothers Feng Xiaogang Movie Town
attractions.summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. attractions.name: 滕王阁游轮
attractions.summary: Tengwang Pavilion, located by the city and facing the river, is known as the "first tower of the Xijiang River". For thousands of years, people have been intoxicated by the beautiful scenery of the Gan River, where "the sunset and solitary geese fly together, and the autumn water flows in the same color as the sky". In recent years, Nanchang City has built two cities in the north and south with the Gan River as the main axis. "One River, Two Banks" is not only a landmark landscape of modern Nanchang, but also an indispensable landscape element for visiting the Gan River. In order to further enhance the image of Nanchang as a historical and cultural city in China, meet the development needs of Nanchang as a tourist city, and facilitate the general public and domestic and foreign tourists to appreciate the charming scenery of Nanchang such as "famous city, famous river, famous building, famous scenery", greatly improve the quality of tourists' sightseeing, and enrich the content of tourists' sightseeing. The LED walls of 296 high-rise buildings along the Yangtze River form a giant screen, setting a Guinness record. Every night at 8:30, a spectacular light show is staged, taking you to experience the charm of Nanchang. Southeast Huaguang. The Tengwang Pavilion Cruise is a wonderful platform to enjoy the night view of the Gan River, with 360 degree sightseeing without any blind spots. The Tengwang Pavilion on the east bank is quaint and magnificent, and the Honggu Beach on the west bank is fashionable and beautiful. The "Tengwang Pavilion" cruise ship, with a length of 36 meters and a width of 10 meters, is a twin body three story sightseeing cruise ship. attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 万寿宫历史文化街区

attractions.name: 绳金塔
attractions.tag: Monuments and ruins; historical buildings; Ancient Pagodas; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Shengjin Tower is located on the east side of Shengjin Tower Street in the Xihu District of Nanchang City, originally outside the ancient city’s Jinxiang Gate. It was first built during the Tang Dynasty, in the Tianyou period (904–907 AD). According to legend, before the tower was constructed, a monk named Weiyi dug the ground and found an iron box containing four golden ropes, three ancient swords (inscribed with the words "Drive Wind," "Pacify Fire," and "Subdue Dragon"), and a golden bottle filled with 300 relics, which is how the tower got its name.

· The Shengjin Tower is a typical brick-and-wood structure in Jiangnan, designed in a pagoda style. It stands approximately 50.86 meters tall and consists of seven levels and eight sides (with seven visible levels and eight hidden levels). The tower features red railings, blue tiles, black corners, clean walls, and a gourd-shaped copper roof with strong religious significance. It has graceful flying eaves, with copper bells hanging from them (recast using ancient bell-making techniques to create wind chimes, with seven layers producing seven different tones). The gourd-shaped copper roof shines brilliantly in gold, with the body of the tower adorned in red railings, blue tiles, and black corners, creating an elegant, simple, and timeless appearance. Each level of the tower has four real doorways and four false doorways, arranged in a staggered manner between levels, with each level’s doors differing in design. The Shengjin Tower is both ancient and beautiful, embodying the typical artistic style of Jiangnan architecture. Having been built during the Tang Dynasty over a thousand years ago, it serves as a carrier of historical information and a testament to the wisdom of generations of laboring people. Shengjin Tower is often referred to as "Water and Fire Harmonized, Overlooking Jiangcheng."
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient pagoda, originally built during the Tang Dynasty in the Tianyou era.

The world's largest clock will also be installed, with 60 space capsules representing a 60-minute time scale. The Ferris wheel will adopt dual power supply and dual power system to ensure the safety of tourists.

attractions.name: 南昌海洋公园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Nanchang Ocean Park is a large-scale modern ocean park covering an area of 40 mu. The total length of the undersea tunnel of Nanchang Ocean Park is 74 meters, with more than 800 species of marine life and more than 10,000 tails. Nanchang Ocean Park is one of the largest marine aquariums in China and is known as Nanchang Ocean Zoo and Nanchang Aquarium. Ocean Park is a large-scale modern ocean park invested, designed and built by Hangzhou Underwater World Science Popularization Co., Ltd. The first phase of the marine aquarium has a total investment of 100 million yuan, covering an area of 40 mu, a building area of 12,000 square meters, a total water body of more than 5,000 tons, a total length of 74 meters of undersea tunnel, more than 800 species of marine life and more than 10,000 animals (tails). It is one of the largest marine aquariums in China. (1) The Freshwater Biological Museum of Ocean Park displays nearly a hundred kinds of tropical freshwater ornamental fish: ferocious silver pomfret, precious Chinese sturgeon, huge walrus... The mysterious Yama brings you infinite reverie from the forest scenery. (2) The lively and lovely seals and dolphin "actors" in the sea animal and dolphin performance theater perform spiritual programs such as header and skateboarding for you, which makes people laugh. (3) Hundreds of colorful and shaped coral reef fish in the Coral Reef Biological Museum, such as the overbearing cannonball fish, the lazy sucker fish, and the boxy papaya fish, swim in the flowery coral clusters. The unique charming scenery of the tropical coral sea makes people fascinated and linger. (4) Ocean Park Cross-Harbour Tunnel Pavilion is located in a dark underwater passage, and the super monster sharks and rays in the depths of the seabed near Bermuda are close at hand, which is thrilling. (5) The Ocean Theater of Nanchang Ocean Park performs large-scale performances such as human turtles, human sharks dancing together, and thousands of fish competing for food. (6) The Ocean Folk Museum of the park has participatory projects such as "Picking Shellfish on the Beach", "DIY Area for Weaving Fish Nets", "Multimedia Science Popularization Area" and "Fish Pond". (7) Park Ocean Restaurant provides all kinds of quick and delicious Chinese and western meals with children, which you will definitely like. (8) The souvenir mall is full of exquisite gifts with various ocean themes, which adds to the enrichment and joy of the journey. attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.

- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.

Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper.
