attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 越秀公园-韩国庭院
attractions.summary: Yuexiu Park is the largest park in Guangzhou and one of the oldest parks in Guangzhou's history. The park is shaded by green trees and boasts picturesque lakes and mountains, making it a great destination for citizens to relax and entertain themselves. The Korean Garden is a distinctive attraction within Yuexiu Park, showcasing traditional Korean garden art and providing visitors with a window to learn about Korean culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 五羊石雕
attractions.summary: The Five Rams Stone Carving is located in Yuexiu Park and is a symbol of Guangzhou city, as well as the origin of the name "Yangcheng". The Five Rams Stone Carving originated from a beautiful legend. Legend has it that in the past, Guangzhou was very barren and people could not afford to eat or drink. Five immortals rode five sheep with ears of grain in their mouths and flew here, leaving the ears of grain to the people of Guangzhou. They wished for a bountiful harvest every year and then flew away with clouds, turning the sheep into stones. Guangzhou became a prosperous land from then on. The Five Rams Stone Carving was built in April 1960. The statue is 11 meters high and is carved from 130 pieces of granite. It is a commemoration of a beautiful legend. There is also a sculpture of the Five Immortals next to it, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 珠江夜游
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Located 2km west of Canton Tower, North Gate Square of Sun Yat-sen University, at CUHK/memorial archway. 
The wharf is located in Guang Zhouta, Haizhu District, an important landscape area of the new central axis of the city. It is planned to open a number of water bus routes. The wharf is positioned as a midway terminal for citizens to visit Guang Zhouta, tour the Pearl River at night and travel. The departure route of Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf is-Ersha Island-Xinghai Concert Hall-North Gate of Zhongda University-Haiyin Bridge-Guangzhou Bridge-Haixinsha-Guang Zhouta-Liede Bridge-and returns to Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour around the bright night scene of Yangcheng

attractions.name: 广东省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
The new museum was completed in 2010. It is the only provincial comprehensive museum in Guangdong Province, a patriotic education base and social practice base in Guangzhou. 
Guangdong's history, culture, art and nature are the three main exhibition directions, which are divided into four parts: history museum, nature museum, art museum and temporary exhibition hall. 
More precious exhibits include "baleen whale skeleton", "giant malachite" and "Xinyi jade" weighing more than five tons in natural specimens.
attractions.shortFeatures: Treasure Box Architecture with Rich Calligraphy and Painting in Lingnan

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海珠有轨电车1号线
attractions.summary: Guangzhou Haizhu Tram Line 1 has a total of 11 subway stations, including Wanshengwei, Pazhou Tower, Pazhou Bridge South, Exhibition East, Exhibition Central, Exhibition West, Nanfeng, Pati, Liede Bridge South, Guangzhou Tower East, and Guangzhou Tower.

attractions.name: 猎德大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: Single-tower self-anchored structure

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园
attractions.summary: Haixinsha is located in the area of Bati, the Pearl River - Guangzhou Tower - Huacheng Square. It is an artificial island located on the the Pearl River. The night scene here is very beautiful. With the lights of Huacheng Square, you can see the colorful changes of Guangzhou Tower across the river, which reflect each other. Moreover, it is also a great destination for the exterior of Guangzhou Tower, where many photography enthusiasts take photos. The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Those who have watched the opening ceremony will surely remember this boat shaped sports arena vividly. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. The unique geographical location makes Haixinsha and its surrounding areas a must for exploring the international metropolis of Guangzhou, which is a new landmark of Guangzhou. The subway APM line connects these three areas to form a three-point line. Generally, APM can take you to Haixinsha Station, but if you want to have a better tour, it is recommended to get off at Dahua Theater Station. Because you can also visit the Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Library, which are new cultural landmarks in Guangzhou. Then take a slow walk to Liede Bridge and see Haixinsha and Guangzhou Tower from the other side.

attractions.name: 富陶温泉
attractions.summary:
Futao Hot Spring is located near Linggudong Scenic Area, surrounded by bamboo forests, with pleasant landscape. 
The hot spring takes water 2008 meters underground, the outlet water temperature is 53 ℃, and the daily water output is 435 tons. 
The water quality of hot springs is clear and rich in a variety of trace elements, which helps to relax nerves and relieve stress, and has certain curative effects on all kinds of dermatitis, arthritis, skin diseases and cardiovascular diseases.
attractions.shortFeatures: Soak in the hot spring among the bamboo forests

attractions.name: 宜兴竹海
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; treasure spot for kids.; Forests
attractions.summary:
- The Yixing Bamboo Sea Scenic Area is located in Hufu Town, Yixing, covering nearly 15,000 hectares of bamboo forest that rises and falls with the terrain. The bamboo sways with the mountains, resembling rolling waves that stretch endlessly.
- The scenic area is known for its clear mountains and waters, where the four seasons can be experienced in a single day, offering natural wonders and delights. Major attractions include "The First Source of Taihu Lake," "The First Peak of Southern Jiangsu," "Bamboo Brings Peace," and "The Mirror Lake Scenic View."
- This place is a natural oxygen bar and an excellent location for film and TV shooting. It has been used in the production of notable works such as *Romance of the Three Kingdoms*, *The Flying Hero White Dragon*, and *The Founding of the Song Dynasty*.
- Visitors can now take a cable car to the mountain top, where they can enjoy a panoramic aerial view of the bamboo sea. If the wind is strong, one can experience the magnificent and tumultuous waves of the bamboo forest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the Bamboo Sea and enjoy a cool summer.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:00-16:30(Admission ends at 16:00),Opens at Daylight saving time 08:00-17:00(Admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 张公洞
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Caves; Rafting
attractions.summary:
- Zhanggong Cave is located at the foot of Mengfeng Mountain, southwest of Yixing City. It is one of the "Three Wonders" of Yixing and a famous limestone karst cave.  
- According to legend, Zhang Daoling, a Taoist of the Han Dynasty, practiced Taoism here, and Zhang Guolao, an immortal from the Tang Dynasty, lived here in seclusion, hence the name Zhanggong Cave.  
- The cave consists of two sections: the front and rear caves. The halls are vast, with many chambers interconnected. There are caves within caves, all connected, and the temperature varies from one cave to another. It is known as a "marvel of the world."  
- The cave features thrilling underground river exploration and offers rafting, but visitors must wear raincoats, or they will be splashed with water by other tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the奇妙 and bizarre stalactites.

hotel.Hotel Name: Sanya Banling Hot Spring Haiyun Villa Resort Hotel

attractions.name: 南山文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- The Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone is a large park showcasing traditional Chinese Buddhist culture, with numerous attractions inside. The 108-meter-tall Sea Guanyin statue is undoubtedly one of its highlights.
- Major attractions include Nanshan Temple, the Sea Guanyin Buddha statue, the "No Two Dharma Gates", the Ten Directions Pagoda Forest and the Returning to the Roots Garden, the Buddhist Culture Exchange Center, and the Vegetarian Cuisine Shopping Street.
- The world's largest Sea Guanyin statue is also located here. The statue, shaped in the form of Guanyin, faces three directions, is majestic in appearance, stands at 108 meters tall, and cost 190 million RMB to build. It is known as the "Treasure of the Island" throughout Hainan.
- The park has a vegetarian restaurant offering a "Temple Vegetarian Cuisine" buffet, and there are hotels providing accommodation, making it very convenient for sightseeing and Buddhist worship.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the sea view and visit Buddhist landmarks.

attractions.name: 南山海上观音
attractions.name_en: Nanshan Guanyin of the South Sea
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Statues/Sculptures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The statue of Guanyin on the sea in Nanshan is 108 meters high, and Lingbo stands on the King Kong Island on the sea. It is known as a "world-class and century-class" Buddhist project. 
· Integrated three shapes, with solemn treasure appearance, stepping on a 108-petal lotus throne, under the lotus seat is the Vajra Terrace, and inside the Vajra Terrace is the Yuantong Treasure Hall. 
Jingangzhou is connected with the land bank by Puji Bridge. On the other side of Puji Bridge is Guanyin Square and theme parks on both sides of the square. 
In addition, we also make full use of high-tech techniques to create lighted night scenes, fully displaying the cultural and artistic effects of Guanyin such as "Buddha's light shines everywhere" and "stepping on the sea".
attractions.shortFeatures: Majestic statue of Guanyin Bodhisattva

attractions.name: 南山寺
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Temples
attractions.summary:
Located in Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone, Sanya, it is a large temple imitating the style of the prosperous Tang Dynasty and facing the sea. 
There are existing imitation buildings of Tang Dynasty, such as Renwang Hall, Tianwang Hall, Bell Tower, Runwheel Collection, East-West Mountain Climbing Gallery, East-West Side Hall and Golden Hall. 
· The main hall is called Golden Hall. The three main statues enshrined in the golden hall represented the "Buddha of the Three Generations" in space. 
· The whole building is magnificent. It is the largest Buddhist dojo newly built in China in the past 50 years and the largest temple in southern China.
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale antique monasteries

attractions.name: 蜈支洲岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; love sports; Outdoor Diving; Beaches; Seashores; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Wuzhizhou Island Tourist Area is a famous 5A-level scenic spot, located in Haitang Bay, Sanya City, covering an area of approximately 1.48 square kilometers. It boasts rich underwater ecological resources and a comprehensive water sports product system for "quadruple" ocean experiences. It has become a national coastal island resort integrating island sightseeing, recreational activities, honeymoon vacations, and family tourism, making it one of the most well-known tourist destination brands in China.

Here, you’ll find "China's first tropical marine ranch," which has nurtured and developed leading marine recreation methods. The island offers typical diving activities, such as luxury island circum-navigation diving, advanced diving, and coral reef diving. It also features new entertainment projects introduced from abroad, such as dynamic airships, dolphin submarines, and sky dance. In addition, there are helicopter island tours and an immersive outdoor wind tunnel experience center, catering to tourists' vacation desires and pursuits of "sea, land, air, and underwater" activities. Whether you're a curious diving explorer or an adventurous "extreme enthusiast," you will find the perfect activity here.

In addition to the diverse entertainment options, the island also boasts popular tourist spots like Lover's Bridge, Lover’s Island, Sun Viewing Rock, and custom-made swimming pools, all of which are perfect for capturing breathtaking photos. The winding coastline, crystal-clear waters, and the colorful, vibrant underwater world featuring various corals, mackerels, groupers, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, prawns, luminous snails, and a variety of tropical fish make it a premier diving destination in China. Currently, Wuzhizhou Island offers four main diving spots—Qilin Sea, Back Garden, Glass Fish Planet, and Little Universe—each with its own unique characteristics, attracting diving enthusiasts from around the world.

The only island hotel on the island, Coral Hotel, is one of the few high-end boutique island hotels in China. It consists of five connected buildings designed with coral as the prototype, built to five-star standards. The hotel offers various room types including sea-view, garden-view, poolside, duplex, suites, and wooden houses, totaling 305 rooms. It is a sweet destination for romantic proposals, honeymoon trips, and family vacations, providing a private and pure island leisure experience for visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic diving resort destination

attractions.name: 私人订制
attractions.summary:
The freshwater swimming pool is located on wuzhizhou island, which is the shooting location of the movie Private Custom. 
· There is a white "bird's nest"-shaped building beside the pool, and there are many plants and flowers around it. 
The scenery is exquisite and beautiful, and the color is mainly blue and white, giving people a fresh and holiday feeling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pure island holiday style

attractions.name: 情人桥
attractions.summary: Originally an iron cable bridge, it was the sea observation point of the island guarding troops at that time. Walking on the swaying iron cable bridge requires a bit of courage and cleverness. Some women want to cross the bridge to the observation point and experience it, but they are afraid of falling into the sea. When crossing the bridge, they tightly hold onto their friends' hands and do not let go, so this bridge is jokingly called the "Lover Bridge". Later, for the safety of our guests, our island transformed the original iron cable bridge into the current wooden bridge. Friends who are interested in crossing the "Lover's Bridge" may want to give it a try.

attractions.name: 三亚亚特兰蒂斯失落的空间水族馆
三亚亚特兰蒂斯水世界
attractions.summary: Atlantis Water World is a year-round water park that will bring surprise experiences to happy families from all over the world. Atlantis Water World and Dolphin Island cover an area of 200000 square meters and are one of the open and eye-catching seaside resorts in Sanya Atlantis Resort and even locally. Tourists can experience various anti gravity water slides here and feel the adrenaline pumping gliding. Or challenge the turbulent waterways scattered throughout the park; Or explore underwater tunnels meandering along the river; Or have intimate contact with sharks and rays - this is a paradise for visitors of all ages. Whether you are a fan of floating rafts, a seeker of wild speed skating, or someone who prefers to stroll by the pool, sometimes leisurely and at other times splashing water, Atlantis Water World can bring you endless fun. In the summer of Hainan, there is not only sunshine, beaches, waves, coconut wind, and flip flops, but also the indispensable Sanya Atlantis. Located in Haitang Bay on the national coast, Atlantis Water World, along with Dolphin Island, covers an area of 200000 square meters and is one of the entertainment destinations in Sanya City. Tourists can enjoy 34 water slides in the park, experience various anti gravity water facilities, and feel the adrenaline pumping gliding. Children also have exclusive play activities, such as Speed Drifting River, Ocean Empire, and Water Fun, which bring coolness and fun to children and create memories of midsummer nights. The Sea God's Leap slides rapidly down a nearly vertical slide, curving through the shark pool tunnel. Unknowingly opening your eyes, you will see sharks and rays swimming freely beside you, allowing you to immediately experience another courage challenge that is still in shock. The challenger arrived at the top of the tower, which was nearly 8 stories high, standing on the door of the transparent launch module, overlooking the entire water world. At this moment, the door suddenly opened, and the challenger will fall into the water slide below in a free fall manner, sliding at a super high speed in the curved slide with their body. If you are not ready to challenge yourself with a high difficulty project, you can choose to do some warm-up exercises with Shark Crossing. Entering the tunnel surrounded by sharks through a relatively gentle slide, as the water flows slowly forward, one will experience a mix of leisurely and thrilling experiences. The Chain Horn (Thunderbolt Storm) continuously passes through a snake shaped bend in the darkness, swaying back and forth with the water flow, with a total length of nearly 200 meters. The thrilling and exciting slide setting makes you scream continuously with joy. 19 mini slides with different functions and various scenes provide an immersive experience, allowing children of all ages to find their own fun. Such an extraordinary experience is unforgettable. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-19:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 椰梦长廊
attractions.summary:
Coconut Dream Promenade is a seaside scenic avenue built around Sanya Bay. Coconut trees are neatly arranged along the roadside, forming a wonderful picture with the beach and sea water. 
· This is a world-class cold shelter and leisure resort; On one side of the sea is a tropical botanical garden forest, and on the other side is a leisure resort. 
Visiting the Coconut Dream Promenade in the evening is the most emotional thing. The golden sunset will cover the whole Coconut Dream Promenade. If there are clouds, it will also form a rare phenomenon of burning clouds.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the beautiful seaside coconut grove

attractions.name: 三亚千古情
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Sanya Eternal Scenic Area is a living ancient city of Li and Miao. 
There are dozens of theme areas in the scenic spot, such as Yazhou Ancient Street, Love Street, Licun Miao Village, Interactive Amusement Hall, Virtual Space, Water Playing Area, Eternal Love Inn, etc., which are suitable for both rain and shine, and can enjoy young and old. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Sanya" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Based on the magnificent history of Sanya for 10,000 years, it breaks through the boundary between traditional space and feeling with its brand-new stage design, making every corner filled with the tension of the performance in full bloom, shaking the audience's visual and auditory nerves. 
The 5D live-action drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, and houses collapsing. Real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, the performing arts shows such as "Recruiting Marriage in Lizhai", "Dopamine Flash", "YOLO Carnival" and "Li Miao Celebrating a Harvest Year" are splendid, allowing visitors to feel the history, culture and folk customs of Sanya for thousands of years. With constant activities all year round, it is an ideal destination for Sanya tourism.  
Sanya Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the rich Li culture in Sanya

restaurants.name_en: Crowne Plaza Sanya Bay Resort·Tanjia Fish Steak Seafood Restaurant

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 广西药用植物园
attractions.summary: The Guangxi Medicinal Plant Garden is affiliated with the Health Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. It is located in the eastern suburbs of Nanning, 8 kilometers from the city center. The coordinates are 108°19′E, 22°51′N. The altitude ranges from 72 to 113 meters. The area has a subtropical climate, characterized by abundant heat, ample rainfall, and distinct dry and wet seasons. The average annual temperature is 21.6°C, with a maximum extreme temperature of 40.4°C and a minimum extreme temperature of -2.1°C. The average monthly temperature exceeds 20°C for seven months, with an average temperature of 12.8°C in January and an average maximum temperature of 28.3°C in July. The annual sunshine duration is 1,827 hours, and the annual precipitation is 1,200-1,500 millimeters, mostly concentrated from May to September. The annual average relative humidity is 79%.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display herbs and plants such as Two-leaf Pin.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 基诺山寨
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
Jinuo Shanzhai is a place where Jinuo people live in concentrated communities, and it is the only live performing arts experience place in China that shows Jinuo culture in the most comprehensive and concentrated way. 
The performances in the scenic spot are concentrated in the Sun Square in the center of the stockade. Young men and women dressed in Jinuo costumes are singing and dancing with props in hand, which is magnificent. 
You can eat the unique local barbecue, enjoy the performances with rich ethnic customs and experience the rich Jinuo folk customs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery and feel the Jinuo customs

attractions.name: 古纳卡傣族文化园
attractions.summary: Gunaka Dai Cultural Park is located in an ancient village in Xishuangbanna. The stockade is rich in Dai cultural characteristics and retains the ancient cultural heritage of Dai people. There are famous scenic spots such as Manhena and Dai Well in the cultural park. Here you can also see the lush forest and the handicraft making process with Dai characteristics.

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 热带花卉园
attractions.summary: The Xishuangbanna Tropical Flower Garden is located within the Yunnan Tropical Crops Research Institute in the urban area of Jinghong City, covering an area of approximately 80 hectares. The garden is designed around a series of natural water surfaces as the main axis for sightseeing, with attractions such as the Flower Garden, Sky Garden, Premier Zhou Enlai Memorial, Palm Area, Rare Tree and Grassland Area, Bonsai Area, Foliage Plant Area, Tropical Fruit Tree Area, and more. It integrates functions of research, science popularization, tourism, and vacation. The garden preserves nearly 1,000 varieties of flowers and economic plants. As you stroll through the park, you are surrounded by a world of exotic flowers, unique trees, and a colorful array of plants, making it an important tourist destination in Xishuangbanna.
attractions.shortFeatures: Science-themed Resort Park

attractions.name: 西双版纳总佛寺
attractions.summary:
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple is the center for Buddhist believers in Xishuangbanna to worship Buddha, and it is also the highest-ranking Buddhist temple in Xishuangbanna. 
The general Buddhist temple is magnificent, with exquisite beams and columns carved, mainly including Weihan Hall, Buddhist College teaching building and other buildings. 
There is an altar in front of the north wall of today's courtyard building, where there are several Buddha statues, and the Buddha's Sutra is painted on the wall. 
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple and Manting Park are connected, and tourists usually enter the General Buddhist Temple from Manting Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beams and columns are beautifully carved, and the architecture is magnificent

attractions.name: 曼听公园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 八一广场
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the heart of Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, it is an important place for political, economic, cultural, leisure, entertainment and other activities in Jiangxi. 
It consists of the central square, the rostrum and the east and west gardens. It is the largest city central square in Jiangxi Province. 
· The large musical fountain in the center of the square, with 1,290 sprinklers, reproduces the bloody battle of the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army in Taihang. 
In the center of the square stands the "August 1st Nanchang Uprising Memorial Tower" inscribed by Marshal Ye Jianying, where many tourists will take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where the military flag is raised

attractions.name: 江西省美术馆
attractions.summary: The art museum officially opened in 2020, with a building area of about 20000 square meters. It displays many works of Chinese modern and contemporary artists and is a public welfare art museum.

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 万寿宫历史文化街区
attractions.summary: The Wanshou Palace Historical and Cultural District showcases the architectural style and historical culture of the Jiangyou ethnic group. Here, tourists can stroll through retro style shops, taste snacks from the 1980s and 1990s, and reminisce about the past.

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 《寻梦滕王阁》实景演出
attractions.summary: The "Searching for Dreams Tengwang Pavilion" is a large-scale "virtual+real-life" interactive cultural performance project in Nanchang. It starts with the Pavilion of Dreams and is led by Mr. Liang Sicheng, who drew the architectural drawings of Tengwang Pavilion. It is initiated by Wang Bo, the leader of the Four Great Masters of the Early Tang Dynasty, who wrote the "Preface to Tengwang Pavilion", bringing together the sages of various dynasties in Jiangxi. Through video projection, lighting, and performances by more than 140 actors, combined with the architectural structure characteristics of Tengwang Pavilion's "Bright Three Dark Seven", with "Seven Dreams and Seven Realms" as the core, seven colors are used to interpret seven life realms. The cultural characteristics of various dynasties, including "poetry, books, rituals, and music", are infused into every detail of the performance, highlighting the literary style and poetic charm, creating a beautiful immersive experience, allowing the audience to appreciate Tengwang Pavilion's profound cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 江西省博物馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) is one of the three major cultural centers in Jiangxi Province. It is based on a square box and symbolizes a treasure box. It has six floors, a building area of 86000 square meters, and an exhibition area of 28000 square meters. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Museum) gathers precious historical relics and ancient art masterpieces discovered from various parts of Jiangxi, and collects a large number of cultural relics from the province. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) has established an exhibition system that combines permanent and temporary exhibitions, consisting of 8 permanent exhibitions and 3 temporary exhibition halls. The entire exhibition showcases the historical landscape and cultural characteristics of Jiangxi, meeting the diverse needs of the public in the new era with high quality.

attractions.name: 南昌汉代海昏侯国遗址公园
attractions.name_en: The National Archaeological Site Park of Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis
attractions.summary: The Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site in Nanchang consists of the capital city of Haihun Marquis State, Zijin City, the first generation Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery, and the western and southern tomb groups of the city site. It is a typical Han Dynasty capital settlement site discovered in China. Since the archaeological excavation of Liuhe Cemetery began in 2011, more than 10000 precious cultural relics such as gold, bronze, iron, jade, lacquered wood, ceramics, bamboo weaving, grass weaving, textiles, bamboo slips, and wooden slips have been unearthed, which is rare in recent archaeological work in China. Among them, as many as 480 gold artifacts were excavated and unearthed. At the same time, the discovery of precious cultural relics such as Confucius' clothing mirror, gilded patterned bells, chimes, jade seals, etc., has great value. The Haihun Hou State Archaeological Site Park is divided into six functional areas: the Site Museum Area, the Tomb Exhibition Area, the Zijin City Exhibition Area, the Archaeological Reserve Area, the Entrance Functional Area, and the Historical Experience Ecological Leisure Area. Highlight 1: The design of the Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Tourist Center in Nanchang incorporates elements from the jade bi unearthed from Liu He's tomb. From a high altitude, it looks like a self forming circular "Congbi Litian" jade clasp. The building area is 8500 square meters. The tourist center comprehensively accommodates tourist reception services, cultural leisure display, cultural experience, entertainment shopping and other functions. Highlight 2: The architectural form of the Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Guo Site Museum has extracted the dragon shaped patterns that have appeared multiple times in the cultural relics unearthed from Liu He's tomb, symbolizing the hidden dragon in the mountains and fields. The building area is 39296 square meters. Our positioning for it is cultural display, cultural experience, etc. The archaeological museum has exhibitions and displays of unearthed cultural relics, as well as projects such as 4D cinemas and VR experiences. Highlight 3: Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery Liu He Cemetery has a trapezoidal plan, with a width of 141-186 meters from north to south and a length of 233-248 meters from east to west. The perimeter of the walls is 868 meters and the width is about 2 meters, covering a total area of about 46000 square meters. The cemetery consists of two main tombs, seven burial tombs, an outer pit and garden wall, north and east gates and their gates, sleeping quarters, ancestral halls, and temple officials' quarters. There is a complete road system and drainage facilities in the park. Some tombs have ancestral halls built in front of them. The two main tombs, Hou Tomb and Hou Madam Tomb, are located in the same tomb but different caves, occupying a higher and central position in the cemetery. The two tombs share a high platform with an area of about 4000 square meters. Its ceremonial architecture consists of east and west wing rooms, sleeping halls, and ancestral halls. Full text 

attractions.name: 南昌汉代海昏侯国遗址博物馆
attractions.name_en: Nanchang Relic Museum For Haihun Principality of Han Dynasty
attractions.summary: The Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site Museum is located in Xinjian District, Nanchang City. It mainly displays precious cultural relics unearthed from the Haihun Marquis tomb, including horseshoe gold, lacquerware, bronze ware, bamboo slips, etc. The exhibits are exquisite and rich in connotation.

attractions.name: 秋水广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanchang Qiushui Square is located on the Ganjiang River in Honggutan New District, close to the administrative center square and across the river from Tengwang Pavilion. 
The main fountain of the square, which can spray up to 108 meters, is the largest musical fountain in Asia. 
Standing under the fountain in summer, it's extremely cool. Looking at the sun through the mist, you can find countless small rainbows, which are very beautiful. 
At night, the dynamic lights on the opposite side dance with the fountain, and there is Taiwan Province Snack Street next to it, which is a good place to enjoy midnight snack.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the musical fountain with changing lights

attractions.name: 南昌秋水广场-音乐喷泉
attractions.summary: Nanchang Qiushui Square faces Tengwang Pavilion across the river, and it is very lively when night falls. The most eye-catching thing in the square is the fountain performance every night. The main spray height of the fountain is 128 meters. When the fountain moves with the music, it is colorful, and people can watch the beautiful scenery of Tengwang Pavilion while enjoying the music.

attractions.name: 南昌之星摩天轮
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ferris wheel; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The landmark of Nanchang, 160 meters high, is 25 meters higher than the previous world record holder "Eye of London". 
· The diameter of the turntable is 153 meters, with 60 space capsules. A ferris wheel can seat six people and can accommodate nearly a thousand people per hour. It takes half an hour to sit in a circle. 
· Overlooking the whole city of Nanchang, the cabin is equipped with LCD TV and Mitsubishi heating and cooling air conditioning. 
The world's largest clock will also be installed, with 60 space capsules representing a 60-minute time scale. The Ferris wheel will adopt dual power supply and dual power system to ensure the safety of tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the romantic landmarks

attractions.name: 华侨城万科世纪水岸鸟屿浮云塔
attractions.name_en: OCT Vanke Century Waterfront Bird Island Floating Cloud Tower
attractions.summary: The Niaoyu Floating Cloud Pagoda is located in Xihu District, Nanchang City. It was personally designed by Norwegian design master Thomas, who extracted waves as symbolic elements. It is named after its shape resembling a suspended aerial tower.

attractions.name: 象湖湿地公园
attractions.summary: The construction area of Xianghu Wetland Park is about 1.89 square kilometers (about 2800 acres), mainly featuring aquaculture water surface in the western landscape project. The area will be developed into a citizen ecological recreation center that integrates tourism, leisure, sightseeing, and entertainment functions.

attractions.name: 万寿宫
attractions.summary: The Wanshou Palace is located on a central island in Xianghu Park, showcasing the traditional architectural style of the late Qing Gan School while retaining the charm of old Nanchang.

restaurants.name_en: I am very happy to meet you

attractions.name: 南头古城
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
attractions.summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 莲花山公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The main peak has a peak square of about 4,000 square meters, which is the tallest outdoor square in Shenzhen. 
· It's a good place to pay tribute to the great man's elegance, see the city's landscape and overlook Futian CBD. 
· One of the red tourist attractions in China, it is a good place for Shenzhen citizens to have daily leisure. 
There are rhododendrons in the garden, and a rhododendron flower show will be held.

attractions.name: 华强北博物馆
attractions.summary: The Huaqiangbei Museum is located in Futian District, Shenzhen. Its permanent exhibition halls include four chapters: Development Dream, Entrepreneurship Dream, Innovation Dream, and Future Dream. Through diverse presentation methods, it integrates comprehensive elements such as technology, fashion, and art.

attractions.name: 东门老街
attractions.summary: Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

attractions.name: 地王观光·深港之窗
attractions.summary: The tourist destination for Diwang sightseeing refers to Diwang Building, a well-known landmark in Shenzhen with a total height of 383.95 meters and an actual building height of 324.8 meters. Climbing up to the 69th floor, you can overlook Hong Kong to the south and Shenzhen to the north. Diwang Sightseeing, also known as the Window of Shenzhen and Hong Kong, is a themed high-rise tourist attraction. Accompanied by melodious music, taking the elevator only takes fifty seconds to reach the top floor of the 69th floor of the Diwang Building. The scenic area features novel and exciting multidimensional dynamic movies, documentary digital overlay slides, and fifteen interesting landscapes. Standing at an altitude of over 300 meters, the winding Shenzhen River looks like a giant dragon waiting to take off, and like a gorgeous green ribbon tightly linking Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 20:20; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 盐田海滨栈道
attractions.summary: Yantian Seaside Plank Road starts from the Seaside Plank Road Fitness Square near Zhongying Street, Shatoujiao, Yantian in the east, ends at Beizaijiao, runs through Meisha Beach and OCT in the east, and is known as the world's longest "Seaside Jade Belt". The total length of the road is 19.5 kilometers, and it is officially divided into three thematic sections: urban living shoreline section, industrial port area shoreline section and natural ecological shoreline section. My three sections are: the first section is 7.2 kilometers from Zhongying Street Seaside Fitness Plaza in Sha Tau Kok to Yantian Food Street; The second section is 9.8 kilometers from Yantian Food Street to Dameisha; The third section is the last 3 kilometers from Dameisha to Beizaijiao Beach.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit Dameisha Waterfront Park

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨栈道
attractions.summary: Dameisha Waterfront Plank Road starts from Yantian Donggang District in the west and ends at Dameisha Waterfront Park in the east, with a total length of about 1km. There are hiking trails, trails, landscape platforms, trestles, stone arch bridges and other facilities along the way. Meandering on the steep shore of the mountain, below are jagged and mottled rocks. The rushing current surges and violently impacts the rocks, forming a magnificent landscape. On the wide platform, the experiencers enjoy the natural beauty by the sea and the wind.

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 深圳市大鹏新区古城博物馆
attractions.summary: The Dapeng Ancient City Museum is a thematic historical museum set up with Dapeng Ancient City as its theme. The museum collects and displays a large number of cultural relics, local customs, and humanistic historical materials, and each collection tells you the story of Dapeng City.

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

attractions.name: 鹿咀驿站
attractions.summary: Lujiao Posthouse, located in Shenzhen, is a comprehensive tourist attraction integrating leisure, entertainment and shopping. Not only is there a wide range of dining options here, but there are also various specialty shops, making it a great place for tourists to relax and enjoy life.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

restaurants.name_en: Red Room All Sea View Restaurant

attractions.name: 盛鑫源洗浴
attractions.summary: Harbin Shengxinyuan Bathhouse has large bathing areas for men and women, rest halls, bone-loosening rooms, jade steaming, gemstone experience areas, yurts, billiards, video games, table tennis, chess and card rooms, children's playgrounds, Dining and other comprehensive facilities. It also has business suites, standard rooms, etc., where you can experience leisure and health, feel the courtesy, and the waiting pavilion of Shengxinyuan Bathhouse.

attractions.name: 松花江观光索道
attractions.summary: The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway starts from Tongjiang Square in the south and ends at Taiyang Island Scenic Area in the north, spanning across the Songhua River. It is a well-known tourist transportation vehicle. The total length of the cableway is 1156 meters, and the cableway bracket in the river is more than 70 meters away from the river surface. Riding in the car, you can overlook the panoramic view of both sides of the Songhua River, with infinite scenery. The Songhua River Sightseeing Cableway is one of the key projects in Harbin City, which was built and constructed with huge investment in 1997. It introduced equipment from the world's senior cableway equipment company, Austria's Dopema Company, and ranks among the high-end international cableways today. The cableway is adjacent to Stalin Park, Flood Control Memorial Tower, and Central Street, like a jade belt tightly connecting the two banks of the Songhua River. The cableway is equipped with 19 fully automatic and fully enclosed high-end cabins for 8 people, 6 luxurious cabins, and built-in sofas, bars, and speakers, providing comfort, elegance, warmth, and romance. The cableway runs at a speed of 1-5 meters per second, with ease and speed. Walking leisurely in the courtyard, one can enjoy the scenery of northern China and the city, and the scenery wherever they go is infinite. So far, the cableway has been in operation for more than 20 years, with a safety factor of 100%. Full text 

attractions.name: 太阳岛风景区
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids.; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- Sun Island Park is located on the northern bank of the Songhua River in Harbin, across from Stalin Park, and is known by visitors as a summer resort.
- The island features numerous European-style villas, which were once summer retreats for the Russians. These architectural structures are nestled amidst lush green trees.
- This is the largest winter theme park in China with a snow theme, and in winter, it becomes a world of snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Summer for escaping the heat, winter for enjoying snow sculptures.

attractions.name: 哈尔滨极地公园
attractions.summary:
Harbin Polarland is one of the few original cultural and tourism resort areas in China. The design of the park's buildings, overall planning, and product creativity were all developed by the company's in-house team. The project is located in the national-level tourist scenic area of Sun Island, with a total investment of one billion RMB. It is a cultural and tourism resort area in China centered on polar-themed performances and interactive science education experiences. It is also a well-known brand in China's polar oceanarium industry and a world-class tourism landmark created by Heilongjiang Province. 

The park includes five major venues: the Polar Pavilion, the Ocean Pavilion, the Penguin Learning Pavilion, the Polar Bear Experience Pavilion, and the Dinosaur Pavilion. Seven themed performances are featured: the Beluga Whale Show, Dolphin Show, Glacier Aurora Show, Walrus Stand-up Comedy Show, Penguin Performance, Water Dance, and Stingray Performance.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 果戈里大街
attractions.summary:
· It has a history of more than 100 years, and there are many Russian-style buildings, including the famous Qiulin Food Company Building and St. Alexeyev Church. 
The prosperity and night scene are no less beautiful than Central Street, and it is also a "bar street" in Harbin. 
It is also a famous cultural street, with modern horseshoe stones on both sides of the road, and a piece engraved with Heilongjiang historical and cultural celebrities is inlaid every other section.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old Russian-style block

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 东北虎林园
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
attractions.summary:
The Northeast Tiger Park is located on the north bank of the Songhua River, covering an area of approximately 1.2 million square meters, and is only separated by a small body of water from the famous summer resort, Sun Island Scenic Area. The Tiger Park occupies 360,000 square meters and is currently the world's largest wild natural park for Northeast Tigers. It was established to save and protect the endangered Northeast Tiger species.

The park currently has 10 sightseeing areas: the Wild Training Area, Adult Tiger Area, Young Tiger Area, Tiger King Area, Breeding Tiger Area, Breeding Male Tiger Area, Lion and Tiger Area, African Lion Area, Walking Area, and Tiger Viewing Platform. Visitors can see over 100 purebred Northeast Tigers, 8 white tigers, 1 snow tiger, 2 white lions, 2 liger hybrids, 3 black jaguars, and 20 African lions. Except for the Walking Area and Tiger Viewing Platform, the other areas require visitors to travel in vehicles to search for the tigers and appreciate their majesty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up Observation of Amur Tiger's Habitat

attractions.name: 哈尔滨大剧院
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary: Harbin Grand Theatre is a newly completed theater in Harbin, and it will soon become the best place for concerts, stage plays, dramas and other performances in Harbin. This Harbin Grand Theatre, which is inspired by the ice and snow landscape of Northern China, is also a rookie in Harbin architecture. The undulating architectural lines are rich in natural rhythm, like continuous snow-capped mountains. Even if you don't watch the show, this unique architectural beauty is worth visiting.
attractions.shortFeatures: New landmark of online celebrity, night scene space feeling; A landmark building like flowing clouds

attractions.name: 侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆
attractions.summary: The Criminal Evidence Site of Unit 731, located in the southern suburbs of Harbin, displays a large amount of evidence of Japanese aggressors conducting experiments on living people. Various experimental equipment, character scenes, sculptures, pictures, and testimony materials, as well as sites such as microbiology laboratories, frostbite laboratories, and crematoriums, are all iron evidence like mountains. Unit 731 was founded in 1933 and has been conducting human experiments on captured Chinese soldiers and a large number of innocent Chinese civilians for more than 20 years, including frostbite experiments, dissection of living people, gas experiments, microbiological experiments, pressure experiments, and so on.. And now there are still many radioactive devices buried on the land of the three northeastern provinces of China. The site exhibition hall is divided into an indoor exhibition hall and an outdoor site. The indoor exhibition hall is the headquarters building of the 731 Army. On the walls on both sides of the central corridor of the building, there are nearly 3000 names of people who were victims of microbial experiments and microbial warfare. These names are well documented, including Chinese, Soviet, Mongolian and Korean. Among them, 1467 people were brutally killed by being transported through this corridor to the "special prison" through the "special transfer" method, and the remaining more than 1000 people were mostly victims of the Southern Microbial War. On the eve of Japan's surrender in 1945, when the 731 troops were defeated and fled, they did not forget to continue to maim the Chinese people. They released mice infected with pestis bacteria, which led to the pestis in the cottage area in 1946, and a large number of local residents died of this disaster. In order to cover up the crimes of Unit 731, most of the buildings here were destroyed during their escape, forming the current pattern of the ruins. Unit 731 is the largest microbial warfare unit in the history of world wars, and it is known as one of the world's two great killing dens, along with Auschwitz concentration camp, for annihilating humanity. What is displayed here is not only the heinous crimes of the Japanese aggressors, but also a warning to the Chinese not to forget the national humiliation. Full text 
