attractions.name: 无锡热雪奇迹
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ice and Snow Park
attractions.summary:
· Wuxi Hot Snow Miracle is located in Sunac Cultural and Cultural Tourism City, Binhu District, Wuxi City. It is a ski resort in East China that integrates indoor skiing and snow entertainment, covering the entire population of Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai. It opened on June 29, 2019, with a construction area of approximately 17,500 square meters and a reception service area of approximately 7,500 square meters. 
· The constant temperature of the venue is about-6 ℃ throughout the year. It is suitable for all kinds of people to experience, practice and train. A snow recreation area and gentle slope covering an area of about 5,600 square meters are set up for young children. Children can also practice skiing and snow recreation activities. It is a good place for citizens and tourists to play in the snow in all seasons.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world of real ice and snow in Nordic style
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 10:00-21:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 18:00)

attractions.name: 清名桥古运河景区
attractions.name_en: Qingming Bridge Ancient Grand Canal Scenic Area
attractions.summary: The Qingmingqiao Ancient Canal Scenic Area is located in the center of Wuxi city, with antique water town buildings and real old houses forming a block. There are attractions to visit, as well as bars and restaurants. The night view here is even more beautiful than the day view. The houses with pink walls and black tiles are lit up, and strings of red lanterns are reflected in the canal, attracting countless photography enthusiasts. Sitting on a cruise ship, from the Nanchan Temple Pier to the Kuatang Bridge, one can see the antique style architecture of Yangchun Lane Commercial District. From the Tangqiao Bridge to the Qingming Bridge is the essence part, which is called "Jiangnan Water Alley, the canal out of print". Seeing the memorial archway of "Canal Ancient Town" on the right bank means entering the real historical block transformed from old houses. Along the way, many beautiful people and small terraces can be found near the water. After passing Dagong Bridge, there is the China Silk Industry Museum on the right bank, and after passing Qingming Bridge, there is the Wuxi Kiln Site Museum on the left bank. Then go ahead to the Narcissus Taoist Temple, and see the memorial archway of "Tang Tree Leaves Shadows", which means the end of the block. It is recommended to take a cruise to the foot of Shuixian Road Courtyard and then walk back to Nanchan Temple Pier. Along the way, you can visit attractions such as Shuixian Road Courtyard, Canal Culture and Art Museum, Kanggong Salvation Society, and China Silk Industry Museum. If interested, you can also turn to Yangchun Lane for a stroll.

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 宜兴水恩思迪帆船中心
attractions.summary: The water activities here include sailing and kayaking, and the surrounding scenery is also very beautiful. Friends who enjoy these sports must not miss them.

attractions.name: 海澜飞马水城
attractions.summary: Hailan Feima Water City is located at the southern end of Xinqiao Town, Jiangyin City. It is a comprehensive equestrian base that integrates equestrian training, performance, competition, and leisure vacation. It includes multiple entertainment experience projects such as equestrian performance hall, horse culture museum, and Hailan art museum. It is a large-scale horse culture comprehensive tourism project. Nowadays, Hailan Feima Water City has become a gathering place for internet celebrities to check in with its European style characteristic buildings.

attractions.name: 花山滑翔伞基地
attractions.summary: The Jiangyin Huashan Paragliding Base is located south of Huashan in Nanzha Town, Jiangyin City. The base focuses on paragliding as its core project, allowing more people to understand and experience paragliding, fall in love with paragliding, and enjoy the unique charm of paragliding. At the same time, it also provides outdoor play facilities such as rock climbing challenges (12 meters), diving experiences, diving training (4 meters), basketball courts, football fields, beach motorcycles, trampolines, barbecues, camping, etc. The base has two takeoff grounds at an altitude of 230 meters, covering an area of 3000 square meters, all covered with high-quality lawns. The main landing site covers an area of 15000 square meters, providing solid support for the safe landing of pilots.

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 南昌融创乐园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Nanchang Sunac Cultural Tourism City is located in the Honggutan Jiulong Lake New District of Nanchang, integrating traditional Ganjia culture with world-class theme park elements.  
- Whether you are an adventurous young trendsetter, a romantic couple in search of sweet moments, or a parent wanting to give your children a magical childhood, Nanchang Sunac Park has something for everyone. The park’s large-scale attractions, including the longest wooden roller coaster in China, "Bamboo Forest Green Python," the highest and fastest roller coaster, "Flying Roller Coaster," and the nearly 40-meter-high flying chairs "Phoenix Dance in the Sky," are a paradise for amusement park enthusiasts; international-level stage shows such as the water and light performance "Bridge of Light" are also eye-catching.  
- Not only is Sunac Park worth a visit, but Sunac Mall is also a place where you can spend an entire day. In Nanchang Sunac Sea World, you can watch various marine fish swim past you, and in Movie Park, you can travel through history to experience Jiangxi's culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Thrilling Experience of the Three Major Roller Coasters

attractions.name: 南昌融创海世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
attractions.summary:
· The park covers an area of 36,800 square meters, with more than 300 species of marine life and more than 20,000 fish. 
· It has Monterey Bay, Ocean Theater, Cold Water Ocean, Jellyfish Pavilion, Tropical Rainforest and 360 ° Dome Movie Exhibition Area. 
· You can appreciate the wonderful and interesting natural habits of marine life and various ocean scenery. It is an indoor ocean park integrating fish display, animal performance, biological science popularization and wedding celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Seven themed pool exhibition areas

attractions.name: 江西省博物馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) is one of the three major cultural centers in Jiangxi Province. It is based on a square box and symbolizes a treasure box. It has six floors, a building area of 86000 square meters, and an exhibition area of 28000 square meters. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Museum) gathers precious historical relics and ancient art masterpieces discovered from various parts of Jiangxi, and collects a large number of cultural relics from the province. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) has established an exhibition system that combines permanent and temporary exhibitions, consisting of 8 permanent exhibitions and 3 temporary exhibition halls. The entire exhibition showcases the historical landscape and cultural characteristics of Jiangxi, meeting the diverse needs of the public in the new era with high quality.

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 木兰草原
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Treasure spots for kids.
attractions.summary: Mulan Prairie - The only AAAA-level Mongolian-style scenic area in Central China, located in Niejiagang, Wangjiahe Town, Huangpi District, Wuhan, to the east of the famous Mulan Mountain and to the south of Mulan Lake, one of the top ten leisure resorts in Hubei. The scenic area is 36 kilometers from downtown Wuhan and 12 kilometers from the nearest highway exit, with very convenient transportation. The planned area of the scenic spot is 4,800 acres, divided into the Grassland Style Tourism Area and the Leisure Resort Area. It integrates grassland-style sightseeing, outdoor activities, water entertainment, business meetings, and leisure vacations. It is currently the only AAAA-level scenic area in Central China themed around grassland culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the prairie charm through horseback riding and archery.

attractions.name: 木兰山
attractions.tag: Climbing Heights and Mountains; Nature and Adventure
attractions.summary: The Mulan Mountain Scenic Area is located in the northern part of Huangpi District, Wuhan, just 50 kilometers from the city center. With an elevation of 582.1 meters, it is a national geological park, a provincial-level scenic area, and a provincial-level nature reserve. In November 2014, the Mulan Mountain Scenic Area was approved by the National Tourism Administration as a 5A-level tourist attraction, as the core scenic area of the Huangpi Mulan Cultural Ecological Tourism Zone. Mulan Mountain is known as the "back garden of Wuhan" and was praised by the Ming Dynasty poet Tu Da as "the most magnificent of Xiling, the ultimate view of the Three Chu regions."
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Hua Mulan's Hometown

attractions.name: 木兰天池
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
- Mulan Tianchi is a national forest park. The area is characterized by beautiful mountains and clear waters, and is an important part of the Mulan Cultural Ecotourism Area.
- The entire scenic area is divided into a sightseeing area and a leisure resort area. Due to the lower temperatures in summer compared to the city, it is ideal for a summer retreat.
- The area is crisscrossed with ravines and rich in forests, with flowing water throughout the year, presenting a wetland ecosystem where mountains and waters blend together.
- The main attractions in the area include waterfalls, stream pools, and strange rock formations. There is also a meadow with entertainment activities such as grass skiing and slideways.
- In early spring, Mulan Tianchi is a paradise for apricot blossoms, with thousands of acres of wild apricot flowers spread across the forest valleys, where the verdant hills and blooming apricot flowers create a picturesque scene.
attractions.shortFeatures: The lush mountains and clear waters are like a scene from a painting; a summer resort with beautiful mountains and clear waters.

attractions.name: 锦里沟
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary: Jinligou is the only Tujia cultural tourism area in Wuhan and also the largest natural landscape resort. The scenic area consists of three parts: the lakeside cultural experience zone, the canyon tour zone, and the Zhaiwang cultural display zone. Surrounded by green mountains and clear waters, with streams, lakes, waterfalls, canyons, strange stones, wildflowers, and traditional Tujia buildings such as stilted houses, wind-and-rain bridges, and Tusi villages, it forms a unique Tujia-style poetic landscape, making it an excellent destination for weekend getaways from the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the rich Tujia customs.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 广州塔460米摩天轮
attractions.summary: The Ferris wheel is located 460 meters away from the Guangzhou Tower and is one of the popular tourist attractions in the tower. It cleverly utilizes the platform at the top of the tower and, unlike other Ferris wheels, runs on an inclined track. It is currently the tallest horizontal Ferris wheel in the world. The Ferris wheel is composed of 16 transparent crystal ball cabins that resemble sparkling pearls, slowly flowing around, and the beautiful scenery of Yangcheng unfolds before my eyes like a scroll. Sun, moon, and stars, accompanied by auspicious clouds, this place has become a romantic place for marriage proposals, allowing tourists to experience the romance at the top of the world. Full text 

attractions.name: 海心桥
attractions.summary: To the north of the construction site of the the Pearl River Pedestrian Landscape Bridge is the island tip on the east side of Ersha Island, and to the south is the International Media Port. The width of the river is about 280 meters, with an upstream distance of about 500 meters from Guangzhou Bridge and a downstream distance of about 1.4 kilometers from Liede Bridge. The planned navigation net width at the bridge location is not less than 180 meters and the net height is 10 meters. The main bridge adopts a steel structure inclined arch bridge with a main span of 240 meters. The total length of the bridge deck on the east side is about 451 meters, and the total length of the main beam on the west side is about 296 meters. The pedestrian bridge has a total width of 20 meters in the middle span, with a width of 6 meters on the west side, 8 meters on the east side, and 6 meters on the middle staircase.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游广州塔·中大码头

attractions.summary: Guangzhou Tower · Zhongda Pier, close to Sun Yat sen University, is an important the Pearl River night cruise ship dock. The cruise ship starts from the Zhongda Pier via Ersha Island - Xinghai Concert Hall - Zhongda North Gate - Haiyin Bridge - Guangzhou Bridge - Haixinsha - Guangzhou Tower - Liede Bridge - and returns to Guangzhou Tower. Full text 

attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

attractions.name: 余荫山房
attractions.summary: Yuyin Mountain Villa, also known as Yuyin Garden, is a private garden of Wu Bin, a scholar from the Qing Dynasty. It has a history of more than 130 years. The garden is renowned for its exquisite and intricate artistic features, with pavilions, halls, towers, bridges, corridors, and embankments all compactly arranged within a 300-step radius. The garden is rich in four major types of carvings—brick carvings, wood carvings, plaster carvings, and stone carvings—showing off the elegance and charm of the renowned garden. Ancient trees soar, and rare flowers dazzle, bringing vibrant life to the entire garden. The four major wonders of the garden, namely "Bamboo in the Side Wall," "Rainbow Bridge Reflecting the Moon," "Hidden Treasures in the Deep Willows," and "Double Greens Welcoming Spring," leave visitors in awe and make them reluctant to leave.
attractions.shortFeatures: Known for its compact and delicate layout.

attractions.name: 广东科学中心
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary:
- The Guangdong Science Center is a non-profit social public service organization themed around "Nature, Humanity, Science, and Civilization," providing a venue for public science education and social science and technology activities.
- The Guangdong Science Center has four main functions: science education, science and technology achievements exhibition, international academic exchanges, and science tourism. It is one of the largest science education bases in China and even Asia.
- Covering an area of approximately 450,000 square meters, the Guangdong Science Center has a building area of about 140,700 square meters. It features 12 permanent theme exhibition halls, over 510 sets of exhibits, 5 science cinemas (IMAX, 4D, 3D, Dome, and Virtual Flight Dynamic Cinema), as well as an outdoor science exploration park that integrates nature, technology, and art. The center also boasts an ecological lake of around 80,000 square meters, over 2,000 varieties of Lingnan plants, and dozens of outdoor exhibits.
attractions.shortFeatures: Edutainment Technology Aircraft Carrier; Natural Human Scientific Civilization; National Science Popularization Education Base

restaurants.name_en: Lixiang Wanying Japanese and Korean cuisine

attractions.name: 漓江风景名胜区
attractions.summary: There is an article in primary school Chinese textbooks that says' Guilin's scenery is the best in the world ', which refers to visiting the Li River. The mountains on both sides of the Lijiang River are tall and straight, with thousands of shapes. They are the essence of Guilin scenery. The Li River, a hundred mile gallery ", each scenery is a typical Chinese ink painting. The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. The main ways to visit the Li River in general include taking boats, bamboo rafts, and hiking, including three-star and four-star boat tours, bamboo raft tours, and large boat tours in Xingping Fishing Village.

attractions.name: 漓江竹筏游
attractions.name_en: Bamboo Rafting on the Li River in Xingping
attractions.summary: Xingping Jiuma Painting Mountain Lijiang River Bamboo Raft Youxingping Section is located in Yangshuo, which has always been considered as the essence of Guilin landscape. There has long been a saying in the local area that 'Yangshuo's scenery is as beautiful as Guilin, and Yangshuo's beauty lies in Xingping'. There are over 20 scenic spots here, including Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection, Monk and Nun Meeting, Chaoban Mountain, and a 20 yuan background picture. Throughout history, the beautiful mountains, rivers, and streams of Xingping have captivated countless ink artists. Along the Xingping Li River, you can also enjoy picturesque scenery such as Xingping Jiajing, Huangbu Reflection, Carp Jumping over Dragon Gate, Chaoban Mountain, Luosi Mountain, and Beautiful Women's Mirrors. Yangdi Xingping Lijiang Bamboo Raft Tour Yangdi section is a must visit project when visiting Yangshuo, Guilin. The beautiful Yangdi is an important part of Guilin tourism and Guilin scenery. The hundred mile Li River, with "one mountain, one water, and one poem title", is like a long scroll of colorful ink landscape with poetry and painting. The Yangdi Tourist Area is about 18 kilometers long and is the golden section of the Li River. Departing from Yangdi Pier on a bamboo raft, heading down the river, the scenery along the way is beautiful, including the picturesque Nine Horse Painting Mountain and the reflection of yellow cloth. This section of the river is winding and twisting, with clear waters lingering and numerous scenic spots. The peaks reflect the scenery, and the bamboo and wood are lush.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00)

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 九马画山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 兴坪古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Rafting
attractions.summary:
· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.
attractions.shortFeatures: 20 yuan RMB back picture location

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 如意峰索道景区
attractions.summary: 1、 Basic information: Yangshuo Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area is a high-altitude tourism and leisure project jointly invested and built by Shaanxi Junjing Cableway Investment and Construction Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shaanxi Tourism Group, and Guilin Ruisheng Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The total investment of the project is 260 million yuan. The scenic area is located in Meng Village, Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, adjacent to National Highway 321, 5km away from the Gaotian entrance and exit of Baomao (Guiwu) Expressway, and about 5km away from core scenic areas such as Yulong River, Moon Mountain, Shili Gallery in Yangshuo and Yinziyan Scenic Area in Lipu. 2、 Project Construction The project will build Yangshuo Mountain Top Natural Park, which is composed of the natural karst natural landscape "three peaks and two valleys" (Yuanbao Peak, Ruyi Peak, Xianglian Peak, Caixi Valley, Baihua Valley), cableway, Ruyi Cloud Top Viewing Platform, Ruyi Cable Bridge, Walk in the Forest, glass walkway Road, Digital Experience Hall and other creative landscapes. Tourists can overlook the unique karst peak forest landscape in Yangshuo from a high altitude in all directions, walk through the forest, watch the landscape of Guilin, and experience the fun of walking in the forest! The Ruyi Peak Cableway has a total length of 2012 meters. The lower station of the cableway is located in Xingtianle International Tourism Resort, and the upper station leads directly to Yuanbao Peak. The vertical height difference is 242 meters, and the one-way capacity can reach 2000 people/hour, with a speed of 0.5-6 meters/second (adjustable). The cableway has introduced equipment from POMA company in France, which is a single line cyclic unhooking gripper 8-person hanging box cableway. The overall operation and safety system adopts advanced passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 3、 Since its opening on January 6, 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area has been operating in good condition. During the operation period, the goal of zero occurrence of safety production responsibility accidents was achieved, with no major tourist complaints or incidents of malfunctioning parking, and no occurrence of fire and other personal injury safety accidents. In November 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the honor of "Top Ten Scenic Spots of Guilin City" by the Guilin Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism. On December 24, 2021, it was rated as a "Contract abiding and Creditworthy" public enterprise in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region for the year 2020 by the Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. On December 28, 2021, Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the certificates of "Safety Production Standardization Enterprise" and "Service Quality 5S Enterprise" by the China Cableway Association. In 2022, it was awarded as one of the "Top Ten Internet Famous Scenic Spots in Guilin" and "Top Ten Astronomy and Climate Landscape Check ins in Guangxi", and was selected as one of the "World Karst Science Entrance Examination Route". 4、 Sightseeing route Take the cableway up the mountain -- View Yuanbao Peak -- Experience Ruyi Cable Bridge -- View Yangshuo from Ruyi Cloud Summit -- Walk through the forest and view the peak forest landscape -- Experience the glass walkway -- Visit the "Singing in Guilin" experience hall -- Return to the mountain 1. The horizontal distance of Ruyi Peak cableway is 2012 meters, the height difference is 241 meters, and the one-way traffic volume is 2000 people/hour. The cableway system equipment is designed and manufactured by POMA company in France. The overall operation and safety system adopts good passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 2. The Ruyi Suoqiao Bridge is 142.4 meters long, 2 meters wide, and 58 meters away from the valley floor. Standing among them, one can see the Yangshuo Peak Forest in full view, and the slight swaying in the air provides a thrilling and wonderful experience. 3. Ruyi Cloud Peak is named after its ridge resembling the traditional auspicious object of the Chinese nation, Ruyi. Ruyi Cloud Peak is a 360 ° viewing platform from the highest point of Ruyi Peak, a sacred place for people to pray and fulfill their wishes, and also a viewing spot for the Linqi Mountain in the distance. 4. The forest walking path winds through the peaks and valleys, with a total length of 246 meters and a center height of 32.5 meters. It is composed of a grid structure embedded with tempered glass and steel grilles. From a distance, it looks like a graceful "rainbow" in the peaks and forests, and also like an aerial ribbon left at the top of the jungle. Walking through it, you can fully enjoy the beauty of the peak forest and feel the joy of crossing the native jungle from the sky. 5. Glass walkway glass walkway is built along the cliff wall, 138 meters long and 1.8 meters wide. Walking on it is thrilling and extremely challenging. Looking into the distance, the peaks and forests are lush, the smoke from cooking is lingering, and the countryside is picturesque. 6. The Singing Tour Guilin Experience Hall is located at the upper station of the Ruyi Peak Cableway. It is an immersive digital experience space that uses digital technology and environmental art to showcase spatial creativity and intelligent interactive experiences. It integrates karst style and ethnic cultural creativity, making visitors feel as if they are walking in the dynamic painting of Guilin's mountains and waters, creating a wonderful feeling of "people swimming in the painting".

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 斯大林公园
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as Riverside Park, located on the south bank of Songhua River, it is a belt-shaped open park built along the embankment and near the water. It imitates the Russian classical architectural style and the "five-color grass flower beds" all over the park, as well as the sixteen groups of artistic sculptures distributed among green spaces, such as "Swan Spreading Wings", "Three Teenagers", "Starting", "Diving" and "Sword Dancing", each with its own characteristics. It faces the famous Sun Island across the river. In addition, the center of the park is the symbol of Harbin city-the Flood Control Memorial Tower, which was built to commemorate the victory of Harbin people over the catastrophic flood in 1957.  
· The riverside restaurant in the park was built before liberation (Puppet Manchukuo period), located on the west side of the Flood Control Memorial Tower and near the yacht dock. It was built after Russian classical wooden structures. The roof ridge is strewn at random, with sharp edges and corners, and colorful. The appearance is in the shape of building blocks. The transparent outer corridor facing the river and the indoor European architectural pattern reflect the simple and elegant European architectural style. In the 1950s, Changchun Film Studio used its modeling structure to shoot several sets of shots in the movie Xu Qiuying Case, and other film and television organizations also successively shot shots of movies and TV dramas such as Black Triangle, Ming Girl, Harbin at Night, The Story of Church Street and Annual Rings in Stalin Park, which shows how attractive the scenery of Stalin Park is. 
In summer, the river is refreshing, the green willows are shaded, and the natural bathing beach is wide along the river, which is a summer resort for tourists; In winter, watching the ice and snow world in the north is pleasing to the eye and wonderful.
attractions.shortFeatures: Songhua River Open Landscape Park

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 防洪纪念塔
attractions.summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

attractions.name: 东北虎林园
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
attractions.summary:
The Northeast Tiger Park is located on the north bank of the Songhua River, covering an area of approximately 1.2 million square meters, and is only separated by a small body of water from the famous summer resort, Sun Island Scenic Area. The Tiger Park occupies 360,000 square meters and is currently the world's largest wild natural park for Northeast Tigers. It was established to save and protect the endangered Northeast Tiger species.

The park currently has 10 sightseeing areas: the Wild Training Area, Adult Tiger Area, Young Tiger Area, Tiger King Area, Breeding Tiger Area, Breeding Male Tiger Area, Lion and Tiger Area, African Lion Area, Walking Area, and Tiger Viewing Platform. Visitors can see over 100 purebred Northeast Tigers, 8 white tigers, 1 snow tiger, 2 white lions, 2 liger hybrids, 3 black jaguars, and 20 African lions. Except for the Walking Area and Tiger Viewing Platform, the other areas require visitors to travel in vehicles to search for the tigers and appreciate their majesty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up Observation of Amur Tiger's Habitat

attractions.name: 太阳岛风景区
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids.; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- Sun Island Park is located on the northern bank of the Songhua River in Harbin, across from Stalin Park, and is known by visitors as a summer resort.
- The island features numerous European-style villas, which were once summer retreats for the Russians. These architectural structures are nestled amidst lush green trees.
- This is the largest winter theme park in China with a snow theme, and in winter, it becomes a world of snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Summer for escaping the heat, winter for enjoying snow sculptures.

attractions.name: 哈尔滨大剧院
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary: Harbin Grand Theatre is a newly completed theater in Harbin, and it will soon become the best place for concerts, stage plays, dramas and other performances in Harbin. This Harbin Grand Theatre, which is inspired by the ice and snow landscape of Northern China, is also a rookie in Harbin architecture. The undulating architectural lines are rich in natural rhythm, like continuous snow-capped mountains. Even if you don't watch the show, this unique architectural beauty is worth visiting.
attractions.shortFeatures: New landmark of online celebrity, night scene space feeling; A landmark building like flowing clouds

attractions.name: 哈尔滨极地公园·极地馆
attractions.summary: Harbin Polar Park is one of the few original cultural and tourism resorts in China. The architectural design, overall planning, and product creativity of the park venues are all creatively designed and developed by the company's own team. The project is located on Sun Island, a tourist scenic area with a total investment of one billion yuan. It is a cultural and tourism resort in China with polar themed performances and interactive science popularization experiences as its core. It is a well-known brand in China's polar oceanarium industry and a tourism business card created by Heilongjiang. The park includes five major venues: Polar Pavilion, Ocean Pavilion, Taoxue Penguin Pavilion, Polar Bear Experience Pavilion, and Dinosaur Pavilion; Create seven themed performances: White Whale Show, Dolphin Show, Glacier Aurora Show, Walrus Talk Show, Penguin Show, Water Dance, and Ray Show.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 哈尔滨冰雪大世界
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Ice and Snow Parks
attractions.summary:
· In the world of ice and snow, you can enjoy the tallest, longest and largest ice and snow landscape in the world; And every session will have a new theme. 
· There are world-renowned buildings, classic cartoon characters, and you can also watch European-style song and dance performances. 
There are all kinds of ice sports in the park. When the colorful lights are turned on at night, it is like being in a fairy tale world of ice lanterns. 
· Due to its particularity, it is only open from December to February in winter every year.
attractions.shortFeatures: After lighting up, the crystal ice sculpture is more dreamy; Ice and Snow Theme Carnival

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 哈药集团制药六厂
attractions.summary: Harbin Pharmaceutical Group Sixth Factory was founded in 1977 and is an important pharmaceutical enterprise under Harbin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. The enterprise has numerous well-known brands, such as "Hu Tong", "Gai Zhong Gai", "Xie Li Ting", etc. Its products cover multiple fields such as chemical drugs, health food, and beverages.

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 音乐长廊
attractions.summary: The music gallery has a total length of 165 meters and a building area of 2000 square meters. It has two exhibition halls, east and west, where visitors can enjoy music performances.

attractions.name: 哈尔滨工业大学
attractions.summary: Harbin Institute of Technology, referred to as Harbin Institute of Technology for short, is located in Harbin, an ice city in northern China. It is a university directly under the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China. It is one of the first batch of key construction institutions of Project 211 and Project 985. The Soviet-style main building is very distinctive. The Russian architectural style is classical, absorbing and compromising various European architectural styles, and wins with its tall, solemn and mysterious momentum. The movie "Lover's Knot" was shot here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The first batch of 211 key universities in China

attractions.name: 伏尔加庄园
attractions.summary:
The Volga Manor is located on the banks of the Ashi River in the suburban area of Harbin, covering an area of over 600,000 square meters. It is a national AAAA-level cultural tourism attraction, a base for China-Russia cultural exchange, a creative base for the Russian Artists Association, and an international exchange center of Moscow University. The manor advocates the business philosophy of "cultural depth for long-term success, and taste for true value." The reconstructed St. Nicholas Church and the riverside restaurant carry the memories of the old Harbin residents; the Petrov Art Palace and the Pushkin Exhibition Hall provide platforms for cultural and artistic exchange. It is a cultural destination for tourists, a vacation manor.

The manor can accommodate approximately 1,000 people for dining and 800 people for accommodation, offering high-quality services for tourism, leisure vacations, exhibitions, business meetings, study tours, weddings, outdoor sports, and other activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian Style Manor

attractions.name: 侵华日军第七三一部队遗址
attractions.name_en: Site of Unit 731 of the Imperial Japanese Army
attractions.summary: The crime evidence site of the 731st unit of the Japanese invaders is located in Pingfang District, Harbin, covering an area of 6.1 million square meters. During World War II, Japanese fascists established here the largest germ warfare unit in the history of world wars. It is also known as the two world-wide murderous caves in the world together with Auschwitz concentration camp of German Nazis. In the building of the headquarters, the room is opened into a criminal evidence exhibition hall, which basically uses text, data, pictures and other materials hanging on the wall for exhibitions.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京明故宫遗址公园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
