attractions.name: 重庆好吃街夜市
attractions.summary: Chongqing Delicious Street is a street of food culture. In Southwest Mandarin, the word "good" in "delicious" is pronounced as four sounds, meaning "greedy". "Delicious" means "greedy". Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 解放碑步行街
attractions.summary: Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street is a more prosperous business circle in Chongqing, where there are many department stores and hotels. It is a good place for shopping, eating and strolling. It is also a good place for visiting Chongqing beauties. The pedestrian street is located in Yuzhong District, centered on Monument to the people's Liberation, including Minquan Road, Zourong Road and Bayi Road. There are many food, shopping, and beauty shopping malls, as well as a variety of snacks and beautiful women, making it the "three highs" of a pedestrian street. You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. There are also scenic spots near the pedestrian street, such as Nengren Temple and Arhat Temple. Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street and its surrounding areas are also one of the main choices for tourists to stay in Chongqing. There are intercontinental hotels and economical hotels with high cost performance. Full text 

attractions.name: 重庆WFC会仙楼观景台
attractions.summary: The WFC Huixianlou Observation Deck is located on floors 73-75 of WFC and was officially unveiled on June 8, 2017, perfectly presenting the past and present of Huixianlou. In the early 1980s, the Huixianlou Observation Deck was the first high-altitude observation deck in Chongqing and was known as the "pinnacle of Chongqing". The WFC Huixianlou Observation Deck overlooks the core urban landscapes of Chongqing, including the confluence of two rivers, the Grand Theater, the night view of Nanbin Road, a tree viewing platform, two river cruise ships, and the three-dimensional night view of the mountain city. While enjoying a visual feast, one can also experience the unique geographical wonders of Chongqing, pursue the cultural symbols that belong to Chongqing, and bloom the charm of Chongqing. WFC Hui Xian Lou Observation Deck 73-74 floors offer a 360 degree modern and innovative viewing experience; The 75 story fully open-air design allows you to admire the dazzling starry sky and contemplate the vast universe. It can also be used as a filming location for wedding photos, commercial films, and movies; Fashion show venue; Cold buffet and cocktail parties can choose venues; A must visit place for travel. Has hosted five international and Chengdu Chongqing high-rise building competitions, the first cloud based collective wedding in Yuzhong District in 2023, and won awards such as the 2019 Cloud based Scenic Spot and the 2022 Landmark Attraction. The first height of WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck | Unparalleled View WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck, with an altitude of 590 meters, stands proudly on the Yuzhong Peninsula, bringing you an extraordinary visual feast at such a height. 360 ° panoramic view of the confluence of the two rivers and the seventeen bridges spanning the Yangtze River and Jialing River, allowing you to experience the unique urban panorama of the magical mountain city and the ever-changing urban changes of Chongqing. L Core Area | Location can not be copied WFC Huixianlou Sightseeing Platform, which is located in the core area of Yuzhong Peninsula, the mother city of Chongqing. It is the closest viewing platform to Monument to the people's Liberation, echoing the landmark landscapes such as Chongqing Grand Theater and Nanbin Road from afar. Whether tourists from all over the country or native citizens, it is easy to reach by light rail, public transport or other means of transportation. There are more than 800 parking spaces in the underground garage, which is convenient for self driving. L Past Life | History Can't Replace WFC Huixian Tower Sightseeing Platform is located on the 73-75 floors of Chongqing World Financial Center. WFC was the tallest Huixian Tower in Chongqing in the past, built in the 1980s, and the first high-rise in Chongqing higher than Monument to the people's Liberation. The location of Huixian Tower, formerly known as Huixian Bridge, was the birthplace of Chongqing's fashion industry in the 1920s. It once saw the emergence of high-end venues such as the Old Paris Barber Shop, Queen's Dance Hall, and Heart Caf é. On the 73rd floor of the WFC Huixian Tower Observation Deck, a large number of old photos and maps of Chongqing are displayed. The mottled old time is condensed in each frame, showcasing the changes in Chongqing's history and the past and present of Huixian Tower from a temporal and spatial perspective, allowing the charm of Chongqing's city to be fully revealed. Full text 

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 重庆云端之眼观景台
attractions.summary: Standing higher, seeing more fully, the scenery varies by height, infinite scenery is in the sky. The "Top of Mountain City, Eye of Chongqing" Yangtze River Cableway High altitude Observation Deck is a gathering place for urban landscapes from the perspective of God. It is a popular photo spot in the Chongqing photography circle and has "Cloud Radio" and "Cloud Prayer" projects. From the indoor observation deck on the 67th floor and the apron observation deck on the 69th floor, you can enjoy a 360 ° panoramic view of Chongqing's forests and the scenery of the two rivers and four banks without any blind spots. During the day, looking up at the vast blue sky and bowing down to the continuous buildings; At night, the starry sky above and the lights of thousands of homes below provide visitors with a unique viewing experience of the Sky City "Skywalker".

attractions.name: 朝天门广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the "Top Ten Cultural Symbols of Chongqing", it is located at the intersection of Jialing River and Yangtze River in Yuzhong Peninsula, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the hub of the two rivers and the largest waterway passenger terminal in Chongqing. 
· Chaotianmen was once one of the seventeen ancient city gates in Chongqing, where the Three Gorges cruise ships, sightseeing cruise ships and ferries to Foreigner Street all departed.  
The night view of Chaotianmen is also very beautiful. The lights are turned on at night, which is particularly beautiful. In front of you is the brightly lit pier, and there are flowery cruise ships shuttling around. 
· And this is also the "zero kilometer" point sign of Chongqing Highway, which will be located in Chaotianmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient Wharf in Chongqing

attractions.name: 朝天门号两江夜景游轮
attractions.summary: The "Changhang Chaotianmen" two river cruise ship integrates urban sightseeing, night view, river view, mountain view, and entertainment. It is a great choice for entertaining guests, gathering friends, relaxing, entertaining, surrounding the Yuzhong Peninsula, and appreciating the charm of the Heavenly Market in Chongqing. Spend an unforgettable and enjoyable night on the beautiful Yangtze River and Jialing River on the Chaotianmen cruise ship.

attractions.name: 渣滓洞
attractions.summary:
· Originally a coal cave on the outskirts of Chongqing, a small coal mine opened in 1920, and later set up as a detention center by the Military Bureau of the National Government. 
Zhazidong is surrounded by mountains on three sides and ditches on one side. The terrain is hidden, and it specializes in detaining and persecuting revolutionaries. The more famous one is "Sister Jiang". 
Zhazi Cave was repaired and rebuilt on the original site, which truly reflected the scene at that time. The atmosphere was depressed, and the instruments of torture displayed were shocking.  
The whole scenic spot is not big, so you can visit the Tomb of the Martyrs and the White Mansion together. There are also special buses arranged in the scenic spot, which is very convenient.

attractions.name: 磁器口古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town

attractions.name_en: Liziba Monorail Through Building Observation Platform
attractions.summary: The monorail through building viewing platform is located on the sixth to eighth floors of a 19 story building. Every day, a scene of the monorail passing through the building and flying through the air is staged. Although tourists from all over the country and even abroad come to watch, the light rail uses low-noise inflatable rubber tires, which are quieter than the cars passing downstairs, so it will not disturb the public.

attractions.name: 二厂文创公园
attractions.name_en: Second Factory Cultural and Creative Park
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Art Districts; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as Chongqing No.2 Printing Factory, it can be said that it was once a color printing giant in southwest printing industry. 
The renovated old factory building retains the original style of the old single-family building and adds the artistic style of modern design; The combination of old and new is unique and charming. 
The movie "Passing Through Your World" was shot here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Location of "Passing Through Your World"

attractions.name: 黄桷坪涂鸦艺术街
attractions.summary: Huangjueping Graffiti Art Street is located in the Huangjueping area of Jiulongpo District, Chongqing. It originated from Huangjueping Hospital and ends at 501 Art Gallery. The artistic atmosphere here is very strong, but a long time ago it was just a run down neighborhood. Later, through the transformation of artists, it has become a highly artistic neighborhood. Everywhere you look, there are colorful and varied graffiti. The walls over ten meters high are densely packed with graffiti works, and wherever you go, you can see graffiti around you, as well as some scattered sculptures.

attractions.name: 重庆动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Hidden gem for walking with kids; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- Located in Yangjiaping, Jiulongpo District, it was established in 1954 and is one of the largest comprehensive parks in Chongqing.
- It has more than 20 animal enclosures, housing over 150 species and more than 1,200 animals, including rare species such as the giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey, and the wild turkey.
- It is an executive council member of the China Zoo Association and a member of the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums.

attractions.name: 草堂寺钟楼
attractions.summary:
The largest and most well-preserved bell tower left over from ancient China, with six chime performances every day. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and the top is a gilded treasure top, which is magnificent. 
Standing on the bell tower, you can see the east, south, west and north streets extending from the bell tower, the most prosperous business district in Xi'an around the bell tower, and the Drum Tower not far away. 
When visiting the bell tower, you can also enjoy wonderful performances of visiting ancient times, six performances every day. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the bell and drum tower square, with a musical fountain.

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 易俗社百年博物馆
attractions.summary: Located in the new urban area of Xi'an City, the Centennial Museum of Yisu Society covers an area of more than 4000 square meters and has more than 10 exhibition halls. It focuses on the experience of opera culture, and shows the development history, social influence and artistic achievements of Qin Opera of Yisu Society for more than 100 years.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院-丽山园
attractions.summary: The Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, located in the suburb of Xi'an, is the mausoleum of Ying Zheng, the first emperor in Chinese history. Among the mausoleums of Chinese emperors, it is famous for its grand scale. At present, the imperial tomb has not been excavated, and you can wander around the tomb to think of ancient times. The Imperial Mausoleum was built between 246 BC and 208 BC, lasting for 39 years. The imperial tomb embodies the ritual system of "treating death as if it were life", completely modeled after the layout of the Qin capital Xianyang at that time. It has two rammed earth city walls inside and outside, symbolizing the imperial and palace cities of the capital Xianyang. The tomb mound (also known as the Da Feng Tu Dui, the burial mound of Emperor Qin Shi Huang) is located in the southern part of the inner city, in the shape of a covered bucket, and is currently about 50 meters high. After more than two thousand years of vicissitudes, the main relic on the ground of the imperial tomb is only the towering tomb. At present, the scenic area outlines the outline of the city wall through planting vegetation belts, as well as prominent signs and tags, allowing tourists to understand the direction, scope, and location of the city wall in the past. Up to now, the underground palace of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has not been excavated due to the constraints of existing scientific and technological conditions. Legend has it that in the underground palace of the First Emperor, various precious stones are used as the sun, moon, and stars, gold and jade are used as mountains and rivers, mercury is used as rivers, lakes, and seas, and the South China Sea mermaids refine oil into lamps that will last for thousands of years. Tourists can also visit the Bai Xi Qi Pit (also known as 9901 Accompanying Burial Pit) located in the southeast and the Wen Guan Qi Pit (also known as 0006 Accompanying Burial Pit) on the southwest side of the Fengtu Pile inside the imperial tomb. attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.

At the same time, more than 300 film projection equipment that spans the development of world cinema are collected here. The Film Industry Museum preserves the only still operating film processing and printing production line in China, showcasing numerous creative manuscripts and artistic archives from the classic film production process, as well as a large number of interactive experience devices that showcase film principles and technological charm.

Tourists can wait at the sightseeing station sign to get on the bus. During the operation, the "Sightseeing Bus" will stop at each sightseeing station for 5 to 10 minutes. Tourists can arrange to get on and off the bus according to their own itinerary for sightseeing experience, and can take the next "Xi'an City Sightseeing Bus" to continue to the later sightseeing stations for sightseeing. Starting station: Parking lot on the east side of Dayan Pagoda North Square (parking lot on the east side of Xi'an Citizen Tourist Service Center).

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 蠡园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; garden parks; Gardens
attractions.summary:
- Li Garden is a well-known park in Wuxi, famous for its water scenery and featuring the traditional Jiangnan garden style.
- According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn period, Fan Li and Xi Shi retreated to Taihu Lake, and many of the garden's buildings are themed around Fan Li and Xi Shi, with exquisite landscaping. In spring and summer, visitors can also come here to enjoy the flowers.
- The Li Garden scenic area includes attractions such as the Four Seasons Pavilion, Xi Shi Manor, Tao Zhu Mansion, Thousand-Step Long Corridor, and the Spring and Autumn Pavilion, all offering great visual appeal.
- To the east of Li Garden, there is a Ferris wheel at Li Lake Park. With Li Garden in the foreground and the Ferris wheel as the background, the photos taken here are very artistic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fang Li and Xi Shi Themed Water Garden

restaurants.name_en: Chinese Restaurant at the Paramita Hotel

attractions.name: 苏韵十三园
attractions.summary: Suyun Thirteen Gardens is designed by Professor Chen Wei, an expert in ancient architecture at Southeast University. Adhering to the design concept of "recreating high-quality Jiangsu gardens with the past", it authentically reproduces the classic ancient garden architecture of thirteen prefecture level cities in Jiangsu, allowing visitors to enjoy the classic gardens of Jiangsu in one day. Full time and immersive Chinese style performance tour "Su Yun Seeking Fragrance" is performed every day in Su Yun Thirteen Garden. Led by the talented scholar Li Yu from Jiangsu, tourists meet historical literati, experience the unique charm of different cities, and embark on a journey of Su Yun culture in the gardens of Jiangnan. One city, one garden, one story, one step, one scenery, one stunning sight. Suyun Thirteen Gardens innovatively integrates experiential commercial scenes with immersive cultural exhibitions. Through the interweaving of artistic life and cultural imagination, visitors can experience the classic aesthetic philosophy of Jiangsu gardens, depict the colorful cultural picture of Jiangsu, and experience the natural, humanistic, and beautiful Suyun elegant life.

attractions.name: 汤山一号温泉度假区
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Nanjing Tangshan is famous for its hot springs at home and abroad. There are four springs in Tangshan No.1 Hot Spring Resort, with a daily water output of 5,000 tons. The water temperature is kept at 65 degrees all the year round, the ph value is 7.32, and the salinity is 1.715---1.723 g/L. It contains more than 30 kinds of trace elements such as potassium, sodium, calcium and magnesium. Tangshan No.1 Hot Spring Resort is located in the beautiful hot spring resort of Nanjing Military Region. It integrates tourism and vacation, recreation and entertainment, leisure and health care, and business meetings, covering a total area of about 680 mu. It consists of six areas: open-air hot spring area, hotel villa area, catering and entertainment area, conference and physical examination area.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 湖南博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the mystery exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- The largest comprehensive historical and art museum in Hunan Province, with a rich collection of cultural relics, particularly featuring the artifacts from the Mawangdui Han tomb, and bronzeware from the Shang and Zhou dynasties.
- The exhibits include gauzy, feather-light silk garments, perfectly preserved printed cotton robes, painted lacquerware, silk paintings, as well as various wooden figurines, musical instruments, weapons, and more.
- The exhibition includes a female corpse and her internal organs preserved in the basement, a restored giant coffin, and the remains of tomb pit No. 3 and mound No. 2 from the Mawangdui site.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the artifacts of the Mawangdui Han Tomb

attractions.name: 马王堆汉墓遗址
attractions.summary: In the Mawangdui Han Tomb Site, the famous Mawangdui female corpse was unearthed. The site is located in the Mawangdui Hospital in the eastern suburbs of Changsha. Among the three tomb pits, the first and second pits have been filled, and only the third pit and the exhibition room on the pit are open to the public. The Mawangdui Han Tomb is the burial site of Li Cang, the Prime Minister of Changsha State in the early Western Han Dynasty, as well as his wife and son. Among them, the first tomb pit buried Li Cang's wife Xin Zhui. When unearthed, the soft tissues were elastic, the joints could move, and the blood vessels were clearly visible. It is an unprecedented non decaying wet corpse in the history of world archaeology. Afterwards, this type of ancient corpse was named the Mawangdui Corpse. At present, the female corpse and other burial objects have been relocated to the Hunan Provincial Museum.

attractions.name: 隆平水稻博物馆
attractions.summary: The Longping Rice Museum is the first large-scale rice themed museum in China and even in the world. It is located in Furong District, Changsha City, with a main building area of 11000 square meters and nearly 6000 square meters of exhibition space. It is mainly divided into five different functional areas: exhibition area, storage area, public service area, and technical and administrative management space, with a commercial supporting area of 6000 square meters. The museum has planned three major exhibitions with rice as the theme, namely "Rice Fragrance for Thousands of Years - Exhibition of Chinese Rice History and Culture", "Dreams Come True - Exhibition of Yuan Longping and Hybrid Rice", and "Strange Journey - Exhibition of the Life of Rice". The display covers the entire rice cultivation area and rice cultivation remains. The three displays showcase the past, present, and future of rice, complementing each other and opening up a magnificent picture of the emergence, development, and impact of rice to the audience. Viewers can not only learn about the long history of rice culture in the Chinese nation, but also perceive the rapidly changing trend of rice technology development. They can also learn about the patriotic, dedicated, and unremitting spirit of scientific researchers represented by Yuan Longping.

attractions.name: 五一广场
attractions.summary: Wuyi Square is located in Furong District, Changsha City, with convenient transportation, numerous high-rise buildings and shops, integrating multiple functions such as tourism, vacation, leisure, and daily life.

attractions.name: 长沙世界之窗
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
Changsha Window of the World is located in the northeastern suburbs of the city, along the Liuyang River. It is a comprehensive large-scale theme park that integrates 20 major creative events throughout the year, 50 major thrill rides, architectural wonders from around the world, cultural performances from five continents, and a film shooting base.

The 50 major thrill rides include the "Four Kings of Screams," which are popular among young people, such as the hanging roller coaster, motorcycle roller coaster, sky swing, and twin towers. There are also family-friendly theme areas, such as the Fine Wool Tot Children's Playground, King Kong Jungle Parent-Child Playground, and Pet Paradise. In addition, there is a new concept water park, which has become a new water play landmark for the people of Changsha during the summer.

The 20 major creative events throughout the year include the Chinese Carnival, International Street Art Festival, Halloween, Christmas and New Year season, and more, aiming to bring fresh experiences and endless joy to visitors!

Among the miniature architectural wonders scattered throughout the park, the most popular iconic structures are the New Swan Castle, the Louvre Glass Pyramid from France, and the Lighthouse of Alexandria. As the leader of theme parks in Central and Southern China, Changsha Window of the World continuously upgrades its hardware and software to provide better services and even more fantastic experiences for visitors!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch iconic landmarks around the world.

attractions.name: 黄兴路步行街
attractions.summary: Huangxing Road Pedestrian Street is one of the bustling areas in Changsha City. It is a pedestrian commercial street that was renovated and completed in 2002. Starting from Simenkou in Furong District in the north and ending at Nanmenkou in the south, the total length is 838 meters and the street width is 23-26 meters. It includes Huangxing Square, which covers nearly 10000 square meters, with a total commercial area of 250000 square meters, including a newly built area of 150000 square meters. It is a comprehensive venue that integrates shopping, leisure, entertainment, catering, culture, and tourism functions. The pedestrian street is divided into an inner street and an outer street, with the inner street having three levels. There are numerous shops and a complete range of brands. In addition to various regular clothing and jewelry stores, this place also gathers snacks and delicacies from all over the country. The nearby Pozi Street is also a gathering place for Changsha's specialty snacks, such as the Fire Palace, Shuangyan Tower, and Red Plum Cold Drinks, which are well-known to Changsha people. There are countless of them.

attractions.name: 星城之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: The uniqueness of the Changsha Ferris wheel lies in its standing on a giant roof, which is very novel. At night, this place is brightly lit and colorful. The Ferris wheel is located 120 meters above the ground level downstairs and can accommodate 360 people at the same time. It takes about 20 minutes for the Ferris wheel to complete one circle, providing a panoramic view of the entire city of Changsha. To the east, you can see Changsha University, Window of the World, and Xingsha Economic Development Zone. To the south, you can see the Provincial Botanical Garden, Nanjiao Park, and the under construction Tianxin Ecological New City. To the west, you can see Yuelu Mountain, Xiangjiang River, and Orange Island. To the north, you can see the Kaifu District Government located north of Wujialing. The rotating shaft installed at the center of the Ferris wheel can emit more than 50 different colors of computer combination lights, forming 50 colorful "color exercises" every night. The outer ring of the Ferris wheel is also equipped with a halo, which can emit various colors of light. The two series of lights make the Ferris wheel a beautiful scenery in Changsha.

attractions.name: 华谊兄弟(长沙)电影小镇
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Film and TV studio base; Film Studios; Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The town is located within the Changsha Xiangjiang New District Dawangshan Tourism Resort. The first phase of the project is the Italian town, which consists of Venice, the Water City, and Assisi, the Mountain City. It integrates scenes from Huayi Film and TV, blending the urban characteristics and architectural style of an Italian town. The buildings and roads in the area are mainly arranged in a linear layout, and the planning utilizes the existing natural terrain to reshape the mountainous geography of the site, thereby creating the classic appearance of an Italian town. The area also features Italian-style dining, handicrafts, tourist products, and traditional workshops, offering an interactive experience with a pure Italian style.
attractions.shortFeatures: Comprehensive cultural and tourism scenic area with a film theme

attractions.name: 湘江风光带
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Xiangjiang River is the mother river of Changsha. It flows from south to north through Shaoshan Mountain and enters Changsha City, forming a beautiful scenic belt along the Yangtze River in Changsha. 
Xiangjiang Scenic Belt consists of more than ten leisure and fitness squares, green belts and historical and cultural landscapes, which have unique customs day and night. 
· It is also one of the best places to watch fireworks displays, so every weekend night, there is a lot of excitement along the river.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place for citizens to relax and entertain

attractions.name: 杜甫江阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Du Fu Jiang Pavilion was built in memory of Du Fu, forming a context belt with Tianxin Pavilion, Daolin Second Temple in Yuelu Mountain and Yuelu Academy. 
There is a biography of a great poet inside. Whenever fireworks are set off on summer weekends, the number of visitors who come to watch will increase a lot. 
· Local landmark buildings, close to the Xiangjiang River, can climb high and overlook both sides of the Xiangjiang River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb high overlooking Xiangjiang River and enjoy the grand fireworks

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 湖南大学
attractions.summary: Hunan University is located in Changsha, Hunan Province, China. It is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history dating back to the founding of Yuelu Academy in 976 AD. Hunan University is renowned for its beautiful campus environment, rich cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Yuelu Academy and Aiwan Pavilion, which are important windows for understanding ancient Chinese education and culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

restaurants.name_en: A pot of Hunan lip string hot pot

attractions.name: 甪直古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Lùzhí Ancient Town has a history of over 2,500 years. The town is crisscrossed by waterways, with numerous bridges, and is known for its "Hall of Five Lakes" and "Confluence of Six Marshes."  
· There are 41 ancient bridges in the town, each with unique and elegant designs. Among them, five pairs of bridges connected at right angles stand out and are truly remarkable.  
· The most notable attractions include the Baosheng Temple from the Tang Dynasty, as well as the Shen Residence, Xiao Fangfang Performing Arts Center, Wang Tao Memorial Hall, and the famous Wansheng Rice Mill.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Wansheng Rice Shop in Ye Shengtao's Writings

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 周庄沈厅
attractions.summary: The original name of Shen Hall was Jingye Hall, which was renamed Songmao Hall in the late Qing Dynasty. It was built by Shen Benren, a descendant of Shen Wansan, in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1742 AD). It is divided into seven entrances and five gates, and the architectural layout has the style of a wealthy family. Shen Hall is a must visit attraction in Zhouzhuang, and tourists come here mainly to explore the past of the wealthy Shen Wansan. Layout structure: The first entrance of the Shen Hall is the Water Wall Gate, which is equivalent to the private dock of the Shen family for docking their boats; The second entrance is the foyer; The third entrance is the tea pavilion, used to entertain guests with average status; The fourth entrance is the main hall, Songmao Hall, used to entertain distinguished guests; The fifth entrance is the lobby building where women reside; The sixth entrance is the small hall building; The seventh entrance is the restaurant, with a kitchen next to it. Highlights of Shen Hall: Brick carved gatehouse, main hall, treasure trove, and copper murals are several highlights of Shen Hall. The gatehouse between the third and fourth entrances is one of the five exquisite gatehouses in Shenting. There are beautiful brick carvings on the gatehouse, with the words "Accumulated Thick and Flowing Light" carved in the middle. The main hall, Songmao Hall, is spacious and grand, with old dark windows visible when looking up. In the sixth entrance of the small hall building, there is a statue of Shen Wansan, and in front of him is a glittering treasure trove, which is said to bring wealth to people. There are copper murals on both sides of the lane in Shen Hall, introducing the legendary life of Shen Wansan. Visiting the second floor of the Shen Hall's Ma Tower requires an additional fee. On the second floor, you can look at the various courtyards of the Shen Hall from a different angle, and also see the ladies' boudoirs. It is quite interesting to peek into the main hall's Song Mao Hall from the dark window.

attractions.name: 周庄张厅
attractions.summary:
Zhang Hall, formerly known as Yishun Hall, was built in the Ming Dynasty. In the early Qing Dynasty, Zhang's surname was transferred to Yuyan Hall, commonly known as Zhang Hall. 
After more than 500 years of vicissitudes, solid stone pillars and exquisite carvings, it is still not difficult to see the former elegant demeanor of Zhang Hall. 
The hall is spacious and bright, with a rare wooden drum pier under the court pillar, which is an obvious symbol of Ming Dynasty architecture. 
The backyard of Zhang Hall is a quiet and clean small garden, surrounded by dwellings with white walls and black tiles. 
Enter with the ticket of the day and listen to the story with the tour guide. Although things have changed, you can still feel the details of the life of large families.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sedan chair entered the boat in front of the door and passed through the house

attractions.name: 双桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Shuangqiao is composed of Shide Bridge and Yongan Bridge. It was built in the Ming Dynasty. The two bridges are connected and look like ancient keys, also known as key bridges. 
The special significance here is that the reflection through the lake forms a standard circle with the bridge itself, which is very distinctive. 
Shuangqiao can best reflect the charm of the ancient town. Chen Yifei created an oil painting titled Memories of Hometown with Shuangqiao as the background. 
Although the commercial development is serious and there are many people here, the flowing water and ancient buildings in the south of the Yangtze River have been preserved.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful ancient bridge is a landmark of Zhouzhuang

attractions.name: 富安桥
attractions.summary:
The oldest bridge in Zhouzhuang was built in the Yuan Dynasty, and was later rebuilt by Shen Wansan's younger brother Shen Wansan, and renamed Fu'an Bridge. 
· The only remaining three-dimensional bridge building in the water town of the south of the Yangtze River, the bridge building is rising from the waves, facing each other from a distance, and its momentum is extraordinary. 
There is a local saying that walking the Fu'an Bridge three times will lead to a successful career. It is said that Premier Zhu Rongji walked the Fu'an Bridge three times before taking office. 
Because Fu'an Bridge is quite distinctive, there are a lot of people coming here. Friends who want to go choose a good time, otherwise it will be difficult to take a single photo.

attractions.name: 华谊兄弟电影世界
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Film and TV base; Theme Parks; Film Studios
attractions.summary:
Huayi Brothers Film World is the first world-class film cultural experience project in China with the theme of self-sustaining film intellectual property rights. It is located in Yangcheng Lake Peninsula National Tourist Resort. The project covers an area of 460,000 square meters, with a total investment of 2 billion yuan. 
Huayi Brothers Movie World is based on seven classic Huayi Brothers movies, and has created five theme areas: Avenue of Stars District, If You Are the One District, Assembly District, Tongtian Empire District and Taiji District. In each area, you can watch movies, play movies and walk into movies: in the Avenue of Stars area with "the first movie children's professional experience hall in the whole park", you can Do not forget your initiative mind and realize your star dream; In the 50-meter-high bungee jumping event in If You Are the One area, you can jump and express your unswerving love; In the assembly area with "the world's first VR-Ride project", the iron-blooded military soul and the customs of the Republic of China will surely touch your heart; In Taiji District, the first movie-themed live show in China, "Weird Coffee Breaks through the Sky", restores the mobile prop "Troy" in the movie one to one, bringing you unprecedented audio-visual shock; In the "Swallow Building" in Tongtian Empire District, you can not only taste the tail-burning banquet in the prosperous times of the Tang Dynasty, but also see the beauty of the oiran.
attractions.shortFeatures: Immersive cinematic world

restaurants.name_en: Fall in love with Jiangnan fashion theme restaurants

attractions.name: 解放碑步行街
attractions.summary: Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street is a more prosperous business circle in Chongqing, where there are many department stores and hotels. It is a good place for shopping, eating and strolling. It is also a good place for visiting Chongqing beauties. The pedestrian street is located in Yuzhong District, centered on Monument to the people's Liberation, including Minquan Road, Zourong Road and Bayi Road. There are many food, shopping, and beauty shopping malls, as well as a variety of snacks and beautiful women, making it the "three highs" of a pedestrian street. You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. There are also scenic spots near the pedestrian street, such as Nengren Temple and Arhat Temple. Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street and its surrounding areas are also one of the main choices for tourists to stay in Chongqing. There are intercontinental hotels and economical hotels with high cost performance. Full text 

attractions.name: 重庆好吃街夜市
attractions.summary: Chongqing Delicious Street is a street of food culture. In Southwest Mandarin, the word "good" in "delicious" is pronounced as four sounds, meaning "greedy". "Delicious" means "greedy".
