Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 长江索道
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly hidden gems; cable car and gondola; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The second cable car across the Yangtze River in Chongqing, known as the "First Aerial Corridor of the Yangtze River" and the "Sky Bus of the Mountain City."
- The cabin is surrounded by transparent glass, offering a panoramic view of the natural scenery on both banks during the day, and a spectacular sight of dazzling lights at night.
- A filming location for several films and TV shows, including "Crazy Stone" and "A Bite of China."
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the beautiful cityscape of the mountain city across the Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 长嘉汇弹子石老街
attractions.tag: Stroll through the neighborhood; Nighttime sightseeing; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
Changjiahui Danzishi Old Street is the first national AAAA tourist attraction in China themed around "open port culture and the city’s nine-level hillside terrain." It is located on Nanbin Road, which is known as the "Chongqing Bund." The old street stretches one kilometer from end to end, with an elevation difference of about 80 meters across nine levels of slopes. Visitors walk uphill through streets and alleys with Eastern Sichuan-style courtyards, passing by scattered stilted buildings and businesses.

The scenic area is set against the mountains and water, offering a combination of rich historical heritage, sightseeing, leisure, entertainment, and shopping. Key attractions include the French Naval Barracks (a national heritage site), the Madame Tussauds Chongqing (the first in Southwest China), Changjiahui Ocean Park, Yide Hall, Wang’s Mansion, and others.

This is the only place in Chongqing where visitors can simultaneously "view two rivers," "see three bridges," and "admire three landmarks." At night, the 270-degree panoramic view from the "Two Rivers Viewing Platform" offers a sweeping view of the Yuzhong Peninsula and Jiangbei District, presenting the essence of Chongqing’s nightscape. It truly offers "a complete view of Chongqing at a glance." In addition to its unique landscape features, the area is also a food haven. Along the one-kilometer old street, every few steps you’ll find "Chongqing famous snacks" and "China’s renowned shops," as well as restaurants and bars with prime riverfront views. Today, Danzishi Old Street has become the first choice for locals to relax and entertain, as well as the must-visit destination for showing out-of-town guests the charm of Chongqing.

attractions.name: 南山风景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Climb a mountain; Mountains; Botanical Gardens; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanshan Scenic Area is located on the south bank of the Yangtze River in Chongqing, starting from Tongluo Gorge in the north and ending at Jinzhugou in the south, including dozens of peaks such as Wangshan, Huangshan, Yuanshan, Jiangshan, Daishan, Laojun Mountain and Wenfeng Mountain. 
Known as the back garden of Chongqing, Nanshan Botanical Garden in the scenic spot has more than 1,000 kinds of famous Chinese and foreign flowers, which is a good place to enjoy flowers in spring. 
At night, you can go to a tree observation platform overlooking Yuzhong Peninsula and Nan'an District, including the confluence of the two rivers. Mountain lanterns and rivers complement each other.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the mountain to see the brightly lit mountain city

attractions.name: 南山植物园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Treasure Spots; Enjoy Autumn Flowers
attractions.summary:
The Nanshan Botanical Garden is a popular outing spot for the citizens of Chongqing. The garden features a rose garden, orchid garden, plum garden, camellia garden, bonsai garden, and the Golden Eagle Garden, with flower exhibitions throughout the year. The most lively time is in spring, from March to April, when visitors flock to the garden to enjoy cherry blossoms.

If you miss the flowering season, don’t worry. The garden also has a greenhouse that showcases various tropical plants, offering a visual feast.

It is worth mentioning that the movie *Back to 1942*, directed by Feng Xiaogang, was filmed in the garden. Locations such as the stone bridge and Spanish-style villa can be found within the botanical garden.

Crossing the bridge that spans the road leads to another section of the garden, where you’ll find the orchid garden and camellia garden. The main entrance on this side also leads to the Golden Eagle Viewing Platform. Of course, if you don't wish to visit the Golden Eagle, there is a small path on the left that leads down to the road.

The Nanshan Botanical Garden offers cherry blossom viewing from January to April, with over 30 varieties of cherry blossoms blooming in turn.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk into the city's natural oxygen bar.

attractions.name: 南山一棵树观景台
attractions.summary: The Nanshan Tree Observation Deck is located on Nanshan Mountain in Nan'an District, Chongqing. It includes a tree observation pavilion and a wilderness leisure area, and can accommodate thousands of people at the same time. It is one of the places to enjoy the night view of the mountain city. Standing on the observation deck, looking from afar, the lights of thousands of households in Yuzhong District, Chongqing; Surrounded by two rivers, shining brightly; A long bridge spanning over, with a clear outline; The entire city, layered and arranged in a staggered and colorful manner, is magnificent and dazzling against the backdrop of the night sky.

attractions.name: 李子坝轻轨站
attractions.summary: The local internet famous light rail station, where light rail trains pass through the walls of the building.

attractions.name: 磁器口古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园
attractions.summary: Haixinsha is located in the area of Bati, the Pearl River - Guangzhou Tower - Huacheng Square. It is an artificial island located on the the Pearl River. The night scene here is very beautiful. With the lights of Huacheng Square, you can see the colorful changes of Guangzhou Tower across the river, which reflect each other. Moreover, it is also a great destination for the exterior of Guangzhou Tower, where many photography enthusiasts take photos. The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Those who have watched the opening ceremony will surely remember this boat shaped sports arena vividly. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. The unique geographical location makes Haixinsha and its surrounding areas a must for exploring the international metropolis of Guangzhou, which is a new landmark of Guangzhou. The subway APM line connects these three areas to form a three-point line. Generally, APM can take you to Haixinsha Station, but if you want to have a better tour, it is recommended to get off at Dahua Theater Station. Because you can also visit the Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Library, which are new cultural landmarks in Guangzhou. Then take a slow walk to Liede Bridge and see Haixinsha and Guangzhou Tower from the other side.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 广州兰圃
attractions.summary: Lanpu and Yuexiu Park in Guangzhou are located in the city center, with convenient transportation and direct access by subway. Perhaps because across the road is Yuexiu Park, there are relatively few visitors to Lanpu, which makes the park very quiet. Lanpu is a great place to admire orchids. It is a specialized orchid park in the Lingnan region, cultivating over 200 varieties of orchids and nearly 10000 pots of orchids, including precious orchid species such as Dahuasu, Dafengwei Su, Dendrobium, and Xiandian Baimo. The orchid planting in Orchid Garden is divided into three grids. The first and third grids are mainly planted with orchids, which have light and fragrant flowers; The second grid is dominated by parasitic orchids, with bright flowers but little fragrance. Of course, for tourists, most of them don't care about the variety of orchids. Just take a look and take photos. The flowers are brightly colored and most of them are extremely photogenic. At its entrance, there are two couplets that read 'Fragrant in the Upper Country, Splendid in the South', and the horizontal sign reads' Orchid Garden ', which is very imposing. Strolling into the garden, one can see the elements of Jiangnan gardens everywhere, such as arches, stacked mountains, stone masonry, long corridors, and water pavilions. It suddenly feels like coming to a garden in Suzhou. The entire orchid garden is quiet and deep, with a very good environment, and the air is particularly elegant and high-quality due to the fragrance of orchids. Orchids are classified according to their flowering time, including spring orchids, summer orchids, autumn orchids, cold orchids, and New Year orchids. If you want to see magnolia, its flowering period is from February to March. If you want to see more orchids, spring would be more suitable. In addition to enjoying flowers, most people come here for tea and small Dim sum. Although Lanpu is small, it has many tea rooms with different tea resources and styles. The decoration of the tea rooms is mostly high-end, unique and elegant, very stylish. When the spring is warm and the flowers are blooming, sitting in the tea house with friends and enjoying a small drink, the feeling must be excellent.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Located 2km west of Canton Tower, North Gate Square of Sun Yat-sen University, at CUHK/memorial archway. 
The wharf is located in Guang Zhouta, Haizhu District, an important landscape area of the new central axis of the city. It is planned to open a number of water bus routes. The wharf is positioned as a midway terminal for citizens to visit Guang Zhouta, tour the Pearl River at night and travel. The departure route of Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf is-Ersha Island-Xinghai Concert Hall-North Gate of Zhongda University-Haiyin Bridge-Guangzhou Bridge-Haixinsha-Guang Zhouta-Liede Bridge-and returns to Guangzhou Tazhong Wharf.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour around the bright night scene of Yangcheng

attractions.name: 广州市文化馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The new building of Guangzhou Cultural Center is designed with the theme of "Ten Miles of Red Clouds, One Bay of Water, Eight Bridges, Painting Boats, and Sixteen Pavilions". It cleverly combines traditional architecture and garden space to recreate the beautiful scenery of Lingnan water town gardens, including Hanmo Garden, Quyi Garden, Guangfu Garden, Guangxiu Garden and other theme garden buildings, as well as the large garden landscape formed by them together. It is a city living room rich in Lingnan ecological characteristics and cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 黄埔军校旧址纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Former Site of Huangpu Military Academy
attractions.summary:
- The Army Officer School, founded by Sun Yat-sen in 1924 during the first cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, is the cradle of Chinese military leaders.  
- The military school held seven sessions on Changzhou Island before relocating to Nanjing in 1930, and later moved to Chengdu and Taiwan. It was destroyed in 1938 by a Japanese bombing raid.  
- The entire old site features architectural styles from the Republic of China era, with key attractions including the school headquarters, Sun Yat-sen's former residence, the Eastern Expedition Martyrs' Cemetery, the Northern Expedition Monument, and the Dapo Di Artillery Battery.  
- The venue offers guided tours at 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00, and 15:00.
attractions.shortFeatures: The cradle of modern Chinese military leaders.

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 岭南印象园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gem for Kid-Friendly Activities; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 空中缆车
attractions.summary: Entering from the north gate, you can directly take the cable car from Swan Lake Station to Panda Park Station (near the south gate), pass through Panda Park Koala Pavilion to Africa Grassland Station, then take the small train ride to the amusement area and return to Swan Lake Station.

attractions.name: 猛兽地带-非洲狮
attractions.summary: Walking into the African corridor, the incoming heat wave brings the scorching sun, which in Greek means' scorching sun 'in Africa. The African Corridor is adjacent to the tropical rainforest area, sweeping away the humidity of the rainforest. The first thing tourists see is the home of a very familiar animal - the mongoose brother. There are three families with a total of 30 mongoose brothers living here. These diligent and elf like small animals are known as coal digging machines among animals, and can repair a tunnel for escaping in one night. The neighbors of the small tailed mongoose's house have a Japanese hippopotamus from the primitive forests of West Africa, which is the smallest hippopotamus in the world. The unique glass pavilion allows visitors to enjoy the rarely seen lower body of the hippopotamus and see them swimming in the pool with short hands and feet. In contrast, the animals in the herbivorous animal corridor are much more elegant, quietly grazing, but being overshadowed by the colorful macaws and hornbills nearby. Watching African animals and learning about African culture cannot do without the dance of African indigenous people. At the Africa Square, there are daily indigenous dance performances, taking tourists into the African world.

attractions.name: 澳洲森林
attractions.summary: In the eucalyptus forest full of Australian atmosphere, you can see rare monotremes up close - the cute red kangaroo; There is also the second largest bird on Earth - the emu, which looks like an ostrich. Don't confuse them; Don't miss out on the elegant black swan.

attractions.name: 非洲森林
attractions.summary: The "African Forest" exhibition area covers an area of over 30000 square meters, and the overall design highly restores the landscape of African forests. More than 30 black and white colobus monkeys and intelligent chimpanzees have settled down in African forests and interacted with everyone up close! In addition, there are various small animals crossing through the forests of Africa, such as the active black and white lemurs and the elf white cheeked gibbons appearing beside you. There are also authentic drum performances by Kenyan indigenous people on site, allowing tourists to fully experience the rich African culture.

attractions.name: 丛林发现
attractions.summary: Jungle Discovery is an interactive experience area within Chimelong Wildlife World in Guangzhou, where visitors can observe and learn about the living habits of various wild animals up close, and experience the fun of interacting with them.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 雨林仙踪
attractions.summary: The interactive three-dimensional ecological rainforest exhibition area "Rainforest Fairy" covers an area exceeding the projects "Jurassic Forest" and "Golden Snake Secret Realm" in the same region. It innovatively integrates international advanced exhibition concepts and fully follows the concept of natural layering in the natural rainforest ecosystem to observe animals, opening an unprecedented and unimaginable exploration door for you. At the "Rainforest Wizard of Oz", tourists can delve into the giant ant nests of giant anteaters and observe their magical process of feeding with their tongues; Traverse the magical glass passage and catch a glimpse of mini plush monkeys playing overhead! Don't worry about missing out on the graceful and graceful climbing posture of the orangutans living in the treetops. The unique aerial wooden boardwalk allows you to fully enjoy their wonderful artistic gymnastics performances! In addition, there are dozens of "rainforest residents" such as gibbons, gibbons, flying hornbills, honeysuckers, and big billed birds that come into close contact with you.

attractions.name: 长颈鹿广场
attractions.shortFeatures: Star animals that must be photographed and punched in

attractions.name: 考拉广场
attractions.summary: Koala Square is located within the Chimelong Tourist Resort in Guangzhou. These national treasures from Australia are blooming and scattering in the Chimelong Wildlife Park. Not only are there twins "Huanhuan" and "Lele", but also the koala family with "six generations living together".

attractions.name: 熊猫乐园
attractions.summary: In 'Panda Village', there are the only triplets of panda cubs in the world who are cute, handsome, and cool. Mengmeng is a gentle and lovely older sister, while Shuai and Kuku are handsome and charming younger brothers. At Panda Park, you can watch panda cubs eat fragrant bamboo up close and take away furry panda dolls.

attractions.name: 青龙山
attractions.summary: In the brand new Jurassic Forest covering hundreds of thousands of square meters, robots from the future take you through time and space tunnels, and the Jurassic scenery is presented realistically. The world's most real and largest dinosaurs are around you, making you feel like you are in prehistoric times. Experience the resurrection of dinosaurs in an unprecedented way and embark on exciting jungle adventures.

attractions.name: 金蛇秘境
attractions.summary: The "Golden Snake Secret Realm" created with huge investment in the Year of the Snake is the largest ecological themed snake park, showcasing over 20 species and more than 300 rare snakes, including the world's largest golden python. Hundreds of thousands of square meters of pristine forest secrets, unique dome shaped snake watching methods, and innovative multimedia viewing experiences bring visitors a brand new world of snakes, discovering the friendly, beautiful, and auspicious side of snakes and providing unprecedented snake watching experiences.

attractions.name: 考拉园
attractions.summary: Going to Koala Park can fulfill your desire to carefully observe the adorable koalas. Here, there are not only twins "Huanhuan" and "Lele", but also a four generation koala family living together. Koalas are very drowsy during the day, except for eating eucalyptus leaves, they just sleep. If you encounter a koala with its eyes open and not sleeping, it's lucky.

attractions.name: 亚洲象园
attractions.summary: The Asian Elephant Park is located in Guangzhou and is a park dedicated to showcasing and protecting Asian elephants. Tourists can observe these large animals up close, understand their living habits and conservation status. There are also educational exhibitions within the park aimed at raising public awareness of Asian elephants and their habitat conservation.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 白云山
attractions.tag: Climbing and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Baiyun Mountain is one of the famous mountains in southern Guangdong, known as the "First Beauty of Yangcheng" and "The First Mountain of Nanyue."

· It consists of more than 30 peaks. From the summit, visitors can overlook the entire city and get a distant view of the Pearl River, making it a popular destination for spring outings.

· After rain or during the late spring season, clouds swirl around the mountain, and the name "Baiyun Mountain" (White Cloud Mountain) is derived from this phenomenon.

· The scenic area is divided into seven tourist zones: Mingzhu Tower, Moxing Ridge, Mingchun Valley, Santai Ridge, Luhu Lake, Fei'e Ridge, and Heyi Ridge.

· Visitors can also enjoy recreational activities such as grass skiing, slideways, and small bungee jumping in the scenic area.

· Baiyun Mountain is dotted with stunning rhododendrons in red, pink, and white. From a distance, the mountains are adorned with a sea of blooming flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climbing high to enjoy the scenery and admire the moonlight.

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 郑州海昌海洋公园
attractions.summary: Zhengzhou Haichang Ocean Park is located in the Modern Service Industry Development Zone of Zhongmou County, Zhengzhou, Henan Province. It covers a total area of approximately 425000 square meters and is a national AAAA level tourist attraction. It includes various tourism products such as ocean park parks, themed towns, and resort hotels. The scenic area operates around the theme of "Ocean+" cultural tourism integration, with ocean culture as the core. Through the deep integration of multiple IPs such as Ultraman, rich and immersive play content is presented in small town scenes. At the same time, it is equipped with two major theme hotels, Ocean and Ultraman, to create an integrated and comprehensive family tourism and vacation destination.

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉野生动物王国
attractions.summary: Wuhan Wildlife Kingdom is located in Wumei Mountain, surrounded by West Lake and beautiful scenery in Caidian District. It is surrounded by mountains and waters, with abundant natural resources, covering an area of about 2250 acres. The total investment for the third phase is 1.5 billion yuan, integrating wildlife breeding and breeding, animal and plant protection research, tourism and viewing, science education, and interactive experience. As a large-scale immersive experience wildlife park in Central China, the park plans to introduce more than 250 species of animals, with a total of over 10000 individuals, including 25 rare and protected animals. The park takes "natural mountains and rivers as the background, kindred culture as the gene, and animal spirits as the context" to build Wuhan Wildlife Kingdom into a landmark theme park where humans and nature (animals) coexist harmoniously. Full text 

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 西双版纳傣族园
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
- Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park is composed of five well-preserved Dai natural villages, namely Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga.
- Upon entering the park, the first thing you encounter is the Welcome Square, where you are greeted by warm-hearted Dai people performing welcome dances, singing blessings, and sprinkling water for good wishes.
- The park also houses the Manchunman Ancient Buddhist Temple, one of the oldest temples in Xishuangbanna, with a history of over 1,400 years. Every day, you can hear the sound of chanting inside the temple.
- The grandest festival for the Dai people in Xishuangbanna is the Water-Splashing Festival. At the Water-Splashing Square in the Dai Ethnic Park, you can experience the lively scenes of the festival every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Accept the warm welcome dance of the Dai people.

attractions.name: 曼听御花园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 热带花卉园
attractions.summary: The Xishuangbanna Tropical Flower Garden is located within the Yunnan Tropical Crops Research Institute in the urban area of Jinghong City, covering an area of approximately 80 hectares. The garden is designed around a series of natural water surfaces as the main axis for sightseeing, with attractions such as the Flower Garden, Sky Garden, Premier Zhou Enlai Memorial, Palm Area, Rare Tree and Grassland Area, Bonsai Area, Foliage Plant Area, Tropical Fruit Tree Area, and more. It integrates functions of research, science popularization, tourism, and vacation. The garden preserves nearly 1,000 varieties of flowers and economic plants. As you stroll through the park, you are surrounded by a world of exotic flowers, unique trees, and a colorful array of plants, making it an important tourist destination in Xishuangbanna.
attractions.shortFeatures: Science-themed Resort Park

attractions.name: 古纳卡傣族文化园
attractions.summary: Gunaka Dai Cultural Park is located in an ancient village in Xishuangbanna. The stockade is rich in Dai cultural characteristics and retains the ancient cultural heritage of Dai people. There are famous scenic spots such as Manhena and Dai Well in the cultural park. Here you can also see the lush forest and the handicraft making process with Dai characteristics.

attractions.name: 西双版纳勐泐文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 西九文化区
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park presents a grand and diverse Christmas celebration in Hong Kong, creating a festive atmosphere together. Celebrate the holiday at the "West Kowloon Christmas Market" and choose global holiday cuisine and selected Christmas gifts with family, friends, and children. Appreciate the enlarged Christmas town and giant Christmas tree of the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Join the "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" global super inflatable bouncing party (November 22, 2024- Hong Kong). As winter approaches, the West Kowloon Cultural District (West Kowloon) invites the public to participate in the grand and diverse Christmas celebration event with family, friends, and children from November 22, 2024 (Friday) to January 5, 2025 (Sunday). Nine Colorful Christmas ". The West Kowloon Christmas Market will be unveiled on Friday, November 22, 2024. During the first three weekends (Friday to Sunday), six distinctive stalls will be opened on the lawn of the art park seaside first; Starting from December 12th (Friday), the market will expand to over 30 specialty stalls, located on the east lawn of the art park and the seaside platform opposite M+. The West Kowloon Christmas Market offers a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts. Surrounded by the charming Victoria Harbour scenery and lush green lawns of the West Kowloon Art Park, visitors can immerse themselves in the dazzling holiday lights and enjoy melodious live music and performances. Apart from the Christmas market, visitors should not miss the "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Parade" held by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) on the West Lawn at the seaside from November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025. The giant and dazzling Christmas tree standing over 20 meters tall in the enlarged version of Christmas Town will be transformed into a giant canvas this year, with projections of different winter festival scenes added to enhance the festive atmosphere. The Christmas town of over 10000 square feet will open on November 22, and the Hong Kong Tourism Board will also stage a total of four "Winter Victoria Harbour Water Fireworks" on the opening day and from December 24 to 26, shining brightly in Victoria Harbour. The global super inflatable bouncing party "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" will be held for the first time on December 21, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park lawn, bringing a new outdoor bouncing experience to children and kids. West Kowloon is the first stop of The Big Bounce World Tour in Asia, featuring four uniquely designed super giant inflatable amusement areas, including the "Global Super Inflatable Castle" and the Hong Kong's ultra long inflatable obstacle course. There are multiple exclusive events throughout the day, with parent-child events during the day and a night jumping party for people aged 16 and above at night. The party brings an exciting lineup of special guests and themes, inviting the public to celebrate the festival together with "day jumping and night jumping". The second phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside East Lawn and M+opposite the Seaside Platform. The "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Tour" organized by the Hong Kong Tourism Board: Visitors can immerse themselves in the Greater Bay Area. Version of Christmas Town, On site, there is a winter scenery presented with colorful Christmas gifts and a giant Christmas tree. Time: November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025 Location: Art Park Seaside West Lawn 3, "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station": Both children and adults can participate in the global super large inflatable bouncing party, with bubble parties and DJ stationed on-site. During the day, it is a parent-child event, and in the evening, it is a night bouncing party for people aged 16 and above. There are special guests and themes available. Time: December 21, 2024 to January 5, 2025, 10:00-23:10 (divided into time slots) Location: Art Park Grand Lawn Cultural and Art Programs and Activities During the Christmas period, a series of art and cultural activities will be held at different locations in West Kowloon. Visitors can enjoy cultural and artistic activities while also enjoying a wonderful and unforgettable Christmas experience. Art enthusiasts can visit the two museums in West Kowloon for exhibitions. The "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Sino French Cultural Exchange in the 17th and 18th Centuries" exhibition at the Palace Museum in Hong Kong will be open to the public on December 18th, while visitors to M+can visit two special exhibitions, "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and "Guo Pei: Artistic Imagination in the Sky". Visitors can also watch weekend street performances planned by the West Kowloon Cultural Centre and other cultural events held in West Kowloon. The global touring exhibition "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition", organized by Visionairs Asia Hong Kong, will open on December 8, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park. The exhibition is presented in collaboration between digital heritage expert Histovery and the public restoration agency of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, with support from L'Oreal Group, and will be staged on the occasion of the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral. Through innovative technology, the exhibition allows visitors to experience the unique architectural treasure of Notre Dame Cathedral in high-definition historical landscapes. As Notre Dame Cathedral was engulfed in fire and reopened after five years of restoration, exploring this architectural treasure holds great historical and cultural significance. The 2024 Dahua Bank Ink Art Festival will be held from December 13th to 29th, 2024 at the Art Exhibition Pavilion and the High Lawn of the Art Park, presenting Hong Kong's premier ink art celebration to the audience. Sponsored by Dahua Bank (Hong Kong) and organized by Dahua Bank's "Art · Workshop", the Ink Art Festival will host a variety of exciting activities, including the 2024 Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award winning works exhibition, art workshops, ink themed forums, music performances, interactive installations, and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" Carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. The "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition" coincides with the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris this month, and visitors can visit the exhibition from Exhibition Art. Asia. Hong Kong (Visionairs) The Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition will be held from December 8, 2024 to March 7, 2025. Visitors can visit a series of exciting and rich activities, including the 2024 "Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award" exhibition and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. New concept stores and limited time "West Kowloon Consumption Rewards" have landed in the Art Park, providing visitors with more diverse dining options, including% Arabica's boutique coffee Honbo's signature burgers and hot dogs, Tiger Hall's delicious pearl milk tea, and local convenience store brand 852 Eight Five Two's light meals.
