attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 凌霄阁
attractions.summary:
Lingxiao Pavilion is the terminal of the Peak Tram, and it is also a comprehensive tourist attraction integrating climbing, viewing, shopping, dining and entertainment. 
There are 6 floors in total. The 1st-3rd floors are mainly delicious food. There are 4 different fashionable restaurants in China, West and Japan, where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery while eating. 
· It also includes important attractions such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Peak Post Office, which are also a must-check-in place for tourists to visit Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: The skyscraper enjoys the beautiful view of Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 人民英雄纪念碑
attractions.summary:
· The Monument to the People's Heroes is located in the center of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, the capital, and was built to commemorate the revolutionary martyrs in modern Chinese history.  
The whole Hero Monument is carved with more than 170 figures, which summarizes and vividly shows the great historical facts of the people's revolution in China in the past hundred years. 
On the front of the tablet, there are eight characters "People's Heroes Live Forever" inscribed by Chairman Mao himself, and on the back there is an inscription drafted by Chairman Mao and written by Premier Zhou Enlai. 
· This is the memory of the older generation and the study place of the younger generation. When you come to Tiananmen Square, you will definitely come here to commemorate it.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the symbol buildings of the motherland

attractions.name: 人民大会堂
attractions.summary:
· Located on the west side of Tiananmen Square in the center of Beijing, it is an important part of Tiananmen Square. 
The Great Hall of the People faces east from west, 336 meters long from north to south, 206 meters wide from east to west, and 46.5 meters high. It covers an area of 150,000 square meters, which is larger than the total building area of the Forbidden City. 
It is an important place for the party, the state and various people's organizations to hold political activities, and it is also a place for Chinese state leaders and people to hold political, diplomatic and cultural activities. 
Usually, there will be some performances in the Great Hall of the People, such as concerts and some Peking Opera performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: The meeting place of the people's congress

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 昆明湖
attractions.summary: Kunming Lake occupies three-quarters of the area of the Summer Palace, with beautiful scenery and is the soul of the entire garden. Every summer and autumn, a large number of tourists come to enjoy boating on the lake, admiring the pavilions and towers by the lake, and admiring the beautiful scenery of the entire park. In addition to the beautiful scenery of the lake, attractions such as the Seventeen Arch Bridge and the West Embankment in the lake are also worth savoring. Overview of Travel: Kunming Lake can be divided into three parts based on the division of water bodies: Great Lake, West Lake, and Back Lake. It takes about 2 hours to walk around the lake for a week. In summer and autumn, you can take a boat tour of the lake, which is both relaxing and enjoyable, without missing out on sightseeing and sightseeing. There are 8 boat docks and 5 different types of boats in the park. The prices and routes of cruise ships vary, please consult the scenic area for details. The main attraction to the east of Kunming Lake is Zhichun Pavilion, which is said to be where the thawing of Kunming Lake begins every spring. Not only can you capture the beautiful scenery of the entire park here, but the vast water color will also give you a very artistic silhouette effect. The seventeen span bridge spans between Nanhu Island and the east bank, with a length of 150 meters, like a long rainbow perched on the sparkling blue waves. It is a replica of Lugou Bridge, with stone lions of various shapes carved on the top of each stone barrier on the bridge, appearing exquisite, majestic, and beautiful. On the east bank of the Seventeen Arch Bridge, there stands a national octagonal pavilion. Nearby, there is a beautifully crafted bronze bull, the size of a real cow, squatting with its head held high and ears raised. If one hears something and looks back in surprise, it is very beautiful and vivid. Originally taken from the meaning of a divine cow guarding the water, it is now a precious cultural relic. To the south of the Seventeen Arch Bridge, there is a west embankment modeled after the West Lake Su Causeway, with six exquisitely constructed bridge pavilions that are worth a visit.

attractions.name: 佛香阁
attractions.summary:
· Buddha Fragrance Pavilion is the main building of the Summer Palace, which is built on a 20-meter-high square platform of Wanshou Mountain. 
· Facing Kunming Lake in the south, backed by the Sea of Wisdom, the buildings centered on it spread out to the two wings in a neat and symmetrical manner, forming a magnificent trend of stars holding the moon. 
Foxiang Pavilion is 41 meters high, with 8 sides, 3 floors and 4 eaves. There are 8 huge iron pear wood Optimus Prime in the pavilion, which is quite complicated in structure and is a masterpiece of classical architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the famous buildings of the Summer Palace

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 回音壁
attractions.summary:
The echo wall, located in the Temple of Heaven Park, is the circular wall of the imperial dome. The wall is made of Shandong Linqing bricks and ground bricks, and is covered with blue glazed tube tile roof. 
Because the curvature of the wall is very regular, it becomes a good reflector of sound waves. Two people can stand at both ends of the wall and hear the sound. 
The two of them answered, asked questions and answered, and their voices were long and interesting. Feel the wisdom and magic of the ancients.
attractions.shortFeatures: The walls are extremely smooth and tidy

attractions.name: 北海公园
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Enjoying Autumn Leaves
attractions.summary:
·Beihai Park is located in the center of Beijing and is the oldest existing classical royal garden in China, with the most complete preservation and the deepest cultural heritage.  
·The park is centered around Beihai Lake and is divided into four main areas: the "North Shore Scenic Area," "East Shore Scenic Area," "Qiong Island Scenic Area," and "Tuan City Scenic Area."  
·The vast water area is rare in Beijing, and the best time for boating and sightseeing in the park is in the evening, when one can admire imperial architecture and sit by the lake, chatting with elderly locals about the royal history of the capital.  
·On the east shore, there are several courtyard-style gardens such as Hao Pu Jian, Hua Fang Zhai, and Can Tan, which are hidden among the ancient pines and cypress trees. These gardens not only have a natural charm but also exude the elegance of a private garden in southern China.  
·On the north shore, from east to west, there are Jingxin Zhai, Western Heaven, Chengguan Hall, the Nine-Dragon Wall, Chanfu Temple, and the World of Bliss. The Five-Dragon Pavilion is dotted along the lake, blending seamlessly with the natural landscape, creating a scene that seems entirely natural, like a masterpiece of landscape painting.  
·Beihai Park is home to one of the Eight Scenic Spots of Yanjing, "Qiong Island Spring Shade," which will reach its best viewing period in April. The blooming flowers, beautiful rocks, and captivating scenery make it a particularly enchanting sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Royal Garden of Bai Ta Lake, intertwined with water.

restaurants.name_en: Commune restaurant at the foot of the Great Wall
Gold, purple and silver parity seafood

attractions.name: 福州西湖公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
West Lake Park is located on Hubin Road in the northwest of the city. It has a history of more than 1,700 years and is the most complete classical garden in Fuzhou so far. 
In the third year of Jin Taikang, Yan Gao, the county governor, brought water from the northwest mountains here to irrigate farmland. Because it was located in the west of the city wall of Jin Dynasty, it was called the West Lake. 
There are three small islands in the West Lake-Kaihua Island, Xieping Island and Yaojiao Island. Fujian Provincial Museum and Food Exhibition Hall are also located in the West Lake Park.  
Every year during the Dragon Boat Festival, a dragon boat race will be held in the West Lake. At that time, the fierce and spectacular race scene will be launched between the vast water and sky, and the sound of gongs and drums will reach the sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fuzhou's old city park

attractions.name: 三坊七巷
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Celebrity Residences; Famous Residences; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It originated in the Jin Dynasty, flourished during the Tang and Five Dynasties, and reached its peak during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The layout of its alleys and lanes remains largely intact, making it a living fossil of the ancient Chinese li-bang system.
- Composed of three blocks, seven lanes, and a central street, it has long been known as the "Three Lanes and Seven Alleys."
- The area consists of narrow alleys, white-washed walls and tiled roofs, with an intricate network of lanes. The stone-paved roads are lined with stone archways at the entrances of each block and lane.
- Today, it is home to many time-honored food stalls and traditional crafts, making it a great place to visit, explore the birthplace of famous figures, and enjoy local specialties.
attractions.shortFeatures: Museum of Ming and Qing Architecture

attractions.name: 林则徐纪念馆
attractions.summary:
· Lin Zexu, the first person to open his eyes to the world in modern China. Lin Zexu Memorial Hall, located on Macao Road, was originally Lin Zexu's ancestral temple. 
· The whole museum is a classical garden building, which is now turned into Lin Zexu's life exhibition room. It is divided into parts such as Lin Zexu's life, Lin Zexu and the Opium War, Lin Zexu and disaster relief, water conservancy, the first person in the world, Lin Zexu's handwriting, etc., and introduces Lin Zexu's life of patriotism and concern for the people. 
There are three bluestone tablets inside, one is the imperial edict, the other is the imperial sacrifice, and the other is the imperial inscription, all of which were given by the emperor when Lin Zexu died, and were engraved when the temple was built.

attractions.name: 上下杭
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The blocks of Shanghang Road and Xiahang Road in Taijiang, Fuzhou, are also known as "Shuanghang". A traditional block with strong Chinese and Western architectural cultural characteristics in Fuzhou and typical Fujian merchants' cultural characteristics, including ten scenic spots in Nantai, three bridges and fishing fires.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traditional blocks with rich architectural culture

attractions.name: 西禅古寺
attractions.summary: In the old days, there were Zen temples in the southeast, northwest, and northwest suburbs of Fuzhou. This temple was located at the foot of Yishan Mountain in the western suburbs of Fuzhou, so it was called Xichan Temple. In history, Xichan Temple has been destroyed several times, so although it is an ancient temple, most of the Xichan Temples you see now are newly built. Overall, the repairs are very good, and the main hall of the temple is very tall and magnificent. In the temple, there are the Shakya ManiHall, Dharma Hall, Sutra Pavilion, Jade Buddha Tower, Guanyin Pavilion, guest hall, Zen Hall, Abbot Room and other buildings. The most precious cultural relic is the Kangxi imperial calligraphy of the "Medicine Buddha Sutra" hidden in the Sutra Pavilion, but tourists cannot see it. The environment of Xichan Temple is beautiful and the greenery is well done, and there is also a famous feature - lychee trees. On the pillars of the ancient temple gate, there is a couplet engraved: "The four dynasties of the Li tree are passed down to the Song Dynasty, and the sound of the bell echoes through the ages." This is a couplet written by Zhou Lian in the Qing Dynasty. This not only indicates that there are many lychee trees in Xichan Temple, but also shows that Xichan Temple has existed since the Tang Dynasty. The lychee tree in the front courtyard of the Dharma Hall is an ancient tree that dates back to the Song Dynasty and is still blooming and bearing fruit today. Like other temples, Xichan Temple also has a release pool with a lot of fish and turtles inside. Children will be very happy to see it. In addition, overseas temples such as Shuanglin Temple in Singapore, Shuangqing Temple in Penang, Malaysia, and Nanputuo Temple in Vietnam are all under the jurisdiction of the Western Zen Lower House and are still managed by the monks of the Western Zen Temple. Therefore, this is a window for cultural exchange between Fuzhou and Southeast Asia. Every year, many foreign monks and believers visit and participate, making it a unique landscape of ancient temples. Overall, for a city like Fuzhou where almost every park is free, seeing paid temples is somewhat uncomfortable, and it feels like worshiping Buddha has a more secular flavor. If you have plenty of time and there are not many scenic spots in Fuzhou, and this is still considered a good attraction, then you can come. Full text 

attractions.name: 福道
attractions.shortFeatures: Forest trail with steel frame hollow design

attractions.name: 福建马尾船政建筑群
attractions.summary: The Fujian Mawei Shipyard Architecture Complex is located in Mawei District, Fuzhou City, Fujian Province, China. It is one of the important sites of modern Chinese industry. This was an important shipbuilding base during the Qing Dynasty and also the cradle of China's modern navy. The architectural complex includes several historical buildings such as the Shipbuilding Administration Office, Shipbuilding Academy, and Shipyard, showcasing the development of China's industry and navy from the late 19th century to the early 20th century.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:30 to 17:30 throughout the year

attractions.name: 罗星塔公园
attractions.summary: Luo Xing Pagoda is an internationally recognized navigation mark, the gateway symbol of Minjiang River, and has the reputation of "China Tower". Under the tower is Luoxing Park, beside which is the International Seafarers Club. Climb to the top of the tower, the port wharf and the development zone are all in sight. There are also ancient forts on both sides of the river. You can see the ancient battlefield of the Sino-French battle filled with fireworks, and you can see the Zhaozhong Temple to pay tribute to the martyrs who died for the country.
attractions.shortFeatures: Internationally recognized navigation beacon

attractions.name: 福州贵安溪山温泉
attractions.summary: Xishan Hot Spring Resort Hotel - located in the center of Haixia Cultural Village, backed by the lush pine and bamboo forests of Tangling, facing the shimmering Aojiang River, and surrounded by the gurgling Xixi River. The high-quality hot springs are well-known, separated from the international standard 18 hole hot spring golf course and facing the Xixi National Forest Park from afar. Xishan Hot Spring has unique and abundant resources, not only with a profound historical background, but also with excellent water quality, earning it the title of "the first hot spring town in Xishan, Fujian". The theme of Xishan Hot Spring Resort Hotel is "Taste, Leisure, and Health Preservation". Hot spring culture is a "health culture" that should provide every guest with a peaceful environment, allowing them to immerse themselves in real nature and relax in a truly natural landscape. Only when the environment is elegant and the mood is comfortable, can the effect of health preservation be achieved. Xishan Hot Springs has high-quality hot spring water -7000 tons of fluorine-containing and radon containing hot springs with sunrise water, China's high-end membership hot spring club, and unique seasonal SPA. With 30000 square meters of hydrophilic hot spring park, there are more than 100 open bathing pool surrounded by green trees, more than 50 luxury soup houses, more than 10 boats sailing in the Panxi River on the water, as well as health care projects such as hot spring SPA, and entertainment facilities such as water paddling, beach, yacht, three hole golf course are all available, bringing consumers happy and healthy leisure time. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-22:30(Tickets available until 21:30; admission ends at 21:30)
