attractions.name: 黄浦江
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is known as the "mother river of Shanghai", and Pudong and Puxi use it as a boundary to form important landmarks such as the world-renowned Bund and the Lujiazui Financial Center. Watching the magnificent night view of Pujiang River is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Shanghai. You can also take a cruise on the river and enjoy the scenery on both sides. The Huangpu River, with a total length of about 113 kilometers and a river width of 300 to 700 meters, flows through all districts of Shanghai. It is the symbol and symbol of Shanghai and gathers the essence of Shanghai's urban landscape. The Bund and Binjiang Avenue along the Huangpu River are both excellent tourist attractions, with fewer tourists visiting Binjiang Avenue compared to the Bund. Strolling along the riverbank, the Bund International Architecture Exhibition Complex on the west bank of the Pujiang River, filled with rich exotic colors, stands in sharp contrast to the modern skyscrapers towering into the clouds on the east bank. You can glimpse Shanghai's century long development history from it. The night view of Pujiang is also worth watching. At night, both sides of the Huangpu River are ablaze with lights. You can start from the the 16 Pu on the second Shandong Road in Huangpu District, and take the Pujiang River cruise ship to drive on the river, with a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery along the way. The Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge across the Huangpu River, the classic Garden Bridge of Shanghai like a jade belt, the Pudong Binjiang Avenue with beautiful environment, and the Shanghai International Conference Center with unique shape have formed a beautiful scenery line under the creation of gorgeous lights, which makes people dizzy. The ship offers Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Pujiang while enjoying delicious food. The sailing time of the cruise ship is from 11:00 to 21:30 every day, once every hour from 11:00 to 13:00, and once every half hour from 13:00 to 21:30. The single voyage time is about 60 minutes. If you don't want to spend too much time taking a cruise, taking a ferry between Pudong and Puxi is also an affordable choice to experience the Pujiang style, which is more nostalgic. The ferry runs back and forth from Jinling East Road Ferry Terminal next to the Bund to Dongchang Road Ferry Terminal in Pudong from 7:00-22:00, with a one-way journey of about ten minutes and a departure every 15 minutes. There are also ferries that run between Fuxing East Road Ferry and Dongchang Road Ferry. Fuxing East Road Ferry operates from 7:00-19:00, while Dongchang Road Ferry operates from 7:00-18:45, with one ferry every half hour.

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉欢乐谷
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spots; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
- The first Happy Valley themed amusement park in Central China, a large cultural tourism destination that is complex, ecological, and innovative, offering a spectacular interpretation of diverse joy.  
- Composed of eight major themes: Dream Avenue, Cartoon Factory, Happy Time, Speed World, Fisherman's Island, Feather Paradise, Hurricane Bay, and Joyful River City.  
- Featuring more than 30 amusement rides, over 40 ecological and cultural landscapes, more than 10 cultural performance shows, and over 20 themed entertainment games.
attractions.shortFeatures: A popular amusement park with a wide variety of attractions.

attractions.name: 海口观澜湖火山温泉谷
attractions.name_en: Haikou Mission Hills Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
The main building of the hot spring area is inspired by the unique circular earth building in southern China, and a large number of bamboo and volcanic stones are used as materials to create a simple and natural atmosphere. The park includes volcanic rock mineral hot springs with the styles of six continents around the world, uniquely designed spas and outdoor volcanic rock water parks. 
Volcanic mineral hot spring is taken from natural spring water with a depth of about 800 meters underground. The natural water temperature is between 15 ℃ and 43 ℃, and it contains various natural mineral ingredients with health effects. The water quality has been certified by the British International Water Quality Institute.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy special hot springs on five continents

attractions.name: 海南热带野生动植物园
attractions.name_en: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens; Zoos
attractions.summary: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden, also known as Dongshan Wildlife Park, is China's first large-scale tropical wildlife park and the country's only island-type tropical rainforest botanical and zoological garden. It is acclaimed as a "natural museum that condenses the essence of Hainan Island's native flora and fauna." The park is located in Dongshan Town, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, approximately 27 kilometers from downtown Haikou. It is themed around tropical wildlife exhibitions and science popularization. The park's landscapes are entirely natural, with vast forested areas and dense vegetation providing an excellent wild environment for animals. Meanwhile, the artificially created jungle trails and a variety of exotic flowers and plants make visitors feel as if they are immersed in a vibrant natural world full of birdsong and floral fragrances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals in the tropical jungle
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 观澜湖火山温泉谷
attractions.name_en: Guanlan Lake Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
attractions.summary: Guanlan Lake Volcanic Hot Spring Valley is located in Haikou City and is a comprehensive tourist resort that integrates hot spring bathing, leisure and entertainment, and health preservation. There are various styles of hot spring pools here, including volcanic rock hot springs, herbal hot springs, floral hot springs, etc., which can meet the needs of different tourists. The hot spring valley has a beautiful environment with lush green trees, making it an excellent place to relax and enjoy nature.

attractions.name: 雷琼海口火山群世界地质公园
attractions.name_en: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
attractions.summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.
attractions.shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社(百年记忆公社)
attractions.name_en: Mission Hills Huayi Brothers Feng Xiaogang Movie Town
attractions.summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 五公祠
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
Wugong Temple Complex is located at No.169 Haifu Avenue, Haikou City, about 5 kilometers away from the city center. Near the downtown area, it is unique and quiet, and is known as "Qiongtai Scenic Spot", "Yinghai Humanities" and "Hainan's No.1 Scenic Spot". The building complex of Wugong Temple includes: the first floor of Hainan (also known as Wugong Temple), Xuepu Hall, Guanjia Hall, Xizhai (Wugong Jingshe), Dongzhai, Su Gong Temple, Liangfubo Temple, Dongzhuo Pavilion, Fusu Spring, Qiongyuan and the newly-built Wugong Temple Exhibition Hall. 
Wugong Temple is a cultural relic and historic site that displays ancient Chinese demotion culture, Hainan history and culture and ancient architectural art with Hainan characteristics. "Wugong Temple" is the general name of a group of ancient buildings, covering an area of about 100 mu together with gardens, wells and ponds. It was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, rebuilt in the 15th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1889), and then repaired many times, and it is still shining brightly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding the ancient culture of official demotion in ancient buildings

attractions.name: 骑楼老街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street

attractions.name: 海口钟楼
attractions.summary: The Haikou Bell Tower is an important landmark building in Haikou, with a history of nearly a hundred years. It was originally built to adapt to foreign trade. The building is five stories high and the walls are built with red bricks. The Haikou Bell Tower stands on Changdi Road, facing the estuary. The row of ancient buildings across from the Haikou Bell Tower is the famous Haikou Qilou Old Street. The current Haikou Bell Tower was renovated in 1987 with funding based on the original appearance of the old clock tower. Named 'New Sound of Ancient Bell'. The Bell Tower is a symbol of Haikou, witnessing the city's growth process. Full text 

attractions.name: 迪士尼小镇
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary:
Disney Town is part of Shanghai Disney Resort and is adjacent to Shanghai Disneyland, making it a great place for a leisure getaway with friends and family. Continue the magical experience of the park, where you can stroll along Broadway Avenue, taste the international neighborhood style, and buy diverse and high-quality goods from light luxury to fashion in one stop. You can also find and taste a variety of world cuisines along the cobblestone streets of Baishixiang Street. On Disney Town Lakefront, you will be surrounded by peaceful beauty of Star Wish Lake, where you can relax your mind and enjoy the tranquility with family and friends. The beauty of the sparkling lake also makes it an ideal place for romantic moments and anniversaries. Besides, there are wonderful and rich activities in Disney Town all year round, which will bring you infinite surprises. Whether it's band performances with different styles or theme activities with unique Disney characteristics, every trip to Disney Town will be full of pleasure. 
Disney Town is also the back garden for Disney friends to play at leisure. Here, the wonderful magic is continuing; Here, everyone is happy in the moment and inspired by generate; Here, maybe at the next corner, you will encounter something wonderful unexpected.
attractions.shortFeatures: Continue the magical experience of Disneyland

attractions.name: 星愿公园
attractions.summary:
"If you are looking for a great place to embrace nature, Star Wish Park with its beautiful Star Wish Lake is not to be missed. Strolling along the walking path of about 2.5 kilometers in this amazing wetland scenery, you can enjoy the different scenery in all seasons of the year, watching flowers in spring and wind in summer, fallen leaves in autumn and snow in winter. You can also rent a bicycle, ride with your family and friends to explore the beautiful woodland, and walk through lush trees. There is beautiful scenery in front of you, surrounded by birds and butterflies. This is the wonder of nature! 
In Star Park, there is also a "Little Dragonfly Garden" where adventurous children can enjoy themselves. It is colorful and interesting, and it is most suitable for the whole family to "explore" nature and enjoy a weekend of leisure sports. When night falls, the Starlight Amphitheater under the night sky stimulates tourists' imagination and creativity. "
attractions.shortFeatures: There are 2500 meters of walking trails inside

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 奇梦之光幻影秀
attractions.name_en: Ignite the Dream - A Nighttime Spectacular of Magic and Light
attractions.summary: Mickey will show you the wonderful magic of dreams and the magical power of imagination. Follow him and have a swim! Witness the miracle at the center of Shanghai Disneyland! Mickey opens the door to a brand new adventure, presenting infinite and wonderful worlds one by one before your eyes. Through thrilling projection, laser, fountain, and various other visual effects techniques, Mickey will use his magic to turn the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" into a dreamlike new world, while illuminating the dreams in all of us.

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 【上海】《金字塔之巅：古埃及文明大展》展览
attractions.name_en: On Top of the Pyramid: The Civilization of Ancient Egypt
attractions.summary: The "Top of the Pyramid: Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition" is the fourth exhibition in the "Dialogue with the World" cultural relics and art exhibition series of Shanghai International Import Expo. It was grandly unveiled on July 18, 2024 at the People's Square Pavilion and opened to the public on July 19. As the largest global and high-level exhibition of ancient Egyptian cultural relics in Asia, the exhibition gathers 492 sets of 788 precious cultural relics from different periods of ancient Egyptian civilization. More than 95% of the cultural relics cooperate with the Egyptian government capital. The exhibition will last for 13 months, fully revealing the appearance of ancient Egyptian civilization and its archaeological discoveries to the audience, and promoting mutual learning between Chinese and Egyptian civilizations.

attractions.name: 上海博物馆(东馆)
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Museum has a collection of bronze artifacts from various eras since the Xia Dynasty, many of which are national treasures that have been passed down and recorded repeatedly, forming a complete system, complete variety, and many exquisite collections. The "Ancient Chinese Bronze Museum" in the East Pavilion is the sixth exhibition renovation in 50 years, presenting the audience with a relatively complete display of ancient Chinese bronze ware both domestically and internationally. At present, there are more than 500 selected exhibits on display, reflecting the development and evolution of ancient Chinese bronze ware from the late summer of the 18th century BC to the mid Qing Dynasty of the 19th century AD. The exhibition hall takes the development history of Chinese bronze craftsmanship as a clue and is divided into seven sections: the emergence period, the cultivation period, the peak period, the transformation period, the renewal period, the integration period, and the retro period. The exhibits fully demonstrate the characteristics of bronze craftsmanship in different periods and jointly showcase the brilliant brilliance of Chinese bronze art. There is also a section on bronze ware production technology, vividly showcasing how ancient laboring people used their astonishing intelligence and nimble hands to create the splendid and magnificent Chinese bronze culture. Compared with the People's Square building, the bronze exhibition hall in the East Hall has been adjusted and upgraded in terms of panel structure, panel content, unit descriptions, instrument descriptions, and exhibits. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 上海交通大学-校史博物馆(徐汇校区)
attractions.summary: The History Museum of Shanghai Jiao Tong University is located on the second and third floors of the old library, with a total exhibition area of approximately 600 square meters. The museum has three exhibition halls. The time span of the first exhibition hall ranges from the establishment of Nanyang Public School to the liberation of Shanghai, divided into three periods: the establishment of Nanyang Public School, the construction of a modern engineering university, and the integration of science, engineering, and management at Jiaotong University; The time span of the second exhibition hall is from the liberation of Shanghai to the present day. These two exhibition halls display nearly 700 precious cultural relics, documents, photographic materials, etc., reflecting the school's development process and fruitful achievements in academic research over the past century. The third exhibition hall is the performance exhibition of academicians from the "two academies" of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The photo data, literature and material objects of nearly 200 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the CAE Member who studied or taught at Jiaotong University were displayed. Their biographies and main achievements were introduced in order of their birth dates. The third exhibition room also has the "Professor Lin Tongyan Exhibition Room", which displays more than 300 photos, works, papers, and image materials of Mr. Lin Tongyan, a famous alumnus of Jiaotong University, internationally renowned structural engineer, educator, and Chinese American scholar.

attractions.name: 浦东美术馆
attractions.tag: Special exhibition hall; night tour and sightseeing; Art Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Pudong Art Museum (MAP) is invested, constructed and operated by Lujiazui Group and designed by the famous French architect and Pritzker Prize winner Jean Nouvel. Construction started on September 26, 2017 and will be officially opened to the public in July 2021. Open. Pudong Art Museum is located in the core area of Xiaolujiazui Riverside. It is a modern building with 6 floors and 30 meters high. It extends westward to the bank of the Huangpu River and eastward to connect to the Oriental Pearl Tower via the Garden Square, forming a 30,000-square-meter art museum territory.
The main building of Pudong Art Museum covers an area of 13,000 square meters, with a total building space area of nearly 40,000 square meters. It has 13 exhibition halls and an exhibition area of more than 10,000 square meters. The facade and floor of the building are made of Shandong Baima granite, and the interior space and decoration are inspired by Malevich's classic geometric drawings.
As a state-owned public art museum, Pudong Art Museum is an important measure to build the "Shanghai Culture" brand. It shoulders the cultural mission and social responsibilities entrusted by the urban and municipal governments. It focuses on international art exhibitions and exchanges, takes into account domestic art exhibitions, and highlights the four major functions of exhibitions, aesthetic education, cultural creativity, and international exchanges. It is committed to becoming a new landmark of Shanghai's international cultural venues and an important platform for international cultural and artistic exchanges.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lujiazui Binjiang New Internet Celebrity Landmark

attractions.name: 中华艺术宫
attractions.summary:
It used to be the China National Pavilion of Shanghai World Expo, with a collection of more than 8,000 pieces, including a large number of paintings by famous painters such as Zhang Yuguang and Wu Guanzhong. 
The exhibition halls of the Art Palace are mainly located on the 0m floor, 5m floor, 33m floor, 41m floor and 49m floor. It is recommended to visit them from top to bottom. 
The most interesting thing is the treasure of the town hall-the multimedia version of Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival, which is located on the 49m floor, but you need to pay extra tickets to watch it. 
In addition, there are many exhibition halls for viewing, such as Shadow Art Exhibition, Modern Art Exhibition and Shanghai Artists Invitational Exhibition.
attractions.shortFeatures: Former China National Pavilion at Shanghai World Expo

attractions.name: 苏州河
attractions.summary: Shanghainese always have an inexplicable emotion when it comes to Suzhou River, with a touch of vicissitudes and emotion. The once bustling and luxurious scenery on both sides has been replaced by new buildings, and the grievances of ten mile foreign companies have long disappeared from the historical stage, only the quiet river remains. As the witness of modern Shanghai, Suzhou Creek has left many representative historical buildings, such as Garden Bridge of Shanghai, Shanghai Post Office, the former British Consulate and the former site of Shanghai General Chamber of Commerce, forming a special nostalgic landscape of modern Shanghai. The rise of industry along the Suzhou River once led to serious pollution of the river water. The black and odorous river once affected people's environment and life, and even caused the disappearance of fish and shrimp in the urban section of the river, known as the "blooming black peony". After a series of renovation projects, the dormant Suzhou River finally woke up, with green trees on both sides. Not only has the water quality been significantly improved, but it has also become a new landmark in Shanghai, along with historical buildings and creative parks along the bank, and opened up a night cruise tour route on the Suzhou River. Suzhou Creek is 125 kilometers long. It originates from the Taihu Lake Lake and joins the Huangpu River near Garden Bridge of Shanghai. It is the second largest river in Shanghai. Before the opening of Shanghai as a port, Suzhou Creek was always called Wusong River. To be exact, the lower reaches of Wusong River to the east of Beixin Jing was called "Suzhou Creek". It is said that foreigners found that they could take a boat from this river to Suzhou, hence the name. The Suzhou River, which has flowed for 5000 years, records the historical changes of Shanghai from ancient times to the present, and its long journey from prosperity to defeat and then to restoration represents the development footprint of Shanghai Beach over the past century.

attractions.name: 上海四行仓库抗战纪念馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Sihang Warehouse Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall
attractions.summary: Sihang Warehouse was built in 1931. It is a six-story building with a reinforced concrete structure. It is named because it was a warehouse jointly funded and built by four banks in old Shanghai: Jincheng, Zhongnan, Daliu and Salt Industry. During the Battle of Songhu, 452 Kuomintang soldiers were stationed here heroically resisting the Japanese attack. The iron doors of the original four-line warehouse are preserved at the entrance of the Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall, which are stained with rust.
attractions.shortFeatures: Research and practical education base for primary and secondary school students

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is a tributary of the lower reaches of the Yangtze River, mostly in Nanjing, and is regarded as the mother river of Nanjing 
Known as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai", it is one of the most prosperous places in Nanjing, and it is also a must-see place for many tourists to come to Nanjing. 
· You can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Qinhuai River by boat at night, and feel the local customs and customs of the river from different perspectives. 
There are festivals in all seasons, such as cultural temple fair in spring, Qinhuai summer in summer, Confucius Temple Food Festival in autumn, Jinling Lantern Festival in winter, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Listen to the music on both sides of the strait and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the Beautiful night view

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 佛顶宫
attractions.summary:
Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

attractions.name: 桃花溪
attractions.summary: In spring, the flower buds gradually bloom in Taohua Creek, creating a sea of enchanting flowers.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. attractions.name: 蝴蝶园
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Butterfly Garden covers an area of 8 hectares. There are over 100 types of butterflies kept here, with the Brook King butterfly being the most abundant.

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 南糯山
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Tea Plantations
attractions.summary: Nannuoshan is also known as the tea producing area in Xishuangbanna. Here, there is a cultivated tea tree king with a tree age of more than 800 years. It has a strange appearance and a tea content of about 30%, which is higher than that of ordinary cultivated tea trees. Until now, tea trees are still lush all year round, so it is known as the hometown of tea tree king. Around the mountains of Nannuoshan, there are tea gardens all over the slopes and fields. The tea produced has long been famous in history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xishuangbanna's famous origin tea

attractions.name: 般若寺
attractions.summary: Prajna Temple is built on the top of the mountain, where you can see the golden Buddha of the Great Buddha Temple and the clouds and smoke of Jinghong. It is solemn and sacred. Because of its unique shape, it has become a new punch-in place in online celebrity, attracting many tourists to visit.

attractions.name: 热带花卉园
attractions.summary: The Xishuangbanna Tropical Flower Garden is located within the Yunnan Tropical Crops Research Institute in the urban area of Jinghong City, covering an area of approximately 80 hectares. The garden is designed around a series of natural water surfaces as the main axis for sightseeing, with attractions such as the Flower Garden, Sky Garden, Premier Zhou Enlai Memorial, Palm Area, Rare Tree and Grassland Area, Bonsai Area, Foliage Plant Area, Tropical Fruit Tree Area, and more. It integrates functions of research, science popularization, tourism, and vacation. The garden preserves nearly 1,000 varieties of flowers and economic plants. As you stroll through the park, you are surrounded by a world of exotic flowers, unique trees, and a colorful array of plants, making it an important tourist destination in Xishuangbanna.
attractions.shortFeatures: Science-themed Resort Park
