attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 人民大会堂
attractions.summary:
· Located on the west side of Tiananmen Square in the center of Beijing, it is an important part of Tiananmen Square. 
The Great Hall of the People faces east from west, 336 meters long from north to south, 206 meters wide from east to west, and 46.5 meters high. It covers an area of 150,000 square meters, which is larger than the total building area of the Forbidden City. 
It is an important place for the party, the state and various people's organizations to hold political activities, and it is also a place for Chinese state leaders and people to hold political, diplomatic and cultural activities. 
Usually, there will be some performances in the Great Hall of the People, such as concerts and some Peking Opera performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: The meeting place of the people's congress

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 午门
attractions.summary:
The main entrance of the Forbidden City, the largest of the four gates, has a history of nearly 600 years and is now an important exhibition hall of the Palace Museum. 
There are three doors in the middle of the tower, and a tuck door on each side. The middle door can only be walked once when the emperor, the queen enters the palace on the wedding day, and when the top scholar, the second place and the flowers leave the palace in the final imperial examination. 
This is also the place where the emperor holds important ceremonies. In case of a large-scale triumphant prisoner sacrifice ceremony, the emperor will climb to the Meridian Gate Tower to accept worship.
attractions.shortFeatures: The main entrance of the Forbidden City
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:40)

attractions.name: 太和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Supreme Harmony, commonly known as the Jinluan Hall, is the highest existing palace in China and is known as the first of the "Three Great Halls of the East". 
The interior decoration of the hall is very luxurious, with gold bricks paving the floor, and a throne with golden lacquer cloud dragon patterns, inlaid with thousands of golden dragon patterns, which is exquisite and unusually. 
There are also sundials, bronze turtles, bronze cranes, etc. in front of the temple, and a stone faucet for drainage is installed. During the rainy season, it can present the spectacle of thousands of dragons spitting water. 
At the same time, it is also the center of gravity of the Forbidden City, where it is used to hold various grand ceremonies, such as the emperor's accession to the throne, the emperor's wedding, and the establishment of the queen.
attractions.shortFeatures: The "Golden Temple" in the Forbidden City

attractions.name: 保和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Preservation of Harmony was built in 1420, behind the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and it is one of the three halls outside the Forbidden City. 
The floor in the hall is paved with gold bricks, and there is a carved gold lacquer throne from north to south. The inner and outer eaves are painted with golden dragons and seals, and the ceiling is a front dragon with powder and gold, which is luxurious and rich when matched with the decoration and furnishings that emphasize Dan red. 
The temple had different uses in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Before the ceremony of the Ming Dynasty, the emperor often changed clothes here. In the Qing Dynasty, every New Year's Eve and the 15th day of the first month, the emperor's family banquet and palace examination were held in Baohe Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Roof covered with yellow glazed tiles

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 御花园
attractions.summary:
Located at the northern end of the central axis of the Forbidden City, it covers an area of more than 12,000 square meters. It was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty and named "Palace Houyuan". It was renamed "Imperial Garden" in the Yongzheng Dynasty of the Qing Dynasty. 
The buildings in the park adopt the symmetrical layout of the central axis, and the buildings are mostly leaning against walls. Only a few beautifully shaped pavilions stand in the park, and the space is wide. 
Cypress and locust trees are planted in the garden, with potted plants and bronze statues to add vitality, forming an evergreen scenery all year round, highlighting the Han culture of harmony between man and nature. 
In early spring, the apricot trees next to Chengrui Pavilion in the Royal Garden gradually enter the full bloom period.
attractions.shortFeatures: According to legend, the place where the emperor climbed to enjoy the moon

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 德云社三里屯剧场
attractions.summary: Deyun Sanlitun Theater is the second branch of Deyun Society in Beijing, and it was also formed under the influence of the old flyover. Listening to a traditional cross talk in Sanlitun, the youngest and most fashionable area, is also a unique experience.
attractions.shortFeatures: Crosstalk Society founded by Degang Guo

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 奥林匹克公园
attractions.summary: The Olympic Park is located at the northern end of the Beijing Central Axis Extension Line. It embodies the three major concepts of "technology, green, and humanities", and is a new urban area that integrates multiple functions such as office, commercial, hotel, cultural, sports, conference, and residential.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 回音壁
attractions.summary:
The echo wall, located in the Temple of Heaven Park, is the circular wall of the imperial dome. The wall is made of Shandong Linqing bricks and ground bricks, and is covered with blue glazed tube tile roof. 
Because the curvature of the wall is very regular, it becomes a good reflector of sound waves. Two people can stand at both ends of the wall and hear the sound. 
The two of them answered, asked questions and answered, and their voices were long and interesting. Feel the wisdom and magic of the ancients.
attractions.shortFeatures: The walls are extremely smooth and tidy

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 西洋楼遗址景区
attractions.summary: There is a European style garden in the northern part of Changchun Garden in the Yuanming Three Gardens, commonly known as the "Western style Building". Founded in the 12th year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1747), it was basically completed around the 24th year of the Qianlong reign. Including Western style architecture, large fountains, several small fountains, and garden ornaments, they are distributed in a strip along the north wall. It consists of more than 10 landscapes, including Xieqiqu, Huanghua Formation, Bird Cage, Fangwai, Wuzhu Pavilion, Haiyan Hall, Yuanying Temple, Dashui, Guanshui, Xianfa Mountain, Fanghe, and Xianfa Painting, with a total area of about 8 hectares.

attractions.name: 清华大学
attractions.summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 北京大学
attractions.summary: Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 曼听御花园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 西双版纳总佛寺
attractions.summary:
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple is the center for Buddhist believers in Xishuangbanna to worship Buddha, and it is also the highest-ranking Buddhist temple in Xishuangbanna. 
The general Buddhist temple is magnificent, with exquisite beams and columns carved, mainly including Weihan Hall, Buddhist College teaching building and other buildings. 
There is an altar in front of the north wall of today's courtyard building, where there are several Buddha statues, and the Buddha's Sutra is painted on the wall. 
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple and Manting Park are connected, and tourists usually enter the General Buddhist Temple from Manting Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beams and columns are beautifully carved, and the architecture is magnificent

attractions.name: 西双版纳勐泐文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

InterContinental Xishuangbanna Resort Hotel Seafood Buffet
InterContinental Xishuangbanna Resort Tai Dai Restaurant

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 烟袋斜街
attractions.summary:
Yandai Xiejie, with a total length of 232 meters, is the oldest commercial street in Beijing. During the Qing Dynasty, it mainly dealt in smoking sets, mounting calligraphy and painting, selling antiques and jade articles, etc. 
Yandai Xiejie itself is like a tobacco bag, the slender street is like a tobacco bag pole, and the east entrance is like a tobacco bag mouth, so it is named Xiejie after "Yandai". 
There are Beijing paper-cutting, sugar-blowing people and Beijing specialty snacks here, which are full of ancient and unique city customs and full of charm. 
There are also famous scenic spots such as Yinding Bridge, Lotus Market and Prince Gong's Mansion around, as well as special delicacies such as Yaoji Fried Liver and Nanmen Hotpot, which can be visited together.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the breath of old Beijing in the old hutong

attractions.name: 观复博物馆
attractions.summary:
Guanfu Museum is the first private museum established after New China. It was established with the approval of the government on October 30, 1996 and opened to the public on January 18, 1997. The founder is Mr. Ma Weidu. 
· The Council system was introduced in 2004. The museum has: porcelain hall, furniture hall, oil painting hall, craft hall, image hall, door and window hall and multi-functional hall. Hold all kinds of exhibitions and lectures all year round, and carry out appraisal and consulting business. The exhibition focuses on open forms, emphasizes the communication between people and history, and highlights the affinity of traditional culture. 
· Guanfu Museum has a local museum in Shanghai. The museum mainly includes porcelain museum, furniture museum, oil painting museum, door and window museum, craft museum and other museums.
attractions.shortFeatures: Museum founded by Mr. Ma Weidu
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:00(Tickets available until 15:00; admission ends at 15:00)

attractions.name: 红砖美术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary:
The biggest difference between Red Brick Art Museum and other art galleries in architectural composition is that the modern garden carefully built with Chinese traditional garden images constitutes a dual extension of visiting experience and architectural structure. 
Dong Yugan, a professor at Peking University Architectural Research Center, is responsible for the unification of the architectural and garden design of the art museum. Red bricks are used as the basic architectural elements, and the integrity of each brick is ensured as much as possible without cutting in the process of building masonry, thus forming a unique architectural language and creating a contemporary art museum that grew up outside the hustle and bustle and has a different kind of garden. 
The Red Brick Art Museum has a unique control and expression of light and shadow, and it will show different appearances at different times of the day, which is very layered.
attractions.shortFeatures: Art lovers can't miss it

attractions.name: 798艺术区
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries; Art Districts
attractions.summary:
· 798 Art District is located in Dashanzi area, Jiuxianqiao Street, Chaoyang District, Beijing, so it is also called Dashanzi Art District. It was originally the location of the old factories of electronic industries such as the former state-owned 798 Factory. 
· 798 Art District is favored by many artists because of its Bauhaus-style factory style, which also combines idle factory buildings with modern art, and is an art distribution center in Beijing. 
· A multicultural space integrating galleries, cultural companies, bars and shops has been formed here, with a strong artistic atmosphere, and various exhibitions are held here all the year round.
attractions.shortFeatures: A punch-in resort for literary youth in Beijing

attractions.name: 清华大学艺术博物馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Museum; Fine Art Galleries; Buildings by Famous Architects
attractions.summary:
Tsinghua University Art Museum embodies the wishes of several generations of Tsinghua people. It was completed in 2016 and will be officially opened to the public in September.  
There are more than 13,000 components in the collection, including six categories: calligraphy and painting, weaving and embroidery, ceramics, furniture, bronzes and comprehensive works of art. 
The vast majority of the collection comes from the collections of the Academy of Fine Arts over the years since 1956, as well as donations from alumni and social elites.  
Here, you can feel the collision between culture and soul, and experience an immersive artistic aesthetic journey, which is worth seeing.

attractions.name: 清华大学
attractions.summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 西洋楼遗址景区
attractions.summary: There is a European style garden in the northern part of Changchun Garden in the Yuanming Three Gardens, commonly known as the "Western style Building". Founded in the 12th year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1747), it was basically completed around the 24th year of the Qianlong reign. Including Western style architecture, large fountains, several small fountains, and garden ornaments, they are distributed in a strip along the north wall. It consists of more than 10 landscapes, including Xieqiqu, Huanghua Formation, Bird Cage, Fangwai, Wuzhu Pavilion, Haiyan Hall, Yuanying Temple, Dashui, Guanshui, Xianfa Mountain, Fanghe, and Xianfa Painting, with a total area of about 8 hectares.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 回音壁
attractions.summary:
The echo wall, located in the Temple of Heaven Park, is the circular wall of the imperial dome. The wall is made of Shandong Linqing bricks and ground bricks, and is covered with blue glazed tube tile roof. 
Because the curvature of the wall is very regular, it becomes a good reflector of sound waves. Two people can stand at both ends of the wall and hear the sound. 
The two of them answered, asked questions and answered, and their voices were long and interesting. Feel the wisdom and magic of the ancients.
attractions.shortFeatures: The walls are extremely smooth and tidy

attractions.name: 圜丘
attractions.summary:
Located in the southern half of the Temple of Heaven, Qiu Qiu was founded in 1530. Qiu Qiu was the place where the emperor held the ceremony of worshipping heaven in the winter solstice, also known as the Temple of Heaven. 
The hill faces south, surrounded by red palace walls and decorated with green glazed tiles, commonly known as "sub-walls". 
The number of stones used in the altar is all related to "nine". The sum of the three floors is 45 feet, which is not only a multiple of nine, but also means "the respect of the ninth five years".

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.

attractions.name: 课植园
attractions.summary:
Kezhi Garden, which took 15 years to build, is the largest manor-style garden building in the town. It was once the private residence of Ma Wenqing, a local magnate. 
The name of the garden is "Class Planting", which means "don't forget to cultivate after reading in class". The class garden is a living and learning area, and the topiary is a recreational farming area, with a quiet environment and unique scenery. 
Wangyue Building and Bookstore are the most typical buildings combining Chinese and Western styles in the garden. The stele gallery in the garden is inlaid with handwritten stone carvings such as poems and letters of Tang, Zhu, Wen and Zhou, the four talented scholars of Ming Dynasty, which have high historical and cultural value. 
· It is a great place to take children to play here with rich tour content.
attractions.shortFeatures: A combination of Chinese and Western, originally owned by Jia Shang

attractions.name: 朱家角大清邮局
attractions.summary: The Zhujiajiao Great Qing Post Office was established in 1903 and is the former site of the Great Qing Post Office preserved in East China. It is also the earliest postal institution in the region. It is said that there were a total of thirteen postal stations in Shanghai at that time, and Zhujiajiao Post Office was one of them. After the Xinhai Revolution overthrew the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Post Office continued to operate as China Post. In 1953, it was relocated to the vicinity of Fangsheng Bridge on North Street, and in 2001, it was listed as a cultural relic protection unit in Qingpu District. The antique bronze cast dragon mailbox standing outside the old post office site is a unique business card of Zhu Jiajiao, showcasing the retro romance of "slow carriages and horses, long letters and letters". In 2022, the overall building of Zhujiajiao Daqing Post Office will undergo a comprehensive spatial upgrade, revitalizing through the renovation of the old style. While preserving the original Ming and Qing architectural styles and cultural heritage, it will integrate new Chinese aesthetics, combining cultural exchange, cultural and creative experiences, art exhibitions, study salons, boat tours, and other diverse cultural experiences. This will recreate the century old vicissitudes of the ancient town post office and showcase the long history of China Post. In addition to the historical attributes of ancient architectural sites, more cultural exchange spaces such as theme coffee, cultural exhibitions, characteristic cultural creation, creative workshops, art summer camps, etc. have also been opened up. In this building that has witnessed the time, we will continue to publicize the profound history and the vitality of modern China-Chic culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 朱家角城隍庙
attractions.summary:
Qingpu City God Palace, where Cheng Lujimou, a native of Huizhou, moved to its current site in the 28th year of Qianlong's reign, is the main activity place of Taoists in Zhujiajiao Town. 
The seat of the Chenghuang Temple faces east to west, and the main entrance is facing the river with a stack of walls. In the middle of the temple is the head gate, the stage and the main hall, with verandas on both sides, and Xiaoqu Creek next to it. Peaches, plums and willows can be seen everywhere, with elegant layout and 12 scenic spots. The neck of the stage consists of 160 bucket arches to form a round roof, which is very rare. 
There are three treasures in the Chenghuang Temple: the ancient stage, the big abacus and the century-old ginkgo biloba, all of which are intriguing, so you can find out when you visit. 
There are all kinds of snack shops and some handicrafts on the roadside. You can eat and play and enjoy the night view.
attractions.shortFeatures: Taoist holy place with elegant architectural layout

attractions.name: 圆津禅院
attractions.summary: Yuanjin Buddhist Temple is located in far western Shanghai’s Zhujiajiao Ancient Town. Dating to the Yuan Dynasty, the temple as first built around 1341. The hall contains many important cultural relics in addition to the well-known Qinghua Pavilion, located inside the temple grounds. The pavilion’s height makes it visible from many parts of Zhujiajiao, lending a sense of importance and focus. If you’re visiting Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, be sure not to miss visiting Yuanjin Buddhist Temple.

attractions.name: 全华水彩艺术馆
attractions.summary: The Quanhua Watercolor Art Museum is located in Shanghai and is a venue dedicated to showcasing and exchanging watercolor art. The museum houses numerous works by renowned watercolor artists both domestically and internationally, and regularly hosts watercolor exhibitions, art lectures, and workshops, making it an ideal destination for watercolor art enthusiasts.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 上海手工艺朱家角展示馆
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Handicraft Zhujiajiao Exhibition Hall is located in Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai, and is a place to showcase traditional Chinese handicraft culture. The museum exhibits a variety of traditional handicrafts including ceramics, embroidery, wood carving, lacquerware, etc., allowing visitors to experience the charm of traditional Chinese craftsmanship up close.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 广富林文化遗址
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Enjoying autumn leaves; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The ancient civilization of the Guangfulin Cultural Site has been preliminarily confirmed through scientific archaeology. As early as the late Neolithic period, around four to five thousand years ago, rice cultivation was already widespread in the area, indicating an advanced agricultural production system. Additionally, the textile history here is long-standing, with pottery spindles from the late Neolithic period uncovered at the site.

The development of the Guangfulin Site Park aims to inherit historical culture and preserve the original ecological structure of the ancient town. It will integrate modern urban construction concepts to create an "underwater museum." Stepping into the site, the Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is particularly captivating. The entire exhibition space is set underwater, with pyramid-like rooftops floating on Fulin Lake, blending with the surrounding environment to create a beautiful scene. The exhibition hall is designed with the concept of a "Journey through Time and Space," combining modern audiovisual technology to present scenes such as the archaeological memories of Guangfulin, the formation of Shanghai's land, the arrival of early settlers, the rise of local cities, the flourishing of Songjiang Prefecture, the emergence of Shanghai as a city, and a vision for the future. Visitors can experience and explore the history of Shanghai's civilization in a time tunnel.

At night, the site hosts an exciting lantern festival. From the lake-bottom garage entrance to near Zhuque Gate, over 40 large lantern sets light up the area, creating a dazzling, beautiful display. Among these, the 3D Mapping show is a major highlight, condensing the thousand-year history of Guangfulin into a stunning three-minute light and shadow performance projected onto Fulin Tower, attracting numerous visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the unique underwater exhibition hall

attractions.name: 广富林水下博物馆
attractions.summary: The Guangfulin Underwater Museum is built on the Guangfulin site, with a unique and innovative architectural concept that can be described as a "flooded" building. Half of it is on the water, and the other half is underwater. In addition to unearthed cultural relics, the museum also uses modern technology and wax figures to cross time and space, truly and cleverly reproducing the historical process from ancient times to modern times. Let people understand the evolution and development of Guangfulin over the past five thousand years through restored wax figure scenes.

attractions.name: 广富林郊野公园
attractions.summary: Guangfulin Suburban Park is located in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and is named after its proximity to the Guangfulin Cultural Site. The park starts from Chenshantang in the east, connects with Youdun Port in the west, starts from Chenhua Road in the north, and ends at Guangfulin Road in the south, with a total of 7 entrances and exits, covering a total area of about 4 square kilometers.

attractions.name: 上海广富林奇石馆
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Guangfulinchi Stone Museum is located within the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park in Songjiang District, Shanghai. It is a specialized museum showcasing various exotic stones. The museum houses precious and exotic stones from around the world, including various mineral crystals, fossils, jade, and other materials. Each exhibit embodies the incredible craftsmanship of nature and a long geological history.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 广富林文化展示馆
attractions.summary: The Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is located in the circular building with the first large roof and side floating in the Fulin Lake, and the entire exhibition space is set underwater. Entering the exhibition hall gives people a hint of stepping into the underground and heading towards ancient times. The exhibition hall design is based on the concept of "time and space journey", through the design of scenes such as Guangfulin archaeological memory, Shanghai's land evolution, the arrival of ancestors' activities, the formation of urban characteristics, the prosperity of Songjiang County government, the rise of Shanghai city, and the future, allowing the audience to experience and read Shanghai as a city in a time tunnel, from where it came from and where it is going.

attractions.name: 朵云书院(广富林店)
attractions.summary: Duoyun Academy (Guangfulin Store) is a well preserved Huizhou style building with an area of approximately 1600 square meters. In this institution, regular events such as the Duoyun Lecture Hall, Guangfulin Reading Club, art exhibitions and appreciation, academic exchanges, and industry summit forums will be held.

attractions.name: 广富林考古遗址展示馆
attractions.summary: To the north of the core protection area of Guangfulin Cultural Site, there are several semi buried buildings that resemble damaged ancient pottery. They are the exhibition hall of Guangfulin Archaeological Site and a relatively important landmark exhibition hall in Guangfulin. The museum houses carefully selected representative cultural relics from tens of thousands of archaeological discoveries in Guangfulin. Some of the exhibits are provided by the Shanghai Museum. In addition to exhibiting and displaying the treasures excavated from Guangfulin, this museum will also serve as a venue for exchange and exhibition with international museums. There is also a dedicated space for restoration in the museum, which is connected to the north themed exhibition space. Thus extending the exhibition space outdoors greatly enhances the visual impact on visitors.

attractions.name: 广富林木艺展示馆
attractions.summary: The Guangfulin Woodcraft Exhibition Hall is located within the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park in Songjiang District, Shanghai. It is a specialized museum showcasing traditional woodworking culture. The museum exhibits a large number of wooden works, including furniture, sculptures, architectural components, etc., showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship and rich cultural connotations of ancient Chinese wooden art.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 【上海】广富林"山海密藏"展-相外山海宇宙之五臧山经

Let's take a look with Xiaogu. (1) When entering the Happy Hour area from the main entrance, the first thing that catches the eye is the Happy Hour area! A relaxed and enjoyable gaming experience, suitable for families to check-in happily! 【 Joyful Collision 】 Enjoy galloping in the colorful parking lot, experience passion in collisions, capture pleasure in passion, and let you touch it all at once! It has a 1200 meter whistling journey and over 10 zero gravity space experiences, challenging speed and passion! In the up and down reciprocating motion, it perfectly combines the two pole experience of ejection and falling. The palace style double decker carousel, with galloping horses, takes you to a fairy tale like dreamland, sparking endless imagination. [Dreamy Top] The large turntable revolves, the small turntable rotates, and the cabin rotates centrifugally, providing a composite experience that allows you to enjoy excitement and joy while spinning. Do you still remember the first human dream of flying? Sitting on a swinging umbrella, swirling and dancing in the air, one after another, floating up and down, hovering like a silver swallow in the clear sky! （2） Shanghai Beach District's "Ultimate Wind" is the world's new generation of suspended roller coasters, known as "roller coasters", allowing you to experience the magical acceleration of free fall from a vertical drop of 60 meters. attractions.name: 极速飞车卡丁车俱乐部
attractions.summary: This is located next to the Shanghai Happy Valley Tourist Center, and you can experience it without entering the scenic area. The project covers a total area of 12000 square meters, with a track length of 700 meters and a track width of 8 meters. It will officially open to the public in the summer of 2023. Extreme Speed Kart is a jungle karting project that allows you to travel through the jungle and experience the real-life version of speed and passion. There are 200cc fuel powered go karts available here, including single person go karts suitable for competition, as well as double person go karts designed for families and couples, to meet the driving experience of drivers of all levels. Before starting the real competition, every "driver" will receive professional training from the coach in the tutorial room, from safety knowledge to track driving techniques, to ensure that everyone is "certified", even beginners can quickly get started. Put on your racing suit and helmet, and race freely on various curves, drifting as you please. The timing system provides comprehensive and accurate record and query functions for the entire project, with timing and ranking for each round of competition, making real-time results clear at a glance. Considering safety protection, "Extreme Speed" has specially prepared a racing training class to provide safety training for each racer before entering, allowing everyone to quickly master the skills of karting.

The time is around 10am to 6pm, depending on the weather conditions of the day, and additional fees will be charged. Jumping from a height of 55 meters, most tourists cannot be as carefree as a coach. The experience inevitably resulted in a stiff body, accompanied by falling movements not only by the sound of the wind, but also screams piercing through the sky. At the moment of bottoming out and rebounding, my heart was lifted to my throat. Some stretched out in the air like 'yes', while others were so scared that they closed their eyes tightly and were frozen in various poses in the air.

attractions.name: 深坑秘境乐园-上海世茂精灵之城主题乐园
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Shimao Elf City Theme Park is built on the deep pit of Tianma Mountain, integrating unique natural resources of cliffs and combining indoor and outdoor concepts to create a unique themed amusement park with hotel wonders in the deep pit. The amusement park has new hardware, high specifications, novel interaction, and comfortable experience. In addition, with the support of the Shimao Shenkeng Intercontinental Hotel, which ranks nearly one hundred in negative altitude, the experience of overlooking the Shenkeng Yunjing Garden in the Elf City Theme Park is commendable. This is a dreamlike paradise on earth: ancient and mysterious canyons and jungles, deep pits and ridges crisscrossed by streams and waterfalls, ancient mythical creatures soaring in the sky, and quiet tree bottom elves, all waiting here with breath holding - your grand arrival. The glass walkway in the theme park of the City of Elves is 88 meters above the center of the earth. Experience the magical realm from all angles, including the sky, pool water, and cliffs; Embark on an elegant gliding ride on the Snowy Owl, fly over deep pits, and experience the perspective of 'God' at the high point of the amusement park; The cliff hurricane swings nearly 30 meters high, forming a drop of nearly 100 meters with the lower part of the deep pit. With a speed of 100 meters per hour, it swings greatly, rotates and flips up and down, staring helplessly at the abyssal cliffs beneath its feet; Parent child experience area: The world in the eyes of children is full of infinite imagination. The architectural models here not only have beautiful appearances, but also are highly interactive, providing a platform for children aged 2-16 to unleash their creativity and exercise their physical fitness. attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights".
