By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 榕杉湖景区
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: Rongshan Lake Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin City. It is a Lianxin Lake connected by water bodies. It is bounded by Yangqiao, with Shanhu Lake in the east and Ronghu Lake in the west. It is named after the banyan trees and fir trees growing on the shore of the lake. During the Tang and Song Dynasties, the artificially excavated moat in the south of the city was called Nanyang River. It was called Jianhu Lake in Yuan Dynasty, and the city was expanded in Ming Dynasty to become Inner Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after banyan tree and fir tree

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

attractions.name: 古南门
attractions.summary: The Ancient South Gate is located on the north bank of Ronghu Lake in Guilin City. Also known as Tree Gate. Masonry construction, 5.3 meters high, 39.4 meters long, and 19.4 meters thick. According to records, Li Jing, a famous general of the Tang Dynasty, built a city guard in Guilin after pacifying Lingnan in the fourth year of Wude (621). It is the southern gate of Guilin's "Tang City" and has been in existence for over 1300 years. According to the Ming Dynasty's "Yitong Zhi", "The banyan tree gate is also known as the ancient southern gate. According to legend, during the Tang Dynasty, a banyan tree was planted at the gate, and over time, its roots crossed the gate and twisted the ground." Ming Zhou Yude's "Record of Chongtong banyan tree gate" said, "The so-called banyan tree gate refers to the southern gate of the ancient city of Tang and Song

attractions.name: 漓江四星游船
attractions.summary: The basic situation of the cruise ship is that the Li River cruise ship has been upgraded and upgraded. Taking into account the tourist experience and psychological expectations, strict regulations have been made for the per capita cabin area, passenger seat specifications, cabin dining table specifications, and per capita area of the walking deck of the upgraded cruise ship. In addition, fabric soft wrapped sofas are used, which greatly improve comfort and aesthetics compared to ordinary cruise ships. And high material standards are required for the decoration and renovation of the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. of the cruise ship, and clear regulations are made for the replacement period of curtains, tablecloths, and other decorations, creating a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. The sanitary facilities are fully equipped with advanced technology, and the humanized detail design is comprehensive. The four-star cruise ship has a double decker cabin layout and decoration, with the first floor being a business cabin (second-class), and the per capita area in the tourist cabin not less than 1.8 square meters; The second floor is a luxury business cabin (first-class cabin), with a per capita area of no less than 2.5 square meters in the tourist cabin; The ship is equipped with a double deck walking deck with a wide view and a per capita area of not less than 1.4 square meters. The deck is equipped with sunshades and resting tables and chairs; There are 1.2m high aluminum alloy safety guardrails around. The cabin floor is made of high wear-resistant wood flooring and high-end carpets, while the ceiling and wall panels are made of wood and honeycomb aluminum plate materials, with exquisite craftsmanship. The cabin decoration is beautiful and elegant, reflecting cultural connotations or ethnic characteristics, decorated with flowers and green plants. The cabin dining table is made of elm wood and water chestnut materials, with carved decorations. The tourist seats are designed with armrests, which are comfortable and stylish. The double decker cabin provides both Chinese and Western style buffet meals or customized special dining options for tourists. The tableware and tea utensils are made of high-quality ceramic materials and are equipped with matching tableware for both Chinese and Western cuisine. There are also mini bars to meet the entertainment needs of different tourists. Each row of seats or table is equipped with a tablet computer near the window sill, which can provide a series of intelligent services such as Guilin tourism information, entertainment, and ordering. Full text 

attractions.name: 黄布倒影
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
attractions.shortFeatures: Background map of 20 yuan RMB

attractions.name: 九马画山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 二十元人民币背景图
attractions.summary: The background picture of 20 RMB is located in Xingping Town, Guilin. The picturesque scenery here, with green mountains and clear waters, attracts many tourists to come and play. Full text 

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 阳朔月亮山风景区
attractions.summary: Moon Mountain is a unique scenery within Yangshuo, located at the end of the Ten Mile Gallery landscape belt. Moon Mountain is an arched peak with a large hole running through it below the top, resembling a bright moon that blends seamlessly with nature. Looking at this Moon Mountain from different angles, the shape of this cave constantly changes, which is very interesting. Moon Mountain is about 380 meters high, and visitors can follow an 800 level hiking trail to reach the Moon Cave at the top of the mountain. The Moon Cave has a large area, with a height and width of 50 meters each, while the mountain walls are only a few meters thick. The top of the cave is covered with stalactites of various shapes, two of which resemble Wu Gang and Jade Rabbit in the Moon Palace. In fact, Moon Mountain can be admired from a distance. Across from the scenic area, there is a rest area with a gathering of restaurants, which is one of the locations where you can view Moon Mountain from afar. Due to its unique geological environment, Moon Mountain has also become a gathering place for rock climbing enthusiasts.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 富里桥
attractions.summary:
Fuli Bridge, located in the upper reaches of Yulong River, has a history of more than 500 years. It is one of the three ancient bridges in Yangshuo. 
Fuli Bridge is beautiful in shape, with an ancient tree at each bridge head, and the reflection in the water is just like the full moon. The bridge is the best place to watch the scenery of Lijiang River. 
It is also the only place for rafting on the Yulong River. It is surrounded by green hills and green waters around the village, with a southern scenery.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to see the idyllic scenery

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 燕莎热气球飞行体验
attractions.summary: Yansha Hot Air Balloon Base has professional high-altitude flight instructors to provide you with high-quality, safe, and professional flight services. Sitting on a hot air balloon and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the Yulong River from a high altitude, from a divine perspective, one can truly experience the "panoramic landscape" and appreciate the beautiful scenery of "the river is a clear ribbon of vines, the mountains are like jade hairpins". It is also possible to fully appreciate the wonder of "people living in the Blue Lotus Peak". You can also take 360 ° selfies on a hot air balloon, making your social circle envious and popular.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 香港大学
attractions.summary: The University of Hong Kong, abbreviated as HKU, is the earliest established higher education institution in Hong Kong and one of the most prestigious universities in Asia. The University of Hong Kong is renowned for its outstanding academic research, international campus environment, and rich campus life. There are many historical buildings and modern facilities on campus, making it an excellent place to learn about Hong Kong's higher education and culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 香港文化博物馆
attractions.summary:
The Hong Kong Heritage Museum, located at No.1 Man Lam Road, Sha Tin, is a comprehensive museum in Hong Kong, covering various fields of history, art and culture. The design of the museum adopts the traditional Chinese courtyard layout and combines modern architectural techniques, which is very distinctive. 
With the theme of caring for Hong Kong's nature and understanding Hong Kong's history, the "Children's Discovery Hall" in the Hong Kong Heritage Museum leads children to discover the mysteries of archaeology. The exhibition "Hong Kong Children's Play" is set up to attract the active participation of visitors through games and interactions. "Zhao Shaoang Art Museum" is named after Professor Zhao Shaoang, a master of Chinese painting in Lingnan School. It mainly displays Professor Zhao's masterpieces, manuscripts and sketches. The "New Territories Heritage Museum" is a long-term exhibition hall dedicated to the history of the New Territories. Visitors can shuttle through eight time tunnels, namely, Natural Environment, Prehistoric Life, Trade and Coastal Defense, Fishermen's Glimpses, Countryside Landscape, British Governance, New Town Development and Future Construction, and learn about the historical and social changes in the New Territories over the years. "Cantonese Opera Heritage Museum" allows visitors to experience the feeling of being in the theater and backstage. Unique Cantonese opera costumes, cosmetics and documents are displayed in the showcase, and the eucalyptus stalls in the museum give visitors the opportunity to relive the past performances and feel the unique opera art of Guangdong Province. The Hong Kong Heritage Museum is a leisure and cultural service.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the essence of Hong Kong culture

attractions.name: 香港电车叮叮车
attractions.summary: Dingding is an integral part of the bustling streets of Hong Kong, and it is also the only double decker tram in the world. The route of Dingding car is in the bustling commercial center of Hong Kong, passing through the western, upper, central, Wan Chai, Tai Koo, Shau Kei Wan and the Victoria Harbour coast. This ancient mode of transportation, which is only found on Hong Kong Island, is actually a type of tram. It is famous for the sound of "ding ding, ding ding" when the driver steps on the scooter while driving, so people call it Dingding car. The tram currently operates 6 partially overlapping routes connecting Kennedy Town to Shau Kei Wan, with an average tram arriving at the station every 1 minute and 30 seconds. The 6 main routes are as follows: 1. Shau Kei Wan to Sheung Wan Market (there are special trips between Shau Kei Wan and Kennedy Town during peak hours from Monday to Friday); 2. From Shau Kei Wan to Happy Valley; 3. North Point to Shek Tong Tsui; 4. Happy Valley to Kennedy Town; 5. Causeway Bay to Kennedy Town; 6. From Sheung Wan Market to Kennedy Town (only available during peak hours from Monday to Friday). Please refer to the official website for the detailed operation route diagram of Dingding car.

attractions.name: 尖沙咀
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Tsim Sha Tsui is located at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, facing Victoria Harbour and across the sea from Central, Hong Kong Island. It is the "geographical center" of Hong Kong. 
There are many famous scenic spots in Hong Kong, such as Avenue of Stars, Victoria Harbour, Kowloon Park, etc., which are all must-check-in places for tourists to come to Hong Kong. It is also a good place to see the night view. Victoria Harbour and Avenue of Stars are good choices. 
· It is the most prosperous shopping paradise in Hong Kong, with various large shopping malls, duty-free shops, international brand stores, etc. to meet all the needs of one-stop shopping. 
· There are also cultural places such as the Hong Kong History Museum, the Hong Kong Science Museum and the Hong Kong Cultural Center, which are good choices for parent-child tours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping paradise on the shore of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 天星小轮
attractions.summary: • Known as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, the Star Ferry has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. • It is not only an important part of the cross sea transportation system between Hong Kong and Kowloon, but also a must experience itinerary for visitors to Hong Kong. • The National Geographic Tourism Magazine once praised taking the Star Ferry to visit both sides of Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life". To this day, the Star Ferry still maintains its retro design, with wooden benches and iron fans in the cabin, giving it a strong Hong Kong vibe. At present, the Star Ferry has two ferry routes and stops at three piers, namely the Tsim Sha Tsui Central Link and the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line. Among them, the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line is more suitable for enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. Full text 

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 东方明珠259米全透明悬空观光廊
attractions.summary: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower fully transparent sightseeing corridor is 259 meters high, 150 meters long and 2.1 meters wide. It is the only 360 degree fully transparent sightseeing corridor in the world. Standing on the fully transparent sightseeing corridor, enjoy the panoramic view of Shanghai in a unique way of "aerial stroll" and experience an unprecedented shock.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉科技馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary: Here, you can learn about natural science in an all-round way through various modern equipment and rich display and interactive ways. For children, this must be a must-visit place for entertainment and education. The Science and Technology Museum is divided into three floors, with exhibition halls of the universe, life and water in the "natural plate";
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:00-16:30(Admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 归元禅寺
attractions.summary:
· One of the most important monasteries in Wuhan, together with Baotong Temple, Xilian Temple and Zhengjue Temple, is called the four jungles of Wuhan.  
It is the daily custom of many Wuhan citizens to come to Guiyuan Temple to pray for blessings. Every year on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, hundreds of thousands of pilgrims come here to grab the first incense. 
· Enter the Arhat Hall, start with any 　 Arhat, and count to your actual age in sequence. The identity, expression and movements of the counted Arhat indicate your fate.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the famous temple of the golden arhat

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 汉正街
attractions.summary:
Hanzheng Street is "the main street of ancient Hankou", the earliest central street in the history of Hankou, and a place where thousands of businessmen gather and commodities compete for flow. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is a commodity wholesale market with a wide range. It is mainly divided into different commodities. The prices of commodities here are still very cheap. However, when shopping here, on the one hand, you have to have a certain ability to identify commodities, because the authenticity and falsehood are uneven; On the other hand, you have to be able to counter-offer. Cheap is not that simple. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is being renovated and relocated, from Qiaokou District of Hankou to Hankou North. However, there are still many commercial ports at the original site, and it should take many years to completely relocate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hankou commercial district in history

attractions.name: 木兰草原
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Treasure spots for kids.
attractions.summary: Mulan Prairie - The only AAAA-level Mongolian-style scenic area in Central China, located in Niejiagang, Wangjiahe Town, Huangpi District, Wuhan, to the east of the famous Mulan Mountain and to the south of Mulan Lake, one of the top ten leisure resorts in Hubei. The scenic area is 36 kilometers from downtown Wuhan and 12 kilometers from the nearest highway exit, with very convenient transportation. The planned area of the scenic spot is 4,800 acres, divided into the Grassland Style Tourism Area and the Leisure Resort Area. It integrates grassland-style sightseeing, outdoor activities, water entertainment, business meetings, and leisure vacations. It is currently the only AAAA-level scenic area in Central China themed around grassland culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the prairie charm through horseback riding and archery.

attractions.name: 木兰山
attractions.tag: Climbing Heights and Mountains; Nature and Adventure
attractions.summary: The Mulan Mountain Scenic Area is located in the northern part of Huangpi District, Wuhan, just 50 kilometers from the city center. With an elevation of 582.1 meters, it is a national geological park, a provincial-level scenic area, and a provincial-level nature reserve. In November 2014, the Mulan Mountain Scenic Area was approved by the National Tourism Administration as a 5A-level tourist attraction, as the core scenic area of the Huangpi Mulan Cultural Ecological Tourism Zone. Mulan Mountain is known as the "back garden of Wuhan" and was praised by the Ming Dynasty poet Tu Da as "the most magnificent of Xiling, the ultimate view of the Three Chu regions."
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Hua Mulan's Hometown

restaurants.name_en: Zao two nine gong grid hot pot
Miaochu Dad Spring Water Steam Stone Pot Fish
Shang Yu three sauce stew pot

attractions.name: 鼓楼
attractions.summary: The scale of the building is rare in China, and it is divided into two layers. The lower layer is an arch shaped city tower without beams, and the upper layer is a roof with double eaves and four slopes. carved beams and painted rafters is very spectacular. The upstairs was originally a place in the Ming Dynasty to welcome kings and concubines, receive imperial edicts, and announce the time. Originally, there were two large drums, twenty-four small drums, and other musical instruments used for announcing the time and conducting ceremonies. After the fall of the Ming Dynasty, these furnishings were all lost. The current building foundation was originally built in the Ming Dynasty, and the upper building was renovated in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1685, a huge monument was built on the upper floor and the Drum Tower was renamed as the Stele Tower, but the locals still refer to it as the Drum Tower. Full text 

attractions.name: 中山码头
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Port is located on the south bank of the Yangtze River in Nanjing, also known as Xiaguan Port. Before the opening of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge in the past, people used to take ferries across the river through Zhongshan Pier, with Pukou Railway Station (Nanjing North Station) on the opposite bank. Transportation at the pier was extremely busy. Until the opening of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge and the closure of Pukou Railway Station, only some locals still take ferries at Zhongshan Pier. However, due to the strong Republican style of Zhongshan Pier and Pukou Railway Station, it has attracted many literary and artistic youth and photography enthusiasts to come here for photos and nostalgia. Its tourism significance is gradually outweighing its transportation role. The "Ningpu Line" ferry still operates from Zhongshan Port to Pukou Port today. From 5:00 to 23:00, the ferry departs every 20 minutes, with a 15 minute one-way fare of 2 yuan. Pukou Port is adjacent to Pukou Railway Station. Take a ferry and take a look at the old railway station. Here, you can embark on a nostalgic journey of the Republic of China.

attractions.name: 南京北站(旧址)
attractions.summary: Pukou Railway Station, also known as Nanjing North Station, was founded in 1914 and is a "century old railway station" that fully preserves its historical style. It is listed as one of the nine railway stations of Chinese literature and art. Here, you can see the beige main building of the train station, the arched rain corridor connecting to the ferry terminal, the former waiting hall (with the gate closed and only visible through the window), and the platform used by passengers to board and disembark trains. You can also walk on the railway tracks to play and take photos. There are old-fashioned green trains parked on the tracks, and walking on the tracks at dusk is very romantic. The witness of history: Many important historical events in modern China occurred here, as seen in Zhu Ziqing's' Back View '; Mr. Sun Yat sen's spirit arrived here to hold a welcoming ceremony. The scenery of Pukou Railway Station in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China attracted a large number of film and television crews to shoot outdoor scenes, and it truly became a stage for multiple plays. In recent years, movies and TV dramas filmed at Pukou Railway Station include "Sun Yat sen", "Deep Love in the Rain", "Golden Powder Family", and so on.

attractions.name: 南京长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The first double-decker railway and highway bridge on the Yangtze River designed and built by China itself. 
· It is of great significance in the history of bridges in China and even the world, and is an important milestone in China's bridge construction. 
· The railings on both sides of the bridge are embedded with various cast iron reliefs, and there are two high bridgeheads at the north and south ends, which is one of the landmarks of Nanjing. 
There is the Nanbao Park of the bridge under the bridge. Every night, the lights on the bridge are all lit up, and the whole bridge is like a rainbow flying over the river, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Yangtze River Bridge built by the Chinese

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 熙南里
attractions.summary: Xinan Li is located on Zhongshan South Road in Nanjing, covering an area of 12300 square meters, at the intersection of Zhongshan South Road and Shengzhou Road. Based on the national key cultural relics protection unit, the existing large-scale and well preserved Qing Dynasty private residence "Ganxi Former Residence" in Nanjing is the cultural core, supplemented by exquisite and high-end leisure retail, trendy catering, exclusive services and other formats, creating a unique Jinling historical style urban fashion commercial district.

attractions.name: 雨花台
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Zhonghua Gate in Nanjing, it consists of three beautiful hills surrounded by pine and cypress trees, and is a red tourism site in Nanjing.
- The entire scenic area is divided into six main zones: the Martyrs’ Cemetery Area, the Historical Sites Area, the Yuhuashi Stone Cultural Area, the Yuhuacha Tea Culture Area, the Amusement Activity Area, and the Ecological Forest Area.
- The Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial Hall and the Martyrs’ Achievements Exhibition Hall display many books, manuscripts, clothing, and writing tools used by the soldiers of that time.
- The park is lush and green, making it not only a popular tourist destination but also a place for leisure and recreation for Nanjing residents.
- An annual Yuhuashi Art Festival is held every September, and a large Rhododendron Exhibition takes place from March to June. It is also a great spot for plum and magnolia flower viewing.

attractions.name: 侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
attractions.summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

attractions.name: 太平天国历史博物馆(瞻园)
attractions.name_en: The Historical Museum of The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
attractions.tag: Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Zhanyuan, also known as the Great Ming Palace or the First Garden of Jinling, was first built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty. It was originally the palace of Xu Da, a founding hero of the Ming Dynasty. It is a long-standing garden in Nanjing and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Wuxi Jichang Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. Historical background: Zhanyuan has a history of over 600 years. The layout of the whole garden is elegant and exquisite, including ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Taihu Lake Lake stones of the Northern Song Dynasty, quiet buildings, pavilions, rockeries, etc. During Emperor Qianlong's southern tour, he visited here twice and borrowed the imperial name of the garden from Ouyang Xiu's poem "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky". He personally inscribed the plaque "Viewing the Garden". During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, it was still the residence of the Eastern King Yang Xiuqing and the Young Western King Xiao Youhe. Dongzhan Garden is divided into two parts, east and west. The main gate (south gate) is located in the east half, with a large plaque hanging on the gate reading "Jinling First Garden". In the center of the entrance is a half body bronze statue of Hong Xiuquan. The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom History Museum is the main visiting point of Dongzhan Garden, displaying cultural relics such as the Jade Seal of the Heavenly Father, the Golden Crown of the Loyal King, the Great Flag, the Sword, and the Stone Trough. Xizhan Garden can be reached through Shuiyuan, which is a typical Jiangnan garden. The ancient buildings in the park include the Viewing Pavilion, Flower Basket Hall, Zhishuang Pavilion, Yingcui Pavilion, and winding corridors. These buildings and corridors divide the Xizhan Garden into five small courtyards and a main garden, with rockeries being the main scenery and backbone of the entire garden. There are rockeries in the south, north, and west, each exquisitely crafted. The central part of the main garden is Jingmiao Hall, surrounded by water on three sides and by land on one side. The "Tiger" stone tablet on the right wall at the entrance of the Guanyu Pavilion is said to have been bestowed upon the tiger general Xu Da by Zhu Yuanzhang. It stands upright like a tiger, howling loudly in the sky. Upon closer examination, one can discern the four characters "the richest in the world", making it the "number one tiger in the world". The copper pavilion and the other miracle in the the Taihu Lake Shizhan Garden, the copper pavilion (namely the fan pavilion), are the world's earlier heating equipment (equivalent to air conditioning buildings). In addition, there are also two the Taihu Lake Lake stones in the garden. The Immortal Peak is in the garden behind the south gate, and it stands in a beautiful place; Leaning against the cloud peak in the southeast corner of the flower basket hall, amidst the osmanthus bushes, it stands out with a sudden and graceful charm. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 鱼嘴湿地公园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Yuzui Wetland Park is located at the southern end of Hexi New City in Jianye District, Nanjing, at the confluence of the Yangtze River, Jiajiang River, and Qinhuai New River. The total area is 640000 square meters, with wetlands as the theme, cleverly integrating ecological water treatment systems, treehouses, wetland workstations and other facilities to create a wild urban ecological park.

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

restaurants.name_en: Metropark International Hotel Suiyuan Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 回音壁
attractions.summary:
The echo wall, located in the Temple of Heaven Park, is the circular wall of the imperial dome. The wall is made of Shandong Linqing bricks and ground bricks, and is covered with blue glazed tube tile roof. 
Because the curvature of the wall is very regular, it becomes a good reflector of sound waves. Two people can stand at both ends of the wall and hear the sound. 
The two of them answered, asked questions and answered, and their voices were long and interesting. Feel the wisdom and magic of the ancients.
attractions.shortFeatures: The walls are extremely smooth and tidy

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 故宫珍宝馆
attractions.summary: The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

attractions.name: 故宫钟表馆
attractions.summary: The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute.
