Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 定陵
attractions.summary: The world-famous Ming Thirteen Tombs are located at the southern foot of Tianshou Mountain in Changping District, Beijing. They were first built as long tombs in May of the seventh year of the Yongle reign (1409 AD), and lasted for more than 230 years until the last emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Chongzhen, entered the Siling Mausoleum. During this period, 13 magnificent imperial tombs with golden walls, 7 imperial consort tombs, and 1 eunuch tomb were built here. A total of 13 emperors, 23 empresses, 2 crown princes, over 30 concubines, and 2 eunuchs were buried, making it the most well preserved and buried imperial tomb complex in the world today. The Ming Thirteen Tombs have magnificent architecture, complete system, long history, and high historical and cultural value. The Ming Dingling Mausoleum is the tomb of Emperor Wanli, and the overall layout of the ground buildings is in a front to back circular shape, symbolizing the ancient Chinese philosophical concept of "the sky is round and the earth is round". The construction of Dingling began as early as the lifetime of Emperor Wanli. It started in the twelfth year of Wanli (1584 AD) and took six years to complete, consuming eight million taels of silver. The emperor was only 28 years old when the tomb was built, and it was not officially put into use until 1620. The tomb remained unused for 30 years. Dingling has become one of the three cemeteries among the Thirteen Tombs.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 孔庙和国子监博物馆
attractions.name_en: Confucian Temple And Imperial College Museum
attractions.summary: The Confucius Temple and the Guozijian Museum are composed of ancient buildings in Beijing, which are closely adjacent and have similar themes. They are now open to the public as the same scenic area. The ticket office is located next to the entrance of the Confucius Temple. After purchasing tickets, enter the Confucius Temple and enter the Guozijian for sightseeing at the "Chijing Gate" next to the Stele Pavilion. The Confucius Temple was first built in the Yuan Dynasty and was a place where Confucius was worshipped during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. The building has a large scale, and it takes about 1-2 hours to visit and tour inside the Confucian Temple. There are three main points to pay attention to when visiting Confucian temples. The first is that there are rare Yuan Dynasty style ancient buildings in the temple, which are very unique in Beijing. The second is the numerous stone tablets in the courtyard, including inscriptions by Yuan Chonghuan, Lin Zexu, Li Hongzhang and others, name tablets for over 50000 successful candidates from the Yuan Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, and a forest of steles engraved with the Thirteen Classics of Confucianism, which are rich in content and very precious. The third is the traditional ritual dance "Dacheng Ritual Music" performed several times a day in the Chongsheng Temple, which showcases ancient traditional culture and art, and is very exciting. In addition, the courtyard is antique with many towering ancient trees, as well as memorial tablets and cultural relics exhibitions dedicated to Confucius, all of which can be visited one by one. Guozijian was a national institution of learning during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and also the place where emperors personally gave lectures in the past. Like inside the Confucian Temple, the buildings here are also ancient and charming, with towering ancient trees in the courtyard that look quaint and beautiful. It is suitable for visiting and taking photos, and usually takes about an hour for sightseeing. When visiting the Imperial Academy, you can pay attention to the buildings inside. Jixian Gate, Taixue Gate, glazed memorial archway and other buildings are very distinctive, especially the glazed memorial archway, which is a landmark of the Imperial College. The Biyong Hall is the main body of the Imperial Academy, surrounded by a circular pool on the outside and a square shaped central hall, which is very unique. The Yilun Hall next to it is the place where ancient emperors gave lectures, and you can also visit it well. There are also perennial exhibitions such as the "Ancient Chinese Imperial Examination Exhibition" and the "Exhibition of the Original State of the Imperial Academy" inside the Imperial Academy, which visitors interested in the imperial examination system can visit. Full text 

attractions.name: 雍和宫
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast corner of the inner city of Dongcheng District, Beijing, that is, east of Yonghegong Street Road, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist temple in Beijing. 
In the thirty-second year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it became the residence of Yinzhen, the fourth son of the emperor. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Zhaotai Gate, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, Yonghe Gate, Lama Temple, Lecture Hall and Tantric Hall present the standard layout of "seven halls and blue blues" in Chinese Buddhist temples. 
· From the east-west memorial archway with cornices and arches to the antique east-west Shunshan Tower, there are more than a thousand halls in total, which are very luxurious and worth visiting
attractions.shortFeatures: Lived in two emperors Yongzheng and Qianlong

attractions.name: 北海公园
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Enjoying Autumn Leaves
attractions.summary:
·Beihai Park is located in the center of Beijing and is the oldest existing classical royal garden in China, with the most complete preservation and the deepest cultural heritage.  
·The park is centered around Beihai Lake and is divided into four main areas: the "North Shore Scenic Area," "East Shore Scenic Area," "Qiong Island Scenic Area," and "Tuan City Scenic Area."  
·The vast water area is rare in Beijing, and the best time for boating and sightseeing in the park is in the evening, when one can admire imperial architecture and sit by the lake, chatting with elderly locals about the royal history of the capital.  
·On the east shore, there are several courtyard-style gardens such as Hao Pu Jian, Hua Fang Zhai, and Can Tan, which are hidden among the ancient pines and cypress trees. These gardens not only have a natural charm but also exude the elegance of a private garden in southern China.  
·On the north shore, from east to west, there are Jingxin Zhai, Western Heaven, Chengguan Hall, the Nine-Dragon Wall, Chanfu Temple, and the World of Bliss. The Five-Dragon Pavilion is dotted along the lake, blending seamlessly with the natural landscape, creating a scene that seems entirely natural, like a masterpiece of landscape painting.  
·Beihai Park is home to one of the Eight Scenic Spots of Yanjing, "Qiong Island Spring Shade," which will reach its best viewing period in April. The blooming flowers, beautiful rocks, and captivating scenery make it a particularly enchanting sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Royal Garden of Bai Ta Lake, intertwined with water.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

restaurants.name_en: noodles with soy bean paste, Beijing

attractions.name: 唐山街28号鸳鸯楼
attractions.summary: In fact, this is a residential building in the middle of an old residential area, and it is the dormitory building of a vegetable company. Recently, it has been popular with young people because of its unique architectural style and mottled background, and has become one of the punch-in places in online celebrity, Nanning.

attractions.name: 南宁人民公园
attractions.summary: People's Park is located in the northern part of Nanning city and is a famous urban park in Nanning. The park features the rippling White Dragon Lake and attractions such as the Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial. Visitors can climb up to the Zhenning Battery to overlook the surrounding urban area, and the Guangxi Natural History Museum is also located adjacent to the park. The People's Park has a large area, with a small hill called "Wangxian Slope" in the park. Climbing up 141 steps to the top of Wangxian Slope, you can see a two-story circular castle (Zhenning Battery) built with giant stones. This is also a good place to overlook the urban area of Nanning. To the south of Wangxianpo is a emerald green lake called Bailong Lake. There is a small island in the center of the lake, and the Nine Curve Bridge to the west of the island and the Three Hole Moon Bridge to the north connect the island with the lake shore, creating a delicate and lush atmosphere. The Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial on the north side of the park was erected in 1956. It is a historical monument commemorating the revolutionary martyrs who bravely sacrificed themselves for the liberation of Nanning and the establishment of New China during the Great Revolution, the War of Resistance Against Japan, and the Liberation War. In addition, there are many amusement facilities suitable for all ages in the southeast of the park.

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁畅游阁
attractions.summary: Nanning Changyou Pavilion adopts the traditional multi story building form, with a total of five floors and a height of nearly 50 meters. It is a tourist building on the banks of the Yongjiang River.

attractions.name: 南宁极地海洋世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; a hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Aquariums
attractions.summary:
Nanning Polar Ocean World is a polar ocean-themed cultural center in Guangxi, covering an area of 30,000 square meters with a total water volume of 15,000 tons. The venue consists of four floors, divided into 16 major exhibition areas, including the Polar Exhibition Zone, Underwater Tunnel, Jellyfish Palace, Shark Zone, Amazon River Basin Freshwater Area, Touch Pool Interactive Zone, and Marine Science Education Zone. It also features creative and stunning performances such as the Ocean Pool Underwater Fantasy Show (mermaid performance), Happy Ocean Theater (sea lion and dolphin shows), Whale and Dolphin Sea (whale flower performance), and Seal Bay (seal interaction).

The venue houses various large marine animals, including sea lions, sea dogs, spotted seals, Arctic wolves, penguins, flower whales, and dolphins, along with more than 40,000 rare fish. Nanning Polar Ocean World has been rated as a national 4A-level tourist attraction and an educational base for middle and primary school students' field trips.

attractions.name: 龙门水都
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
Guangxi Longmen Shuidu Cultural Ecological Tourism Scenic Area is located beside the Outer Ring Expressway in the High-tech Zone of Nanning. The scenic area covers an area of approximately 20.14 square kilometers, with a forest coverage rate of 98%. The high gorge and flat lake stretch over more than 700 acres, winding and curving along the mountain, resembling a dragon soaring through the sky.

The area boasts beautiful scenery, with evergreen trees throughout the year and a constant fragrance of flowers. Surrounded by mountains, it is densely forested, with streams crisscrossing and mountain springs flowing continuously. The concentration of negative oxygen ions reaches 30,000 to 60,000 per cubic centimeter of air, making it the largest and highest quality eco-friendly, low-carbon large-scale ecological sightseeing industry in Nanning.

The scenic spots include the Hundred Family Surnames Garden, Longyin Tianxia, Longying Gallery, Gourmet Corridor, Graphite Garden, Top Scholar Bridge, Water Walkway, Nine-Dragon Square, Ba Gui Top Scholar Forest, Longmen Reservoir, and Guixue Building, among others. It also features a conference center equipped with top-tier meeting facilities and a professional one-stop conference butler service. Additionally, there are pure hot springs, mountain spring medicinal baths, SPA treatments, children's water play areas, leisure swimming pools, and entertainment centers, making it a large-scale tourist resort that integrates entertainment, leisure, historical culture, natural scenery, business meetings, fitness activities, science education, and specialty dining.
attractions.shortFeatures: The year-round evergreen ecological oxygen bar

attractions.name: 云顶观光
attractions.tag: Observation deck; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Diwang Genting, with an absolute height of 276 meters, not only refers to the pure building height, but also reveals the challenge of Diwang Genting sightseeing to the height of traditional tourism methods. The grand opening of Diwang Yunding Sightseeing took a new approach when the smoke in the tourism market was thick, adding a fresh impetus to Nanning tourism market, and initiating the first urban high-altitude landscape tourism project in the whole southwest area. On this high-altitude tarmac with an area of 1,270 square meters, we can relax our mood. Here, you can overlook the entire land of Tancheng, overlooking the beautiful Yongjiang River, the green Nanhu Lake, the scenic Qingxiu Mountain Scenic Area, the majestic Nanhu Bridge and Baisha Bridge. In addition to the beautiful scenery, you can also challenge your own limits here. Under the hollow and transparent glass, the scene of an abyss suddenly appears, where timid people can regain their confidence. Bold people can truly realize the true feeling of "above ten thousand people" and be a real king.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Nanning in a fully transparent corridor

attractions.name: 邕江夜游
attractions.summary: Yongjiang Night Tour is a new water tourism project in Nanning City, bringing a brand new water travel experience. Equipped with a 57 meter long and 17 meter wide barge, with three floors built on top. The first floor is the waiting hall, and the second and third floors are tourist leisure, entertainment, and dining areas; Two 120 passenger tourist boats, with an 80 seat hall on the first floor, 4 observation rooms on the second floor, and an observation deck on the third floor. The tourist boat has complete supporting facilities, comfortable and spacious, with a wide view. Tourists can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Yongjiang River and listen to the historical and cultural stories of Nanning in the gentle river breeze.

attractions.name: 南宁大明山
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Canyons
attractions.summary:
Daming Mountain in spring offers the opportunity to hike up to the half-mountain level and enjoy the flowers. In summer, you can escape the heat by hiding in its natural icebox. In autumn, hiking to the summit allows you to breathe fresh air and moisturize your lungs. In winter, the frost-covered trees and ice formations on the mountain are stunningly beautiful. 

Daming Mountain attracts numerous self-driving travelers and hikers who come to "steal a moment of leisure" and experience the changing seasons. You can wander through vast primitive forests and explore the wonders of the Luoyue culture, experiencing the marvelous "shadowless noon" phenomenon. Beneath the Tianping grassland on Daming Mountain, there are mysterious ancient symbols waiting to be uncovered.

The microwave station on the summit is an ideal spot for watching the sunrise, and visitors can also enjoy photography from the nearby platform, which provides excellent angles. 

For those who admire snowy landscapes, a visit to Daming Mountain from December to February offers the chance to stand at the peak of the southern border and enjoy the breathtaking northern scenery, with the entire mountain covered in silver and adorned with jade-like trees and flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Spring flowers, summer waterfalls, autumn clouds, winter snow.

restaurants.name_en: Guan Xian Lao MA casserole brochette

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. Full text 

attractions.name: 金乌温泉公园
attractions.summary: This is a very beautiful open park, and upon entering the park, one will be amazed to find that there are internet famous pink and white chaos here. There is a bathing pool free of charge for citizens in the park. Although it is not allowed to bathe in soup, tourists can use hot spring water to soak their feet, water and face. The environment of the park is very good, the air is fresh, and many citizens come here to exercise and keep fit.

attractions.name: 汤山一号温泉度假区
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Nanjing Tangshan is famous for its hot springs at home and abroad. There are four springs in Tangshan No.1 Hot Spring Resort, with a daily water output of 5,000 tons. The water temperature is kept at 65 degrees all the year round, the ph value is 7.32, and the salinity is 1.715---1.723 g/L. It contains more than 30 kinds of trace elements such as potassium, sodium, calcium and magnesium. Tangshan No.1 Hot Spring Resort is located in the beautiful hot spring resort of Nanjing Military Region. It integrates tourism and vacation, recreation and entertainment, leisure and health care, and business meetings, covering a total area of about 680 mu. It consists of six areas: open-air hot spring area, hotel villa area, catering and entertainment area, conference and physical examination area.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 中国科举博物馆(江南贡院)
attractions.summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 栖霞寺
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
Sheshan Qixia Temple is located on Qixia Mountain in the northeast of Nanjing. It is one of the four famous temples in China and the birthplace of the "Three Theories" of Jiangnan Buddhism. Qixia Temple is not only large in scale and magnificent in style, but also the best scenery in Nanjing. It is also famous for its important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Qixia Temple Feng covers an area of more than 40 mu, and there are three courtyards of Pilu Temple Tibetan Sutra Building, which rise layer by layer according to the mountain, and the pattern is neat and beautiful. Main attractions: Stupa The Qixia Temple Stupa is a relic of the Southern Tang Dynasty. It is one of the oldest stone pagodas south of the Yangtze River and the largest stupa in my country. The stone pagoda is eight-angled and five-level, about fifteen meters high. The base is surrounded by a stone railing with a hook line, which is restored for the original objects of the Five Dynasties excavated in modern times. The floor of the base is carved with seawater, dragon, phoenix, fish, shrimp and other figures, and only a part of it remains. The eight phases of Sakyamuni are embossed on all sides of the Sumeru seat under the pagoda. After thousands of years of wind and rain, although some stone eaves have been destroyed, they still stand tall, becoming a witness to the prosperity of Buddha spirit in Jinling. The Great Buddha Pavilion, also known as the Three Holy Temples, is dedicated to the Buddha of Infinite Life and was excavated for Shiyi in the Southern Qi Dynasty. The Buddha statue is 10.8 meters high, and its seat is 13.3 meters high. Guanyin is 11 meters high to stand on the left and right side of the Bodhisattva. The pleated style of the Buddha statue is quite similar to the stone Buddha in Yungang, Datong. The original two Buddhas next to the stupa are more than three meters high, beautiful and elegant, similar to the Longmen Stone Buddha in Luoyang, and are also peerless treasures in the golden age of Chinese Buddhist art. Qianfoyan, known as "Yungang in the south of the Yangtze River", is the only Southern Dynasty grottoes in China. Wuliang Hall Wuliang Hall is the earliest and largest Buddhist shrine in Qianfo Rock. The Buddha of Infinite Life is in the middle, and Guanyin is on both sides. The statue is well-proportioned and the lines are smooth. The fold style of the three Buddhas' clothes is similar to that of Yungang Grottoes, and the excavation date is seventeen years earlier than that of Yungang Grottoes. The statue is exquisite and simple, which can be compared with Datong Longmen. Its value lies in preserving the original rhyme of Buddha statues in the Southern Dynasties, which is especially rare in the south of the Yangtze River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire exquisite stupas and Buddha statues in grottoes

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康大楼
attractions.summary: Wukang Building, located at the intersection of Huaihai Middle Road and Wukang Road, is flat in shape, like an iron, and looks like a French Renaissance style. Some celebrities in the cultural and entertainment circles have stayed here. The vicinity of Wukang Building is full of French style. Sitting at the open-air table of a roadside coffee shop, drinking a cup of coffee and basking in the sun, it seems like entering another time and space.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many famous people have stayed here

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 开封府
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Kaifeng Fu, also known as the Southern Yamen, was the administrative and judicial office for officials in the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, and was praised as the "first prefecture under heaven."
- Among the various government offices throughout history, it was the largest in scale, equivalent to the Beijing municipal government today.
- The architecture is grand and magnificent, complementing the waters of the Three Pools Lake, creating the scenic view of "Eastern Prefecture, Western Temple, Pavilion and Clear Water."
- In addition to a large collection of precious historical materials and exhibits, visitors can also enjoy performances such as the "Opening of the Yamen," "Judge Bao’s Rulings," and "Fire-Spitting Face-Changing."
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the ancient-style performance of Judge Bao solving cases.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Spring and summer 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Winter 07:00-18:30(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Autumn 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 大相国寺
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for taking kids out; Temples
attractions.summary:
- Originally named Jianguo Temple, it is the place where Lu Zhishen uprooted the willows in *Water Margin* and was also a royal temple during the Song Dynasty.
- The present-day Daxiangguo Temple is mostly a recent reconstruction. The Main Hall no longer houses any statues, but it frequently hosts exhibitions of cultural relics and arts.
- The Arhat Hall, commonly known as the "Octagonal Glazed Hall," is an octagonal building with a corridor, where visitors can view the wooden sculpture of the Four-faced Thousand-armed, Thousand-eyed Guanyin from the Qianlong period.
- The Sutra Repository is the venue for activities of the Kaifeng Academy of Calligraphy and Painting, showcasing various calligraphy and painting works for viewing or purchase. The bronze bell hanging in the pavilion at the eastern corner of the temple is a valuable cultural relic.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Royal Temple of the Northern Song Dynasty Capital

attractions.name: 包公湖
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Lakes; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Baogong Lake is a lake in Kaifeng City, Henan Province. It is located in the ancient city wall of Song Dynasty and in the southwest corner of the ancient city. The whole lake runs from northwest to southeast, like a reclining gourd. There is Yingbin Road, a north-south road across the lake in the west of the middle, and Baogong Hunan Road in the southwest. Around the lake, there are places of interest such as Baogong Temple and Yanqing Temple.
attractions.shortFeatures: The lake is full of historical, cultural and ancient buildings

attractions.name: 龙亭景区
attractions.tag: Ancient ruins; Appreciate autumn flowers; City Parks; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the northern end of Zhongshan Road in Kaifeng, this ancient architectural complex is built according to the layout of the Qing Wanshou Palace.
- It was once the site of the Northern Song Dynasty imperial capital. From the stone railing, you can enjoy a view of the ancient city of Kaifeng, and inside the hall, you can view the displayed cultural relics.
- Known both domestically and internationally as a famous chrysanthemum viewing destination, it hosts an annual Chrysanthemum Festival in the golden autumn. During this time, the park is splendid, with thousands of chrysanthemum varieties competing in beauty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb to the Top and View the Scenery of Kaifeng Ancient City

attractions.name: 铁塔景区
attractions.summary: Kaifeng Iron Tower, located in Iron Tower Park, was originally named Kaibao Temple Tower, also known as Inspiration Tower or Shangwen Temple Tower. Due to the brown glazed bricks embedded on the outer wall, it appears to be iron from afar and is commonly known as the "Iron Tower". The iron tower has been built for over 900 years and has withstood disasters such as wars, floods, and earthquakes, still standing tall today. The design of the iron tower is exquisite and the structure is sturdy. The tower body is octagonal, with a total of 13 floors and a height of about 55 meters, gradually decreasing from the bottom to the top. The brick carvings here are very famous, with over 50 patterns of flying sky, qilin, bodhisattva, geisha, lion and other motifs carved on the bricks. The shapes are beautiful and the expressions are vivid, making it a masterpiece of brick carving art in the Song Dynasty. There are stairs inside the tower that lead directly to the top of the tower, offering a panoramic view of the city and its surroundings. On the top of the iron tower is a gourd shaped copper bead, which looks like a monk wearing a solemn monk's hat from afar. The window design of the tower is also very unique, with two types: bright windows and blind windows. There is one bright window on each floor, with the first floor in the north, the second floor in the south, the third floor in the west, the fourth floor in the east, and so on, until the upper floors. The so-called blind window is actually a window model that cannot be opened. Back then, this tower was an important attraction in Bianjing, named "Iron Tower Clouds". Climbing the tower and looking into the distance, the Yellow River is like a belt, and the earth is like a brocade. To the west of the iron tower, there is a temple dedicated to the introduction of a bronze Buddha from the Song and Jin dynasties, which is about 5 meters high and weighs about 12 tons. It is also a precious treasure. The other buildings of the temple were abandoned during the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang period. Full text 

attractions.name: 天波杨府
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: At Tianbo Mansion, listen to the stories of Tianbo Mansion, enjoy the beautiful scenery within the mansion, where the scenery and the stories blend, creating a unique charm.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Song Dynasty ancient architecture commemorating the famous general Yang Ye

attractions.name: 清明上河园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gem; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A large-scale Song Dynasty cultural theme park built based on the famous Song Dynasty painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*.
- The park closely replicates the scenes from *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*, consisting of eight functional zones and four cultural zones.
