- The Southern Garden recreates the bustling streets of Northern Song Dynasty’s capital, Bianjing (today's Kaifeng), while the Northern Garden showcases the Song Dynasty's royal gardens and court entertainment, with palace architecture adorned in golden and brilliant colors.
- The staff inside the park wear Song Dynasty clothing, creating a time-travel experience. In addition, there are exciting scene performances and folk shows.
attractions.shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Scenery of Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden

attractions.name: 《大宋东京梦华》演出
attractions.tag: Featured performance; Nighttime sightseeing; Live Show
attractions.summary: The Grand Song Dynasty Tokyo Dream "is a large-scale live water performance created by live action planner Mei Shuaiyuan, directed by renowned live action director Zhang Rensheng, and produced by Kaifeng Qingming Shanghe Garden. The performance of 'Dream of the Song Dynasty in Tokyo' lasts for 70 minutes and is performed by over 700 actors, making it another masterpiece of live action performances in China. The Dream of Splendor in the Eastern Capital of the Great Song Dynasty "is an impressionistic painting about the heyday of the Northern Song Dynasty, and a historical representation of" Along the River during the Qingming Festival "and" Dreams of Splendor in the Eastern Capital ". It uses eight well-known classical Song Ci and its artistic conception, such as "Yu Meiren", "Zui Dongfeng", "Butterflies in Love with Flowers", "Man Jianghong", to outline the historical picture of Tokyo, the capital city of the Northern Song Dynasty. The whole performance was divided into six acts and four scenes, including Preface - Yu Meiren, Drunk by the East Wind, Butterflies in Love with Flowers, Qitian Music, Man Jianghong, and Ending the Water Melody. The gorgeous scenes, classic Song lyrics, and high-tech dance beauty brought strong audio-visual shock to the tourists, vividly and truly representing the prosperity of Bianliang, the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty.

restaurants.name_en: Come together and turn around small hot pot

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 北京野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- Beijing Wildlife Park is located in the vast forest area of Daxing District and houses more than 200 species of animals, with a population of over ten thousand, making it a paradise for children to visit and learn.
- The zoo is divided into two main routes: the southern and northern lines. The southern line features the Lion and Tiger Pavilion, the Lion and Baboon Pavilion, the Monkey Pavilion, and more, where visitors can see lions and baboons living together.
- The northern line mainly consists of bird exhibits, where visitors can see beautiful birds like flamingos and peacocks, as well as parrots that can talk to people.
- Many animals in the park are raised in open environments. Visitors can take a caged vehicle for a close-up view of the animals, and enjoy performances such as bear acrobatics, monkeys riding bicycles, and lions jumping through hoops.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up view of wildlife

attractions.name: 北京杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.summary: Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in Beijing is located on Qianmen Street and is the branch of Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in Beijing. It displays numerous extremely realistic wax figures, and visitors can take photos with many celebrities and celebrities from home and abroad. The Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in Beijing has a total of 8 exhibition areas, where many historical and modern domestic and foreign celebrities such as Michael Jackson, Obama, Putin, Feng Xiaogang, Jackie Chan, Jay Chou, etc. can be seen. There is also a unique "Chinese Spirit" exhibition area in the Beijing Pavilion, where celebrities from various industries such as Lang Ping and Cui Jian can see it, which is the focus of tourists' group photo tours.

attractions.name: 老舍茶馆
attractions.summary: Lao She Teahouse has become a comprehensive cultural enterprise that combines Chinese opera culture, food culture, tea culture, and Beijing flavor culture, integrating various forms such as old Beijing Qing Teahouse, dining Teahouse, wild tea stall, and book Teahouse. The tea house is divided into three floors with a business area of over 2600 square meters. The "Qianmen Sihe Tea House" located on the second floor is modeled after the ancient and classic Beijing traditional architecture of a quadrangle courtyard; While preserving the original appearance of the old Beijing quadrangle courtyard, it also embodies the characteristics of "solemnity in the north and simplicity in the south". The various wing rooms are arranged in a staggered and varied manner, combining traditional art with modern technology.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 明十三陵
attractions.summary:
- The collective name for the tombs of the 13 emperors of the Ming Dynasty after the capital was moved to Beijing, it is also one of the largest imperial tomb complexes in China, with the most imperial and empress tombs still extant.
- The scenic area is a unified whole, while each tomb is independent. Each tomb is located in front of a mountain, with Changling being the first of the Ming Thirteen Tombs. It is the tomb of the Ming Emperor Chengzu, Zhu Di, and the largest imperial tomb among the Thirteen Tombs.
- The Changling Museum exhibits various burial artifacts, including phoenix crowns, civil officials' hats, men's jade belts, and hairpins, all of which are worth seeing.
- Only four scenic areas are open to the public: Changling, Zhao Tomb, Ding Tomb, and the Sacred Way. Although these are tombs, only the Ding Tomb has been excavated so far.
- In addition to history, it is also nice to take a walk along the Zhao Tomb and Sacred Way. The Sacred Way is lined with various vivid stone statues, and the Zhao Tomb area is quiet and less crowded, perfect for a peaceful stroll.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tomb complex that houses the thirteen Ming Dynasty emperors.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 香山公园
attractions.summary:
- It is a royal garden with mountain and forest features. In ancient times, the emperor would come here for hunting and to cool off during the summer and autumn seasons.  
- The garden is home to numerous cultural relics and historical sites, such as "Xishan Qingxue" (Clear Snow on the Western Mountains), one of the Eight Views of Yanjing, and the "Biyun Temple," a monastery that blends the architectural styles of the Ming and Qing dynasties.  
- The red leaves of Xiangshan are famous both at home and abroad. In 1986, it was named one of the "Sixteen New Scenic Spots of Beijing," becoming the city's most iconic autumn scenery.  
- The Laimei Valley in Xiangshan Park has been established for more than 10 years, and over 100 wintersweet trees are now flourishing there. The petals of wintersweet are small, and their bright yellow color shines under the warm winter sunlight, emitting a subtle, fragrant aroma.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the rustic charm of the mountains and the natural oxygen bar; a top autumn destination with mountains covered in red leaves.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 王府井
attractions.summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 中国国家博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
With a total construction area of nearly 200,000 square meters and a collection of more than 1 million pieces, it is the largest museum in the world. 
The museum is divided into five floors and has 48 exhibition halls. It is one of the museums with the richest collection of Chinese cultural relics. 
The exhibition system consists of basic exhibition, special exhibition, international exchange exhibition and temporary exhibition, covering all stages from ancient times to the present. 
· There are a large number of visitors, so you can make an appointment online before going to save time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at Chinese Treasures through Millenniums

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 平津战役纪念馆
attractions.summary:
The Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum is a special memorial dedicated to showcasing the great victory of the Pingjin Campaign, as decided by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. On August 23, 1994, the 67th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 14th Central Committee decided to build the Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum in Tianjin, with the Beijing Military Region taking the lead and working together with the municipal governments of Beijing and Tianjin to complete the construction. The foundation stone was laid on November 29, 1995, and the museum was completed and opened on July 23, 1997.

The main exhibition hall is a majestic three-story building, 22 meters high, with a simple and ancient style, featuring warm gray granite cladding. It combines traditional Chinese elements with modern aesthetic styles. On the large archway above the exhibition hall is a golden inscription of "Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum" in seven characters written by Marshal Nie Rongzhen, with his signature on the lower right. A 40-meter-wide granite staircase guides visitors into the exhibition hall. The total length of the exhibition line in the main hall is 740 meters, divided into six sections: Preliminaries, Campaign Decisions, Campaign Implementation, People's Support, Great Victory, and Heroes' Achievements. The exhibition displays over 400 historical photos, more than 2,000 cultural relics, as well as multimedia, electric sand tables, restored sites, landscapes, sculptures, and paintings as auxiliary exhibits.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place to learn about the history of the Pingjin Campaign

attractions.name: 南开大学(八里台校区)
attractions.summary: Nankai University is one of the famous higher education institutions in China, located in Tianjin, with the Balitai campus being one of its main campuses. The campus has a beautiful environment, unique architectural style, and a fusion of Chinese and Western architectural elements, making it an important cultural landmark in Tianjin.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 五号院相声茶馆（古文化街通庆里店）
attractions.name_en: No. 5 Courtyard Xiangsheng Teahouse (Ancient Cultural Street Tongqingli Store)
attractions.summary: Experience the courtyard tea house, enjoy tea, taste fresh Tianjin style snacks, and listen to traditional cross-talk.

attractions.name: 天津自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Science and Technology Museum; Museum; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary:
Tianjin Museum of Natural History has a wide area with three floors, including permanent exhibition area, temporary exhibition area, experience entertainment area and popular science education area. 
There are many exhibits in the museum. If you first enter the exhibition area, you can first see a long scroll of life evolution. A pair of "mother and son" giant Shandong dragon skeletons in the center of the hall will immediately bring you into the situation of natural legends. On the left side of the hall is the living butterfly garden in the first museum in China. You can not only watch the colorful living butterflies flying all over the sky, but also observe the transformation process from caterpillars to beautiful butterflies, and truly experience "emerging into butterflies". 
The most unmissable thing is the exhibition hall on the third floor, which displays about 300 precious specimens of world wildlife, such as precious Chinese animal specimens such as crested ibis, giant panda, golden monkey and takin, which are known as the "Four Treasures of Qinling Mountains".
attractions.shortFeatures: A long history and a rich collection

restaurants.name_en: Pan Pacific Hotel Tianjin-Haitianlou Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 宁海森林温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; a hidden gem for kids.
attractions.summary:
The commonly known "Tianming Mountain Nanxi Hot Spring" is a natural "Oxygen Valley" in Ningbo, and one of China's three major famous hot springs.  
With a water temperature of around 49.5°C, it is rich in various beneficial minerals and trace elements, making it a rare mid-temperature hot spring with a sodium bicarbonate water quality in China, regarded as a "unique gem in the Yangtze River Delta."  
Surrounded by peaks, the scenic area boasts a beautiful natural environment and is a comprehensive resort that integrates natural attractions, hot spring spas, outdoor activities, and gourmet food.  
The average temperature in summer is 3-5°C lower than in the city, making it an ideal place for leisure, cooling off, and escaping the heat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Forest Hot Springs in East China

attractions.name: 宁海湾横山岛景区
attractions.summary: One of the 12 islands in the Qiangjiao Archipelago, it is an important component of the developing Ninghai Bay Tourist Resort. The island runs north-south, with a length of 0.76 kilometers, a width of 0.23 kilometers, and a high point of 51 meters above sea level. No matter from which perspective the island is viewed, it forms a horizontal shape resembling the character "mountain", hence its name. There is a Zhenfu Temple on the island, which was originally divided into two halls, front and back. It was built during the Ming Dynasty, and the beams and columns were shaped in the Qing Dynasty. It is called "Xiaoputuo" and attracts a continuous stream of devout men and women from Fenghua, Ningbo, and Ninghai. On the island, lush forests and bamboo cultivation create a serene and elegant atmosphere. The rocks around the island have been battered by the waves for years, forming cliffs and caves with various shapes and shapes, and the scenery is tempting. If you are fortunate enough to visit, become a "Penglai Fairy"! Other attractions include the Punan Zen Monastery and the former site of the Provincial Fisheries School. This is an ancient and mysterious island. As early as the Han Dynasty, Emperor Wu set up a pavilion called "Tu Qi" because this place was a key point on the sea route. In the Northern Song Dynasty, Lin Bu, who was accompanied by his wife and children, became interested in this place and built the Taiji Palace with the Eight Trigrams image in Siguping. In the Ming Dynasty, this place was also called the Mirage Gate due to the appearance of mirages, and the entire sea corner was named Mirage Sea because of this. At this time, a story of Guanyin solving difficulties was spreading among the people, so a Zhenfu Temple dedicated to Guanyin was erected on Hengshan Island, and the name "Little Putuo" was rumored to be well-known. Since the Ming Dynasty, deforestation has been banned, and to this day, the entire island is covered in towering ancient trees, including mulberry and hibiscus trees that have been in existence for over 700 years. Nowadays, Qiangjiao has built a 3000 ton dock, which is a natural harbor and seafood base in Ningbo City. However, the Tingzhai ruins, Ming and Qing ancient buildings, as well as the Siguping Road Courtyard, Xiaoputuo Hall and other historical sites are still intact. Visiting here, you can experience the charm of ancient times, appreciate the wonders of the sea and sky, and taste the new flavors of seafood. Full text 

attractions.name: 前童古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qiantong Ancient Town is known as the "First Confucian Town in Jiangnan," "Little Lijiang of Jiangnan," and "Living Folk Museum."
- It is the largest settlement of the Tong family in Jiangnan. The town preserves a complete set of Ming and Qing Dynasty architecture, with white walls and black tiles, exuding grandeur.
- The entire town resembles a countryside painting rich in ancient charm, with every household featuring carved beams, every home having flowing water, and an octagonal water system running throughout the village.
- The village follows a "return" style layout with a nine-square, eight-trigram arrangement. The streets and alleys are narrow, and the buildings are densely packed, making it feel like walking through a maze.

attractions.name: 世纪公园
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Enjoying Autumn Leaves
attractions.summary:
- Century Park is the largest natural ecological park in downtown Shanghai, divided into areas such as the Native Garden Area, Lakeside Area, Bird Sanctuary, and Exotic Garden Area.
- Jing Tian Lake in the park is the largest artificial lake in the Shanghai area, with a diameter of about 300 meters. The park offers fishing and boating services by the lake.
- The "Plum Blossom and Wintersweet Exhibition" of Century Park is held every January, featuring nearly 50,000 square meters of wintersweet and over 100 ancient plum and wintersweet trees.
- The "Shanghai International Music Fireworks Festival" is held annually from October to November, with top fireworks designers from different countries showcasing their skills.
attractions.shortFeatures: Large Ecological Park in the City Center

attractions.name: 人民广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
People's Square is the largest public square in Shanghai. It was transformed from the "largest horse racing hall in the Far East" in the concession era, and it is also a landmark of Shanghai. 
People's Square in a broad sense is mainly composed of open squares, People's Park, Shanghai Grand Theatre, Shanghai Museum and other buildings. 
Hong Kong Famous Street, Di Mei Shopping Center and Old Shanghai 1930 Style Street are built underground in the square, showing the old appearance of Shanghai in 1930s. 
There is a fountain in the center of the square, which sprays water about every half hour at night. It is beautiful under various lights and is a good place to enjoy the cool air.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Landmark and Transportation Hub

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 上海外滩美术馆
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Bund Art Museum is adjacent to the Bund and Garden Bridge of Shanghai. The building is the Asian Cultural Society Building built in 1932. The "Shanghai Museum" was once located here. Art museums often have different exhibitions where you can see works by Chinese and foreign artists, including abstract paintings, sculptures, and small scene arrangements. The Bund Art Museum in Shanghai combines architectural elements of Chinese and Western cultures, with an elegant and exquisite decorative art style. It has become a high-end photography destination in Shanghai and is deeply loved by literary and artistic youth. The exhibitions in the art museum are mainly regular thematic exhibitions, with themes and exhibits changing every few months. You can follow the guide to learn more about the content of the exhibits. In addition, there are also some exhibits on the walls inside the caf é, while the outdoor part is a rooftop where you can enjoy the surrounding city scenery or sit here for a cup of coffee and take a nap.

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 滨江大道
attractions.summary:
· Binjiang Avenue is a pedestrian avenue located on the Huangpu River, with a total length of about 2,500 meters, facing the Bund across the river. 
· It has become one of the most famous tourist attractions in Shanghai because it can overlook the World Expo complex and Puxi scenery on the Bund on the other side. 
In the center of Binjiang Avenue, there is a water spray square composed of 21 water spray heads, and a huge fountain equipped with colorful lights shines brightly at night. 
Compared with the Bund, Binjiang Avenue is characterized by a richer flavor of life. People watch the river in groups of three or five or alone, which is more quiet and leisurely.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pedestrian walkway across the river from the Bund

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 葡萄滩海水浴场
attractions.summary: Because there are few communities around Grape Beach, which are basically villages, there are few people engaging in group activities at the seaside, so it is an ideal place for outsiders to play. Moreover, the bathing facilities here are at the seaside, which is very convenient for people who bathe at the sea. The beach here will be maintained and cleaned frequently, and it will be managed by special personnel. The advantages of Grape Beach are: it has a large area and relatively few people, so you can have a good time. The bathing beach has a gentle slope, but it is deep water when you swim further in, and the sea water is deep and shallow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Catch crabs in the sea

attractions.name: 刘公岛景区
attractions.summary: Liugong Island, located at the mouth of Weihai Bay, faces the Yellow Sea and is backed by Weihai Bay. It is known as the "Peach Blossom Spring on the Sea". The main attractions on the island include Liugong Island National Forest Park, Liugong Island Expo Park, Liugong Island Whale Museum, Qidingshan Battery, and more. There is also a Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895 Museum, making it a memorial site for the war and a patriotic education base. To visit Liugong Island, you need to take a passenger ship from Weihai, which takes about 20 minutes. It is recommended to head west to the nearby Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895 Museum after landing on the island. This is a museum of archaeological sites, mainly featuring Qing Dynasty buildings such as the Beiyang Navy Admiral's Office and the Naval Academy, which truly reproduces the historical appearance of the Beiyang Navy and the War of 1894-1895. After visiting, head north through the exit and enter Liugong Island National Forest Park, which is also one of the few marine parks in China. The park is covered with green pine and cypress trees, with blooming mountain flowers and a very high plant coverage. There is a small zoo in the park, and visitors can see many sika deer in the sika deer house. Afterwards, you can go to the mountain to see the Qidingshan Battery. After visiting, you can take the cable car here and enjoy the Liugong Island Expo Park. From the cable car, you can also overlook the entire Expo Park. In the Expo Park, you can truly understand the history of Liugong Island, and it takes about 2 hours to play the entire park. The "Liu Gong Virtue" area mainly uses huge wall carvings and wood carvings to tell the culture of Liu Gong Island. In the Memorial Hall of the Battle of Jiawu, one can also see the process of the Beiyang Fleet from its formation to its downfall, vividly reproducing the heroic scenes of the war. Outside the memorial hall is the Deng Shichang stone carving that came into view when landing on the island. The buildings outside the exhibition hall are mostly characterized by sloping roofs and a square chimney, which is very distinctive. In addition, tourists can also choose to take a sightseeing bus through the forest and pine forests, and the 20 minute journey can take in a panoramic view of all major attractions. Alternatively, you can choose to take a cruise around the island to experience the full view of Liugong Island. Among them, Courtyard 4 and Courtyard 5 have more than 60 island folk countryside houses, peaceful courtyards, fresh air, counting stars and listening to frogs here, as if returning to childhood. The rich historical and cultural atmosphere, tranquil island nights, bathing in the sea breeze, enjoying the sea view, have a unique flavor in your heart. Liugong Island attracts tourists from home and abroad with its unique natural scenery and rich historical and cultural atmosphere. On the rest island, staying at Liu Gong Island Hotel, you can fully appreciate the beauty of nature, watch the waves bloom, listen to the sound of the waves, bask in the gentle sea breeze, enjoy the tranquility and comfort of a paradise, and experience the peaceful night on the island. It will definitely make your journey unique and exciting. Full text 

attractions.name: 定远舰
attractions.summary:
Dingyuan Ship Scenic Area is located in the bustling urban area of Weihai, a beautiful coastal city in Shandong Province. The main landscape is the flagship "Dingyuan" of Beiyang Navy in the late Qing Dynasty, which is reproduced according to its original appearance. 
The current Dingyuan ship is a 1: 1 copy of the Dingyuan of the Beiyang Navy in the late Qing Dynasty. It was the flagship of the Yellow Sea War during the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 and witnessed a glorious past of the Chinese Navy. The warship reproduced the practical daily necessities of soldiers at that time, such as machine guns, torpedoes and other military supplies. The ring screen cinema used film and television materials to restore many historical scenes, and also collected many historical documents. The situation of a hundred years ago is gone, but history is still stirring in the hearts of every Chinese.
attractions.shortFeatures: Truly restored Dingyuan Sea Ship
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Off season 08:00-17:30,Opens at Peak season 07:30-17:30

attractions.name: 威海幸福门
attractions.summary: Happiness Gate, also known as the "Gate of Weihai", is located at the eastern end of Shichang Avenue in Weihai Happiness Park. The building is designed with a height of 45 meters and a width of 42 meters, and the entire structure is in the shape of a "door". The building is located about 30 meters above ground level and features an 11 story sightseeing corridor connected by a horizontal pedestrian bridge. Standing on the corridor, one can overlook the beautiful Liugong Island to the east and the panoramic view of Weihai city center to the west. Set up a high-end sea view Western restaurant at a height of 36 meters (13th floor) and 39 meters (14th floor), where you can enjoy delicious food while also admiring the beautiful and charming blue sea view. Under the Happiness Gate Tower, you can often visit various cultural exhibitions such as celebrity art exhibitions, photography exhibitions, and urban change photography exhibitions. As a landmark building of Weihai, the Happiness Gate is like a messenger of Weihai's image, welcoming friends from all over with open hearts and enthusiasm. At the same time, it embodies people's longing for a happy life and symbolizes the beautiful meaning of "opening the door to happiness and welcoming a better tomorrow". It is like the Arc de Triomphe in Paris, becoming a symbol of Weihai, inheriting unique coastal culture and continuing Weihai's cultural heritage. The beautiful Happiness Park and the magnificent Happiness Gate are like a business card of Weihai. As a disseminator of Weihai's urban culture, they showcase Weihai's modern and open coastal ecological living city image to the world.

attractions.name: 仙姑顶
attractions.tag: Climbing to a high place and hiking in the mountains; Mountains
attractions.summary: Xian Guding is known as the "World's No. 1 Jade Scenic Area." Walking through the area, one can find jade sculptures of mythical figures and Taoist sites, with even the statues of the music fountain made from jade. The most famous feature is the jade Buddha statue on the mountainside, which is the heaviest jade Buddha in the world, weighing 300 tons, and is truly spectacular. In addition, the annual Xian Guding Temple Fair has a long history and is usually held on the 15th day of the third lunar month. During the fair, visitors can pray devoutly, sample snacks, and experience a strong sense of local folklore.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Sacred Realm of Xian Dao Culture

attractions.name: 威海公园
attractions.summary:
Weihai Park is one of the largest waterfront parks in domestic cities. The park starts from Sifang Road in the north and ends at Pingdu Road in the south, facing Weihai Bay. 
From north to south, the park has four theme scenic spots: Haiya, Hailian, Haisong, Haihui and a central cultural square. Weihai Park is built along the sea. The total length of the seawall is about 3,200 meters. It is built in three structural forms: big cylinder, big steps and big slope. There is a platform for sightseeing and watching the sea on the shore. In the middle of the park, a large cultural square with a length of about 580 meters from north to south and an extension of about 107 meters from the seawall revetment is set up. Each square expresses its theme with sculptures of different sizes and shapes, and sets off the sculptures with ups and downs and dense greening. Two green belts are formed along both sides of Haibin South Road in the park, which is a belt-shaped open park with a width of about 30 meters on the west side of the road and a width of 70 meters on the east side of the road. Greening adopts European brocade technique, with lawn as the keynote and evergreen tall trees as the mainstay. About 130,000 trees such as ginkgo biloba, Fatong tree, cedar and metasequoia glyptostroboia and more than 900,000 flowering shrubs are planted. The whole project combines roads, parks and buildings for overall environmental design, forming a regional landscape in which architecture, greening, sculpture, revetment and sea are interdependent and organically integrated, forming a beautiful picture of ecological coastal city.
attractions.shortFeatures: Waterfront park built by the sea

attractions.name: 悦海公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The lighthouse is more famous

attractions.name: 海上公园
attractions.summary:
The Sea Park is located on the east side of Crown Community of Weihai Economic and Technological Development Zone, and connects with Weihai Park in the north. It includes six parts: amusement park, artificial lake, strange stone garden, forest ecological park, bathing beach and Kowloon Bay tourist resort.  
With the theme of maritime culture, ecological sightseeing, tourism and vacation, the park not only has the characteristics of water towns in the south of the Yangtze River in China, but also has the scenery of islands in Japan and South Korea, forming a unique style of combining Chinese and Western cultures. The whole park has six parks with complete functions and unique characteristics, and has become a large-scale maritime amusement park area integrating tourists' leisure, children's entertainment, ecological sightseeing, tourism and vacation, maritime culture and other functions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ecological scenic spots with both Chinese and Western styles

attractions.name: “侨乡号”游轮
attractions.summary: Overseas Chinese Hometown - Weihai Bay Panoramic Leisure and Sightseeing Cruise, a large luxury marine sightseeing cruise ship in northern China built by Shandong Overseas Chinese Hometown Group Co., Ltd. with a huge investment of 200 million, is a coastal sightseeing cruise ship independently built by countrymen, which is currently a big luxury in China. It has a fashionable appearance, beautiful lines, elegant decoration, luxury and elegant, and complete internal functions. It integrates luxurious seascape guest rooms, characteristic marine restaurants, VIP reception halls, seascape bars and tea bars, simulated golf, VIP exclusive elevators, multi-functional performance halls, and other supporting facilities are built according to the standards of star rated hotels. Everything here can bring you a supreme experience. The Qiaoxiang is a luxury sea cruise ship with a total weight of 5000 tons, with a total length of 95.8 meters, a vertical line length of 83.8 meters, a width of 15.8 meters, a main deck depth of 5.40 meters, a service speed of not less than 15 nautical miles, a range of 1000 nautical miles, a passenger capacity of 500 people, and can also undertake a series of service projects such as business conferences, forums and salons, sea gatherings, sea weddings, and sea cultural exhibitions. It can provide guests from all over the world with an unforgettable sea journey in Weihai. The "Overseas Chinese Town" is divided into four levels, mainly including: main deck, dining deck, entertainment deck, and observation deck.

attractions.name: 环翠楼公园
attractions.summary:
The Huancui Tower Park is located on the western foothills of the ancient Gu Mountain in the city center of Weihai. The park is built against the mountain with an ascending terrain, covering an area of more than 300 acres, including both Huancui Park and Huancui Tower Square. It is named after the classical building "Huancui Tower" located within the park.

Huancui Tower has undergone two major reconstructions. The original tower, built during the Ming Dynasty, featured painted beams and carved rafters, with flying eaves and a plank door. In 1931, it was rebuilt, but in 1944, it was destroyed by Japanese forces. In 1978, the Weihai Municipal People's Government planned to rebuild the tower, creating a classical architectural complex consisting of pavilions, towers, and corridors. The main building is three stories high, measuring 16.8 meters, with a glazed tile roof and a hip-and-gable style with carved floral patterns. From the top of the tower, one can see "the vast green waves to the east of the city, surrounded by lush greenery, and the beautiful scenery of the sea and mountains," hence the name "Huancui" (meaning "green waves").
attractions.shortFeatures: Climbing the Tower to Gaze at the Panoramic View of Weihai
