attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 古麓山寺
attractions.summary:
Gulushan Temple, also known as Huiguang Temple and Wanshou Temple, has a history of more than 1,700 years. It is the earliest relic of Buddhism entering Hunan and one of the early Buddhist temples in China. 
The environment of the temple is very quiet. There are two Podocarpus pines in front of the temple, which are relics of the Six Dynasties. There are precious Buddhist scriptures and ancient books in the temple. 
Today's ancient Lushan Temple is full of incense worshippers. The hall is hidden among layers of trees, with morning bells and evening drums, and bursts of Sanskrit sounds.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient and secluded temple deep in Yuelu Mountain

attractions.name: 湖南省植物园
attractions.tag: A hidden gem for taking kids.; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
· The botanical garden is mainly composed of broadleaf forests, with a forest coverage rate as high as 90%, and the air is very fresh. It is located next to Changsha South Bus Station, with convenient transportation. It is a green gem that integrates scientific research, tourism, and science education.

· It is the area in Changsha with the richest natural distribution of plant resources. The Wild Animal Rescue and Breeding Center in the garden has successfully rescued and domesticated more than 110 species of wild animals, including over 80,000 individuals, such as the red-crowned crane, the yellow-bellied tragopan, and the milu deer, which are all national Class I protected species.

· The botanical garden boasts nearly 100 varieties of tulips imported from the Netherlands, which bloom in early spring across nearly 300 acres of land.
attractions.shortFeatures: The forest is lush, with flowers blooming throughout the garden, perfect for sightseeing and leisure.

attractions.name: 南强街巷
attractions.summary: Nanqiang Street is a famous historical and cultural street, mainly composed of old courtyard buildings from the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China. The streets are filled with various delicacies and performances, which are worth visiting and touring.

attractions.name: 金马碧鸡坊
attractions.name_en: Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Archway
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Founded in Xuande period of Ming Dynasty, the existing Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Square was rebuilt in 1998 according to the original style. 
The memorial archway on the east side near Jinma Mountain is called Jinma Square, and the memorial archway on the west side is near Biji Mountain, so it is called Biji Square. 
· It is the landmark and city center of Kunming and one of the symbols of Kunming; The vast majority of tourists to Kunming will visit here and take photos with the memorial archway. 
At night, there are often lively night markets in the surrounding streets. You can go to the vendors to choose what you like.
attractions.shortFeatures: Kunming landmark group photo holy land

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 云南省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary: The construction project of Yunnan Provincial Museum is one of the top ten landmark key cultural facilities construction projects in our province, located at No.6393 Guangfu Road, Kunming. The new building covers an area of 150 mu, with a building area of 60,000 square meters. The shape of the building is cubic and the plane is zigzag. There is a landscape pool on the left and right sides of the main entrance, with two floors underground and five floors ground, 39 meters high.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to learn about Yunnan's history and culture

attractions.name: 古渡梨园
attractions.summary: The full name of Gudu Pear Garden is "Gudu Pear Garden Dian Opera Flower Lantern Training Hall", located in an inconspicuous alley in Guandu Ancient Town, Kunming. Every time there is a performance, a group of "grassroots" artists will appear here. The plays they sing are rich and colorful, including Wang Baochuan, Qin Xianglian, Bai Fanji, and 24 Filial Piety. In the modern society where Dian Opera is gradually declining, they inherit the ancient art of Dian Opera with their authentic singing style and vivid performances.

restaurants.name_en: Grace Garden Resort Hotel training center North restaurant

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 南京海底世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: It is mainly composed of lobby, tropical rain forest area, penguin pavilion, touch pool, undersea tunnel, human-shark dance performance area, undersea cinema, etc. The underwater world shows the development process of Chinese aquariums. From ancient Chinese palace-style aquariums to tropical rain forests that simulate nature, you can enjoy bright colors and petite coral fish and freshwater tropical fish, all kinds of jellyfish in the jellyfish pavilion, and you can also see people and sharks dancing together and "mermaid" performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch a wonderful show in the undersea tunnel

attractions.name: 紫金山昆虫博物馆
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Purple Mountain Insect Museum is a natural themed museum that integrates insect taxonomy research, insect ecology exhibition, and natural science education. The Nanjing Purple Mountain Insect Museum has been completed at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. The main exhibition areas include the Prologue Hall, Nanjing Local Insect Hall, Insect Diversity Hall, Lepidoptera Insect Hall, Insect Culture Hall, Insect Behavior Hall, Social and Aquatic Insect Hall, and Live Insect Exhibition Area. Through natural ecological simulation landscaping, multimedia technology applications, large-scale live ecological boxes, etc., the museum showcases the basic forms, living environments, main groups, and relationships with humans of insects.

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京古生物博物馆
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Museum of Paleontology is a modern museum that integrates exhibition, collection, research, and education. It is an important base for the popularization and education of natural sciences. The Museum of Paleontology tells a story about the evolution history of Earth and life. Based on paleontological fossils, with a focus on ancient invertebrates, plants, and microfossils, it is currently one of the largest paleontological museums in the world. The museum has a rich collection of fine exhibits, among which the fossil specimens of "Chengjiang Fauna" and "Jehol Biota", including "Chinese Loong Bird", are more precious and can be regarded as fine fossils.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:00-17:00(Admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京地质博物馆
attractions.summary: Nanjing Geological Museum is located in Zhujiang Road, Xuanwu District, Nanjing. It was built in 1935. It was formerly known as the Geological and Mineral Exhibition Hall of the Central Geological Survey. It is one of the oldest natural science museums in China and the first professional museum in China with geology and mineral resources as its main content. Its predecessor was the Mineral Exhibition Hall of the Central Geological and Geological Survey established in 1913. It is the birthplace of Chinese geological science and the cradle of training Chinese geologists.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various ancient fossils
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Friday 09:30-16:30(Admission ends at 16:00),Opens at Saturday-Sunday 09:00-16:30(Admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Baijia Kitchen·Mong Kok Stew Private Cuisine

attractions.name: 重庆两江游
attractions.summary: Without admiring the night view, I haven't been to Chongqing. The Two Rivers Tour of Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous night view of Chongqing. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. The colorful lights reflect in the river, and the flowing lights are particularly tempting. The buildings of different heights along the river are arranged in a staggered manner under the illumination of the lights. And now there are also daytime boat trips available, where you can not only enjoy the night view of Chongqing, but also admire the unique landmarks of Chongqing during the day. Full text 

attractions.name: 渣滓洞
attractions.summary:
· Originally a coal cave on the outskirts of Chongqing, a small coal mine opened in 1920, and later set up as a detention center by the Military Bureau of the National Government. 
Zhazidong is surrounded by mountains on three sides and ditches on one side. The terrain is hidden, and it specializes in detaining and persecuting revolutionaries. The more famous one is "Sister Jiang". 
Zhazi Cave was repaired and rebuilt on the original site, which truly reflected the scene at that time. The atmosphere was depressed, and the instruments of torture displayed were shocking.  
The whole scenic spot is not big, so you can visit the Tomb of the Martyrs and the White Mansion together. There are also special buses arranged in the scenic spot, which is very convenient.

attractions.name: 白公馆
attractions.summary:
· Bai Mansion, formerly known as Xiangshan Villa, was originally the villa of warlord Bai Ju, and later converted into a Kuomintang prison, a two-story building.  
This is the place where the story of Little Carrot Head took place. It once held the Communist Party, and it was also the place where many martyrs died. Its historical significance is much greater than that of scenic spots. 
Divided into two lanes, left and right, you need to climb the ladder, and visit Xiangshan Villa on the left side, which is actually the place where "political prisoners" are held; Climb the mountain on the right side to visit the place where Yang Hucheng died and the place where Little Carrot Head was killed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Prototype Place of the Novel Red Rock

attractions.name: 磁器口古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town

attractions.name: 李子坝单轨穿楼观景平台
attractions.name_en: Liziba Monorail Through Building Observation Platform
attractions.summary: The monorail through building viewing platform is located on the sixth to eighth floors of a 19 story building. Every day, a scene of the monorail passing through the building and flying through the air is staged. Although tourists from all over the country and even abroad come to watch, the light rail uses low-noise inflatable rubber tires, which are quieter than the cars passing downstairs, so it will not disturb the public.

attractions.name: 二厂文创公园
attractions.name_en: Second Factory Cultural and Creative Park
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Art Districts; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as Chongqing No.2 Printing Factory, it can be said that it was once a color printing giant in southwest printing industry. 
The renovated old factory building retains the original style of the old single-family building and adds the artistic style of modern design; The combination of old and new is unique and charming. 
The movie "Passing Through Your World" was shot here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Location of "Passing Through Your World"

attractions.name: 长江索道
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly hidden gems; cable car and gondola; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The second cable car across the Yangtze River in Chongqing, known as the "First Aerial Corridor of the Yangtze River" and the "Sky Bus of the Mountain City."
- The cabin is surrounded by transparent glass, offering a panoramic view of the natural scenery on both banks during the day, and a spectacular sight of dazzling lights at night.
- A filming location for several films and TV shows, including "Crazy Stone" and "A Bite of China."
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the beautiful cityscape of the mountain city across the Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 重庆云端之眼观景台
attractions.summary: Standing higher, seeing more fully, the scenery varies by height, infinite scenery is in the sky. The "Top of Mountain City, Eye of Chongqing" Yangtze River Cableway High altitude Observation Deck is a gathering place for urban landscapes from the perspective of God. It is a popular photo spot in the Chongqing photography circle and has "Cloud Radio" and "Cloud Prayer" projects. From the indoor observation deck on the 67th floor and the apron observation deck on the 69th floor, you can enjoy a 360 ° panoramic view of Chongqing's forests and the scenery of the two rivers and four banks without any blind spots. During the day, looking up at the vast blue sky and bowing down to the continuous buildings; At night, the starry sky above and the lights of thousands of homes below provide visitors with a unique viewing experience of the Sky City "Skywalker".

attractions.name: 重庆大剧院
attractions.tag: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater
attractions.summary: It is a landmark building in Chongqing, a place where operas, plays and concerts are performed, and it is regarded as the highest-grade and most complete theater in Chongqing. The appearance of the building is very distinctive, and it will be even more spectacular if you appreciate it during the night tour of the two rivers; The interior is divided into three parts: the grand theater, the middle theater and the concert hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stage classic musicals at home and abroad

attractions.name: 两江汇观景台
attractions.name_en: liang jiang hui guan jing tai
attractions.summary: The observation deck has a long history and has witnessed the development and changes of Chongqing. Standing on the observation deck, one can overlook the magnificent scene of the confluence of two rivers and feel the magical charm of nature.

attractions.name: 长嘉汇弹子石老街
attractions.tag: Stroll through the neighborhood; Nighttime sightseeing; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
Changjiahui Danzishi Old Street is the first national AAAA tourist attraction in China themed around "open port culture and the city’s nine-level hillside terrain." It is located on Nanbin Road, which is known as the "Chongqing Bund." The old street stretches one kilometer from end to end, with an elevation difference of about 80 meters across nine levels of slopes. Visitors walk uphill through streets and alleys with Eastern Sichuan-style courtyards, passing by scattered stilted buildings and businesses.

The scenic area is set against the mountains and water, offering a combination of rich historical heritage, sightseeing, leisure, entertainment, and shopping. Key attractions include the French Naval Barracks (a national heritage site), the Madame Tussauds Chongqing (the first in Southwest China), Changjiahui Ocean Park, Yide Hall, Wang’s Mansion, and others.

This is the only place in Chongqing where visitors can simultaneously "view two rivers," "see three bridges," and "admire three landmarks." At night, the 270-degree panoramic view from the "Two Rivers Viewing Platform" offers a sweeping view of the Yuzhong Peninsula and Jiangbei District, presenting the essence of Chongqing’s nightscape. It truly offers "a complete view of Chongqing at a glance." In addition to its unique landscape features, the area is also a food haven. Along the one-kilometer old street, every few steps you’ll find "Chongqing famous snacks" and "China’s renowned shops," as well as restaurants and bars with prime riverfront views. Today, Danzishi Old Street has become the first choice for locals to relax and entertain, as well as the must-visit destination for showing out-of-town guests the charm of Chongqing.

restaurants.name_en: Zhou Xiaomang · Mala Fragrant Pot Bistro

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 反斗奇兵大本营
attractions.summary:
· This is the first theme park of "Anti-Fighting Base Camp" in Asia. 
Taking the movie "Raiders 3" as the backbone, all kinds of super-giant toys are placed in the area, and passengers are in it, such as becoming dwarfs. 
· There are three mobile games in the area: one is that guests take a bumpy ride on facilities like "dachshunds"; Another facility is a shuttle car, which picks up guests quickly back and forth along a U-shaped track with a height of tens of feet; Finally, there is a "skydiving" training tour, where guests can feel the speed of plunging down from a 25-meter platform according to their preferences.
attractions.shortFeatures: Skyward remote control car

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park presents a grand and diverse Christmas celebration in Hong Kong, creating a festive atmosphere together. Celebrate the holiday at the "West Kowloon Christmas Market" and choose global holiday cuisine and selected Christmas gifts with family, friends, and children. Appreciate the enlarged Christmas town and giant Christmas tree of the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Join the "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" global super inflatable bouncing party (November 22, 2024- Hong Kong). As winter approaches, the West Kowloon Cultural District (West Kowloon) invites the public to participate in the grand and diverse Christmas celebration event with family, friends, and children from November 22, 2024 (Friday) to January 5, 2025 (Sunday). Nine Colorful Christmas ". The West Kowloon Christmas Market will be unveiled on Friday, November 22, 2024. During the first three weekends (Friday to Sunday), six distinctive stalls will be opened on the lawn of the art park seaside first; Starting from December 12th (Friday), the market will expand to over 30 specialty stalls, located on the east lawn of the art park and the seaside platform opposite M+. The West Kowloon Christmas Market offers a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts. Surrounded by the charming Victoria Harbour scenery and lush green lawns of the West Kowloon Art Park, visitors can immerse themselves in the dazzling holiday lights and enjoy melodious live music and performances. Apart from the Christmas market, visitors should not miss the "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Parade" held by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) on the West Lawn at the seaside from November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025. The giant and dazzling Christmas tree standing over 20 meters tall in the enlarged version of Christmas Town will be transformed into a giant canvas this year, with projections of different winter festival scenes added to enhance the festive atmosphere. The Christmas town of over 10000 square feet will open on November 22, and the Hong Kong Tourism Board will also stage a total of four "Winter Victoria Harbour Water Fireworks" on the opening day and from December 24 to 26, shining brightly in Victoria Harbour. The global super inflatable bouncing party "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" will be held for the first time on December 21, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park lawn, bringing a new outdoor bouncing experience to children and kids. West Kowloon is the first stop of The Big Bounce World Tour in Asia, featuring four uniquely designed super giant inflatable amusement areas, including the "Global Super Inflatable Castle" and the Hong Kong's ultra long inflatable obstacle course. There are multiple exclusive events throughout the day, with parent-child events during the day and a night jumping party for people aged 16 and above at night. The party brings an exciting lineup of special guests and themes, inviting the public to celebrate the festival together with "day jumping and night jumping". Highlight 1 of the "Colorful Christmas in West Kowloon" event: West Kowloon Christmas Market: Visitors can purchase a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts at the featured stalls, bringing a happy holiday experience to families and young children. On designated days and times, there will be live music and performance times available: the first phase will take place from November 22nd to 24th, November 29th to December 1st, and December 6th to 8th (a total of 9 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The second phase will take place from December 12th to 23rd, 2024, and from 27th to 29th (a total of 15 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The actual opening hours will be announced again on December 24th to 26th, 2024 (a total of 3 days) from 14:00 to 23:00. Location: The first phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside Lawn. The second phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside East Lawn and M+opposite the Seaside Platform. The "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Tour" organized by the Hong Kong Tourism Board: Visitors can immerse themselves in the Greater Bay Area. Version of Christmas Town, On site, there is a winter scenery presented with colorful Christmas gifts and a giant Christmas tree. Time: November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025 Location: Art Park Seaside West Lawn 3, "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station": Both children and adults can participate in the global super large inflatable bouncing party, with bubble parties and DJ stationed on-site. During the day, it is a parent-child event, and in the evening, it is a night bouncing party for people aged 16 and above. There are special guests and themes available. Time: December 21, 2024 to January 5, 2025, 10:00-23:10 (divided into time slots) Location: Art Park Grand Lawn Cultural and Art Programs and Activities During the Christmas period, a series of art and cultural activities will be held at different locations in West Kowloon. Visitors can enjoy cultural and artistic activities while also enjoying a wonderful and unforgettable Christmas experience. Art enthusiasts can visit the two museums in West Kowloon for exhibitions. The "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Sino French Cultural Exchange in the 17th and 18th Centuries" exhibition at the Palace Museum in Hong Kong will be open to the public on December 18th, while visitors to M+can visit two special exhibitions, "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and "Guo Pei: Artistic Imagination in the Sky". Visitors can also watch weekend street performances planned by the West Kowloon Cultural Centre and other cultural events held in West Kowloon. The global touring exhibition "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition", organized by Visionairs Asia Hong Kong, will open on December 8, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park. The exhibition is presented in collaboration between digital heritage expert Histovery and the public restoration agency of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, with support from L'Oreal Group, and will be staged on the occasion of the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral. Through innovative technology, the exhibition allows visitors to experience the unique architectural treasure of Notre Dame Cathedral in high-definition historical landscapes. As Notre Dame Cathedral was engulfed in fire and reopened after five years of restoration, exploring this architectural treasure holds great historical and cultural significance. The 2024 Dahua Bank Ink Art Festival will be held from December 13th to 29th, 2024 at the Art Exhibition Pavilion and the High Lawn of the Art Park, presenting Hong Kong's premier ink art celebration to the audience. Sponsored by Dahua Bank (Hong Kong) and organized by Dahua Bank's "Art · Workshop", the Ink Art Festival will host a variety of exciting activities, including the 2024 Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award winning works exhibition, art workshops, ink themed forums, music performances, interactive installations, and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" Carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. The "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition" coincides with the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris this month, and visitors can visit the exhibition from Exhibition Art. Asia. Hong Kong (Visionairs) The Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition will be held from December 8, 2024 to March 7, 2025. Location: GF01-03 underground of the Art Park. Visitors can visit a series of exciting and rich activities, including the 2024 "Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award" exhibition and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. Location: Art Exhibition Pavilion and High Lawn of the Art Park. For more information about the activities, please refer to the organizers of the program or event. New concept stores and limited time "West Kowloon Consumption Rewards" have landed in the Art Park, providing visitors with more diverse dining options, including% Arabica's boutique coffee Honbo's signature burgers and hot dogs, Tiger Hall's delicious pearl milk tea, and local convenience store brand 852 Eight Five Two's light meals. Designated restaurants and retail stores in the West Kowloon Cultural District will also provide surprise shopping experiences during the Christmas period. On the same day, customers can redeem HKD 50 or HKD 100 cash vouchers by spending a specified amount through electronic payment (up to four different store receipts can be accumulated). For more details, please visit the website of the West Kowloon Cultural District. M+2024 Christmas Celebration Gift Series M+Store presents a series of festive gifts for museum visitors, allowing everyone to share joy with their loved ones. Selected items include exquisite Christmas gift baskets bringing high-quality food and exquisite M+products from the Hong Kong Grand Hyatt Hotel, as well as Christmas sock sets to add a festive atmosphere### Editor's note: The West Kowloon Cultural District is one of the largest cultural projects in the world, with the vision of creating a colorful new cultural zone for Hong Kong on a 40 hectare reclaimed land adjacent to Victoria Harbour. There are various theaters, performance spaces, and museums within the cultural zone that produce and host exhibitions, performance programs, and cultural and artistic activities; And it will provide 23 hectares of public space, including a two kilometer long seaside promenade. attractions.name: 浅水湾
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 尖沙咀
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Tsim Sha Tsui is located at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, facing Victoria Harbour and across the sea from Central, Hong Kong Island. It is the "geographical center" of Hong Kong. 
There are many famous scenic spots in Hong Kong, such as Avenue of Stars, Victoria Harbour, Kowloon Park, etc., which are all must-check-in places for tourists to come to Hong Kong. It is also a good place to see the night view. Victoria Harbour and Avenue of Stars are good choices. 
· It is the most prosperous shopping paradise in Hong Kong, with various large shopping malls, duty-free shops, international brand stores, etc. to meet all the needs of one-stop shopping. 
· There are also cultural places such as the Hong Kong History Museum, the Hong Kong Science Museum and the Hong Kong Cultural Center, which are good choices for parent-child tours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping paradise on the shore of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: M+
attractions.summary: M+is the first global contemporary visual culture museum in Asia, located in the West Kowloon Cultural District of Hong Kong. M+Museum is dedicated to collecting, showcasing, and interpreting visual art, design and architecture, mobile imagery, and Hong Kong visual culture from the 20th and 21st centuries. 【 Ticket Information 】 M+Standard Ticket for Visiting M+Standard Ticket Exhibition M+Special Exhibition Ticket: "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" You can visit "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and M+Standard Ticket Exhibition 【 Exhibition Content 】 Special Exhibition "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" (Extended until January 5, 2025) I.M. Pei (1917-2019) Large scale Retrospective Exhibition "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture", which will examine the works of this Chinese American architect in great detail. Shan Mingshui should start from the traditional Chinese concept of "mountains and waters" and explore the relationship between humans and nature in terms of "objects, space, and interaction". The design and architecture of "M+Hick Collection: Biography" explores the style and practice of contemporary Chinese art from the 1990s to the present through visual means. The multimedia center, large steps (excluding ticket holding activities), B1 floor of the building, and rooftop garden are open to the public for free visit. Shi Hanrui: Transforming Pictures into Words (exhibition until November 10, 2024) showcases the works of Shi Hanrui (born in 1934), known as the father of graphic design in Hong Kong, during his decades of flourishing development. attractions.name: 旺角
attractions.summary:
· One of the most popular areas in Hong Kong, where fashion, traditional culture, city style, snacks and delicious food are all gathered. 
There are many theme streets, such as Goldfish Street, Sneaker Street, Women's Street, Gun Street, Electric Street, etc. You can have fun until dawn in the early morning. 
· It is a shopping mecca in the hearts of young people, with cosmetics chain stores, electronic and digital stores and well-known upstairs bookstores; Garden Street and so on. 
· It is famous for its many snack bars, including Japanese baked wheat cakes, German sausages, desktop drinks, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Bustling shopping district with many characteristic blocks

attractions.name: 油麻地
attractions.summary:
· Located in the middle of Kowloon Peninsula, Hong Kong, closely connected with Mong Kok, together with Tsim Sha Tsui, it forms the "Yau Tsim Mong" district. 
· This is the early territory of Kowloon, where the famous Tin Hau Ancient Temple and Temple Street are located. 
Compared with Mong Kok, it has a more Hong Kong flavor, and it is a place to explore the old life of Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: Localized area with strong Hong Kong flavor

attractions.name: 铜锣湾
attractions.summary:
Causeway Bay is a very prosperous place in Hong Kong, with a complete range of shops and department stores. It can be said that it is five steps to one shop and ten steps to one shop. In just 15 minutes, you can pass through more than ten shopping malls of different sizes. It is a good shopping place. 
· The choice here is also very diverse, from large department stores and boutique stores to stalls selling cheap goods. The prices of goods range from tens of Hong Kong dollars to tens of thousands of dollars. People are rich and frugal, enough to spend a whole day shopping. 
· If you like internationally renowned brands, you can visit Lee Garden Phase I/II, Hysan Place, Lee Stage and Fashion Walk; If you are looking for mid-to-high-end goods, you can go to Times Square, Sogo Department Store and wtc more World Trade Center; If you don't like large shopping malls and want to find young fashionable clothes, go to Kimberly Shopping Mall; The hot spot for sales of cheap clothes and groceries is naturally Jardine Square. 
When walking in Causeway Bay, be sure to take the ding-ding car once. The ding-ding car runs slowly, and you can hear the "thud-dang-dang" sound caused by the friction between the axle and the track when you pass by. Whenever you stop, you must first make a "ding-ding-ding" prompt sound.
attractions.shortFeatures: A commercial block integrating shopping, food and nightlife

attractions.name: 赤柱
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; City Walk; Seashores; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
· It is a beautiful town at the southern tip of Hong Kong Island. It was once a British military stronghold and the administrative center of Hong Kong Island. 
· Stanley Main Beach and St. Stephen's Bay are frequented by tourists. Whenever the sun rises, the glow forms a red column on the water surface, which gains the reputation of "Stanley Morning Glow". 
The landmark buildings are Murray Building and Bugong Pier. Murray Building retains the classical Victorian architectural style and is a good choice for shooting retro blockbusters. 
· Most of the goods sold in Stanley Market are tourist souvenirs, such as postcards, T-shirts and accessories printed with Hong Kong scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll Beach Surf BBQ

attractions.name: 浅水湾
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 山顶凌霄阁摩天台428
attractions.summary: This is the Lingxiao Pavilion located on the locally elevated 360 degree observation deck, also known as the Skyscraper 428. Tourists can stand on the observation deck at an altitude of 428 meters and overlook the beautiful scenery of Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 中环
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Central is the political and commercial center of Hong Kong. Many banks, multinational financial institutions and foreign consulates are located in Central. 
· All kinds of skyscrapers and shopping malls are all over Central, with gorgeous lights and neon lights. 
· Popular shopping malls such as Landmark Plaza, Jiaxuan Plaza, Prince Building, Alexander Building and International Financial Center Shopping Mall gather designer brands and international palace-level brand stores. 
· The landscape of Central is a mixture of colonial architecture and modern high-tech buildings. Hong Kong's iconic buildings such as Legislative Council Building, Bank of China Tower and IFC International Financial Center in Central are also located here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong Political and Business Centre

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 西环钟声泳棚
attractions.summary: The Western Ring Swimming Pool was a place for citizens to swim in the 1960s and 1970s. It had a long wooden bridge, some bamboo sheds, and a rudimentary changing room, which could be said to be the public swimming pool of that time. Nowadays, there are very few people who come to swim at the Western Ring Swimming Pool. Most of them come to fish on weekdays, and the sunset here is beautiful. It not only attracts photography enthusiasts, but also many couples come to play and couples come to take wedding photos.

attractions.name: 香港电车叮叮车
attractions.summary: Dingding is an integral part of the bustling streets of Hong Kong, and it is also the only double decker tram in the world. The route of Dingding car is in the bustling commercial center of Hong Kong, passing through the western, upper, central, Wan Chai, Tai Koo, Shau Kei Wan and the Victoria Harbour coast. This ancient mode of transportation, which is only found on Hong Kong Island, is actually a type of tram. It is famous for the sound of "ding ding, ding ding" when the driver steps on the scooter while driving, so people call it Dingding car. The tram currently operates 6 partially overlapping routes connecting Kennedy Town to Shau Kei Wan, with an average tram arriving at the station every 1 minute and 30 seconds. The 6 main routes are as follows: 1. Shau Kei Wan to Sheung Wan Market (there are special trips between Shau Kei Wan and Kennedy Town during peak hours from Monday to Friday); 2. From Shau Kei Wan to Happy Valley; 3. North Point to Shek Tong Tsui; 4. Happy Valley to Kennedy Town; 5. Causeway Bay to Kennedy Town; 6. From Sheung Wan Market to Kennedy Town (only available during peak hours from Monday to Friday). Please refer to the official website for the detailed operation route diagram of Dingding car.

attractions.name: 庙街夜市
attractions.summary:
It used to be the shooting venue of many films such as "New Love" and "God of Cooking", which contains authentic Hong Kong feelings. 
· The stalls sell a wide variety of items, including men's clothing, handicrafts, tea sets, jade, antiques, and even cheap electronics. 
The only remaining food stalls in Hong Kong are retained, the pillars covered with various small advertisements, and the shaking head fans covered with grease are still swaying tirelessly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shooting location of God of Cooking

attractions.name: 兰桂坊
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: Lan Kwai Fong (Lan Kwai Fong), in a narrow sense, refers to an L-shaped uphill trail located in the Central District of Hong Kong, named "Lan Kwai Fong" (taking the meaning of Lan Kwai Tengfang). Broadly speaking, it refers to a mid-to-high-end consumption area with D 'Aguilar Street, Wellington Street, Wyndham Street, He'an Lane, Renshou Lane and Ronghua Lane, where there are many foreigners, mostly white-collar workers, which is the biggest feature of Lan Kwai Fong. Every day from 17:00 to 20:00 is the "happy hour" time, and the bar is crowded with white-collar workers who get off work. Drinks are also cheaper at this time than at night. From 9 o'clock in the evening, many fashionable young people and foreigners come to the bar to drink and entertain, feast and feast, and the night becomes more and more exciting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong Nightlife Resorts

restaurants.name_en: Tapeo: Bar De Tapas y Vino

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 东林书院
attractions.summary: Donglin Academy was established in the first year of the Zhenghe era of the Northern Song Dynasty, in 1111 AD. It was a place where the famous Neo-Confucian scholar Yang Shi, a direct disciple of Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi, lectured for a long time. The academy was later abolished. In the 32nd year of the Wanli reign of the Ming Dynasty, in 1604 AD, it was revived and renovated by Donglin scholars such as Gu Xiancheng. They gathered people here for lectures, advocating the spirit of "reading, lecturing, and loving the country," which received widespread response from scholars across the country and gained great fame. Donglin Academy became a cultural hub in the Jiangnan region and a major center for public discourse on national affairs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the peaceful scent of books

attractions.name: 三国水浒景区(中央电视台无锡影视基地)
attractions.name_en: CCTV Wuxi Movie & TV Production Base
attractions.summary: Wuxi Film and Television Base is a direct subsidiary of Zhongshi Media Co., Ltd. (stock code: Zhongshi Media 600088). The Wuxi Film and Television Base was founded in 1987, covering an area of approximately 1200 acres, with a usable water area of about 3000 acres. The Three Kingdoms Water Margin Scenic Area, to which it belongs, is a large-scale film and television filming base built for the historical masterpieces "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" and "Water Margin". It is the earliest theme scenic area in China that perfectly combines historical culture, film and television culture, and tourism culture, and is also one of the first national AAAAA level tourist attractions. The Three Kingdoms City and the Water Margin City are in a superior geographical position. With a panoramic view of the vastness of the Taihu Lake Lake and the verdant Junzhang Mountain on their backs, they enjoy the charm of the Taihu Lake Lake. The buildings in the scenic area are magnificent, ancient and dignified, and staggered. The main attractions include the Wu Palace, Taoyuan, Ganlu Temple, Caoying Water Village, Zishi Street, Qingming Shanghe Street, Song Palace, Liangshan Juyi Hall, etc. The spectacular performance program is a highlight of the scenic area. The large-scale horse battle performance "Three Heroes Fighting against Lu Bu" reproduces the war scenes of the Three Kingdoms period with golden spears, iron horses, and fierce competition. Its grand performance scene and stunning horse fighting performance have won the hearts of countless audiences. The film and television special effects performance "Fighting and Killing Ximen Qing" reproduces the wonderful story of Wu Song avenging his brother and fighting and killing Ximen Qing. The performance reveals to visitors the secrets of special effects commonly used in film and television filming, such as flying figures, aerial fights, burning people, and fireworks explosions, which are displayed one by one in the program; The dazzling stage play "Ode to the Goddess of Luo" focuses on classic poetry, famous essays, and timeless paintings. It uses artistic forms such as dance, instrumental music, and recitation to integrate stage design, visual effects, lighting, and sound effects, providing visitors with a legendary journey through time and space, leading the public to enjoy the masterpiece together... These wonderful performances that have been performed for many years in the Three Kingdoms Water Margin Scenic Area showcase well-known and popular classic stories from historical classics. The participating projects in the scenic area are diverse and colorful. Touring the Taihu Lake Lake by ancient boat, Zhuge Liannu, Bagua Formation, Water Army Training Camp and other activities are full of fun and make people linger. As a famous film and television production base in China, this place has hosted the filming of thousands of domestic and foreign films and TV dramas, such as "Romance of the Three Kingdoms", "Water Margin", "Emperor Tang Ming", "Great Ming Palace Poetry". Wuxi Film and Television Base warmly welcomes domestic and foreign tourists and film and television production teams with scientific management, high-quality services, innovative products, and complete film and television shooting facilities! Full text 

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

restaurants.name_en: Jinling Grand Hotel Golden Bay Buffet Restaurant
Chinese Restaurant at the Paramita Hotel

attractions.name: 西双版纳滨江公园
attractions.summary:
--Riverside Park in Xishuangbanna is located on the south bank of Lancang River in Jinghong City. It is permeated with rich ethnic customs and shows us beautiful pictures of dazzling and uncanny workmanship. 
--The park has the comfort and carefree comfort of "quiet in the middle of the noise, quiet in the middle of the noise, and winding paths leading to seclusion". It is indeed a good place for citizens and foreign tourists to relax, entertain and take a walk.  
--On the floor about 20 meters in front of the main entrance of the park, a map of Xishuangbanna is cast with copper, which is refreshing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Filled with rich ethnic customs

attractions.name: 澜沧江风光
attractions.summary: The Lancang River originates from Tanggula Mountain on the Qinghai Plateau and flows out of the country through Xishuangbanna. The natural scenery and cultural landscape from Jinghong to Olive Dam are the best, where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Xishuangbanna. Tourists can enjoy the scenery of the Lancang River by boat. From Jinghong, they can take a boat down to the border of China, Laos, and Myanmar via the Olive Dam. The riverbank is lined with reefs, and the scenery is infinitely beautiful. You can also watch local specialty dances on board and experience the local customs. There is a saying in the local area that goes: "If you don't go to Xishuangbanna in Yunnan, you don't count as having been to Yunnan; if you don't take a boat tour of the Lancang River in Xishuangbanna, you don't count as having been to Xishuangbanna; if you don't go up the rocks to enjoy the scenery of the Olive Dam on the Lancang River by boat, you won't feel the beauty of the Dai villages. Full text 

attractions.name: 澜沧江
attractions.summary: The geomorphic types of the drainage basin are complex and diverse. The Lancang River is a typical river flowing from south to south. With the flow of the river from north to south, it flows through Qinghai, Xizang and Yunnan provinces.

attractions.name: 湄公河·六国水上市场
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Water Activities; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The floating market project shows the unique cultural customs of the six countries in the Mekong River Basin (China, Laos, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia and Vietnam), and creates relevant life scenes in the six countries (mainly Dai and Thai). It is the only floating market with Southeast Asian customs in China. Visitors can also shuttle through the floating market by boat and experience the floating market by boating.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bustling market with Southeast Asian sentiment

attractions.name: 景洪市大金塔寺
attractions.name_en: The Great Pagoda Temple of Jinghong
attractions.summary: Jinghong Pagoda, also known as Myanmar Pagoda, is located next to the roundabout of Xuanwei Avenue in Jiangbei section of Cangjiang New District, Jinghong City. The Jinghong Golden Pagoda stands at 66.6 meters tall, symbolizing the connection of one river to six countries. The four small pagodas are solid pagodas, while the large pagoda serves as the Beiye Jing Museum. It has two levels of usable space and four entrances in the east, west, north, and south directions. Around the central tower pillar, there is a worship of Zhou Buddha for visitors to pray for blessings.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 曼听公园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
