attractions.name: 野象谷索道
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Wild Elephant Valley is located within the Mengyangzi Nature Reserve and the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve, 22 kilometers away from Jinghong City. It is a national park in China with animal and environmental protection as its main themes. According to archaeological discoveries, Asian elephants were widely distributed in the Yangtze River Basin, Guangdong and Guangxi provinces, and even as far north as the Yellow River Basin. With the harsh climate and geographical environment, Asian elephants were forced to migrate southward. Currently, Xishuangbanna is the habitat of Asian elephants in China. The Wild Elephant Valley, located at the junction of the east and west areas of Mengyang Nature Reserve, is the central channel for the exchange and gathering of wild Asian elephants living in the two areas. The Wild Elephant Valley offers a variety of tourist attractions, including high-altitude observation trails, rainforest sightseeing cable cars, Asian Elephant Museum, Asian Elephant Breeding Base, and Asian Elephant Performance School, allowing visitors to safely observe Asian wild elephants and their living environment without disturbing their daily lives. It has become a place in China where visitors can communicate closely with Asian wild elephants and is known as the "bridge between humans and Asian wild elephants". Wild Elephant Valley is rich in natural resources, gathering tropical rainforests, subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forests, and numerous rare animal and plant populations. It is a comprehensive ecological tourism scenic spot that integrates ecological tourism, scientific research and teaching, and leisure vacation. It has won many honorary titles, such as the first batch of "National Ecotourism Demonstration Area" in China, and the gold medal of "50 places worthy of foreigners to visit in China". At the same time, Wild Elephant Valley also undertakes multiple ecological conservation research projects, such as the "National Science Popularization Education Base", "China Yunnan Asian Elephant Source Breeding Base" (a cooperative project between Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve Administration and World Wildlife Fund WWF), and Xishuangbanna Wild Butterfly Breeding Research Base. Full text 

attractions.name: “澜沧江·湄公河之夜”歌舞篝火晚会
attractions.name_en: Singing Dancing Fire Evening Party of The Lancang-Mekong River
attractions.summary: The Lancang River is one of the twelve major rivers in the world, originating from the Tanggula Mountains on the Qinghai Tibet Plateau, with a total length of over 4880 kilometers. It flows through China, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, and from Vietnam into the South China Sea. It is a golden waterway for China to enter Southeast Asian countries. The main ethnic group is the Dai ethnic group, and the "Water Splashing Festival" in mid April every year is a traditional festival of the Dai ethnic group. Due to historical and geographical reasons, the Dai ethnic group is divided into "Shui Dai", "Han Dai", and "Hua Yao Dai". The "Lancang Mekong River Night" Song and Dance Bonfire Evening focuses on showcasing the ethnic customs, dance culture, clothing culture, and food culture of Xishuangbanna and various countries in the Lancang Mekong River Basin to tourists. It integrates tourists' participation in amusement and has become a carrier for the park to showcase ethnic culture to the outside world, receiving widespread praise from all sectors of society.

attractions.name: 勐远仙境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Geological Sites; Villages
attractions.summary:
Mengyuan Wonderland is located in the Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve in Yunnan, within the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, and is one of the first pilot health and wellness towns in Yunnan Province. It is also one of the 20 key cultural and tourism projects in the province.

Mengyuan Wonderland covers an area of approximately 16.4 square kilometers, with a total investment of around 4.8 billion yuan. The project aims to build a world-class "health living destination" and focuses on creating a flagship health and wellness project for Lancang-Mekong cooperation. The development targets high-net-worth individuals and is driven by four major sectors: health and wellness, tourism, study tours, and sports. The project is positioned as "Rainforest Spirit Cave, Health and Wellness Paradise," with plans to create a world-class air purification and detoxification destination, a tropical rainforest canyon wellness haven, the country’s first constant-temperature karst cave health therapy base, and a high-end spiritual retreat destination in China.

Mengyuan Wonderland boasts abundant tropical rainforest resources. The project is located at 21°N latitude, with an average annual temperature of 21°C. The Baojiao Cave maintains a constant temperature of 21°C year-round, with mild summers and winters, making it a natural healing sanctuary. The area’s negative ion concentration peaks at 320,000 per cubic centimeter, offering a natural negative ion bath. The Earth's magnetic field ranges between 4.6 and 5.0 Gauss, making it a natural magnetic healing environment. The small molecular cluster water flowing from the original tropical rainforest is rich in minerals like strontium and metasilicic acid.

The project offers a unique environment for rehabilitation and wellness, supported by a comprehensive ecosystem. It serves as a health and wellness destination that integrates leisure, sightseeing, vacationing, and spiritual retreat.

Mengyuan Wonderland is rich in diverse ecological resources such as karst landscapes, tropical rainforests, and unique cultural elements, including Theravada Buddhism, Baojiao culture, and the ethnic customs of the Dai and Yao people. It is a "wonderful sanctuary" for nurturing the soul and promoting physical and mental wellness.

The abundant tropical rainforest resources and vibrant ethnic culture have attracted excellent domestic and international film, television, and entertainment production teams for location shoots. Mengyuan Wonderland has served as the filming location for the BBC’s "Discovering Chinese Cuisine—Yunnan Xishuangbanna," Baidu and Discovery's "U-Live Survival Challenge," the movie "Princess Peacock" starring Tang Guoqiang, and programs like "Wild Kitchen" and "Small Chase the Ball" on Hunan TV and Mango TV.

Currently, Mengyuan Wonderland has successfully transformed from a traditional sightseeing destination to a deeper experiential tourist attraction. Its main features include experience tours, in-depth tours, thematic tours, and educational tours, making it one of the healthiest and most promising tourist destinations in Xishuangbanna’s business landscape. In addition to traditional sightseeing products such as cave tours and rainforest hiking, the project offers a wide range of popular experiential and deep-dive products, including stargazing campsite tent camping, tropical rainforest zip-lining, rainforest banquets, cave exploration, rainforest crossing, Dai architecture courses, rice field fishing, riverside hotels, farm produce picking, bonfire parties, RV camping, magnetic therapy, natural healing, cave health therapies, yoga, Tai Chi, and calligraphy. In the future, top-tier wellness resorts, health management centers, health check-up centers, air purification and detoxification services, Dai therapies, and traditional Chinese medicine treatments will be introduced as the project develops.
attractions.shortFeatures: The relatively intact tropical rainforest areas

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 榕杉湖景区
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: Rongshan Lake Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin City. It is a Lianxin Lake connected by water bodies. It is bounded by Yangqiao, with Shanhu Lake in the east and Ronghu Lake in the west. It is named after the banyan trees and fir trees growing on the shore of the lake. During the Tang and Song Dynasties, the artificially excavated moat in the south of the city was called Nanyang River. It was called Jianhu Lake in Yuan Dynasty, and the city was expanded in Ming Dynasty to become Inner Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after banyan tree and fir tree

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

attractions.name: 古南门
attractions.summary: The Ancient South Gate is located on the north bank of Ronghu Lake in Guilin City. Also known as Tree Gate. Masonry construction, 5.3 meters high, 39.4 meters long, and 19.4 meters thick. According to records, Li Jing, a famous general of the Tang Dynasty, built a city guard in Guilin after pacifying Lingnan in the fourth year of Wude (621). It is the southern gate of Guilin's "Tang City" and has been in existence for over 1300 years. According to the Ming Dynasty's "Yitong Zhi", "The banyan tree gate is also known as the ancient southern gate. According to legend, during the Tang Dynasty, a banyan tree was planted at the gate, and over time, its roots crossed the gate and twisted the ground." Ming Zhou Yude's "Record of Chongtong banyan tree gate" said, "The so-called banyan tree gate refers to the southern gate of the ancient city of Tang and Song

attractions.name: 如意峰索道景区
attractions.summary: 1、 Basic information: Yangshuo Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area is a high-altitude tourism and leisure project jointly invested and built by Shaanxi Junjing Cableway Investment and Construction Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shaanxi Tourism Group, and Guilin Ruisheng Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The total investment of the project is 260 million yuan. The scenic area is located in Meng Village, Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, adjacent to National Highway 321, 5km away from the Gaotian entrance and exit of Baomao (Guiwu) Expressway, and about 5km away from core scenic areas such as Yulong River, Moon Mountain, Shili Gallery in Yangshuo and Yinziyan Scenic Area in Lipu. 2、 Project Construction The project will build Yangshuo Mountain Top Natural Park, which is composed of the natural karst natural landscape "three peaks and two valleys" (Yuanbao Peak, Ruyi Peak, Xianglian Peak, Caixi Valley, Baihua Valley), cableway, Ruyi Cloud Top Viewing Platform, Ruyi Cable Bridge, Walk in the Forest, glass walkway Road, Digital Experience Hall and other creative landscapes. Tourists can overlook the unique karst peak forest landscape in Yangshuo from a high altitude in all directions, walk through the forest, watch the landscape of Guilin, and experience the fun of walking in the forest! The Ruyi Peak Cableway has a total length of 2012 meters. The lower station of the cableway is located in Xingtianle International Tourism Resort, and the upper station leads directly to Yuanbao Peak. The vertical height difference is 242 meters, and the one-way capacity can reach 2000 people/hour, with a speed of 0.5-6 meters/second (adjustable). The cableway has introduced equipment from POMA company in France, which is a single line cyclic unhooking gripper 8-person hanging box cableway. The overall operation and safety system adopts advanced passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 3、 Since its opening on January 6, 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area has been operating in good condition. During the operation period, the goal of zero occurrence of safety production responsibility accidents was achieved, with no major tourist complaints or incidents of malfunctioning parking, and no occurrence of fire and other personal injury safety accidents. In November 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the honor of "Top Ten Scenic Spots of Guilin City" by the Guilin Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism. On December 24, 2021, it was rated as a "Contract abiding and Creditworthy" public enterprise in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region for the year 2020 by the Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. On December 28, 2021, Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the certificates of "Safety Production Standardization Enterprise" and "Service Quality 5S Enterprise" by the China Cableway Association. In 2022, it was awarded as one of the "Top Ten Internet Famous Scenic Spots in Guilin" and "Top Ten Astronomy and Climate Landscape Check ins in Guangxi", and was selected as one of the "World Karst Science Entrance Examination Route". 4、 Sightseeing route Take the cableway up the mountain -- View Yuanbao Peak -- Experience Ruyi Cable Bridge -- View Yangshuo from Ruyi Cloud Summit -- Walk through the forest and view the peak forest landscape -- Experience the glass walkway -- Visit the "Singing in Guilin" experience hall -- Return to the mountain 1. The horizontal distance of Ruyi Peak cableway is 2012 meters, the height difference is 241 meters, and the one-way traffic volume is 2000 people/hour. The cableway system equipment is designed and manufactured by POMA company in France. The overall operation and safety system adopts good passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 2. The Ruyi Suoqiao Bridge is 142.4 meters long, 2 meters wide, and 58 meters away from the valley floor. Standing among them, one can see the Yangshuo Peak Forest in full view, and the slight swaying in the air provides a thrilling and wonderful experience. 3. Ruyi Cloud Peak is named after its ridge resembling the traditional auspicious object of the Chinese nation, Ruyi. Ruyi Cloud Peak is a 360 ° viewing platform from the highest point of Ruyi Peak, a sacred place for people to pray and fulfill their wishes, and also a viewing spot for the Linqi Mountain in the distance. 4. The forest walking path winds through the peaks and valleys, with a total length of 246 meters and a center height of 32.5 meters. It is composed of a grid structure embedded with tempered glass and steel grilles. From a distance, it looks like a graceful "rainbow" in the peaks and forests, and also like an aerial ribbon left at the top of the jungle. Walking through it, you can fully enjoy the beauty of the peak forest and feel the joy of crossing the native jungle from the sky. 5. Glass walkway glass walkway is built along the cliff wall, 138 meters long and 1.8 meters wide. Walking on it is thrilling and extremely challenging. Looking into the distance, the peaks and forests are lush, the smoke from cooking is lingering, and the countryside is picturesque. 6. The Singing Tour Guilin Experience Hall is located at the upper station of the Ruyi Peak Cableway. It is an immersive digital experience space that uses digital technology and environmental art to showcase spatial creativity and intelligent interactive experiences. It integrates karst style and ethnic cultural creativity, making visitors feel as if they are walking in the dynamic painting of Guilin's mountains and waters, creating a wonderful feeling of "people swimming in the painting".

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 阳朔月亮山风景区
attractions.summary: Moon Mountain is a unique scenery within Yangshuo, located at the end of the Ten Mile Gallery landscape belt. Moon Mountain is an arched peak with a large hole running through it below the top, resembling a bright moon that blends seamlessly with nature. Looking at this Moon Mountain from different angles, the shape of this cave constantly changes, which is very interesting. Moon Mountain is about 380 meters high, and visitors can follow an 800 level hiking trail to reach the Moon Cave at the top of the mountain. The Moon Cave has a large area, with a height and width of 50 meters each, while the mountain walls are only a few meters thick. The top of the cave is covered with stalactites of various shapes, two of which resemble Wu Gang and Jade Rabbit in the Moon Palace. In fact, Moon Mountain can be admired from a distance. Across from the scenic area, there is a rest area with a gathering of restaurants, which is one of the locations where you can view Moon Mountain from afar. Due to its unique geological environment, Moon Mountain has also become a gathering place for rock climbing enthusiasts.

attractions.name: 工农桥
attractions.summary: Yangshuo Gongnong Bridge is located in the middle of Shili Gallery, which is on the 321 National Highway. It is the essence of Yangshuo karst landscape. Standing on the Workers' and Peasants' Bridge and looking out from both sides, one can see the undulating peaks and the contrasting mountains and waters in front of them, as well as the classic landscape of "Camels Crossing the River", which is a free viewing spot. Gongnong Bridge is located at the confluence of Yulong River, Jinbao River, and Tianjia River, and is the endpoint of Yulong River drifting. This area is lined with strange peaks and has beautiful scenery. Many tourists who ride bicycles to visit the Ten Mile Gallery stop here to take photos. In the hot season, many tourists also go down to the river to tread water and feel the coolness.

attractions.name: 骆驼过江
attractions.summary: In the Yulong River basin, drifting through three connected mountain peaks on the right bank of the Li River, like a two humped camel with a necked back, it seems to be walking towards the river, known as a camel crossing the river. Qing'e Ancient Ferry is located at the scenic spot. The representative works of the famous Chinese art master Xu Beihong, "Spring Rain on the Li River" and "Crossing the Green River", were created here.

attractions.name: 漓江风景名胜区
attractions.summary: There is an article in primary school Chinese textbooks that says' Guilin's scenery is the best in the world ', which refers to visiting the Li River. The mountains on both sides of the Lijiang River are tall and straight, with thousands of shapes. They are the essence of Guilin scenery. The Li River, a hundred mile gallery ", each scenery is a typical Chinese ink painting. The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. The main ways to visit the Li River in general include taking boats, bamboo rafts, and hiking, including three-star and four-star boat tours, bamboo raft tours, and large boat tours in Xingping Fishing Village.

attractions.name: 黄布倒影
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
attractions.shortFeatures: Background map of 20 yuan RMB

attractions.name: 九马画山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 兴坪古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Rafting
attractions.summary:
· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.
attractions.shortFeatures: 20 yuan RMB back picture location

attractions.name: 燕莎热气球飞行体验
attractions.summary: Yansha Hot Air Balloon Base has professional high-altitude flight instructors to provide you with high-quality, safe, and professional flight services. Sitting on a hot air balloon and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the Yulong River from a high altitude, from a divine perspective, one can truly experience the "panoramic landscape" and appreciate the beautiful scenery of "the river is a clear ribbon of vines, the mountains are like jade hairpins". It is also possible to fully appreciate the wonder of "people living in the Blue Lotus Peak". You can also take 360 ° selfies on a hot air balloon, making your social circle envious and popular.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 伊岭岩
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Geological Sites; Caves
attractions.summary: Located 21 kilometers from Nanning city, it is a typical Karst limestone cave. Before entering the cave to admire the rock formations, visitors can enjoy a folk performance from the Zhuang ethnic group. Inside the cave, there are remarkable limestone formations such as "Double Lions Welcoming Guests" and "Seaside Park." This is a journey where your imagination will play a key role, and the full tour takes about two hours. If you have more time, you can also visit the nearby Yiling Cave and Lingshui Scenic Area; however, if you are short on time and have already visited large caves, it is not recommended to go.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Karst caves in the outskirts of Nanning.

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州古运河游船(山塘街白居易码头)
attractions.name_en: Suzhou Ancient Canal Cruise (Shantang Street Baijuyi Wharf)
attractions.summary: As the lights start to light up, the scenery along the ancient canal becomes even more enchanting. Tourists feel like they are in a water paradise under the shadow of lights, fully experiencing the unique charm of Suzhou, this eastern water city. Cruise boats shuttle back and forth, wooden boats cutting through the calm river surface, causing ripples. The night view on the water is truly charming. Standing in the tranquil and elegant environment of the mountain pond street, witnessing the wonderful night view of the Jiangnan water city, one cannot help but feel refreshed, intoxicated, and reluctant to leave.

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"
