attractions.name: 南宁大明山
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Canyons
attractions.summary:
Daming Mountain in spring offers the opportunity to hike up to the half-mountain level and enjoy the flowers. In summer, you can escape the heat by hiding in its natural icebox. In autumn, hiking to the summit allows you to breathe fresh air and moisturize your lungs. In winter, the frost-covered trees and ice formations on the mountain are stunningly beautiful. 

Daming Mountain attracts numerous self-driving travelers and hikers who come to "steal a moment of leisure" and experience the changing seasons. You can wander through vast primitive forests and explore the wonders of the Luoyue culture, experiencing the marvelous "shadowless noon" phenomenon. Beneath the Tianping grassland on Daming Mountain, there are mysterious ancient symbols waiting to be uncovered.

The microwave station on the summit is an ideal spot for watching the sunrise, and visitors can also enjoy photography from the nearby platform, which provides excellent angles. 

For those who admire snowy landscapes, a visit to Daming Mountain from December to February offers the chance to stand at the peak of the southern border and enjoy the breathtaking northern scenery, with the entire mountain covered in silver and adorned with jade-like trees and flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Spring flowers, summer waterfalls, autumn clouds, winter snow.

hotel.Hotel Name: Xia Shang Yi Xiang Holiday Hotel

attractions.name: 中山路步行街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street is the oldest commercial street in Xiamen. People often buy souvenir gifts here, and there must be exhibitions and sales activities on holidays. 
The buildings here are all arcades, with 　 and milky white as the main colors, with a strong Nanyang style. The colorful night scene and the dazzling array of snacks from Fujian and Taiwan are also a major feature of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. 
Famous snack bars include eight mothers-in-law burning fairy grass and Huang Zehe peanut soup, etc., which are worth trying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xiamen Landmark Commercial Street

attractions.name: 厦门科技馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Xiamen Science and Technology Museum is an advanced comprehensive science and technology museum in China, and it is also a popular parent-child tourist destination in China. It is known as "Science Disney". The Science and Technology Museum has five theme exhibition halls, about 400 interactive experience projects and three dynamic cinemas, attracting more than one million audiences every year.  
As soon as you walk into the preface hall, you can see the treasure of the Science and Technology Museum-the water clock, which is a water-powered timing device. Its design combines the pivot escapement mechanism invented by Su Song, a Xiamen scientist in the Northern Song Dynasty.  
A new adventure into the Discovery Hall is about to begin: indulge in the ever-changing cosmic galaxy in the time and space tunnel, an exhibit in online celebrity; Really experience a "angry crown" on the open magneto-electrical stage; Disoriented in an oversized maze of mirrors …. 
The moment you step into the Creation Museum, you feel like you have come to the future world-watching robots dance, playing chess with robots, and letting robots draw portraits of you... There is also a very popular world of light and shadow: a wonderful sea of colorful flowers, created with gestures. A different kind of fireworks fountain, discover a shadow world given "life"... 
From the beginning of entering the Harmony Pavilion, an experience space full of science and technology and futuristic sense will immediately appear in front of you. Through immersive human adventures, vivid and rich 3D animations to interesting and fun physical fitness tests, you can explore the secrets of the human body from cells.  
Come to the domestic "Intelligent Mecha" immersive experience space, and many domestic mecha interactive devices are exhibited for the first time. The secret world of the future time and space exceeds 1,000 square meters, and the future world is unfolded from this. Let's travel through time and space together and explore the unknown! In the quiet future forest, there are mecha jellyfish dancing their tentacles in the air, and flying wings with vast birds singing in the sky; The ugly "mecha dog", who has no head and slender limbs, is greeting you and performing a heel flip. 
When you come to the aquarium, you must prepare a curious heart and active brain, because there is not only an underwater world where you can use your imagination, but also a magical and interesting VR underwater adventure and AR surfing experience.  
Walking to the children's pavilion on the second floor is like opening a Pandora's treasure box, with endless fun inside: witness with your own eyes how the magic rain overcomes gravity and flows backwards from bottom to top, experience the pleasure of sliding from the big slide to the ocean ball pool, and watch the small ball kingdom. The ball climbs gears, suspends... each shows its unique stunts.  
In addition to five theme exhibition halls, there are three cinemas in the Science and Technology Museum. The dream theater that combines reality and reality, the 4D flying theater with a strong sense of story, and the 720Rider theater with a full sense of experience, you can not only see the beautiful special effects but also not miss the exciting experience during the movie watching process.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the fun of new technology

attractions.name: 厦门大学
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Schools
attractions.summary:
Founded in 1921 by Mr. Chen Jiageng, a patriotic overseas Chinese leader, it is one of the most beautiful campuses in China. 
The quaint architecture of overseas Chinese hometown in southern Fujian, lush southern plants and youthful Nanqiang students all retain their original appearance. 
The humanistic charm of Jiannan Auditorium and Songen Building, and the beautiful scenery of Furong Lake and Lover Valley are the campus corners that can best reflect the beauty of Xiamen University.
attractions.shortFeatures: A famous university surrounded by mountains and seas

attractions.name: 厦门大学芙蓉湖
attractions.summary:
The most well-known "Furong Lake" of Xiamen University is located in the center of the campus, which is the finishing touch of the whole campus planning. 
Chen Jiageng's son-in-law Li Guangqian's hometown is Furong Township, Nan'an. Li Guangqian has made great contributions to the construction of Xiamen University campus, so many buildings on the campus have been added with "Furong". 
Furong Lake has beautiful scenery, and there are black swans in the lake. It is the shooting location of "Let's Watch the Meteor Shower Together" and the best tourist destination of Xiamen University.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the black swan under the century-old willow tree

attractions.name: 胡里山炮台
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located near Xiamen University, it was founded in 1894 during the 20th year of the Guangxu era in the Qing Dynasty, and is now a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The total area of the fort is over 70,000 square meters, divided into the battle area, barracks area, and rear area, with hidden tunnels, ammunition depots, soldier quarters, officer's office, and more inside.
- The structure is a combination of a semi-bunker style and a semi-city wall style, featuring architectural styles from both Europe and China's Ming and Qing Dynasties, making it very beautiful.
attractions.shortFeatures: A blend of European and Ming-Qing styles.

attractions.name: 厦门双子塔
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Xiamen Twin Towers is a new landmark in Xiamen. Two independent towers are connected by podiums, which look like sails and incorporate the visual elements of Xiamen's flower "bougainvillea". 
One of them is a five-star hotel and a top office building, the other is a SOHO office building, and the podium building is built into a comprehensive commercial building integrating shopping, leisure, entertainment and catering. 
Be sure to board the Xiamen Viewing Hall on the Yunshang on the 55th floor to experience the invincible 360 view. Overlooking Gulangyu Island and overlooking the whole Ludao customs, it is beautiful. 
The sightseeing hall also has a coffee room, selling all kinds of special souvenirs, handicrafts, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: The 55th floor sightseeing hall overlooks Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 云上厦门观光厅
attractions.tag: Observation deck; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shimao Yunshang Xiamen Sightseeing Hall stands on the 55F of Tower B, Shimao Strait Building, Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, and has the highest altitude view in Xiamen. The sightseeing hall of about 1,300 square meters integrates high-altitude vision, multimedia interaction, leisure and entertainment. At an altitude of about 300 meters, you can overlook Gulangyu Island, the sea garden, and Xiamen-Hong Kong area, which is "the richest Xiamen flavor". Wanshishan, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Huandao Road and other "Old Xiamen" business cards can be seen at a glance. Kinmen Island and Taiwan Province Strait, which are separated only by a strip of water, have a panoramic view. Shimao Yunshang Xiamen Sightseeing Hall looks at the mountains, the sea, the garden and the waves from a unique perspective, where you can enjoy the pure "private house" sea and sky scenery. 
B1F Ticket Hall-Multimedia Interaction 
There is a wonderful Preshow and cool multimedia interaction on the way to buy tickets. The ultra-high-speed elevator can reach the 55F sightseeing hall in only 45 seconds, opening the long-awaited high-altitude sightseeing experience at speed. 
55F Sightseeing Hall-360 ° transparent viewing platform 
Rotate Xiamen's charming customs 360 degrees, overlooking the graceful city through floor-to-ceiling windows. Famous scenic spots in Xiamen, such as Gulangyu Island, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Shapowei, Yanwu Bridge, Baicheng Beach and Hulishan Fort, can be seen at a glance, and enjoy the shock of 300 meters at an altitude. 
View Restaurant-Exclusive starry cuisine 
While enjoying delicious food at leisure, you can see the vigorous waves of the vast sea at a glance, which is pleasing to the eye, and you can enjoy different delicious food and quiet time. 
VR interactive experience-fantasy is just around the corner 
Immersive swimming explores in the clouds, swimming in the ocean world like a dream, and feeling the high-altitude tour around the Twin Towers. High-tech VR interaction brings you a brand-new immersive and wonderful experience. 
High-altitude glass box-a challenge for the brave 
A new perspective for the brave! Step on the high-altitude glass box and feel the trembling 300 meters under your feet, which stimulates your eyeballs and challenges your heartbeat. 
Air Shop-Bringing Xiamen on the Cloud Home 
Postcards, commemorative shirts, Taiwan Province accompanying gifts, Xiamen souvenirs, and cute themed cute things bring home the beautiful memories of Xiamen on the clouds.  
High-altitude telescope-start mysterious exploration 
Explore the beautiful scenery of Xiamen through a telescope. When the weather is fine, you can also overlook Kinmen. Wandering at the low place VS overlooking at the high altitude will tell you a complete story of Xiamen and take you to enjoy the charming scenery of Xiamen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the shocking scenery at an altitude of 100 meters

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gulangyu Island is home to over a thousand buildings with a variety of styles, blending both Chinese and Western architecture. There are temples with traditional Chinese flying eaves and curved corners, Minnan-style courtyard houses, the Bagua Tower with a combination of Chinese and Western elements, small and delicate Japanese-style houses, 19th-century European consulates from Western countries, and the Shuzhuang Garden, which is considered a gem of Jiangnan classical gardens. It can be called an exposition of world architecture.

In recent years, several new buildings have been completed, including the former Gulangyu Park transformed into an Underwater World, the tall statue and relief of Zheng Chenggong in Haoyue Park, the marble statue of renowned Chinese gynecologist Lin Qiaozhi in Yuyuan, the subtropical plant introduction garden at Huijiao, with its shrubs, flowers, and fragrant palms, the Xiamen Museum displaying the city's thousand-year history and the development of its special economic zone, the Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall honoring the hero’s achievements, as well as Yanping Park, Gangzihou Swimming Pool, Zhongshan Library, People’s Stadium, and the Gulangyu villas with garden-style architecture, Guanhaiyuan Resort, Gulangyu Hotel, and more. With so many parks and buildings in just 1.78 square kilometers, the density of these structures is likely rare even in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: World Architecture Expo

attractions.name: 日光岩
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
attractions.summary:
· Sunlight Rock is the highest peak of Gulangyu Island and the iconic scenic spot of Gulangyu Island. 
Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 钢琴博物馆
attractions.summary:
· Tingtaoxuan, located in Shuzhuang Garden, Gulangyu Scenic Spot, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, houses many pianos with a long history. 
It is divided into the first hall and the second hall. There will be regular piano explanations in the hall, and there will be piano performances from time to time in the hall. 
As a decoration, candlestick lamps have a history of more than one hundred years. Visiting the Piano Museum is equivalent to browsing the history of piano development in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the strangely shaped clavichord
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 皓月园
attractions.summary:
Located in the east of Gulangyu Island, it was built to commemorate Zheng Chenggong's historical achievements in expelling Dutch barbarians and recovering Taiwan Province. 
The name of Haoyue Garden is taken from the word "Haoyue" in Zheng Chenggong's poem "I can't sleep when I miss you, but the bright moon is plain". 
The most eye-catching thing in the park is undoubtedly the statue of Zheng Chenggong, which is 10 times tall. 
Haoyue Garden is very close to Xiamen Island, and it is the best place to watch and shoot the Jinmao Twin Towers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Statue garden commemorating national heroes
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:00-17:30,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:00-18:00

attractions.name: 厦门方特梦幻王国
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Cultural and technological theme park with high technology as its main form of expression, a large-scale high-tech fourth-generation theme park built by Shenzhen Huaqiang Group with huge investment. 
Science fiction and interactive experience are the biggest features. It skillfully integrates international fashion elements such as animation cartoons and movie stunts with Chinese traditional culture, and is known as the Oriental Dream Park and the magic of Asian science fiction.  
There are more than a dozen large-scale theme project areas in the park, such as Jungle Story, Decisive Battle of Jinshan Temple, Light of Life, Magic Castle, etc., which guarantee you to have fun. 
Among them, the story of the jungle is a large-scale original magic stage play. Visitors who like to watch stage plays should not miss it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Focus on science fiction interactive experience

attractions.name: 浅水湾
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 香港大学美术博物馆
attractions.name_en: University Museum and Art Gallery, The University of Hong Kong
attractions.summary: The University of Hong Kong Art Museum is the oldest museum in Hong Kong. It was founded in 1953 and was first called the "Feng Pingshan Museum." The building it occupies originally belonged to the "Feng Pingshan Chinese Library" that was opened in 1932. Both are named after the donor of the building. By 1994, the museum was renamed the "Hong Kong University Art Museum". In 1996, a new wing was added to the museum, and the exhibition hall in Xuzhan Hall was completed and opened. In the past 60 years, the museum has collected many China art of historical value. They are mainly divided into three categories: bronzes, ceramics and paintings. They range from the Neolithic Age to the Qing Dynasty. They also include traditional Chinese and modern paintings from the Ming Dynasty to the 21st century.

attractions.name: 西环钟声泳棚
attractions.summary: The Western Ring Swimming Pool was a place for citizens to swim in the 1960s and 1970s. It had a long wooden bridge, some bamboo sheds, and a rudimentary changing room, which could be said to be the public swimming pool of that time. Nowadays, there are very few people who come to swim at the Western Ring Swimming Pool. Most of them come to fish on weekdays, and the sunset here is beautiful. It not only attracts photography enthusiasts, but also many couples come to play and couples come to take wedding photos.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 香港会议展览中心
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary:
--The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, located at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, is one of the newest seaside buildings in Hong Kong. 
--It can be used for large-scale conferences and exhibitions, as well as two five-star hotels, office buildings and luxury apartments.  
--The venue of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony in 1997, where many awards ceremonies and music awards ceremonies are usually held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Place of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 天星小轮
attractions.summary: • Known as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, the Star Ferry has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. • It is not only an important part of the cross sea transportation system between Hong Kong and Kowloon, but also a must experience itinerary for visitors to Hong Kong. • The National Geographic Tourism Magazine once praised taking the Star Ferry to visit both sides of Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life". To this day, the Star Ferry still maintains its retro design, with wooden benches and iron fans in the cabin, giving it a strong Hong Kong vibe. At present, the Star Ferry has two ferry routes and stops at three piers, namely the Tsim Sha Tsui Central Link and the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line. Among them, the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line is more suitable for enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. Full text 

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 上海乐高探索中心
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Children's playground
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Lego Discovery Center is a super indoor amusement park made of thousands of Lego bricks. It is operated by Merlin Entertainment Group, a global family entertainment giant. It is the first Lego Discovery Center in China and the 17th Lego Discovery Center in the world. 
There are 11 theme areas, including: Lego Factory Tour, Castle Adventure, Mini World, Lego Creative Studio, Lego Friends, Depot Farm, Wonderful Undersea Tour, Magic Turntable, Lego Naughty Castle, Lego Racing Circuit and Lego 4D Experience, which provides parent-child families with an average of about 2-3 hours of rich and inspiring Lego-themed play experience. The unique concept of entertaining and entertaining allows children and parents to stimulate unlimited imagination and creativity while having fun.
attractions.shortFeatures: Children build fun building blocks with their own hands
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-18:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:45)

attractions.name: 上海大自然野生昆虫馆
attractions.summary: The Nature Wild Insect Museum is located in Lujiazui, Pudong, west of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower. Here, you can enjoy various living insects and insect specimens, including rare insects with peculiar appearances that you may have never seen before. You can also see various amphibians and reptiles, such as lizards, frogs, turtles, etc. Bringing children here will definitely broaden your horizons. The insect museum has two floors, and if you bring your children to take a slow look, it will take about two hours to finish. Please note that it may be a bit stuffy indoors in summer. Firstly, you will arrive at the upper level where there is a fish feeding area where you can feed koi and observe animals such as Yangtze alligators, snakes, and cute mini monkeys. Then, you will see various live insects and arthropods, including spiders, scorpions, bamboo worms, unicorns, and various reptiles. Coming downstairs, you can see reptiles, including various lizards, turtles, frogs, and a wide variety of butterfly specimens. Here, there are also small animals such as Totoro, rabbits, goats, owls, bats, etc. You can feed them to goats, rabbits, and even touch them. On weekends at 11:00 and 14:30, as well as during Golden Week and holidays at 11:00, 13:30, and 15:00, in the small animal display area, you can see interesting animal knowledge introductions, including Totoro, Lizards, etc. Children can also participate in interactive activities on stage.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 上海海洋水族馆
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; A Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids
attractions.summary:
- The Ocean Aquarium has three floors. After entering the aquarium, take the elevator to the third floor, then visit from top to bottom.
- It includes exhibition areas such as the China Exhibition Area and the Americas Exhibition Area, with a wide variety of marine species in each zone.
- The entire exhibition hall uses themes, images, and various effects to showcase different types of marine life.
- The aquarium also features the world's only observation tunnel showcasing the Amazon rainforest. There is also a fast food restaurant on the first floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the underwater tunnel to observe marine life.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

restaurants.name_en: Banyan Tree on the Bund-Haiyi Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 湖北美术馆
attractions.summary: Hubei Museum of Art, formerly known as Hubei Provincial Art Museum, is located on the shore of Donghu Lake in Wuchang District, Wuhan City, opposite the Hubei Provincial Museum. The main building of the art museum has 4 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. There are ten exhibition halls in the museum, making it a holy land for art enthusiasts and cultural youth. The exhibitions in the museum are updated frequently. If you want to know the exhibition plan, there are previews on the official website. You can check them before going. In addition to the exhibition hall, the art museum also has modern collection art libraries, multifunctional academic lecture halls, VIP halls, artist studios, art training centers, movie theaters, Chinese and Western restaurants, cafes and other advanced supporting service facilities. After visiting the Hubei Provincial Museum, why not come here and have a look? If you're lucky, you can also see everyone's exhibition. Alternatively, you can sit in the coffee shop here and savor art and life.

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 昙华林历史文化街区
attractions.summary: Wuhan Tanhualin is a cultural old street and also a popular check-in street with rich historical and architectural styles. In Tanhualin, you can admire old buildings, explore historical memories, visit cultural shops, and taste coffee.

attractions.name: 昙华林历史文化陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Tanhualin Historical and Cultural Exhibition Hall
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Featured exhibition hall

attractions.name: 昙华林近代教育博物馆
attractions.name_en: tan hua lin jin dai jiao yu bo wu guan
attractions.summary: The exhibition hall of Tanhualin Modern Education Museum covers an area of about 634 square meters, showcasing the rich educational resources in the Tanhualin area of Wuchang since modern times and its important role in the history of modern education in China. There are three sections in the museum: the Modern Education Exhibition Hall, the Outdoor Corridor Cultural Relief Wall, and the Tanhua Public Library.

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 落梅轩
attractions.summary: Although Luomei Pavilion is a three storey reinforced concrete structure, it looks like a wooden double eave corner, a suspended building, a supporting arch, a leaky window, a colorful lattice door and window, a wooden sculpture hanging down, a scenic door, a drum bearing stone, a ound ridge roof roof, ochre colored glazed tiles, etc., all of which give people the impression of a long history and antiquity.

attractions.name: 鹅池
attractions.summary: Wang Xizhi, a sage of calligraphy, had a geese under the Yellow Crane Tower. One day, he chatted with a scholar about geese, saying that geese are "heroes among birds, as white as snow and as clean as jade." The more he talked, the more excited he became, and he couldn't help writing the word "goose" on the ground. To commemorate this much-told story, later generations built a pool to commemorate it. Build a stone bridge on the water surface shaped like a crescent moon, and divide the pool into two petals. The south with larger water surface is Goose Pond, and the north with smaller water surface is Bailong Pond. The water surface area of the goose pond is about 600 square meters. Water lilies and Wang Lian are planted in the pond, and there are also two rockeries composed of Taihu stones. Red carp and koi fish roam leisurely in the water, and several white geese "sing to the sky", forming a beautiful natural landscape painting.

attractions.name: 白云阁
attractions.summary: In history, Baiyun Pavilion was also known as Nanlou, named after the Tang Dynasty poet Cui Hao's poem "The Yellow Crane has gone and will never return, and the white clouds have been empty for a thousand years". The Baiyun Pavilion, completed in January 1992, has a tower like appearance in the shape of a "T", facing north and south, covering an area of 695 square meters. Baiyun Pavilion is located at the top of Snake Mountain Gaoguan Mountain, about 274 meters east of Yellow Crane Tower. At an altitude of 75.5 meters, the pavilion is 41.7 meters high, only 10 meters lower than the Yellow Crane Main Building. Due to its high point in the park, it has become a landmark building that commands the east, south, and north districts. It is a great attraction for viewing the Yellow Crane Tower, the Snake Mountain, and the Yangtze River, as well as an ideal place to admire the clouds in the three towns.

attractions.name: 搁笔亭
attractions.summary: Pen Pavilion is located in the east of the Yellow Crane Tower in Wuchang, in the south area of the park, 132 meters east of the Yellow Crane Tower and 159 meters southwest of Baiyun Pavilion. A scenic spot in the southwest of Baiyun Pavilion to commemorate the story of "Cui Hao's poem and Li Bai's pen" on the Yellow Crane Tower in the prosperous Tang Dynasty. The plaque of "Pen Pavilion" was inscribed by Cang Kejia, a great contemporary writer, and the following couplet was written by Cao Yu, a famous playwright: "There was a crane before the building was raised, but there was no poem after the pen was put aside".

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 鲁迅广场
attractions.summary: Lu Xun Square is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, on the left side of Changtian Tower. There is a half body statue of Lu Xun built on the square, surrounded by lush pine and cypress trees, colorful flowers, green trees, and solemn and dignified surroundings. The square echoes the Xingyin Pavilion to the south, with one side commemorating the great patriotic poet Qu Yuan of ancient times and the other side commemorating the leader of the modern New Culture Movement, Lu Xun.

attractions.name: 行吟阁
attractions.summary: Xingyin Pavilion is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a landmark building of the entire Donghu Lake. The Xingyin Pavilion is surrounded by water on all sides, and can be reached by the Tingtao Pavilion via the Lotus Wind Bridge. The other side is connected to the land by the Falling Feather Bridge. Xingyin Pavilion was built in 1955, named after the phrase "Qu Yuan was released and swam by the river and pool, singing along the banks of the river" in the poem "Fisherman's Father" in Chu Ci. This pavilion is an antique brick and wood building, actually constructed with reinforced concrete. The pavilion is 22.5 meters high, square in plan, with four corners and a spire, three stories of cornices, covered with green tiles, antique. A statue of Qu Yuan stands in front of the pavilion, with a height of 3.6 meters, a pedestal height of 3.2 meters, and a total height of 6.8 meters. He looked up at the sky with his head held high, taking a step to walk as if he were reciting the "Tianwen" by the edge of the river. On all sides of the platform, there are beautiful trees and flowers scattered, and the island is surrounded by weeping willows and palm trees, embellished with elegance and a broad artistic conception. Inside the Xingyin Pavilion, there are columns and spiral staircases that allow visitors to climb up layer by layer. There are windows on the second and third floors for visitors to admire. Climbing up to the Xingyin Pavilion and looking around, there is even a magnificent scene.

attractions.name: 长天楼
attractions.summary: Changtian Tower is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, with the left side leading to Bitan for fish watching and the right side being Lu Xun Square. Changtian Tower was built in 1956 with a total area of 1775 square meters. It is a palace style building with a brick, wood, and cement structure. The small building has two floors, with a width of 7 rooms and a depth of 2 rooms. The building is open and clean, with interesting railings and straight colonnades at both ends, leading to the left and right pavilions. The front of the building is spacious, and behind it is a small courtyard with flower walls and moon doors that lead to the back mountain. Tourists can gaze out of the window and see the vast expanse of blue waves, wanting to catch up with the blue sky, feeling the emotion of 'autumn water grows together and the sky becomes one color'.

attractions.name: 九女墩
attractions.summary: Jiunvdun is located on the northwest bank of Wuhan East Lake in Tingtao Scenic Area. According to legend, nine women who participated in the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom rebel army died bravely here, and their remains were buried here by the villagers. At that time, in order to avoid persecution by the Qing government, it was called a pier instead of a grave. There is a 70-square-meter platform in front of the tomb of Jiunvdun, surrounded by guardrails, and a magnificent monument in the middle. The monument was built in 1952, made of granite, and is more than 8 meters high. It is engraved with inscriptions and inscriptions written by Dong Biwu, Soong Ching Ling, Guo Moruo, He Xiangning, Zhang Nanxian and others. There are six copper bells hanging at the top, and the wind blows the bells, just like the fierce battle of martyrs and heroes running on the battlefield.
attractions.shortFeatures: In memory of the nine women of the rebels

attractions.name: 可竹轩
attractions.summary: Kezhuxuan is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan. It was founded in 1958, taking inspiration from Su Shi's saying "I would rather eat meat than live without bamboo". This is an ancient architectural corridor imitating bamboo art, with single-layer eaves, blue tiled walls, colorful eaves, staggered pavilions, and winding corridors, exuding an antique charm. It stands quietly in the Cangbai Park, deep in the green shade, surrounded by emerald bamboo, elegant and unique, appearing quaint and elegant. The emerald bamboo and camphor trees exude a scholarly atmosphere everywhere. Around the Kezhu Pavilion, there are old camphor trees that have been planted for a hundred years. Behind the pavilion, there are hundreds of bamboo poles, swaying in the wind with an audible sound. There is a Zhou Cangbai Memorial Room inside the building, which displays images, texts, and physical materials related to Zhou Cangbai, including the piano used by Mr. Zhou before his death.

attractions.name: 湖光阁
attractions.summary: Huguang Pavilion is located on a small island in the center of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, north of Moshan Scenic Area and south of Tingtao Scenic Area. It is the main garden building of the central island of the lake. Huguang Pavilion was built in 1931, originally named "Zhongzheng Pavilion", and renamed "Huguang Pavilion" after liberation. The Huguang Pavilion is a typical tower style building connected to the land by a ten mile long embankment. The attic has three floors, with green eaves and antique style tiles. Ascending to the attic, one can take in a panoramic view of the surrounding lakes and mountains. The Huguang Pavilion is connected to the Xuhai Beach Bathing Beach, where visitors can climb up to enjoy the scenery and play in the sand and water below, creating endless fun.

attractions.name: 寓言雕塑园
attractions.summary: The Fable Garden is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a fable sculpture garden based on ancient Chinese fables. More than 20 ancient allegorical story sculptures with profound meanings have been built, including Yu Gong moving mountains, covering his ears and stealing bells, fox pretending to be a tiger's power, Mr. Dongguo, playing the flute for numbers, self contradiction, blind people touching elephants, playing the qin for cows, waiting for rabbits by the trees, praying with his arm as a carriage, and oil sellers. They are vivid and lifelike. Fable sculptures are mainly composed of large blocks, with various variations of characters depicted using vertical and parallel lines to depict detailed patterns. The relief group named "Yu Gong Moves the Mountain" is 40 meters long and 6 meters wide, with a magnificent momentum. These sculptures, with their antique, vivid, and simple shapes, not only bring joy to tourists, but also have a great educational significance.

attractions.name: 碧潭观鱼
attractions.summary: The pavilions and pavilions with the layout of fish watching in Bitan are ingenious, which not only reflects the architectural features of Chu's preference to build pavilions near the water, but also has a kind feeling of holding water with your hands. The winding Jiuqu Bridge is connected with the green tile pavilion, forming the most beautiful place in East Lake. East Lake has been raising goldfish since 1951, and now it has bred more than 80 varieties of goldfish, including a "red high head" with a big red hydrangea on its head; A "lion's head" with wings and a wide and raised head; "Goose Top Red" wearing silver armor and a little red tassel; The "Mo Long" covered in pure ink paint, light, brave and enchanting; Short tail, round body, colorful "five-flower egg ball" and so on. Visitors can watch fish or fish here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pavilions and pavilions with character layout

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路
attractions.summary: Lihuangpi Road and Huangpi Road are the same road. Lihuangpi Road, with a total length of 604 meters, was built in 1900 (the 26th year of Guangxu) and was built by Huangpi people, hence the name Huangpi Road. Later, it was assigned to the Russian Concession in Hankou, which was called Yima Road. Located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Because Li Yuanhong, the two presidents of the Republic of China, was a native of Huangpi, Wuhan, and was known as Li Huangpi, this road was renamed Li Huangpi Road in 1946. Lihuangpi Road is a famous "slow life" block in Wuhan, which is a continuation of Hankou's spirit and temperament.
attractions.shortFeatures: Literary and retro slow life block

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路街头博物馆
attractions.summary:
· Named after Li Yuanhong, the leader of the Revolution of 1911, there are still about 17 European-style buildings left over from the concession era on both sides of Lihuangpi Road. 
After the opening of Hankou, foreign powers poured into the concession, established consulates and foreign firms, showing an abnormal prosperity with colonial color, and became the "Chicago of the East" that the colonists forgot to leave. 
Lihuangpi Road in the center of the concession is the epitome of this humiliating history. 
Today, Lihuangpi Road Street Museum includes seventeen ancient buildings, which are marked by tablets on the street and at the end of the street.

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 开封博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Kaifeng Museum was founded in March, 1962, and its predecessor was Kaifeng Exhibition Hall. After the provincial museum moved to Zheng, it was established at its original site, Sansheng Street. Because the original building of the museum site was dilapidated and not suitable for all aspects of business, the current site was chosen to be expanded into the current new museum in 1986. The new museum was completed in September, 1988 and officially opened to the public, which became a great event of Kaifeng's cultural undertakings. The new Kaifeng Museum opened in March 2018
attractions.shortFeatures: Show Kaifeng History and Northern Song Culture
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 开封府
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Kaifeng Fu, also known as the Southern Yamen, was the administrative and judicial office for officials in the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, and was praised as the "first prefecture under heaven."
- Among the various government offices throughout history, it was the largest in scale, equivalent to the Beijing municipal government today.
- The architecture is grand and magnificent, complementing the waters of the Three Pools Lake, creating the scenic view of "Eastern Prefecture, Western Temple, Pavilion and Clear Water."
- In addition to a large collection of precious historical materials and exhibits, visitors can also enjoy performances such as the "Opening of the Yamen," "Judge Bao’s Rulings," and "Fire-Spitting Face-Changing."
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the ancient-style performance of Judge Bao solving cases.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Spring and summer 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Winter 07:00-18:30(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Autumn 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 清明上河园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gem; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A large-scale Song Dynasty cultural theme park built based on the famous Song Dynasty painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*.
- The park closely replicates the scenes from *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*, consisting of eight functional zones and four cultural zones.
- The Southern Garden recreates the bustling streets of Northern Song Dynasty’s capital, Bianjing (today's Kaifeng), while the Northern Garden showcases the Song Dynasty's royal gardens and court entertainment, with palace architecture adorned in golden and brilliant colors.
- The staff inside the park wear Song Dynasty clothing, creating a time-travel experience. In addition, there are exciting scene performances and folk shows.
attractions.shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Scenery of Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden

attractions.name: 开封包公祠
attractions.tag: Night Tour and Scenic View; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Bao Gong Temple is a restored and reconstructed site dedicated to commemorating Bao Zheng, a renowned ancient Chinese upright official and political reformer. It is located on the west shore of Bao Gong Lake in Kaifeng, Henan Province, and is one of the key attractions in the Central Plains tourist area developed by the National Tourism Administration.  

The temple consists of the main hall, second hall, east and west side halls, half-wall corridor, and a stele pavilion. Its style is ancient, solemn, and dignified. On the east side is the Lingshi Garden, which is composed of stone carvings and a waterside pavilion, elegant and distinctive. Inside the temple, there are exhibits such as a bronze statue of Bao Gong, a dragon, tiger, and dog bronze cleaver, wax figures of Bao Gong administering justice, the "Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele," historical novels about Bao Gong, Bao Gong’s career-declaration poems, the Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele, Bao Gong's family instructions, Bao Gong’s calligraphy, and an epitaph, among other historical artifacts.
attractions.shortFeatures: Song-style ancient architecture in memory of Bao Zheng.

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 翱翔•飞越地平线
attractions.summary: Come on an exciting flight and witness this magical world in an unprecedented way! Embark on the journey of "Soaring and Flying over the Horizon", feel the gentle breeze brushing your face, and fly over the treetops and rooftops. This is definitely a heart warming flying experience. On this magical journey around the world, fully appreciate the beautiful scenery along the way and enjoy the freedom and pleasure of soaring in the sky.

attractions.name: 创极速光轮
attractions.summary:
The world premiere, Tomorrowland Park shows the future world depicted in the Disney movie Chuang: War Chronicle. 
· Riding a two-wheeled speed light wheel motorcycle, tourists fly past the track under the magnificent dome, and enter the fantasy space where reality and reality can't be distinguished at high speed. 
Visitors in the waiting area can imagine the future world under the color-changing dome, and watch the speedy light wheel fly by to the infectious music. 
The giant dome is undulating, and it will be shocking even when viewed from a distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: A thrilling speed

attractions.name: 雷鸣山漂流
attractions.summary: Embark on an exciting raft journey, delve into the dark abyss, race against fierce beasts, and toss and roll in the rapids. Join the Explorer Alliance and head to the peak of the exploration island - the "Thunder Mountain" that emits a terrifying roar.

attractions.name: 巴斯光年星际营救
attractions.summary: "Buzz Lightyear Interstellar Rescue" is an amusement project from the Disney Pixar movie Toy Story series. Visitors will work together to complete the task of saving the world. The immersive experience, new storyline, and the latest shooting system will make it one of the most attractive attractions in Disneyland.
attractions.shortFeatures: Embark on an interstellar adventure with Buzz Lightyear

attractions.name: 小飞侠天空奇遇
attractions.summary:
Visitors can take the "spaceship" of "Peter Pan Sky Adventure" overlooking London and fly to Neverland. 
Under the leadership of Peter Pan, tourists have to go through a series of adventures to fight Captain Hook and his pirate crew. 
The whole amusement project is full of dreamy and animated scenes, and it is a project that both adults and children can experience. 
The queuing time varies. It is recommended to plan the trip in advance to reduce the queuing time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Set sail and fly to Neverland

attractions.name: 七个小矮人矿山车
attractions.summary:
· The Seven Dwarfs mine car is suitable for the whole family to ride together. It is based on the classic Disney animated film Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs. 
Drive tourists into a beautiful mine shining with gemstones, and meet seven dwarfs singing while working. 
Visitors can enjoy the music and animated characters of Disney classic films, and meet helpful forest animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: A roller coaster for the whole family

attractions.name: 小熊维尼历险记
attractions.name_en: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
attractions.summary: the Bear and his friends are harmonious and friendly, and life is full of fun. The cute Winnie the Pooh is recognized as a good friend. Winnie the Pooh invites you to go to the 100-acre forest for a dream adventure. You will meet Eeyore, Valley Buddha, Mother Kangaroo, Piglet, Tigger and Adzuki Bean.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the 100-acre forest with 　 the Bear

attractions.name: 加勒比海盗——沉落宝藏之战
attractions.name_en: Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure
attractions.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean - The Battle of Fallen Treasures is a heavyweight project in Treasure Cove, telling the story of Captain Jack. Realistic renderings, combined with circular giant screens and cool 3D effects, make people feel as if they are immersed in the real scene of the battle of sunken treasures. In this facility, tourists will also turn into pirates and join Captain Jack's adventure team to explore the treasures hidden by David Jones in the deep sea. Throughout the process, tourists will board a small raft that can accommodate 30 people and cross the battle zone between two pirate fleets. Disney utilizes emerging technology to present the entire naval battle to visitors. Sail and embark on a fun filled sea journey, diving deep into the sea to search for the spoils of war that David Jones has buried beneath - along the way, you will also encounter pirates, mermaids, and even creepy sea monsters. Embark on a journey with the charming pirate, the cunning and charming Captain Jack, and set sail for Treasure Cove!

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 长隆水上乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Water Parks
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Water Park has won many international awards, and its large play space and top-notch supporting facilities attract tourists from all over the world. 
The projects worth playing include "Drifting River" and "Wave Pool". There are often various performances on the center stage, which is the most popular place in the whole water park. 
· The most exciting projects in the park are "high-speed slide", "super big horn", "super big skateboard", etc., all of which are off the charts projects with heartbeat index. 
· In addition, those traveling with children can consider going to "Baby Water City", "Little Horn", "Cobra" and other scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Water night electronic music show from morning till night

attractions.name: 长隆水上乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Water Parks
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Water Park has won many international awards, and its large play space and top-notch supporting facilities attract tourists from all over the world. 
The projects worth playing include "Drifting River" and "Wave Pool". There are often various performances on the center stage, which is the most popular place in the whole water park. 
· The most exciting projects in the park are "high-speed slide", "super big horn", "super big skateboard", etc., all of which are off the charts projects with heartbeat index. 
· In addition, those traveling with children can consider going to "Baby Water City", "Little Horn", "Cobra" and other scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Water night electronic music show from morning till night

attractions.name: 漂流河历险
attractions.summary: Dear children and adults, take your children on an adventure in the drifting river jungle, through fairy tale like glacier tunnels, and experience the thrilling rock wave zone. Let's give you an endless journey of fun!

attractions.name: 超级大喇叭
attractions.summary: Novelty and excitement are must-have experiences. Friends and family sit in a four leaf clover shaped floating circle that can accommodate up to four people at a time. Starting from a platform over six floors high, they slip and fall into a huge horn like a tornado. As they slide quickly, everyone cheers to their heart's content. The large horn will spread your voice throughout the entire park, and the staff will capture exciting moments as a souvenir for you. It is especially suitable for enthusiastic and adventurous tourists who enjoy experiencing novelty.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 433米白云星空观光大厅
attractions.summary: The 107/108 sightseeing floor is the highest point of indoor sightseeing in the Guangzhou Tower. The two floors of sightseeing hall with the theme of white clouds and stars respectively have a panoramic view of the new central axis of the city and the vast the Pearl River. Each floor is equipped with a fully transparent tempered glass "suspended corridor" for aerial viewing, which is a place for taking photos and souvenirs.

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries.
