· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 【中国香港】《狮子王庆典》音乐剧
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Disneyland Festival of The Lion King
attractions.summary: Lion King Simba, Timon, and Pumbaa step out of the big screen and become the protagonists of a large-scale musical, accompanied by a series of exciting acrobatics and fire dance performances, taking you to experience the fun of the jungle! Performing at the Wilderness Theater. The Lion King Celebration is a live performance adapted from the movie The Lion King, which is very exciting and suitable for children to watch.

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园铁路
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Disneyland Railway is a small train type amusement facility in Hong Kong, where passengers can take the nostalgic steam train at either Town Street Railway Station or Fantasia World Railway Station. Experience the atmosphere and enjoy the scenery during the ride, and explore various attractions in the amusement park.

attractions.name: 反斗奇兵大本营
attractions.summary:
· This is the first theme park of "Anti-Fighting Base Camp" in Asia. 
Taking the movie "Raiders 3" as the backbone, all kinds of super-giant toys are placed in the area, and passengers are in it, such as becoming dwarfs. 
· There are three mobile games in the area: one is that guests take a bumpy ride on facilities like "dachshunds"; Another facility is a shuttle car, which picks up guests quickly back and forth along a U-shaped track with a height of tens of feet; Finally, there is a "skydiving" training tour, where guests can feel the speed of plunging down from a 25-meter platform according to their preferences.
attractions.shortFeatures: Skyward remote control car

attractions.name: 小飞象旋转世界
attractions.summary: This is a recreational activity where people can take off with small flying elephants and experience the feeling of free flight.

attractions.name: M+
attractions.summary: M+is the first global contemporary visual culture museum in Asia, located in the West Kowloon Cultural District of Hong Kong. M+Museum is dedicated to collecting, showcasing, and interpreting visual art, design and architecture, mobile imagery, and Hong Kong visual culture from the 20th and 21st centuries. 【 Ticket Information 】 M+Standard Ticket for Visiting M+Standard Ticket Exhibition M+Special Exhibition Ticket: "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" You can visit "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and M+Standard Ticket Exhibition 【 Exhibition Content 】 Special Exhibition "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" (Extended until January 5, 2025) I.M. Pei (1917-2019) Large scale Retrospective Exhibition "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture", which will examine the works of this Chinese American architect in great detail. Shan Mingshui should start from the traditional Chinese concept of "mountains and waters" and explore the relationship between humans and nature in terms of "objects, space, and interaction". attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 中环至半山自动扶梯
attractions.summary: The Central to Mid Levels escalator connects the Central business district with the Mid Levels residential area. It was built by the British Hong Kong government in 1993 to improve traffic in Mid Levels. The escalator consists of 20 one-way escalators and 3 automatic pedestrian walkways, starting from the Central Market and ending at Conduit Road. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and there are multiple exits along the way, making it convenient for pedestrians to get on and off. The Mid Levels escalator crosses multiple major streets in Central, including Queen's Road Central, Hollywood Road, and other attractions along the way, such as the old Central Police Station, making it a great means of transportation for tourists. In addition, the escalator will also pass through the SOHO area, which is filled with restaurants and bars, European style small bars, specialty tea restaurants, and souvenir shops, where foodies can find satisfying cuisine.

attractions.name: 荷李活道
attractions.summary:
· The first and most famous characteristic street since the opening of Hong Kong, it was originally a Chinese settlement. Its actual name comes from the holly trees planted along Hollywood Road in the early years. 
Hollywood Road is characterized by the combination of Chinese and western cultures in Hong Kong, and the famous Hollywood Antique Street is a well-known treasure place. Every day, many Hong Kong tourists, collectors and antiques come here to shop for treasures. 
· It is also a world-famous shopping area. Besides antiques, it also gathers world-famous brands. "If you have never been to Hollywood, don't say you have been to Hong Kong."
attractions.shortFeatures: Characteristic street with combination of Chinese and Western cultures

attractions.name: 香港大学
attractions.summary: The University of Hong Kong, abbreviated as HKU, is the earliest established higher education institution in Hong Kong and one of the most prestigious universities in Asia. The University of Hong Kong is renowned for its outstanding academic research, international campus environment, and rich campus life. There are many historical buildings and modern facilities on campus, making it an excellent place to learn about Hong Kong's higher education and culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 香港科学馆
attractions.tag: Science and Technology Museum; Science & Technology Museums
attractions.summary:
· The Hong Kong Science Museum opened in 1992. It is located on Science Museum Road, Tsim Sha Tsui. It is a three-storey building with a sci-fi appearance. 
· Among them, 70% of the exhibits can be touched and operated by the audience, which is suitable for bringing children to play and experience the effects of science and technology on society. 
The most striking exhibit is the 22-meter-high energy shuttle, which is located in the center of the exhibition hall of the Science Museum and runs through the fourth floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the charm of science for yourself

attractions.name: 香港太空馆
attractions.tag: Science and Technology Museum; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary:
· The Hong Kong Space Museum is located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon Peninsula, close to Victoria Harbour. Its unique egg-shaped design is very eye-catching. 
· It is an astronomical museum in Hong Kong focusing on promoting astronomy and space science knowledge. It is also one of the most advanced space science museums in the world. 
· The space museum has a hemispherical screen and a star projector for delivering images, which is the most advanced instrument in Asia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience space walks and rocket launches

attractions.name: 香港动植物公园
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
There are more than 1,000 species of plants in the park, most of which come from tropical and subtropical regions. Including major local and foreign varieties in Hong Kong, such as pine and cypress, fig, palm, eucalyptus, magnolia, camellia, rhododendron and spring feather. There is a "Medicinal Botanical Garden" in the south of the park, while shrubs and plants are concentrated in the fountain platform garden, where colorful flowers are often planted. The park collects and records rich animals and plants in detail. The main purpose of the outdoor learning activities is to promote the contribution of the park to fauna and flora, and to enable students and the public to have a better understanding of animals, plants, biodiversity and the environment through explanations and educational labels. 
Exit C2 of MTR Admiralty Station, transfer to a taxi and get off at the entrance of Albinley Road

Driving from Admiralty ：12A, 12M, 40M, 40P, 40 
From Causeway Bay: 23A, 23B 
From North Point: 23 
From Lok Fu: 103
attractions.shortFeatures: More than 1000 kinds of tropical and subtropical flora and fauna

attractions.name: 香港艺术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Museum of Art is located on the waterfront of Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, adjacent to the Space Museum. It is about ten times larger than the old museum. There are five floors in total. Each floor has two fixed exhibition areas, which are divided into Chinese cultural relics, Chinese paintings and calligraphy, Hong Kong contemporary art, historical paintings and Chinese paintings and calligraphy in virtual collections, etc., mainly ancient Chinese works of art, and there will be various mobile exhibitions that keep pace with the times from time to time. The equipment is advanced and perfect. There are six exhibition halls, lecture halls, outdoor plastic courtyards, art galleries and art exhibition services in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: A wide variety of ancient and modern collections

attractions.name: 高等法院
attractions.summary: The High Court of Hong Kong is a court of the Hong Kong judiciary, located adjacent to the Admiralty Government Offices. The Hong Kong High Court, which often appears in TVB TV dramas, is not very tall in architecture, but gives people a sense of solemnity and solemnity. Some publicly available cases are open for people to attend, where they can feel the majesty and democracy of Hong Kong's rule of law.

attractions.name: 香港湿地公园
attractions.tag: Natural landscape; Caves; City Parks; Wetlands
attractions.summary: Hong Kong Wetland Park is divided into two parts: visitor center and wetland reserve, and has a wide variety of animals. At the entrance of the visitor center, there are people watching exhibitions, selling goods, watching short films, and a Café de Coral selling food. There is also an indoor play area (swamp adventure), while the wetland reserve is a large wetland environment, including waterwater swamps, pools, reed beds, mudflats, mangroves, grasslands and woodlands, etc., where you can enjoy all kinds of wildlife at close range.
attractions.shortFeatures: View wetland landscape, animals and plants

attractions.name: 上海佛罗伦萨小镇
attractions.summary: Florence Town - Shanghai Famous Outlets "opened in January 2015. As the second outlet project of Italian retail giant RDM Asia in China, it settled in Pudong, Shanghai and became a popular destination for fashion enthusiasts in Shanghai and the surrounding Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions. Shanghai Florence Town has introduced over a hundred globally renowned brands, including Burberry, Armani，Bottega Veneta， Etro，Salvatore Ferragamo， Moncler，Bally，Ermenegildo Zegna，Montblanc，Max Mara，Lane Crawford，Coach，I.T，Moschino, Michael Kors, Tory Burch, Swarovski And UGG, among which 7 are for ALL MANKING, ACNE STUDIOS, CELINE, ETRO, FENDI, LA PERLA, LANE CRAWFORD, MARC JACOBS, MONNALISA, VICTORIA'S SECRET and other Outlet stores are newly opened in the East China region.

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 翱翔•飞越地平线
attractions.summary: Come on an exciting flight and witness this magical world in an unprecedented way! Embark on the journey of "Soaring and Flying over the Horizon", feel the gentle breeze brushing your face, and fly over the treetops and rooftops. This is definitely a heart warming flying experience. On this magical journey around the world, fully appreciate the beautiful scenery along the way and enjoy the freedom and pleasure of soaring in the sky.

attractions.name: 创极速光轮
attractions.summary:
The world premiere, Tomorrowland Park shows the future world depicted in the Disney movie Chuang: War Chronicle. 
· Riding a two-wheeled speed light wheel motorcycle, tourists fly past the track under the magnificent dome, and enter the fantasy space where reality and reality can't be distinguished at high speed. 
Visitors in the waiting area can imagine the future world under the color-changing dome, and watch the speedy light wheel fly by to the infectious music. 
The giant dome is undulating, and it will be shocking even when viewed from a distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: A thrilling speed

attractions.name: 雷鸣山漂流
attractions.summary: Embark on an exciting raft journey, delve into the dark abyss, race against fierce beasts, and toss and roll in the rapids. Join the Explorer Alliance and head to the peak of the exploration island - the "Thunder Mountain" that emits a terrifying roar.

attractions.name: 巴斯光年星际营救
attractions.summary: "Buzz Lightyear Interstellar Rescue" is an amusement project from the Disney Pixar movie Toy Story series. Visitors will work together to complete the task of saving the world. The immersive experience, new storyline, and the latest shooting system will make it one of the most attractive attractions in Disneyland.
attractions.shortFeatures: Embark on an interstellar adventure with Buzz Lightyear

attractions.name: 小飞侠天空奇遇
attractions.summary:
Visitors can take the "spaceship" of "Peter Pan Sky Adventure" overlooking London and fly to Neverland. 
Under the leadership of Peter Pan, tourists have to go through a series of adventures to fight Captain Hook and his pirate crew. 
The whole amusement project is full of dreamy and animated scenes, and it is a project that both adults and children can experience. 
The queuing time varies. It is recommended to plan the trip in advance to reduce the queuing time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Set sail and fly to Neverland

attractions.name: 七个小矮人矿山车
attractions.summary:
· The Seven Dwarfs mine car is suitable for the whole family to ride together. It is based on the classic Disney animated film Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs. 
Drive tourists into a beautiful mine shining with gemstones, and meet seven dwarfs singing while working. 
Visitors can enjoy the music and animated characters of Disney classic films, and meet helpful forest animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: A roller coaster for the whole family

attractions.name: 小熊维尼历险记
attractions.name_en: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
attractions.summary: the Bear and his friends are harmonious and friendly, and life is full of fun. The cute Winnie the Pooh is recognized as a good friend. Winnie the Pooh invites you to go to the 100-acre forest for a dream adventure. You will meet Eeyore, Valley Buddha, Mother Kangaroo, Piglet, Tigger and Adzuki Bean.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the 100-acre forest with 　 the Bear

attractions.name: 加勒比海盗——沉落宝藏之战
attractions.name_en: Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure
attractions.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean - The Battle of Fallen Treasures is a heavyweight project in Treasure Cove, telling the story of Captain Jack. Realistic renderings, combined with circular giant screens and cool 3D effects, make people feel as if they are immersed in the real scene of the battle of sunken treasures. In this facility, tourists will also turn into pirates and join Captain Jack's adventure team to explore the treasures hidden by David Jones in the deep sea. Throughout the process, tourists will board a small raft that can accommodate 30 people and cross the battle zone between two pirate fleets. Disney utilizes emerging technology to present the entire naval battle to visitors. Sail and embark on a fun filled sea journey, diving deep into the sea to search for the spoils of war that David Jones has buried beneath - along the way, you will also encounter pirates, mermaids, and even creepy sea monsters. Embark on a journey with the charming pirate, the cunning and charming Captain Jack, and set sail for Treasure Cove!

attractions.name: 米奇童话专列
attractions.summary: The daytime theme parade-"Mickey Fairy Tale Train" will be full of fantasy, romance, music and laughter. Many Disney friends will come to you one by one. Mickey will drive the train on the locomotive, and the subsequent dream floats are all based on classic Disney movies, bringing you familiar Disney friends and intoxicating music. Walk through the theme park of Shanghai Disneyland. "Mickey's Fairy Tale Special Train" will drive through the longest cruise route in Disney parks around the world under the leadership of a magical locomotive. Amid the exciting music, "Mickey Fairy Tale Train" will bring wonders, surprises and laughter to tourists, creating an unforgettable and wonderful experience.
attractions.shortFeatures: Interact with characters from Disney movies

attractions.name: 奇梦之光幻影秀
attractions.name_en: Ignite the Dream - A Nighttime Spectacular of Magic and Light
attractions.summary: Mickey will show you the wonderful magic of dreams and the magical power of imagination. Follow him and have a swim! Witness the miracle at the center of Shanghai Disneyland! Mickey opens the door to a brand new adventure, presenting infinite and wonderful worlds one by one before your eyes. Through thrilling projection, laser, fountain, and various other visual effects techniques, Mickey will use his magic to turn the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" into a dreamlike new world, while illuminating the dreams in all of us.

attractions.name: 上海海昌海洋公园
attractions.summary: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park has been rated as a National 4A-level tourist attraction. The park is closely centered around marine culture and is divided into five major themed areas: Mermaid Bay, Polar Town, Ice and Snow Kingdom, Underwater Wonders, and Ocean Tribe. It features sixteen star performances, including "Killer Whale Science Show," "Dolphin Romance," "Sea Lion Fun Adventures," "Beluga Love," "Marine Animal Feeding Show," "Mermaid Fairy Tale," "Water Dance Between Fish," "Town Party," "Water Flying Man," "Chinese Style Grand Event," "Flying Fairy Little Dragon Girl," "Seven Cute Adventures," "Clown Meet and Greet," "Ocean Dream Parade," "Illusory Sea Realm," and "Ocean EDM Party." The park also has six animal exhibition halls: Antarctic Penguin Hall, Marine Mammal Exploration Hall, Iceberg Arctic Hall, Underwater World Hall, Volcano Shark Hall, and Coral Jellyfish Hall. It houses over 30,000 rare marine animals, including polar bears and emperor penguins. Additionally, there are six amusement facilities: Volcano Rafting, Dolphin Roller Coaster, Time and Space Cable Car, Deep Sea Adventure, Sky Theater, and Sensory 4D Cinema. The park is also complemented by the Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel, which features five marine-themed rooms, including penguin and mermaid-themed rooms, offering visitors a spectacular oceanic dream journey!
attractions.shortFeatures: See rare marine life and enjoy thrilling attractions.

attractions.name: 深坑秘境乐园-上海世茂精灵之城主题乐园
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Shimao Elf City Theme Park is built on the deep pit of Tianma Mountain, integrating unique natural resources of cliffs and combining indoor and outdoor concepts to create a unique themed amusement park with hotel wonders in the deep pit. The amusement park has new hardware, high specifications, novel interaction, and comfortable experience. In addition, with the support of the Shimao Shenkeng Intercontinental Hotel, which ranks nearly one hundred in negative altitude, the experience of overlooking the Shenkeng Yunjing Garden in the Elf City Theme Park is commendable. This is a dreamlike paradise on earth: ancient and mysterious canyons and jungles, deep pits and ridges crisscrossed by streams and waterfalls, ancient mythical creatures soaring in the sky, and quiet tree bottom elves, all waiting here with breath holding - your grand arrival. The glass walkway in the theme park of the City of Elves is 88 meters above the center of the earth. Experience the magical realm from all angles, including the sky, pool water, and cliffs; Embark on an elegant gliding ride on the Snowy Owl, fly over deep pits, and experience the perspective of 'God' at the high point of the amusement park; The cliff hurricane swings nearly 30 meters high, forming a drop of nearly 100 meters with the lower part of the deep pit. With a speed of 100 meters per hour, it swings greatly, rotates and flips up and down, staring helplessly at the abyssal cliffs beneath its feet; Parent child experience area: The world in the eyes of children is full of infinite imagination. The architectural models here not only have beautiful appearances, but also are highly interactive, providing a platform for children aged 2-16 to unleash their creativity and exercise their physical fitness. attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries.
