attractions.name: 西九艺术公园
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park has lawns and a seaside promenade, with large areas for picnicking, playing, and playing with pets. People can also participate in outdoor activities held in the park or visit exhibitions at the M+Pavilion. The newly built exhibition pavilion near the entrance of the seaside promenade is a great place to enjoy the harbor view and sunset scenery.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 大屿山
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
· The largest island in Hong Kong, twice the size of Hong Kong Island. 
There are Tai O fishing village with traditional Lingnan style, as well as the world's largest outdoor bronze sitting Buddha Temple of Heaven and Hong Kong Disneyland. 
· There is also the Ngong Ping Cable Car, the longest double cable road in Asia, overlooking Lantau Island.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping, leisure, mountaineering, hydrophilic dream park

attractions.name: 昂坪360
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Cable car ropeway; Cable Cars
attractions.summary:
· Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car is the longest outdoor double-cable cable car in Asia, and has won the reputation of Top Ten Surprise Cable Car Tours in the World, Top Ten Best Cable Car Experiences in the World and Top Ten Global Cable Car Tours. 
· A total length of 5.7 kilometers, built on a hill, connecting Tung Chung and Ngong Ping. Overlooking the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, surrounded by the South China Sea, it connects Tung Chung and Ngong Ping Market. 
· After getting off the bus, you will arrive at Ngong Ping Market, which is connected to Po Lin Temple and Tiantan Buddha. It is enjoyed by a vast natural environment and combines Chinese architecture with diversified shopping and dining experiences. 
· In addition to shopping and dining, Ngong Ping Market also provides entertainment programs including: 360VR Experience Hall, 360 Stage, 360 Dynamic Cinema and Walking with Buddha.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the magnificent scenery of mountains and seas; Crystal cabin bottom glass fully transparent

attractions.name: 天际100香港观景台
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Sky100 Hong Kong Observation Deck is located on the 100th floor of the International Commerce Centre (ICC), the tallest building in Hong Kong. It is the tallest indoor observation deck in Hong Kong. 
· Visitors can enjoy a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Victoria Harbour and Kowloon Peninsula from a viewing position at a height of 393 meters above sea level, as far as Macau. 
· Skyline 100 has the "five best", namely, the latest scenic spot, the tallest building, the fastest double-decker elevator, the most complete landscape and the most city center. 
· The observation deck is equipped with stereoscopic projection exhibition and 3D cinema, where you can learn about the development and customs of Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: 360-degree bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 旺角
attractions.summary:
· One of the most popular areas in Hong Kong, where fashion, traditional culture, city style, snacks and delicious food are all gathered. 
There are many theme streets, such as Goldfish Street, Sneaker Street, Women's Street, Gun Street, Electric Street, etc. You can have fun until dawn in the early morning. 
· It is a shopping mecca in the hearts of young people, with cosmetics chain stores, electronic and digital stores and well-known upstairs bookstores; Garden Street and so on. 
· It is famous for its many snack bars, including Japanese baked wheat cakes, German sausages, desktop drinks, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Bustling shopping district with many characteristic blocks

attractions.name: 天星小轮
attractions.summary: • Known as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, the Star Ferry has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. • It is not only an important part of the cross sea transportation system between Hong Kong and Kowloon, but also a must experience itinerary for visitors to Hong Kong. • The National Geographic Tourism Magazine once praised taking the Star Ferry to visit both sides of Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life". To this day, the Star Ferry still maintains its retro design, with wooden benches and iron fans in the cabin, giving it a strong Hong Kong vibe. At present, the Star Ferry has two ferry routes and stops at three piers, namely the Tsim Sha Tsui Central Link and the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line. Among them, the Tsim Sha Tsui Wan Chai Line is more suitable for enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. Full text 

attractions.name: 尖沙咀
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Tsim Sha Tsui is located at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, facing Victoria Harbour and across the sea from Central, Hong Kong Island. It is the "geographical center" of Hong Kong. 
There are many famous scenic spots in Hong Kong, such as Avenue of Stars, Victoria Harbour, Kowloon Park, etc., which are all must-check-in places for tourists to come to Hong Kong. It is also a good place to see the night view. Victoria Harbour and Avenue of Stars are good choices. 
· It is the most prosperous shopping paradise in Hong Kong, with various large shopping malls, duty-free shops, international brand stores, etc. to meet all the needs of one-stop shopping. 
· There are also cultural places such as the Hong Kong History Museum, the Hong Kong Science Museum and the Hong Kong Cultural Center, which are good choices for parent-child tours.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shopping paradise on the shore of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 铜锣湾
attractions.summary:
Causeway Bay is a very prosperous place in Hong Kong, with a complete range of shops and department stores. It can be said that it is five steps to one shop and ten steps to one shop. In just 15 minutes, you can pass through more than ten shopping malls of different sizes. It is a good shopping place. 
· The choice here is also very diverse, from large department stores and boutique stores to stalls selling cheap goods. The prices of goods range from tens of Hong Kong dollars to tens of thousands of dollars. People are rich and frugal, enough to spend a whole day shopping. 
· If you like internationally renowned brands, you can visit Lee Garden Phase I/II, Hysan Place, Lee Stage and Fashion Walk; If you are looking for mid-to-high-end goods, you can go to Times Square, Sogo Department Store and wtc more World Trade Center; If you don't like large shopping malls and want to find young fashionable clothes, go to Kimberly Shopping Mall; The hot spot for sales of cheap clothes and groceries is naturally Jardine Square. 
When walking in Causeway Bay, be sure to take the ding-ding car once. The ding-ding car runs slowly, and you can hear the "thud-dang-dang" sound caused by the friction between the axle and the track when you pass by. Whenever you stop, you must first make a "ding-ding-ding" prompt sound.
attractions.shortFeatures: A commercial block integrating shopping, food and nightlife

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 苏州古运河
attractions.tag: Water Conservancy Projects; Boat Tours; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The ancient city of Suzhou has become a paradise where thousands of merchants gather due to the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal. To this day, nearly half of Suzhou's freight volume still relies on waterways, adding a unique scenery to the Suzhou Grand Canal. Here, you can walk along the Suzhou Ancient Canal for sightseeing, or take a boat tour. Along the coast, willow branches brush against the water, creating a myriad of charming scenery. The night view seen by taking a cruise ship is very beautiful, and the dazzling lights complement the architecture of the ancient city of Suzhou, blending seamlessly and enchanting, allowing you to fully appreciate the beauty and delicacy of the millennium old city of Suzhou. Along the way, you will pass through 10 ancient city gates of Suzhou, including Panmen, Xumen, Jinmen, and Lumen, as well as 20 bridges with different styles. Many bridge openings are also adorned with exquisite reliefs, which are a unique beauty that can only be enjoyed by taking a cruise ship. Different tourist tickets pass through different attractions, and the information disclosed in the ticket shall prevail. On the night tour boat, there is also a Pingtan performance with explanations along the way. While sightseeing, you can fully appreciate the historical allusions of Suzhou and feel the profound cultural connotation of the ancient city of Suzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 木渎古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Mudu Ancient Town, known as the "First Town of Wu" in the Wu region, is famous for its small bridges, flowing water, and ancient trees, offering a unique charm among many other ancient towns.  
· The town is crisscrossed by waterways such as the Muguang River, and its stone embankments create an ancient waterway landscape. The old streets and narrow alleys are home to many traditional courtyards.  
· Inside the Hongyin Mountain Villa, there is a grand stage where Emperor Qianlong watched performances during his six visits to Jiangnan. The villa also displays twenty imperial edicts from the emperor.  
· The town is a food lover's paradise, with the recommended Shijia Restaurant serving its signature dish, Fish Lung Soup, made by simmering fish liver in chicken broth. The fish liver is tender, and the soup is extremely delicious.  
· Local crafts in Mudu include silk, double-sided embroidery, redwood carvings, Chengni inkstones, calligraphy and paintings, and stone carvings, all available for purchase as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to explore the classical gardens.

restaurants.name_en: Scholarly Family Pingjiang Mansion Muxiang Chinese Restaurant
Haitian Building Chinese Restaurant, Pan Pacific Hotel Wu Palace

attractions.name: 知音号
attractions.summary: Zhiyin Hao is the world's first drifting theater created by Wuhan Culture and Tourism Group in collaboration with director Fan Yue, using a ship as a carrier. It features the multi-dimensional experiential play of the same name, "Zhiyin Hao". Unlike conventional plays, 'Zhiyin Hao' does not provide a complete main storyline, but rather creates a journey through time and space for you to travel. We will scatter every character you may encounter on your journey in the large ship, living as if they were real in various areas such as dance halls, bars, cabins, and decks on the Zhiyin ship. Between words, you can hear their stories, feel the various aspects of their lives, and have the opportunity to share your story with them. In the time of mutual exploration between you and them, meet, understand, and try to become each other's' kindred spirits'. Boarding the ship, you will embark on a real journey as a sailor on the Yangtze River with every character on the Zhiyin ship. Go aboard, actually you are also the one who brought the story onto the ship Full text 

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 编钟演奏厅
attractions.summary: The Bell Chime Performance Hall of Hubei Provincial Museum performs wonderful bell chimes every day. The Zeng Houyi Bell Chime in the performance hall is one of the four treasures of Hubei Provincial Museum.

attractions.name: 湖北美术馆
attractions.summary: Hubei Museum of Art, formerly known as Hubei Provincial Art Museum, is located on the shore of Donghu Lake in Wuchang District, Wuhan City, opposite the Hubei Provincial Museum. The main building of the art museum has 4 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. There are ten exhibition halls in the museum, making it a holy land for art enthusiasts and cultural youth. The exhibitions in the museum are updated frequently. If you want to know the exhibition plan, there are previews on the official website. You can check them before going. In addition to the exhibition hall, the art museum also has modern collection art libraries, multifunctional academic lecture halls, VIP halls, artist studios, art training centers, movie theaters, Chinese and Western restaurants, cafes and other advanced supporting service facilities. After visiting the Hubei Provincial Museum, why not come here and have a look? If you're lucky, you can also see everyone's exhibition. Alternatively, you can sit in the coffee shop here and savor art and life.

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路
attractions.summary: Lihuangpi Road and Huangpi Road are the same road. Lihuangpi Road, with a total length of 604 meters, was built in 1900 (the 26th year of Guangxu) and was built by Huangpi people, hence the name Huangpi Road. Later, it was assigned to the Russian Concession in Hankou, which was called Yima Road. Located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Because Li Yuanhong, the two presidents of the Republic of China, was a native of Huangpi, Wuhan, and was known as Li Huangpi, this road was renamed Li Huangpi Road in 1946. Lihuangpi Road is a famous "slow life" block in Wuhan, which is a continuation of Hankou's spirit and temperament.
attractions.shortFeatures: Literary and retro slow life block

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 烟台山景区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Mountains; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the northern end of the city, it integrates mountains, sea, city, and port, making it a seaside mountain park with three sides facing the sea. It is also a landmark scenic spot in Yantai.
- Within the scenic area and its surroundings, there are consulates, foreign trade firms, and numerous villas, forming the most complete and densely packed modern foreign consulate cluster in Asia.
- The lighthouse at the top of the mountain is the highest point in Yantai, and visitors can take an elevator inside the lighthouse to the 11th-floor observation deck, where they can enjoy a magnificent view of the sea, coastline, and cityscape.
- Below the lighthouse is a beacon tower, where live performances are held with actors dressed in Ming Dynasty costumes, holding torches and lighting signal fires, which are very exciting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the iconic lighthouse to enjoy a panoramic view of Yantai.

attractions.name: 所城里
attractions.summary: In the city, there is a thousand household garrison built during the Ming Dynasty. Now preserving the old house and transforming it into a tourist commercial street, it is worth a visit to learn about history and experience modernity.

attractions.name: 东炮台海滨风景区
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Seaside beach; Seashores; Military Sites; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The East Fort was named after the late Qing Dynasty. It was designed and supervised by German technicians and has a rigorous structure. It is one of the most complete coastal defense facilities in China. Surrounded by the sea on three sides, the scenic spot is mainly divided into four areas: Ancient Fort, Moon Bay, Seaview Garden and Picking Beach. 
In the scenic spot, visitors can watch the artillery drill of Qing soldiers, and they can also operate the restored Krupp cannon in person.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful seaside scenery of Yantai

attractions.name: 月亮湾
attractions.summary:
Moon Bay is a symbol of Yantai's urban charm, and it is also recognized as a romantic holy place for couples. 
Located on the coast of the Yellow Sea, Yantai Mountain on the left, East Fort on the right, close to Jiuzhang Cliff and backed by Daiwang Mountain. 
· Two headlands, one in the east and the other in the west, embrace a deep moon-shaped bay. The rocks, sea water, long embankments and harbors are integrated into one, which is spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Clear water and gentle sandy beach

attractions.name: 文成城堡
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Castles
attractions.summary:
Wencheng Castle, located next to Yanpeng Tourist Avenue, was built by Mr. Li Wencheng, an overseas Chinese from Canada, and Penglai Wencheng Architectural Decoration Co., Ltd. with an investment of 600 million RMB. The castle is a skillful combination of European architectural elements, mainly in Baroque style, and the building materials mainly based on precious cave stones carry the essence of European architecture and decorative arts, embodying a unique aristocratic atmosphere. Surrounded by a moat, it is filled with seawater, which can raise sea cucumbers and abalones, and can also be used for people to play in the water and row boats, which is full of fun. Coupled with the design of concave front and convex back, the castle presents unique variability whether it is forward-looking or rear-looking, whether it is flat or three-dimensional. Although it is only 4 storeys high, its incomparable diversity of other buildings brings unlimited imagination. The shape is elegant and generous, the round roof points directly to the blue sky, the trapezoidal and tapered roofs on both sides are interspersed with each other, superimposed and staggered, and the fireplace chimney is dotted among them, which fully shows the unique romantic feelings and heroic spirit of European technology. 
In July, 17, Mahua FunAge's team traveled all over the country to find a venue to shoot the fourth comedy film "The Richest Man in Xihong City", and finally "stepped through the iron shoes and found nowhere, but it took no effort to get it". By chance, they met Wencheng Castle, which has great European classical architectural artistic characteristics, and finally were amazed by such a unique European-style castle group in China, taking it as the most ideal interior shooting location.
attractions.shortFeatures: The shooting location of "The Richest Man in Xihong City"

attractions.name: 八仙雕塑
attractions.summary: The sculpture of the Eight Immortals is located across from Peace Square, facing the sea. It is a symbol of Penglai and a highlight of the Penglai Scenic Area. Legend has it that this is the gathering place of the Eight Immortals. The sculptures are vivid and vividly depict the legend of the Eight Immortals, telling the story of eight immortals punishing evil and promoting good on the Qiong Pavilion in Penglai, and benefiting all sentient beings. Behind the Sculpture Square is a vast seaside.

attractions.name: 振扬门
attractions.shortFeatures: The south gate of Penglai Water City built in the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 蓬莱阁
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Penglai Pavilion, along with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is known as one of China's Four Great Towers.  
· Known as the "Fairyland on Earth," the well-known myth of "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea" originates here.  
· Penglai Pavilion is located by the sea, often shrouded in mist, making it feel like being in a fairyland. On a good day, one can even witness a "mirage."  
· In addition to Penglai Pavilion, the scenic area also includes Tianheng Mountain, Dengzhou Museum, Ancient Ship Museum, and the dividing line between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.  
· From the mountain top, one can enjoy a distant view of the junction between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, where the boundary line between the yellow and blue waters is very distinct, and one can also see Changdao Island in the distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Legend of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea

attractions.name: 木府
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountain Climbing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The residence of Mu's chieftain in Lijiang in past dynasties, which combines the architectural style of Central Plains in Ming Dynasty with the craftsmanship of Bai and Naxi nationalities, is a landmark of the ancient city. 
After hundreds of years of glory, most of them were destroyed by war, and the remaining parts were seriously damaged in the earthquake in 1996. At present, most of them are rebuilt. 
It is the "Grand View Garden" of the ancient city of Lijiang. Coming to Lijiang without seeing Mufu is almost equivalent to not coming to Lijiang.
attractions.shortFeatures: Locations for hot dramas such as "Mufu Fengyun"

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 大水车
attractions.summary:
· The landmark buildings and landmarks of the ancient city of Lijiang, tourists must go to the place to take photos. 
The oldest agricultural irrigation tool in China is a superb labor skill created by our ancestors and a precious historical and cultural heritage. 
In the past, there were waterwheels in ancient cities, represented by the big waterwheels in ancient cities, which are still used in some remote places today. 
The waterwheel in the ancient city of Lijiang is only used as a landmark building and ornamental function.
attractions.shortFeatures: Symbol of Old Town of Lijiang

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山索道
attractions.summary: The Yulong Snow Mountain Cableway is one of the three cableways in the Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. Tourists can take the cableway directly from the cableway station located in Ganhaizi to the Glacier Park at an altitude of 4506 meters. After getting off the cableway and following the wooden boardwalk laid on the glacier, you can climb all the way to the highest point at an altitude of 4680 meters, experiencing the charm of the snow capped mountains and glaciers up close. Full text 

attractions.name: 冰川公园大索道
attractions.summary: The cableway has a total length of 2980 meters, with an upper station elevation of 4506 meters and a lower station elevation of 3356 meters. The vertical height difference between the upper and lower stations is 1150 meters, making it one of the cableways built at high altitudes both domestically and internationally.

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 白水河
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.
attractions.shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain

attractions.name: 《印象丽江》演出
attractions.tag: Featured performance; Mountain Climbing; Live Show
attractions.summary: Impression Lijiang "is one of the" Impression Series "directed by Zhang Yimou. The performance is set against the backdrop of snow capped mountains, with folk culture as the theme and local indigenous people as actors. On the open-air stage of the Ganhaizi Blue Moon Valley Theater in Yulong Snow Mountain at an altitude of 3100 meters, it truly showcases the indigenous people's emotions towards heaven, earth, people, and mountains. Impression of Lijiang "is divided into two parts:" Snow Mountain Chapter "and" Ancient City Chapter ", including six parts:" Ancient Road Horse Gang "," Duijiu Snow Mountain "," Heaven and Earth "," Jumping Song Group "," Encouragement and Sacrifice to Heaven ", and" Prayer Ceremony ". The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. The more than 500 actors participating in the performance are all from the surrounding rural areas, giving the audience a very authentic impression of Lijiang with their rough momentum, native posture, and simple singing.

attractions.name: 白沙古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
Baisha Ancient Town was once the political, economic and cultural center of Lijiang, and it was also the original settlement of Naxi people in Lijiang Dam, retaining the original Naxi culture. 
The ancient town retains its original appearance, has not been over-developed, is quieter than Dayan and Shuhe, and you can see Yulong Snow Mountain when you look up. 
Baisha Mural is the most famous scenic spot in the town. It lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, and it is a good place to learn about Dongba culture. 
You can sit and drink tea in the street shop, hang out slowly, and chat with the local old grandmother in a language that each other doesn't understand, which is relaxed and leisurely.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the quiet of the original ecological ancient town

attractions.name: 雪嵩村(玉湖村)
attractions.summary: Xuesong Village, also known as Yuhu Village, is a peaceful ancient village located at the foot of the snow capped mountains. The surrounding scenery is very beautiful, and the houses in the village are all built of stones, exuding an ancient and simple atmosphere. This place is suitable for taking photos and also for tourists who like quietness to stay here and enjoy the peaceful beauty at the foot of the snow capped mountains. Xuesong Village is not as famous as Dayan Ancient Town and Shuhe Ancient Town, but it is actually one of the birthplaces of the Naxi Mu Clan Tusi and has a considerable international reputation. In 1922, American Austrian explorer Joseph Locke came to Lijiang and lived there for 27 years, leaving behind a large amount of graphic and textual materials about the area. His former residence is currently located in the village and can be visited with tickets. There is a villa called Yulu Xuesongyuan Hotel in Xuesong Village, which was carefully designed by renowned architect Nie Jianping. The appearance of the stone building blends with the style of Xuesong Village, and the landscape is very beautiful. Tourists who want to experience the charm of Xuesong Village more can stay here. The hotel is very high-end and the price was not cheap back then. In addition to this one, there are also some guesthouses in the village, which are relatively complete in various local areas and can be selected according to needs.

attractions.name: 丽江千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area is a large performing arts park and a living ancient tea-horse city, located at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
In the scenic spot, the theme areas such as Chama Ancient Street, Nacuo Sea, Snow Mountain Beach and ethnic villages show Lijiang's thousand-year-old culture and historical customs. The towers are towering, the business is prosperous, the ringing of horse bells in the ancient tea-horse street, and there are many workshops such as wineries, tea houses, Dongba paper, hand-dyeing and copper shops. The rippling blue waves of Nacuo Sea are like a fairyland, with flowers and weeping willows on both sides of the strait; Enjoy leisure time with yaks in a daze on the snowy mountain beach; Feel the strong ethnic customs in ethnic villages and experience a different tea-horse tour. 
The main show "Lijiang Eternal Love" is a must-see performance in a lifetime, which reproduces the history and legend of Lijiang for thousands of years, leads the audience through the snow-capped mountains, and feels a beautiful moment in the remote and primitive wild land, Mosuo Flower House on the banks of Lugu Lake, the ancient tea-horse road wrapped in wind and rain, the romantic and miserable third country of Yulong, and the paradise-like Shambhala. 
The large-scale live performance "Lijiang Love Songs" tells the beautiful and tragic love story of Tibetan boy Abda and Naxi girl Gajimi. There is a volcano here, which can instantly spew out flames more than ten meters high; Here, there are strong Tibetan boys who bravely climb volcanoes, cut boulders and set off huge waves; There are beautiful dances of all ethnic groups in Yunnan, and you can feel the artistic feast in the south of colorful clouds. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
There are also wonderful performing shows in the scenic spot, such as "Mufu Recruiting Son-in-Law", "Guozhuang Carnival", "National Flash Mob", "Muppet", "Yak in a Daze" and "Wandering Singers Singing in Residence", which are staged in turn. 
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area, looking for Shambhala in your heart!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the wonderful performance of eternal love

attractions.name: 拉市海湿地公园
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
Located about 10 kilometers west of Lijiang City, it is the largest plateau lake in Lijiang and the first nature reserve named after "wetland" in Yunnan Province. 
Every year, tens of thousands of waterfowl come here to spend the winter. Between December and February of the following year, it is the best time to watch birds in Lashihai. 
The lake is surrounded by Naxi villages, and every village near the lake has opened a horse farm, which has become an excellent place for horse riding, boating and bird watching in Lijiang.

attractions.name: 荒野之国
attractions.summary: The Wilderness Country is located in the ancient town area of Lijiang City. It was created by folk singers using discarded tires, fan leaves, metal buckets, and other materials. It is very creative and environmentally friendly. In the Wilderness Country, there are dozens of small houses with different styles, such as Samurai Kusanagi, Nomadic Wanderers, Rainy Art Museum, Tree House Cafe, Cloud Bamboo Restaurant, etc.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 09:00-20:00(Admission ends at 19:30),Opens at Standard time 09:00-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 诚品书店(诚品生活苏州店)
attractions.summary: Eslite Bookstore is not so much a bookstore as a comprehensive building with bookstores as its main body. The entire building is built with a strong sense of design, and from the east gate, you can see the iconic 72 step staircase that is 18 meters high and 6 meters wide, which is very magnificent. The bookstore sells a large number of books and thoughtfully sets aside areas for customers to sit down and read. In addition, exquisite stationery stores, dessert shops, coffee shops, restaurants, and clothing stores are distributed on various floors, where literary and artistic youth can stroll around for a whole day. The rich collection of books includes 150000 varieties and 500000 volumes of Chinese and foreign books from 2000 publishing institutions around the world, covering five major book areas: Chinese and foreign literature, humanities and social sciences, art and design, lifestyle, and trend learning. You can see a large number of traditional Chinese books by Taiwanese writers, but the book prices are slightly higher. At the entrance of the book sales area is the "Eslite Selected Books" bookshelf, which lists Eslite's recommended books. It is said that the quality is good and worth a look. An interesting store located in B1 collects and sells small items and handicrafts, such as Suzhou embroidery, Suzhou fans, nuclear carving, woodcut New Year paintings, etc., all of which have local characteristics of Suzhou. The visual laboratory is located in the attic above the art book area, exhibiting art works and decorated in a small and fresh manner. The Eslite Children's Center on the second floor sells children's books and small toys, and customers with children can come here to take a stroll. Full text 

attractions.name: 李公堤
attractions.tag: Road trips; Night tour viewing; Roads/Highways; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Ligongdi is one of the scenic spots of Jinji Lake, and it is also the core scenic spot, with a total length of 1,400 meters. It was built by Li Chaoqiong, the magistrate of Yuanhe County in Guangxu period, hence the name "Ligongdi". 
· Ligong Embankment is not a simple long embankment for viewing. There are countless restaurants on the embankment. Walking through the long embankment, you can not only enjoy the lake view, but also live, eat and take photos in the restaurants. 
The lake and water color, the lights and feasts complement each other, which is intoxicating. Suzhou people often drive here with their families for leisure spending, get together with friends, and stage the grand scene of "Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival" in the new era.
attractions.shortFeatures: A model of domestic mixed hydrophilic community

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区-虎丘塔
attractions.summary: Huqiu Pagoda is located on Huqiu Mountain in the northwest suburbs of Suzhou, 5 kilometers away from the city center. According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn Period, King Fuchai of Wu buried his father (Helu) here. Three days after the burial, a white tiger perched on it, hence the name Huqiu Mountain, abbreviated as Huqiu. Huqiu Pagoda is a famous ancient pagoda from the Song Dynasty, both domestically and internationally. Founded in the sixth year of Xiande in the Later Zhou Dynasty (959 AD) and completed in the second year of Jianlong in the Northern Song Dynasty (961 AD). The tower has seven levels and eight sides, with two layers of internal and external columns and half arches, brick body and wooden eaves. It is a representative work of brick towers in the Yangtze River Basin in the 10th century. Due to multiple fires from the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, the wooden eaves at the top were all damaged, and the current height of the tower is 47.5 meters. In 1956, a large number of cultural relics were discovered inside the tower, including rare art treasures such as Yue kiln and lotus stone turtle. The Tiger Hill Tower is a leaning tower.

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 网师园
attractions.summary:
- Wangshi Garden is a representative example of a medium-sized classical Chinese garden, featuring traditional landscape and residential architecture. It was established during the Southern Song Dynasty.
- Initially named "Yuyin" (Fisherman's Retreat), it was renamed "Wangshi Garden" in 1765, reflecting the owner's intention to retreat into a life of seclusion.
- Despite the garden's many buildings, they are not crowded, and although the pond is less than one mu in size, it does not feel small. It can be considered a model of Chinese gardens where simplicity triumphs over complexity.
- From the main gate to the carriage hall, Wanjuantang, and Xiexiu Tower, the buildings unfold along the central axis. The main hall, Wanjuantang, is spacious with elegant decorations.
- In addition to understanding the layout's intricacies, another highlight of the garden is enjoying the traditional opera performances during the annual night garden events.
attractions.shortFeatures: The garden known for its delicate and intricate design.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.

- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
