attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 长沙世界之窗
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
Changsha Window of the World is located in the northeastern suburbs of the city, along the Liuyang River. It is a comprehensive large-scale theme park that integrates 20 major creative events throughout the year, 50 major thrill rides, architectural wonders from around the world, cultural performances from five continents, and a film shooting base.

The 50 major thrill rides include the "Four Kings of Screams," which are popular among young people, such as the hanging roller coaster, motorcycle roller coaster, sky swing, and twin towers. There are also family-friendly theme areas, such as the Fine Wool Tot Children's Playground, King Kong Jungle Parent-Child Playground, and Pet Paradise. In addition, there is a new concept water park, which has become a new water play landmark for the people of Changsha during the summer.

The 20 major creative events throughout the year include the Chinese Carnival, International Street Art Festival, Halloween, Christmas and New Year season, and more, aiming to bring fresh experiences and endless joy to visitors!

Among the miniature architectural wonders scattered throughout the park, the most popular iconic structures are the New Swan Castle, the Louvre Glass Pyramid from France, and the Lighthouse of Alexandria. As the leader of theme parks in Central and Southern China, Changsha Window of the World continuously upgrades its hardware and software to provide better services and even more fantastic experiences for visitors!

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 流溪河国家森林公园
attractions.summary: The Liuxihe National Forest Park is surrounded by mountains, with lakes and large areas of forests, resulting in fresh air and charming scenery. In the park's mountains and forests, there are precious tree species such as bamboo and cypress, camphor, and camphor, as well as ornamental flowers and trees such as cherry blossoms, magnolias, crane top orchids, and rhododendrons. Liuxi Fragrant Snow "is a unique winter scenery in Liuxi River National Forest Park, attracting countless Chinese and foreign tourists every year to admire, sing, paint, photograph, and praise plum blossoms. Liuxihe Forest Farm has over 3000 acres of plum trees planted around the lake, known as the "number one plum blossom in China and the first branch of spring in the south" (20 days before New Year's Day and 10 days after). Starting from December every year, more than 100000 plum trees planted here bloom clusters of white flowers on their branches, proudly blooming in the cold, shining like snow and frost on the snowy and frosty ground, along with the emerald streams, lakes, and green mountains. The park mainly has scenic spots such as Sanyatang Yougu, Xiaoli River, Emerald Islands, Lakeside boardwalk, Liuxi Lv Greenway, tea garden, plum garden, bamboo garden, etc. The supporting facilities are also very complete, including cruise ships, outdoor expansion, etc. For those who enjoy mountain climbing, you can add the trip to San Ya Tang. San Ya Tang is located on Wuzhi Mountain, and of course, there are also many expansion enthusiasts who come here for leisure activities. The specific itinerary can be planned according to your hobbies. San Ya Tang You Valley is located in the Wuzhishan Scenic Area south of Liuxi River National Forest Park. A 2500 meter long upstream path runs through the middle of the valley, surrounded by lush green bamboo. In the stream, there are flowing springs and waterfalls, and in the valley, there are towering boulders. The Liuxi River National Forest Park currently has large, medium, and small boats, as well as speedboats. The developed water amusement projects mainly include: boat tours of Liuxi Lake, airship tours of Liuxi Lake, sharing fun with monkeys (taking a boat to Monkey Island), participating in Peacock Garden (taking a boat to Peacock Island), visiting Liuxi River Dam, and visiting Xiaoli River. The usual routes chosen by most guests are boat tours to enjoy the flowing streams and lakes, Monkey Island, and Peacock Island. Note: Guangzhou Liuxihe Forest Park is divided into two major scenic areas, namely Liuxihu Scenic Area with Liuxihu as its theme and Wuzhishan Scenic Area with river tracing and mountain climbing as its theme. The two are 4 kilometers apart and there are currently no scenic area vehicles connecting them. Full text 

attractions.name: 天堂顶风景区
attractions.summary: Paradise Top is the main peak of Nankun Mountain, located in Shimen Scenic Area of Congfossil Gate National Forest Park in Guangzhou. With an altitude of about 1210 meters, it is the highest peak in Guangzhou. It is adjacent to Paitan Town in Zengcheng City in the east, Liangkou Town in Conghua City in the south, and Nankunshan Mountain in Longmen County in the north. The annual average temperature is about 15 ℃, the highest temperature is about 22 ℃, and the lowest temperature is about minus 5 ℃. Long-term frost and ice in winter, with occasional snow. There, the mountains are high and refreshing, the trees are lush, and the mountains are staggered. It has natural characteristics such as beauty, seclusion and Austrian. The top of heaven, together with the nearby second peak of heaven, monkey's forehead and horizontal pit top, constitute four peaks. The sunset is bright and steeper, which makes people feel that Cangshan Mountain is not old. You can watch the sunrise, the sea of forests and the sea of clouds, overlooking Liuxi River, Nankun Mountain, Conghua Hot Spring, pumped storage power station and other scenery.
attractions.shortFeatures: The trees are lush and the mountains are staggered

attractions.name: 石门风景区
attractions.summary: The Shimen Scenic Area is located 8 kilometers away from the Park Hotel, with two stone mountains standing tall and rugged, about hundreds of zhang high. The ancient pine trees on the top of the mountains are vigorous and magnificent, resembling two open stone doors. What's even more amazing is that there is a thousand year old banyan tree on each side, like a pair of male and female lions guarding the stone gate tightly. Here, you can admire the towering Shimen, Shimen Fragrant Snow, autumn and winter red leaves, sparrow flowers, rare plants, Shimen Creek, and explore the diverse Shimen Valley. Shimen Yougu has a total length of 2.5 kilometers and is also one of the components of the canyon exploration area. In the secluded valley, a small stream flows downstream. Tracing up the river, strolling in the secluded valley, listening to the gurgling sound of water and the pleasant chirping of birds, enjoying the strange and rugged rocks that can be seen everywhere, and admiring the emerald green pools of water. The two peaks on both sides of the Shimen Shuangfeng Road face each other, with steep cliffs standing upright like knives, forming a natural "gate". The peach blossoms in Shimen Scenic Area can be seen in patches. The Shimen Furong Boardwalk is over 800 meters long, mainly consisting of stone based waterfront trails and wooden board waterfront boardwalks. The boardwalk runs up the river and connects to scenic spots such as Shimen Xiangxue and Shimen Yougu in the central area of Shimen. Due to the presence of hibiscus trees planted on both sides of the boardwalk, it is named "Hibiscus boardwalk". Strolling through it, the gurgling water is pleasant to listen to, the chirping of insects and birds is gentle and melodious. Every May, the hibiscus flowers bloom, and the water and shadows complement each other, forming a beautiful scenery of "shining water hibiscus". Full text 

attractions.name: 天池花海
attractions.summary: Tianchi Flower Sea is located in Guangzhou and is a tourist attraction with the theme of flower viewing. Here, flowers bloom all year round and are colorful, making it a paradise for photography and nature enthusiasts. There are not only various flower exhibitions in the scenic area, but also leisure and entertainment facilities suitable for families to play.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world.

The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 灰熊山谷
attractions.name_en: Big Grizzly Mountain Runaway Mine Cars
attractions.summary: Grizzly Bear Valley is a theme park within Hong Kong Disneyland, which opened on July 14, 2012. In the "Grizzly Valley" full of western charm, guests can feel the prosperity of the town of Seeking Gold. The innovative "Grizzly Mountain Rapid Mining Car" will suddenly charge forward, make sharp turns, and plummet rapidly, leading tourists on a mountain crossing adventure. At the same time, there will be multiple mining cars running side by side, which is thrilling and exciting.

attractions.name: 蚁侠与黄蜂女：击战特攻！
attractions.name_en: Ant Man & The Wasp Nano Battle
attractions.tag: Theme Parks; Science & Technology Museums; Other Experiences
attractions.summary: Ant Man and Wasp Woman: Strike Special Attack is a recreational facility where people ride on chariots and fight against enemies alongside Ant Man and Wasp Woman. The game ends, and the machine will display your score and hit rate.

attractions.name: 迷离庄园
attractions.summary:
· Blurred Manor is a unique theme park in Hong Kong Disneyland, which opened on May 17th, 2013. The main amusement facility in the area is Blurred Mansion. 
· The story tells the story of a British explorer who is also an adventurer. Sir Henry, a member of the Explorers Institute, set up a mansion in the tropical rainforest and turned the basement into a museum for guests to visit. Different collections are displayed in the museum. 
· "Blurred Manor" is also known as one of the most complex amusement facilities in Disney history, and it is also the last project in the existing expansion plan of Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors will experience an audio-visual feast with sound, smell and somatosensory here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the blurred mansion

attractions.name: 反斗奇兵大本营
attractions.summary:
· This is the first theme park of "Anti-Fighting Base Camp" in Asia. 
Taking the movie "Raiders 3" as the backbone, all kinds of super-giant toys are placed in the area, and passengers are in it, such as becoming dwarfs. 
· There are three mobile games in the area: one is that guests take a bumpy ride on facilities like "dachshunds"; Another facility is a shuttle car, which picks up guests quickly back and forth along a U-shaped track with a height of tens of feet; Finally, there is a "skydiving" training tour, where guests can feel the speed of plunging down from a 25-meter platform according to their preferences.
attractions.shortFeatures: Skyward remote control car

attractions.name: 星際極速穿梭
attractions.summary: Star Wars Speed Shuttle is located within Disneyland and is a popular recreational activity here. With high speeds and cool sound systems, visitors feel as if they are traveling through the universe. For adventurous friends, don't miss it.

attractions.name: 幻想世界
attractions.summary: Full of joy, it is a fairy tale world in a dream. You can find the most beloved Disney characters in Disney stories here, and the protagonist in every fairy tale can bring joy and fantasy. The central symbol of Fantasy World will be a brand-new and unique dream garden, unique to Hong Kong Disneyland.
attractions.shortFeatures: A real children's paradise

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园登山缆车
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Ocean Park cable car is a classic facility of the Ocean Park, taking visitors leisurely back and forth between the seaside amusement park at the foot of the mountain and the peak amusement park on the mountain. Passengers can slowly climb up the green hills in the sea breeze, fully enjoy the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, and have a panoramic view of various attractions in the Ocean Park, planning their next stop itinerary carefully.

attractions.name: 翻天覆地
attractions.summary: Earth shaking is a famous scenic spot in Hong Kong, renowned for its unique landscapes and rich activities. This place not only boasts magnificent natural scenery, but also offers a variety of entertainment and leisure activities, making it an excellent location for tourists to experience the charm of Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 海洋奇观
attractions.summary: Hurry up and take a deep breath, because "Ocean Wonders" will take you into the unprecedented deep-sea world and uncover the mystery of marine ecology! When you step into the bottom of the sea, remember to look up, because the viewing dome with a diameter of 5.5 meters will take you to explore the underwater world from a new angle! You can also walk into the coral reef tunnel and explore the rainbow-like colorful corals and colorful fish, which will definitely make you stare! Finally, you will arrive at a giant viewing screen with a width of 13 meters, where you can watch more than 400 species and 5,000 precious fish at one time, and enjoy your eyes!

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园 · 水上乐园
attractions.name_en: Water World Ocean Park Hong Kong
attractions.summary: Welcome explorers to our mysterious kingdom Just a few minutes from the city center, you can immerse yourself in this hidden civilization world built around water and nature We sincerely invite you to explore nature with us and experience endless waves! Located at the intersection of verdant mountains and the South China Sea, Hong Kong Ocean Park Water Park takes you into this year-round, all-weather amusement park. Challenge every wave, swim in rivers of all sizes, and conquer every water slide. Re recognize and appreciate the wonders of nature. Reorganize your thoughts, let every wave cheer you up, and establish deeper connections between family and friends. The exploration journey of the mysterious kingdom of Joy Barrier Reef is about to begin with the vast area built by the sea, known as Joy Barrier Reef. You can take a walk along the seaside and enjoy the sea breeze, or immediately immerse yourself in an exciting and fun water park trip! As soon as you arrive at the Water Park Plaza, our guide will give you a warm welcome and prepare a series of exciting experiences for you. Starting from deconstructing the mysterious code of nature, like the symbol of Happy Barrier Reef, gradually dismantling this coral joyful world composed of "fish" and "grass"! △ [Jumping River Basin] Combining the symbols of "joy" and "water" into one is a way to express the joyful experience in the "Jumping River Basin". Immediately challenge various thrilling slide devices! Experience the thrill of rotating and taking sharp turns on the Whirlwind Twin Ladder and the Rapid Rotation Twin Ladder; Compete and sprint on the eight colored ladder; Enjoy the stunning experience brought by mysterious rapids and whirlpools! You can also embark on a giant rubber raft with your companions and drift freely to the Lost Tribe. △ [Lost Tribe] The explorer pursued the excitement and scream of being both far and near, and arrived at the "Lost Tribe". The mysterious symbol of "Lost Tribe" is composed of "people" and "mountains", representing the lost civilization hidden deep in the mysterious kingdom. Flowing water rushes in from all directions, bringing more fun to the explorer's adventure journey. The guide will teach everyone surfing techniques. You can play in the Tianhai Bay or let children explore in the Weiwei Water Zone. Even take a drifting adventure to explore the "Lost Tribe" and broaden your understanding of the mysterious kingdom. △ [Adventure Bay Shore] Like the symbol of "Adventure Bay Shore", this is a mysterious oasis composed of "water" and "trees". Here, you can feel the ocean power hidden in nature. Adventure Bay Beach is a tropical paradise where you can enjoy the sunshine and surf in the surging waves. Traveling downstream along the rapids, you can also relax in the Yingwan cottage and indulge in delicious snacks on the bay shore. Standing at the top of the valley, overlooking the entire valley and the ocean, this thrilling themed area can attract explorers who dare to challenge their limits. The 'Jueling Deep Valley' is composed of mysterious symbols symbolizing 'energy' and 'water', representing the beginning of thrilling experiences. After reaching the mountaintop, the explorer will challenge the thrilling thrill of high-speed drops in the Brave's Peak and the Deep Valley Waterfall, charging through the high-speed loop and soaring waterfall until entering the Lost Tribe. Full text 

attractions.name: 开封博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Kaifeng Museum was founded in March, 1962, and its predecessor was Kaifeng Exhibition Hall. After the provincial museum moved to Zheng, it was established at its original site, Sansheng Street. Because the original building of the museum site was dilapidated and not suitable for all aspects of business, the current site was chosen to be expanded into the current new museum in 1986. The new museum was completed in September, 1988 and officially opened to the public, which became a great event of Kaifeng's cultural undertakings. The new Kaifeng Museum opened in March 2018
attractions.shortFeatures: Show Kaifeng History and Northern Song Culture
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 开封府
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Kaifeng Fu, also known as the Southern Yamen, was the administrative and judicial office for officials in the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, and was praised as the "first prefecture under heaven."
- Among the various government offices throughout history, it was the largest in scale, equivalent to the Beijing municipal government today.
- The architecture is grand and magnificent, complementing the waters of the Three Pools Lake, creating the scenic view of "Eastern Prefecture, Western Temple, Pavilion and Clear Water."
- In addition to a large collection of precious historical materials and exhibits, visitors can also enjoy performances such as the "Opening of the Yamen," "Judge Bao’s Rulings," and "Fire-Spitting Face-Changing."
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the ancient-style performance of Judge Bao solving cases.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Spring and summer 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Winter 07:00-18:30(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Autumn 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 清明上河园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gem; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A large-scale Song Dynasty cultural theme park built based on the famous Song Dynasty painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*.
- The park closely replicates the scenes from *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*, consisting of eight functional zones and four cultural zones.
- The Southern Garden recreates the bustling streets of Northern Song Dynasty’s capital, Bianjing (today's Kaifeng), while the Northern Garden showcases the Song Dynasty's royal gardens and court entertainment, with palace architecture adorned in golden and brilliant colors.
- The staff inside the park wear Song Dynasty clothing, creating a time-travel experience. In addition, there are exciting scene performances and folk shows.
attractions.shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Scenery of Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden

attractions.name: 开封包公祠
attractions.tag: Night Tour and Scenic View; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Bao Gong Temple is a restored and reconstructed site dedicated to commemorating Bao Zheng, a renowned ancient Chinese upright official and political reformer. It is located on the west shore of Bao Gong Lake in Kaifeng, Henan Province, and is one of the key attractions in the Central Plains tourist area developed by the National Tourism Administration.  

The temple consists of the main hall, second hall, east and west side halls, half-wall corridor, and a stele pavilion. Its style is ancient, solemn, and dignified. On the east side is the Lingshi Garden, which is composed of stone carvings and a waterside pavilion, elegant and distinctive. Inside the temple, there are exhibits such as a bronze statue of Bao Gong, a dragon, tiger, and dog bronze cleaver, wax figures of Bao Gong administering justice, the "Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele," historical novels about Bao Gong, Bao Gong’s career-declaration poems, the Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele, Bao Gong's family instructions, Bao Gong’s calligraphy, and an epitaph, among other historical artifacts.
attractions.shortFeatures: Song-style ancient architecture in memory of Bao Zheng.

restaurants.name_en: Xiaoji Three Delays Stewed Noodles Food City

attractions.name: 草堂寺钟楼
attractions.summary:
The largest and most well-preserved bell tower left over from ancient China, with six chime performances every day. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and the top is a gilded treasure top, which is magnificent. 
Standing on the bell tower, you can see the east, south, west and north streets extending from the bell tower, the most prosperous business district in Xi'an around the bell tower, and the Drum Tower not far away. 
When visiting the bell tower, you can also enjoy wonderful performances of visiting ancient times, six performances every day. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the bell and drum tower square, with a musical fountain.

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 易俗社百年博物馆
attractions.summary: Located in the new urban area of Xi'an City, the Centennial Museum of Yisu Society covers an area of more than 4000 square meters and has more than 10 exhibition halls. It focuses on the experience of opera culture, and shows the development history, social influence and artistic achievements of Qin Opera of Yisu Society for more than 100 years.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院-丽山园
attractions.summary: The Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, located in the suburb of Xi'an, is the mausoleum of Ying Zheng, the first emperor in Chinese history. Among the mausoleums of Chinese emperors, it is famous for its grand scale. At present, the imperial tomb has not been excavated, and you can wander around the tomb to think of ancient times. The Imperial Mausoleum was built between 246 BC and 208 BC, lasting for 39 years. The imperial tomb embodies the ritual system of "treating death as if it were life", completely modeled after the layout of the Qin capital Xianyang at that time. It has two rammed earth city walls inside and outside, symbolizing the imperial and palace cities of the capital Xianyang. The tomb mound (also known as the Da Feng Tu Dui, the burial mound of Emperor Qin Shi Huang) is located in the southern part of the inner city, in the shape of a covered bucket, and is currently about 50 meters high. After more than two thousand years of vicissitudes, the main relic on the ground of the imperial tomb is only the towering tomb. At present, the scenic area outlines the outline of the city wall through planting vegetation belts, as well as prominent signs and tags, allowing tourists to understand the direction, scope, and location of the city wall in the past. Up to now, the underground palace of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has not been excavated due to the constraints of existing scientific and technological conditions. Legend has it that in the underground palace of the First Emperor, various precious stones are used as the sun, moon, and stars, gold and jade are used as mountains and rivers, mercury is used as rivers, lakes, and seas, and the South China Sea mermaids refine oil into lamps that will last for thousands of years. Tourists can also visit the Bai Xi Qi Pit (also known as 9901 Accompanying Burial Pit) located in the southeast and the Wen Guan Qi Pit (also known as 0006 Accompanying Burial Pit) on the southwest side of the Fengtu Pile inside the imperial tomb. Full text 

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. Full text 

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 西安电影制片厂·西影电影博物馆
attractions.name_en: Xian Film Studio Experience Center For Arts of Film
attractions.summary: The Xiying Film Museum includes functional areas such as the Film Vintage Car Museum, Film Film Collection Library, Journey to the West Fantastic House, Film Production Technology Science Popularization Experience Area, Film Clothing and Chemical Exhibition Experience Area, World Film Projector Collection Museum, Light and Shadow Interactive Experience Area, and Xiying Factory History Museum. At the same time, more than 300 film projection equipment that spans the development of world cinema are collected here. The Film Industry Museum preserves the only still operating film processing and printing production line in China, showcasing numerous creative manuscripts and artistic archives from the classic film production process, as well as a large number of interactive experience devices that showcase film principles and technological charm.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-20:00(Tickets available until 19:30; admission ends at 19:30)

attractions.name: 西安城市观光车
attractions.summary: The "Xi'an City Sightseeing Bus" takes the "Tang Culture" as its main axis and roughly runs through the Xi'an urban area in a north-south direction. Tourists can wait at the sightseeing station sign to get on the bus. During the operation, the "Sightseeing Bus" will stop at each sightseeing station for 5 to 10 minutes. Tourists can arrange to get on and off the bus according to their own itinerary for sightseeing experience, and can take the next "Xi'an City Sightseeing Bus" to continue to the later sightseeing stations for sightseeing. Starting station: Parking lot on the east side of Dayan Pagoda North Square (parking lot on the east side of Xi'an Citizen Tourist Service Center).

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 小南门
attractions.summary: Xiaonan Gate is adjacent to Zhuque Gate and Hanguang Gate, and is a single hole city gate. There are many delicious and fun things nearby. Here, tourists can not only taste local specialties, but also learn about the long history of the area.

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.name: 成都市人民公园
attractions.summary: The park was founded in 1911 and is now a leisure destination for locals to drink tea, chat, and play cards. You can experience the happy "slow life" of Chengdu people here. You can order a cup of tea, read a book, bask in the sun and daydream in the tea house in the park. The original name of the park was Shaocheng Park, which was originally the "Eight Banners and Full City" of the Qing Dynasty, used for the residence of Manchus and Mongolians. In the third year of the Xuantong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1911), General Yukun stationed in Chengdu abolished the system of supplying banner residents and built a park. Nowadays, there are attractions such as Plum Garden, Haitang Garden, and large rockeries in the park, making it a place for locals to relax and have fun. Come here to drink tea, play cards, set up a dragon gate formation, chat, and enjoy the leisurely slow life of the leisure capital. Full text 

attractions.name: 宽窄巷子
attractions.summary: Kuanzhai Alley is the only ancient street left over from the Qing Dynasty in Chengdu, consisting of three parallel old urban streets - Kuanzhai Alley, Kuanzhai Alley, and Jingzhai Alley, as well as a courtyard community between them. Come here, drink tea, eat hotpot, and experience the leisurely, slow, and new life of Chengdu. You can order a cup of Mengshan Huangya here and set up a dragon gate formation with the old man next to you; You can also call yourself 'Shu'er Lang' and enjoy the pleasure of digging your ears comfortably; You can also enjoy a wide variety of snacks at the snack stall. The Kuanzhai Alley under the night sky also has its own charm. Bars such as Dianzui, Baiye, and Huli are full of Chengdu's fashion sense, blooming its charm at night. Full text 

attractions.name: 春熙路
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jinhua Pavilion is located in the hinterland of Chunxi Road, a small street less than 50 meters long. It was newly built after the renovation of Chunxi Road in recent years, connecting Kejia Lane in Chunxi. Because of the architectural style of the Republic of China, this small street presents a different style, quiet and romantic in the downtown area, and then it has become an outdoor shooting place for many photographers, and even a location place for some photo studios to take photos. 
Chengdu Jinhua Pavilion was built in 1914, located between Zhengkejia Lane and Chunxi Road, but people are used to directly calling it Jinhua Pavilion on Chunxi Road, Chengdu. Sichuan has been a place with extremely developed sericulture since ancient times. Shu embroidery and Shu brocade are famous all over the world, and Chengdu is also known as Jinguan City. Jinhua Pavilion is named for it, which means "prosperity and brocade".
attractions.shortFeatures: Representative bustling commercial street in Chengdu

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
attractions.name_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
attractions.tag: Mengmeng Animals; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- The Giant Panda Breeding and Research Center fully simulates the natural habitat of the giant panda, featuring lakes, streams, bamboo forests, and lawns. It houses more than 100 giant pandas.
- Near the main entrance, there is a Giant Panda Museum, where you can send postcards stamped with panda-themed postmarks from the Panda Country Post Office, and watch documentaries about giant pandas at the cinema.
- In addition to giant pandas, you can also see other animals like the black-necked crane, peacock, and heron. The Sun and Moon Nurseries house the cutest, newly born and a few months old panda cubs, which are extremely adorable. Highly recommended!
attractions.shortFeatures: The adorable national treasure is waiting for you.

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 杜甫草堂
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; Former residences of celebrities.
attractions.summary: In the past, there was a small path in front of Du Fu's thatched cottage, lined with flowers and trees. He once wrote in his poem: "The flower path has never been swept for guests, the humble door is now opened for you." Today’s flower path is a red-walled alley connecting the Du Fu Thatched Cottage Memorial Hall and the original Caotang Temple. At the end of the flower path stands the "Caotang Screen Wall," where the characters "Caotang" were inlaid with blue-and-white porcelain shards by Zhou Shanpei, the Governor of Sichuan’s Quanye Dao during the late Qing Dynasty. These characters have been damaged and repaired several times. When Chairman Mao visited the cottage in 1958, he gazed at these two characters for a long time. As one of the symbols of the cottage, many visitors stop here to take photos as a memento.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit Du Fu's Former Residence and Experience the Cultural Sacred Site

attractions.name: 三星堆博物馆
attractions.summary: The Sanxingdui Museum holds and displays over a thousand precious cultural relics in bronze, jade, gold, and ceramic, unearthed at the nearby Sanxingdui (“Three Stars Mound”) archaeological site. The Sanxingdui Archaeological Museum is quite large and comprises two independent exhibition areas. The first area is a general exhibition where you can see gold, copper, jade, stone, and ceramic cultural relics. The second area is the bronze exhibition, which houses all sorts of bronzeware that has been unearthed at the site.

attractions.name: 都江堰景区
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Water Conservancy Projects
attractions.summary:
- It is the oldest and the only remaining large-scale hydraulic project in the world to feature an un-dammed water diversion system.
- It consists mainly of three parts: the Yuzui Dividing Weir, the Feishayan Flood Discharge Channel, and the Baopingkou Inlet, and has been playing a role in flood control and irrigation.
- The area around Dujiangyan is known for its beautiful scenery and numerous historical sites, including Fulong Temple, Erwang Temple, Anlan Suspension Bridge, Yulei Pass, and Lidui Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Water Conservancy Project Lasting for Two Thousand Years
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 青城山
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for family outings; Mountains; Taoist Temples
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western part of Dujiangyan, it is one of the birthplaces of Taoism and is famously known as "Qingcheng, the most serene place under heaven."
- The area is divided into two scenic zones: the front mountain and the back mountain. Most visitors go to the front mountain, while the back mountain is more suited for hiking enthusiasts.
- The front mountain is smaller in area, with a temple or palace visible almost every hundred steps, classical and mysterious under the dense vegetation.
- The back mountain is larger in area and retains a relatively primitive appearance. Although the palaces and incense offerings are not as abundant as on the front mountain, it is quieter and more pristine.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the birthplace of Taoism
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 茶马花街
attractions.summary: Tea Horse Street is about 300 meters long and located on the west bank of Dianchi Lake. It was jointly built by Yunnan Urban Investment Group and Xishan Park. A short tea horse flower street takes into account the display of many cultural elements and the layout of leisure formats. Hundreds of folk snacks make your mouth keep your mouth from the street to the end of the street without stopping for a moment. The pioneer of food taste who is determined to revive the famous Yunnan cuisine, the master of cultural heritage who is proficient in ancient crafts and techniques, the literary and artistic space with the supremacy of emotions and feelings, the essence of Yunpin that shoulders the true colors of Yunnan's fame all over the world, and so on, are refreshing, interesting and informative formats are presented here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many specialty shops and delicious food

attractions.name: 金马碧鸡坊
attractions.name_en: Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Archway
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Founded in Xuande period of Ming Dynasty, the existing Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Square was rebuilt in 1998 according to the original style. 
The memorial archway on the east side near Jinma Mountain is called Jinma Square, and the memorial archway on the west side is near Biji Mountain, so it is called Biji Square. 
· It is the landmark and city center of Kunming and one of the symbols of Kunming; The vast majority of tourists to Kunming will visit here and take photos with the memorial archway. 
At night, there are often lively night markets in the surrounding streets. You can go to the vendors to choose what you like.
attractions.shortFeatures: Kunming landmark group photo holy land

attractions.name: 南屏步行街
attractions.summary: Nanping Street is an old block in the history of Kunming and also an ancient commercial street in the city. There are numerous restaurants, shops, supermarkets, and brand chain stores on the streets, offering a wide range of food, accommodation, travel, shopping, and entertainment options. It is one of the bustling streets in Kunming and also a popular spot for tourists to check in. At the entrance of Nanping Street, there is a large memorial archway, which is one of the landmark attractions here. Many tourists take photos here. There are also bronze statues on the street, with lifelike figures that can be photographed and recorded. Shopping, tasting delicious food, and savoring the charm of Kunming.

attractions.name: 云南大学-映秋院(东陆校区)
attractions.summary: The Yingqiu Campus of Yunnan University is located at the main campus of Yunnan University. It was listed as a provincial-level key cultural relic protection unit in 1987 and was designed by renowned architect Lin Huiyin. Yingqiu Courtyard is a courtyard building consisting of bungalows, buildings, walkways, and corridors. It has a Moon Palace Gate in the northeast and a watchtower in the southwest.

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 圆西路
attractions.summary: Yuanxi Road, a street where all kinds of delicious food gathers, is less than 500 meters away. It is close to Yunnan University and Yunnan University for Nationalities. There are many shops here and it is extremely popular. As early as many years ago, it formed a distinctive dining street. Many people go into the street to eat, or visit the stalls, and then turn a corner and disappear to the most sentimental places in Kunming, such as Cuihu Lake, Wenhua Lane, Wenlin Street and Xiaoximen. As a result, Yuanxi Road has become a must-see place recommended by many Kunming locals to friends from other places.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering special food from all over the world

attractions.name: 文化巷
attractions.summary:
· Wenhua Lane is a famous food street in Kunming, adjacent to several primary schools and universities. 
This alley, which is about two kilometers long, is full of snack bars, clothes shops and bookstores. 
There are many people, and it is often crowded.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering special food from all over the world

attractions.name: 官渡古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Town and Village; Nighttime Scenic Tour; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Guandu Town is one of Kunming's famous historical and cultural ancient towns. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a bustling market town with developed commerce and handicrafts. In the Tang Dynasty, it was part of the Nanzhao Kingdom, a popular stop for the nobility of the Dali Kingdom when they visited Dianchi Lake.

· The ancient town is rich in cultural landscapes, with five hills, six temples, seven pavilions, and eight shrines, as well as various lively shops. The Miao Zhan Temple, known as the "first of the six temples," is particularly notable, with its Vajra Throne Pagoda standing prominently at the entrance.

· A specialty dish is Guandu Baba, known locally as Mai Baba. The most famous version is the "Eyeglass Baba" on Vajra Tower Commercial Street, with two popular fillings: sesame and peanut.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire ancient temples and cultural landscapes.

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

restaurants.name_en: Scholarly Family Pingjiang Mansion Muxiang Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园
attractions.summary: Haixinsha is located in the area of Bati, the Pearl River - Guangzhou Tower - Huacheng Square. It is an artificial island located on the the Pearl River. The night scene here is very beautiful. With the lights of Huacheng Square, you can see the colorful changes of Guangzhou Tower across the river, which reflect each other. Moreover, it is also a great destination for the exterior of Guangzhou Tower, where many photography enthusiasts take photos. The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Those who have watched the opening ceremony will surely remember this boat shaped sports arena vividly. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. The unique geographical location makes Haixinsha and its surrounding areas a must for exploring the international metropolis of Guangzhou, which is a new landmark of Guangzhou. The subway APM line connects these three areas to form a three-point line. Generally, APM can take you to Haixinsha Station, but if you want to have a better tour, it is recommended to get off at Dahua Theater Station. Because you can also visit the Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Library, which are new cultural landmarks in Guangzhou. Then take a slow walk to Liede Bridge and see Haixinsha and Guangzhou Tower from the other side.

attractions.name: 广州大剧院
attractions.tag: Theatre Theatre; City coordinates; Theater; Buildings by Famous Architects
attractions.summary: Guangzhou Grand Theatre is like two spiritual stones washed by the Pearl River. It is strange in appearance, complex and changeable, and full of whimsy. Since the official opening of the theater, as of June 2012, it has ushered in more than 600 high-level performances all over the world and at home and abroad, including the opening performance Turandot, the world classic opera Tosca, the Chinese version of the world classic musical Mamma Mia, carreras, one of the world's three tenors, the world famous cellist Yo-Yo Ma, and the world conductor Lorraine 61 Mazel who came to Guangzhou for the second time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Located near Guangzhou CBD

attractions.name: 广州图书馆
attractions.summary: The new library has a total construction area of 100,000 square meters, a collection of 3.82 million volumes (pieces) (Guangzhou Library has a total collection of 5.26 million volumes (pieces)), 4,000 reading seats, 500 computers for readers, 4,000 wired network nodes, and 100% wireless network coverage. Realize the integration of collection, borrowing, reading and consultation; With the design concept of "beautiful books", relying on the landscape of the new central axis of the city, the new museum adopts the elegant shape of east-west direction, north-south towers and unique "zigzag", highlighting the layered architectural texture, implying the overlap of books and the deposition of history and culture, and at the same time incorporating cultural elements such as arcades, which reflects the artistic characteristics of Lingnan architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The north and south towers are in zigzag shape

attractions.name: 广州塔460米摩天轮
attractions.summary: The Ferris wheel is located 460 meters away from the Guangzhou Tower and is one of the popular tourist attractions in the tower. It cleverly utilizes the platform at the top of the tower and, unlike other Ferris wheels, runs on an inclined track. It is currently the tallest horizontal Ferris wheel in the world. The Ferris wheel is composed of 16 transparent crystal ball cabins that resemble sparkling pearls, slowly flowing around, and the beautiful scenery of Yangcheng unfolds before my eyes like a scroll.
