attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 

- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.

attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.

attractions.name: 栖霞寺
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
Sheshan Qixia Temple is located on Qixia Mountain in the northeast of Nanjing. It is one of the four famous temples in China and the birthplace of the "Three Theories" of Jiangnan Buddhism. Qixia Temple is not only large in scale and magnificent in style, but also the best scenery in Nanjing. It is also famous for its important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Qixia Temple Feng covers an area of more than 40 mu, and there are three courtyards of Pilu Temple Tibetan Sutra Building, which rise layer by layer according to the mountain, and the pattern is neat and beautiful. Main attractions: Stupa The Qixia Temple Stupa is a relic of the Southern Tang Dynasty. It is one of the oldest stone pagodas south of the Yangtze River and the largest stupa in my country. The stone pagoda is eight-angled and five-level, about fifteen meters high. The base is surrounded by a stone railing with a hook line, which is restored for the original objects of the Five Dynasties excavated in modern times. The floor of the base is carved with seawater, dragon, phoenix, fish, shrimp and other figures, and only a part of it remains. The eight phases of Sakyamuni are embossed on all sides of the Sumeru seat under the pagoda. After thousands of years of wind and rain, although some stone eaves have been destroyed, they still stand tall, becoming a witness to the prosperity of Buddha spirit in Jinling. The Great Buddha Pavilion, also known as the Three Holy Temples, is dedicated to the Buddha of Infinite Life and was excavated for Shiyi in the Southern Qi Dynasty. The Buddha statue is 10.8 meters high, and its seat is 13.3 meters high. Guanyin is 11 meters high to stand on the left and right side of the Bodhisattva. The pleated style of the Buddha statue is quite similar to the stone Buddha in Yungang, Datong. The original two Buddhas next to the stupa are more than three meters high, beautiful and elegant, similar to the Longmen Stone Buddha in Luoyang, and are also peerless treasures in the golden age of Chinese Buddhist art. Qianfoyan, known as "Yungang in the south of the Yangtze River", is the only Southern Dynasty grottoes in China. Wuliang Hall Wuliang Hall is the earliest and largest Buddhist shrine in Qianfo Rock. The Buddha of Infinite Life is in the middle, and Guanyin is on both sides. The statue is well-proportioned and the lines are smooth. The fold style of the three Buddhas' clothes is similar to that of Yungang Grottoes, and the excavation date is seventeen years earlier than that of Yungang Grottoes. The statue is exquisite and simple, which can be compared with Datong Longmen. Its value lies in preserving the original rhyme of Buddha statues in the Southern Dynasties, which is especially rare in the south of the Yangtze River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire exquisite stupas and Buddha statues in grottoes

During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the lake area here was larger than it is now. Water lilies and lotus flowers were widely planted in the lake. At that time, willows and maple trees on the shore complemented each other, and it was often a place for literati to drink and write poetry. In 1751, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty came to Qixia Mountain on his first southern tour. When he saw the scenery of Mingjing Lake, he immediately wrote "Seven Wonders, Mingjing Lake" with his brush and ink; Rainbow is not sunshine, mirror is not copper. The bends of the creek and the bridge are intertwined. Xi Biming distinguishes between truth and falsehood, using his false illusions to cover up the vacuum. The stone Guanyin Bodhisattva, several meters high in the lake, smiles kindly at all beings in the world. A rainbow pavilion is built in the center of the lake, and a rainbow like curved bridge runs through it. The lake water is clear and transparent, just like a mirror; Ripples suddenly rise, and waves of light float. The red leaves around are reflected inside, beautiful beyond measure.

attractions.name: 千佛岩
attractions.summary:
It is located on the rock wall from Shamao Peak to Zipen Peak in Qixia Mountain. According to legend, Seng Shao, the founder of Qixia Temple, once dreamed that there was a Buddha light on the west rock wall, so he decided to build a Buddha statue here. After his death, his son began to carve a Buddhist niche on the west wall with Zen Master Zhidu in the second year of Yongming in the Southern Qi Dynasty (484), and engraved three Buddha statues. These three Buddhas are collectively called "Three Saints of the West", and this temple is also called "Three Holy Temples". In the middle, the Infinite Buddha is three feet and three feet high, and it is the largest Buddha in the Thousand Buddha Rocks, so this cave is named "Infinite Buddha", also known as "Big Buddha Pavilion". In the first year of Liang Datong (504), it was reported that Buddha light appeared on the top of the Buddhist shrine. Therefore, feudal nobles of Qi and Liang dynasties, such as Prince Qi Wenhui, King of Yuzhang Literature and subjects, thought that the Buddha had appeared, and competed to donate money to chisel stone statues, which were called Thousand Buddhas and named Thousand Buddhas Rock. Buddha statues are sitting and standing, several feet in size, only inches in size, and exquisite in shape. They are as famous as Datong and Yungang Grottoes in the north and south. Thousand Buddha Rocks were repaired and engraved in Song and Ming Dynasties. On the rock wall, there are seven regular script characters of "Ancient Thousand Buddhas Rock Qixia Temple" written by Song You Jiuyan. 
 
The famous "Dongfeitian is in the Buddhist niche No.102. In 2000," Dongfeitian "was discovered in Qixia Mountain. This niche is very small, with five Buddha statues. Two groups of flying sky on the top of the cave are orange, with clear lines and discernible lines. The flame on the top of the Buddha statue in the middle is faintly visible. 
Although there are only two pairs of flying sky, this is the easternmost "Dunhuang relic" found in China.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the sitting statue of the Buddha of Infinite Life

attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 正佳极地海洋世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
attractions.summary: Zhengjia Polar Ocean World is located on the second and third floors on the west side of Zhengjia Plaza, with a total construction area of about 58,000 square meters and a total of 500 species of about 30,000 polar marine animals. It is a very distinctive indoor aerial polar aquarium. There are 22 themed exhibition areas in the exhibition hall, including 44-meter acrylic single aquarium display tank, colorful jellyfish corridor, 360-degree wide-angle undersea tunnel, beluga music hall, ocean oxygen bar, beluga underwater show, and the palace-level mermaid show brought by Ukrainian water ballet... striving to bring every visitor a dream-themed polar ocean experience integrating viewing, entertainment, leisure, science popularization and environmental protection.
attractions.shortFeatures: Extra-large aquarium display tank

attractions.name: 正佳雨林生态植物园
attractions.summary: Zhengjia Rainforest Ecological Botanical Garden is located on the seventh floor of Zhengjia Square, with a total area of approximately 15000 square meters. It is an indoor aerial rainforest ecological garden. The park showcases a "natural ecosystem" with biodiversity, allowing you to experience the charm of the rainforest firsthand. There are over 800 species of animals and plants here, including insects, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and more. There are also plants such as baobab trees, konjac with wart stalks, and blood sealed throats. The park is divided into eight exhibition areas, where not only can you embark on a fascinating exploration of plants, interact with cute pets up close, but you can also experience the 360 ° jungle skywalk overlooking the entire rainforest park, or cross the high mountain boardwalk to feel the danger and excitement of a 15 meter aerial waterfall cascading down. There are also a large number of multimedia interactive areas in the park, making your exploration journey more cool and fun; There is also a 'Nature Center' that helps visitors unravel the natural ecology beneath tree roots, allowing them to experience the wonders of the microscopic world in a tree root space magnified 100 times.

attractions.name: 黄埔古港
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
Huangpu Ancient Port is a window of the golden age of China's maritime trade in the 17th and 18th centuries. It is also the hub of economic and cultural exchanges between China and the West, witnessed the prosperity of the "Maritime Silk Road", and is known as "the first pass of Guangdong and Sea". 
· Huangpu Ancient Village is an important historical and cultural relic in Guangzhou and a witness to Guangzhou's glorious maritime trade history. Huangpu Ancient Village is prosperous because of Huangpu Ancient Port, and talented people come forth in large numbers. Up to now, there are still many relics such as ancient ports, ancient ancestral halls, ancient temples, ancient dwellings and former residences of celebrities in Huangpu Village.
attractions.shortFeatures: Important Customs Trade Port in Ancient Times

attractions.name: 浙江省博物馆孤山馆区
attractions.summary: The Zhejiang Museum has two venues, Gushan Hall and Wulin Hall. The old museum, Gushan Hall, is located at the southern foot of Gushan and consists of the main building, Zhejiang West Lake Art Museum, and the Royal Library Wenlan Pavilion. The main exhibition features pottery and lacquerware from the Hemudu culture, as well as jade and silk fabrics from the Liangzhu culture; Bronze artifacts from the state of Yue; Works of Zhejiang calligraphers and painters from the Ming and Qing dynasties. The main building has three floors, with exhibition halls such as Ceramic Hall, Celadon Hall, Lacquerware Hall, etc. The first floor mainly displays some pottery, the second and third floors mainly display porcelain, the second floor mainly displays some Yue kiln porcelain, Longquan porcelain, etc., and the third floor displays porcelain from the Ming and Qing dynasties or later periods. The Zhejiang West Lake Art Museum on the east side of Gushan Museum mainly displays some calligraphy and painting works. In addition, there are two special exhibition halls available for visitors: Huang Binhong Calligraphy and Painting Museum and Lv Xiaguang Art Museum. In addition, the main building of the museum and the West Lake Art Museum hold different temporary exhibitions from time to time every year. The Wenlan Pavilion on the west side is one of the seven pavilions in the Qing Dynasty that collected the Complete Library of Four Treasures. However, it no longer houses the Complete Library of Four Treasures, only the bookshelf where the books were stored at that time. There are sample introductions to the Complete Library of Four Treasures and introductions to the process of collecting them after being destroyed in war. However, the Wenlan Pavilion has a beautiful scenery and is a typical Jiangnan courtyard building, worth a visit. Xiling Seal Engravers Society is located not far from Gushan Pavilion. We recommend tourists interested in humanities to visit it together

attractions.name: 中国茶叶博物馆
attractions.summary: China Tea Museum is a museum with the theme of displaying tea culture. There are six relatively independent and interrelated exhibition spaces: tea history, tea extraction, tea affairs, tea edge, tea sets and tea customs, which interpret tea culture from different angles. Here you can not only see different kinds of famous teas at home and abroad, but also appreciate the evolution and development of tea sets in various historical periods in China, and learn about the tea making process and tea drinking methods and etiquette in Yunnan, Sichuan, Tibet, Fujian, Guangdong and the Ming and Qing Dynasties.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understand the history of tea, tea extraction, tea set and tea culture

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 三潭印月
attractions.tag: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Also known as Xiaoyingzhou, it is the largest island among the three islands in the West Lake and the only island that can be visited. It is known as the first scenic spot in the West Lake. 
The outline is like the word "Tian", the outer ring is Jiangnan garden, and the inside is divided into four small lakes by cross-shaped islands and bridges, which are full of poetry and painting. 
The whole island is densely covered with flowers and trees, mainly green willow, lotus, red maple and hibiscus, which is the representative work of water courtyard art in the south of the Yangtze River. 
The back of the RMB one-dollar banknote adopts the grand scene of three pools reflecting the moon, which shows that it plays an extremely important symbolic role in my country's scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landing on the island and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the West Lake from a new perspective

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 杭州宋城
attractions.tag: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 外滩观光隧道
attractions.summary: The Bund Sightseeing Tunnel connects the Bund and the Lujiazui commercial district in Pudong, and is the first pedestrian tunnel across the river in China. Tourists can take a fully transparent sightseeing bus to cross the Huangpu River in a tunnel with constantly changing colors, as if traveling through time and space. The inner walls of the tunnel are constantly changing in various strange colors, and the sound effects are combined with the changing landscape in front of us, creating a sense of immersive shock. The tunnel includes themes such as "Time Tunnel Zone", "Shuttle Zone", and "Magma Spray Zone", with dazzling light and shadow effects that make people feel as if they have entered another world. In addition, the tunnel has added leisure and amusement projects such as "Sound Fantasy World" and "Deep Sea Rare Exhibition", which are suitable for tourists to bring their children and have fun together on holidays. Surrounding the tunnel are the Global Curiosity Museum and the 3D Magical Fun Museum, which are suitable for tourists to take photos and scenery. Later, tourists can also experience snacks and shopping in the Nanjing Road Walkway. Tourists with time can also visit the surrounding Oriental Pearl TV Tower, the Bund and other landmark attractions in Shanghai.

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩-观景平台
attractions.summary: The Bund in Shanghai is a famous scenic spot located on the banks of the Huangpu River and is one of the iconic architectural complexes in Shanghai. The Bund Viewing Platform is a viewing area that offers a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery on both sides of the Huangpu River. It is located at the southern end of the Bund and offers views of high-rise buildings, historical buildings, and night light shows on both sides of the river. The architectural design of the viewing platform is simple and elegant, using glass curtain walls and steel structures. The entire platform has a large area and can accommodate many tourists to enjoy at the same time. If you want to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Shanghai, the Bund Observation Deck is a good choice.

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 东方明珠259米全透明悬空观光廊
attractions.summary: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower fully transparent sightseeing corridor is 259 meters high, 150 meters long and 2.1 meters wide. It is the only 360 degree fully transparent sightseeing corridor in the world. Standing on the fully transparent sightseeing corridor, enjoy the panoramic view of Shanghai in a unique way of "aerial stroll" and experience an unprecedented shock.

attractions.name: 90米室外观光走廊
attractions.summary: The 90 meter outdoor sightseeing corridor is located on the high-rise of a famous building in Shanghai, providing a unique perspective that allows tourists to overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Shanghai city. This is an ideal place for photography enthusiasts and tourists seeking exciting experiences.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 上海之巅观光厅
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Tower's Observation Deck at the Top of Shanghai is a functional experience area of the Shanghai Tower. From the 360-degree observation deck at the top, you can have a close-up view of the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and the World Financial Center below your feet, while enjoying a distant view of the Expo Park, City God Temple, the Shanghai Stadium, and Hongqiao Airport. The winding Suzhou Creek and Huangpu River merge into the Yangtze River and flow into the East China Sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ascend to the Top of the Sea and Enjoy the Panoramic City View.

attractions.name: 陆家嘴空中步行连廊
attractions.summary: The Pudong Lujiazui Sky Pedestrian Corridor is approximately 543 meters long, starting from the second floor of Guojin Center in the west, crossing Yincheng Middle Road, crossing Dongtai Road along the north side of Jinmao Tower to the east, following the Global Financial Center to reach the Lujiazui Ring Road, and connecting with the Lujiazui Circular Sky Corridor. From the corridor, one can overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Lujiazui Financial City. Citizens can take a leisurely stroll in the air through the aerial corridor, conveniently shuttling between various shopping malls and subway stations.

attractions.name: 浦东美术馆
attractions.tag: Special exhibition hall; night tour and sightseeing; Art Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Pudong Art Museum (MAP) is invested, constructed and operated by Lujiazui Group and designed by the famous French architect and Pritzker Prize winner Jean Nouvel. Construction started on September 26, 2017 and will be officially opened to the public in July 2021. Open. Pudong Art Museum is located in the core area of Xiaolujiazui Riverside. It is a modern building with 6 floors and 30 meters high. It extends westward to the bank of the Huangpu River and eastward to connect to the Oriental Pearl Tower via the Garden Square, forming a 30,000-square-meter art museum territory.
The main building of Pudong Art Museum covers an area of 13,000 square meters, with a total building space area of nearly 40,000 square meters. It has 13 exhibition halls and an exhibition area of more than 10,000 square meters. The facade and floor of the building are made of Shandong Baima granite, and the interior space and decoration are inspired by Malevich's classic geometric drawings.
As a state-owned public art museum, Pudong Art Museum is an important measure to build the "Shanghai Culture" brand. It shoulders the cultural mission and social responsibilities entrusted by the urban and municipal governments. It focuses on international art exhibitions and exchanges, takes into account domestic art exhibitions, and highlights the four major functions of exhibitions, aesthetic education, cultural creativity, and international exchanges. It is committed to becoming a new landmark of Shanghai's international cultural venues and an important platform for international cultural and artistic exchanges.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lujiazui Binjiang New Internet Celebrity Landmark

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 人民广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
People's Square is the largest public square in Shanghai. It was transformed from the "largest horse racing hall in the Far East" in the concession era, and it is also a landmark of Shanghai. 
People's Square in a broad sense is mainly composed of open squares, People's Park, Shanghai Grand Theatre, Shanghai Museum and other buildings. 
Hong Kong Famous Street, Di Mei Shopping Center and Old Shanghai 1930 Style Street are built underground in the square, showing the old appearance of Shanghai in 1930s. 
There is a fountain in the center of the square, which sprays water about every half hour at night. It is beautiful under various lights and is a good place to enjoy the cool air.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Landmark and Transportation Hub

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览（金陵东路码头）
attractions.name_en: The Huangpu River Cruise (Jinling East Road Pier)
attractions.summary: The express tour condenses the essence of both banks of the Pujiang River. The route is Jinling East Road Wharf - Shiliupu Old Wharf - Nanpu Bridge - Jiangnan Shipyard Site - Chinese Art Palace - Lupu Bridge - Bund World Architecture Expo Group - Jinling East Road Wharf. The entire tour lasts about 60 minutes.

attractions.name: 广富林文化遗址
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Enjoying autumn leaves; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The ancient civilization of the Guangfulin Cultural Site has been preliminarily confirmed through scientific archaeology. As early as the late Neolithic period, around four to five thousand years ago, rice cultivation was already widespread in the area, indicating an advanced agricultural production system. Additionally, the textile history here is long-standing, with pottery spindles from the late Neolithic period uncovered at the site.

The development of the Guangfulin Site Park aims to inherit historical culture and preserve the original ecological structure of the ancient town. It will integrate modern urban construction concepts to create an "underwater museum." Stepping into the site, the Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is particularly captivating. The entire exhibition space is set underwater, with pyramid-like rooftops floating on Fulin Lake, blending with the surrounding environment to create a beautiful scene. The exhibition hall is designed with the concept of a "Journey through Time and Space," combining modern audiovisual technology to present scenes such as the archaeological memories of Guangfulin, the formation of Shanghai's land, the arrival of early settlers, the rise of local cities, the flourishing of Songjiang Prefecture, the emergence of Shanghai as a city, and a vision for the future. Visitors can experience and explore the history of Shanghai's civilization in a time tunnel.

At night, the site hosts an exciting lantern festival. From the lake-bottom garage entrance to near Zhuque Gate, over 40 large lantern sets light up the area, creating a dazzling, beautiful display. Among these, the 3D Mapping show is a major highlight, condensing the thousand-year history of Guangfulin into a stunning three-minute light and shadow performance projected onto Fulin Tower, attracting numerous visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the unique underwater exhibition hall

attractions.name: 广富林郊野公园
attractions.summary: Guangfulin Suburban Park is located in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and is named after its proximity to the Guangfulin Cultural Site. The park starts from Chenshantang in the east, connects with Youdun Port in the west, starts from Chenhua Road in the north, and ends at Guangfulin Road in the south, with a total of 7 entrances and exits, covering a total area of about 4 square kilometers.

attractions.name: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址
attractions.name_en: The site of the first CPC National Congress
attractions.summary: Shanghai is the birthplace of the CPC, the birthplace of its original aspiration, and the birthplace of its great founding spirit. The site of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China is the place where the CPC dreams to set sail and the spiritual home of CPC people. On July 23, 1921, the first National Congress of the CPC was held at No. 106 Wangzhi Road (now No. 76 Xingye Road) in Shanghai, announcing the official establishment of the CPC. In September 1952, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was restored, a memorial hall was established, and it was opened to the public. In March 1961, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was designated as a national key cultural relic protection unit. The Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China is directly under the Propaganda Department of the Shanghai Municipal Committee. On June 3, 2021, the brand new Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was officially completed. The upgraded Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China has formed the characteristic pattern of "one hall and three sites". With the newly completed exhibition hall as the main core, it manages the site of the first National Congress of the CPC, the former site of the dormitory of the first National Congress of the CPC (Bowen Women's School), and the former site of the CPC delegation office in Shanghai (Zhou Mansion) as three key cultural relics under national protection. It is a red hall that tells the story of the founding of the party, demonstrates the founding of the party, and interprets the great spirit of the founding of the party. There are over 128000 collections of various levels from the Opium War to the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The new basic display, The Great Beginning - The Exhibition of the Creation History of the CPC, tells the history of the founding of the Party in a panoramic way, leading the audience to deeply understand the rich connotation of the great spirit of party building.

attractions.name: 复兴公园
attractions.summary: Fuxing Park is one of the earliest parks established in Shanghai. More than 80 years ago, this was originally a fertile farmland inhabited by hardworking and poor farmers. Fuxing Park is a French style park with a regular garden layout and a natural style that gradually changes towards the southwest. In recent years, a large number of flowers and trees have been added, with a total of 140 species and over 10000 shrubs, including towering plane trees, as well as precious trees such as seven chestnut trees, oak trees, and maple trees. The Fuxing Park is also very lively at night. The French atmosphere matches the colorful night life. The sound of high-heeled shoes will suddenly come from a peaceful corner, or under the French wutong tree late at night, there are young people waiting for a taxi at the roadside. I always sleep very late here at night in Shanghai.

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 思南公馆
attractions.tag: Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
The name of Sinan Mansion comes from Sinan Road. Sinan Road dates back to the road name of the French Concession in Shanghai-Route Massenet, and the English name of Sinan Mansion Hotel comes from this. 
This area began to be developed in the 1920s as the core area of the French Concession at that time. This year, the first batch of garden houses rose along Lafide Road (now Fuxing Middle Road) south of French Park (now Fuxing Park). 
In the following ten years, garden houses in the area south of Lafeide Road, east of Mas South Road (now Sinan Road) and west of Luban Road (now Chongqing South Road) were built one after another, attracting a large number of military and political dignitaries, entrepreneurs, professionals and famous artists at that time to move in. Zhou Enlai, Liu Yazi, Mei Lanfang and other celebrities once lived here, making this area a residence and gathering place of the upper class at that time. 
Today, Sinan Mansion combines 49 renovated historic buildings and 9 new buildings into four complementary functional areas: hotel, commercial, residential and office. Sinan Mansion has become one of the preservation and protection projects of Shanghai's historical and cultural features and excellent historical buildings. It has 51 garden houses with a long history, and at the same time, it gathers various architectural styles such as independent garden houses, corridor buildings and garden lanes. It combines humanities, fashion and historical heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the patches of garden houses

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 外白渡桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Waibaidu Bridge, erected at the confluence of the Suzhou River and the Huangpu River in Shanghai, is a steel frame underbearing bridge and the largest steel bridge in Shanghai. 
Waibaidu Bridge has a history of one hundred years, bearing the history and culture of old Shanghai, and witnessing the rapid development of new Shanghai. It can be seen in many TV dramas of old Shanghai. 
· To enjoy the bridge, you need to stand in the distance to see the panoramic view, or you can stand on the bridge to get in close contact and enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Suzhou River. 
If you are lucky, you may also be able to see new couples taking photography, and take unique wedding photos on the bridge when there is no car at the red light.
attractions.shortFeatures: Location of old Shanghai film and television dramas
