attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 观前街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Located in the center of Suzhou ancient city, the area is prosperous in commerce, famous shops gather and numerous historic sites. There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering many Suzhou specialties

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

restaurants.name_en: Scholarly Family Pingjiang Mansion Muxiang Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 果戈里大街
attractions.summary:
· It has a history of more than 100 years, and there are many Russian-style buildings, including the famous Qiulin Food Company Building and St. Alexeyev Church. 
The prosperity and night scene are no less beautiful than Central Street, and it is also a "bar street" in Harbin. 
It is also a famous cultural street, with modern horseshoe stones on both sides of the road, and a piece engraved with Heilongjiang historical and cultural celebrities is inlaid every other section.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old Russian-style block

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 龙塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Long Tower, with a height of 336 meters, ranks second in the world and first in Asia among steel towers. It is a comprehensive multi-functional tower integrating broadcast and television transmission, tourism, dining and entertainment, advertising, environmental and meteorological monitoring, microwave communication, and wireless communication. It is an iconic landmark of Harbin, Northeast China. 

The total area of Long Tower is 16,600 square meters, with the base covering 13,000 square meters and the tower building covering 3,600 square meters. The tower base consists of one underground floor and four above-ground floors, forming a spherical crown shape. The tower body is an octagonal prism, with a parabolic shape and a cylindrical shaft in the center. The structure is surrounded by seven silver-white aluminum alloy panels and nine dark blue coated glass panels. The tower's lower and upper levels are located at 181 meters and 206 meters, respectively, consisting of a disc-shaped lower tower and a circular upper tower. The antennas are positioned between 220.5 meters and 336 meters. 

Long Tower has meticulously created an "honorable hospitality" service, adhering to aviation service standards and forming a team with international service capabilities. It has successfully hosted many central government leaders, including Li Changchun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and He Guoqiang, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, as well as foreign dignitaries such as Russian Deputy Prime Minister Sergey Khristenko and former South Korean Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung. Large-scale delegations from Hong Kong, Macau, and the business and professional sectors, as well as celebrities from the entertainment and business industries, often visit the tower. Visitors often praise the tower’s unique features, beautiful scenery, delicious food, and excellent service. Long Tower has become a must-visit tourist destination for both domestic and international travelers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The high-altitude rotating restaurant offers a view of the night scene; overlooking the panoramic view of Harbin from a height of 100 meters.

attractions.name: 防洪纪念塔
attractions.summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

attractions.name: 亚布力森林温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
· Yabuli Forest Hot Spring is located in Yabuli Tourist Resort, Heilongjiang Province. The hot spring is divided into two areas: indoor pavilion and outdoor hot spring. 
The indoor pavilion takes tropical garden scenery as the theme of hot springs, and combines the abundant Chinese herbal medicine resources in local mountainous areas to create local characteristic medicinal hot springs. There are more than 20 kinds of characteristic hot springs such as ginseng spring, ganoderma lucidum spring, astragalus spring and schisandra spring. 
· Outdoor hot spring pools are distributed in the original birch forest and pine forest, and you can experience the hot spring experience of spring flowers, summer green, autumn yellow and winter snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical garden scenery indoor hot spring

attractions.name: 亚布力滑雪旅游度假区
attractions.summary: Yabuli Ski Resort is a famous ski resort in China, gathering multiple professional ski resorts and resort hotels. Here, you can experience the thrilling "snow diving" on professional ski slopes, and there are many professional coaches to help beginners quickly master basic skills, allowing you to fully enjoy the fun of skiing. Yabuli Ski Resort is located in the southern mountainous area of Yabuli Town. The snow quality here is excellent and the hardness is moderate. The snow accumulation period is 170 days, and the skiing period is nearly 150 days. From mid November to late March of the following year, it is a good time for skiing. In addition, there are also activities such as playing snow circles and snowmobiles. International events such as the Asian Winter Games are often held here. The resort consists of three peaks with an altitude of over 1000 meters (Daguokui, Erguokui, and Sanguokui), and is home to multiple ski resorts, such as the Xinhao Sunshine Ski Resort with better facilities and larger facilities in China, and the Xinti Commission Ski Resort with better facilities. Although skiing costs are slightly higher than ordinary ski resorts, they are worth experiencing. In addition, summer vacation areas are also suitable for leisure vacations. The forests here are dense and the scenery is beautiful. There are entertainment projects such as golf, boating, fishing, etc. in the vacation area, making it a good place to escape the heat and summer. Full text 

attractions.name: 亚布力世界第一滑道
attractions.name_en: Yabuli Sightseeing Cable Car and World's First Slide
attractions.summary:
· The world's first slide in Yabuli is located on Sanguokui Mountain at an altitude of 999.8 meters. It extends down the hillside, with a total length of 2,680 meters and a drop of 570 meters. It has 48 curves, which is the highest in the world. 
· You need to take the high-speed uphill cable car to the top of the mountain. During this period, you can overlook this beautiful forest and snowfield, pine trees, stone sea, hanging trees and other scenic spots. I was also lucky enough to see professional athletes speeding in the ski field. 
· The slide is divided into single-person vehicles and double-person vehicles. Each vehicle has a control handle. The slide will pass through two tunnels and 48 detours. The top speed can reach 80 kilometers per hour. Experience the thrill of speed and passion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Total length 2680 meters

attractions.name: 清明上河园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gem; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A large-scale Song Dynasty cultural theme park built based on the famous Song Dynasty painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*.
- The park closely replicates the scenes from *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*, consisting of eight functional zones and four cultural zones.
- The Southern Garden recreates the bustling streets of Northern Song Dynasty’s capital, Bianjing (today's Kaifeng), while the Northern Garden showcases the Song Dynasty's royal gardens and court entertainment, with palace architecture adorned in golden and brilliant colors.
- The staff inside the park wear Song Dynasty clothing, creating a time-travel experience. In addition, there are exciting scene performances and folk shows.
attractions.shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Scenery of Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden

attractions.name: 鼓楼夜市
attractions.summary: This is a paradise for foodies and a popular gathering place for snacks among Kaifeng residents on a daily basis. There are various types of snacks with different flavors, such as lamb kang bread with a crispy exterior and a fragrant interior, almond tea with a sweet and fragrant aroma, soup dumplings with rich juice, and even a barbecue to eat. It is a great place for three to five friends to enjoy delicious food, drink spicy food, and chat. Full text 

attractions.name: 开封古城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: The second largest ancient city wall building in China
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient city walls with architectural style of Yuan and Ming Dynasties
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-21:00(Tickets available until 20:30; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 中国翰园碑林
attractions.tag: Garden; Enjoy Autumn Flowers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The China Han Garden was established in 1985 by Li Gongtao with self-raised funds. It consists of two main scenic areas: the Stele Corridor and the Garden. The garden is fresh and elegant, with charming scenery, cascading waterfalls, fountains, and lakeside islands shining in harmony. The stele inscriptions mainly focus on calligraphy art, incorporating poetry, calligraphy, painting, and seal cutting. It is an artistic treasure trove that integrates stele engraving art and classical garden architecture. The stele corridors are divided into several sections based on their themes and subjects, including the Central Stele Corridor, Modern Stele Corridor, Song Dynasty Stele Corridor, Stele Corridor of Emperors and Famous Ministers of Various Dynasties, Painting Stele Corridor, Seal Engraving Stele Corridor, Hard Pen Calligraphy Stele Corridor, Stele Corridor of Minority Script Calligraphy, Middle-Aged Calligraphy Stele Corridor, and the International Friendship Stele Corridor.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are thousands of precious steles hidden.

attractions.name: 万岁山武侠城
attractions.summary: Wansui Mountain Wuxia City is located in the Wansui Mountain Tourist Area in the northwest of Kaifeng City. It is a large-scale tourist area built against the backdrop of Song Dynasty culture and martial arts culture. There are ancient and charming Song Dynasty garden streets and alleys built in the scenic area, with exciting martial arts and ancient costume performances all year round, as well as rich entertainment facilities. It is a good place for relaxation and entertainment in the surrounding areas of Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. When visiting Wansui Mountain Wuxia City, the first thing to experience is the beautiful scenery of the scenic area. The overall atmosphere of Wuxia City is shaped by the Song Dynasty, with many eye-catching landscapes such as Wansui Temple, which reproduces the glory of the thousand year old temple of the Song Dynasty, Dragon Altar, which embodies the spirit of Buddhism, Confucianism, and Taoism, the well preserved ruins of the ancient city walls of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and one of the large-scale artificial streams and waterfalls in China, the "Nine Dragon Waterfall". What's rare is that there are also very large forest green spaces in the scenic area, with a peaceful environment and flowers blooming in the appropriate season, which is very suitable for photography. Afterwards, tourists will notice the unique martial arts characteristics in the scenic area. There are 36 martial arts themed performances released here year-round (about 60 performances per day), including "Cross Slope", "Wu Song Drunken Beats Jiang Men Shen", "Wild Boar Forest" and several other exciting themed performances. Don't miss it here; Interactive performances such as "Wuxia Film and Television Experience Hall", "Wuzhuangyuan", and "Li Kui's Case" can also allow tourists to participate in Wuxia stories, which are full of fun. In the architectural design of the scenic area, there are also many elements of martial arts, such as the martial arts road with large weapons such as the "Heaven Reliant Sword" and "Overlord Sword", the "Swordsman Map" of the Song Dynasty Martial Arts Academy, the "Sword Altar" of the Cross Slope, the Juxian Village, and the martial arts venue, all of which are unique. In addition, during the Spring Festival every year, Wansui Mountain holds large-scale temple fairs with grand performances, rich specialty snacks, dazzling handicrafts, and unique entertainment activities, creating a lively atmosphere. It has become one of the popular temple fairs in the Central Plains region. Full text 

attractions.name: 开封包公祠
attractions.tag: Night Tour and Scenic View; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Bao Gong Temple is a restored and reconstructed site dedicated to commemorating Bao Zheng, a renowned ancient Chinese upright official and political reformer. It is located on the west shore of Bao Gong Lake in Kaifeng, Henan Province, and is one of the key attractions in the Central Plains tourist area developed by the National Tourism Administration.  

The temple consists of the main hall, second hall, east and west side halls, half-wall corridor, and a stele pavilion. Its style is ancient, solemn, and dignified. On the east side is the Lingshi Garden, which is composed of stone carvings and a waterside pavilion, elegant and distinctive. Inside the temple, there are exhibits such as a bronze statue of Bao Gong, a dragon, tiger, and dog bronze cleaver, wax figures of Bao Gong administering justice, the "Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele," historical novels about Bao Gong, Bao Gong’s career-declaration poems, the Kaifeng Prefecture Inscription Stele, Bao Gong's family instructions, Bao Gong’s calligraphy, and an epitaph, among other historical artifacts.
attractions.shortFeatures: Song-style ancient architecture in memory of Bao Zheng.

attractions.name: 开封府
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Kaifeng Fu, also known as the Southern Yamen, was the administrative and judicial office for officials in the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, and was praised as the "first prefecture under heaven."
- Among the various government offices throughout history, it was the largest in scale, equivalent to the Beijing municipal government today.
- The architecture is grand and magnificent, complementing the waters of the Three Pools Lake, creating the scenic view of "Eastern Prefecture, Western Temple, Pavilion and Clear Water."
- In addition to a large collection of precious historical materials and exhibits, visitors can also enjoy performances such as the "Opening of the Yamen," "Judge Bao’s Rulings," and "Fire-Spitting Face-Changing."
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the ancient-style performance of Judge Bao solving cases.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Spring and summer 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Winter 07:00-18:30(Admission ends at 18:30),Opens at Autumn 07:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 龙亭景区
attractions.tag: Ancient ruins; Appreciate autumn flowers; City Parks; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the northern end of Zhongshan Road in Kaifeng, this ancient architectural complex is built according to the layout of the Qing Wanshou Palace.
- It was once the site of the Northern Song Dynasty imperial capital. From the stone railing, you can enjoy a view of the ancient city of Kaifeng, and inside the hall, you can view the displayed cultural relics.
- Known both domestically and internationally as a famous chrysanthemum viewing destination, it hosts an annual Chrysanthemum Festival in the golden autumn. During this time, the park is splendid, with thousands of chrysanthemum varieties competing in beauty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb to the Top and View the Scenery of Kaifeng Ancient City

attractions.name: 樊楼
attractions.summary: Fan Building, also known as Fan Building, located at the northern end of Songdu Royal Street, is a group of courtyard-style pavilions rebuilt in 1988, and it is also the largest entertainment center imitating Song Dynasty in Kaifeng at present. According to legend, Fanlou was once the most prosperous restaurant in Tokyo in the Northern Song Dynasty. Even the then emperor Song Huizong visited this building in person and left a much-told story about meeting Li Shishi. Fan Building consists of five buildings: east, west, south, north and middle, each building is three stories high. Among them, the west building is the main building of Fan Building, and it is also the largest one on the fifth floor. The throne of Emperor Huizong of Song Dynasty is located upstairs, and the furnishings are magnificent. There are Li Shishi's piano room and study on the middle and upper floors, which are elegantly and quietly arranged. Fan Building, located at the northern end of Royal Street in Songdu, is a group of courtyard-style pavilions rebuilt in 1988 according to historical records. According to legend, Fanlou was the first of the 72 restaurants in Tokyo in the Northern Song Dynasty. Song Huizong, the romantic emperor, and Li Shishi, a famous prostitute in Kyoto, often met here. The novel Water Margin also describes this building. Liu Zicui, a poet of the Song Dynasty, once left a story that "Liang Garden sings and dances are full of romantic songs, and fine wine is like a knife to solve sorrow. I recall the pleasure of Chengping, and the lights go to Fanlou in the late night." Hymn. Fan Lou consists of five buildings: east, west, south, north and middle. Grey tiles and blue bricks, carved beams and painted buildings, magnificent furnishings, simple and elegant.
attractions.shortFeatures: Courtyard-style imitation pavilion of Song Dynasty

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 南宁博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Nanning Museum is a local comprehensive museum focusing on education, display, collection and research of Nanning's historical and cultural heritage. The architectural design of the museum is beautiful and has unique local characteristics. It looks like a bunch of light leaves, noble and gorgeous phoenix wings, the flying feather man on the bronze drum pattern, and the sailing fleet. The facade is decorated with modern materials such as hollow aluminum plates, and it is decorated with ethnic patterns such as Zhuang brocade. Modernity, regionality and nationality are unified, implying a modern Nanning with hard work, progress, tolerance and unity. In the hall, the art installation of the word "Yong" creatively designed by a famous designer is displayed, which not only embodies the original meaning of the word "Yong" surrounded by many waters, but also derives the cultural connotation of "harmony and harmony" from the holiday of "Yong" and "Yong", which is both artistic and functional, and is the first in domestic museums.
attractions.shortFeatures: A comprehensive museum for studying Nanning's history

attractions.name: 王府井
attractions.summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing

attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark of Beijing's fashionable life

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 烟袋斜街
attractions.summary:
Yandai Xiejie, with a total length of 232 meters, is the oldest commercial street in Beijing. During the Qing Dynasty, it mainly dealt in smoking sets, mounting calligraphy and painting, selling antiques and jade articles, etc. 
Yandai Xiejie itself is like a tobacco bag, the slender street is like a tobacco bag pole, and the east entrance is like a tobacco bag mouth, so it is named Xiejie after "Yandai". 
There are Beijing paper-cutting, sugar-blowing people and Beijing specialty snacks here, which are full of ancient and unique city customs and full of charm. 
There are also famous scenic spots such as Yinding Bridge, Lotus Market and Prince Gong's Mansion around, as well as special delicacies such as Yaoji Fried Liver and Nanmen Hotpot, which can be visited together.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the breath of old Beijing in the old hutong

attractions.name: 清华大学
attractions.summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 北京大学
attractions.summary: Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 国家大剧院
attractions.name_en: National Centre for the Performing Arts
attractions.summary: The National Centre for the Performing Arts is the highest performance venue in Beijing and the highest hall of Chinese performing arts. The theater is located on Chang'an Street in the west of Beijing, adjacent to the Great Hall of the People and Tiananmen Square. The north entrance is connected to Tiananmen West Station of the subway, and there is a ticket office at the entrance. Its architectural appearance is unique, which is a steel structure shell with a semi-ellipsoidal shape, novel shape and unique conception; The underwater promenade inside is 80m long and sparkling. The National Centre for the Performing Arts has three professional theaters: the concert hall on the east side, the opera house in the middle and the theater on the west side. In addition, there is an experimental small theater to meet the entertainment and cultural needs of people of all ages.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the beautiful water drop architecture

attractions.name: 人民大会堂
attractions.summary:
· Located on the west side of Tiananmen Square in the center of Beijing, it is an important part of Tiananmen Square. 
The Great Hall of the People faces east from west, 336 meters long from north to south, 206 meters wide from east to west, and 46.5 meters high. It covers an area of 150,000 square meters, which is larger than the total building area of the Forbidden City. 
It is an important place for the party, the state and various people's organizations to hold political activities, and it is also a place for Chinese state leaders and people to hold political, diplomatic and cultural activities. 
Usually, there will be some performances in the Great Hall of the People, such as concerts and some Peking Opera performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: The meeting place of the people's congress

attractions.name: 中国国家博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
With a total construction area of nearly 200,000 square meters and a collection of more than 1 million pieces, it is the largest museum in the world. 
The museum is divided into five floors and has 48 exhibition halls. It is one of the museums with the richest collection of Chinese cultural relics. 
The exhibition system consists of basic exhibition, special exhibition, international exchange exhibition and temporary exhibition, covering all stages from ancient times to the present. 
· There are a large number of visitors, so you can make an appointment online before going to save time.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at Chinese Treasures through Millenniums

attractions.name: 人民英雄纪念碑
attractions.summary:
· The Monument to the People's Heroes is located in the center of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, the capital, and was built to commemorate the revolutionary martyrs in modern Chinese history.  
The whole Hero Monument is carved with more than 170 figures, which summarizes and vividly shows the great historical facts of the people's revolution in China in the past hundred years. 
On the front of the tablet, there are eight characters "People's Heroes Live Forever" inscribed by Chairman Mao himself, and on the back there is an inscription drafted by Chairman Mao and written by Premier Zhou Enlai. 
· This is the memory of the older generation and the study place of the younger generation. When you come to Tiananmen Square, you will definitely come here to commemorate it.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the symbol buildings of the motherland

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 祈年殿
attractions.name_en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven

attractions.name: 圜丘
attractions.summary:
Located in the southern half of the Temple of Heaven, Qiu Qiu was founded in 1530. Qiu Qiu was the place where the emperor held the ceremony of worshipping heaven in the winter solstice, also known as the Temple of Heaven. 
The hill faces south, surrounded by red palace walls and decorated with green glazed tiles, commonly known as "sub-walls". 
The number of stones used in the altar is all related to "nine". The sum of the three floors is 45 feet, which is not only a multiple of nine, but also means "the respect of the ninth five years".

attractions.name: 皇穹宇
attractions.summary: The Imperial Vault of Heaven is located north of the Round Hill Altar of the Temple of Heaven, and is a place where the altar of the Round Hill Altar worships the divine position and stores sacrificial plaques. The Imperial Dome is a brick and wood structure. There is no cross beam in the hall. The roof is supported by 8 eaves columns, 8 gold columns and many arch of wooden architecture. Three layers of ceiling and coffered ceiling, with each layer folded in, are extremely distinctive and rare in ancient architecture. The eaves of the hall are covered with blue glazed tiles, and there is a gilded crown on the eaves. The walls of the hall are brick walls made of perfectly round polished bricks, which look like a sapphire umbrella with a golden crown when viewed from afar. There are two side halls on either side of the Imperial Vault, each with a width of five rooms. The structure is a single eaved gable roof, and outside the main hall are the famous Echo Wall, Three Tones Stone, and Dialogue Stone. The imperial dome enclosure has the function of transmitting sound, commonly known as the echo wall. The San Yin Stone is located on the corridor in front of the Imperial Palace. Standing at the Three Tones Stone and clapping, you can hear three echoes, a phenomenon known as human whispers and heavenly thunder.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Peak season 08:00-16:30,Opens at Off season 08:00-15:30

attractions.name: 前门大街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Beijing's famous commercial street, located on the central axis of Beijing, starts from Moon Bay and ends at Tianqiao intersection, connecting with Tianqiao South Street. 
The street is about 845 meters long. It was called Zhengyangmen Street from the Ming Dynasty, Qing Dynasty to the Republic of China, and it was commonly known as Qianmen Street by the people. In 1965, it was officially named Qianmen Street. 
There are many famous time-honored shops, such as Quanjude and Donglaishun, including Dashilan and Xianyukou Hutong. 
While the original time-honored stores and traditional business characteristics have basically been preserved, new stores such as clothing department stores, food, clocks and clocks have been opened one after another.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beijing-style old commercial street

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 太和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Supreme Harmony, commonly known as the Jinluan Hall, is the highest existing palace in China and is known as the first of the "Three Great Halls of the East". 
The interior decoration of the hall is very luxurious, with gold bricks paving the floor, and a throne with golden lacquer cloud dragon patterns, inlaid with thousands of golden dragon patterns, which is exquisite and unusually. 
There are also sundials, bronze turtles, bronze cranes, etc. in front of the temple, and a stone faucet for drainage is installed. During the rainy season, it can present the spectacle of thousands of dragons spitting water. 
At the same time, it is also the center of gravity of the Forbidden City, where it is used to hold various grand ceremonies, such as the emperor's accession to the throne, the emperor's wedding, and the establishment of the queen.
attractions.shortFeatures: The "Golden Temple" in the Forbidden City

attractions.name: 保和殿
attractions.summary:
The Hall of Preservation of Harmony was built in 1420, behind the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and it is one of the three halls outside the Forbidden City. 
The floor in the hall is paved with gold bricks, and there is a carved gold lacquer throne from north to south. The inner and outer eaves are painted with golden dragons and seals, and the ceiling is a front dragon with powder and gold, which is luxurious and rich when matched with the decoration and furnishings that emphasize Dan red. 
The temple had different uses in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Before the ceremony of the Ming Dynasty, the emperor often changed clothes here. In the Qing Dynasty, every New Year's Eve and the 15th day of the first month, the emperor's family banquet and palace examination were held in Baohe Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Roof covered with yellow glazed tiles

attractions.name: 乾清宫
attractions.summary:
· Qianqing Palace is the first of the three palaces in the Forbidden City. It is located in Qianqing Gate and is the essence of Han palace architecture. 
On the spacious platform in front of the hall, there are bronze turtles, bronze cranes, sundials and Jialiang on the left and right respectively. There are four gilded incense burners in front, and the hall is covered with gold bricks. 
It used to be the bedroom of the emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and it was also the place where the emperors of the Ming and Qing Dynasties handled daily political affairs. Now it is the original display of court life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The main halls of the three palaces of the Forbidden City

attractions.name: 坤宁宫
attractions.summary:
Kunning Palace is the last of the three palaces in the inner court. Its name is taken from the sentence in Tao Te Ching. Kun De Yi Yining, hence the name Kunning Palace. In ancient times, the status of the queen is opposite to that of the emperor, and she is the most noble woman in the world. Kunning Palace echoes the Qianqing Palace where the emperor lives. In the Ming Dynasty, it has always been the bedroom of the queen, the empress of the main palace. In the Qing Dynasty, Kunning Palace was rebuilt according to Manchu customs. The rebuilt Kunning Palace style was full of Manchu cultural characteristics, and its main function was changed from the queen's bedroom to a place of sacrifice. On all the days of great sacrifices and on the first and fifteenth days of each month, the emperor and queen would personally come here to worship the gods. Every major celebration and New Year's Day, the queen also holds a celebration ceremony here. In addition, it has an important function, that is, as a new house for the emperor's wedding. Kangxi, Tongzhi, Guangxu and Xundi Puyi, who were young to the throne, all lived in Dongnuan Pavilion of Kunning Palace for two days when they got married, and then returned to Qianqing Palace or Yangxin Hall. At present, the Dongnuan Pavilion of Kunning Palace is still furnished according to the wedding room of the emperor of the Qing Dynasty. 
Every year at the beginning of April, apricot blossoms in Kunning Palace begin to bloom, and pink and white apricot blossoms bloom all over the branches.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient multifunctional palace architecture

attractions.name: 御花园
attractions.summary:
Located at the northern end of the central axis of the Forbidden City, it covers an area of more than 12,000 square meters. It was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty and named "Palace Houyuan". It was renamed "Imperial Garden" in the Yongzheng Dynasty of the Qing Dynasty. 
The buildings in the park adopt the symmetrical layout of the central axis, and the buildings are mostly leaning against walls. Only a few beautifully shaped pavilions stand in the park, and the space is wide. 
Cypress and locust trees are planted in the garden, with potted plants and bronze statues to add vitality, forming an evergreen scenery all year round, highlighting the Han culture of harmony between man and nature. 
In early spring, the apricot trees next to Chengrui Pavilion in the Royal Garden gradually enter the full bloom period.
attractions.shortFeatures: According to legend, the place where the emperor climbed to enjoy the moon

attractions.name: 神武门
attractions.summary: Shenwumen is the north gate of the Forbidden City. It was built in 1420 and is known as Xuanwu Gate. When it was rebuilt in the year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it was renamed Shenwumen to avoid the name of Emperor Kangxi Xuanye. Shenwumen used to set up bells and drums, which were managed by Luan Yiwei. Qin Tianjian instructed to change the point, and one doctor took turns every day. The bell rings 108 times after dusk every day, and the drum rings after the bell. After that, the bell and drum were rung every time, and the bell was rung again when the dawn was enlightened. When the emperor lives in the palace, he doesn't ring the bell. As the back door of the palace, Shenwumen is an important entrance guard for daily access to the palace. The queens of the Ming and Qing Dynasties entered and exited from this door when they performed their silkworm kiss ceremony. In the Qing Dynasty, female draft was selected every three years, and the candidates entered the palace through this partial door. In 1924, Xun Di Pu Yi was expelled from the palace, and he left through this door when he left the palace.
attractions.shortFeatures: The North Gate of the Forbidden City

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 昆明湖
attractions.summary: Kunming Lake occupies three-quarters of the area of the Summer Palace, with beautiful scenery and is the soul of the entire garden. Every summer and autumn, a large number of tourists come to enjoy boating on the lake, admiring the pavilions and towers by the lake, and admiring the beautiful scenery of the entire park. In addition to the beautiful scenery of the lake, attractions such as the Seventeen Arch Bridge and the West Embankment in the lake are also worth savoring. Overview of Travel: Kunming Lake can be divided into three parts based on the division of water bodies: Great Lake, West Lake, and Back Lake. It takes about 2 hours to walk around the lake for a week. In summer and autumn, you can take a boat tour of the lake, which is both relaxing and enjoyable, without missing out on sightseeing and sightseeing. There are 8 boat docks and 5 different types of boats in the park. The prices and routes of cruise ships vary, please consult the scenic area for details. The main attraction to the east of Kunming Lake is Zhichun Pavilion, which is said to be where the thawing of Kunming Lake begins every spring. Not only can you capture the beautiful scenery of the entire park here, but the vast water color will also give you a very artistic silhouette effect. The seventeen span bridge spans between Nanhu Island and the east bank, with a length of 150 meters, like a long rainbow perched on the sparkling blue waves. It is a replica of Lugou Bridge, with stone lions of various shapes carved on the top of each stone barrier on the bridge, appearing exquisite, majestic, and beautiful. On the east bank of the Seventeen Arch Bridge, there stands a national octagonal pavilion. Nearby, there is a beautifully crafted bronze bull, the size of a real cow, squatting with its head held high and ears raised. If one hears something and looks back in surprise, it is very beautiful and vivid. Originally taken from the meaning of a divine cow guarding the water, it is now a precious cultural relic. To the south of the Seventeen Arch Bridge, there is a west embankment modeled after the West Lake Su Causeway, with six exquisitely constructed bridge pavilions that are worth a visit.

attractions.name: 万寿山
attractions.summary: Wanshou Mountain is the remnant of Yanshan Mountain, with a height of 58.59 meters and an altitude of 108.94 meters, facing Kunming Lake. In the seventh year of Hongzhi in the Ming Dynasty (1494), Xiaozong's nurse helped the saint lady Luo Shi to build a quiet temple in front of the mountain. In the early Qing Dynasty, it used to be a forage yard for horses raising in the court. In the fifteenth year of Qianlong's reign (1750), in order to celebrate the 60th birthday of the Empress Dowager, a Da Bao'en Yanshou Temple was built at the former site of Yuanjing Temple. The following year, the mountain was renamed Wanshou Mountain.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the main landscapes in the Summer Palace

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 雍和宫
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Located in the northeast corner of the inner city of Dongcheng District, Beijing, that is, east of Yonghegong Street Road, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist temple in Beijing. 
In the thirty-second year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it became the residence of Yinzhen, the fourth son of the emperor. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Zhaotai Gate, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, Yonghe Gate, Lama Temple, Lecture Hall and Tantric Hall present the standard layout of "seven halls and blue blues" in Chinese Buddhist temples. 
· From the east-west memorial archway with cornices and arches to the antique east-west Shunshan Tower, there are more than a thousand halls in total, which are very luxurious and worth visiting
attractions.shortFeatures: Lived in two emperors Yongzheng and Qianlong

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 
