attractions.name: 津湾广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jinwan Square is located beside the Haihe River, opposite Tianjin Station across the Haihe River. It is one of the most prosperous areas in Tianjin. 
The biggest highlight is its cultural heritage. The diverse composition of Tianjin's modern architectural style highlights the characteristics of the times when Chinese and western cultures converge.  
In addition, it is also the best place to enjoy the day and night scenery of Haihe River. The tall buildings backed by it are a bustling modern city, which is gorgeous and charming when lit at night. 
The European buildings around the square and on both sides of the river also constitute the whole landscape, which is one of the iconic viewing spots in Tianjin.
attractions.shortFeatures: The bustling area of Tianjin with charming night scene

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 静园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
Jingyuan, which combines Spanish and Japanese styles, is a typical representative of courtyard-style private mansion in Tianjin Concession period. 
It used to be the residence of Lu Zongyu, the minister of Beiyang government in Japan. Later, the last emperor Puyi lived here with Queen Wanrong and Shu Fei Wenxiu. 
· The noise of the city center is blocked out, only bursts of birdsong, which is very leisurely and suitable for tourists who like history and architecture to meditate and travel slowly. 
Reed flowers bloom in late autumn (October-December) every year, which is an excellent season to watch reed flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of the last emperor Puyi

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 盘山
attractions.summary: Panshan is located on the west side of Jixian County and is a famous mountain in the Beijing Tianjin area. There are many strange pine trees, rocks, and flowing water on the mountain, and with different heights, three layers of scenery appear in sequence, becoming the famous "Three Pans" scenery. Due to its beautiful scenery, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited Panshan 32 times and even exclaimed, "If I had known there were Panshan, why go down to Jiangnan. Although Panshan belongs to Tianjin city, it is actually closer to Beijing city center than to Tianjin city center. During holidays, tourists from the vicinity of Beijing and Tianjin rush to visit, and there are more people there. There are two cable cars in front of the mountain: the Jinsheng Cable Car (Shanmen Wansong Temple), which costs 60 yuan one-way and can reach halfway up the mountain; Yunsong Cableway (Wansong Temple Yunmao Temple), one-way 60 yuan, from halfway up the mountain to Yunmao Temple under the hanging moon peak, very close to the mountaintop. There is a mountain sightseeing bus and a hanging moon cableway in the back mountain, which are sold together for 100 yuan per trip. After taking the sightseeing bus and cableway in sequence, climb a short distance to reach the top of the mountain. The highest peak on the mountain is only 864.4 meters above sea level, but if you hike the entire distance, you will have to walk about 30 kilometers. Although the mountain is not high, you have to climb several hills, which is very tiring. A more reasonable arrangement is to take a sightseeing car and a hanging moon cableway from the back mountain directly to the top of the mountain, then walk down from the front mountain and walk along the front mountain from the hanging moon peak to the mountain gate, which is about 12 kilometers. Hanging Moon Peak: After climbing to the top of the mountain by sightseeing car and cable car, you can see the Pagoda of Dingguang Buddha Relic, which is a stone pagoda and a symbol of the mountain top. Start descending the mountain. If you have good physical strength, you can choose to climb the second highest peak of the mountain, Zilai Peak, at the fork in the road; If you want to save energy or time, just go all the way down the mountain. Top of the Mountain - Wansong Temple: After passing through the high temples such as Yunmao Temple, Nantian Gate, and Jiangjun Stone on Panshan Mountain, you can descend to the large temple Wansong Temple (formerly known as Li Jing'an, where the famous Tang Dynasty general Li Jing once lived). This is the road that the Yunsong Cableway passes through. If you hike, there are many dirt roads that are difficult to walk on and have few scenic spots. However, you can see the magnificent natural scenery, with rolling mountains, white clouds dotted in the blue sky, and the strange pine trees on the upper plate and the strange rocks in the middle plate all in one's sight. Wansong Temple Shanmen: This section is the route that the Jinsheng Cableway passes through. The road is relatively easy to walk, with a concentration of scenic spots and many cultural attractions. You can also see the scenery of Shuisheng in the lower part. Hiking down the mountain, one passes through the Tallinn, which is composed of 99 tombs and pagodas of eminent monks from various dynasties with different shapes; The place where Qianlong's substitute monk became a monk - Tiancheng Temple. To the east of the temple gate is the Woyun Tower, and at the foot of the mountain opposite the tower is the old site of a small stage. Qianlong once watched a play here. Further ahead, you can see Shuxia, one of the representative attractions of the Lower Water Festival. A waterfall like structure resembling strands of silk floats into the pool, bringing a refreshing feeling. Continuing on, I encountered a stone that looked like a gold ingot - Yuanbaoshi. It is said that touching it can bring wealth. When you see the stone with the words "entering victory" handwritten by Rong Lu, the Minister of War and Governor General of Zhili in the late Qing Dynasty, it indicates that the mountain gate is not far away. Every March and April, a temple fair is held in Panshan, where the scene of "Qianlong's Tour of Panshan" can be seen, recreating the grand scene of Qianlong's parade in the past. Full text 

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 西开教堂
attractions.summary: The Xikai Church is located at the southern end of the bustling Binjiang Road commercial street. It was founded in 1917 and is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Tianjin. The architectural style of the church is solemn and grand, and the sculptures inside the church are also complex and exquisite. In addition, Mass and Catholic holiday activities are open to the public, allowing participants to experience the strong religious atmosphere. The exterior of the church is made of red and yellow flower bricks, with three towers arranged in a cross shape and towering into the clouds covered with green copper sheets. After years of erosion, the mottled green shines with a sense of history under the sunshine, and each tower has a bronze cross on its top. Entering the church, the first thing that catches the eye is the main color scheme composed of lake blue, white, and light yellow, giving a fresh feeling. Various patterns are carved in just the right positions, and 14 columns are arranged from the doorway to the altar, exuding an extraordinary aura. There are exquisite copper statues of believers around the church, and oil paintings depicting the story of Jesus' suffering are hung on the walls. Inside the church, there are also colorful statues of the Virgin Mary, Jesus, angels, and others. In addition, the stained glass windows are also very charming. On one side of the church, you will find a small wooden room with a small cross on top, which is a "confession pavilion" used by priests to receive believers for confession and confession. The mass event of Xikai Church is open to the public, and non believers can also participate. However, during the mass time, visitors cannot wander around the church. They should sit quietly in the back row, not make loud noises or take photos, and feel the inner peace in the bustling city. In addition, there are also many Catholic holiday activities that are open to the public, just like Mass. The specific times for Mass and Catholic holiday events can be found on the official website. Full text 

attractions.name: 世纪钟广场
attractions.summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark building in Tianjin next to the railway station

attractions.name: 海河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It starts from Tianjin Jingang Bridge, ends at Dagukou and enters Bohai Bay, and runs through Tianjin city. It is the "mother river" of Tianjin. 
· There are Jingang Bridge, Lion Forest Bridge, Jintang Bridge, Bei'an Bridge, Jiefang Bridge and other bridges built on the Haihe River, which are very spectacular. 
There are all kinds of high-rise buildings and more than 20 historical and cultural buildings on both sides of the strait, which are worth visiting. There are also cruise docks in tianjin railway station, Ancient Culture Street and Great Beiyuan, where you can board the boat. 
Night is a good time to watch the Haihe River. The lights on both sides are on, and the scenery is very beautiful. I recommend Tianjin Eye, Jinta Jinmen and other places to take beautiful photos.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Tianjin Jingji Shengguang Marriott Hotel Seafood Buffet

attractions.name: 锦绣中华民俗村
attractions.summary: Jinxiu Zhonghua Folk Village consists of two parts: Jinxiu Zhonghua and Zhonghua Folk Village. The former has many miniature representations of well-known Chinese landscapes, allowing you to "explore China in one day". The latter has 24 village buildings where you can experience folk customs, and you can also watch folk performances of 56 ethnic groups. The two parks have been merged, just purchase one ticket. It is generally recommended to visit Jinxiu Zhonghua in the morning and Folk Village in the afternoon, as the large-scale performances in Folk Village are usually held in the afternoon. If you want to browse quickly for half a day, you can also consider combining walking with an electric scooter. The shuttle bus format is fixed, with the stop at the Confucian Temple in Jinxiu Zhonghua and the stop at Mosuo Village in Folk Village. It takes about 25 minutes to browse the entire scenic area. The docking time is 2 minutes. Splendid China mainly looks at miniature scenic spots and photographs. Nearly one hundred Chinese scenic spots are scaled down by 1:15, which can be called the collection of essence of China's natural scenery and human history. The mini version of the Great Wall, the Terra Cotta Warriors of the Qin Dynasty, the Mogao Grottoes of Dunhuang, Huangguoshu Waterfall and other places of interest can all be seen here, so it is said that "you can travel all over China in one day". The Chinese Folk Village offers a unique blend of 56 ethnic groups in China, where you can witness colorful ethnic costumes, the architectural styles of 24 villages, and various folk performances, making it a sight to behold. All 24 villages are built in a 1:1 ratio, giving people a sense of immersion. The architectural styles of ethnic minority villages are even more unique, such as the stone villages of the Buyi people, the wooden houses of the Mosuo people, the bamboo buildings of the Dai people, the Mongolian yurts, and the Tibetan monasteries. People take pictures of them from time to time. There are also many participating projects in the park that you can experience firsthand, such as the Wupeng boat, wooden boat, Dulong tribe zip line, horseback riding, archery, etc. You can check the official website link in advance for the performance schedule and introduction. Full text 

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 世界之窗-阿尔卑斯冰雪世界
attractions.tag: Indoor Skiing; Ice and Snow Parks
attractions.summary: Window of the World Alpine Ice and Snow World is a large-scale indoor ice and snow amusement park, with crystal clear fairy tale castles and dreamlike ice and snow wonders. You can enjoy ice sculptures, ice dancing, skiing, and fully experience the fun of ice and snow carnival. The Ice and Snow World is mainly divided into three parts: ice sculpture area, ice skating area, and skiing area. The ice sculpture area is colorful, with transparent ice sculptures shining brilliantly under landscape lights; The ice rink is like a natural ice lake, where tourists can freely engage in sports such as ice dancing and figure skating; Enjoy the fun of speed and passion in the ski area.

restaurants.name_en: Blue Italian Restaurant, Venice Ruitu Hotel Shenzhen

attractions.name: 龙门石窟
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Grottoes; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves in China, with a long history, the construction spanned multiple dynasties and lasted for over 500 years.
- Among the numerous caves carved during the Northern Wei period, the Ancient Yang Cave, the Central Cave of Binyang, the Lotus Cave, and the Cave Temple are the most representative.
- There are more than 97,000 Buddha statues in total, with the Western Mountain Caves being the most refined part, including the Luoshen Buddha statue and the "Twenty Images of Longmen."
- Among the key caves of the Tang Dynasty Longmen Grottoes, the grand and imposing group sculptures of the Great Luoshen Buddha are the most famous.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves of China
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 洛阳博物馆
attractions.summary:
Luoyang Museum echoes the landmark buildings of the city such as the Pearl TV Tower of the Central Plains. The shape of the new museum is like a big tripod, which means "Dingding Luoyi". 
· The museum consists of a main building and an auxiliary building. The main building has two floors. The first floor is a general exhibition, and the second floor is a boutique exhibition of the museum. 
· There are more than 11,000 pieces of cultural relics on display in the new museum. Besides the local unearthed cultural relics, it also accepted a number of treasures allocated by the Palace Museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate Rare Treasures and Taste Luoyang Ancient Capital Culture

attractions.name: 中国国花园
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
The Chinese National Flower Garden is located on the site of the Sui-Tang Ancient City Ruins in Luoyang. It is currently the largest peony-specialized garden in China.  
The garden is built on the foundation of Sui-Tang historical culture, with peony culture as its main theme. It integrates history, peony culture, and landscape architecture, fully showcasing the beauty, purity, and serenity of the peony.  
The garden currently plants over 1,000 varieties of peonies, making it the largest area of multi-variety blooming peonies that could be seen in Luoyang during early visits.
attractions.shortFeatures: Integrating peony culture and garden landscape.

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城应天门遗址
attractions.name_en: The Ruins of Yingtian Gate, Sui-Tang Luoyang City
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Historical ruins
attractions.summary: Ying Tian Gate was the main southern gate of Ziwei City, originally constructed in the first year of the Sui Dynasty's Daye era (605 AD). It was initially named Ze Tian Gate, but in the first year of the Shenlong era (705 AD), it was renamed Ying Tian Gate to avoid using Empress Wu Zetian's name. Later, it became known as the Five Phoenix Tower and endured through the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song Dynasty. Ying Tian Gate was an important venue for the imperial court to hold major state ceremonies and diplomatic events. These included significant occasions such as the Yuan Zheng (New Year's Day), the Winter Solstice, ceremonial music performances, banquets, amnesties, and the transition to a new year. During such events, including tributes from foreign envoys and dignitaries, the emperor would ascend the gate to listen to state affairs. Historical ceremonies such as Emperor Gaozong's capture of the Baekje king, Empress Wu Zetian's ascension to the throne, and Emperor Xuanzong's reception of Japan's eighth envoy to Tang China were all held on the Ying Tian Gate tower. Its function was similar to that of the Meridian Gate in modern Beijing. Ying Tian Gate was a massive architectural complex shaped like a "concave" character, consisting of a main gate tower, parapet walls, east and west watchtowers, and connecting corridors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Sui and Tang ruins, savor the culture of the ancient capital.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 丽景门景区
attractions.tag: Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Without arriving at Lijingmen, one would be wasting their time in Luoyang City. Lijingmen was first built in the Sui Dynasty and is the western gate of the ancient city of Luoyang, known as the "first gate of the ancient capital". The current Lijingmen Scenic Area was rebuilt on the original site of the Luoyang Municipal Government, consisting of parts such as the City Gate Tower, Wengcheng, Arrow Tower, City Wall, Lijingqiao, and moat. It is also the location of Luoyang Old Street. Tourists can come here to climb up and enjoy the scenery, taste local snacks, and learn about the ancient Heluo culture. New Year Bell ringing Activity: Every year on the occasion of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Lijingmen City Tower holds the "Welcoming the New Year at midnight Bell" activity. Tourists can personally climb up to the city and ring the 108 bells symbolizing the prosperity, auspiciousness, peace, and happiness of the new year, echoing the sound of the Ma Temple bell from afar.

attractions.name: 河洛古城
attractions.summary: The design concept of the "Heluo Ancient City" project is based on the Heluo culture, with Ming and Qing architecture as the main carrier, supplemented by Sui and Tang architectural styles, showcasing the humanistic and traditional architectural culture of Luoyang for thousands of years. As a comprehensive urban cultural and tourism complex, "Heluo Ancient City" integrates food, accommodation, transportation, tourism, shopping, and entertainment. After completion, it will be a relatively large tourist hub and secondary consumption place in Luoyang city.

restaurants.name_en: Black Haired Beef Roast Meat Restaurant

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 临潼博物馆
attractions.summary: Lintong Museum, located on the east side of Lintong County, is a local museum that mainly displays the unearthed cultural relics in the county. It was built in 1979, following the form of quadrangles in northern China. There are three exhibition rooms, namely, Zhou and Qin Art Room, Tang Buddhist Art Room, Han and Tang Art Room, and a monument gallery. There are more than 10,000 cultural relics from the Neolithic Age to the Ming and Qing Dynasties, including the earliest bronzes of the Western Zhou Dynasty. There are the golden coffin and silver statue unearthed from the site of Qingshan Temple in Tang Dynasty, and the relic account of Sakyamuni Tathagata (which is an extremely precious Buddhist cultural relic), which has been listed as a national special cultural relic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Collection of Western Zhou bronzes in the museum

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 西安事变旧址五间厅
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity
attractions.summary:
Wujianting is located in Huaqing Pool Scenic Area in Lintong, Xi'an, which is one of the famous sites of Xi'an Incident in history. 
Built in the late Qing Dynasty, it is a brick and wood hall. 
It is adjacent to Lishan Mountain in the south and Lotus Pond in the north. The courtyard is flat and the trees are lush. It is named Five Halls because it is connected by five single rooms.  
On the glass windows and walls of the five halls, there are still bullet marks from the fierce battle between soldiers and remonstrance. 
· Desks, chairs, beds, sofas, tea sets, stoves, carpets, telephones, etc. used in offices in each room are copied and placed as they were originally.
attractions.shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure hall
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:20; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 网师园
attractions.summary:
- Wangshi Garden is a representative example of a medium-sized classical Chinese garden, featuring traditional landscape and residential architecture. It was established during the Southern Song Dynasty.
- Initially named "Yuyin" (Fisherman's Retreat), it was renamed "Wangshi Garden" in 1765, reflecting the owner's intention to retreat into a life of seclusion.
- Despite the garden's many buildings, they are not crowded, and although the pond is less than one mu in size, it does not feel small. It can be considered a model of Chinese gardens where simplicity triumphs over complexity.
- From the main gate to the carriage hall, Wanjuantang, and Xiexiu Tower, the buildings unfold along the central axis. The main hall, Wanjuantang, is spacious with elegant decorations.
- In addition to understanding the layout's intricacies, another highlight of the garden is enjoying the traditional opera performances during the annual night garden events.
attractions.shortFeatures: The garden known for its delicate and intricate design.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区-虎丘塔
attractions.summary: Huqiu Pagoda is located on Huqiu Mountain in the northwest suburbs of Suzhou, 5 kilometers away from the city center. According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn Period, King Fuchai of Wu buried his father (Helu) here. Three days after the burial, a white tiger perched on it, hence the name Huqiu Mountain, abbreviated as Huqiu. Huqiu Pagoda is a famous ancient pagoda from the Song Dynasty, both domestically and internationally. Founded in the sixth year of Xiande in the Later Zhou Dynasty (959 AD) and completed in the second year of Jianlong in the Northern Song Dynasty (961 AD). The tower has seven levels and eight sides, with two layers of internal and external columns and half arches, brick body and wooden eaves. It is a representative work of brick towers in the Yangtze River Basin in the 10th century. Due to multiple fires from the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, the wooden eaves at the top were all damaged, and the current height of the tower is 47.5 meters. In 1956, a large number of cultural relics were discovered inside the tower, including rare art treasures such as Yue kiln and lotus stone turtle. The Tiger Hill Tower is a leaning tower.

attractions.name: 枫桥景区
attractions.summary: Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 观前街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Located in the center of Suzhou ancient city, the area is prosperous in commerce, famous shops gather and numerous historic sites. There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering many Suzhou specialties

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.

attractions.name: 沧浪亭
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
It is the oldest garden in Suzhou and one of the four famous gardens in Suzhou. It was originally the pool pavilion of King Guangling of Wu Yue in the Five Dynasties. 
· Built by the water, the various window styles and bamboo in the garden are the biggest attractions. 
The biggest difference between the layout and other gardens in Suzhou lies in its transparency, and the rockery is integrated with the pool water outside the garden. 
The rockery in the garden is integrated with the pool water outside the garden, and the bamboo and wood are quiet, full of ancient meaning, natural harmony, which can be called clever conception.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classic gardens with rockery scenery
