attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Mountains; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the northern end of the city, it integrates mountains, sea, city, and port, making it a seaside mountain park with three sides facing the sea. It is also a landmark scenic spot in Yantai.
- Within the scenic area and its surroundings, there are consulates, foreign trade firms, and numerous villas, forming the most complete and densely packed modern foreign consulate cluster in Asia.
- The lighthouse at the top of the mountain is the highest point in Yantai, and visitors can take an elevator inside the lighthouse to the 11th-floor observation deck, where they can enjoy a magnificent view of the sea, coastline, and cityscape.
- Below the lighthouse is a beacon tower, where live performances are held with actors dressed in Ming Dynasty costumes, holding torches and lighting signal fires, which are very exciting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the iconic lighthouse to enjoy a panoramic view of Yantai.

attractions.name: 月亮湾
attractions.summary:
Moon Bay is a symbol of Yantai's urban charm, and it is also recognized as a romantic holy place for couples. 
Located on the coast of the Yellow Sea, Yantai Mountain on the left, East Fort on the right, close to Jiuzhang Cliff and backed by Daiwang Mountain. 
· Two headlands, one in the east and the other in the west, embrace a deep moon-shaped bay. The rocks, sea water, long embankments and harbors are integrated into one, which is spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Clear water and gentle sandy beach

attractions.name: 蓬莱阁
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Penglai Pavilion, along with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is known as one of China's Four Great Towers.  
· Known as the "Fairyland on Earth," the well-known myth of "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea" originates here.  
· Penglai Pavilion is located by the sea, often shrouded in mist, making it feel like being in a fairyland. On a good day, one can even witness a "mirage."  
· In addition to Penglai Pavilion, the scenic area also includes Tianheng Mountain, Dengzhou Museum, Ancient Ship Museum, and the dividing line between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.  
· From the mountain top, one can enjoy a distant view of the junction between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, where the boundary line between the yellow and blue waters is very distinct, and one can also see Changdao Island in the distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Legend of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea

attractions.name: 田横山公园
attractions.summary: Tianheng Mountain is located on the west side of Penglai Pavilion on Danya Mountain. There is a lighthouse built on the mountain. The line between Tianheng Mountain and Laotie Mountain lighthouse in Lushun is the boundary between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, so it has a unique geographical position of "one mountain divides two seas". In 202 BC, King Tian Heng of Qi committed suicide by cutting himself due to his unwillingness to serve his vassal Liu Bang. Upon hearing the news of Tian Heng's death, the five hundred strong men stationed on Tian Heng Mountain sang funeral songs, and after the songs ended, they committed suicide one after another. The indomitable spirit of Tian Heng and five hundred brave warriors deeply influenced future generations, hence the name Tian Heng Mountain. Tianheng Mountain has an altitude of only 72 meters, but the rocks are reddish brown. From a distance and up close, it has the characteristic of a "water blue mountain red" cliff scenery. The cliffs on the east, north, and west sides are steep, with strange rocks and scales. Standing on the railing, watching the sea and listening to the waves, thinking about the past and cherishing the present, has a unique charm. There are inscriptions on the tomb of Ji Tianheng, Qi Wang Ding, Xiaoyaolu, Bagua Pile, and Sun Tzu Han Bamboo Slips sculpture inside.

attractions.name: 九丈崖
attractions.summary:
Because of sea erosion, the cliffs by the sea stand upright, and some places are greater than 90 degrees, which is unique in the domestic seaside landscape. 
The cliffs and reefs here are in various shapes. They are places for catching the sea and fishing, and they are also rare materials for artistic creation such as photography. 
A crown-shaped observation platform was also built on the cliff head of Jiuzhang Cliff. It's also a great place to watch the sunset and sunrise.
attractions.shortFeatures: Towering and steep seaside cliffs

attractions.name: 月牙湾公园
attractions.summary: Crescent Bay, also known as Half Moon Bay, is located at the northern end of Beichangshan Island. Crescent Bay is a beach with mountains and water on its back. As the name suggests, its shape resembles a crescent moon in the night sky, embedded between green mountains and clear waters. However, what is particularly unique is the ball stones scattered on the beach, as white as jade, colorful and extremely beautiful. The main buildings in the park are a 20 meter high "Crescent Pavilion" that combines Chinese and Western styles, a "Guanlan Pavilion" standing on a cliff, and a long corridor about a kilometer long. In front of the long corridor, there is a 100 meter "stone carpet" decorated with stone balls, giving a feeling of "stepping on pearls" when walking on it. What is particularly charming is the ballstone of Crescent Bay, which can be said to be a world of glittering and precious ballstones. It is as white as jade and crystal clear as amber, and no matter where you pick it up, you will not be able to let go of a single one.

attractions.name: 仙境源
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Beaches
attractions.summary:
Wonderland Scenic Spot is located in Wanggou Village, on the east coast of Changdao County. It is famous for the unearthed human skull fossil and nearly 100 tombs dating back 2,500 years, and is known as the first village in northern China. It combines primitive natural scenery and beautiful myths and legends, showing the charming charm of natural landscape. The sea and sky in the scenic spot are vast, which makes people feel refreshed and linger. 
It is said that the source of fairyland used to be the place where the Eight Immortals lived, and the place where Qin Emperor and Hanwu sought immortals and medicine. Step into the source of fairyland, watch the sunrise of the Yellow Sea in the east, the majestic sunset of the Bohai Sea in the west, the Penglai Pavilion where the Eight Immortals gather in the south, and the Laotieshan Mountain in Liaodong Peninsula in the north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Natural scenery and myths and legends are integrated

attractions.name: 烟台金沙滩海滨公园
attractions.summary: Yantai Jinshatan Beach has a gentle slope and clean water, with fine and soft sand, making it one of the excellent beaches in China. As the name suggests, Jinshatan Beach has a soft golden yellow color and a bright golden hue, which is rare in China. The beach forest belt is lush and green, the air is fresh and clean, and the mountains, water, forests, and beaches complement each other beautifully; The locust forest in the southern part of Haibin Road reflects the European style buildings, which not only have a natural atmosphere but also a rich European style. It is a tourist destination for leisure and vacation. Full text 

attractions.name: 青岩古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Ancient Towns; Military Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qingyan Ancient Town was established in the Ming Dynasty and has well-preserved a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing periods. It is known as one of the four major ancient towns in Guizhou, alongside Zhenyuan, Bian'an, and Longli.
- The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Missing Gun"

attractions.name: 花溪公园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gems: Autumn Leaf Viewing; City Parks
attractions.summary: Huaxi Park is a historically significant natural scenic park in Guiyang. The park was completed in 1940 and was officially named Huaxi Park in 1949. The park is primarily known for its real mountains, real waters, and pastoral landscapes, featuring scenic spots such as Furong Island, Baibu Bridge, Bashang Bridge, Golden Avenue, Lin Mountain, Gui Mountain, Pine and Cypress Garden, Peach Garden, Peony Garden, Bamboo Lotus Pond, and Rest Garden.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the authentic rural scenery.

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.name: 永宁门
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Yongning Gate is the south gate of Xi'an City Wall. It was built in the early Sui Dynasty. At that time, it was the east of the three gates in the south of the imperial city. It was originally called Anmen Gate. It was reserved as the south gate when Han Jian shrank to build a new city in the late Tang Dynasty, and changed to Yongning Gate in the Ming Dynasty. Now Yongning Gate is round-the-island traffic, with South Gate Square outside the gate, South Street inside the gate and Nanguanzheng Street outside the gate.
attractions.shortFeatures: The main entrance of Xi'an City Wall

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 书院门步行街
attractions.summary:
Xi'an people usually refer to the Academy Gate, which refers to a pedestrian street from Forest of Steles to the entrance of Guanzhong Academy. 
There is a tall archway with ancient charm at the corner of the street, with three golden characters "Academy Gate" written on it. 
There are blue antique buildings on both sides of the street, the ground is paved with bluestone, and the end of the street is the Forest of Steles.  
During the day, it is a street of calligraphy and painting, with a strong literary flavor; It is a snack street in the evening, and Xi'an is rich in characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: A pedestrian street full of books

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 陕西考古博物馆
attractions.summary: The permanent exhibition of Shaanxi Archaeological Museum is themed "Huazhang Shaanxi, the Holy Land of Archaeology", and is divided into four chapters: "Archaeological Process", "Cultural Genealogy", "Archaeological Discoveries", and "Cultural Protection Technology".

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《秦始皇和他的地下王国》电影
attractions.name_en: "Qin Shi Huang and His Underground Kingdom" Movie
attractions.summary: The 3D giant screen movie "Qin Shi Huang and His Underground Kingdom" is an 8K quality 3D film and television documentary filmed using SONY F65 digital cameras. As the "eighth wonder of the world", the Terra Cotta Warriors has attracted the attention of the whole world, while the unexplored the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has always been full of fog. "The First Emperor of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor and His Underground Kingdom" combines the new progress of the archaeology of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, approaches the Terra Cotta Warriors limitlessly, unveils the mystery of the Terra Cotta Warriors Mausoleum, and tells the secrets of the huge empire behind the Terracotta Warriors.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 岳王庙景区
attractions.summary: The Yuewang Temple is located at the northwest corner of West Lake, opposite Quyuan Fenghe, and is a place to commemorate the national hero Yue Fei. The tomb of Yue Fei and his son, as well as the kneeling statue of Qin Hui, who has been kneeling in front of the tomb for thousands of years, and four other treacherous officials, make people's hearts surge. In addition, the exhibition hall also displays historical materials about the life of General Yue Fei, which can reveal his life of being "loyal and devoted to the country". Entering the main entrance of the Yuewang Temple scenic area, there is a square courtyard, with the main building of the Yuewang Temple, the Martyrs' Shrine, directly in front of it. The main hall is dedicated to Yue Fei, and there is a plaque with the four characters "Heart Shines on the Heavenly Sun" hanging on the door, which is very solemn. Entering the main hall, one is greeted by a full body portrait of Yue Fei dressed in military attire, with his oath hanging high above his head, 'Return my country'. The murals on the walls around the main hall record the life of Yue Fei, among which the classic "Mother in law tattooed" is widely circulated. On both sides of the main hall, there are two generals of Yue Fei, Niu Gao and Zhang Xian, enshrined. After visiting the main hall, return to the courtyard, walk west through the stele corridor, cross the Jingzhong Bridge, and arrive at the tomb area. Here, one large and one small are the tombs of Yue Fei and his son Yue Yun. Facing the tomb of Yue is an archway, with a pair of iron statues of treacherous officials kneeling on either side of the door. They face the tomb of Yue Fei, kneeling to plead guilty to him. On the left are Qin Xian and his wife Wang. In the past, people came here not only to admire national heroes, but also to spit in front of these two kneeling statues. Nowadays, spitting is no longer allowed, and there are signs hanging on the wall next to it that read 'Civilized tourism, no spitting'. The entire Yuewang Temple is not large, but the ancient trees are towering. It is not far from the cemetery to return to the main entrance of the Yuewang Temple, and the entire tour time is about one hour. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Hangzhou Xixi Hotel Yiyuan Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 曼听御花园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 热带花卉园
attractions.summary: The Xishuangbanna Tropical Flower Garden is located within the Yunnan Tropical Crops Research Institute in the urban area of Jinghong City, covering an area of approximately 80 hectares. The garden is designed around a series of natural water surfaces as the main axis for sightseeing, with attractions such as the Flower Garden, Sky Garden, Premier Zhou Enlai Memorial, Palm Area, Rare Tree and Grassland Area, Bonsai Area, Foliage Plant Area, Tropical Fruit Tree Area, and more. It integrates functions of research, science popularization, tourism, and vacation. The garden preserves nearly 1,000 varieties of flowers and economic plants. As you stroll through the park, you are surrounded by a world of exotic flowers, unique trees, and a colorful array of plants, making it an important tourist destination in Xishuangbanna.
attractions.shortFeatures: Science-themed Resort Park

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

restaurants.name_en: Zhonghe Club · Restaurant Bar Pao Ding Fresh Cut Beef Shop

attractions.name: 漓江三星游船
attractions.summary: The three star cruise ship on the Li River is comfortable, beautiful, hygienic, safe, energy-saving and environmentally friendly, making people feel comfortable and warm. Different boats have different styles, with soft sofas made of fabric or leather that are comfortable, soft, and elegant; Traditional hollowed out grid patterned Chinese rosewood, with an antique charm. Not only that, the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. are decorated with high standard materials, and the new arrangement of curtains and tablecloths creates a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. Full text 

attractions.name: 漓江风景名胜区
attractions.summary: There is an article in primary school Chinese textbooks that says' Guilin's scenery is the best in the world ', which refers to visiting the Li River. The mountains on both sides of the Lijiang River are tall and straight, with thousands of shapes. They are the essence of Guilin scenery. The Li River, a hundred mile gallery ", each scenery is a typical Chinese ink painting. The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. The main ways to visit the Li River in general include taking boats, bamboo rafts, and hiking, including three-star and four-star boat tours, bamboo raft tours, and large boat tours in Xingping Fishing Village.

attractions.name: 九马画山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 黄布倒影
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
attractions.shortFeatures: Background map of 20 yuan RMB

attractions.name: 二十元人民币背景图
attractions.summary: The background picture of 20 RMB is located in Xingping Town, Guilin. The picturesque scenery here, with green mountains and clear waters, attracts many tourists to come and play. Full text 

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 如意峰索道景区
attractions.summary: 1、 Basic information: Yangshuo Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area is a high-altitude tourism and leisure project jointly invested and built by Shaanxi Junjing Cableway Investment and Construction Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shaanxi Tourism Group, and Guilin Ruisheng Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The total investment of the project is 260 million yuan. The scenic area is located in Meng Village, Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, adjacent to National Highway 321, 5km away from the Gaotian entrance and exit of Baomao (Guiwu) Expressway, and about 5km away from core scenic areas such as Yulong River, Moon Mountain, Shili Gallery in Yangshuo and Yinziyan Scenic Area in Lipu. 2、 Project Construction The project will build Yangshuo Mountain Top Natural Park, which is composed of the natural karst natural landscape "three peaks and two valleys" (Yuanbao Peak, Ruyi Peak, Xianglian Peak, Caixi Valley, Baihua Valley), cableway, Ruyi Cloud Top Viewing Platform, Ruyi Cable Bridge, Walk in the Forest, glass walkway Road, Digital Experience Hall and other creative landscapes. Tourists can overlook the unique karst peak forest landscape in Yangshuo from a high altitude in all directions, walk through the forest, watch the landscape of Guilin, and experience the fun of walking in the forest! The Ruyi Peak Cableway has a total length of 2012 meters. The lower station of the cableway is located in Xingtianle International Tourism Resort, and the upper station leads directly to Yuanbao Peak. The vertical height difference is 242 meters, and the one-way capacity can reach 2000 people/hour, with a speed of 0.5-6 meters/second (adjustable). The cableway has introduced equipment from POMA company in France, which is a single line cyclic unhooking gripper 8-person hanging box cableway. The overall operation and safety system adopts advanced passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 3、 Since its opening on January 6, 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area has been operating in good condition. During the operation period, the goal of zero occurrence of safety production responsibility accidents was achieved, with no major tourist complaints or incidents of malfunctioning parking, and no occurrence of fire and other personal injury safety accidents. In November 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the honor of "Top Ten Scenic Spots of Guilin City" by the Guilin Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism. On December 24, 2021, it was rated as a "Contract abiding and Creditworthy" public enterprise in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region for the year 2020 by the Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. On December 28, 2021, Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the certificates of "Safety Production Standardization Enterprise" and "Service Quality 5S Enterprise" by the China Cableway Association. In 2022, it was awarded as one of the "Top Ten Internet Famous Scenic Spots in Guilin" and "Top Ten Astronomy and Climate Landscape Check ins in Guangxi", and was selected as one of the "World Karst Science Entrance Examination Route". 4、 Sightseeing route Take the cableway up the mountain -- View Yuanbao Peak -- Experience Ruyi Cable Bridge -- View Yangshuo from Ruyi Cloud Summit -- Walk through the forest and view the peak forest landscape -- Experience the glass walkway -- Visit the "Singing in Guilin" experience hall -- Return to the mountain 1. The horizontal distance of Ruyi Peak cableway is 2012 meters, the height difference is 241 meters, and the one-way traffic volume is 2000 people/hour. The cableway system equipment is designed and manufactured by POMA company in France. The overall operation and safety system adopts good passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 2. The Ruyi Suoqiao Bridge is 142.4 meters long, 2 meters wide, and 58 meters away from the valley floor. Standing among them, one can see the Yangshuo Peak Forest in full view, and the slight swaying in the air provides a thrilling and wonderful experience. 3. Ruyi Cloud Peak is named after its ridge resembling the traditional auspicious object of the Chinese nation, Ruyi. Ruyi Cloud Peak is a 360 ° viewing platform from the highest point of Ruyi Peak, a sacred place for people to pray and fulfill their wishes, and also a viewing spot for the Linqi Mountain in the distance. 4. The forest walking path winds through the peaks and valleys, with a total length of 246 meters and a center height of 32.5 meters. It is composed of a grid structure embedded with tempered glass and steel grilles. From a distance, it looks like a graceful "rainbow" in the peaks and forests, and also like an aerial ribbon left at the top of the jungle. Walking through it, you can fully enjoy the beauty of the peak forest and feel the joy of crossing the native jungle from the sky. 5. Glass walkway glass walkway is built along the cliff wall, 138 meters long and 1.8 meters wide. Walking on it is thrilling and extremely challenging. Looking into the distance, the peaks and forests are lush, the smoke from cooking is lingering, and the countryside is picturesque. 6. The Singing Tour Guilin Experience Hall is located at the upper station of the Ruyi Peak Cableway. It is an immersive digital experience space that uses digital technology and environmental art to showcase spatial creativity and intelligent interactive experiences. It integrates karst style and ethnic cultural creativity, making visitors feel as if they are walking in the dynamic painting of Guilin's mountains and waters, creating a wonderful feeling of "people swimming in the painting".

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

It used to be the China National Pavilion of Shanghai World Expo, with a collection of more than 8,000 pieces, including a large number of paintings by famous painters such as Zhang Yuguang and Wu Guanzhong. 
The exhibition halls of the Art Palace are mainly located on the 0m floor, 5m floor, 33m floor, 41m floor and 49m floor. It is recommended to visit them from top to bottom. 
The most interesting thing is the treasure of the town hall-the multimedia version of Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival, which is located on the 49m floor, but you need to pay extra tickets to watch it. 
In addition, there are many exhibition halls for viewing, such as Shadow Art Exhibition, Modern Art Exhibition and Shanghai Artists Invitational Exhibition.

- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.

attractions.name: 广富林文化遗址
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Enjoying autumn leaves; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The ancient civilization of the Guangfulin Cultural Site has been preliminarily confirmed through scientific archaeology. As early as the late Neolithic period, around four to five thousand years ago, rice cultivation was already widespread in the area, indicating an advanced agricultural production system. Additionally, the textile history here is long-standing, with pottery spindles from the late Neolithic period uncovered at the site.

The development of the Guangfulin Site Park aims to inherit historical culture and preserve the original ecological structure of the ancient town. It will integrate modern urban construction concepts to create an "underwater museum." Stepping into the site, the Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is particularly captivating. The entire exhibition space is set underwater, with pyramid-like rooftops floating on Fulin Lake, blending with the surrounding environment to create a beautiful scene. The exhibition hall is designed with the concept of a "Journey through Time and Space," combining modern audiovisual technology to present scenes such as the archaeological memories of Guangfulin, the formation of Shanghai's land, the arrival of early settlers, the rise of local cities, the flourishing of Songjiang Prefecture, the emergence of Shanghai as a city, and a vision for the future. Visitors can experience and explore the history of Shanghai's civilization in a time tunnel.

At night, the site hosts an exciting lantern festival. From the lake-bottom garage entrance to near Zhuque Gate, over 40 large lantern sets light up the area, creating a dazzling, beautiful display. Among these, the 3D Mapping show is a major highlight, condensing the thousand-year history of Guangfulin into a stunning three-minute light and shadow performance projected onto Fulin Tower, attracting numerous visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the unique underwater exhibition hall

attractions.name: 广富林文化展示馆
attractions.summary: The Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is located in the circular building with the first large roof and side floating in the Fulin Lake, and the entire exhibition space is set underwater. Entering the exhibition hall gives people a hint of stepping into the underground and heading towards ancient times. The exhibition hall design is based on the concept of "time and space journey", through the design of scenes such as Guangfulin archaeological memory, Shanghai's land evolution, the arrival of ancestors' activities, the formation of urban characteristics, the prosperity of Songjiang County government, the rise of Shanghai city, and the future, allowing the audience to experience and read Shanghai as a city in a time tunnel, from where it came from and where it is going.

attractions.name: 广富林考古遗址展示馆
attractions.summary: To the north of the core protection area of Guangfulin Cultural Site, there are several semi buried buildings that resemble damaged ancient pottery. They are the exhibition hall of Guangfulin Archaeological Site and a relatively important landmark exhibition hall in Guangfulin. The museum houses carefully selected representative cultural relics from tens of thousands of archaeological discoveries in Guangfulin. Some of the exhibits are provided by the Shanghai Museum. In addition to exhibiting and displaying the treasures excavated from Guangfulin, this museum will also serve as a venue for exchange and exhibition with international museums. There is also a dedicated space for restoration in the museum, which is connected to the north themed exhibition space. Thus extending the exhibition space outdoors greatly enhances the visual impact on visitors.

attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.

attractions.name: 思南路
attractions.summary: Some people say that Sinan Road is the "harem" of Huaihai Road, hidden behind the bustling streets, like a solitary lotus in the world, quiet and peaceful, narrating the history of old Shanghai and the stories of the past at a slow pace. Sinan Road is named after the French composer Jules in the early 20th century Masnan is a famous French road, a clean and romantic one-way street, and two rows of French wutong trees covering the sky, connecting Huaihai Road and Xujiahui. The garden villas on both sides of the road have different styles, English, French, and Spanish, reflecting their pre liberation identity. It is said that there are more than twenty garden style western-style houses on Sinan Road, which gather almost all the residential styles of old Shanghai - it is a living book of urban history. Walking here, it feels like returning to that hurried and chaotic era that still remains prosperous. Nowadays, Sinan Road not only preserves various former residences, but also the Sinan Mansion, which has been transformed into a hotel. Along the street, there are also some specialty small shops. You can have a cup of coffee at a caf é or go to the "Aniang Noodle Shop" to enjoy a bowl of authentic yellow croaker Aniang noodles for 20 yuan, and then visit antique shops to savor the unique history and romance of Shanghai in nostalgia.

attractions.name: 南京路步行街

· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.

attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
