attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 天津极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Tianjin Polar Ocean Park is a national 4A level scenic spot and popular science education base. With its rich and unique polar ocean resources, exquisite animal celebrity performances, and diverse interactive projects, it is known as one of the "Top Ten Popular Ocean Theme Parks Popular by Consumers" and a "Destination for Parent Child Tourism Projects". Tianjin Polar Ocean Park is an open scenic area covering an area of 49000 square meters, with a whale shaped composite structure. Featuring fifteen major exhibitions (Antarctic Penguin Island, Mysterious Arctic Village, Underwater Tunnel, Ancient Ocean, Shark Harbor, Coral Sea, White Whale Bay, Liuchuanyu Lane, Sea Grass Hall, Exploring Fish Universe, Future Jellyfish Pavilion, Cute Beast Bay, Magic Ocean Technology Experience Hall, Cute Pet Paradise, Wonderful Rainforest), four major performances (Happy Moon Island, Whale Moon Legend, Mermaid Fairy Tale, Aoaoxing Adventure), five major animal science popularization shows and high-end themed products such as overnight stays and banquets, it is deeply loved by tourists. Among them, the Future Jellyfish Pavilion is a characteristic themed exhibition hall with an open back area, with a total of more than 80 exhibition tanks, showcasing up to 20 types of jellyfish and more than 10000 individuals. Through various forms such as digital interaction, sound and light projection, we showcase the colorful and magical world of jellyfish to tourists. The "Four Great Performances" were carefully crafted over three years and made their debut in 2014. With four unique and exciting performances, "Happy Moon Island", "Whale Moon Legend", "Mermaid Fairy Tale", and "The Adventures of the Roaring Star", they jointly created four unique and exciting performances. The five popular animal stars - beluga whales, dolphins, fake killer whales, walruses, and sea lions - each have their own unique skills and work together with mermaid princesses to perform a lively and exciting "Ocean Circus". Whether in plot, performance, or atmosphere, it is of high domestic standard, which has opened the eyes and made many tourists enjoy it. The museum is divided into 15 exhibition areas, including Antarctic Penguin Island, Mysterious Arctic Village, Underwater Tunnel, Ancient Ocean, Shark Harbor, Coral Sea, Beluga Bay, Liuchuan Fish Lane, Seaweed Hall, Exploring Fish Universe, Future Jellyfish Pavilion, Cute Beast Bay, Magic Ocean Technology Experience Pavilion, Cute Pet Paradise, and Wonderful Rainforest. The 15 major exhibition areas complement each other and have their own unique features, allowing tourists to feel the magic of the ocean as if they are traveling through a mysterious underwater world. The Future Jellyfish Pavilion is divided into six themed exhibition areas: the Featured Light and Shadow Area, Jellyfish Kaleidoscope, Jellyfish Secret Realm, Jellyfish Music Hall, Jellyfish Fairy Tale Area, and Jellyfish Interactive Area, as well as two functional exhibition areas: Jellyfish Laboratory and Jellyfish Classroom. Jellyfish Kaleidoscope ": It gathers nearly one tenth of the world's jellyfish species. In the exhibition area, in addition to showcasing familiar species such as the Sea Moon Jellyfish, the Andromeda Jellyfish, and the Australian Spotted Jellyfish, it will also introduce interesting and ornamental species such as the Peace Jellyfish, Inverted Jellyfish, Egg Jellyfish, and Cloud Jellyfish, as well as difficult to raise species such as the Black Sea Jellyfish, Pacific Sea Jellyfish, and Purple Sea Jellyfish; Jellyfish Secret Area ": Using technological elements such as imagery, sound, light, and shadow, allowing visitors to experience the vast and romantic jellyfish planet intertwined with light and shadow; Jellyfish Interactive Zone ": Tourists can interact with virtual jellyfish through the interactive biomimetic wall, learn about the structure of jellyfish, their natural enemies, etc., allowing tourists to not only understand the interesting science of jellyfish, but also experience the feeling of touching jellyfish, and comprehensively understand the wonderful and beautiful jellyfish; Jellyfish Concert Hall ": The perfect combination of music rhythm and jellyfish swimming frequency, immersing oneself in it is like lying in the depths of the sea, imagining jellyfish drifting by, changing different colors. Cooperate with the frequency of jellyfish oscillation to improve one's breathing rate, achieving physical and mental relaxation and balance unconsciously. Jellyfish Fairy Tale Area ": It is a place that children love, where various types of jellyfish are transformed into cartoon characters, introducing their characteristics to tourists. The complete knowledge of jellyfish can be seen at a glance; Various jellyfish themed amusement facilities such as jellyfish swings and jellyfish swings attract children's attention. Jellyfish Laboratory ": The exhibition area will open its backstage, and lucky visitors can book and participate in the" Jellyfish Exploration Tour "to observe the feeding, reproduction, and other processes of jellyfish up close, learn about interesting science popularization stories about jellyfish, and have face-to-face academic exchanges with professional jellyfish breeders. Jellyfish Classroom ": It is a jellyfish classroom designed for jellyfish enthusiasts and children. If you want to have a deeper understanding of popular science knowledge and interesting stories about jellyfish, you can sit quietly and enjoy a vivid science class in the world of jellyfish. In 2018, a new exhibition area for ancient ocean science popularization was opened, with a total area of over 700 square meters and a tour route of over 100 meters. It is located in the back of the third and a half floors. Mainly based on biological evolution as the clue, with five major species extinctions as the main nodes, showcasing content including fish, invertebrate arthropods, insects, amphibians, reptiles, birds, mammals, etc., a total of more than 40 sets of exhibition tanks, 77 species of organisms, and more than 350 animals. In chronological order, from the Cambrian to the Cenozoic era, select several periods with typical events, and design the exhibition area with the evolutionary history of five major species extinctions as the dividing point. Select current and historically close species for display. Raccoons, squirrel monkeys, Dutch pigs, Totoro, Eurasian red squirrels, groundhogs, plush cats, and many other adorable pets will accompany you through 500 million years of the Earth in a brand new way! Mengshou Bay is an outdoor venue that showcases a variety of marine animals to visitors. People can get up close to marine animals in the sunlight and appreciate their diverse lifestyles from different perspectives. Learning popular science knowledge while having intimate contact with "cute beasts" is the best choice for families to travel, play and check-in. At Moe Beast Bay, you can meet a group of cute spotted seals and enjoy the relaxed sunshine with lazy seals. Ocean Happy Planet is an outdoor ocean theater that can accommodate thousands of people watching simultaneously. Here, performers combine the ups and downs of the story with stunning performances of marine animals, allowing visitors to experience a brand new ocean themed drama and creating a harmonious coexistence between humans and nature in a fairy tale world of the ocean. Cute Pet Paradise is an open outdoor tourist venue that combines sightseeing, entertainment, and education. The amusement park mainly features eight popular creatures such as spotted deer, grey goats, alpacas, squirrels, peacocks, and various parrots, gathering nearly a thousand cute pets from land and air. It integrates three core elements of immersive experience, zero distance interaction, and knowledge popularization, which can expand children's understanding of natural animals. Here, you can step into a simulated natural environment and learn about the little secrets of cute pets: sika deer like to live alone as adults, and alpaca spitting is a self-defense method. You can also have close contact with various cute pets and experience diverse interactive scenes, making it a place for parent-child outings and pure natural experiences. 【 Featured Projects 】 For families with children, Tianjin Polar Ocean Park also offers overnight stays and banquets to explore the characteristics of the polar regions in the deep ocean at night, taste polar cuisine in the blue underwater tunnel, sleep with fish at night, and experience the magical polar regions at night. This project has become one of the popular parent-child experience projects in the Beijing Tianjin Hebei region. Tianjin Polar Ocean Park has launched a variety of characteristic projects according to the needs of different age groups. For family tourists, it has launched the "5D Dynamic Experience" and "Ice Age Pavilion". In the 5D dynamic experience, visitors can once again experience the stunning visual impact, allowing you to enjoy an exciting dynamic experience. In the Ice Age Pavilion at minus ten degrees Celsius, visitors can enjoy rich and interesting animal ice sculptures, explore the mysterious life of Inuit people up close, and enjoy a romantic snow area, allowing you to cross the polar regions in one second and enjoy the coolness. For children, "Penguin Fun Park" and "Interactive Beach" have become popular featured projects. Penguin Paradise is a polar ocean themed children's soft pack adventure experience amusement project. Children can find their favorite polar dolls, communicate and explore with them, play together, and exercise social skills, physical fitness, and coordinated movements while playing. The "Interactive Beach" project allows children to play freely on the artificial beach, experience the ocean scenery, and get up close with animals. Tianjin Polar Ocean Park concentrates the polar essence and exhibits the wonders of the sea. Come to Tianjin Polar Ocean Park and experience the soul ringing "Blue and White Symphony", and reap pure joy and emotion! Full text 

attractions.name: 杭州宋城
attractions.tag: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 三潭印月
attractions.tag: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Also known as Xiaoyingzhou, it is the largest island among the three islands in the West Lake and the only island that can be visited. It is known as the first scenic spot in the West Lake. 
The outline is like the word "Tian", the outer ring is Jiangnan garden, and the inside is divided into four small lakes by cross-shaped islands and bridges, which are full of poetry and painting. 
The whole island is densely covered with flowers and trees, mainly green willow, lotus, red maple and hibiscus, which is the representative work of water courtyard art in the south of the Yangtze River. 
The back of the RMB one-dollar banknote adopts the grand scene of three pools reflecting the moon, which shows that it plays an extremely important symbolic role in my country's scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landing on the island and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the West Lake from a new perspective

attractions.name: 白堤
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as Baishadi, it is the link hub between the city and scenic spots. Bai Juyi's famous sentence "The favorite lake is not enough to travel eastward, but Baishadi in the shade of green poplars" is here. 
There are neat willows and peach trees planted on both sides of the road, and you can see the beautiful view of the West Lake, which is very suitable for a leisurely stroll. 
Visiting Baidi is suitable for all seasons. Go there in spring and watch the panoramic view of Baidi on the opposite Beishan Road. The photos taken are also the most beautiful. 
The total length of Baidi is about 1km, and it can be visited on foot. It is most appropriate to come here in the morning and evening after staggering the peak period of tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: The long embankment of West Lake suitable for strolling

attractions.name: 苏堤
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Su Causeway runs through the north and south of the West Lake. It was built by Su Dongpo when he was an official in Hangzhou, also called "Su Gong Causeway". 
Because of its charming spring scenery, it is called "Spring Dawn on Su Causeway" and is the first of the ten scenic spots of West Lake. 
· With a total length of nearly 3 kilometers, there are six stone bridges from south to north: Yingbo, Suolan, Wangshan, Yidi, Dongpu and Kuahong. 
The embankment bridge is suitable for viewing the panoramic view of the West Lake. The imperial tablet pavilion in the south of the bridge has the inscription "Spring Dawn on Su Causeway" inscribed by Emperor Kangxi. 
There are concentrated scenic spots at both ends of Su Causeway. There is Su Dongpo Memorial Hall at the south end, which can be visited for free, and Yuewang Temple, Quyuan Fenghe and other scenic spots at the north end.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the West Lake and enjoy the scenery along the way

attractions.name: 断桥残雪
attractions.summary:
It is the meeting place of Xu Xian and White Lady in The Legend of the New White Lady, which adds a lot of romantic color to this long bridge. 
At the beginning of winter snow, the snow and ice on the sunny side of the bridge melt, but the shady side is still covered with residual snow. From a height, the bridge seems to be broken but not broken, forming the famous "broken bridge with residual snow". 
It can be used as the starting point for visiting the West Lake, from Baidi on the Broken Bridge to Gushan, and then visit various scenic spots around the West Lake in turn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Xu Xian and White Snake met on the broken bridge

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 京杭大运河杭州景区
attractions.summary: The Grand Canal (Hangzhou section) is the southernmost end of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal. Over thousands of years of history, it has integrated the unique products, cuisine, clothing, customs, and etiquette of various regions in northern and southern China, forming the canal cultural landscape represented by the "Ten Scenic Spots of the Canal". Caofang boats are the "tide" boats of the Hangzhou Grand Canal. Today's Caozao boats integrate historical ship elements of the canal with modern science and technology, and are an important carrier of modern canal tourism. Starting from Wulinmen Pier, taking Caofang boats all the way north can appreciate the unique scenery along the Grand Canal heritage line, such as Jiangqiao Muyu, Xiangji Fanyin, Fuyi Liuyu, Gongchen Yaoyue, and Qiaoxi Renjia. You can experience the slow life of Hangzhou by taking a boat ride. Canal water tourism represented by boats and boats, including canal tours, night tours, ancient town tours, and red transportation tours, is favored by citizens and tourists.

attractions.name: 六和塔
attractions.summary:
From the outside, the nearly 60-meter ancient pagoda has 13 floors, but in fact there are only seven floors inside the pagoda, and the structure of "seven bright and six dark" is very unique. 
You can climb inside the Pagoda of Six Harmonies. The further you go up, the narrower the stairs are. Each floor can go out to observe the scenery and look out into the distance from different heights. 
Climbing to the top floor of the tower, you can see that the rolling Qiantang River is right now. The Qiantang River Bridge spans both sides of the river, and you can have a panoramic view of the buildings and greening on both sides of the river. 
The Pagoda of Six Harmonies has been a favorite place for literati to watch the river and recite poems since ancient times. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited here and once erected inscriptions and plaques for each floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climbing the tower and overlooking the Qiantang River
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 07:00-17:30,Opens at Standard time 07:00-16:55

attractions.name: 钱塘江
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary:
Qiantang River, known as Zhejiang in ancient times, whose full name is "Zhejiang", also known as "Zhejiang River", "Zhijiang River" and "Luosha River". Generally, the Fuyang section of Zhejiang Province is called Fuchun River, and the Hangzhou section of the lower reaches of Zhejiang Province is called Qiantang River. 
Qiantang River was first named in Shan Hai Jing, named after flowing through ancient Qiantang County (now Hangzhou), and is one of the main birthplaces of Wuyue culture. Qiantang River is the largest river in Zhejiang Province, the name source of Liangzhe Road in Song Dynasty, and the name source of Zhejiang Province when it was founded in the early Ming Dynasty. Starting from the Xin'an River in the north source, the river length is about 588.73 kilometers; Starting from Majin Creek in the upper reaches of Qujiang River in Nanyuan, the river length is about 522.22 kilometers. From the source, it flows through today's southern Anhui Province and Zhejiang Province, with a drainage area of about 55,058 square kilometers, and flows into the East China Sea through Hangzhou Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch Qiantang Tide

restaurants.name_en: Sullivan Western Restaurant at Wanghu Hotel

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 古石城
attractions.summary:
It is said that the ancestors of Ancient Stone City ran to the mountains to escape the war and gradually became a village. Therefore, the whole village was the descendant of one ancestor, and now there are hundreds of people. Houses are built with local materials, so almost all of them are stone houses, stone roads, stone wells and stone flat. Stone City has a long history, and its construction date is still a mystery. It is one of the best preserved ancient cities in Guangxi. 
Along the mountain road, you can enjoy the karst landform from a commanding position. You can find villagers' homes cooking farm dishes in Shitouzhai or Dayantou Village. After eating, continue to walk east, pass through Daping Village and Shuiyanmen Mountain to Xianggong Mountain, which is one of the best shooting spots of Lijiang River. There is a platform on the top of the mountain, which is a relatively easy mountain to climb. The best shooting time is 6:00, and it is a good place to watch the sunrise of the mountains of Lijiang River and the first bay of Lijiang River.

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 漓江四星游船
attractions.summary: The basic situation of the cruise ship is that the Li River cruise ship has been upgraded and upgraded. Taking into account the tourist experience and psychological expectations, strict regulations have been made for the per capita cabin area, passenger seat specifications, cabin dining table specifications, and per capita area of the walking deck of the upgraded cruise ship. In addition, fabric soft wrapped sofas are used, which greatly improve comfort and aesthetics compared to ordinary cruise ships. And high material standards are required for the decoration and renovation of the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. of the cruise ship, and clear regulations are made for the replacement period of curtains, tablecloths, and other decorations, creating a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. The sanitary facilities are fully equipped with advanced technology, and the humanized detail design is comprehensive. The four-star cruise ship has a double decker cabin layout and decoration, with the first floor being a business cabin (second-class), and the per capita area in the tourist cabin not less than 1.8 square meters; The second floor is a luxury business cabin (first-class cabin), with a per capita area of no less than 2.5 square meters in the tourist cabin; The ship is equipped with a double deck walking deck with a wide view and a per capita area of not less than 1.4 square meters. The deck is equipped with sunshades and resting tables and chairs; There are 1.2m high aluminum alloy safety guardrails around. The cabin floor is made of high wear-resistant wood flooring and high-end carpets, while the ceiling and wall panels are made of wood and honeycomb aluminum plate materials, with exquisite craftsmanship. The cabin decoration is beautiful and elegant, reflecting cultural connotations or ethnic characteristics, decorated with flowers and green plants. The cabin dining table is made of elm wood and water chestnut materials, with carved decorations. The tourist seats are designed with armrests, which are comfortable and stylish. The double decker cabin provides both Chinese and Western style buffet meals or customized special dining options for tourists. The tableware and tea utensils are made of high-quality ceramic materials and are equipped with matching tableware for both Chinese and Western cuisine. There are also mini bars to meet the entertainment needs of different tourists. Each row of seats or table is equipped with a tablet computer near the window sill, which can provide a series of intelligent services such as Guilin tourism information, entertainment, and ordering. attractions.name: 九马画山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 黄布倒影
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
attractions.shortFeatures: Background map of 20 yuan RMB

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

restaurants.name_en: Ah Niu Ge Authentic Beer Fish
Liang Ji fragrant stone pot fish

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 草堂寺钟楼
attractions.summary:
The largest and most well-preserved bell tower left over from ancient China, with six chime performances every day. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and the top is a gilded treasure top, which is magnificent. 
Standing on the bell tower, you can see the east, south, west and north streets extending from the bell tower, the most prosperous business district in Xi'an around the bell tower, and the Drum Tower not far away. 
When visiting the bell tower, you can also enjoy wonderful performances of visiting ancient times, six performances every day. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the bell and drum tower square, with a musical fountain.

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)
