attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 广西民族村
attractions.shortFeatures: Hakka enclosed houses and Zhuang Qianlan folk houses

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 十全街
attractions.summary: Shiquan Street is located in the southeast of Suzhou Ancient City, starting from Renmin Road, the main road of the north-south center of the ancient city in the west, and reaching Fengmen in the ancient city in the east. It is not only a part of Suzhou's delicious food, but also a bar gathering area in Suzhou, but most of them are small bars.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit former residences of celebrities

attractions.name: 东方之门
attractions.name_en: Gate to the East Exhibition Center
attractions.summary:
Oriental Gate is regarded as a skyscraper on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou, with a total height of about 301.8 meters. The Oriental Gate is divided into two parts: the South Building and the North Building. Its external shape is a door, and it is known as "the first door in the world". This landmark building is adjacent to Jinji Lake in the east and International Building and Century Financial Building in the west. It is not only a new gate for Suzhou, but also a new gate for the world to look at China. 
This 88-story building was completed in 2013, surpassing Suzhou Xindi Center to become the tallest building in Suzhou. Oriental Gate includes commercial, hotel, office buildings and other services, creating a new urban hotspot for Suzhou with commercial prosperity and driving the prosperity of CDB area. 
Jinji Lake at night is very vibrant. Moonlight Pier, Water Curtain Movie, Ligongdi and Suzhou Paradise light up the shores of Jinji Lake, and the majestic and elegant Oriental Gate is also one of the major landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Suzhou Internet celebrity punch-in new landmark

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖游船
attractions.summary: The Jinji Lake Cruise Project aims to view Jinji Lake from the water and take you to experience a different scenery. Looking eastward from the famous scenic spot of Huqiu Mountain in Wuzhong, one can see a blue wave shining with charming radiance in the sunshine. This is Jinji Lake located in the eastern part of Suzhou. Take a cruise ship and enjoy the unique scenery of Jinji Lake from the water. You will find that the blue waves of Jinji Lake shine with charming brilliance in the sunshine, very brilliant. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 西园寺
attractions.tag: Garden garden; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples
attractions.summary: Xiyuan Jiezhuanglu Temple, referred to as Xiyuan Temple for short, is located outside Changmen in the west of Suzhou. It was founded from Yuan Dynasty to Yuan Dynasty and has a history of 700 years. The temple has deep ancient trees, heavy Brahma universe, green water, birds singing and flowers fragrant. Most of the existing temples were built in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and they are the largest temples in Suzhou. On the central axis, from south to north, there are three-room memorial archway, mountain gate, King Kong Hall, release pool, Daxiong Hall and Tibetan Sutra Building. There is Guanyin Hall on the east side of King Kong Hall and Arhat Hall on the west side. There are also Buddhist Chanting Hall, Fayun Hall, Guest Hall, Zhai Hall, warehouse and other buildings in the temple. There are four complete books of Dragon Tibet in the Tibetan Sutra Building, which were later given to Baolian Temple in Hong Kong, and more than 80,000 Buddhist scriptures such as Huayan Sutra written by Master Shan Ji in the Yuan Dynasty. Xiyuan Temple is a large temple with complete scale, magnificent temple, solemn Buddha statues and garden characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combining temples with gardens

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 

attractions.name: 海口观澜湖火山温泉谷
attractions.name_en: Haikou Mission Hills Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
The main building of the hot spring area is inspired by the unique circular earth building in southern China, and a large number of bamboo and volcanic stones are used as materials to create a simple and natural atmosphere. The park includes volcanic rock mineral hot springs with the styles of six continents around the world, uniquely designed spas and outdoor volcanic rock water parks. 
Volcanic mineral hot spring is taken from natural spring water with a depth of about 800 meters underground. The natural water temperature is between 15 ℃ and 43 ℃, and it contains various natural mineral ingredients with health effects. The water quality has been certified by the British International Water Quality Institute.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy special hot springs on five continents

attractions.name: 雷琼海口火山群世界地质公园
attractions.name_en: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
attractions.summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.
attractions.shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 海南热带野生动植物园
attractions.name_en: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens; Zoos
attractions.summary: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden, also known as Dongshan Wildlife Park, is China's first large-scale tropical wildlife park and the country's only island-type tropical rainforest botanical and zoological garden. It is acclaimed as a "natural museum that condenses the essence of Hainan Island's native flora and fauna." The park is located in Dongshan Town, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, approximately 27 kilometers from downtown Haikou. It is themed around tropical wildlife exhibitions and science popularization. The park's landscapes are entirely natural, with vast forested areas and dense vegetation providing an excellent wild environment for animals. Meanwhile, the artificially created jungle trails and a variety of exotic flowers and plants make visitors feel as if they are immersed in a vibrant natural world full of birdsong and floral fragrances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals in the tropical jungle
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 五公祠
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
Wugong Temple Complex is located at No.169 Haifu Avenue, Haikou City, about 5 kilometers away from the city center. Near the downtown area, it is unique and quiet, and is known as "Qiongtai Scenic Spot", "Yinghai Humanities" and "Hainan's No.1 Scenic Spot". The building complex of Wugong Temple includes: the first floor of Hainan (also known as Wugong Temple), Xuepu Hall, Guanjia Hall, Xizhai (Wugong Jingshe), Dongzhai, Su Gong Temple, Liangfubo Temple, Dongzhuo Pavilion, Fusu Spring, Qiongyuan and the newly-built Wugong Temple Exhibition Hall. 
Wugong Temple is a cultural relic and historic site that displays ancient Chinese demotion culture, Hainan history and culture and ancient architectural art with Hainan characteristics. "Wugong Temple" is the general name of a group of ancient buildings, covering an area of about 100 mu together with gardens, wells and ponds. It was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, rebuilt in the 15th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1889), and then repaired many times, and it is still shining brightly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding the ancient culture of official demotion in ancient buildings

attractions.name: 骑楼老街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street

attractions.name: 海口钟楼
attractions.summary: The Haikou Bell Tower is an important landmark building in Haikou, with a history of nearly a hundred years. It was originally built to adapt to foreign trade. The building is five stories high and the walls are built with red bricks. The Haikou Bell Tower stands on Changdi Road, facing the estuary. The row of ancient buildings across from the Haikou Bell Tower is the famous Haikou Qilou Old Street. The current Haikou Bell Tower was renovated in 1987 with funding based on the original appearance of the old clock tower. Named 'New Sound of Ancient Bell'. The Bell Tower is a symbol of Haikou, witnessing the city's growth process. Full text 

attractions.name: 万绿园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Located in the reclamation area on the north side of Haikou, facing Qiongzhou Strait, it is the largest open tropical seaside ecological garden landscape garden in Haikou. 
· Many tropical ornamental plants are planted in Wanlv Garden, which integrates clear water and blue sky with high-rise buildings. 
The 16 scenic spots and many surrounding supporting facilities in the park are complete. It is a large park for Haikou citizens to exercise in the morning and take a walk in the evening.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical Ecological Garden for Citizens' Leisure

attractions.name: 海口云洞图书馆
attractions.summary: The Yundong Library is located adjacent to the sea, with a total area of over 700 square meters. The library has a wide variety of books, including a reading area, terrace, and coffee shop.

attractions.name: 假日海滩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Beaches; Seashores
attractions.summary:
- Located in the northern part of Haikou, stretching 6 kilometers, the beach faces the boundless Qiongzhou Strait, with sailboats coming and going, creating a picturesque scene.  
- The beach consists of sunbathing areas, water sports zones, dining areas, and leisure sections, making it a comprehensive seaside tourism and leisure destination in Haikou.  
- The beach also features a dedicated barbecue area and a water park, which are lively and bustling with crowds throughout the day.  
- Nearby, there are yacht rental services and numerous luxury hotels to choose from, while strolling along the clean coastal avenue and enjoying the breeze is incredibly pleasant.
attractions.shortFeatures: Haikou's iconic seaside leisure destination

attractions.name: 福建博物院
attractions.summary: Fujian Museum is a provincial comprehensive museum integrating cultural relics protection, cultural relics archaeology, history, natural specimens and art research. It covers an area of 60,000 square meters and has a building area of 35,000 square meters. The museum area consists of four buildings: exhibition hall, nature hall, comprehensive building and cultural and museum training center. The whole building has unique marine cultural characteristics, and at the same time, it combines the stone culture of southern Fujian and the ancient architectural style of Fujian. Fujian Museum has nearly 170,000 cultural relics and natural specimens in its collection, including more than 30,000 precious cultural relics. The exhibition hall covers an area of 10,000 to 20,000 square meters.
attractions.shortFeatures: A comprehensive museum with Fujian characteristics

attractions.name: 闽江夜游
attractions.summary: The sages said: Good deeds are like water. The water of Minjiang River rises from the sky, and it is the mother river of Mindu. Minjiang River, which has won the first prize of Zhongzhao Lighting Award and the CCTV News Network for many times, is a pearl in the night scene of Chinese cities. Minjiang Night Tour departs from Taijiang Port on Jiangbin Road in Taijiang District, passing through Taijiang Jinwai Bund, Nanbei Jiangbin to Hongshan Bridge, and then turns back at Sanqiao before returning. If affected by tides, the route can be temporarily adjusted to return to Taijiang Port at Gushan Bridge. Minjiang Night Tour Route - Overview: Passed through attractions: Haixi 3D Light Show - Zhongzhou Island - Jiefang Bridge - Panchuanpu Catholic Church - Minjiang Bridge - Aofengzhou Bridge - Gushan Bridge "Minjiang Sightseeing Tour" Route - Overview: Passed through attractions: Panchuanpu Church, Taijiang Financial Street Wanda, Eastern Office Area, International Convention and Exhibition Center, etc. There are tour guides on board explaining the historical stories of various attractions. The "Minjiang Red Underground Route" - Overview: The "Minjiang Red Underground Route" was an important component of the Urban Work Department of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China during the Liberation War, and also served as a revolutionary communication network connecting northern Fujian, eastern Fujian, central Fujian, western Fujian, both sides of the Minjiang River, and the Fujian Zhejiang Jiangxi Border Region. You can watch the 1959 movie "Underground Route" on this route. Daily flight times: (1) Classic Minjiang Night Tour: Departure at 19:40. (2) Minjiang Night Tour High end new energy: departing at 19:00/20:15 (3) Minjiang Night Talk: departing at 21:20 daily (specific time subject to on-site inspection) Full text 

attractions.name: 三坊七巷
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Celebrity Residences; Famous Residences; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It originated in the Jin Dynasty, flourished during the Tang and Five Dynasties, and reached its peak during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The layout of its alleys and lanes remains largely intact, making it a living fossil of the ancient Chinese li-bang system.
- Composed of three blocks, seven lanes, and a central street, it has long been known as the "Three Lanes and Seven Alleys."
- The area consists of narrow alleys, white-washed walls and tiled roofs, with an intricate network of lanes. The stone-paved roads are lined with stone archways at the entrances of each block and lane.
- Today, it is home to many time-honored food stalls and traditional crafts, making it a great place to visit, explore the birthplace of famous figures, and enjoy local specialties.
attractions.shortFeatures: Museum of Ming and Qing Architecture

attractions.name: 南后街
attractions.summary: Nanhou Street starts from Yangqiao intersection in the north and ends at Jipi Road to Macau Bridge in the south, with a total length of about 1,000 meters. It is named after it is located behind the South Street on the central axis of Fuzhou. Nanhou Street Memorial Arch is the central axis of "Three Lanes and Seven Alleys" in Fuzhou. There are seven lanes (Yangqiao Lane, Langguan Lane, Anmin Lane, Huangxiang, Taxiang, Gongxiang and Jipi Lane) on its east side and three lanes (Yijinfang, Wenrufang and Guanglufang) on its west side. It was the main commercial street from the rise of Fuzhou Three Lanes and Seven Alleys to the Republic of China, where merchants gathered on the road.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural street combining tradition with modernity

attractions.name: 西禅古寺
attractions.summary: In the old days, there were Zen temples in the southeast, northwest, and northwest suburbs of Fuzhou. This temple was located at the foot of Yishan Mountain in the western suburbs of Fuzhou, so it was called Xichan Temple. In history, Xichan Temple has been destroyed several times, so although it is an ancient temple, most of the Xichan Temples you see now are newly built. Overall, the repairs are very good, and the main hall of the temple is very tall and magnificent. In the temple, there are the Shakya ManiHall, Dharma Hall, Sutra Pavilion, Jade Buddha Tower, Guanyin Pavilion, guest hall, Zen Hall, Abbot Room and other buildings. The most precious cultural relic is the Kangxi imperial calligraphy of the "Medicine Buddha Sutra" hidden in the Sutra Pavilion, but tourists cannot see it. The environment of Xichan Temple is beautiful and the greenery is well done, and there is also a famous feature - lychee trees. On the pillars of the ancient temple gate, there is a couplet engraved: "The four dynasties of the Li tree are passed down to the Song Dynasty, and the sound of the bell echoes through the ages." This is a couplet written by Zhou Lian in the Qing Dynasty. This not only indicates that there are many lychee trees in Xichan Temple, but also shows that Xichan Temple has existed since the Tang Dynasty. The lychee tree in the front courtyard of the Dharma Hall is an ancient tree that dates back to the Song Dynasty and is still blooming and bearing fruit today. Like other temples, Xichan Temple also has a release pool with a lot of fish and turtles inside. Children will be very happy to see it. In addition, overseas temples such as Shuanglin Temple in Singapore, Shuangqing Temple in Penang, Malaysia, and Nanputuo Temple in Vietnam are all under the jurisdiction of the Western Zen Lower House and are still managed by the monks of the Western Zen Temple. Therefore, this is a window for cultural exchange between Fuzhou and Southeast Asia. Every year, many foreign monks and believers visit and participate, making it a unique landscape of ancient temples. Overall, for a city like Fuzhou where almost every park is free, seeing paid temples is somewhat uncomfortable, and it feels like worshiping Buddha has a more secular flavor. If you have plenty of time and there are not many scenic spots in Fuzhou, and this is still considered a good attraction, then you can come. Full text 

attractions.shortFeatures: Traditional blocks with rich architectural culture

attractions.name: 烟台山公园
attractions.summary: Yantai Mountain Park currently covers an area of 2.11 hectares, located at the top of Meiwu in Cangqian Mountain, leaning against the river and with a simple terrain. According to historical records, during the Yuan Dynasty, there were artillery fortifications built on mountains to control the Min River; During the Ming and Qing dynasties, Yantai was reestablished for the purpose of reporting to the enemy, hence the name Yantai Mountain. The park now has facilities such as stone hole bridges, stacked rockeries, stone carvings, and flower galleries. Full text 

attractions.name: 烟台山商业漫步街区
attractions.summary: The Yantai Mountain Commercial Pedestrian Block relies on the profound historical context of Yantai Mountain to break the traditional closed commercial experience, build a relaxed and leisurely outdoor art and cultural walking space, reshape a fashionable lifestyle and unique commercial value, integrate history, modernity, architecture, commerce, culture, and art without boundaries, collide with each other, burst out unique sparks, and create a unique new commercial ecology.

attractions.name: 闽越水镇
attractions.summary: Minyue Water Town, also known as Bamin Ancient City, is located in Zhuqi Township, Minhou County. The construction of the scenic area restores the century old water town style of Fuzhou, planning more than ten cultural themed sections and nearly 20 experience halls such as the Governor General's Office, Fujian Merchants Association, and Maritime Silk Road Cultural Center. And will integrate the unique leisure and vacation formats of Fuzhou as a demonstration base and entrepreneurial base for Fuzhou's cultural innovation industry. Full text 

attractions.name: 青岩古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Ancient Towns; Military Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qingyan Ancient Town was established in the Ming Dynasty and has well-preserved a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing periods. It is known as one of the four major ancient towns in Guizhou, alongside Zhenyuan, Bian'an, and Longli.
- The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.

attractions.name_en: Huaxi National City Wetland Park Shili River Beach
attractions.summary: The Huaxi Shilihetan Tourist Resort mainly includes Huaxi Wetland Park, Huaxi Park, Cross Street, Confucian Academy, Golden Avenue, etc. It stretches from the Dajiangshan Mountain Range in the east to the Guesthouse (inclusive) in the west, Mingzhu Avenue in the south, and Tenglongwan in the north, with a total area of 5.32 square kilometers. The average altitude of the resort is 1140 meters, and the annual average temperature is 15.3 ° C. There is no severe cold in winter and no extreme heat in summer, and the climate is mild and humid with fresh and pleasant air. It is known as the "ecological oxygen bar" and natural "air conditioning". It is a tourist resort that integrates science education, park sightseeing, and leisure vacation.

attractions.name: 解放桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jiefang Bridge is a hub bridge connecting Hebei, Hedong and Heping districts and communicating with tianjin railway station. 
· Originally known as "Wanguo Bridge", it was known as "a country within a country" because there was a concession of nine countries in Tianjin at that time. After the liberation of Tianjin, this bridge was renamed "Jiefang Bridge". 
· Jiefang Bridge will be opened during important festivals. When the bridge opens, luxury yachts will sail across the opened Jiefang Bridge, accompanied by the colorful Haihe River, which is intoxicating and the most beautiful time. 
If you are lucky, you may even meet the scene of taking wedding photos in the middle of Jiefang Bridge while stopping at the red light, which is novel and interesting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Tianjin

attractions.name: 世纪钟广场
attractions.summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark building in Tianjin next to the railway station

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 津门故里
attractions.summary: Located in Tianjin Ancient Culture Street, the memorial archway of the hometown of memorial archway is painted in the form of "smoke carving ink stone chasing jade". The words on the heart of the memorial archway are "the hometown of Tianjin" (facing south) and "sunny snow" (facing north). Jinmen "is another name for Tianjin," Hometown "means old place, and" Jinmen Hometown "is the old place of Tianjin Wei, which means the birthplace of Tianjin Wei. 'Qing' means good weather, while 'Xue' means' wash '; Qingxue "is the scenery just after snowfall, with a clear sky stretching thousands of miles and streets crowded with tourists. It metaphorically refers to a person's pure and innocent mood, as if washed away. Here, we offer incense to the Queen of Heaven and wish for a better future.

attractions.name: 宝和轩相声茶楼(古文化街店)
attractions.name_en: Baohexuan Crosstalk Teahouse (Ancient Culture Street Store)
attractions.summary: Baohe Xuan Tea House, opened in the eleventh year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1885), is the earliest miscellaneous garden in Jinmen (renamed "Quyi" at the first National Cultural and Art Congress in July 1949), and is also known as one of the "Four Great Pavilions". Founder Zhang Fuxing and Meng Guanghui wrote the plaque. After nearly a century of changes and the baptism of the times. In 2022, Baohe Xuan Tea House will appear in front of the world with a brand new appearance. Preserving the historical relics of the teahouse and presenting them in front of the audience in conjunction with the transition to the new era. Baohe Xuan Tea House gathers renowned cross-talk performers from three age groups: old, middle-aged, and young. The performers combine traditional culture with new era content to perform. Speaking, learning, teasing, singing, and performing all kinds of things in the world, laughing, cursing, and joking are just for the sake of everyone's laughter. Baohexuan Tea House is located in a cultural town 50 meters away from the theater building on Jinmen Ancient Culture Street across the Haihe River. Welcome everyone to Baohe Xuan Cross Talk Tea House to experience authentic Tianjin style cross talk! Full text 

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 西开教堂
attractions.summary: The Xikai Church is located at the southern end of the bustling Binjiang Road commercial street. It was founded in 1917 and is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Tianjin. The architectural style of the church is solemn and grand, and the sculptures inside the church are also complex and exquisite. In addition, Mass and Catholic holiday activities are open to the public, allowing participants to experience the strong religious atmosphere. The exterior of the church is made of red and yellow flower bricks, with three towers arranged in a cross shape and towering into the clouds covered with green copper sheets. After years of erosion, the mottled green shines with a sense of history under the sunshine, and each tower has a bronze cross on its top. Entering the church, the first thing that catches the eye is the main color scheme composed of lake blue, white, and light yellow, giving a fresh feeling. Various patterns are carved in just the right positions, and 14 columns are arranged from the doorway to the altar, exuding an extraordinary aura. There are exquisite copper statues of believers around the church, and oil paintings depicting the story of Jesus' suffering are hung on the walls. Inside the church, there are also colorful statues of the Virgin Mary, Jesus, angels, and others. In addition, the stained glass windows are also very charming. On one side of the church, you will find a small wooden room with a small cross on top, which is a "confession pavilion" used by priests to receive believers for confession and confession. The mass event of Xikai Church is open to the public, and non believers can also participate. However, during the mass time, visitors cannot wander around the church. They should sit quietly in the back row, not make loud noises or take photos, and feel the inner peace in the bustling city. In addition, there are also many Catholic holiday activities that are open to the public, just like Mass. The specific times for Mass and Catholic holiday events can be found on the official website. Full text 

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 新民园广场
attractions.summary: The newly built Tianjin Minyuan Square has a surface area of 22500 square meters and an underground area of 47500 square meters, continuing to retain the sports and fitness functions of the original Minyuan Sports Stadium. The square has added new functions such as tourism and leisure, cultural and museum exhibitions, and specialty catering, and has become the core scenic area and distribution center of the Five Avenues Cultural Tourism Zone together with the surrounding Qingwang Mansion, Xiannong Business and Tourism Area, and Minyuan Xili Cultural and Creative Block.

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)
