It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 良渚古城遗址公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
Liangzhu National Heritage Park is located in Liangzhu and Pingyao towns in the northwest suburb of Hangzhou. It is the site of Liangzhu Cultural Center. 135 sites have been found, with a protection area of about 42 square kilometers. It is one of the most important large-scale archaeological sites in China and has outstanding significance in the development of oriental civilization. 
Heritage Park is different from ordinary parks. It is a comprehensive project to protect, utilize, develop and display cultural relics. The park takes Liangzhu Ancient City in Mojiao Mountain as the core, and includes cultural sites such as Fanshan Mountain, Huiguan Mountain, Tangshan Mountain and Yaoshan Mountain. Through the cross-section display and restoration display of the site site, a popular Liangzhu cultural cognitive system combining points, lines and surfaces is formed. According to the original intention of "Beautiful Island" in Liangzhu and the living area in Liangzhu culture period, it has the characteristics of hills, lonely hills, swamp plains with alternating rivers and lakes, and warm and humid subtropical climate. 
Liangzhu National Heritage Park will take the existing new Liangzhu Museum as the axis, and set up an "S"-shaped north-south green belt with a width of about 200 meters from east to west and a length of about 1,100 meters from north to south, as an important gateway and prelude to the heritage park. Visitors can visit Liangzhu Site through two different routes: water and land, or on foot or boating.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the precious cultural relics of Liangzhu period

attractions.name: 瓶窑老街
attractions.summary: Pingyao Old Street has a history of more than 20 years. After renovation, Pingyao Old Street still retains the style of the 1970s and 1980s. The old street not only has various unique snacks, but also intangible cultural heritage exhibition halls such as the Sericulture Museum, Liangzhu Jade Carving Museum, Yuhang Paper Umbrella Museum, Pingyao Pottery Museum, Kite Lantern Museum, etc.

attractions.name: 杭州开元森泊度假乐园
attractions.tag: Resorts; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Hangzhou Kaiyuan Senbo Resort, located in Xianghu Tourist Resort, Hangzhou, is a large-scale leisure and resort complex integrating accommodation, amusement, catering and business, and it is also a parent-child resort with perfect details. The park not only provides a comfortable holiday wooden cabin living experience, but also a variety of leisure activities such as year-round constant temperature water park, super-large children's playground, outdoor exploration and amusement, and local food.
attractions.shortFeatures: Accommodation, catering, amusement and resort

restaurants.name_en: Hangzhou Xixi Hotel Truffle Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 天津极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Tianjin Polar Ocean Park is a national 4A level scenic spot and popular science education base. With its rich and unique polar ocean resources, exquisite animal celebrity performances, and diverse interactive projects, it is known as one of the "Top Ten Popular Ocean Theme Parks Popular by Consumers" and a "Destination for Parent Child Tourism Projects". Tianjin Polar Ocean Park is an open scenic area covering an area of 49000 square meters, with a whale shaped composite structure. Featuring fifteen major exhibitions (Antarctic Penguin Island, Mysterious Arctic Village, Underwater Tunnel, Ancient Ocean, Shark Harbor, Coral Sea, White Whale Bay, Liuchuanyu Lane, Sea Grass Hall, Exploring Fish Universe, Future Jellyfish Pavilion, Cute Beast Bay, Magic Ocean Technology Experience Hall, Cute Pet Paradise, Wonderful Rainforest), four major performances (Happy Moon Island, Whale Moon Legend, Mermaid Fairy Tale, Aoaoxing Adventure), five major animal science popularization shows and high-end themed products such as overnight stays and banquets, it is deeply loved by tourists. Among them, the Future Jellyfish Pavilion is a characteristic themed exhibition hall with an open back area, with a total of more than 80 exhibition tanks, showcasing up to 20 types of jellyfish and more than 10000 individuals. Through various forms such as digital interaction, sound and light projection, we showcase the colorful and magical world of jellyfish to tourists. The "Four Great Performances" were carefully crafted over three years and made their debut in 2014. With four unique and exciting performances, "Happy Moon Island", "Whale Moon Legend", "Mermaid Fairy Tale", and "The Adventures of the Roaring Star", they jointly created four unique and exciting performances. The five popular animal stars - beluga whales, dolphins, fake killer whales, walruses, and sea lions - each have their own unique skills and work together with mermaid princesses to perform a lively and exciting "Ocean Circus". Whether in plot, performance, or atmosphere, it is of high domestic standard, which has opened the eyes and made many tourists enjoy it. The museum is divided into 15 exhibition areas, including Antarctic Penguin Island, Mysterious Arctic Village, Underwater Tunnel, Ancient Ocean, Shark Harbor, Coral Sea, Beluga Bay, Liuchuan Fish Lane, Seaweed Hall, Exploring Fish Universe, Future Jellyfish Pavilion, Cute Beast Bay, Magic Ocean Technology Experience Pavilion, Cute Pet Paradise, and Wonderful Rainforest. The 15 major exhibition areas complement each other and have their own unique features, allowing tourists to feel the magic of the ocean as if they are traveling through a mysterious underwater world. The Future Jellyfish Pavilion is divided into six themed exhibition areas: the Featured Light and Shadow Area, Jellyfish Kaleidoscope, Jellyfish Secret Realm, Jellyfish Music Hall, Jellyfish Fairy Tale Area, and Jellyfish Interactive Area, as well as two functional exhibition areas: Jellyfish Laboratory and Jellyfish Classroom. Jellyfish Kaleidoscope ": It gathers nearly one tenth of the world's jellyfish species. In the exhibition area, in addition to showcasing familiar species such as the Sea Moon Jellyfish, the Andromeda Jellyfish, and the Australian Spotted Jellyfish, it will also introduce interesting and ornamental species such as the Peace Jellyfish, Inverted Jellyfish, Egg Jellyfish, and Cloud Jellyfish, as well as difficult to raise species such as the Black Sea Jellyfish, Pacific Sea Jellyfish, and Purple Sea Jellyfish; Jellyfish Secret Area ": Using technological elements such as imagery, sound, light, and shadow, allowing visitors to experience the vast and romantic jellyfish planet intertwined with light and shadow; Jellyfish Interactive Zone ": Tourists can interact with virtual jellyfish through the interactive biomimetic wall, learn about the structure of jellyfish, their natural enemies, etc., allowing tourists to not only understand the interesting science of jellyfish, but also experience the feeling of touching jellyfish, and comprehensively understand the wonderful and beautiful jellyfish; Jellyfish Concert Hall ": The perfect combination of music rhythm and jellyfish swimming frequency, immersing oneself in it is like lying in the depths of the sea, imagining jellyfish drifting by, changing different colors. Cooperate with the frequency of jellyfish oscillation to improve one's breathing rate, achieving physical and mental relaxation and balance unconsciously. Jellyfish Fairy Tale Area ": It is a place that children love, where various types of jellyfish are transformed into cartoon characters, introducing their characteristics to tourists. The complete knowledge of jellyfish can be seen at a glance; Various jellyfish themed amusement facilities such as jellyfish swings and jellyfish swings attract children's attention. Jellyfish Laboratory ": The exhibition area will open its backstage, and lucky visitors can book and participate in the" Jellyfish Exploration Tour "to observe the feeding, reproduction, and other processes of jellyfish up close, learn about interesting science popularization stories about jellyfish, and have face-to-face academic exchanges with professional jellyfish breeders. Jellyfish Classroom ": It is a jellyfish classroom designed for jellyfish enthusiasts and children. If you want to have a deeper understanding of popular science knowledge and interesting stories about jellyfish, you can sit quietly and enjoy a vivid science class in the world of jellyfish. In 2018, a new exhibition area for ancient ocean science popularization was opened, with a total area of over 700 square meters and a tour route of over 100 meters. It is located in the back of the third and a half floors. Mainly based on biological evolution as the clue, with five major species extinctions as the main nodes, showcasing content including fish, invertebrate arthropods, insects, amphibians, reptiles, birds, mammals, etc., a total of more than 40 sets of exhibition tanks, 77 species of organisms, and more than 350 animals. In chronological order, from the Cambrian to the Cenozoic era, select several periods with typical events, and design the exhibition area with the evolutionary history of five major species extinctions as the dividing point. Select current and historically close species for display. Raccoons, squirrel monkeys, Dutch pigs, Totoro, Eurasian red squirrels, groundhogs, plush cats, and many other adorable pets will accompany you through 500 million years of the Earth in a brand new way! Mengshou Bay is an outdoor venue that showcases a variety of marine animals to visitors. People can get up close to marine animals in the sunlight and appreciate their diverse lifestyles from different perspectives. Learning popular science knowledge while having intimate contact with "cute beasts" is the best choice for families to travel, play and check-in. At Moe Beast Bay, you can meet a group of cute spotted seals and enjoy the relaxed sunshine with lazy seals. Ocean Happy Planet is an outdoor ocean theater that can accommodate thousands of people watching simultaneously. Here, performers combine the ups and downs of the story with stunning performances of marine animals, allowing visitors to experience a brand new ocean themed drama and creating a harmonious coexistence between humans and nature in a fairy tale world of the ocean. Cute Pet Paradise is an open outdoor tourist venue that combines sightseeing, entertainment, and education. The amusement park mainly features eight popular creatures such as spotted deer, grey goats, alpacas, squirrels, peacocks, and various parrots, gathering nearly a thousand cute pets from land and air. It integrates three core elements of immersive experience, zero distance interaction, and knowledge popularization, which can expand children's understanding of natural animals. Here, you can step into a simulated natural environment and learn about the little secrets of cute pets: sika deer like to live alone as adults, and alpaca spitting is a self-defense method. You can also have close contact with various cute pets and experience diverse interactive scenes, making it a place for parent-child outings and pure natural experiences. 【 Featured Projects 】 For families with children, Tianjin Polar Ocean Park also offers overnight stays and banquets to explore the characteristics of the polar regions in the deep ocean at night, taste polar cuisine in the blue underwater tunnel, sleep with fish at night, and experience the magical polar regions at night. This project has become one of the popular parent-child experience projects in the Beijing Tianjin Hebei region. Tianjin Polar Ocean Park has launched a variety of characteristic projects according to the needs of different age groups. For family tourists, it has launched the "5D Dynamic Experience" and "Ice Age Pavilion". In the 5D dynamic experience, visitors can once again experience the stunning visual impact, allowing you to enjoy an exciting dynamic experience. In the Ice Age Pavilion at minus ten degrees Celsius, visitors can enjoy rich and interesting animal ice sculptures, explore the mysterious life of Inuit people up close, and enjoy a romantic snow area, allowing you to cross the polar regions in one second and enjoy the coolness. For children, "Penguin Fun Park" and "Interactive Beach" have become popular featured projects. Penguin Paradise is a polar ocean themed children's soft pack adventure experience amusement project. Children can find their favorite polar dolls, communicate and explore with them, play together, and exercise social skills, physical fitness, and coordinated movements while playing. The "Interactive Beach" project allows children to play freely on the artificial beach, experience the ocean scenery, and get up close with animals. Tianjin Polar Ocean Park concentrates the polar essence and exhibits the wonders of the sea. Come to Tianjin Polar Ocean Park and experience the soul ringing "Blue and White Symphony", and reap pure joy and emotion! Full text 

attractions.name: 海河
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It starts from Tianjin Jingang Bridge, ends at Dagukou and enters Bohai Bay, and runs through Tianjin city. It is the "mother river" of Tianjin. 
· There are Jingang Bridge, Lion Forest Bridge, Jintang Bridge, Bei'an Bridge, Jiefang Bridge and other bridges built on the Haihe River, which are very spectacular. 
There are all kinds of high-rise buildings and more than 20 historical and cultural buildings on both sides of the strait, which are worth visiting. There are also cruise docks in tianjin railway station, Ancient Culture Street and Great Beiyuan, where you can board the boat. 
Night is a good time to watch the Haihe River. The lights on both sides are on, and the scenery is very beautiful. I recommend Tianjin Eye, Jinta Jinmen and other places to take beautiful photos.

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 南市食品街
attractions.summary: Nanshi Food Street gathers various well-known snacks from Tianjin and is a specialty shopping center mainly focused on food. Not only can you taste a variety of traditional cuisine here, but you can also appreciate traditional tea garden arts such as cross-talk and opera. In addition, the architecture here combines Chinese and Western styles, and the photos are also very beautiful. Nanshi Food Street is a corridor style three story building with entrances in all four directions. The third floor is the inner hall of a restaurant, while the first and second floors offer shopping opportunities. The first floor here is relatively open, which is a fake arcade style building. The main shops are various snacks, such as Fried Dough Twists in Tianjin Gui Faxiang, Fried Dough Twists in 18th Street, Ear Eye, Bean Collapse, etc. In addition to delicious food, you can also find interesting traditional stalls such as candy figurines on this floor. You can go and take a look. The second and third floors of Nanshi Food Street are semi open corridor style buildings, with each floor connected and passing through shops like shopping. These two floors are mainly served by various restaurants, including Sichuan cuisine, Shandong cuisine, and other cuisines. Famous restaurants include Tianjin Restaurant and Yaxi Restaurant. In addition, the Kong Family Restaurant on the second floor often has cross-talk performances in the afternoon and evening. If you are interested, you can go and listen to them.

restaurants.name_en: Meihua Hotel Jiangnan Village Famous Vegetable Building

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 阳澄湖莲花岛
attractions.summary: Lianhua Island is located in the northeast of the ancient city of Suzhou, surrounded by water on three sides. It is named after its lotus like shape, which is embedded in the lake. The total area of the island is 3.2 square kilometers, with over 300 households living on the lake and making a living from crabs. The water here is vast and the water quality is particularly good. It is the birthplace of authentic Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs and is known as the "hometown of hairy crabs". The attractions on the island, such as Yiyuan Garden, Yaoshi Temple, Sanyuan Mansion, Xizui Wetland, Dadi Painting, Windmill Array, Cow Water Performance, and Water Treading, are both ornamental and experiential. With the rise of rural tourism, more and more tourists have come to visit, forming an industrial service chain integrating food, housing, tourism, entertainment and shopping. Lotus Island is developing into a resort for vacation and leisure. The Yiyuan Yiyuan Museum covers an area of over 5000 square meters and showcases the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake. It not only restores the original ecological lifestyle of Lianhua Island, but also uses artistic techniques to spread the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town. The entire building includes: the foyer, atrium, fishery hall, water town wedding hall, water town costume hall, historical and cultural hall, and folk customs hall. The waterwheel was an irrigation tool used in ancient times and was popular in most parts of China. When used, stepping on the crutch to rotate the large wheel axle drives the blade in the groove to scrape water upwards and pour it into the field. This type of water lifting facility has a long history because its shape resembles a dragon bone, also known as a "dragon bone water wheel". Fengqing Fishing Port Fengqing Fishing Port is home to the original residents of Lianhua Island who live by the water on both sides. The pink walls and black tiles are connected together, and there is a row of boats and boats in front of the houses, maintaining the original ecological style of the Jiangnan water town. There are aquatic products all year round, and in the golden autumn season, crabs are harvested with joy. Every household welcomes guests with a smiling face. The charming water alleys of Lianhua Island make tourists come and go frequently. Xizui Wetland Park covers an area of over 300 acres, with diverse vegetation types and a good ecological environment. Along the lakeside boardwalk, visitors can enjoy the lake scenery and lotus flowers. In the flower planting area, rapeseed flowers can be seen in spring and sunflowers can be seen in autumn, creating a beautiful scenery. Cattle fetching water used to be a common scene in agriculture in Jiangnan. In a pavilion that was over a person tall, an old cow with its eyes covered was placed by a large wooden plate, circling in circles. The rotation of the large wheel axle drove the blades in the trough to scrape the water upwards, and the river water was irrigated by the "bucket board" into the fields by the river. The former residence of Qian Qi in the San Yuan Mansion, where "San Yuan" refers to Lianzhong Huiyuan, Jieyuan, and Zhuangyuan. Only 15 people in Chinese history have received this honor. In October 2010, construction was carried out on Qian Qi's old house, which consists of three entrances in front and back, with a total area of 300 square meters. The first two entrances are Ming style buildings with an area of 160 square meters, while the last entrance is an early Qing Dynasty building with an area of 140 square meters. The Suzhou Yangcheng Lake Tourism Distribution Center is located in the middle of the "Beauty Leg" Peninsula in Yangcheng Lake Resort. It is a comprehensive service center that integrates tourism distribution, tourist services, cultural exhibitions, and product sales. It is also a transportation hub that combines road and water transportation, and is a benchmark for smart tourism distribution centers in China. It covers an area of 36.5 acres and has a building area of 6848 square meters. It consists of three main parts: an ecological parking lot, a distribution building, and a boat dock. Designed by the architectural master Kengo Kuma, the building resembles a layered structure of thatch, which is a concrete expression of the rural areas of Jiangnan; The massive triangular roof is like a mountain range connected along the lake, perfectly blending with nature. This is a new cultural landmark, as well as a brand new cultural window and innovation and entrepreneurship base by Yangcheng Lake. It has become a well-known check-in spot for internet celebrities. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Yang Mingyu braised chicken with rice

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 中国科举博物馆(江南贡院)
attractions.summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 阅江楼
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Yuejiang Tower in Nanjing, along with the Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is collectively known as the Four Famous Towers of Jiangnan. It features a distinctive Ming Dynasty style and classical royal grandeur.
- The most unique feature of Yuejiang Tower is that the tower was built based on the "Yuejiang Lou Ji" (Record of Yuejiang Tower) by Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang of the Ming Dynasty.
- From the top of Yuejiang Tower, one can enjoy a panoramic view of the vast Yangtze River, the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, and the entire city of Jinling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb the Ming Dynasty tower to admire the vast Yangtze River.

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 仙湖植物园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- To the east, it is bordered by Wutong Mountain, the highest peak in Shenzhen, and to the west, it adjoins Shenzhen Reservoir. The botanical garden integrates species conservation, research, science popularization, and tourism functions.
- The botanical garden is divided into six major scenic areas: Tian Shang Ren Jian (Heaven and Earth), Lake Area, Temple Area, Desert Plant Area, Fossil Forest Scenic Area, and Pine, Cypress, and Rhododendron Scenic Area.
- It features several unique garden attractions, including Bie You Dong Tian (Cave of Hidden Wonders), Liang Yi Pavilion, Yu Dai Bridge, Long Zun Tower, Ting Tao Pavilion, Lan Sheng Pavilion, and Die Gu You Lan (Butterfly Valley with Orchids), among others.
- The garden also houses a distinctive Paleontology Museum, unique garden architecture, and a mysterious plant kingdom, all of which are highly praised.
- Hongfa Temple is located here, known as the most effective temple, with a strong incense offering and frequent visits by locals who come to burn incense.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire a variety of plants and visit Hongfa Temple.

attractions.name: 弘法寺
attractions.summary: Shenzhen Hongfa Temple is located in Shenzhen Xianhu Botanical Garden, backed by Wutong Mountain, the "green heart and lung" of Shenzhen, and facing Xianhu. The surrounding natural scenery is very beautiful. The temple was founded in 1985, with a short history, but its scale is second to none in the local area. On the first and fifteenth days of the lunar month, countless believers come to burn incense and worship Buddha. Walk about 2.2 kilometers from the entrance of Xianhu Botanical Garden, you can see the true appearance of Hongfa Temple. Along the way, there are green mountains and green hills, and the scenery is beautiful. There are Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Tibetan Sutra Building, etc. in the temple, with arches and cornices stacked on top of each other, which is very majestic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Temple scale is second to none in Shenzhen

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

attractions.name: 南长街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: On the street, you can still see the preserved old threshold, the grooves of the old storefronts' door panels, and the creaking floor slabs when you walk up. However, these old-fashioned buildings are full of all kinds of fashionable creative elements. As the core part of Qingmingqiao Historical and Cultural Block in Wuxi, characteristic shops are gathered here, which is integrated with the old-fashioned buildings in Wuxi. It is quite flavorful. No matter whether you go there during the day or at night, you will have a different feeling.
attractions.shortFeatures: The charm of classical architecture still exists

attractions.name: 南禅寺
attractions.summary:
English:  
- Formerly known as "Liangxi Feng Da Sha," with a long history and many eminent monks. The current temple was rebuilt in the 1980s and 1990s.  
- During the Tian Sheng period of the Northern Song Dynasty, Emperor Renzong of Song named it "Fusheng Chan Yuan." Eight years later, Emperor Renzong also named the northern counterpart to the Southern Chan Temple, "Shousheng Chan Yuan."  
- The temple includes the Heavenly King Hall, Miaoguang Pagoda, Five Precepts Hall, and a Liberation Pond, all of which visitors can explore.  
- After visiting the temple to pay respects, you can stroll around the nearby streets and enjoy local delicacies. The night scenery here is also worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: A blessed place of worship with strong incense offerings.

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 无锡锡惠公园-寄畅园
attractions.summary: Jichang Garden is a classical garden located at the eastern foot of Huishan Mountain and within Xihui Park in Wuxi. Jichang Garden incorporates the water from Huishan Spring into its water scenery, cleverly utilizing the technique of borrowing scenery. Within the garden, one can see the reflection of the Dragon Light Tower on Xishan in the pond, which is quite unique in its arrangement. Jichang Garden was once a private garden for returning officials in the Ming Dynasty, and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Nanjing Zhan Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. The park is centered around a rockery pond, surrounded by buildings such as Yupan Pavilion Corridor, Zhiyu Barrier, Seven Star Bridge, Hanbi Pavilion, and Qingyu Corridor. It also introduces water from the "Erquan" (Huishan Spring) into the ravine, known as the "Bayin Stream" due to its murmuring sound. There are also buildings in the park, such as the "Bingtang Hall" within the park and the former study of the park owner, the "Hanzhen Study". Jichang Garden was deeply loved by the two emperors of the Qing Dynasty, Kangxi and Qianlong. They visited this garden several times during their southern tours, and now they can still see the imperial stone plaques of Kangxi's "Mountain Scenery and Stream Light" and Qianlong's "Jade and Golden Fir". Even the Xiqu Garden in Beijing's Summer Palace and the Grand Duke of Kuoran (destroyed in the war) in the Summer Palace were built in imitation of Jichang Garden. In addition, the towering trees in the park are also a great place to relax in summer, and in autumn, you can see colorful red maple and ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 天下第二泉
attractions.summary: The Second Spring in the World is located in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. A melodious music of "Two Springs Reflecting the Moon" will take you to the famous second spring in the world, make a cup of Two Springs tea, and drink it in your mouth. It is sweet and mellow. When you pour tea carefully, you can also find that the tea is several millimeters above the mouth of the cup without overflowing. This is because it contains a lot of minerals. Experts believe that the second spring water has the effect of relieving annoyance, quenching thirst and prolonging life. There are many clear springs in Huishan, and there is a saying of "Thirteen Springs of Nine Dragons" in history. Huishan Spring, located near Huishan Temple, was originally known as Yilan Spring. According to legend, it was excavated by Jingcheng, the magistrate of Wuxi County, in the wei year of Dali in the Tang Dynasty (AD 779). There are two pools in total, the upper pool is round, the water is clear and blue, and all drinks are drawn here; Lu Yu in the Tang Dynasty arranged 20 famous springs in his "Tea Classic", and Huishan Spring in Wuxi ranked second. Liu Bochu, another water critic, thought: "The spring water suitable for making tea has seven eyes, and Huishan Spring is the second." Since then, the name of "the second spring in the world" has been recognized by literati and celebrities in the past dynasties. Boil tea with two springs to entertain guests. Wang Ji, a famous painter, painted for a bamboo stove in the eighth year of Hongwugan (AD 1395), and wrote a poem: "I don't sleep at night in a cold fasting, and I sit by the fireside with tea; The fire simmers mountain chestnuts, knocks on ice to draw streams and springs, tiles turn white clouds, and bamboos emit green smoke; A sip of a phoenix gives birth to the armpit, and the Russian police bones are immortal! "It shows his falling feelings. The famous painter Wen Zhengming had a tea party with his friends in Huishan on February 19th, the 13th year of Zhengde in the Ming Dynasty (AD 1518). The party caused by the party to make a" Huishan Tea Party Picture ", which was colored on paper, reproducing the scene of poets and painters cooking tea in bamboo stoves and thinking in Maoting. This precious picture scroll is treasured in the Palace Museum. Pi Rixiu, a poet in the late Tang Dynasty, compared Li Deyu's addiction to drinking second spring water with Yang Guifei's love for lychees, and wrote a satirical poem: When the prime minister often thinks about cooking tea, it is only too late for the county marquis to urge him; Wu Guan went to the country for three thousand miles, and Mo Xiao Yang Fei loves lychees. In the later Song Dynasty, Hui Song Dynasty included the second spring water as a tribute, and it entered a hundred altars every month. Su Dongpo, a famous poet, sang the famous sentence "Take a small moon in the sky alone and try the second spring in the world". Both Kangxi and Qianlong went to Huishan to taste springs to inscribe chants. A Bing, a blind folk musician in modern times, once wandered around Huishan, and composed a song "Two Springs Reflect the Moon", which was widely circulated at home and abroad. For 3,000 years, the stone threshold has been trampled by water drawers for more than ten centimeters. The center is the spring pavilion, with the upper pool and the middle pool in the pavilion; Above the spring pavilion is the "Jinghui Hall": under the spring pavilion is the "Yilan Hall", and in front of the hall is the lower pool. The upper pool, middle pool and lower pool form a complete water system of "the second spring in the world". The three pools have different shapes, all built with exquisite bluestone railings. The middle pool is square, close to the upper pool, only three feet apart, and the stone bottom is "a trickle of running water. Clear and lovely, but the water quality is poor. " Above the upper pool and the lower pool, there is a "Two Springs Pavilion".
attractions.shortFeatures: The Origin of the Creation of Two Springs Reflecting the Moon

attractions.name: 惠山寺
attractions.summary: Huishan Temple was founded in the Southern and Northern Dynasties, and it has been more than 1,500 years ago. Huishan Temple has preserved precious cultural relics such as the stone bed of listening to pine in Tang Dynasty, the scriptures of Tang and Song Dynasties, the Xianghua Bridge, the Jinlian Bridge in Song Dynasty, the ancient ginkgo in Ming Dynasty, the imperial monument in Qing Dynasty, as well as the Daxiong Hall and Huishan Temple bell restored in recent years, which show the unique charm of Buddhist culture. Huishan Temple ranks first among the top ten jungles in Wuxi because of its long history and profound culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit historic sites, worship Buddha and pray for blessings

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 长春桥
attractions.summary: Changchun Bridge was built in 1936. It is located in a pool of Hanwanxuan and Jiangxuexuan. The front and rear lake embankments of the bridge are separated from Taihu Lake. The bridge is arched, like the Jade Belt Bridge in the Summer Palace, and the bridge opening reflects the sun into a muddy round shape. Japanese cherry blossoms have been introduced on the lake embankment for more than 60 years. Every April, flowers bloom like clouds, light red, pink and white. Under the shade of green mountains and green waters, they are particularly enchanting, and they are called "Changchun Cherry Blossom". In front of Changchun Bridge, there is an ancient building half exposed to the water, with the title "Jiangxuexuan", opposite Hanwanxuan. Next to Jiangxuexuan is Yundou Building, which was built by the owner in memory of the ancestor Yang Duwang, with Cai Yuanpei's inscription on it. Uphill, there is the Flower Temple, which was built in 1931. It offers the statue of "Flower Goddess Yi" in the middle, with a high bun and clouds, and a beautiful posture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built in 1936

attractions.name: 太湖佳绝处
attractions.name_en: Best Scenic Spot of Taihu Lake

attractions.name: 横云山庄
attractions.summary: Entering the gate tower of "the Taihu Lake Lake is a wonderful place" is Yuantouzhu Classical Garden Scenic Spot. Here, the frequency lake leans against the mountain, pavilions, corridors and pavilions, small bridges and flowing water, a style of classical gardens in the south of the Yangtze River, Changchun Bridge, Jiangxue Pavilion, memorial archway, Xu Xiake's bronze statue, Chanfen Hall, Pure perfume Pavilion and other scenic spots are distributed among them.

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-鼋渚春涛
attractions.name_en: Taihu Turtle Head Islet Scenic Area - Spring Waves of Turtle Islet
attractions.summary: Mountain pavilions are looming, and lakeside lighthouses are towering; Looking at the ups and downs of the island in the distance, I can hear the waves close to the shore. Many scenic spots are listed on the lakeshore, highlighting the accumulation of history everywhere. This is the essence scenic spot of Yuantouzhu. The main scenic spots are lighthouse, "Yuantouzhu" stone tablet, "Hengyun" cliff stone carvings, "Zhenze Shenyan" bronze statue, Chenglan Hall, Feiyun Pavilion, etc.

attractions.name: 太湖仙岛
attractions.summary:
It is a group of small islands in the lake in Yuantouzhu scenic spot, which is divided into scenic spots such as Dongtianfudi and Tiandu Xianfu, and has the reputation of "Three Mountains Yingbi". 
There are statues of Taoist fairy palace and grottoes of Taoism and Buddhism on the island. Among them, the 18-meter-high statue of the Jade Emperor in the Taoist temple is rare in China and very eye-catching. 
· There are Huaguo Mountain, Mountain Curtain Cave and Performing Arts Field for monkeys to inhabit and perform monkey art, reproducing the scenes in the famous classical novel The Journey to the West. 
Dajue Bay, Xianren Cave and other scenic spots gather the art of Chinese Buddhist and Taoist grottoes, and the scenic spots such as Tiantai, Yuelao Temple and Yuanyang Pavilion are also magnificent.
