attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to enjoy the vast lake view

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 灵山大佛
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue

attractions.name: 灵山梵宫
attractions.summary:
After visiting the main hall of the Brahma Palace, go directly to the second floor, and walk straight to the entrance of the Treasure Hall. 
The four beauties in ancient China, adult fish, falling geese, closed moon and ashamed flowers, were very exquisite. Their clothes were very realistic, and the shape of their cuffs was very thin. This kind of art was perfect. 
There are many works of Patriarch Bodhidharma. There is a large statue of Patriarch Bodhidharma erected in the center, with a red gourd on the back, a pool around it, and many works around it are exquisite treasures ~
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent Buddhist palace

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 香月花街
attractions.summary: Xiangyuehua Street is the Zen theme street of Nianhuawan. It is the core area of leisure and holiday life in Nianhuawan, and it is also the most humanistic block at present. The architecture here is dominated by Tang style and Song rhyme, which is simple and elegant. There are also a dazzling array of cultural and creative product shops and special experience workshops, as well as shops with various themed restaurants, creative food and local snacks, and Zen-themed inns with different styles and themes. Here, you can find the most comfortable and pleasant Zen life experience to meet your needs of physical and mental vacation relaxation.
attractions.shortFeatures: The architecture is mainly Tang style and Song rhyme

attractions.name: 梵天花海
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay "Brahma Flower Sea" is backed by mountains, and there is a clear river flowing in the sea of flowers. There is an elegant and vast sea of auspicious flowers here, which smudges Zen in time. Bright yellow sulfur chrysanthemum, pink zinnia, delicate drunken butterfly flower, one color flower, blindly Zen, interpret beauty and contain goodness. Flowers bloom all over the mountains, swaying gently, time is quiet and happiness is full.
attractions.shortFeatures: A sea of colorful flowers can be seen during flowering period

attractions.name: 鹿鸣谷
attractions.summary: Luming Valley is a narrow valley in the northeasternmost part of Nianhua Bay, a Zen town. It is the first petal of the "five petals" in the "Eight Views of Lotus". The trees here are towering, quiet and quiet, and it is a natural landscape with deep flowers and trees in Zen rooms. The name of Luming Valley is due to a thousand-year-old story. It is said that when the Tang monk came back from the Buddha's scriptures, he passed by here, and released two sacred deer brought back from the Luyeyuan of Buddha in Tianzhu Kingdom into the mountain forest. Up to now, there is a clear pool called "Lumian Pond" deep in the mountain bay. The Zen life here is therefore vividly called "Ming Sleeping Zen". There is Luming Tea House in Luming Valley, which is used to receive high-end tea parties or customized meditation activities of private and enterprises.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a retreat meditation temple

attractions.name: 妙音台
attractions.summary: Miaoyin Stage is located in Nianhua Bay, Lingshan Town, No. 68 Huanshan West Road, Binhu District, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province. The stage is the stage of Nianhua Bay, and the column couplet at the entrance reads "Insight sees everything, Miaoyin fills ten directions." Unlike traditional opera gates, the entrance and exit gates here are "Laixi" and "Guitou", which are also rich in Zen meaning. The traditional drama culture and Zen culture of the small stage world and the large stage world are cleverly integrated, making people feel emotional and have endless aftertaste.

attractions.name: 铁公祠
attractions.summary: Tiegong Temple, located at the west end of the north bank of Daming Lake, was built to commemorate Tiexuan, the minister of the Ministry of War in Ming Dynasty. It is a comprehensive garden courtyard, which consists of ancestral hall, Xiaocanglang Pavilion, Deyue Pavilion, lakeside promenade, lotus pool and other scenic spots. There is a built-in bronze statue of Tie Xuan in the ancestral hall, which is 2.3 meters high and weighs 1.8 tons. It is antique bronze. Tie Gong is wearing Ming Dynasty civil servant costumes, with a crown and a robe, slightly frowned eyebrows and a sad face. The characters are vivid and lifelike. The combination of traditional sculpture and modern sculpture can better depict the character characteristics and inner world of characters. On the inner wall of the hall, ancient and modern calligraphers' handwritten stone carvings are embedded in all directions. True, line, cursive, seal script and Wei tablet are all equipped with profound skills and their own merits. There are many literati inscriptions in the courtyard, including travel notes, redacted records, poems, inscriptions, birthday words and commemorative articles.
attractions.shortFeatures: In memory of Tie Xuan, Minister of War of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 汇波楼
attractions.summary: Huibo Building is located in the northeast corner of Daming Lake Park. Built in the early Yuan Dynasty, it was named after the building was built on Huibo Bridge (also known as Beishuimen). On the eve of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the building was destroyed and rebuilt in 1981. It is a concrete structure with a width of seven rooms and two floors, wing corners hanging from mountains, Dan pillars and green tiles, lifelike kissing beasts, and sonorous wind chimes. Surrounded by poplars, like stars holding the moon. Li Xiongcai, a contemporary painter and calligrapher, inscribed Huibo Building on it. When you climb the building, you can look at famous mountains such as Lishan and Yuhan in the south, Huashan Mountain, Queshan Mountain and Yaoshan Mountain in the north, look up at the blue sky and clear clouds, and look down at the clear waves of Minghu Lake. In the green lotus bush, boats are competing for the crossing, and the reflection of Hanguang is unobstructed. If you climb the stairs on sunny days or in the evening, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery. The sunset lake reflects each other, the sunset is spread, the soft waves are fascinating, and the upper and lower sky lights are integrated. This wonderful place makes people worry and annoy. The evening photo of Huibo, one of the eight scenic spots in Jinan in ancient times, is called this scene. Liu Haisu, a master of contemporary painting and calligraphy, inscribed a plaque upstairs on Huibo Late Photo.
attractions.shortFeatures: Now Jinan Chess Training Base

attractions.name: 藕神祠
attractions.summary: Lotus Shen Temple, located on the northeast bank of Daming Lake and the south side of Huibo Building, was built in 1998. It has three rooms wide, a mansion in front, and a flower partition. The shrine is dedicated to the colored sculpture of lotus root god dressed in women's costumes of Song Dynasty, which is 2.8 meters high; There are murals painted on the east, north and west walls. The main content of the painting is the legendary story of Li Qingzhao, and the background is the beautiful scenery of Daming Lake. Its feelings and scenery are just as written in the ancestral couplet: "It's Ye Feiye, the fairy lotus shadow in the water; Return to Xi, the talented female soul of Ci Zong in Song Dynasty.

attractions.name: 雨荷厅
attractions.summary: On the south side of Nanfeng Temple Courtyard, near the lakeshore, there are three waterside pavilions, named "Rain Lotus Hall", with red column carved windows, blue tile cornices, surrounded by corridors, surrounded by water on three sides, east, west and north, and planted with lotus flowers. It is said that this is where Emperor Qianlong and Xia Yuhe, a folk woman in Jinan, met and fell in love in the TV series "Huanzhugege".
attractions.shortFeatures: Red column carved window, blue tile cornice

attractions.name: 山东华夏书信文化博物馆
attractions.name_en: Shan Dong Huaxia Shuxin Culture Museum
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Letter Culture Museum is located in Jinan City, Shandong Province, and is the original site of the Jinan Old Telegraph Building. The museum has two floors, with letters as the main collection, divided into four parts: the cultural history of letters, the collection of ancient letters, the collection of modern and contemporary letters, and the collection of letters from famous people in Shandong. It exhibits nearly 300 pictures and more than 100 authentic works, as well as nearly 100 replicas of representative ancient exhibits.

attractions.name: 江湖艺社
attractions.summary: Jianghu Art Society is a cultural venue in Jinan City that integrates traditional folk art performances, cultural exchanges, and art exhibitions. Here, traditional folk arts performances such as cross-talk, storytelling, and fast-paced storytelling are regularly held, making it a great place to learn about Chinese traditional culture and art.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 21:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 王舍人环联夜市
attractions.summary: Wangsheren Huanlian Night Market is a market that integrates food, shopping, and entertainment, where you can taste authentic specialty snacks.

attractions.name: 黑虎泉
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Springs; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It contains a natural cave with massive stones lying within, resembling a fierce tiger hidden deep inside, and the sound of the spring is eerily similar to a tiger's roar, hence named Black Tiger Spring.
- Black Tiger Spring is majestic and powerful, with a flow rate second only to Baotu Spring, ranking second among all the springs in Jinan.
- Many locals come here to collect water, which is crystal clear. Bees might also want to try the spring water here.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Springs of Jinan.

attractions.name: 白石泉
attractions.summary: Baishi Spring is located in the northeast of Heihu Spring, on the river bank on the south side of Jiefang Pavilion, and adjacent to Jiunv Spring in the west. Because there are many rocks in the spring week, it is named "White Stone Spring". There are white natural stones lying prone beside Baishi Spring, and the water is as sweet as the wind, which can be irrigated and drunk. During the water season, strings of blisters emerge, rippling, and confusing with the green algae and white stones in the water, weaving a water pattern.
attractions.shortFeatures: Clear spring with green algae and white stones

attractions.name: 玛瑙泉
attractions.summary: Agate Spring is located on the east bank of Black Tiger Spring, on the south bank of the moat. It is named after the clusters of water bubbles rising from the bottom of the pool, which, when exposed to sunlight, are colorful and resemble agate. The pool is square, 3.7 meters long, 3.2 meters wide, and 2.7 meters deep, with a stone bank. The pool water flows out from seven holes in the upper part of the pool and falls onto the moat, resembling a hanging curtain.

attractions.name: 珍珠泉
attractions.summary: Pearl Spring is one of the four famous springs in Jinan (Baotu Spring, Black Tiger Spring, Pearl Spring and Wulongtan). It is located in the courtyard of Shandong Provincial People's Congress (also called Pearl Spring Courtyard) on the south side of Daming Lake Park. It used to be the residence of the governor of Shandong during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. Compared with Baotu Spring, which is full of tourists, the courtyard where Pearl Spring is located is much quieter. It is very pleasant to enjoy the spring and take a walk here. Come and see Pearl Fountain. The spring water of Pearl Spring is as clear as blue. Standing on the floating pavilion on the south bank of the pool, you can see a string of white bubbles pouring out from the bottom of the pool not far from the pool, like floating pearls, so it is known as "Pearl Spring". Legend has it that the strings of "pearls" in the Pearl Spring were turned into the tears of Shun's two concubines, E Huang and Nv Ying. There are many fish in the spring pool (most of the fish in the spring water in Jinan are brocade scales), showing great vitality. You can also see kind people feeding them with big white steamed buns. Compared with Daming Lake, this place is really a paradise for fish.
attractions.shortFeatures: Pearl-white bubbles poured out from the bottom of the pool

attractions.name: 王府池子
attractions.summary:
Wangfu Pool, also known as Zhuoying Spring, is more than 30 meters long from north to south and 20 meters wide from east to west, with a water surface of more than 600 square meters. Walk from Furong Street to Donghuaqiangzi Street, go east to Qifengqiao Street, then walk to Wangfu Chizi Street, walk to the middle section of Wangfu Chizi Street, turn west, and a large area of green pool water appears in front of you. This is Wangfu Chizi, and the bank of the pool is made of large bluestone, which is filled with a strong civilian atmosphere. In the eyes of many people, among many famous springs, Wangfu Pool may be the most common and friendly. 
On the west side of Wangfu Pool is a two-story building. The foundation is all made of bluestone, which is tall and imposing. Most of the foundations of the east and west bungalows are immersed in water. After many years, the green trees around the pool are shaded, which has the charm of Jiangnan water town.

attractions.name: 辘轳把子街
attractions.summary: Lubazi Street is located in the old city of Jinan. The street itself is not very long, but there are authentic snacks from Jinan here, and the price is reasonable. There are old houses in Jinan on both sides of the street, which is a good place to experience the customs of old Jinan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Taste authentic Jinan snacks

attractions.name: 鞭指巷
attractions.summary: Whip Finger Lane is located on Quancheng Road. It is said that Emperor Qianlong came here and asked, "What kind of lane is this?" Prime Minister Liu Yong didn't know the name of this lane, so he improvised and answered, "Whip Finger Lane," and immediately got its name.

attractions.name: 曲水亭街
attractions.summary:
Qushuiting Street is a famous old street with historical and cultural characteristics at home and abroad in Jinan, Quancheng. 
On one side is an old house with blue bricks and red tiles, and on the other side is a clear spring flowing calmly, where people facing the street wash rice and wash laundry, making the old street vibrant. 
At present, the spring city style of "every household springs water, every household hangs poplars" in Travels of Lao Can is still completely retained.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old street with historical and cultural characteristics in Jinan

attractions.name: 五龙潭公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
Located outside the west gate of Jinan Old City, it is bordered by Baotu Spring in the south and Daming Lake in the north. There are many famous springs around the pool, forming Wulongtan Spring Group. 
The main landscape is named after Wulongtan. Legend has it that Wulongtan is the mansion of Qin Qiong, a hero of Sui and Tang Dynasties, and then it fell and sank due to heavy rain to become today's Wulongtan. 
The garden style combines the essence of gardening in the north and south. It is composed of pools, pools, streams, ports and other landscapes, and 27 springs and pools around the springs are connected as a whole. 
The places of interest and historical sites and newly-built landscapes in the park include: the site of Qin Qiong's former residence, the former site of the leading organs of the Communist Party of China in Shandong Province, the famous pavilion, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Splendid Spring Water Park

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 城市阳台
attractions.summary: Hangzhou City Balcony is located in the core area of Qianjiang New Town. There are three city balconies, one main and two auxiliary balconies. Each balcony is an open and vibrant modern city park, which integrates various functions such as leisure, tide watching, recreation and relaxation. The main balcony is located on the central axis of the core area, with the Qiantang River embankment as the bottom line and tens of meters away from the river surface. It is about 322 meters long. Most of it is overhead on the river surface, and the farthest point protrudes from the river embankment for about 80 meters. The whole balcony is divided into upper and lower floors, and the building area of the first floor alone is 24,000 square meters.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the night view and watch the light show. Excellent observation platform

attractions.name: 云栖竹径
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Hiking; Forests; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
Yunqi Bamboo Trail has the most beautiful bamboo sea around the West Lake, and is famous for its "green, clear, cool and quiet" bamboo scenery. 
In the park, you can still find the preservation of Yunqi Ancient Temple in ancient times, as well as scenic spots such as Huiyanfeng, Baodaolong and Biguan Peak, as well as thousand-year-old Liquidambar formosana trees. 
The bluestone slab in the center of the bamboo path is separated from the pebbles on both sides by black bricks. According to legend, Kangxi and Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty came to Yunqi. 
Next to the path, there are pavilions such as washing heart and Sanju. At the end of the bamboo path, there are rows of ancient trees, pavilions to rest, and tea rooms to sit and enjoy tea.
attractions.shortFeatures: The location of the movie Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon

attractions.name: 九溪十八涧
attractions.summary: Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams are located in the mountains west of West Lake, winding seven kilometers from Longjing into Qiantang River. The scenery of Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams is natural, with little craftsmanship. Every tourist who has visited here likes the peaceful and pleasant scenery.

attractions.name: 九溪烟树
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Commonly known as "Nine Streams and Eighteen Streams", it is a "Y"-shaped stream formed by the confluence of many small streams. After the rain, the smoke of the woods on the nearby Bajue Mountain rises and the valley is hazy, forming a beautiful "smoke tree" landscape. 
· Jiuxi is about 5.5 kilometers long. Along the stream are lush trees and large tea gardens, making it an excellent summer resort. 
There are three entrances and exits, namely Longjing Village on the upper left of the "Y" word, Yangmeiling on the upper right, and Jiuxi Road below. The intersection in the middle is called "Creek in the Creek", where Jiuxi Yanshu Park, Li'an Temple, waterfall and other scenic spots are concentrated. 
You can choose your own route, but the recommended way is Jiuxi Road-Xizhongxi-Longjing Village. In addition to walking, Jiuxi Road-Xizhongxi-Yangmeiling section can be driven by yourself, and there is a parking lot in the scenic spot.
attractions.shortFeatures: The smoke in the woods after the rain is really beautiful

attractions.name: 龙井村
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Longjing Village is located in the southwest of West Lake Scenic Area, surrounded by mountains on all sides, showing a trend of high in the north and low in the south. It has nearly 800 mu of alpine tea gardens. 
The northwest peak, Lion Peak and Tianzhu Peak in the northwest of the village form a natural barrier to block the cold wind from the northwest. There is Jiuxi in the south, and the valley is deep and wide, which leads directly to Qiantang River. The southeast wind in spring and summer is easy to enter the valley. The geographical conditions of ventilation and ventilation provide unique advantages for the growth of Longjing tea. Longjing tea produced here ranks first among "lion, dragon, cloud and tiger". 
· According to legend, when Emperor Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River, he went to Hugong Temple at the foot of Shifeng Mountain in Longjing Village to taste West Lake Longjing tea. After drinking, he was full of praise, and named the eighteen tea trees in front of the temple "Imperial Tea". Longjing Village, the "first village in tea township", is famous for its abundance of top-class West Lake Longjing tea. 
It is bordered by Xizi Lake in the east, Wuyun Mountain in the west, Qiantang River in the south, and the north and south peaks inserted into the clouds in the north. It is surrounded by green mountains and clouds, just like an emerald gemstone inlaid on the shores of Xizi Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: "The First Village of Tea Township"

attractions.name: 上天竺法喜讲寺
attractions.summary:
Shangtianzhu Temple, also known as Faxi Temple, was built in the 10th century. It is the origin of Guanyin in white in China. It has a history of more than 1,000 years. It has always been a famous Buddhist holy place in China, and it is also said to be one of the dojos of Guanyin Bodhisattva. Now it is an effective online celebrity temple in Hangzhou. 
Today's Faxi Temple is the largest temple among the three temples in Tianzhu. It contains the Tibetan Sutra Hall, Liangfeng Hall, Qianfo Pavilion, Shuiyue Building, Huanghua Pavilion, etc. There are scenic spots such as Baiyun Peak, Rudou Peak, Rudou Spring and Baiyun Spring around the temple. You can worship Buddha and pray here, or visit buildings and surrounding scenic spots. 
There are five hundred years of ancient magnolia here. Every early spring, magnolia flowers bloom, and the trees are all white, which is particularly gorgeous, decorating the ancient temples in the deep mountains with full charm.
attractions.shortFeatures: The scenery is quiet and there are many eminent monks

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 飞来峰
attractions.summary: Feilai Peak, also known as Lingjiu Peak, is 168 meters high and composed of limestone. Due to long-term exposure to groundwater erosion, Feilai Peak has formed many fantastic and varied caves and ravines, including Qinglin Cave, Yuru Cave, Longhong Cave, etc. The old trees and vines on the mountain are intertwined and tangled; The rock bones are exposed, and the peaks and ridges are as sharp as cutting. The amazing thing about Feilai Peak is the relatively complete 345 Buddhist themed statues on the mountain, with diverse forms, rich themes, vivid carvings, and unique styles, making it an attractive and wonderful spectacle.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 07:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00),Opens at Daylight saving time 06:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30)

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 杭州宋城
attractions.tag: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"

Commonly known as "Nine Streams and Eighteen Streams", it is a "Y"-shaped stream formed by the confluence of many small streams. After the rain, the smoke of the woods on the nearby Bajue Mountain rises and the valley is hazy, forming a beautiful "smoke tree" landscape. 
· Jiuxi is about 5.5 kilometers long. Along the stream are lush trees and large tea gardens, making it an excellent summer resort. 
There are three entrances and exits, namely Longjing Village on the upper left of the "Y" word, Yangmeiling on the upper right, and Jiuxi Road below. The intersection in the middle is called "Creek in the Creek", where Jiuxi Yanshu Park, Li'an Temple, waterfall and other scenic spots are concentrated. 
You can choose your own route, but the recommended way is Jiuxi Road-Xizhongxi-Longjing Village. In addition to walking, Jiuxi Road-Xizhongxi-Yangmeiling section can be driven by yourself, and there is a parking lot in the scenic spot.
attractions.shortFeatures: The smoke in the woods after the rain is really beautiful
