Hot Earth Manor Su Yuan Restaurant

attractions.name: 珠江夜游天字码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Tianzi Pier
attractions.summary: The Pearl River Night Tour is one of the eight scenic spots in Guangzhou, a window to display the splendid ancient civilization and modern development achievements of Guangzhou, and also a crystallization of Guangzhou tourism. The time-honored ferry dock in Guangzhou, the Tianzi Dock (built in the reign of Emperor Yongzheng in the Qing Dynasty), has a history of more than 270 years. It has become the main deck of the Pearl River night navigation, receiving foreign guests welcomed by the Party and leaders as well as the people's government of Guangdong Province and Guangzhou City. Full text 

attractions.name: 东山口
attractions.summary:
Dongshankou is a holy land of literature and art, where art spaces, life aesthetics shops and studios take root and sprout, growing a literary atmosphere with Dongshankou characteristics. 
Walking in the Dongshan western buildings, you can feel the uneven and undulating terrain here like a hills. 
The number of western buildings in Dongshan is amazing, among which the more famous ones are five gardens.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Republic of China has many historical features and cultural buildings

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园
attractions.summary: Haixinsha is located in the area of Bati, the Pearl River - Guangzhou Tower - Huacheng Square. It is an artificial island located on the the Pearl River. The night scene here is very beautiful. With the lights of Huacheng Square, you can see the colorful changes of Guangzhou Tower across the river, which reflect each other. Moreover, it is also a great destination for the exterior of Guangzhou Tower, where many photography enthusiasts take photos. The Asian Games Park on the island was the venue for the opening ceremony of the Guangzhou Asian Games in 2010. Those who have watched the opening ceremony will surely remember this boat shaped sports arena vividly. Huacheng Square is on the north bank of the Pearl River, Haixinsha is in the river, and Guangzhou Tower is on the south bank. The unique geographical location makes Haixinsha and its surrounding areas a must for exploring the international metropolis of Guangzhou, which is a new landmark of Guangzhou. The subway APM line connects these three areas to form a three-point line. Generally, APM can take you to Haixinsha Station, but if you want to have a better tour, it is recommended to get off at Dahua Theater Station. Because you can also visit the Grand Theatre and Guangzhou Library, which are new cultural landmarks in Guangzhou. Then take a slow walk to Liede Bridge and see Haixinsha and Guangzhou Tower from the other side.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 广州荔枝湾游船
attractions.summary: Lizhi Bay is located in the hinterland of Xiguan in the old city area of Guangzhou, and it is also the origin of Xiguan's current name, "Liwan District". There is a poem that describes the scenery of Lizhi Bay as "a bay with green water and red Lizhi on both sides". Litchi Bay has a beautiful environment, crisscrossing water systems, and numerous historical sites. Taking a boat tour is a great way to enjoy the scenery. There are two types of boats here, one is rowing boats and the other is painting boats. You can take the bus at both Wenta Square and the entrance of the Liang Clan Ancestral Hall, mainly passing through the first, second, and third phases of Lizhi Bay and Liwan Lake. Along the coast, you will pass by several famous people's former residences, as well as important attractions such as Wenta, Chen Lianbo Mansion, Haishan Xian Guan Long Corridor, Shide Yinhe, Lixiang River Square, and the Eight Harmony Hall in the third phase, as well as more than ten small bridges spanning the bay, allowing you to experience the cultural charm of Lizhi Bay at once.

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 太古仓
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built by British Swire Ocean Company between 1904 and 1908, it was used by Swire Steamship Company. It is a relatively complete storage terminal. 
It consists of 3 T-shaped trestle concrete wharves and 7 brick and wood structure warehouses, which is the historical epitome of Guangzhou Port's foreign trade. 
Guangzhou's "City Living Room", which integrates cultural creativity, exhibition and trade, sightseeing, leisure and entertainment and other functions. 
On the basis of retaining the original history, it will be transformed into a creative industrial park including bars, cinemas and yacht marinas.
attractions.shortFeatures: A creative park transformed into a dock warehouse

attractions.name: 长洲岛
attractions.summary: Changzhou Island, located on the eastern edge of Guangzhou, is an island in the middle of the river on the Pearl River in Huangpu area. It is named Changzhou Island because of its long and narrow shape. There are historic sites everywhere, profound cultural heritage and rich tourism resources. Whampoa Military Academy founded by Dr. Sun Yat-sen has made it a place that attracts worldwide attention and a tourist attraction in Guangzhou.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jiangxin Island in Huangpu area

attractions.name: 黄埔古港
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
Huangpu Ancient Port is a window of the golden age of China's maritime trade in the 17th and 18th centuries. It is also the hub of economic and cultural exchanges between China and the West, witnessed the prosperity of the "Maritime Silk Road", and is known as "the first pass of Guangdong and Sea". 
· Huangpu Ancient Village is an important historical and cultural relic in Guangzhou and a witness to Guangzhou's glorious maritime trade history. Huangpu Ancient Village is prosperous because of Huangpu Ancient Port, and talented people come forth in large numbers. Up to now, there are still many relics such as ancient ports, ancient ancestral halls, ancient temples, ancient dwellings and former residences of celebrities in Huangpu Village.
attractions.shortFeatures: Important Customs Trade Port in Ancient Times

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Cangyuantang freshly stewed bird's nest store
Sunshine Gourmet Restaurant ▪ Signature Fan Chicken

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 仙湖植物园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- To the east, it is bordered by Wutong Mountain, the highest peak in Shenzhen, and to the west, it adjoins Shenzhen Reservoir. The botanical garden integrates species conservation, research, science popularization, and tourism functions.
- The botanical garden is divided into six major scenic areas: Tian Shang Ren Jian (Heaven and Earth), Lake Area, Temple Area, Desert Plant Area, Fossil Forest Scenic Area, and Pine, Cypress, and Rhododendron Scenic Area.
- It features several unique garden attractions, including Bie You Dong Tian (Cave of Hidden Wonders), Liang Yi Pavilion, Yu Dai Bridge, Long Zun Tower, Ting Tao Pavilion, Lan Sheng Pavilion, and Die Gu You Lan (Butterfly Valley with Orchids), among others.
- The garden also houses a distinctive Paleontology Museum, unique garden architecture, and a mysterious plant kingdom, all of which are highly praised.
- Hongfa Temple is located here, known as the most effective temple, with a strong incense offering and frequent visits by locals who come to burn incense.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire a variety of plants and visit Hongfa Temple.

attractions.name: 弘法寺
attractions.summary: Shenzhen Hongfa Temple is located in Shenzhen Xianhu Botanical Garden, backed by Wutong Mountain, the "green heart and lung" of Shenzhen, and facing Xianhu. The surrounding natural scenery is very beautiful. The temple was founded in 1985, with a short history, but its scale is second to none in the local area. On the first and fifteenth days of the lunar month, countless believers come to burn incense and worship Buddha. Walk about 2.2 kilometers from the entrance of Xianhu Botanical Garden, you can see the true appearance of Hongfa Temple. Along the way, there are green mountains and green hills, and the scenery is beautiful. There are Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Tibetan Sutra Building, etc. in the temple, with arches and cornices stacked on top of each other, which is very majestic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Temple scale is second to none in Shenzhen

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 东部华侨城大侠谷
attractions.summary: Daxia Valley is a theme park located within the OCT scenic area in eastern Shenzhen, and is also one of its core tourist areas. Daxia Valley is a fusion of natural scenery and thrilling amusement projects, making it a choice for young people to gather and travel. It usually takes one day to visit the Great Xia Valley. It is recommended to take the jungle cable car to the Cloud Sea Highland after entering the scenic spot in the morning. This is the essence of the Great Xia Valley. The 110 meter high Natural Eye Observation Tower on the Cloud Sea Plateau and the "Peak of Extreme" all glass observation deck extending beyond the cliff offer panoramic views of the entire Eastern Overseas Chinese Town, making it the observation deck of the Great Hero Valley. After playing on the mountain, take the Cloud Sea Cableway down the mountain to the Ecological Canyon at noon or afternoon. This is a place where thrilling and exciting amusement projects are concentrated, including rapids, wooden roller coasters, 4000 miles from the center of the earth, deep-sea exploration, hurricane rescue, jungle shuttle, phantom whirlwind, children's amusement park, mountain and sea mysterious realm performances, etc. Among them, the most exciting ones are the wooden roller coasters and rapids. After playing exciting amusement projects, continue walking and you will come to Haifeide (a small town). Haifeide (a small town) is a characteristic block with the theme of world wine culture. The buildings in the town are full of exotic charm, and there are many copper sculptures related to wine on the street. Full text 

attractions.name: 海菲德(小城)
attractions.summary: The characteristic block of Haifeide Town is themed around wine culture, with warm and simple buildings combining logs and bricks, and rich American characteristics. The series of bronze sculptures showcases the entire process from grape picking to red wine making, showcasing the charm of a wine town in Napa Valley, California in the 19th century. Strolling through it, both floors are exotic buildings, with numerous shops along the street and a huge LED canopy overhead, constantly playing spectacular scenes of space, ocean, and forest alternating and changing. The red wine experience hall and homemade beer house are must visit places here, and the lakeside food gallery has many unique and delicious dishes.

attractions.name: 东门老街
attractions.summary: Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

attractions.name: 深圳平安金融中心云际观光层
attractions.name_en: Ping An Finance Center Sky Observation Deck, Shenzhen
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Observation deck
attractions.summary: FREE SKY Cloud Sightseeing Floor is located on the 116th floor of Ping An Financial Center, the fourth tallest building in the world. It is proud of Shenzhen's new landmark at an altitude of about 547.6 meters, and has a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Shenzhen's different landscapes and urban features in all directions. The cloud sightseeing layer integrates sightseeing and entertainment, cultural creativity and popular science education, and is a new landmark of urban sightseeing with cultural connotation. At the same time, the sightseeing floor is connected with a huge transportation network and rich tourist lines, which will become an unmissable choice for many tourists to visit Shenzhen. The sightseeing floor covers a number of functional spaces, such as transparent viewing spots, interactive experience areas, characteristic exhibition areas, etc., and displays the young culture with rich Shenzhen characteristics with advanced intelligent multimedia facilities. This is an excellent place to taste the prosperity and natural reflection of Shenzhen. You can enjoy the unique experience of enjoying the city scenery at Dapeng Fuyun, and the 360-degree cloud overview is shocking.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the suspended observation platform with a bird's-eye view of Shenzhen and Hong Kong

attractions.name: 地王观光·深港之窗
attractions.summary: The tourist destination for Diwang sightseeing refers to Diwang Building, a well-known landmark in Shenzhen with a total height of 383.95 meters and an actual building height of 324.8 meters. Climbing up to the 69th floor, you can overlook Hong Kong to the south and Shenzhen to the north. Diwang Sightseeing, also known as the Window of Shenzhen and Hong Kong, is a themed high-rise tourist attraction. Accompanied by melodious music, taking the elevator only takes fifty seconds to reach the top floor of the 69th floor of the Diwang Building. The scenic area features novel and exciting multidimensional dynamic movies, documentary digital overlay slides, and fifteen interesting landscapes. Standing at an altitude of over 300 meters, the winding Shenzhen River looks like a giant dragon waiting to take off, and like a gorgeous green ribbon tightly linking Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 20:20; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 大鹏半岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Shenzhen Dapeng Peninsula National Geological Natural Park is located in the southeasternmost Dapeng Peninsula of Shenzhen. The geological heritage protection area covers an area of about 46.07 square kilometers. In 2005, it was rated as a national geological park. 
The types of geological relics in the park are mainly ancient volcanic relics formed by five volcanic eruptions about 146 million years ago and coastal landscapes formed in 20,000 to 10,000 years ago. The uncanny workmanship of nature has created the unique landscape here. 
The main peak of Qiniang Mountain formed by volcanic eruption is about 869.7 meters above sea level, making it the second highest peak in Shenzhen. The stretching coastline was rated as one of the "eight most beautiful coasts in China" by China National Geographic. 
The park is divided into four scenic spots: Qiongqiu Travel Scenic Spot, Haishi Wonder Scenic Spot, Luzui Tide Watching Scenic Spot and Buxi Yangmei Scenic Spot. Based on the needs of geological relics and natural environment protection, the areas officially open to the public in the park are "Qiongqiu Tour" and "Luzui Tide Watching", with museum scenic spots, main peak scientific research line and Luyan scientific research line.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shenzhen's "Gold Coast"

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 甘坑古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Villages; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gankeng Village was originally an ancient village with a long history. Together with Guanlan Printmaking Village, Hehu New Residence, Makan Ancient Village and Dawanshiju, it is known as one of the top ten Hakka ancient villages in Shenzhen. The protection and development direction of Gankeng is to rebuild the central OCT of Shenzhen and give Shenzhen people a slow time. 
More than 350 years ago, Xie Wenming and Zhuo Meifa, the ancestors of Gankeng Village, Hakkas from Meizhou, took a fancy to the natural environment here and settled here and thrived. Nowadays, the Hakka people open their sincere arms and invite tourists from all over the country to Gankeng to experience and explore Shenzhen Hakka culture with an inclusive mind. 
In Gankeng Village, there are Hakka dwellings and many ancient buildings, surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the houses are connected with alleys, which are strewn at random, just like a picture scroll. More amorous style buildings such as gun towers, watchtowers, arcades and diaojiao buildings are blended into the mountains and rivers, forming a unique carrier of Hakka culture with hundreds of years old Hakka houses.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hakka Water Town Customs and Farming Experience

restaurants.name_en: Linghai affordable wild seafood food stall
Kingkey Bay Hotel Inaguan Japanese Cuisine Restaurant
Sea Old Chen Fish Steak Restaurant

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 南屏步行街
attractions.summary: Nanping Street is an old block in the history of Kunming and also an ancient commercial street in the city. There are numerous restaurants, shops, supermarkets, and brand chain stores on the streets, offering a wide range of food, accommodation, travel, shopping, and entertainment options. It is one of the bustling streets in Kunming and also a popular spot for tourists to check in. At the entrance of Nanping Street, there is a large memorial archway, which is one of the landmark attractions here. Many tourists take photos here. There are also bronze statues on the street, with lifelike figures that can be photographed and recorded. Shopping, tasting delicious food, and savoring the charm of Kunming.

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 海埂大坝
attractions.summary:
· Located next to Dianchi Lake, you can see Dianchi Lake at the foot of Xishan Mountain, and the scenery is beautiful. 
It's a good choice to come here to see seagulls. The dam is full of seagulls flying around, which is very spectacular. 
· The dam is very wide and long, and parking is very convenient. Many newlyweds choose to come here to take wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to enjoy seagulls

attractions.name: 滇池游船
attractions.summary: Take a cruise ship to enjoy the scenery of Dianchi Lake, sit on the boat and admire the coastal scenery of Haigeng Park, century old eucalyptus trees, sea view corridor, Dianchi Lake interface, aerial cableway, overlooking Xishan Forest Park, Xishan Longmen, and Sleeping Beauty Mountain. In winter, you can sit on the boat and watch or play with seagulls; Professional explanation of scenic spots: Take a boat ride to experience the unique charm of Dianchi Lake, enjoy an elegant water life, frolic with seagulls, enjoy song and dance performances, and enjoy the blue sea and sky around the lake area! In Dianchi Lake, a piece of bread can feed the red billed gulls all afternoon, and the sky is filled with red billed gulls during feeding, creating a spectacular scenery. Dianchi Lake has both the beauty of the sea and the grandeur of the sea. The water is wide, surrounded by mountains, with rivers crisscrossing and vast fields. Around the lake, there are fishing villages and the Guanyin Mountain Scenic Area dotted with sails; There is a white fish mouth empty valley garden that has spent all its tree shadows; There are several miles long, clear and sandy seaside beaches and beautiful and elegant Grand View Tower Park, all of which are very pleasant places to visit, especially on the other side of the rippling green waves and the majestic summit of the Western Hills, where water and clouds cover the sky.

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 茶马花街
attractions.summary: Tea Horse Street is about 300 meters long and located on the west bank of Dianchi Lake. It was jointly built by Yunnan Urban Investment Group and Xishan Park. A short tea horse flower street takes into account the display of many cultural elements and the layout of leisure formats. Hundreds of folk snacks make your mouth keep your mouth from the street to the end of the street without stopping for a moment. The pioneer of food taste who is determined to revive the famous Yunnan cuisine, the master of cultural heritage who is proficient in ancient crafts and techniques, the literary and artistic space with the supremacy of emotions and feelings, the essence of Yunpin that shoulders the true colors of Yunnan's fame all over the world, and so on, are refreshing, interesting and informative formats are presented here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many specialty shops and delicious food

attractions.name: 大观公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for walking with kids; Lakes; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Daguan Park is located on the north side of Dianchi Lake. It is a beautiful park with lush greenery and elegant pavilions, featuring scenic areas like near Huapu and Daguan Tower, as well as Lou Wai Lou.  
· Built by the water, Daguan Park features a lakeside dam, lotus ponds, and exquisite pavilions and towers, all arranged with great elegance.  
· The Daguan Tower, built during the Kangxi period, offers views of the Western Hills and Dianchi Lake, and was once considered one of the top ten ancient towers in China.  
· During festivals, the park often holds garden parties and sometimes hosts traditional lantern festivals, attracting a steady stream of visitors and creating a lively atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: A beautiful park on the northern shore of Dianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 金殿公园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for strolling with kids; Taoist Temples
attractions.summary: Jindian Park is named after the main hall, which is made of brass and shines brightly under the sunlight, casting a golden glow over the lush valley and the serene forest. It is also known as the Copper Roof Temple. The renowned Jindian is part of the Taoist Taihe Palace, originally built in the Ming Dynasty (1602), and is one of China's four major copper temples, with the best-preserved structure. In the 10th year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1671), the King of the Western Frontier, Wu Sangui, renovated it. With a long history, Jindian offers beautiful natural scenery, with paths winding through forests where towering trees create a canopy, occasionally interrupted by bird songs. The area is deeply infused with the essence of Taoist culture. In early spring, the hundred-acre camellia garden in the "Jindian Botanical Garden" blooms in full, filling the air with a sea of crimson, creating a breathtaking sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place for a refreshing stroll in a pleasant environment.

restaurants.name_en: Bridge incense Garden Bridge rice noodles
Shan Xiangju · Dai family small courtyard
Dai Xiangyue - Dehong Dai taste Hall

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 长沙世界之窗
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
Changsha Window of the World is located in the northeastern suburbs of the city, along the Liuyang River. It is a comprehensive large-scale theme park that integrates 20 major creative events throughout the year, 50 major thrill rides, architectural wonders from around the world, cultural performances from five continents, and a film shooting base.

The 50 major thrill rides include the "Four Kings of Screams," which are popular among young people, such as the hanging roller coaster, motorcycle roller coaster, sky swing, and twin towers. There are also family-friendly theme areas, such as the Fine Wool Tot Children's Playground, King Kong Jungle Parent-Child Playground, and Pet Paradise. In addition, there is a new concept water park, which has become a new water play landmark for the people of Changsha during the summer.

The 20 major creative events throughout the year include the Chinese Carnival, International Street Art Festival, Halloween, Christmas and New Year season, and more, aiming to bring fresh experiences and endless joy to visitors!

Among the miniature architectural wonders scattered throughout the park, the most popular iconic structures are the New Swan Castle, the Louvre Glass Pyramid from France, and the Lighthouse of Alexandria. As the leader of theme parks in Central and Southern China, Changsha Window of the World continuously upgrades its hardware and software to provide better services and even more fantastic experiences for visitors!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch iconic landmarks around the world.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海心桥
attractions.summary: To the north of the construction site of the the Pearl River Pedestrian Landscape Bridge is the island tip on the east side of Ersha Island, and to the south is the International Media Port. The width of the river is about 280 meters, with an upstream distance of about 500 meters from Guangzhou Bridge and a downstream distance of about 1.4 kilometers from Liede Bridge. The planned navigation net width at the bridge location is not less than 180 meters and the net height is 10 meters. The main bridge adopts a steel structure inclined arch bridge with a main span of 240 meters. The total length of the bridge deck on the east side is about 451 meters, and the total length of the main beam on the west side is about 296 meters. The pedestrian bridge has a total width of 20 meters in the middle span, with a width of 6 meters on the west side, 8 meters on the east side, and 6 meters on the middle staircase.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游广州塔财富码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Canton Tower Fortune Pier
attractions.summary: The Fortune Wharf of the Pearl River Tower is one of the embarkation points for the night tour of the Pearl River. It is located on the new central axis of Guangzhou city, facing the CBD of Pearl River New Town across the river and close to the Guangzhou Tower.

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 荔湾湖公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The park was built in 1958, bounding Longjin West Road in the east, Xiguankou in the south, Huangsha Avenue in the west and Zhongshan 8th Road in the north, where a large number of lychees were planted. 
· The park is equipped with restaurants, teahouses, dance halls and various amusement facilities, making it a comprehensive park integrating sightseeing, cultural and sports, entertainment and rest. 
Liwan Lake Park is a lake-dominated park that can best reflect the elegant and soft style of southern China. 
· The lake occupies two-thirds. It consists of four lakes: Xiaocui Lake, Yucui Lake, Ruyi Lake and Wuxiu Lake. Visitors can take rental boats and water bikes for a tour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the eight scenic spots of Yangcheng; Experience the traditional customs of the Mid-Autumn Festival

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 广州长隆国际大马戏
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong International Circus has more than 300 circus elites from more than 20 countries, and more than 500 rare animals of more than 40 species performing on the same stage 
· It has the world's largest forest live stage layout, and you can see live forests, streams, boats, etc., which is absolutely refreshing 
· The performance is divided into several parts such as animal performance, float parade, acrobatics, etc. Cute and intelligent animals and awesome stage layout make it feel like being there 
· In addition, the theater strongly launched "Magic Legend II", which combines beauty, romance and fantasy to make the performance more legendary
attractions.shortFeatures: A gorgeous circus is staged on a super-large live stage

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds
