attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 南京长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The first double-decker railway and highway bridge on the Yangtze River designed and built by China itself. 
· It is of great significance in the history of bridges in China and even the world, and is an important milestone in China's bridge construction. 
· The railings on both sides of the bridge are embedded with various cast iron reliefs, and there are two high bridgeheads at the north and south ends, which is one of the landmarks of Nanjing. 
There is the Nanbao Park of the bridge under the bridge. Every night, the lights on the bridge are all lit up, and the whole bridge is like a rainbow flying over the river, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Yangtze River Bridge built by the Chinese

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京台城
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing City Wall Essence Section

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 老门东牌坊
attractions.summary: The Old Gate East memorial archway is the main entrance of the Old Gate East Historic District, which is a landmark building here. A stone tablet below the memorial archway is engraved with the history of Nanjing City, which has a lot of historical and cultural details.

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 外秦淮河游船
attractions.name_en: wai qin huai he you chuan

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 中央大街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.
attractions.shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood

attractions.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building

attractions.name: 果戈里大街
attractions.summary:
· It has a history of more than 100 years, and there are many Russian-style buildings, including the famous Qiulin Food Company Building and St. Alexeyev Church. 
The prosperity and night scene are no less beautiful than Central Street, and it is also a "bar street" in Harbin. 
It is also a famous cultural street, with modern horseshoe stones on both sides of the road, and a piece engraved with Heilongjiang historical and cultural celebrities is inlaid every other section.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old Russian-style block

attractions.name: 中华巴洛克风情街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: Located in Nansan, Nansan and Nantoudao Streets outside Laodao, some of the surrounding buildings are renovated from old buildings, while others are imitations. The street is very quiet, and the old-fashioned shop has a bag shop. Fan Jiyong, don't come at the dinner mouth. There are so many people, queuing up and waiting for signs. It's too prosperous. The street, the bronze statue in the courtyard, takes you back to the past as if you were traveling.
attractions.shortFeatures: Street with a unique flavor

attractions.name: 龙塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Long Tower, with a height of 336 meters, ranks second in the world and first in Asia among steel towers. It is a comprehensive multi-functional tower integrating broadcast and television transmission, tourism, dining and entertainment, advertising, environmental and meteorological monitoring, microwave communication, and wireless communication. It is an iconic landmark of Harbin, Northeast China. 

The total area of Long Tower is 16,600 square meters, with the base covering 13,000 square meters and the tower building covering 3,600 square meters. The tower base consists of one underground floor and four above-ground floors, forming a spherical crown shape. The tower body is an octagonal prism, with a parabolic shape and a cylindrical shaft in the center. The structure is surrounded by seven silver-white aluminum alloy panels and nine dark blue coated glass panels. The tower's lower and upper levels are located at 181 meters and 206 meters, respectively, consisting of a disc-shaped lower tower and a circular upper tower. The antennas are positioned between 220.5 meters and 336 meters. 

Long Tower has meticulously created an "honorable hospitality" service, adhering to aviation service standards and forming a team with international service capabilities. It has successfully hosted many central government leaders, including Li Changchun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and He Guoqiang, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, as well as foreign dignitaries such as Russian Deputy Prime Minister Sergey Khristenko and former South Korean Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung. Large-scale delegations from Hong Kong, Macau, and the business and professional sectors, as well as celebrities from the entertainment and business industries, often visit the tower. Visitors often praise the tower’s unique features, beautiful scenery, delicious food, and excellent service. Long Tower has become a must-visit tourist destination for both domestic and international travelers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The high-altitude rotating restaurant offers a view of the night scene; overlooking the panoramic view of Harbin from a height of 100 meters.

attractions.name: 防洪纪念塔
attractions.summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

attractions.name: 亚布力森林温泉
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
· Yabuli Forest Hot Spring is located in Yabuli Tourist Resort, Heilongjiang Province. The hot spring is divided into two areas: indoor pavilion and outdoor hot spring. 
The indoor pavilion takes tropical garden scenery as the theme of hot springs, and combines the abundant Chinese herbal medicine resources in local mountainous areas to create local characteristic medicinal hot springs. There are more than 20 kinds of characteristic hot springs such as ginseng spring, ganoderma lucidum spring, astragalus spring and schisandra spring. 
· Outdoor hot spring pools are distributed in the original birch forest and pine forest, and you can experience the hot spring experience of spring flowers, summer green, autumn yellow and winter snow.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical garden scenery indoor hot spring

attractions.name: 亚布力滑雪旅游度假区
attractions.summary: Yabuli Ski Resort is a famous ski resort in China, gathering multiple professional ski resorts and resort hotels. Here, you can experience the thrilling "snow diving" on professional ski slopes, and there are many professional coaches to help beginners quickly master basic skills, allowing you to fully enjoy the fun of skiing. Yabuli Ski Resort is located in the southern mountainous area of Yabuli Town. The snow quality here is excellent and the hardness is moderate. The snow accumulation period is 170 days, and the skiing period is nearly 150 days. From mid November to late March of the following year, it is a good time for skiing. In addition, there are also activities such as playing snow circles and snowmobiles. International events such as the Asian Winter Games are often held here. The resort consists of three peaks with an altitude of over 1000 meters (Daguokui, Erguokui, and Sanguokui), and is home to multiple ski resorts, such as the Xinhao Sunshine Ski Resort with better facilities and larger facilities in China, and the Xinti Commission Ski Resort with better facilities. Although skiing costs are slightly higher than ordinary ski resorts, they are worth experiencing. In addition, summer vacation areas are also suitable for leisure vacations. The forests here are dense and the scenery is beautiful. There are entertainment projects such as golf, boating, fishing, etc. in the vacation area, making it a good place to escape the heat and summer. Full text 

attractions.name: 亚布力世界第一滑道
attractions.name_en: Yabuli Sightseeing Cable Car and World's First Slide
attractions.summary:
· The world's first slide in Yabuli is located on Sanguokui Mountain at an altitude of 999.8 meters. It extends down the hillside, with a total length of 2,680 meters and a drop of 570 meters. It has 48 curves, which is the highest in the world. 
· You need to take the high-speed uphill cable car to the top of the mountain. During this period, you can overlook this beautiful forest and snowfield, pine trees, stone sea, hanging trees and other scenic spots. I was also lucky enough to see professional athletes speeding in the ski field. 
· The slide is divided into single-person vehicles and double-person vehicles. Each vehicle has a control handle. The slide will pass through two tunnels and 48 detours. The top speed can reach 80 kilometers per hour. Experience the thrill of speed and passion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Total length 2680 meters

attractions.name: 亚布力熊猫馆
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: Yabuli Panda Pavilion is located in Yabuli Ski Resort, more than 200 kilometers away from Harbin. The whole Panda Pavilion covers an area of 2,700 square meters. According to the different indoor and outdoor venues of pandas, it is divided into inner venues and outer venues. The design inspiration of Panda Pavilion is the shape of fallen leaves. The scenic spots include Panda Pavilion, Beast Pavilion, Bear Pavilion, Primate Pavilion, Herbivore Pavilion, etc., which is unique, both a building and a scene. Moreover, more than 20 species of wild animals endemic to Northeast China, such as alpaca, sable, sika deer, brown bear and black bear, have been introduced to settle down here and live and multiply.

Hufengling, located in the easternmost part of Yabuli Forestry Bureau, covers a total area of about 11,964 hectares. No.8 and Hualingou outside Hufeng are the sources of Ant River. 
There is a famous Du Cao Cave on the ridge, which used to be a military place in War of Resistance against Japan and the War of Liberation. 
The "Lilac Peak" of Hufengling, located in the west of Hufengling, is 1,080 meters above sea level. It is an alpine wetland with unique scenery in four seasons.

It was first built in the early years of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty. For nearly 300 years, the temple has been bustling with incense, and the sound of Buddhist scriptures and chants continues to educate countless sentient beings.

attractions.name: 人民公园
attractions.shortFeatures: Covers an area of more than 30 hectares

attractions.name: 绳金塔
attractions.tag: Monuments and ruins; historical buildings; Ancient Pagodas; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Shengjin Tower is located on the east side of Shengjin Tower Street in the Xihu District of Nanchang City, originally outside the ancient city’s Jinxiang Gate. It was first built during the Tang Dynasty, in the Tianyou period (904–907 AD). According to legend, before the tower was constructed, a monk named Weiyi dug the ground and found an iron box containing four golden ropes, three ancient swords (inscribed with the words "Drive Wind," "Pacify Fire," and "Subdue Dragon"), and a golden bottle filled with 300 relics, which is how the tower got its name.

· The Shengjin Tower is a typical brick-and-wood structure in Jiangnan, designed in a pagoda style. It stands approximately 50.86 meters tall and consists of seven levels and eight sides (with seven visible levels and eight hidden levels). The tower features red railings, blue tiles, black corners, clean walls, and a gourd-shaped copper roof with strong religious significance. It has graceful flying eaves, with copper bells hanging from them (recast using ancient bell-making techniques to create wind chimes, with seven layers producing seven different tones). The gourd-shaped copper roof shines brilliantly in gold, with the body of the tower adorned in red railings, blue tiles, and black corners, creating an elegant, simple, and timeless appearance. Each level of the tower has four real doorways and four false doorways, arranged in a staggered manner between levels, with each level’s doors differing in design. The Shengjin Tower is both ancient and beautiful, embodying the typical artistic style of Jiangnan architecture. Having been built during the Tang Dynasty over a thousand years ago, it serves as a carrier of historical information and a testament to the wisdom of generations of laboring people. Shengjin Tower is often referred to as "Water and Fire Harmonized, Overlooking Jiangcheng."
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient pagoda, originally built during the Tang Dynasty in the Tianyou era.

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 江西省美术馆
attractions.summary: The art museum officially opened in 2020, with a building area of about 20000 square meters. It displays many works of Chinese modern and contemporary artists and is a public welfare art museum.

attractions.name: 八一广场
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the heart of Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, it is an important place for political, economic, cultural, leisure, entertainment and other activities in Jiangxi. 
It consists of the central square, the rostrum and the east and west gardens. It is the largest city central square in Jiangxi Province. 
· The large musical fountain in the center of the square, with 1,290 sprinklers, reproduces the bloody battle of the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army in Taihang. 
In the center of the square stands the "August 1st Nanchang Uprising Memorial Tower" inscribed by Marshal Ye Jianying, where many tourists will take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where the military flag is raised

attractions.name: 秋水广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanchang Qiushui Square is located on the Ganjiang River in Honggutan New District, close to the administrative center square and across the river from Tengwang Pavilion. 
The main fountain of the square, which can spray up to 108 meters, is the largest musical fountain in Asia. 
Standing under the fountain in summer, it's extremely cool. Looking at the sun through the mist, you can find countless small rainbows, which are very beautiful. 
At night, the dynamic lights on the opposite side dance with the fountain, and there is Taiwan Province Snack Street next to it, which is a good place to enjoy midnight snack.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the musical fountain with changing lights

attractions.name: 南昌汉代海昏侯国遗址公园
attractions.name_en: The National Archaeological Site Park of Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis
attractions.summary: The Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site in Nanchang consists of the capital city of Haihun Marquis State, Zijin City, the first generation Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery, and the western and southern tomb groups of the city site. It is a typical Han Dynasty capital settlement site discovered in China. Since the archaeological excavation of Liuhe Cemetery began in 2011, more than 10000 precious cultural relics such as gold, bronze, iron, jade, lacquered wood, ceramics, bamboo weaving, grass weaving, textiles, bamboo slips, and wooden slips have been unearthed, which is rare in recent archaeological work in China. Among them, as many as 480 gold artifacts were excavated and unearthed. At the same time, the discovery of precious cultural relics such as Confucius' clothing mirror, gilded patterned bells, chimes, jade seals, etc., has great value. The Haihun Hou State Archaeological Site Park is divided into six functional areas: the Site Museum Area, the Tomb Exhibition Area, the Zijin City Exhibition Area, the Archaeological Reserve Area, the Entrance Functional Area, and the Historical Experience Ecological Leisure Area. Highlight 1: The design of the Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Tourist Center in Nanchang incorporates elements from the jade bi unearthed from Liu He's tomb. From a high altitude, it looks like a self forming circular "Congbi Litian" jade clasp. The building area is 8500 square meters. The tourist center comprehensively accommodates tourist reception services, cultural leisure display, cultural experience, entertainment shopping and other functions. Highlight 2: The architectural form of the Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Guo Site Museum has extracted the dragon shaped patterns that have appeared multiple times in the cultural relics unearthed from Liu He's tomb, symbolizing the hidden dragon in the mountains and fields. The building area is 39296 square meters. Our positioning for it is cultural display, cultural experience, etc. The archaeological museum has exhibitions and displays of unearthed cultural relics, as well as projects such as 4D cinemas and VR experiences. Highlight 3: Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery Liu He Cemetery has a trapezoidal plan, with a width of 141-186 meters from north to south and a length of 233-248 meters from east to west. The perimeter of the walls is 868 meters and the width is about 2 meters, covering a total area of about 46000 square meters. The cemetery consists of two main tombs, seven burial tombs, an outer pit and garden wall, north and east gates and their gates, sleeping quarters, ancestral halls, and temple officials' quarters. There is a complete road system and drainage facilities in the park. Some tombs have ancestral halls built in front of them. The two main tombs, Hou Tomb and Hou Madam Tomb, are located in the same tomb but different caves, occupying a higher and central position in the cemetery. The two tombs share a high platform with an area of about 4000 square meters. Its ceremonial architecture consists of east and west wing rooms, sleeping halls, and ancestral halls. Full text 

attractions.name: 江西省博物馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) is one of the three major cultural centers in Jiangxi Province. It is based on a square box and symbolizes a treasure box. It has six floors, a building area of 86000 square meters, and an exhibition area of 28000 square meters. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Museum) gathers precious historical relics and ancient art masterpieces discovered from various parts of Jiangxi, and collects a large number of cultural relics from the province. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) has established an exhibition system that combines permanent and temporary exhibitions, consisting of 8 permanent exhibitions and 3 temporary exhibition halls. The entire exhibition showcases the historical landscape and cultural characteristics of Jiangxi, meeting the diverse needs of the public in the new era with high quality.

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 昆明老街
attractions.summary: Kunming Old Street is the most authentic old neighborhood in the center of Kunming. There are six streets and ten lanes in the block, and a large number of characteristic residential buildings and old businesses in the Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China are preserved, which has a unique historical charm. Ancient streets, buildings and gatehouses all have a sense of history and age. There are dozens of historical buildings and cultural buildings all over the blocks, which is the best place to feel the history and culture of Kunming.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat small pot rice noodles to shop for Yunnan antiques

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 石林风景区
attractions.summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 金殿公园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for strolling with kids; Taoist Temples
attractions.summary: Jindian Park is named after the main hall, which is made of brass and shines brightly under the sunlight, casting a golden glow over the lush valley and the serene forest. It is also known as the Copper Roof Temple. The renowned Jindian is part of the Taoist Taihe Palace, originally built in the Ming Dynasty (1602), and is one of China's four major copper temples, with the best-preserved structure. In the 10th year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1671), the King of the Western Frontier, Wu Sangui, renovated it. With a long history, Jindian offers beautiful natural scenery, with paths winding through forests where towering trees create a canopy, occasionally interrupted by bird songs. The area is deeply infused with the essence of Taoist culture. In early spring, the hundred-acre camellia garden in the "Jindian Botanical Garden" blooms in full, filling the air with a sea of crimson, creating a breathtaking sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place for a refreshing stroll in a pleasant environment.

restaurants.name_en: Blue bird Spring food Western restaurant
Bridge fragrant Garden authentic bridge rice noodles

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿鸣谷
attractions.summary: Luming Valley is a narrow valley in the northeasternmost part of Nianhua Bay, a Zen town. It is the first petal of the "five petals" in the "Eight Views of Lotus". The trees here are towering, quiet and quiet, and it is a natural landscape with deep flowers and trees in Zen rooms. The name of Luming Valley is due to a thousand-year-old story. It is said that when the Tang monk came back from the Buddha's scriptures, he passed by here, and released two sacred deer brought back from the Luyeyuan of Buddha in Tianzhu Kingdom into the mountain forest. Up to now, there is a clear pool called "Lumian Pond" deep in the mountain bay. The Zen life here is therefore vividly called "Ming Sleeping Zen". There is Luming Tea House in Luming Valley, which is used to receive high-end tea parties or customized meditation activities of private and enterprises.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a retreat meditation temple

attractions.name: 梵天花海
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay "Brahma Flower Sea" is backed by mountains, and there is a clear river flowing in the sea of flowers. There is an elegant and vast sea of auspicious flowers here, which smudges Zen in time. Bright yellow sulfur chrysanthemum, pink zinnia, delicate drunken butterfly flower, one color flower, blindly Zen, interpret beauty and contain goodness. Flowers bloom all over the mountains, swaying gently, time is quiet and happiness is full.
attractions.shortFeatures: A sea of colorful flowers can be seen during flowering period

attractions.name: 拈花湾禅行表演
attractions.name_en: nian hua wan chan xing biao yan
attractions.summary: Zen walking performance is an important cultural activity in Nianhua Bay, aimed at providing tourists with a spiritual baptism through the influence of Zen culture. The performance lasts from 18:00 to 20:50 every day, providing visitors with an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of Zen culture and experience Zen life. In addition, Nianhua Bay also has other exciting night performances, such as "Nianhua Smile" night performance, "Water Curtain Dance", "Bright Tower Ceremony" and "Five Lakes Blooming Flowers" night performances, which are held at different locations and times, providing tourists with diverse cultural experiences. Nianhua Bay is not only a tourist attraction, but also a place that can purify and relax the soul. Through these cultural performances, tourists can deeply feel the charm and connotation of Zen culture.

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 九龙灌浴
attractions.summary:
Kowloon Bath, located in the square of Lingshan Giant Buddha, is the largest musical dynamic bronze sculpture group in China, telling the story of Sakyamuni's birth. 
· This is a major landscape of Lingshan Scenic Spot. With the accompaniment of music, the opening and closing of lotus flowers, and the Prince Buddha slowly rises from it, it rotates around in the water curtain formed by the water spray of Jiulong. 
· There are five performances a day. After the performances, the dragon mouth around the square will spray merit water, which visitors can take away; If you want to watch the bathing show in Kowloon, you can choose a location in advance.
attractions.shortFeatures: Giant bronze sculpture of lotus in bud

attractions.name: 灵山大佛
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue

attractions.name: 五印坛城
attractions.summary:
--Wuyin Mandala City stands in the rippling sea of perfume, complementing Lingshan Brahma Palace and Manfeilong Pagoda. It is a unique and authentic Tibetan cultural landscape. 
--What is displayed here is the Tibetan Buddhist culture. Although it is not as magnificent as the Brahma Palace, it is also extremely gorgeous. The mandala is dedicated to five Buddhas in five directions, and its appearance is solemn and brilliant. 
--Walking into the mandala, visitors can not only appreciate all kinds of Buddhist cultural and artistic treasures from all over Tibet, but also participate in interactive folk activities such as lighting butter lamps and pushing Mani sutra tubes.

attractions.name: 灵山梵宫
attractions.summary:
After visiting the main hall of the Brahma Palace, go directly to the second floor, and walk straight to the entrance of the Treasure Hall. 
The four beauties in ancient China, adult fish, falling geese, closed moon and ashamed flowers, were very exquisite. Their clothes were very realistic, and the shape of their cuffs was very thin. This kind of art was perfect. 
There are many works of Patriarch Bodhidharma. There is a large statue of Patriarch Bodhidharma erected in the center, with a red gourd on the back, a pool around it, and many works around it are exquisite treasures ~
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent Buddhist palace

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-鼋渚春涛
attractions.name_en: Taihu Turtle Head Islet Scenic Area - Spring Waves of Turtle Islet
attractions.summary: Mountain pavilions are looming, and lakeside lighthouses are towering; Looking at the ups and downs of the island in the distance, I can hear the waves close to the shore. Many scenic spots are listed on the lakeshore, highlighting the accumulation of history everywhere. This is the essence scenic spot of Yuantouzhu. The main scenic spots are lighthouse, "Yuantouzhu" stone tablet, "Hengyun" cliff stone carvings, "Zhenze Shenyan" bronze statue, Chenglan Hall, Feiyun Pavilion, etc.

attractions.name: 江南兰苑
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary: Jiangnan Orchid Garden is a special garden mainly cultivating and ornamental orchids. In 1989, it was listed as the research center of orchid germplasm resources protection in China by the Chinese Botanical Society. The garden has lush vegetation, scattered pavilions, quaint layout, orchid fragrance in all seasons, quiet and pleasant, which can be called a good place to enjoy orchids and taste tea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Special garden mainly cultivating ornamental orchids

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-樱花谷
attractions.name_en: Taihu Yuantouzhu Scenic Area - Cherry Blossom Valley
attractions.summary: Located at the northern foot of Luding Mountain in Yuantouzhu Scenic Area, it is adjacent to the Sino-Japanese Cherry Blossom Friendship Forest and integrated into one. It covers an area of 200,000 square meters and has more than 30,000 cherry blossoms of 68 varieties. It is the largest cherry blossom garden in China. Cherry Blossom Valley has buildings such as Cherry Blossom Viewing Building, Tianyun Pavilion, Fanyingxuan and Cuchun Bridge. It is a good place for people to enjoy cherry blossoms and carry out friendly exchange activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the cherry blossoms in the mountains from many angles in spring

attractions.name: 充山隐秀
attractions.summary: The mountain is hidden and beautiful, located at the southeast foothills of Luding Mountain, where the former Chen Family Garden was located. Chen Family Garden, also known as Ruopu, was built in 1928 by Chen Zhongyan, a national industrial and commercial businessman in Wuxi, and set up a nursery after the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is the main location of Taihu Ornamental Botanical Garden, which wins by trees and flowers, natural wild scenery, many ancient and famous trees, and birds and flowers everywhere.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are many ancient and famous trees

attractions.name: 藕花深处
attractions.summary:
The name of "Deep Lotus Flowers" comes from Li Qingzhao's poem "Return to the boat late after excitement, and stray into the deep lotus flowers", which is full of poetry. If there are no lotus roots to see, there are also cherry blossoms all over the embankment. 
A spoonful of rivers and lakes is thousands of miles away, and a piece of stone is Taihua Chihiro. Often, a poem, a tablet and a plaque are like the finishing touch. A little imagination will have the effect of four or two pounds. 
Deep in the north of the lotus root, there is a small memorial archway near the lake, with the forehead of "Hengyun Mountain Villa" hanging on the front and the forehead of "Scenic Spots in the District" hanging on the back. The word "District" is pronounced as "Europe", which has some origins. Jiu District is another name of Taihu Lake besides Zhenze, Lize and Wuhu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Numerous miles of contiguous aquatic plants

restaurants.name_en: Moon on the Water • Lake View Restaurant

attractions.name: 趵突泉景区
attractions.summary: Baotu Spring Park is located in the bustling area of Jinan city center, with Qianfo Mountain to the south, Daming Lake scenic area to the north, and Quancheng Square to the east. It is a characteristic garden with spring water as its theme. Baotu Spring, known as the "number one spring in the world", is located at the top of Jinan's "72 famous springs" and has a history of more than 2000 years. It has also appeared multiple times in literary works, with the representative being "Baotu Spring" by Lao She. And tourists come here to witness the magnificent scene of the three springs of Baotu Spring erupting. Baotu Spring is the main attraction in the park, with three streams of clear and pure water that gushes day and night, reaching several feet in height during peak hours. There are large stone blocks around the spring, surrounded by railings, which allow you to overlook the spectacular scene of the three springs gushing in the pool from the edge of the railing. There is a stone tablet standing next to the spring, inscribed with the words "First Spring". Its color is dark green and it was inscribed by Prince Zhonglin of Licheng during the reign of Emperor Tongzhi of the Qing Dynasty. In addition, there are more than 30 famous springs scattered near Baotu Spring, including Jinxian Spring, Shuyu Spring, Xibo Spring, Liuxu Spring, Huanghua Spring, Dukang Spring, and Bailongquan, forming the Baotu Spring group. Due to the heavy rainfall in July and August, it is a good season to come and enjoy the spring water. During the summer season, tourists can have intimate contact with spring water in the park. Some springs do not have railings around them, and there are stone paths in the pool where the spring water flows. Visitors can go down to the pool and enjoy the water. Walking on the stone paths, their feet will be wet by the spring water, creating a cool feeling. In addition to being hydrophilic, there is also free spring water available for tourists to drink directly by the Baotu Spring pool. On the east side of the spring, there is the Hope Heting Tea Society, which provides visitors with fragrant tea brewed with Baotu spring water at a moderate price. In addition to the spring water, there is also a scenic spot worth watching in the park, which is the south gate of the park. It is decorated in a magnificent and elegant manner, and the horizontal plaque on the gate reads "Baotu Spring" with a blue background and gold letters. It was written by Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty and is known as the "first gate" of Chinese gardens. In the past few years, Baotu Spring often experienced seasonal water stoppage, but after years of protection, its normal water level has been basically restored. In addition, Baotu Spring Park often holds various cultural activities. On the first day of the first lunar month every year, a lantern festival will be held in the park, lasting for 20 days. In late September every year, there is also the Baotu Spring Water Culture Festival, which lasts for about 10 days. At that time, there will be various folk activities, calligraphy and painting exhibitions, opera performances and other performances in the park for tourists to enjoy. Every year from the end of October to the end of November, there is also a chrysanthemum exhibition held in the park. In the golden autumn season, the springs flow together and chrysanthemums and springs complement each other, making it very worth a visit. In addition, the Baotu Spring Scenic Area has also launched a boat tour route. After visiting the Baotu Spring Scenic Area, tourists can board the boat at the Baotu Spring Boat Show if they are interested. The boat passes through the Ximen Bridge in the old city area of Jinan, passes through the east gate of Wulongtan Park, and enters the first passenger ship lock in Jinan's history - Wulongtan Ship Lock, where they can experience a drop of more than 2 meters. Sitting on the east side of the ship, you can still see the relief of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Jinan". There are many aquatic plants along the shore, and the river water is clear to the bottom. The cruise ship finally crossed the Yanbo Bridge and entered the Daming Lake Scenic Area. Full text 

attractions.name: 黑虎泉
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Springs; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It contains a natural cave with massive stones lying within, resembling a fierce tiger hidden deep inside, and the sound of the spring is eerily similar to a tiger's roar, hence named Black Tiger Spring.
- Black Tiger Spring is majestic and powerful, with a flow rate second only to Baotu Spring, ranking second among all the springs in Jinan.
- Many locals come here to collect water, which is crystal clear. Bees might also want to try the spring water here.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Springs of Jinan.

attractions.name: 大明湖景区
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It integrates water scenery, garden landscape and ancient buildings, and is known as "the first spring lake in China". 
Known as "one pavilion, three gardens, three floors, four temples, six islands, seven bridges and ten pavilions", there are 16 famous scenic spots of Minghu Lake to enjoy. 
Besides walking, cruise is also a good choice to visit Daming Lake. Boating on Daming Lake is both relaxed and sightseeing. 
· There are exhibitions of winter jasmine, orchids and bonsai from time to time every year; It is recommended to focus on the lotus exhibition, with the flowering period from July 15th to August 31st.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful natural spring lake park

attractions.name: 大明湖风景名胜区-超然楼
attractions.summary: The Chaoran Building is the carrier of the Chaoran Zhiyuan landscape in the Daming Lake Scenic Area. The building was first built in the Yuan Dynasty. According to the "Licheng County Annals", after the Daming Lake Water Pavilion, Li Cong, a scholar from the Yuan Dynasty, built the Chaoran Building. The poet Yang Yansi of the Ming Dynasty wrote the poem "Chaoran Tower": "The pavilions and terraces near the water are lush with vegetation, and the Zhu Tower echoes a hundred feet away. The windows contain the East China Sea rain, and the threshold overlooks the southern mountains with Daidai clouds. The willow colored lotus fragrance is revered outside, and the sound of Lingge and fishing is heard in the seats. Who can collect the smoke and moon on the seven bridges? It has already scattered into the Minghu Lake." The Chaoran Tower has an area of 5673 square meters, a height of 51.7 meters, and is divided into seven floors. The upper floor is for sightseeing, and the lower floors are decorated with wood carvings, murals, pictures, texts, and other forms, reflecting Jinan's spring culture, urban garden culture, and folk culture of old Jinan.

attractions.name: 曲水亭街
attractions.summary:
Qushuiting Street is a famous old street with historical and cultural characteristics at home and abroad in Jinan, Quancheng. 
On one side is an old house with blue bricks and red tiles, and on the other side is a clear spring flowing calmly, where people facing the street wash rice and wash laundry, making the old street vibrant. 
At present, the spring city style of "every household springs water, every household hangs poplars" in Travels of Lao Can is still completely retained.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old street with historical and cultural characteristics in Jinan

attractions.name: 芙蓉街
attractions.summary: Furong Street is an old street with a Jinan style and is an old commercial street in Jinan city, known as the "number one snack street in Qilu". Furong Street is named after the Furong Spring in the street, and is adjacent to the two major government offices and the Gongyuan, the Fu Confucian Temple, and the main road of the ancient city throughout history. During the Jin, Ming, and Qing dynasties, it was a place where literati and poets drank and wrote poetry. Among the old streets in Jinan now, Furong Street is particularly lively. Countless small vendors and vendors set up stalls or shops on both sides of the road, offering a wide variety of snacks from all over China, Europe, America, Japan, and Korea. Furong Street is bustling with people every day, and compared to most quiet old streets, Furong Old Street is full of commercial vitality. Here is the travel guide. In addition to exploring the unique neighborhoods and experiencing the historical and cultural heritage of Qilu, there is also the opportunity to enjoy delicious food. Guozu Stinky tofu is different from Changsha stinky tofu. Its skin is burnt, its inside is tender, and its fragrance is full. There is a Lingji Duck Blood Vermicelli that tastes great, with delicious soup and Tea egg. There are vendors selling roasted pig trotters on the roadside. When passing by, they smell super fragrant and drool. There are also a variety of kebabs, Bingtanghulu, etc. Come here and look for your favorite food. The crowd here is quite crowded, please take care to protect your belongings. Full text 

attractions.name: 千佛山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Treasure for Kids; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is known as one of the "Three Major Scenic Spots of Jinan" alongside Baotu Spring and Daming Lake. It is part of the Taishan mountain range, not very high, but with undulating peaks and lush forests.
- The Thousand Buddha Cave here houses nearly 30,000 Buddhist statues, with the largest reclining Buddha measuring 28 meters in length. The cave also features exquisite murals that showcase the profound cultural connotations of Buddhism.
