- Visitors usually enter Qianfo Mountain through the North Gate and begin the climb. It generally takes less than an hour to reach the summit, where they can enjoy a panoramic view of downtown Jinan.
- A temple fair is held every year on the 3rd day of the 3rd lunar month and the 9th day of the 9th lunar month, lasting for a week, featuring performances such as gong and drum, martial arts, and Shandong kuaishu (a fast-paced storytelling art).
attractions.shortFeatures: The summit offers a panoramic view of downtown Jinan.

attractions.name: 山东博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary: Shandong Museum, located in the east of Jinan, is the earliest provincial-level comprehensive geographical museum established in China, covering an area of about 34,000 square meters and a building area of about 21,000 square meters. Up to now, there are more than 140,000 pieces of cultural relics in the collection, and nearly 10,000 pieces of natural specimens in the collection, with rich display categories. The magnificent and elegant architectural complex embodies the combination of national style and modern art, and has become a major landscape of Jinan, a famous historical and cultural city in China. Here, you can see a large number of ancient ceramics, bronzes, ancient paintings and calligraphy books, Oracle bones, Han portrait stones and other cultural relics. Among them, the red pottery animal-shaped pot unearthed at Dawenkou site, Oracle Bone Inscriptions in Shang Dynasty, the great jade bi of Lu State in Warring States Period, the bamboo slips of Sun Tzu's Art of War and Sun Bin's Art of War, and the murals of Dongping Han Tomb are all treasures of the town hall, which are very rare, and only some of them are exhibited occasionally. There are souvenir shops and coffee shops on the first floor of the museum, which can provide light meals; There are water fountains on each floor to provide boiling water. If you are tired of visiting, there are many rest seats in the museum for resting your feet.
attractions.shortFeatures: A large collection of ancient cultural relics

attractions.name: 灵岩寺
attractions.tag: Climbing mountains; appreciating autumn leaves; Mountain Climbing; Temples
attractions.summary:
The Lingyan Temple in Jinan is a national scenic area and a Buddhist holy site, established during the Eastern Jin Dynasty, with a history of over 1,600 years.  
Standing in the midst of the beautiful scenery of Lingyan, you will see the surrounding mountains, steep cliffs, and secluded caves; the layered pines and cypress, the sweet springs, and fragrant tea; the numerous ancient sites, with the sounds of Buddhist chanting filling the air. Here, you can find the towering Biji Pagoda, the legendary Iron Kasaya, the Banzhou Hall from the Sui and Tang Dynasties, and the colorful clay sculptures of arhats from the Song Dynasty. There are also natural wonders such as the "Mirror Pool in Spring Dawn," "Fang Mountain Covered in Green," and "Bright孔晴雪." Therefore, the Ming Dynasty writer Wang Shizhen said, "Lingyan is the most secluded place behind Mount Tai; if one travels to Mount Tai without visiting Lingyan, the journey is incomplete."
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Temples of China.

attractions.name: 融汇济南老商埠
attractions.summary: As a complex of Jinan's unique commercial port culture, Ronghui Old Commercial Port is the place that can best reflect the history and culture of old Jinan besides the ancient city area with spring water and old streets. The buildings here are scattered at random, with different styles. There are century-old buildings Zhang Caicheng's former residence and Baolong Foreign Company, as well as rebuilt buildings that reflect modern styles. Each building is named after the buildings that actually existed in the old commercial port period, and the charm of that era can be vaguely seen, so that the culture of the century-old commercial port area can be admired, experienced and passed down.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understand the history and culture of old Jinan

hotel.Hotel Name: Shenzhen Luwan International Mansion Resort Hotel

attractions.name: 莲花山公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The main peak has a peak square of about 4,000 square meters, which is the tallest outdoor square in Shenzhen. 
· It's a good place to pay tribute to the great man's elegance, see the city's landscape and overlook Futian CBD. 
· One of the red tourist attractions in China, it is a good place for Shenzhen citizens to have daily leisure. 
There are rhododendrons in the garden, and a rhododendron flower show will be held.

attractions.name: 福田红树林生态公园
attractions.shortFeatures: View mangroves and various birds

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨栈道
attractions.summary: Dameisha Waterfront Plank Road starts from Yantian Donggang District in the west and ends at Dameisha Waterfront Park in the east, with a total length of about 1km. There are hiking trails, trails, landscape platforms, trestles, stone arch bridges and other facilities along the way. Meandering on the steep shore of the mountain, below are jagged and mottled rocks. The rushing current surges and violently impacts the rocks, forming a magnificent landscape. On the wide platform, the experiencers enjoy the natural beauty by the sea and the wind.

attractions.name: 地王观光·深港之窗
attractions.summary: The tourist destination for Diwang sightseeing refers to Diwang Building, a well-known landmark in Shenzhen with a total height of 383.95 meters and an actual building height of 324.8 meters. Climbing up to the 69th floor, you can overlook Hong Kong to the south and Shenzhen to the north. Diwang Sightseeing, also known as the Window of Shenzhen and Hong Kong, is a themed high-rise tourist attraction. Accompanied by melodious music, taking the elevator only takes fifty seconds to reach the top floor of the 69th floor of the Diwang Building. The scenic area features novel and exciting multidimensional dynamic movies, documentary digital overlay slides, and fifteen interesting landscapes. Standing at an altitude of over 300 meters, the winding Shenzhen River looks like a giant dragon waiting to take off, and like a gorgeous green ribbon tightly linking Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 20:20; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 深圳市大鹏新区古城博物馆
attractions.summary: The Dapeng Ancient City Museum is a thematic historical museum set up with Dapeng Ancient City as its theme. The museum collects and displays a large number of cultural relics, local customs, and humanistic historical materials, and each collection tells you the story of Dapeng City.

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 桔钓沙
attractions.summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.
attractions.shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

restaurants.name_en: Rainbow Bay Seafood Restaurant and Bar

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 广西民族村
attractions.shortFeatures: Hakka enclosed houses and Zhuang Qianlan folk houses

attractions.name: 海口观澜湖火山温泉谷
attractions.name_en: Haikou Mission Hills Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
The main building of the hot spring area is inspired by the unique circular earth building in southern China, and a large number of bamboo and volcanic stones are used as materials to create a simple and natural atmosphere. The park includes volcanic rock mineral hot springs with the styles of six continents around the world, uniquely designed spas and outdoor volcanic rock water parks. 
Volcanic mineral hot spring is taken from natural spring water with a depth of about 800 meters underground. The natural water temperature is between 15 ℃ and 43 ℃, and it contains various natural mineral ingredients with health effects. The water quality has been certified by the British International Water Quality Institute.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy special hot springs on five continents

attractions.name: 雷琼海口火山群世界地质公园
attractions.name_en: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
attractions.summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.
attractions.shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 海南热带野生动植物园
attractions.name_en: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens; Zoos
attractions.summary: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden, also known as Dongshan Wildlife Park, is China's first large-scale tropical wildlife park and the country's only island-type tropical rainforest botanical and zoological garden. It is acclaimed as a "natural museum that condenses the essence of Hainan Island's native flora and fauna." The park is located in Dongshan Town, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, approximately 27 kilometers from downtown Haikou. It is themed around tropical wildlife exhibitions and science popularization. The park's landscapes are entirely natural, with vast forested areas and dense vegetation providing an excellent wild environment for animals. Meanwhile, the artificially created jungle trails and a variety of exotic flowers and plants make visitors feel as if they are immersed in a vibrant natural world full of birdsong and floral fragrances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals in the tropical jungle
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 五公祠
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
Wugong Temple Complex is located at No.169 Haifu Avenue, Haikou City, about 5 kilometers away from the city center. Near the downtown area, it is unique and quiet, and is known as "Qiongtai Scenic Spot", "Yinghai Humanities" and "Hainan's No.1 Scenic Spot". The building complex of Wugong Temple includes: the first floor of Hainan (also known as Wugong Temple), Xuepu Hall, Guanjia Hall, Xizhai (Wugong Jingshe), Dongzhai, Su Gong Temple, Liangfubo Temple, Dongzhuo Pavilion, Fusu Spring, Qiongyuan and the newly-built Wugong Temple Exhibition Hall. 
Wugong Temple is a cultural relic and historic site that displays ancient Chinese demotion culture, Hainan history and culture and ancient architectural art with Hainan characteristics. "Wugong Temple" is the general name of a group of ancient buildings, covering an area of about 100 mu together with gardens, wells and ponds. It was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, rebuilt in the 15th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1889), and then repaired many times, and it is still shining brightly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding the ancient culture of official demotion in ancient buildings

attractions.name: 骑楼老街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street

attractions.name: 海口钟楼
attractions.summary: The Haikou Bell Tower is an important landmark building in Haikou, with a history of nearly a hundred years. It was originally built to adapt to foreign trade. The building is five stories high and the walls are built with red bricks. The Haikou Bell Tower stands on Changdi Road, facing the estuary. The row of ancient buildings across from the Haikou Bell Tower is the famous Haikou Qilou Old Street. The current Haikou Bell Tower was renovated in 1987 with funding based on the original appearance of the old clock tower. Named 'New Sound of Ancient Bell'. The Bell Tower is a symbol of Haikou, witnessing the city's growth process. Full text 

attractions.name: 万绿园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Located in the reclamation area on the north side of Haikou, facing Qiongzhou Strait, it is the largest open tropical seaside ecological garden landscape garden in Haikou. 
· Many tropical ornamental plants are planted in Wanlv Garden, which integrates clear water and blue sky with high-rise buildings. 
The 16 scenic spots and many surrounding supporting facilities in the park are complete. It is a large park for Haikou citizens to exercise in the morning and take a walk in the evening.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical Ecological Garden for Citizens' Leisure

attractions.name: 海口云洞图书馆
attractions.summary: The Yundong Library is located adjacent to the sea, with a total area of over 700 square meters. The library has a wide variety of books, including a reading area, terrace, and coffee shop.

attractions.name: 天鹅湖动物基地
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary: Haikou Swan Lake Animal Base is a modern ecological park integrating rare animal breeding and tourism. The park is located in Guilinyang Development Zone, Haikou City, next to Guilinyang Avenue. It consists of water surface, small islands and peninsulas. The water surface is called Swan Lake, and large waterfowl with swans as the main body are free-range on the lake; The island and peninsula are divided into lemur island, tortoise world, flamingo valley, parrot world, mongoose otter capybara area, alpaca pony zebra area, and bird world centered on American red ibis, colored ibis and pink spoonbill.
attractions.shortFeatures: Zero-distance contact with nearly 100 kinds of cute animals
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 东寨港红树林
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Nature Reserves; National Parks
attractions.summary: Dongzhaigang Mangrove Nature Reserve is about 30 kilometers away from the city center and 12 kilometers away from Haikou Meilan International Airport. It spans Yanfeng Town, Sanjiang Farm and Sanjiang Town in Meilan District, Haikou City, and borders Luodou Farm in Wenchang City, with a total coastline of 84 kilometers. It is the first mangrove nature reserve in China. Different from mangroves in other places, at high tide in Dongzhai Port, the dense mangroves will be flooded by the tide, exposing only the green canopy rippling with the waves, becoming a spectacular "sea forest". In addition, it is also a "bird paradise" and a "natural farm".
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat shuttle among half-flooded mangroves
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:30(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 18:00)

attractions.name: 假日海滩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Beaches; Seashores
attractions.summary:
- Located in the northern part of Haikou, stretching 6 kilometers, the beach faces the boundless Qiongzhou Strait, with sailboats coming and going, creating a picturesque scene.  
- The beach consists of sunbathing areas, water sports zones, dining areas, and leisure sections, making it a comprehensive seaside tourism and leisure destination in Haikou.  
- The beach also features a dedicated barbecue area and a water park, which are lively and bustling with crowds throughout the day.  
- Nearby, there are yacht rental services and numerous luxury hotels to choose from, while strolling along the clean coastal avenue and enjoying the breeze is incredibly pleasant.
attractions.shortFeatures: Haikou's iconic seaside leisure destination

restaurants.name_en: Sham Tseng Chen Kee Roast Goose Tea Restaurant

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 烟袋斜街
attractions.summary:
Yandai Xiejie, with a total length of 232 meters, is the oldest commercial street in Beijing. During the Qing Dynasty, it mainly dealt in smoking sets, mounting calligraphy and painting, selling antiques and jade articles, etc. 
Yandai Xiejie itself is like a tobacco bag, the slender street is like a tobacco bag pole, and the east entrance is like a tobacco bag mouth, so it is named Xiejie after "Yandai". 
There are Beijing paper-cutting, sugar-blowing people and Beijing specialty snacks here, which are full of ancient and unique city customs and full of charm. 
There are also famous scenic spots such as Yinding Bridge, Lotus Market and Prince Gong's Mansion around, as well as special delicacies such as Yaoji Fried Liver and Nanmen Hotpot, which can be visited together.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the breath of old Beijing in the old hutong

attractions.name: 圆明园
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 黄大仙祠
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Wong Tai Sin Temple, formerly known as Sik Sik Yuen, is one of the most popular temples. 
· Wong Tai Sin, where the temple is enshrined, is said to be responsive to requests. There are other buildings rich in Chinese traditional colors in the temple, such as Sansheng Temple, Main Hall and Congxin Garden. 
There is a small park next to the shrine, which is well designed, exquisite and exquisite, and has a garden scenery. The Nine Dragon Wall on the side is modeled after the Forbidden City in Beijing.  
The most distinctive feature of Wong Tai Sin Temple is its "five-shaped" architectural layout. Feiluan Terrace, Sutra Hall, Yuye Pool, Yuxiang Pavilion and Zhaobi in the temple each represent the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire and earth.
attractions.shortFeatures: The temple of the three religions with exuberant incense

attractions.name: 香港会议展览中心
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary:
--The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, located at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, is one of the newest seaside buildings in Hong Kong. 
--It can be used for large-scale conferences and exhibitions, as well as two five-star hotels, office buildings and luxury apartments.  
--The venue of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony in 1997, where many awards ceremonies and music awards ceremonies are usually held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Place of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony

attractions.name: 西九文化区
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park presents a grand and diverse Christmas celebration in Hong Kong, creating a festive atmosphere together. Celebrate the holiday at the "West Kowloon Christmas Market" and choose global holiday cuisine and selected Christmas gifts with family, friends, and children. Appreciate the enlarged Christmas town and giant Christmas tree of the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Join the "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" global super inflatable bouncing party (November 22, 2024- Hong Kong). As winter approaches, the West Kowloon Cultural District (West Kowloon) invites the public to participate in the grand and diverse Christmas celebration event with family, friends, and children from November 22, 2024 (Friday) to January 5, 2025 (Sunday). Nine Colorful Christmas ". The West Kowloon Christmas Market will be unveiled on Friday, November 22, 2024. During the first three weekends (Friday to Sunday), six distinctive stalls will be opened on the lawn of the art park seaside first; Starting from December 12th (Friday), the market will expand to over 30 specialty stalls, located on the east lawn of the art park and the seaside platform opposite M+. The West Kowloon Christmas Market offers a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts. Surrounded by the charming Victoria Harbour scenery and lush green lawns of the West Kowloon Art Park, visitors can immerse themselves in the dazzling holiday lights and enjoy melodious live music and performances. Apart from the Christmas market, visitors should not miss the "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Parade" held by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) on the West Lawn at the seaside from November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025. The giant and dazzling Christmas tree standing over 20 meters tall in the enlarged version of Christmas Town will be transformed into a giant canvas this year, with projections of different winter festival scenes added to enhance the festive atmosphere. The Christmas town of over 10000 square feet will open on November 22, and the Hong Kong Tourism Board will also stage a total of four "Winter Victoria Harbour Water Fireworks" on the opening day and from December 24 to 26, shining brightly in Victoria Harbour. The global super inflatable bouncing party "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station" will be held for the first time on December 21, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park lawn, bringing a new outdoor bouncing experience to children and kids. West Kowloon is the first stop of The Big Bounce World Tour in Asia, featuring four uniquely designed super giant inflatable amusement areas, including the "Global Super Inflatable Castle" and the Hong Kong's ultra long inflatable obstacle course. There are multiple exclusive events throughout the day, with parent-child events during the day and a night jumping party for people aged 16 and above at night. The party brings an exciting lineup of special guests and themes, inviting the public to celebrate the festival together with "day jumping and night jumping". Highlight 1 of the "Colorful Christmas in West Kowloon" event: West Kowloon Christmas Market: Visitors can purchase a variety of global holiday delicacies and selected Christmas gifts at the featured stalls, bringing a happy holiday experience to families and young children. On designated days and times, there will be live music and performance times available: the first phase will take place from November 22nd to 24th, November 29th to December 1st, and December 6th to 8th (a total of 9 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The second phase will take place from December 12th to 23rd, 2024, and from 27th to 29th (a total of 15 days) from 14:00 to 21:00. The actual opening hours will be announced again on December 24th to 26th, 2024 (a total of 3 days) from 14:00 to 23:00. Location: The first phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside Lawn. The second phase will be held at the Art Park Seaside East Lawn and M+opposite the Seaside Platform. The "Hong Kong Colorful Winter Tour" organized by the Hong Kong Tourism Board: Visitors can immerse themselves in the Greater Bay Area. Version of Christmas Town, On site, there is a winter scenery presented with colorful Christmas gifts and a giant Christmas tree. Time: November 22, 2024 to January 1, 2025 Location: Art Park Seaside West Lawn 3, "HSBC Insurance The Big Bounce World Tour Hong Kong Station": Both children and adults can participate in the global super large inflatable bouncing party, with bubble parties and DJ stationed on-site. During the day, it is a parent-child event, and in the evening, it is a night bouncing party for people aged 16 and above. There are special guests and themes available. Time: December 21, 2024 to January 5, 2025, 10:00-23:10 (divided into time slots) Location: Art Park Grand Lawn Cultural and Art Programs and Activities During the Christmas period, a series of art and cultural activities will be held at different locations in West Kowloon. Visitors can enjoy cultural and artistic activities while also enjoying a wonderful and unforgettable Christmas experience. Art enthusiasts can visit the two museums in West Kowloon for exhibitions. The "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Sino French Cultural Exchange in the 17th and 18th Centuries" exhibition at the Palace Museum in Hong Kong will be open to the public on December 18th, while visitors to M+can visit two special exhibitions, "I.M. Pei: Life is Like Architecture" and "Guo Pei: Artistic Imagination in the Sky". Visitors can also watch weekend street performances planned by the West Kowloon Cultural Centre and other cultural events held in West Kowloon. The global touring exhibition "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition", organized by Visionairs Asia Hong Kong, will open on December 8, 2024 at the West Kowloon Art Park. The exhibition is presented in collaboration between digital heritage expert Histovery and the public restoration agency of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, with support from L'Oreal Group, and will be staged on the occasion of the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral. Through innovative technology, the exhibition allows visitors to experience the unique architectural treasure of Notre Dame Cathedral in high-definition historical landscapes. As Notre Dame Cathedral was engulfed in fire and reopened after five years of restoration, exploring this architectural treasure holds great historical and cultural significance. The 2024 Dahua Bank Ink Art Festival will be held from December 13th to 29th, 2024 at the Art Exhibition Pavilion and the High Lawn of the Art Park, presenting Hong Kong's premier ink art celebration to the audience. Sponsored by Dahua Bank (Hong Kong) and organized by Dahua Bank's "Art · Workshop", the Ink Art Festival will host a variety of exciting activities, including the 2024 Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award winning works exhibition, art workshops, ink themed forums, music performances, interactive installations, and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" Carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. The "Rebirth by Fire - Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition" coincides with the reopening of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris this month, and visitors can visit the exhibition from Exhibition Art. Asia. Hong Kong (Visionairs) The Notre Dame Cathedral Augmented Reality Immersive Experience Exhibition will be held from December 8, 2024 to March 7, 2025. Location: GF01-03 underground of the Art Park. Visitors can visit a series of exciting and rich activities, including the 2024 "Dahua Bank Annual Ink Art Award" exhibition and the Hong Kong "Ink Garden" carnival, showcasing the perfect integration of interactive games and art. Location: Art Exhibition Pavilion and High Lawn of the Art Park. For more information about the activities, please refer to the organizers of the program or event. New concept stores and limited time "West Kowloon Consumption Rewards" have landed in the Art Park, providing visitors with more diverse dining options, including% Arabica's boutique coffee Honbo's signature burgers and hot dogs, Tiger Hall's delicious pearl milk tea, and local convenience store brand 852 Eight Five Two's light meals. Designated restaurants and retail stores in the West Kowloon Cultural District will also provide surprise shopping experiences during the Christmas period. On the same day, customers can redeem HKD 50 or HKD 100 cash vouchers by spending a specified amount through electronic payment (up to four different store receipts can be accumulated). For more details, please visit the website of the West Kowloon Cultural District. M+2024 Christmas Celebration Gift Series M+Store presents a series of festive gifts for museum visitors, allowing everyone to share joy with their loved ones. Selected items include exquisite Christmas gift baskets bringing high-quality food and exquisite M+products from the Hong Kong Grand Hyatt Hotel, as well as Christmas sock sets to add a festive atmosphere### Editor's note: The West Kowloon Cultural District is one of the largest cultural projects in the world, with the vision of creating a colorful new cultural zone for Hong Kong on a 40 hectare reclaimed land adjacent to Victoria Harbour. There are various theaters, performance spaces, and museums within the cultural zone that produce and host exhibitions, performance programs, and cultural and artistic activities; And it will provide 23 hectares of public space, including a two kilometer long seaside promenade. Full text 

attractions.name: 浅水湾
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 广东省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
The new museum was completed in 2010. It is the only provincial comprehensive museum in Guangdong Province, a patriotic education base and social practice base in Guangzhou. 
Guangdong's history, culture, art and nature are the three main exhibition directions, which are divided into four parts: history museum, nature museum, art museum and temporary exhibition hall. 
More precious exhibits include "baleen whale skeleton", "giant malachite" and "Xinyi jade" weighing more than five tons in natural specimens.
attractions.shortFeatures: Treasure Box Architecture with Rich Calligraphy and Painting in Lingnan

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:45; admission ends at 16:45)

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 环园
attractions.summary: Huan Yuan was originally a post office of the Qing Dynasty. In 1936, Huan Yuan was converted into a temporary residence and a plan to suppress the Communist Party was deployed, which triggered the "Xi'an Incident".

attractions.name: 西安事变旧址五间厅
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity
attractions.summary:
Wujianting is located in Huaqing Pool Scenic Area in Lintong, Xi'an, which is one of the famous sites of Xi'an Incident in history. 
Built in the late Qing Dynasty, it is a brick and wood hall. 
It is adjacent to Lishan Mountain in the south and Lotus Pond in the north. The courtyard is flat and the trees are lush. It is named Five Halls because it is connected by five single rooms.  
On the glass windows and walls of the five halls, there are still bullet marks from the fierce battle between soldiers and remonstrance. 
· Desks, chairs, beds, sofas, tea sets, stoves, carpets, telephones, etc. used in offices in each room are copied and placed as they were originally.
attractions.shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure hall

attractions.name: 兵谏亭
attractions.summary:
Bingjian Pavilion is located next to the tabby stone in Xixiuling halfway up Lishan Mountain. Chiang Kai-shek's hiding place is famous for the "Xi'an Incident". 
· In order to commemorate the "Xi'an Incident", initiated by Hu Zongnan in 1946, all the non-commissioned officers of the Seventh Branch of Whampoa Military Academy raised money to build a stone pavilion, named "Zhengqi Pavilion". After the founding of New China, it was renamed "Chiang-shek Pavilion", and it was only changed to "Soldier Remonstrance Pavilion" in 1980s. 
The stone pavilion is 4 meters high and 2.5 meters wide. It seems inconspicuous, but it has a different meaning because it is closely related to major events in Chinese history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stone pavilion commemorating the revolution

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
