attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 中国煤炭博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Coal Museum is the only professional museum in China dedicated to the coal industry and is a symbol of science and civilization. Due to its unique function and status, it has been awarded the title of "National First-Class Museum" by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Here, visitors can also view dozens of coal specimens, including long flame coal, poor coal, lignite, and gas coal. The museum's most distinctive feature is the "Coal Amusement Palace." The "Coal Amusement Palace" is a large-scale underground simulated mine, recreated using numerous real-life prototypes or 1:1 replicas. The visitor route spans several hundred meters and is said to be the largest in Asia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduced Underground Simulation Mine

attractions.name: 天龙山石窟
attractions.summary: The Tianlong Mountain Grottoes are located on the mountainside of Tianlong Mountain, 40 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City. Tianlong Mountain was originally named Fangshan. In the Northern Qi Dynasty, after the construction of Tianlong Temple at the foot of the mountain, this mountain was called Tianlong Mountain. This was once the summer palace of Gao Huan, the father of the Northern Qi Emperor Gao Yang. Tianlong Mountain has beautiful scenery, surrounded by undulating mountains and lush pine and cypress forests. The Dragon King Stone Cave on the top of the mountain has rippling springs, and the streams in front of the mountain are clear and gurgling. The Tianlongshan Grottoes are located at the waist of the cliffs on the east and west peaks of Tianlongshan Mountain. There are 24 caves excavated by the Eastern Wei, Northern Qi, Sui, and Tang dynasties, including eight caves on the east peak, thirteen caves on the west peak, and three caves on the north side of the mountain. There are over 1500 statues and 1144 reliefs, cofferdams, and portraits in the Coexistence Grottoes. The Tianlongshan Grottoes are known for their mature, full, refined techniques, and meticulous expression of emotions, which are close to the life atmosphere of laborers. They are characterized by strong ethnic and local characteristics, and are known for their "small but refined" nature.

attractions.name: 太山
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Located in the north of Fengyugou, 23 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City. Surrounded by jungles, ancient cypresses, and temples hidden in the middle, it is not easy to see unless you climb. The name of Taishan first appeared in Song Shu written by Shen Yue. It is said that in the Northern Han Dynasty, there was a mountain man Shi Gandang, who was famous for his bravery, and the mountain where he lived was also famous all over the world. 
It is particularly worth mentioning that on May 8th, 2008, a hexagonal underground palace was discovered in Longquan Temple in Taishan, which amazed the archaeological community. There were five relics buried in the underground palace. Taiyuan TV broadcast live the whole process of archaeologists opening the stone letter and golden coffin. In the amazed eyes of the audience, five coffins were opened heavily... silver coffins and golden coffins were dazzling and ingenious, and the answer was finally kept in the golden coffins. Experts said that for fear that the technical means are imperfect and the precious cultural relics in the golden coffin cannot be properly protected, the last layer of the coffin will be opened at another time. Even so, Shanxi people still feel the mystery of archaeological excavation of cultural relics in a brand-new way. Even the soft ribbon on the silver coffin has inspired many people's associations. More than 1300 years later, you can still see the true appearance of Tang Dynasty silk, and the audience is excited. The underground palace of Longquan Temple is the only underground palace where relics of the Tang Dynasty have been buried so far in Shanxi. 
Internal attractions: Daxiong Hall, Longquan Temple, Li Cunxiao Tomb and so on
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous for its red leaves in late autumn

restaurants.name_en: Buffet at Elements Western Restaurant at Kempinski Hotel
Xinghewan Hotel Taiyuan Coffee Italian Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 翠湖公园
attractions.summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city

attractions.name: 云南陆军讲武堂旧址
attractions.summary: The former site of the military academy of Yunnan Army is located in Cuihu West Road, Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. The military academy was built in 1909 and was called one of the three military academy in China when it was first built. The old building is currently well preserved and is an elegant yellow small building. The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons warehouse of the year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the military academy, the 99 Uprising and the National Defense Movement

attractions.name: 南屏步行街
attractions.summary: Nanping Street is an old block in the history of Kunming and also an ancient commercial street in the city. There are numerous restaurants, shops, supermarkets, and brand chain stores on the streets, offering a wide range of food, accommodation, travel, shopping, and entertainment options. It is one of the bustling streets in Kunming and also a popular spot for tourists to check in. At the entrance of Nanping Street, there is a large memorial archway, which is one of the landmark attractions here. Many tourists take photos here. There are also bronze statues on the street, with lifelike figures that can be photographed and recorded. Shopping, tasting delicious food, and savoring the charm of Kunming.

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 大观公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for walking with kids; Lakes; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Daguan Park is located on the north side of Dianchi Lake. It is a beautiful park with lush greenery and elegant pavilions, featuring scenic areas like near Huapu and Daguan Tower, as well as Lou Wai Lou.  
· Built by the water, Daguan Park features a lakeside dam, lotus ponds, and exquisite pavilions and towers, all arranged with great elegance.  
· The Daguan Tower, built during the Kangxi period, offers views of the Western Hills and Dianchi Lake, and was once considered one of the top ten ancient towers in China.  
· During festivals, the park often holds garden parties and sometimes hosts traditional lantern festivals, attracting a steady stream of visitors and creating a lively atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: A beautiful park on the northern shore of Dianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 金殿公园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for strolling with kids; Taoist Temples
attractions.summary: Jindian Park is named after the main hall, which is made of brass and shines brightly under the sunlight, casting a golden glow over the lush valley and the serene forest. It is also known as the Copper Roof Temple. The renowned Jindian is part of the Taoist Taihe Palace, originally built in the Ming Dynasty (1602), and is one of China's four major copper temples, with the best-preserved structure. In the 10th year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1671), the King of the Western Frontier, Wu Sangui, renovated it. With a long history, Jindian offers beautiful natural scenery, with paths winding through forests where towering trees create a canopy, occasionally interrupted by bird songs. The area is deeply infused with the essence of Taoist culture. In early spring, the hundred-acre camellia garden in the "Jindian Botanical Garden" blooms in full, filling the air with a sea of crimson, creating a breathtaking sight.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place for a refreshing stroll in a pleasant environment.

attractions.name: 斗南花市
attractions.summary: Dounan Flower Market is located in Chenggong District, Kunming City, where the flowers flow like the sea and the fragrance fills the air. Yunnan is known as the kingdom of flora and fauna, with spring like seasons and pleasant climate. It supplies 70-80% of the country's fresh flowers. Every tourist to Yunnan hopes to experience the fragrance of flowers grown in the 25 degree north latitude region at Dounan Flower Market, which is the flower capital of China. The first floor of Dounan Flower Market is filled with dried flowers, while the second floor is filled with succulents. The flowers here can be considered as cabbage prices, with varieties such as ping pong chrysanthemum, lily, sunflower, emperor flower, violet, and starry sky. The variety is complete, making it the largest flower trading market in Asia. Anyone who comes here will return with a full load.

restaurants.name_en: Shan Xiangju · Dai family small courtyard

attractions.name: 蜀风雅韵川剧院
attractions.summary: The Sichuan opera performance with the "Shu style and elegant charm" in Chengdu is a shining pearl in the treasure trove of Chinese opera. It is a popular folk art among the people of southwestern provinces such as Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou. In terms of the vocal style of traditional Chinese opera, Sichuan opera is composed of four major vocal styles: Gaoqiang, Kunqiang, Huqin, and Qianqiang, as well as a local folk lantern opera. These five types, except for lantern opera, were introduced to Sichuan by opera troupes from other provinces from the late Ming Dynasty to the mid Qing Dynasty. Sichuan Opera is a shining pearl in the treasure trove of Chinese opera. The Sichuan style and elegant charm have once gathered many famous Sichuan Opera performers. In recent years, they have reunited with famous Sichuan Opera performers to jointly launch a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Shufeng Yayun was founded in 1998, based in the Land of Abundance and facing both domestic and international markets, showcasing authentic Western Sichuan folk arts and classic operas in all aspects. It is a large-scale multi-functional pear garden destination that integrates traditional Chinese art performances, folk characteristic skill performances, and opera and drama supplies. "Sichuan Style and Elegant Charm", a Sichuan featured performance, integrates the essence of Bashu Quyi, covering the culture of the Three Kingdoms and Bashu folk stunts: Sichuan Opera, face changing, spitting fire, puppet, tea art, rolling lights, etc., which are unique in Sichuan culture. The charm of Shu has been passed down through the ages, and the elegance has been passed down for a hundred years. Shu style and elegant charm, located in the ancient architectural complex of Qingyang Palace on the ancient path of Qintai in Chengdu, Sichuan, China, adjacent to the ancient famous Qingyang Palace partition wall, with Du Fu Thatched Cottage and Wuhou Temple complementing each other from afar. The architecture of Shu style and elegant charm is ancient and rustic, with the generous and leisurely spirit of ancient Western Shu. It was once a century old pear garden with ups and downs. The Sichuan Opera Actors Guild Hall, which has been a gathering place for famous actors for a long time, is currently a folk pear orchard with deep roots in Sichuan. The elegant Sichuan style gongs, drums, zithers, and flutes show their elegance without a word. Playing, playing, and singing, the essence of Qupai comes at once. Life, dan, jing, mo, and ugliness all come on the stage. Kun, gao, hu, tan, and opera come one after another. Here, there are authentic Sichuan opera skills such as face changing, spitting fire, and dressing up, as well as famous lantern rolling and hand shadow plays in the prosperous era of China. There are also staff headed puppets that are exquisitely crafted, with drums and music playing together to create a soul stirring sound, and traditional melodies lingering in the background. One night, a thousand year experience of Western Shu culture - Shu style and elegance welcome you. Shufeng Yayun used to be a gathering place for famous Sichuan opera actors. In recent years, it has reunited with famous actors in Sichuan and launched a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Not only did it gain fame, but it was also widely reported by media both domestically and internationally. In the blink of an eye, it brings back the charm of the pear orchard from the past, and the traditional sound lingers around. The Western Shu civilization has been passed down from generation to generation, with unique advantages. Face changing, spitting fire, and rolling lanterns are well-known in China, and the puppet with a staff head is exquisitely crafted with exquisite skills; My daughter's clear voice is indescribable. Listening to the guqin playing, I couldn't help but dream back to the Three Kingdoms. Upon hearing the sound of the erhu, it changed to the floating clouds and the wild dogs. The hand shadow play, which has been extinct for many years, returns to the folk; The sound of drums and music resonates with the soul, bringing infinite joy. The Shu style and elegant charm have lofty aspirations, intending to revive the folk art of Ba Shu and bring back the floating culture of folk art in tea houses, and bring back famous actors and masters with unique skills to the people. Today, Shufeng Yayun has become a gathering place for famous figures and masters in folk culture, and a hub for ticket enthusiasts to visit Chengdu. Full text 

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 宽窄巷子
attractions.summary: Kuanzhai Alley is the only ancient street left over from the Qing Dynasty in Chengdu, consisting of three parallel old urban streets - Kuanzhai Alley, Kuanzhai Alley, and Jingzhai Alley, as well as a courtyard community between them. Come here, drink tea, eat hotpot, and experience the leisurely, slow, and new life of Chengdu. You can order a cup of Mengshan Huangya here and set up a dragon gate formation with the old man next to you; You can also call yourself 'Shu'er Lang' and enjoy the pleasure of digging your ears comfortably; You can also enjoy a wide variety of snacks at the snack stall. The Kuanzhai Alley under the night sky also has its own charm. Bars such as Dianzui, Baiye, and Huli are full of Chengdu's fashion sense, blooming its charm at night. Full text 

attractions.name: 人民公园
attractions.summary:
The street park, where Chengdu people love to drink tea leisurely, is a comprehensive garden integrating cultural relics and leisure and entertainment. 
· The park is composed of natural landscapes such as Jinshui Creek and bonsai garden, and various vegetation and streams planted along the coast complement each other. 
· Goldfish Island and Yongju Tea House are integrated to create a cultural place for fish viewing and tea tasting. At present, there are more than ten kinds of precious goldfish on the island. 
The most famous one in the park is Heming Tea House, whose style has not changed for nearly a hundred years. The standard is bamboo chairs, low tables and covered bowls of tea, and the best tea is "fragrant tablets". 
· Chengdu People's Park is an excellent choice to experience the leisure life and slow time of local people, so as to truly appreciate the lifestyle of "leisure capital".

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 南岸嘴
attractions.summary: A green dragon and a yellow dragon meet here-Nan'anzui is an extraordinary place in China's geography and is known as "the first corner of China". Because it is the impact zone formed by the confluence of the Yangtze River, the largest river in China, and the Han River, the largest tributary of the Yangtze River. Some people say that Nan'anzui is where China's Dantian is located, which means that it is the place where China's essence is most concentrated.

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 龟山公园-铁门关
attractions.tag: Historic site; Military Sites; Historical Sites
attractions.summary: For hundreds of years from the Three Kingdoms period to the early Tang Dynasty, Tiemenguan has been an important military fortress in Wuhan, and has experienced many fierce offensive and defensive battles. In the fourth year of Tang Wude (AD 621), with the construction of Hanyang City, the military role of Tiemenguan was gradually weakened, and it became an important channel for cultural, economic and trade exchanges, and at the same time became a tourist attraction. At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Tiemenguan was destroyed, leaving only the earth foundation wall base. At the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, Guandi Temple was built on the remaining earth foundation. In the early years of the Republic of China, due to war, the ruins of Tiemenguan together with the temple became ruins. In December 1990, Tiemenguan was rebuilt.
attractions.shortFeatures: Strong ethnic architectural style

attractions.name: 汉阳造艺术区
attractions.summary:
· The abandoned industrial plant used was originally part of Hanyang Arsenal and 824 Factory during the Westernization Movement in China. 
· The park covers a small area, mostly composed of office buildings. Besides, graffiti, performance art and creative sculptures can be seen everywhere. 
· A model of old industrial transformation into commercial and artistic creation park, novel and innovative enough for artists to exert their unlimited creativity and imagination.

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 吉庆民俗街
attractions.summary: Premature Hubu Lane, late night Jiqing Street ". During the day, the area is sparsely populated, but as night falls, Jiqing Street is brightly lit and bustling with people. Simple stalls line up in a row, offering a wide variety of local delicacies. When enjoying the feast, you can also enjoy folk performances full of "Han flavor", which are extremely lively. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉博物馆
attractions.summary: The Wuhan Museum is located on Youth Road in Jianghan District, where you can learn about the development and changes of Wuhan over thousands of years. The museum has a display area of approximately 6,000 square meters, spread across three floors. The first floor has three exhibition halls, showcasing collections of cultural relics from different dynasties, ancient ceramic art, and Ming and Qing calligraphy and paintings. Precious artifacts such as bronzeware, jade, bamboo, wood and ivory carvings, inkstones, seals, snuff bottles, and enamelware, as well as masterpieces of Ming and Qing calligraphy and paintings, can be seen here. The second floor is dedicated to the ancient history of Wuhan, with five sections: Dawn of Jianghan (Prehistoric Period), Shang Wind and Chu Charm (Xia, Shang, and Zhou Periods), Military Key Passes (Qin, Han, Wei, Jin, and Northern and Southern Dynasties), Water and Land Twin Cities (Sui, Tang, Song, and Yuan Periods), and Nine Provinces Converge (Ming and Qing Dynasties to the pre-modern opening of Hankou).
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding Wuhan's Thousand-Year History

restaurants.name_en: Eisenhower Hotel, Food and Beverage Department

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《长恨歌》演出
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
China's first large-scale live-action historical dance drama, with eleven scenes in four levels, such as "loving each other" and "being spoiled and charming". 
· A strong cast of 300 professional actors artistically reproduces this touching love story in the original place of the story. 
Since the official performance in 2007, more than 2,500 performances have been performed and 3.5 million audiences have been received, reaching the grand occasion of "one ticket is hard to find".
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei and Tang Minghuang's eternal love

attractions.name: 华清御汤·宝积池温泉
attractions.summary: The Huaqing Yutang Baojichi Outdoor Hot Spring Area is located on the south side of the Xi'an Huaqing Yutang Hotel in Lintong District, Xi'an City. It is adjacent to the Lishan National Forest Park to the south and the Huaqing Palace, a national 5A level tourist attraction to the north. Relying on the 6000 year old Imperial Hot Spring and Lishan Natural Oxygen Bar, it inherits the essence of Tang Dynasty bathing culture, backed by the natural oxygen bar, with lush forests and fresh air. There are bathing pool outdoor hot springs of different sizes and styles in Baoji Pool. The selection of bathing pool materials is exquisite and elegant. There are also elegant and refined modern celebrities who like beige. The Tang Palace's ancient style lounge features elegant seating, offering Tang Dynasty style health tea drinks and fruit snacks. Savor the unique Tang culture bathing and health preservation concept in the leisurely stillness of time.

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 百戏俑坑
attractions.summary: The Baixi Qikeng is named after the various postures of the pottery figurines.

attractions.name: 文官俑坑
attractions.summary: The civil figurine pit is part of the Terra Cotta Warriors Museum in Xi'an, which is located on the east side of the the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor. Here, a large number of terracotta warriors are displayed, representing the image of civil officials during the Qin Dynasty, including officials, scholars, etc., reflecting the political and cultural life of the Qin Dynasty.

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 陕西自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary: The Shaanxi Natural History Museum is located on a boat-shaped island around the Xi'an Television Tower on Chang'an South Road, Xi'an. It consists of five major exhibition areas: the Natural Exhibition Hall, the Science and Technology Exhibition Hall, the Dome Theater, the Outdoor Exhibition Area, and the Temporary Exhibition Area. The Natural and Science Museums are situated at the north and south ends, respectively, with the Xi'an Television Tower serving as the symmetry point. The Dome Theater in the Science Museum is the first of its kind in Northwest China. The exterior of the Science Exhibition Hall is shaped like a glass sphere, while the Natural Exhibition Hall is crescent-shaped, symbolizing the "Sun" and "Moon," with the meaning of "Sun and Moon Shining Together."
attractions.shortFeatures: Children's Science Museum

attractions.name: 白城沙滩
attractions.summary:
Located at the foot of Baicheng in the south of Xiamen University, it is a beautiful beach between Yanwu Bridge and Hulishan Fort.  
· There are many interesting scenes. The beach is dotted with huge mouse sculptures, and the semi-ring flyover is like a huge clock. 
There are ruins of Zheng Chenggong's era distributed on the beach, which combines beautiful scenery with profound cultural and historical heritage. 
· This is a natural leisure park for Xiamen University students, Xiamen citizens and tourists to stroll, play games, swim and watch the sunset.
attractions.shortFeatures: Seaside beach adjacent to Xiamen University

attractions.name: 厦门双子塔
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Xiamen Twin Towers is a new landmark in Xiamen. Two independent towers are connected by podiums, which look like sails and incorporate the visual elements of Xiamen's flower "bougainvillea". 
One of them is a five-star hotel and a top office building, the other is a SOHO office building, and the podium building is built into a comprehensive commercial building integrating shopping, leisure, entertainment and catering. 
Be sure to board the Xiamen Viewing Hall on the Yunshang on the 55th floor to experience the invincible 360 view. Overlooking Gulangyu Island and overlooking the whole Ludao customs, it is beautiful. 
The sightseeing hall also has a coffee room, selling all kinds of special souvenirs, handicrafts, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: The 55th floor sightseeing hall overlooks Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 环岛路
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Hiking/Biking; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiamen Huandao Road is built along the coast. It is a section of coast from Xiamen University to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and is called the "Golden Coastline". 
· Also known as Five-Color Road: blue sea, golden beach, green grass, red runway and gray road. 
There are many scenic spots along the way, such as Hulishan Fort, Yefeng Village, International Convention and Exhibition Center, Wuyuan Bay, etc. 
On the side of Huandao Road facing the sea, there are sculptures of different styles such as "Wave of Gulangyu Island", "Meditation Song of the Sea" and "Choice", which are of great ornamental value. 
You can rent a bicycle to ride, which has a unique charm. It is the most beautiful section from Yefengzhai to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and it takes about 40 minutes to ride by bike.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy riding the coastline

attractions.name: 环岛路海滩
attractions.summary: Xiamen Huandao Road is one of the scenic tourist roads around the sea in Xiamen. The construction of Huandao Road has always pursued the tenet of "seeing the sea by the sea and leaving the most beautiful beaches to the people". Some are close to the mountains and the sea, some bridge the sea, and some drill holes through stones. The construction starting point is high and the standards are strict, which fully reflects the characteristics of subtropical scenery.
attractions.shortFeatures: Sightseeing scenic belt

attractions.name: 环岛路观光大道
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots here, including temples, ancient trees, strange stones, sculptures, and three seaside squares.

attractions.name: 胡里山炮台
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located near Xiamen University, it was founded in 1894 during the 20th year of the Guangxu era in the Qing Dynasty, and is now a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The total area of the fort is over 70,000 square meters, divided into the battle area, barracks area, and rear area, with hidden tunnels, ammunition depots, soldier quarters, officer's office, and more inside.
- The structure is a combination of a semi-bunker style and a semi-city wall style, featuring architectural styles from both Europe and China's Ming and Qing Dynasties, making it very beautiful.
attractions.shortFeatures: A blend of European and Ming-Qing styles.

attractions.name: 曾厝垵
attractions.summary:
· Zeng Cuo An Village is known as "the most literary village in the country". It used to be a simple fishing village, but now it has become a hot cultural and creative village. 
Modern and quaint neighborhoods are integrated, and there are many unique small shops gathered on the street. You can eat, buy and shoot while shopping, which is enough for you to toss all day. Food is another label here besides literature and art. There are all kinds of snacks and dazzling fruits in five streets and eighteen lanes in Zeng Cuo An Village. 
It is also a gathering place for characteristic homestays, including traditional courtyards, baroque single-family villas, quaint and unique fishing villages, and lively and unique youth hostels. 
· Zeng Cuo An Village late at night belongs to folk songs and bars. Young people talk about their ideals in bars. Under the hoarse voice of folk songs, they drink with emotions and stories to recall the most unforgettable times.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xiamen cultural innovation landmark

attractions.name: 黄厝海滩
attractions.summary:
· Huangcuo Beach is the most natural and cleanest beach on the whole roundabout road, and it is a good place to get close contact with the sea in Xiamen. 
There are many surrounding scenic spots, including International Convention and Exhibition Center, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Hulishan Fort, etc., with superior geographical location. 
For those who like quietness, this is a good place to watch the sea quietly. It is also a good choice to ride a bike by the seaside and blow the sea breeze.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the International Marathon

attractions.name: 椰风寨
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· Located on the seaside of Huandao Road, Xiamen City, covering an area of nearly 10,000 square meters, it is a beach resort full of coconut trees. 
It is the first comprehensive leisure tourism center in Xiamen that integrates outdoor amusement, catering and leisure, water sports and beach expansion.  
The whole park is divided into six functional areas: seaside amusement park, Xindi Paradise, 4D dynamic cinema, seaside bathing, water sports area and food court. 
Across the sea, you can overlook Kinmen Island and the big brand of "One Country, Two Systems", and you can also enjoy the beautiful sunrise here. It is a good place for few people to relax.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coconut tree-lined beaches

attractions.name: 鹭江夜游
attractions.summary: As a must check in night tour project in Xiamen. Strolling through Xiamen during the day and admiring the Lujiang River at night. This is a route that offers a panoramic view of the night scenery of Xiamen and Gulangyu, including Gulangyu Island, Twin Towers, International Cruise Home Port, Tide Eye, and Haicang Bridge The city is on the sea, still in the city ", experiencing a visual collision between a quaint world heritage island and a modern metropolis. How can you miss such a" unique romance "! Full text 

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gulangyu Island is home to over a thousand buildings with a variety of styles, blending both Chinese and Western architecture. There are temples with traditional Chinese flying eaves and curved corners, Minnan-style courtyard houses, the Bagua Tower with a combination of Chinese and Western elements, small and delicate Japanese-style houses, 19th-century European consulates from Western countries, and the Shuzhuang Garden, which is considered a gem of Jiangnan classical gardens. It can be called an exposition of world architecture.

In recent years, several new buildings have been completed, including the former Gulangyu Park transformed into an Underwater World, the tall statue and relief of Zheng Chenggong in Haoyue Park, the marble statue of renowned Chinese gynecologist Lin Qiaozhi in Yuyuan, the subtropical plant introduction garden at Huijiao, with its shrubs, flowers, and fragrant palms, the Xiamen Museum displaying the city's thousand-year history and the development of its special economic zone, the Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall honoring the hero’s achievements, as well as Yanping Park, Gangzihou Swimming Pool, Zhongshan Library, People’s Stadium, and the Gulangyu villas with garden-style architecture, Guanhaiyuan Resort, Gulangyu Hotel, and more. With so many parks and buildings in just 1.78 square kilometers, the density of these structures is likely rare even in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: World Architecture Expo

attractions.name: 港仔后海滨浴场
attractions.summary:
· Aberdeen Hou Beach is located in the west of Shuzhuang Garden, and the two are adjacent to each other. 
· Standing on the beach, with the Sunlight Rock on the back, you can see the highest bare rock. 
The bathing beach has soft sand, gentle slopes and flat waves, and low seawater flow rate. Coupled with the beautiful scenery of Gulangyu Island, it is very suitable for seaside leisure and swimming.
attractions.shortFeatures: Great view and beautiful scenery

attractions.name: 菽庄花园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
Shuzhuang Garden was built in 1913, named after the homophonic word "Shuzang" by Lin Erjia, a wealthy businessman in Taiwan Province. It is divided into two parts: Bushan Garden and Zanghai Garden. 
The main landscape of Bushan Garden is rockery, that is, twelve caves, with a total of 12 caves, inlaid with twelve zodiac signs at each cave entrance. 
The reason why Tibetan Sea Garden is called Tibetan Sea is that only when you turn out of the Moon Cave Gate will the sea appear in front of you, and the Forty-Fourth Bridge is the best point to view the sea. 
The Piano Museum in Tingtao Xuan in Shuzhuang Garden is a highlight. There will be special piano improvisation performances every half hour in the museum, which is worth listening to.
attractions.shortFeatures: Garden Landscape with Western Colors

attractions.name: 钢琴博物馆
attractions.summary:
· Tingtaoxuan, located in Shuzhuang Garden, Gulangyu Scenic Spot, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, houses many pianos with a long history. 
It is divided into the first hall and the second hall. There will be regular piano explanations in the hall, and there will be piano performances from time to time in the hall. 
As a decoration, candlestick lamps have a history of more than one hundred years. Visiting the Piano Museum is equivalent to browsing the history of piano development in the world.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the strangely shaped clavichord
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 日光岩
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
attractions.summary:
· Sunlight Rock is the highest peak of Gulangyu Island and the iconic scenic spot of Gulangyu Island. 
Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island

attractions.name: 厦门市鼓浪屿风景名胜区-日光岩寺
attractions.summary: The Riguangyan Temple is located at 60-62 Huangyan Road, Gulangyu Island. It was first built in the year of Wanli Bingxu, which is the 14th year of Wanli. In September 1999, the overall planning and renovation were completed.

attractions.name: 万国建筑博览
attractions.summary: The International Architecture Exhibition is not just the name of a building, but a combination of various Chinese and Western architecture on Gulangyu Island. These architectural complexes are collectively referred to as the International Architecture Exhibition, which is the essence of the cultural exchange between China and the West on Gulangyu Island. These buildings include traditional Chinese temples with upturned eaves and corners, Minnan style courtyard bungalows, Bagua buildings with a combination of Chinese and Western walls, small and exquisite Japanese houses, former national consulates in 19th century European style, and Shuzhuang Garden, which can be regarded as a masterpiece of classical gardens in Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 原英国领事馆
attractions.summary: The former British Consulate General's residence in Xiamen, located at No. 5 Zhangzhou Road, Gulangyu Island, is a beautiful mansion nestled among green trees. Today, it has become an exhibition hall of the Xiamen Jinquan Coin Museum. The original British Consulate building on Gulangyu Island was a three story red brick building with bricks and stones at the four corners. The structure was square and rigorous, with floor to ceiling doors and windows, all equipped with louvers to adjust sunlight and block wind and sand, and also decorated with fireplaces. According to research, this mansion represents the early colonial architectural style of Gulangyu Island.

attractions.name: 鼓浪屿龙头路
attractions.summary: Longtou Road is located on Gulangyu Island, not far from the pier, and it is also a necessary route to reach the pier. This road is a bustling commercial street on Gulangyu Island. The not wide streets are lined with various cultural shops, delicious snacks, and more. Each shop has its own style and characteristics in terms of window display and decoration. Even if you don't go into the shop, it's still great to just stroll outside and take a look.

attractions.name: 八卦楼
attractions.summary: The Organ Museum is located at 43 Guxin Road, Gulangyu Island. The venue is not very large and displays more than 5000 organs of various ages and styles. Those interested in music can come and visit, otherwise they may find it boring. It is said to be the only organ museum in China and the largest in the world at present. The first floor of the venue displays many historical organs from around the world, most of which are produced in France and Spain. The treasure of the town hall here is the world's largest organ. The backyard of the museum houses some smuggled cultural relics seized from customs, all of which are stone carvings.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty.
