The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

restaurants.name_en: Metropark International Hotel Suiyuan Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 古麓山寺
attractions.summary:
Gulushan Temple, also known as Huiguang Temple and Wanshou Temple, has a history of more than 1,700 years. It is the earliest relic of Buddhism entering Hunan and one of the early Buddhist temples in China. 
The environment of the temple is very quiet. There are two Podocarpus pines in front of the temple, which are relics of the Six Dynasties. There are precious Buddhist scriptures and ancient books in the temple. 
Today's ancient Lushan Temple is full of incense worshippers. The hall is hidden among layers of trees, with morning bells and evening drums, and bursts of Sanskrit sounds.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient and secluded temple deep in Yuelu Mountain

attractions.name: 潮宗街
attractions.summary: Chaozong Street is named after Chaozongmen, the city gate, also known as Caochangmen Main Street. It starts from Xiangjiang Road in the east and ends at Huangxing North Road (formerly Beizheng Street) in the west. It is one of the only four remaining ancient granite streets in Changsha City. It was originally 511 meters long, but today it is about 400 meters wide and 9 meters wide. It was the widest street in the past. Chaozong Street has historical and cultural monuments such as the former site of Jinjiu activities, the True Jesus Church Hall, the hotel and stage of the Republic of China in Ziyuan, the remains of War of Resistance against Japan's air defense facilities, the former site of Cultural Bookstore and the former residence of Qu Hongyu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Blocks witness the historical changes of Changsha

attractions.name: 杜甫江阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Du Fu Jiang Pavilion was built in memory of Du Fu, forming a context belt with Tianxin Pavilion, Daolin Second Temple in Yuelu Mountain and Yuelu Academy. 
There is a biography of a great poet inside. Whenever fireworks are set off on summer weekends, the number of visitors who come to watch will increase a lot. 
· Local landmark buildings, close to the Xiangjiang River, can climb high and overlook both sides of the Xiangjiang River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb high overlooking Xiangjiang River and enjoy the grand fireworks

attractions.name: 黄兴路步行街
attractions.summary: Huangxing Road Pedestrian Street is one of the bustling areas in Changsha City. It is a pedestrian commercial street that was renovated and completed in 2002. Starting from Simenkou in Furong District in the north and ending at Nanmenkou in the south, the total length is 838 meters and the street width is 23-26 meters. It includes Huangxing Square, which covers nearly 10000 square meters, with a total commercial area of 250000 square meters, including a newly built area of 150000 square meters. It is a comprehensive venue that integrates shopping, leisure, entertainment, catering, culture, and tourism functions. The pedestrian street is divided into an inner street and an outer street, with the inner street having three levels. There are numerous shops and a complete range of brands. In addition to various regular clothing and jewelry stores, this place also gathers snacks and delicacies from all over the country. The nearby Pozi Street is also a gathering place for Changsha's specialty snacks, such as the Fire Palace, Shuangyan Tower, and Red Plum Cold Drinks, which are well-known to Changsha people. There are countless of them.

attractions.name: 长沙世界之窗
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
Changsha Window of the World is located in the northeastern suburbs of the city, along the Liuyang River. It is a comprehensive large-scale theme park that integrates 20 major creative events throughout the year, 50 major thrill rides, architectural wonders from around the world, cultural performances from five continents, and a film shooting base.

The 50 major thrill rides include the "Four Kings of Screams," which are popular among young people, such as the hanging roller coaster, motorcycle roller coaster, sky swing, and twin towers. There are also family-friendly theme areas, such as the Fine Wool Tot Children's Playground, King Kong Jungle Parent-Child Playground, and Pet Paradise. In addition, there is a new concept water park, which has become a new water play landmark for the people of Changsha during the summer.

The 20 major creative events throughout the year include the Chinese Carnival, International Street Art Festival, Halloween, Christmas and New Year season, and more, aiming to bring fresh experiences and endless joy to visitors!

Among the miniature architectural wonders scattered throughout the park, the most popular iconic structures are the New Swan Castle, the Louvre Glass Pyramid from France, and the Lighthouse of Alexandria. As the leader of theme parks in Central and Southern China, Changsha Window of the World continuously upgrades its hardware and software to provide better services and even more fantastic experiences for visitors!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch iconic landmarks around the world.

restaurants.name_en: Sign King of Kings String Hot Pot

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 东湖绿道
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; On foot; Hiking; Hiking/Biking
attractions.summary:
East Lake Greenway is located in East Lake Eco-tourism Scenic Area, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, with a total length of about 101.98 kilometers. It is the longest greenway around the lake in the core area of 5A-level cities in China. 
East Lake Greenway is divided into seven themed landscape roads: Tingtao Road, Huzhong Road, Baima Road, Country Road, Forest Road, Moshan Road and Hushan Road. It fully relies on eight natural features of East Lake Mountain, Forest, Ze, Garden, Island, Embankment, Field and Bay, and turns East Lake into an "ecological green heart" of the city where citizens are close to nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: Leisure trails connecting many scenic spots in East Lake

attractions.name: 东湖之眼摩天轮
attractions.name_en: The East Lake Eye Ferris Wheel
attractions.summary: The Eye of Donghu Ferris Wheel is a Ferris wheel located in the Joyful Jungle of Donghu Moshan Tourist Scenic Area, Wuchang District, Wuhan City, China. The diameter of this Ferris wheel is 49.9 meters, and the highest point is 55 meters above the ground. The rotation time is specially set to 13 minutes and 14 seconds, symbolizing "a lifetime". The Ferris wheel has 28 cherry blossom pink cabins, each cabin can accommodate 4 people, and a total of 112 people can ride at the same time. The cabin is equipped with air conditioning and a custom Bluetooth speaker, providing passengers with a comfortable riding experience.

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 古琴台
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Featured exhibition hall; Wax Museums; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
According to legend, Yu Boya and Zhong Ziqi met here in "high mountains and flowing waters meet bosom friends", and together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Qingchuan Pavilion, they are called "Three Chu Scenic Spots". 
The piano platform in front of the palace is a square stone platform made of white marble. It is said that it is the place where Boya plays the piano, and it is known as "the first bosom friend in the world". 
In addition to the main building, there are courtyards, forest gardens, flower beds, tea rooms, etc., with exquisite layout and distinct levels.
attractions.shortFeatures: The birthplace of Guqin song "High Mountains and Flowing Water"

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 黎黄陂路
attractions.summary: Lihuangpi Road and Huangpi Road are the same road. Lihuangpi Road, with a total length of 604 meters, was built in 1900 (the 26th year of Guangxu) and was built by Huangpi people, hence the name Huangpi Road. Later, it was assigned to the Russian Concession in Hankou, which was called Yima Road. Located in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Because Li Yuanhong, the two presidents of the Republic of China, was a native of Huangpi, Wuhan, and was known as Li Huangpi, this road was renamed Li Huangpi Road in 1946. Lihuangpi Road is a famous "slow life" block in Wuhan, which is a continuation of Hankou's spirit and temperament.
attractions.shortFeatures: Literary and retro slow life block

attractions.name: 巴公房子
attractions.summary: Bagong House is located at No. 86 Poyang Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. Around 1901, the Ba brothers bought a large piece of land in the Russian Concession in Hankou, covering the east-west direction from Liangyi Street (now Dongting Street) to Luojiabei Road (now Luojiashan Street), north-south direction from Lierbin Street (now Lanling Road) to today's Lihuangpi Road. A large isosceles triangle house was built in the triangle between Liangyi Street and Sanjiao Street (now Poyang Street) and Lihuangpi Road and Lanling Road. It was built in 1901 and completed in 1910. This is what people call Bagong House. The completed Bagong House became the landmark building of the Russian concession in this area.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian style apartment

attractions.name: 江汉关博物馆
attractions.summary: The building was built in 1924. Its establishment is a symbol of the opening of an era, a witness of the opening of Hankou, and a monument to the vicissitudes of Wuhan. Jianghan Building is located at the intersection of Yanjiang Avenue and Jianghan Road in Wuhan. The main building has four floors, with a semi-basement on the ground floor and four floors of the bell tower, with a total height of about 46.3 meters, of which the top of the bell tower is about 83.8 meters above the ground. The bell tower is elegant and beautiful, with clocks with a diameter of about 4 meters on all sides. In sunny weather, it can be seen ten miles away. Its punctual bells have always been a part of Wuhan's urban life.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the landmarks of Wuhan

restaurants.name_en: Jiangcheng Mingzhu Haosheng Hotel Coffee Shop

attractions.name: 昂坪360
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Cable car ropeway; Cable Cars
attractions.summary:
· Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car is the longest outdoor double-cable cable car in Asia, and has won the reputation of Top Ten Surprise Cable Car Tours in the World, Top Ten Best Cable Car Experiences in the World and Top Ten Global Cable Car Tours. 
· A total length of 5.7 kilometers, built on a hill, connecting Tung Chung and Ngong Ping. Overlooking the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, surrounded by the South China Sea, it connects Tung Chung and Ngong Ping Market. 
· After getting off the bus, you will arrive at Ngong Ping Market, which is connected to Po Lin Temple and Tiantan Buddha. It is enjoyed by a vast natural environment and combines Chinese architecture with diversified shopping and dining experiences. 
· In addition to shopping and dining, Ngong Ping Market also provides entertainment programs including: 360VR Experience Hall, 360 Stage, 360 Dynamic Cinema and Walking with Buddha.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the magnificent scenery of mountains and seas; Crystal cabin bottom glass fully transparent

attractions.name: 大澳
attractions.summary:
· Tai O, located on an outlying island, is the earliest developed fishing village on the island. The tall shacks built on the water are the characteristic of Tai O. 
· Fishing villages are far away from the hustle and bustle of urban areas and less affected by urbanization, so they still retain the features of early Hong Kong fishing villages. 
· The vertical and horizontal waterways and water shacks constitute a unique feeling of water town and fishing village scenery, so it is known as the Venice of Hong Kong. 
· The traditional salted fish, shrimp paste and fish maw here are very famous. When you set foot in Tai O, you will feel the strong taste of the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: A tall hut built on the water

attractions.name: 赤柱广场-天幕广场
attractions.summary: It is a comprehensive commercial square that integrates shopping, dining, and leisure entertainment. You can find various fashionable clothing, accessories, cosmetics, and household items here. Whether you are a shopping enthusiast or a fashion follower, this place can meet your needs.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 凌霄阁
attractions.summary:
Lingxiao Pavilion is the terminal of the Peak Tram, and it is also a comprehensive tourist attraction integrating climbing, viewing, shopping, dining and entertainment. 
There are 6 floors in total. The 1st-3rd floors are mainly delicious food. There are 4 different fashionable restaurants in China, West and Japan, where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery while eating. 
· It also includes important attractions such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Peak Post Office, which are also a must-check-in place for tourists to visit Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: The skyscraper enjoys the beautiful view of Hong Kong

attractions.name: 中环至半山自动扶梯
attractions.summary: The Central to Mid Levels escalator connects the Central business district with the Mid Levels residential area. It was built by the British Hong Kong government in 1993 to improve traffic in Mid Levels. The escalator consists of 20 one-way escalators and 3 automatic pedestrian walkways, starting from the Central Market and ending at Conduit Road. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and there are multiple exits along the way, making it convenient for pedestrians to get on and off. The Mid Levels escalator crosses multiple major streets in Central, including Queen's Road Central, Hollywood Road, and other attractions along the way, such as the old Central Police Station, making it a great means of transportation for tourists. In addition, the escalator will also pass through the SOHO area, which is filled with restaurants and bars, European style small bars, specialty tea restaurants, and souvenir shops, where foodies can find satisfying cuisine.

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 香港会议展览中心
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary:
--The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, located at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, is one of the newest seaside buildings in Hong Kong. 
--It can be used for large-scale conferences and exhibitions, as well as two five-star hotels, office buildings and luxury apartments.  
--The venue of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony in 1997, where many awards ceremonies and music awards ceremonies are usually held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Place of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 飞鹅山观景台
attractions.summary: At Fei Ngo Shan, climbing up to the observation deck, you can enjoy the vast sea and dozens of islands in Sai Kung, as well as the panoramic view of the entire Kowloon and Hong Kong Island. It is also one of the good places for many people to drive for outings on Sundays. This is also a good place for people to fly kites and model planes, so there are also many beautiful kites and model planes flying in the sky on Sundays.

attractions.name: 中环街市
attractions.summary: The Central Market was completed in 1939 and is one of the few indoor markets in the area that was built before the war.

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 南丫岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
· Lamma Island, also known as Boliao Island, is the third largest island in Hong Kong. It was first known as the hometown of Chow Yun Fat. 
Nowadays, it is the first choice for outlying islands. You can walk leisurely among picturesque scenery, visit literary shops and simple fishing villages, and taste seafood feasts. 
There are traditional western food, Indian food, Mediterranean food and other specialty restaurants on Lamma Island. The most famous ones are Chinese restaurants "Longhua Seafood" and "over the rainbow Seafood", which focus on seafood. 
The accommodation on the island is mostly homestays, mainly located in Rongshu Bay, Hong Shing Ye Bay, Sok Kwu Wan, etc. In addition, there are several listed resorts.
attractions.shortFeatures: A picturesque leisurely outlying island

attractions.name: 天星维港游
attractions.summary: The Tianxinghai Upstream Service allows tourists and citizens to take the newly modified "World Star" cruise ship to explore the beautiful coastal scenery of Hong Kong waters. The new route launched by Haishang is provided by a new generation of smoke-free and environmentally friendly ferries. Haishang services are no longer limited to Victoria Harbour. The "World Star" ferry will depart from Victoria Harbour and take a brand new route, taking tourists and citizens to explore different attractions in Hong Kong waters. The Star Ferry has always been regarded as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, and has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. Among them, the globally renowned travel review website TripAdvisor has awarded the Star Ferry the "TripAdvisor Annual Excellence Award" for two consecutive years; National Geographic Travel Magazine praised taking the Star Ferry to visit Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life"; The US website Global Post also listed the Star Ferry as one of the "31 Reasons to Live in Hong Kong".

attractions.name: 香港电车叮叮车
attractions.summary: Dingding is an integral part of the bustling streets of Hong Kong, and it is also the only double decker tram in the world. The route of Dingding car is in the bustling commercial center of Hong Kong, passing through the western, upper, central, Wan Chai, Tai Koo, Shau Kei Wan and the Victoria Harbour coast. This ancient mode of transportation, which is only found on Hong Kong Island, is actually a type of tram. It is famous for the sound of "ding ding, ding ding" when the driver steps on the scooter while driving, so people call it Dingding car. The tram currently operates 6 partially overlapping routes connecting Kennedy Town to Shau Kei Wan, with an average tram arriving at the station every 1 minute and 30 seconds. The 6 main routes are as follows: 1. Shau Kei Wan to Sheung Wan Market (there are special trips between Shau Kei Wan and Kennedy Town during peak hours from Monday to Friday); 2. From Shau Kei Wan to Happy Valley; 3. North Point to Shek Tong Tsui; 4. Happy Valley to Kennedy Town; 5. Causeway Bay to Kennedy Town; 6. From Sheung Wan Market to Kennedy Town (only available during peak hours from Monday to Friday). Please refer to the official website for the detailed operation route diagram of Dingding car.

attractions.name: 黄大仙祠
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Wong Tai Sin Temple, formerly known as Sik Sik Yuen, is one of the most popular temples. 
· Wong Tai Sin, where the temple is enshrined, is said to be responsive to requests. There are other buildings rich in Chinese traditional colors in the temple, such as Sansheng Temple, Main Hall and Congxin Garden. 
There is a small park next to the shrine, which is well designed, exquisite and exquisite, and has a garden scenery. The Nine Dragon Wall on the side is modeled after the Forbidden City in Beijing.  
The most distinctive feature of Wong Tai Sin Temple is its "five-shaped" architectural layout. Feiluan Terrace, Sutra Hall, Yuye Pool, Yuxiang Pavilion and Zhaobi in the temple each represent the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire and earth.
attractions.shortFeatures: The temple of the three religions with exuberant incense

attractions.name: 庙街
attractions.summary:
Temple Street, also known as Men's Street, is named after Tin Hau Temple in Yau Ma Tei. It is a popular location for Hong Kong movies. 
Although it is only a short street, it condenses the most authentic Hong Kong culture. 
· Temple Street is famous for its night market selling cheap goods, and is known as Hong Kong's civilian nightclub.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Hong Kong style street with strong market atmosphere

hotel.Hotel Name: Xi'an Lintong Yuechun Hot Spring Hotel

attractions.name: 书院门步行街
attractions.summary:
Xi'an people usually refer to the Academy Gate, which refers to a pedestrian street from Forest of Steles to the entrance of Guanzhong Academy. 
There is a tall archway with ancient charm at the corner of the street, with three golden characters "Academy Gate" written on it. 
There are blue antique buildings on both sides of the street, the ground is paved with bluestone, and the end of the street is the Forest of Steles.  
During the day, it is a street of calligraphy and painting, with a strong literary flavor; It is a snack street in the evening, and Xi'an is rich in characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: A pedestrian street full of books

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 海棠汤
attractions.summary: Haitang Tang is Yang Guifei's special soup pool, which is named after a blooming begonia flower on the plane of the soup pool. The soup pool is wide from east to west and narrow from north to south. The top and bottom are divided into two floors, and 16 coupon stones form a blooming "begonia flower". Tangchi is about 5 meters long from east to west and 2.9 meters wide from north to south.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei's special soup pool

attractions.name: 西安事变旧址五间厅
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity
attractions.summary:
Wujianting is located in Huaqing Pool Scenic Area in Lintong, Xi'an, which is one of the famous sites of Xi'an Incident in history. 
Built in the late Qing Dynasty, it is a brick and wood hall. 
It is adjacent to Lishan Mountain in the south and Lotus Pond in the north. The courtyard is flat and the trees are lush. It is named Five Halls because it is connected by five single rooms.  
On the glass windows and walls of the five halls, there are still bullet marks from the fierce battle between soldiers and remonstrance. 
· Desks, chairs, beds, sofas, tea sets, stoves, carpets, telephones, etc. used in offices in each room are copied and placed as they were originally.
attractions.shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure hall
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:20; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 兵谏亭
attractions.summary:
Bingjian Pavilion is located next to the tabby stone in Xixiuling halfway up Lishan Mountain. Chiang Kai-shek's hiding place is famous for the "Xi'an Incident". 
· In order to commemorate the "Xi'an Incident", initiated by Hu Zongnan in 1946, all the non-commissioned officers of the Seventh Branch of Whampoa Military Academy raised money to build a stone pavilion, named "Zhengqi Pavilion". After the founding of New China, it was renamed "Chiang-shek Pavilion", and it was only changed to "Soldier Remonstrance Pavilion" in 1980s. 
The stone pavilion is 4 meters high and 2.5 meters wide. It seems inconspicuous, but it has a different meaning because it is closely related to major events in Chinese history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stone pavilion commemorating the revolution

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 青龙寺遗址博物馆
attractions.summary: The Qinglong Temple Site Museum Project is one of the follow-up projects of the Xi'an Municipal Government's key project in 2010 and an important component of the Qinglong Temple Site Park. The Qinglong Temple Site Museum is located in the Ancient Yuanlou Square of the Qinglong Temple Site Park. It consists of a Tang style ancient building main building, east-west supporting buildings, and the Ancient Yuanlou Square, with a total construction area of 3164 square meters and an exhibition area of 848 square meters. It is divided into three floors. The exhibition mainly focuses on the external cultural exchange of Tang Qinglong Temple, highlighting the unearthed cultural relics from the Qinglong Temple site and related objects of cultural exchange between ancient and modern China and Japan.

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

restaurants.name_en: Yanxiang Chuanwei BBQ Braised Pork Lobster Pengci Main Store
Silk Road Restaurant, Angsana Hotel & Spa

attractions.name: 浅水湾
attractions.tag: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely

attractions.name: 香港大学美术博物馆
attractions.name_en: University Museum and Art Gallery, The University of Hong Kong
attractions.summary: The University of Hong Kong Art Museum is the oldest museum in Hong Kong. It was founded in 1953 and was first called the "Feng Pingshan Museum." The building it occupies originally belonged to the "Feng Pingshan Chinese Library" that was opened in 1932. Both are named after the donor of the building. By 1994, the museum was renamed the "Hong Kong University Art Museum". In 1996, a new wing was added to the museum, and the exhibition hall in Xuzhan Hall was completed and opened. In the past 60 years, the museum has collected many China art of historical value. They are mainly divided into three categories: bronzes, ceramics and paintings. They range from the Neolithic Age to the Qing Dynasty. They also include traditional Chinese and modern paintings from the Ming Dynasty to the 21st century.

attractions.name: 西环钟声泳棚
attractions.summary: The Western Ring Swimming Pool was a place for citizens to swim in the 1960s and 1970s. It had a long wooden bridge, some bamboo sheds, and a rudimentary changing room, which could be said to be the public swimming pool of that time. Nowadays, there are very few people who come to swim at the Western Ring Swimming Pool. Most of them come to fish on weekdays, and the sunset here is beautiful. It not only attracts photography enthusiasts, but also many couples come to play and couples come to take wedding photos.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 山顶缆车
attractions.tag: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 香港会议展览中心
attractions.name_en: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary:
--The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, located at 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai, is one of the newest seaside buildings in Hong Kong. 
--It can be used for large-scale conferences and exhibitions, as well as two five-star hotels, office buildings and luxury apartments.  
--The venue of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony in 1997, where many awards ceremonies and music awards ceremonies are usually held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Place of Hong Kong's reunification ceremony

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Aquariums; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences. 
Eight theme areas: Asian Animal World, Dream Water Capital, Weiwei World, Tropical Rainforest World, Dynamic World, Ocean World, Rapids World and Ice Pole World. 
Five major activities: New Year-themed lucky group worship, rare animal-themed high-definition zoo, summer water ceremony with cool summer vacation theme, Halloween-themed Hellobike Garden Festival and Christmas-themed Christmas City HOHOHO. 
· Three kinds of transportation facilities in the park: mountaineering cable car (the most popular with many people waiting in line), ocean train and mountaineering lift (the second longest open-air escalator in Hong Kong). 
Marriott Hong Kong Ocean Park Hotel has prepared for you, with interesting Weiwei and Friends themed family rooms, comfortable ocean decorated suites, lagoon themed swimming pools, spa and fitness centers and other facilities. 
And Ocean Park Hong Kong is one of the stations of MTR. No matter which station you get on the subway, you can go to Ocean Park Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 香港海洋公园登山缆车
attractions.summary: The Hong Kong Ocean Park cable car is a classic facility of the Ocean Park, taking visitors leisurely back and forth between the seaside amusement park at the foot of the mountain and the peak amusement park on the mountain. Passengers can slowly climb up the green hills in the sea breeze, fully enjoy the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, and have a panoramic view of various attractions in the Ocean Park, planning their next stop itinerary carefully.

attractions.name: 南丫岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
· Lamma Island, also known as Boliao Island, is the third largest island in Hong Kong. It was first known as the hometown of Chow Yun Fat. 
Nowadays, it is the first choice for outlying islands. You can walk leisurely among picturesque scenery, visit literary shops and simple fishing villages, and taste seafood feasts. 
There are traditional western food, Indian food, Mediterranean food and other specialty restaurants on Lamma Island. The most famous ones are Chinese restaurants "Longhua Seafood" and "over the rainbow Seafood", which focus on seafood. 
The accommodation on the island is mostly homestays, mainly located in Rongshu Bay, Hong Shing Ye Bay, Sok Kwu Wan, etc. In addition, there are several listed resorts.
attractions.shortFeatures: A picturesque leisurely outlying island

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京明故宫遗址公园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
