- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 湖南路
attractions.summary: Hunan Road is a famous commercial street in Gulou District, Nanjing, known for its bustling shopping environment and abundant dining options. This place gathers numerous well-known domestic and foreign brands, making it a paradise for shopping enthusiasts. At the same time, Hunan Road is also a great place for Nanjing citizens to relax and entertain, and the night light show attracts a large number of tourists.
attractions.opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 新街口
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the bronze statue of Sun Yat-sen

attractions.name: 狮子桥步行美食街
attractions.summary: Shiziqiao Pedestrian Food Street, located in the Gulou District of Nanjing City, is more than 300 meters long, connecting Hunan Road and Hubei Road. At the two intersections, there are "Hundred Lion memorial archway" and a stone bridge. This street was originally a farmers' market street, which was transformed into a food pedestrian street in 2000. The scale of Shiziqiao Food Street is small, but tourists can still taste many local food and snacks with Nanjing characteristics, such as duck blood fans, chicken soup dumplings, salted duck (osmanthus duck), salted duck, assorted tofu waterlogging, sugar Congee lotus root, Nanjing dried silk, etc. In addition, tourists can also eat gourd king in Beijing, octopus small balls, Yunnan rice noodles, Korean barbecue and various kebabs from various countries on the street. Famous restaurants and food streets are lined with shops, including a number of well-known restaurants and snack shops in Nanjing, such as: Remembering Duck Blood Vermicelli Soup, Yin's Chicken Soup Bun, Lion King's Mansion Restaurant, Su Yiming Crab roe Bun, Nanjing Big Brand Stalls, and so on. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京1912街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: To feel the nightlife of Nanjing, 1912 is a must. With the architecture of the Republic of China, fashionable bars and living rooms of the city, 1912 Street is as famous as Sanlitun Bar Street in Beijing. It is a fashionable commercial and leisure block composed of 19 Republic of China style buildings and four street squares: Republic, Boai, New Century and Pacific Ocean. This street is also famous for its architecture and delicious food. The blue brick without decoration and glitz is both the wall and the external decoration. On the smoky gray wall, the white brick joints are outlined. Therefore, 1912 is definitely a place where photography enthusiasts in Nanjing often create and gather, and it is also an excellent place to take wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: The gathering place of nightlife in Nanjing

attractions.name: 正阳步行街
attractions.summary: Zhengyang Pedestrian Street is located in the center of Guilin city, with numerous restaurants and shopping shops. It is adjacent to scenic spots such as the Two Rivers and Four Lakes, Duxiu Peak King City, and Dongxi Lane. Whether you are taking a break for a meal after sightseeing or shopping for souvenirs, this is a great place to go. Zhengyang Pedestrian Street starts from Shanhu North Road in the south and ends at Jiefang East Road in the north. It runs parallel to the bustling Zhongshan Middle Road in Guilin city and crosses the central square to the east. Here, there are mainly souvenir shops, restaurants, and clothing stores, and many snacks are very distinctive. You can also taste the local cuisine of Guilin. After visiting nearby scenic spots, it is a good choice to rest and eat here. Many small commodity stores sell unique things, and buying souvenirs is also a good option.

attractions.name: 东西巷
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: East and West Lane, close to Jingjiang Palace, is a comprehensive commercial block integrating tourism, folk customs, culture, shopping, catering, leisure and entertainment. East-West Lane is the only historical street left over from the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Guilin, with a pleasant spatial scale. It is a scenic spot of Guilin's ancient historical features, including Zhengyang Street East Lane, Jiangnan Lane, Lanjing Lane and other traditional streets and lanes in Guilin.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the rare historic districts of the city

attractions.name: 漓江风景名胜区
attractions.summary: There is an article in primary school Chinese textbooks that says' Guilin's scenery is the best in the world ', which refers to visiting the Li River. The mountains on both sides of the Lijiang River are tall and straight, with thousands of shapes. They are the essence of Guilin scenery. The Li River, a hundred mile gallery ", each scenery is a typical Chinese ink painting. The Li River scenic area is surrounded by green peaks, flowing green water, steep canyons, hanging springs and waterfalls, oases and dangerous shoals, strange caves and beautiful stones, with a variety of scenery. Along the river, there are dozens of well-known scenic spots: Wuzhitan, Jiuniusanzhou, Batshan, Wangfu Stone, Lawn Scenery, Guanyan, Xiushan, Banbianqi Qidu, Xianren Tumo, Yangdi Scenery, Carp Hanging on the Wall, Wave Stone Wonders, Xialongwan Bay, Jilong Mountain, Eight Immortals Crossing the River, Wuzhishan, Turtle Climbing, Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection (background of 20 RMB), Camel Crossing the river, Chaoban Mountain, Xingping Jiajing, Luoshi Mountain, Fishing Village, Longtou Mountain, and so on. The main ways to visit the Li River in general include taking boats, bamboo rafts, and hiking, including three-star and four-star boat tours, bamboo raft tours, and large boat tours in Xingping Fishing Village.

attractions.name: 兴坪佳境
attractions.summary: Located on both sides of the upper reaches of the Li River, 25 kilometers away from Yangshuo County, it is known for its beautiful mountains and waters and unparalleled scenery.

attractions.name: 兴坪古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Rafting
attractions.summary:
· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.
attractions.shortFeatures: 20 yuan RMB back picture location

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world. 
· The three most important performances of the day are the 　 celebration during the day, the light and shadow celebration at night, and the fireworks display near the closing castle. The performance time varies according to the specific business hours. Visitors can refer to the official website of the park or check the performance time manual of the day. 
· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.
attractions.shortFeatures: In the amazing Disney world

attractions.name: 灰熊山极速矿车
attractions.summary: The Grizzly Mountain Rapid Mining Car is a popular amusement facility at Hong Kong Disneyland, located in the Adventure World area. This roller coaster is renowned for its high speed and thrilling turns, simulating the experience of a mining car speeding through a mine. Tourists can experience the thrill of rapidly falling from the mountaintop, as well as the excitement of crossing caves and making sharp turns.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 10:00 to 18:00 all year round

attractions.name: 迷离庄园
attractions.summary:
· Blurred Manor is a unique theme park in Hong Kong Disneyland, which opened on May 17th, 2013. The main amusement facility in the area is Blurred Mansion. 
· The story tells the story of a British explorer who is also an adventurer. Sir Henry, a member of the Explorers Institute, set up a mansion in the tropical rainforest and turned the basement into a museum for guests to visit. Different collections are displayed in the museum. 
· "Blurred Manor" is also known as one of the most complex amusement facilities in Disney history, and it is also the last project in the existing expansion plan of Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors will experience an audio-visual feast with sound, smell and somatosensory here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the blurred mansion

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 中环
attractions.tag: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Central is the political and commercial center of Hong Kong. Many banks, multinational financial institutions and foreign consulates are located in Central. 
· All kinds of skyscrapers and shopping malls are all over Central, with gorgeous lights and neon lights. 
· Popular shopping malls such as Landmark Plaza, Jiaxuan Plaza, Prince Building, Alexander Building and International Financial Center Shopping Mall gather designer brands and international palace-level brand stores. 
· The landscape of Central is a mixture of colonial architecture and modern high-tech buildings. Hong Kong's iconic buildings such as Legislative Council Building, Bank of China Tower and IFC International Financial Center in Central are also located here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hong Kong Political and Business Centre

attractions.name: 中环至半山自动扶梯
attractions.summary: The Central to Mid Levels escalator connects the Central business district with the Mid Levels residential area. It was built by the British Hong Kong government in 1993 to improve traffic in Mid Levels. The escalator consists of 20 one-way escalators and 3 automatic pedestrian walkways, starting from the Central Market and ending at Conduit Road. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and there are multiple exits along the way, making it convenient for pedestrians to get on and off. The Mid Levels escalator crosses multiple major streets in Central, including Queen's Road Central, Hollywood Road, and other attractions along the way, such as the old Central Police Station, making it a great means of transportation for tourists. In addition, the escalator will also pass through the SOHO area, which is filled with restaurants and bars, European style small bars, specialty tea restaurants, and souvenir shops, where foodies can find satisfying cuisine.

attractions.name: 大馆(前中区警署建筑群)
attractions.tag: Theater; Art Museums; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary: The main building is located on Hollywood Road in Central, Hong Kong. The complex includes three historic sites: the former Central Police Station, the former Central Magistracy, and Victoria Prison. The Central Police Station was built in 1864 and was originally a three story classical style building. On December 20, 2005, the police held a farewell ceremony and officially handed over the Central Police Station. The original site is adjacent to the former Central Magistracy and Victoria Prison, which also have a long history, and is planned to be developed into a historical and cultural tourism area. In April 2011, the Hong Kong Jockey Club announced that it had completed archaeological surveys in the area and discovered some artifacts believed to be from the late Qing Dynasty to the early 20th century, including containers, pottery pipes, copper coins, fragments of porcelain bowls, suspected tunnel buildings, and foundation remains. Da Guan is now a historic site and art museum, dedicated to bringing rich and exciting historical relics and artistic experiences to Hong Kong.

attractions.name: 坚尼地城
attractions.summary: Kennedy Town, originally written as Kennedy Town, is commonly known as the "West End" (meaning the end of the West Ring). It is backed by Mount Davis to the south, bordered by Belcher Bay to the north, facing the Big and Small Green Islands across the sea to the west, and connected to Shek Tong Tsui to the east. Its scope includes Xining Street to the intersection of Belcher's Street and Queen's Road West. It is one of the earlier developed regions in the area.

attractions.name: 金紫荆广场
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

attractions.name: 星光大道
attractions.summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry

attractions.name: 天安门广场
attractions.summary:
One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

attractions.name: 毛主席纪念堂
attractions.summary:
· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

attractions.name: 故宫博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.
attractions.shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 景山公园
attractions.tag: "Treasure spots for stroller walks; garden park"
attractions.summary:
- Jingshan Park is located at the central point of Beijing's north-south central axis. It is south of the Forbidden City, west of Beihai, and faces the Drum Tower to the north. It was once the highest point in the center of Beijing.  
- The park features towering ancient trees, a solitary peak, majestic pavilions, a wide variety of peonies, and diverse cultural activities.  
- Among them, Wanchun Pavilion is regarded as the highest point on Beijing's central axis. It enjoys a prime location, offering a panoramic view of the Forbidden City and a full glimpse of the city's axis.  
- Another notable cultural landmark in Jingshan Park is the site where Emperor Chongzhen ended his life.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Chongzhen of the Ming Dynasty hanged himself.

attractions.name: 南锣鼓巷
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.
attractions.shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 慕田峪长城
attractions.summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.

attractions.name: 张裕爱斐堡酒庄
attractions.summary: Zhangyu Aifeibao International Winery is a winery created by Yantai Zhangyu Group, integrating capital from multiple countries such as France and Portugal. On the basis of the original grape cultivation and wine making, Aifebao is also equipped with three innovative functions: wine themed tourism, professional tasting training, and leisure vacation, opening a new era for the winery. Changyu Aifeibao International Winery is designed in a European style, featuring the French Avenue, fresh grape picking garden, Gothic castle, underground wine cellar, European town, Changyu Centennial History Museum, and landscape leisure area. You can fully experience the fun brought by wine culture, have intimate contact with nature, and completely relax your body and mind. Changyu Eifferberg International Winery Appreciation Center cooperates with OIV and other international well-known wine organizations, and has designed a number of courses for countrymen people, focusing on introducing the internationally popular knowledge system of wine culture and wine etiquette. The Wine Club is a spiritual home for wine enthusiasts around the world. Here, you can taste Chinese and Western cuisine with rich wine culture characteristics in elegant and diverse wine themed restaurants. You can also explore European towns modeled after French towns, which have Western style churches, cigar bars, and wine spas. Full text 

One can only see the unique style of Bruges walls, and multiple European style castle buildings scattered on both sides of the canal, each with its own charm reflected on the river surface of the water city. The gentle breeze, swaying tree shadows, winding water lanes, flowing clear waves, immerse oneself in the dream of rippling blue waves, the poetic and picturesque scenery of the coastal city, and the romance of Dalian are rendered here. attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.summary: Chongqing Happy Valley Theme Park and Maya Beach Water Park are the seventh stop in the nationwide strategic layout of OCT Group's "East, West, South, North, and Central, Happy Great China" plan. They are also the only mountain-themed Happy Valley in the country, located in the Liangjiang New Area Lijia International Business and Tourism City. The Chongqing Happy Valley Theme Park covers an area of approximately 480,000 square meters and is built on a mountain, making it the first mountain-themed Happy Valley in China. The park is divided into six major theme areas: Happy Time, Dream Island, Hurricane Bay, Dinosaur Forest, Old Chongqing, and River Valley Mining Town. It features over 100 world-class amusement attractions, including the world's most advanced flying wing roller coaster, the sixth-largest Ferris wheel in the world, and the longest and largest wooden roller coaster in Southwest China. Traditional Happy Valley performances and festivals, such as the grand parade showcasing cultural features from various countries, the world's largest International Magic Festival, and the most exciting Halloween Happy Festival, will also be held here.

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum.

attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 南京欢乐谷
attractions.summary: Nanjing Happy Valley is the 8th stop in the nationwide chain of Happy Valley, located on the east side of Qixia Mountain, adjacent to the Yangtze River, surrounded by mountains and waters, with a unique geographical environment. Nanjing Happy Valley has six major parks: Happy Time, Lost Fortress, Dessert Kingdom, Black Iron City, Fantasia Ocean, and Magic Eye Forest. Among them, "Dessert Kingdom" and "Fantasia Ocean" are jointly developed with the animated IP Biscuit Sheriff and well-known Hong Kong brand B The area jointly created by Duck and Little Yellow Duck. In addition, Nanjing Happy Valley incorporates hardcore steampunk style into the amusement park, launching the "Black Iron City" that integrates retro sentiment, mechanical aesthetics, Gothic architecture and other characteristics, injecting more trendy genes into the holiday leisure of urban youth. Nanjing Happy Valley boasts over 40 amusement equipment, including Asia's first flying wing roller coaster with reverse seats in the rear row, the "Predator". The scenery in front of us is flowing backwards, and adrenaline is racing rapidly. The luxurious double decker carousel, family roller coaster "Time Race", children's playground "Sheriff Training Camp"... a variety of colorful amusement equipment will allow visitors of all ages to enjoy a wonderful leisure. The completion of Nanjing Happy Valley not only promotes the rapid formation of a new landmark for entertainment in the "Great Southern Capital", but also further enhances the radiation ability of Zidong tourism resources. Through stable customer flow, it injects a shot in the arm into Nanjing's development plan and interprets the true essence of "a prosperous and happy city" in Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中国秦淮灯会主会场（白鹭洲公园）
attractions.name_en: China Qinhuai Lantern Festival Main Venue (Bailuzhou Park)
attractions.summary: The main venue of the 33rd Qinhuai Lantern Festival in China is located in Bailuzhou Park in Nanjing. After more than four months of closure and renovation, the scenery inside the park has become more pleasant and unique. The theme of this Bai Lu Zhou Park Lantern Festival is "Bai Lu Ya Ji, the Capital of Literature". All the lantern groups are centered around poetry and songs, allowing visitors to not only appreciate the beautiful lantern groups but also recite poetry from ancient times. The Qinhuai Painting Boat has always been a business card for tourists visiting the Confucius Temple in Nanjing. On the night when the lanterns are first lit, sitting on the Qinhuai Painting Boat and watching the colorful lights on both sides of the river feels like traveling back to the ancient Qinhuai River. This lantern festival, the Qinhuai Painting Boat has set up a dock in Bailuzhou Park. Taking the painting boat to visit the Confucius Temple and watch the Bailuzhou Lantern Festival, you can shuttle between Bailuzhou Park and the core scenic area of Confucius Temple.

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.

attractions.name: 广州动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Kid-friendly treasure spots; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- Guangzhou Zoo is located on the eastern section of Xianlie Middle Road and was established in 1958. It is considered one of the top three city zoos in China, along with Beijing Zoo and Shanghai Zoo. The zoo is suitable for family visits, where you can teach children about small animals, visit the aquarium, and enjoy the amusement park.
- Here, you can see China's national treasures, such as the giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey, South China tiger, milu deer, and black-necked crane, as well as animals from around the world, including hippopotamuses, rhinoceroses, and African elephants.
- In addition to the animal exhibits, the zoo features the Guangzhou Ocean Aquarium, Butterfly House, Golden Carp Pavilion (where you can see goldfish), Amusement Park (with small rides like the carousel, bumper cars, and log flume), Fun Park, and Stone Museum. Separate tickets are required for the aquarium, Golden Carp Pavilion, Stone Museum, and amusement park rides.
- Fun Park is particularly suitable for young children, where they can have close contact with baby camels, lambs, and piglets. Additionally, the zoo's keepers feed animals such as hippos, elephants, and pelicans at scheduled times each day, and visitors can go to watch the feeding sessions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Rare Animal Viewing and Interactive Amusement Attraction

attractions.name: 南越王博物院(王墓展区)
attractions.name_en: The Nanyue King Museum of The Western Han Dynasty
attractions.summary: The Western Han Nanyue King Museum is located in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, and is the exhibition area for the royal tombs of the Nanyue King Museum (a research center for the history of Western Han Nanyue). In June 1983, the tomb of the King of Nanyue was excavated and unearthed. The museum was built based on the original site of the tomb, mainly displaying the original site of the King of Nanyue's tomb and its unearthed cultural relics. Compared to other museums, its highlight lies in the precious "Silk Thread Jade Robe". The Silk Thread Jade Robe of the King of Nanyue is one of the earliest and most complete sets of jade robes excavated in China, which is definitely worth a visit. Also, this museum was built on the site of the cemetery, so it contains the tomb of the King of Nanyue. To the east of the museum is a three story comprehensive exhibition building, and to the north is a two-story main exhibition building. The three buildings are connected as a whole by a surrounding corridor that connects them up and down. The museum has a total of 10 exhibition halls, with permanent exhibitions including cultural relics exhibitions and porcelain pillow exhibitions, as well as occasional temporary exhibitions. The cultural relics exhibition is the main body of the museum, mainly consisting of unearthed cultural relics from the tomb of King Zhao Xu of Nanyue, with over 10000 pieces of various burial objects unearthed from the tomb. The exhibition is divided into five units: Emperor Wen's Golden Seal, Treasures of the Main Chamber, Martyrdom in the Tomb, Treasures in the Imperial Treasury, and Bell and Ding Food. There are a large number of jade artifacts in the accompanying collection, such as the Qingyu Jiao Cup, eleven sets of jade accessories, and fifty-eight jade sword ornaments, all of which are significant discoveries in Han jade. The treasures among jade artifacts are undoubtedly the "Silk Thread Jade Robe", "Carrying Plate High Foot Cup", and "Dragon and Phoenix Pattern Heavy Ring Jade Pendant". The dragon and phoenix patterned heavy ring jade pendant is a decorative jade artifact unearthed from the right eye of the tomb owner. It is carved from blue and white jade and is divided into two rings: the inner ring is intricately carved with a swimming dragon, and the outer ring is intricately carved with a phoenix bird. Its design has been selected as the emblem of the Nanyue King Museum of the Western Han Dynasty. Full text 

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 五羊石雕
attractions.summary: The Five Rams Stone Carving is located in Yuexiu Park and is a symbol of Guangzhou city, as well as the origin of the name "Yangcheng". The Five Rams Stone Carving originated from a beautiful legend. Legend has it that in the past, Guangzhou was very barren and people could not afford to eat or drink. Five immortals rode five sheep with ears of grain in their mouths and flew here, leaving the ears of grain to the people of Guangzhou. They wished for a bountiful harvest every year and then flew away with clouds, turning the sheep into stones. Guangzhou became a prosperous land from then on. The Five Rams Stone Carving was built in April 1960. The statue is 11 meters high and is carved from 130 pieces of granite. It is a commemoration of a beautiful legend. There is also a sculpture of the Five Immortals next to it, which can be visited together.

Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.

attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.summary: The Guangdong Customs Museum is located in Guangzhou, with a total of 4 floors facing north and south. There are thousands of collections in the museum, as well as a basic exhibition on "The Development History of Chinese Customs" and a special exhibition on "Guangdong Customs and the Maritime Silk Road".

Guangzhou's "City Living Room", which integrates cultural creativity, exhibition and trade, sightseeing, leisure and entertainment and other functions.
