attractions.name: 大佛古寺
attractions.summary: The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 越秀公园-韩国庭院
attractions.summary: Yuexiu Park is the largest park in Guangzhou and one of the oldest parks in Guangzhou's history. The park is shaded by green trees and boasts picturesque lakes and mountains, making it a great destination for citizens to relax and entertain themselves. The Korean Garden is a distinctive attraction within Yuexiu Park, showcasing traditional Korean garden art and providing visitors with a window to learn about Korean culture.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 五羊石雕
attractions.summary: The Five Rams Stone Carving is located in Yuexiu Park and is a symbol of Guangzhou city, as well as the origin of the name "Yangcheng". The Five Rams Stone Carving originated from a beautiful legend. Legend has it that in the past, Guangzhou was very barren and people could not afford to eat or drink. Five immortals rode five sheep with ears of grain in their mouths and flew here, leaving the ears of grain to the people of Guangzhou. They wished for a bountiful harvest every year and then flew away with clouds, turning the sheep into stones. Guangzhou became a prosperous land from then on. The Five Rams Stone Carving was built in April 1960. The statue is 11 meters high and is carved from 130 pieces of granite. It is a commemoration of a beautiful legend. There is also a sculpture of the Five Immortals next to it, which can be visited together.

attractions.name: 广州中山纪念堂
attractions.summary: The Sun Yat sen Memorial Hall is a commemorative building built to commemorate the great revolutionary Sun Yat sen. It has witnessed many historical events in Guangzhou and is of great commemorative significance. It is now an important venue for large-scale gatherings and performances in Guangzhou. Here you can see a brief introduction and life story of Sun Yat sen, in order to commemorate him. It is located at the southern foot of Yuexiu Park, started construction in 1929 and completed in 1931. The transportation to the memorial hall is very convenient, just take Metro Line 2 and get off at the memorial hall. After entering the gate, there is a square where you can see the towering statue of Sun Yat sen, which can be photographed as a souvenir. Then further ahead is the main building of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, with a ticket office next to it. The main building is a grand and magnificent octagonal palace style building, rich in traditional Chinese characteristics. In the center, there is a painted gold plaque with a blue background and red border hanging high, on which there are four large characters written by Sun Yat sen: "The world is for all", which is powerful and majestic. Inside the themed building is a performance hall, and now many concerts are also held here. There are many pictures and texts posted on the wall, introducing the construction of the memorial hall and a brief introduction to Sun Yat-sen. There is also a small independent room behind the memorial hall - the Sun Yat sen Historical Sites Exhibition Hall, which also introduces Sun Yat sen's life. Besides, there are also some plants worth seeing here, such as the kapok tree from Guangzhou and the white orchid tree from Guangzhou. In the northeast corner of Zhongshan Memorial Hall, there is a unique tree called "Tree Hug Tree" or "One Rod, Two Trees", which is naturally formed, not married. Full text 

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

"Delicious" means "greedy". Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

They are also the only mountain-themed Happy Valley in the country, located in the Liangjiang New Area Lijia International Business and Tourism City. The Chongqing Happy Valley Theme Park covers an area of approximately 480,000 square meters and is built on a mountain, making it the first mountain-themed Happy Valley in China. The park is divided into six major theme areas: Happy Time, Dream Island, Hurricane Bay, Dinosaur Forest, Old Chongqing, and River Valley Mining Town. It features over 100 world-class amusement attractions, including the world's most advanced flying wing roller coaster, the sixth-largest Ferris wheel in the world, and the longest and largest wooden roller coaster in Southwest China. Traditional Happy Valley performances and festivals, such as the grand parade showcasing cultural features from various countries, the world's largest International Magic Festival, and the most exciting Halloween Happy Festival, will also be held here.

The old street faces the Yangtze River, backed by Nanshan Mountain, and you have a panoramic view of the scenic spots of Yuzhong. There are 1 ropeway, 2 light rails, 5 bridges and 19 supporting bus lines around them, linking Jiangbei, Yuzhong and Danzishi CBDs, radiating the whole city. 
Longmenhao Old Street has a history of one hundred years, where the port opening culture, anti-Japanese war site culture, Buddhist culture, Bayu culture and dock culture are colorful. The restoration of the old street employs first-class cultural relics restoration craftsmen, and uses 1.6 million old bricks, 400,000 old tiles and 30,000 tons of old stones collected from various places. Based on the principle of repairing the old as before, the building technology of a hundred years ago is adopted to restore the former style of Longmen Hao Old Street.

attractions.name: 上海环球金融中心
attractions.summary: The Shanghai World Financial Center stands within the Lujiazui Financial and Trade Zone and is the fourth tallest building in China, shaped like a bottle opener. On the 100th floor of the sightseeing hall, you can look up at the Oriental Pearl TV Tower spire. Stepping on the suspended sightseeing corridor, overlooking the scenery on both sides of the Pujiang River through the transparent glass underfoot, it's like strolling in the clouds. The Shanghai World Financial Center is 492 meters high, with 101 floors above ground and a total of 6 entrances. The basement level 2 to the above ground level 3 are shopping malls and dining areas, and no admission tickets are required. The 7th to 77th floors are offices, and the 79th to 93rd floors are Park Hyatt hotels. Gate 2 is the entrance to the sightseeing hall, located on Dongtai Road near Huayuan Shiqiao Road. Enter the ticketing area on the B1 floor through the entrance, and then take the high-speed elevator with a speed of up to 8 meters per second. It only takes 66 seconds to travel from the basement level 2 to the 94th floor. The 94th to 100th floors are the observation hall. Visitors can start from the 94th floor, take the escalator to the 97th floor, walk over the observation bridge, and take the elevator to the 100th floor. Of course, they can also go in the opposite direction. You can also buy and mail postcards on the 94th floor. 100th floor: Located at 474 meters, the unique feature is a suspended sightseeing corridor about 55 meters long. The corridor is equipped with three transparent glass floors, allowing clear views of cars and pedestrians passing through the ground. 97th floor: located at 439 meters, the open glass ceiling design here is very unique. When the weather is clear, the glass ceiling slides to both sides to open, and the entire sightseeing hall is like a floating "sky bridge" in the air. 94th floor: Located at 423 meters, with a height of 8 meters, the space is very spacious and offers a panoramic view of the Pujiang River scenery. There are also commemorative shops, cafes, and climbing commemorative photos. Various exhibitions and events can also be held here.

attractions.summary: The 88th floor observation hall of Jinmao Tower is one of the famous high-altitude observation decks in Shanghai, located in the Lujiazui Financial and Trade Zone. Taking the elevator that runs 9 meters per second from the ground floor lobby of Jinmao Tower, it only takes 45 seconds to reach the 340 meter high 88th floor observation hall. The fully transparent glass curtain wall allows you to overlook the city scenery from 360 degrees. It is recommended to pay attention to the weather in advance and choose a sunny day to go. In the evening, you can see the charming sunset, and the Lujiazui and Bund under the night sky are particularly beautiful under the rendering of lights. There is a coin operated telescope (1 yuan per session) available for use in the sightseeing hall.

· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林

attractions.name: 小石林景区-阿诗玛
attractions.summary: Ashima Incarnation Stone is located in Dongshilin Scenic Area, Kunming City. Ashima is a smart and beautiful girl in the mythology of the Yi ethnic group in Yunnan. Her steadfast love with Ahei Ge is well-known, and the movie "Ashima" filmed in the 1960s spread the story of Ashima both domestically and internationally. The beautiful Ashima has deeply penetrated people's hearts. The stone forest resembling Ashima is a famous attraction in the Shilin Scenic Area, and also a great place for people to reminisce about Ashima and revisit that beautiful legend. Ashima's stone form and spirit resemble Ashima's. She is full of affection, as if eagerly awaiting the arrival of Ahei Ge. People place their nostalgia for Ashima in this stone forest, which has become the embodiment of Ashima and is crowded with visitors every day.

attractions.name: 九乡
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
attractions.summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"

attractions.name: 惊魂峡
attractions.summary: Jinghun Gorge is a model of many legends in ancient China that dripping water penetrates rocks and overcome hardness with softness. Now the canyon has been washed into an underground river with a height of more than 70 meters and a width of only 35 meters. The magic of nature is nothing more than this. The gorge is nearly 100 meters high and only three or four meters wide at its narrowest point. It is the deepest underground grand canyon ever discovered in China. The cliffs on both sides of the river are cut, and there is a flowing spring at the bottom of the gorge, which is spectacular. A faint flowing spring looked weak and boneless, but due to years of erosion, it actually cut through the steel-like cliff formed 600 million years ago. What a great thing this is? The Ai Jinghun Gorge can be walked through the whole journey by a plank road. Walking in the canyon makes people worry that the canyon will close at any time. When they go to the depths of the canyon and look back, the sky is carried into a thin slice. At the end of the canyon, there are two layers of ancient stalactite caves penetrated by the ancient river channel.
attractions.shortFeatures: The dome is in the shape of a cave bridge

attractions.name: 雌雄飞瀑
attractions.summary: Jiaozi Snow Mountain is located in Luquan County, Kunming City, Yunnan Province. It is the highest peak in central Yunnan and is named after its shape resembling a sedan chair. The scenery here varies throughout the four seasons. In spring, the mountain flowers bloom brilliantly, in summer, the green grass is lush, in autumn, the forests are lush, and in winter, they are covered in snow. It is an excellent place for hiking, exploration, and photography.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 龙门
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the 500-mile vast Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 海埂公园
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
attractions.summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake

attractions.name: 海埂大坝
attractions.summary:
· Located next to Dianchi Lake, you can see Dianchi Lake at the foot of Xishan Mountain, and the scenery is beautiful. 
It's a good choice to come here to see seagulls. The dam is full of seagulls flying around, which is very spectacular. 
· The dam is very wide and long, and parking is very convenient. Many newlyweds choose to come here to take wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to enjoy seagulls

attractions.name: 斗南花市
attractions.summary: Dounan Flower Market is located in Chenggong District, Kunming City, where the flowers flow like the sea and the fragrance fills the air. Yunnan is known as the kingdom of flora and fauna, with spring like seasons and pleasant climate. It supplies 70-80% of the country's fresh flowers. Every tourist to Yunnan hopes to experience the fragrance of flowers grown in the 25 degree north latitude region at Dounan Flower Market, which is the flower capital of China. The first floor of Dounan Flower Market is filled with dried flowers, while the second floor is filled with succulents. The flowers here can be considered as cabbage prices, with varieties such as ping pong chrysanthemum, lily, sunflower, emperor flower, violet, and starry sky. The variety is complete, making it the largest flower trading market in Asia. Anyone who comes here will return with a full load.

restaurants.name_en: Eighteen Lane Hong Kong Tea Restaurant
Bridge fragrant Garden authentic bridge rice noodles
Cafeteria at Haosheng Hotel in Nanya Fengqing Garden

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 岭南印象园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gem for Kid-Friendly Activities; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 西华路美食街
attractions.summary: There are many food streets in Guangzhou, but the ones that truly win the hearts of Guangzhou people are undoubtedly the local small shops hidden in the old city area. The Xihua Road Food Street, located on Xihua Road in the old city, takes only 10 minutes to walk from one end to the other, but it is filled with various old restaurants' delicacies. Most of the people who come here to eat are local residents, and the food is delicious and affordable. There are no exquisite decorations or excessive services here, only familiar and neighborhood prices from old Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 正佳自然科学博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Zhengjia Natural Science Museum is located on the 6th floor of Zhengjia Plaza, a national AAAA-level tourist attraction. It is a new natural science museum built with reference to international standards and concepts. There are nearly a thousand rare paleontological fossils and mineral specimens in the museum. "Treasure of the Town Hall" is a fossil specimen of Ceratosaurus Medusa from Montana, USA. It is the first original fossil of Ceratosaurus Medusa collected in a museum in China (as of 2018) 
Zhengjia Museum of Natural Science takes "popular science with entertainment and education" as its museum concept, uses advanced, innovative and scientific expression techniques to tell the story of the birth of the earth and the evolution of life, and combines static exhibition objects with dynamic interactive experiences to create an immersive visit line, allowing the audience to explore natural science in a joyful and relaxed atmosphere.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-20:00(Tickets available until 19:30; admission ends at 19:30)

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 大水车
attractions.summary:
· The landmark buildings and landmarks of the ancient city of Lijiang, tourists must go to the place to take photos. 
The oldest agricultural irrigation tool in China is a superb labor skill created by our ancestors and a precious historical and cultural heritage. 
In the past, there were waterwheels in ancient cities, represented by the big waterwheels in ancient cities, which are still used in some remote places today. 
The waterwheel in the ancient city of Lijiang is only used as a landmark building and ornamental function.
attractions.shortFeatures: Symbol of Old Town of Lijiang

attractions.name: 丽江古城酒吧街
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the bustling and bustling of the ancient city of Lijiang

attractions.name: 白水河
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.
attractions.shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山索道
attractions.summary: The Yulong Snow Mountain Cableway is one of the three cableways in the Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. Tourists can take the cableway directly from the cableway station located in Ganhaizi to the Glacier Park at an altitude of 4506 meters. After getting off the cableway and following the wooden boardwalk laid on the glacier, you can climb all the way to the highest point at an altitude of 4680 meters, experiencing the charm of the snow capped mountains and glaciers up close. Full text 

attractions.name: 冰川公园大索道
attractions.summary: The cableway has a total length of 2980 meters, with an upper station elevation of 4506 meters and a lower station elevation of 3356 meters. The vertical height difference between the upper and lower stations is 1150 meters, making it one of the cableways built at high altitudes both domestically and internationally.

attractions.name: 冰川公园
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountain Climbing; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
· Located on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north of Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, it is a typical representative of the modern glacier in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
· The park composed of stone caves and caves eroded by glaciers is a landform relic formed by Quaternary glaciers, and is known as the "Glass Palace of Lucerne".  
In autumn, winter and spring, the snow is vast here. In summer, you can see the glaciers formed more than 40,000 years ago, and you can feel the snow-capped mountains at close range. 
The white mountain at the top of the mountain is magnificent, spectacular, white and delicate, and there is also a marking stone tablet with an altitude of 4,680 meters, which is also a popular group photo place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience glaciers and snow-capped mountains up close

attractions.name: 《印象丽江》演出
attractions.tag: Featured performance; Mountain Climbing; Live Show
attractions.summary: Impression Lijiang "is one of the" Impression Series "directed by Zhang Yimou. The performance is set against the backdrop of snow capped mountains, with folk culture as the theme and local indigenous people as actors. On the open-air stage of the Ganhaizi Blue Moon Valley Theater in Yulong Snow Mountain at an altitude of 3100 meters, it truly showcases the indigenous people's emotions towards heaven, earth, people, and mountains. Impression of Lijiang "is divided into two parts:" Snow Mountain Chapter "and" Ancient City Chapter ", including six parts:" Ancient Road Horse Gang "," Duijiu Snow Mountain "," Heaven and Earth "," Jumping Song Group "," Encouragement and Sacrifice to Heaven ", and" Prayer Ceremony ". The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. The more than 500 actors participating in the performance are all from the surrounding rural areas, giving the audience a very authentic impression of Lijiang with their rough momentum, native posture, and simple singing.

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 辛亥革命武昌起义纪念馆
attractions.summary: The predecessor of the Wuchang Uprising Memorial Hall was the Hubei Consultative Bureau in the late Qing Dynasty. In October 1911, the first shot of the Xinhai Revolution was fired in Wuchang. After the successful uprising, the revolutionary party established a military government here. The main body of the memorial hall is a small building with red walls and tiles, commonly known as the "Red Chamber" by locals. The memorial hall, founded in 1909, is a two-story brick and wood Western style building. There are currently two themed displays in the museum. One is the "Restoration Exhibition of the Former Site of the Governor General's Office of the Hubei Army", which reproduces the scene of the early establishment of the Governor's Office. From the display, we can learn about the organizational structure of the military government in its early days. There is also a flag on display, called the Eighteen Star Flag, which is the military flag of the Wuchang Uprising. The eighteen yellow stars represent the descendants of Yan and Huang from the eighteen provinces within Shanhaiguan. The other main exhibition is the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution", which showcases the historical scene of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution through cultural relics, pictures, and models. Here, you can also see portraits of figures related to the Wuchang Uprising. There is also a photo of a woman in the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution". The person in the photo is Zhang Zhujun, the president of the Shanghai Red Cross Society. During the Wuchang Uprising, she organized a civilian medical team and disguised revolutionary party member Huang Xing as a doctor of the Red Cross Society, taking her on a ship to Wuhan. Full text 

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

hotel.Hotel Name: Xi'an Lintong Yuechun Hot Spring Hotel

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《长恨歌》演出
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
China's first large-scale live-action historical dance drama, with eleven scenes in four levels, such as "loving each other" and "being spoiled and charming". 
· A strong cast of 300 professional actors artistically reproduces this touching love story in the original place of the story. 
Since the official performance in 2007, more than 2,500 performances have been performed and 3.5 million audiences have been received, reaching the grand occasion of "one ticket is hard to find".
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei and Tang Minghuang's eternal love

attractions.name: 华清御汤·宝积池温泉
attractions.summary: The Huaqing Yutang Baojichi Outdoor Hot Spring Area is located on the south side of the Xi'an Huaqing Yutang Hotel in Lintong District, Xi'an City. It is adjacent to the Lishan National Forest Park to the south and the Huaqing Palace, a national 5A level tourist attraction to the north. Relying on the 6000 year old Imperial Hot Spring and Lishan Natural Oxygen Bar, it inherits the essence of Tang Dynasty bathing culture, backed by the natural oxygen bar, with lush forests and fresh air. There are bathing pool outdoor hot springs of different sizes and styles in Baoji Pool. The selection of bathing pool materials is exquisite and elegant. There are also elegant and refined modern celebrities who like beige. The Tang Palace's ancient style lounge features elegant seating, offering Tang Dynasty style health tea drinks and fruit snacks. Savor the unique Tang culture bathing and health preservation concept in the leisurely stillness of time.

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 百戏俑坑
attractions.summary: The Baixi Qikeng is named after the various postures of the pottery figurines.

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 白鹿原影视城
attractions.tag: Hi Fun Park; Kid-Friendly Treasure Spot; Film Studios
attractions.summary:
- Based on Mo Yan's Mǎo Dùn Literature Award-winning novel *White Deer Plain*, this is Shaanxi's first large-scale film and television city that integrates film shooting and experiences, cultural leisure, children's entertainment, and spectacular performances.
- By showcasing the architecture, history, and patriarchal culture of the Guanzhong region, visitors can journey through the five major passes—Wuguan, Xiaoguan, Tongguan, Jin Suoguan, and Dasan—experiencing the ancient plains and understanding the ancient history, traversing through the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties.
- There are 13 performance projects, including two large-scale live-action special effect performances, *The Two Tigers Guarding Chang'an* and *The Great Earthquake of Guanzhong*, four children's fun performances, and seven traditional Guanzhong folk performances.
- The site restores the folk customs of Guanzhong, offering an immersive experience of local culture and a true-to-life movie shooting set.

attractions.summary:
· Qingdao's earliest military-specific artificial wharf is a landmark building and a famous scenic spot in Qingdao. 
The octagonal building inside the breakwater at the southern end is called "Huilan Pavilion". Standing here, you can enjoy the "Flying Pavilion Huilan", one of the ten scenic spots in Qingdao. 
The north coast is called "Zhanqiao Park", with lush flowers and plants, and stone chairs for tourists to rest and enjoy the scenery of the sea and sky.

attractions.name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.
attractions.shortFeatures: Decoding the Production Process of Tsingtao Beer

attractions.name: 五四广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement

attractions.name: 青岛奥帆中心
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for family outings; Boating/Sailing; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: The venue for the sailing events of the Beijing Olympics.

attractions.name: 崂山
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Kid-friendly hidden gems; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Qingdao, Mount Laoshan is known as the "First Famous Mountain on the Sea." Its highest peak, Jufeng, rises to about 1,133 meters above sea level. The mountain is famous for its grandeur, magnificence, uniqueness, and beauty, and is a renowned Taoist sacred mountain.
- The Taoist temples of Laoshan, the sunrise, and the sea of clouds are all highly famous; the southern route includes Liqing River and Yakou; the eastern route leads to Yangkou; the central route passes through Beijiushui; visitors arriving by sea mainly explore the Taiqing and Shangqing scenic areas.
- The Laoshan Mountaineering Festival is held every April; the Laoshan Cherry Blossom Festival takes place every May, attracting large numbers of tourists and creating a lively atmosphere.
- In late March every year, the cherry blossoms bloom all over Laoshan, turning the entire area into a sea of flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciating the red leaves and sunset glow at a famous Taoist mountain.

attractions.name: 仰口海滩
attractions.summary: Yangkou Beach is located within the Yangkou Scenic Area. This beach is wide, flat, and has excellent sand quality, making it a relatively high-quality beach in the suburbs of Qingdao. The location of Yangkou Beach is a crescent shaped bay - Yangkou Bay, about 22 kilometers long, with distant islands called Daguan Island, Xiaoguan Island, and Rabbit Island. However, Yangkou Beach is currently not a formal beach and there are no safety personnel here. For safety reasons, it is not recommended to swim here.

attractions.name: 小麦岛公园
attractions.summary: Maimai Island Park is located 50 meters west of Maidao Road in Laoshan District. Maimai Island is a circular island with large flat and wide green grasslands. In the distance, there is a deep blue sea water, and you can overlook the distant coastline from here. It is a beautiful seaside scenery that is very suitable for photography.

attractions.name: 石老人海水浴场
attractions.summary: The Shilaoren Beach is located in the eastern part of Qingdao city and is one of the larger beaches in Qingdao. This place is adjacent to the Ocean World to the south, and to the east, you can see the giant stone "Stone Old Man" standing in the sea. This strange stone looks like an old man sitting in the sea, and it is a sea eroded pillar landscape formed by millions of years of wind and wave erosion and impact. The Shilaoren Beach has a flat slope and many people believe that the seawater is clearer than several beaches in the city, so many local residents love to come here for swimming. Moreover, there are fewer people here, the air is fresher, and the sand is finer. It's very enjoyable to take a walk and bask in the sun here. However, during summer, there are often seaweed floating on the water surface, which can slightly affect swimming. Not far from the bathhouse, there is also the famous International Beer City on Hong Kong East Road. During the summer beer festival, there are crowds of people here, and you can also come here to join the fun, enjoy beer, barbecue, and seafood, and play a roller coaster in the amusement park.

attractions.name: 小青岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a treasure spot for strolling with kids.; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiao Qingdao is named for its shape, which resembles an ancient zither, and is also known as "Qin Island." The white conical lighthouse standing at the highest point is the landmark building.  
· At night, the red light on the lighthouse and the lights on the pier float on the turquoise waves, creating the scene known as "Qin Island Floating Lights," which is regarded as one of Qingdao's top ten scenic spots and has become one of the city's symbols.  
· Now open to the public as a park, the island is mainly planted with black pines, along with seasonal flowering ornamental plants.  
· On the relatively flat southern part of the island, there is a small square, in the center of which stands a sculpture of a woman holding a zither, facing the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the landmark lighthouse on Qingdao Island.

attractions.name: 圣弥厄尔教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in 1930, formerly known as "St. Miel Church", it is the largest Romanesque building in Qingdao and the only consecrated church in China. 
· Designed by German designer Biloha, according to Gothic and Romanesque architectural styles. It is a masonry twin tower building with four bells inside. 
· The church is spacious and bright. The hall is about 18 meters high. There are two confession booths on both sides of the corridors for priests to receive believers to confess and confess.  
• The church has a valuable organ imported from Germany, which is played only during Sunday Mass.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Western Architecture in Qingdao

attractions.name: 上街里·银鱼巷
attractions.summary: Shangjie Lane · Yinyu Lane is a century old block formed by the intersection of Ningyang Road and Shoukang Road in the southern district of Qingdao. It preserves the traditional courtyard architecture of Qingdao and is also a cultural gathering place, with a strong atmosphere. There are also many trendy shops, jewelry and souvenir shops, coffee shops, restaurants, and more inside.

attractions.name: 中国摄影之岛
attractions.summary: China Photography Island is located in Ganshuiwan Village, Huangdao District, Qingdao City. It is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. It has beautiful scenery and beautiful environment, with both rural atmosphere and coastal scenery. It is a fishing village full of original flavors.

attractions.name: 黄岛金沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 

attractions.name: 金沙滩啤酒城
attractions.summary: Jinshatan Beer City is located on the northwest side of the West Coast International Beer Square, consisting of 7 buildings. It is designed in a unique small town style in southern Bavaria, Germany and is one of the important iconic buildings of the West Coast Beer Square. It includes six functional areas: beer culture exhibition hall, brand beer exhibition hall, craft beer house, gravity beer bar, beer culture experience entertainment hall, and beer derivative exhibition hall. The Brand Beer Exhibition Hall selects international level beer brands for display and experience; Craft beer houses aim to experience the lifestyle carried by modern beer culture and create one of the earliest gathering experience areas for craft beer in China; The Beer Culture Experience and Entertainment Center combines beer culture with entertainment facilities, with two 5D dynamic entertainment experience halls, the Flying Cinema and Qiqu Maileburg, opening up tourists' interesting interpretation and intelligent exploration of beer culture through a deep interactive entertainment method; The Beer Derivatives Exhibition Hall focuses on beer and develops a series of artistic and innovative derivatives.

attractions.name: 连三岛
attractions.summary: Liansan Island is located in the Yellow Sea, about 7.5 kilometers southwest of Qingdao Economic and Technological Development Zone, with an altitude of 6.1 meters, a length of 0.5 kilometers, a width of 0.1 kilometers, a coastline of 1.08 kilometers, and an area of 0.03 square kilometers. Liansan Island is mainly composed of three small islands that are connected by rising tides and separated by falling tides. The rising tides are separated, and the three islands stand proudly, while the falling tides make them stand shoulder to shoulder, working together as one, which is truly remarkable. Three small islands are arranged in a straight line, from north to south, from big to small, like three huge pearls extending deep into the South China Sea. The scenery of Liansan Island is unique, the environment is beautiful, there are more than ten kinds of strange stones, and seaweed is scattered on the rocks. The surrounding waters are rich in sea treasures such as yellow croaker, blackhead fish, eight banded fish, sea cucumber, abalone, etc., making it a good place for people to fish. Liansan Island is now not only a breeding base, but also a popular tourist destination for Chinese and foreign friends.
