attractions.name_en: hai shi shan meng · an nuo bie shu

attractions.name: 青岛极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Qingdao Polar Ocean Park is a national AAAA level scenic spot located at No. 60 Donghai East Road, Laoshan District, Qingdao City. It is situated in the core coastal tourism belt of Laoshan, facing the Yellow Sea, backed by Fushan Mountain, adjacent to Sculpture Garden, Shilaoren Beach, and Wheat Island Park, facing the sea on three sides. With beautiful scenery and convenient transportation, it is a polar ocean themed park that integrates ocean display, cultural tourism experience, science education, and animal conservation. The Qingdao Polar Ocean Park consists of five major venues: the Polar Ocean Pavilion, the Horizon Theater, the Deep Sea Fantasy Jellyfish Secret Realm, the Polar Legend Ice and Snow Experience Pavilion, and the 360 ° Ball Screen Cinema. Combined with the Whale Joy Square in the center of the park, it creates a unique and joyful ocean cube in Shandong Province. Immersed in it, you can observe polar animals such as beluga whales, dolphins, walruses, polar bears up close, as well as over 50000 marine creatures such as hawksbill turtles, sand tiger sharks, golden scads, swallow rays, jellyfish, and seahorses. Not only that, there are six major performances including "Whale and Dolphin Show", "White Whale Love", "Deep Sea Mermaid Show", "Sea Lion Legend - Pava", "Scientific Magic Show", and "Magic Ocean"; The seven internet famous check-in areas of 360 ° fully transparent dreamy jellyfish tunnel, underwater tunnel, beluga whale exhibition tank, deep-sea migration pool, ocean cute main gallery, flowing light goldfish bay, and whale joy square combine real ocean scenes with artificial scenery, allowing you to "come to the polar regions and leave memories", feel the fantasy and charm of the ocean, and harvest the wonderful experience of "crossing the North and South Poles in a day and receiving countless surprises". 1、 Five Theme Pavilions 1. Polar Aquarium: Tens of thousands of marine animals from the North and South Poles live here, crossing the poles in one stop, encountering deep blue secrets, and experiencing the joy of countless ocean "whales". 2. Sea level theater: Watch a fun competition of walruses and sea lions in an outdoor theater overlooking the sea. The LED giant screen and all-round audio-visual effects bring an extraordinary visual feast. 3. attractions.name: 青岛海泉湾度假区
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Haiquanwan Ocean Hot Spring is the only theme park-style ocean hot spring with entertainment and health functions and marine culture as its theme. 
Haiquan Bay Resort City relies on the two scarce resources of nearly 1,000 meters of golden beach and ocean hot spring in Aoshan Bay. Resort hotels, various restaurants and bars with Mediterranean style spread along the sea, so that tourists can fully appreciate the beach and seascape. The hot spring bathing center with more than 30,000 square meters is designed with a natural landscape combined with mountains, garden trails, flowing water, waterfalls and pools, as well as European, Japanese and Korean styles.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy romantic European-style castle hotel

attractions.name: 青岛海泉湾•海洋之星摩天轮
attractions.name_en: Qingdao Haiquan Bay • Ocean Star Ferris Wheel
attractions.summary: The Qingdao Ocean Spring Bay • Ocean Star Ferris Wheel is located in the Harbour China Travel Service Ocean Spring Bay Resort. The Ocean Star Ferris Wheel is 88 meters high and has 54 suspended observation cabins, making it the tallest Ferris wheel in Qingdao at present. The Ocean Star stands tall and straight on the shore of Aoshan Bay, just like the May wind on Fushan Bay, telling people from afar that this is Qingdao. Sitting on the Ferris wheel, one can take in a panoramic view of a thousand mile golden beach, with thousands of hectares of ocean waves rushing back and forth.

attractions.name: 藏马山国际旅游度假区
attractions.summary: Qingdao Zangma Mountain International Tourism Resort combines natural beauty with a variety of recreational facilities. Here, there are various European style villas and small buildings, estate landscapes full of European style, as well as amusement parks, RV campsites, etc. In addition to enjoying the beautiful scenery, you can also experience leisure estate life firsthand. When you arrive here, the first thing that catches your eye is the beautiful blueberry town. Various European style small buildings are neatly arranged, and every decoration is full of design and romance. There is also a 2000 acre high-quality blueberry sightseeing and picking garden for tourists to pick. Millennium Valley is a large amusement park here and also a popular place in the entire scenic area. It offers gliding experiences and sightseeing planes. Paying in the air for this beautiful Tibetan horse mountain is sure to have a unique flavor. There are also camping and recreational facilities such as RVs here. There is also a horse riding enthusiast's amusement park called the Royal Racecourse in Zangma Mountain, where there are various experiential activities such as equestrian performances, competitions, and horseback riding. In winter, you can also experience the ski resort here. Of course, in addition to the beautiful scenery, there are also many delicious foods here. On the folk street, you can find almost all kinds of specialty snacks from all over the country.

attractions.name: 青岛动物园
attractions.summary: Qingdao Zoo founded an animal cage in 1915, and formed a small zoo in 1930s. Since then, it has continued to develop, and by the early 1960s, it has reached considerable scale. In 1977, Qingdao Zoo was built on the southwest side of Taiping Mountain. After 10 years, 18 unique animal houses, such as Ape Pavilion, Orangutan Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Bird Cage, Songbird Pavilion, Liger Mountain and Children's Pet Garden, were gradually built, with hundreds of species of animals on display.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the unique ape museum

attractions.name: 太平山景区
attractions.summary: Qingdao Taipingshan Central Park is located within the Qingdao Scenic Area, abbreviated as Taipingshan Central Park. Taiping Mountain Central Park has included seven parks including Zhongshan Park, Botanical Garden, Zoo, Julin Park, Qingdao Mountain Park, Baihua Garden, and Huiquan Square. The Central Park scenic area is divided into 18 parks, including waterfront landscape area, children's playground area, main entrance area of the park, pre meeting village ruins park, osmanthus garden, city garden, magnolia garden, peony garden, greenhouse viewing area, bonsai garden, "Peach Blossom Spring" scenic area, "Lake and Mountain Scenery" scenic area, Dujuanpo, tea garden, valley amusement area, rock garden, boutique garden, and plum blossom valley.

attractions.name: 青岛红树林度假世界
attractions.summary: Qingdao Mangrove Resort World is located on Binhai Avenue, near Huanghe Road. The total area is 800000 square meters, with 5 hotels of different styles, allowing for intimate contact with the sea within less than 100 meters.

attractions.name: 灵山岛
attractions.summary: Lingshan Island is located in Lingshan Bay, southeast of Huangdao District, Qingdao City. It is isolated from the world and has a primitive way of life and natural island scenery. You can also experience the fisherman's style here through various ways of play. To enter and exit Lingshan Island, one needs to take a boat. After arriving on the island, one can rent a boat for sea fishing, usually heading to the northeast coast of the island. It is said that someone caught over a hundred mackerel there in a day, and some people caught about thirty pounds of large sea bass. The variety of seafood on the island is very rich. When the tide falls at night, you can find many spicy snails, eccentric snails, etc. at the Stone Beach in the north of the island. The mountain treasures here are even more delicious, and CCTV's "Beautiful Chinese Countryside Tour" was filmed because of this. Lingshan Island is located in the open sea with minimal pollution, and most local residents still maintain their traditional way of life. The visibility here is high, and the starry sky at night is particularly beautiful, attracting countless astronomy enthusiasts to come here. In addition, there are also attractions such as Beilai Stone and Tiger Mouth on the island that can be enjoyed together.

attractions.name: 崂山
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Kid-friendly hidden gems; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Qingdao, Mount Laoshan is known as the "First Famous Mountain on the Sea." Its highest peak, Jufeng, rises to about 1,133 meters above sea level. The mountain is famous for its grandeur, magnificence, uniqueness, and beauty, and is a renowned Taoist sacred mountain.
- The Taoist temples of Laoshan, the sunrise, and the sea of clouds are all highly famous; the southern route includes Liqing River and Yakou; the eastern route leads to Yangkou; the central route passes through Beijiushui; visitors arriving by sea mainly explore the Taiqing and Shangqing scenic areas.
- The Laoshan Mountaineering Festival is held every April; the Laoshan Cherry Blossom Festival takes place every May, attracting large numbers of tourists and creating a lively atmosphere.
- In late March every year, the cherry blossoms bloom all over Laoshan, turning the entire area into a sea of flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciating the red leaves and sunset glow at a famous Taoist mountain.

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 寿字峰
attractions.summary:
The huge stone wall of "Shou Zi Peak" is engraved with the words "Shou" of all sizes. 
Chinese people's pursuit of longevity has a long history. Throughout the ages, from Qin Shihuang sending Xu Fu to the east to look for the elixir of immortality, to Tang Xuanzong sending Sun Tan to Laoshan Mountain to collect medicine and alchemy, and then to generations of Taoists in Laoshan Mountain to cultivate Taoism and keep in good health, until today, people wish their elders health and longevity, which shows the position of the word "longevity" in people's minds. 
The word "Shou" written by ancient and modern Chinese calligraphers in different fonts is engraved on the peak of Shou, including Li, Seal, Xing, Cao, Kai and other fonts. It forms a spectacular picture of a hundred longevity on the huge rock wall, and it is also a calligraphy exhibition of the word "Shou". We can enjoy the art of calligraphy while enjoying the strange peaks and valleys. Among them, the very eye-catching, vigorous and dignified word "Shou" is 20 meters high and 16 meters wide. Shen Peng, president of the Chinese Calligraphers Association, is happy to write "the longest life in the world", which can be called "the longest life in China", which means "long life, long life, long life and long life". Many tourists come here, and they like to take photos with the word "longevity" as the background. First, they keep it as a souvenir of the tour, and second, they pray that they will be accompanied by "longevity".

attractions.name: 狮子峰
attractions.summary: Lion Peak is like a strong and mighty male lion towering over the vast sea, hence it is called "Lion Peak". Lion Peak is backed by mountains and facing the sea, with majestic clouds. The huge mouth opened by the "Lion" can accommodate more than ten people at the same time. Between the upper and lower jaws of the lion's mouth, due to the erosion of wind and rain, the rock particles are uneven, forming countless "teeth" that are very realistic. By passing through the cave under the lion's rib, one can climb onto the lion's back. This is an ideal place to watch the sunrise over the sea, and has always been a place for literati to express their thoughts. If in the early morning, the clouds and mist have not yet opened and the white clouds are lingering, standing in the distance to see Lion Peak, it is another wonderful sight: cloud blocks float around the waist of Lion Peak Mountain, waves of sea breeze blow, cloud blocks flow like flowing water and clouds, like rough waves. Looking at that lion again, in the rolling sea of clouds, it seemed like it was about to leap with its claws, its huge mouth opening wide, swallowing clouds and exhaling mist, and howling long into the sky. This landscape is called "Shiling Hengyun" and is one of the "Famous Twelve Scenic Spots of Laoshan Mountain". There are many ancient poems from the Ming and Qing dynasties carved on the top and surrounding stone walls of Lion Peak, which are also of great ornamental value.

attractions.name: 觅天洞
attractions.summary:
· Mitian Cave is made up of many boulders in the cracks between two big cliffs. It looks artificial, but it is not artificial. It is a natural strange cave from bottom to top, with a strange configuration and unique style. 
The strange cave of Mitian is divided into five floors from bottom to top. The cave is twisting, strange, thrilling and blurred, which can be described as a combination of strange, secluded, dangerous and interesting. 
· It is said that in the early years, local people hid in caves to avoid soldiers, which could accommodate hundreds of people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Natural strange caves from bottom to top

attractions.name: 天苑
attractions.summary: Tianyuan is the highest peak in Yangkou, and the best place to enjoy the scenery of Yangkou mountains and seas. You need to cross the Mitian Cave to climb it. It is said that it is the back garden of the Queen Mother.

attractions.name: 会场赶海园
attractions.summary: You can dig up various shellfish on the beach, and the secret is that by seeing the small holes on the beach, you will know that there must be small creatures below. Remember to bring rain boots when you come here. Not only can you play on the beach, take beautiful photos, but you can also enjoy the beautiful sunset scenery.

attractions.name: 青山村
attractions.summary: Qingshan Village is located in Qingdao, Shandong Province, China. It is a small village full of natural scenery and traditional culture. This place is renowned for its beautiful scenery, fresh air, and rich cultural heritage, making it an ideal destination for tourists to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and get closer to nature.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 崂山太清游览区
attractions.summary: The Taiqing Scenic Area is located at the southeast end of Laoshan Mountain, named after the Taoist temple Taiqing Palace. It is mainly divided into two tourist areas: the surrounding area of Taiqing Palace and along the Bashui River. The former is located by the sea, while the latter is a hiking route. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 佛顶宫
attractions.summary:
Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 夫子庙大成殿
attractions.summary:
Dacheng Hall of Confucius Temple is the main hall of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. The largest portrait of Confucius in China hangs in the center of the hall. 
The furnishings in the hall imitate fifteen kinds of ancient musical instruments such as chimes and chimes 2,500 years ago, and regularly perform ancient songs and elegant music. 
The main hall is surrounded by murals of Confucius' achievements, with both form and spirit. The temple is surrounded by two stele galleries, and there are thirty original inscriptions of Mo Bao written by famous calligraphers such as Zhao Puchu, Lin Sanzhi, Shen Peng and Wu Zhongqi on the wall. 
The stele gallery displays the Yuhua Stone exhibition, which is known as "the unique thing in China". Exhibitions of other historical relics and works of art are often organized in Dacheng Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Offering Sacrifices and Understanding Confucius' Hall

attractions.name: 中国科举博物馆(江南贡院)
attractions.summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

attractions.name: 王导谢安纪念馆
attractions.summary: The Wang Dao Xie An Memorial Hall is located in Wuyi Lane on the south bank of the Qinhuai River at the Confucius Temple in Nanjing. It is a thematic exhibition hall that showcases the culture and art of the Six Dynasties and the family backgrounds of Wang and Xie. There are buildings such as Laiyan Hall and Jianjin Tower in the museum, displaying precious cultural relics from the Six Dynasties period. This was once the barracks of the Jianye Forbidden Army, the capital of Eastern Wu. Because soldiers were dressed in black at that time, the alley was named "Wuyi", and to this day, there is still a glimpse of the "Wuyi Well" in the alley. During the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Wuyi Lane was a residential area for high-ranking officials and nobles in the imperial court. The houses in the alley are towering and arranged in rows. During the Six Dynasties period, representative figures of the Wang Xie family, including Wang Dao and Xie An, lived here. During the Tang Dynasty, Liu Yuxi visited this place and wrote the timeless masterpiece "Wild grass and flowers by Zhuque Bridge, sunset slanting at the entrance of Wuyi Lane. In the past, swallows flew into ordinary people's homes in front of Wang Xietang".
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-22:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 李香君故居
attractions.summary: The story of Li Xiangjun and the talented scholar Hou Fangyu is well-known in the ancient capital of the Six Dynasties. Naturally, when you come to this land of golden powder in the Six Dynasties, how can you not read the legend of the Eight Beauties of Qinhuai? The former residence of Li Xiangjun, also known as the "Meixiang Tower", is a typical Qing Dynasty river hall and river house building with three entrances and two courtyards. The style is exquisite and elegant, displaying some ancient calligraphy, painting, seal carving, and also restoring Li Xiangjun's living conditions at that time. Let's unfold 'Peach Blossom Fan' and reminisce about the entanglement of a chaotic era. The Li Xiangjun Former Residence Exhibition Hall is located at the southern end of Laiyan Bridge in Confucius Temple, at No. 38 Chaoku Street. The hall faces south and north, with three entrances and two courtyards, facing the food street, backed by the Qinhuai River, with blue bricks and small tiles, horsehead walls, hanging corridors, and lattice windows. It is a typical Jiangnan residential style. There are sedan halls, information halls, Meixianglou former residence exhibitions, tea culture, fan culture exhibition halls, calligraphy and painting exhibition rooms, river halls, ancient water gates, etc. in the museum. The Meixiang Tower in the museum is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit with a history of more than 300 years. It is the former residence of the famous Li Xiangjun in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. Li Xiangjun, who rebelled against the Qing and restored the Ming dynasty, spared no effort to maintain national integrity by touching the pillar with his head and performing a tragic drama with a blood splatter fan, which is admired by future generations. The former residence currently has a boudoir, study, living room, and piano room. The river hall of Meixiang Building is also a representative building. The carved beams and painted rafters in the hall are exquisite and vivid. Each work has auspicious meanings, has a strong atmosphere of Ming and folk culture, and is well preserved.

attractions.name: 秦大士故居
attractions.summary: The former residence of Qin Dashi is a well preserved former residence of the top scholar in Nanjing. It was originally a mansion bestowed by Emperor Chongzhen of the late Ming Dynasty to Grand Secretary He Ruchong. Qin Dashi originally lived in Qin Zhuangyuan Lane. After retiring in the 28th year of the Qianlong reign, he still lived in his original residence. Seven years later, he bought this mansion and the old residence in Qin Zhuangyuan Lane was converted into the Qin Family Ancestral Hall. The entire building of Qin Zhuangyuan Mansion originally had five roads and nine entrances, stretching south to Changle Road, north to Chaoku Street, east to Pipa Lane, west to Wuding Bridge, and a garden behind it. It was named "Zhan Garden" after Ouyang Xiu of the Song Dynasty, who said, "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky. The park is lush with trees, with towering rockeries. There was originally a "Hundred Sons Living Together Hall" in the mansion, surrounded by four types of trees: cypress, catalpa, paulownia, and reed. This is a representative building of the Nanjing Prefecture during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Qin Dashi was the top scholar during the Qianlong period (1714-1777), with the courtesy names Luyi, Jianquan, Jianquan, and Qiutian Laoren. He once served as a trial lecturer to teach the prince how to read. He was proficient in seal script, clerical script, cursive script, regular script, and calligraphy, and his works of poetry and painting were considered excellent. He was commissioned by Emperor Qianlong to write the "Selected Works of the Ming Dynasty". The calligraphy art of the Qing Dynasty saw great development. Many calligraphers have emerged, and the stars are brilliant. The famous calligraphy critic of the Qing Dynasty, Bao Shidou, selected 91 calligraphers from the Qing Dynasty in his book "Yizhou Shuangji", among whom was Qin Dashi. It can be seen that the calligraphy of Qin Dashi was highly regarded during the Qing Dynasty. The current collection includes twelve calligraphy stone tablets by Qin Dashi, which were written by him after his retirement from office and were approximately between the 34th and 41st years of the Qianlong reign. The font size is uniform, the layout is neat, yet each has its own form and spirit, and all styles are well prepared, pleasing to the eye.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

restaurants.name_en: Mengzhiyuan Ancient Method Hot Pot Mutton

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 西安事变旧址五间厅
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity
attractions.summary:
Wujianting is located in Huaqing Pool Scenic Area in Lintong, Xi'an, which is one of the famous sites of Xi'an Incident in history. 
Built in the late Qing Dynasty, it is a brick and wood hall. 
It is adjacent to Lishan Mountain in the south and Lotus Pond in the north. The courtyard is flat and the trees are lush. It is named Five Halls because it is connected by five single rooms.  
On the glass windows and walls of the five halls, there are still bullet marks from the fierce battle between soldiers and remonstrance. 
· Desks, chairs, beds, sofas, tea sets, stoves, carpets, telephones, etc. used in offices in each room are copied and placed as they were originally.
attractions.shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure hall
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:20; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院秦陵铜车马
attractions.name_en: Bronze Chariot and Horse of Qinling
attractions.summary: Copper chariots and horses were discovered 20 meters west of the imperial tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang. These are two large painted bronze chariots and horses, one in front and one behind, placed in a wooden coffin. Although it was crushed by soil when unearthed, there were no major changes in its original position, and the components of the chariot and horse were basically complete. This is a bronze chariot and horse that was discovered early, large in size, and well preserved in the history of archaeology in China. Archaeologists have restored it and it was exhibited to the public in 1983. Copper chariots and horses were one of the burial objects of Emperor Qin Shi Huang, symbolizing a part of his royal carriage. The copper chariot and horse are made by reducing the proportion of half of the real copper chariot and horse. The car cover and the interior and exterior of the carriage are painted with exquisite patterns, and the gold and silver decorations on top weigh up to 14 kilograms. The No.1 copper chariot is a standing chariot, also known as a tall chariot. The carriage is rectangular in shape with a single shaft and two wheels. The doors are located at the back of the carriage, and there is a circular copper umbrella on the carriage. Under the umbrella stands the imperial official, who controls the carriage with both hands and drives four horses in front. The carriage was equipped with weapons such as copper crossbows, copper shields, and copper arrowheads, which played a role in opening roads, guarding, and launching expeditions in the emperor's convoy. The second car is an Anche and also has a single shaft and two wheels. The total weight is 1241 kilograms, assembled from 3462 components of different sizes. The carriage consists of two compartments, one front and one rear, with windows between them. The door for boarding is located at the back and has an oval shaped hood. It is a precious bronze artifact unearthed in China, with complete equipment, high grade, and exquisite craftsmanship.

attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. Full text 

attractions.name: 西安千古情
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. Roaming through the boundless universe, gazing up at the dazzling starry sky, shuttling through the fantastic jungle... Couples, friends, parents, and families can all check in for fun and exciting outings. The large-scale interactive experience project 'Yan'an Defense Battle' is a magnificent battle of mountains and rivers, a journey to purify the soul, and together we enter the 'battlefield', remembering history and cherishing peace! There are dozens of performing arts shows in the scenic area, such as "Spinning Drum Dance", "Flower Dance", "National Style Flash Show", "Hairpin Flower Ladies", etc. There is always one that suits you. Xi'an Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! Full text 

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 断桥残雪
attractions.summary:
It is the meeting place of Xu Xian and White Lady in The Legend of the New White Lady, which adds a lot of romantic color to this long bridge. 
At the beginning of winter snow, the snow and ice on the sunny side of the bridge melt, but the shady side is still covered with residual snow. From a height, the bridge seems to be broken but not broken, forming the famous "broken bridge with residual snow". 
It can be used as the starting point for visiting the West Lake, from Baidi on the Broken Bridge to Gushan, and then visit various scenic spots around the West Lake in turn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Xu Xian and White Snake met on the broken bridge

attractions.name: 曲院风荷
attractions.name_en: Quyuan Fenghe (Lotus in the Breeze at Crooked Courtyard)
attractions.summary:
One of the ten scenic spots of the West Lake, hundreds of varieties of lotus flowers are cultivated in Fenghe Park, where it is located, which is particularly attractive in summer. 
In the Southern Song Dynasty, there was a wine-making workshop here, which took streams to make koji wine. Whenever the wind blows in summer, the fragrance of wine and lotus is refreshing, so it is called "Quyuan Fenghe".  
· Lotus leaves and fields are enchanting, and small bridges of different shapes are erected on the water. People cross the bridges, like walking in the lotus flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lotus flowers are different red in summer

attractions.name: 杭州西湖观荷区
attractions.summary: The West Lake Lotus Viewing Area in Hangzhou is a famous scenic spot within the West Lake Scenic Area, known for its summer blooming lotus flowers. This is one of the best places to admire lotus flowers, where tourists can enjoy various varieties of lotus flowers and experience the natural beauty and peaceful atmosphere of West Lake.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 乌龟潭
attractions.summary:
Come out from the side of Yanggong Embankment and go north. After crossing Jingxing Bridge, you can see the lake area connected to the West Lake on the west side, which is Wugui Pond. It is named after a hill in the pool that looks like a turtle from a high place (such as Santai Pavilion). The scenery here is beautiful and quiet, with open water surface, natural revetment, surrounding natural mountains immersed in water, and a wide variety of aquatic wet plants, woody flowering plants and berry plants in the middle and middle layers, forming a rich landscape level. Small islands stand in the water and are connected with the waterfront by garden bridges and pavilion bridges. No matter how crowded Su Causeway and Bai Causeway are, it is still quiet here, with few tourists. 
Guitan is one of the places with the longest cherry blossoms in Hangzhou. Everyone's favorite "Three Heroes of Late Cherry Blossoms" will be the finale of the whole cherry blossom season in Hangzhou.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display the historical, natural and ecological landscape of West Lake

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 龙门古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for stroller walks; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary: Longmen Ancient Town is a national 4A-level tourist attraction, located on the beautiful southern bank of the Fuchun River. The town boasts a picturesque environment. Over 90% of the residents have the surname Sun, making it the largest settlement of descendants of Sun Quan, the Emperor of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period. The town has a rich historical and cultural heritage, retaining a strong clan atmosphere and unique local customs. The ancient town's layout is complex, with a defensive, fan-shaped network of streets and alleys as its framework. The clan halls and courtyards are connected, and the alleys interlink, creating a maze-like traditional residential settlement. It is the most complete and rare example of ancient Ming and Qing architectural clusters in the rural countryside of southern Jiangnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie *Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains*

attractions.name: 小河直街历史文化街区
attractions.name_en: Xiaohe Straight Street Historical and Cultural Block
attractions.summary:
· Xiaohezhijie Historic District is located at the intersection of Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, Xiaohe and Yuhangtang River. 
Original old houses, rarely renovated, still have many "old Hangzhou" living today, with a strong flavor of life. 
It is recommended to go to Fang Zengchang Sauce Garden, No.15 Xiaohezhi Street, and take a photo with the word "sauce". It is said that it used to be the largest pickle factory in Xiaohe area. 
There are many cafes, tea bars, mahjong shops and noodle shops along the way. Find a small tea shop opened by local residents, and visit the quaint courtyard along the way.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historical relics such as workshops and shops are retained

attractions.name: 九溪十八涧
attractions.summary: Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams are located in the mountains west of West Lake, winding seven kilometers from Longjing into Qiantang River. The scenery of Jiuxi and Eighteen Streams is natural, with little craftsmanship. Every tourist who has visited here likes the peaceful and pleasant scenery.

attractions.name: 龙井村
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Longjing Village is located in the southwest of West Lake Scenic Area, surrounded by mountains on all sides, showing a trend of high in the north and low in the south. It has nearly 800 mu of alpine tea gardens. 
The northwest peak, Lion Peak and Tianzhu Peak in the northwest of the village form a natural barrier to block the cold wind from the northwest. There is Jiuxi in the south, and the valley is deep and wide, which leads directly to Qiantang River. The southeast wind in spring and summer is easy to enter the valley. The geographical conditions of ventilation and ventilation provide unique advantages for the growth of Longjing tea. Longjing tea produced here ranks first among "lion, dragon, cloud and tiger". 
· According to legend, when Emperor Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River, he went to Hugong Temple at the foot of Shifeng Mountain in Longjing Village to taste West Lake Longjing tea. After drinking, he was full of praise, and named the eighteen tea trees in front of the temple "Imperial Tea". Longjing Village, the "first village in tea township", is famous for its abundance of top-class West Lake Longjing tea. 
It is bordered by Xizi Lake in the east, Wuyun Mountain in the west, Qiantang River in the south, and the north and south peaks inserted into the clouds in the north. It is surrounded by green mountains and clouds, just like an emerald gemstone inlaid on the shores of Xizi Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: "The First Village of Tea Township"

attractions.name: 龙井茶田
attractions.summary: Located at the western foothills of Wengjia Mountain, west of West Lake. Longjing was originally named Longhong, and during the Jin Dynasty, Ge Hong practiced alchemy here. Longjing is a circular spring pool that never dries up in severe drought. Ancient people believed that this spring was connected to the sea and contained dragons, hence the name Longjing. About 500 meters away from Longjing, there is Longjing Temple in Luohuiwu, commonly known as Old Longjing. It was founded in the Later Han Dynasty of the Five Dynasties and was originally named Baoguo Kanjingyuan. During the Northern Song Dynasty, it was renamed Shoushengyuan. During the Southern Song Dynasty, it was renamed Guangfuyuan and Yan'en Yanqing Temple. In the third year of the Ming Dynasty's Zhengtong reign (1438), it was relocated to Jingpan, and now the temple has been abandoned and is secluded as a tea room. The water of Longjing Spring is composed of two parts: groundwater and surface water. The proportion of groundwater is relatively high, so groundwater is below and surface water is above. If a rod is used to stir the spring water in the well, the spring water below will flip to the surface. Forming a circle of dividing water lines, when the underground spring water sinks again, the dividing water lines gradually shrink until they disappear, which is very interesting.

attractions.name: 满觉陇
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn flowers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Juelong, also known as Manlong and Manjialong, is located in the south of the West Lake in Hangzhou, a valley at the southern foot of the southern peak. In the fourth year of Tianfu in the later Jin Dynasty (AD 939), Yuanxing Courtyard was built, and in the second year of Zhiping in the Northern Song Dynasty (AD 1065), it was changed to Manjue Courtyard. Manjue means "perfect consciousness", and the place was named after the temple. 
Juelong is famous for its sweet-scented osmanthus. Every autumn, sweet-scented osmanthus blooms, the fragrance fills the empty mountains, and falls like rain, so it has the reputation of "Manlong Guiyu". In 1985, "Manlong Guiyu" was rated as one of the ten scenic spots of the New West Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Longguiyu, you can have a panoramic view of the tea garden scenery

restaurants.name_en: The same home in the west lake

attractions.name: 青秀山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.

attractions.name: 广西民族博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.
attractions.shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.

attractions.name: 西关夜市街
attractions.summary: Xiguan Night Market Street is located on Chaoyang Road in Xingning District, with a length of about three to four hundred meters. It is lined with food stalls from various places. Xiguan Night Market Street is one of the busiest night markets in Nanning, with a nearby New Heping Clothing Wholesale City.

attractions.name: 相思小镇
attractions.summary: Nanning Xiangsi Town, formerly known as Xiangsi Lake Red Bean Style Street, is located next to Xiangsi Lake Park in Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. It is a newly-built scenic area mainly composed of southern and ethnic style buildings, as well as leisure, entertainment, sightseeing, and romantic dating. There are ancient style houses standing tall in the small town, and every snap of them is a national style blockbuster. Full text 

attractions.name: 三街两巷文化艺术中心
attractions.summary: The Three Streets and Two Alleys Cultural and Art Center is located in Xingning District, Nanning City, where historical buildings such as the Jinshi Lane residential complex, the former site of Guangxi High Court, the martyrdom site of Su Xi, the magistrate of Yongzhou, Chenghuang Temple, Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall, etc. are preserved. It is a comprehensive neighborhood that integrates historical culture and modern commerce. Not only does it preserve the ancient architectural complex of Nanning, but it also gathers numerous specialty restaurants and cultural and creative shops. This scenic spot is suitable for sightseeing both day and night, especially at night, where you can intuitively experience the local customs and traditions of Nanning in the unique atmosphere created by colorful lights.

attractions.name: 南宁亭子码头
attractions.summary: Tingzi Wharf is backed by Tingzi Binjiang Park and is one of the nine cultural zones along the 85 kilometer Yongjiang River comprehensive renovation and development project. It is the finishing touch of the hundred mile beautiful Yongjiang River renovation project that the Nanning Municipal Government is striving to create.

attractions.name: 伊岭岩
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Geological Sites; Caves
attractions.summary: Located 21 kilometers from Nanning city, it is a typical Karst limestone cave. Before entering the cave to admire the rock formations, visitors can enjoy a folk performance from the Zhuang ethnic group. Inside the cave, there are remarkable limestone formations such as "Double Lions Welcoming Guests" and "Seaside Park." This is a journey where your imagination will play a key role, and the full tour takes about two hours. If you have more time, you can also visit the nearby Yiling Cave and Lingshui Scenic Area; however, if you are short on time and have already visited large caves, it is not recommended to go.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Karst caves in the outskirts of Nanning.

attractions.name: 沈阳故宫
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids; Palaces; Museums
attractions.summary:
· Also known as the Shenyang Imperial Palace of the Qing Dynasty, it is one of the two most complete ancient palace complexes remaining in China and an ancient site rich in historical and cultural significance.  
· There are 114 ancient buildings, over 500 rooms, and numerous precious cultural relics from the Ming and Qing dynasties displayed in various exhibition halls, all well-preserved to this day.  
· The entire palace is imposing and magnificent, with every corner reflecting the grandeur of the royal family. Its unique architectural style of "high palaces and low halls" is unparalleled in Chinese palace architecture history.  
· There are two baggage storage areas and two service stations, located at the entrances of Daqingmen and Siwenmen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Taste the Palaces and Cultural Relics of the Ming and Qing Dynasties.

attractions.name: 张学良旧居
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Famous Residences; Museums
attractions.summary:
