- It is the residence and private home of Zhang Zuolin and his eldest son, General Zhang Xueliang, and it is the best-preserved celebrity residence in Northeast China.
- Inside the various buildings, there are photographs, wax figures, and various items once used by the Zhang father and son, showcasing their life trajectories.
- The luxurious mansion contains numerous stone carvings, wood carvings, brick carvings, murals, and many priceless calligraphic works by the Zhang family, all of which are well worth appreciating.

attractions.name: 辽宁省博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary: The Liaoning Provincial Museum is the best place to learn about the history of the provincial capital. As one of China's large art and history museums, it houses national treasures such as the Shang Dynasty bronze ding with a beast face and taotie pattern, and a duck-shaped zun from the Western Zhou Dynasty. Visitors can also explore exhibits of ancient ethnic relics unique to the Liao River culture, such as those of the Khitan, Manchu, and Xianbei peoples, as well as occasional temporary exhibitions of precious treasures, such as the Tang Dynasty painting "Lady with Hairpin" (簪花仕女图), the only surviving wild cursive work by the great Tang calligrapher Zhang Xu, "Four Poems in Cursive Script" (古诗四帖), Ouyang Xun's "Dream Dedication" (梦奠帖), and Zhao Ji (Emperor Huizong of the Song Dynasty)'s "Auspicious Cranes" (瑞鹤图). Each of these is sure to bring you surprises and insights.
attractions.shortFeatures: The collection includes numerous historical and artistic artifacts.

attractions.name: 老北市
attractions.summary: Laobei City Cultural Park, located in the North Market of Shenyang City, was transformed from the original Laobei City Mall. The time span is mainly the Qing Dynasty, the Republic of China and the puppet Manchukuo period. The first and second floors of the park operate specialty restaurants and cultural clubs respectively. On the north side, a new Silver Brick Avenue will be built, where time-honored specialty restaurants will be gathered, and on the south side, aquariums, antique jewelry, bars and other clubs will be operated. There are about 160 mobile characteristic kiosks in the two horizontal and two vertical inner streets of the park, which operate folk handicrafts, tourist souvenirs, flavored snacks and other characteristic formats. The third floor of the cultural park is the Old Shenyang Museum of Urban Memory, which will display Shenyang's history and culture and Kanto's characteristic folk culture, and display Shenyang's historical relics, folk artworks and living objects. There are eight exhibition halls, including source memory, Shengjing memory, Fengtian memory, black memory, red memory, time-honored brand memory, old north city memory and folk memory.

restaurants.name_en: Ouyang Family Spring Pancake Home style Cuisine

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 老门东牌坊
attractions.summary: The Old Gate East memorial archway is the main entrance of the Old Gate East Historic District, which is a landmark building here. A stone tablet below the memorial archway is engraved with the history of Nanjing City, which has a lot of historical and cultural details.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 双塔寺
attractions.summary: The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

attractions.name: 太原北齐壁画博物馆
attractions.summary: The Taiyuan Northern Qi Mural Museum is located in Yingze District, Taiyuan City. It has exhibition halls and a mural restoration research center. It mainly has sections such as site overview, digital exhibition, cultural and museum lecture hall, etc. It displays Xu Xianxiu's tomb murals, such as patterns of cattle, horses, weapons, etc.

attractions.name: 太原植物园
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 蒙山大佛
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Historical Ruins; Historical Sites; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
· The Mount Meng Giant Buddha, also known as the West Mountain Giant Buddha, was originally a cliff-side Buddha statue behind the Kaihua Temple on Mount Meng. It was destroyed during the late Yuan Dynasty.
· In 1980, the Mount Meng Giant Buddha was rediscovered. By the time of its discovery, the Buddha's head was missing, and the body was buried in soil and stone, severely weathered.
· The height from the bottom of the legs to the neck is about 30 meters, while the original height was approximately 46 meters. The current Buddha head was carved by later generations.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Thousand-Year-Old Buddha in the suburbs of Taiyuan.

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场音乐喷泉
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square Music Fountain
attractions.summary: The Music Fountain of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, also known as the Xi'an Music Fountain, is located on the central axis of the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda. The Music Fountain Square consists of water feature fountains, cultural squares, garden landscapes, cultural corridors, and tourism and commercial facilities. It is an important Tang culture square in China. There are a large number of sculptures and statues on the square. While enjoying the music fountain, it is also a good choice to savor these sculptures carefully. The music fountain is divided into three areas: a hundred meter waterfall pool, an eight level waterfall pool, and a front-end music pool. The eight level variable frequency array in the eight level cascade pool is the largest array in the world, with 1024 nozzle points, which can transform into various water types such as mountains and seas, lotus flowers, vast clouds, seagulls spreading their wings, butterflies falling in love with flowers, water mist, etc., shining brightly and beautifully. In the large laser water curtain, which is 60 meters wide and over 20 meters high, four fountains spray out from the water, fully burning and exploding at a low temperature at a height of 6 meters, further enhancing the awe inspiring power of the entire fountain.

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 永兴坊
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

restaurants.name_en: Silk Road Restaurant, Angsana Hotel & Spa

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 湄公河·六国水上市场
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Water Activities; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The floating market project shows the unique cultural customs of the six countries in the Mekong River Basin (China, Laos, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia and Vietnam), and creates relevant life scenes in the six countries (mainly Dai and Thai). It is the only floating market with Southeast Asian customs in China. Visitors can also shuttle through the floating market by boat and experience the floating market by boating.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bustling market with Southeast Asian sentiment

attractions.name: 景洪市大金塔寺
attractions.name_en: The Great Pagoda Temple of Jinghong
attractions.summary: Jinghong Pagoda, also known as Myanmar Pagoda, is located next to the roundabout of Xuanwei Avenue in Jiangbei section of Cangjiang New District, Jinghong City. The Jinghong Golden Pagoda stands at 66.6 meters tall, symbolizing the connection of one river to six countries. The four small pagodas are solid pagodas, while the large pagoda serves as the Beiye Jing Museum. It has two levels of usable space and four entrances in the east, west, north, and south directions. Around the central tower pillar, there is a worship of Zhou Buddha for visitors to pray for blessings.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 西双版纳傣族园
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
- Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park is composed of five well-preserved Dai natural villages, namely Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga.
- Upon entering the park, the first thing you encounter is the Welcome Square, where you are greeted by warm-hearted Dai people performing welcome dances, singing blessings, and sprinkling water for good wishes.
- The park also houses the Manchunman Ancient Buddhist Temple, one of the oldest temples in Xishuangbanna, with a history of over 1,400 years. Every day, you can hear the sound of chanting inside the temple.
- The grandest festival for the Dai people in Xishuangbanna is the Water-Splashing Festival. At the Water-Splashing Square in the Dai Ethnic Park, you can experience the lively scenes of the festival every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Accept the warm welcome dance of the Dai people.

attractions.name: 曼听御花园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 热带花卉园
attractions.summary: The Xishuangbanna Tropical Flower Garden is located within the Yunnan Tropical Crops Research Institute in the urban area of Jinghong City, covering an area of approximately 80 hectares. The garden is designed around a series of natural water surfaces as the main axis for sightseeing, with attractions such as the Flower Garden, Sky Garden, Premier Zhou Enlai Memorial, Palm Area, Rare Tree and Grassland Area, Bonsai Area, Foliage Plant Area, Tropical Fruit Tree Area, and more. It integrates functions of research, science popularization, tourism, and vacation. The garden preserves nearly 1,000 varieties of flowers and economic plants. As you stroll through the park, you are surrounded by a world of exotic flowers, unique trees, and a colorful array of plants, making it an important tourist destination in Xishuangbanna.
attractions.shortFeatures: Science-themed Resort Park

attractions.name: 古纳卡傣族文化园
attractions.summary: Gunaka Dai Cultural Park is located in an ancient village in Xishuangbanna. The stockade is rich in Dai cultural characteristics and retains the ancient cultural heritage of Dai people. There are famous scenic spots such as Manhena and Dai Well in the cultural park. Here you can also see the lush forest and the handicraft making process with Dai characteristics.

attractions.name: 西双版纳勐泐文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 大水车
attractions.summary:
· The landmark buildings and landmarks of the ancient city of Lijiang, tourists must go to the place to take photos. 
The oldest agricultural irrigation tool in China is a superb labor skill created by our ancestors and a precious historical and cultural heritage. 
In the past, there were waterwheels in ancient cities, represented by the big waterwheels in ancient cities, which are still used in some remote places today. 
The waterwheel in the ancient city of Lijiang is only used as a landmark building and ornamental function.
attractions.shortFeatures: Symbol of Old Town of Lijiang

attractions.name: 木府
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountain Climbing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The residence of Mu's chieftain in Lijiang in past dynasties, which combines the architectural style of Central Plains in Ming Dynasty with the craftsmanship of Bai and Naxi nationalities, is a landmark of the ancient city. 
After hundreds of years of glory, most of them were destroyed by war, and the remaining parts were seriously damaged in the earthquake in 1996. At present, most of them are rebuilt. 
It is the "Grand View Garden" of the ancient city of Lijiang. Coming to Lijiang without seeing Mufu is almost equivalent to not coming to Lijiang.
attractions.shortFeatures: Locations for hot dramas such as "Mufu Fengyun"

attractions.name: 狮子山
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Night tour viewing; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
An important part of the ancient city of Lijiang, named after the mountain looks like a sleeping lion. 
The ancient city complex is surrounded by mountains at the foot of Lion Rock, which is the best place to enjoy the panoramic view of Lijiang ancient city. 
On the top of the mountain, there is the first floor of an all-wooden structure building in China with a column that is not connected to the top-Eternal Building. 
Climb the building and overlook the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north. Look at the ancient city of Lijiang in the east, Lijiang New City in the west and rural villages in the south.
attractions.shortFeatures: Unobstructed view of the ancient city and Jade Dragon Snow Mountain

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.summary: Sifang Street is located in the center of the Old Town of Lijiang, in the shape of a rectangle. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a trade hub in northwest Yunnan and a trading center on the Ancient Tea Horse Road. Today, it is still a busy market in the Old Town of Lijiang, with shops, restaurants, bars and tourists everywhere. It is a busy landmark in the ancient city. On Sifang Street, whether it's day or night, there won't be any silence. During the day, tourists linger here, locals gather here to meet, and every afternoon a group of Naxi old ladies wearing ethnic costumes dance here. At night, this is a joyful place where you can dance around the bonfire in Guozhuang, or sway along with the rhythm of wandering singers, free and unrestrained. Four main streets extend from the center of Sifang Street, namely Qiyi Street, Wuyi Street, Xinhua Street, and Dongda Street. Each street is further divided into many small streets and alleys, which are connected in all directions. Snacks and restaurants are everywhere around Sifang Street, and you can easily find many Naxi specialty foods by strolling around. Xinhua Street next to Sifang Street is Lijiang's bar street. Every night, the bar street is brightly lit and bustling.

attractions.name: 丽江千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area is a large performing arts park and a living ancient tea-horse city, located at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
In the scenic spot, the theme areas such as Chama Ancient Street, Nacuo Sea, Snow Mountain Beach and ethnic villages show Lijiang's thousand-year-old culture and historical customs. The towers are towering, the business is prosperous, the ringing of horse bells in the ancient tea-horse street, and there are many workshops such as wineries, tea houses, Dongba paper, hand-dyeing and copper shops. The rippling blue waves of Nacuo Sea are like a fairyland, with flowers and weeping willows on both sides of the strait; Enjoy leisure time with yaks in a daze on the snowy mountain beach; Feel the strong ethnic customs in ethnic villages and experience a different tea-horse tour. 
The main show "Lijiang Eternal Love" is a must-see performance in a lifetime, which reproduces the history and legend of Lijiang for thousands of years, leads the audience through the snow-capped mountains, and feels a beautiful moment in the remote and primitive wild land, Mosuo Flower House on the banks of Lugu Lake, the ancient tea-horse road wrapped in wind and rain, the romantic and miserable third country of Yulong, and the paradise-like Shambhala. 
The large-scale live performance "Lijiang Love Songs" tells the beautiful and tragic love story of Tibetan boy Abda and Naxi girl Gajimi. There is a volcano here, which can instantly spew out flames more than ten meters high; Here, there are strong Tibetan boys who bravely climb volcanoes, cut boulders and set off huge waves; There are beautiful dances of all ethnic groups in Yunnan, and you can feel the artistic feast in the south of colorful clouds. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
There are also wonderful performing shows in the scenic spot, such as "Mufu Recruiting Son-in-Law", "Guozhuang Carnival", "National Flash Mob", "Muppet", "Yak in a Daze" and "Wandering Singers Singing in Residence", which are staged in turn. 
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area, looking for Shambhala in your heart!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the wonderful performance of eternal love
