attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 云杉坪索道
attractions.summary: Yunshanping Cableway is one of the three cableways in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area and has also become a small cableway. Tourists can take the cableway from the station near Baishui River to Yunshanping at an altitude of 3240 meters. The legend of Yunshanping is that it was a place where many young men and women sacrificed their lives in the past. Here, you can enjoy dense spruce forests, alpine meadows, and even the magnificent Jade Dragon Snow Peak.

attractions.name: 云杉坪
attractions.summary:
· Located in the east of Yulong Snow Mountain, at an altitude of 3,240 meters, it is a huge lawn hidden in the virgin spruce forest. 
Regarded as the entrance of the "Third Country of Jade Dragon" in Naxi myths and legends, the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is close at hand, and the Millennium Glacier is clearly visible. 
Legend has it that it is the place where the first pair of lovers of Naxi people died for love, also known as the "Valley of Martyrdom".
attractions.shortFeatures: View the snow peaks in front of the big lawn

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 白水河
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.
attractions.shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain

attractions.name: 玉水寨
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located 15 kilometers north of Lijiang Old Town, at the foot of the Yulong Snow Mountain, with an altitude of 2,500 meters, it is one of the main sources of the river water in Lijiang Old Town.
- It is a sacred site for the inheritance of the Dongba culture of Lijiang, as well as the base for the inheritance of Baisha Xiyue music and Leba dance. Inside, it also showcases ancient Naxi architecture.
- In addition, there are many unique scenic spots with ethnic and local characteristics, such as the Shenlong Triple Waterfall Group, salmon farming eco-tourism, ancient trees, and the largest sacred spring of Yulong Snow Mountain.
- Here, you can learn about many local customs and cultures. It is recommended to bring altitude sickness medication when visiting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Shenlong Three-Tier Waterfall.

attractions.name: 玉柱擎天风景区
attractions.summary: Yuzhu Qingtian Scenic Area is one of the components of Lijiang Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. At the southern foot of the main peak of Yulong Snow Mountain, it is also known as the first village at the foot of Yulong Mountain-Wuluken (Baisha Yuhu Village), which is more than ten miles away from the ancient city. Together with Yushui Village, Yufeng Temple, Dongba Valley, Dongba Wanshen Garden and Dongba Kingdom, it is known as "Three Jades and Three East".
attractions.shortFeatures: Incorporating snow-capped mountains and cliff carvings

attractions.name: 雪嵩村(玉湖村)
attractions.summary: Xuesong Village, also known as Yuhu Village, is a peaceful ancient village located at the foot of the snow capped mountains. The surrounding scenery is very beautiful, and the houses in the village are all built of stones, exuding an ancient and simple atmosphere. This place is suitable for taking photos and also for tourists who like quietness to stay here and enjoy the peaceful beauty at the foot of the snow capped mountains. Xuesong Village is not as famous as Dayan Ancient Town and Shuhe Ancient Town, but it is actually one of the birthplaces of the Naxi Mu Clan Tusi and has a considerable international reputation. In 1922, American Austrian explorer Joseph Locke came to Lijiang and lived there for 27 years, leaving behind a large amount of graphic and textual materials about the area. His former residence is currently located in the village and can be visited with tickets. There is a villa called Yulu Xuesongyuan Hotel in Xuesong Village, which was carefully designed by renowned architect Nie Jianping. The appearance of the stone building blends with the style of Xuesong Village, and the landscape is very beautiful. Tourists who want to experience the charm of Xuesong Village more can stay here. The hotel is very high-end and the price was not cheap back then. In addition to this one, there are also some guesthouses in the village, which are relatively complete in various local areas and can be selected according to needs.

attractions.name: 白沙古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
Baisha Ancient Town was once the political, economic and cultural center of Lijiang, and it was also the original settlement of Naxi people in Lijiang Dam, retaining the original Naxi culture. 
The ancient town retains its original appearance, has not been over-developed, is quieter than Dayan and Shuhe, and you can see Yulong Snow Mountain when you look up. 
Baisha Mural is the most famous scenic spot in the town. It lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, and it is a good place to learn about Dongba culture. 
You can sit and drink tea in the street shop, hang out slowly, and chat with the local old grandmother in a language that each other doesn't understand, which is relaxed and leisurely.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the quiet of the original ecological ancient town

attractions.name: 白沙壁画
attractions.summary: The famous "Lijiang Mural" is the product of the great opening of Naxi society in Ming Dynasty. Its painting lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty. The late Ming and early Qing Dynasties were the heyday of Lijiang murals, which has a history of 500 years. During these long years, Lijiang has experienced the rule of more than ten generations of chieftains and officials. Among the chieftains and officials, there are enlightened people and fatuous people; There are those who flourish and those who decline; There are believers in Buddhism, believers in Taoism and Lamaism. With the preference of the rulers, various religions in Lijiang often have an alternate development process one after another, and temples in Lijiang often rise and fall, which directly affects the rise and fall of murals. In 1962, the investigation report of Yunnan Cultural Relics Task Force wrote as follows: "Lijiang murals were distributed in Wande Palace in Yangxi, Conversion Hall in Dayan Town, Hantan Temple, Dajue Palace in Shuhe, Mu's former residence in Yajiao Village, Fuguo Temple in Zhishan, Baisha Liuli Hall, Dabaoji Palace, Dharma Protection Hall, Dading Pavilion and Xuesong Temple in Xuesong Village." At that time, there were more than ten existing murals in Lijiang. The existing 55 murals are distributed in four temples, such as Dabaoji Palace, Liuli Hall, Dading Pavilion and Dajue Palace in Shuhe, which are religious buildings around the ancient city. Among them, the murals located in Dabaoji Palace in Baisha Village, five kilometers north of Dayan Ancient City, were announced by the state as the fourth batch of national key cultural relics protection units in 1996.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exquisite ancient painting art

attractions.name: 黑龙潭公园
attractions.tag: Climbing High and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
- Black Dragon Pool was originally a Dragon King Temple in Lijiang, with numerous spring wells beside the temple, forming a pool. Because the spring water is as clear as jade and reflects the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, it is also known as "Yuqian Park."
- This is both the water source for the ancient city of Lijiang and the area with the highest concentration of nationally protected cultural relics in Lijiang.
- The classic postcard view of Lijiang consists of the Five-Arch Bridge, Moon-Viewing Tower, the Snow Mountain, and the reflection of the Snow Mountain in Black Dragon Pool.
- Black Dragon Pool is the best location to photograph the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with the best light for photography in the morning and evening.
attractions.shortFeatures: A great place to visit for snow-capped mountains and ancient cities.

attractions.name: 东钱湖
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· It is the largest freshwater lake in Zhejiang, composed of Guzi Lake, Mei Lake, and Outer Lake, and is four times the size of West Lake in Hangzhou.  
· The most popular attraction at Dongqian Lake is the long causeway near Xiaoputuo, which is highly recommended for a walk to enjoy the scenic beauty of Dongqian Lake.  
· Apart from visiting attractions, cycling around Dongqian Lake is arguably the most popular activity, allowing visitors to leisurely admire the lakeside landscapes, mountain views, and natural villages along the way.  
· The Plum Garden by Dongqian Lake is renowned as one of the most beautiful spots in Ningbo for appreciating plum blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cycling along the lake to see the Waterborne Guanyin

attractions.name: 东钱湖陶公岛景区
attractions.name_en: Dongqian Lake Taogong Island Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure
attractions.summary:
Taogong Island Scenic Spot is the seclusion place of Fan Li and Xi Shi, and Taogong Island is the most auspicious and romantic place in Ningbo.  
Taogong Island Scenic Spot integrates nostalgia, leisure and entertainment, among which the ancestral court of the God of Wealth is the only in the world, the dragon boat entertainment is the only in Ningbo, the picnic barbecue is the first in Ningbo, and the delicious taste of Taogong is the best in Ningbo. 
The main landscapes of Taogong Island Scenic Area are: Ruyi Gate, Caishen Ancestral Court, Wulu Caishen Temple, Jiutai Da Yuanbao, etc. It is the most popular place for tourism and leisure in Ningbo and Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combine nostalgia, leisure and entertainment

attractions.name: 韩岭老街
attractions.summary:
Hanling Old Street is known as "the first ancient street in eastern Zhejiang". Hanling Village has a long history. It is said that it was named after the Han surname lived here in its early years. 
There are two old streets in Hanling, namely the front street and the back street, which run through the whole village. Commerce and trade are concentrated in Qianjie, with a total length of more than 500 meters, which is divided into Xiajie, Middle Street and Shangjie. More than 30 shops in the village are mostly concentrated in the lower street, and there is a street stream flowing slowly in the middle of the lower street. The whole street used to be paved with blue-black cobblestones, but now it is a cement road. 
The old street still maintains the style of hundreds of years ago: there are all two-story buildings on both sides, gray tiles and white walls, and red paint facades, one room after another, stretching forward, using the place names left by the market of that year, such as bamboo shed roots, firewood fields, etc. There is also a small manhole in the village. The well water is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a hint of sweetness. Although there is tap water in the village, the villagers still like to eat the water from the small manhole.
attractions.shortFeatures: The old street maintains the style of hundreds of years ago

attractions.name: 东钱湖福泉山景区
attractions.name_en: Dongqian Lake Fuquan Mountain Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Fuquan Mountain Scenic Area is an eco-tourism resort that integrates tea culture, blessing culture and Buddhist culture in natural mountains and forests, and integrates famous tea, famous trees and famous springs. 
The scenic spot is divided into eight scenic spots: Wanghu Pavilion, Phoenix Lake, Wutai Guanri, Longtan Fuquan, Phoenix Drunken Valley, Ancient Gui Piaoxiang, Daci Xunyi and Tiandayan. 
Whenever the sun sets and dusk comes, the scenic spot presents a charming and beautiful scenery, which can be described as "a mountain views the lake and sea, and thousands of greens embrace the blessing spring".

attractions.name: 天一阁博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; hidden gem for kids; Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the city of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, it is the oldest existing private library in China, as well as the oldest library in Asia and one of the world's earliest family libraries.
- Built in the mid-Ming Dynasty, it was overseen by Fan Qin, a retired Deputy Minister of the Ministry of War. Many exhibition halls display books collected by the Fan family from all corners of the world.
- The architecture combines various traditional folk crafts such as wood carving, brick carving, stone carving, gilding, and embossing, making it a masterpiece of Ningbo's residential architecture.
- Inside the Tianyi Pavilion, there is also an interesting Mahjong Museum, which has become a popular spot for many to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient private library.

attractions.name: 鼓楼
attractions.summary:
Drum Tower, also known as Haishu Tower, was built in the Tang Dynasty, the only remaining ancient city building site in Ningbo. You can get a glance at the whole picture of Ningbo City by climbing the building. 
Above the tower is a Roman-style bell tower, with a unique combination of Chinese and Western styles. 
The nearby Park Road is the gathering place of major cultural activities in Ningbo, and art exhibitions, calligraphy exhibitions and photo exhibitions are often held in the building. 
The Drum Tower is surrounded by an antique pedestrian shopping area, and Ningbo specialty snacks such as Youzanzi are worth trying.

attractions.name: 双塔寺
attractions.summary: The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

attractions.name: 柳巷
attractions.shortFeatures: A bustling commercial street with a long history in Taiyuan

attractions.name: 太原市食品街
attractions.summary: Taiyuan Food Street is located in Yingze District, Taiyuan City. Passing through the bustling commercial area of Gulou Street, you can see the ancient archway of Food Street and the spacious and tidy large parking lot of Gulou Street. The newly renovated food street, with its smooth marble pavement, features the five flavors of "sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, and salty" in ancient Chinese characters, indicating the uniqueness of this street. Standing at the south entrance of Food Street, looking north, there are two rows of two-story buildings modeled after the Ming and Qing dynasties, pavilions, memorial archway, cornices, and arch of wooden architecture. The traditional cultural symbols of Shanxi, such as painted buildings and red lanterns, are presented one by one in the block. Anti corrosion long flower pots, sculptures that reflect the characteristics of Shanxi noodles, and antique leisure chairs are neatly arranged on the road paved with bluestone strips. Taiyuan Food Street gathers numerous delicious foods, not only old shops such as Quanwazi snacks and Xueshan cold drinks, but also new ones such as Yantonglou, Jinyunlou, and Old Beijing braised and burned food are crowded with diners who come to try them out. A newly renovated food street is not just a symbol of cuisine, but also a cultural symbol. The "guards" dressed in the costumes of Song Dynasty warriors guard the street corner, adding a cultural atmosphere to the food street. In the center of the street, there are antique vending cars that not only complement the surrounding buildings, but also showcase the rich Jin merchant culture.

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 店头村
attractions.summary: Diantou Ancient Village is located in the branch of Lvliang Mountain, within the mouth of Fengyugou, with Mengshan Mountain to its back and Longshan Mountain to its south, stretching for 1km from east to west. Diantou Village is one of the eight villages in Fengyu. In history, it was a must pass place from Yangcheng in ancient Jin to Shaanxi Gansu Ningxia, and also an ancient military castle that was easy to defend but difficult to attack. There are currently over 360 relatively complete houses remaining. Diantou Ancient Village has a rich historical and cultural heritage, which is not only a corner of Jin culture, but also a carrier of ancient villages in Jin state. The team behind the movie 'Blood Drops' once filmed in the ancient village of Diantou.

attractions.name: 晋商博物院
attractions.summary: The Jin Shang Museum is a humanistic and historical museum established based on the former site of the Shanxi Governor's Office, a national key cultural relic protection unit. It integrates cultural relics, ancient architecture, garden landscapes, and exhibitions.

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 中国煤炭博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Coal Museum is the only professional museum in China dedicated to the coal industry and is a symbol of science and civilization. Due to its unique function and status, it has been awarded the title of "National First-Class Museum" by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Here, visitors can also view dozens of coal specimens, including long flame coal, poor coal, lignite, and gas coal. The museum's most distinctive feature is the "Coal Amusement Palace." The "Coal Amusement Palace" is a large-scale underground simulated mine, recreated using numerous real-life prototypes or 1:1 replicas. The visitor route spans several hundred meters and is said to be the largest in Asia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduced Underground Simulation Mine

attractions.name: 东湖醋园
attractions.summary:
Donghu Vinegar Garden is the first company-based, factory-style museum in Shanxi Province that showcases the traditional and modern production processes of aged vinegar and the historical and cultural connotations of aged vinegar.

The Exhibition Hall and Vinegar Therapy Garden collect various vinegar brewing tools, farming implements, and over 700 vinegar therapy recipes dating back to the Western Han Dynasty, providing a comprehensive understanding of the historical and cultural heritage of Shanxi aged vinegar.

Visitors can participate in part of the production process and enjoy free tastings of various aged vinegars.

As this is a food industry site, for hygiene reasons, visitors are not allowed to wander or touch production tools during the tour.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the brewing process of aged Shanxi vinegar.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:30-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 上海辰山植物园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Adventures; Nature and Exploration
attractions.summary:
· The Chenshan Botanical Garden in Shanghai offers plant viewing throughout the year. Even in winter, the exhibition greenhouse presents a lush and vibrant scene. Climbing to the top of the hill provides a panoramic view of the entire park.  
· The park also has a dedicated botanical garden for the visually impaired. Plants that are non-toxic, thornless, and have distinct olfactory characteristics are planted to cater to their tactile, auditory, and olfactory needs.  
· Spring is the best time to visit; in summer, you can admire aquatic plants like water lilies; and in autumn, chrysanthemums bloom.  
· The botanical garden also hosts various flower exhibitions, such as the Spring Festival "Welcoming Spring" show, the Orchid Show from late March to April, and the "Autumn Charm" exhibition in the fall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful plants to admire in all seasons.

attractions.name: 上海欢乐谷
attractions.summary: Shanghai Happy Valley travel guide is here! As a happy place in the bustling city of "dynamic, fashionable and passionate", Shanghai Happy Valley has celebrated various festivals throughout the year, such as the New Year China-Chic Festival, the doting season, the Super Children's Day, the EV syllable, the Magic Lamp Festival, the Marvel Tide Festival and so on; There are also wonderful performances from all over the world gathered here, such as the large-scale cross media live water show "Sky Sky Water Extreme", the film and television special effects live play "New Shanghai Beach Wind and Cloud", as well as the joyful sea lion show, comedy show, dunk show and other zero distance programs that are performed daily, 365 days of non-stop joy! Let's take a look with Xiaogu. (1) When entering the Happy Hour area from the main entrance, the first thing that catches the eye is the Happy Hour area! A relaxed and enjoyable gaming experience, suitable for families to check-in happily! 【 Joyful Collision 】 Enjoy galloping in the colorful parking lot, experience passion in collisions, capture pleasure in passion, and let you touch it all at once! Gu Mu You Long is known as the "pioneer of roller coaster industry", using super structured American southern pine wood as the main material. It has a 1200 meter whistling journey and over 10 zero gravity space experiences, challenging speed and passion! The Twin Towers Space Shuttle, with one tower launching at high speed from bottom to top and the other rapidly descending from top to bottom. In the up and down reciprocating motion, it perfectly combines the two pole experience of ejection and falling. The palace style double decker carousel, with galloping horses, takes you to a fairy tale like dreamland, sparking endless imagination. [Dreamy Top] The large turntable revolves, the small turntable rotates, and the cabin rotates centrifugally, providing a composite experience that allows you to enjoy excitement and joy while spinning. Do you still remember the first human dream of flying? Sitting on a swinging umbrella, swirling and dancing in the air, one after another, floating up and down, hovering like a silver swallow in the clear sky! （2） Shanghai Beach District's "Ultimate Wind" is the world's new generation of suspended roller coasters, known as "roller coasters", allowing you to experience the magical acceleration of free fall from a vertical drop of 60 meters. The large pendulum delivers you to a height of 15 floors at a speed of 110km/h, experiencing the pleasure of acceleration, deceleration, overweight, and weightlessness, and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky. The back and forth swing of 'Sea like Years' from slow to fast is like being in a turbulent sea, sometimes rushing up the waves, sometimes falling to the bottom of the waves, feeling the danger of riding the wind and breaking the waves, and challenging the limits of psychological endurance. The alternating sensations of weightlessness and overweight are thrilling and unforgettable. During peak hours, the 22 meter bouncing tower is rapidly stimulated and slowly rises to high altitude. After pausing for a few seconds, it suddenly drops and rises rapidly again without any warning, constantly feeling the ups and downs of the heartbeat. With the cheers of falling together, enjoy the beautiful scenery of the distant sky. （3） Shangri La District's Blue Moon Flying Car accelerates at a speed of 110 kilometers per hour, dives at a height of 30 meters, and accelerates rapidly in 2 seconds, bringing you the exhilaration of free flying! Canyon Drifting: The winding 369 meter long river extends into the hard interior of the canyon, taking you through the canyon and embarking on a romantic drifting journey! Spin and glide on a 90 meter long undulating track, feeling the howling wind and letting your mood soar. （4） The newly introduced suspended family roller coaster in the Happy Ocean Zone [Ocean Adventure] features a blue sky above and a flowing fountain below, taking you and your family to joyfully ride between heaven and earth. As you immerse yourself in the cabin of the airship, your flight journey immediately begins. At times, it flies in the sky, and at other times, it glides over the water, splashing joyful splashes of water. You enjoy the joy of flying while constantly diving, spinning, and chasing. 【 Ocean Star 】 6D simulated roller coaster, traversing through real scenes and screen shadows, experiencing the speed and weightlessness of a real roller coaster through ups and downs, screaming constantly, and having endless fun. 【 Rainbow Vortex 】 Being in the 'Rainbow Vortex', constantly turning the steering wheel in your hand, the cup also keeps spinning, the faster it turns. Hurry up and have an eternal chase with them! （5） Standing at the highest point of the park, Jinyin Island in Jinjin Town offers a panoramic view of the beautiful valley with misty clouds and rosy clouds, towering trees with emerald colors flowing, and a babbling stream with green water. The entire park scenery comes into view, including Sheshan and Yuehu. 【 Mining Adventure 】 The all-new 'Mining Adventure' returns with a heavy return, incorporating steampunk style design to create a 360 degree fully sensory immersive experience! The 'mine tunnel' creates a mysterious steampunk charm; Sound effects, hot air, and water mist bring an experience, diving into mine caves, leaping over steam engines, and shuttling between gears, perfectly combining speed and adventure! （6） The classic water project of Hurricane Bay Area's "Rushing Forward" is a thrilling and exhilarating experience as it rushes down from a height of 26 meters, creating a splash of water that fills the air. The perfect storm, known as the "drum washing machine", is a 360 degree super "spinning" that perfectly combines with the music fountain water curtain. Only after playing it can you know what it means to be mesmerized. [Rapid Whirlwind] Introducing a new multi-dimensional rotation project, riding on an 18 meter high-altitude "windmill", 360 ° flipping, twisting, swinging... Experience the speed and passion of rotation! 【 Magical Straw Hats 】 Five magical big straw hats, spinning and soaring, sway and dance vigorously in the dynamic music, with endless fun.

attractions.name: 谷木游龙
attractions.summary: The world's oldest wooden roller coaster, made mainly of American Southern pine wood, known as a super structural material, is built along the lake embankment, providing visitors with over 10 experiences of zero gravity in space, challenging the lightness that life cannot bear! Bring a 1200 meter whistling journey.

attractions.name: 极速飞车卡丁车俱乐部
attractions.summary: This is located next to the Shanghai Happy Valley Tourist Center, and you can experience it without entering the scenic area. The project covers a total area of 12000 square meters, with a track length of 700 meters and a track width of 8 meters. It will officially open to the public in the summer of 2023. Extreme Speed Kart is a jungle karting project that allows you to travel through the jungle and experience the real-life version of speed and passion. There are 200cc fuel powered go karts available here, including single person go karts suitable for competition, as well as double person go karts designed for families and couples, to meet the driving experience of drivers of all levels. Before starting the real competition, every "driver" will receive professional training from the coach in the tutorial room, from safety knowledge to track driving techniques, to ensure that everyone is "certified", even beginners can quickly get started. Put on your racing suit and helmet, and race freely on various curves, drifting as you please. The timing system provides comprehensive and accurate record and query functions for the entire project, with timing and ranking for each round of competition, making real-time results clear at a glance. Considering safety protection, "Extreme Speed" has specially prepared a racing training class to provide safety training for each racer before entering, allowing everyone to quickly master the skills of karting.

attractions.name: 上海欢乐谷蹦极滑索
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Happy Valley Bungee Jumping and Zip-Lining
attractions.summary: The newly opened bungee jumping event is located at the junction of the "Happy Hour" area and the "Shanghai Beach" area. The time is around 10am to 6pm, depending on the weather conditions of the day, and additional fees will be charged. Jumping from a height of 55 meters, most tourists cannot be as carefree as a coach. The experience inevitably resulted in a stiff body, accompanied by falling movements not only by the sound of the wind, but also screams piercing through the sky. At the moment of bottoming out and rebounding, my heart was lifted to my throat. Some stretched out in the air like 'yes', while others were so scared that they closed their eyes tightly and were frozen in various poses in the air.

attractions.name: 峡谷漂流
attractions.summary: Canyon drifting is a classic water amusement project in Happy Valley, taking you through canyons, rockeries, culverts, forest farms, flower seas... for a romantic drifting adventure.

attractions.name: 深坑秘境乐园-上海世茂精灵之城主题乐园
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Shimao Elf City Theme Park is built on the deep pit of Tianma Mountain, integrating unique natural resources of cliffs and combining indoor and outdoor concepts to create a unique themed amusement park with hotel wonders in the deep pit. The amusement park has new hardware, high specifications, novel interaction, and comfortable experience. In addition, with the support of the Shimao Shenkeng Intercontinental Hotel, which ranks nearly one hundred in negative altitude, the experience of overlooking the Shenkeng Yunjing Garden in the Elf City Theme Park is commendable. This is a dreamlike paradise on earth: ancient and mysterious canyons and jungles, deep pits and ridges crisscrossed by streams and waterfalls, ancient mythical creatures soaring in the sky, and quiet tree bottom elves, all waiting here with breath holding - your grand arrival. The glass walkway in the theme park of the City of Elves is 88 meters above the center of the earth. Experience the magical realm from all angles, including the sky, pool water, and cliffs; Embark on an elegant gliding ride on the Snowy Owl, fly over deep pits, and experience the perspective of 'God' at the high point of the amusement park; The cliff hurricane swings nearly 30 meters high, forming a drop of nearly 100 meters with the lower part of the deep pit. With a speed of 100 meters per hour, it swings greatly, rotates and flips up and down, staring helplessly at the abyssal cliffs beneath its feet; Parent child experience area: The world in the eyes of children is full of infinite imagination. The architectural models here not only have beautiful appearances, but also are highly interactive, providing a platform for children aged 2-16 to unleash their creativity and exercise their physical fitness. Full text 

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)
