attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 南岸嘴
attractions.summary: A green dragon and a yellow dragon meet here-Nan'anzui is an extraordinary place in China's geography and is known as "the first corner of China". Because it is the impact zone formed by the confluence of the Yangtze River, the largest river in China, and the Han River, the largest tributary of the Yangtze River. Some people say that Nan'anzui is where China's Dantian is located, which means that it is the place where China's essence is most concentrated.

attractions.name: 晴川阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in the Ming Dynasty, its name is taken from the famous poem "Qingchuan calendars Hanyang trees". Together with the Yellow Crane Tower and Guqin Terrace, it is also known as the three major scenic spots in Wuhan. 
The pavilion is divided into two floors, upper and lower floors, along the eaves and cloisters, which reproduces the magnificent style of Chu people building platforms on mountains and building pavilions on platforms, and is rich in Chu culture. 
Qingchuan Pavilion faces the Yellow Crane Tower, south of the Yangtze River and north of the Yangtze River, and the pavilions face each other, setting off each other, which is spectacular. It is known as the "Holy Land of Three Chus". 
From the end of March to the beginning of April every year, you can enjoy cherry blossoms all over the sky next to the quaint Qingchuan Pavilion. The best place to view cherry blossoms in Qingchuan Pavilion is located in the cherry blossom forest in the back garden of Qingchuan Holiday Hotel.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking at the three towns of Wuhan and the Yellow Crane Tower from a distance
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:30(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 龟山公园-铁门关
attractions.tag: Historic site; Military Sites; Historical Sites
attractions.summary: For hundreds of years from the Three Kingdoms period to the early Tang Dynasty, Tiemenguan has been an important military fortress in Wuhan, and has experienced many fierce offensive and defensive battles. In the fourth year of Tang Wude (AD 621), with the construction of Hanyang City, the military role of Tiemenguan was gradually weakened, and it became an important channel for cultural, economic and trade exchanges, and at the same time became a tourist attraction. At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Tiemenguan was destroyed, leaving only the earth foundation wall base. At the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, Guandi Temple was built on the remaining earth foundation. In the early years of the Republic of China, due to war, the ruins of Tiemenguan together with the temple became ruins. In December 1990, Tiemenguan was rebuilt.
attractions.shortFeatures: Strong ethnic architectural style

attractions.name: 汉阳造艺术区
attractions.summary:
· The abandoned industrial plant used was originally part of Hanyang Arsenal and 824 Factory during the Westernization Movement in China. 
· The park covers a small area, mostly composed of office buildings. Besides, graffiti, performance art and creative sculptures can be seen everywhere. 
· A model of old industrial transformation into commercial and artistic creation park, novel and innovative enough for artists to exert their unlimited creativity and imagination.

attractions.name: 汉口江滩
attractions.tag: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to Longwang Temple and Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, facing the Yellow Crane Tower Scenic Area, it is a unique landscape center in downtown Wuhan.  
Hankou River Beach is a park-like leisure place for citizens. Together with Wuchang River Beach and Hanyang River Beach, it has become a famous public leisure place in the city. 
The most famous reeds on the river beach are late autumn reeds, which are distributed near the Second Yangtze River Bridge and stretch for about 4km. There are reeds of this scale in the center of the city, which is unique among big cities in China, and it is a beautiful scenery in Wuhan. 
The flowering period of cherry blossoms is from February to March. There are many varieties of cherry blossoms, scattered in locations, and unique artistic conception. You can go to Jiangtan Cherry Garden for concentrated viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk along the Yangtze River and enjoy the river and city scenery

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 吉庆民俗街
attractions.summary: Premature Hubu Lane, late night Jiqing Street ". During the day, the area is sparsely populated, but as night falls, Jiqing Street is brightly lit and bustling with people. Simple stalls line up in a row, offering a wide variety of local delicacies. When enjoying the feast, you can also enjoy folk performances full of "Han flavor", which are extremely lively. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉东湖海洋世界
attractions.summary: Wuhan Donghu Ocean World is located by the 5A level scenic spot of Donghu Lake. The building covers an area of 30000 square meters and showcases over a thousand species and more than ten thousand rare marine fish. The entire exhibition hall consists of the Tropical Rainforest Pavilion, Underwater Tunnel, Marine Biology Pavilion, Dreamy Jellyfish Pavilion, Ocean Theater, and more. We are currently upgrading and renovating the aquarium with the concept of understanding, understanding, loving, and protecting the ocean. We have introduced the Jiaolong IP and added themed venues such as the Shark Pavilion, Arctic Pavilion, Coral Pavilion, Specimen Pavilion, Science and Technology Pavilion, and Boutique Pavilion. Entering the East Lake Ocean World, you can have intimate conversations with thousands of marine creatures, enjoy the mystery and unfathomability of the Amazon rainforest, the profound and mysterious underwater landscape, the humor and wit of the sea beast theater, the thrilling dance of humans and sharks, and the graceful performance of mermaids. It is a large-scale dynamic marine science education base with ocean culture as its theme, integrating viewing, amusement, fun, and knowledge.

restaurants.name_en: Eisenhower Hotel, Food and Beverage Department

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 夫子庙大成殿
attractions.summary:
Dacheng Hall of Confucius Temple is the main hall of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. The largest portrait of Confucius in China hangs in the center of the hall. 
The furnishings in the hall imitate fifteen kinds of ancient musical instruments such as chimes and chimes 2,500 years ago, and regularly perform ancient songs and elegant music. 
The main hall is surrounded by murals of Confucius' achievements, with both form and spirit. The temple is surrounded by two stele galleries, and there are thirty original inscriptions of Mo Bao written by famous calligraphers such as Zhao Puchu, Lin Sanzhi, Shen Peng and Wu Zhongqi on the wall. 
The stele gallery displays the Yuhua Stone exhibition, which is known as "the unique thing in China". Exhibitions of other historical relics and works of art are often organized in Dacheng Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Offering Sacrifices and Understanding Confucius' Hall

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 八一广场
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the heart of Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, it is an important place for political, economic, cultural, leisure, entertainment and other activities in Jiangxi. 
It consists of the central square, the rostrum and the east and west gardens. It is the largest city central square in Jiangxi Province. 
· The large musical fountain in the center of the square, with 1,290 sprinklers, reproduces the bloody battle of the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army in Taihang. 
In the center of the square stands the "August 1st Nanchang Uprising Memorial Tower" inscribed by Marshal Ye Jianying, where many tourists will take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where the military flag is raised

attractions.name: 江西省美术馆
attractions.summary: The art museum officially opened in 2020, with a building area of about 20000 square meters. It displays many works of Chinese modern and contemporary artists and is a public welfare art museum.

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 万寿宫历史文化街区
attractions.summary: The Wanshou Palace Historical and Cultural District showcases the architectural style and historical culture of the Jiangyou ethnic group. Here, tourists can stroll through retro style shops, taste snacks from the 1980s and 1990s, and reminisce about the past.

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 《寻梦滕王阁》实景演出
attractions.summary: The "Searching for Dreams Tengwang Pavilion" is a large-scale "virtual+real-life" interactive cultural performance project in Nanchang. It starts with the Pavilion of Dreams and is led by Mr. Liang Sicheng, who drew the architectural drawings of Tengwang Pavilion. It is initiated by Wang Bo, the leader of the Four Great Masters of the Early Tang Dynasty, who wrote the "Preface to Tengwang Pavilion", bringing together the sages of various dynasties in Jiangxi. Through video projection, lighting, and performances by more than 140 actors, combined with the architectural structure characteristics of Tengwang Pavilion's "Bright Three Dark Seven", with "Seven Dreams and Seven Realms" as the core, seven colors are used to interpret seven life realms. The cultural characteristics of various dynasties, including "poetry, books, rituals, and music", are infused into every detail of the performance, highlighting the literary style and poetic charm, creating a beautiful immersive experience, allowing the audience to appreciate Tengwang Pavilion's profound cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 江西省博物馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) is one of the three major cultural centers in Jiangxi Province. It is based on a square box and symbolizes a treasure box. It has six floors, a building area of 86000 square meters, and an exhibition area of 28000 square meters. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Museum) gathers precious historical relics and ancient art masterpieces discovered from various parts of Jiangxi, and collects a large number of cultural relics from the province. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) has established an exhibition system that combines permanent and temporary exhibitions, consisting of 8 permanent exhibitions and 3 temporary exhibition halls. The entire exhibition showcases the historical landscape and cultural characteristics of Jiangxi, meeting the diverse needs of the public in the new era with high quality.

attractions.name: 南昌汉代海昏侯国遗址公园
attractions.name_en: The National Archaeological Site Park of Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis
attractions.summary: The Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site in Nanchang consists of the capital city of Haihun Marquis State, Zijin City, the first generation Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery, and the western and southern tomb groups of the city site. It is a typical Han Dynasty capital settlement site discovered in China. Since the archaeological excavation of Liuhe Cemetery began in 2011, more than 10000 precious cultural relics such as gold, bronze, iron, jade, lacquered wood, ceramics, bamboo weaving, grass weaving, textiles, bamboo slips, and wooden slips have been unearthed, which is rare in recent archaeological work in China. Among them, as many as 480 gold artifacts were excavated and unearthed. At the same time, the discovery of precious cultural relics such as Confucius' clothing mirror, gilded patterned bells, chimes, jade seals, etc., has great value. The Haihun Hou State Archaeological Site Park is divided into six functional areas: the Site Museum Area, the Tomb Exhibition Area, the Zijin City Exhibition Area, the Archaeological Reserve Area, the Entrance Functional Area, and the Historical Experience Ecological Leisure Area. Highlight 1: The design of the Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Tourist Center in Nanchang incorporates elements from the jade bi unearthed from Liu He's tomb. From a high altitude, it looks like a self forming circular "Congbi Litian" jade clasp. The building area is 8500 square meters. The tourist center comprehensively accommodates tourist reception services, cultural leisure display, cultural experience, entertainment shopping and other functions. Highlight 2: The architectural form of the Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Guo Site Museum has extracted the dragon shaped patterns that have appeared multiple times in the cultural relics unearthed from Liu He's tomb, symbolizing the hidden dragon in the mountains and fields. The building area is 39296 square meters. Our positioning for it is cultural display, cultural experience, etc. The archaeological museum has exhibitions and displays of unearthed cultural relics, as well as projects such as 4D cinemas and VR experiences. Highlight 3: Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery Liu He Cemetery has a trapezoidal plan, with a width of 141-186 meters from north to south and a length of 233-248 meters from east to west. The perimeter of the walls is 868 meters and the width is about 2 meters, covering a total area of about 46000 square meters. The cemetery consists of two main tombs, seven burial tombs, an outer pit and garden wall, north and east gates and their gates, sleeping quarters, ancestral halls, and temple officials' quarters. There is a complete road system and drainage facilities in the park. Some tombs have ancestral halls built in front of them. The two main tombs, Hou Tomb and Hou Madam Tomb, are located in the same tomb but different caves, occupying a higher and central position in the cemetery. The two tombs share a high platform with an area of about 4000 square meters. Its ceremonial architecture consists of east and west wing rooms, sleeping halls, and ancestral halls. Full text 

attractions.name: 南昌汉代海昏侯国遗址博物馆
attractions.name_en: Nanchang Relic Museum For Haihun Principality of Han Dynasty
attractions.summary: The Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site Museum is located in Xinjian District, Nanchang City. It mainly displays precious cultural relics unearthed from the Haihun Marquis tomb, including horseshoe gold, lacquerware, bronze ware, bamboo slips, etc. The exhibits are exquisite and rich in connotation.

attractions.name: 秋水广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Nanchang Qiushui Square is located on the Ganjiang River in Honggutan New District, close to the administrative center square and across the river from Tengwang Pavilion. 
The main fountain of the square, which can spray up to 108 meters, is the largest musical fountain in Asia. 
Standing under the fountain in summer, it's extremely cool. Looking at the sun through the mist, you can find countless small rainbows, which are very beautiful. 
At night, the dynamic lights on the opposite side dance with the fountain, and there is Taiwan Province Snack Street next to it, which is a good place to enjoy midnight snack.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the musical fountain with changing lights

attractions.name: 南昌秋水广场-音乐喷泉
attractions.summary: Nanchang Qiushui Square faces Tengwang Pavilion across the river, and it is very lively when night falls. The most eye-catching thing in the square is the fountain performance every night. The main spray height of the fountain is 128 meters. When the fountain moves with the music, it is colorful, and people can watch the beautiful scenery of Tengwang Pavilion while enjoying the music.

attractions.name: 南昌之星摩天轮
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ferris wheel; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The landmark of Nanchang, 160 meters high, is 25 meters higher than the previous world record holder "Eye of London". 
· The diameter of the turntable is 153 meters, with 60 space capsules. A ferris wheel can seat six people and can accommodate nearly a thousand people per hour. It takes half an hour to sit in a circle. 
· Overlooking the whole city of Nanchang, the cabin is equipped with LCD TV and Mitsubishi heating and cooling air conditioning. 
The world's largest clock will also be installed, with 60 space capsules representing a 60-minute time scale. The Ferris wheel will adopt dual power supply and dual power system to ensure the safety of tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the romantic landmarks

attractions.name: 华侨城万科世纪水岸鸟屿浮云塔
attractions.name_en: OCT Vanke Century Waterfront Bird Island Floating Cloud Tower
attractions.summary: The Niaoyu Floating Cloud Pagoda is located in Xihu District, Nanchang City. It was personally designed by Norwegian design master Thomas, who extracted waves as symbolic elements. It is named after its shape resembling a suspended aerial tower.

attractions.name: 象湖湿地公园
attractions.summary: The construction area of Xianghu Wetland Park is about 1.89 square kilometers (about 2800 acres), mainly featuring aquaculture water surface in the western landscape project. The area will be developed into a citizen ecological recreation center that integrates tourism, leisure, sightseeing, and entertainment functions.

attractions.name: 万寿宫
attractions.summary: The Wanshou Palace is located on a central island in Xianghu Park, showcasing the traditional architectural style of the late Qing Gan School while retaining the charm of old Nanchang.

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州古运河游船(山塘街白居易码头)
attractions.name_en: Suzhou Ancient Canal Cruise (Shantang Street Baijuyi Wharf)
attractions.summary: As the lights start to light up, the scenery along the ancient canal becomes even more enchanting. Tourists feel like they are in a water paradise under the shadow of lights, fully experiencing the unique charm of Suzhou, this eastern water city. Cruise boats shuttle back and forth, wooden boats cutting through the calm river surface, causing ripples. The night view on the water is truly charming. Standing in the tranquil and elegant environment of the mountain pond street, witnessing the wonderful night view of the Jiangnan water city, one cannot help but feel refreshed, intoxicated, and reluctant to leave.

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

restaurants.name_en: Old Beijing copper pot shabu shabu

attractions.name: 百福岛
attractions.summary: Baifu Bay (Baifukushima) is located in the narrow mountain range on the west side of Yalong Bay, like a jade hairpin extending deep into the sea, surrounded by the sea on three sides and mountains on one side, forming a geographical form of a peninsula. Baifu Cape at the southern end faces Jinmu Cape at the southern end of Hainan Island across the sea. Extremely spectacular, facing Jieshi to the east to observe the vast sea. On the east side of Baifu Island, there is also a beautiful beach called Baifu Bay, which is also a national soft coral protection base. The water quality is clear and the underwater life is abundant. It is better from March to October every summer. Although Baifu Bay is not large, its delicate beach and isolated comfort make it a high-quality place for Hainan's original ecological experience and island leisure.

attractions.name: 蜈支洲岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; love sports; Outdoor Diving; Beaches; Seashores; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Wuzhizhou Island Tourist Area is a famous 5A-level scenic spot, located in Haitang Bay, Sanya City, covering an area of approximately 1.48 square kilometers. It boasts rich underwater ecological resources and a comprehensive water sports product system for "quadruple" ocean experiences. It has become a national coastal island resort integrating island sightseeing, recreational activities, honeymoon vacations, and family tourism, making it one of the most well-known tourist destination brands in China.

Here, you’ll find "China's first tropical marine ranch," which has nurtured and developed leading marine recreation methods. The island offers typical diving activities, such as luxury island circum-navigation diving, advanced diving, and coral reef diving. It also features new entertainment projects introduced from abroad, such as dynamic airships, dolphin submarines, and sky dance. In addition, there are helicopter island tours and an immersive outdoor wind tunnel experience center, catering to tourists' vacation desires and pursuits of "sea, land, air, and underwater" activities. Whether you're a curious diving explorer or an adventurous "extreme enthusiast," you will find the perfect activity here.

In addition to the diverse entertainment options, the island also boasts popular tourist spots like Lover's Bridge, Lover’s Island, Sun Viewing Rock, and custom-made swimming pools, all of which are perfect for capturing breathtaking photos. The winding coastline, crystal-clear waters, and the colorful, vibrant underwater world featuring various corals, mackerels, groupers, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, prawns, luminous snails, and a variety of tropical fish make it a premier diving destination in China. Currently, Wuzhizhou Island offers four main diving spots—Qilin Sea, Back Garden, Glass Fish Planet, and Little Universe—each with its own unique characteristics, attracting diving enthusiasts from around the world.

The only island hotel on the island, Coral Hotel, is one of the few high-end boutique island hotels in China. It consists of five connected buildings designed with coral as the prototype, built to five-star standards. The hotel offers various room types including sea-view, garden-view, poolside, duplex, suites, and wooden houses, totaling 305 rooms. It is a sweet destination for romantic proposals, honeymoon trips, and family vacations, providing a private and pure island leisure experience for visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic diving resort destination

attractions.name: 海棠湾后海冲浪基地
attractions.summary: Haitang Bay Houhai Surfing Base - a platform for novice surfers in China, with shallow and gentle beaches that are not easily injured. It is known as the "Surfer's Paradise" and is located near the Wuzhizhou Island pier. During the slow flow of tourists, they enjoy a unique and leisurely life.

attractions.name: 亚龙湾热带天堂森林公园
attractions.name_en: Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park
attractions.summary: The Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park Scenic Area is located within the Yalong Bay National Tourism Resort. The main filming locations for the movie "If You Are the One II" and the TV series "Dear, Loved" are in Sanya, Hainan. The park is positioned as an international coastal ecological sightseeing and ecological vacation forest park, and is praised by experts as a model of third-generation forest tourism products. The trees in the park are lush, and you can see the dense vines and gurgling streams. You can also encounter the century old vines and towering banyan trees, and hear insects singing and birds singing, which is extremely wild. Scenes from "If You Are the One II" and "Dear, Beloved" can be seen everywhere in the scenic area. Shu Qi, Ge You, Yang Zi, and Li Xian walked across the "Crossing the River Dragon Rope Bridge" known as the Lover's Bridge, the "Cliff Sky Pool" at the edge of the cliff, the trial room in "If You Are the One II" witnessing romantic love, and the internet famous glass wharf are all must visit check-in spots for couples. Strolling along Tianjie, enjoying the slow life of Tianjie at 18 ° N latitude, walking on the panoramic sea view glass bridge, taking in the beautiful scenery of Yalong Bay, facing the sea, backed by green mountains, and blooming all year round. The panoramic sea view glass wharf is located at the top of the Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park, with a highest elevation of 450 meters. It is a panoramic sea view glass wharf. The glass wharf is built along the mountain, with a total length of 400 meters, composed of 130 tons of ultra white imported laminated glass. It includes attractions such as Lingkong Platform, Colorful Sky Ladder, Colorful Lotus Viewing Platform, Rainbow Road, Mountain Oath and Heart to Heart Connection. The road surface of the wharf is entirely paved with 3M * 3M large single transparent glass. Walking on the wharf, you can look up at the sky high and clear clouds, overlook the rainforest valley more than 100 meters deep below, and have a panoramic view of Yalong Bay in front. While feeling scared, you can also enjoy the joy of soaring in the sky. Rainforest Float, also known as the "forest float and water float roller coaster". The floating slide is made of high-strength tempered double-layer laminated glass, with a total length of 3100 meters and a drop of 280 meters, equivalent to a rapid slide down from a 93 story rooftop. The Feipiao has 28 bends throughout its journey, with a total length of 600 meters, including 17 C-shaped bends, 11 S-shaped bends, and multiple consecutive S-shaped major bends. Rainforest drifting is like a roller coaster floating on water, sometimes soaring over the top of the rainforest, sometimes crossing deep forests, sometimes overlooking beautiful mountains and seas, and sometimes exploring the wonders of the rainforest. While enjoying thrills and excitement, participants can also get up close to tropical ecological wonders such as the Root Hug Stone and the High Board Root. They can also have intimate interactions with common tropical wildlife such as giant spiders, cobras, elephants, macaques, crocodiles, giraffes, etc. 【 Orchid Valley 】 Orchid Valley mainly showcases the unique landscape of the original tropical rainforest. On the winding trail that stretches for more than 1000 meters in the valley, vines are densely covered, streams are gurgling, and various orchids compete and bloom. Along the hiking trail in the valley, towering banyan trees, century old vines, wild bamboo shoots, and six wonders of the tropical rainforest can be seen everywhere. Walking in the rainforest, you can feel the refreshing coolness. Here, you can unload the hustle and bustle, cross the rainforest boardwalk, breathe fresh air, and enjoy the happy time of leisure. The filming location for the movie "If You Are the One II" and the TV drama "Dear, Loved" is "Crossing the Yangtze River Dragon Bridge". The Jianglong Cable Bridge spans between two mountains, with a total length of 168 meters and a height of nearly 40 meters above the ground. Walking on the cable-stayed bridge, looking up at the undulating mountains, overlooking the vast ocean, listening to the birds singing and smelling the fragrance of flowers, it feels like being in a fairyland of the sea and sky. Suoqiao, also known as Lover's Bridge, is a bridge woven with love. If lovers walk over it, they will eventually become a couple. Ge You, Shu Qi, Yang Zi, and Li Xian performed a romantic love story here. Crossing this bridge may be thrilling and exciting, but loving someone is also an adventurous journey? The Yanbo Pavilion next to the cable-stayed bridge, accompanied by ancient banyan trees, is a great place to appreciate the panoramic view of the bridge. The "If You Are the One II" trial room is a trial room in the movie plot, with no changes to the decoration or arrangement, showcasing the simple yet romantic moments of Xiao Xiao and Qin Fen. Rainforest Magic Cinema: A giant dragon flies from the top of a 450 meter mountain, and the tree lined path is full of dangers. Giant pythons and birds may appear at any time, while waterfalls and mountains allow you to shuttle and soar. The film, produced by a foreign team hired by the scenic area to protect the tropical rainforest, will allow us to explore the rainforest in a different way, allowing every organ of the body to directly experience the thrilling excitement. Leaping through the dense and primitive rainforest of Yalong Bay, with towering mountains and misty clouds, the Leaping Rainforest project will take you to experience the wonderful feeling of flying squirrels crossing the top of the rainforest. There are 13 high-altitude challenge projects such as zip line, rock climbing, plum blossom stake, and cycling, allowing you to challenge yourself and find joy in the jungle adventure. Climbing up to the Thousand Mile Umbrella, drifting clouds under your feet, the blue sea and sky, and the wind blowing from all directions make you feel relaxed and happy. Looking down from below, the green mountains, green trees, and red flowers complement the Tianchi Bird's Nest. The swimming pool built along the cliffs blends with the sky and sea, and is integrated with the mountains and forests. Like a blue sapphire embedded in the mountains, with a vast sea view in front of you. Along a long cobblestone road, you will stroll through the tropical style buildings lining both sides. Here, you can taste local Hainan specialty snacks, Li Miao specialty rainforest meals, purchase dad tea, Thai handicrafts, Hainan Huanghua pears, and even write your beautiful mood on postcards and send them to distant friends through the 18 ° North latitude post office. The high-altitude zip line, with a total length of 600 meters, glides at high speed from the mountaintop to the highest point, experiencing the speed and passion of crossing between the sea and sky, more like an elf in the valley, free and unrestrained. Under my feet lies infinite greenery, and the vast sea view unfolds before my eyes like a long painting. Rainforest Magic Maze is a children's fantasy adventure park full of family warmth, wisdom, and courage. Parents and children experience the entertainment process of rope crossing, tree maze, time tunnel and other sports expansion projects together. By completing various tasks with children, they give them greater courage and enhance their confidence. There is a large dragon sculpture made of purple copper, weighing 5000 kilograms, standing on the mountaintop, guarding the South China Sea. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿回头风景区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountains; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located on the southern tip of the Luhuitou Peninsula in Sanya, surrounded by the sea on three sides and adjacent to downtown Sanya on the other, it is an ideal viewpoint for overlooking the sea, watching the sunrise and sunset, and getting a panoramic view of the entire city.
- The beautiful love legend of the Li people and the Luhuitou sculpture in the park are among the symbols of Sanya, often referred to as the "Deer City," and they serve as the city's emblem and calling card.
- In the core area of the Sanya Forest Vegetation Nature Reserve, with a greening coverage rate of 96.6%, over 300 plant species, and dozens of wild animals living within.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb to a high place to enjoy the scenery and seascape of Sanya.

attractions.name: 凤凰岭海誓山盟景区
attractions.name_en: Phoenix Ridge Love Vows Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountains; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Sanya Phoenix Ridge Everyone Scenic Spot is located in the center of Sanya, which is the highest peak in the center of Sanya. It is the only best place to have a full view of the four major bays of Sanya (Sanya Bay, East China Sea, Yulin Bay and Yalong Bay) and a 360 bird's-eye view of the whole city of Sanya. 
· The scenic spot introduces the world's most advanced Austrian ropeway, which is known as the Rolls-Royce of ropeways. It is the aerial ropeway with the largest investment and the best scenery in southern China. The cable car rises slowly, giving you a panoramic view of the entire city. It is known as Asia's No. 1 ropeway for viewing the sea and watching the city. 
The scenic spot has love-themed landscapes such as the stone tablet of eternal vows, Ruying Pavilion, Handle Platform, Yuelaoquan, Lovers Tree, Crystal Temple, etc. It is known as the southernmost love holy place on China's continental shelf, and is also known as the love holy mountain at 18 north latitude.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb to the summit and overlook the four bays of Sanya

attractions.name: 凤凰岛直升机基地
attractions.summary: Take a helicopter ride to experience a smooth and expansive new perspective, explore the romantic Sanya from a different angle, fly low along the coastline, shuttle through the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, overlook the entire Sanya, and enjoy a private aerial viewing journey. Take off from the Phoenix Island helicopter base in Sanya, and experience the magical feeling of low altitude flight (at an altitude of about 300 meters or less) and helicopter takeoff and landing during the flight, depending on the selected products. At the same time, enjoy the beautiful scenery of Phoenix Island in Sanya, overlook the diverse crowds and constantly changing colors of the nearby sea.

attractions.name: 南山文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- The Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone is a large park showcasing traditional Chinese Buddhist culture, with numerous attractions inside. The 108-meter-tall Sea Guanyin statue is undoubtedly one of its highlights.
- Major attractions include Nanshan Temple, the Sea Guanyin Buddha statue, the "No Two Dharma Gates", the Ten Directions Pagoda Forest and the Returning to the Roots Garden, the Buddhist Culture Exchange Center, and the Vegetarian Cuisine Shopping Street.
- The world's largest Sea Guanyin statue is also located here. The statue, shaped in the form of Guanyin, faces three directions, is majestic in appearance, stands at 108 meters tall, and cost 190 million RMB to build. It is known as the "Treasure of the Island" throughout Hainan.
- The park has a vegetarian restaurant offering a "Temple Vegetarian Cuisine" buffet, and there are hotels providing accommodation, making it very convenient for sightseeing and Buddhist worship.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the sea view and visit Buddhist landmarks.

attractions.name: 天涯海角
attractions.name_en: English: The Ends of the Earth
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Beaches; Rock Monuments
attractions.summary:
- Located at the western end of Sanya Bay, the beach is dotted with various rocks, many of which are engraved with inscriptions left by famous figures from both ancient and modern times.  
- The most famous are two giant stones inscribed with the words "Tianya" (End of the Sky) and "Haijiao" (Cape of the Sea), which have long been regarded as symbols of love and are also one of Sanya's iconic landmarks.  
- Other notable rock carvings include "Nantian Yizhu" (Pillar of the Southern Sky), also known as the "Wealth Stone", and "Riyue Shi" (Sun and Moon Stone), which symbolizes love.  
- The Celebrity Sculpture Park, the Couple Trees, and other unique attractions within the scenic area are also worth visiting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a photo with the Sanya landmark stone carvings.

attractions.name: 天涯小镇
attractions.summary: Tianya Town is located in Sanya City, Hainan Province. The town has jurisdiction over Maling Community, Heitu Village, Bufu Village, Hongtang Village, Taling Village, Wenmen Village, Guoling Village, and Huali Village.

attractions.name: 大小洞天
attractions.summary: The Sanya Xiaodongtian Tourist Area is located 40 kilometers west of Sanya City, with a total area of 22.5 square kilometers, and is a national 5A level tourist attraction. The 800 year old scenic spot of Qiongya is renowned throughout the world! The development of Xiaodongtian began in the Southern Song Dynasty (1187 AD), and it is a historic scenic spot in Hainan Province and a Taoist cultural tourist destination in the southern part of China. Today, it has developed into a boutique tourist scenic area with ancient Yazhou culture as its thread, gathering traditional Chinese Taoist culture and dragon culture, integrating tropical coastal scenery, folk customs, science education, outdoor expansion, elderly care, and leisure vacation. Wuzhizhou Island Tourist Area is a famous 5A-level scenic spot, located in Haitang Bay, Sanya City, covering an area of approximately 1.48 square kilometers. It has become a national coastal island resort integrating island sightseeing, recreational activities, honeymoon vacations, and family tourism, making it one of the most well-known tourist destination brands in China.

Here, you’ll find "China's first tropical marine ranch," which has nurtured and developed leading marine recreation methods. The island offers typical diving activities, such as luxury island circum-navigation diving, advanced diving, and coral reef diving. It also features new entertainment projects introduced from abroad, such as dynamic airships, dolphin submarines, and sky dance. In addition, there are helicopter island tours and an immersive outdoor wind tunnel experience center, catering to tourists' vacation desires and pursuits of "sea, land, air, and underwater" activities. Whether you're a curious diving explorer or an adventurous "extreme enthusiast," you will find the perfect activity here.

In addition to the diverse entertainment options, the island also boasts popular tourist spots like Lover's Bridge, Lover’s Island, Sun Viewing Rock, and custom-made swimming pools, all of which are perfect for capturing breathtaking photos. The winding coastline, crystal-clear waters, and the colorful, vibrant underwater world featuring various corals, mackerels, groupers, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, prawns, luminous snails, and a variety of tropical fish make it a premier diving destination in China. Currently, Wuzhizhou Island offers four main diving spots—Qilin Sea, Back Garden, Glass Fish Planet, and Little Universe—each with its own unique characteristics, attracting diving enthusiasts from around the world.

The only island hotel on the island, Coral Hotel, is one of the few high-end boutique island hotels in China. The park is positioned as an international coastal ecological sightseeing and ecological vacation forest park, and is praised by experts as a model of third-generation forest tourism products. Shu Qi, Ge You, Yang Zi, and Li Xian walked across the "Crossing the River Dragon Rope Bridge" known as the Lover's Bridge, the "Cliff Sky Pool" at the edge of the cliff, the trial room in "If You Are the One II" witnessing romantic love, and the internet famous glass wharf are all must visit check-in spots for couples. Strolling along Tianjie, enjoying the slow life of Tianjie at 18 ° N latitude, walking on the panoramic sea view glass bridge, taking in the beautiful scenery of Yalong Bay, facing the sea, backed by green mountains, and blooming all year round. The panoramic sea view glass wharf is located at the top of the Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park, with a highest elevation of 450 meters. It is a panoramic sea view glass wharf. The glass wharf is built along the mountain, with a total length of 400 meters, composed of 130 tons of ultra white imported laminated glass. It includes attractions such as Lingkong Platform, Colorful Sky Ladder, Colorful Lotus Viewing Platform, Rainbow Road, Mountain Oath and Heart to Heart Connection. The road surface of the wharf is entirely paved with 3M * 3M large single transparent glass. Walking on the wharf, you can look up at the sky high and clear clouds, overlook the rainforest valley more than 100 meters deep below, and have a panoramic view of Yalong Bay in front. While feeling scared, you can also enjoy the joy of soaring in the sky. Rainforest Float, also known as the "forest float and water float roller coaster". The floating slide is made of high-strength tempered double-layer laminated glass, with a total length of 3100 meters and a drop of 280 meters, equivalent to a rapid slide down from a 93 story rooftop. The Feipiao has 28 bends throughout its journey, with a total length of 600 meters, including 17 C-shaped bends, 11 S-shaped bends, and multiple consecutive S-shaped major bends. Walking on the cable-stayed bridge, looking up at the undulating mountains, overlooking the vast ocean, listening to the birds singing and smelling the fragrance of flowers, it feels like being in a fairyland of the sea and sky. attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
