attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 榕杉湖景区
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
attractions.summary: Rongshan Lake Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin City. It is a Lianxin Lake connected by water bodies. It is bounded by Yangqiao, with Shanhu Lake in the east and Ronghu Lake in the west. It is named after the banyan trees and fir trees growing on the shore of the lake. During the Tang and Song Dynasties, the artificially excavated moat in the south of the city was called Nanyang River. It was called Jianhu Lake in Yuan Dynasty, and the city was expanded in Ming Dynasty to become Inner Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Named after banyan tree and fir tree

attractions.name: 日月双塔
attractions.name_en: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
attractions.summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

attractions.name: 东西巷
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary: East and West Lane, close to Jingjiang Palace, is a comprehensive commercial block integrating tourism, folk customs, culture, shopping, catering, leisure and entertainment. East-West Lane is the only historical street left over from the Ming and Qing Dynasties in Guilin, with a pleasant spatial scale. It is a scenic spot of Guilin's ancient historical features, including Zhengyang Street East Lane, Jiangnan Lane, Lanjing Lane and other traditional streets and lanes in Guilin.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the rare historic districts of the city

attractions.name: 逍遥楼
attractions.summary: Between Jiefang Bridge and Fubo Mountain in the northern section of Binjiang Road in today's urban area. Founded in the Tang Dynasty, it is the Dongcheng Building of Guizhou City in the Tang Dynasty, with a stone tablet of "Xiaoyao Building" written by Yan Zhenqing. Yan Zhenqing (709-785), whose courtesy name is Qing Chen, was a native of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province today. He was a scholar in the Kaiyuan period of Tang Dynasty. He once worked as the censor in the palace, the prefect of Pingyuan (now Shandong Province), and then became the prince Taishi and the duke of Lu County. He was known as "Yan Lugong" in the world. His calligraphy is dignified, vigorous and powerful, and original, which is called "Yan Ti". Yan Zhenqing has never been to Guilin. According to legend, this tablet was re-engraved according to the hook copy of the tablet in Puzhou (now Yongji, Shanxi). Because it is located in Dongcheng Building, this building is called "Xiaoyao Building". The first year of Chongning in Song Dynasty (1102). Guangnan West Road was reassured by Cheng Jie to rebuild the building and renamed it "Xiangnan Building". The "Records of Xiangnan Building" on the stele yin of the existing "Xiaoyao Building" records the process of building repair and the reason for name change.
attractions.shortFeatures: Dongcheng Tower of Guizhou City in Tang Dynasty

attractions.name: 漓江四星游船
attractions.summary: The basic situation of the cruise ship is that the Li River cruise ship has been upgraded and upgraded. Taking into account the tourist experience and psychological expectations, strict regulations have been made for the per capita cabin area, passenger seat specifications, cabin dining table specifications, and per capita area of the walking deck of the upgraded cruise ship. In addition, fabric soft wrapped sofas are used, which greatly improve comfort and aesthetics compared to ordinary cruise ships. And high material standards are required for the decoration and renovation of the cabin floor, ceiling, cabin wall panels, dining tables, etc. of the cruise ship, and clear regulations are made for the replacement period of curtains, tablecloths, and other decorations, creating a high-end and elegant viewing environment for tourists. The sanitary facilities are fully equipped with advanced technology, and the humanized detail design is comprehensive. The four-star cruise ship has a double decker cabin layout and decoration, with the first floor being a business cabin (second-class), and the per capita area in the tourist cabin not less than 1.8 square meters; The second floor is a luxury business cabin (first-class cabin), with a per capita area of no less than 2.5 square meters in the tourist cabin; The ship is equipped with a double deck walking deck with a wide view and a per capita area of not less than 1.4 square meters. The deck is equipped with sunshades and resting tables and chairs; There are 1.2m high aluminum alloy safety guardrails around. The cabin floor is made of high wear-resistant wood flooring and high-end carpets, while the ceiling and wall panels are made of wood and honeycomb aluminum plate materials, with exquisite craftsmanship. The cabin decoration is beautiful and elegant, reflecting cultural connotations or ethnic characteristics, decorated with flowers and green plants. The cabin dining table is made of elm wood and water chestnut materials, with carved decorations. The tourist seats are designed with armrests, which are comfortable and stylish. The double decker cabin provides both Chinese and Western style buffet meals or customized special dining options for tourists. The tableware and tea utensils are made of high-quality ceramic materials and are equipped with matching tableware for both Chinese and Western cuisine. There are also mini bars to meet the entertainment needs of different tourists. Each row of seats or table is equipped with a tablet computer near the window sill, which can provide a series of intelligent services such as Guilin tourism information, entertainment, and ordering. Full text 

· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 黄布倒影
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
attractions.summary:
· The new 20 yuan RMB background pattern is famous because it is taken from the reflection of yellow cloth, and it is the essence of the essence of Lijiang River. 
Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.
attractions.shortFeatures: Background map of 20 yuan RMB

attractions.name: 桂林千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area is jointly created by Songcheng Performing Arts and Guilin Travel Stock, which reproduces Guilin's history, culture and ethnic customs, and is suitable for all ages to have fun with each other, rain or shine. 
The giant song fairy statue is magnificent and integrated with Guilin's landscape. It is the embodiment of the truth, goodness and beauty of Bagui land. Everything in the scenic spot is tourist-centered, with tens of thousands of square meters of No.3 secret tourism complex, wind and rain corridor and five-star standard toilet with all-indoor air conditioning. Haunted House, Qingming Riverside Film Museum, Wonderful Street and other high-tech and children's experience projects are full of fun. Yangshuo Ancient Village has created a unique farming and market life style. Handicraft workshops such as grandfather's wine jar, grandma's cakes and father's toys in Shijing Street and Fengqing Street keep homesickness and look for the memories of parents. Lover's Harbor and No.4 Bay are good places for young people to relax. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Guilin" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Using advanced high-tech means such as sound, light and electricity and stage machinery, it sings the legend of truth, goodness and beauty in Bagui land through time and space in the three-dimensional space of water, land and air, bringing Bagui culture hidden under the 800-mile Lijiang River into everyone's field of vision, and reproduces a love affair in Guilin for three lives and three lifetimes. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as National Flash Show, Mo Tusi Recruiting Son-in-Law, Song Fairy Welcomes Guests, Guozhuang Carnival, etc. 
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduction of Guilin ethnic customs

attractions.name: 《印象刘三姐》山水实景演出
attractions.summary: 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

attractions.name: 遇龙河景区
attractions.summary: Yulong River is a tributary of the Li River in Yangshuo. The water is as clear as a mirror, and you can easily take pictures of landscape paintings. Compared to the scenery of the Li River, the scenery of the Yulong River is more gentle and is known as the "Little Li River". The bamboo raft drifting along the Yulong River is very famous, where you can take a raft and savor the beautiful scenery of the mountains, waters, and countryside along the river. Drifting on a bamboo raft at the drifting dock, enjoying the picturesque scenery on both sides of the Yulong River. The docks include Jinlong Bridge, Yulong Bridge, Jiuxian, Jima, Shuiedi, Gongnong Bridge, Wanjing, etc. If you choose to drift on the upper half of the Yulong River (from Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian), the drifting time is about 1.5 hours, passing through Yulong Bridge and Rhinoceros Pond along the way. The second half of the drifting (from Chaoyang/Jima to Gongnong Bridge) is mostly accompanied by group tourists.

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 桂海晴岚
attractions.summary: Xinchang · Guihai Qinglan - Guilin's popular new scenic spot attracts groups of visitors to come here to taste art, enjoy mountains and waters, negotiate aesthetics, freely ride bicycles, paint art, have picnics, go for walks Guihai Qinglan integrates life into nature, immersing both adults and children in joy and finding their own answers to a beautiful life

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 十全街
attractions.summary: Shiquan Street is located in the southeast of Suzhou Ancient City, starting from Renmin Road, the main road of the north-south center of the ancient city in the west, and reaching Fengmen in the ancient city in the east. It is not only a part of Suzhou's delicious food, but also a bar gathering area in Suzhou, but most of them are small bars.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit former residences of celebrities

attractions.name: 东方之门
attractions.name_en: Gate to the East Exhibition Center
attractions.summary:
Oriental Gate is regarded as a skyscraper on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou, with a total height of about 301.8 meters. The Oriental Gate is divided into two parts: the South Building and the North Building. Its external shape is a door, and it is known as "the first door in the world". This landmark building is adjacent to Jinji Lake in the east and International Building and Century Financial Building in the west. It is not only a new gate for Suzhou, but also a new gate for the world to look at China. 
This 88-story building was completed in 2013, surpassing Suzhou Xindi Center to become the tallest building in Suzhou. Oriental Gate includes commercial, hotel, office buildings and other services, creating a new urban hotspot for Suzhou with commercial prosperity and driving the prosperity of CDB area. 
Jinji Lake at night is very vibrant. Moonlight Pier, Water Curtain Movie, Ligongdi and Suzhou Paradise light up the shores of Jinji Lake, and the majestic and elegant Oriental Gate is also one of the major landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Suzhou Internet celebrity punch-in new landmark

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖游船
attractions.summary: The Jinji Lake Cruise Project aims to view Jinji Lake from the water and take you to experience a different scenery. Looking eastward from the famous scenic spot of Huqiu Mountain in Wuzhong, one can see a blue wave shining with charming radiance in the sunshine. This is Jinji Lake located in the eastern part of Suzhou. Take a cruise ship and enjoy the unique scenery of Jinji Lake from the water. You will find that the blue waves of Jinji Lake shine with charming brilliance in the sunshine, very brilliant. Full text 

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 西园寺
attractions.tag: Garden garden; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples
attractions.summary: Xiyuan Jiezhuanglu Temple, referred to as Xiyuan Temple for short, is located outside Changmen in the west of Suzhou. It was founded from Yuan Dynasty to Yuan Dynasty and has a history of 700 years. The temple has deep ancient trees, heavy Brahma universe, green water, birds singing and flowers fragrant. Most of the existing temples were built in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and they are the largest temples in Suzhou. On the central axis, from south to north, there are three-room memorial archway, mountain gate, King Kong Hall, release pool, Daxiong Hall and Tibetan Sutra Building. There is Guanyin Hall on the east side of King Kong Hall and Arhat Hall on the west side. There are also Buddhist Chanting Hall, Fayun Hall, Guest Hall, Zhai Hall, warehouse and other buildings in the temple. There are four complete books of Dragon Tibet in the Tibetan Sutra Building, which were later given to Baolian Temple in Hong Kong, and more than 80,000 Buddhist scriptures such as Huayan Sutra written by Master Shan Ji in the Yuan Dynasty. Xiyuan Temple is a large temple with complete scale, magnificent temple, solemn Buddha statues and garden characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combining temples with gardens

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉大学
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as the self-improvement school founded by Zhang Zhidong, governor of Huguang in the late Qing Dynasty, it was later renamed "National Wuhan University"; It is close to the East Lake, surrounded by Luojia Mountain, and the campus is lined with trees. 
Cherry blossoms are famous, and there are major cherry blossom viewing places on campus such as Cherry Blossom Castle, Cherry Blossom Avenue, Cherry Blossom Top and Luojia Square; Among them, the "Cherry Blossom Avenue" in front of the "Laozhai House" is a good place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan University. 
Besides cherry blossoms, what is more worth seeing is the old buildings; The architectural style of the faculty residential complex in the southeast of Luoshan Mountain adopts the style of English country houses as a whole, and each building has its own characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: Walk through the campus and enjoy the vintage architecture

attractions.name: 湖北美术馆
attractions.summary: Hubei Museum of Art, formerly known as Hubei Provincial Art Museum, is located on the shore of Donghu Lake in Wuchang District, Wuhan City, opposite the Hubei Provincial Museum. The main building of the art museum has 4 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. There are ten exhibition halls in the museum, making it a holy land for art enthusiasts and cultural youth. The exhibitions in the museum are updated frequently. If you want to know the exhibition plan, there are previews on the official website. You can check them before going. In addition to the exhibition hall, the art museum also has modern collection art libraries, multifunctional academic lecture halls, VIP halls, artist studios, art training centers, movie theaters, Chinese and Western restaurants, cafes and other advanced supporting service facilities. After visiting the Hubei Provincial Museum, why not come here and have a look? If you're lucky, you can also see everyone's exhibition. Alternatively, you can sit in the coffee shop here and savor art and life.

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 东湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking with kids; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Wuchang, Wuhan, it is named accordingly. It is the second largest urban lake in China and currently one of the largest urban lakes in the country by water surface area.
- It is divided into four areas: Tingtao Scenic Area, East Lake Moshan Scenic Area, Luoye Scenic Area, and Chuidi Scenic Area, each with its own unique characteristics.
- Chairman Mao was lifelong fond of East Lake and referred to it as "the place of white clouds and yellow cranes."
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll along the lakeside and enjoy the captivating lake view.

attractions.name: 东湖听涛景区
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
attractions.summary:
East Lake Tingtao Scenic Area is the earliest scenic spot built and opened in East Lake Scenic Area. 
The main scenic spots in the scenic spot are Xingyin Pavilion, Changtian Tower, Jiunvdun Monument, Kezhuxuan, Huguang Pavilion, Fable Sculpture Garden, Bitang Fish Watching, etc. 
There are also scenic spots, Lu Xun Square and beach bathing beach with the memory of patriotic poet Qu Yuan as the main body.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chu Feng's rich leisure and entertainment place

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 中共五大会址纪念馆
attractions.summary: The Memorial Hall of the Fifth National Congress of the Communist Party of China was established in 2007 and is located in the Tanqiu Campus of Zhonghua Road Primary School in Wuchang District, Wuhan. It complements the old site of the Agricultural Lecture Hall on the same street, forming a "red scenic spot". The memorial hall is lush with trees and has a building area of approximately 4000 square meters. The museum displays the venue for the opening ceremony of the Fifth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the bedroom of Chen Tanqiu and his wife, and the teaching classrooms of Chen Tanqiu and Wu Xiuquan. It consists of three exhibition areas: "Peak and Crisis", "Contribution and Limitations", and "Response and Transformation". At present, the Memorial Hall of the Fifth National Congress of the Communist Party of China has collected more than 110 cultural relics and historical materials, and some of them are exhibited to the public. Through the use of high-tech means, the heartbreaking historical scene around 1927 has been reproduced.

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911.
