· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 辛亥革命博物馆
attractions.summary: The Museum of the Revolution of 1911, located on the south side of Shouyi Square, is a special museum built by Wuhan to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911 in Wuchang. The appearance of the museum combines traditional Chinese architectural elements with modern architectural features. From the air, it is a red "V" shape, which symbolizes the spirit of being the first and the take-off of Wuhan. The museum has four floors, one floor underground and three floors above ground. It has a preface hall, five basic exhibition halls and a multi-functional exhibition hall. The basic exhibition of the Revolution Museum of 1911 "The Foundation of the Republic-Historical Exhibition of the Revolution of 1911" is divided into five parts: China in the late Qing Dynasty, the origin of the revolution, the first righteousness of Wuchang, the founding of the Republic, and the centenary of 1911. It displays 428 pieces (sets) of historical relics of the Revolution of 1911, 694 historical photos, 27 restoration scenes of major historical events, 12 works of art and 20 multimedia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understand the history of the Revolution of 1911

attractions.name: 辛亥革命武昌起义纪念馆
attractions.summary: The predecessor of the Wuchang Uprising Memorial Hall was the Hubei Consultative Bureau in the late Qing Dynasty. In October 1911, the first shot of the Xinhai Revolution was fired in Wuchang. After the successful uprising, the revolutionary party established a military government here. The main body of the memorial hall is a small building with red walls and tiles, commonly known as the "Red Chamber" by locals. The memorial hall, founded in 1909, is a two-story brick and wood Western style building. There are currently two themed displays in the museum. One is the "Restoration Exhibition of the Former Site of the Governor General's Office of the Hubei Army", which reproduces the scene of the early establishment of the Governor's Office. From the display, we can learn about the organizational structure of the military government in its early days. There is also a flag on display, called the Eighteen Star Flag, which is the military flag of the Wuchang Uprising. The eighteen yellow stars represent the descendants of Yan and Huang from the eighteen provinces within Shanhaiguan. The other main exhibition is the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution", which showcases the historical scene of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution through cultural relics, pictures, and models. Here, you can also see portraits of figures related to the Wuchang Uprising. There is also a photo of a woman in the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution". The person in the photo is Zhang Zhujun, the president of the Shanghai Red Cross Society. During the Wuchang Uprising, she organized a civilian medical team and disguised revolutionary party member Huang Xing as a doctor of the Red Cross Society, taking her on a ship to Wuhan. Full text 

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 张公山寨
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Zhanggong Shanzhai is located on the outskirts of Hongshan District, Wuhan, adjacent to Baiyu Mountain of WISCO, and facing East Lake Scenic Area across the dam. The scenic spots include Zhanggong Shanzhai, Orange Island, Peach Blossom Island, Wu Zhu Temple, Happy Farm, Forest Villa, Expansion Exercise, Live CS Battlefield, Yanxi Lake 
Point. You can take a cruise tour in the park. It is a wetland ecological park integrating wetland ecological landscape, agricultural leisure, tourism and vacation. 
The victory of Yanxi Lake lies only in the water. Yanxi Lake has a lake surface of 20,000 mu, a lake shoreline of 66 kilometers, 99 lake branches, surrounded by 56 hills, with clear water and vast lake surface. There are many harbor branches and fish ponds distributed among various scenic spots, forming a unique wetland landscape of Yanxi Lake. 
The importance of Yanxi Lake lies in ecology. Zhanggong Shanzhai Real Estate Co., Ltd. follows the principle of "ecological priority, minimum intervention, emphasis on culture, people-oriented and sustainable development". Besides retaining the original topography and landform, trees and flowers are planted everywhere in the park. The ecological park is a natural green oxygen bar. 
The unique natural landscape of Yanxi Lake has also given birth to rich cultural landscapes. Zhanggong Mountain, Wuzhu Temple, Shimei Temple, Zhushan Mountain, Gujia Mountain, etc. by the lakeside have cultural allusions about Sun Quan, Zhu Yuanzhang, Liu Bowen, Chuzhuangwang and Zhang Zhidong, which are amazing.

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. Full text 

attractions.name: 乡土园
attractions.summary: The Rural Park is located in Wuhan City and is a theme park showcasing traditional Chinese rural culture. The park has restored various traditional buildings and agricultural cultures, allowing visitors to personally experience the daily life and traditional handicrafts of rural China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:30 to 17:30 throughout the year

attractions.name: 竹蹊廊
attractions.summary: The Bamboo Raft Gallery is located in Wuhan and is a unique attraction that combines natural landscapes with cultural arts. This place attracts many tourists with its exquisite bamboo architecture and peaceful environment, making it an excellent place to experience traditional culture and enjoy natural beauty.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 武汉野生动物王国
attractions.summary: Wuhan Wildlife Kingdom is located in Wumei Mountain, surrounded by West Lake and beautiful scenery in Caidian District. It is surrounded by mountains and waters, with abundant natural resources, covering an area of about 2250 acres. The total investment for the third phase is 1.5 billion yuan, integrating wildlife breeding and breeding, animal and plant protection research, tourism and viewing, science education, and interactive experience. As a large-scale immersive experience wildlife park in Central China, the park plans to introduce more than 250 species of animals, with a total of over 10000 individuals, including 25 rare and protected animals. The park takes "natural mountains and rivers as the background, kindred culture as the gene, and animal spirits as the context" to build Wuhan Wildlife Kingdom into a landmark theme park where humans and nature (animals) coexist harmoniously. Full text 

attractions.name: 汉口里
attractions.summary: The original historical and cultural street of the Republic of China-"Hankouli", based on the opening of Hankou for more than a hundred years, restores the representative buildings, culture and commercial forms of Hanzheng Street, Dajia Street, Changdi Street and Hualou Street in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and shows the old Hankou lifestyle.
attractions.shortFeatures: Showing the folk customs of Hankou in the late Qing Dynasty

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京明故宫遗址公园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 黔灵山公园
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids' outings; City Parks
attractions.summary:
- Qianling Mountain Park is characterized by its famous mountains, beautiful waters, secluded forests, ancient temples, sacred springs, and spiritual monkeys, and is known as "The First Mountain of Southern Guizhou."
- The Hongfu Temple at the top of the mountain is the largest Buddhist monastery in Guizhou and is the province's most prominent temple. It was founded during the Qing Dynasty, and it is said that prayers here are very effective.
- There are many rhesus monkeys along the Hongfu Temple and the path down the mountain. Many visitors come to Qianling Mountain Park specifically to see these monkeys, which are free-roaming within the park.
- Halfway up the mountain, there is a zoo with a wide variety of animals. The Qilin Cave in the scenic area was the place where General Zhang Xueliang was once imprisoned.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking the scenery of Guiyang City from the mountain

attractions.name: 甲秀楼
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Jiaxiu Building is a landmark building in Guiyang. Anyone who goes to Guiyang will board it to observe the scenery. 
The existing building was rebuilt during the Xuantong period of Qing Dynasty. The three-story building stands on Aoji Stone, in front of which is the flowing Nanming River. 
Walking through the floating jade bridge connecting Jiaxiu Building, it is Cuiwei Garden, with pavilions and waterside pavilions in the garden, which is quite south of the Yangtze River. 
The night view of Jiaxiu Building is particularly beautiful. From a distance, it is brightly lit.
attractions.shortFeatures: A wooden attic built in the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 二七路小吃街(鸿通城购物中心店)
attractions.summary: Erqi Road Snack Street was once the filming location for "A Bite of China". Here, in addition to tasting Guizhou's local specialty cuisine, people can also fully understand the local food culture and customs.

attractions.name: 天河潭旅游度假区
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A treasure spot for kids; Waterfalls
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the Calcified Beach Waterfall and the Caves.

attractions.name: 青岩古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Ancient Towns; Military Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Qingyan Ancient Town was established in the Ming Dynasty and has well-preserved a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing periods. It is known as one of the four major ancient towns in Guizhou, alongside Zhenyuan, Bian'an, and Longli.
- The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.
attractions.shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Missing Gun"

attractions.name: 南江大峡谷
attractions.summary:
- The South River Grand Canyon is located in Guiyang, integrating natural scenery and cultural facilities, and is known as the "Karst Ecological Museum."
- The scenic area features various landforms, with magnificent Karst canyon landscapes that are the most diverse in type, making it a prime example of canyon scenery.
- It is home to the largest travertine waterfall in Asia, the Jinzhong Waterfall, and is known for its numerous waterfalls in different forms. It also has the longest suspended wooden plank road in the country.
- In addition to the scenery, thrilling activities such as rafting and CS real-life experience games are also must-tries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience Karst Canyon Rafting

attractions.name: 花溪夜郎谷
attractions.shortFeatures: The ruins of the ancient Yelangtunbao have been preserved
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:30-19:00(Admission ends at 18:00),Opens at Daylight saving time 08:30-19:30(Admission ends at 18:30)

attractions.name: 花溪公园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly Hidden Gems: Autumn Leaf Viewing; City Parks
attractions.summary: Huaxi Park is a historically significant natural scenic park in Guiyang. The park was completed in 1940 and was officially named Huaxi Park in 1949. The park is primarily known for its real mountains, real waters, and pastoral landscapes, featuring scenic spots such as Furong Island, Baibu Bridge, Bashang Bridge, Golden Avenue, Lin Mountain, Gui Mountain, Pine and Cypress Garden, Peach Garden, Peony Garden, Bamboo Lotus Pond, and Rest Garden.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the authentic rural scenery.

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 天平山
attractions.tag: Historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Historical Sites; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
The Tianping Mountain Scenic Area is located in the southwest of the ancient city of Suzhou, by the shores of Taihu Lake. It is the core scenic area of the Taihu National Scenic Area and is known as the "First Mountain of Wu" and "A Beautiful Place in Jiangnan." The mountain has an elevation of about 201 meters, with steep and perilous terrain. It was formerly known as Baiyun Mountain, and also called Cishan Mountain, as it is the ancestral burial site of Fan Zhongyan, a renowned official of the Northern Song Dynasty.

The scenic area covers nearly 100 hectares and is famous for its three attractions: red maple trees, strange rocks, and clear springs. It features eighteen scenic spots, including "Wanhui Chao Tian," "Gao Yi Die Cui," "Wan Zhang Hong Xia," and "Yu Quan Qing Yin." The red maples are especially well-known, and every year in autumn, the mountain is covered with red leaves, creating a breathtakingly beautiful scene. It is often hailed as "The Best Red Maple in the World." The best time to view the red maples is at the end of October during the Suzhou Tianping Red Maple Festival.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the Relics of Fan Zhongyan in the Mountains and Forests
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 木渎古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Mudu Ancient Town, known as the "First Town of Wu" in the Wu region, is famous for its small bridges, flowing water, and ancient trees, offering a unique charm among many other ancient towns.  
· The town is crisscrossed by waterways such as the Muguang River, and its stone embankments create an ancient waterway landscape. The old streets and narrow alleys are home to many traditional courtyards.  
· Inside the Hongyin Mountain Villa, there is a grand stage where Emperor Qianlong watched performances during his six visits to Jiangnan. The villa also displays twenty imperial edicts from the emperor.  
· The town is a food lover's paradise, with the recommended Shijia Restaurant serving its signature dish, Fish Lung Soup, made by simmering fish liver in chicken broth. The fish liver is tender, and the soup is extremely delicious.  
· Local crafts in Mudu include silk, double-sided embroidery, redwood carvings, Chengni inkstones, calligraphy and paintings, and stone carvings, all available for purchase as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to explore the classical gardens.

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 五四广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement

attractions.name: 栈桥
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; City coordinates; Bridges; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Qingdao's earliest military-specific artificial wharf is a landmark building and a famous scenic spot in Qingdao. 
The octagonal building inside the breakwater at the southern end is called "Huilan Pavilion". Standing here, you can enjoy the "Flying Pavilion Huilan", one of the ten scenic spots in Qingdao. 
The north coast is called "Zhanqiao Park", with lush flowers and plants, and stone chairs for tourists to rest and enjoy the scenery of the sea and sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old sea promenade

attractions.name: 圣弥厄尔教堂
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Built in 1930, formerly known as "St. Miel Church", it is the largest Romanesque building in Qingdao and the only consecrated church in China. 
· Designed by German designer Biloha, according to Gothic and Romanesque architectural styles. It is a masonry twin tower building with four bells inside. 
· The church is spacious and bright. The hall is about 18 meters high. There are two confession booths on both sides of the corridors for priests to receive believers to confess and confess.  
• The church has a valuable organ imported from Germany, which is played only during Sunday Mass.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous Western Architecture in Qingdao

attractions.name: 小鱼山公园
attractions.summary: Xiaoyushan Park is one of the best scenic spots in Qingdao, firstly because it is located in the city center and is a mountain close to the sea, with a geographical location; Secondly, due to its altitude of only 60 meters, climbing the mountain is not tiring. When you reach the top, you can see the representative scenery of Qingdao, which is "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky". At the top of Xiaoyushan Mountain, there is a three story octagonal pavilion called the Tide Viewing Pavilion, which is 18 meters high and covered with green glazed tiles. Climbing up the spiral staircase to enjoy the view, nearby are German style buildings with red tiles and yellow walls hidden among green trees. To the southeast, you can see the golden sand of the first beach connected to the blue sea. To the northeast, you can see the Qingdao TV Tower on Taiping Mountain. When the weather is good to the west, you can distinguish the small Qingdao and the wharf in the distance. To the north, you can take a panoramic view of Signal Mountain Park. The guesthouse on the mountainside of Signal Mountain and the three red topped mushroom buildings on the mountaintop are clearly visible. At night, you can take photos of the night view of Qingdao city on the mountain. To the west of the Lianchao Pavilion is the Hexagonal Pavilion with Bibo Pavilion, and to the east is the Four Corner Pavilion with Cuicui Pavilion. Both pavilions are covered with green glazed tiles, providing scenic views. The front of the curved corridor connecting the Lianchao Pavilion and Yongcui Pavilion features white reliefs, with modern characters "small" and "mountain" and ancient pictographic characters "fish" forming the mountain emblem of Xiaoyushan. You can take a photo with it, and there are also beautiful murals next to the emblem. In addition, on the southern slope of Xiaoyushan, there are miniature models that gather Qingdao architecture. If you are interested, you can also take a look. There are many scenic spots near Xiaoyushan Park, mostly along the coastline. To the west, you can follow the route of Zhanqiao - Navy Museum - Little Qingdao - Lu Xun Park - Xiaoyushan Park. To the east, you can see Kang Youwei's former residence, the first beach, Badaguan, and then go to Taipingjiao to see the sunset. Full text 

attractions.name: 鲁迅公园
attractions.summary:
Lu Xun Park is a free and open coastal park in Qingdao, with large reddish-brown reefs on the seaside. 
The park stretches from east to west along the long and narrow bedrock coast, adjacent to Qingdao Aquarium and First Bathing Beach in the east, with a total length of about 2 kilometers.  
The park has colorful red reefs, clear water, green pines, secluded paths, pavilions and pavilions, and charming scenery. It is a scenic spot with both garden beauty and natural beauty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Open Seaside Park with Beautiful Scenes

attractions.name: 海军博物馆
attractions.summary: The PLA Naval Museum is a military museum reflecting the development of the Chinese navy in China. It is the historical, spiritual and cultural highland of the People's Navy. The Navy Museum is located at No. 8 Laiyang Road, Shinan District, Qingdao, adjacent to Lu Xun Park to the east and Little Qingdao Park to the west, echoing the wharf from afar. The Naval Museum has a land area of approximately 141 acres and a sea area of approximately 214 acres. It was officially opened to the public in October 1989. In 2001, it was rated as a national defense education demonstration base by the Central Propaganda Department. In June 2021, at the important historical moment of celebrating the 100th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and achieving the goal of "the first 100 years", the Naval Museum completed its reconstruction and expansion, opened to the outside world with a new look, and presented the glorious history of the People's Navy for more than 70 years under the strong leadership of the CPC in a panoramic manner. On May 18, 2022, the Naval Museum's "Strong Towards the Sea - Basic Exhibition of the History of the People's Navy" was awarded the 19th (2021) "National Museum Top Ten Exhibition Excellence Award". The Naval Museum is divided into three exhibition areas: indoor, sea, and land. The indoor main exhibition hall is the basic display of the history of the People's Navy, with four exhibition halls covering an area of over 7000 square meters. It is divided into three parts: "Socialist Revolution and Construction Period", "New Era of Reform and Opening up and Socialist Modernization Construction", and "New Era of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics". There are over 18000 cultural relics in the collection, mainly displayed under the strong leadership of the Party, where the People's Navy was born, grew, and developed through artillery fire; Along the way, cutting through waves and traversing thousands of miles of maritime territory, galloping across the vast oceans, we are striding towards the goal of building a world-class navy. The exhibition area for naval vessels covers an area of over 40000 square meters, with 3 docks and 6 berths. It mainly showcases China's first destroyer Anshan (hull number 101), the first domestically produced destroyer Jinan (hull number 105), the first domestically produced air defense frigate Yingtan (hull number 531), the first nuclear submarine Long March 1 (hull number 401), the first experimental submarine Great Wall 200 (hull number 200) and other iconic vessels. The land equipment exhibition area covers an area of over 13000 square meters. The main exhibition showcases the small surface vessels, naval aviation equipment, marine equipment, and naval coastal defense equipment that have served in the People's Navy since its establishment. The main exhibits include: the Liberation class meritorious boats and gunboats that made great collective contributions in the Battle of Wanshan; The honor boat - No. 245 wooden shell torpedo boat showcased during the first naval parade of the People's Navy; The Il-14 aircraft, which once ensured the participation of Navy Commander Xiao Jingguang in various activities and carried out important tasks such as transporting rescue personnel, supplies, and international friends; Meritorious artillery that participated in the aid to Vietnam and anti US air defense operations; The T-34 tank, which has been widely equipped with the Marine Corps and island guarding forces such as the Xisha Islands; The YJ-62A shore to ship missile launcher, which is used to block ports and sea routes, and maneuver to strike large and medium-sized surface targets, is a significant naval weapon and equipment. These weapons and equipment have played a significant role in tasks such as liberating coastal islands, safeguarding maritime security, and protecting people's lives and property. The Naval Museum will focus on inheriting the red genes, keeping in mind the original mission, strengthening historical memory, and exerting educational functions, striving to build a leading domestic and world leading naval museum. Full text 

attractions.name: 小青岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a treasure spot for strolling with kids.; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Xiao Qingdao is named for its shape, which resembles an ancient zither, and is also known as "Qin Island." The white conical lighthouse standing at the highest point is the landmark building.  
· At night, the red light on the lighthouse and the lights on the pier float on the turquoise waves, creating the scene known as "Qin Island Floating Lights," which is regarded as one of Qingdao's top ten scenic spots and has become one of the city's symbols.  
· Now open to the public as a park, the island is mainly planted with black pines, along with seasonal flowering ornamental plants.  
· On the relatively flat southern part of the island, there is a small square, in the center of which stands a sculpture of a woman holding a zither, facing the sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the landmark lighthouse on Qingdao Island.

attractions.name: 第二海水浴场
attractions.summary: If you go south along Ningwu Pass Road to explore Badaguan, you will come to the second beach next to Huashi Tower. The bathhouse and Badaguan complement each other, forming a typical beautiful landscape of "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky" in Qingdao. Therefore, couples often take wedding photos here, making it a popular location for outdoor filming. The beach of the second bath is slightly smaller than the first beach, but there are fewer tourists here and the environment is better. The beach shore here is made of reddish brown rocks, with cliffs as steep as knives, and black pine trees planted all over the shore, creating a pleasant environment. Even if you come here to take a stroll and bask in the sun, it is still quite comfortable. And the seawater in the second bath is relatively clean, with small waves and gentle slopes, making it a summer swimming destination. There are many pebbles on the western beach of the bathhouse, and visitors often come to pick them up. Due to the abundance of reefs in this area, it is suitable for picking up shells, and even living creatures such as hermit crabs and starfish can be seen. The sandy beach here is relatively fine, so it is suitable for walking barefoot here, and children can also play digging sand. There is also a stone embankment bridge that extends into the sea, where you can walk and feel closer to the ocean.

attractions.name: 青岛啤酒博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.
attractions.shortFeatures: Decoding the Production Process of Tsingtao Beer

attractions.name: 八大关
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Badaguan refers to eight roads named after the eight passes of the Great Wall (now it has been increased to ten). Because there are villas with architectural styles from more than 20 countries, such as Russia, Britain, France, Germany and Mai, it is known as the "World Architecture Expo". 
Huashi Building and Princess Building in Guannei are the most famous, with unique architectural styles and need to charge tickets. They are must-punch places here. 
In addition to viewing buildings, you can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of Badaguan in the four seasons. Shaoguan Road is full of peaches, which bloom in spring; Lagerstroemia indica is planted all over Zhengguan Road, which blooms in summer; Juyongguan Road is a five-angled maple, which is dyed with maple red in autumn frost; There are rows of cedar trees on both sides of Zijingguan Road, which are evergreen all year round.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn viewing resort with red leaves in autumn

attractions.name: 崂山仰口游览区
attractions.summary: Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.

attractions.name: 青山渔村
attractions.summary: Qingshan Fishing Village is located in Laoshan Scenic Area, Laoshan District, Qingdao. Halfway up the mountainside of Laoshan Mountain, it still retains the original style of the fishing village. It has the reputation of Laoshan Fishing Village Folk Customs Museum
attractions.shortFeatures: Featuring fisherman culture

attractions.name: 崂山太清游览区
attractions.summary: The Taiqing Scenic Area is located at the southeast end of Laoshan Mountain, named after the Taoist temple Taiqing Palace. It is mainly divided into two tourist areas: the surrounding area of Taiqing Palace and along the Bashui River. The former is located by the sea, while the latter is a hiking route. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".

attractions.name: 黄岛金沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 

attractions.name: 海口观澜湖火山温泉谷
attractions.name_en: Haikou Mission Hills Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
attractions.summary:
The main building of the hot spring area is inspired by the unique circular earth building in southern China, and a large number of bamboo and volcanic stones are used as materials to create a simple and natural atmosphere. The park includes volcanic rock mineral hot springs with the styles of six continents around the world, uniquely designed spas and outdoor volcanic rock water parks. 
Volcanic mineral hot spring is taken from natural spring water with a depth of about 800 meters underground. The natural water temperature is between 15 ℃ and 43 ℃, and it contains various natural mineral ingredients with health effects. The water quality has been certified by the British International Water Quality Institute.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy special hot springs on five continents

attractions.name: 雷琼海口火山群世界地质公园
attractions.name_en: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
attractions.summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.
attractions.shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.

attractions.name: 海南热带野生动植物园
attractions.name_en: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden
attractions.tag: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens; Zoos
attractions.summary: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden, also known as Dongshan Wildlife Park, is China's first large-scale tropical wildlife park and the country's only island-type tropical rainforest botanical and zoological garden. It is acclaimed as a "natural museum that condenses the essence of Hainan Island's native flora and fauna." The park is located in Dongshan Town, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, approximately 27 kilometers from downtown Haikou. It is themed around tropical wildlife exhibitions and science popularization. The park's landscapes are entirely natural, with vast forested areas and dense vegetation providing an excellent wild environment for animals. Meanwhile, the artificially created jungle trails and a variety of exotic flowers and plants make visitors feel as if they are immersed in a vibrant natural world full of birdsong and floral fragrances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals in the tropical jungle
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 五公祠
attractions.tag: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
Wugong Temple Complex is located at No.169 Haifu Avenue, Haikou City, about 5 kilometers away from the city center. Near the downtown area, it is unique and quiet, and is known as "Qiongtai Scenic Spot", "Yinghai Humanities" and "Hainan's No.1 Scenic Spot". The building complex of Wugong Temple includes: the first floor of Hainan (also known as Wugong Temple), Xuepu Hall, Guanjia Hall, Xizhai (Wugong Jingshe), Dongzhai, Su Gong Temple, Liangfubo Temple, Dongzhuo Pavilion, Fusu Spring, Qiongyuan and the newly-built Wugong Temple Exhibition Hall. 
Wugong Temple is a cultural relic and historic site that displays ancient Chinese demotion culture, Hainan history and culture and ancient architectural art with Hainan characteristics. "Wugong Temple" is the general name of a group of ancient buildings, covering an area of about 100 mu together with gardens, wells and ponds. It was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, rebuilt in the 15th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1889), and then repaired many times, and it is still shining brightly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding the ancient culture of official demotion in ancient buildings

attractions.name: 骑楼老街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street

attractions.name: 海口钟楼
attractions.summary: The Haikou Bell Tower is an important landmark building in Haikou, with a history of nearly a hundred years. It was originally built to adapt to foreign trade. The building is five stories high and the walls are built with red bricks. The Haikou Bell Tower stands on Changdi Road, facing the estuary. The row of ancient buildings across from the Haikou Bell Tower is the famous Haikou Qilou Old Street. The current Haikou Bell Tower was renovated in 1987 with funding based on the original appearance of the old clock tower. Named 'New Sound of Ancient Bell'. The Bell Tower is a symbol of Haikou, witnessing the city's growth process. Full text 

attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Located in the reclamation area on the north side of Haikou, facing Qiongzhou Strait, it is the largest open tropical seaside ecological garden landscape garden in Haikou. 
· Many tropical ornamental plants are planted in Wanlv Garden, which integrates clear water and blue sky with high-rise buildings. 
The 16 scenic spots and many surrounding supporting facilities in the park are complete. It is a large park for Haikou citizens to exercise in the morning and take a walk in the evening.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tropical Ecological Garden for Citizens' Leisure

attractions.summary: The Yundong Library is located adjacent to the sea, with a total area of over 700 square meters. The library has a wide variety of books, including a reading area, terrace, and coffee shop.

attractions.name: 假日海滩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Beaches; Seashores
attractions.summary:
- Located in the northern part of Haikou, stretching 6 kilometers, the beach faces the boundless Qiongzhou Strait, with sailboats coming and going, creating a picturesque scene.  
- The beach consists of sunbathing areas, water sports zones, dining areas, and leisure sections, making it a comprehensive seaside tourism and leisure destination in Haikou.  
- The beach also features a dedicated barbecue area and a water park, which are lively and bustling with crowds throughout the day.
