restaurants.name_en: Cantonese Morning Tea at Hilton Haikou

attractions.name: 拈花湾
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿鸣谷
attractions.summary: Luming Valley is a narrow valley in the northeasternmost part of Nianhua Bay, a Zen town. It is the first petal of the "five petals" in the "Eight Views of Lotus". The trees here are towering, quiet and quiet, and it is a natural landscape with deep flowers and trees in Zen rooms. The name of Luming Valley is due to a thousand-year-old story. It is said that when the Tang monk came back from the Buddha's scriptures, he passed by here, and released two sacred deer brought back from the Luyeyuan of Buddha in Tianzhu Kingdom into the mountain forest. Up to now, there is a clear pool called "Lumian Pond" deep in the mountain bay. The Zen life here is therefore vividly called "Ming Sleeping Zen". There is Luming Tea House in Luming Valley, which is used to receive high-end tea parties or customized meditation activities of private and enterprises.
attractions.shortFeatures: There is a retreat meditation temple

attractions.name: 梵天花海
attractions.summary: Nianhua Bay "Brahma Flower Sea" is backed by mountains, and there is a clear river flowing in the sea of flowers. There is an elegant and vast sea of auspicious flowers here, which smudges Zen in time. Bright yellow sulfur chrysanthemum, pink zinnia, delicate drunken butterfly flower, one color flower, blindly Zen, interpret beauty and contain goodness. Flowers bloom all over the mountains, swaying gently, time is quiet and happiness is full.
attractions.shortFeatures: A sea of colorful flowers can be seen during flowering period

attractions.name: 拈花湾禅行表演
attractions.name_en: nian hua wan chan xing biao yan
attractions.summary: Zen walking performance is an important cultural activity in Nianhua Bay, aimed at providing tourists with a spiritual baptism through the influence of Zen culture. The performance lasts from 18:00 to 20:50 every day, providing visitors with an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of Zen culture and experience Zen life. In addition, Nianhua Bay also has other exciting night performances, such as "Nianhua Smile" night performance, "Water Curtain Dance", "Bright Tower Ceremony" and "Five Lakes Blooming Flowers" night performances, which are held at different locations and times, providing tourists with diverse cultural experiences. Nianhua Bay is not only a tourist attraction, but also a place that can purify and relax the soul. Through these cultural performances, tourists can deeply feel the charm and connotation of Zen culture.

attractions.name: 灵山胜境
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located by the shores of Taihu Lake in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, it is a national 5A-level tourist attraction. It is the only Buddhist cultural theme park that showcases the achievements of Shakyamuni Buddha.
- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.

attractions.name: 九龙灌浴
attractions.summary:
Kowloon Bath, located in the square of Lingshan Giant Buddha, is the largest musical dynamic bronze sculpture group in China, telling the story of Sakyamuni's birth. 
· This is a major landscape of Lingshan Scenic Spot. With the accompaniment of music, the opening and closing of lotus flowers, and the Prince Buddha slowly rises from it, it rotates around in the water curtain formed by the water spray of Jiulong. 
· There are five performances a day. After the performances, the dragon mouth around the square will spray merit water, which visitors can take away; If you want to watch the bathing show in Kowloon, you can choose a location in advance.
attractions.shortFeatures: Giant bronze sculpture of lotus in bud

attractions.name: 灵山大佛
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue

attractions.name: 五印坛城
attractions.summary:
--Wuyin Mandala City stands in the rippling sea of perfume, complementing Lingshan Brahma Palace and Manfeilong Pagoda. It is a unique and authentic Tibetan cultural landscape. 
--What is displayed here is the Tibetan Buddhist culture. Although it is not as magnificent as the Brahma Palace, it is also extremely gorgeous. The mandala is dedicated to five Buddhas in five directions, and its appearance is solemn and brilliant. 
--Walking into the mandala, visitors can not only appreciate all kinds of Buddhist cultural and artistic treasures from all over Tibet, but also participate in interactive folk activities such as lighting butter lamps and pushing Mani sutra tubes.

attractions.name: 灵山梵宫
attractions.summary:
After visiting the main hall of the Brahma Palace, go directly to the second floor, and walk straight to the entrance of the Treasure Hall. 
The four beauties in ancient China, adult fish, falling geese, closed moon and ashamed flowers, were very exquisite. Their clothes were very realistic, and the shape of their cuffs was very thin. This kind of art was perfect. 
There are many works of Patriarch Bodhidharma. There is a large statue of Patriarch Bodhidharma erected in the center, with a red gourd on the back, a pool around it, and many works around it are exquisite treasures ~
attractions.shortFeatures: A magnificent Buddhist palace

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-鼋渚春涛
attractions.name_en: Taihu Turtle Head Islet Scenic Area - Spring Waves of Turtle Islet
attractions.summary: Mountain pavilions are looming, and lakeside lighthouses are towering; Looking at the ups and downs of the island in the distance, I can hear the waves close to the shore. Many scenic spots are listed on the lakeshore, highlighting the accumulation of history everywhere. This is the essence scenic spot of Yuantouzhu. The main scenic spots are lighthouse, "Yuantouzhu" stone tablet, "Hengyun" cliff stone carvings, "Zhenze Shenyan" bronze statue, Chenglan Hall, Feiyun Pavilion, etc.

attractions.name: 江南兰苑
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary: Jiangnan Orchid Garden is a special garden mainly cultivating and ornamental orchids. In 1989, it was listed as the research center of orchid germplasm resources protection in China by the Chinese Botanical Society. The garden has lush vegetation, scattered pavilions, quaint layout, orchid fragrance in all seasons, quiet and pleasant, which can be called a good place to enjoy orchids and taste tea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Special garden mainly cultivating ornamental orchids

attractions.name: 太湖鼋头渚风景区-樱花谷
attractions.name_en: Taihu Yuantouzhu Scenic Area - Cherry Blossom Valley
attractions.summary: Located at the northern foot of Luding Mountain in Yuantouzhu Scenic Area, it is adjacent to the Sino-Japanese Cherry Blossom Friendship Forest and integrated into one. It covers an area of 200,000 square meters and has more than 30,000 cherry blossoms of 68 varieties. It is the largest cherry blossom garden in China. Cherry Blossom Valley has buildings such as Cherry Blossom Viewing Building, Tianyun Pavilion, Fanyingxuan and Cuchun Bridge. It is a good place for people to enjoy cherry blossoms and carry out friendly exchange activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the cherry blossoms in the mountains from many angles in spring

attractions.name: 充山隐秀
attractions.summary: The mountain is hidden and beautiful, located at the southeast foothills of Luding Mountain, where the former Chen Family Garden was located. Chen Family Garden, also known as Ruopu, was built in 1928 by Chen Zhongyan, a national industrial and commercial businessman in Wuxi, and set up a nursery after the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is the main location of Taihu Ornamental Botanical Garden, which wins by trees and flowers, natural wild scenery, many ancient and famous trees, and birds and flowers everywhere.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are many ancient and famous trees

attractions.name: 藕花深处
attractions.summary:
The name of "Deep Lotus Flowers" comes from Li Qingzhao's poem "Return to the boat late after excitement, and stray into the deep lotus flowers", which is full of poetry. If there are no lotus roots to see, there are also cherry blossoms all over the embankment. 
A spoonful of rivers and lakes is thousands of miles away, and a piece of stone is Taihua Chihiro. Often, a poem, a tablet and a plaque are like the finishing touch. A little imagination will have the effect of four or two pounds. 
Deep in the north of the lotus root, there is a small memorial archway near the lake, with the forehead of "Hengyun Mountain Villa" hanging on the front and the forehead of "Scenic Spots in the District" hanging on the back. The word "District" is pronounced as "Europe", which has some origins. Jiu District is another name of Taihu Lake besides Zhenze, Lize and Wuhu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Numerous miles of contiguous aquatic plants

restaurants.name_en: Chinese Restaurant at the Paramita Hotel
Moon on the Water • Lake View Restaurant

attractions.name: 木府
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountain Climbing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The residence of Mu's chieftain in Lijiang in past dynasties, which combines the architectural style of Central Plains in Ming Dynasty with the craftsmanship of Bai and Naxi nationalities, is a landmark of the ancient city. 
After hundreds of years of glory, most of them were destroyed by war, and the remaining parts were seriously damaged in the earthquake in 1996. At present, most of them are rebuilt. 
It is the "Grand View Garden" of the ancient city of Lijiang. Coming to Lijiang without seeing Mufu is almost equivalent to not coming to Lijiang.
attractions.shortFeatures: Locations for hot dramas such as "Mufu Fengyun"

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 丽江千古情
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
attractions.summary:
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area is a large performing arts park and a living ancient tea-horse city, located at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
In the scenic spot, the theme areas such as Chama Ancient Street, Nacuo Sea, Snow Mountain Beach and ethnic villages show Lijiang's thousand-year-old culture and historical customs. The towers are towering, the business is prosperous, the ringing of horse bells in the ancient tea-horse street, and there are many workshops such as wineries, tea houses, Dongba paper, hand-dyeing and copper shops. The rippling blue waves of Nacuo Sea are like a fairyland, with flowers and weeping willows on both sides of the strait; Enjoy leisure time with yaks in a daze on the snowy mountain beach; Feel the strong ethnic customs in ethnic villages and experience a different tea-horse tour. 
The main show "Lijiang Eternal Love" is a must-see performance in a lifetime, which reproduces the history and legend of Lijiang for thousands of years, leads the audience through the snow-capped mountains, and feels a beautiful moment in the remote and primitive wild land, Mosuo Flower House on the banks of Lugu Lake, the ancient tea-horse road wrapped in wind and rain, the romantic and miserable third country of Yulong, and the paradise-like Shambhala. 
The large-scale live performance "Lijiang Love Songs" tells the beautiful and tragic love story of Tibetan boy Abda and Naxi girl Gajimi. There is a volcano here, which can instantly spew out flames more than ten meters high; Here, there are strong Tibetan boys who bravely climb volcanoes, cut boulders and set off huge waves; There are beautiful dances of all ethnic groups in Yunnan, and you can feel the artistic feast in the south of colorful clouds. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
There are also wonderful performing shows in the scenic spot, such as "Mufu Recruiting Son-in-Law", "Guozhuang Carnival", "National Flash Mob", "Muppet", "Yak in a Daze" and "Wandering Singers Singing in Residence", which are staged in turn. 
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area, looking for Shambhala in your heart!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the wonderful performance of eternal love

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located northwest of Lijiang Old Town, it is quiet and ancient, with mountains and waters, more tranquil and primitive than Dayan Ancient Town.
- The mountains behind the ancient town are the foothills of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with lush and beautiful rolling peaks and dense forests.
- The Grand Stone Bridge and the Dajue Palace are well-preserved, with murals depicting figures from Buddhist teachings.
- It is an important part of the UNESCO World Heritage Lijiang Old Town and was selected as a "Charming Town of China" by CCTV in 2005.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tranquil and serene town of Chama Ancient Town.

restaurants.name_en: Intercontinental Lijiang Hefu Resort-Zisu Cuisine Restaurant
Lijiang Jinmao Hotel Hyatt Choice-Lakeside Restaurant

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 余荫山房
attractions.summary: Yuyin Mountain Villa, also known as Yuyin Garden, is a private garden of Wu Bin, a scholar from the Qing Dynasty. It has a history of more than 130 years. The garden is renowned for its exquisite and intricate artistic features, with pavilions, halls, towers, bridges, corridors, and embankments all compactly arranged within a 300-step radius. The garden is rich in four major types of carvings—brick carvings, wood carvings, plaster carvings, and stone carvings—showing off the elegance and charm of the renowned garden. Ancient trees soar, and rare flowers dazzle, bringing vibrant life to the entire garden. The four major wonders of the garden, namely "Bamboo in the Side Wall," "Rainbow Bridge Reflecting the Moon," "Hidden Treasures in the Deep Willows," and "Double Greens Welcoming Spring," leave visitors in awe and make them reluctant to leave.
attractions.shortFeatures: Known for its compact and delicate layout.

attractions.name: 岭南印象园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gem for Kid-Friendly Activities; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 珠江夜游天字码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Tianzi Pier
attractions.summary: The Pearl River Night Tour is one of the eight scenic spots in Guangzhou, a window to display the splendid ancient civilization and modern development achievements of Guangzhou, and also a crystallization of Guangzhou tourism. The time-honored ferry dock in Guangzhou, the Tianzi Dock (built in the reign of Emperor Yongzheng in the Qing Dynasty), has a history of more than 270 years. It has become the main deck of the Pearl River night navigation, receiving foreign guests welcomed by the Party and leaders as well as the people's government of Guangdong Province and Guangzhou City. Full text 

attractions.name: 越秀公园
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Nighttime Sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The largest park in Guangzhou, known for its beautiful natural scenery, is ideal for walking and exercising.  
· It consists of the main peak Yuejing Hill and seven surrounding hills, including Guihua Hill, Mukai Hill, Liyu Hill, and others, as well as three artificial lakes: Beixiu, Nanxiu, and Dongxiu.  
· The park contains many historical sites, including the Five Rams Statue, the Sun Yat-sen Monument, the ancient city walls of Guangzhou, and the Four Cannon Platforms.  
· In addition to the natural scenery and historical sites, the park also features cultural and recreational facilities such as a stadium, swimming pool, and Jin Yin Amusement Park.  
· Near the west entrance of the park is Guangxiao Temple, and one can visit both Guangxiao Temple and Chen Clan Ancestral Hall in a single day.  
· In the spring of March, the cotton tree flowers bloom, with their bright red petals harmonizing beautifully with the ancient architecture.
attractions.shortFeatures: The sculpture of the Five Rams, a symbol of Guangzhou.

attractions.name: 宝墨园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; gardens and parks.; Gardens
attractions.summary:
· Bao Mo Garden is a distinctive Lingnan-style garden, built during the Jiaqing period of the Qing Dynasty to commemorate Bao Zheng.
· The main buildings and attractions in the garden include Zhiben Hall, Bao Mo Hall, Qingxin Pavilion, Yanglian Bridge, Zidong Boat, Longtu Pavilion, Qianxiang Corridor, and the Flavor Street.
· In front of the gate, there are two finely crafted folk brick carvings. The garden also features a large number of gray carvings, stone carvings, ceramic sculptures, and rosewood carvings, as well as traditional palace lanterns.
· Additionally, there are ancient pine trees over a thousand years old, Jiuli fragrant trees, two-faced trees, ginkgo trees, Yutang Spring, banyan trees, Crape Myrtle trees, and Lingnan-style bonsais.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lingnan Culture: Landscape and Garden; The Beauty of Lingnan Architecture

attractions.name: 沙湾古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient towns and villages; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
- With a history of over 800 years, it is well-preserved and a historic ancient town of Lingnan culture.
- Represented by Liugengtang, the ancient village layout of "stone steps and stone alleys" is well-preserved, retaining a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming, Qing, and Republic of China periods.
- Shawan Ancient Town has preserved a large number of artistic masterpieces, such as brick carvings, wood carvings, stone carvings, clay sculptures, and murals, and is known as the "Hometown of Folk Sculpture" in Guangdong Province.
- It also boasts intangible cultural heritage and traditional cultural activities, such as Lion Dance, Cantonese music, Shawan Floating Colors, brick carvings, as well as events like the Birthday of the North Emperor, Aoyu Dance, Dragon Boat Racing, and Orchid Cultivation.
attractions.shortFeatures: A robe of splendour travels through Shawan; Hometown of Chinese Folk Art; A famous historic and cultural town in China.

attractions.name: 花城广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza

attractions.name: 海心沙亚运公园-海心沙广场
attractions.summary: Haixinsha Square is a place that integrates floral art, horticulture, and urban architectural art.

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 飞鹅山观景台
attractions.summary: At Fei Ngo Shan, climbing up to the observation deck, you can enjoy the vast sea and dozens of islands in Sai Kung, as well as the panoramic view of the entire Kowloon and Hong Kong Island. It is also one of the good places for many people to drive for outings on Sundays. This is also a good place for people to fly kites and model planes, so there are also many beautiful kites and model planes flying in the sky on Sundays.

attractions.name: 黄大仙祠
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Wong Tai Sin Temple, formerly known as Sik Sik Yuen, is one of the most popular temples. 
· Wong Tai Sin, where the temple is enshrined, is said to be responsive to requests. There are other buildings rich in Chinese traditional colors in the temple, such as Sansheng Temple, Main Hall and Congxin Garden. 
There is a small park next to the shrine, which is well designed, exquisite and exquisite, and has a garden scenery. The Nine Dragon Wall on the side is modeled after the Forbidden City in Beijing.  
The most distinctive feature of Wong Tai Sin Temple is its "five-shaped" architectural layout. Feiluan Terrace, Sutra Hall, Yuye Pool, Yuxiang Pavilion and Zhaobi in the temple each represent the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire and earth.
attractions.shortFeatures: The temple of the three religions with exuberant incense

attractions.name: 通菜街
attractions.summary:
· The open-air market with more than 100 street stalls is a popular place to shop for cheap clothing and souvenirs. 
· Vendors usually set up blue and white canvas with iron branches to sell women's clothing, men's clothing, cosmetics, jewelry, household goods, etc. 
In addition to Chinese tourists, there are many foreign tourists who can bargain for things, sometimes 50-60% off. 
Generally, stalls start to open around 12 o'clock, but some stall owners don't set up stalls during the day and wait until evening to open.
attractions.shortFeatures: A well-known women's shopping street

attractions.name: 香港故宫文化博物馆
attractions.summary: ·Appreciate over 900 precious cultural relics from the Palace Museum, some of which have never been publicly exhibited. From a Hong Kong perspective and with a global perspective, appreciate the collections of the Palace Museum and other important cultural institutions around the world. Experience Chinese culture and art in a new way. △ Qiu Ying (c. 1494-1552) Lanting Inscription, mid-16th century gold plaque with colored fan surface © Exhibition Hall 8 of the Palace Museum: Bank of China (Hong Kong) presents "Tracing the Origins of Chinese Civilization" (September 25, 2024 to February 7, 2025). Chinese civilization is one of the four major civilizations in the world, profound and long-standing. The exhibition aims to showcase the historical context of the origin, formation, and development of Chinese civilization, bringing together approximately 110 precious cultural relics from 14 important cultural and museum institutions across the country, including 16 national first-class cultural relics. These cultural relics span from the mid to late Neolithic period to the Xia Dynasty (8200-3500 years ago), including pottery, jade, stone carvings, bone artifacts, bronze ware, etc. Most of the cultural relics were exhibited in Hong Kong for the first time. Exhibition Hall 9: "When the Forbidden City Meets the Palace of Versailles - Cultural Exchange between China and France in the 17th and 18th Centuries" (December 18, 2024 to May 4, 2025) The exhibition showcases nearly 150 treasures from the two world heritage sites - the Forbidden City and the Palace of Versailles, presenting the history of mutual admiration, inspiration, and exchange between the Chinese and French courts in culture, art, technology, and other fields from the second half of the 17th century to the 18th century, as well as the precious friendship between the two countries. Full text 

attractions.name: 前水警总部大楼及马厩
attractions.name_en: Former Water Police Headquarters Building and Stables
attractions.summary: The former Marine Police Headquarters building was built in 1884, including the main building, stables, and time tower; After restoration, it became the '1881 Heritage', which includes exhibitions related to this building.

attractions.name: 尖沙咀钟楼
attractions.summary:
· The Clock Tower is the only remaining building of the Kowloon-Canton Railway Terminus, built in 1915. It is located next to the Star Ferry Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui. 
· This is a landmark of Kowloon and a symbol of the steam train era. It was originally located in Kowloon Railway Station. It has been listed as a declared monument in Hong Kong.  
The appearance of the bell tower is simple and elegant. Visitors can only watch it from the outside, but are not allowed to enter the inside of the bell tower.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cultural Center Square Landmark Building

attractions.name: 天际100香港观景台
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Sky100 Hong Kong Observation Deck is located on the 100th floor of the International Commerce Centre (ICC), the tallest building in Hong Kong. It is the tallest indoor observation deck in Hong Kong. 
· Visitors can enjoy a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Victoria Harbour and Kowloon Peninsula from a viewing position at a height of 393 meters above sea level, as far as Macau. 
· Skyline 100 has the "five best", namely, the latest scenic spot, the tallest building, the fastest double-decker elevator, the most complete landscape and the most city center. 
· The observation deck is equipped with stereoscopic projection exhibition and 3D cinema, where you can learn about the development and customs of Hong Kong.
attractions.shortFeatures: 360-degree bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 南丫岛
attractions.tag: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
· Lamma Island, also known as Boliao Island, is the third largest island in Hong Kong. It was first known as the hometown of Chow Yun Fat. 
Nowadays, it is the first choice for outlying islands. You can walk leisurely among picturesque scenery, visit literary shops and simple fishing villages, and taste seafood feasts. 
There are traditional western food, Indian food, Mediterranean food and other specialty restaurants on Lamma Island. The most famous ones are Chinese restaurants "Longhua Seafood" and "over the rainbow Seafood", which focus on seafood. 
The accommodation on the island is mostly homestays, mainly located in Rongshu Bay, Hong Shing Ye Bay, Sok Kwu Wan, etc. In addition, there are several listed resorts.
attractions.shortFeatures: A picturesque leisurely outlying island

attractions.name: 洛阳古墓博物馆
attractions.summary:
Luoyang Ancient Art Museum is the largest special museum of ancient tombs in China and the first museum of ancient tombs in the world. 
The museum consists of three exhibition areas: the exhibition area of typical tombs of past dynasties, the exhibition area of imperial tombs of Northern Wei Dynasty and the exhibition of quintessence of ancient tombs. 
There are dozens of tombs from various periods in ancient China in the museum, all of which were relocated from their original sites and restored and displayed underground according to the shape of tombs. 
Here, you can get to know the internal environment of the ancient tomb at close range and from multiple perspectives, including tomb chamber buildings and murals, unearthed cultural relics and cultural relics, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient Tomb Museum with Archaeological Value

attractions.name: 龙门石窟
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Grottoes; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves in China, with a long history, the construction spanned multiple dynasties and lasted for over 500 years.
- Among the numerous caves carved during the Northern Wei period, the Ancient Yang Cave, the Central Cave of Binyang, the Lotus Cave, and the Cave Temple are the most representative.
- There are more than 97,000 Buddha statues in total, with the Western Mountain Caves being the most refined part, including the Luoshen Buddha statue and the "Twenty Images of Longmen."
- Among the key caves of the Tang Dynasty Longmen Grottoes, the grand and imposing group sculptures of the Great Luoshen Buddha are the most famous.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves of China
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 潜溪寺
attractions.summary: Qianxi Temple is the first big cave at the northern end of Longmen West Mountain. It is more than nine meters high, nine meters wide and nearly seven meters deep. It was built in the early Tang Dynasty more than 1,300 years ago. The caisson on the top of the cave is a shallow carved big lotus flower. Amitabha, the main Buddha, sits upright on the Sumeru platform, with a plump face, raised chest, and oblique clothes hanging in front of the seat. His body is well proportioned and his expression is wise. His whole posture gives people a sense of quietness and kindness. On the left side of the Buddha is the big disciple Kasyapa, and on the right side is the younger disciple Ananda. Next to the two disciples are Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva and Mahashizhi Bodhisattva. In particular, the Bodhisattva on the south wall is full and honest in shape and quiet in manner. There are 1: 1 replicas displayed in the Palace Museum. Amitabha and the two Bodhisattvas on both sides are called the Three Saints of the West, that is, the three saints in charge of the western paradise, and are the objects of Buddhist Pure Land belief.
attractions.shortFeatures: Xishan Grottoes with quiet and kind Buddha statues

attractions.name: 宾阳洞区
attractions.summary: The Binyang Cave is located within the Xishan Grottoes and consists of three caves: Binyang South Cave, Binyang Middle Cave, and Binyang North Cave. Binyang "means welcoming the sun of birth and is one of the caves created by Emperor Xuanwu of Northern Wei to honor his parents, Empress Dowager Xiaowen and Empress Dowager Wenzhao. Binyang Middle Cave is a representative cave of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which started construction in 500 AD and took 24 years to complete. Due to the death of host Liu Teng and other reasons, only one of the three planned caves, Binyang Middle Cave, was completed. The main statues of the South Cave and North Cave were not completed until the early Tang Dynasty. The cave in Binyang has a horseshoe shaped flat surface, a dome shaped roof, and a lotus treasure cover carved with double petals of large lotus flowers in the center. Around the lotus flowers are eight auspicious gods and two offerings to heaven and man. The cave is themed around the Three Buddhas of the past, present, and future, with Shakyamuni as the main Buddha. Due to the Northern Wei Dynasty's emphasis on thinness as beauty, the main Buddha Shakyamuni had thin cheeks, a slender neck, and a slender body. On the north and south sides of the front wall of the cave, there are four layers of exquisite reliefs from top to bottom. The first layer is a relief sculpture based on the story of the Vimalakirti Sutra, called "Vimalakirti". The second layer consists of two stories about the life of Buddha. The third layer is the famous painting of emperors and empresses worshiping Buddha. The fourth layer is a relief statue of the "Ten Divine Kings". The main Buddha statues in Binyang South Cave were all completed in the early Tang Dynasty. The main Buddha in the cave is Amitabha Buddha, with a full face, broad shoulders, and a plump body, reflecting the Tang Dynasty's style of beauty based on obesity. Full text 

attractions.name: 万佛洞
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Nature and Adventure; Caves; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
The Wanfo Cave is named after 15,000 small Buddhas carved neatly on the north and south sides of the cave. It was built in the Tang Dynasty. The cave has a structure of front and rear chambers, with two powerful men and two lions in the front room and one Buddha, two disciples, two Bodhisattvas and two heavenly kings in the back room. It is the cave with the most complete statue combination in Longmen Grottoes. 
There is a statue of Guanyin Bodhisattva carved on the south wall outside the cave, which is a beautiful example of many Bodhisattva statues in Tang Dynasty in Longmen Grottoes. 
The main Buddha in the cave is Amitabha, sitting upright on a double-layer lotus seat, with a plump and round face and wide shoulders. The simple and smooth clothes pattern uses the carving technique of round knife in Tang Dynasty. The Lord Buddha gives the "Fearless Seal", which means that there is no fear between heaven and earth, and I am the only one. 
The whole cave is magnificent, showing people the ideal land of the western paradise, and setting off a warm and cheerful atmosphere in which all people become Buddhas.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fifteen thousand small Buddhas neatly arranged

attractions.name: 莲花洞
attractions.summary:
Lotus Cave is located in Xishan Grottoes in Longmen Grottoes scenic spot. It is named after a big lotus with high relief carved on the top of the cave. Lotus Cave was excavated around the Northern Wei Dynasty. 
Lotus, as a famous symbol of Buddhism, is widely used in the decoration of grotto roofs, but such a huge and exquisite high-relief lotus flowers as the lotus cave roofs are rare in Longmen Grottoes. Feitian surrounding the lotus flowers had a light figure, a slender waist and a long dress, and his posture was free. 
A Buddha, two disciples and two Bodhisattvas are built on the front wall of the cave, and the main statue is a standing statue of Sakyamuni. One Buddha and two disciples are standing up, showing the image of Sakyamuni leading the two disciples to lobby and give lectures. The eldest disciple Kasyapa holds a tin staff and wears a heavy and wide cassock, which seems to have traveled a long distance after hard years. Unfortunately, its head was stolen in its early years, and it is now in the Guimet Museum in France. 
The left and right Bodhisattvas wear lotus crowns and have a graceful posture. 
On the upper side of the south wall, there is a small thousand Buddhas with a height of only 2cm, which are finely engraved and vivid in shape. There are two exquisite Buddhist stories in the second niche on the lower floor, with flying dancing on them. 
The lintel outside the cave is engraved with a flame pattern, and an animal-shaped shop head is engraved in the middle, with exquisite carving. At the top left, there is the word "Yi Jue" inscribed by Zhao Yan, the censor who patrolled Henan and other places in the Ming Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The top of the cave is carved with a large lotus flower in relief

attractions.name: 奉先寺
attractions.summary:
Fengxian Temple, located in the south of Longmen West Mountain, is the largest and most representative open-air Buddhist shrine in Longmen Grottoes. 
The main Buddha Lushena, 17.14 meters high, is the largest Buddha statue in Longmen Grottoes. This Buddha statue is a typical statue of the Tang Dynasty, wearing a cassock, with a plump face, a slightly curled mouth and a slight smile. 
The statues in the temple show the high achievements of sculpture art in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and are wonders in the history of stone carving art.

attractions.name: 卢舍那大佛
attractions.summary: Lu Shena Buddha, shaped according to the image of Wu Zetian, was built in the fourth year of Emperor Gaozong Xianheng of Tang Dynasty, that is, in 672 AD. It is located in Fengxian Temple on the southern mountainside of Longmen West Mountain in Luoyang, with a height of 17.14 meters. It is the highest artistic level, the strictest overall design and the largest scale in Longmen Grottoes. The stone statue of Great Lushena is 17.14 meters high, with a head height of 4 meters and an ear length of 1.9 meters. The Sanskrit word "Lushena Buddha" means universal light and universal brilliance, which comes from the belief of the sun god worshipped by the ancient sun god. Standing nearby and gazing at the Buddha will make people amazed. The Buddha is dressed in a shoulder-long coat, which wraps from the right shoulder to the left shoulder, covering the soothing pleats of the whole body, which is elegant and mighty. The layout of Fengxian Temple statues consists of nine statues, such as one Buddha, two disciples, two Bodhisattvas, two heavenly kings and two powerful men. According to the rules of Buddhism, the artist carved a large group of statues with different personalities and temperaments, and also showed the internal connection between these groups of statues in perfect harmony and vividly.
attractions.shortFeatures: Buddha statues shaped in Wu Zetian's image
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 白园
attractions.summary:
Baiyuan, located on the Pipa Peak of Dongshan Mountain in Longmen Grottoes Scenic Area, is the cemetery of Bai Juyi, a famous poet in Tang Dynasty. 
White Garden is built on the mountain, which is beautiful and quaint. There are more than 10 main small scenic spots in the garden, such as Tingyi Pavilion, Music Paradise, Poetry Gallery, Tomb Area, Japanese Calligraphy Gallery and Daoshi Bookstore. 
You can reach the summit of Pipa Peak by following the stone steps on the right of Letian, where Bai Juyi's cemetery is located. 
The Japanese Calligraphy Gallery is built for the exchange of calligraphy between China and Japan, and most of them are works by famous contemporary Japanese calligraphers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient cemetery of Bai Juyi, a poet in Tang Dynasty

attractions.name: 香山寺
attractions.summary: Xiangshan is named after its abundant production of fragrant kudzu. Xiangshan Temple was first built in the first year of Xiping in Northern Wei (516 AD) and in the sixth year of Dahe in Tang Dynasty (832 AD). Henan Yin Bai Juyi donated six to seven hundred thousand guan to rebuild Xiangshan Temple and lived here in seclusion in his later years. It is separated from the world cultural heritage site of the Longmen Grottoes Xishan Grottoes by a narrow strip of water, facing each other across the river, and connected to the Longmen Grottoes Dongshan Grottoes and Baiyuan, standing side by side.

attractions.name: 老君山景区
attractions.summary: According to legend, Laojun Mountain Scenic Area is the place where the founder of Taoism, Li Er (Laozi), retired and practiced. During the Northern Wei Dynasty, a temple was built in the mountain to commemorate him, and later it was honored as a "famous mountain in the world". It has always been a place of strong incense. The trees in the mountains are lush, the scenery is picturesque, and mountain springs can be seen everywhere. In the golden autumn, this is the best choice for surrounding areas to enjoy the red leaves. After the rain, Laojun Mountain is surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland in the sky. The scenic area is vast, mainly divided into the central Laojun Mountain main scenic area, the Dream Chasing Valley scenic area in the west, and the Zhaigou scenic area in the east. Generally, tourists spend a day exploring the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, which is also a well-developed region of the entire scenic area. If you go to the mountaintop, there is still a chance to enjoy the beautiful sea of clouds, sunrise, and sunset. The main scenic area of Laojun Mountain includes major attractions such as Zhongtianmen, Jinding, Laojun Temple, Nantianmen, Yuhuangding, and Mazongling. Since its establishment in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Laojun Temple has been the center of worship for pilgrims from the Central Plains; The Taoist temple at the Jade Emperor's Peak enshrines the Jade Emperor, which is also a great place for mountain viewing; Jinding and Mazongling are great places to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds. Recommended itinerary: A one-day tour to explore the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain is the choice of most tourists. Roughly speaking, the route is as follows: Lingguan Hall - Laojun Statue at the foot of the mountain - Linqi Hall - Zhongtian Gate - Linyin Trail - Woyun Pine - Bodhisattva Hall - Laojun Temple, Jinding - Yuhuangding, and then return to the original route. Tourists can choose to visit Laojun Mountain on foot or by "walking+cableway" depending on their own situation. Between the Lingguan Hall at the foot of the mountain and the Zhongtian Gate on the mountainside, there is the Zhongling Cableway in the scenic area. Take the Zhongling Cableway and then walk from Zhongtianmen to the Jade Emperor Peak at the top of the mountain. The road from Zhongtianmen to the top is not very steep and usually takes about an hour to complete. If you have plenty of time, you can spend two days exploring Laojun Mountain. The approximate itinerary is as follows: D1： Visit the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain and stay overnight in the mountains. D2： From the top of Laojun Mountain, choose to descend from the Dream Chasing Valley in the west or the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, and reach the west and east gates of the scenic area respectively. In the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, accommodation is available near Zhongtianmen on the mountainside and Laojun Temple on the mountaintop. There are hotels near Zhongtianmen with good accommodation conditions, while the accommodation conditions around Laojun Temple are relatively poor. If you are planning to go to the mountaintop the next morning to watch the sunrise, then you can stay around the Laojun Temple. Compared to the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, the mountain roads in Chasing Dreams Valley are smoother, and tourists can choose one of them to descend according to their preferences. There are multiple places in the entire scenic area that can provide catering services for tourists, but some road signs in the scenic area are not yet very complete, so tourists need to pay more attention when playing. Full text 

attractions.name: 中天门广场
attractions.summary: The square is located in Luanchuan County, Luoyang City. At the entrance of the square, there is a mountain gate with the words "Jingshi" written on it. Surrounded by mountains and streams, the scenery is beautiful.

attractions.name: 十里画屏
attractions.summary: The Ten Mile Painted Screen is located within the Laojun Mountain Scenic Area in Luanchuan County, Luoyang City. Here, there are both the hardness of mountain peaks and the softness of clouds and mist, which are breathtaking and unforgettable. It is one of the famous landscapes of Laojun Mountain. The ten mile long cloud crossing plank road within Laojun Mountain is a picturesque scenery, hence it is called the Ten Mile Painted Screen. Looking around, the entire mountain is covered in green and red, magnificent and spectacular. Walking in the middle, step by step, the scenery is picturesque, making people mesmerized.

attractions.name: 金顶道观群
attractions.summary: The Jinding Taoist Temple is located in the Laojun Mountain Scenic Area of Luanchuan County, Luoyang City, at the top of towering peaks. Under the sunlight, the Taoist temple group reflects dazzling golden light, like a dream or a fairyland. The Jinding Taoist Temple complex includes two Jinding temples, one Jinding hall, as well as buildings such as the Daode Mansion and the Bell and Drum Towers. Among them, there is a cloud bridge connecting the larger Wumu Golden Hall and the majestic Daode Mansion, making it easy to visit.

attractions.name: 寻迹洛神赋
attractions.summary: Luoshui Tang Tang, a river of history and culture. "Black Bow BLACKBOW draws inspiration from the spirit of" Luoyang charm "and uses the Heluo culture as a creative blueprint to tell the story of Luoyang through technology and art, constructing China's first digital immersive performance" Luoshen Fu ". The opening ceremony visual effects director of the Beijing Winter Olympics, Wang Zhiou, served as the chief director, and the opening ceremony visual effects production team, Black Bow BLACKBOW, served as the chief creator. The venue combines digital imaging, mechanical devices, and live performances to showcase the reincarnation story of the ancient capital Luoyang City; Integrating digital immersive performances, immersive museums, and multi-dimensional digital performances, it comprehensively and comprehensively showcases the cultural history of Luoyang. The expert team BLACKBOW specially invited Pan Lusheng of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles, Guan Jun, president of the Calligraphy Institute of the Chinese Academy of Arts, Sun Xiaochun, president of the School of Humanities of the University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Geng Shuo, associate professor of the School of Humanities of the Central Academy of Fine Arts, to serve as the expert of "Tracing Luoshen Fu". Based on the Heluo culture, with a historical perspective of "ancient, modern, and new", we will deeply explore the historical culture and humanistic arts of Luoyang "in the world", as well as the "radiation" and dissemination of Luoyang culture to the world. The digital immersive performance black bow highly extracts the core cultural symbols of Luoyang, breaks the traditional theater viewing mode, and uses a combination of non-linear narrative and three-dimensional performance areas to break through the limitations of time and space, bringing multi-dimensional sensory stimulation and emotional resonance to the audience. Experience a fully immersive walking and performance mode, walking in different time and space. Exploring the long forgotten story of Luoyang from a new perspective, and glimpsing the origins and traces of the Hetu Luoshu. Witnessing the encounter between Cao Zhi and Luo Shen, experiencing the sorrow of wandering for roots, and exploring the state of mind of literati and ink masters Saints, grandmasters, and famous poets have gathered in Luoyang for thousands of years. The story of Chinese civilization begins here - the Xia and Shang dynasties began, casting tripods and shaping inscriptions; Duke Zhou established the capital and established rituals and music; The Three Kingdoms and Two Jin Dynasties were both literary and martial; The Buddhist capital of Northern Wei, the wonder of Galan; During the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties, various countries came to court; In the Western Capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, famous scholars gathered. Immersive museums rely on the form of "digital" cultural and museum exhibitions to comprehensively and stereoscopically reproduce the glorious era of the ancient capital Luoyang. By combining digital art, real-time interactive exhibitions, and live performances, we will experience a journey through time and space. Pursuing the source of civilization, entering the temporal and spatial dimensions of history, exploring and practicing cross-border innovation of "cultural relics+technology", and unfolding the "picture scroll" drawn by the unique cultural symbols of Luoyang one by one. The book of rivers, maps, and Luo in the world is here; Chinese civilization originated here; Duke Zhou measured the shadows and established his capital here. The wheels of history slowly pass by, and civilization flows endlessly for thousands of years. We will return to the "world" in the hearts of ancient people, awaken the dormant Chinese civilization under this land, trace the source of civilization and explore the center of the world through the changes of the world. Wulu Tongluo Luoyang is also a crossroads of ancient Chinese transportation, where waterways and land routes intersect. The Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the Ten Thousand Mile Tea Road, the Grassland Silk Road, the Desert Silk Road, and the Maritime Silk Road, transportation arteries from different periods converge in Luoyang, forming a major transportation pattern of "five roads connecting Luoyang". They are not only economic and trade routes, but also cultural exchange routes, injecting a continuous stream of vitality into the historical process of Luoyang's prosperity for thousands of years. Culture collides and blends in exchanges, and we will become ancient people, listening to camel bells in the desert, traveling through ancient sandy roads, encountering boats, carts, and merchants, and retrieving the "treasures" left behind by our predecessors on the way, returning to the magnificent era of "Five Roads Connecting to Luo". If you ask about the rise and fall of ancient and modern times, please only look at Luoyang City. Looking back at Luoyang for a thousand years, it seems like a dream. Today, we will pick up the fleeting shadows scattered in the long river of history one by one, immerse ourselves in this shining historical memory, return to the prosperous era of the ancient capital, and search for the dream of the divine city together. The national beauty of peonies has accompanied Luoyang for thousands of years. What would the world look like in her eyes? From the perspective of peonies, in the cycle of four seasons and the flow of time and space, we explore the beauty of national colors and feel the growth and decline of all things. We can see the scene of peonies blooming in the capital during the blooming season, and experience the step by step blooming like a startled swan, waving our sleeves into poetry. The 24 solar terms of Heluo Palm Lantern Festival are an important part of traditional culture, reflecting the wisdom and romantic feelings of ancient Chinese people, and embodying the long history and profoundness of Chinese culture. In the "Heluo Palm Lantern" segment, Black Bow incorporates iconic Chinese culture such as the Luoshen Fu and the 24 solar terms. It blends multiple levels of performance forms in outdoor spaces, using technological aesthetics to subvert tradition and make you feel like you are in a fantasy dream, encountering the goddess of Luoshui. The "24 solar terms" unfold slowly like a historical scroll, carrying the longing for the charm of Luoyang and entering the wonderful night of Luoyang together. In the long scroll of time, Luoyang has painted scenes of history, and now it will also paint scenes of the future... The journey of "tracing" has never ended. Let us step onto this land to explore, see, and experience! Full text 

attractions.name: 白马寺
attractions.summary:
- The first temple built by the government after Buddhism was introduced to China, it is known as the "First Ancient Temple of China."
- The existing relics at the White Horse Temple date back to the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, and are all aligned along the north-south central axis.
- The Mahavira Hall is the main hall of the entire temple, with other major buildings including the Hall of Heavenly Kings, the Great Buddha Hall, and the Pilu Pavilion.
- The temple preserves a large number of rare Yuan dynasty sculptures, including statues of the Three Buddhas, the Two Heavenly Generals, and the Eighteen Arhats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Ancestral Grounds of Chinese Buddhism and the Tomb of Di Renjie

attractions.name: 白马寺国际佛殿苑
attractions.name_en: White Horse Temple International Buddha Hall Garden
attractions.summary: The Bai Ma Temple International Buddhist Hall Garden is located inside the Bai Ma Temple in Luoyang City. Walking into the garden, you will see a Buddhist hall full of exotic elements. This garden was built in the early 1990s and incorporates the architectural style of Thai temples, making it very exotic.

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城九洲池
attractions.summary: Today's Jiuzhouchi Site Park covers an area of 288 acres, including the Great Inner Dormitory area in the northwest of the palace city, a part of the Taoguang Garden in the north of the palace city, and the Jiuzhouchi Royal Garden in the north of the city west of the palace city. There are a total of 12 sites, which are protected and displayed through various scientific methods. We hope to use methods and forms such as displaying the original site of ancient ruins and simulating the ground to allow more people to understand the royal garden style during the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties. Jiuzhou Pool, as the imperial garden of Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang dynasties, was a real existence in history. According to the "Fangkao of the Two Capital Cities of Tang Dynasty", "Jiuzhou Pool has a curved pool with several islands in it, like Jiuzhou in the East China Sea. It covers an area of ten hectares, with a water depth of more than ten zhang, and is home to birds, fish, and flowers." In 1960, archaeologists discovered it while excavating Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The palace city area of Luoyang during the Sui and Tang dynasties was composed of a central core area and many surrounding small towns. Jiuzhou Pool is located in the northern part of Xige City on the west side of the Imperial Palace, accounting for about two fifths of Xige City. The scope of "ten hectares of residential land" recorded in the records is based on the Tang Dynasty's system of land cultivation. In the Tang Dynasty, one foot was about 29.5 centimeters and ten hectares were about 520000 square meters, which was larger than the entire western city. However, the actual archaeological measurement of the water area of Jiuzhou Lake is about 139250 square meters. Chinese classical garden art holds a pivotal position in traditional Chinese architecture. The forms of Chinese landscape gardens, represented by literati gardens and royal gardens, are aimed at pursuing the spiritual realm of nature, thus achieving the aesthetic pursuit of "although created by humans, as if opened by heaven", reflecting the cultural concept of "harmony between man and nature", which is completely consistent with the overall architectural concept of Luoyang City in the Sui and Tang dynasties. As a royal garden, Jiuzhou Pool not only embodies the combination of nature and culture, expressing the concept of harmonious unity between humans and nature, but also highlights the "ritual system" in traditional Chinese culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城国家遗址公园天堂明堂景区
attractions.summary: The Sui and Tang Luoyang City National Heritage Park was once the core area of the palace ruins of the Sui, Tang, Five Dynasties, and Song dynasties, among which the famous ones were the Mingtang and Tiantang during the reign of Empress Wu Zetian. Mingtang is located on the axis of Luoyang city during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It is the main hall of the palace city and an important place for Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu Zetian to unify the world and govern the country. The prototype of the Tianfu Tu in the 2013 film "Detective Dee: The Empire of Heaven" directed by Tsui Hark is here. Heaven is the place where Empress Wu Zetian worshipped Buddhism. The building has five floors on the exterior and nine floors on the interior, symbolizing the supreme status of the emperor as the ruler of China. Tourists can take the elevator directly to the ninth floor, overlooking the panoramic view of Luoyang, and the night view is not to be missed. There are also large and small Buddha statues and murals on other floors, which can reveal the profound Buddhist culture. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

restaurants.name_en: Old Town Wangfu Roast Duck Restaurant

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 富里桥
attractions.summary:
Fuli Bridge, located in the upper reaches of Yulong River, has a history of more than 500 years. It is one of the three ancient bridges in Yangshuo. 
Fuli Bridge is beautiful in shape, with an ancient tree at each bridge head, and the reflection in the water is just like the full moon. The bridge is the best place to watch the scenery of Lijiang River. 
It is also the only place for rafting on the Yulong River. It is surrounded by green hills and green waters around the village, with a southern scenery.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to see the idyllic scenery

attractions.name: 如意峰索道景区
attractions.summary: 1、 Basic information: Yangshuo Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area is a high-altitude tourism and leisure project jointly invested and built by Shaanxi Junjing Cableway Investment and Construction Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shaanxi Tourism Group, and Guilin Ruisheng Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The total investment of the project is 260 million yuan. The scenic area is located in Meng Village, Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, adjacent to National Highway 321, 5km away from the Gaotian entrance and exit of Baomao (Guiwu) Expressway, and about 5km away from core scenic areas such as Yulong River, Moon Mountain, Shili Gallery in Yangshuo and Yinziyan Scenic Area in Lipu. 2、 Project Construction The project will build Yangshuo Mountain Top Natural Park, which is composed of the natural karst natural landscape "three peaks and two valleys" (Yuanbao Peak, Ruyi Peak, Xianglian Peak, Caixi Valley, Baihua Valley), cableway, Ruyi Cloud Top Viewing Platform, Ruyi Cable Bridge, Walk in the Forest, glass walkway Road, Digital Experience Hall and other creative landscapes. Tourists can overlook the unique karst peak forest landscape in Yangshuo from a high altitude in all directions, walk through the forest, watch the landscape of Guilin, and experience the fun of walking in the forest! The Ruyi Peak Cableway has a total length of 2012 meters. The lower station of the cableway is located in Xingtianle International Tourism Resort, and the upper station leads directly to Yuanbao Peak. The vertical height difference is 242 meters, and the one-way capacity can reach 2000 people/hour, with a speed of 0.5-6 meters/second (adjustable). The cableway has introduced equipment from POMA company in France, which is a single line cyclic unhooking gripper 8-person hanging box cableway. The overall operation and safety system adopts advanced passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 3、 Since its opening on January 6, 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area has been operating in good condition. During the operation period, the goal of zero occurrence of safety production responsibility accidents was achieved, with no major tourist complaints or incidents of malfunctioning parking, and no occurrence of fire and other personal injury safety accidents. In November 2020, the Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the honor of "Top Ten Scenic Spots of Guilin City" by the Guilin Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism. On December 24, 2021, it was rated as a "Contract abiding and Creditworthy" public enterprise in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region for the year 2020 by the Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. On December 28, 2021, Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area was awarded the certificates of "Safety Production Standardization Enterprise" and "Service Quality 5S Enterprise" by the China Cableway Association. In 2022, it was awarded as one of the "Top Ten Internet Famous Scenic Spots in Guilin" and "Top Ten Astronomy and Climate Landscape Check ins in Guangxi", and was selected as one of the "World Karst Science Entrance Examination Route". 4、 Sightseeing route Take the cableway up the mountain -- View Yuanbao Peak -- Experience Ruyi Cable Bridge -- View Yangshuo from Ruyi Cloud Summit -- Walk through the forest and view the peak forest landscape -- Experience the glass walkway -- Visit the "Singing in Guilin" experience hall -- Return to the mountain 1. The horizontal distance of Ruyi Peak cableway is 2012 meters, the height difference is 241 meters, and the one-way traffic volume is 2000 people/hour. The cableway system equipment is designed and manufactured by POMA company in France. The overall operation and safety system adopts good passenger cableway technology and full process digital automation control system, with technical indicators reaching the world level. 2. The Ruyi Suoqiao Bridge is 142.4 meters long, 2 meters wide, and 58 meters away from the valley floor. Standing among them, one can see the Yangshuo Peak Forest in full view, and the slight swaying in the air provides a thrilling and wonderful experience. 3. Ruyi Cloud Peak is named after its ridge resembling the traditional auspicious object of the Chinese nation, Ruyi. Ruyi Cloud Peak is a 360 ° viewing platform from the highest point of Ruyi Peak, a sacred place for people to pray and fulfill their wishes, and also a viewing spot for the Linqi Mountain in the distance. 4. The forest walking path winds through the peaks and valleys, with a total length of 246 meters and a center height of 32.5 meters. It is composed of a grid structure embedded with tempered glass and steel grilles. From a distance, it looks like a graceful "rainbow" in the peaks and forests, and also like an aerial ribbon left at the top of the jungle. Walking through it, you can fully enjoy the beauty of the peak forest and feel the joy of crossing the native jungle from the sky. 5. Glass walkway glass walkway is built along the cliff wall, 138 meters long and 1.8 meters wide. Walking on it is thrilling and extremely challenging. Looking into the distance, the peaks and forests are lush, the smoke from cooking is lingering, and the countryside is picturesque. 6. The Singing Tour Guilin Experience Hall is located at the upper station of the Ruyi Peak Cableway. It is an immersive digital experience space that uses digital technology and environmental art to showcase spatial creativity and intelligent interactive experiences. It integrates karst style and ethnic cultural creativity, making visitors feel as if they are walking in the dynamic painting of Guilin's mountains and waters, creating a wonderful feeling of "people swimming in the painting".

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.
