attractions.name: 漓江竹筏游
attractions.name_en: Bamboo Rafting on the Li River in Xingping
attractions.summary: Xingping Jiuma Painting Mountain Lijiang River Bamboo Raft Youxingping Section is located in Yangshuo, which has always been considered as the essence of Guilin landscape. There has long been a saying in the local area that 'Yangshuo's scenery is as beautiful as Guilin, and Yangshuo's beauty lies in Xingping'. There are over 20 scenic spots here, including Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection, Monk and Nun Meeting, Chaoban Mountain, and a 20 yuan background picture. Throughout history, the beautiful mountains, rivers, and streams of Xingping have captivated countless ink artists. Along the Xingping Li River, you can also enjoy picturesque scenery such as Xingping Jiajing, Huangbu Reflection, Carp Jumping over Dragon Gate, Chaoban Mountain, Luosi Mountain, and Beautiful Women's Mirrors. Yangdi Xingping Lijiang Bamboo Raft Tour Yangdi section is a must visit project when visiting Yangshuo, Guilin. The beautiful Yangdi is an important part of Guilin tourism and Guilin scenery. The hundred mile Li River, with "one mountain, one water, and one poem title", is like a long scroll of colorful ink landscape with poetry and painting. The Yangdi Tourist Area is about 18 kilometers long and is the golden section of the Li River. Departing from Yangdi Pier on a bamboo raft, heading down the river, the scenery along the way is beautiful, including the picturesque Nine Horse Painting Mountain and the reflection of yellow cloth. This section of the river is winding and twisting, with clear waters lingering and numerous scenic spots. The peaks reflect the scenery, and the bamboo and wood are lush.

attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
· One of the famous landscapes of the Lijiang River in Guilin, it stands near the river, with a cut wall and a huge painting screen in the distance. 
It is connected by nine mountain peaks, adjacent to the stone mountains on the banks of the Lijiang River, with alternating shades and shades. 
Bees can freely choose to hike or rafting on the Lijiang River to enjoy the wonderful workmanship of nature.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of Guilin's classic landscapes

attractions.name: 西街
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

restaurants.name_en: Guilin love taste fresh spicy seafood pot

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 岳麓山
attractions.tag: Climbing heights and mountains; admiring autumn leaves.; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area is located within the Orange Isle Scenic Area. It is the last peak of the 72 peaks of Mount Heng in the Southern Mountains, and one of China's four major maple viewing spots.
- The scenic area includes famous attractions such as Yuelu Academy, Aiwan Pavilion, Lushan Temple, and Yunlu Palace. The mountain is covered with dense trees, and ancient and famous trees can be seen everywhere.
- In addition, there are the tombs of revolutionary martyrs such as Huang Xing, Chen Tianhua, Cai E, and Xiao Jinguang on the mountain.
- Every December, visitors can enjoy the red leaves, and Aiwan Pavilion, Huang Xing's tomb, and other spots are excellent locations for leaf viewing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Yuelu Mountain, Half of Hunan's History

attractions.name: 岳麓书院
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
One of the four famous academies in Chinese history, located in Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, has a history of more than a thousand years. 
It is also famous for preserving a large number of tablets and cultural relics, such as the "Lushan Temple Monument" engraved in Tang Dynasty and the stone tablet "Yuelu Academy" engraved in Song Zhenzong's handwriting in Ming Dynasty. 
On the hill of Qingfeng Gorge, the back mountain of the academy, there is the Aiwan Pavilion, which was a place that Chairman Mao Zedong often went to in his youth.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old university understands scholarly humanities

attractions.name: 爱晚亭
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Aiwan Pavilion is surrounded by mountains on three sides and maple forests. It is one of the best places to watch the autumn scenery of red leaves in Yuelu Mountain. 
The name is taken from Du Mu's famous poem "Stop and sit in love with the maple forest at night, and the frost leaves are red in February flowers". 
The four wing corners of the pavilion are tilted upwards and covered with green glazed tiles. It is the place where Comrade Mao Zedong engaged in revolutionary activities in his early years. 
When the Aiwan Pavilion was rebuilt, Mao Zedong personally inscribed the word "Aiwan Pavilion", and the plaque hanging now is based on Mao Zedong's handwriting.
attractions.shortFeatures: Maple-viewing resorts in famous poems and lines

attractions.name: 古麓山寺
attractions.summary:
Gulushan Temple, also known as Huiguang Temple and Wanshou Temple, has a history of more than 1,700 years. It is the earliest relic of Buddhism entering Hunan and one of the early Buddhist temples in China. 
The environment of the temple is very quiet. There are two Podocarpus pines in front of the temple, which are relics of the Six Dynasties. There are precious Buddhist scriptures and ancient books in the temple. 
Today's ancient Lushan Temple is full of incense worshippers. The hall is hidden among layers of trees, with morning bells and evening drums, and bursts of Sanskrit sounds.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ancient and secluded temple deep in Yuelu Mountain

attractions.name: 潮宗街
attractions.summary: Chaozong Street is named after Chaozongmen, the city gate, also known as Caochangmen Main Street. It starts from Xiangjiang Road in the east and ends at Huangxing North Road (formerly Beizheng Street) in the west. It is one of the only four remaining ancient granite streets in Changsha City. It was originally 511 meters long, but today it is about 400 meters wide and 9 meters wide. It was the widest street in the past. Chaozong Street has historical and cultural monuments such as the former site of Jinjiu activities, the True Jesus Church Hall, the hotel and stage of the Republic of China in Ziyuan, the remains of War of Resistance against Japan's air defense facilities, the former site of Cultural Bookstore and the former residence of Qu Hongyu.
attractions.shortFeatures: Blocks witness the historical changes of Changsha

attractions.name: 杜甫江阁
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Du Fu Jiang Pavilion was built in memory of Du Fu, forming a context belt with Tianxin Pavilion, Daolin Second Temple in Yuelu Mountain and Yuelu Academy. 
There is a biography of a great poet inside. Whenever fireworks are set off on summer weekends, the number of visitors who come to watch will increase a lot. 
· Local landmark buildings, close to the Xiangjiang River, can climb high and overlook both sides of the Xiangjiang River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Climb high overlooking Xiangjiang River and enjoy the grand fireworks

attractions.name: 黄兴路步行街
attractions.summary: Huangxing Road Pedestrian Street is one of the bustling areas in Changsha City. It is a pedestrian commercial street that was renovated and completed in 2002. Starting from Simenkou in Furong District in the north and ending at Nanmenkou in the south, the total length is 838 meters and the street width is 23-26 meters. It includes Huangxing Square, which covers nearly 10000 square meters, with a total commercial area of 250000 square meters, including a newly built area of 150000 square meters. It is a comprehensive venue that integrates shopping, leisure, entertainment, catering, culture, and tourism functions. The pedestrian street is divided into an inner street and an outer street, with the inner street having three levels. There are numerous shops and a complete range of brands. In addition to various regular clothing and jewelry stores, this place also gathers snacks and delicacies from all over the country. The nearby Pozi Street is also a gathering place for Changsha's specialty snacks, such as the Fire Palace, Shuangyan Tower, and Red Plum Cold Drinks, which are well-known to Changsha people. There are countless of them.

attractions.name: 湖南省植物园
attractions.tag: A hidden gem for taking kids.; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
· The botanical garden is mainly composed of broadleaf forests, with a forest coverage rate as high as 90%, and the air is very fresh. It is located next to Changsha South Bus Station, with convenient transportation. It is a green gem that integrates scientific research, tourism, and science education.

· It is the area in Changsha with the richest natural distribution of plant resources. The Wild Animal Rescue and Breeding Center in the garden has successfully rescued and domesticated more than 110 species of wild animals, including over 80,000 individuals, such as the red-crowned crane, the yellow-bellied tragopan, and the milu deer, which are all national Class I protected species.

· The botanical garden boasts nearly 100 varieties of tulips imported from the Netherlands, which bloom in early spring across nearly 300 acres of land.
attractions.shortFeatures: The forest is lush, with flowers blooming throughout the garden, perfect for sightseeing and leisure.

restaurants.name_en: Iwaki restaurant, barbecue, earthen pot skewers

attractions.name: 雨花台
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Zhonghua Gate in Nanjing, it consists of three beautiful hills surrounded by pine and cypress trees, and is a red tourism site in Nanjing.
- The entire scenic area is divided into six main zones: the Martyrs’ Cemetery Area, the Historical Sites Area, the Yuhuashi Stone Cultural Area, the Yuhuacha Tea Culture Area, the Amusement Activity Area, and the Ecological Forest Area.
- The Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial Hall and the Martyrs’ Achievements Exhibition Hall display many books, manuscripts, clothing, and writing tools used by the soldiers of that time.
- The park is lush and green, making it not only a popular tourist destination but also a place for leisure and recreation for Nanjing residents.
- An annual Yuhuashi Art Festival is held every September, and a large Rhododendron Exhibition takes place from March to June. It is also a great spot for plum and magnolia flower viewing.

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京海底世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary: It is mainly composed of lobby, tropical rain forest area, penguin pavilion, touch pool, undersea tunnel, human-shark dance performance area, undersea cinema, etc. The underwater world shows the development process of Chinese aquariums. From ancient Chinese palace-style aquariums to tropical rain forests that simulate nature, you can enjoy bright colors and petite coral fish and freshwater tropical fish, all kinds of jellyfish in the jellyfish pavilion, and you can also see people and sharks dancing together and "mermaid" performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch a wonderful show in the undersea tunnel

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 杭州森泊水乐园
attractions.summary: Senbo Water Park is mainly composed of indoor and outdoor parts, with more than ten large-scale water amusement equipment and dozens of water amusement projects, fully meeting the various needs of tourists. The indoor water park covers an area of 9200 square meters and is a large, year-round 30 ° temperature controlled water park that breaks free from the constraints of weather. The park features Polynesian island style as its main style, and the transparent dome design makes you feel like you are in the midst of a sunny island, where you can indulge in water play and enjoy the shadow of coconut groves and sand. The indoor water park has a wave making pool, a surfing pool loved by trendsetters, a climbing pool chasing the limits of sports, and a sports pool; There are also massage pools for soothing the body and mind, children's pools for sharing time with children, joyful water villages, etc; There is also a tornado storm combination slide that spans indoor and outdoor water parks, and a unique rapids river designed by renowned water park designers, allowing you to enjoy the water world even in winter. The outdoor water park is intimately connected with nature, and at the top of the slide, the scenery of lakes and mountains is instantly visible. Outdoor amusement facilities such as Sunshine Island Water Playground, Vertical Extreme Rainbow Slide, Devil Fish Family Fun Slide, etc. allow you to experience primitive joy. In addition, there are leisure bars both indoors and outdoors for relaxation. Don't forget to recharge your energy while having fun. Full text 

attractions.name: 杭州长乔极地海洋公园
attractions.tag: "Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Playground"
attractions.summary:
· Hangzhou Polar Ocean Park is a large-scale polar ocean park that integrates polar animal exhibitions and polar landscape experiences.  
· The park features 19 major themed venues, 5 exciting performance theaters, and hundreds of polar animals, including whales, dolphins, fish, corals, and jellyfish.  
· The highlight not to be missed is the park's treasure—the pilot whale, the first whale species introduced to a marine park in China.  
· The most spectacular part of the ocean world is the animal performances, with the clever sea lion all-stars performing kung fu shows, including impressive tricks like the "Golden Rooster Stand" and "Upside-down Hook."

attractions.name: 森泊幻想岛
attractions.summary: Neverland covers an area of over 3000 square meters, with a 9-meter-high and a large exploration castle of over 1700 square meters. It is a comprehensive amusement park that integrates amusement, sports, puzzle, fitness and other functions. It has 23 large-scale themed amusement projects, fully unleashing children's natural love for drilling, climbing, sliding, rolling, shaking, swinging, jumping, and shaking. This is the children's dream factory, a dreamlike paradise with floating clouds indoors, flying submarines, plum blossom piles, spider towers, simulation laboratories, mini karts, trampolines, bubble factories, and more. Here, fun and educational activities such as Little Chef, Cute Painter, and Young Firefighter help children become true all-around little heroes. In addition, the children's playground has thoughtfully designed a rest area for parents to enjoy a cup of coffee while taking care of their children. Full text 

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 广州圣心大教堂
attractions.summary: The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. The peaceful and solemn atmosphere of the church has also been elevated in this authentic layout. You can freely find a seat inside the church and experience the sacredness and tranquility brought by the building. Full text 

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 上下九步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous commercial street in Guangzhou

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. But relatively speaking, eating on Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is more suitable, with more options available. Full text 

attractions.name: 广州热雪奇迹
attractions.tag: Hi Fun Park; Kid's Treasure Spot; Indoor Skiing; Ice and Snow Parks
attractions.summary:
Guangzhou Snow Miracle covers an area of approximately 75,000 square meters, with temperatures consistently maintained between -6°C and 0°C. It can accommodate around 3,000 visitors at the same time, making it the indoor snow venue with the most diverse snow-related activities and ski slopes.  
The ski area features five slopes of varying difficulty, including practice slopes for beginners on both snowboards and skis, as well as beginner, intermediate, and advanced slopes. Among them, the world's first two 3D-crossing ski slopes offer intermediate and advanced skiers a unique challenge and fun. Additionally, the beginner slope and the ski practice slopes are connected by a buffer zone, forming an ultra-long indoor alpine ski slope of approximately 460 meters.  
The snow play area includes seven attractions, such as Snow Disc, Glacier Leap, Ice Bike, and Ice Bumper Cars, along with two themed areas: Frozen Planet and Polar Bear’s Home. These allow visitors to enjoy the fun of snow and ice under the sunny skies of southern China.  
Whether enjoying family time in the snow or the thrill of skiing, Guangzhou Snow Miracle (Sunac Snow World) offers a 360-degree cool experience, bringing the grand snow carnival to visitors 365 days a year!  
The venue provides free rental of ski suits, ski boots, helmets, and skis, along with disposable socks. Ski enthusiasts may also bring their own equipment.  

**Ski Area**  
The ski area has a total vertical drop of about 66 meters, with five slopes of varying difficulty, ranging from 7.6° to 21° in gradient, and an average width of approximately 35 meters. The snow thickness is maintained at about 50 cm year-round. The uphill facilities include one two-person chairlift and five magic carpets.  

**Snowboard Practice Slope**  
The slope is wide, with a width of about 35 meters and a length of about 70 meters, with a gradient of around 10°. It is slightly steeper than most snowboard practice slopes, so beginners are advised to practice on flat areas first to master basic stances and stopping techniques before boldly attempting new moves from the top.  

**Bear Slope**  
The Bear Slope is wide, measuring about 50 meters in width and 70 meters in length, with a gradient of approximately 8°. It is relatively gentle, making it suitable for beginners. Children can confidently practice here.  

**Snow Rabbit Slope**  
The Snow Rabbit Slope is about 35 meters wide, 300 meters long, and has a gradient of around 10°. It is the most popular slope in the snow park, with the highest skier density. This slope is ideal for those who have mastered basic skiing stances, falling, and stopping. It is also perfect for practicing ground tricks for both snowboard and ski enthusiasts, earning it the nickname “Ground Trick Avenue.”  

**Moose Slope**  
The Moose Slope is about 35 meters wide and 230 meters long, with an average gradient of about 14.8°. It is suitable for intermediate and advanced skiers. The upper section has a gradient of about 18°, testing your stability and skill on steeper slopes, while the lower section, with a gradient of around 10-12°, allows for a full carving experience. Additionally, there are mushroom and wavy paths in the lower section for an extraordinary terrain experience.  

**Tiger Slope**  
The Tiger Slope is about 35 meters wide and 220 meters long, with an average gradient of 16.8°. As the terrain park is located on this slope, it is frequented by the most skilled skiers in the venue. Skiers can often be seen practicing tricks on the props and ramps here.  

**Snow Disc**  
Sit on an inflatable snow disc shaped like a flying saucer and race down from the top of the mountain. The refreshing snow wind hits your face as you speed down to the bottom in the blink of an eye, offering a thrilling and exhilarating snow experience.  
**Requirements**: Passengers must weigh less than 90 kg. Children under 1.2 meters must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Ice Bumper Cars**  
The smooth ice surface reduces friction, adding excitement to the bumper car game, allowing you to experience a popular winter activity even in the south.  
**Requirements**: Children under 1 meter must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Adventure Trail**  
The first indoor adventure trail at a ski resort in China combines fun, entertainment, and challenges of height, speed, strength, and endurance. Feel the thrill and the sense of achievement in overcoming obstacles.  
**Requirements**: Visitors must be over 1.4 meters tall and weigh less than 100 kg. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Ice Bicycle**  
Ride a bicycle on the smooth ice – a fun and unexpected experience for those in southern China. It is a family-friendly ice activity.  
**Requirements**: Visitors must be over 1 meter tall. Children under 1.2 meters must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Glacier Leap**  
The first indoor ski resort with a dual-direction ski lift.
attractions.shortFeatures: Large indoor ski resort; professional ski instruction services; 17,000 square meters of snow and ice amusement area.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-21:30(Tickets available until 19:30; admission ends at 19:30)

attractions.name: 广州融创乐园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Guangzhou Sunac Land covers an area of approximately 596,000 square meters, making it a large outdoor theme park with unique South Yue culture and Lingnan style. The park features six themed areas: Millennium Trading Capital, Maritime Silk Road, Lingnan Impressions, Ancient Kingdom of Nanyue, Legend of the Five Rams, and Dream Garden, which blend ancient and modern elements to offer a delightful and unforgettable experience.

The park boasts 31 high-tech amusement rides, including the immersive 8K flying theater "Fly Over Guangdong," the thrilling dual-track dual-car roller coaster "Double Dragons Flying," and the mysterious 4K+VR experience "Nature Exploration," among others. The rides offer a variety of experiences ranging from exciting to romantic, interactive to educational, ensuring something for every visitor. Additionally, there are 12 spectacular shows, including the eye-catching 3D light and water show "Silk Road Romance," the magical visual effects of "Dog Eating the Sun," and the joyous Dream Parade, all of which provide an immersive visual feast for guests.

The park not only showcases the local culture of Guangdong but also blends Western and Eastern elements, incorporating high-tech amusement features. In addition to the outdoor attractions, a series of indoor innovative temperature-controlled theaters and summer cooling projects have been created, making it a year-round theme park that breaks the limitations of seasons and weather to meet visitors' desires for fun at any time.

★★★Visitor Guide★★★  
**Fly Over Guangdong**  
A cutting-edge 8K flying theater provides a thrilling and immersive experience, with a giant panoramic dome screen and breathtaking visuals. The flight seats, combined with realistic effects like wind, water, sound, and light, allow visitors to soar through the sky, traversing time and space to enjoy the unique and magnificent landscapes of Guangdong.

**Flower Garden Wonderland**  
Enjoy joyful parent-child moments in a dreamlike garden where flowers bloom, and butterflies dance. A family-friendly, magical project designed for children, with a colorful and exciting suspended roller coaster that travels indoors and outdoors, featuring fun media interactions for an enchanting, fairytale-like adventure.

**Flower Sea Surfing**  
Ride the waves down colorful slides, experiencing the thrill of sudden drops while taking in the beauty of the surrounding flower sea, enjoying both the excitement and the refreshing sensations.

**Double Dragons Flying**  
An exhilarating adventure that will get your adrenaline pumping! With multiple thrilling ways to experience the ride, the dual-track dual-car roller coaster at Guangzhou Sunac Land allows you to choose between sitting or hanging, and the two cars race side by side, often crossing paths with intense near-collisions for a truly thrilling experience.

**Raging Seas and Furious Waves**  
A combination of water rapids and roller coaster thrills, this ride takes you through dark water tunnels that suddenly steepen or spin. Meanwhile, floods and fires rush toward you, providing a wet and exhilarating adventure like experiencing the apocalypse.

**Sky Tower**  
Experience the sensation of a space shuttle launch and the weightlessness of free-fall. In just 1.8 seconds, you are launched 59 meters into the air, only to plummet back down in a heart-pounding journey that leaves you breathless.

**Dog Eating the Sun Theater**  
An exciting theatrical performance that blends magic tricks and thrilling storytelling. With stunning visual effects and impressive sleight-of-hand, the magician’s extraordinary skills will leave the audience in awe as the magical show unfolds.

**Children's Theater "The Adventures of Kingdom Reversal"**  
A lively and educational performance featuring animals, plants, and insects, bringing various creatures to life through a fun and engaging storyline, with humorous performances and interactive designs that lead visitors into a magical world of reversals.

**Dream Parade**  
Join the "Flower Queen" and a host of colorful characters from China and around the world in a grand and vibrant parade. Beautifully designed themed floats roll through the streets, with performers dressed in dazzling costumes, offering interactive performances and inviting you to join in the joy of this spectacular party.

**Lake Show Theater**  
A breathtaking 3D light and water show on a giant water screen, enhanced by advanced special effects. Set against the backdrop of the Maritime Silk Road, the show tells a moving story that will captivate the audience with its stunning visuals and emotional depth.

It is a scenic spot with beautiful mountain-friendly and water-friendly environment. The main scenic spots are Maoping Ancient Village, Bamboo Sea Warbler, Stone Pot Boiling Spring, Yougu Cuixi, Baibu Ladder, Qianlong Waterfall, etc., the most spectacular of which is Qianlong Waterfall.

attractions.name: 从化碧水湾温泉
attractions.summary: Bishuiwan Hot Spring Resort is located on the banks of Liuxi River in Conghua, Guangzhou, at the center of the "Conghua 80 kilometer Green Tourism Corridor". It is one of the two rare radon containing baking soda hot springs in the world (the other is in Switzerland, Europe). The hot spring area belongs to garden style design, with high fun and privacy. The hot spring area also provides free health drinks, cucumber facial mask, and the hot spring lounge provides free bread, biscuits, fruits, and milk tea Here is a complete guide to bathing in Bishuiwan Hot Springs. Bishuiwan Hot Spring Zone has more than 40 hot spring pools with different styles and functions, such as rose petal pool, three flavor beauty pool, aromatherapy pool, tea bath pool, such as dynamic and fashionable dream spa pool, buoyancy massage pool, ice fire pool, such as happy parent-child bubble spring full of childlike fun, Türkiye fish therapy&Indonesia fish therapy pool, children play pool, such as a blue outdoor swimming pool, boundless bubble pool built near the river, characteristic infrared sauna, dry and wet steaming, etc. The Boundless Bubble Pool is located in the riverside hot spring area, built along the river and close to water and nature. Standing in the boundless pond, looking up, you will see a panoramic view of the clear flowing river and the Wei Wei Fei'e Mountain. Thanks to the design concept of boundless visual effects, when taking a bath, looking straight at the pool surface feels like the pool has no boundaries and is connected to the flowing river. The Water Joy Pool is also one of the popular areas in the Bishuiwan Hot Spring District, which has won the hearts of children. The water depth of the children's play pool is about 60cm, which belongs to a relatively safe range. In summer, it is usually warm water, and in winter, the water temperature ranges from 28 to 33 ℃ depending on the temperature. The children's play pool is equipped with water slides, cascading waterfalls, and expanded duckweed, which are specially designed for children to play and keep fit. Infrared sauna room is one of the internet famous photo spots that must not be missed when coming to Bishui Bay. It is only one of you away from Liuxi River! The infrared sauna imported from Switzerland combines the advantages of sauna and sunbathing. Full text 

attractions.name: 从化温泉风景区
attractions.summary: The Conghua Hot Spring Scenic Area, located in Conghua District, Guangzhou, is 75 kilometers away from Guangzhou. There are 13 springs distributed on both sides of the river in the area, among which Xianmuyuan Hot Spring Park and Bishuiwan Hot Spring Resort are more well-known. According to research, the hot springs in this area were already developed and utilized during the Ming and Qing dynasties. The spring water is colorless, odorless, crystal clear, and rich in minerals, making it a globally renowned scenic spot.

attractions.name: 流溪河国家森林公园
attractions.summary: The Liuxihe National Forest Park is surrounded by mountains, with lakes and large areas of forests, resulting in fresh air and charming scenery. In the park's mountains and forests, there are precious tree species such as bamboo and cypress, camphor, and camphor, as well as ornamental flowers and trees such as cherry blossoms, magnolias, crane top orchids, and rhododendrons. Liuxi Fragrant Snow "is a unique winter scenery in Liuxi River National Forest Park, attracting countless Chinese and foreign tourists every year to admire, sing, paint, photograph, and praise plum blossoms. Liuxihe Forest Farm has over 3000 acres of plum trees planted around the lake, known as the "number one plum blossom in China and the first branch of spring in the south" (20 days before New Year's Day and 10 days after). Starting from December every year, more than 100000 plum trees planted here bloom clusters of white flowers on their branches, proudly blooming in the cold, shining like snow and frost on the snowy and frosty ground, along with the emerald streams, lakes, and green mountains. The park mainly has scenic spots such as Sanyatang Yougu, Xiaoli River, Emerald Islands, Lakeside boardwalk, Liuxi Lv Greenway, tea garden, plum garden, bamboo garden, etc. The supporting facilities are also very complete, including cruise ships, outdoor expansion, etc. For those who enjoy mountain climbing, you can add the trip to San Ya Tang. San Ya Tang is located on Wuzhi Mountain, and of course, there are also many expansion enthusiasts who come here for leisure activities. The specific itinerary can be planned according to your hobbies. San Ya Tang You Valley is located in the Wuzhishan Scenic Area south of Liuxi River National Forest Park. A 2500 meter long upstream path runs through the middle of the valley, surrounded by lush green bamboo. In the stream, there are flowing springs and waterfalls, and in the valley, there are towering boulders. The Liuxi River National Forest Park currently has large, medium, and small boats, as well as speedboats. The developed water amusement projects mainly include: boat tours of Liuxi Lake, airship tours of Liuxi Lake, sharing fun with monkeys (taking a boat to Monkey Island), participating in Peacock Garden (taking a boat to Peacock Island), visiting Liuxi River Dam, and visiting Xiaoli River. The usual routes chosen by most guests are boat tours to enjoy the flowing streams and lakes, Monkey Island, and Peacock Island. Note: Guangzhou Liuxihe Forest Park is divided into two major scenic areas, namely Liuxihu Scenic Area with Liuxihu as its theme and Wuzhishan Scenic Area with river tracing and mountain climbing as its theme. The two are 4 kilometers apart and there are currently no scenic area vehicles connecting them. Full text 

attractions.name: 溪头旅游村
attractions.summary: Xitou Village is located in the northeast of Liangkou Town, Conghua District, Guangzhou City, and is one of the three major sources of the Liuxi River. Here, the mountains are high and the forests are dense, and the streams are clear, creating a primitive scenery. The scattered farmhouses and old houses present a strong sense of life here. The quaint residential buildings on both sides of the "Xitou Stone Lane" street are lined up, and the roadside is filled with local specialties. The landscape tofu pudding here is very famous. Sanhua Li is also a specialty here. Red skin and red meat are sweet and sour. You can taste them when you play. Seven classic hiking routes, including the Yinggu Line, Xiaoxi Line, and Jizhen Line, all pass through Xitou Village. There is also a stream tracing line next to the small mountain, along which you can stroll, search for the source of the stream, and enjoy the beautiful scenery of clear water and mountains.

- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.

The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai.

When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it.

Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 
