Some celebrities in the cultural and entertainment circles have stayed here. The vicinity of Wukang Building is full of French style. Sitting at the open-air table of a roadside coffee shop, drinking a cup of coffee and basking in the sun, it seems like entering another time and space.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many famous people have stayed here

attractions.name: 双塔寺
attractions.summary: The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

attractions.name: 蒙山大佛
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Historical Ruins; Historical Sites; Statues/Sculptures
attractions.summary:
· The Mount Meng Giant Buddha, also known as the West Mountain Giant Buddha, was originally a cliff-side Buddha statue behind the Kaihua Temple on Mount Meng. It was destroyed during the late Yuan Dynasty.
· In 1980, the Mount Meng Giant Buddha was rediscovered. By the time of its discovery, the Buddha's head was missing, and the body was buried in soil and stone, severely weathered.
· The height from the bottom of the legs to the neck is about 30 meters, while the original height was approximately 46 meters. The current Buddha head was carved by later generations.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Thousand-Year-Old Buddha in the suburbs of Taiyuan.

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 太原古县城景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Taiyuan Ancient County City is located in Jinyuan District, covering an area of approximately 0.8 square kilometers. There are numerous historical architectural remains in the city, with a clear cross street layout and a well-developed street and alley texture. It follows the ancient architectural pattern of the "Phoenix Soaring in the City" of Jinyang Ancient City, resembling a phoenix with a head to the north and a tail to the south. It has been known as the "Phoenix City" since ancient times and is an extension of the 2500 year cultural heritage of Jinyang Ancient City. There are 79 existing cultural relics buildings in the city, and 49 historical buildings listed for protection by the Taiyuan Municipal Government. Among them, the Confucian Temple has been listed as a national key cultural relic protection unit.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-21:00(Tickets available until 20:00; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 太原方特东方神画
attractions.summary: Taiyuan Fantawild Oriental Divine Painting is a large-scale cultural and high-tech theme park carefully built by Huaqiang Fantawild Group. The theme of the amusement park is the inheritance of Chinese history and culture. Through new content creativity, technological innovation, and exquisite layout, it integrates myths and legends, historical allusions, folk customs, etc., allowing visitors to experience the infinite charm of the integration and collision of technology and culture. The amusement park comprehensively utilizes technologies such as dynamic ball screen flying cinema, panoramic AR, comprehensive three-dimensional track, and programmable magic bricks, integrating various performance techniques such as real person interpretation. Through participation, experience, and interaction, it presents visitors with a brilliant picture of the essence of China's 5000 year history and civilization.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at December 1-December 30 Saturday-Sunday 10:00-17:00(Admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 钟鼓楼广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.
attractions.shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.

attractions.name: 大慈恩寺
attractions.summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top

attractions.summary: The Chang'an Twelve Hours Theme Block is based on Tang Dynasty common culture, with the web drama "Chang'an Twelve Hours" IP as the theme, and immersive experience as the core. It is fully packaged in the fields of architecture, soft decoration, currency, characters, clothing, language, music, stories, etc., while surrounding deep immersive story experiences. It sets up supporting catering, cultural and creative, performing arts and other formats, and overall creates a Tang Dynasty common culture experience place that integrates Tang Dynasty spatial play, Tang style common experience, theme immersive interaction, Tang music and dance performance, cultural social leisure and other aspects.

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 大雁塔北广场
attractions.name_en: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain

attractions.name: 陕西历史博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.
attractions.shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.

attractions.name: 西安博物院
attractions.tag: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
attractions.summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.
attractions.shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.

attractions.name: 西安碑林博物馆
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 上海之巅观光厅
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Tower's Observation Deck at the Top of Shanghai is a functional experience area of the Shanghai Tower. From the 360-degree observation deck at the top, you can have a close-up view of the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and the World Financial Center below your feet, while enjoying a distant view of the Expo Park, City God Temple, the Shanghai Stadium, and Hongqiao Airport. The winding Suzhou Creek and Huangpu River merge into the Yangtze River and flow into the East China Sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ascend to the Top of the Sea and Enjoy the Panoramic City View.

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name_en: Huangpu River Cruise(Oriental Pearl Tower Cruise Terminal)
attractions.summary: Take the Oriental Pearl TV Tower Huangpu River cruise along the river, you can enjoy the urban feelings of prosperity and competition, and let tourists enjoy the modern urban landscape on both sides. Experience the high-end transformation from Old Shanghai Beach to New Shanghai Beach, and fully enjoy the urban atmosphere.

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览（金陵东路码头）
attractions.name_en: The Huangpu River Cruise (Jinling East Road Pier)

The route is Jinling East Road Wharf - Shiliupu Old Wharf - Nanpu Bridge - Jiangnan Shipyard Site - Chinese Art Palace - Lupu Bridge - Bund World Architecture Expo Group - Jinling East Road Wharf. The entire tour lasts about 60 minutes.

Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 世博会博物馆
attractions.summary:
· The World Expo Museum is not only the first truly international museum in China, but also the unique museum in the world that comprehensively displays the special topics of the World Expo. 
The exhibition area of the museum is about 12,000 square meters, with 8 permanent exhibition halls and 3 temporary exhibition halls, gathering hundreds of precious cultural relics from all over the world. 
· You don't need to travel all over the world to experience the history of the World Expo for more than 150 years in Shanghai and learn about the host cities of previous World Expos.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum that comprehensively displays the special topics of the Expo

attractions.name: 土山湾博物馆
attractions.summary: Tushan Bay Museum, located at the former site of Tushan Bay Orphanage, was opened to the public during the Shanghai World Expo in China on June 12th, 2010. This is the only remaining north building of the original Tushanwan Orphanage, with a brick and wood structure and a height of three floors. It was built in the Tongzhi period of Qing Dynasty. Because the orphanage pays attention to arts and crafts training, it is also called the Orphan Crafts Institute. The exhibition hall of the whole museum covers an area of more than 900 square meters, and is divided into four units: Pai Building Hall, Xujiahui Hall, Tushan Bay Hall and Inheritance and Influence Hall. There are nearly 400 exhibits on display, including more than 200 historical photos. The main exhibition contents are physical objects, photos, models and historical documents, and multimedia and other auxiliary means, to restore the daily scenes of Tushan Bay Orphan Craft Institute.
attractions.shortFeatures: Restoring daily scenes of Tushan Bay Orphanage

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 静安寺
attractions.summary:
Jing'an Temple is a famous ancient temple in Shanghai. The architectural style of the temple is combined with Tibetan temples. The silver Buddha enshrined in the Daxiong Hall weighs 15 tons. 
The main buildings of the temple are Mountain Gate, Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, etc. Looking at the whole temple from a distance, a golden roof is particularly conspicuous. 
Jing'an Temple is full of incense. Every birthday and anniversary of Bodhisattva, the temple will hold a Dharma fair. Every year, on the eighth day of April in the lunar calendar, a three-day temple fair will be held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Rare Tibetan-style temples in the east

attractions.name: 广富林文化遗址
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Enjoying autumn leaves; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The ancient civilization of the Guangfulin Cultural Site has been preliminarily confirmed through scientific archaeology. As early as the late Neolithic period, around four to five thousand years ago, rice cultivation was already widespread in the area, indicating an advanced agricultural production system. Additionally, the textile history here is long-standing, with pottery spindles from the late Neolithic period uncovered at the site.

The development of the Guangfulin Site Park aims to inherit historical culture and preserve the original ecological structure of the ancient town. It will integrate modern urban construction concepts to create an "underwater museum." Stepping into the site, the Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is particularly captivating. The entire exhibition space is set underwater, with pyramid-like rooftops floating on Fulin Lake, blending with the surrounding environment to create a beautiful scene. The exhibition hall is designed with the concept of a "Journey through Time and Space," combining modern audiovisual technology to present scenes such as the archaeological memories of Guangfulin, the formation of Shanghai's land, the arrival of early settlers, the rise of local cities, the flourishing of Songjiang Prefecture, the emergence of Shanghai as a city, and a vision for the future. Visitors can experience and explore the history of Shanghai's civilization in a time tunnel.

At night, the site hosts an exciting lantern festival. From the lake-bottom garage entrance to near Zhuque Gate, over 40 large lantern sets light up the area, creating a dazzling, beautiful display. Among these, the 3D Mapping show is a major highlight, condensing the thousand-year history of Guangfulin into a stunning three-minute light and shadow performance projected onto Fulin Tower, attracting numerous visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the unique underwater exhibition hall

attractions.name: 广富林文化展示馆
attractions.summary: The Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is located in the circular building with the first large roof and side floating in the Fulin Lake, and the entire exhibition space is set underwater. Entering the exhibition hall gives people a hint of stepping into the underground and heading towards ancient times. The exhibition hall design is based on the concept of "time and space journey", through the design of scenes such as Guangfulin archaeological memory, Shanghai's land evolution, the arrival of ancestors' activities, the formation of urban characteristics, the prosperity of Songjiang County government, the rise of Shanghai city, and the future, allowing the audience to experience and read Shanghai as a city in a time tunnel, from where it came from and where it is going.

attractions.name: 广富林考古遗址展示馆
attractions.summary: To the north of the core protection area of Guangfulin Cultural Site, there are several semi buried buildings that resemble damaged ancient pottery. They are the exhibition hall of Guangfulin Archaeological Site and a relatively important landmark exhibition hall in Guangfulin. The museum houses carefully selected representative cultural relics from tens of thousands of archaeological discoveries in Guangfulin. Some of the exhibits are provided by the Shanghai Museum. In addition to exhibiting and displaying the treasures excavated from Guangfulin, this museum will also serve as a venue for exchange and exhibition with international museums. There is also a dedicated space for restoration in the museum, which is connected to the north themed exhibition space. Thus extending the exhibition space outdoors greatly enhances the visual impact on visitors.

attractions.name: 上海海昌海洋公园
attractions.summary: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park has been rated as a National 4A-level tourist attraction. The park is closely centered around marine culture and is divided into five major themed areas: Mermaid Bay, Polar Town, Ice and Snow Kingdom, Underwater Wonders, and Ocean Tribe. It features sixteen star performances, including "Killer Whale Science Show," "Dolphin Romance," "Sea Lion Fun Adventures," "Beluga Love," "Marine Animal Feeding Show," "Mermaid Fairy Tale," "Water Dance Between Fish," "Town Party," "Water Flying Man," "Chinese Style Grand Event," "Flying Fairy Little Dragon Girl," "Seven Cute Adventures," "Clown Meet and Greet," "Ocean Dream Parade," "Illusory Sea Realm," and "Ocean EDM Party." The park also has six animal exhibition halls: Antarctic Penguin Hall, Marine Mammal Exploration Hall, Iceberg Arctic Hall, Underwater World Hall, Volcano Shark Hall, and Coral Jellyfish Hall. It houses over 30,000 rare marine animals, including polar bears and emperor penguins. Additionally, there are six amusement facilities: Volcano Rafting, Dolphin Roller Coaster, Time and Space Cable Car, Deep Sea Adventure, Sky Theater, and Sensory 4D Cinema. The park is also complemented by the Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel, which features five marine-themed rooms, including penguin and mermaid-themed rooms, offering visitors a spectacular oceanic dream journey!
attractions.shortFeatures: See rare marine life and enjoy thrilling attractions.

attractions.name: 上海电影博物馆
attractions.summary: The museum will be divided into four theme exhibition areas, one art theater, No.5 studio, etc., which integrate display and interaction, visit and experience, covering the functions of cultural relics collection, academic research, social education, exhibition and other functions. It is a landmark venue of urban culture that presents visitors the charm of Shanghai films for a century and vividly interprets filmmakers, film events and stories behind films. It is one of the important cultural attractions of the first 4A-level urban tourist attractions built in Xuhui District.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display various movie posters and shooting props

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 上海琉璃艺术博物馆
attractions.summary:
The only glazed art museum in Shanghai was founded and designed by Taiwan Province artists Zhang Yi and Yang Huishan. There are two giant metal mesh peony flowers attached to the outer wall of the museum, which seem to bloom from the colored glass: during the day, the shadows of the flowers are quiet; At night, the flowers are gorgeous, showing a strong modern artistic meaning. 
Nearly a hundred pieces of glazed treasures of past dynasties are on display in the museum, including not only the labor crystallization of ancient Chinese people, but also the works of Emile Gallè, a French artist who appeared at the 19th century Paris World Expo and was known as the "father of glazed in the world". Fifty-four works of Buddha-making focus on the wisdom and hard work of artist Yang Huishan for 23 years. The most amazing exhibit is the statue of Guanyin, which took 10 years to create. This three-dimensional restoration work from the Yuan Dynasty mural of Mogao Grottoes in Dunhuang is the only work made of non-glazed material in the museum. Above it is a well-designed multimedia projection-flying sky, and under Guanyin's seat are clear yellow glazed lotus flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the exquisite glass masterpieces at home and abroad

attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.

attractions.name: 南禅寺
attractions.summary:
English:  
- Formerly known as "Liangxi Feng Da Sha," with a long history and many eminent monks. The current temple was rebuilt in the 1980s and 1990s.  
- During the Tian Sheng period of the Northern Song Dynasty, Emperor Renzong of Song named it "Fusheng Chan Yuan." Eight years later, Emperor Renzong also named the northern counterpart to the Southern Chan Temple, "Shousheng Chan Yuan."  
- The temple includes the Heavenly King Hall, Miaoguang Pagoda, Five Precepts Hall, and a Liberation Pond, all of which visitors can explore.  
- After visiting the temple to pay respects, you can stroll around the nearby streets and enjoy local delicacies. The night scenery here is also worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: A blessed place of worship with strong incense offerings.

attractions.name: 南长街
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: On the street, you can still see the preserved old threshold, the grooves of the old storefronts' door panels, and the creaking floor slabs when you walk up. However, these old-fashioned buildings are full of all kinds of fashionable creative elements. As the core part of Qingmingqiao Historical and Cultural Block in Wuxi, characteristic shops are gathered here, which is integrated with the old-fashioned buildings in Wuxi. It is quite flavorful. No matter whether you go there during the day or at night, you will have a different feeling.
attractions.shortFeatures: The charm of classical architecture still exists

attractions.name: 鼋头渚
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.

attractions.name: 蠡园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; garden parks; Gardens
attractions.summary:
- Li Garden is a well-known park in Wuxi, famous for its water scenery and featuring the traditional Jiangnan garden style.
- According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn period, Fan Li and Xi Shi retreated to Taihu Lake, and many of the garden's buildings are themed around Fan Li and Xi Shi, with exquisite landscaping. In spring and summer, visitors can also come here to enjoy the flowers.
- The Li Garden scenic area includes attractions such as the Four Seasons Pavilion, Xi Shi Manor, Tao Zhu Mansion, Thousand-Step Long Corridor, and the Spring and Autumn Pavilion, all offering great visual appeal.
- To the east of Li Garden, there is a Ferris wheel at Li Lake Park. With Li Garden in the foreground and the Ferris wheel as the background, the photos taken here are very artistic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fang Li and Xi Shi Themed Water Garden

attractions.name: 惠山古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 263米主观光层
attractions.summary: The 263 meter subjective light layer is located in the second sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. You can enjoy the beauty of Shanghai 360 degrees, look at both sides of the Pujiang River, and deeply understand the vicissitudes and rich cultural heritage of Shanghai.

attractions.name: 上海城市历史发展陈列馆
attractions.name_en: Shanghai Urban History Development Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
· It integrates history, culture and appreciation, reflecting the modern historical changes of Shanghai, with an exhibition area of 10,000 square meters. 
It consists of seven exhibition halls: Tracing the Origin of Huating, Style of the City, Glimpse of the Opening of the Port, Ten Miles of Ocean Market, Sea Tracking, Architectural Expo and Spring and Autumn of Chariots and Horses. The exhibits are fine and the information is detailed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Show the Changes of Shanghai's Modern History

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康大楼
attractions.summary: Wukang Building, located at the intersection of Huaihai Middle Road and Wukang Road, is flat in shape, like an iron, and looks like a French Renaissance style. Some celebrities in the cultural and entertainment circles have stayed here. The vicinity of Wukang Building is full of French style. Sitting at the open-air table of a roadside coffee shop, drinking a cup of coffee and basking in the sun, it seems like entering another time and space.
attractions.shortFeatures: Many famous people have stayed here

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 天一阁博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; hidden gem for kids; Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the city of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, it is the oldest existing private library in China, as well as the oldest library in Asia and one of the world's earliest family libraries.
- Built in the mid-Ming Dynasty, it was overseen by Fan Qin, a retired Deputy Minister of the Ministry of War. Many exhibition halls display books collected by the Fan family from all corners of the world.
- The architecture combines various traditional folk crafts such as wood carving, brick carving, stone carving, gilding, and embossing, making it a masterpiece of Ningbo's residential architecture.
- Inside the Tianyi Pavilion, there is also an interesting Mahjong Museum, which has become a popular spot for many to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient private library.

attractions.name: 南塘老街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Ningbo Nantang Old Street, developed and constructed by Ningbo City Travel Investment Development Co., Ltd., is located outside the south gate of Ningbo Ancient City, Zhejiang Province. It used to be the "Three Cities at the South Gate" of the old Ningbo trade and culture gathering place, ranking one of the eight historical districts in Ningbo, and it is also the protected area of Ningbo's "Purple Line Planning". It runs north-south, bounded by Zuguanshan Road, and is divided into two streets: south and north streets. The block retains more than 300 meters of traditional streets and lanes, with one cultural protection unit and six cultural protection points. The descendants of Yuan Xie, a famous scholar in the Song Dynasty, have lived here for generations. The existing residential buildings of the Yuan family in the area are the largest, including residential courtyards, ancestral halls, schools, etc., and others include cultural protection buildings such as Yongshui Bridge, Yongshan Pavilion and Guansheng Temple. North Street takes traditional culture as its keynote, commerce as its content and urban tourism as its development direction. South Street focuses on the concept of "urban leisure", highlighting leisure life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reappear the century-old business life in Ningbo

attractions.name: 鼓楼
attractions.summary: The Ningbo Drum Tower is one of the landmark buildings in Ningbo City, located in the center of the city and part of the ancient city wall of Ningbo. The Drum Tower was first built in the Tang Dynasty and has undergone multiple reconstructions. The existing architecture is in the style of the Qing Dynasty. The Drum Tower is not only an important symbol of Ningbo's history and culture, but also a window for tourists to learn about Ningbo's history and culture.

attractions.name: 老外滩
attractions.tag: A hidden gem for strolling with kids; neighborhood walk.; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Ningbo Old Bund opened to the public in 1844 and is currently one of the few Bunds in China with a history of over a century. It serves as the gateway to the ancient city of Ningbo.  
- The Old Bund still preserves many European-style old buildings that have been converted into bars and restaurants. The Gothic-style Catholic Church in Jiangbei is one of the landmarks of Ningbo.  
- What makes the Old Bund unique is that it is not enclosed; citizens can experience their daily life at the Sanjiang Port of the Old Bund.  
- At the same time, the Old Bund is also a bar street, bustling with activity in the evening, and many foreigners enjoy relaxing and socializing here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoying drinks at a bar while admiring the beautiful European-style architecture.

attractions.name: 东门渔岛
attractions.summary: Dongmen Fishing Island is located to the east of Shipu Town, Xiangshan County, Zhejiang Province, facing the urban area of Shipu Town across the harbor. There is Dongmen Fishing Village on the island, with a developed fishing economy, including 274 acres of orchards, 1799 acres of forests, and 200 acres of marine aquaculture. Most of the young and middle-aged people in the village are engaged in marine fishing. Dongmen Fishing Village boasts both mountains and seas, with picturesque scenery and a long history of coastal defense. The island is home to numerous historical sites, ancient landscapes, and cultural landmarks, as well as rich marine cultural relics and a strong fishing culture.

attractions.name: 石浦镇
attractions.summary:
Shipu Town, located at the southern end of Xiangshan Peninsula in Zhejiang Province, is known as the "important town of Zheyang Middle Road". Shipu Town is named after the unique scenery of Shipu Port. 
In the fifth episode of Meeting on the Tip of China 2, the story of Zhang Shizhong's return to Taiwan and his family reunion took place in Shipu, Xiangshan. The film also focused on Xiangshan seafood-mussel. Shipu Town is an ancient town on one side and the sea on the other. Walking in the town, you can appreciate the rich seaside town customs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Zheyang Middle Road Important Town

attractions.name: 象山影视城
attractions.tag: Hi Fun Park; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Film Studios
attractions.summary:
- Located in the picturesque Datang Port Ecotourism Area in Xiangshan County, Zhejiang, with Lingyan Mountain as the backdrop, it cleverly integrates the local natural landscapes such as mountains, rocks, caves, water, and forests.
- It consists of five main scenic areas: the Main Gate Plaza Area, Village Workshop Area, Tomb Mountain Cave Area, Manor Lake Area, and Shop Town Residential Area.
- The film studio, with its unique and numerous architectural designs, can shoot historical themes from the Spring and Autumn Period, the Qin and Han Dynasties, the Tang and Song Dynasties, as well as the Ming and Qing Dynasties, offering suitable settings for various historical films.
- It has hosted well-known TV dramas such as "The Return of the Condor Heroes," "The Blood Sword," "Young Yang Family Generals," and "Investiture of the Gods," blending film culture with tourism and leisure.
attractions.shortFeatures: Filming locations of "Nirvana in Fire"

attractions.name: 中国渔村
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids
attractions.summary: The Chinese Fishing Village is the largest pristine seaside leisure and resort area on the east coast of China. It is a large seaside tourist destination themed around "fishing culture and folk tourism" and "seaside and marine leisure vacations." It not only features the five essential elements of seaside leisure — ocean, beach, air, sunshine, and greenery — but also fully showcases the living atmosphere of a fishing area.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fisherman Culture and Folklore Resort Area

attractions.name: 石浦皇城沙滩
attractions.summary: Huangcheng Beach is located in the northeast of Shipu City, Xiangshan Mountain, facing the sea in the east, Tianchou in the west, and connected with mountains at both ends of the northeast. The beach head is gentle, and the sand is moderately soft and hard. The beach is more than 1,800 meters long and 300 meters wide, and it is like a crescent moon. When it starts, the waves are overwhelming, as cool as a city wall surging rapidly on the sea, and its momentum is as huge as the beach on the east coastline of Zhejiang; When the air is flat, the ripples meet the sky, and the flexibility is infinite, which can be used by Xi Shi to wash yarn. There are the main venue of China Fishing Festival with more than 10,000 fixed seats, ornamental standard berms costing 10 million yuan, and leisure and entertainment facilities. You can jump on the mount and ride your horse to gallop; You can also drink a cup of tea, look at the sea and listen to the waves; You can pounce into the sea and show your skills. The "March 3rd, Stepping on the Beach" activity with profound cultural heritage, the annual China Fishing Festival sea sacrifice ceremony, maritime stunt performances and other activities make the Huangcheng Beach crowded and lively, attracting thousands of Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. In 1998, it was rated as one of the new ten scenic spots in Ningbo.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a cup of tea, look at the sea and listen to the waves

attractions.name: 上海佛罗伦萨小镇
attractions.summary: Florence Town - Shanghai Famous Outlets "opened in January 2015. As the second outlet project of Italian retail giant RDM Asia in China, it settled in Pudong, Shanghai and became a popular destination for fashion enthusiasts in Shanghai and the surrounding Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions. Shanghai Florence Town has introduced over a hundred globally renowned brands, including Burberry, Armani，Bottega Veneta， Etro，Salvatore Ferragamo， Moncler，Bally，Ermenegildo Zegna，Montblanc，Max Mara，Lane Crawford，Coach，I.T，Moschino, Michael Kors, Tory Burch, Swarovski And UGG, among which 7 are for ALL MANKING, ACNE STUDIOS, CELINE, ETRO, FENDI, LA PERLA, LANE CRAWFORD, MARC JACOBS, MONNALISA, VICTORIA'S SECRET and other Outlet stores are newly opened in the East China region.

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 翱翔•飞越地平线
attractions.summary: Come on an exciting flight and witness this magical world in an unprecedented way! Embark on the journey of "Soaring and Flying over the Horizon", feel the gentle breeze brushing your face, and fly over the treetops and rooftops. This is definitely a heart warming flying experience. On this magical journey around the world, fully appreciate the beautiful scenery along the way and enjoy the freedom and pleasure of soaring in the sky.

attractions.name: 创极速光轮
attractions.summary:
The world premiere, Tomorrowland Park shows the future world depicted in the Disney movie Chuang: War Chronicle. 
· Riding a two-wheeled speed light wheel motorcycle, tourists fly past the track under the magnificent dome, and enter the fantasy space where reality and reality can't be distinguished at high speed. 
Visitors in the waiting area can imagine the future world under the color-changing dome, and watch the speedy light wheel fly by to the infectious music. 
The giant dome is undulating, and it will be shocking even when viewed from a distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: A thrilling speed

attractions.name: 雷鸣山漂流
attractions.summary: Embark on an exciting raft journey, delve into the dark abyss, race against fierce beasts, and toss and roll in the rapids. Join the Explorer Alliance and head to the peak of the exploration island - the "Thunder Mountain" that emits a terrifying roar.

attractions.name: 巴斯光年星际营救
attractions.summary: "Buzz Lightyear Interstellar Rescue" is an amusement project from the Disney Pixar movie Toy Story series. Visitors will work together to complete the task of saving the world. "Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots.
