attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere.

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing

· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing

It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 武康大楼

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

- There are more than 97,000 Buddha statues in total, with the Western Mountain Caves being the most refined part, including the Luoshen Buddha statue and the "Twenty Images of Longmen."
- Among the key caves of the Tang Dynasty Longmen Grottoes, the grand and imposing group sculptures of the Great Luoshen Buddha are the most famous.

· The museum consists of a main building and an auxiliary building. The main building has two floors. The first floor is a general exhibition, and the second floor is a boutique exhibition of the museum. 
· There are more than 11,000 pieces of cultural relics on display in the new museum. Besides the local unearthed cultural relics, it also accepted a number of treasures allocated by the Palace Museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate Rare Treasures and Taste Luoyang Ancient Capital Culture

attractions.name: 寻迹洛神赋
attractions.summary: Luoshui Tang Tang, a river of history and culture. "Black Bow BLACKBOW draws inspiration from the spirit of" Luoyang charm "and uses the Heluo culture as a creative blueprint to tell the story of Luoyang through technology and art, constructing China's first digital immersive performance" Luoshen Fu ". The opening ceremony visual effects director of the Beijing Winter Olympics, Wang Zhiou, served as the chief director, and the opening ceremony visual effects production team, Black Bow BLACKBOW, served as the chief creator. The venue combines digital imaging, mechanical devices, and live performances to showcase the reincarnation story of the ancient capital Luoyang City; Integrating digital immersive performances, immersive museums, and multi-dimensional digital performances, it comprehensively and comprehensively showcases the cultural history of Luoyang. The expert team BLACKBOW specially invited Pan Lusheng of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles, Guan Jun, president of the Calligraphy Institute of the Chinese Academy of Arts, Sun Xiaochun, president of the School of Humanities of the University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Geng Shuo, associate professor of the School of Humanities of the Central Academy of Fine Arts, to serve as the expert of "Tracing Luoshen Fu". Based on the Heluo culture, with a historical perspective of "ancient, modern, and new", we will deeply explore the historical culture and humanistic arts of Luoyang "in the world", as well as the "radiation" and dissemination of Luoyang culture to the world. The digital immersive performance black bow highly extracts the core cultural symbols of Luoyang, breaks the traditional theater viewing mode, and uses a combination of non-linear narrative and three-dimensional performance areas to break through the limitations of time and space, bringing multi-dimensional sensory stimulation and emotional resonance to the audience. Experience a fully immersive walking and performance mode, walking in different time and space. Exploring the long forgotten story of Luoyang from a new perspective, and glimpsing the origins and traces of the Hetu Luoshu. Witnessing the encounter between Cao Zhi and Luo Shen, experiencing the sorrow of wandering for roots, and exploring the state of mind of literati and ink masters Saints, grandmasters, and famous poets have gathered in Luoyang for thousands of years. The story of Chinese civilization begins here - the Xia and Shang dynasties began, casting tripods and shaping inscriptions; Duke Zhou established the capital and established rituals and music; The Three Kingdoms and Two Jin Dynasties were both literary and martial; The Buddhist capital of Northern Wei, the wonder of Galan; During the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties, various countries came to court; In the Western Capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, famous scholars gathered. Immersive museums rely on the form of "digital" cultural and museum exhibitions to comprehensively and stereoscopically reproduce the glorious era of the ancient capital Luoyang. By combining digital art, real-time interactive exhibitions, and live performances, we will experience a journey through time and space. Pursuing the source of civilization, entering the temporal and spatial dimensions of history, exploring and practicing cross-border innovation of "cultural relics+technology", and unfolding the "picture scroll" drawn by the unique cultural symbols of Luoyang one by one. The book of rivers, maps, and Luo in the world is here; Chinese civilization originated here; Duke Zhou measured the shadows and established his capital here. The wheels of history slowly pass by, and civilization flows endlessly for thousands of years. We will return to the "world" in the hearts of ancient people, awaken the dormant Chinese civilization under this land, trace the source of civilization and explore the center of the world through the changes of the world. Wulu Tongluo Luoyang is also a crossroads of ancient Chinese transportation, where waterways and land routes intersect. The Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the Ten Thousand Mile Tea Road, the Grassland Silk Road, the Desert Silk Road, and the Maritime Silk Road, transportation arteries from different periods converge in Luoyang, forming a major transportation pattern of "five roads connecting Luoyang". They are not only economic and trade routes, but also cultural exchange routes, injecting a continuous stream of vitality into the historical process of Luoyang's prosperity for thousands of years. Culture collides and blends in exchanges, and we will become ancient people, listening to camel bells in the desert, traveling through ancient sandy roads, encountering boats, carts, and merchants, and retrieving the "treasures" left behind by our predecessors on the way, returning to the magnificent era of "Five Roads Connecting to Luo". If you ask about the rise and fall of ancient and modern times, please only look at Luoyang City. Looking back at Luoyang for a thousand years, it seems like a dream. Today, we will pick up the fleeting shadows scattered in the long river of history one by one, immerse ourselves in this shining historical memory, return to the prosperous era of the ancient capital, and search for the dream of the divine city together. The national beauty of peonies has accompanied Luoyang for thousands of years. What would the world look like in her eyes? From the perspective of peonies, in the cycle of four seasons and the flow of time and space, we explore the beauty of national colors and feel the growth and decline of all things. We can see the scene of peonies blooming in the capital during the blooming season, and experience the step by step blooming like a startled swan, waving our sleeves into poetry. The 24 solar terms of Heluo Palm Lantern Festival are an important part of traditional culture, reflecting the wisdom and romantic feelings of ancient Chinese people, and embodying the long history and profoundness of Chinese culture. In the "Heluo Palm Lantern" segment, Black Bow incorporates iconic Chinese culture such as the Luoshen Fu and the 24 solar terms. It blends multiple levels of performance forms in outdoor spaces, using technological aesthetics to subvert tradition and make you feel like you are in a fantasy dream, encountering the goddess of Luoshui. The "24 solar terms" unfold slowly like a historical scroll, carrying the longing for the charm of Luoyang and entering the wonderful night of Luoyang together. In the long scroll of time, Luoyang has painted scenes of history, and now it will also paint scenes of the future... The journey of "tracing" has never ended. Let us step onto this land to explore, see, and experience! Full text 

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城国家遗址公园天堂明堂景区
attractions.summary: The Sui and Tang Luoyang City National Heritage Park was once the core area of the palace ruins of the Sui, Tang, Five Dynasties, and Song dynasties, among which the famous ones were the Mingtang and Tiantang during the reign of Empress Wu Zetian. Mingtang is located on the axis of Luoyang city during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It is the main hall of the palace city and an important place for Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu Zetian to unify the world and govern the country. The prototype of the Tianfu Tu in the 2013 film "Detective Dee: The Empire of Heaven" directed by Tsui Hark is here. Heaven is the place where Empress Wu Zetian worshipped Buddhism. The building has five floors on the exterior and nine floors on the interior, symbolizing the supreme status of the emperor as the ruler of China. Tourists can take the elevator directly to the ninth floor, overlooking the panoramic view of Luoyang, and the night view is not to be missed. There are also large and small Buddha statues and murals on other floors, which can reveal the profound Buddhist culture. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城九洲池
attractions.summary: Today's Jiuzhouchi Site Park covers an area of 288 acres, including the Great Inner Dormitory area in the northwest of the palace city, a part of the Taoguang Garden in the north of the palace city, and the Jiuzhouchi Royal Garden in the north of the city west of the palace city. There are a total of 12 sites, which are protected and displayed through various scientific methods. We hope to use methods and forms such as displaying the original site of ancient ruins and simulating the ground to allow more people to understand the royal garden style during the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties. Jiuzhou Pool, as the imperial garden of Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang dynasties, was a real existence in history. According to the "Fangkao of the Two Capital Cities of Tang Dynasty", "Jiuzhou Pool has a curved pool with several islands in it, like Jiuzhou in the East China Sea. It covers an area of ten hectares, with a water depth of more than ten zhang, and is home to birds, fish, and flowers." In 1960, archaeologists discovered it while excavating Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The palace city area of Luoyang during the Sui and Tang dynasties was composed of a central core area and many surrounding small towns. Jiuzhou Pool is located in the northern part of Xige City on the west side of the Imperial Palace, accounting for about two fifths of Xige City. The scope of "ten hectares of residential land" recorded in the records is based on the Tang Dynasty's system of land cultivation. In the Tang Dynasty, one foot was about 29.5 centimeters and ten hectares were about 520000 square meters, which was larger than the entire western city. However, the actual archaeological measurement of the water area of Jiuzhou Lake is about 139250 square meters. Chinese classical garden art holds a pivotal position in traditional Chinese architecture. The forms of Chinese landscape gardens, represented by literati gardens and royal gardens, are aimed at pursuing the spiritual realm of nature, thus achieving the aesthetic pursuit of "although created by humans, as if opened by heaven", reflecting the cultural concept of "harmony between man and nature", which is completely consistent with the overall architectural concept of Luoyang City in the Sui and Tang dynasties. As a royal garden, Jiuzhou Pool not only embodies the combination of nature and culture, expressing the concept of harmonious unity between humans and nature, but also highlights the "ritual system" in traditional Chinese culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城应天门遗址
attractions.name_en: The Ruins of Yingtian Gate, Sui-Tang Luoyang City
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Historical ruins
attractions.summary: Ying Tian Gate was the main southern gate of Ziwei City, originally constructed in the first year of the Sui Dynasty's Daye era (605 AD). It was initially named Ze Tian Gate, but in the first year of the Shenlong era (705 AD), it was renamed Ying Tian Gate to avoid using Empress Wu Zetian's name. Later, it became known as the Five Phoenix Tower and endured through the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song Dynasty. Ying Tian Gate was an important venue for the imperial court to hold major state ceremonies and diplomatic events. These included significant occasions such as the Yuan Zheng (New Year's Day), the Winter Solstice, ceremonial music performances, banquets, amnesties, and the transition to a new year. During such events, including tributes from foreign envoys and dignitaries, the emperor would ascend the gate to listen to state affairs. Historical ceremonies such as Emperor Gaozong's capture of the Baekje king, Empress Wu Zetian's ascension to the throne, and Emperor Xuanzong's reception of Japan's eighth envoy to Tang China were all held on the Ying Tian Gate tower. Its function was similar to that of the Meridian Gate in modern Beijing. Ying Tian Gate was a massive architectural complex shaped like a "concave" character, consisting of a main gate tower, parapet walls, east and west watchtowers, and connecting corridors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Sui and Tang ruins, savor the culture of the ancient capital.

Founded in 1955, it is named after its construction on the site of Wangcheng in the Eastern Zhou Dynasty. It is the largest comprehensive park in Luoyang.

During the annual Peony Festival, Wangcheng Park is the best place to enjoy flowers in the ancient city.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 重庆十八梯传统风貌区
attractions.summary: The land area of the Eighteen Stairs Traditional Style Area project is about 88 acres, with a construction area of about 170000 square meters and a total investment scale of over 2 billion yuan. According to the project positioning, it will rely on the cultural and tourism resources of Chongqing's "mother city", integrate and develop the modern cultural tourism industry, and build it into a characteristic cultural tourism demonstration zone, a cultural exhibition window for Chongqing facing the international community, and become an international cultural tourism destination. Integrating the four functions of commerce, scenery, tourism, and culture, presenting a panoramic view of Chongqing's 800 year history and cultural life in the region, and creating a strong experiential cultural and tourism commercial demonstration base. Chongqing Shibati Traditional Scenic Area, centering on "urban sightseeing", "intangible heritage inheritance" and "cultural creativity experience", and combining the industrial positioning of modern service industries such as "night economy", realizes the development of panoramic experience of "culture+tourism", "culture+commerce", "culture+creativity", and "culture+cross-border", and plans four characteristic areas of traditional cultural experience, China-Chic cultural and creative experience, international exchange center, and lifestyle center. Traditional Culture Experience (AB Zone) is based on the traditional folk culture, urban culture, and historical architectural culture of Bayu, creating an open cultural experience block that integrates cultural leisure, cultural sightseeing, and dining and accommodation, deeply attracting foreign tourists. Introduce Sichuan Chongqing hotpot, characteristic Jianghu cuisine, boutique Chongqing cuisine, specialty snacks, and other intangible cultural heritage displays to showcase the unique charm of "Chongqing flavor" and the Ba Yu culture. Use inherited and innovative handicraft products, refined and developed tourism products, and unique cultural IP derivatives to show China-Chic fashion culture and deeply attract literary and art customers. Introduce China-Chic brand, innovative retail, boutique accessories, craft gifts, theme coffee bars, and show the charm of China-Chic's cultural creativity with a variety of China-Chic brands. The D District International Exchange Center (open in 2022) integrates multiple functions such as international diversified culture, tourism service distribution, and city brand reception, creating an international exchange center that deeply attracts high-end consumers at home and abroad. The area plans to introduce cultural exhibitions, retail, catering and other formats, as well as cross-border flagship stores for brands, automotive concept experience stores, digital experience stores, fashion and cultural creativity, international trends, Michelin and Black Pearl foreign cuisine restaurants, and other brands showcasing distinctive culture, creating an international cultural exchange space. The Lifestyle Center (E Zone) (opened in 2022) integrates various functions such as nighttime economic demonstration gathering, personalized leisure consumption, and open youth socialization, showcasing exquisite lifestyles and deeply attracting young consumer groups. The area plans to introduce leisure and entertainment, retail, catering and other formats, with a focus on introducing cultural performances, specialty bars, themed pubs, international catering chains and other characteristic brands, creating a "late night canteen" that fits multiple taste experiences, and creating a leisure and entertainment street that integrates catering and trendy culture, activating the city's night economy. attractions.name: 山城步道
attractions.summary: The so-called trail refers to a city path that can only be walked on. Chongqing is a city built in the mountains, with many adjacent areas having a drop of several tens of meters, and transportation can only rely on urban trails that climb uphill and uphill. In the past, some famous trails were bustling, and many old ruins in Chongqing are located next to these trails. With the large-scale renovation of old cities and improvement of transportation conditions, these trails have gradually lost their function, and some have disappeared or become deserted. Some famous ruins in the surrounding area are slowly being forgotten by people and disappearing into the long river of history The repaired third trail is one of its representatives. This trail is located on the southern slope of the Yuzhong Peninsula, running from north to south, passing through Zhongshan Hospital, Kangjian Hall, Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, the former site of the French Renai Hall, and the suspended boardwalk. It is 1748 meters long and compactly connects a series of traditional neighborhoods and historical and cultural relics. The higher point of the trail is near the Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, and the lower point is at the entrance of Shancheng Lane, with a height difference of 79.5 meters. It is a mountain city trail with distinctive features of Chongqing city.

attractions.name: 戴家巷崖壁步道
attractions.name_en: dai jia xiang ya bi bu dao
attractions.summary: The Daijiaxiang Cliff Trail is a sturdy cliff plank path with cliffs as walls, standing by the Jialing River and Hongyadong. The cliff trail extends horizontally, forming a wide viewing platform on the narrow mountainside. Whether it is the layered urban landscape or the rippling Jialing River scenery, it is all within reach.

attractions.name: 重庆好吃街夜市
attractions.summary: Chongqing Delicious Street is a street of food culture. In Southwest Mandarin, the word "good" in "delicious" is pronounced as four sounds, meaning "greedy". "Delicious" means "greedy". Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 解放碑步行街
attractions.summary: Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street is a more prosperous business circle in Chongqing, where there are many department stores and hotels. It is a good place for shopping, eating and strolling. It is also a good place for visiting Chongqing beauties. The pedestrian street is located in Yuzhong District, centered on Monument to the people's Liberation, including Minquan Road, Zourong Road and Bayi Road. There are many food, shopping, and beauty shopping malls, as well as a variety of snacks and beautiful women, making it the "three highs" of a pedestrian street. You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. There are also scenic spots near the pedestrian street, such as Nengren Temple and Arhat Temple. Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street and its surrounding areas are also one of the main choices for tourists to stay in Chongqing. There are intercontinental hotels and economical hotels with high cost performance. Full text 

attractions.name: 白公馆
attractions.summary:
· Bai Mansion, formerly known as Xiangshan Villa, was originally the villa of warlord Bai Ju, and later converted into a Kuomintang prison, a two-story building.  
This is the place where the story of Little Carrot Head took place. It once held the Communist Party, and it was also the place where many martyrs died. Its historical significance is much greater than that of scenic spots. 
Divided into two lanes, left and right, you need to climb the ladder, and visit Xiangshan Villa on the left side, which is actually the place where "political prisoners" are held; Climb the mountain on the right side to visit the place where Yang Hucheng died and the place where Little Carrot Head was killed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Prototype Place of the Novel Red Rock

attractions.name: 渣滓洞
attractions.summary:
· Originally a coal cave on the outskirts of Chongqing, a small coal mine opened in 1920, and later set up as a detention center by the Military Bureau of the National Government. 
Zhazidong is surrounded by mountains on three sides and ditches on one side. The terrain is hidden, and it specializes in detaining and persecuting revolutionaries. The more famous one is "Sister Jiang". 
Zhazi Cave was repaired and rebuilt on the original site, which truly reflected the scene at that time. The atmosphere was depressed, and the instruments of torture displayed were shocking.  
The whole scenic spot is not big, so you can visit the Tomb of the Martyrs and the White Mansion together. There are also special buses arranged in the scenic spot, which is very convenient.

attractions.name: 磁器口古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town

attractions.name: 龙门浩老街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Longmenhao Old Street is located in the central area of Chongqing, in the middle section of Nanbin Road, a 4A-level tourist belt. The old street faces the Yangtze River, backed by Nanshan Mountain, and you have a panoramic view of the scenic spots of Yuzhong. There are 1 ropeway, 2 light rails, 5 bridges and 19 supporting bus lines around them, linking Jiangbei, Yuzhong and Danzishi CBDs, radiating the whole city. 
Longmenhao Old Street has a history of one hundred years, where the port opening culture, anti-Japanese war site culture, Buddhist culture, Bayu culture and dock culture are colorful. The restoration of the old street employs first-class cultural relics restoration craftsmen, and uses 1.6 million old bricks, 400,000 old tiles and 30,000 tons of old stones collected from various places. Based on the principle of repairing the old as before, the building technology of a hundred years ago is adopted to restore the former style of Longmen Hao Old Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chongqing historical and cultural old street; Well preserved; Very large scale

attractions.name: 南滨路
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Chongqing Nanbin Road is located in Nan'an District, with a total length of about 25 kilometers. It is a sightseeing area for urban viewing and leisure. 
At night, Nanbin Road is a good place to see the charming night view of Yuzhong Peninsula. 
The whole sightseeing area is not only sightseeing, but also a food street, which can meet the needs of delicious food while watching the scenery. 
· It is a good place for citizens to relax, entertain and run, and sometimes the Ramazon competition is held here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chongqing Bund surrounded by mountains and rivers

attractions.name: 重庆云端之眼观景台
attractions.summary: Standing higher, seeing more fully, the scenery varies by height, infinite scenery is in the sky. The "Top of Mountain City, Eye of Chongqing" Yangtze River Cableway High altitude Observation Deck is a gathering place for urban landscapes from the perspective of God. It is a popular photo spot in the Chongqing photography circle and has "Cloud Radio" and "Cloud Prayer" projects. From the indoor observation deck on the 67th floor and the apron observation deck on the 69th floor, you can enjoy a 360 ° panoramic view of Chongqing's forests and the scenery of the two rivers and four banks without any blind spots. During the day, looking up at the vast blue sky and bowing down to the continuous buildings; At night, the starry sky above and the lights of thousands of homes below provide visitors with a unique viewing experience of the Sky City "Skywalker".

attractions.name: 长嘉汇弹子石老街
attractions.tag: Stroll through the neighborhood; Nighttime sightseeing; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
Changjiahui Danzishi Old Street is the first national AAAA tourist attraction in China themed around "open port culture and the city’s nine-level hillside terrain." It is located on Nanbin Road, which is known as the "Chongqing Bund." The old street stretches one kilometer from end to end, with an elevation difference of about 80 meters across nine levels of slopes. Visitors walk uphill through streets and alleys with Eastern Sichuan-style courtyards, passing by scattered stilted buildings and businesses.

The scenic area is set against the mountains and water, offering a combination of rich historical heritage, sightseeing, leisure, entertainment, and shopping. Key attractions include the French Naval Barracks (a national heritage site), the Madame Tussauds Chongqing (the first in Southwest China), Changjiahui Ocean Park, Yide Hall, Wang’s Mansion, and others.

This is the only place in Chongqing where visitors can simultaneously "view two rivers," "see three bridges," and "admire three landmarks." At night, the 270-degree panoramic view from the "Two Rivers Viewing Platform" offers a sweeping view of the Yuzhong Peninsula and Jiangbei District, presenting the essence of Chongqing’s nightscape. It truly offers "a complete view of Chongqing at a glance." In addition to its unique landscape features, the area is also a food haven. Along the one-kilometer old street, every few steps you’ll find "Chongqing famous snacks" and "China’s renowned shops," as well as restaurants and bars with prime riverfront views. Today, Danzishi Old Street has become the first choice for locals to relax and entertain, as well as the must-visit destination for showing out-of-town guests the charm of Chongqing.

attractions.name: 李子坝轻轨站
attractions.summary: The local internet famous light rail station, where light rail trains pass through the walls of the building.

attractions.name: 桂园
attractions.summary: It is named after two sweet-scented osmanthus trees in the courtyard. Guiyuan is the place where Mao Zedong and Comrade Zhou Enlai negotiated with Kuomintang representatives and signed the Minutes of the Talks between the Representatives of the Kuomintang and the Communist Party (i.e. the "Double Tenth Agreement"). The second floor is where Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai work and rest. Photos of Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai's activities during the negotiations in Chongqing are also displayed
attractions.shortFeatures: Admiral's Mansion Full of Osmanthus Flowers

attractions.name: 周公馆
attractions.summary:
Zhou Mansion is located at the east end of Zhongshan 4th Road, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the office of the Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee in the urban area. 
· In front of the door is the spacious Zengjiayan Square. In the center of the square is a full-body bronze statue of 　 and Zhou Enlai who worked hard through hardships. People are here to pursue the past and cherish the memory of great men.

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览(十六铺码头)
attractions.summary: Taking a boat tour of the Huangpu River is one of the ways to appreciate the bustling urban landscape of Shanghai. As a century old wharf in Shanghai, starting from the 16 Pu, to the west of the Huangpu River is the Bund of World Buildings, and to the east of the Huangpu River is the modern Lujiazui Financial District. When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". Starting from the the 16 Pu, which has a history of more than 100 years, and going down the river, the first thing you can see is Lujiazui Financial District, which is full of skyscrapers. The Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Jinmao Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other landmark buildings are here. After the magnificent Yangpu Bridge and the Garden Bridge of Shanghai, which has a history of more than 100 years, it is a classical and solemn architectural complex with a variety of architectural styles. The scenery is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
attractions.shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals from around the world
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:30; admission ends at 15:30)

attractions.name: 宁波鼓楼
attractions.summary: Drum Tower, also known as Haishu Tower, is the only remaining ancient city tower site in Ningbo city. Its lower part is in the traditional Chinese style of a city tower, while above it is a Roman style bell tower, with a unique blend of Chinese and Western styles. Nowadays, the area around Gulou is an antique pedestrian shopping district, and Ningbo specialty snacks such as Youzan Zi are worth trying. Nowadays, the Drum Tower and the surrounding Park Road area have become the gathering places for major cultural activities in Ningbo. Art exhibitions, calligraphy exhibitions, and photo exhibitions are often held inside the tower. On both sides of the road are shops imitating the traditional architectural style of Ningbo, with small blue tile double slope roofs, wind and fire horse head walls, and various exquisite exterior wood decorations, which not only have the style of Ningbo's traditional commercial street, but also have a strong historical and cultural texture. The two ancient stone memorial archway at the entrance of the east and west ends, the ruins of the city wall, the stone monument of Zicheng's historical changes, and the Yongfengku Site Park near the Drum Tower can provide you with a detailed reading of Ningbo's history. At night, the Drum Tower area is very popular, and when the landscape lights are on, it is particularly suitable for taking night shots.

attractions.name: 老外滩
attractions.tag: A hidden gem for strolling with kids; neighborhood walk.; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Ningbo Old Bund opened to the public in 1844 and is currently one of the few Bunds in China with a history of over a century. It serves as the gateway to the ancient city of Ningbo.  
- The Old Bund still preserves many European-style old buildings that have been converted into bars and restaurants. The Gothic-style Catholic Church in Jiangbei is one of the landmarks of Ningbo.  
- What makes the Old Bund unique is that it is not enclosed; citizens can experience their daily life at the Sanjiang Port of the Old Bund.  
- At the same time, the Old Bund is also a bar street, bustling with activity in the evening, and many foreigners enjoy relaxing and socializing here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoying drinks at a bar while admiring the beautiful European-style architecture.

attractions.name: 蒋氏故居
attractions.name_en: Former Residence of the Jiang Family
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings
attractions.summary:
The former residences of Chiang Kai-shek and Jiang Jingguo, the fourth batch of national key cultural relics protection units, important historical sites and representative buildings in modern times. 
The former residence is a group building, which includes Fenggao House, Small House, Yutai Salt Shop, etc. The bureau is a traditional front hall and back hall, with two hatchbacks and four halls. 
The building is connected with the building, with ink pillars and ochre walls, which is magnificent. There are three gardens in the front hall and left and right, and there are also Jiang's ancestral hall and Jiang's mother's cemetery in the garden. 
The corridor of the hall is covered with carved colorful paintings, and there are plaques written by Chiang Kai-shek in the newspaper hall, "Newspaper respects relatives is the moral important way" and "Being reasonable and handsome".
attractions.shortFeatures: Visiting the footprints of Jiang Gong and his family
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 雪窦山
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains; Temples
attractions.summary:
National 5A-level scenic spot, famous for its shanshui, ancient temples and valley waterfalls, was known as "Penglai on the Sea" as early as the Han Dynasty.  
Scenic spots include Xuedou Mountain, Xuedou Temple, one of the ten Zen temples in the world, and the tallest sitting bronze open-air statue of Maitreya Buddha in the world. 
Standing on the observation deck of Qianzhangyan Waterfall, you can see lush trees, which is a veritable natural oxygen bar.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy streams and waterfalls and attend the Maitreya Buddha

attractions.name: 天一阁博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; hidden gem for kids; Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the city of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, it is the oldest existing private library in China, as well as the oldest library in Asia and one of the world's earliest family libraries.
- Built in the mid-Ming Dynasty, it was overseen by Fan Qin, a retired Deputy Minister of the Ministry of War. Many exhibition halls display books collected by the Fan family from all corners of the world.
- The architecture combines various traditional folk crafts such as wood carving, brick carving, stone carving, gilding, and embossing, making it a masterpiece of Ningbo's residential architecture.
- Inside the Tianyi Pavilion, there is also an interesting Mahjong Museum, which has become a popular spot for many to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient private library.

attractions.name: 天一阁·月湖景区
attractions.name_en: Tianyi Pavilion and Moon Lake Scenic Area
attractions.summary: Tianyi Pavilion · Moon Lake Scenic Area is located in the central area of Ningbo city, consisting of two core scenic areas: Tianyi Pavilion Museum and Moon Lake. The scenic area has rich historical resources and profound cultural heritage, with cultural relics protection units at all levels.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京明故宫遗址公园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Majestic Ruins of the Imperial Palace of the Ming Dynasty

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 双塔寺
attractions.summary: The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

attractions.name: 柳巷
attractions.shortFeatures: A bustling commercial street with a long history in Taiyuan

attractions.name: 太原市食品街
attractions.summary: Taiyuan Food Street is located in Yingze District, Taiyuan City. Passing through the bustling commercial area of Gulou Street, you can see the ancient archway of Food Street and the spacious and tidy large parking lot of Gulou Street. The newly renovated food street, with its smooth marble pavement, features the five flavors of "sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, and salty" in ancient Chinese characters, indicating the uniqueness of this street. Standing at the south entrance of Food Street, looking north, there are two rows of two-story buildings modeled after the Ming and Qing dynasties, pavilions, memorial archway, cornices, and arch of wooden architecture. The traditional cultural symbols of Shanxi, such as painted buildings and red lanterns, are presented one by one in the block. Anti corrosion long flower pots, sculptures that reflect the characteristics of Shanxi noodles, and antique leisure chairs are neatly arranged on the road paved with bluestone strips. Taiyuan Food Street gathers numerous delicious foods, not only old shops such as Quanwazi snacks and Xueshan cold drinks, but also new ones such as Yantonglou, Jinyunlou, and Old Beijing braised and burned food are crowded with diners who come to try them out. A newly renovated food street is not just a symbol of cuisine, but also a cultural symbol. The "guards" dressed in the costumes of Song Dynasty warriors guard the street corner, adding a cultural atmosphere to the food street. In the center of the street, there are antique vending cars that not only complement the surrounding buildings, but also showcase the rich Jin merchant culture.

attractions.name: 晋祠博物馆
attractions.summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.
attractions.shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex

attractions.name: 店头村
attractions.summary: Diantou Ancient Village is located in the branch of Lvliang Mountain, within the mouth of Fengyugou, with Mengshan Mountain to its back and Longshan Mountain to its south, stretching for 1km from east to west. Diantou Village is one of the eight villages in Fengyu. In history, it was a must pass place from Yangcheng in ancient Jin to Shaanxi Gansu Ningxia, and also an ancient military castle that was easy to defend but difficult to attack. There are currently over 360 relatively complete houses remaining. Diantou Ancient Village has a rich historical and cultural heritage, which is not only a corner of Jin culture, but also a carrier of ancient villages in Jin state. The team behind the movie 'Blood Drops' once filmed in the ancient village of Diantou.

attractions.name: 晋商博物院
attractions.summary: The Jin Shang Museum is a humanistic and historical museum established based on the former site of the Shanxi Governor's Office, a national key cultural relic protection unit. It integrates cultural relics, ancient architecture, garden landscapes, and exhibitions.

attractions.name: 山西博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions
attractions.shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics

attractions.name: 中国煤炭博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids.; Museums
attractions.summary: The China Coal Museum is the only professional museum in China dedicated to the coal industry and is a symbol of science and civilization. Due to its unique function and status, it has been awarded the title of "National First-Class Museum" by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Here, visitors can also view dozens of coal specimens, including long flame coal, poor coal, lignite, and gas coal. The museum's most distinctive feature is the "Coal Amusement Palace." The "Coal Amusement Palace" is a large-scale underground simulated mine, recreated using numerous real-life prototypes or 1:1 replicas. The visitor route spans several hundred meters and is said to be the largest in Asia.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reproduced Underground Simulation Mine

attractions.name: 东湖醋园
attractions.summary:
