Donghu Vinegar Garden is the first company-based, factory-style museum in Shanxi Province that showcases the traditional and modern production processes of aged vinegar and the historical and cultural connotations of aged vinegar.

The Exhibition Hall and Vinegar Therapy Garden collect various vinegar brewing tools, farming implements, and over 700 vinegar therapy recipes dating back to the Western Han Dynasty, providing a comprehensive understanding of the historical and cultural heritage of Shanxi aged vinegar.

Visitors can participate in part of the production process and enjoy free tastings of various aged vinegars.

As this is a food industry site, for hygiene reasons, visitors are not allowed to wander or touch production tools during the tour.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the brewing process of aged Shanxi vinegar.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:30-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier

attractions.name: 冰川公园
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountain Climbing; Glaciers
attractions.summary:
· Located on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north of Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, it is a typical representative of the modern glacier in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
· The park composed of stone caves and caves eroded by glaciers is a landform relic formed by Quaternary glaciers, and is known as the "Glass Palace of Lucerne".  
In autumn, winter and spring, the snow is vast here. In summer, you can see the glaciers formed more than 40,000 years ago, and you can feel the snow-capped mountains at close range. 
The white mountain at the top of the mountain is magnificent, spectacular, white and delicate, and there is also a marking stone tablet with an altitude of 4,680 meters, which is also a popular group photo place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience glaciers and snow-capped mountains up close

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain

attractions.name: 拉市海
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary: Lashihai, located 10 kilometers west of Lijiang, is the largest plateau lake in Lijiang and the first nature reserve named after "wetland" in Yunnan Province. Every year, tens of thousands of waterfowl come here to spend the winter. Between December and February of the following year, it is the best time to watch birds in Lashihai. The lake is surrounded by Naxi villages, and every village near the lake has opened a horse farm. Lashihai has thus become an excellent place for horse riding, boating and bird watching in Lijiang. Tips: Every morning and evening hour is the best time for bird watching. The services of the surrounding racecourses are mixed, so pay attention to negotiating the price and service details in advance. When riding a horse, try not to put valuables in pockets and other places, which are easy to lose.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beautiful grassland wetland

attractions.name: 白沙古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
attractions.summary:
Baisha Ancient Town was once the political, economic and cultural center of Lijiang, and it was also the original settlement of Naxi people in Lijiang Dam, retaining the original Naxi culture. 
The ancient town retains its original appearance, has not been over-developed, is quieter than Dayan and Shuhe, and you can see Yulong Snow Mountain when you look up. 
Baisha Mural is the most famous scenic spot in the town. It lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, and it is a good place to learn about Dongba culture. 
You can sit and drink tea in the street shop, hang out slowly, and chat with the local old grandmother in a language that each other doesn't understand, which is relaxed and leisurely.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the quiet of the original ecological ancient town

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located northwest of Lijiang Old Town, it is quiet and ancient, with mountains and waters, more tranquil and primitive than Dayan Ancient Town.
- The mountains behind the ancient town are the foothills of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with lush and beautiful rolling peaks and dense forests.
- The Grand Stone Bridge and the Dajue Palace are well-preserved, with murals depicting figures from Buddhist teachings.
- It is an important part of the UNESCO World Heritage Lijiang Old Town and was selected as a "Charming Town of China" by CCTV in 2005.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tranquil and serene town of Chama Ancient Town.

attractions.name: 万寿宫
attractions.summary: The Wanshou Palace is located on a central island in Xianghu Park, showcasing the traditional architectural style of the late Qing Gan School while retaining the charm of old Nanchang.

attractions.name: 蛤蟆街夜市
attractions.summary: This is a unique food street with a variety of delicious snacks, making it a lively place.

attractions.name: 江西省美术馆
attractions.summary: The art museum officially opened in 2020, with a building area of about 20000 square meters. It displays many works of Chinese modern and contemporary artists and is a public welfare art museum.

attractions.name: 八一广场
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the heart of Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, it is an important place for political, economic, cultural, leisure, entertainment and other activities in Jiangxi. 
It consists of the central square, the rostrum and the east and west gardens. It is the largest city central square in Jiangxi Province. 
· The large musical fountain in the center of the square, with 1,290 sprinklers, reproduces the bloody battle of the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army in Taihang. 
In the center of the square stands the "August 1st Nanchang Uprising Memorial Tower" inscribed by Marshal Ye Jianying, where many tourists will take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where the military flag is raised

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 《寻梦滕王阁》实景演出
attractions.summary: The "Searching for Dreams Tengwang Pavilion" is a large-scale "virtual+real-life" interactive cultural performance project in Nanchang. It starts with the Pavilion of Dreams and is led by Mr. Liang Sicheng, who drew the architectural drawings of Tengwang Pavilion. It is initiated by Wang Bo, the leader of the Four Great Masters of the Early Tang Dynasty, who wrote the "Preface to Tengwang Pavilion", bringing together the sages of various dynasties in Jiangxi. Through video projection, lighting, and performances by more than 140 actors, combined with the architectural structure characteristics of Tengwang Pavilion's "Bright Three Dark Seven", with "Seven Dreams and Seven Realms" as the core, seven colors are used to interpret seven life realms. The cultural characteristics of various dynasties, including "poetry, books, rituals, and music", are infused into every detail of the performance, highlighting the literary style and poetic charm, creating a beautiful immersive experience, allowing the audience to appreciate Tengwang Pavilion's profound cultural heritage.

attractions.name: 江西省博物馆(新馆)
attractions.summary: The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) is one of the three major cultural centers in Jiangxi Province. It is based on a square box and symbolizes a treasure box. It has six floors, a building area of 86000 square meters, and an exhibition area of 28000 square meters. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Museum) gathers precious historical relics and ancient art masterpieces discovered from various parts of Jiangxi, and collects a large number of cultural relics from the province. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) has established an exhibition system that combines permanent and temporary exhibitions, consisting of 8 permanent exhibitions and 3 temporary exhibition halls. The entire exhibition showcases the historical landscape and cultural characteristics of Jiangxi, meeting the diverse needs of the public in the new era with high quality.

attractions.name: 南昌秋水广场-音乐喷泉
attractions.summary: Nanchang Qiushui Square faces Tengwang Pavilion across the river, and it is very lively when night falls. The most eye-catching thing in the square is the fountain performance every night. The main spray height of the fountain is 128 meters. When the fountain moves with the music, it is colorful, and people can watch the beautiful scenery of Tengwang Pavilion while enjoying the music.

attractions.name: 南昌之星摩天轮
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Ferris wheel; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The landmark of Nanchang, 160 meters high, is 25 meters higher than the previous world record holder "Eye of London". 
· The diameter of the turntable is 153 meters, with 60 space capsules. A ferris wheel can seat six people and can accommodate nearly a thousand people per hour. It takes half an hour to sit in a circle. 
· Overlooking the whole city of Nanchang, the cabin is equipped with LCD TV and Mitsubishi heating and cooling air conditioning. 
The world's largest clock will also be installed, with 60 space capsules representing a 60-minute time scale. The Ferris wheel will adopt dual power supply and dual power system to ensure the safety of tourists.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the romantic landmarks

restaurants.name_en: Jordan Chak Kee Hong Kong-style Tea Restaurant

attractions.name: 重庆两江游
attractions.summary: Without admiring the night view, I haven't been to Chongqing. The Two Rivers Tour of Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous night view of Chongqing. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. The colorful lights reflect in the river, and the flowing lights are particularly tempting. The buildings of different heights along the river are arranged in a staggered manner under the illumination of the lights. And now there are also daytime boat trips available, where you can not only enjoy the night view of Chongqing, but also admire the unique landmarks of Chongqing during the day. Full text 

attractions.name: 渣滓洞
attractions.summary:
· Originally a coal cave on the outskirts of Chongqing, a small coal mine opened in 1920, and later set up as a detention center by the Military Bureau of the National Government. 
Zhazidong is surrounded by mountains on three sides and ditches on one side. The terrain is hidden, and it specializes in detaining and persecuting revolutionaries. The more famous one is "Sister Jiang". 
Zhazi Cave was repaired and rebuilt on the original site, which truly reflected the scene at that time. The atmosphere was depressed, and the instruments of torture displayed were shocking.  
The whole scenic spot is not big, so you can visit the Tomb of the Martyrs and the White Mansion together. There are also special buses arranged in the scenic spot, which is very convenient.

attractions.name: 白公馆
attractions.summary:
· Bai Mansion, formerly known as Xiangshan Villa, was originally the villa of warlord Bai Ju, and later converted into a Kuomintang prison, a two-story building.  
This is the place where the story of Little Carrot Head took place. It once held the Communist Party, and it was also the place where many martyrs died. Its historical significance is much greater than that of scenic spots. 
Divided into two lanes, left and right, you need to climb the ladder, and visit Xiangshan Villa on the left side, which is actually the place where "political prisoners" are held; Climb the mountain on the right side to visit the place where Yang Hucheng died and the place where Little Carrot Head was killed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Prototype Place of the Novel Red Rock

attractions.name: 山城步道
attractions.summary: The so-called trail refers to a city path that can only be walked on. Chongqing is a city built in the mountains, with many adjacent areas having a drop of several tens of meters, and transportation can only rely on urban trails that climb uphill and uphill. In the past, some famous trails were bustling, and many old ruins in Chongqing are located next to these trails. With the large-scale renovation of old cities and improvement of transportation conditions, these trails have gradually lost their function, and some have disappeared or become deserted. Some famous ruins in the surrounding area are slowly being forgotten by people and disappearing into the long river of history The repaired third trail is one of its representatives. This trail is located on the southern slope of the Yuzhong Peninsula, running from north to south, passing through Zhongshan Hospital, Kangjian Hall, Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, the former site of the French Renai Hall, and the suspended boardwalk. It is 1748 meters long and compactly connects a series of traditional neighborhoods and historical and cultural relics. The higher point of the trail is near the Bodhi Diamond Pagoda, and the lower point is at the entrance of Shancheng Lane, with a height difference of 79.5 meters. It is a mountain city trail with distinctive features of Chongqing city.

attractions.name: 磁器口古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town

attractions.name: 三峡博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The museum is built according to the terrain, integrated with People's Square and the People's Hall. It houses a large collection of cultural relics, including porcelains, calligraphy, paintings, and coins from various dynasties.
- It is divided into four floors, featuring a 360-degree panoramic film, four main exhibitions, including "Magnificent Three Gorges," "Ancient Ba and Yu," "Chongqing: Path of the City," and "The War Years," as well as six themed exhibitions.
- The "Magnificent Three Gorges" exhibition hall collects numerous artifacts from the Three Gorges Reservoir area, realistically restoring the original landscape of the Three Gorges.
- The museum offers free guided tours based on the number of visitors. Free admission does not include ticket exemption. There is a free baggage storage service at the main entrance on the first floor.
attractions.shortFeatures: Understanding the history of the Mountain City and the landscape of the Three Gorges.

attractions.name: 长嘉汇弹子石老街
attractions.tag: Stroll through the neighborhood; Nighttime sightseeing; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
Changjiahui Danzishi Old Street is the first national AAAA tourist attraction in China themed around "open port culture and the city’s nine-level hillside terrain." It is located on Nanbin Road, which is known as the "Chongqing Bund." The old street stretches one kilometer from end to end, with an elevation difference of about 80 meters across nine levels of slopes. Visitors walk uphill through streets and alleys with Eastern Sichuan-style courtyards, passing by scattered stilted buildings and businesses.

The scenic area is set against the mountains and water, offering a combination of rich historical heritage, sightseeing, leisure, entertainment, and shopping. Key attractions include the French Naval Barracks (a national heritage site), the Madame Tussauds Chongqing (the first in Southwest China), Changjiahui Ocean Park, Yide Hall, Wang’s Mansion, and others.

This is the only place in Chongqing where visitors can simultaneously "view two rivers," "see three bridges," and "admire three landmarks." At night, the 270-degree panoramic view from the "Two Rivers Viewing Platform" offers a sweeping view of the Yuzhong Peninsula and Jiangbei District, presenting the essence of Chongqing’s nightscape. It truly offers "a complete view of Chongqing at a glance." In addition to its unique landscape features, the area is also a food haven. Along the one-kilometer old street, every few steps you’ll find "Chongqing famous snacks" and "China’s renowned shops," as well as restaurants and bars with prime riverfront views. Today, Danzishi Old Street has become the first choice for locals to relax and entertain, as well as the must-visit destination for showing out-of-town guests the charm of Chongqing.

attractions.name: 海棠溪筒子楼
attractions.summary: The old buildings in Chongqing have a retro atmosphere from the 1990s and are a great place to take photos and check in. Full text 

attractions.name: 南滨路
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Chongqing Nanbin Road is located in Nan'an District, with a total length of about 25 kilometers. It is a sightseeing area for urban viewing and leisure. 
At night, Nanbin Road is a good place to see the charming night view of Yuzhong Peninsula. 
The whole sightseeing area is not only sightseeing, but also a food street, which can meet the needs of delicious food while watching the scenery. 
· It is a good place for citizens to relax, entertain and run, and sometimes the Ramazon competition is held here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Chongqing Bund surrounded by mountains and rivers

attractions.name: 南滨路钟楼
attractions.summary: Chongqing Nanbin Road has become a beautiful business card of Chongqing due to its collection of delicious food from all over the world and magnificent riverside scenery. And the clock tower, this beautiful business card, has added a bold and colorful touch. This place has become a stunning spot for people to relax and enjoy the scenery of the Yuzhong Peninsula and the confluence of the Yangtze River and Jialing River.

attractions.name: 李子坝轻轨站
attractions.summary: The local internet famous light rail station, where light rail trains pass through the walls of the building.

attractions.name: 三层马路
attractions.summary:
Three-story road, as the name implies, has three-story roads overlapping on the hillside, which is the unique terrain of Chongqing. 
The third-story road starts from Liziba Anti-Japanese War Ruins Park and ends at Wenchuang Park of Eling No.2 Factory, a landmark in online celebrity. This road is long and tortuous, quiet and unique. It's very pleasant to walk here and enjoy the scenery all the way in your leisure time. Each floor of the road has different scenery. 
The first floor is historical. It is backed by a mountain city and views the Jialing River from a distance. It has beautiful scenery and broad vision. During the Anti-Japanese War, many rich dignitaries gathered, and many historical sites are still preserved until now. 
The second floor is for gourmet food, and there are famous delicious restaurants on both sides of the inconspicuous road. People come here in an endless stream. 
The third floor is literary and artistic. The second printing factory, which has been more than 70 years old, has transformed from a decaying old factory area into a cultural and creative park, attracting countless young people.

attractions.name: 二厂文创公园
attractions.name_en: Second Factory Cultural and Creative Park
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; Art Districts; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Formerly known as Chongqing No.2 Printing Factory, it can be said that it was once a color printing giant in southwest printing industry. 
The renovated old factory building retains the original style of the old single-family building and adds the artistic style of modern design; The combination of old and new is unique and charming. 
The movie "Passing Through Your World" was shot here.
attractions.shortFeatures: Location of "Passing Through Your World"

attractions.name: 涂鸦一条街
attractions.summary:
· On this short street, from buildings and walls, to the exterior walls of campuses and shops, it is full of graffiti, which is equivalent to a giant 3D graffiti painting. 
Although the graffiti is old, there are few people here and it is quiet, so you can take photos casually. 
Near Tuya Street is Sichuan Academy of Fine Arts. There are two places in the school that you can't miss, one is the art gallery and the other is the tank warehouse. 
There are many delicious food in Tuya Street, such as Tikan Douhua, Erwa Noodles, Huji Hoof Flower Soup and other old shops, which are cheap and delicious.
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale graffiti art group

attractions.name: 印象西湖《最忆是杭州》演出
attractions.summary: Impression of West Lake "is one of the" Impression Series "created by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue. The theater is located between Yuehu Lake, Quyuan Fenghe, and Sudi in the northwest area of West Lake. Using the lake as a stage, the scene is rendered using high-tech sound and light technology, and the plot is performed by numerous actors to recreate the beautiful scenery and folk legends of Jiangnan. On a quiet night, on the charming Xizi Lake, the beautiful scenery of Jiangnan and timeless legends bloom in the night and memories.

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 三潭印月
attractions.tag: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Also known as Xiaoyingzhou, it is the largest island among the three islands in the West Lake and the only island that can be visited. It is known as the first scenic spot in the West Lake. 
The outline is like the word "Tian", the outer ring is Jiangnan garden, and the inside is divided into four small lakes by cross-shaped islands and bridges, which are full of poetry and painting. 
The whole island is densely covered with flowers and trees, mainly green willow, lotus, red maple and hibiscus, which is the representative work of water courtyard art in the south of the Yangtze River. 
The back of the RMB one-dollar banknote adopts the grand scene of three pools reflecting the moon, which shows that it plays an extremely important symbolic role in my country's scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landing on the island and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the West Lake from a new perspective

attractions.name: 花港观鱼
attractions.summary:
Huagang Fish Watching, located in the south of the West Lake, was once the private garden of officials in the Southern Song Dynasty. 
The whole park is divided into five scenic spots: Red Fish Pond, Peony Garden, Flower Harbor, Big Lawn and Dense Forest. 
· The most famous thing in the garden is the swarms of red carp in the red fish pond. There are always adults and children feeding the fish with feed and bread crumbs, which is a great pleasure. 
There are three main entrances to the park. The south gate is on Nanshan Road, the west gate is on Yanggong Causeway, and you can also walk north to Su Causeway.
attractions.shortFeatures: Buy feed to feed big, red carp

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 杭州动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· A mountain zoo integrating wildlife protection, scientific research, popular science, education and sightseeing. 
· The layout of the zoo is clever, with more than 150 kinds of animals on display, including golden monkeys, black langurs, tigers, pandas, peacocks, etc. 
There are elephant pavilion, giant panda pavilion, goldfish pavilion, giraffe pavilion, precious monkey room, songbird pavilion, and wonderful animal performances in the park. 
In addition to animals, there are also many gardens in the garden, which has an excellent environment and is a viewing place suitable for all seasons.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch great animal acrobatics

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 长生鹿苑
attractions.summary: Changsheng Deer Garden "is located on the east side of" Tai Xiang Zhao Ming "in Meihua Valley of Ming Xiaoling, on the north bank of Yanque Lake, and currently has 16 spotted deer. The south side of Luyuan is separated from Mingling Road by only a few meters of lake water, which will recreate the historical landscape of "silver deer wandering in the forest". When Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang built the Xiaoling Mausoleum, he raised a thousand deer in the Xiaoling Mausoleum area. The deer had a silver medal hanging on their neck with the words "Changsheng" on it, so later people called Xiaoling deer "Changsheng Deer" or "Silver Medal Deer". Tourists entering the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum can have an intimate encounter with the little deer at the "Changsheng Deer Garden".

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 华谊兄弟(长沙)电影小镇
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Film and TV studio base; Film Studios; Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The town is located within the Changsha Xiangjiang New District Dawangshan Tourism Resort. The first phase of the project is the Italian town, which consists of Venice, the Water City, and Assisi, the Mountain City. It integrates scenes from Huayi Film and TV, blending the urban characteristics and architectural style of an Italian town. The buildings and roads in the area are mainly arranged in a linear layout, and the planning utilizes the existing natural terrain to reshape the mountainous geography of the site, thereby creating the classic appearance of an Italian town. The area also features Italian-style dining, handicrafts, tourist products, and traditional workshops, offering an interactive experience with a pure Italian style.
attractions.shortFeatures: Comprehensive cultural and tourism scenic area with a film theme

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 胡雪岩故居
attractions.summary:
Hu Xueyan was the richest man in the late Qing Dynasty. His former residence was cleverly combined with Chinese and western architectural styles, and the extremely luxurious Jiangnan garden was the first residence of Chinese giants in the late Qing Dynasty. 
Among the residential communities, Zhiyuan Garden was its main building. At that time, Hangzhou had the reputation of "a flying peak, like a shrinkage of Lion Grove". 
The pavilions, small bridges, flowing water and bright corridors in the garden are ingeniously conceived, and the rockery in the garden is the largest existing artificial cave in China. 
There are also calligraphy stone carvings by famous artists such as Dong Qichang, Zheng Banqiao, Tang Bohu and Wen Zhiming in the former residence, as well as two rare mahogany official sedan chairs worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Luxury Mansion of Hu Xueyan, a giant merchant with red roof in the late Qing Dynasty

attractions.name: 杭州宋城
attractions.tag: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 西九艺术公园
attractions.summary: The West Kowloon Art Park has lawns and a seaside promenade, with large areas for picnicking, playing, and playing with pets. People can also participate in outdoor activities held in the park or visit exhibitions at the M+Pavilion. The newly built exhibition pavilion near the entrance of the seaside promenade is a great place to enjoy the harbor view and sunset scenery.

attractions.name: 太平山顶
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Victoria Peak is one of Hong Kong's landmarks and the highest point in Hong Kong, where you can overlook the panoramic view of Hong Kong. 
· You can take the retro red cable car to the top of the mountain, with a total length of about 1,350 meters and five stops halfway. It is the earliest cable car ropeway system in Asia. 
Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking. 
Besides Lingxiao Pavilion, there are also good scenic spots on the top of the mountain, such as Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and Mountain Post Office, which should not be missed.
attractions.shortFeatures: Overlooking Lantau Island and overlooking Hong Kong

attractions.name: 香港K11 MUSEA
attractions.summary: K11 MUSEA, a brand new cultural retail landmark, brings diverse and exciting inspirations to life with the power of creativity, culture, and innovation. The naming inspiration for K11 MUSEA comes from the goddess Muse in ancient Greek mythology. This experiential landmark stands in the heart of Victoria Dockside in Tsim Sha Tsui, integrating retail, art, culture, entertainment, and dining. From fashionable clothing and accessories, beauty and skincare to creative living, multiple internationally renowned brands converge here, many of which are limited edition or flagship stores that have entered Hong Kong for the first time with new concepts, including limited editions and personalized design masterpieces. Full text 

attractions.name: 香港摩天轮
attractions.tag: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.
attractions.shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour

attractions.name: 维多利亚港
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Landmark viewing; Ports/Bays; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world. 
· After nightfall, the lights shine, and the large-scale lighting show "Symphony of Lights" will be staged at 8 o'clock every night. It is the main venue for fireworks displays in Hong Kong. 
· Victoria Harbour is one of the most precious treasures of Hong Kong. No matter how many times you have been to Hong Kong, you will still be fascinated by her stunning elegance. It is a good choice to take a sightseeing boat or a Chinese sailboat, be in the middle of the harbour, and feel the vitality and dynamics of Hong Kong from a new angle. 
· Harbour City Observation Deck-"Maritime View" is the best place to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of Victoria Harbour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the three night scenes in the world

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.
