attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 归元禅寺
attractions.summary:
· One of the most important monasteries in Wuhan, together with Baotong Temple, Xilian Temple and Zhengjue Temple, is called the four jungles of Wuhan.  
It is the daily custom of many Wuhan citizens to come to Guiyuan Temple to pray for blessings. Every year on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, hundreds of thousands of pilgrims come here to grab the first incense. 
· Enter the Arhat Hall, start with any 　 Arhat, and count to your actual age in sequence. The identity, expression and movements of the counted Arhat indicate your fate.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the famous temple of the golden arhat

attractions.name: 汉正街
attractions.summary:
Hanzheng Street is "the main street of ancient Hankou", the earliest central street in the history of Hankou, and a place where thousands of businessmen gather and commodities compete for flow. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is a commodity wholesale market with a wide range. It is mainly divided into different commodities. The prices of commodities here are still very cheap. However, when shopping here, on the one hand, you have to have a certain ability to identify commodities, because the authenticity and falsehood are uneven; On the other hand, you have to be able to counter-offer. Cheap is not that simple. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is being renovated and relocated, from Qiaokou District of Hankou to Hankou North. However, there are still many commercial ports at the original site, and it should take many years to completely relocate.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hankou commercial district in history

attractions.name: 东湖磨山景区
attractions.summary: The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉植物园
attractions.tag: Treasure spot for walking kids; Enjoy autumn flowers; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- The Wuhan Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was established in 1956. It is one of the three core national botanical gardens, integrating scientific research, species conservation, science popularization, and leisure tourism. It has collected and cultivated more than 10,293 plant species, primarily focusing on plant resources from the Central China region and inland aquatic plants of China. It serves as the most important base for plant species diversity and genetic resource preservation in Central China, with the largest aquatic plant resource garden and kiwi germplasm resource garden in the world.
- The Wuhan Botanical Garden is a national AAAA-level scenic area and has been recognized as a National Science Popularization Education Base, National Youth Science and Technology Education Base, and a base for science popularization, environmental education, and patriotism education in Hubei Province and Wuhan City.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciating Seasonal Flowers in Gardens Around the World

attractions.name: 东湖落雁景区
attractions.summary: The Luoyan Scenic Area is located on the east bank of Donghu Lake in Wuhan and is an important part of the Donghu Scenic Area. The scenic area has undulating hills, vast water bodies, numerous peninsulas, and intersecting harbors, creating a very beautiful natural environment. Every year, the scenic area attracts a large number of migratory birds to winter, and a large number of cormorants inhabit the pond cypress on the island, which is very spectacular and can be called the "bird hunting land" of Wuhan. The scenic area includes eight major landscapes, including Qinghe Ancient Bridge, Magpie Bridge Meeting, Yanzhou Suoqiao, Luzhou Ancient Ferry, Zhao's Garden, Ancient Tree Wonders, Yanqiping Sand, and Luzhou Falling Geese, full of romantic feelings.

attractions.name: 湖北省博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
attractions.summary:
Located on the bank of East Lake, it is an important national museum in China, with a rich collection of cultural relics and the largest exhibition hall of ancient musical instruments in China. 
Yue Wang Goujian's sword, Zeng Houyi's chime, Yunxian human skull fossil, and Yuan blue and white plum bottle are the most worth seeing treasures of the four town halls. 
It is composed of antique buildings such as comprehensive exhibition hall, Chu Cultural Center and Chime Hall, which reflects the architectural layout of ancient Chu architecture. 
The daily exhibitions in the museum have distinctive characteristics of ancient Chu culture and ancient Yangtze River civilization. 
· There are bell performances every day. The cultural relics and display spaces on display in the museum may change due to demand. You can visit according to the signs in the museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the treasures of the town hall and feel the ancient Chu culture

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. Full text 

attractions.name: 江汉路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located in the center of Hankou, Wuhan, it is the longest pedestrian street in China and has the reputation of "the first pedestrian street in the world". 
· It is suitable for shopping, entertainment and leisure, with many shops, snacks and restaurants. At the same time, you can eat Wuhan local snacks such as Regan Noodles, Zhou Hei Ya, beef powder and bean skin when shopping. 
As a former British concession, more than a dozen modern buildings of various styles are lined up, and the whole street is the 20th century architecture museum in the hearts of local people.
attractions.shortFeatures: Century-old commercial street building sweeping top-notch goods

attractions.name: 知音号
attractions.summary: Zhiyin Hao is the world's first drifting theater created by Wuhan Culture and Tourism Group in collaboration with director Fan Yue, using a ship as a carrier. It features the multi-dimensional experiential play of the same name, "Zhiyin Hao". Unlike conventional plays, 'Zhiyin Hao' does not provide a complete main storyline, but rather creates a journey through time and space for you to travel. We will scatter every character you may encounter on your journey in the large ship, living as if they were real in various areas such as dance halls, bars, cabins, and decks on the Zhiyin ship. Between words, you can hear their stories, feel the various aspects of their lives, and have the opportunity to share your story with them. In the time of mutual exploration between you and them, meet, understand, and try to become each other's' kindred spirits'. Boarding the ship, you will embark on a real journey as a sailor on the Yangtze River with every character on the Zhiyin ship. Go aboard, actually you are also the one who brought the story onto the ship Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

attractions.name: 古德寺
attractions.summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.
attractions.shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style

attractions.name: 武汉天地
attractions.summary: Like Xintiandi in Shanghai, Wuhan Tiandi, which is close to Hankou River Beach, is a characteristic block transformed from old buildings. Strolling along the pedestrian walkway, the red brick small western-style buildings, antique wooden windows, antique blue bricks, and wooden or bamboo chairs placed outdoors all exude a strong nostalgic atmosphere. Many young people like to come here to take photos. Wuhan Tiandi gathers delicacies from all over the world. You can not only eat the New Element Restaurant opened by Li Na, a tennis elder sister, but also the South Restaurant of Shanghai Delicate Dim sum Restaurant, the Creative Sichuan Restaurant with pepper, and the Bali lobster and Yitang lobster that you must eat in summer in Jiangcheng. In addition to dining venues, a fashionable shopping center called Yifang Shopping Center has been built here, featuring over 300 global fashion brands and integrating international cuisine, IMAX theaters, LIFESTYLE bookstores, children's experiential play, and family consumption, conveying the spirit of fashion at the forefront.

attractions.name: 蓬莱阁
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Penglai Pavilion, along with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is known as one of China's Four Great Towers.  
· Known as the "Fairyland on Earth," the well-known myth of "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea" originates here.  
· Penglai Pavilion is located by the sea, often shrouded in mist, making it feel like being in a fairyland. On a good day, one can even witness a "mirage."  
· In addition to Penglai Pavilion, the scenic area also includes Tianheng Mountain, Dengzhou Museum, Ancient Ship Museum, and the dividing line between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.  
· From the mountain top, one can enjoy a distant view of the junction between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, where the boundary line between the yellow and blue waters is very distinct, and one can also see Changdao Island in the distance.
attractions.shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Legend of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea

attractions.name: 八仙过海景区
attractions.name_en: The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Seashores; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- A national AAAA-level tourist attraction, the place where the Eight Immortals crossed the sea in Chinese mythology, with a shape resembling a treasure gourd lying across the sea.
- Composed of nearly 40 scenic spots, including the Eight Immortals Square, Eight Immortals Bridge, Wangying Tower, Eight Immortals Temple, Huixian Pavilion, and Baixian Terrace, among others.
- A maritime garden and pavilion themed around the Eight Immortals, with jade artifacts and stone carvings visible everywhere, making it a huge treasure trove.
- An ideal place for worshipping the immortals and sightseeing, hence Penglai enjoys the reputation of "a fairyland on earth and a leisure paradise."
attractions.shortFeatures: Revisiting ancient myths and legends

attractions.name: 文成城堡
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Castles
attractions.summary:
Wencheng Castle, located next to Yanpeng Tourist Avenue, was built by Mr. Li Wencheng, an overseas Chinese from Canada, and Penglai Wencheng Architectural Decoration Co., Ltd. with an investment of 600 million RMB. The castle is a skillful combination of European architectural elements, mainly in Baroque style, and the building materials mainly based on precious cave stones carry the essence of European architecture and decorative arts, embodying a unique aristocratic atmosphere. Surrounded by a moat, it is filled with seawater, which can raise sea cucumbers and abalones, and can also be used for people to play in the water and row boats, which is full of fun. Coupled with the design of concave front and convex back, the castle presents unique variability whether it is forward-looking or rear-looking, whether it is flat or three-dimensional. Although it is only 4 storeys high, its incomparable diversity of other buildings brings unlimited imagination. The shape is elegant and generous, the round roof points directly to the blue sky, the trapezoidal and tapered roofs on both sides are interspersed with each other, superimposed and staggered, and the fireplace chimney is dotted among them, which fully shows the unique romantic feelings and heroic spirit of European technology. 
In July, 17, Mahua FunAge's team traveled all over the country to find a venue to shoot the fourth comedy film "The Richest Man in Xihong City", and finally "stepped through the iron shoes and found nowhere, but it took no effort to get it". By chance, they met Wencheng Castle, which has great European classical architectural artistic characteristics, and finally were amazed by such a unique European-style castle group in China, taking it as the most ideal interior shooting location.
attractions.shortFeatures: The shooting location of "The Richest Man in Xihong City"

attractions.name: 欧乐堡梦幻世界
attractions.tag: The best places to take kids; playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary: Shandong Penglai OLE Dreamworld is located on the Golden Coast of Penglai, in close proximity to the national 5A scenic spots, the Baxian Crossing the Sea Scenic Area and the Sanxian Mountain Scenic Area. The park features classic European architectural styles, allowing visitors to experience foreign charm without leaving the country. It integrates the most advanced European and American technological elements, creating the most cutting-edge facilities, the most comprehensive attractions, and the highest technological content in any large amusement park in China, surpassing the limits of imagination.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the Exotic Theme Park

attractions.name: 蓬莱欧乐堡水上世界
attractions.summary: Penglai Oulebao Water World is equipped with six themed areas, multiple sets of large-scale water entertainment facilities, and more than 30 slides, integrating exotic charm to create a large-scale water amusement kingdom that combines excitement, adventure, parent-child, and fantasy. The main equipment includes: water roller coaster, high-speed halo, mysterious cave, parent-child water play area, joyful water area, dreamy vortex, magic loop, Green Lantern, flying carpet expert, spiral sprint, time travel, adventure drifting, hurricane bay, and unlimited check-in all day long. The "magic loop" that turns rivers and seas, allowing you to cheer freely in speed and passion; Experience the "dream vortex" of high-speed centrifugal rotation, an extraordinary and exciting journey that you can't stop loving; The 28 meter high "time and space shuttle" slide, which makes your heart beat faster, slides freely at a speed of 21 meters per second, allowing screams and splashes to accompany you and enjoy a wind like feeling; The "Hurricane Bay" with surging waves, the 10000 meter white sand wave making pool not only allows you to experience the surging waves, but also feel the warmth and romance of Ma Dai; A 550 meter long "adventure drift", traversing through the jungle and waterfalls, experiencing a thrilling and exciting wonderful journey; Parent child water play area and joyful water area, where both adults and children can freely play and enjoy the fun of water and water play in this lively world; More beautiful and romantic bubble shows bring you white romantic colors; DJ electronic music was full of excitement and turned the whole venue upside down; Splashing water battles allow you to unleash yourself and fully experience the joy of being wet. This is a summer paradise and a joyful ocean! Cool summer! Everything is in the water world of Orenburg! Full text 

attractions.name: 长岛黄渤海分界线
attractions.shortFeatures: Made from the piling of pebbles

attractions.name: 九丈崖
attractions.summary:
Because of sea erosion, the cliffs by the sea stand upright, and some places are greater than 90 degrees, which is unique in the domestic seaside landscape. 
The cliffs and reefs here are in various shapes. They are places for catching the sea and fishing, and they are also rare materials for artistic creation such as photography. 
A crown-shaped observation platform was also built on the cliff head of Jiuzhang Cliff. It's also a great place to watch the sunset and sunrise.
attractions.shortFeatures: Towering and steep seaside cliffs

attractions.name: 望夫礁景区
attractions.summary: Wangfu Reef Park is one of the tourist attractions on Long Island. The main attractions include the "Fu" character on the slope of Wangfu Reef, which is 21.9 meters high and 16.3 meters wide, as well as the Guanyin Pavilion, Olympic Monument, Geological Museum, etc. This large "Fu" character immediately highlights the atmosphere of the "source of Fu".

attractions.name: 万鸟岛
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Che Island, also known as Gaoshan Island, is located in the east of the middle of Long Island Islands. In the vast ocean, it is simply an insignificant grain of sand. However, the deep sea is attractive, and the island is small and interesting. There are tens of thousands of seagulls inhabiting the island, which is called "Ten Thousand Birds Island". 
The best time for birding is around May every year, when seagulls and various other birds hatch and brood. Watching seabirds is not only near this island, but also in several surrounding islands. The general sea tour route will also pass through several small islands, and some will leave some time for tourists to go to the island. Therefore, when taking part in the sea tour, don't forget to bring some hard bread to feed the seagulls.
attractions.shortFeatures: Seagull habitat and seabird breeding ground in northern China; Parent-child fun

attractions.name: 月牙湾公园
attractions.summary: Crescent Bay, also known as Half Moon Bay, is located at the northern end of Beichangshan Island. Crescent Bay is a beach with mountains and water on its back. As the name suggests, its shape resembles a crescent moon in the night sky, embedded between green mountains and clear waters. However, what is particularly unique is the ball stones scattered on the beach, as white as jade, colorful and extremely beautiful. The main buildings in the park are a 20 meter high "Crescent Pavilion" that combines Chinese and Western styles, a "Guanlan Pavilion" standing on a cliff, and a long corridor about a kilometer long. In front of the long corridor, there is a 100 meter "stone carpet" decorated with stone balls, giving a feeling of "stepping on pearls" when walking on it. What is particularly charming is the ballstone of Crescent Bay, which can be said to be a world of glittering and precious ballstones. It is as white as jade and crystal clear as amber, and no matter where you pick it up, you will not be able to let go of a single one.

restaurants.name_en: Baiweifang Qingdao Pork Ribs with Rice

attractions.name: 漓江竹筏游
attractions.name_en: Bamboo Rafting on the Li River in Xingping
attractions.summary: Xingping Jiuma Painting Mountain Lijiang River Bamboo Raft Youxingping Section is located in Yangshuo, which has always been considered as the essence of Guilin landscape. There has long been a saying in the local area that 'Yangshuo's scenery is as beautiful as Guilin, and Yangshuo's beauty lies in Xingping'. There are over 20 scenic spots here, including Jiuma Huashan, Huangbu Reflection, Monk and Nun Meeting, Chaoban Mountain, and a 20 yuan background picture. Throughout history, the beautiful mountains, rivers, and streams of Xingping have captivated countless ink artists. Along the Xingping Li River, you can also enjoy picturesque scenery such as Xingping Jiajing, Huangbu Reflection, Carp Jumping over Dragon Gate, Chaoban Mountain, Luosi Mountain, and Beautiful Women's Mirrors. Yangdi Xingping Lijiang Bamboo Raft Tour Yangdi section is a must visit project when visiting Yangshuo, Guilin. The beautiful Yangdi is an important part of Guilin tourism and Guilin scenery. The hundred mile Li River, with "one mountain, one water, and one poem title", is like a long scroll of colorful ink landscape with poetry and painting. The Yangdi Tourist Area is about 18 kilometers long and is the golden section of the Li River. Departing from Yangdi Pier on a bamboo raft, heading down the river, the scenery along the way is beautiful, including the picturesque Nine Horse Painting Mountain and the reflection of yellow cloth. This section of the river is winding and twisting, with clear waters lingering and numerous scenic spots. The peaks reflect the scenery, and the bamboo and wood are lush.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00)

attractions.name: 兴坪古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Rafting
attractions.summary:
· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.
attractions.shortFeatures: 20 yuan RMB back picture location

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.tag: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
attractions.summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).
attractions.shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.

attractions.name: 富里桥
attractions.summary:
Fuli Bridge, located in the upper reaches of Yulong River, has a history of more than 500 years. It is one of the three ancient bridges in Yangshuo. 
Fuli Bridge is beautiful in shape, with an ancient tree at each bridge head, and the reflection in the water is just like the full moon. The bridge is the best place to watch the scenery of Lijiang River. 
It is also the only place for rafting on the Yulong River. It is surrounded by green hills and green waters around the village, with a southern scenery.
attractions.shortFeatures: A good place to see the idyllic scenery

attractions.name: 遇龙河漂流
attractions.summary: Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

attractions.name: 世外桃源
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.
attractions.shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.summary: Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling

hotel.Hotel Name: Xi'an Lintong Yuechun Hot Spring Hotel

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《长恨歌》演出
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
China's first large-scale live-action historical dance drama, with eleven scenes in four levels, such as "loving each other" and "being spoiled and charming". 
· A strong cast of 300 professional actors artistically reproduces this touching love story in the original place of the story. 
Since the official performance in 2007, more than 2,500 performances have been performed and 3.5 million audiences have been received, reaching the grand occasion of "one ticket is hard to find".
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei and Tang Minghuang's eternal love

attractions.name: 华清御汤·宝积池温泉
attractions.summary: The Huaqing Yutang Baojichi Outdoor Hot Spring Area is located on the south side of the Xi'an Huaqing Yutang Hotel in Lintong District, Xi'an City. It is adjacent to the Lishan National Forest Park to the south and the Huaqing Palace, a national 5A level tourist attraction to the north. Relying on the 6000 year old Imperial Hot Spring and Lishan Natural Oxygen Bar, it inherits the essence of Tang Dynasty bathing culture, backed by the natural oxygen bar, with lush forests and fresh air. There are bathing pool outdoor hot springs of different sizes and styles in Baoji Pool. The selection of bathing pool materials is exquisite and elegant. There are also elegant and refined modern celebrities who like beige. The Tang Palace's ancient style lounge features elegant seating, offering Tang Dynasty style health tea drinks and fruit snacks. Savor the unique Tang culture bathing and health preservation concept in the leisurely stillness of time.

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 秦始皇兵马俑一号陪葬坑
attractions.name_en: Terracotta Army Pit 1 of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
attractions.shortFeatures: Large-scale No. 1 pit figurine

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑三号坑遗址
attractions.summary: It is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's mausoleum. In May, 1976, the No.3 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered 25 meters north of the western end of the No.1 instigator pit. The scale of No.3 instigator pit is small, and its plane is "concave". There is a slope doorway in the east, and 72 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the pit. Some scholars believe that it is the headquarters of the No.1 and No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pits, which was called "military curtain" in ancient times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The headquarters of Pit No. 2

attractions.name: 秦兵马俑二号坑遗址大厅
attractions.name_en: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
attractions.summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines

attractions.name: 百戏俑坑
attractions.summary: The Baixi Qikeng is named after the various postures of the pottery figurines.

attractions.name: 大唐不夜城
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements

attractions.name: 大雁塔
attractions.tag: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

attractions.name: 西安城墙
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
attractions.shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 西安鼓楼
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
attractions.shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 高家大院
attractions.summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street

attractions.name: 粉巷
attractions.summary: Fenxiang is located in Beilin District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Nanyuanmen in the west, Nandajie in the east, and Defu Lane, a bar street in Xi'an, to the south. Fenxiang is only 329 meters long, but it has become lively because it connects several famous streets in Xi'an. There are different opinions about the origin of Fen Lane. One theory suggests that it was originally a street selling for free, another suggests that it was once a place selling rouge, water powder, and other speculations suggest that this street was the one where the emperor selected his concubines. On both sides of Fen Lane, there are numerous shops with unique styles and various tempting snacks, attracting many girls to come here for shopping. Therefore, many people say that there are many beautiful girls in Fen Lane. Strolling around here, you can always see beautiful girls walking through it. In addition, the Xi'an Antique Bookstore is also located on this street, and these words on the plaque were inscribed by Mr. Lu Xun at that time. Here, you can find many newly printed ancient books, Chinese and foreign history, philosophy, classical literature, cultural relics and archaeology, calligraphy, picture books and other various books.

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 蝴蝶园
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Butterfly Garden covers an area of 8 hectares. There are over 100 types of butterflies kept here, with the Brook King butterfly being the most abundant.

attractions.name: 西双版纳原始森林公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
attractions.summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.

attractions.name: 基诺山寨
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
Jinuo Shanzhai is a place where Jinuo people live in concentrated communities, and it is the only live performing arts experience place in China that shows Jinuo culture in the most comprehensive and concentrated way. 
The performances in the scenic spot are concentrated in the Sun Square in the center of the stockade. Young men and women dressed in Jinuo costumes are singing and dancing with props in hand, which is magnificent. 
You can eat the unique local barbecue, enjoy the performances with rich ethnic customs and experience the rich Jinuo folk customs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery and feel the Jinuo customs

attractions.name: 西双版纳勐泐文化旅游区
attractions.summary:
- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

attractions.name: 曼丢村寨
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary: Mandiu Village belongs to Manzhangzai Village Committee, Gasa Town, Jinghong City, Yunnan Province. It is a beautiful small village that is free and open, with simple folk customs and open doors at night. The whole stockade is very clean and tidy. The stockade is on the slope and there is a pond in front, which is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 曼听御花园
attractions.summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演

attractions.name: 西双版纳总佛寺
attractions.summary:
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple is the center for Buddhist believers in Xishuangbanna to worship Buddha, and it is also the highest-ranking Buddhist temple in Xishuangbanna. 
The general Buddhist temple is magnificent, with exquisite beams and columns carved, mainly including Weihan Hall, Buddhist College teaching building and other buildings. 
There is an altar in front of the north wall of today's courtyard building, where there are several Buddha statues, and the Buddha's Sutra is painted on the wall. 
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple and Manting Park are connected, and tourists usually enter the General Buddhist Temple from Manting Park.
attractions.shortFeatures: Beams and columns are beautifully carved, and the architecture is magnificent
