attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 上海之巅观光厅
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Tower's Observation Deck at the Top of Shanghai is a functional experience area of the Shanghai Tower. From the 360-degree observation deck at the top, you can have a close-up view of the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and the World Financial Center below your feet, while enjoying a distant view of the Expo Park, City God Temple, the Shanghai Stadium, and Hongqiao Airport. The winding Suzhou Creek and Huangpu River merge into the Yangtze River and flow into the East China Sea.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ascend to the Top of the Sea and Enjoy the Panoramic City View.

attractions.name: 陆家嘴空中步行连廊
attractions.summary: The Pudong Lujiazui Sky Pedestrian Corridor is approximately 543 meters long, starting from the second floor of Guojin Center in the west, crossing Yincheng Middle Road, crossing Dongtai Road along the north side of Jinmao Tower to the east, following the Global Financial Center to reach the Lujiazui Ring Road, and connecting with the Lujiazui Circular Sky Corridor. From the corridor, one can overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Lujiazui Financial City. Citizens can take a leisurely stroll in the air through the aerial corridor, conveniently shuttling between various shopping malls and subway stations.

attractions.name: 浦东美术馆
attractions.tag: Special exhibition hall; night tour and sightseeing; Art Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Pudong Art Museum (MAP) is invested, constructed and operated by Lujiazui Group and designed by the famous French architect and Pritzker Prize winner Jean Nouvel. Construction started on September 26, 2017 and will be officially opened to the public in July 2021. Open. Pudong Art Museum is located in the core area of Xiaolujiazui Riverside. It is a modern building with 6 floors and 30 meters high. It extends westward to the bank of the Huangpu River and eastward to connect to the Oriental Pearl Tower via the Garden Square, forming a 30,000-square-meter art museum territory.
The main building of Pudong Art Museum covers an area of 13,000 square meters, with a total building space area of nearly 40,000 square meters. It has 13 exhibition halls and an exhibition area of more than 10,000 square meters. The facade and floor of the building are made of Shandong Baima granite, and the interior space and decoration are inspired by Malevich's classic geometric drawings.
As a state-owned public art museum, Pudong Art Museum is an important measure to build the "Shanghai Culture" brand. It shoulders the cultural mission and social responsibilities entrusted by the urban and municipal governments. It focuses on international art exhibitions and exchanges, takes into account domestic art exhibitions, and highlights the four major functions of exhibitions, aesthetic education, cultural creativity, and international exchanges. It is committed to becoming a new landmark of Shanghai's international cultural venues and an important platform for international cultural and artistic exchanges.
attractions.shortFeatures: Lujiazui Binjiang New Internet Celebrity Landmark

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 上海博物馆
attractions.summary:
- The Shanghai Museum is a large museum of ancient Chinese art, with 12 thematic galleries and a collection of over 120,000 exquisite artifacts.
- The museum features historical relics from various dynasties, with a particular focus on ancient bronze, ceramics, calligraphy, and paintings.
- Notable treasures include the Western Zhou "Da Ke Ding" (Great Ke Ding), the Spring and Autumn period "Zi Zhong Jiang Pan" (Zizhong Jiang Dish), the Tang Dynasty "Gao Yi Tu" (Painting of Gao Yi), and Wang Xianzhi's "Ya Tou Wan Tie" (Duck Head Pill Script) from the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
- Additionally, the museum regularly hosts special exhibitions, featuring a variety of domestic and international artifacts, artworks, calligraphy, and paintings.
attractions.shortFeatures: A world-renowned famous museum

attractions.name: 人民广场
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
People's Square is the largest public square in Shanghai. It was transformed from the "largest horse racing hall in the Far East" in the concession era, and it is also a landmark of Shanghai. 
People's Square in a broad sense is mainly composed of open squares, People's Park, Shanghai Grand Theatre, Shanghai Museum and other buildings. 
Hong Kong Famous Street, Di Mei Shopping Center and Old Shanghai 1930 Style Street are built underground in the square, showing the old appearance of Shanghai in 1930s. 
There is a fountain in the center of the square, which sprays water about every half hour at night. It is beautiful under various lights and is a good place to enjoy the cool air.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Landmark and Transportation Hub

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 上海城隍庙道观
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai. Most of the tourists coming to the Chenghuang Temple tourist area are admiring the snacks and Yu Garden here. However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Full text 

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 黄浦江游览（金陵东路码头）
attractions.name_en: The Huangpu River Cruise (Jinling East Road Pier)
attractions.summary: The express tour condenses the essence of both banks of the Pujiang River. The route is Jinling East Road Wharf - Shiliupu Old Wharf - Nanpu Bridge - Jiangnan Shipyard Site - Chinese Art Palace - Lupu Bridge - Bund World Architecture Expo Group - Jinling East Road Wharf. The entire tour lasts about 60 minutes.

attractions.name: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址
attractions.name_en: The site of the first CPC National Congress
attractions.summary: Shanghai is the birthplace of the CPC, the birthplace of its original aspiration, and the birthplace of its great founding spirit. The site of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China is the place where the CPC dreams to set sail and the spiritual home of CPC people. On July 23, 1921, the first National Congress of the CPC was held at No. 106 Wangzhi Road (now No. 76 Xingye Road) in Shanghai, announcing the official establishment of the CPC. In September 1952, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was restored, a memorial hall was established, and it was opened to the public. In March 1961, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was designated as a national key cultural relic protection unit. The Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China is directly under the Propaganda Department of the Shanghai Municipal Committee. On June 3, 2021, the brand new Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was officially completed. The upgraded Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China has formed the characteristic pattern of "one hall and three sites". With the newly completed exhibition hall as the main core, it manages the site of the first National Congress of the CPC, the former site of the dormitory of the first National Congress of the CPC (Bowen Women's School), and the former site of the CPC delegation office in Shanghai (Zhou Mansion) as three key cultural relics under national protection. It is a red hall that tells the story of the founding of the party, demonstrates the founding of the party, and interprets the great spirit of the founding of the party. There are over 128000 collections of various levels from the Opium War to the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The new basic display, The Great Beginning - The Exhibition of the Creation History of the CPC, tells the history of the founding of the Party in a panoramic way, leading the audience to deeply understand the rich connotation of the great spirit of party building.

attractions.name: 复兴公园
attractions.summary: Fuxing Park is one of the earliest parks established in Shanghai. More than 80 years ago, this was originally a fertile farmland inhabited by hardworking and poor farmers. Fuxing Park is a French style park with a regular garden layout and a natural style that gradually changes towards the southwest. In recent years, a large number of flowers and trees have been added, with a total of 140 species and over 10000 shrubs, including towering plane trees, as well as precious trees such as seven chestnut trees, oak trees, and maple trees. The Fuxing Park is also very lively at night. The French atmosphere matches the colorful night life. The sound of high-heeled shoes will suddenly come from a peaceful corner, or under the French wutong tree late at night, there are young people waiting for a taxi at the roadside. I always sleep very late here at night in Shanghai.

attractions.name: 田子坊石库门
attractions.summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

attractions.name: 思南公馆
attractions.tag: Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
The name of Sinan Mansion comes from Sinan Road. Sinan Road dates back to the road name of the French Concession in Shanghai-Route Massenet, and the English name of Sinan Mansion Hotel comes from this. 
This area began to be developed in the 1920s as the core area of the French Concession at that time. This year, the first batch of garden houses rose along Lafide Road (now Fuxing Middle Road) south of French Park (now Fuxing Park). 
In the following ten years, garden houses in the area south of Lafeide Road, east of Mas South Road (now Sinan Road) and west of Luban Road (now Chongqing South Road) were built one after another, attracting a large number of military and political dignitaries, entrepreneurs, professionals and famous artists at that time to move in. Zhou Enlai, Liu Yazi, Mei Lanfang and other celebrities once lived here, making this area a residence and gathering place of the upper class at that time. 
Today, Sinan Mansion combines 49 renovated historic buildings and 9 new buildings into four complementary functional areas: hotel, commercial, residential and office. Sinan Mansion has become one of the preservation and protection projects of Shanghai's historical and cultural features and excellent historical buildings. It has 51 garden houses with a long history, and at the same time, it gathers various architectural styles such as independent garden houses, corridor buildings and garden lanes. It combines humanities, fashion and historical heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the patches of garden houses

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 静安寺
attractions.summary:
Jing'an Temple is a famous ancient temple in Shanghai. The architectural style of the temple is combined with Tibetan temples. The silver Buddha enshrined in the Daxiong Hall weighs 15 tons. 
The main buildings of the temple are Mountain Gate, Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, etc. Looking at the whole temple from a distance, a golden roof is particularly conspicuous. 
Jing'an Temple is full of incense. Every birthday and anniversary of Bodhisattva, the temple will hold a Dharma fair. Every year, on the eighth day of April in the lunar calendar, a three-day temple fair will be held.
attractions.shortFeatures: Rare Tibetan-style temples in the east

attractions.name: 静安雕塑公园
attractions.summary: Jing'an Sculpture Park is the only specialized sculpture park in the center of Shanghai, which serves as an urban public product with ecological, artistic, and cultural functions. Originally just a small green area, this place has now become a park. Although the space is not large and there are not many sculptures, the environment is pleasant, and the selected sculptures are often replaced. This is also a small place where nearby residents often come to exercise.

attractions.name: 中科院西双版纳热带植物园
attractions.name_en: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
attractions.summary: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in the tropical forest sea of Menglun Town, Mengla County, Xishuangbanna, known locally as Menglun Botanical Garden. The park is divided into two parts: the eastern and western areas. The main attraction for sightseeing is the western area, which consists of multiple small botanical gardens; The eastern region is a narrow tropical rainforest suitable for hiking. The distance between the east and west areas is relatively far, and the scenic area is connected by electric scooters. There are more than 20 specialized botanical gardens in the western area, and the popular one among tourists is the "Strange Flower Garden". It is planted with colorful flowers, clock flowers that bloom on time, dancing grass that vibrates with music, bachelor trees with only trunks and no leaves, and arrow poison wood that seals the throat at the sight of blood, and other various exotic flowers and grasses, which are eye opening. The eastern region is a vast area of pristine tropical rainforest, where you can see wild orchids, strangled trees, and other wonders. Most areas in the forest are equipped with observation trails, please pay attention to protecting plants. Full text 

attractions.name: 西双版纳傣族园
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary:
- Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park is composed of five well-preserved Dai natural villages, namely Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga.
- Upon entering the park, the first thing you encounter is the Welcome Square, where you are greeted by warm-hearted Dai people performing welcome dances, singing blessings, and sprinkling water for good wishes.
- The park also houses the Manchunman Ancient Buddhist Temple, one of the oldest temples in Xishuangbanna, with a history of over 1,400 years. Every day, you can hear the sound of chanting inside the temple.
- The grandest festival for the Dai people in Xishuangbanna is the Water-Splashing Festival. At the Water-Splashing Square in the Dai Ethnic Park, you can experience the lively scenes of the festival every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: Accept the warm welcome dance of the Dai people.

attractions.name: 基诺山雨林徒步
attractions.summary: Entering the depths of Baopiao Village in the rain forest of Jinuo Mountain, one can see the phenomenon of huge tree roots, tall trees that cover the sky, traditional Chinese herbs in tropical rainforests, dripping leaf tips, flower growth in old trees, parasitic epiphytes and other wonders along the way. Along the 2-kilometer upstream challenge section, plant identification is carried out, water is taken from the rainforest, and several kilometers of mountain climbing sections are completed.

attractions.name: 星光夜市
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts

attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.
attractions.shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.

attractions.name: 云南西双版纳景洪市告庄夜市
attractions.name_en: Gaozhuang Night Market, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan
attractions.summary: Gaozhuang Night Market in Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan Province is a charming and charming night market in Xishuangbanna. The colorful umbrellas in the Starlight Night Market are very distinctive, including the imported Thai Golden Pagoda, which is a very exquisite Buddhist pagoda and a major highlight. In addition, there are handicrafts from Southeast Asian countries, Dai pottery, specialty snacks, etc. in the Shuangjing area of Gaozhuang West, which can be purchased as souvenirs. Due to its unique climate, stalls can be set up all year round in Xishuangbanna. The Gaozhuang Night Market in Xishuangbanna is not only a gathering place for artistic youth, but also a good place for tourists to buy souvenirs.

attractions.name: 曼丢村寨
attractions.tag: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary: Mandiu Village belongs to Manzhangzai Village Committee, Gasa Town, Jinghong City, Yunnan Province. It is a beautiful small village that is free and open, with simple folk customs and open doors at night. The whole stockade is very clean and tidy. The stockade is on the slope and there is a pond in front, which is very beautiful.

attractions.name: 野象谷
attractions.summary: Yexiang Valley is located 36 kilometers north of Jinghong City in Xishuangbanna, on the west side of National Highway 213. This is a place frequented by Asian wild elephants, hence the name Wild Elephant Valley. Arriving at Wild Elephant Valley, one can watch elephant performances and the other can enjoy the tropical rainforest. Within the scenic area, there is a pedestrian walkway that stretches for over 4000 meters, winding through the tropical rainforest. You can stroll along it and experience the scent of the rainforest. Along the trail, you can not only see rare tropical plants, but also traces of footprints and feces left by wild elephants. If you're lucky, you might even be able to see herds of wild elephants strolling through the woods. There are fixed elephant performances near the south gate of the scenic area every day. The adorable elephants interact with the staff, dancing, crossing a single plank bridge, and even kicking a ball with their trunks, which is very exciting. Here, getting up close with well-trained elephants is both safe and fun, and a great experience. There are also bird gardens and butterfly gardens near the south gate that can be visited together. There is also a 920 meter long elevated corridor from Bainiaoyuan to the North Gate Asian Elephant Museum, where you can see elephant skeleton specimens, learn about elephant knowledge, and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. Additionally. There are restaurants within the scenic area for dining, and there are also some farmhouses at the entrance of the scenic area that can solve the problem of eating, which is very convenient. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 曼掌村
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Villages
attractions.summary: Manzhang Villagers Group belongs to Manjingkan Village Committee of Mengyang Town, and belongs to dam area village. It is a characteristic village with a history of more than 500 years, with Dai people as the main ethnic group, and its traditional ethnic culture is intact.
attractions.shortFeatures: Villages with Dai as the main ethnic group

restaurants.name_en: DoubleTree by Hilton Wanda Resort & Spa Full-day Dining
Sheraton Xishuangbanna Yuntou Hotel Hongluoletai Restaurant
InterContinental Xishuangbanna Resort Hotel Seafood Buffet
InterContinental Xishuangbanna Resort Tai Dai Restaurant

attractions.name: 八达岭长城
attractions.tag: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.
attractions.shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.

attractions.name: 颐和园
attractions.tag: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.

attractions.name: 鸟巢(国家体育场)
attractions.summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

attractions.name: 水立方(国家游泳中心)
attractions.tag: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:30-20:30(Tickets available until 19:50; admission ends at 20:00)

attractions.name: 清华大学
attractions.summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 北京大学
attractions.summary: Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.
attractions.opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

attractions.name: 恭王府
attractions.tag: Famous Person's Former Residence; Historical Buildings
attractions.summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 天坛公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

attractions.name: 什刹海
attractions.summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.

attractions.name: 云南野生动物园
attractions.summary: Yunnan Wildlife Park Co., Ltd. is the only tourism attraction in Yunnan Province focused on the breeding, domestication, viewing, and exhibition of wild animals. It integrates sightseeing, science education, and ex situ conservation. Located 7 kilometers from downtown Kunming, it is situated within the Jindian National Forest Park, adjacent to Jindian Reservoir, and facing the Expo Garden across the water. Covering a total area of approximately 2,800 acres, the park highlights the theme of showcasing Yunnan's "Animal Kingdom." The park features lush greenery, beautiful scenery, and themed attractions such as the Rare Animal Area, African Herbivorous Animal Area, Giant Panda Pavilion, and Lion and Tiger Manor. It is home to over 200 species and more than 10,000 animals. Among them are national treasures such as the giant panda and golden snub-nosed monkey, as well as exotic species like giraffes, rhinos, orangutans, and emus. Most of these animals live in natural free-range conditions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Close-up view of rare animals

attractions.name: 昆明老街
attractions.summary: Kunming Old Street is the most authentic old neighborhood in the center of Kunming. There are six streets and ten lanes in the block, and a large number of characteristic residential buildings and old businesses in the Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China are preserved, which has a unique historical charm. Ancient streets, buildings and gatehouses all have a sense of history and age. There are dozens of historical buildings and cultural buildings all over the blocks, which is the best place to feel the history and culture of Kunming.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat small pot rice noodles to shop for Yunnan antiques

attractions.name: 官渡古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Town and Village; Nighttime Scenic Tour; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Guandu Town is one of Kunming's famous historical and cultural ancient towns. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a bustling market town with developed commerce and handicrafts. In the Tang Dynasty, it was part of the Nanzhao Kingdom, a popular stop for the nobility of the Dali Kingdom when they visited Dianchi Lake.

· The ancient town is rich in cultural landscapes, with five hills, six temples, seven pavilions, and eight shrines, as well as various lively shops. The Miao Zhan Temple, known as the "first of the six temples," is particularly notable, with its Vajra Throne Pagoda standing prominently at the entrance.

· A specialty dish is Guandu Baba, known locally as Mai Baba. The most famous version is the "Eyeglass Baba" on Vajra Tower Commercial Street, with two popular fillings: sesame and peanut.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire ancient temples and cultural landscapes.

attractions.name: 云南民族村
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
attractions.summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan

attractions.name: 滇池
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau

attractions.name: 西山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
attractions.summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 新民园广场
attractions.summary: The newly built Tianjin Minyuan Square has a surface area of 22500 square meters and an underground area of 47500 square meters, continuing to retain the sports and fitness functions of the original Minyuan Sports Stadium. The square has added new functions such as tourism and leisure, cultural and museum exhibitions, and specialty catering, and has become the core scenic area and distribution center of the Five Avenues Cultural Tourism Zone together with the surrounding Qingwang Mansion, Xiannong Business and Tourism Area, and Minyuan Xili Cultural and Creative Block.

attractions.name: 庆王府
attractions.summary: The Prince Qing's Mansion is a historical building located in both Beijing and Tianjin. The Qingwang Mansion Boutique Cultural Hotel Area consists of an "Urban Cultural Heritage Club" and a "Villa style Historical and Cultural Theme Hotel", and is a comprehensive cultural tourism, business conference, and leisure vacation community. Qingwangfu Mansion is a villa style historical and cultural themed hotel in Tianjin. Its predecessor was the "Shanyili" English style alleyway residential complex built in 1937. It has 16 sets of townhouse style hotel suites and 17 sets of hotel style apartments. After two years of careful renovation, it fully preserves the architectural style of sloping red tiles and sulfur tank brick walls, as well as the dense and orderly block texture. Each villa room comes with its own courtyard, providing guests with a private and peaceful living experience away from the world. The main building of Qingwang Mansion features elegant and distinctive Chinese and Western style private rooms, offering a feast of Chinese, Western, and Asian cuisine. The atrium of the main building is a sky covered shared hall, where guests can relax and enjoy a cup of afternoon tea. Standing on the rooftop terrace of the third floor, you can have a bird's-eye view of the rows of modern Western style buildings on the Five Avenues, experiencing the tranquility and elegance that once belonged to the early 20th century. Experience the unique historical charm and cultural atmosphere of the Qingwang Mansion in Tianjin, and enjoy a special cocktail in the evening, allowing guests to enjoy a romantic and comfortable slow paced life after busy work. At the caf é located in the courtyard, you can enjoy a leisurely afternoon tea, coffee, pastries, and French light meals while admiring the beautiful scenery of the small bridge, flowing water, and lush greenery. The red bar and cigar shop specially set up in the annex have a leisurely feeling of being away from the hustle and bustle. Full text 

attractions.name: 疙瘩楼
attractions.summary:
· Built in 1937 and designed by Italian designer Paolo Bonetti, it is a western apartment townhouse building with a strong Italian style. 
It used to be the apartment of the British Huanong Company at the earliest, and later the former residence of Ma Lianliang, a Peking Opera performing artist, in Tianjin. 
The main building, commonly known as the "Bumble Building", is called the "Huayun Museum". It used to be an "edible museum", but now it no longer operates catering. 
More than 3,000 pieces of cultural relics of more than 100 kinds are displayed inside, which are valuable, including the most typical bronzes in various historical periods from the Western Zhou Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Characteristic architecture combining Chinese and Western

attractions.name: 先农大院
attractions.summary: Xiannong Courtyard is a place that integrates catering, fashion, art, and leisure. There is an exotic villa with a variety of delicious food gathered here. During the day, you can sit in the yard and have lunch and afternoon tea. The night view is illuminated, making it very comfortable and suitable for bringing children to play and have meals here.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 张学良故居
attractions.summary:
Zhang Xueliang's Former Residence Museum, also known as Shaoshual's Mansion, lived here in the 1920s and 1930s. This building is luxurious, beautiful and generous, mainly in western Baroque style. The rooms are elegantly decorated, and the stairs, floors, doors and windows are all made of Philippine wood. 
Zhang Xueliang's former residence, which has been renovated for more than two years, reappears today. The music, decoration, clothing, furniture and characters here reappear the original appearance of the Zhang family's life in the French Concession in Tianjin.

attractions.name: 张爱玲旧居
attractions.summary: Zhang Ailing's former residence is located in Heping District, Tianjin. It is a remarkable historical building with the prominent words "Zhang Ailing's Former Residence", which makes people want to explore the place where this talented woman lived. Nowadays, Zhang Ailing's former residence is not only a historical building, but also a coffee shop with a comfortable life.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 马可波罗广场
attractions.summary:
· Tianjin Kyle Polo Square is located in the original Italian concession in Hebei District, Tianjin. It is the only Italian concession in modern China and the only concession that Italy once had abroad. 
· Marco Polo Square covers an area of 2,200 square meters. The sculpture of the Goddess of Peace is located in the center of the square. It was built to commemorate the victory of the First World War. After completion, it was transported from Italy to Tianjin via Shanghai. 
· The square consists of the sculpture of the Goddess of Peace and 6 typical Mediterranean style villas in southern Italy. The main sculpture includes a fountain pool, a pedestal, a Roman column and a statue of the Goddess of Peace. It is 13.6 meters high and all made of granite stone. The upper part of the pedestal is decorated with 4 European figures. The top of the column is a bronze statue of the Goddess of Peace flying with wings, holding an olive branch in her hand. It symbolizes the eternal theme of "friendship and peace".
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the statue of the goddess of

attractions.name: 但丁广场
attractions.summary: Dante Square is located in the Italian style district of Hebei District, Tianjin, at the intersection of Freedom Road and Minsheng Road. In the center of the square, there is a statue of Italian Renaissance poet Alighi Dante. The theme style of the square is Italian style, which is coordinated with the style of the surrounding cultural area. To the west of the square is Marco Polo Square, surrounded by numerous historical buildings such as the Yuan Yi Guo Garden, Zhang Mingqi's former residence, and Wang Yimin's former residence, making it a must visit place for tourists visiting the scenic area. There is a special floor tile on Dante's Square, located in the center of the square and carved with Dante's portrait, which is one of the characteristics of Dante's Square.

attractions.name: 梁启超饮冰室书斋
attractions.summary:
The ice drinking room refers to the study of Liang Qichao's former residence. The study "Ice Drinking Room" is a light gray two-story building built in 1924. The first floor is its study, and the second floor is used for bedrooms and reception. Liang Qichao's later works were all completed here. 
The "Ice Drinking Room" is specially designed by Italian architect Bailonio, with a unique and elegant shape.

attractions.name: 原意大利兵营
attractions.summary:
· The barracks, built in 1925, have a wide playground and two tall three-story sloping-roofed buildings at right angles, with corridors more than ten feet wide in front of each floor. The building is magnificent and unique in style. It is well preserved so far, but it also reveals a magnificent and twisting. When tourists stop here, their feelings must be complicated. 
This ancient Romanesque building is located in a very inconspicuous alley. It is one of the largest buildings in the original concession. It is also the only preserved foreign barracks in the Nine-Kingdom Garrison Barracks in Tianjin, and the only completely preserved building of its kind in the country. 
It is said that when Pu Yi was in Tianjin, he visited the barracks to "inspect" and left a photo that can be seen in the exhibition room in Jingyuan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Relatively well-preserved foreign military barracks in Tianjin

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 泥人张美术馆
attractions.tag: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
attractions.summary: Clay Figurine Zhang Art Museum was built with funds raised by descendants of clay figurine Zhang's family. It collects more than a thousand works of clay figurine Zhang's family in past dynasties, and exhibits more than 100 pieces all year round.
attractions.shortFeatures: Display the works of famous Zhang family artists in the past dynasties

attractions.name: 天后宫
attractions.summary:
There is an old saying in Tianjin: Tianhou Temple first, followed by Tianjin Guard. It can be seen the position of Tianhou Temple in the minds of Tianjin people. It is one of the three major Tian Hou temples in China and the oldest surviving building in Tianjin. 
Tianhou Temple is actually a temple where ordinary people worship the Empress of Tianhou, commonly known as the "Empress Palace". In the past, Tianhou Palace was dedicated to the Lord God, of course, the Empress of Tianhou. Due to historical reasons, Tianhou Temple has formed a complicated situation in which Buddhism and Taoism are mixed and hundreds of gods gather in the long years. 
Every year on the 23rd of March of the lunar calendar, a grand "Imperial Meeting" is held here, performing Dragon Lantern Dance, Lion Dance, Shaolin Club, Gao Jian, Dharma Drum, Dry Boat, Yangko, Wushu, Beijing Opera, Pingju, Bangzi, etc.

attractions.name: 名流茶馆(古文化街店)
attractions.tag: Crosstalk Quyi; Venue exhibition hall; Quyi crosstalk
attractions.summary:
Where you can experience Tianjin's traditional cultural crosstalk on the spot, there will be different crosstalk teams performing on Friday and Saturday. It's best to book it in official website, and it may be sold out on the spot. 
The audience sits around a square table for four people, giving away snacks and white water, and ordering tea separately. There are three different seats, and the prices range from 40 to 90 yuan. 
Many locals will also come here to listen to cross talk. New and old cross talk actors will perform here, and Yun-peng Yue has also appeared here. It should be noted that the old actors have a heavy accent. 
 
 
Tips 
The Spring Festival ticket price will be higher than usual, usually 70/100/150 yuan.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 泰达航母主题公园
attractions.tag: Parenting Treasure Spot; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
- A large military-themed park integrating eight major sections, including sightseeing, themed performances, and entertainment, based on the Soviet aircraft carrier "Kiev."
- The ship features dozens of attractions, such as the combat command center, intelligence room, aircraft carrier technology museum, history of naval ship development, sailor tilt room, and the Warrior's Corridor.
- Whether standing beside it or entering its interior, one can feel the overwhelming impact of the massive steel structure! It is perfect for military enthusiasts.
- The park also includes the World Aircraft Carrier Museum, weapon model exhibition, Expo Tianjin Pavilion, dock square, 4D cinema, and many other attractions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the aircraft carrier to watch the combat performance.

attractions.name: 国家海洋博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary: The main building of the National Museum of Marine Science and Technology has 3 floors, with some areas extending to 4 floors. The exhibition hall covers an area of approximately 23,000 square meters and is divided into six major exhibition zones, including: the Marine Nature Exhibition Zone, the Chinese Marine Civilization Exhibition Zone, the Marine Interactive Exhibition Zone, the Education and Public Outreach Center, the Marine Ecology Exhibition Zone, and the High-End Cooperation and Temporary Exhibition Zone. The museum also features public service facilities such as a museum shop, restaurant, café, and cinema. The National Museum of Marine Science and Technology will present Earth, the ocean, life, humans, and their interdependent and symbiotic systems, revealing the true meaning of harmony between humanity and the sea, guiding the public to better understand, love, and protect the ocean.

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours.
