attractions.name: 雨花台
attractions.summary:
- Located in the southern part of Zhonghua Gate in Nanjing, it consists of three beautiful hills surrounded by pine and cypress trees, and is a red tourism site in Nanjing.
- The entire scenic area is divided into six main zones: the Martyrs’ Cemetery Area, the Historical Sites Area, the Yuhuashi Stone Cultural Area, the Yuhuacha Tea Culture Area, the Amusement Activity Area, and the Ecological Forest Area.
- The Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial Hall and the Martyrs’ Achievements Exhibition Hall display many books, manuscripts, clothing, and writing tools used by the soldiers of that time.
- The park is lush and green, making it not only a popular tourist destination but also a place for leisure and recreation for Nanjing residents.
- An annual Yuhuashi Art Festival is held every September, and a large Rhododendron Exhibition takes place from March to June. It is also a great spot for plum and magnolia flower viewing.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

It sets up supporting catering, cultural and creative, performing arts and other formats, and overall creates a Tang Dynasty common culture experience place that integrates Tang Dynasty spatial play, Tang style common experience, theme immersive interaction, Tang music and dance performance, cultural social leisure and other aspects.

attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums

- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.

The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.

attractions.name: 西安钟楼
attractions.summary: The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 

attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.

attractions.name: 红山森林动物园
attractions.summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院-丽山园
attractions.summary: The Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, located in the suburb of Xi'an, is the mausoleum of Ying Zheng, the first emperor in Chinese history. Among the mausoleums of Chinese emperors, it is famous for its grand scale. At present, the imperial tomb has not been excavated, and you can wander around the tomb to think of ancient times. The Imperial Mausoleum was built between 246 BC and 208 BC, lasting for 39 years. The imperial tomb embodies the ritual system of "treating death as if it were life", completely modeled after the layout of the Qin capital Xianyang at that time. It has two rammed earth city walls inside and outside, symbolizing the imperial and palace cities of the capital Xianyang. The tomb mound (also known as the Da Feng Tu Dui, the burial mound of Emperor Qin Shi Huang) is located in the southern part of the inner city, in the shape of a covered bucket, and is currently about 50 meters high. After more than two thousand years of vicissitudes, the main relic on the ground of the imperial tomb is only the towering tomb. At present, the scenic area outlines the outline of the city wall through planting vegetation belts, as well as prominent signs and tags, allowing tourists to understand the direction, scope, and location of the city wall in the past. Up to now, the underground palace of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has not been excavated due to the constraints of existing scientific and technological conditions. Legend has it that in the underground palace of the First Emperor, various precious stones are used as the sun, moon, and stars, gold and jade are used as mountains and rivers, mercury is used as rivers, lakes, and seas, and the South China Sea mermaids refine oil into lamps that will last for thousands of years. Tourists can also visit the Bai Xi Qi Pit (also known as 9901 Accompanying Burial Pit) located in the southeast and the Wen Guan Qi Pit (also known as 0006 Accompanying Burial Pit) on the southwest side of the Fengtu Pile inside the imperial tomb. attractions.summary: The Xi'an Eternal Scene Area is a scenic spot that transcends ancient and modern times and subverts imagination, jointly created by Xi'an Shiyuan Group and Songcheng Performing Arts. Within the scenic area, there are various scenic spots such as Annals Avenue, Sky City, Wanghu Pavilion, Chang'an Gate, Songcheng Pagoda, Songcheng Gate, Ghost House, Flaming Volcano, Chang'an Square, Performing Arts Square, and Songcheng Square, all of which are bizarre and surreal, as if transported back to the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Strolling along the scenic areas of Guoyan Street and Yunyun Street, strolling along the tree lined paths by the lake, the silver sand beach, Jinxiu Lake, and Chang'an Tower complement each other in beauty, cherishing the present and life is a journey. It is a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities that combines entertainment, tourism, and vacation, suitable for all ages and weather conditions. The large-scale song and dance "Eternal Love in Xi'an" revolves around the story of a Chinese American girl returning to her home country to search for her roots, embarking on a journey to search for national memories. It is like a magical time travel machine, showcasing the grand chapters of the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties in a comprehensive and three-dimensional manner. Here lies the vast and ancient half slope light, the romantic poetry of Ba Liu Yi Yi, the majestic spirit of the Great Qin, the legendary Silk Road with thousands of miles of sand, and the glorious era of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty... Tens of thousands of sets of machinery and equipment are in full operation, 3000 tons of floodwaters pour down, and hundreds of cubic meters of yellow sand come rushing towards us. The combination of reality and virtuality breaks the boundaries between the stage and the audience area, immersing us in a journey through time. The real-life experience drama 'Great Earthquake' uses high-tech methods to recreate the scenes of the earthquake, with mountains collapsing and earth shattering, houses collapsing and houses collapsing. One true story after another, one touching scene after another, showcases the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief and disaster relief. Immersive naked eye 3D "fantasy space", ride a virtual roller coaster through the jungle, drive a spaceship through space, and follow a sea turtle on an adventure... Eight types of time travel adventures, flying adventure journeys, take you to the sea and the earth. Immersion style internet celebrity check-in point "Light and Shadow Show", a colorful and dreamlike world. attractions.name: 《驼铃传奇》秀
attractions.summary: The Huaxia Culture and Tourism Xi'an Resort project includes supporting facilities such as Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Grand Theater, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Ocean Park, Xi'an Huaxia Culture and Tourism Water World, Xi'an Ancestral Tribe Scenic Area, and catering and commercial facilities. The Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater staged a live performance called "The Legend of Camel Bells", which pioneered a rotating and walking audience stand. It combines modern high-tech with the legendary historical and cultural classics of the camel road and silk road, bringing extraordinary visual experience and spiritual shock to the audience, and spreading the cultural legends of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The Xi'an Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Grand Theater, as a landmark building of the Huaxia Cultural and Tourism Xi'an Resort project, is designed as a large ellipsoidal building with a length of 142 meters, a width of 128 meters, and a height of about 50 meters, which can accommodate 3000 people to watch performances at the same time. The theater cleverly designed and built a movable audience stand in the center, breaking the world's single stage performance mode. By rotating and walking the stands, the audience is transported to the viewing position, bringing them a new audio-visual enjoyment. The running live performance "Camel Bell Legend" show, in the process of compiling the "Camel Bell Legend" show, takes the "the Belt and Road" as the main line, deeply excavates the traditional culture of the Tang Dynasty, traces the trail of the camel caravan on the Silk Road, and spreads the cultural legend of Xi'an's glorious historical period with positive energy. The entire performance is divided into seven acts, including the prologue "Time Returns" and "Sending You a Thousand Miles Away", "Wolf Path in Danger", "Foreign Charm", "Auspicious Rain Cleanses Dust", "Welcoming the Return of the Lang", and "The Prosperous Age of China". With the aim of "good-looking, pleasant, and fun", it creates an entertainment that is open to the public, accessible to both refined and popular audiences, enjoyable and satisfying. The plot design of the performance begins with a newlywed couple's reluctant farewell in "Farewell to You for a Thousand Miles", telling the story of the westward camel caravan's journey through natural dangers such as volcanoes, avalanches, sandstorms, deserts, and wolf pack raids, resulting in nine deaths in life; Later, loaded with goods, they returned to Chang'an, praying for Bamiyan on the way. They coincidentally encountered holy water from heaven and returned safely to Chang'an in the hopes of their loved ones. During the journey, they also interspersed descriptions of exotic customs and traditions; The entire performance was full of ups and downs, providing the audience with a stunning, exciting, beautiful, and joyful audio-visual experience. Up to 47 invention patents were used, including thrilling performances by camels and wolves. The Legend of Camel Bells takes you through the grandeur and vastness of desert sandstorms, listening to the crisp and mysterious sound of camel bells on the Silk Road, savoring exotic customs, witnessing the glory of the Tang Dynasty, and listening to the echoes of China for thousands of years. The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

When night falls, the lights on both sides shine brightly, and the scenery is even more beautiful. The 16 Pu has three areas, with many flights such as "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess", and "essence Tour". attractions.name: 朱家角古镇景区
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Night Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.

- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.

attractions.name: 浙江自然博物院(杭州馆)
attractions.summary: The Zhejiang Natural History Museum, formerly known as the West Lake Museum, was founded in 1929. The museum, with its rich collection resources and rigorous scientific professional academic support, interprets the era's proposition of harmonious development between humans and nature through exhibitions in three major sections: "Stories of Earth Life," "Rich and Strange Biological World," and "Green Zhejiang. Here, you can see the origin of life, understand the mysteries of the ocean, discover the world of plants, and have a wonderful encounter with ancient fossils. Enhance your knowledge and cherish this beautiful blue planet even more.

attractions.name: 杭州长乔极地海洋公园
attractions.tag: "Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Playground"
attractions.summary:
· Hangzhou Polar Ocean Park is a large-scale polar ocean park that integrates polar animal exhibitions and polar landscape experiences.  
· The park features 19 major themed venues, 5 exciting performance theaters, and hundreds of polar animals, including whales, dolphins, fish, corals, and jellyfish.  
· The highlight not to be missed is the park's treasure—the pilot whale, the first whale species introduced to a marine park in China.  
· The most spectacular part of the ocean world is the animal performances, with the clever sea lion all-stars performing kung fu shows, including impressive tricks like the "Golden Rooster Stand" and "Upside-down Hook."
attractions.shortFeatures: Get close to and learn about adorable marine creatures.

attractions.name: 钱塘江夜游
attractions.summary: Boarding at Binjiang Pier, passing through Qianjianglong - Hangzhou Yin - Xixing Bridge - Olympic Sports Center - Qianjiang Century City - enjoying the Qianjiang New City Light Show - Hangzhou Radio and Television Station - overlooking the Fuxing Bridge - Qianwang Shooting Tide - returning to Binjiang Pier, experiencing the leisurely and comfortable feeling of "the moon reaches the center of the sky, the wind comes to the water surface", fully enjoying the skyline of high-rise buildings on both sides of the new city under neon lights, allowing you to spend an unforgettable night tour of Qiantang in the prosperous era. Qian Yin Hao: Incorporating elements of Hangzhou Qiantang culture and serving multiple tourism purposes. The design of the top eaves adopts the traditional Chinese architectural form of eaves, showing a soaring momentum. The cruise ship adopts large bay glass windows to increase transparency and blend millennium classical culture with modern fashion temperament, allowing tourists to pursue urban memories and feel the artistic conception of "one mountain, one water dream paradise, one boat, one scenery visiting hometown" during the journey. Menghang: Integrating the elements of modern architecture and dynamic characteristics of Hangzhou, breaking the traditional design concept of passenger ships, and using modern structural methods to freehand handle silk, perfectly interpreting the fusion of the artistic beauty of flowing millennium classical culture and the modern temperament of fashion. The cruise ship is divided into three levels, with indoor cabins on the first and second levels, and an open sightseeing platform on the third level. The entire ship adopts a diesel electric hybrid environmentally friendly propulsion system, which can effectively reduce fuel use and emissions of PM2.5, exhaust gas, etc., greatly reduce noise and vibration, and enhance passenger comfort. Qiantang River - Under the shallow moonlight, I think of Zhang Ruoxu and imagine walking into his "Spring River Flower Moon Night": "The tide of the spring river connects to the sea level, and the bright moon on the sea rises together. It follows the waves for thousands of miles, where is the spring river without moonlight... The river and sky are one color without dust, and the moon shines alone in the sky. Who first sees the moon on the riverbank, and when does the river moon shine on people..." Without noisy tourists or various different observers, under the reflection of the lights on both sides, a cruise ship can also carry a quiet and high-end atmosphere. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 飞来峰
attractions.summary: Feilai Peak, also known as Lingjiu Peak, is 168 meters high and composed of limestone. Due to long-term exposure to groundwater erosion, Feilai Peak has formed many fantastic and varied caves and ravines, including Qinglin Cave, Yuru Cave, Longhong Cave, etc. The old trees and vines on the mountain are intertwined and tangled; The rock bones are exposed, and the peaks and ridges are as sharp as cutting. The amazing thing about Feilai Peak is the relatively complete 345 Buddhist themed statues on the mountain, with diverse forms, rich themes, vivid carvings, and unique styles, making it an attractive and wonderful spectacle.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 07:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00),Opens at Daylight saving time 06:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30)

attractions.name: 西湖风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 满觉陇
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn flowers; Mountains
attractions.summary:
Juelong, also known as Manlong and Manjialong, is located in the south of the West Lake in Hangzhou, a valley at the southern foot of the southern peak. In the fourth year of Tianfu in the later Jin Dynasty (AD 939), Yuanxing Courtyard was built, and in the second year of Zhiping in the Northern Song Dynasty (AD 1065), it was changed to Manjue Courtyard. Manjue means "perfect consciousness", and the place was named after the temple. 
Juelong is famous for its sweet-scented osmanthus. Every autumn, sweet-scented osmanthus blooms, the fragrance fills the empty mountains, and falls like rain, so it has the reputation of "Manlong Guiyu". In 1985, "Manlong Guiyu" was rated as one of the ten scenic spots of the New West Lake.
attractions.shortFeatures: Full of Longguiyu, you can have a panoramic view of the tea garden scenery

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州园林博物馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Garden Museum was first located in the residential area of Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built and opened in the autumn of 1992. It is the first garden museum in China. The new museum of Suzhou Garden Museum is now located on the west side of the Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built in October 2005 and has a building area of 3,390 square meters. The Garden Art Hall also shows in detail the gardening techniques such as stacking mountains, water management, flowers and trees, and architecture. The whole new museum is divided into preface hall, garden history hall, garden art hall, garden culture hall and end hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Entering Suzhou Garden Culture

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 东方之门
attractions.name_en: Gate to the East Exhibition Center
attractions.summary:
Oriental Gate is regarded as a skyscraper on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou, with a total height of about 301.8 meters. The Oriental Gate is divided into two parts: the South Building and the North Building. Its external shape is a door, and it is known as "the first door in the world". This landmark building is adjacent to Jinji Lake in the east and International Building and Century Financial Building in the west. It is not only a new gate for Suzhou, but also a new gate for the world to look at China. 
This 88-story building was completed in 2013, surpassing Suzhou Xindi Center to become the tallest building in Suzhou. Oriental Gate includes commercial, hotel, office buildings and other services, creating a new urban hotspot for Suzhou with commercial prosperity and driving the prosperity of CDB area. 
Jinji Lake at night is very vibrant. Moonlight Pier, Water Curtain Movie, Ligongdi and Suzhou Paradise light up the shores of Jinji Lake, and the majestic and elegant Oriental Gate is also one of the major landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Suzhou Internet celebrity punch-in new landmark

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 退思园
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Garden Garden; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
Built in the Guangxu period of Qing Dynasty, it was a mansion built after Lan Sheng, the director of the garden, was impeached and dismissed. The name of the garden is "retreating", which means "making up for it". 
Compared with the four famous gardens in Suzhou, Tuisi Garden is a small garden with a small area but fine design. 
· The layout of the park is unique, with pavilions, terraces, buildings, pavilions, corridors, squares, bridges, pavilions, halls, halls, houses and pavilions. 
The whole collection of Qing Dynasty gardens is small and exquisite, and it is a classic of classical gardens in the south of the Yangtze River. It has been used as the shooting location of many film and television dramas, and it is a must-see place when you come to Tongli.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classical gardens built in the late Qing Dynasty

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 《长恨歌》演出
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
China's first large-scale live-action historical dance drama, with eleven scenes in four levels, such as "loving each other" and "being spoiled and charming". 
· A strong cast of 300 professional actors artistically reproduces this touching love story in the original place of the story. 
Since the official performance in 2007, more than 2,500 performances have been performed and 3.5 million audiences have been received, reaching the grand occasion of "one ticket is hard to find".
attractions.shortFeatures: Yang Guifei and Tang Minghuang's eternal love

attractions.name: 华清御汤·宝积池温泉
attractions.summary: The Huaqing Yutang Baojichi Outdoor Hot Spring Area is located on the south side of the Xi'an Huaqing Yutang Hotel in Lintong District, Xi'an City. It is adjacent to the Lishan National Forest Park to the south and the Huaqing Palace, a national 5A level tourist attraction to the north. Relying on the 6000 year old Imperial Hot Spring and Lishan Natural Oxygen Bar, it inherits the essence of Tang Dynasty bathing culture, backed by the natural oxygen bar, with lush forests and fresh air. There are bathing pool outdoor hot springs of different sizes and styles in Baoji Pool. The selection of bathing pool materials is exquisite and elegant. There are also elegant and refined modern celebrities who like beige. The Tang Palace's ancient style lounge features elegant seating, offering Tang Dynasty style health tea drinks and fruit snacks. Savor the unique Tang culture bathing and health preservation concept in the leisurely stillness of time.

attractions.name: 骊山
attractions.summary: Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.name: 四明湖水杉
attractions.summary: The Siming Lake Water Cedar Wetland is located by the tranquil Siming Lake, where large areas of water spruce trees grow with straight and upright trunks, rising from the ground. They are neatly arranged, standing quietly in the water or on the shore. Every autumn, the leaves turn golden yellow or orange red, which looks very beautiful from afar and is also a great place to enjoy autumn. It is also known as the "Little Xinjiang" of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shanghai. Full text 

attractions.name: 梁弄古镇
attractions.summary: Liangnong is a famous historical and cultural town in Zhejiang Province. During the Anti-Japanese War, it was the heart of Siming Mountain revolutionary base area. Historically, it was also an important post station of Tang poetry road in eastern Zhejiang, where many poets such as Li Bai and Pi Rixiu stopped. There are historical sites such as Wuguilou, Song Tomb Stone Carving, Horseshoe Street, and revolutionary sites such as the Memorial Hall of East Zhejiang Base Area, the former site of the New Fourth Army East Zhejiang Column Headquarters, and Simingshan Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery in the town. Nature and humanities complement each other. Liangnong Town, it is said that two ancestors surnamed Liang and Feng first settled here. Originally known as Liang Feng, it somehow became Liangnong. It is an ancient town with a history of more than 1,000 years. Liang Nong, with winding alleys, gurgling water, green tiles and brown eaves, and ninety-nine alleys are all open. She is like aged wine, and you must taste it carefully before you can know its mellow fragrance. Enter the ancient town and go eastbound along "Zhengmeng Street". Although it is a new street, you only feel the ancient wind blowing on your face. This street is built in the style of Ming and Qing Dynasties, and intersects with the old streets in the town. There are mostly two-or three-story houses along the street, with scattered eaves and gables, echoing the second library in eastern Zhejiang. And the century-old town central primary school is nearby, as if deliberately showing off its quaint style and long history to people. After walking dozens of meters, turn right, and it is an old street before liberation. In this ancient street, you can see the complete living customs of the mountain township in the south of the Yangtze River, and at the same time, you can appreciate the elegant style of the mountain township figures. On a street, there are many sheep-killing workshops "Yangtao", noodle-making workshops, soju workshops, etc. There are also old shop counters that are still open to welcome guests, etc., all of which condense the social culture of Jiangnan Mountain Township. Walking into the old houses in the old street, you can still see people sleeping in ancient beds, hanging century-old banners, and even eating bowls are not short. They seem to live in the past history. Nowadays, most of the people living in the old streets in the town are elderly people, and letting them still live here seems to be a measure taken to protect the old houses in the old streets. Go to the end of the old street and turn left to the former site of the guerrilla column headquarters in eastern Zhejiang of the New Fourth Army. The former headquarters site is located in "Xiaoyuanhe" in Liangnong, and it is a key cultural relics protection unit in Yuyao City. The former headquarters site was renovated to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the founding of the base area. In March, 1993, the historical materials exhibition room of the East Zhejiang Column of the New Fourth Army was established, displaying more than 30 revolutionary historical relics, more than 160 historical photos and more than 10 charts.
attractions.shortFeatures: Historical town, base area during the Anti-Japanese War

attractions.name: 四明山国家森林公园
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
attractions.summary:
Siming Mountain National Forest Park is located in the five urban areas of Yuyao, Yinzhou, Fenghua, Shengzhou and Shangyu in the hinterland of Siming Mountain in eastern Zhejiang Province. It is distributed in a long and narrow shape from east to west, with a total area of 6,665 hectares, and the provincial highway Huxi line passes through it. 
There are many low mountains and hills in the park, with undulating peaks and cascading hills. The altitude is between 600-900 meters. The main peak, Jinzhong Mountain, is about 1018 meters above sea level. The climate of the park is slightly cold and humid, with four distinct seasons, abundant sunshine, abundant rainfall, obvious alternation of winter and summer monsoons, and cool summer. 
The park is densely treed, flowers and plants are fragrant, and cliffs and boulders often appear among pines and cypresses. The park is particularly rich in species. After preliminary investigation, there are nearly 1,000 species of plants and 106 species of main animals. There are evergreen broad-leaved forest, cedar promenade, money pine forest, cypress forest, Huangshan pine forest, the hometown of red maple in Siming Mountain-10,000 mu of red maple forest and various bird landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Ideal for outings

attractions.name: 仰天湖景区

Turn left 5 kilometers from the Siming Mountain ticket office or navigate to Yangtian Lake Villa. Yangtian Lake is a small basin formed after a volcanic eruption. The lake water is clear, and the scenery by the lake reflects it, making people feel relaxed and happy.

attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
attractions.summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress

attractions.name: 东门老街
attractions.summary: Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully.

attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.summary: Dameisha Waterfront Plank Road starts from Yantian Donggang District in the west and ends at Dameisha Waterfront Park in the east, with a total length of about 1km. On the wide platform, the experiencers enjoy the natural beauty by the sea and the wind.

· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.summary: Monument to the people's Liberation Pedestrian Street is a more prosperous business circle in Chongqing, where there are many department stores and hotels. The pedestrian street is located in Yuzhong District, centered on Monument to the people's Liberation, including Minquan Road, Zourong Road and Bayi Road. There are many food, shopping, and beauty shopping malls, as well as a variety of snacks and beautiful women, making it the "three highs" of a pedestrian street. You can stroll around the high-end Meimei Times Department Store and Metropolitan Plaza here, as well as the more affordable Chongqing Department Store and Pacific Department Store; You can eat almost all Chongqing food on the pedestrian street. There are Bayi Road Delicious Street, where you can find cheap and delicious hot and sour noodles, mountain town small rice dumpling and Wonton. And when you stroll on the pedestrian street, within a few steps, a tall and fair skinned Chongqing beauty will flash past you. As a bustling commercial street in Chongqing and even in western China, whether you are a local resident or a tourist visiting Chongqing, you can find your own happiness on the pedestrian street. Monument to the people's Liberation: a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. The Monument to the people's Liberation on the pedestrian street is a monument to the victory of the Anti Japanese War. "Delicious" means "greedy". Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

attractions.name: 洪崖洞民俗风貌区
attractions.name_en: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.

attractions.name: 夜游两江
attractions.summary: Without admiring the night view, I haven't been to Chongqing. The night view of the Two Rivers in Chongqing cleverly combines the scenery of Chongqing with the world-famous Chongqing night view. On a cruise ship, enjoy the night view of Chongqing, facing the gentle river breeze and looking up at the magnificent urban areas of Changbin Road and Jiabin Road. The colorful lights reflect in the river, and the flowing lights are particularly tempting. The buildings of different heights along the river are arranged in a staggered manner under the illumination of the lights. Jinbi Palace, a luxury cruise ship, is fully equipped with sound, lighting, and projector systems, as well as a large deck VIP lounge and multiple luxurious river view private rooms. The "Chaotianmen" cruise ship is a carefully crafted luxury cruise ship and an upgraded version of the "Chaotiangong" cruise ship, with increasingly complete functions.

It includes a tree observation pavilion and a wilderness leisure area, and can accommodate thousands of people at the same time. It is one of the places to enjoy the night view of the mountain city. Standing on the observation deck, looking from afar, the lights of thousands of households in Yuzhong District, Chongqing; Surrounded by two rivers, shining brightly; A long bridge spanning over, with a clear outline; The entire city, layered and arranged in a staggered and colorful manner, is magnificent and dazzling against the backdrop of the night sky.

The whole sightseeing area is not only sightseeing, but also a food street, which can meet the needs of delicious food while watching the scenery.

attractions.summary: The Dongshuimen Yangtze River Bridge is a cross river passage connecting Yuzhong District and Nan'an District in Chongqing. attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 上海海昌海洋公园
attractions.summary: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park has been rated as a National 4A-level tourist attraction. The park is closely centered around marine culture and is divided into five major themed areas: Mermaid Bay, Polar Town, Ice and Snow Kingdom, Underwater Wonders, and Ocean Tribe. It features sixteen star performances, including "Killer Whale Science Show," "Dolphin Romance," "Sea Lion Fun Adventures," "Beluga Love," "Marine Animal Feeding Show," "Mermaid Fairy Tale," "Water Dance Between Fish," "Town Party," "Water Flying Man," "Chinese Style Grand Event," "Flying Fairy Little Dragon Girl," "Seven Cute Adventures," "Clown Meet and Greet," "Ocean Dream Parade," "Illusory Sea Realm," and "Ocean EDM Party." The park also has six animal exhibition halls: Antarctic Penguin Hall, Marine Mammal Exploration Hall, Iceberg Arctic Hall, Underwater World Hall, Volcano Shark Hall, and Coral Jellyfish Hall. It houses over 30,000 rare marine animals, including polar bears and emperor penguins. Additionally, there are six amusement facilities: Volcano Rafting, Dolphin Roller Coaster, Time and Space Cable Car, Deep Sea Adventure, Sky Theater, and Sensory 4D Cinema. The park is also complemented by the Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel, which features five marine-themed rooms, including penguin and mermaid-themed rooms, offering visitors a spectacular oceanic dream journey!
attractions.shortFeatures: See rare marine life and enjoy thrilling attractions.

- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.

attractions.name: 上海野生动物园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; A hidden gem for taking kids out
attractions.summary:
• Shanghai Wildlife Park is a theme park that integrates the breeding, exhibition, conservation, scientific education, and recreational activities of wild animals. The park officially opened on November 18, 1995, and is located in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, covering 153 hectares (about 2300 acres). It is one of the first national 5A-level tourist attractions.

• The park is home to more than 200 species of rare wild animals from both domestic and foreign regions, including giant pandas, golden monkeys, golden takins, crested ibises, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, white rhinos, cheetahs, and more, with a population of over 10,000 animals.

• Visitors can further understand animal friends through a combination of education and entertainment. Not only can you observe giant pandas, African elephants, Asian elephants, giraffes, chimpanzees, gibbons, lemurs, flamingos, crested ibises, and other rare wild animals, but there are also many special animal behavior demonstrations.

• Visitor Notice: A complete smoking ban is now in effect throughout the park! For the health of yourself, other visitors, and the animals, please refrain from smoking within the park. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated, and thank you for your understanding!
