attractions.name: 南越王博物院(王墓展区)
attractions.name_en: The Nanyue King Museum of The Western Han Dynasty
attractions.summary: The Western Han Nanyue King Museum is located in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, and is the exhibition area for the royal tombs of the Nanyue King Museum (a research center for the history of Western Han Nanyue). In June 1983, the tomb of the King of Nanyue was excavated and unearthed. The museum was built based on the original site of the tomb, mainly displaying the original site of the King of Nanyue's tomb and its unearthed cultural relics. Compared to other museums, its highlight lies in the precious "Silk Thread Jade Robe". The Silk Thread Jade Robe of the King of Nanyue is one of the earliest and most complete sets of jade robes excavated in China, which is definitely worth a visit. Also, this museum was built on the site of the cemetery, so it contains the tomb of the King of Nanyue. To the east of the museum is a three story comprehensive exhibition building, and to the north is a two-story main exhibition building. The three buildings are connected as a whole by a surrounding corridor that connects them up and down. The museum has a total of 10 exhibition halls, with permanent exhibitions including cultural relics exhibitions and porcelain pillow exhibitions, as well as occasional temporary exhibitions. The cultural relics exhibition is the main body of the museum, mainly consisting of unearthed cultural relics from the tomb of King Zhao Xu of Nanyue, with over 10000 pieces of various burial objects unearthed from the tomb. The exhibition is divided into five units: Emperor Wen's Golden Seal, Treasures of the Main Chamber, Martyrdom in the Tomb, Treasures in the Imperial Treasury, and Bell and Ding Food. There are a large number of jade artifacts in the accompanying collection, such as the Qingyu Jiao Cup, eleven sets of jade accessories, and fifty-eight jade sword ornaments, all of which are significant discoveries in Han jade. The treasures among jade artifacts are undoubtedly the "Silk Thread Jade Robe", "Carrying Plate High Foot Cup", and "Dragon and Phoenix Pattern Heavy Ring Jade Pendant". The dragon and phoenix patterned heavy ring jade pendant is a decorative jade artifact unearthed from the right eye of the tomb owner. It is carved from blue and white jade and is divided into two rings: the inner ring is intricately carved with a swimming dragon, and the outer ring is intricately carved with a phoenix bird. Its design has been selected as the emblem of the Nanyue King Museum of the Western Han Dynasty. Full text 

Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.

attractions.name: 北京路步行街
attractions.summary: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. This undoubtedly adds a touch of brightness to Beijing Road, which combines classical atmosphere and commercial center. In addition, there are also many specialty snacks here, such as squid balls, squid, radish, beef brisket, beef offal, cotton candy, and so on. attractions.name: 老君山景区
attractions.summary: According to legend, Laojun Mountain Scenic Area is the place where the founder of Taoism, Li Er (Laozi), retired and practiced. During the Northern Wei Dynasty, a temple was built in the mountain to commemorate him, and later it was honored as a "famous mountain in the world". It has always been a place of strong incense. The trees in the mountains are lush, the scenery is picturesque, and mountain springs can be seen everywhere. In the golden autumn, this is the best choice for surrounding areas to enjoy the red leaves. After the rain, Laojun Mountain is surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland in the sky. The scenic area is vast, mainly divided into the central Laojun Mountain main scenic area, the Dream Chasing Valley scenic area in the west, and the Zhaigou scenic area in the east. Generally, tourists spend a day exploring the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, which is also a well-developed region of the entire scenic area. If you go to the mountaintop, there is still a chance to enjoy the beautiful sea of clouds, sunrise, and sunset. The main scenic area of Laojun Mountain includes major attractions such as Zhongtianmen, Jinding, Laojun Temple, Nantianmen, Yuhuangding, and Mazongling. Since its establishment in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Laojun Temple has been the center of worship for pilgrims from the Central Plains; The Taoist temple at the Jade Emperor's Peak enshrines the Jade Emperor, which is also a great place for mountain viewing; Jinding and Mazongling are great places to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds. Recommended itinerary: A one-day tour to explore the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain is the choice of most tourists. Roughly speaking, the route is as follows: Lingguan Hall - Laojun Statue at the foot of the mountain - Linqi Hall - Zhongtian Gate - Linyin Trail - Woyun Pine - Bodhisattva Hall - Laojun Temple, Jinding - Yuhuangding, and then return to the original route. Tourists can choose to visit Laojun Mountain on foot or by "walking+cableway" depending on their own situation. Between the Lingguan Hall at the foot of the mountain and the Zhongtian Gate on the mountainside, there is the Zhongling Cableway in the scenic area. Take the Zhongling Cableway and then walk from Zhongtianmen to the Jade Emperor Peak at the top of the mountain. The road from Zhongtianmen to the top is not very steep and usually takes about an hour to complete. If you have plenty of time, you can spend two days exploring Laojun Mountain. The approximate itinerary is as follows: D1： Visit the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain and stay overnight in the mountains. D2： From the top of Laojun Mountain, choose to descend from the Dream Chasing Valley in the west or the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, and reach the west and east gates of the scenic area respectively. In the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, accommodation is available near Zhongtianmen on the mountainside and Laojun Temple on the mountaintop. There are hotels near Zhongtianmen with good accommodation conditions, while the accommodation conditions around Laojun Temple are relatively poor. If you are planning to go to the mountaintop the next morning to watch the sunrise, then you can stay around the Laojun Temple. Compared to the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, the mountain roads in Chasing Dreams Valley are smoother, and tourists can choose one of them to descend according to their preferences. There are multiple places in the entire scenic area that can provide catering services for tourists, but some road signs in the scenic area are not yet very complete, so tourists need to pay more attention when playing. Taking Wenfeng Pagoda, Confucian Temple, Tuoling Palace, Siyanjinghao and other protected sites in the park as nodes, and Xintan and moat system as links, the overall goal is to organically combine classical and modern buildings, so that old buildings and new buildings are not separated, which not only reflects the traditional cultural heritage of Luoyi Ancient City but also does not lose the modern flavor. The park is scientifically divided into functional areas, and the elegant demeanor of the Millennium Ancient City is concentrated. In the park, functional areas such as catering, tourism, accommodation, business services, etc. are dotted among them. The whole park has a strong cultural atmosphere step by step. It develops and inherits the original cultural landscape and cultural atmosphere of Luoyi Ancient City, making it a highlight of cultural relics protection, revival and inheritance of Luoyang traditional culture in Luoyang Ancient City. attractions.name: 丽景门景区
attractions.tag: Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Without arriving at Lijingmen, one would be wasting their time in Luoyang City. Lijingmen was first built in the Sui Dynasty and is the western gate of the ancient city of Luoyang, known as the "first gate of the ancient capital". The current Lijingmen Scenic Area was rebuilt on the original site of the Luoyang Municipal Government, consisting of parts such as the City Gate Tower, Wengcheng, Arrow Tower, City Wall, Lijingqiao, and moat. It is also the location of Luoyang Old Street. Tourists can come here to climb up and enjoy the scenery, taste local snacks, and learn about the ancient Heluo culture. New Year Bell ringing Activity: Every year on the occasion of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Lijingmen City Tower holds the "Welcoming the New Year at midnight Bell" activity. Tourists can personally climb up to the city and ring the 108 bells symbolizing the prosperity, auspiciousness, peace, and happiness of the new year, echoing the sound of the Ma Temple bell from afar.

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城九洲池
attractions.summary: Today's Jiuzhouchi Site Park covers an area of 288 acres, including the Great Inner Dormitory area in the northwest of the palace city, a part of the Taoguang Garden in the north of the palace city, and the Jiuzhouchi Royal Garden in the north of the city west of the palace city. There are a total of 12 sites, which are protected and displayed through various scientific methods. We hope to use methods and forms such as displaying the original site of ancient ruins and simulating the ground to allow more people to understand the royal garden style during the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties. Jiuzhou Pool, as the imperial garden of Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang dynasties, was a real existence in history. According to the "Fangkao of the Two Capital Cities of Tang Dynasty", "Jiuzhou Pool has a curved pool with several islands in it, like Jiuzhou in the East China Sea. It covers an area of ten hectares, with a water depth of more than ten zhang, and is home to birds, fish, and flowers." In 1960, archaeologists discovered it while excavating Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The palace city area of Luoyang during the Sui and Tang dynasties was composed of a central core area and many surrounding small towns. Jiuzhou Pool is located in the northern part of Xige City on the west side of the Imperial Palace, accounting for about two fifths of Xige City. The scope of "ten hectares of residential land" recorded in the records is based on the Tang Dynasty's system of land cultivation. In the Tang Dynasty, one foot was about 29.5 centimeters and ten hectares were about 520000 square meters, which was larger than the entire western city. However, the actual archaeological measurement of the water area of Jiuzhou Lake is about 139250 square meters. Chinese classical garden art holds a pivotal position in traditional Chinese architecture. The forms of Chinese landscape gardens, represented by literati gardens and royal gardens, are aimed at pursuing the spiritual realm of nature, thus achieving the aesthetic pursuit of "although created by humans, as if opened by heaven", reflecting the cultural concept of "harmony between man and nature", which is completely consistent with the overall architectural concept of Luoyang City in the Sui and Tang dynasties. As a royal garden, Jiuzhou Pool not only embodies the combination of nature and culture, expressing the concept of harmonious unity between humans and nature, but also highlights the "ritual system" in traditional Chinese culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 庆王府
attractions.summary: The Prince Qing's Mansion is a historical building located in both Beijing and Tianjin. The Qingwang Mansion Boutique Cultural Hotel Area consists of an "Urban Cultural Heritage Club" and a "Villa style Historical and Cultural Theme Hotel", and is a comprehensive cultural tourism, business conference, and leisure vacation community. Qingwangfu Mansion is a villa style historical and cultural themed hotel in Tianjin. Its predecessor was the "Shanyili" English style alleyway residential complex built in 1937. It has 16 sets of townhouse style hotel suites and 17 sets of hotel style apartments. After two years of careful renovation, it fully preserves the architectural style of sloping red tiles and sulfur tank brick walls, as well as the dense and orderly block texture. Each villa room comes with its own courtyard, providing guests with a private and peaceful living experience away from the world. The main building of Qingwang Mansion features elegant and distinctive Chinese and Western style private rooms, offering a feast of Chinese, Western, and Asian cuisine. The atrium of the main building is a sky covered shared hall, where guests can relax and enjoy a cup of afternoon tea. Standing on the rooftop terrace of the third floor, you can have a bird's-eye view of the rows of modern Western style buildings on the Five Avenues, experiencing the tranquility and elegance that once belonged to the early 20th century. Experience the unique historical charm and cultural atmosphere of the Qingwang Mansion in Tianjin, and enjoy a special cocktail in the evening, allowing guests to enjoy a romantic and comfortable slow paced life after busy work. At the caf é located in the courtyard, you can enjoy a leisurely afternoon tea, coffee, pastries, and French light meals while admiring the beautiful scenery of the small bridge, flowing water, and lush greenery. The red bar and cigar shop specially set up in the annex have a leisurely feeling of being away from the hustle and bustle. Full text 

attractions.name: 海河游船
attractions.summary: Haihe Sightseeing Boat gathers the essence of Tianjin tourism. Along the way, you can not only feel the changes of Tianjin era, but also appreciate the modern buildings of modern cities. A Haihe River has summarized the history of Tianjin. As the saying goes, only with the Haihe River can there be the history and prosperity of Tianjin, and the prosperity of Haihe River leads to the prosperity of Tianjin. In the Haihe River sightseeing cruise route, what attracts people's attention are the distinctive bridges, which are the pride of Tianjin's urban style. The Yongle Bridge, which integrates with the huge Ferris wheel "Tianjin Eye", the Jiefang Bridge, one of Tianjin's iconic buildings, and the Lion Grove, which has a variety of stone lions. While getting close to these bridges by boat, taking the Haihe River cruise can also enjoy the "Nine Bridges and Thirteen Scenic Spots" along the Haihe River, such as the Dabeiyuan commercial area, the historic Tianjin Station, and the Italian style street that combines Chinese and Western styles.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 五号院相声茶馆（古文化街通庆里店）
attractions.name_en: No. 5 Courtyard Xiangsheng Teahouse (Ancient Cultural Street Tongqingli Store)
attractions.summary: Experience the courtyard tea house, enjoy tea, taste fresh Tianjin style snacks, and listen to traditional cross-talk.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

restaurants.name_en: Yipintang Republic of China Experience Street

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 中国科举博物馆(江南贡院)
attractions.summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 夫子庙大成殿
attractions.summary:
Dacheng Hall of Confucius Temple is the main hall of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. The largest portrait of Confucius in China hangs in the center of the hall. 
The furnishings in the hall imitate fifteen kinds of ancient musical instruments such as chimes and chimes 2,500 years ago, and regularly perform ancient songs and elegant music. 
The main hall is surrounded by murals of Confucius' achievements, with both form and spirit. The temple is surrounded by two stele galleries, and there are thirty original inscriptions of Mo Bao written by famous calligraphers such as Zhao Puchu, Lin Sanzhi, Shen Peng and Wu Zhongqi on the wall. 
The stele gallery displays the Yuhua Stone exhibition, which is known as "the unique thing in China". Exhibitions of other historical relics and works of art are often organized in Dacheng Hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Offering Sacrifices and Understanding Confucius' Hall

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷景区
attractions.summary: Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

attractions.name: 龙泉驿欢乐田园
attractions.summary: OCT Longquanyi Happy Countryside is located on Section 4 of Automobile City Avenue in Longquanyi District, Chengdu, adjacent to Dong'an Lake Sports Park. It covers an area of 450 acres and is the second joyful countryside in China created by the Overseas Chinese Town Group. Joyful Countryside revolves around the attributes of urban countryside, creating seven sections: Sichuan Impression, Luxi Ranch, Fantasy Time, Panda Waves, Bamboo Forest Secret Realm, Starry Sky Lawn, and Splendid Linlang. It integrates various projects such as splendid flower scenery, cute pet interaction, parent-child play, swimming in the waves, delicious food, and secret adventure. It is an exquisite version of the Joyful Countryside walking paradise in the suburbs of the city that is loved by people of all ages. Here, there is a unique and diverse rural landscape, with beautiful flower clusters and colorful seasons. Here, joy and childlike innocence are everywhere. You can have an unexpected encounter with cute animals up close, as well as experience treasure hunting and fantasy amusement. Everyone can have a unique park experience here, making it a dream destination for family outings.

attractions.name: 龙泉山观景台
attractions.summary: The Longquan Mountain Observation Deck is located in Longquanyi District, Chengdu City. The view from the observation deck is wide and offers a panoramic view of the entire Longquanyi urban area. At sunset, the stunning sunset scenery here is truly breathtaking. Every spring when peach blossoms are in full bloom, birds sing and swallows dance everywhere here, and the fragrance of flowers is overwhelming, truly breathtaking.

attractions.name: 金龙长城
attractions.summary: The Golden Dragon Great Wall, also known as the Luodai Great Wall, is not the world-famous Great Wall, but an imitation of future generations. If you don't have the opportunity to go to the Great Wall in Beijing, you can consider coming here to experience the fun of climbing the Great Wall. The slope of the Great Wall is very steep, but the scenery on the mountain is very good. There are many people on holidays, so friends who don't like crowds can go at the wrong peak. It's best to carry toilet water when climbing the Great Wall to prevent insect bites; Be safe when taking pictures.
attractions.shortFeatures: One lake, one temple and one Great Wall

attractions.name: 洛带古镇
attractions.summary:
- Luodai Ancient Town is the best-preserved Hakka ancient town in the suburbs of Chengdu, and is known as the "First Hakka Town in Western China."
- The town's thousand-year-old street and Hakka dwellings are well-preserved, with the old street following a pattern of "one street and seven alleys," and shops lining both sides of the street.
- Major attractions include the Guangdong Guild Hall, Jiangxi Guild Hall, Huguang Guild Hall, Northern Sichuan Guild Hall, and the Hakka Museum, all of which preserve the past atmosphere of the Hakka people.
- Local Hakka people often hold various Hakka cultural activities here, such as "eating Hakka food, wearing Hakka clothes, and sleeping on wooden platform beds."
attractions.shortFeatures: The complete millennium-old Hakka-style ancient town

attractions.name: 中国航空博物馆
attractions.summary:
The China Aviation Museum is the first large-scale aviation museum in China open to the public. Located at the foot of Da Tang Mountain in Changping, Beijing, it houses 91 types of aircraft, with a total of 163 aircraft, as well as over 600 pieces of missile, radar, anti-aircraft artillery, and other military equipment. On August 20, 2007, the museum was rated as a National 4A Tourist Attraction by the National Tourism Quality Rating Committee.

As a window for the development of Air Force culture, the museum thoroughly documents the history of the birth, growth, and strengthening of the Air Force of New China, and showcases the history, reality, and future of national defense technology. Over the past 20 years, the China Aviation Museum has played a unique and positive role in strengthening patriotic education, promoting fine traditions, raising awareness of national defense, popularizing scientific knowledge, facilitating international exchanges, and promoting tourism.

Covering an area of over 50 hectares, the museum has two large exhibition halls—the Cave Hall and the Outdoor Aircraft Display Area. The Cave Hall, converted from an aircraft storage facility built in the 1970s, is grand and spacious, with a total area of 20,000 square meters. It mainly displays representative and precious aircraft from various periods of China’s aviation history, including the Initial Training Aircraft–5, which ended China’s history of being unable to build aircraft; the J-12, China’s newly designed fighter jet (aerial version of Li Xiangyang); and the Y-5, which once carried the ashes of the Premier back to the motherland.

The outdoor exhibition area mainly displays aircraft from around the world, such as the British-made “Viscount” transport aircraft, the world’s first to use a turboprop engine, along with other fine aircraft models. In addition, the museum hosts exhibitions such as the "Engine Series," "Treasures Exhibition," "Aviation Photography Equipment Exhibition," "Rescue and Protective Equipment Exhibition," and "Chairman Mao's Airplane Exhibition." The museum houses over 100 types of aircraft, more than 200 aircraft in total, and over 600 aviation exhibits, including surface-to-air missiles, radar, and more, with many exquisite items on display. With such a large scale, the China Aviation Museum is one of the few aviation-themed museums in the world, representing a miniature of China’s aviation history and a grand exhibition of aircraft.
attractions.shortFeatures: A collection of over a hundred aircraft

attractions.name: 凤山温泉度假村
attractions.summary: Beijing Fengshan Hot Spring Resort is backed by Fengshan and Mangshan National Forest Parks, and faces the Thirteen Tombs Reservoir to the west. It is a secluded paradise away from the hustle and bustle. Here, we gather services such as conferences, hot spring therapy, entertainment, catering, accommodation, etc., providing guests with meticulous and thoughtful integrated family services, allowing you to enjoy the joy of bathing as you please. There are 68 kinds of unique hot spring baths in the Hot Spring Paradise, which add more private space for enjoyment in the distinctive hot spring bathing pool. Amidst the misty spring water, one can witness the splashing of pearls and jade, appreciate the verdant peaks, and experience a pleasant surprise.

attractions.name: 明十三陵
attractions.summary:
- The collective name for the tombs of the 13 emperors of the Ming Dynasty after the capital was moved to Beijing, it is also one of the largest imperial tomb complexes in China, with the most imperial and empress tombs still extant.
- The scenic area is a unified whole, while each tomb is independent. Each tomb is located in front of a mountain, with Changling being the first of the Ming Thirteen Tombs. It is the tomb of the Ming Emperor Chengzu, Zhu Di, and the largest imperial tomb among the Thirteen Tombs.
- The Changling Museum exhibits various burial artifacts, including phoenix crowns, civil officials' hats, men's jade belts, and hairpins, all of which are worth seeing.
- Only four scenic areas are open to the public: Changling, Zhao Tomb, Ding Tomb, and the Sacred Way. Although these are tombs, only the Ding Tomb has been excavated so far.
- In addition to history, it is also nice to take a walk along the Zhao Tomb and Sacred Way. The Sacred Way is lined with various vivid stone statues, and the Zhao Tomb area is quiet and less crowded, perfect for a peaceful stroll.
attractions.shortFeatures: The tomb complex that houses the thirteen Ming Dynasty emperors.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 老门东历史街区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Because it is located in the east of the south gate of Nanjing, it is called "Mendong", opposite the west of the old gate, and it is an important part of the Qinhuai scenic belt of Confucius Temple in Nanjing. 
· Laomendong is the gathering place of traditional dwellings in Nanjing. Since ancient times, it has been the place where merchants in the south of the Yangtze River gather, humanities gather together and families live. 
On the basis of preserving historical buildings and cultural relics, the block will transform the old factory buildings into "one courtyard and two halls" such as Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Institute, Jinling Art Museum and Old Town South Memory Museum. 
Introduce studios, century-old shops, cultural entertainment, antique clubs, etc., and become a cultural block integrating history and culture, leisure and entertainment, and tourist landscape.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the well style of Nanjing old city

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 东钱湖
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Lakes
attractions.summary:
· It is the largest freshwater lake in Zhejiang, composed of Guzi Lake, Mei Lake, and Outer Lake, and is four times the size of West Lake in Hangzhou.  
· The most popular attraction at Dongqian Lake is the long causeway near Xiaoputuo, which is highly recommended for a walk to enjoy the scenic beauty of Dongqian Lake.  
· Apart from visiting attractions, cycling around Dongqian Lake is arguably the most popular activity, allowing visitors to leisurely admire the lakeside landscapes, mountain views, and natural villages along the way.  
· The Plum Garden by Dongqian Lake is renowned as one of the most beautiful spots in Ningbo for appreciating plum blossoms.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cycling along the lake to see the Waterborne Guanyin

attractions.name: 东钱湖小普陀
attractions.summary:
Little Putuo in Ningbo, also known as Xiayu, is located in the center of Dongqian Lake. It is one of the main scenic spots in Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort and has a profound cultural heritage. 
The main landscapes of the scenic spot are: Butuo Cave Sky, Qiandi Smoke Wave, Taogong Diaoyi, Qingfeng Xianggui, Chenghu Lake Bright Moon, Xiayu Suolan, Mountain Monk Hubo, Erling Snapshot 
You can drink tea at the Moonwave Building in the square, or play live CS and barbecue at the paintball center 
Guanyin on the water is the landmark landscape of Xiaoputuo. There is a stone building "Western Ship" in the temple. It is very nice to board the boat and see the scenery of Dongqian Lake from a height. 
Every year in March and April, peach blossoms bloom in Taohuawu between Suolan Bridge and Guanyin on the Water, which is the best time to visit Xiaoputuo.
attractions.shortFeatures: Popular Guanyin Dojo around Ningbo

attractions.name: 东钱湖陶公岛景区
attractions.name_en: Dongqian Lake Taogong Island Scenic Area
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure
attractions.summary:
Taogong Island Scenic Spot is the seclusion place of Fan Li and Xi Shi, and Taogong Island is the most auspicious and romantic place in Ningbo.  
Taogong Island Scenic Spot integrates nostalgia, leisure and entertainment, among which the ancestral court of the God of Wealth is the only in the world, the dragon boat entertainment is the only in Ningbo, the picnic barbecue is the first in Ningbo, and the delicious taste of Taogong is the best in Ningbo. 
The main landscapes of Taogong Island Scenic Area are: Ruyi Gate, Caishen Ancestral Court, Wulu Caishen Temple, Jiutai Da Yuanbao, etc. It is the most popular place for tourism and leisure in Ningbo and Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort.
attractions.shortFeatures: Combine nostalgia, leisure and entertainment

attractions.name: 南宋石刻遗址公园
attractions.name_en: Southern Song Stone Carving Heritage Park
attractions.summary: The park covers an area of 6.7 hectares, with a total investment of more than 30 million yuan. The stone carvings in the park are mainly from the Southern Song Dynasty, and there are also works from the Ming and Qing Dynasties, totaling more than 200 statues. There are many stone carvings in China, but they are basically Buddhist grottoes and royal cemeteries, except the Southern Song Dynasty. Among the grand royal cemetery stone carvings in the Southern Song Dynasty, there is no representative stone carving. Instead, many tomb stone carvings were found in the cemeteries of the four most important prime ministers in the Southern Song Dynasty. These stone carvings not only fill the gap in the history of carving art in the Southern Song Dynasty, but also are unique in China. When you step into the garden, the first thing you see is the five stone carvings of civil ministers, military commanders, squatting tigers, immediately horses and kneeling sheep. These five stone carvings represent "loyalty, courage, integrity, righteousness and filial piety" respectively, reproducing the historical and cultural landscape of the Southern Song Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the rare cultural relics of stone carvings in Southern Song Dynasty
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 韩岭老街
attractions.summary:
Hanling Old Street is known as "the first ancient street in eastern Zhejiang". Hanling Village has a long history. It is said that it was named after the Han surname lived here in its early years. 
There are two old streets in Hanling, namely the front street and the back street, which run through the whole village. Commerce and trade are concentrated in Qianjie, with a total length of more than 500 meters, which is divided into Xiajie, Middle Street and Shangjie. More than 30 shops in the village are mostly concentrated in the lower street, and there is a street stream flowing slowly in the middle of the lower street. The whole street used to be paved with blue-black cobblestones, but now it is a cement road. 
The old street still maintains the style of hundreds of years ago: there are all two-story buildings on both sides, gray tiles and white walls, and red paint facades, one room after another, stretching forward, using the place names left by the market of that year, such as bamboo shed roots, firewood fields, etc. There is also a small manhole in the village. The well water is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a hint of sweetness. Although there is tap water in the village, the villagers still like to eat the water from the small manhole.
attractions.shortFeatures: The old street maintains the style of hundreds of years ago

attractions.name: 雪窦山
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains; Temples
attractions.summary:
National 5A-level scenic spot, famous for its shanshui, ancient temples and valley waterfalls, was known as "Penglai on the Sea" as early as the Han Dynasty.  
Scenic spots include Xuedou Mountain, Xuedou Temple, one of the ten Zen temples in the world, and the tallest sitting bronze open-air statue of Maitreya Buddha in the world. 
Standing on the observation deck of Qianzhangyan Waterfall, you can see lush trees, which is a veritable natural oxygen bar.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy streams and waterfalls and attend the Maitreya Buddha

attractions.name: 人间弥勒(雪窦寺)
attractions.summary: The Xuedou Mountain Giant Buddha Scenic Area, also known as Xuedou Temple, is the Maitreya Dojo at the foot of Xuedou Mountain. The temple is relatively new and has a large scale. The huge open-air Maitreya Buddha statue in the temple can be regarded as a prominent landmark in the Xikou Scenic Area, and many places can be seen from afar. Walking in front of the Buddha and embracing his feet to experience good fortune is also a favored experience for tourists and pilgrims. Apart from the open-air Maitreya Temple, there are no special landscapes that cannot be missed in Xuedou Temple. You just need to relax and take a stroll in it, and you will enjoy it very much. You can buy tickets to visit Xuedou Temple alone, but most tourists will directly purchase a package ticket for Xuedou Mountain Scenic Area, along with the scenic spots such as Miaogao Platform and Qianzhang Rock on Xuedou Mountain. This not only provides a richer experience, but also a more reasonable route and more cost-effective price. Miaoxiangzhai is the vegetarian restaurant of Xuedou Temple, and tourists can also come here for meals. We had a buffet, and you can add your own after finishing.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 08:30-16:30(Tickets available until 15:00; admission ends at 15:00)

attractions.name: 千丈岩
attractions.summary:
Qianzhangyan is a famous resort in Xuedou Mountain Scenic Area since ancient times. Qianzhangyan Waterfall, with a drop of 186 meters, is famous for its magnificence and grandeur. Zhao Heng, emperor Zhenzong of the Northern Song Dynasty, once named it "Dongzhe Waterfall". Standing on the Flying Snow Pavilion, you can see the waterfall plummeting down the cliff in front of you. The three characters "Qianzhangyan" in the rock wall were written by Mr. Huang Qi, vice chairman of Chinese Calligraphers Association, and carved in 1992. 
Feixue Pavilion has been the best place to watch Qianzhangyan Waterfall since ancient times. Because the water of Qianzhangyan Waterfall is like flying snow, it was called Flying Snow Waterfall in ancient times, so this pavilion was named Flying Snow Pavilion.
attractions.shortFeatures: View spectacular waterfalls

attractions.name: 三隐潭
attractions.summary: The scenery integrates peaks, caves, pools and streams, which is particularly beautiful. Sanyintan is divided into upper, middle and lower pools. The water of the hidden pool jumped out from the three cliffs and turned into three waterfalls. There was a pool under the waterfall, which was faint and bottomless. There are two boulders standing on the flowing water of the upper hidden pool, steep walls and deep valleys, moss mottled on the rocks, and pines standing on the edge of the ditch. A stone bridge was built on the pool, and the waterfall poured down the cliff. The flowing water was in the shape of lines. The water hit the two cliffs and echoed loudly. On the bridge at the bottom of the valley, fog filled the air and the water mist evaporated, giving people a cool feeling. The stones in the middle hidden pond are vertical and horizontal, with strange ups and downs. The flowing water circles the stones, circles and twists, and rushes out of the rock formation through thousands of difficulties and dangers. Then, in one go, it sprayed out of the cliff mouth and refracted to the east, forming an elegant waterfall. The mountain wind blew water foam and splashed in all directions. It was impossible to tell whether it was fog or rain, and it was poetic and picturesque. There are piles of huge stones in the lower hidden pond, overlapping each other, and the large and small stones are piled up for more than ten square meters. Among them, there is a stalagmite peak, which is more than 20 meters high. The stalagmite peak is on the pool, and the deep pool is at the bottom of the peak, revealing half.
attractions.shortFeatures: The pool water poured down to form a three-level waterfall

attractions.name: 妙高台
attractions.summary: Miaogaotai, also known as Miaofeng Peak and Tianzhu Peak, is the main landscape in Xuedou Mountain Scenic Area. Although the altitude is only 396 meters, it is backed by mountains, raised in the middle, cliffs on three sides, and faces an abyss. The terrain is very steep. Miaogao Terrace in a narrow sense refers to a platform with an area of about 350 square meters. Standing at the front of the platform, you can watch the natural scenery of the lake under the pavilion. Miaogaotai is a thoughtful summer resort with dense ancient trees, green bamboos blocking the sun and cool breeze.
attractions.shortFeatures: Cliff abyss, climb high to enjoy lakes and mountains

attractions.name: 蒋氏故居
attractions.name_en: Former Residence of the Jiang Family
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings
attractions.summary:
The former residences of Chiang Kai-shek and Jiang Jingguo, the fourth batch of national key cultural relics protection units, important historical sites and representative buildings in modern times. 
The former residence is a group building, which includes Fenggao House, Small House, Yutai Salt Shop, etc. The bureau is a traditional front hall and back hall, with two hatchbacks and four halls. 
The building is connected with the building, with ink pillars and ochre walls, which is magnificent. There are three gardens in the front hall and left and right, and there are also Jiang's ancestral hall and Jiang's mother's cemetery in the garden. 
The corridor of the hall is covered with carved colorful paintings, and there are plaques written by Chiang Kai-shek in the newspaper hall, "Newspaper respects relatives is the moral important way" and "Being reasonable and handsome".
attractions.shortFeatures: Visiting the footprints of Jiang Gong and his family
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 武岭门
attractions.summary: Wuling Gate, located in Xikou Town, Fenghua, Zhejiang Province, is away from Wuling Ridge, the gateway of the ancient town. The original site of Wuling Temple is Wuling Temple, with a tea pavilion. In 1929, the antique tower was demolished and built, with three rooms on two floors and cornices. Before 1929, it was a small nunnery. In 1930, Chiang Kai-shek converted it into three two-story Wuguan-style gate buildings. The inscription "Wuling" is engraved on both sides of the door, and the front is written by Yu Youren, a Kuomintang veteran and famous calligrapher. The back is handwritten by Chiang Kai-shek. In April 2007, it was announced by Fenghua Municipal People's Government as the fifth batch of municipal cultural relics protection units.
attractions.shortFeatures: Wuguan-style city gate building

attractions.name: 文昌阁(武岭西路)
attractions.summary: Due to its geographical advantage, Wenchang Pavilion has become a scenic spot in Xikou Town. It is located at the southern end of Wushan, on the bank of Shanxi River, overlooking the southern mountains of the river, overlooking a three mile long street, and facing the wind on all sides, creating a beautiful scenery. The Wenchang Pavilion was first built in the ninth year of the Yongzheng reign of the Qing Dynasty (1731). Due to the worship of the first Kui star inside the pavilion, it is also known as the "Kui Pavilion" and is known as the "Kui Pavilion Lingxiao". It is one of the ten scenic spots in Xikou during the Qing Dynasty.

attractions.name: 丰镐房
attractions.summary: Fenggaofang, the former residence of Jiang's family, is the most important cultural landscape in Xikou Town. Fenggaofang, also known as Suju, is named because the Jiang family believed in Buddhism and ate vegetarianism for generations. Fenghao House covers an area of 4,800 square meters, with a building area of 1,850 square meters. The architectural pattern is the front hall and the back hall, two hatchbacks and four corridors, which is a traditional family mansion pattern. There are also three gardens in the front hall and left and right, which are connected by the moon cave gate. There is a small patio in the middle, with a gold and silver osmanthus on both sides, which was planted by Song Meiling himself. There are also three highlights in Fenggao House, namely carving, colorful painting and stacking sculptures. Entering the front hall, you can see the pile of plastics in the middle of the roof, with "Fu Lu Shou Samsung Gao Zhao" in the middle and "Double Dragons Playing Pearls" on both sides. The Baobentang, where Chiang Kai-shek worships ancestors and worships heaven, is the core of the whole building of Fenggaofang.
attractions.shortFeatures: Explore Jiang's former residence and enjoy wood carvings and colorful paintings

attractions.name: 溪口滕头旅游景区-玉泰盐铺
attractions.summary: Yutai Salt Shop was established by Jiang Siqian in 1871 and later inherited by Jiang Zhaocong.
