After Jiang Zhaocong's death, his brothers separated and the salt shop was managed by Jiang Jieqing. In 1919, Jiang Jieqing went out to seek trouble and the salt shop was closed. There are currently three buildings, three bungalows, and ancillary buildings such as kitchens and toilets.

attractions.name: 丹山赤水
attractions.tag: Climbing high and hiking in the mountains; admiring the autumn leaves.
attractions.summary: Dan Mountain and Chishui are located in Siming Mountain. From a high vantage point, one can enjoy a panoramic view of Siming Mountain. Not only can you breathe in the fresh air, but you can also experience life in the mountains and the charm of rural homesteads. The cliffs, strange rocks, ancient bridges, flowing streams, and waterfalls are the main attractions here. With the blend of Taoist culture and the well-preserved ancient mountain village style of Eastern Zhejiang, the scenery is breathtaking.
attractions.shortFeatures: The old house made of stone.

attractions.name: 四明湖
attractions.tag: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves; Lakes
attractions.summary: Siming Lake is located in Liangnong Town, Yuyao City, in the north of Siming Mountain, more than 10 kilometers away from the urban area. It has beautiful scenery, rippling blue waves, lakes and mountains complement each other, and the lake area is nearly 20 square kilometers. Siming Lake collects streams, springs and waterfalls, with a volume of about 120 million cubic meters, irrigating 300,000 mu of fertile land in the northwest of Yuyao. The lake is rich in fishery resources and attracts a large number of birds. There are Bazi Bridge, Wildcat Bay, Dingshan, etc. in the lake, forming five islands in the center of the lake, which are like emeralds embedded in a mirror, adding to the charm of Siming Lake. Yutu Island in the center of the lake is the largest island in Siming Lake, covering an area of about 270 mu. Its shape resembles a jade rabbit, especially on the night of the moon. Overlooking from the lake, it looks like a jade rabbit worshipping the moon. There are pines and bamboos on the island, orchards and tea gardens all over the mountains and plains, and winding mountain paths, wandering, simple and quiet, which makes people feel refreshing and happy.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through the quaint and quiet Yutu Island

attractions.name: 四明湖水杉
attractions.summary: The Siming Lake Water Cedar Wetland is located by the tranquil Siming Lake, where large areas of water spruce trees grow with straight and upright trunks, rising from the ground. They are neatly arranged, standing quietly in the water or on the shore. Every autumn, the leaves turn golden yellow or orange red, which looks very beautiful from afar and is also a great place to enjoy autumn. It is also known as the "Little Xinjiang" of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shanghai. Full text 

attractions.name: 浙东小九寨
attractions.tag: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Military Sites
attractions.summary: Xiaojiuzhai in East Zhejiang Province is located at the northern foot of Siming Mountain, in Zhilin Village, Dayin Town, Yuyao. The territory has continuous mountains, winding mountains, abundant bamboo forests, criss-crossing streams, valleys, streams, ancient trees and bamboo forests, and attractive scenery, so it is known as Xiaojiuzhai in eastern Zhejiang. Xiaojiuzhai is named after the stream.
attractions.shortFeatures: Looking for red footprints and enjoying a cool summer

attractions.name: 慈城古县城
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Cicheng Ancient County is located in the northern suburbs of Ningbo. The city retains the layout of the county town and a large number of Ming and Qing Dynasty ancient buildings. Walking around the city, you can see quaint courtyards everywhere, and occasionally large mansions and deep courtyards. It is a comfortable and quiet ancient city. Don't miss out on the high-quality and affordable specialty snacks here, among which Cicheng Nian Gao, which has been featured on CCTV, is more famous. Entering Guxian City from the tourist center on the east side, you will first pass by Feng Yu's residence. The poem "The Wanderer's Song" displayed outside the ancient residence straightforwardly reveals that Cicheng is the hometown of filial piety. The Feng Yu Mansion is also one of the large-scale and well preserved ancient architectural complexes in Ningbo, with exhibitions such as the Seat Culture Exhibition, Huishan Clay Figure Exhibition, Jingdezhen Blue and White Porcelain Exhibition, etc. It is worth visiting the buildings of the Feng Yu Mansion alone. The Jinjiajing Lane on the west side of Feng Yu's residence, from east to west, is home to the Buzhengfang, Fuzi Mentou, and Jiadi Shijia, all of which are typical Ming and Qing architecture. Turning south to Zhuxiang East Road, you can see the Lingxing Gate of the Confucian Temple. It is the only well preserved Confucian temple in eastern Zhejiang, with some ancestral halls and inscriptions, where you can experience the Confucian atmosphere. Going north along Jiefang Road, at the end is the Cicheng Ancient County Government Office. The ancient county government office is very large and has now been integrated into the Qingfeng Garden Scenic Area. Inside, wax figures have been used to restore the original scene of the county government office. What leaves a deep impression on people is a copper coin shaped gate, which gives them a feeling of "entering the eyes of money" when entering. Inside are statues of corrupt officials from various dynasties and three guillotine knives of dragons, tigers, and dogs, which are gloomy and intimidating. The Chenghuang Temple on the west side of the county government is an interesting place in the whole ancient county. There is a Cicheng Rice Cake Shop inside, which not only displays the production process of rice cakes with physical objects and pictures, but also offers a taste of Cicheng Rice Cake that has been featured on CCTV programs if you are hungry. Walking to the north of Guxian City is Cihu Lake, with water tombs, Dong Xiaozi Well, Shigu Pavilion and other landscapes along the lake. To the east of the lake, there is an exhibition about the imperial examination system at the School Scholar Hall. The scenery along the lake is great, you can take a nap here for a while. The Zoumalou Restaurant and Baoshantang Bar by the lake have antique architecture, where you can go eat something and also visit the buildings. There are also many snacks and noodle shops on the street for dining. On your return journey, you will go south along the Taihu Lake Road and pass by the gate of Feng Yue's painting platform. The mother's art exhibition here can visit and experience needlework art such as Chinese knots and Paper Cuttings. Going south along the moat outside the city, you can reach the Qingdao Temple. This scenic spot is slightly further away, on a small hill where you can climb up and enjoy the scenery. Those interested in Taoism can come and take a look. Full text 

attractions.name: 天一阁博物院
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; hidden gem for kids; Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the city of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, it is the oldest existing private library in China, as well as the oldest library in Asia and one of the world's earliest family libraries.
- Built in the mid-Ming Dynasty, it was overseen by Fan Qin, a retired Deputy Minister of the Ministry of War. Many exhibition halls display books collected by the Fan family from all corners of the world.
- The architecture combines various traditional folk crafts such as wood carving, brick carving, stone carving, gilding, and embossing, making it a masterpiece of Ningbo's residential architecture.
- Inside the Tianyi Pavilion, there is also an interesting Mahjong Museum, which has become a popular spot for many to take photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ancient private library.

attractions.name: 月湖公园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; autumn leaf viewing; City Parks
attractions.summary:
The park is centered around Moon Lake, with over sixty sculptures scattered along the shore, themed around the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The lakeside is divided into four seasonal docks, each with its own unique scenery.  
The spring shore is made up of the Water Curtain Bridge, a limestone cave, and a water stage. The restroom inside the limestone cave is quite interesting, resembling a cave, with faucets designed like stalactites.  
The autumn shore is a vast lawn with buildings like the Autumn Moon Pavilion Restaurant and the Moon Lake Art Museum. The museum regularly hosts art exhibitions, including painting exhibitions, art displays, and large-scale car shows, showcasing award-winning artworks from both domestic and international artists.  
The park offers a shuttle that circulates every fifteen minutes between the four seasonal dock stations. There are also restaurants and cafés in the park, where one can sit and enjoy a cup of coffee while admiring the view outside the window.
attractions.shortFeatures: Strolling through the city's green lungs and visiting the vintage mansion.

attractions.name: 宁波府城隍庙
attractions.summary: Chenghuang Temple, also known as Ningbo County Temple, is an old business center in the center of Ningbo. There are always bustling tourists here. Whether it's Ningbo Duck and Dog rice dumpling or local snacks, it's not difficult to find it here. It's a good place for tourists to experience the folk customs of Ningbo. The scale of Chenghuang Temple in Ningbo is one of the best in China. Thousands of shops gather here. You can always find your favorite gadget while eating. The Tianfeng Pagoda in the south of Chenghuang Temple is the symbol of this area. You can climb the pagoda to look far and overlook the busy city scenery of Ningbo. Not far to the north of Chenghuang Temple is Tianyi Square, which is a new business district in Ningbo, with a more modern shopping environment. The Moon Lake Park to the west is a peaceful scenic area in the city center, where you can stroll along the lake and enjoy the pavilions and gardens, which is very pleasant. Full text 

attractions.name: 宁波鼓楼
attractions.summary: Drum Tower, also known as Haishu Tower, is the only remaining ancient city tower site in Ningbo city. Its lower part is in the traditional Chinese style of a city tower, while above it is a Roman style bell tower, with a unique blend of Chinese and Western styles. Nowadays, the area around Gulou is an antique pedestrian shopping district, and Ningbo specialty snacks such as Youzan Zi are worth trying. Nowadays, the Drum Tower and the surrounding Park Road area have become the gathering places for major cultural activities in Ningbo. Art exhibitions, calligraphy exhibitions, and photo exhibitions are often held inside the tower. On both sides of the road are shops imitating the traditional architectural style of Ningbo, with small blue tile double slope roofs, wind and fire horse head walls, and various exquisite exterior wood decorations, which not only have the style of Ningbo's traditional commercial street, but also have a strong historical and cultural texture. The two ancient stone memorial archway at the entrance of the east and west ends, the ruins of the city wall, the stone monument of Zicheng's historical changes, and the Yongfengku Site Park near the Drum Tower can provide you with a detailed reading of Ningbo's history. At night, the Drum Tower area is very popular, and when the landscape lights are on, it is particularly suitable for taking night shots.

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆西馆
attractions.summary: Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Full text 

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 太平老街
attractions.summary: Taiping Street is located in the southern part of the old urban area of Changsha City, with Taiping Street as the main line. It stretches north to Wuyi Avenue, south to Jiefang Road, west to Weiguo Street, and east to Sanxing Street and Santai Street. This is a cultural district with a long history, featuring historical sites such as Jia Yi's former residence, Changhuaijing, and the west archway of Mingjifan's mansion. There are also some old houses with blue tiles and white walls, where you can find the shadow of old Changsha. Nowadays, there are numerous shops lining Taiping Street, and visitors flock to it, creating a lively atmosphere. This is also a food street in Changsha stinky tofu. It is worth tasting whether it is a century old shop or a newly emerging specialty shop. The food you can't miss is local snacks such as Changsha stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, and flavored shrimp.

attractions.name: 橘子洲
attractions.tag: The Best Places to Take Kids for a Walk; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Orange Isle is a sandbank in the Xiang River, surrounded by water and stretching for several miles. It is a national key scenic area.  
· The scenic area features historical and cultural exhibition halls, a Xiaoxiang Celebrities Club, an orange culture park, and other attractions, offering a combination of sightseeing, leisure, and entertainment.  
· During certain periods, the fireworks on Orange Isle are a visual feast that should not be missed.  
· A giant white marble monument in the center of the park has the inscription "Orange Isle Head" written by Mao Zedong on the front, and the full text of *Qinyuan Spring · Changsha* on the back.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Xiang River flows north, at the tip of Orange Isle.

attractions.name: 湘江游轮
attractions.summary: Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. Not only can you have a panoramic view of the mountains, waters, islands, and city of Changsha, but you can also appreciate the different effects of urban landscapes with different styles as the direction of the boat changes. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

attractions.name: 华谊兄弟(长沙)电影小镇
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Film and TV studio base; Film Studios; Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: The town is located within the Changsha Xiangjiang New District Dawangshan Tourism Resort. The first phase of the project is the Italian town, which consists of Venice, the Water City, and Assisi, the Mountain City. It integrates scenes from Huayi Film and TV, blending the urban characteristics and architectural style of an Italian town. The buildings and roads in the area are mainly arranged in a linear layout, and the planning utilizes the existing natural terrain to reshape the mountainous geography of the site, thereby creating the classic appearance of an Italian town. The area also features Italian-style dining, handicrafts, tourist products, and traditional workshops, offering an interactive experience with a pure Italian style.
attractions.shortFeatures: Comprehensive cultural and tourism scenic area with a film theme

restaurants.name_en: Modern Gloria Hotel Golden Truffle Method Restaurant

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 南京市博物馆(朝天宫)
attractions.summary: Chaotian Palace was a Confucian temple in the Qing Dynasty. The entire architectural complex includes Jiangning Prefectural School, Chaotian Palace, and the Nanjing Museum, which was converted from several main halls of Chaotian Palace. Currently, Jiangning Prefectural School is the Jiangsu Kunqu Opera House, which can only be viewed from the outside. The only places that tourists can visit inside are Chaotian Palace and Nanjing Museum. The history of Chaotian Palace can be traced back to the Spring and Autumn Period. Wu King Fuchai melted iron and forged swords here, and the history of building a Confucian temple can be traced back to the Northern Song Dynasty. In the Ming Dynasty, it was named Chaotian Palace and was a place for the royal family to worship Taoist gods and learn the etiquette of meeting the emperor. Later, it was destroyed in war. In the fifth to ninth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1866-1870 AD), it was rebuilt on the original basis and became a Confucian temple. Jiangning Prefectural School also moved from Jiming Mountain here. The Chaotian Palace is adjacent to the artificial canal "Yundu" in the south, surrounded by "Wanren Palace Wall", with a pan pool in the wall, and on the east and west sides are the memorial archway of "Depai Tiandi" and "Daoguan Ancient and Modern" respectively. The main buildings, from southeast to northwest, are Lingxing Gate, Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, and Chongsheng Hall. The roof is covered with yellow glazed tiles, and the four pairs of dragon statues under Lingxing Gate are lifelike. In front of Dacheng Gate stands a statue of Confucius. Behind the Chongsheng Hall is the back garden, near the Feiyun Pavilion on the east is the Qianlong Imperial Stele Pavilion, and the Jingyi Pavilion on the west is the highest point of Yeshan. On one side of the Chongsheng Hall of Nanjing Museum is the main exhibition hall of Nanjing Museum, which mainly displays the basic exhibition "Dragon and Tiger Dwelling - Nanjing Urban History Exhibition". The exhibits are arranged in chronological order, with the first layer featuring exhibits from ancient times to the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the second layer featuring exhibits from the Republican era. On the third floor is the "Yutang Exquisite Artifacts - Exhibition of Fine Treasures in the Collection". The "Treasure of the Town Hall" blue and white plum vase from the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties is located here, with the exquisite painting "Xiao He Chases Han Xin under the Moon" on the vase. The Nanjing Museum has designated the Dacheng Hall and Chongsheng Hall as special and temporary exhibition halls, and any exhibitions currently being held at the Chaotian Palace will be displayed on signs at the entrance. The venues for special and temporary exhibitions may change from time to time. For specific locations, please call the scenic area management department at 025-84200177.

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

attractions.name: 灵谷寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 陵园路
attractions.summary: Lingyuan Road is located at the southern foot of Zijin Mountain. It was built in 1929. There are French wutong trees on both sides of the road. At the end of the 20th century, Queen Elizabeth II of England praised this road: 'Heaven above, Suzhou and Hangzhou below, and a green corridor in Nanjing', referring to this road.

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 栖霞山名胜风景区-红叶谷
attractions.summary: Hongye Valley is located at the junction of the Imperial Garden and the southwest slope of Fengxiang Peak. Due to the lack of human intervention for many years and the erosion of mountains and rivers, the exposed rocks here showcase a landscape of cliff melting and strange rocks, while the rest are dense forests and wetlands. The unique climate environment makes the rocks here rugged, ancient maple trees stand tall, and ancient vines entangle. The construction of this scenic spot fully considers the harmonious combination of landforms, water bodies, plants, facilities, etc., pays attention to the restoration of the ecological functions of Qixia Mountain, continuously beautifies, optimizes, and colors the environment, and draws water to build ponds to improve the ecological environment of the area. Hongye Valley covers an area of about 50000 square meters, with beautiful natural scenery and unique rocks and red leaves. It is a new red leaf viewing area that integrates mountains, rocks, water, forests, and pavilions.

attractions.name: 栖霞山名胜风景区-明镜湖
attractions.summary: Mingjing Lake, located within Qixia Mountain, is naturally formed, with peach blossom streams and mid peak streams flowing down into the lake. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the lake area here was larger than it is now. Water lilies and lotus flowers were widely planted in the lake. At that time, willows and maple trees on the shore complemented each other, and it was often a place for literati to drink and write poetry. In 1751, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty came to Qixia Mountain on his first southern tour. When he saw the scenery of Mingjing Lake, he immediately wrote "Seven Wonders, Mingjing Lake" with his brush and ink; Rainbow is not sunshine, mirror is not copper. The bends of the creek and the bridge are intertwined. Xi Biming distinguishes between truth and falsehood, using his false illusions to cover up the vacuum. The stone Guanyin Bodhisattva, several meters high in the lake, smiles kindly at all beings in the world. A rainbow pavilion is built in the center of the lake, and a rainbow like curved bridge runs through it. The lake water is clear and transparent, just like a mirror; Ripples suddenly rise, and waves of light float. The red leaves around are reflected inside, beautiful beyond measure.

attractions.name: 栖霞寺
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
Sheshan Qixia Temple is located on Qixia Mountain in the northeast of Nanjing. It is one of the four famous temples in China and the birthplace of the "Three Theories" of Jiangnan Buddhism. Qixia Temple is not only large in scale and magnificent in style, but also the best scenery in Nanjing. It is also famous for its important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Qixia Temple Feng covers an area of more than 40 mu, and there are three courtyards of Pilu Temple Tibetan Sutra Building, which rise layer by layer according to the mountain, and the pattern is neat and beautiful. Main attractions: Stupa The Qixia Temple Stupa is a relic of the Southern Tang Dynasty. It is one of the oldest stone pagodas south of the Yangtze River and the largest stupa in my country. The stone pagoda is eight-angled and five-level, about fifteen meters high. The base is surrounded by a stone railing with a hook line, which is restored for the original objects of the Five Dynasties excavated in modern times. The floor of the base is carved with seawater, dragon, phoenix, fish, shrimp and other figures, and only a part of it remains. The eight phases of Sakyamuni are embossed on all sides of the Sumeru seat under the pagoda. After thousands of years of wind and rain, although some stone eaves have been destroyed, they still stand tall, becoming a witness to the prosperity of Buddha spirit in Jinling. The Great Buddha Pavilion, also known as the Three Holy Temples, is dedicated to the Buddha of Infinite Life and was excavated for Shiyi in the Southern Qi Dynasty. The Buddha statue is 10.8 meters high, and its seat is 13.3 meters high. Guanyin is 11 meters high to stand on the left and right side of the Bodhisattva. The pleated style of the Buddha statue is quite similar to the stone Buddha in Yungang, Datong. The original two Buddhas next to the stupa are more than three meters high, beautiful and elegant, similar to the Longmen Stone Buddha in Luoyang, and are also peerless treasures in the golden age of Chinese Buddhist art. Qianfoyan, known as "Yungang in the south of the Yangtze River", is the only Southern Dynasty grottoes in China. Wuliang Hall Wuliang Hall is the earliest and largest Buddhist shrine in Qianfo Rock. The Buddha of Infinite Life is in the middle, and Guanyin is on both sides. The statue is well-proportioned and the lines are smooth. The fold style of the three Buddhas' clothes is similar to that of Yungang Grottoes, and the excavation date is seventeen years earlier than that of Yungang Grottoes. The statue is exquisite and simple, which can be compared with Datong Longmen. Its value lies in preserving the original rhyme of Buddha statues in the Southern Dynasties, which is especially rare in the south of the Yangtze River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire exquisite stupas and Buddha statues in grottoes

attractions.name: 舍利塔
attractions.summary: The Qixia Temple Pagoda is located to the east of Qixia Temple at the foot of Qixia Mountain in Qixia District, Nanjing City. It is a Buddhist stone pagoda from the Five Dynasties period in China and is the largest pagoda in China.

attractions.name: 外滩
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 翱翔•飞越地平线
attractions.summary: Come on an exciting flight and witness this magical world in an unprecedented way! Embark on the journey of "Soaring and Flying over the Horizon", feel the gentle breeze brushing your face, and fly over the treetops and rooftops. This is definitely a heart warming flying experience. On this magical journey around the world, fully appreciate the beautiful scenery along the way and enjoy the freedom and pleasure of soaring in the sky.

attractions.name: 明日世界
attractions.summary: Tomorrow's world is full of endless possibilities and presents a bright vision for the future. Disney uses various innovative technologies to bring a new look to this park: the new interstellar exploration project "Buzz Lightyear Interstellar Rescue" leads visitors to move forward bravely and surpass infinity; The "jetpack aircraft" allows people to break free from the constraints of gravity; The "Chuangsu Speed Light Wheel" is wrapped under a huge semi transparent dome building, transforming into different colors, attracting tourists to step onto the two wheeled light wheel motorcycle queue and challenge one of the thrilling roller coaster projects in Disney parks around the world. Tourists can also experience two interactive experiences specially designed for Shanghai Disneyland next to "Tomorrow's World" - "Star Wars Expedition Base" and "Marvel Heroes Headquarters".

attractions.name: 梦幻世界(上海迪士尼乐园店)
加勒比海盗——沉落宝藏之战
attractions.name_en: Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure
attractions.summary: Pirates of the Caribbean - The Battle of Fallen Treasures is a heavyweight project in Treasure Cove, telling the story of Captain Jack. Realistic renderings, combined with circular giant screens and cool 3D effects, make people feel as if they are immersed in the real scene of the battle of sunken treasures. In this facility, tourists will also turn into pirates and join Captain Jack's adventure team to explore the treasures hidden by David Jones in the deep sea. Throughout the process, tourists will board a small raft that can accommodate 30 people and cross the battle zone between two pirate fleets. Disney utilizes emerging technology to present the entire naval battle to visitors. Sail and embark on a fun filled sea journey, diving deep into the sea to search for the spoils of war that David Jones has buried beneath - along the way, you will also encounter pirates, mermaids, and even creepy sea monsters. Embark on a journey with the charming pirate, the cunning and charming Captain Jack, and set sail for Treasure Cove!

attractions.name: 探险岛
attractions.summary: Shanghai Disneyland's "Adventure Island" will lead visitors into newly discovered ancient tribes-there are mysterious colors everywhere and hidden treasures. Visitors at the foot of Leiming Mountain can go to the "Monument Exploration Camp" to get out of their own exploration path and prove themselves to be real adventurers; Or travel through time and space in "soaring and flying over the horizon"; You can also board the thrilling raft adventure "Thunder Mountain Rafting" and go deep into the hinterland of "Adventure Island".
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring Ancient Tribes

attractions.name: 米奇大街
attractions.summary: Entering Shanghai Disneyland, the first step is onto Mickey Avenue, which is the first welcoming avenue in the world of Disney parks with Mickey and his companions as the theme. Minnie, Donald Duck, Daisy, Goofy, Pluto and other companions will gather here. This colorful street is divided into four blocks, where you can warmly embrace and take photos with your favorite Disney friends. Among the various shops on the street, the "M Street Shopping Gallery" offers a wide selection of gifts and souvenirs within the amusement park.

attractions.name: 奇梦之光幻影秀
attractions.name_en: Ignite the Dream - A Nighttime Spectacular of Magic and Light
attractions.summary: Mickey will show you the wonderful magic of dreams and the magical power of imagination. Follow him and have a swim! Witness the miracle at the center of Shanghai Disneyland! Mickey opens the door to a brand new adventure, presenting infinite and wonderful worlds one by one before your eyes. Through thrilling projection, laser, fountain, and various other visual effects techniques, Mickey will use his magic to turn the "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle" into a dreamlike new world, while illuminating the dreams in all of us.

attractions.name: 城隍庙旅游区
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions

attractions.name: 南京路步行街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the top ten famous pedestrian streets in China, it is the earliest commercial street established after Shanghai opened as a port. 
· This is the gathering place of department stores, with a complete range of goods, and it is a shopper's paradise. 
Creative urban sculptures can be seen everywhere, and there are a large number of chairs in the middle of the street for tourists to sit, which is full of literary and fashionable atmosphere. 
· On the Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, you can see clangding cars shuttling back and forth like smaller versions of old trams. It has the flavor of old Shanghai, so you might as well experience it.
attractions.shortFeatures: Shanghai's famous commercial pedestrian street

attractions.name: 上海杜莎夫人蜡像馆
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
attractions.summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.

attractions.name: 东方明珠
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spot; Observation deck; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Adjacent to the Huangpu River, facing the Bund across the river, it is one of Shanghai's iconic cultural landmarks.
- A multifunctional complex that integrates urban sightseeing, fashionable dining, shopping, entertainment, historical exhibitions, Huangpu River tours, and conferences and performances. It is one of the first batch of 5A-level tourist attractions in China.
- At 468 meters tall, it has 11 spheres connected from top to bottom. The rotating restaurant located at 267 meters is an excellent spot for a 360° view of Shanghai's nightscape.
- At 259 meters, there is a suspended sightseeing corridor. The passage features a steel structure with glass flooring and walls, offering a panoramic view of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the 360-degree view of Shanghai's landmarks.

attractions.name: 黄浦江
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is known as the "mother river of Shanghai", and Pudong and Puxi use it as a boundary to form important landmarks such as the world-renowned Bund and the Lujiazui Financial Center. Watching the magnificent night view of Pujiang River is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Shanghai. You can also take a cruise on the river and enjoy the scenery on both sides. The Huangpu River, with a total length of about 113 kilometers and a river width of 300 to 700 meters, flows through all districts of Shanghai. It is the symbol and symbol of Shanghai and gathers the essence of Shanghai's urban landscape. The Bund and Binjiang Avenue along the Huangpu River are both excellent tourist attractions, with fewer tourists visiting Binjiang Avenue compared to the Bund. Strolling along the riverbank, the Bund International Architecture Exhibition Complex on the west bank of the Pujiang River, filled with rich exotic colors, stands in sharp contrast to the modern skyscrapers towering into the clouds on the east bank. You can glimpse Shanghai's century long development history from it. The night view of Pujiang is also worth watching. At night, both sides of the Huangpu River are ablaze with lights. You can start from the the 16 Pu on the second Shandong Road in Huangpu District, and take the Pujiang River cruise ship to drive on the river, with a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery along the way. The Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge across the Huangpu River, the classic Garden Bridge of Shanghai like a jade belt, the Pudong Binjiang Avenue with beautiful environment, and the Shanghai International Conference Center with unique shape have formed a beautiful scenery line under the creation of gorgeous lights, which makes people dizzy. The ship offers Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Pujiang while enjoying delicious food. The sailing time of the cruise ship is from 11:00 to 21:30 every day, once every hour from 11:00 to 13:00, and once every half hour from 13:00 to 21:30. The single voyage time is about 60 minutes. If you don't want to spend too much time taking a cruise, taking a ferry between Pudong and Puxi is also an affordable choice to experience the Pujiang style, which is more nostalgic. The ferry runs back and forth from Jinling East Road Ferry Terminal next to the Bund to Dongchang Road Ferry Terminal in Pudong from 7:00-22:00, with a one-way journey of about ten minutes and a departure every 15 minutes. There are also ferries that run between Fuxing East Road Ferry and Dongchang Road Ferry. Fuxing East Road Ferry operates from 7:00-19:00, while Dongchang Road Ferry operates from 7:00-18:45, with one ferry every half hour.

attractions.name: 津湾广场
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Jinwan Square is located beside the Haihe River, opposite Tianjin Station across the Haihe River. It is one of the most prosperous areas in Tianjin. 
The biggest highlight is its cultural heritage. The diverse composition of Tianjin's modern architectural style highlights the characteristics of the times when Chinese and western cultures converge.  
In addition, it is also the best place to enjoy the day and night scenery of Haihe River. The tall buildings backed by it are a bustling modern city, which is gorgeous and charming when lit at night. 
The European buildings around the square and on both sides of the river also constitute the whole landscape, which is one of the iconic viewing spots in Tianjin.
attractions.shortFeatures: The bustling area of Tianjin with charming night scene

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 静园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
Jingyuan, which combines Spanish and Japanese styles, is a typical representative of courtyard-style private mansion in Tianjin Concession period. 
It used to be the residence of Lu Zongyu, the minister of Beiyang government in Japan. Later, the last emperor Puyi lived here with Queen Wanrong and Shu Fei Wenxiu. 
· The noise of the city center is blocked out, only bursts of birdsong, which is very leisurely and suitable for tourists who like history and architecture to meditate and travel slowly. 
Reed flowers bloom in late autumn (October-December) every year, which is an excellent season to watch reed flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of the last emperor Puyi

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 星愿公园
attractions.summary:
"If you are looking for a great place to embrace nature, Star Wish Park with its beautiful Star Wish Lake is not to be missed. Strolling along the walking path of about 2.5 kilometers in this amazing wetland scenery, you can enjoy the different scenery in all seasons of the year, watching flowers in spring and wind in summer, fallen leaves in autumn and snow in winter. You can also rent a bicycle, ride with your family and friends to explore the beautiful woodland, and walk through lush trees. There is beautiful scenery in front of you, surrounded by birds and butterflies. This is the wonder of nature! 
In Star Park, there is also a "Little Dragonfly Garden" where adventurous children can enjoy themselves. It is colorful and interesting, and it is most suitable for the whole family to "explore" nature and enjoy a weekend of leisure sports. When night falls, the Starlight Amphitheater under the night sky stimulates tourists' imagination and creativity. "
attractions.shortFeatures: There are 2500 meters of walking trails inside

attractions.name: 迪士尼小镇
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk
attractions.summary:
Disney Town is part of Shanghai Disney Resort and is adjacent to Shanghai Disneyland, making it a great place for a leisure getaway with friends and family. Continue the magical experience of the park, where you can stroll along Broadway Avenue, taste the international neighborhood style, and buy diverse and high-quality goods from light luxury to fashion in one stop.
