You can also find and taste a variety of world cuisines along the cobblestone streets of Baishixiang Street. On Disney Town Lakefront, you will be surrounded by peaceful beauty of Star Wish Lake, where you can relax your mind and enjoy the tranquility with family and friends. The beauty of the sparkling lake also makes it an ideal place for romantic moments and anniversaries. Besides, there are wonderful and rich activities in Disney Town all year round, which will bring you infinite surprises. Whether it's band performances with different styles or theme activities with unique Disney characteristics, every trip to Disney Town will be full of pleasure. 
Disney Town is also the back garden for Disney friends to play at leisure. Here, the wonderful magic is continuing; Here, everyone is happy in the moment and inspired by generate; Here, maybe at the next corner, you will encounter something wonderful unexpected.
attractions.shortFeatures: Continue the magical experience of Disneyland

attractions.name: 上海迪士尼度假区
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disney theme park in mainland China. Welcome to an unprecedented magical world. 
The park is divided into seven theme parks: Mickey Street, Fantasy Garden, Fantasy World, Adventure Island, Treasure Bay, Tomorrowland and Disney Pixar Toy Story. 
· The park has the world's largest Disney castle "Fantasy Fairy Tale Castle". Visitors can interact with many Disney friends in the park and experience a unique immersive experience. 
It is recommended to download the official APP of Shanghai Disney Resort in advance, check the park map, waiting time, project and performance time, and receive FP, etc.
attractions.shortFeatures: A dream paradise full of joy and childlike innocence

attractions.name: 汤山温泉
attractions.summary:
The world-famous hot spring sanatorium, the only hot spring in China that has obtained the international double certification of hot spring water quality in Europe and Japan, is known as "a thousand-year holy soup, a healthy paradise". 
The water temperature is 60-65 ℃ all year round, contains a variety of minerals and trace elements, and has certain curative effects on skin diseases and hypertension. 
There are many places to bathe in Tangshan, with uneven grades, forming a comprehensive hot spring town for vacation, recuperation, fitness and entertainment. 
The most recommended local product by local people is "Tangshan Ban Chicken", which is well received in taste and taste.
attractions.shortFeatures: Hot springs well-known at home and abroad

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 南京博物院
attractions.summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda

attractions.name: 南京城墙
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world

attractions.name: 鸡鸣寺
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties

attractions.name: 太平天国历史博物馆(瞻园)
attractions.name_en: The Historical Museum of The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
attractions.tag: Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Zhanyuan, also known as the Great Ming Palace or the First Garden of Jinling, was first built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty. It was originally the palace of Xu Da, a founding hero of the Ming Dynasty. It is a long-standing garden in Nanjing and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Wuxi Jichang Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. Historical background: Zhanyuan has a history of over 600 years. The layout of the whole garden is elegant and exquisite, including ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Taihu Lake Lake stones of the Northern Song Dynasty, quiet buildings, pavilions, rockeries, etc. During Emperor Qianlong's southern tour, he visited here twice and borrowed the imperial name of the garden from Ouyang Xiu's poem "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky". He personally inscribed the plaque "Viewing the Garden". During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, it was still the residence of the Eastern King Yang Xiuqing and the Young Western King Xiao Youhe. Dongzhan Garden is divided into two parts, east and west. The main gate (south gate) is located in the east half, with a large plaque hanging on the gate reading "Jinling First Garden". In the center of the entrance is a half body bronze statue of Hong Xiuquan. The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom History Museum is the main visiting point of Dongzhan Garden, displaying cultural relics such as the Jade Seal of the Heavenly Father, the Golden Crown of the Loyal King, the Great Flag, the Sword, and the Stone Trough. Xizhan Garden can be reached through Shuiyuan, which is a typical Jiangnan garden. The ancient buildings in the park include the Viewing Pavilion, Flower Basket Hall, Zhishuang Pavilion, Yingcui Pavilion, and winding corridors. These buildings and corridors divide the Xizhan Garden into five small courtyards and a main garden, with rockeries being the main scenery and backbone of the entire garden. There are rockeries in the south, north, and west, each exquisitely crafted. The central part of the main garden is Jingmiao Hall, surrounded by water on three sides and by land on one side. The "Tiger" stone tablet on the right wall at the entrance of the Guanyu Pavilion is said to have been bestowed upon the tiger general Xu Da by Zhu Yuanzhang. It stands upright like a tiger, howling loudly in the sky. Upon closer examination, one can discern the four characters "the richest in the world", making it the "number one tiger in the world". The copper pavilion and the other miracle in the the Taihu Lake Shizhan Garden, the copper pavilion (namely the fan pavilion), are the world's earlier heating equipment (equivalent to air conditioning buildings). In addition, there are also two the Taihu Lake Lake stones in the garden. The Immortal Peak is in the garden behind the south gate, and it stands in a beautiful place; Leaning against the cloud peak in the southeast corner of the flower basket hall, amidst the osmanthus bushes, it stands out with a sudden and graceful charm. Full text 

attractions.name: 大报恩寺遗址景区
attractions.name_en: The Site of the Great Bao'en Temple
attractions.tag: Historic sites; Night sightseeing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
attractions.shortFeatures: Exploring the magical place of Jinling's history.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-19:30(Tickets available until 19:00; admission ends at 19:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 成都极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Chengdu Polar Ocean Park is a national AAAA level scenic spot with 14 polar marine animal venues, 7 classic performances, various themed amusement areas, and 50+year-round colorful activities waiting for you to unlock the full official guide. Continue reading! The cute and adorable white whale, with a gentle and dignified appearance, instantly reveals its mischievous nature when it sees a child. The cool and cool dolphin transforms into a smiling angel, melting you with a smile, and its affinity is explosive! More than 20 types of jellyfish, showcasing unique beauty. Just snap a picture, it's all beyond imagination! The silly polar bear, elegant Arctic fox, and domineering Arctic wolf, together with the "Three Hegemons of the Arctic" mighty sharks and cute rays, collide in the shark house to create wonderful fun. There are also seals, sea lions, sea turtles... waiting for you to tease the Whale and Dolphin Alliance, the love of beluga whales, and the legend of mermaids one by one... Let you have fun in the ocean and dream. The Sea Lion Games will take you to witness the "superpowers" of the Sea Lion family. In summer, you can also experience float parades and water play carnival, wet body waves, and have fun playing on the cute pet planet. The cute little pandas, emotionally stable water dolphins, ostriches, alpacas, groundhogs... Come and say hello to them! Sea King Amusement Park Carousel, Pirate Ship... Screaming, exciting, fairy tale, one click unlock multiple experiences of Leqi Ice and Snow Park -10 ℃ environment, instantly crossing the winter of the North, there are also thirty sets of cute ice sculptures, lifelike full text 

attractions.name: 环球中心海洋乐园
attractions.summary: The Global Center Ocean Park has a construction area of 250000 square meters. The 8500 square meter large wave making pool in the park transforms into an ocean ball park, with millions of orange and white ocean balls merging into a joyful and vibrant orange ocean; There are also fun activities such as rainbow slides, jumping clouds, inflatable castles, large slides, trampoline parks, etc., to meet the needs of tourists of different ages. Full text 

attractions.name: 杜甫草堂
attractions.tag: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; Former residences of celebrities.
attractions.summary: In the past, there was a small path in front of Du Fu's thatched cottage, lined with flowers and trees. He once wrote in his poem: "The flower path has never been swept for guests, the humble door is now opened for you." Today’s flower path is a red-walled alley connecting the Du Fu Thatched Cottage Memorial Hall and the original Caotang Temple. At the end of the flower path stands the "Caotang Screen Wall," where the characters "Caotang" were inlaid with blue-and-white porcelain shards by Zhou Shanpei, the Governor of Sichuan’s Quanye Dao during the late Qing Dynasty. These characters have been damaged and repaired several times. When Chairman Mao visited the cottage in 1958, he gazed at these two characters for a long time. As one of the symbols of the cottage, many visitors stop here to take photos as a memento.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit Du Fu's Former Residence and Experience the Cultural Sacred Site

attractions.name: 武侯祠
attractions.tag: English: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Memorial Temples
attractions.summary:
- It commemorates Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of the Shu Kingdom, and was incorporated into the Temple of Han Zhao Lie in the early Ming Dynasty. It is also the largest Three Kingdoms relic museum in the country.
- It consists of three parts: Hui Tomb, Temple of Han Zhao Lie, and Wuhou Shrine. The shrine houses 50 statues of Shu-Han heroes, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang.
- The main gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, corridor, Zhuge Liang Hall, and Three Heroes Temple are arranged along a central axis from south to north.
attractions.shortFeatures: Worship Zhuge Liang and Liu Bei, appreciating the Three Kingdoms culture

attractions.name: 锦里古街
attractions.summary: Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

attractions.name: 成都市人民公园
attractions.summary: The park was founded in 1911 and is now a leisure destination for locals to drink tea, chat, and play cards. You can experience the happy "slow life" of Chengdu people here. You can order a cup of tea, read a book, bask in the sun and daydream in the tea house in the park. The original name of the park was Shaocheng Park, which was originally the "Eight Banners and Full City" of the Qing Dynasty, used for the residence of Manchus and Mongolians. In the third year of the Xuantong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1911), General Yukun stationed in Chengdu abolished the system of supplying banner residents and built a park. Nowadays, there are attractions such as Plum Garden, Haitang Garden, and large rockeries in the park, making it a place for locals to relax and have fun. Come here to drink tea, play cards, set up a dragon gate formation, chat, and enjoy the leisurely slow life of the leisure capital. Full text 

attractions.name: 宽窄巷子
attractions.summary: Kuanzhai Alley is the only ancient street left over from the Qing Dynasty in Chengdu, consisting of three parallel old urban streets - Kuanzhai Alley, Kuanzhai Alley, and Jingzhai Alley, as well as a courtyard community between them. Come here, drink tea, eat hotpot, and experience the leisurely, slow, and new life of Chengdu. You can order a cup of Mengshan Huangya here and set up a dragon gate formation with the old man next to you; You can also call yourself 'Shu'er Lang' and enjoy the pleasure of digging your ears comfortably; You can also enjoy a wide variety of snacks at the snack stall. The Kuanzhai Alley under the night sky also has its own charm. Bars such as Dianzui, Baiye, and Huli are full of Chengdu's fashion sense, blooming its charm at night. Full text 

attractions.name: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
attractions.name_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
attractions.tag: Mengmeng Animals; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
attractions.summary:
- The Giant Panda Breeding and Research Center fully simulates the natural habitat of the giant panda, featuring lakes, streams, bamboo forests, and lawns. It houses more than 100 giant pandas.
- Near the main entrance, there is a Giant Panda Museum, where you can send postcards stamped with panda-themed postmarks from the Panda Country Post Office, and watch documentaries about giant pandas at the cinema.
- In addition to giant pandas, you can also see other animals like the black-necked crane, peacock, and heron. The Sun and Moon Nurseries house the cutest, newly born and a few months old panda cubs, which are extremely adorable. Highly recommended!
attractions.shortFeatures: The adorable national treasure is waiting for you.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 金沙遗址博物馆
attractions.tag: Exploration Exhibition Hall; Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
- The Jinsha Site is a relic from the Shang and Zhou Dynasties, with the densest collection of ivory and the richest number of gold and jade artifacts from the same period in the world.
- The most famous item is the "Sun Bird" gold foil in the fourth exhibition hall, which has been designated as the symbol of Chinese cultural heritage and the main logo of Chengdu's city image.
- Here, visitors can pay to enjoy the 4D movie "Dream Back to Jinsha."
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the mysterious Sun God Bird.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 成都太古里
attractions.summary: Chengdu Taikoo Li is a large open style shopping center located in Jinjiang District, Chengdu. It combines modern commerce with traditional culture and is renowned for its unique architectural style and rich brand selection. This is not only a paradise for shopping, but also a great place to experience slow life in Chengdu.

attractions.name: 成都IFS国际金融中心
attractions.summary: The Chengdu IFS International Financial Center is a landmark building in Chengdu, integrating shopping, dining, entertainment, and office functions. It boasts numerous internationally renowned brands and high-end dining options, making it a popular destination for leisure and shopping among Chengdu residents and tourists.

attractions.name: 周庄
attractions.tag: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.

attractions.name: 双桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Shuangqiao is composed of Shide Bridge and Yongan Bridge. It was built in the Ming Dynasty. The two bridges are connected and look like ancient keys, also known as key bridges. 
The special significance here is that the reflection through the lake forms a standard circle with the bridge itself, which is very distinctive. 
Shuangqiao can best reflect the charm of the ancient town. Chen Yifei created an oil painting titled Memories of Hometown with Shuangqiao as the background. 
Although the commercial development is serious and there are many people here, the flowing water and ancient buildings in the south of the Yangtze River have been preserved.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful ancient bridge is a landmark of Zhouzhuang

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 东方之门
attractions.name_en: Gate to the East Exhibition Center
attractions.summary:
Oriental Gate is regarded as a skyscraper on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou, with a total height of about 301.8 meters. The Oriental Gate is divided into two parts: the South Building and the North Building. Its external shape is a door, and it is known as "the first door in the world". This landmark building is adjacent to Jinji Lake in the east and International Building and Century Financial Building in the west. It is not only a new gate for Suzhou, but also a new gate for the world to look at China. 
This 88-story building was completed in 2013, surpassing Suzhou Xindi Center to become the tallest building in Suzhou. Oriental Gate includes commercial, hotel, office buildings and other services, creating a new urban hotspot for Suzhou with commercial prosperity and driving the prosperity of CDB area. 
Jinji Lake at night is very vibrant. Moonlight Pier, Water Curtain Movie, Ligongdi and Suzhou Paradise light up the shores of Jinji Lake, and the majestic and elegant Oriental Gate is also one of the major landscapes.
attractions.shortFeatures: Suzhou Internet celebrity punch-in new landmark

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 盐田海滨栈道
attractions.summary: Yantian Seaside Plank Road starts from the Seaside Plank Road Fitness Square near Zhongying Street, Shatoujiao, Yantian in the east, ends at Beizaijiao, runs through Meisha Beach and OCT in the east, and is known as the world's longest "Seaside Jade Belt". The total length of the road is 19.5 kilometers, and it is officially divided into three thematic sections: urban living shoreline section, industrial port area shoreline section and natural ecological shoreline section. My three sections are: the first section is 7.2 kilometers from Zhongying Street Seaside Fitness Plaza in Sha Tau Kok to Yantian Food Street; The second section is 9.8 kilometers from Yantian Food Street to Dameisha; The third section is the last 3 kilometers from Dameisha to Beizaijiao Beach.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit Dameisha Waterfront Park

attractions.name: 金色海岸游艇
attractions.summary: The Shenzhen Golden Coast Yacht Pier is located on Seafood Street. Tourists can take a yacht to explore magnificent landscapes such as Seafood Street, Yantian Port, Dameisha Seaside Park, Xiaomeisha, Xiashawan Beach, Nanao Fishing Port, Chepingzhou Nature Reserve, Yazhou Island, Ji'ao Island, Shatoujiao, etc. from the sea, and enjoy multiple sea views.

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 地王观光·深港之窗
attractions.summary: The tourist destination for Diwang sightseeing refers to Diwang Building, a well-known landmark in Shenzhen with a total height of 383.95 meters and an actual building height of 324.8 meters. Climbing up to the 69th floor, you can overlook Hong Kong to the south and Shenzhen to the north. Diwang Sightseeing, also known as the Window of Shenzhen and Hong Kong, is a themed high-rise tourist attraction. Accompanied by melodious music, taking the elevator only takes fifty seconds to reach the top floor of the 69th floor of the Diwang Building. The scenic area features novel and exciting multidimensional dynamic movies, documentary digital overlay slides, and fifteen interesting landscapes. Standing at an altitude of over 300 meters, the winding Shenzhen River looks like a giant dragon waiting to take off, and like a gorgeous green ribbon tightly linking Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 20:20; admission ends at 20:30)

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 锦绣中华
attractions.summary:
Splendid China Folk Village itself consists of Splendid China and China Folk Village. Now the two parks have been merged. 
Splendid China mainly looks at miniature scenic spots and takes photos. There are nearly 100 famous scenic spots in China that are reduced at a scale of 1:15. 
Mini versions of the Great Wall, Terracotta Warriors and Horses of Qin Dynasty, Mogao Grottoes in Dunhuang, Huangguoshu Waterfall and other places of interest can be seen here, so there is a saying of "traveling all over China in one day". 
You can appreciate the different customs intertwined by 56 ethnic groups in China, where there are colorful ethnic costumes, village buildings and various folk performances.
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the mini version of the Great Wall

attractions.name: 深圳欢乐谷
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· One of the best theme parks in China, it is divided into eight theme areas, including Plaza de Spain, Cartoon City, Adventure Mountain, Happy Island and Gold Mining Town. 
There are more than 100 rich and colorful amusement projects suitable for all ages, and many unique projects in China and even Asia have been introduced from the United States, the Netherlands and other countries. 
Won the top ten theme parks in Asia-Pacific for four consecutive years, and is the leader of China's theme park industry. 
· It has projects such as China's first hanging roller coaster "Snow Mountain Flying Dragon" and Asia's tallest roller coaster "Global Supreme Ejection Roller Coaster".
attractions.shortFeatures: Colorful land and water amusement projects

attractions.name: 东部华侨城
attractions.summary:
- The first large-scale integrated national ecological tourism demonstration zone in China, combining leisure vacation, sightseeing tourism, outdoor sports, popular science education, and other themes.
- Daxia Valley Ecological Park and Tea Creek Valley Resort Park, integrating mountain wilderness and urban theme parks, present a world where Chinese and Western cultures blend.
- Interlaken Town, Heifeide Town, and Chaoweng Ancient Town create fairy-tale-like dream towns with tea culture and wine culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Thrilling amusement attractions blending with natural scenery
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 09:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

restaurants.name_en: Full of delicious chicken wings with rice

attractions.name: 广州热雪奇迹
attractions.tag: Hi Fun Park; Kid's Treasure Spot; Indoor Skiing; Ice and Snow Parks
attractions.summary:
Guangzhou Snow Miracle covers an area of approximately 75,000 square meters, with temperatures consistently maintained between -6°C and 0°C. It can accommodate around 3,000 visitors at the same time, making it the indoor snow venue with the most diverse snow-related activities and ski slopes.  
The ski area features five slopes of varying difficulty, including practice slopes for beginners on both snowboards and skis, as well as beginner, intermediate, and advanced slopes. Among them, the world's first two 3D-crossing ski slopes offer intermediate and advanced skiers a unique challenge and fun. Additionally, the beginner slope and the ski practice slopes are connected by a buffer zone, forming an ultra-long indoor alpine ski slope of approximately 460 meters.  
The snow play area includes seven attractions, such as Snow Disc, Glacier Leap, Ice Bike, and Ice Bumper Cars, along with two themed areas: Frozen Planet and Polar Bear’s Home. These allow visitors to enjoy the fun of snow and ice under the sunny skies of southern China.  
Whether enjoying family time in the snow or the thrill of skiing, Guangzhou Snow Miracle (Sunac Snow World) offers a 360-degree cool experience, bringing the grand snow carnival to visitors 365 days a year!  
The venue provides free rental of ski suits, ski boots, helmets, and skis, along with disposable socks. Ski enthusiasts may also bring their own equipment.  

**Ski Area**  
The ski area has a total vertical drop of about 66 meters, with five slopes of varying difficulty, ranging from 7.6° to 21° in gradient, and an average width of approximately 35 meters. The snow thickness is maintained at about 50 cm year-round. The uphill facilities include one two-person chairlift and five magic carpets.  

**Snowboard Practice Slope**  
The slope is wide, with a width of about 35 meters and a length of about 70 meters, with a gradient of around 10°. It is slightly steeper than most snowboard practice slopes, so beginners are advised to practice on flat areas first to master basic stances and stopping techniques before boldly attempting new moves from the top.  

**Bear Slope**  
The Bear Slope is wide, measuring about 50 meters in width and 70 meters in length, with a gradient of approximately 8°. It is relatively gentle, making it suitable for beginners. Children can confidently practice here.  

**Snow Rabbit Slope**  
The Snow Rabbit Slope is about 35 meters wide, 300 meters long, and has a gradient of around 10°. It is the most popular slope in the snow park, with the highest skier density. This slope is ideal for those who have mastered basic skiing stances, falling, and stopping. It is also perfect for practicing ground tricks for both snowboard and ski enthusiasts, earning it the nickname “Ground Trick Avenue.”  

**Moose Slope**  
The Moose Slope is about 35 meters wide and 230 meters long, with an average gradient of about 14.8°. It is suitable for intermediate and advanced skiers. The upper section has a gradient of about 18°, testing your stability and skill on steeper slopes, while the lower section, with a gradient of around 10-12°, allows for a full carving experience. Additionally, there are mushroom and wavy paths in the lower section for an extraordinary terrain experience.  

**Tiger Slope**  
The Tiger Slope is about 35 meters wide and 220 meters long, with an average gradient of 16.8°. As the terrain park is located on this slope, it is frequented by the most skilled skiers in the venue. Skiers can often be seen practicing tricks on the props and ramps here.  

**Snow Disc**  
Sit on an inflatable snow disc shaped like a flying saucer and race down from the top of the mountain. The refreshing snow wind hits your face as you speed down to the bottom in the blink of an eye, offering a thrilling and exhilarating snow experience.  
**Requirements**: Passengers must weigh less than 90 kg. Children under 1.2 meters must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Ice Bumper Cars**  
The smooth ice surface reduces friction, adding excitement to the bumper car game, allowing you to experience a popular winter activity even in the south.  
**Requirements**: Children under 1 meter must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Adventure Trail**  
The first indoor adventure trail at a ski resort in China combines fun, entertainment, and challenges of height, speed, strength, and endurance. Feel the thrill and the sense of achievement in overcoming obstacles.  
**Requirements**: Visitors must be over 1.4 meters tall and weigh less than 100 kg. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Ice Bicycle**  
Ride a bicycle on the smooth ice – a fun and unexpected experience for those in southern China. It is a family-friendly ice activity.  
**Requirements**: Visitors must be over 1 meter tall. Children under 1.2 meters must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Glacier Leap**  
The first indoor ski resort with a dual-direction ski lift.
attractions.shortFeatures: Large indoor ski resort; professional ski instruction services; 17,000 square meters of snow and ice amusement area.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 10:00-21:30(Tickets available until 19:30; admission ends at 19:30)

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 仙湖植物园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- To the east, it is bordered by Wutong Mountain, the highest peak in Shenzhen, and to the west, it adjoins Shenzhen Reservoir. The botanical garden integrates species conservation, research, science popularization, and tourism functions.
- The botanical garden is divided into six major scenic areas: Tian Shang Ren Jian (Heaven and Earth), Lake Area, Temple Area, Desert Plant Area, Fossil Forest Scenic Area, and Pine, Cypress, and Rhododendron Scenic Area.
- It features several unique garden attractions, including Bie You Dong Tian (Cave of Hidden Wonders), Liang Yi Pavilion, Yu Dai Bridge, Long Zun Tower, Ting Tao Pavilion, Lan Sheng Pavilion, and Die Gu You Lan (Butterfly Valley with Orchids), among others.
- The garden also houses a distinctive Paleontology Museum, unique garden architecture, and a mysterious plant kingdom, all of which are highly praised.
- Hongfa Temple is located here, known as the most effective temple, with a strong incense offering and frequent visits by locals who come to burn incense.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire a variety of plants and visit Hongfa Temple.

attractions.name: 弘法寺
attractions.summary: Shenzhen Hongfa Temple is located in Shenzhen Xianhu Botanical Garden, backed by Wutong Mountain, the "green heart and lung" of Shenzhen, and facing Xianhu. The surrounding natural scenery is very beautiful. The temple was founded in 1985, with a short history, but its scale is second to none in the local area. On the first and fifteenth days of the lunar month, countless believers come to burn incense and worship Buddha. Walk about 2.2 kilometers from the entrance of Xianhu Botanical Garden, you can see the true appearance of Hongfa Temple. Along the way, there are green mountains and green hills, and the scenery is beautiful. There are Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Tibetan Sutra Building, etc. in the temple, with arches and cornices stacked on top of each other, which is very majestic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Temple scale is second to none in Shenzhen

attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

attractions.name: 象鼻山景区
attractions.summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". Nowadays, it is also a filming base for Guilin's landscape weddings, where lovers make love promises under the witness of Xiangshan, Shuiyue. Full text 

attractions.name: 桂林两江四湖景区
attractions.summary: Night Tour of Two Rivers and Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Two Rivers and Four Lakes: You can enjoy the landscape scenery of Shanhu Lake, Ronghu Lake, Guihu Lake, Mulong Lake, Lijiang River, and Taohua River in the city, visit the core scenic belt of Guilin, and experience the water system around the city that is comparable to the water city of Venice. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots, famous bridges, and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with fish eagles, the Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also enjoy boating on the Li River and Taohua River, experiencing the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoying the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes by boat. Night tour of the One River and Four Lakes allows you to enjoy the scenic views of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, Li River or Taohua River in the city. Visit the core scenic area of Guilin, experience the city's water system comparable to Venice's water city, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with eagles, Yao style, and naked eye 3D light and shadow show of the ancient city wall of Mulong Lake. Highlights and Features: Night tours of one river and four lakes are one of the classic products in our scenic area. Along the way by boat, you can not only enjoy the scenic spots and famous bridges and mountains of the four lakes; Watch exquisite performances such as the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the half zither falling into the moon. You can also take a boat tour of the Li River or Taohua River to experience the essence of Guilin's "city in the scenery, scenery in the city" landscape, and enjoy the brilliant charm of Guilin at night. Night Tour of Four Lakes by Boat Night Tour of Four Lakes can enjoy the splendid night scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, as well as classic performances such as millennium old fishing with fish eagles. Highlights and Features: Night tour of Four Lakes is a premium route for night tours in our scenic area. You can take a boat tour of the core scenic area of Guilin and experience the water system around the city, which is comparable to the water city of Venice. Along the way, you can enjoy many famous scenic spots such as Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, and Mulong Lake, and admire famous bridges and mountains; Watch the millennium old tradition of fishing with eagles, the charm of Yao culture, and the exquisite performance of half zither falling on the moon, and enjoy the dazzling and colorful scenery of Guilin at night. One day tour of one river and four lakes, boat tour of one river and four lakes, can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery of Shanhu, Ronghu, Guihu, Mulong Lake, and the inner section of the Lijiang River, and see the famous mountains with different shapes. Highlights and Features: Taking a boat tour around the core of Guilin city, you can enjoy the picturesque natural scenery up close. Along the way, many famous mountains such as Xiangbi Mountain, Fubo Mountain, Diecai Mountain, Qixing Mountain, Baoji Mountain, and Laoren Mountain will be presented in sequence; The various Chinese and foreign famous bridges, as well as the elegant and majestic pagodas and towers, adorn the ancient landscape city, allowing tourists to truly experience the unparalleled charm of Guilin's scenery. Full text 

attractions.name: 尧山
attractions.summary:
Yao Mountain's main peak has an elevation of about 909.3 meters, with a relative height of about 760 meters, making it the highest peak in Guilin. It was originally an island in the ancient sea of Guilin and is the only earth mountain in the area. The terrain is undulating, with a majestic atmosphere. The mountain is covered in ancient pines and cypresses, creating a green expanse to the horizon.

Yao Mountain is famous for its ever-changing and colorful scenery throughout the four seasons. In spring, azaleas bloom, and peach blossoms are enchanting, competing in beauty with flowers carpeting the fields. In summer, the trees offer shade, and after summer rains, the sea of clouds over Yao Mountain is a unique sight in Guilin. It is also the only mountain in Guilin where you can observe a sea of clouds, which changes unpredictably and resembles the mythical Penglai. In autumn, the forests are dyed in layers of gold. In winter, the mountain is covered in snow, creating a silver sea that showcases the northern scenery. Therefore, “Yao Mountain Winter Snow” has become a famous sight in Guilin. The Ming dynasty's Yan Zhenzhi wrote in "Yao Mountain Winter Snow": "The north wind blows from the east, scattering distant snow, which falls on the peak of Yao Mountain, looking the most extraordinary." It is now said that “If you don’t reach the top of Yao Mountain, you won’t see the scenery of Guilin.”

The Yao Mountain Scenic Area features the richest karst landform types and the world’s largest natural reclining Buddha landscape. On the mountain, the Jade Milk Spring flows from the White Stone Cave, with crystal-clear water that flows year-round. You can drink from this heavenly spring to relieve the fatigue of your journey. On the way down, you can also take a slideway, weaving through the sea of flowers and forests, experiencing the thrill of flying close to the ground. Yao Mountain also houses the best-preserved Ming dynasty princely tombs in the country—the Jingjiang Prince Tombs, which are grand and magnificent. There are over 300 tombs in the Ming Jingjiang Prince Tomb complex, and the plum vases unearthed here are famous worldwide.
attractions.shortFeatures: Reach the summit and gaze at the natural reclining Buddha.

attractions.name: 回民街
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.
attractions.shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood

attractions.name: 大唐芙蓉园
attractions.summary: The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

attractions.name: 华清宫
attractions.tag: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

attractions.name: 秦始皇帝陵博物院(兵马俑)
attractions.name_en: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
attractions.summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang

attractions.summary: Suzhou Shuxiang Shijia Shushan Hot Spring Resort Hotel is located in Shushan Ecological Village, Suzhou High tech Zone. Located at the northern foot of Dayang Mountain, Shushan Ecological Village is adjacent to Tong'an Town to the north and Hushuguan Town to the east. It is adjacent to National Highway 312, Shanghai Nanjing Expressway, Shanghai Nanjing Railway, and the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal, and can reach the Suzhou Ring Expressway in 5 minutes. Suzhou Shuxiangjia Shushan Hot Spring Resort Hotel is managed by the well-known domestic brand "Shuxiangmendi" hotel chain. It is a theme hot spring resort hotel located in Dashushan Ecological Village, Suzhou New District, with elegant environment, complete facilities, excellent service, and comfortable and pleasant atmosphere. The hotel is located in the first granite fissure type hot spring well in the southern Jiangsu region. Its unique and elegant courtyard style outdoor hot springs and club style hot spring SPA are like being in a paradise, in contact with the beautiful springs of nature. The hotel advocates the concept of "living a happy world" and highlights the theme of hot spring SPA. Suzhou Shuxiang Shijia Shushan Hot Spring Resort Hotel provides a hot spring SPA, health and wellness steam rooms, KTV private rooms, chess and card rooms, table tennis rooms, swimming pools, fitness centers, and outdoor training bases for business meetings, leisure tourism, and leisure travelers. It is an ideal choice for leisure vacations, conference tourism, and releasing emotions.
