attractions.name: 蜈支洲岛
attractions.tag: Close to nature; love sports; Outdoor Diving; Beaches; Seashores; Islands/Peninsulas
attractions.summary:
Wuzhizhou Island Tourist Area is a famous 5A-level scenic spot, located in Haitang Bay, Sanya City, covering an area of approximately 1.48 square kilometers. It boasts rich underwater ecological resources and a comprehensive water sports product system for "quadruple" ocean experiences. It has become a national coastal island resort integrating island sightseeing, recreational activities, honeymoon vacations, and family tourism, making it one of the most well-known tourist destination brands in China.

Here, you’ll find "China's first tropical marine ranch," which has nurtured and developed leading marine recreation methods. The island offers typical diving activities, such as luxury island circum-navigation diving, advanced diving, and coral reef diving. It also features new entertainment projects introduced from abroad, such as dynamic airships, dolphin submarines, and sky dance. In addition, there are helicopter island tours and an immersive outdoor wind tunnel experience center, catering to tourists' vacation desires and pursuits of "sea, land, air, and underwater" activities. Whether you're a curious diving explorer or an adventurous "extreme enthusiast," you will find the perfect activity here.

In addition to the diverse entertainment options, the island also boasts popular tourist spots like Lover's Bridge, Lover’s Island, Sun Viewing Rock, and custom-made swimming pools, all of which are perfect for capturing breathtaking photos. The winding coastline, crystal-clear waters, and the colorful, vibrant underwater world featuring various corals, mackerels, groupers, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, prawns, luminous snails, and a variety of tropical fish make it a premier diving destination in China. Currently, Wuzhizhou Island offers four main diving spots—Qilin Sea, Back Garden, Glass Fish Planet, and Little Universe—each with its own unique characteristics, attracting diving enthusiasts from around the world.

The only island hotel on the island, Coral Hotel, is one of the few high-end boutique island hotels in China. It consists of five connected buildings designed with coral as the prototype, built to five-star standards. The hotel offers various room types including sea-view, garden-view, poolside, duplex, suites, and wooden houses, totaling 305 rooms. It is a sweet destination for romantic proposals, honeymoon trips, and family vacations, providing a private and pure island leisure experience for visitors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic diving resort destination

attractions.name: 三亚游艇旅游中心
attractions.summary: Hongzhou Yacht Terminal allows you to go out to sea for sightseeing. On the sailboat, you can personally play the roles of captain and sailor, experience technical operations such as fending, raising sails, and steering, and truly experience the joy of setting sail. Roar on the vast sea, set aside the troubles of life and work, and enjoy the pleasure of riding the wind and waves.

attractions.name: 凤凰岛直升机基地
attractions.summary: Take a helicopter ride to experience a smooth and expansive new perspective, explore the romantic Sanya from a different angle, fly low along the coastline, shuttle through the beautiful scenery of the sea and sky, overlook the entire Sanya, and enjoy a private aerial viewing journey. Take off from the Phoenix Island helicopter base in Sanya, and experience the magical feeling of low altitude flight (at an altitude of about 300 meters or less) and helicopter takeoff and landing during the flight, depending on the selected products. At the same time, enjoy the beautiful scenery of Phoenix Island in Sanya, overlook the diverse crowds and constantly changing colors of the nearby sea.

attractions.name: 亚龙湾热带天堂森林公园
attractions.name_en: Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park
attractions.summary: The Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park Scenic Area is located within the Yalong Bay National Tourism Resort. The main filming locations for the movie "If You Are the One II" and the TV series "Dear, Loved" are in Sanya, Hainan. The park is positioned as an international coastal ecological sightseeing and ecological vacation forest park, and is praised by experts as a model of third-generation forest tourism products. The trees in the park are lush, and you can see the dense vines and gurgling streams. You can also encounter the century old vines and towering banyan trees, and hear insects singing and birds singing, which is extremely wild. Scenes from "If You Are the One II" and "Dear, Beloved" can be seen everywhere in the scenic area. Shu Qi, Ge You, Yang Zi, and Li Xian walked across the "Crossing the River Dragon Rope Bridge" known as the Lover's Bridge, the "Cliff Sky Pool" at the edge of the cliff, the trial room in "If You Are the One II" witnessing romantic love, and the internet famous glass wharf are all must visit check-in spots for couples. Strolling along Tianjie, enjoying the slow life of Tianjie at 18 ° N latitude, walking on the panoramic sea view glass bridge, taking in the beautiful scenery of Yalong Bay, facing the sea, backed by green mountains, and blooming all year round. The panoramic sea view glass wharf is located at the top of the Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park, with a highest elevation of 450 meters. It is a panoramic sea view glass wharf. The glass wharf is built along the mountain, with a total length of 400 meters, composed of 130 tons of ultra white imported laminated glass. It includes attractions such as Lingkong Platform, Colorful Sky Ladder, Colorful Lotus Viewing Platform, Rainbow Road, Mountain Oath and Heart to Heart Connection. The road surface of the wharf is entirely paved with 3M * 3M large single transparent glass. Walking on the wharf, you can look up at the sky high and clear clouds, overlook the rainforest valley more than 100 meters deep below, and have a panoramic view of Yalong Bay in front. While feeling scared, you can also enjoy the joy of soaring in the sky. Rainforest Float, also known as the "forest float and water float roller coaster". The floating slide is made of high-strength tempered double-layer laminated glass, with a total length of 3100 meters and a drop of 280 meters, equivalent to a rapid slide down from a 93 story rooftop. The Feipiao has 28 bends throughout its journey, with a total length of 600 meters, including 17 C-shaped bends, 11 S-shaped bends, and multiple consecutive S-shaped major bends. Rainforest drifting is like a roller coaster floating on water, sometimes soaring over the top of the rainforest, sometimes crossing deep forests, sometimes overlooking beautiful mountains and seas, and sometimes exploring the wonders of the rainforest. While enjoying thrills and excitement, participants can also get up close to tropical ecological wonders such as the Root Hug Stone and the High Board Root. They can also have intimate interactions with common tropical wildlife such as giant spiders, cobras, elephants, macaques, crocodiles, giraffes, etc. 【 Orchid Valley 】 Orchid Valley mainly showcases the unique landscape of the original tropical rainforest. On the winding trail that stretches for more than 1000 meters in the valley, vines are densely covered, streams are gurgling, and various orchids compete and bloom. Along the hiking trail in the valley, towering banyan trees, century old vines, wild bamboo shoots, and six wonders of the tropical rainforest can be seen everywhere. Walking in the rainforest, you can feel the refreshing coolness. Here, you can unload the hustle and bustle, cross the rainforest boardwalk, breathe fresh air, and enjoy the happy time of leisure. The filming location for the movie "If You Are the One II" and the TV drama "Dear, Loved" is "Crossing the Yangtze River Dragon Bridge". The Jianglong Cable Bridge spans between two mountains, with a total length of 168 meters and a height of nearly 40 meters above the ground. Walking on the cable-stayed bridge, looking up at the undulating mountains, overlooking the vast ocean, listening to the birds singing and smelling the fragrance of flowers, it feels like being in a fairyland of the sea and sky. Suoqiao, also known as Lover's Bridge, is a bridge woven with love. If lovers walk over it, they will eventually become a couple. Ge You, Shu Qi, Yang Zi, and Li Xian performed a romantic love story here. Crossing this bridge may be thrilling and exciting, but loving someone is also an adventurous journey? The Yanbo Pavilion next to the cable-stayed bridge, accompanied by ancient banyan trees, is a great place to appreciate the panoramic view of the bridge. The "If You Are the One II" trial room is a trial room in the movie plot, with no changes to the decoration or arrangement, showcasing the simple yet romantic moments of Xiao Xiao and Qin Fen. Rainforest Magic Cinema: A giant dragon flies from the top of a 450 meter mountain, and the tree lined path is full of dangers. Giant pythons and birds may appear at any time, while waterfalls and mountains allow you to shuttle and soar. The film, produced by a foreign team hired by the scenic area to protect the tropical rainforest, will allow us to explore the rainforest in a different way, allowing every organ of the body to directly experience the thrilling excitement. Leaping through the dense and primitive rainforest of Yalong Bay, with towering mountains and misty clouds, the Leaping Rainforest project will take you to experience the wonderful feeling of flying squirrels crossing the top of the rainforest. There are 13 high-altitude challenge projects such as zip line, rock climbing, plum blossom stake, and cycling, allowing you to challenge yourself and find joy in the jungle adventure. Climbing up to the Thousand Mile Umbrella, drifting clouds under your feet, the blue sea and sky, and the wind blowing from all directions make you feel relaxed and happy. Looking down from below, the green mountains, green trees, and red flowers complement the Tianchi Bird's Nest. The swimming pool built along the cliffs blends with the sky and sea, and is integrated with the mountains and forests. Like a blue sapphire embedded in the mountains, with a vast sea view in front of you. Along a long cobblestone road, you will stroll through the tropical style buildings lining both sides. Here, you can taste local Hainan specialty snacks, Li Miao specialty rainforest meals, purchase dad tea, Thai handicrafts, Hainan Huanghua pears, and even write your beautiful mood on postcards and send them to distant friends through the 18 ° North latitude post office. The high-altitude zip line, with a total length of 600 meters, glides at high speed from the mountaintop to the highest point, experiencing the speed and passion of crossing between the sea and sky, more like an elf in the valley, free and unrestrained. Under my feet lies infinite greenery, and the vast sea view unfolds before my eyes like a long painting. Rainforest Magic Maze is a children's fantasy adventure park full of family warmth, wisdom, and courage. Parents and children experience the entertainment process of rope crossing, tree maze, time tunnel and other sports expansion projects together. By completing various tasks with children, they give them greater courage and enhance their confidence. There is a large dragon sculpture made of purple copper, weighing 5000 kilograms, standing on the mountaintop, guarding the South China Sea. Full text 

attractions.summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.
attractions.shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.

attractions.name: 西湖游船
attractions.summary: There are many scenic spots along the West Lake, and taking a boat tour of West Lake is one of the classic ways to appreciate its beauty. The boats and tourists traveling on the lake surface are also a scenic spot of Xizi Lake. Sitting on a cruise ship, enjoying the lake and mountain scenery, admiring the green waves and blue shadows, and experiencing the beautiful and charming scenery of Xizi Lake that is suitable for both light and heavy makeup. There are various types and routes of West Lake cruise ships with different prices, and visitors can choose according to their personal preferences, which is very convenient. Full text 

attractions.name: 三潭印月
attractions.tag: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Also known as Xiaoyingzhou, it is the largest island among the three islands in the West Lake and the only island that can be visited. It is known as the first scenic spot in the West Lake. 
The outline is like the word "Tian", the outer ring is Jiangnan garden, and the inside is divided into four small lakes by cross-shaped islands and bridges, which are full of poetry and painting. 
The whole island is densely covered with flowers and trees, mainly green willow, lotus, red maple and hibiscus, which is the representative work of water courtyard art in the south of the Yangtze River. 
The back of the RMB one-dollar banknote adopts the grand scene of three pools reflecting the moon, which shows that it plays an extremely important symbolic role in my country's scenic spots.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landing on the island and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the West Lake from a new perspective

attractions.name: 雷峰塔
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."
attractions.shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.

attractions.name: 灵隐飞来峰景区
attractions.summary: The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. The North Peak can be climbed or taken by cable car, and Lingshun Temple at the top of the mountain is one of the famous ancient temples in Hangzhou. Full text 

attractions.name: 灵隐寺
attractions.summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.
attractions.shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk

attractions.name: 杭州宋城
attractions.tag: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!
attractions.shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"

attractions.name: 西溪国家湿地公园
attractions.tag: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
attractions.summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 清河坊街
attractions.summary: Qinghefang Street is one of the most popular commercial districts in Hangzhou, with shops along the street that have been renovated from old buildings, exuding an antique charm. Here, there are many local snacks, specialty shops, tea houses, etc., and with the backing of Wushan and close proximity to the food street Gaoyin Street, both tourists and locals often come to visit. The commercial pedestrian street for snacks and shopping is not too large, with a wide variety of products, which can be considered a microcosm of Hangzhou's characteristics. Local specialties can be found here. When shopping for local snacks such as Dingsheng Cake, Butter Cake, Longxu Candy, etc., you may as well buy and taste them, as well as well-known Zhang Xiaoquan scissors, Wang Xingji fans, etc. It is also good to buy one as a souvenir. In addition to snacks and shopping, Qinghefang Street also has many venues worth visiting, among which the must see is Hu Qingyu Hall. It occupies a prominent position on the street, and many people come here for medical treatment and medication on weekdays. The Medicine Museum in Hu Qingyu Hall is open for visitors, and the plants planted in the courtyard are labeled, resembling a large classroom. Similarly, there is the Huichun Hall on the east side of the block. In addition, the Zhu Bingren Bronze Carving Art Museum near Anrong Lane is also worth a visit. Museum doors, windows, furniture, etc. are all made of copper, shining with golden light that catches the eye.

attractions.name: 牛首山文化旅游区
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems for autumn leaf viewing.
attractions.summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Millennium Temple for Pilgrimage and Buddhist Worship

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

attractions.name: 夫子庙秦淮风光带
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.

attractions.name: 秦淮河画舫
attractions.summary: Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

attractions.name: 钟山风景名胜区
attractions.tag: Climb to a high place and hike in the mountains; enjoy the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- Also known as the Eastern Suburbs Scenic Area, it is very close to the city center. Nanjing locals prefer to call Zhongshan Mountain "Zijin Mountain."
- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.
attractions.shortFeatures: Nanjing Landmark Scenic Areas

attractions.name: 中山陵景区
attractions.summary: Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

attractions.name: 明孝陵
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
attractions.summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.

attractions.name: 美龄宫
attractions.tag: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.
attractions.shortFeatures: The beautiful official residence of Jiang's couple on holiday
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

attractions.name: 音乐台
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
attractions.summary:
The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the monumental buildings of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum; A fine building with a rare layout

hotel.Hotel Name: Nanjing Tangshan Ziqing Lake Ecological Tourism Hot Spring Resort Hotel

attractions.name: 汤山紫清湖旅游区
attractions.summary: Tangshan Ziqing Lake Forest Hot Spring is located in the Nanjing Tangshan Ziqing Lake Ecotourism Hot Spring Resort, and is a masterpiece carefully planned and designed by internationally renowned hot spring designers. It showcases the fusion style of Southeast Asian hot spring culture and Northeast Asian hot spring culture. The hot spring area is filled with smoke, towering trees, blooming mountain flowers, gurgling water, and a stunning paradise like a paradise on earth. It is a natural scenery of Tangshan, with mountains, waters, forests, and real hot springs! The Ziqing Lake Ecotourism Hot Spring Resort has a natural ecology and beautiful scenery, with mountains and waters complementing each other, creating a natural beauty with towering trees and fresh and mellow air. Therefore, it is known as a natural oxygen bar; The original wetland landscape area of the resort is filled with rare plants such as Li's River, Water Pine, and Water Cedar, as well as various precious wild waterfowl and birds such as egrets, wild ducks, and swans. Throughout the year, different birds can be enjoyed playing in the Ziqing Lake and dancing gracefully in the sky. The entire forest hot spring area is surrounded by mountains and lakes, with dozens of hot spring pools of different shapes and functions crisscrossing in the hundreds of acres of mountains and forests. The layout is extraordinary and the atmosphere is vivid, which can satisfy nearly a thousand people to soak comfortably without interference. Kiss the Little Fish Pool, Rose Pool, Milk Pool, Red Wine Pool, Mineral Sand Pool, Waterfall Pool, Human Crocodile Bathing and Sighing for Observation, Magical Legend Pool, Featured Petal Pool and dozens of other hot spring pools, all for free! Each spring pool uses natural high-temperature hot spring water unique to Tangshan. In the hot spring area, there are grass topped wooden spring houses, exotic tea bars, natural landscape SPA rooms, stone millstone paths, and misty flowing water walls, all of which are ingeniously combined with natural environment and human fashion. What's unique is that while soaking in the hot spring, you can enjoy the life dynamics of the nationally protected animal, the Yangtze alligator, in the same pool; You can also enjoy the fun of soaking in hot springs, swinging and playing golf. The sky above, the earth bathed in springs, surrounded by green trees, and the harmony between heaven and man. There is a large restaurant on the first floor of the hot spring customer service complex building, which adopts the self-service mode. All dishes, snacks and fruits are specially prepared by senior nutritionists for the appetite, taste and nutrition of guests after soaking in the hot spring. On the second floor, there is a spacious, bright, and comfortable lounge. We also have professional technicians available to meet customers' health needs such as SPA, foot massage, and tuina. There are professional management personnel and well-trained service staff in each area of the hot spring, providing warm, thoughtful and satisfactory services to guests at any time.

attractions.name: 紫清湖野生动物世界
attractions.summary: The open exhibition halls of Ziqing Lake Wildlife World include Panda Science Museum, Panda Museum, Elephant Museum, Parrot Museum, Zebra Museum, Giraffe Museum, Racecourse, Pony Museum, Kangaroo Museum, Wolf Museum, Lion Museum, Bear Museum, etc.

attractions.name: 汤山紫清湖旅游区森林温泉
attractions.name_en: Tangshan Ziqing Lake Tourist Area Forest Hot Spring
attractions.summary: Tangshan Ziqing Lake Tourist Area Forest Hot Springs is a paradise that combines natural beauty and enjoyment. Not only does this place have a superior geographical location, but it has also become an ideal place for urbanites to escape the hustle and bustle and seek physical and mental peace with its attentive service that is open 24/7. Whether it's the early morning light or the falling night, Ziqing Lake Hot Springs always welcomes every soul that desires relaxation with a warm embrace, making every bath an unforgettable natural journey. Next, let's delve into the hot spring secrets of this forest and explore how it transforms the gifts of nature into unparalleled leisure experiences.

attractions.name: 苏韵十三园
attractions.summary: Suyun Thirteen Gardens is designed by Professor Chen Wei, an expert in ancient architecture at Southeast University. Adhering to the design concept of "recreating high-quality Jiangsu gardens with the past", it authentically reproduces the classic ancient garden architecture of thirteen prefecture level cities in Jiangsu, allowing visitors to enjoy the classic gardens of Jiangsu in one day. Full time and immersive Chinese style performance tour "Su Yun Seeking Fragrance" is performed every day in Su Yun Thirteen Garden. Led by the talented scholar Li Yu from Jiangsu, tourists meet historical literati, experience the unique charm of different cities, and embark on a journey of Su Yun culture in the gardens of Jiangnan. One city, one garden, one story, one step, one scenery, one stunning sight. Suyun Thirteen Gardens innovatively integrates experiential commercial scenes with immersive cultural exhibitions. Through the interweaving of artistic life and cultural imagination, visitors can experience the classic aesthetic philosophy of Jiangsu gardens, depict the colorful cultural picture of Jiangsu, and experience the natural, humanistic, and beautiful Suyun elegant life.

attractions.name: 汤山方山国家地质公园博物馆
attractions.name_en: Fangshan Tangshan National Geopark Museum in Jiangning, Jiangsu
attractions.summary: The Jiangsu Jiangning Tangshan Fangshan National Geopark Museum is located within the Tangshan National Geopark in the Tangshan Resort, covering an area of approximately 74.7 hectares. The Site Park is mainly positioned for geological research, popular science education, and cultural tourism. It consists of three parts: the Nanjing Homo erectus Fossil Archaeological Site (Ancient Ape Cave), the Cultural Tourism Complex (Nanjing Homo erectus Fossil Site Museum), and the Time Tunnel. The first phase of the site museum is based on the "Tangshan Geology" and the "Evolution of Life" as the clue, with the core of the Nanjing Homo erectus in the Middle Pleistocene, interpreting the geological changes and human evolutionary history of the vicissitudes of the world. Jiangsu Jiangning Tangshan Fangshan National Geopark Museum will take you on a journey back to the evolution of life in the Nanjing area over 600 million years. Restoring the living environment of human ancestors in Nanjing, revealing how this magical land has nurtured and continued human genes and civilization.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 古猿人洞
attractions.summary: The Ancient Ape Man Cave is a natural karst cave. It was discovered during the excavation of rocks in 1993 and is called the "Hulu Cave" due to its resemblance to a gourd. The karst cave can be divided into six major areas, namely the entrance stone carved spring landscape, the ancient human stone carving garden at the foot of the mountain, the exhibition hall of ancient human historical materials, the cliff carving landscape of the site entrance, the natural karst cave landscape, and the bamboo garden leisure area. The stalactites inside the cave have various shapes and mature development, especially the red and white stalactites, which are rare in the world. But what is precious in the cave are two skulls dating back 580000 to 620000 years, confirming that this is a complete ancient ape human activity site discovered in Jiangnan so far and belongs to the same period as Zhoukoudian in Beijing. As a result, the human history in Nanjing has been pushed forward by more than 200000 years, and it also confirms that the Yangtze River Basin is one of the birthplaces of the Chinese nation. More than ten species of fossils, including spotted deer and spotted deer, were discovered in the cave. These animals mostly grew during the Middle Pleistocene, 150 million years ago. Now, on the mountaintop of the cave, two or three giant bronze statues of ape men hunting have been cast as the giant symbols of the ape man cave. Throughout the scenic area, small stone age buildings such as thatched cottages, stone tools, nest dwellings, and cave dwellings can be seen everywhere, full of historical significance.

attractions.name: 栖霞山
attractions.tag: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
attractions.summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.
attractions.shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains

attractions.name: 栖霞寺
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
attractions.summary:
Sheshan Qixia Temple is located on Qixia Mountain in the northeast of Nanjing. It is one of the four famous temples in China and the birthplace of the "Three Theories" of Jiangnan Buddhism. Qixia Temple is not only large in scale and magnificent in style, but also the best scenery in Nanjing. It is also famous for its important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Qixia Temple Feng covers an area of more than 40 mu, and there are three courtyards of Pilu Temple Tibetan Sutra Building, which rise layer by layer according to the mountain, and the pattern is neat and beautiful. Main attractions: Stupa The Qixia Temple Stupa is a relic of the Southern Tang Dynasty. It is one of the oldest stone pagodas south of the Yangtze River and the largest stupa in my country. The stone pagoda is eight-angled and five-level, about fifteen meters high. The base is surrounded by a stone railing with a hook line, which is restored for the original objects of the Five Dynasties excavated in modern times. The floor of the base is carved with seawater, dragon, phoenix, fish, shrimp and other figures, and only a part of it remains. The eight phases of Sakyamuni are embossed on all sides of the Sumeru seat under the pagoda. After thousands of years of wind and rain, although some stone eaves have been destroyed, they still stand tall, becoming a witness to the prosperity of Buddha spirit in Jinling. The Great Buddha Pavilion, also known as the Three Holy Temples, is dedicated to the Buddha of Infinite Life and was excavated for Shiyi in the Southern Qi Dynasty. The Buddha statue is 10.8 meters high, and its seat is 13.3 meters high. Guanyin is 11 meters high to stand on the left and right side of the Bodhisattva. The pleated style of the Buddha statue is quite similar to the stone Buddha in Yungang, Datong. The original two Buddhas next to the stupa are more than three meters high, beautiful and elegant, similar to the Longmen Stone Buddha in Luoyang, and are also peerless treasures in the golden age of Chinese Buddhist art. Qianfoyan, known as "Yungang in the south of the Yangtze River", is the only Southern Dynasty grottoes in China. Wuliang Hall Wuliang Hall is the earliest and largest Buddhist shrine in Qianfo Rock. The Buddha of Infinite Life is in the middle, and Guanyin is on both sides. The statue is well-proportioned and the lines are smooth. The fold style of the three Buddhas' clothes is similar to that of Yungang Grottoes, and the excavation date is seventeen years earlier than that of Yungang Grottoes. The statue is exquisite and simple, which can be compared with Datong Longmen. Its value lies in preserving the original rhyme of Buddha statues in the Southern Dynasties, which is especially rare in the south of the Yangtze River.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire exquisite stupas and Buddha statues in grottoes

attractions.summary: Nanhu Park is the second largest urban park in China at present, second only to the Summer Palace in Beijing. It was called Huanglong Royal Park during the puppet Manchukuo period. Overlooking Nanhu Park from the air, you can clearly see its whole picture, which is shaped like a dumbbell, narrow from east to west and long from north to south. The lake in the park is clear, with green willows on the shore, curved bridges and pavilions, birds singing and flowers fragrant, and four distinct seasons, which is better than Jiangnan. If you stand on the Nanhu Bridge and look north against the railing, a colorful picture will appear in front of you, which looks like clusters of fluttering flowers blooming on the water. All kinds of bridge pavilions and pavilions are in charm with the lake and forest colors, which makes people linger.
attractions.shortFeatures: A large city park with views all seasons

· The palace is divided into the Outer Court for political activities and the Inner Court for daily life, which are now separately designated as the Manchukuo Palace Exhibition Hall and the Imperial Palace Exhibition Hall, with architectural landmarks including the Jixi Building, Zhonghe Gate, Huaiyuan Building, and Tongde Hall.  
· Part of the Imperial Palace has been designated as the Jilin Provincial Museum, showcasing historical materials of feudal dynasties established in Northeast China, such as Goguryeo, Balhae, Liao, and Jin.

The snow in the ski resort is soft and suitable for all kinds of skiers. There are five snow trails, which are divided into beginner, intermediate, advanced and cross-country snow trails. - Changchun Botanical and Zoological Park, with its lush trees, rare birds and animals, exotic flowers and trees, and picturesque landscapes, offers a delightful environment that makes visitors linger. It is an excellent place for leisure, entertainment, and gatherings.
- The artificial lake divides the park into three natural areas: the eastern area features the Rare Birds and Animals Pavilion, which houses over 200 species of northern flora and fauna, known as a "miniature kingdom of nature"; the western area simulates the vertical distribution of plants with artificial soil mountains, and includes a miniature "Changbai Wilderness" scenic area; the northern part is home to the tropical botanical garden.

Zhongtai Ocean World is a project invested, constructed, operated and managed by Changchun Zhongtai Ocean World Co., Ltd. It is a large-scale ocean-themed MALL integrating popular science education, sightseeing, leisure and entertainment, shopping and catering. The project is adjacent to the two mature business districts of Hongqi Street and Guilin Road in Changchun City. It is located on the southeast side of Chaoyang Park. It covers an area of 40,000 square meters and has a construction area of 50,000 square meters. It has a planned total investment of 450 million RMB. It is a key project supported by the Jilin Provincial Government. 
The architectural theme of the project consists of "Ocean World" and "Ocean Plaza", with a total of 4 floors, 1 floor underground and 3 floors above ground. The project will be planned to become the first MALL in Northeast China with marine culture as its theme and youth consumption as its main customer group. Among them, Ocean Plaza is mainly composed of the first and second floors, with a planned area of 35,000 square meters, including two parts: fashion color pavilion and life theme pavilion. It is a brand-new experiential urban life center integrating children's amusement, international children's star pavilion, international fashion pavilion, hipster beautiful street, hipster beauty street, creative furniture connection, food gift street and universal food collection. Ocean World is planned to be located in one-third of the underground floor, the top floor (third floor) area and the cylindrical circular corridor on the second floor. The planned area is about 15,000 square meters, including deep sea exploration, Jurassic World, rainforest wonders, Our Family Fish, Stylish Coast, Underwater Garden, Fun Aquarium, and Bigfoot Theater. There are eight major themed exhibition and performance venues. Changchun Ocean World has the most advanced three-dimensional distribution and real-life reproduction in China, the immersive tropical rain forest pavilion, and the most distinctive panoramic multi-angle undersea tunnel.

attractions.summary: Lianhua Mountain Ski Resort is currently one of the most popular ski resorts in Changchun area. It is located in Qingshan Village, Sijia Township, Erdao District, Changchun City, about 39 kilometers away from the city center and about 20 kilometers away from Changchun Longjia International Airport. The transportation is extremely convenient, and it is one of the ski resorts in China that is relatively close to the central city in terms of high and intermediate ski resorts. At present, Lianhua Mountain Ski Resort has designed and built two competition venues, "freestyle aerials" and "snowboard U-shaped groove", according to standards; The first phase has opened 6 high, medium, and junior ski slopes, which can meet the needs of tourists with different skiing levels; The newly built 2 high-altitude hanging chair cableways and 2 towing cableways will transport tourists to the starting points of various snow trails in a relatively short period of time and enable paragliding activities. At the same time, various sports such as snowmobile, snow frisbee, ice slide, horse plow, dog plow, and tennis are carried out here. In addition, there is a fish feast at the Lotus Fish Pavilion, a villa complex in the forest that can accommodate over a hundred people, and an athlete center that can accommodate more than 500 people for food and lodging daily. attractions.name: 吉林省东北二人转博物馆
attractions.summary: The Northeast Errenzhuan Museum in Jilin Province is located at the intersection of Sendai Street and Pudong Road in Changchun City. It is on the first floor of the Provincial Mass Art Museum and has an exhibition area of 1300 square meters. It consists of a preface hall, five exhibition areas, and a "Errenzhuan Study Center", showcasing the cultural heritage of Errenzhuan over the past 300 years in various ways. Upon entering the gate, one is greeted by a landscape wall in the shape of a handkerchief, a three-dimensional map of the distribution of Errenzhuan in Northeast China, and a large screen playing a documentary about Errenzhuan. The first part of the exhibition area showcases the artistic origin and development of Errenzhuan through graphics, manuscripts, and cultural relics. The display cabinets display various early Errenzhuan costumes, headwear, as well as hand-held props such as large boards, flower sticks, and salad chickens. Walking inside, you will see the restoration of two scenes of singing about the big car shop and singing about the wooden house, as well as miniature landscapes such as apprenticeship ceremonies displayed in the exhibition cabinet. Full text 

attractions.name: 国家吊水壶森林公园
attractions.summary: The Hanging Water Bottle Forest Park (Shuangyang Ice Cave Scenic Area) is located about 85 kilometers southeast of Changchun city. Here, the mountains are continuous, the forests are dense, and there are mysterious underground karst and ice cave landscapes. Summer is a good time to visit the ice cave tourist area. Not only is the vegetation lush and verdant, but it is also a great place to escape the heat, especially suitable for exploring caves. There are many scenic spots in the scenic spot, such as the old hanging hole, ice hole, sunset tower, wolf valley, thousand meter plank road, Tongtian Cave, Luohan Cave, Maitreya Palace, old road cave, tiger cave, etc. The Sunset Tower is located on the mountain peak at the entrance of the mountain, looking mysterious and unfathomable from a distance. After passing the Sunset Tower, there is a primitive Grand Canyon, which is the Wild Wolf Valley. In spring, you can enjoy the blooming Jindalai here. The 82 meter deep ice cave is a major attraction in the scenic area, divided into two layers. The ice waterfall inside the cave, the colorful ice inside, the peculiar calcite on the cave wall, and the living creatures inside - the red bats - are the five major attractions of the ice cave.

attractions.name: 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社(百年记忆公社)
attractions.name_en: Mission Hills Huayi Brothers Feng Xiaogang Movie Town
attractions.summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. attractions.name: 告庄西双景
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. attractions.name: 厦门科技馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Xiamen Science and Technology Museum is an advanced comprehensive science and technology museum in China, and it is also a popular parent-child tourist destination in China. It is known as "Science Disney". The Science and Technology Museum has five theme exhibition halls, about 400 interactive experience projects and three dynamic cinemas, attracting more than one million audiences every year.  
As soon as you walk into the preface hall, you can see the treasure of the Science and Technology Museum-the water clock, which is a water-powered timing device. Its design combines the pivot escapement mechanism invented by Su Song, a Xiamen scientist in the Northern Song Dynasty.  
A new adventure into the Discovery Hall is about to begin: indulge in the ever-changing cosmic galaxy in the time and space tunnel, an exhibit in online celebrity; Really experience a "angry crown" on the open magneto-electrical stage; Disoriented in an oversized maze of mirrors …. 
The moment you step into the Creation Museum, you feel like you have come to the future world-watching robots dance, playing chess with robots, and letting robots draw portraits of you... There is also a very popular world of light and shadow: a wonderful sea of colorful flowers, created with gestures. A different kind of fireworks fountain, discover a shadow world given "life"... 
From the beginning of entering the Harmony Pavilion, an experience space full of science and technology and futuristic sense will immediately appear in front of you. Through immersive human adventures, vivid and rich 3D animations to interesting and fun physical fitness tests, you can explore the secrets of the human body from cells.  
Come to the domestic "Intelligent Mecha" immersive experience space, and many domestic mecha interactive devices are exhibited for the first time. The secret world of the future time and space exceeds 1,000 square meters, and the future world is unfolded from this. Let's travel through time and space together and explore the unknown! In the quiet future forest, there are mecha jellyfish dancing their tentacles in the air, and flying wings with vast birds singing in the sky; The ugly "mecha dog", who has no head and slender limbs, is greeting you and performing a heel flip. 
When you come to the aquarium, you must prepare a curious heart and active brain, because there is not only an underwater world where you can use your imagination, but also a magical and interesting VR underwater adventure and AR surfing experience.  
Walking to the children's pavilion on the second floor is like opening a Pandora's treasure box, with endless fun inside: witness with your own eyes how the magic rain overcomes gravity and flows backwards from bottom to top, experience the pleasure of sliding from the big slide to the ocean ball pool, and watch the small ball kingdom. The ball climbs gears, suspends... each shows its unique stunts.  
In addition to five theme exhibition halls, there are three cinemas in the Science and Technology Museum. The dream theater that combines reality and reality, the 4D flying theater with a strong sense of story, and the 720Rider theater with a full sense of experience, you can not only see the beautiful special effects but also not miss the exciting experience during the movie watching process.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the fun of new technology

attractions.summary: Nanhu Park is the second largest urban park in China at present, second only to the Summer Palace in Beijing. It was called Huanglong Royal Park during the puppet Manchukuo period. Overlooking Nanhu Park from the air, you can clearly see its whole picture, which is shaped like a dumbbell, narrow from east to west and long from north to south. The lake in the park is clear, with green willows on the shore, curved bridges and pavilions, birds singing and flowers fragrant, and four distinct seasons, which is better than Jiangnan. If you stand on the Nanhu Bridge and look north against the railing, a colorful picture will appear in front of you, which looks like clusters of fluttering flowers blooming on the water. All kinds of bridge pavilions and pavilions are in charm with the lake and forest colors, which makes people linger.

The outdoor square of Changchun Theater is open to the public for free, and a unique welcoming interactive performance is held in the outdoor square before each performance. Passionate songs, dances, gongs, drums, community elderly Yangge teams, and other performances are performed one after another. attractions.name: 净月潭
attractions.summary: Jingyue Lake is a reservoir in the southeast suburb of Changchun City. It is named for its shape like a crescent moon. Large areas of trees are planted around Jingyue Lake, making it a very large forest park in Changchun. It is known as the sisters lake of Taiwan's "Sun Moon Lake". Come to Jingyuetan Forest Park, you can stroll along the edge of the pond, enjoy the lake and mountain scenery by the reservoir dam, or stroll along the wooden boardwalk in the forest, breathe pure air, and enjoy forest bathing. In addition, there are attractions such as Jingyuetan Ski Resort and Beiputuo Temple in the park. The northwest end of Lake Jingyuetan Forest Park by bicycle is the main entrance, which can be reached by taking a light rail or bus from the city center. The park is very large, and there is a road around the lake. If you walk the whole way, it may take a whole day and it is very tiring. You can take a tour bus (electric scooter) along West Huantan Road at the main entrance square, and the final destination is the ski resort. You can get off halfway. However, what is more effortless and interesting is riding a bicycle. It takes nearly two hours to cycle around the lake, and bicycles can be rented at the main entrance. The forest bathing area, Jingyuetan Park, has lush trees and fresh air, making it perfect for enjoying forest bathing. On the south bank of Jingyue Lake, there is a forest bathhouse where you can stroll and relax in the dense forest, breathing in the pure air. To the west of Jingyue Lake, there is a small forest bathhouse where you can bring food, picnic cloth, or even a tent for camping. There is also Jilin Northeast Tiger Park in the park, but it is an independent attraction where you can see animals such as Northeast tigers, African lions, brown bears, and spotted deer. Rowing boats on Jingyue Lake is a pleasant thing, with boat docks located next to dams, ski resorts, and forest baths. In winter, you can come to Jingyuetan Ski Resort for skiing. There are beginner, intermediate, and advanced ski slopes as well as off-road ski slopes here. In summer, you can also experience the ski resort's cable ski slopes, which means taking the cable car up the mountain first, and then taking the 1.6-kilometer-long tube track slide down the mountain through layers of forest, which is quite exciting. attractions.name_en: Museum of the Imperial Palace of the Manchukuo
attractions.tag: Exploration Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
attractions.summary:
· The Puppet Manchurian Imperial Palace Museum is established on the site of the former Puppet Manchurian Imperial Palace, where the last emperor, Aisin Gioro Puyi, resided as the puppet emperor of the Manchukuo state. It displays cultural relics such as the imperial car.  
· The palace is divided into the Outer Court for political activities and the Inner Court for daily life, which are now separately designated as the Manchukuo Palace Exhibition Hall and the Imperial Palace Exhibition Hall, with architectural landmarks including the Jixi Building, Zhonghe Gate, Huaiyuan Building, and Tongde Hall.  
· Part of the Imperial Palace has been designated as the Jilin Provincial Museum, showcasing historical materials of feudal dynasties established in Northeast China, such as Goguryeo, Balhae, Liao, and Jin.
attractions.shortFeatures: Puyi's Imperial Palace

attractions.summary:
- Changchun Botanical and Zoological Park, with its lush trees, rare birds and animals, exotic flowers and trees, and picturesque landscapes, offers a delightful environment that makes visitors linger. It is an excellent place for leisure, entertainment, and gatherings.
- The artificial lake divides the park into three natural areas: the eastern area features the Rare Birds and Animals Pavilion, which houses over 200 species of northern flora and fauna, known as a "miniature kingdom of nature"; the western area simulates the vertical distribution of plants with artificial soil mountains, and includes a miniature "Changbai Wilderness" scenic area; the northern part is home to the tropical botanical garden.
- The park is home to over 140 species of woody plants, including rare tree species such as the "Beauty Pine" native to Changbai Mountain, as well as plant viewing areas like the Flower Garden, Rose Garden, and Osmanthus Garden.
- From the high mountain in the western part of the park, visitors can enjoy a bird's-eye view of the entire park and the city center of Changchun.
attractions.shortFeatures: A Wildlife and Botanical Park with a Rich Variety of Entertainment Activities

attractions.summary: The Tuankou Zhong'an Radon Hot Spring Center has a construction area of 12000 square meters and is one of the largest hot spring centers in East China. It has a shared resting area for men and women, a Sino Italian massage area, a foot massage area, a movie screening hall, an indoor badminton court, a game console entertainment area, a chess and mahjong area, a table tennis and billiards room, and a children's game area. There is also an indoor pool where both men and women can take a bath together. There are over 40 hot spring pools in both indoor and outdoor hot spring areas, each with 25 different functions. The exploration of Tuankou Radon Hot Spring is designed with a well depth of 1500 meters, a water outlet temperature of 47 degrees Celsius, a daily water output of 3000 tons, and a heavy calcium carbonate type hot mineral spring.

The ski trails of the ski resort are more than 800 meters long and 60 meters wide. They are divided into elementary trails and intermediate trails, and the drop of the ski trails is about 250 meters. It is suitable for novices and novices to come here to ski smoothly. It also has a snow play area of 5,000 square meters, where you can experience the fun of snow. 
The snow quality in the snow resort is good and the temperature is pleasant. Besides skiing, snow friends can also enjoy the unique scenery of other famous scenic spots in the scenic spot.
