attractions.summary:
· Located on the banks of Huangpu River in Huangpu District, downtown Shanghai, it is one of the most symbolic attractions of Shanghai. 
· About 1.5 kilometers long, strolling from south to north, on the left hand side is the wide Zhongshan East First Road, with dozens of foreign buildings with different styles lined up along the roadside. 
Close to the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai, huge ships shuttle across the river, while skyscrapers such as Jinmao Tower and World Financial Center stand on the other side of the river. 
At night, neon lights shine on both sides of the Pujiang River, which is suitable for strolling on the Bund with your lover and feeling the charm and romance of the "city that never sleeps".
attractions.shortFeatures: Enjoy the architecture of all countries and the beautiful view of Pujiang River

attractions.name: 新天地
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Based on the unique old Shikumen building area in Shanghai, it is an urban tourist attraction with Shanghai's historical and cultural features and the integration of Chinese and western areas. 
It is divided into Beili and Nanli. Beili is composed of many old Shikumen houses, with many high-end consumption places and restaurants. 
Nanli is dominated by modern buildings, supplemented by old buildings in Shikumen, and has stationed in distinctive merchants, fashion stores loved by young people and other shopping shops. 
In addition to internationally renowned brand merchants, there are many new Asian designer brands, attracting many fashionistas at home and abroad.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fashion landmark in Shikumen

attractions.name: 浦江游览
attractions.summary: The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

attractions.name: 上海温室花园
attractions.summary: The Shanghai Greenhouse Garden is located in the center of the Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park, adjacent to the central lake and backed by the Twin Mountains. It covers an area of about 22000 square meters and has a total construction area of about 40000 square meters above and below ground. It is a multifunctional ecological complex that integrates sightseeing, leisure and entertainment. The exterior design combines historical memory and modern elements through the renovation and utilization of the old factory building of Shanggang No.3, forming a natural and elegant cloud like curve. The Shanghai Greenhouse Garden consists of four venues, including one tourist service center and three themed venues (namely Hall 1 Haishi Shazhou, Hall 2 Yunshang Forest, and Hall 3 Yunwu Canyon). The three main theme venues are classified and set up according to the habitat of plants, combined with the spatial structure of buildings, selecting typical ecological fragments from the world's ecosystem, and creating three environmental types: tropical drought, tropical wetland shade tolerance, and tropical wetland sun preference. They respectively display tropical drought plants, tropical rainforest plants, and tropical floral plants. In terms of display format, we strive to showcase the extension of plants to museums and culture, in order to create a beautiful and fun immersive exhibition greenhouse. In the future, high-tech means such as multimedia imaging, artistic lighting, and mobile interaction will be introduced to create a unique sci-fi and wonderful night tour experience. Stay tuned.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at  09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 上海自然博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
attractions.summary:
Shanghai Museum of Natural History is one of the largest natural history museums in China, with tens of thousands of specimens on display with rich contents. 
The museum has five floors and 10 permanent exhibitions, which are divided into three systems: natural evolution, living environment and human civilization. 
The most interesting thing is the skeleton of Mamenxi Dragon in China and Canada, which is about 26 meters long, which is the largest dinosaur in Asia and the longest neck in the world. 
· The Discovery Center is a favorite of children, and you can experience many activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit various animal and even dinosaur specimens

attractions.name: 豫园
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Gardens and Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."
attractions.shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden

attractions.name: 武康路
attractions.tag: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

attractions.name: 田子坊
attractions.summary:
· Evolved from Shikumen Lane, the most distinctive lane in Shanghai, located in Puxi, it can be called one of the petty bourgeoisie places. 
The name is the nickname given by the painter Huang Yongyu. Young people with personality and literature and art first come to Shanghai and feel the unique personality of Tianzifang. 
Walking in Tianzifang, detour through a maze of alleys, specialty shops and art workshops inadvertently jump into sight. Everything from teahouses, open-air restaurants, open-air cafes, galleries, home furnishings to handicrafts, and many well-known creative studios in Shanghai.
attractions.shortFeatures: Small alleys in Shanghai where literary shops gather

attractions.name: 思南路
attractions.summary: Some people say that Sinan Road is the "harem" of Huaihai Road, hidden behind the bustling streets, like a solitary lotus in the world, quiet and peaceful, narrating the history of old Shanghai and the stories of the past at a slow pace. Sinan Road is named after the French composer Jules in the early 20th century Masnan is a famous French road, a clean and romantic one-way street, and two rows of French wutong trees covering the sky, connecting Huaihai Road and Xujiahui. The garden villas on both sides of the road have different styles, English, French, and Spanish, reflecting their pre liberation identity. It is said that there are more than twenty garden style western-style houses on Sinan Road, which gather almost all the residential styles of old Shanghai - it is a living book of urban history. Walking here, it feels like returning to that hurried and chaotic era that still remains prosperous. Nowadays, Sinan Road not only preserves various former residences, but also the Sinan Mansion, which has been transformed into a hotel. Along the street, there are also some specialty small shops. You can have a cup of coffee at a caf é or go to the "Aniang Noodle Shop" to enjoy a bowl of authentic yellow croaker Aniang noodles for 20 yuan, and then visit antique shops to savor the unique history and romance of Shanghai in nostalgia.

attractions.name: 网师园
attractions.summary:
- Wangshi Garden is a representative example of a medium-sized classical Chinese garden, featuring traditional landscape and residential architecture. It was established during the Southern Song Dynasty.
- Initially named "Yuyin" (Fisherman's Retreat), it was renamed "Wangshi Garden" in 1765, reflecting the owner's intention to retreat into a life of seclusion.
- Despite the garden's many buildings, they are not crowded, and although the pond is less than one mu in size, it does not feel small. It can be considered a model of Chinese gardens where simplicity triumphs over complexity.
- From the main gate to the carriage hall, Wanjuantang, and Xiexiu Tower, the buildings unfold along the central axis. The main hall, Wanjuantang, is spacious with elegant decorations.
- In addition to understanding the layout's intricacies, another highlight of the garden is enjoying the traditional opera performances during the annual night garden events.
attractions.shortFeatures: The garden known for its delicate and intricate design.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 寒山寺
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.
attractions.shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 留园
attractions.tag: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 狮子林
attractions.summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
attractions.shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 虎丘山风景名胜区
attractions.summary: Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 同里古镇
attractions.tag: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.
attractions.shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.

attractions.name: 木渎古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Mudu Ancient Town, known as the "First Town of Wu" in the Wu region, is famous for its small bridges, flowing water, and ancient trees, offering a unique charm among many other ancient towns.  
· The town is crisscrossed by waterways such as the Muguang River, and its stone embankments create an ancient waterway landscape. The old streets and narrow alleys are home to many traditional courtyards.  
· Inside the Hongyin Mountain Villa, there is a grand stage where Emperor Qianlong watched performances during his six visits to Jiangnan. The villa also displays twenty imperial edicts from the emperor.  
· The town is a food lover's paradise, with the recommended Shijia Restaurant serving its signature dish, Fish Lung Soup, made by simmering fish liver in chicken broth. The fish liver is tender, and the soup is extremely delicious.  
· Local crafts in Mudu include silk, double-sided embroidery, redwood carvings, Chengni inkstones, calligraphy and paintings, and stone carvings, all available for purchase as souvenirs.
attractions.shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to explore the classical gardens.

attractions.name: 沧浪亭
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
attractions.summary:
It is the oldest garden in Suzhou and one of the four famous gardens in Suzhou. It was originally the pool pavilion of King Guangling of Wu Yue in the Five Dynasties. 
· Built by the water, the various window styles and bamboo in the garden are the biggest attractions. 
The biggest difference between the layout and other gardens in Suzhou lies in its transparency, and the rockery is integrated with the pool water outside the garden. 
The rockery in the garden is integrated with the pool water outside the garden, and the bamboo and wood are quiet, full of ancient meaning, natural harmony, which can be called clever conception.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classic gardens with rockery scenery
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 苏州博物馆
attractions.tag: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
attractions.summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.
attractions.shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden

attractions.name: 可园
attractions.summary:
Suzhou Keyuan, also known as Near Mountain Forest and Paradise, is located in Sanyuanfang (No.708 Renmin Road) in the south of Suzhou, just one lane away from Canglang Pavilion. Keyuan is a classical garden building built in the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms. The garden gate faces south, facing Canglang Pavilion across the water.  
In 1963, it was listed as a cultural relics protection unit in Suzhou. The existing area of the garden is 5,000 square meters, with a pool in the middle, sparse buildings, curved corridors, bright water and woods, and clear courtyards. It has been repaired several times over the decades.
attractions.shortFeatures: Classical gardens with twists and turns in history
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 耦园
attractions.summary:
Coupling Garden, formerly known as Sheyuan, is located in Xiaoxinqiao Lane, Cangjie, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province. It was built by Lu Jin, the magistrate of Baoning during the Shunzhi period of Qing Dynasty. It takes the meaning of "the garden is involved in the day to become interesting" in Tao Yuanming's "Return to Lai Xi Ci". Huangshi Rockery is the characteristic of Coupling Garden. This garden is named Coupling Garden because there is a garden on the east and west sides of the house. The north-south revetment wharf is one of the characteristics of the coupling garden, which shows the characteristics of "people sleep on the river" in Gusu. 
Coupling Garden is a national key cultural relics protection unit and has been listed as a World Cultural Heritage by UNESCO.
attractions.shortFeatures: A poetic garden that symbolizes the natural birth of a couple
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

restaurants.name_en: Scholarly Family Pingjiang Mansion Muxiang Chinese Restaurant

attractions.name: 老君山景区
attractions.summary: According to legend, Laojun Mountain Scenic Area is the place where the founder of Taoism, Li Er (Laozi), retired and practiced. During the Northern Wei Dynasty, a temple was built in the mountain to commemorate him, and later it was honored as a "famous mountain in the world". It has always been a place of strong incense. The trees in the mountains are lush, the scenery is picturesque, and mountain springs can be seen everywhere. In the golden autumn, this is the best choice for surrounding areas to enjoy the red leaves. After the rain, Laojun Mountain is surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland in the sky. The scenic area is vast, mainly divided into the central Laojun Mountain main scenic area, the Dream Chasing Valley scenic area in the west, and the Zhaigou scenic area in the east. Generally, tourists spend a day exploring the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, which is also a well-developed region of the entire scenic area. If you go to the mountaintop, there is still a chance to enjoy the beautiful sea of clouds, sunrise, and sunset. The main scenic area of Laojun Mountain includes major attractions such as Zhongtianmen, Jinding, Laojun Temple, Nantianmen, Yuhuangding, and Mazongling. Since its establishment in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Laojun Temple has been the center of worship for pilgrims from the Central Plains; The Taoist temple at the Jade Emperor's Peak enshrines the Jade Emperor, which is also a great place for mountain viewing; Jinding and Mazongling are great places to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds. Recommended itinerary: A one-day tour to explore the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain is the choice of most tourists. Roughly speaking, the route is as follows: Lingguan Hall - Laojun Statue at the foot of the mountain - Linqi Hall - Zhongtian Gate - Linyin Trail - Woyun Pine - Bodhisattva Hall - Laojun Temple, Jinding - Yuhuangding, and then return to the original route. Tourists can choose to visit Laojun Mountain on foot or by "walking+cableway" depending on their own situation. Between the Lingguan Hall at the foot of the mountain and the Zhongtian Gate on the mountainside, there is the Zhongling Cableway in the scenic area. Take the Zhongling Cableway and then walk from Zhongtianmen to the Jade Emperor Peak at the top of the mountain. The road from Zhongtianmen to the top is not very steep and usually takes about an hour to complete. If you have plenty of time, you can spend two days exploring Laojun Mountain. The approximate itinerary is as follows: D1： Visit the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain and stay overnight in the mountains. D2： From the top of Laojun Mountain, choose to descend from the Dream Chasing Valley in the west or the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, and reach the west and east gates of the scenic area respectively. In the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, accommodation is available near Zhongtianmen on the mountainside and Laojun Temple on the mountaintop. There are hotels near Zhongtianmen with good accommodation conditions, while the accommodation conditions around Laojun Temple are relatively poor. If you are planning to go to the mountaintop the next morning to watch the sunrise, then you can stay around the Laojun Temple. Compared to the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, the mountain roads in Chasing Dreams Valley are smoother, and tourists can choose one of them to descend according to their preferences. There are multiple places in the entire scenic area that can provide catering services for tourists, but some road signs in the scenic area are not yet very complete, so tourists need to pay more attention when playing. attractions.name: 龙门石窟
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Grottoes; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves in China, with a long history, the construction spanned multiple dynasties and lasted for over 500 years.
- Among the numerous caves carved during the Northern Wei period, the Ancient Yang Cave, the Central Cave of Binyang, the Lotus Cave, and the Cave Temple are the most representative.
- There are more than 97,000 Buddha statues in total, with the Western Mountain Caves being the most refined part, including the Luoshen Buddha statue and the "Twenty Images of Longmen."
- Among the key caves of the Tang Dynasty Longmen Grottoes, the grand and imposing group sculptures of the Great Luoshen Buddha are the most famous.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Caves of China
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

attractions.name: 关林庙
attractions.summary:
- Guān Lín is named after the burial of Guan Gong's head. It was originally built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period and expanded during the Qing Dynasty's Qianlong period. Today, it covers an area of 100 acres.  
- This is the only ancient classical building in China that combines a tomb, a temple, and a forest. The architecture follows the palace style and is characterized by a rigorous and grand layout.  
- The most distinctive feature of the ancient architectural complex is the Dance Tower. In addition, the area is filled with stone tablets, towering ancient cypress trees, and is renowned for its strong incense offerings.  
- Every year on September 29th, the Guanlin International Pilgrimage Ceremony is held here, during which overseas Guan Temple followers and clans gather to conduct a grand worship ceremony.
attractions.shortFeatures: The palace-style ancient temple dedicated to the worship of Lord Guan.

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城应天门遗址
attractions.name_en: The Ruins of Yingtian Gate, Sui-Tang Luoyang City
attractions.tag: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Historical ruins
attractions.summary: Ying Tian Gate was the main southern gate of Ziwei City, originally constructed in the first year of the Sui Dynasty's Daye era (605 AD). It was initially named Ze Tian Gate, but in the first year of the Shenlong era (705 AD), it was renamed Ying Tian Gate to avoid using Empress Wu Zetian's name. Later, it became known as the Five Phoenix Tower and endured through the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song Dynasty. Ying Tian Gate was an important venue for the imperial court to hold major state ceremonies and diplomatic events. These included significant occasions such as the Yuan Zheng (New Year's Day), the Winter Solstice, ceremonial music performances, banquets, amnesties, and the transition to a new year. During such events, including tributes from foreign envoys and dignitaries, the emperor would ascend the gate to listen to state affairs. Historical ceremonies such as Emperor Gaozong's capture of the Baekje king, Empress Wu Zetian's ascension to the throne, and Emperor Xuanzong's reception of Japan's eighth envoy to Tang China were all held on the Ying Tian Gate tower. Its function was similar to that of the Meridian Gate in modern Beijing. Ying Tian Gate was a massive architectural complex shaped like a "concave" character, consisting of a main gate tower, parapet walls, east and west watchtowers, and connecting corridors.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate the Sui and Tang ruins, savor the culture of the ancient capital.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城国家遗址公园天堂明堂景区
attractions.summary: The Sui and Tang Luoyang City National Heritage Park was once the core area of the palace ruins of the Sui, Tang, Five Dynasties, and Song dynasties, among which the famous ones were the Mingtang and Tiantang during the reign of Empress Wu Zetian. Mingtang is located on the axis of Luoyang city during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It is the main hall of the palace city and an important place for Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu Zetian to unify the world and govern the country. The prototype of the Tianfu Tu in the 2013 film "Detective Dee: The Empire of Heaven" directed by Tsui Hark is here. Heaven is the place where Empress Wu Zetian worshipped Buddhism. The building has five floors on the exterior and nine floors on the interior, symbolizing the supreme status of the emperor as the ruler of China. Tourists can take the elevator directly to the ninth floor, overlooking the panoramic view of Luoyang, and the night view is not to be missed. There are also large and small Buddha statues and murals on other floors, which can reveal the profound Buddhist culture. Full text 
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-21:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 隋唐洛阳城九洲池
attractions.summary: Today's Jiuzhouchi Site Park covers an area of 288 acres, including the Great Inner Dormitory area in the northwest of the palace city, a part of the Taoguang Garden in the north of the palace city, and the Jiuzhouchi Royal Garden in the north of the city west of the palace city. There are a total of 12 sites, which are protected and displayed through various scientific methods. We hope to use methods and forms such as displaying the original site of ancient ruins and simulating the ground to allow more people to understand the royal garden style during the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties. Jiuzhou Pool, as the imperial garden of Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang dynasties, was a real existence in history. According to the "Fangkao of the Two Capital Cities of Tang Dynasty", "Jiuzhou Pool has a curved pool with several islands in it, like Jiuzhou in the East China Sea. It covers an area of ten hectares, with a water depth of more than ten zhang, and is home to birds, fish, and flowers." In 1960, archaeologists discovered it while excavating Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The palace city area of Luoyang during the Sui and Tang dynasties was composed of a central core area and many surrounding small towns. Jiuzhou Pool is located in the northern part of Xige City on the west side of the Imperial Palace, accounting for about two fifths of Xige City. The scope of "ten hectares of residential land" recorded in the records is based on the Tang Dynasty's system of land cultivation. In the Tang Dynasty, one foot was about 29.5 centimeters and ten hectares were about 520000 square meters, which was larger than the entire western city. However, the actual archaeological measurement of the water area of Jiuzhou Lake is about 139250 square meters. Chinese classical garden art holds a pivotal position in traditional Chinese architecture. The forms of Chinese landscape gardens, represented by literati gardens and royal gardens, are aimed at pursuing the spiritual realm of nature, thus achieving the aesthetic pursuit of "although created by humans, as if opened by heaven", reflecting the cultural concept of "harmony between man and nature", which is completely consistent with the overall architectural concept of Luoyang City in the Sui and Tang dynasties. As a royal garden, Jiuzhou Pool not only embodies the combination of nature and culture, expressing the concept of harmonious unity between humans and nature, but also highlights the "ritual system" in traditional Chinese culture. Full text 

attractions.name: 洛阳博物馆
attractions.summary:
Luoyang Museum echoes the landmark buildings of the city such as the Pearl TV Tower of the Central Plains. The shape of the new museum is like a big tripod, which means "Dingding Luoyi". 
· The museum consists of a main building and an auxiliary building. The main building has two floors. The first floor is a general exhibition, and the second floor is a boutique exhibition of the museum. 
· There are more than 11,000 pieces of cultural relics on display in the new museum. Besides the local unearthed cultural relics, it also accepted a number of treasures allocated by the Palace Museum.
attractions.shortFeatures: Appreciate Rare Treasures and Taste Luoyang Ancient Capital Culture

attractions.name: 白马寺
attractions.summary:
- The first temple built by the government after Buddhism was introduced to China, it is known as the "First Ancient Temple of China."
- The existing relics at the White Horse Temple date back to the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, and are all aligned along the north-south central axis.
- The Mahavira Hall is the main hall of the entire temple, with other major buildings including the Hall of Heavenly Kings, the Great Buddha Hall, and the Pilu Pavilion.
- The temple preserves a large number of rare Yuan dynasty sculptures, including statues of the Three Buddhas, the Two Heavenly Generals, and the Eighteen Arhats.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Ancestral Grounds of Chinese Buddhism and the Tomb of Di Renjie

attractions.name: 丽景门景区
attractions.tag: Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Without arriving at Lijingmen, one would be wasting their time in Luoyang City. Lijingmen was first built in the Sui Dynasty and is the western gate of the ancient city of Luoyang, known as the "first gate of the ancient capital". The current Lijingmen Scenic Area was rebuilt on the original site of the Luoyang Municipal Government, consisting of parts such as the City Gate Tower, Wengcheng, Arrow Tower, City Wall, Lijingqiao, and moat. It is also the location of Luoyang Old Street. Tourists can come here to climb up and enjoy the scenery, taste local snacks, and learn about the ancient Heluo culture. New Year Bell ringing Activity: Every year on the occasion of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Lijingmen City Tower holds the "Welcoming the New Year at midnight Bell" activity. Tourists can personally climb up to the city and ring the 108 bells symbolizing the prosperity, auspiciousness, peace, and happiness of the new year, echoing the sound of the Ma Temple bell from afar.

attractions.name: 洛邑古城
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary: Luoyi Ancient City Scenic Spot is located in the old city of Luoyang City, Henan Province, and is known as the "Central Plains Ferry". Taking Wenfeng Pagoda, Confucian Temple, Tuoling Palace, Siyanjinghao and other protected sites in the park as nodes, and Xintan and moat system as links, the overall goal is to organically combine classical and modern buildings, so that old buildings and new buildings are not separated, which not only reflects the traditional cultural heritage of Luoyi Ancient City but also does not lose the modern flavor. The park is scientifically divided into functional areas, and the elegant demeanor of the Millennium Ancient City is concentrated. In the park, functional areas such as catering, tourism, accommodation, business services, etc. are dotted among them. The whole park has a strong cultural atmosphere step by step. It develops and inherits the original cultural landscape and cultural atmosphere of Luoyi Ancient City, making it a highlight of cultural relics protection, revival and inheritance of Luoyang traditional culture in Luoyang Ancient City. Relying on profound cultural heritage, Luoyi Ancient City allows the world to see the beauty of Chinese culture.
attractions.shortFeatures: Precipitated the ancient capital culture of thirteen dynasties

attractions.name: 洛阳隋唐大运河文化博物馆
attractions.name_en: Luoyang Sui-Tang Grand Canal Cultural Museum
attractions.summary: Luoyang Sui and Tang Grand Canal Museum, located in Luoyang City, Henan Province, was built on the basis of the national key cultural relics protection unit on the north bank of Luohe River-the ancient building Qunshan Shaanxi Guild Hall. In the exhibition hall, the relationship between Luoyang and the Grand Canal will be comprehensively described through various display methods such as physical objects, pictures and multimedia. Among them, the photo exhibition mainly includes four parts: the excavation of the Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the prosperity and function of the Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the relics of the canal, the protection and application of Luoyang section of the Sui and Tang Grand Canal. The physical exhibition mainly focuses on the cultural relics related to the Grand Canal excavated or collected in Luoyang area, such as the stone components of the riverbank of the Grand Canal, grain specimens containing Jiacang, and cellar models. The museum also plans to use high-tech means to display some typical canal cultural relics in front of the audience through holographic projection, so as to enhance visitors' intuitive feelings. The cultural relics displayed in this way mainly include celadon pots with deer patterns in Changsha Kiln, double-series porcelain notes in Yue Kiln and pots with lids with three-color pearl patterns.
attractions.shortFeatures: Built based on Luoyang Shanshan Guild Hall

attractions.name: 楚河汉街
attractions.summary: Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

attractions.name: 汉秀剧场
attractions.tag: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Featured performance; Theater; Live Show
attractions.summary:
"Hanxiu" means the essence of Han nationality, Chu-Han nationality and Wuhan culture. It is a stage program jointly created by Wanda Group and Frank Degong Entertainment Group, a top international stage art production company. Directed by Mr. Frank Degon, a world-renowned stage art master, it combines profound oriental cultural connotations with top western entertainment elements, cutting-edge technology and extreme performances that challenge physical fitness. 
Hanxiu Theater is located on the shore of the beautiful East Lake and Fruit Lake. The overall appearance design is inspired by the "red lantern", the essence of Chinese traditional culture. It has a novel shape and is particularly beautiful when lit at night. Hanxiu Theater is the world's first water show theater with moving/lifting seats, and it is also the world's first combined stage that can combine the plot to lift, move, tilt and scatter infinitely. It is assisted by dreamy lighting, three-dimensional special effects, gorgeous scenery and wavy curtain to present you with a 90-minute audio-visual feast.
attractions.shortFeatures: An audio-visual feast at the lakeside theatre

attractions.name: 户部巷
attractions.tag: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A century-old lane with a length of about 150 meters, the bustling breakfast stalls have lasted for 20 years, and many famous Wuhan snacks are gathered. 
Local snack brands in Wuhan, such as Shiji Regan Noodles, Chenji Beef Noodles, Xu Sister-in-law paste soup noodles, Li Tao Shaomai, Jinchu soup dumplings, Duohuzhai bean skin, etc., all started here. 
Hubu Lane is crowded at all times, so when eating in Hubu Lane, you should be psychologically prepared: first, you should not be afraid of crowding, and second, you should not be afraid of waiting in line for a seat.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the premature food culture in Wuhan

attractions.name: 黄鹤楼
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Historic Architecture; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The Yellow Crane Tower is located on the banks of the Wuchang side of the Yangtze River, next to the Yangtze River Bridge. It is renowned as "the First Tower in the World" and is one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan."

· It gained worldwide fame due to the poem "The former inhabitant has taken the yellow crane and left, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower behind," with poets such as Li Bai and Mao Zedong having written verses for the tower.

· Built on Snake Hill, the tower offers a panoramic view of the three towns of Wuhan and the Yangtze River from its rooftop. It is one of the city's landmarks, with an expansive view.

· The scenic area also features numerous stone tablets and carvings, all authentic works by famous historical figures, holding significant artistic value.

· Every day at 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00, there are Chu-style chime bell performances at the Luomei Pavilion, priced at 30 yuan per person.
attractions.shortFeatures: The Famous Towers of Jiangnan in Poetry and Verse

attractions.name: 武汉长江大桥
attractions.tag: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· The first road-rail dual-purpose bridge built on the Yangtze River after the founding of New China, with a total length of about 1,670 meters, is called "the first bridge on the Yangtze River". 
· The bridgeheads on both sides of the bridgehead were built with the support and help of the Soviet government. The whole bridge is full of Russian style. 
· The bridge adopts a two-story structure, with the upper floor being a highway, sidewalks on both sides and a railway on the lower floor. It is very convenient to get from the bridge to famous scenic spots such as the Yellow Crane Tower and the Memorial Hall of the Revolution of 1911. 
· Visit the bridge, which can be played together with the scenic spots near the bridgehead; You can also walk across the bridge and see the scenery of the three towns of Wuhan from the distance on the bridge deck.
attractions.shortFeatures: Russian-style landmark bridge

attractions.name: 昙华林
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
attractions.summary:
There are many coffee shops and specialty shops in the north of Wuchang Garden Mountain and south of Phoenix Mountain, starting from Zhongshan Road in the east and ending at Desheng Bridge in the west. 
There are dozens of century-old buildings concentrated in the 1,200-meter block, which is an old street gradually formed after the expansion of Wuchang City in 1371. 
The main scenic spots include Renji Hospital, Wenhua Academy, Foundling Hall Ten Thousand Baby Tomb, etc. Every brick and tile are engraved with the historical memory of old Wuhan. 
Various schools of buildings are built here, where Chinese and western cultures meet, and the wind and rain remain unchanged. It has now become a literary block in Wuhan.
attractions.shortFeatures: A place where literary youth get together

attractions.name: 武汉两江游览·夜游长江
attractions.name_en: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

attractions.name: 武汉园博园(武汉自然博物馆)
attractions.summary: Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. attractions.name: 武汉极地海洋公园
attractions.summary: Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

- Located in the northern part of Haikou, stretching 6 kilometers, the beach faces the boundless Qiongzhou Strait, with sailboats coming and going, creating a picturesque scene.  
- The beach consists of sunbathing areas, water sports zones, dining areas, and leisure sections, making it a comprehensive seaside tourism and leisure destination in Haikou.  
- The beach also features a dedicated barbecue area and a water park, which are lively and bustling with crowds throughout the day.  
- Nearby, there are yacht rental services and numerous luxury hotels to choose from, while strolling along the clean coastal avenue and enjoying the breeze is incredibly pleasant.

attractions.name: 观澜湖华谊冯小刚电影公社(百年记忆公社)
attractions.name_en: Mission Hills Huayi Brothers Feng Xiaogang Movie Town
attractions.summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. Full text 

attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.

attractions.name: 玄武湖景区
attractions.summary: Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

attractions.name: 颐和路公馆区
attractions.summary: There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

attractions.name: 南京总统府
attractions.summary: The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 
