attractions.name: 杨柳青古镇
attractions.tag: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
This famous historical town in northern China has a thousand-year-old cultural heritage. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, Yangliuqing was the distribution center of folk art in northern China, which gave birth to wonderful folk art works such as Yangliuqing New Year pictures, the first of the four woodcut New Year pictures in China, Yangliuqing kites and paper-cutting, which are well-known in Tianjin and Beijing. Ancient Painting Society is also the only folk art exhibition hall of New Year pictures in Yangliuqing, where visitors can appreciate the evolution of Yangliuqing New Year pictures, the treasures of Yangliuqing New Year pictures in past dynasties and experience the whole production process of traditional New Year pictures. 
The old theater, memorial archway and Wenchang Pavilion in the town, which are called the three treasures of Yangliuqing. Now only Wenchang Pavilion still exists; In addition, there are Puliang Pagoda, Baoen Temple and Baitan Temple sites in Qing Dynasty. There are also nearby scenic spots such as Shijia Courtyard, one of the "Eight Great Masters" in Tianjin, Tianjin Tropical Plant Sightseeing Park, a national 4A-level scenic spot, and the exhibition hall of the former site of Tianjin Front Command of Pingjin Campaign, a national scenic spot. 
After visiting Yangliuqing Town, you must try the siomai in Majiaguan.
attractions.shortFeatures: Famous historical towns in northern China

attractions.name: 石家大院
attractions.summary: The Shijia Courtyard is located in the center of Yangliuqing Town, a millennium old ancient town. It was originally the residence of Shi Yuanshi, one of the Eight Great Masters of Jinmen in the late Qing Dynasty. The house was named "Zunmei Hall" and is commonly known as the "Shijia Courtyard" by the public. The Shijia Mansion was first built in the early years of the Guangxu reign (1875). It is a large Qing Dynasty residential building with a history of over 140 years, covering an area of 7500 square meters and a building area of 3552 square meters. The entire building complex consists of 18 courtyards, with a typical four in one layout, courtyards within courtyards, clear axis lines, and grand and imposing style. Its brick, wood, and stone carvings are exquisitely lifelike and symbolize good luck, while the theater in the courtyard is a well preserved and large-scale enclosed residential theater in China. The Shijia Mansion was once known as the "First Residence in North China" and the "First Residence in Tianjin".

attractions.name: 杨柳青如意大街
attractions.summary: This is a bustling street filled with various small shops and stalls. There are many lanterns during festivals, which are suitable for taking children to explore. There are also many jewelry, gourds, ornaments, walnuts, handicrafts, etc. here. There is also a cultural center and the Shijia Courtyard nearby.

attractions.name: 古文化街
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.
attractions.shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine

attractions.name: 津门故里
attractions.summary: Located in Tianjin Ancient Culture Street, the memorial archway of the hometown of memorial archway is painted in the form of "smoke carving ink stone chasing jade". The words on the heart of the memorial archway are "the hometown of Tianjin" (facing south) and "sunny snow" (facing north). Jinmen "is another name for Tianjin," Hometown "means old place, and" Jinmen Hometown "is the old place of Tianjin Wei, which means the birthplace of Tianjin Wei. 'Qing' means good weather, while 'Xue' means' wash '; Qingxue "is the scenery just after snowfall, with a clear sky stretching thousands of miles and streets crowded with tourists. It metaphorically refers to a person's pure and innocent mood, as if washed away. Here, we offer incense to the Queen of Heaven and wish for a better future.

attractions.name: 狮子林桥
attractions.summary:
Lion Forest Bridge is located across the Haihe River, connecting the ancient culture street scenic spot and Wanghailou area. It is a landmark bridge on the Haihe River. 
Each of the lions on the bridge is different in shape, lively, black and white, and very cute.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the lions of various shapes on the bridge

attractions.name: 金汤桥会师公园
attractions.summary: Jintang Bridge is located on the Haihe River between the western end of Jianguo Road and Shuige Street, and is one of the earliest large iron bridges built in Tianjin. The name of the bridge, Jintang, means "as solid as Jintang". The bridge is 76.4 meters long, 10.5 meters wide, and covers an area of 8022 square meters. Jintang Bridge was first built in 1906 and is one of the earliest steel structure bridges in Tianjin and one of the few in China to have a three span swing type opening.

attractions.name: 天后宫（民俗博物馆）
attractions.summary: The Tianhou Temple, commonly known as the "Goddess Temple", is located in the ancient cultural street. It enshrines the "Sea God" Mazu and was first built in the Yuan Dynasty. It has a long history and is one of several Tianhou Temples around the world. Ancient buildings, rich folk exhibitions, and lively temple fairs are all attractions that attract tourists. The Tianhou Temple sits in the west and faces east. From east to west, it is composed of the theater, the streamer pole, the mountain gate, the memorial archway, the front hall, the main hall, the phoenix tail hall, the Sutra Pavilion, the Qisheng Temple, the Bell and Drum Tower, the Zhangxian Pavilion and four side halls. It is an existing ancient architectural complex in Tianjin. Nowadays, Tianhou Palace has become the location of Tianjin Folk Museum. In addition to preserving the restored display of the Tianhou Palace, the museum has also opened exhibitions based on showcasing Tianjin's folk customs, systematically introducing customs such as water transportation, marriage and childbearing, commerce, folk life, folk art, and folk beliefs. Every year on the 23rd day of the third lunar month, it is the birthday of Empress Dowager Tianhou. At that time, the entire ancient cultural street will hold an imperial fair (originally called the "Empress's Fair", named after Emperor Qianlong's visit to Jiangnan). Performances can be seen in the square in front of the Tianhou Palace, the south and north of the palace, including dragon lantern dance, lion dance, Shaolin Festival, stilts, drums, dry boats, yangko dance, martial arts, as well as Beijing Opera, Pingju, Bangzi, etc. It is one of the lively temple fairs in Tianjin.

attractions.name: 宝和轩相声茶楼(古文化街店)
attractions.name_en: Baohexuan Crosstalk Teahouse (Ancient Culture Street Store)
attractions.summary: Baohe Xuan Tea House, opened in the eleventh year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1885), is the earliest miscellaneous garden in Jinmen (renamed "Quyi" at the first National Cultural and Art Congress in July 1949), and is also known as one of the "Four Great Pavilions". Founder Zhang Fuxing and Meng Guanghui wrote the plaque. After nearly a century of changes and the baptism of the times. In 2022, Baohe Xuan Tea House will appear in front of the world with a brand new appearance. Preserving the historical relics of the teahouse and presenting them in front of the audience in conjunction with the transition to the new era. Baohe Xuan Tea House gathers renowned cross-talk performers from three age groups: old, middle-aged, and young. The performers combine traditional culture with new era content to perform. Speaking, learning, teasing, singing, and performing all kinds of things in the world, laughing, cursing, and joking are just for the sake of everyone's laughter. Baohexuan Tea House is located in a cultural town 50 meters away from the theater building on Jinmen Ancient Culture Street across the Haihe River. Welcome everyone to Baohe Xuan Cross Talk Tea House to experience authentic Tianjin style cross talk! Full text 

attractions.name: 海河游船
attractions.summary: Haihe Sightseeing Boat gathers the essence of Tianjin tourism. Along the way, you can not only feel the changes of Tianjin era, but also appreciate the modern buildings of modern cities. A Haihe River has summarized the history of Tianjin. As the saying goes, only with the Haihe River can there be the history and prosperity of Tianjin, and the prosperity of Haihe River leads to the prosperity of Tianjin. In the Haihe River sightseeing cruise route, what attracts people's attention are the distinctive bridges, which are the pride of Tianjin's urban style. The Yongle Bridge, which integrates with the huge Ferris wheel "Tianjin Eye", the Jiefang Bridge, one of Tianjin's iconic buildings, and the Lion Grove, which has a variety of stone lions. While getting close to these bridges by boat, taking the Haihe River cruise can also enjoy the "Nine Bridges and Thirteen Scenic Spots" along the Haihe River, such as the Dabeiyuan commercial area, the historic Tianjin Station, and the Italian style street that combines Chinese and Western styles.

attractions.name: 天津之眼摩天轮
attractions.summary: Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

attractions.name: 意大利风情区
attractions.summary: The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Full text 

attractions.name: 瓷房子
attractions.summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.
attractions.shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain

attractions.name: 张学良故居
attractions.summary:
Zhang Xueliang's Former Residence Museum, also known as Shaoshual's Mansion, lived here in the 1920s and 1930s. This building is luxurious, beautiful and generous, mainly in western Baroque style. The rooms are elegantly decorated, and the stairs, floors, doors and windows are all made of Philippine wood. 
Zhang Xueliang's former residence, which has been renovated for more than two years, reappears today. The music, decoration, clothing, furniture and characters here reappear the original appearance of the Zhang family's life in the French Concession in Tianjin.

attractions.name: 津沽旧事沉浸式剧情体验(赤峰道店)
attractions.name_en: jin gu jiu shi chen jin shi ju qing ti yan ( chi feng dao dian )
attractions.summary: Jincheng has been in its prime for a hundred years, and it's a dream that has been passed down through generations. In the old days, the nine rivers were unparalleled, and everything passed through the mist of condensed incense. Yuan Haowen, a poet from the Jin Dynasty, once exclaimed in his poem "First Arrival at Jinmen": "The flowers and moon in southern Beijing are unparalleled, and the bustling city of Jibei is the first." The immersive drama tour block of "Jingu Old Stories" condenses the century old Tianjin city, with a view of 1300 square meters of Jingu Old Stories Street. The performance revitalizes the dream of a hundred years and gives me an instant return to you. Welcome to the immersive drama tour block of "Jingu Old Stories". It is said that "5000 years of history can be seen in Xi'an, 1000 years of history can be seen in Beijing, and 100 years of history can be seen in Tianjin", which is half of Tianjin's modern history. Tianjin was named after Emperor Yongle of the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Di, who crossed the river during the "Jingnan Campaign" and established a "guard" in Tianjin to protect the army in Beijing. Therefore, Tianjin is also known as the "Tianjin Guard". For more than 400 years, countless nobles and high-ranking officials have used Tianjin as a place to settle in and out of the capital, making this city, which was once only a guardian of the capital, the economic center and political sub center of modern northern China. In 1860, Britain, France, and Russia forced the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Beijing, and Tianjin was forced to open a port, becoming an important base for foreign powers to dump goods, plunder raw materials, and export capital in China. There are over 3000 small western-style buildings in Tianjin, including more than 800 former residences of famous people. Fan Zhuzhai's former residence is one of them. It was one of the founders of Beiyang Cotton Mill and served as the fifth manager of the Hua Accounting Department of the French Oriental Credit Union Bank. It is also the former residence of Fan Zhuzhai, one of the eight major families in Tianjin. Based on the original appearance of the old residence, establish an immersive drama and tourism district called "Jingu Old Stories" to showcase and tell the story of Tianjin's century old commercial and social life. Let's travel back a hundred years to Tianjin in the 1920s. Here, you can see the former glory of the Imperial Palace Dance Hall, stroll around the Chamber of Commerce Club, visit the Fairy Palace Hair Salon, Hezhutang Pharmacy, Chunhe Theater... Give me a moment and give you back a hundred years!

attractions.name: 五大道
attractions.tag: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.

attractions.name: 新民园广场
attractions.summary: The newly built Tianjin Minyuan Square has a surface area of 22500 square meters and an underground area of 47500 square meters, continuing to retain the sports and fitness functions of the original Minyuan Sports Stadium. The square has added new functions such as tourism and leisure, cultural and museum exhibitions, and specialty catering, and has become the core scenic area and distribution center of the Five Avenues Cultural Tourism Zone together with the surrounding Qingwang Mansion, Xiannong Business and Tourism Area, and Minyuan Xili Cultural and Creative Block.

attractions.name: 静园
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
attractions.summary:
Jingyuan, which combines Spanish and Japanese styles, is a typical representative of courtyard-style private mansion in Tianjin Concession period. 
It used to be the residence of Lu Zongyu, the minister of Beiyang government in Japan. Later, the last emperor Puyi lived here with Queen Wanrong and Shu Fei Wenxiu. 
· The noise of the city center is blocked out, only bursts of birdsong, which is very leisurely and suitable for tourists who like history and architecture to meditate and travel slowly. 
Reed flowers bloom in late autumn (October-December) every year, which is an excellent season to watch reed flowers.
attractions.shortFeatures: The former residence of the last emperor Puyi

attractions.name: 泰达航母主题公园
attractions.tag: Parenting Treasure Spot; Playground; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
- A large military-themed park integrating eight major sections, including sightseeing, themed performances, and entertainment, based on the Soviet aircraft carrier "Kiev."
- The ship features dozens of attractions, such as the combat command center, intelligence room, aircraft carrier technology museum, history of naval ship development, sailor tilt room, and the Warrior's Corridor.
- Whether standing beside it or entering its interior, one can feel the overwhelming impact of the massive steel structure! It is perfect for military enthusiasts.
- The park also includes the World Aircraft Carrier Museum, weapon model exhibition, Expo Tianjin Pavilion, dock square, 4D cinema, and many other attractions.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the aircraft carrier to watch the combat performance.

attractions.name: 北塘古镇
attractions.summary:
--The newly-built ancient town, close to the mouth of the Three Rivers, consists of Fenghuang Street, Gujiu Lane, Seafood Boat, Double Base Fort, Xian Xu Buddhist College, Guanlan Academy, Xinglong Commercial Center and Chinese-style villa Germany. 
--It is mainly antique here, with simple and exquisite buildings such as white jade stone bridges, gray bricks and tiles, bucket arches and eaves, as well as antique calligraphy and painting, teahouses and other shops full of cultural heritage. 
--If you don't come on holidays, there will be fewer tourists here, so you can go out to sea by packing a boat, experience the fun of fishing, and have a big meal of seafood after your return.
attractions.shortFeatures: Tour the beautiful Shell Embankment

restaurants.name_en: Yanyu New Ancient Road Grilled Fish

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 深圳人才公园
attractions.shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

attractions.name: 仙湖植物园
attractions.tag: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
attractions.summary:
- To the east, it is bordered by Wutong Mountain, the highest peak in Shenzhen, and to the west, it adjoins Shenzhen Reservoir. The botanical garden integrates species conservation, research, science popularization, and tourism functions.
- The botanical garden is divided into six major scenic areas: Tian Shang Ren Jian (Heaven and Earth), Lake Area, Temple Area, Desert Plant Area, Fossil Forest Scenic Area, and Pine, Cypress, and Rhododendron Scenic Area.
- It features several unique garden attractions, including Bie You Dong Tian (Cave of Hidden Wonders), Liang Yi Pavilion, Yu Dai Bridge, Long Zun Tower, Ting Tao Pavilion, Lan Sheng Pavilion, and Die Gu You Lan (Butterfly Valley with Orchids), among others.
- The garden also houses a distinctive Paleontology Museum, unique garden architecture, and a mysterious plant kingdom, all of which are highly praised.
- Hongfa Temple is located here, known as the most effective temple, with a strong incense offering and frequent visits by locals who come to burn incense.
attractions.shortFeatures: Admire a variety of plants and visit Hongfa Temple.

attractions.name: 弘法寺
attractions.summary: Shenzhen Hongfa Temple is located in Shenzhen Xianhu Botanical Garden, backed by Wutong Mountain, the "green heart and lung" of Shenzhen, and facing Xianhu. The surrounding natural scenery is very beautiful. The temple was founded in 1985, with a short history, but its scale is second to none in the local area. On the first and fifteenth days of the lunar month, countless believers come to burn incense and worship Buddha. Walk about 2.2 kilometers from the entrance of Xianhu Botanical Garden, you can see the true appearance of Hongfa Temple. Along the way, there are green mountains and green hills, and the scenery is beautiful. There are Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Tibetan Sutra Building, etc. in the temple, with arches and cornices stacked on top of each other, which is very majestic.
attractions.shortFeatures: Temple scale is second to none in Shenzhen

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.
attractions.shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world

attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

restaurants.name_en: Hong Kong Jiu Kee Beef Brisket King

attractions.name: 山塘街
attractions.summary: The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

attractions.name: 拙政园
attractions.tag: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
attractions.summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
attractions.shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
attractions.opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

attractions.name: 平江路历史街区
attractions.summary: The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

attractions.name: 金鸡湖
attractions.tag: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.
attractions.shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.

attractions.name: 金鸡湖游船
attractions.summary: The Jinji Lake Cruise Project aims to view Jinji Lake from the water and take you to experience a different scenery. Looking eastward from the famous scenic spot of Huqiu Mountain in Wuzhong, one can see a blue wave shining with charming radiance in the sunshine. This is Jinji Lake located in the eastern part of Suzhou. Take a cruise ship and enjoy the unique scenery of Jinji Lake from the water. You will find that the blue waves of Jinji Lake shine with charming brilliance in the sunshine, very brilliant. Full text 

attractions.name: 甪直古镇
attractions.tag: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Lùzhí Ancient Town has a history of over 2,500 years. The town is crisscrossed by waterways, with numerous bridges, and is known for its "Hall of Five Lakes" and "Confluence of Six Marshes."  
· There are 41 ancient bridges in the town, each with unique and elegant designs. Among them, five pairs of bridges connected at right angles stand out and are truly remarkable.  
· The most notable attractions include the Baosheng Temple from the Tang Dynasty, as well as the Shen Residence, Xiao Fangfang Performing Arts Center, Wang Tao Memorial Hall, and the famous Wansheng Rice Mill.
attractions.shortFeatures: Visit the Wansheng Rice Shop in Ye Shengtao's Writings

attractions.name: 天定山旅游度假小镇
attractions.summary: Tiandingshan Tourist Resort Town is a comprehensive parent-child entertainment square, including dozens of landscapes and amusement projects such as Cute Pet Paradise, Deer Garden, Ring Road Roaming, Extreme Adventure, Rainbow Slide, etc. Tiandingshan Tourist Resort Town is committed to creating a beautiful leisure and rural tourism destination for young people to get close to the natural environment, experience agricultural activities, enjoy organic ecological cuisine, and live a healthy life.

attractions.name: 净月潭
attractions.summary: Jingyue Lake is a reservoir in the southeast suburb of Changchun City. It is named for its shape like a crescent moon. Large areas of trees are planted around Jingyue Lake, making it a very large forest park in Changchun. It is known as the sisters lake of Taiwan's "Sun Moon Lake". Come to Jingyuetan Forest Park, you can stroll along the edge of the pond, enjoy the lake and mountain scenery by the reservoir dam, or stroll along the wooden boardwalk in the forest, breathe pure air, and enjoy forest bathing. In addition, there are attractions such as Jingyuetan Ski Resort and Beiputuo Temple in the park. The northwest end of Lake Jingyuetan Forest Park by bicycle is the main entrance, which can be reached by taking a light rail or bus from the city center. The park is very large, and there is a road around the lake. If you walk the whole way, it may take a whole day and it is very tiring. You can take a tour bus (electric scooter) along West Huantan Road at the main entrance square, and the final destination is the ski resort. You can get off halfway. However, what is more effortless and interesting is riding a bicycle. It takes nearly two hours to cycle around the lake, and bicycles can be rented at the main entrance. The forest bathing area, Jingyuetan Park, has lush trees and fresh air, making it perfect for enjoying forest bathing. On the south bank of Jingyue Lake, there is a forest bathhouse where you can stroll and relax in the dense forest, breathing in the pure air. To the west of Jingyue Lake, there is a small forest bathhouse where you can bring food, picnic cloth, or even a tent for camping. There is also Jilin Northeast Tiger Park in the park, but it is an independent attraction where you can see animals such as Northeast tigers, African lions, brown bears, and spotted deer. Rowing boats on Jingyue Lake is a pleasant thing, with boat docks located next to dams, ski resorts, and forest baths. In winter, you can come to Jingyuetan Ski Resort for skiing. There are beginner, intermediate, and advanced ski slopes as well as off-road ski slopes here. In summer, you can also experience the ski resort's cable ski slopes, which means taking the cable car up the mountain first, and then taking the 1.6-kilometer-long tube track slide down the mountain through layers of forest, which is quite exciting. Full text 

attractions.name: 南头古城
attractions.tag: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
attractions.summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
attractions.shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress

attractions.name: 南头古城博物馆
attractions.summary: The Nantou Ancient City Museum showcases the urban history of Shenzhen in 1677, displaying over 300 cultural relics and narrating the city's history dating back to the sixth year of Xianhe in the Eastern Jin Dynasty (331 AD). The display is mainly divided into two parts: one is the indoor display, which comprehensively showcases the urban development history and resistance to foreign aggression of Shenzhen, with the historical changes and cultural history of Nantou Ancient City as the background. The second part showcases the ancient ruins area, ancient city area, and ancient buildings, with a large number of cultural relics and historical buildings, reflecting the prosperity and lively scene of the ancient city in the past.

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.
attractions.shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong

attractions.name: 大湾区一号(港珠澳大桥航线)
attractions.summary: This is a brand new sea route to check-in on the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge. It departs from Shekou Port and takes 180 minutes to cross the bottom of the bridge twice. Visitors can visit the Qingzhou Channel where a large cruise ship crosses the bridge, as well as beautiful attractions such as Lingding Island, the west artificial island of the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, and Shekou Homeport. In the past, when visiting the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, we needed to take a boat to Zhuhai, which is now within reach and very convenient. The important facilities of the No.1 cruise ship in the Greater Bay Area, China's first comprehensive bay area cruise ship, and China's first oil electric hybrid, luxury catamaran passenger ship, have all achieved "Made in China" cruise ships using innovative IoT networking technology, with features such as low noise and zero emissions, energy conservation and environmental protection, and technological innovation. Delivered for use in August 2020, the cruise ship integrates multiple functions, including a sightseeing area, exhibition area, atrium, technology store, multi-functional room, theater and other leisure and entertainment areas. The cruise ship is 72 meters long and 19 meters wide, with a maximum passenger capacity of 350 people. It has three spacious decks, with the top deck meeting the outdoor sightseeing needs of tourists. The upper deck has a sightseeing corridor for circumnavigation, the exhibition area has a cruise ship simulation driving teaching area, technology store and science classroom, restaurant and wine bar. The main deck has a theater for holding events, conferences, exhibitions, salons, etc. The main deck also has a luxurious private room that can accommodate 10-15 people for business banquets and small gatherings. The main deck also has a large restaurant that can be used for various banquet activities. The bottom cabin of the ship is also... There is a buffet room available to meet the dining needs of 150 people simultaneously.

attractions.name: 伶仃洋
attractions.summary: Lingding Bay, also known as Lingding Bay and the Pearl River Estuary, is a trumpet shaped estuary with a wide water area.

attractions.name: 内伶仃岛
attractions.summary: The Neilingding Island Futian Nature Reserve was established in October 1984, with a total area of approximately 921.64 hectares. It consists of two areas: Neilingding Island and Futian Mangrove Forest. Among them, Futian Mangrove is a nature reserve with a relatively small area of forest and wildlife types. Neilingding Island is located in the southwest of Shenzhen, about 9 kilometers northeast of Shekou. The area is 4.84 square kilometers. Due to living alone in the sea, it was named Lingdingshan, and later changed to distinguish it from Wailingding Island. The Neilingding Island Reserve is located in the east of the Neilingding Bay at the mouth of the the Pearl River, with a total area of about 554 hectares and Jianfeng Mountain at an altitude of 340.9 meters. The peaks of Neilingding Island are lush with green hills, surrounded by lush greenery, and the beautiful water flows endlessly. There are a wide variety of plant species, including 619 vascular plants, among which white cinnamon wood and wild lychee are the main protected plants in the country. Wild animal resources are also abundant, with the main protected species being the national second-class protected macaques, totaling over 900. In addition, there are also major protected animals such as otters, pangolins, black eared kites, pythons, and tiger frogs.

attractions.name: 地王观光·深港之窗
attractions.summary: The tourist destination for Diwang sightseeing refers to Diwang Building, a well-known landmark in Shenzhen with a total height of 383.95 meters and an actual building height of 324.8 meters. Climbing up to the 69th floor, you can overlook Hong Kong to the south and Shenzhen to the north. Diwang Sightseeing, also known as the Window of Shenzhen and Hong Kong, is a themed high-rise tourist attraction. Accompanied by melodious music, taking the elevator only takes fifty seconds to reach the top floor of the 69th floor of the Diwang Building. The scenic area features novel and exciting multidimensional dynamic movies, documentary digital overlay slides, and fifteen interesting landscapes. Standing at an altitude of over 300 meters, the winding Shenzhen River looks like a giant dragon waiting to take off, and like a gorgeous green ribbon tightly linking Shenzhen and Hong Kong. attractions.name: 中英街
attractions.summary:
The street, which is only about 4 meters wide, is the unique one street, two systems in the world, and the epitome of one country, two systems. 
Before the return of Hong Kong to the motherland in 1997, the east side of the street belonged to the Chinese side and the west side of the street belonged to the British side, so it was called Zhongying Street.  
· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.
attractions.shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨栈道
attractions.summary: Dameisha Waterfront Plank Road starts from Yantian Donggang District in the west and ends at Dameisha Waterfront Park in the east, with a total length of about 1km. There are hiking trails, trails, landscape platforms, trestles, stone arch bridges and other facilities along the way. Meandering on the steep shore of the mountain, below are jagged and mottled rocks. The rushing current surges and violently impacts the rocks, forming a magnificent landscape. On the wide platform, the experiencers enjoy the natural beauty by the sea and the wind.

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.
attractions.shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties

attractions.name: 深圳市大鹏新区古城博物馆
attractions.summary: The Dapeng Ancient City Museum is a thematic historical museum set up with Dapeng Ancient City as its theme. The museum collects and displays a large number of cultural relics, local customs, and humanistic historical materials, and each collection tells you the story of Dapeng City.

attractions.name: 较场尾
attractions.summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.
attractions.shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.tag: Climb a mountain; Seaside beach; Mountains; Seashores
attractions.summary:
· It is a hill near the sea. There are green hills, streams and seas here. The scenery is beautiful, and it is known as the most beautiful valley in Shenzhen. 
Because it is far away from the urban area and has not been developed too much, it is still a relatively original leisure place. 
Because of its unique romantic atmosphere, many couples in Shenzhen will choose this place as the location for wedding photos.
attractions.shortFeatures: Romantic coastal leisure belt

attractions.name: 鹿嘴山庄
attractions.summary: Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

restaurants.name_en: Haile Coffee Chinese and Western Restaurant

attractions.name: 广州塔
attractions.tag: Kid-friendly Treasure Spot; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The main body of the Canton Tower is 454 meters high, the antenna mast is 146 meters high, and the total height is 600 meters. It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The tower has a symmetrical top and bottom, a slender waist, and is also known as the "Little Waist." At night, it lights up, and even if you don't visit the tower, you can come here to photograph the exterior.
- Attractions include the Ferris wheel, the Pearl River photography viewing platform, the Spider-Man walkway, and others, most of which are focused on sightseeing and photography.
- Generally, you can reach the top of the TV tower around 4:30-5:00 PM to watch the sunset and night views.
attractions.shortFeatures: Landmark with dazzling night view

attractions.name: 海心桥
attractions.summary: To the north of the construction site of the the Pearl River Pedestrian Landscape Bridge is the island tip on the east side of Ersha Island, and to the south is the International Media Port. The width of the river is about 280 meters, with an upstream distance of about 500 meters from Guangzhou Bridge and a downstream distance of about 1.4 kilometers from Liede Bridge. The planned navigation net width at the bridge location is not less than 180 meters and the net height is 10 meters. The main bridge adopts a steel structure inclined arch bridge with a main span of 240 meters. The total length of the bridge deck on the east side is about 451 meters, and the total length of the main beam on the west side is about 296 meters. The pedestrian bridge has a total width of 20 meters in the middle span, with a width of 6 meters on the west side, 8 meters on the east side, and 6 meters on the middle staircase.

attractions.name: 珠江夜游广州塔财富码头
attractions.name_en: Pearl River Night Cruise Canton Tower Fortune Pier
attractions.summary: The Fortune Wharf of the Pearl River Tower is one of the embarkation points for the night tour of the Pearl River. It is located on the new central axis of Guangzhou city, facing the CBD of Pearl River New Town across the river and close to the Guangzhou Tower.

attractions.name: 陈家祠
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Memorial Temples; Historical Architectures
attractions.summary:
- Originally called the Chen Family Academy, it was built in the 14th year of the Guangxu era during the Qing Dynasty. It is the largest, most well-preserved, and most exquisitely decorated Qing Dynasty ancestral hall still existing in Guangdong.
- The main structure consists of five three-entry halls and nine halls across six courtyards, with the main axis running through the main gate, the Gathering of Talents Hall, and the rear hall. The entire complex is made up of 19 buildings, each of which is both independent and interconnected.
- Within the hall, visitors can still see exquisite architecture, with decorative elements such as wood carvings, stone carvings, brick carvings, clay sculptures, ceramic sculptures, and iron castings adorning both the interior and exterior of the ancestral hall.
attractions.shortFeatures: Architecturally exquisite late Qing ancestral hall

attractions.name: 永庆坊
attractions.summary: The saying "Dongshan young master, Xiguan young lady" is passed down among the people of Guangzhou, symbolizing Dongshan, the area of power, and Xiguan, the area of wealth. Together, they represent a microcosm of Guangzhou's historical and cultural heritage. Yongqingfang is located on Enning Road, a street with a history of over a hundred years. This area was once part of the old Xiguan district, rich in cultural relics and historical sites. After urban renovation, the area has preserved the charm of old Guangzhou's Xiguan while infusing modern commercial art. The transformed Yongqingfang features many hand-painted walls and unique artistic shops, such as the Post Office of Time, letterpress printing experiences, and trendy cafés, making it a perfect place for photography and sightseeing.
attractions.shortFeatures: The popular check-in spots for young people.

attractions.name: 荔湾湖公园
attractions.tag: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
The park was built in 1958, bounding Longjin West Road in the east, Xiguankou in the south, Huangsha Avenue in the west and Zhongshan 8th Road in the north, where a large number of lychees were planted. 
· The park is equipped with restaurants, teahouses, dance halls and various amusement facilities, making it a comprehensive park integrating sightseeing, cultural and sports, entertainment and rest. 
Liwan Lake Park is a lake-dominated park that can best reflect the elegant and soft style of southern China. 
· The lake occupies two-thirds. It consists of four lakes: Xiaocui Lake, Yucui Lake, Ruyi Lake and Wuxiu Lake. Visitors can take rental boats and water bikes for a tour.
attractions.shortFeatures: One of the eight scenic spots of Yangcheng; Experience the traditional customs of the Mid-Autumn Festival

attractions.name: 沙面
attractions.tag: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Shamian is an important commercial port in Guangzhou. After a hundred years, it was a key place for domestic and foreign trade during the Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. After the Opium War, it became a British and French concession 
The epitome of China's modern history and concession history, the European-style architecture on the island has formed a unique open-air architecture "museum". 
· The Catholic Church of Our Lady of Lude, the Church of Christ in Shamian, the Customs House, the British Snow Factory, HSBC Bank and other buildings are all unique. 
The island is like a small European town, with a high production rate of cafes, churches, restaurants and bars. It is a good choice to take photos here.
attractions.shortFeatures: European style architecture is perfect for taking pictures

attractions.name: 长隆野生动物世界
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Featuring large-scale wildlife stocking and self-driving viewing, Chimelong Wildlife World is the largest wildlife park in Asia. 
There are more than 500 kinds of rare animals represented by "Top Ten National Treasures of Rare Animals in the World", including the giant panda in China. 
There are thrilling large-scale white tiger performances, funny elephant performances, Huaguoshan Theater performances where Ming "apes" gather, etc. 
In the zoo, you can take a small train deep into the jungles and grasslands of Asia, and experience the excitement and pride of walking with animals.
attractions.shortFeatures: Where is Dad Going? Shooting location

attractions.name: 广州长隆国际大马戏
attractions.tag: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong International Circus has more than 300 circus elites from more than 20 countries, and more than 500 rare animals of more than 40 species performing on the same stage 
· It has the world's largest forest live stage layout, and you can see live forests, streams, boats, etc., which is absolutely refreshing 
· The performance is divided into several parts such as animal performance, float parade, acrobatics, etc. Cute and intelligent animals and awesome stage layout make it feel like being there 
· In addition, the theater strongly launched "Magic Legend II", which combines beauty, romance and fantasy to make the performance more legendary
attractions.shortFeatures: A gorgeous circus is staged on a super-large live stage

attractions.name: 长隆欢乐世界
attractions.summary: Chimelong Happy World has multiple large-scale amusement equipment, such as the Ten Ring Roller Coaster, Vertical Roller Coaster, Super Pendulum, etc., allowing you to experience exciting experiences with your friends. Chimelong Happy World has also undergone innovative upgrades in areas such as super entertainment, amusement facilities, and catering support services. We will focus on creating six new themed areas, two performance plazas, new floats and parade routes, and fully upgrading super dynamic amusement facilities, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience. Six themed areas, two performance plazas, and a brand new parade route. Chimelong Happy World is reshaping and creating six themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Rhythmic World, Happy Carnival, Star Dream Wonderland, Touching Space, and Scream Zone. Six themed areas will strengthen performance elements, introduce parent-child amusement projects, and further upgrade the visual experience. Happy World has created two major performing arts squares, named Super Performing Arts Square and Central Performing Arts Square respectively. The Super Performing Arts Square is a performance square within the park, with a new concept of mysterious main stage. The central stage of the square adopts a lifting design, which can be connected to the main stage. The center can create fountains, lights, flames, and other displays, and the performance content is even more explosive. The daily scheduled grand performance of "Super Electronic Music Party" presents international level cool electronic music on site, combined with advanced drones and low altitude fireworks performances, bringing visitors a stunning visual feast. In addition, the Central Performing Arts Square features a rocket roller coaster as the stage background and a newly created wave themed stage. Every day, the "Youth Hot Dance Music Party" is held regularly, with cute girl group performances, passionate rock bands, and trendy street dance, allowing you to experience a different kind of entertainment heat wave. The all-new large-scale themed performance "Joyful and Colorful Parade" is coming, with a new tour route surrounding Chimelong Happy World. The parade starts from the Super Performing Arts Square and ends at the starting point, with a total length of 1.6 kilometers and a road width of no less than 8 meters. The new float display has undergone a major upgrade in appearance, with a super large float that can reach a height of 10 meters. It features a large aerial insect device and an animal float formation, making it fun, dynamic, and highly interactive. The "Joyful and Colorful Parade" will continue until August, and the second phase of the super themed parade will follow. More than ten giant themed floats from France, with strange mythical animal shapes and immersive experiences, will bring you the scene of coming to a foreign land. The entire parade features a pioneering track without railings, using ground spotlights to create a safe distance for visitors, achieving true zero distance and enhancing their comfortable viewing experience. At the same time, 8-10 interactive small stages have been set up around the parade route, with more comprehensive scenes and richer content. The performances are uninterrupted throughout the day, and visitors can experience exciting performances at any time when entering the park. Meanwhile, Chimelong Happy World has added three new iconic areas: Circus Town, Cookie Factory, and Time Castle. The circus town is themed around colorful circus elements, featuring pink trains, winding mazes, and clown hat circus shacks; Taking the production line as the story, climbing through curved checkpoints, every time passing through a checkpoint, it feels like completing a process. The cookie factory produces exclusive cookies; The time castle is composed of colorful slides and bouncing balls, allowing time to pass and happy childhood. Three different styles of air modeling play areas, I believe that children entering the colorful world will be unforgettable. There are dozens of fun activities suitable for parent-child play in Chimelong Happy World, such as the Thunderbolt Chair and Swing House at the Happy Carnival, allowing both adults and children to immerse themselves in joyful moments. Xinghui Food Plaza offers a wide range of delicacies from around the world, with fully upgraded services. Chimelong Happy World has launched a new Coconut Grove Restaurant Food Plaza, which adopts European style architecture and features three main restaurants serving Cantonese, Western, and Southeast Asian cuisine, catering to different tourist needs and with a larger capacity. Xinghui Food Plaza fully uses french window, which is one of the sightseeing spots in the park. While enjoying the food, you can also watch the parade and the surrounding interactive performances, with a comfortable environment and a different experience. At the same time, all major restaurants in the park have comprehensively improved their food offerings, making them more delicious and comfortable. Full text 

attractions.name: 长隆飞鸟乐园
attractions.tag: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
attractions.summary:
· Chimelong Bird Paradise is a large-scale natural ecological wetland park, home to tens of thousands of national rare birds such as red-crowned cranes, flamingos and black swans.  
The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.
attractions.shortFeatures: Intimate encounters with tens of thousands of rare birds

attractions.name: 香港迪士尼乐园
attractions.tag: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
attractions.summary:
· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle).

· Definitely a dream place for children and families to travel.

attractions.summary:
· Blurred Manor is a unique theme park in Hong Kong Disneyland, which opened on May 17th, 2013. The main amusement facility in the area is Blurred Mansion. 
· The story tells the story of a British explorer who is also an adventurer. Sir Henry, a member of the Explorers Institute, set up a mansion in the tropical rainforest and turned the basement into a museum for guests to visit. Different collections are displayed in the museum. 
· "Blurred Manor" is also known as one of the most complex amusement facilities in Disney history, and it is also the last project in the existing expansion plan of Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors will experience an audio-visual feast with sound, smell and somatosensory here.

attractions.name: 八一起义纪念馆
attractions.name_en: The Memorial Hall of the August 1st Uprising
attractions.summary:
The building, which has a silver-gray exterior and faces south with a northward orientation, is a four-story courtyard-style structure. Originally known as the Jiangxi Grand Hotel, it was first built in 1922 and completed in 1924. The building adopts a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, with cement reliefs in Western style decorating the doors and windows. Inside the building, there is a large courtyard containing four fireproof water vats, showcasing the unique layout of traditional Chinese architecture.

At 2 a.m. on August 1, 1927, a gunshot rang out, marking the beginning of the August First Nanchang Uprising, which shocked both China and the world. Led by Zhou Enlai, Secretary of the Front Committee of the Communist Party, He Long, the general commander of the uprising, Ye Ting, the front commander, Zhu De, the head of the Third Army's officer training regiment, and Liu Bocheng, the chief of the military staff, over 20,000 troops launched the first armed resistance against the reactionary Kuomintang forces. This event marked the beginning of the Chinese Communist Party's independent leadership of revolutionary armed struggle and the birth of the people's army. To commemorate this great event, in 1956, the People's Government established the Nanchang August First Uprising Memorial Museum at the site of the former headquarters.

attractions.name: 滕王阁
attractions.tag: English: Treasure spots for strolling with kids; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
attractions.summary:
- The Tengwang Pavilion stands by the Ganjiang River and is famous for Wang Bo's "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion," being one of the "Three Famous Towers of Jiangnan" and a landmark of Nanchang.
- The scenic area mainly consists of the main pavilion of Tengwang Pavilion and small gardens on the north and south sides. The main activity here is to climb the tower for a distant view.
- It has 9 floors, with the 5th floor being the best for sightseeing and representing the essence of the entire pavilion. The bronze plaque carving of the "Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion" on the central hall wall is the work of Su Shi.
- The 6th floor features an ancient-style theater, where there is usually a costume performance every hour, and it is also the highest floor for visitors to explore.
attractions.opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:00; admission ends at 21:00)

attractions.name: 滕王阁游轮
attractions.summary: Tengwang Pavilion, located by the city and facing the river, is known as the "first tower of the Xijiang River". For thousands of years, people have been intoxicated by the beautiful scenery of the Gan River, where "the sunset and solitary geese fly together, and the autumn water flows in the same color as the sky". In recent years, Nanchang City has built two cities in the north and south with the Gan River as the main axis. "One River, Two Banks" is not only a landmark landscape of modern Nanchang, but also an indispensable landscape element for visiting the Gan River. In order to further enhance the image of Nanchang as a historical and cultural city in China, meet the development needs of Nanchang as a tourist city, and facilitate the general public and domestic and foreign tourists to appreciate the charming scenery of Nanchang such as "famous city, famous river, famous building, famous scenery", greatly improve the quality of tourists' sightseeing, and enrich the content of tourists' sightseeing. The LED walls of 296 high-rise buildings along the Yangtze River form a giant screen, setting a Guinness record. Every night at 8:30, a spectacular light show is staged, taking you to experience the charm of Nanchang. Southeast Huaguang. The Tengwang Pavilion Cruise is a wonderful platform to enjoy the night view of the Gan River, with 360 degree sightseeing without any blind spots. The Tengwang Pavilion on the east bank is quaint and magnificent, and the Honggu Beach on the west bank is fashionable and beautiful. The two sides of the Taiwan Strait shine brightly and are in the same lineage. The "Tengwang Pavilion" cruise ship, with a length of 36 meters and a width of 10 meters, is a twin body three story sightseeing cruise ship. It is fast, convenient, with beautiful lines, safe and reliable. It is an environmentally friendly, luxurious and pioneering cruise ship with a new style. The layout of this cruise ship is scientifically reasonable, and the cabin space design is highly humanized, integrating the spatial design concepts of business clubs and high-end fashionable cruise ships. It represents the development direction of China's catamaran cruise ships and is known as the "Rolls Royce" of water tourism. It is currently the cruise ship with excellent software and hardware on the Gan River. Full text 
